Design a strong-coupling antenna system using two closely-spaced Janus antennas
Experimentally demonstrate the proposed antennas and systems

11204522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204522.value: The proliferation of 5G, IoT and other massive wireless networks is made possible in part through the use of a large number of antennas which often work in close proximity to one another. For example, in a multiple input multiple output (MIMO) antenna system, multiple antennas work together to increase the channel capacity and enable the rapid transfer of a large amount of data. However, the close-packing of antennas leads to significant mutual coupling (electromagnetic cross-talk among antennas), which degrades the communication capacity. Minimizing mutual coupling among closely-spaced antennas can enhance the performance of MIMO antenna systems and make them more compact. In another application scenario, many wireless power transfer (WPT) systems transmit power wirelessly among two or more antennas and/or resonators which are electrically close to each other. Here, maximizing the coupling between the transmit and receive antennas will improve the system’s power efficiency and eliminate unwanted power leakage. These important applications showcase the attractiveness in controlling the electromagnetic coupling of closely-spaced antennas and electromagnetic structures. Where the Huygens’ source and related antennas have contributed significantly to far-field directionality, the strongly related Janus source has been recently reported to achieve an analogous near-field directionality. However, an active Janus source is yet to be proposed, and its usage in practical applications remains largely unexplored. The proposed research project fills this research gap. We will investigate the electromagnetic near-fields of the ideal Janus source and clarify the nature of its near-field directionality. We will then proceed to design and demonstrate a Janus antenna – an antenna that implements an active Janus source. Finally, we will use our Janus antenna to demonstrate the direction-controlled suppression and enhancement of mutual coupling among closely-spaced antennas. Our preliminary simulation results have shown, in a 2D environment, the creation of an active Janus source and strong mutual coupling suppression for closely-spaced Janus sources. These results strongly indicate that similar achievements are possible in a 3D environment. The research team, consisting of experts in metasurface and antenna design and, notably, the inventor of the magneto-electric dipole, is strongly suited for the proposed project. We expect this project will lead to pioneering demonstrations of the Janus antenna and their usage in direction-controlled near-field coupling suppression and enhancement. These contributions represent exciting academic achievements and will open doors to strong potential applications in MIMO systems, antenna beamforming arrays and WPT systems. 5G、物聯網和其他大規模無線網絡的普及是通過使用大量相互靠近的天線來實現的。例如，在多輸入多輸出 (MIMO) 天線系統中，多個天線協同工作以增加信道容量並實現大量數據的快速傳輸。然而，天線的緊密封裝會導致顯著的相互耦合（天線之間的電磁串擾），從而降低通信容量。消除緊密間隔的天線之間的相互耦合可以提高 MIMO 天線系統的性能並使其更加小巧。另外，許多無線電力傳輸（WPT）系統在彼此接近的兩個或多個天線或諧振器之間無線傳輸電力。在這種場景中，提升發射和接收天線之間的耦合將提高系統的效率並消除不必要的功率洩漏。這些重要的應用展示了：控制緊密間隔的天線和電磁結構的電磁耦合非常重要，并且極具應用潛力。 正如在惠更斯源和相關的天線對遠場方向性有著重大貢獻，近期學術文獻指出跟其有緊密相關的Janus 源能實現類似的近場方向性。然而，有源的Janus源尚未被提出，其實際應用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究項目填補了這一研究空白。我們將研究理想 Janus 源的電磁近場，並闡明其近場的方向性。然後，我們將繼續設計和演示 Janus 天線——一種實現有源 Janus 源的天線。最後，我們將使用我們的 Janus 天線來演示緊密間隔天線之間的方向控制和相互耦合的削弱或增強。我們的初步模擬結果表明，在二維環境中，我們創建了一個有源的 Janus 源，并且演示了緊密間隔Janus天線之間的相互耦合被削弱。這些結果強烈表明，在 三維 環境中也可以取得類似的結果。 我們的研究團隊由超表面和天線設計方面的專家組成，尤其包含磁電偶極子的發明者，因此非常適合擬議的項目。我們預計該項目將開創性地提出 Janus 天線及其在方向控制、近場耦合削弱和增強中的使用。這些貢獻代表了令人興奮的學術成就，並將為 MIMO 系統、天線波束賦形陣列和 WPT 系統開創具備强大應用潛力的新科技。

11204722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11204722.value: 在都市環境中應對低小無人機的威脅

11204722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11204722.value: Low and small (LS) drones are posing a pressing threat as they become increasingly accessible to reckless and malicious users through the commercial market. As the most widely used drone countermeasure, radio frequency (RF) jamming can disable drones' flight control by blocking their on-board pilot radios and RF sensors, therefore thwarting them from intruding into security and safety critical areas. However, existing drone jamming systems struggle to handle LS drones due to two key challenges. First, it is difficult to detect small drones and differentiate them from similar objects like birds under practical sensor resolution constraints. Second, it is highly challenging to reliably track and jam drones in complex low altitude airspace, especially for metropolis like Hong Kong where crowded buildings cause significant sensor clutters.. This project will develop a system called iHawk to tackle the threat of small drones in the low-altitude airspace over metropolises. We will develop a set of novel sensing and beamforming algorithms and systems based on the methodology of deeply fusing computer vision, radar, and array signal processing, enabling accurate detection of small drones under practical sensor resolution constraints, and reliable and efficient jamming against drones in complex low altitude airspace over metropolises. Motivated by the increasing deployments of smart lampposts as a key smart city infrastructure, we will further extend iHawk to harness the diverse sensing perspectives and distributed beamforming capabilities of smart lampposts to greatly improve the detection and jamming performance. The algorithms and systems will not only shed light on the design of countermeasure against next-generation fully autonomous drones, but also make an impact on a wide range of important Internet-of-Things applications that face similar challenges to that of LS drone detection and jamming, such as wireless localization, beamforming in vehicular networks, and environment monitoring in smart cities. 隨著無人機商用市場的迅速繁榮，違規或惡意得飛行低小無人機已構成對公共安全的一種緊迫威脅。作為最廣泛使用的無人機對抗措施，射頻干擾可以通過癱瘓無人機的遠程控制模塊和機載傳感系統來阻止它們侵入安全攸關區域。然而，由於兩個關鍵挑戰，現有的射頻干擾系統難以有效地處理低小無人機。首先，在實際傳感器分辨率的限制下，很難準確偵測小型無人機並將它們與鳥類等類似物體區分開來。其次，在低空環境中很難可靠地跟踪無人機，特別是在像香港這樣的都市環境中，擁擠的建築和複雜的地理環境會帶來大量的雜波，從而導致追蹤無人機的傳感器無法有效工作。該項目將開發一個名為 iHawk 的系統以在都市環境中應對低小無人機的威脅。基於計算機視覺、雷達和陣列信號處理的深度融合，我們將設計、實現並驗證一套新穎的感知和波束成形算法和系統，實現在實際傳感器分辨率約束下對低小無人機的準確檢測以及可靠和高效干擾。有鑑於智能燈柱近年來作為智慧城市的重要基礎設施得到廣泛部署，我們將擴展 iHawk 以利用智能燈柱的多樣化傳感視角和分佈式波束成形能力來進一步提高檢測和乾擾性能。該項目不僅為反制下一代全自動無人機的技術提供借鑒，同時也將啟發與對抗低小無人機面臨相似挑戰的其他物聯網應用，例如無線定位、車載網絡中的波束成形，以及智能城市中的環境監測。

11205222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205222.value: 電容耦合作為未來無線傳輸技術的建模與設計

11205222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205222.value: Existing mature wireless power transfer (WPT) technology is based on near-field inductive power transfer (IPT) that uses magnetic coupling for power transfer. There are known drawbacks of IPT, however, such as the use of ferrite material for coupling enhancement which increases cost and reduces power density. IPT also necessitates detecting metal objects that compromise safety and incur losses. The current technology is awaiting breakthrough that raises the power capacity and efficiency substantially, and we hope to be the key driver of this important technological transition. Capacitive power transfer (CPT), which utilizes high-frequency alternating electric fields, does not cause significant temperature rise in nearby metal objects. The directed nature of electric fields permits CPT to work without using supplementary material for flux guidance. Coupling capacitors are just metal plates, leading to low complexity and cost. Moreover, without cores, the operating frequency is limited essentially by the drive circuits as air-gap loss is negligible, thus permitting high-frequency operation and high power density. Furthermore, CPT has comparable or higher efficiency than IPT for applications of small gaps and similar power levels. The lower coupler-to-gap-volume ratio makes CPT an attractive solution for space-limited applications. There are some critical challenges of CPT that need to be overcome. First, existing models of CPT systems are unsatisfactory for various practical scenarios because parasitic capacitances can be comparable in magnitude to the coupling capacitance, leading to unrealistic estimation of power transfer capability and efficiency. Another key problem is the weak coupling of the capacitor pairs, limiting the power level and mandating a very short transfer distance. Existing solutions addressing the limited coupling voltage and increasing the operating frequency have resorted to specific compensation circuits, but there is no effective general design framework. Our first objective is therefore to establish a unified circuit model that includes parasitic capacitances formed with the surroundings and facilitates calculation of operating conditions for stable and parameter-insensitive power transfer. The model should be accurate in terms of power transfer characteristics, patterns of load variation, and parasitic capacitances of surroundings. The second objective is a performance evaluation framework based on the model developed above. This task involves extensive analysis of design assessment criteria. The third objective is to produce a complete circuit synthesis and design methodology for capacitive coupler structures and compensation circuits that cover key performance aspects including power level, transfer distance, tolerance to misalignments, and practical constraints such as size, weight and cost. 本項目針對電容耦（CPT）合作為未來無線傳輸技術的建模與設計進行研究。CPT 有一些關鍵的挑戰需要克服。首先，由於寄生電容的大小近乎耦合電容，現有的 CPT 系統模型在各種實際情況下都不能令人滿意，導致對功率傳輸能力和效率的估計不切實際。另一個關鍵問題是電容耦合器的弱耦合，限制了功率水平和傳輸距離。現有解決有限耦合電壓和提高工作頻率的解決方案都是基於特定的補償電路，並沒有有效的通用設計框架。因此，我們的第一個目標是建立統一的電路模型，其中包括與周圍環境形成的寄生電容，有助制訂穩定和參數不敏感的功率傳輸的運行條件。該模型在估算功率傳輸特性、負載變化模式和環境寄生電容是準確的。第二個目標是基於上述模型而建立的績效評估框架，這項任務涉及對設計評估標準的廣泛分析。第三個目標是為電容耦合器結構和補償電路提供完整的電路綜合和設計方法，涵蓋關鍵性能方面，包括功率水平、傳輸距離、錯位容限以及尺寸、重量和成本等實際限制。

11205822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11205822.value: 一個能適應不同領域、受血管中心線導向的雙支網絡在三圍超聲頸動脈血管壁和斑塊分割和測量的應用

11205822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11205822.value: Dr Azarpazhooh, M. Reza Prof Chiu, Bernard Chi Yuen Prof Spence, John David

11205822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11205822.value: Identification of patients with high stroke risk is important as dietary and medical intervention can reduce their stroke risk significantly. Our group pioneered the use of three-dimensional ultrasound (3DUS) carotid plaque and vessel wall measurements in risk stratification and sensitive treatment monitoring. However, the requirement of manual plaque and vessel wall segmentation limits the clinical utility of 3DUS techniques, as manual segmentation is time-consuming and prone to observer variability. We therefore propose to develop a fully automated approach to vessel wall and plaque segmentation based on machine learning. Most existing automated vessel wall segmentation techniques delineate only the common but not the internal carotid artery (CCA and ICA, respectively). ICA segmentation is important for accurate risk stratification as plaques are more prevalent in ICA than CCA. Besides, these algorithms require users to provide seed points or a region-of-interest (ROI) for initialization, which is time-consuming even for a medium-scale study of ~300 patients. Therefore, there is a need to develop efficient algorithms for vessel wall and plaque segmentation at the CCA and ICA. The central hypothesis of our approach is that knowledge of the artery centerline will enable a neural network to focus on the artery without the need for manual ROI definition. But, because centerline extraction is itself a difficult problem, we propose to introduce a neural network capable of generating a “centerline heatmap” that indicates high probability regions for the centerline location. The heatmap can then be combined with the 3DUS image in a dual-stream centerline-guided segmentation network that is fully automated. We will also develop an adversarial network to tune the segmentation network trained in images acquired in one patient cohort to a different cohort (target cohort), which has a different level of disease burden, without manual segmentation in the target cohort. Plaque volume and texture measured from manual segmentation were shown to predict cardiovascular events in the target cohort consisting of ~300 patients. Besides evaluating segmentation accuracy, we will compare the event predicting ability of plaque volume and texture measured from automated segmentation with the corresponding measurements from manual segmentation. The proposed framework will improve the clinical utility of 3DUS carotid measurements in multi-center trials and in clinical practice. The adversarial network allows calibration for differences in 3DUS scanning parameters and patient characteristics. The domain adaption ability of the framework will especially benefit medical clinics with less availability of expertise in 3DUS interpretation. 中風高風險人群的識別具有重要的臨床意義，可通過飲食和醫療干預顯著減少其中風的風險。我們小組開創性地使用三維超聲（three-dimensional ultrasound, 3DUS）頸動脈斑塊和血管壁測量進行風險分級和靈敏的療效監測。然而，該技術需要對斑塊和血管壁進行手動分割，這一過程耗時且易出現觀察者差異，無疑限制了3DUS技術的臨床實用性。因此，我們旨在開發一種基於機器學習的全自動血管壁和斑塊分割方法。 大多數現有的自動血管壁分割技術只針對頸總動脈（common carotid artery, CCA），卻忽略了頸內動脈（internal carotid artery, ICA）。由於斑塊在ICA中的分佈比CCA中更為普遍，ICA的分割對於精確的風險分級十分重要。除此之外，這些演算法需要使用者提供種子點或感興趣區域 (region-of- interest, ROI) 進行初始化，即便是對大約 300 名患者參與的中等規模研究而言也很耗時。因此，需要開發更為高效的演算法用於CCA和ICA的血管壁和斑塊分割。 我們方法的核心假設是，動脈中心線能使神經網路專注於動脈，從而無需手動定義ROI。但中心線的提取本身也是一個難題，對此我們計畫引入一個用於生成“中心線熱圖”的神經網路，該熱圖將指示中心線位置的高概率區域。之後通過全自動中心線引導的雙流分割網路將熱圖與三維超聲圖像進行組合。 我們還將開發一個對抗網路用於調整上述分割網路，從而使由一組患者圖像訓練出的分割網路可用於另一組不同疾病程度且沒有手動分割標籤的患者圖像（目標圖像）。在約300名患者的目標圖像中，基於手動分割測量的斑塊體積和紋理資訊可以用於預測心血管事件。因此，除了評估分割的準確性之外，我們還將比較自動分割和手動分割這兩種方式測量的斑塊體積和紋理資訊在病發預測能力上的差異。 我們提出的框架將提高3DUS頸動脈測量在多中心試驗和臨床實踐中的臨床效用。對抗網路將對3DUS掃描參數和患者特徵方面的差異提供校準。該框架的領域自適性將特別有利於在缺乏3DUS專業知識的醫療診所的應用。

11206122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206122.value: 基于事件相机的三维人体姿态估计与跟踪研究

11206122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206122.value: Estimating and tracking 3D human poses from visual sensors have a wide range of applications, including action recognition, sports analysis, video surveillance, and human-robot interaction. While advances have been made in pose estimation and tracking, there are still problems to be solved in challenging scenes such as crowded backgrounds, poor illumination, and fast motion. In recent years, event cameras, a type of bio-inspired visual sensors, have attracted much attention from academia and industry. Compared with conventional cameras, event cameras have very high temporal time resolution, high dynamic range, low latency, and low power consumptions. In addition, the redundancy reduction and data sparsity provided by event cameras make both the computation and memory lighter, while the key information can be preserved. Therefore, event camera provides an attractive candidate for applications in motion-related tasks. In particular, event cameras have its high potential for real-time 3D human pose estimation and tracking which may operate under uncontrolled lighting conditions and crowded backgrounds, while the low latency and power consumption can be guaranteed. Human pose tracking desires low latency pose prediction and tracking. This motivates our study in exploring event cameras for 3D human pose tracking in challenging scenes. This project proposes a novel voxel-wise representation with a graph neural network to encode event signals to unlock the potential of event cameras, so that meaningful spatial-temporal features can be extracted for human pose estimation and tracking. In pose estimation, a temporal densely connected recurrent network will be specially proposed to model the temporal dependency and geometric consistency among a sequence of event streams at different time steps to help complete the information loss due to the sparsity of event data. For the pose estimation and tracking, unlike most existing work that consider pose estimation and tracking as two separately tasks, a novel method will be proposed to couple the pose estimation and tracking in a unified framework. The pose estimation and tracking can benefit from each other, where the pose estimation can initialize the tracking targets and meanwhile tracking results can largely reduce the state space in the pose estimation. In this project, a robust and fast 3D human pose estimation and tracking system based on event cameras will be built, where it can be operated in uncontrolled environments, such as in outdoor scenes and in poor light conditions. 基于视觉传感器的3D人体姿态估计与跟踪具有广泛的应用，包括动作识别、运动分析、视频监控和人机交互等。近年来，尽管姿态估计与跟踪的研究已取得了较大进展，但在具有挑战性的场景中仍然存在一些问题需要解决，例如在复杂背景、低光照环境下较难取得有效的姿态估计、快速运动带来的视觉信号模糊问题等。近年来，事件相机作为一种新型仿生视觉传感器，已经引起了学术界和工业界的广泛关注。与传统相机相比，事件相机具有非常高的时间分辨率、高动态范围、低延迟和低功耗等突出优点。此外，事件相机的数据稀疏性对计算能力和内存空间要求都较低，同时可以保留关键的运动信息。因此，事件相机是一个适合于捕捉场景中运动事件的理想传感器。尤其，事件相机在实时3D人体姿态估计与跟踪方面具有较高的应用潜力，可以在不受控制的光照条件和复杂背景下获取有效的运动视觉信息，同时具有低延迟和低功耗的特性。因此，此项目旨在研究在具有挑战性的场景中探索基于事件相机的 3D人体姿势估计与跟踪。 该项目提出了一种新颖的体素化事件表示方法，同时使用图神经网络对事件信号进行编码，从而提取有意义的时空特征用于人体姿态估计和跟踪。在姿态估计中，将提出一种时间密集连接循环网络，对事件流序列之间的时间依赖性和几何一致性进行建模，解决由于事件数据的稀疏性导致的信息丢失问题。对于姿态估计和跟踪，大多数现有工作将姿态估计和跟踪视为两个独立任务。但是，该项目将提出一种新方法，将姿态估计和跟踪耦合在一个统一的计算框架中。在该框架中，姿态估计和跟踪可以相互作用，其中姿态估计可以初始化跟踪目标，同时跟踪结果可以大大减少姿态估计中的状态空间。该项目旨在构建一个基于事件相机的稳健而快速地3D人体姿态估计和跟踪系统，它可以在不受控制的复杂环境中运行，如在室外场景和光线不足的条件下。

11206322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206322.value: 亞熱帶氣候条件下低溫輻射吊頂系統：動態特性、控制策略及能耗性能研究

11206322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11206322.value: Prof Wu, Huijun Prof Xu, Xinhua

11206322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206322.value: 與傳統的空氣冷卻系統相比，輻射冷卻吊頂（CRCP）具有更好的熱舒適性和更高的能源利用效率。 然而，CRCP的冷卻功率不足，容易結露，使得它在炎熱潮濕的氣候中尚未得到廣泛的應用。我們的前期研究證明帶空氣夾層的CRCP（AiCRCP）：（1）可以使用低溫輻射（例如5攝氏度）來顯著提高其冷卻功率;（2）使用紅外透明膜帶來密封乾空氣層分離空氣接觸面與輻射冷卻面，可以降低結露風險;（iii）低溫輻射（例如5攝氏度）並不會顯著犧牲熱舒適性。因此，AiCRCP具有应用于炎熱潮濕氣候下的建築物的潛力。為實現AiCRCP的潛力，本項目將研究以下幾個關鍵問題。首先是AiCRCP系統的動態特徵。與傳統的CRCP系統相比，AiCRCP使用的輻射冷卻溫度要低得多，並且變化範圍大，因此其動態特徵會顯著不同。二是對AiCRCP系統的控制。由於輻射冷卻溫度變化較大，非線性特征明顯，傳統CRCP系統的控制方法並不適用，需開發新的控制策略。三是AiCRCP系統能效表現。由於AiCRCP系統可以提供足夠的冷卻功率，它可以與全新風系統（DOAS）一起使用。 但是，迄今為止，AiCRCP-DOAS系統的能效表現尚未清楚。我們擬通過實驗測試、動態建模和數值分析來實現指定的研究目標。

11206622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206622.value: 超越數據增強：通過域信息注入在機器學習中進行接近真實訓練數據的生成建模

11206622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206622.value: Due to the highly data-driven nature of current machine learning frameworks, their applicability to scenarios involving rare yet important classes of events, such as traffic accident prediction through detection of unusual pedestrian movements, and disease probability estimation using gene expression profiles, will be severely hampered due to insufficient training data. While different attempts have been made to synthesize new training examples, including data augmentation techniques that transform existing training data to generate new samples, and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based approaches that match the synthetic data probability distribution with the real distribution through adversarial learning, they cannot adequately capture fine-grained relationships across data features and instances for generating semantically-valid training examples. To address this problem, we propose a new framework for synthesizing close-to-real training examples, by capturing fine-grained high-order relationships across data features/instances. Based on preliminary human- and/or machine-annotated prior knowledge in the form of low-order relationships such as correlation between feature pairs, our framework will extrapolate these links into multiple high-order relationships across features/instances through a new graph convolutional neural network approach. The resulting enriched relationships, such as long-range image region correlations in computer vision, and multiple gene subset interactions in bioinformatics, can effectively constrain the data generation process to synthesize semantically-valid training examples. A key research question is how to learn an optimized embedded representation for these high-order relationships, and seamlessly integrate these representations with the learnt latent representations of training data to synthesize new examples. This will significantly broaden the type of prior knowledge for guiding the data synthesis process, beyond coarse-grained information such as class labels in GANs. Another important research question is how to extend the original discriminator in GAN into a generalized critic module for judging whether synthesized examples are semantically valid, by determining the presence/absence of high-order feature/instance relationships previously discovered. In this way, more refined control of the training data synthesis process can be achieved. In view of the pervasive data scarcity problem in machine learning, and the incapability of current approaches in synthesizing semantically-valid training examples, the proposed framework, which enables the judicious injection and enrichment of human and/or machine-annotated knowledge into the training data synthesis process, represents a significant advance beyond conventional coarse-grained data synthesis approaches. The resulting high-quality synthetic training data will significantly contribute to downstream machine learning applications supported by a small training set, including traffic accident prediction in self-driving vehicles, and disease classification based on gene expression profiles. 鑒於目前機器學習框架極度依賴數據驅動的本質，這些模型因為訓練數據缺乏而難以推廣到涉及罕見但重要事件的應用場景。例如，通過檢測異常的行人運動做出交通事故預警，以及利用基因表達譜進行疾病概率評估等。目前有各式各樣的嘗試來合成新訓練數據，包括將現有的訓練數據轉換合成新的訓練數據的數據增強技術，以及通過對抗學習匹配真實數據與合成數據分佈的生成對抗模型（GAN）等。然而，這些模型都不能充分地捕捉跨數據特徵和用於生成有效語意訓練數據實例之間的細微關係。 為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個全新的框架，通過捕捉跨數據特徵和實例之間的細微高階關係合成接近真實的訓練數據。基於以低階關係（如特徵之間的相關性）存在的初步由專家或機器標注的先驗知識，我們的框架通過新的圖卷積神經網絡方式將這些聯繫推斷為跨特徵/實例的多重高階關係。由此產生的豐富關係，例如計算機視覺裡遠程圖像區域相關性以及生物信息科學中多個基因子集的相互作用，可以有效地約束數據生產過程以合成具有有效語意的訓練樣本。 其中一個關鍵的研究問題是如何為這些高階關係學習到最優的嵌入表達，以及無縫融合這些表達和由訓練數據學習得到的隱空間表達用以合成新的樣本。這將顯著地拓寬指引數據合成過程的先驗知識類型，超越生成對抗網絡 （GAN）中以類標籤為代表的粗略信息。另一個重要的研究問題是如何通過判斷高階特徵/樣本關係的存在/不存在，將原始的生成對抗網絡（GAN）的辨別器拓展成為一個判斷合成樣本是否語意有效的廣義評價模塊。通過這種方式達成對訓練數據合成過程更加精細化的控制。 鑒於機器學習中的訓練數據不足及現存方法無法合成語意有效數據的問題，我們提出的框架能夠將專家或機器標注的知識注入和擴充到訓練數據合成過程中，以超越現有的數據合成方法而達到顯著進步。由此生成的高質量合成訓練數據將為只有小型訓練數據集支持的下游機器學習應用做出顯著貢獻，包括在自動駕駛中的交通事故預測以及基於基因表達譜的疾病分類。

11206922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206922.value: 全球變暖下區域風災評估的非平穩隨機熱帶氣旋模型

11206922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11206922.value: Dr Chan, Pak-Wai Dr Zeng, Di-Qi

11206922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206922.value: 熱帶氣旋(TC)是影響中國東南沿海地區(包括香港和廣東)的主要自然災害。TC造成嚴重傷亡，對基礎設施和建築物造成廣泛破壞，並阻礙區域經濟發展。由於全球變暖，未來TC災害的頻率和強度都是非平穩的，導致未來TC災害造成更嚴重損失的可能性。要建立一個適應氣候變化的香港，一項基本任務是建立氣候變化災害模型，以預測在全球變暖的情況下大型城市地區未來的非平穩氣候變化災害。這些災害模型將有助於公共和私營部門的各種組織(如政府應急管理部門和保險公司)就基礎設施損失和緩解戰略作出決策，並有助於基礎設施設計實踐。為此，全路徑TC模型可以在整個海洋區域內生成數千年的合成TC事件，結合TC風場模型，對沿海地區進行極端風害評估。然而，以往的全路徑模型通常基於統計，沒有充分考慮濕度和渦度等環境變量，也沒有考慮TC活動的基本物理因素。因此，它們預測未來非穩態TC危害的能力是有限的。此外，雖然以前的風場模型已經從2D發展到3D，以更真實地模擬TC的空間結構，但它們沒有通過現場測量進行驗證，可能無法令人滿意地重現複雜地形上的風場。 鑑於上述研究背景，本計劃旨在建立一個新的具有物理基礎的非平穩TC災害模型，並評估全球變暖下香港和廣東未來的非平穩TC災害。具體來說，該項目包括四個任務。(1)發展一種結合高級統計模型和基本物理模型、依賴環境的全路徑模型來模擬西北太平洋(WNP)的合成TC事件；該模型將包括基於泊松回歸的成因模型、環境風場驅動的隨機運動模型和具有非飽和核心的TC的強度模型。(2)建立深度學習增強的三維非線性TC風場模型，用於模擬複雜地形影響下的TC風場。為此，香港天文台的多平台氣候監測網絡，包括8個天氣浮標、50多個氣象站、多普勒雷達風廓線儀、無線電探空氣球、氣象飛機投擲的下投式探空儀等，提供整個TC邊界層內測量數據，用於模式訓練、驗證和不確定性分析。建立了香港和廣東地區風場模式參數的統計模型。(3)結合全路徑模型和風場模型的合成TC模型，將利用TC最佳路徑資料和香港天文台的氣候監測資料進行驗證。然後，為每個感興趣的場地建立三種風危害模型，包括該場地年最大風速的概率、以該場地為中心的圓形區域內的年最大風速的概率、該場地年最大風速與對應的最大風速半徑的聯合概率。第二種模型捕捉一個地區內的災害強度，第三種模型使用氣旋事件的強度和大小來表明事件的破壞性。因此，第二和第三種模型都適用於區域損失評估。(4)將全球氣候模式(GCMs)對未來大尺度環境參數的預測與綜合TC模式相結合，評估全球變暖下未來非平穩TC風危害。首先，選取最新的GCM模型構建多模式集合，對未來溫室氣體排放的各種情景下2100年前的大氣和海洋變量進行預測。然後，將預測的環境變量輸入到合成TC模型中，模擬未來短期、中期和長期的TC。最後，分析全球變暖對極端TC災害的影響。

11207222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11207222.value: 一種用於將頸部皮膚震動轉換為數字語音的柔軟傳感器

11207222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11207222.value: 近年来，贴合人体颈部的柔性“智能皮肤”振动传感器已被研究为可穿戴语音识别设备，因为它们在实时语音负载监测、新型麦克风（具有背景降噪功能） 、基于语音的生物识别技术和基于语音的疾病诊断等各种重要领域都有潜在应用。然而，开发具有高灵敏度、低阻尼和优化频率响应的皮肤贴合振动传感器以收集声带产生的颈部皮肤振动信号仍有待实现。此外，与“表皮电子”的开发类似，与无线和自供电组件的系统集成，以及制备与身体曲线表面兼容且对身体活动持久/稳定的软传感器和电子设备的材料识别仍然具有重要意义科学和工程挑战。 在这个项目中，我们的跨学科团队将开发 1) 一种集成无线保形颈部皮肤振动传感器，该传感器基于嵌入碳纳米管 (CNT) 的薄海绵结构来检测皮肤振动。随后，2）将使用皮肤贴合传感器收集志愿者的颈部皮肤振动数据，3）将实施人工智能算法，将皮肤振动信号关联或“转换”为数字语音。此外，我们将 4) 进行理论分析和建模，以优化新型柔性基于 CNT 海绵的传感器的机械电响应性和频率响应，以最大限度地提高其灵敏度。根据我们的初步结果，基于 CNT 的类皮肤海绵传感器可因输入振动而产生压阻和电容响应信号，并有望检测人的喉咙皮肤振动（最高约 4 kHz）和肌肉运动（通常小于 10赫兹）。为了实现这些目标，我们将解决几个关键的技术问题，特别是与 a) 开发与曲线体表面兼容的薄、耐用、稳定和高灵敏度的传感元件； b) 为颈部皮肤振动监测优化的薄碳纳米管海绵传感装置建立可扩展的制造工艺； c) 开发基于人工智能的算法，以有效地将颈部皮肤振动与口语相关联，或将皮肤振动“翻译”成合成语音。 该项目的成果将使香港成为全球智能传感器研发的前沿，可应用于人工喉框架、基于语音的医疗保健和疾病诊断。该项目的成功将有助扩大香港在医疗传感器发展方面的科技实力，推动香港乃至世界的社会经济发展。

11207922.value: 低秩矩陣恢復的先進因式分解方法研究

11207922.label: Project Objectives
11207922.value: Devise efficient bi-factorization based matrix recovery algorithms without the need of rank information. Using the rank-one matrix property of the outer product of two vectors, our key idea is to alternately update these vectors and progressively increment the outer product until a preset criterion is reached. Robustify the proposed bi-factorization based matrix recovery approach for general uncertain scenarios via M-estimation. To achieve computational efficiency, the M-estimation formulation will be transformed with the use of implicit regularization. Extend the factorization based methodology to simultaneously complete multiple matrices using the matrix-to-matrix approach. Here, tri-factorization is adopted and each involved matrix is a product of three matrices where two of them remain the same in all components. Produce theoretical analysis for the developed matrix recovery methods. Important performance metrics including computational complexity and convergence will be examined. Apply the devised algorithms in different real-world problems and compare with state-of-the-art techniques.

11208122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11208122.value: 距离边界协议针对时间差的容错设计

11208122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208122.value: Authentication decisions often need to be based on physical proximity to a location. For instance, a contactless payment card must be physically presented to a payment terminal before payment is taken. Linking the physical proximity of a device to a cryptographic authentication protocol is however a challenging problem. One of the most prominent approaches to addressing this challenge is distance-bounding protocols. In theory, these protocols simply work on the basis of measuring the round-trip time of carefully defined cryptographic challenge-response exchanges, which it uses to estimate the upper distance bound between the devices. In practice, the security of these protocols also depends on the devices’ communication channel as its characteristics effects the round-trip time measurement and the correctness of the bounding exchanges. Only if the full protocol implementation is both secure and reliable can we have confidence in the distance bound. In recent years TOF(time-of-flight) ranging has received attention due to increased prevalence of supporting technology, e.g. IEEE 802.15.4a UWB(ultra-wideband) in Apple iPhone 11/Airtags and IEEE 802.11mc WiFi RTT(round-trip time) in Android phones/Google access points. Distance bounding relies on TOF distance estimation, albeit using proprietary channels designed for this purpose. The traditional use case presented for distance bounding was contactless smart card applications, where a reader bounds a card over a very short-range line-of-sight(LOS) channel. However, emerging distance-bounding use cases, such as keyless entry for vehicles, could require longer range communication over non-line-of-sight(NLOS) links. From TOF literature, it is known that NLOS links exhibit multi-path and permeation effects that could lead to distance estimation errors and in the context of distance-bounding protocols false rejection of a legitimate prover’s proximity claim. Prior work on distance-bounding resilience only address tolerance to errors in the challenge-response values exchanged and not timing errors. In this project, we address distance-bounding protocol resilience in NLOS environments with the objective to develop timing error threshold functions, based on channel information, which could provide tolerance for accepting late honest responses over NLOS links. This will contribute to ensure distance-bounding protocols are reliable in various environments (whether LOS or NLOS). We also aim to develop a mechanism, based on TOF channel information, for verifying the continued validity of an established distance-bound during a communication session. This should detect if the prover moved after the initial distance bound and ensure that the session maintains the initial condition of participant proximity without incurring the overhead of continuously having to rerun the distance-bounding protocol. 身份验证决策通常需要基于与某个位置的物理临近度。例如，非接触式支付卡必须在支付时出示给支付终端。然而，利用加密身份验证协议来验证设备的物理临近性是具有一定挑战性的。解决这一挑战的最突出的方法之一是距离边界协议。从理论上讲，该协议的底层逻辑是通过测量交换谨慎定义的密码质询-响应的往返时间来估计设备之间的距离上限。在实践中，这些协议的安全性还取决于设备的通信信道，因为它的特性会影响往返时间的测量和边界交换的正确性。当整体的协议实现可以既安全又可靠时，我们才能对距离界限协议有信心。 近年来，由于支持技术的普及，TOF（时间差）测距受到了广泛的关注，例如Apple iPhone 11/Airtags 中的 IEEE 802.15.4a UWB（超宽带）和 Android 手机/Google 接入点中的 IEEE 802.11mc WiFi RTT（往返时间）。尽管已经为了实现依赖于TOF距离估计的距离边界协议设计了专有信道，但是该协议的传统用例是非接触式智能卡应用，其中读卡器通过非常短的视距 (LOS) 通道限制卡。与此同时，新兴的距离限制用例，例如车辆的无钥匙进入，可能需要通过非视距 (NLOS) 链路进行更远距离的通信。从有关ToF的文献可知，NLOS 链路会表现出多路径和渗透效应，这可能导致距离估计错误，在距离边界协议中体现为错误的拒绝合法证明者。先前关于距离边界的容错性分析只解决了针对交换的挑战-响应值的错误的容忍性，而不是针对时间错误的容忍性。 在这个项目中，我们解决了 NLOS 环境中的距离边界协议容错问题，目的是开发基于信道信息的时间误差阈值函数，它可以为在NLOS 链路上接受延迟的诚实响应提供容忍度。这将有助于确保距离边界协议在各种环境（无论是 LOS 还是 NLOS）中都是可靠的。我们还旨在开发一种基于 TOF 通道信息的机制，用于验证在通信会话期间已建立的距离限制的持续有效性。该机制用于检测证明者是否在确定初始距离范围之后仍有移动，并确保会话保持参与者接近的初始条件而不会产生不断重新运行距离限制协议的开销。

11208522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11208522.value: 实时系统中的信息同步性管理

11208522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208522.value: 在計算機系統中，當多個信息流匯聚時（比如進行數據融合），信息同步性約束要求不同信息流的數據只有在具有相同或相似的時間戳才能進行融合。例如，自動駕駛汽車對外部環境的感知通常依賴於不同傳感器數據的融合。如果兩個傳感器的數據采樣於相聚很遠的時間點，對它們進行融合則無法用於對外部環境的重建。本項目研究如何形式化地驗證信息同步性約束，並對系統設計進行優化從而更好地同時滿足信息同步性約束和經典的實時性約束（如截止期，數據新鮮度約束等）。 信息同步性取決於兩方面因素：（1）傳感器數據生成的時間屬性，（2）信息流在計算系統中所經歷的延遲。本項目將首先針對第一方面因素進行研究，並在此基礎上將第二方面因素考慮在內。通過這種方式，我們可以獲得對兩方面因素影響的結構化的理解，並設計有效的策略來分別處理它們。從另一個維度，我們將首先聚焦於用於決定如何從不同的信息流中挑選合適的數據進行匹配。然後我們將其擴展到整個系統的設計優化從而更好地滿足各類時間約束。我們將分以下步驟開展項目的研究工作： （1）不考慮其他實時約束的數據同步策略設計。 （2）考慮其他實時約束的數據同步策略設計。 （3）系統級時間分析。 （4）系統級設計優化。 最後我們將開發一個工具原型系統對新分析方法進行實現和評估，並在ROS和Apollo Cyber RT中實現所開發的數據同步策略。我們將通過與工業夥伴進行合作將本項目中開發的技術用於對自動駕駛系統的設計優化。

11209122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209122.value: 面向移动设备的统一内存-存储系统

11209122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209122.value: Non-Volatile Memories (NVM) can serve as both the main memory and the storage, which makes it possible for a unified management of NVM for both storage and the main memory. While there are attempts to utilize unified-storage-memory to improve the performance of servers, unified-storage-memory has not been explored for mobile devices. We find that unified-storage-memory has potential to significantly improve the performance of mobile applications and improve the overall user experience. However, designing unified non-volatile memory management for mobile devices comes with significant challenges from three unique characteristics of mobile applications. First, a large percentage of read/write accesses on mobile devices are small in size. Under unified-storage-memory, the data movements between the main memory and the storage can be significantly reduced as they are on the same physical device. However, small-size data movement could induce significant overhead hence calls for new solutions. Second, mobile applications constantly perform sync operations to maintain data consistency in the case of power outages. These operations could benefit from the non-volatile main memory of the unified-storage-memory architecture and the application-transparent management of NVM. Third, mobile applications are user-experience-critical when they are in the foreground. Hence, the foreground applications should be prioritized under unified-storage-memory architecture by a carefully-designed memory/storage management scheme. Considering the opportunities and challenges brought forward by these mobile application characteristics, this project proposes a novel unified-storage-memory framework for mobile devices. The proposed framework synergistically combines unified-storage-memory’s features and mobile applications’ characteristics to improve the user experience and performance of mobile devices. First, we profile mobile application execution on unified-storage-memory. Foreground/background aware memory management schemes, as well as dynamic memory/storage management schemes will be exploited to improve performance and reduce power consumption for mobile devices. Second, targeting efficient application execution on unified-storage-memory, we explore persistent application execution on unified-storage-memory and granularity-aware application launching over unified memory. Finally, we propose application-aware I/O schemes for unified-storage-memory, considering the specific characteristics of mobile devices, including mobile cache file management and data-intensive-device management. Unified-storage-memory could play an increasingly important role for mobile devices in the upcoming decade. The success of this project will promote the application of the new architecture of mobile devices. High performance, low power consumption, and long device’s lifespan can benefit many mobile users. The success is highly critical for Hong Kong to drive its new wave of innovation and technology in the mobile computing era. 非易失性存储器（NVM）既可以作为主存设备，也可以作为存储设备，这使得对主存和存储的非易失性存储器进行统一管理成为可能。虽然有人尝试利用统一存储内存（unified-storage-memory）来提高服务器的性能，但尚未有人探索在移动设备上使用统一存储内存。我们发现统一存储内存有很大的潜力用于提高移动应用程序的性能并改善整体用户体验。然而，因为移动应用程序三个特性，使得移动设备上的统一非易失存储内存管理设计面临重大挑战。首先，移动设备上有很大比例的小尺寸读/写请求。在统一存储内存架构下，主存和存储位于同一物理设备上，因此，它们之间的数据迁移可以通过重映射机制被大大减少。然而，小尺寸数据的重映射会导致开销过大，因此需要新的解决方案。其次，移动应用程序不断地执行同步操作，以保证在断电的情况下的数据一致性。这些操作可以受益于统一存储内存架构下，对应用程序透明化的非易失性主内存管理机制。第三，移动应用程序在前台运行时对用户体验至关重要。因此，应通过精心设计的内存/存储管理方案在统一存储内存架构下优先考虑前台应用程序。 考虑到这些移动应用程序特性带来的机遇和挑战，本项目提出了一种新颖的移动设备统一存储框架。所提出的框架协同考虑了统一存储内存的特性和移动应用程序的特性，以改善移动设备的用户体验和性能。首先，我们在统一存储内存上分析移动应用程序的执行情况。将利用前/后台感知的内存管理方案以及动态内存/存储管理方案来提高性能并降低移动设备的功耗。其次，为达到统一存储内存上移动应用程序的高效执行，我们探索统一存储内存上的持久应用程序执行和粒度感知的应用程序启动。最后，考虑到移动设备的其他特性，包括移动缓存文件管理和数据密集型设备管理，我们提出了统一存储内存下应用感知的I/O 方案。 在接下来的十年中，统一存储内存可能会在移动设备中发挥越来越重要的作用。因此，该项目的成功将推动移动设备新架构的应用。高性能、低功耗和较长的设备寿命可以使许多移动用户受益。同时，该项目的成功对于香港在移动计算时代推动新一波技术创新至关重要。

11209222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209222.value: 基於鈮酸鋰波導光柵的緊湊型電場傳感器

11209222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209222.value: Instantaneous, strong electromagnetic pulses (EMPs) can appear in extreme weather conditions, nuclear detonation, and electricity supply. Failure in detecting EMPs generated by high-energy facilities, such as nuclear plants and high-voltage power grids, could cause serious disasters in electricity, communication, transportation, and military systems. Conventional electric-field sensors based on metallic structures and antenna probes may disturb the electric field to be measured and give inaccurate results. To avoid mutual electromagnetic interferences, optical electric-field sensors have long been investigated. In particular, compact lithium-niobate (LiNbO3) electric-field sensors based on the large electro-optic effect of LiNbO3 can provide non-invasive, real-time, and long-term measurements with high sensitivities, large dynamic ranges, and broadband frequency responses and stand out as the most promising optical electric-field sensors. Existing LiNbO3 electric-field sensors are mostly configured as waveguide interferometers. The periodic transmission spectra of waveguide interferometers, however, present difficulties in the identification of the operation condition and the multiplexing of multiple sensors. In this project, the PI proposes a new LiNbO3 electric-field sensor configuration to overcome the limitations of the conventional LiNbO3 sensors. The proposed sensor consists of a LiNbO3 waveguide that supports two guided modes, where properly designed periodic shielding electrodes are placed on the waveguide surface. When the waveguide is exposed to an electric field, a periodic modulation in the refractive index of the waveguide, namely a long-period grating, is formed in the waveguide, which enables the fundamental mode of the waveguide to couple to the higher-order mode at a specific resonance wavelength. The transmission of the fundamental mode at the resonance wavelength thus serves as a measure of the external electric field. This sensor configuration removes the ambiguity in the identification of the operation wavelength and allows multiplexing of sensors designed for different wavelengths. In this project, the principle of the proposed sensor will be investigated theoretically and experimentally, and the parameters of the sensor will be optimized for different applications. Centimeter-long prototype sensor chips will be fabricated and fully tested. The PI has over 30 years research experience in the field of waveguide devices, including LiNbO3 devices. He is a pioneer in the development of waveguide devices based on long-period grating structures and CityU possesses all the necessary facilities for the fabrication of the proposed sensors. The PI has all the capacity to complete this project. The outcome of the project should benefit all industries that require reliable measurement of electric fields. 瞬時強電磁脈衝可能出現於極端天氣條件、核爆炸和電力供應中。未能檢測到由核電站和高壓電網等高能設施產生的電磁脈衝可能會給電力、通信、交通和軍事系統造成嚴重的災難。基於金屬結構和天線探頭的傳統電場傳感器可能會干擾待測電場並給出不准確結果。為了避免相互電磁干擾，長期以來光學電場傳感器的研究一直備受關注，尤其是基於鈮酸鋰強大電光效應的緊湊型電場傳感器。鈮酸鋰電場傳感器具有高靈敏度、大動態範圍和寬帶工作頻率，能提供無創、實時和長期測量。這些優點使鈮酸鋰電場傳感器脫穎而出，成為最有前途的光學電場傳感器。現有的鈮酸鋰電場傳感器大多為波導干涉儀結構。然而，波導干涉儀的周期性透射光譜在識別操作條件和傳感器復用方面存在困難。在本項目中，PI提出一種新的鈮酸鋰電場傳感器結構，以克服傳統鈮酸鋰傳感器的局限性。 本項目所提出的傳感器由支持兩種導模的鈮酸鋰波導組成，適當設計的周期性屏蔽電極放置在波導表面上。當波導暴露在電場中時，波導的折射率發生週期性調製，在波導中形成長周期光柵，使波導的基模在特定的共振波長耦合到高階模。因此，在諧振波長處基模的透射可以用作測量外部電場。這種傳感器結構消除了識別工作波長的模糊性，並允許波長復用設計。本項目將對所提出傳感器的原理進行理論和實驗研究，並對傳感器的參數進行優化以適應不同的應用。將製造厘米長的原型傳感器芯片並進行全面測試。 PI在波導器件（包括鈮酸鋰器件）領域擁有超過30年的研究經驗，是開發一系列基於長周期光柵結構波導器件的先驅。香港城市大學擁有製造所提出的傳感器的所有必要設施。PI具備完成本項目的能力與條件。本項目的成果將造福於所有需要可靠測量電場的行業。

11209322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209322.value: Information inequalities, which are inequalities consisting of only entropies, are important in information theory. They are the “physical laws” that characterize fundamental limits in applications like communications and cryptography. Since the birth of information theory, the nonnegativity of the Shannon information measures, for discrete random variables, are the known information inequalities that are categorically known as Shannon-type inequalities. In the late 1990s, information inequalities which are not implied by the nonnegativity of Shannon's information measures were discovered. The discovery of such inequalities known as non-Shannon-type inequalities started the quest of new information inequalities that is still largely uncharted territory. To distinguish between Shannon-type and non-Shannon-type information inequality as well as the task of proving these general information inequalities are nontrivial and open problems in general. Recently, advances were made to explore finding the shortest proof of only Shannon-type information inequalities by computers. This project will study a novel unifying framework for the automated reasoning of both Shannon-type and non-Shannon-type information inequalities with a view towards its underlying theory, computational methodology and applications. We propose the idea of automated reasoning by convex optimization to enable the proving of both Shannon-type and non-Shannon-type inequalities (both unconstrained and constrained) automatically by optimization-theoretic tools and algorithms. This theory-driven approach has three distinctive characters. First, it demonstrates a novel way to characterize the long-standing problem of proving non-Shannon-type inequalities, which brings forth new intellectual considerations. Second, it is driven by a motivation based on the mathematician Hilbert's 24th problem, which was about a criteria for the simplicity of mathematical proofs and the right kind of proof simplicity criterion allows computers to prove theorems in the field of artificial intelligence. This motivates a mathematically rigorous and scalable algorithmic design approach to deduce mathematical tautologies involving as few inequalities from a given optimization constraint set as possible with applications to information theory and large-scale network coding problems that are computationally challenging to solve. Third, it will lead to a Software-as-a-Service freely available to the scientific community to interactively explore proofs to a variety of problems in information theory and network coding. This project will make significant profound contributions to network information theory and push the limits of knowledge discovery via mathematical optimization. Its impact is even larger on its applicability to allow the scientific community to address problems in communications and quantum cryptography as the society's reliance on intelligent networks continues to expand tremendously. 11209622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209622.value: 基於損失分佈的分位數的穩健參數設計的貝葉斯優化

11209622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209622.value: This project will develop Bayesian optimization methods for optimizing robust design objective functions (RDOFs) that are quantiles of the quality loss distribution in product design simulations. We shall focus on the case of deterministic simulations where the vector of input noise factors is a fixed vector in each simulation run, but it is a random vector with a known distribution in actual system operation. Due to increasing availability of computers and modeling software, simulators are becoming widely used for product design. Many of these simulators are computer codes that implement numerical algorithms such as the finite element method to solve partial differential equations, which are deterministic in nature, i.e., a fixed output is obtained given fixed user-specified inputs. To improve quality in product design, it is imperative to evaluate the performance of the product under random manufacturing and/or operating conditions, which are modeled by input noise factor variations, and to find the control (i.e., design) factor setting that minimizes the deleterious effect of the noise variations on quality as quantified by an RDOF. This is a quality improvement approach called robust parameter design (RPD). While Gaussian process (GP) models have been widely used to build emulators for time-consuming simulators to facilitate RPD, there is a lack of Bayesian optimization methods based on the GP emulator for finding control factor settings that optimize RDOFs given by quantiles of the loss distribution. However, such objective functions are favored by some decision-makers such as those who would like to make conservative decisions that ensure the product works well under most operating conditions. This project will develop acquisition functions (AFs) for selecting follow-up design points (i.e., simulator evaluation points) in Bayesian optimization based on a GP emulator of the simulator output for a broad class of RDOFs that consists of quantiles of the loss distribution given by continuous loss functions. AFs for optimizing one quantile of the loss distribution and AFs for simultaneously optimizing a profile of quantiles will be developed. By discretizing the distribution of the noise factors and employing general methods for computing integrals of functions, methods for efficiently computing the proposed AFs will be developed. The finite sample performance and convergence properties of the proposed AFs will be also studied, and the best AFs will be identified. Thus, the project is expected to deliver urgently needed efficient global optimization methods for RPD with costly simulators to the engineering design community. 該項目將開發貝葉斯優化方法，以優化穩健設計目標函數 (RDOF)，RDOF 是產品設計模擬中質量損失分佈的分位數。我們將關注確定性模擬的情況，其中輸入噪聲因子向量在每次模擬運行中是一個固定向量，但在實際系統操作中它是一個具有已知分佈的隨機向量。 由於計算機和建模軟件的日益普及，模擬器正被廣泛用於產品設計。其中許多模擬器是實現數值算法的計算機代碼，例如有限元法求解偏微分方程，這些方程本質上是確定性的，即，在給定固定的用戶指定輸入的情況下獲得固定的輸出。為了提高產品設計的質量，必須評估產品在隨機製造和/或運行條件下的性能，這些條件是用輸入噪聲因子變化來建模的，並找到使得噪聲變化對質量的有害影響最小化的控制（即設計）因子設置，這種影響是由RDOF量化的。這是一種稱為穩健參數設計 (RPD) 的質量提升方法。雖然高斯過程 (GP) 模型已被廣泛用於為耗時的模擬器構建仿真器來促進 RPD，但缺乏基於 GP仿真器的貝葉斯優化方法來尋找最優化由損失分佈的分位數給出的RDOF的控制因子設置。然而，這樣的目標函數受到一些決策者的青睞，例如那些希望做出保守決策以確保產品在大多數運行條件下都能正常工作的決策者。 該項目將開發採集函數 (AFs)，用於為包含了連續損失函數的損失分佈的分位數的一大類RODFs在基於模擬器輸出的GP仿真器的貝葉斯優化中選擇後續設計點（即模擬器評估點）。我們將開發用於優化損失分佈的一個分位數的 AFs 和用於同時優化分位數輪廓的 AFs。通過離散化噪聲因子的分佈並利用計算函數積分的通用方法，將開發有效計算所提出的 AF 的方法。還將研究提出的 AF 的有限樣本性能和收斂性質，並確定最佳 AF。因此，該項目有望為工程設計界提供急需的使用昂貴模擬器的RPD的高效全局優化方法。

11209822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209822.value: 利用中子衍射技術對BCC 高熵合金塑脆轉變及低溫形變機制的原味研究

11209822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209822.value: Most alloys with a body-centered cubic (bcc) structure undergo an abrupt ductile-brittle transition (DBT) when the test temperature decreases. For instance, polycrystal Nb shows a drastic drop in ductility at around -100 ℃. High-entropy alloys (HEAs) are multi component solid-solution alloys with nearly equiatomic ratio. In spite of the complex chemistry, HEAs based on refractory elements can crystallize into an incredibly simple lattice, e.g., the bcc structure. Some of these bcc HEAs display remarkable mechanical properties. For example, the equiatomic TiZrHfNbTa alloy exhibits a room temperature yield strength greater than 900 MPa and 10-20% ductility. Earlier studies by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) indicated that the room-temperature deformation is governed by the glide of screw dislocations. However, analysis of in situ neutron diffraction data suggested that edge dislocations also play a role. More strikingly, as the test temperatures is lowered, the strength of TiZrHfNbTa increases prominently without sacrificing the ductility, manifesting an unusually low DBT temperature. TEM analysis of samples retrieved from interrupted tensile tests has identified the activation of nano-twinning and deformation-induced phase transformation at 77 K. However, unlike face-centered-cubic (fcc) HEAs (e.g., CrCoNiFeMn), the bcc HEA displays almost negligible work hardening. This is markedly different from the characteristics of well-established low temperature deformation mechanisms, e.g., transformation-induced plasticity (TRIP), twinning-induced plasticity (TWIP), or stacking faults. The above experimental results show that the deformation in bcc HEAs, especially at low temperatures, remains poorly understood. We propose to conduct in-situ neutron diffraction study of the deformation behavior of bcc HEAs. The goal is to determine the physical mechanisms governing the excellent mechanical properties, particularly at low temperatures. With in situ neutron diffraction measurements, we aim to identify new deformation mechanisms (e.g., twinning or phase transformation) and to determine the competition between different types of dislocation activities, and use these data to elucidate the dramatic suppression of the anticipated DBT. In-situ neutron diffraction is a powerful method for study of mechanical behaviors and has made major contributions to our understanding of deformation in advanced alloys, most recently in low temperature deformation of fcc HEAs. The neutron diffraction results will be corroborated with TEM analysis and molecular dynamics simulations. Together, these data will provide unique insights into the origin for the lack of DBT in bcc HEAs. The knowledge gained from the proposed study will facilitate the design of new structure materials with superior mechanical properties. 大多数具有体心立方（bcc）结构的合金的塑性随着温度的降低而下降，并在某一温度发生韧脆转变（DBT），例如，多晶Nb的DBT温度大约是-100 ℃。高熵合金是指一类包含多种组成元素且各组元的原子百分比接近的固溶体合金。尽管化学成分十分复杂，基于难熔元素的合金却可以形成非常简单的晶格，即bcc结构。一些bcc高熵合金具有非常优异的力学性能。等原子TiZrHrNbTa合金的室温屈服强度超过900 MPa，断裂伸长率则为10%-20%。早期的透射电子显微镜（TEM）研究表明，合金的室温塑性变形主要由螺位错的滑移主导。然而，原位中子衍射的结果显示，在一些bcc高熵合金体系中刃位错也起到了重要作用。 更引人注目的是，随着温度的降低，TiZrHfNbTa在强度显著提高的同时仍能维持其延展性，合金表现出异常低的DBT温度。通过对拉伸样品进行TEM分析发现，在77K下的变形过程中，纳米孪晶被激活，还伴随着形变诱导相变的发生。然而，不同于面心立方(fcc) 高熵合金(如CrCoNiFeMn)， bcc 高熵合金的加工硬化几乎可以忽略不计。这与公认的低温变形机制(如形变诱导塑性(TRIP)、孪晶诱导塑性(TWIP)或堆垛层错)的特征明显不同。这些实验结果表明，人们对于bcc高熵合金的变形机制，特别是低温下的变形机制，仍然知之甚少。 本项目拟开展bcc高熵合金变形行为的原位中子衍射研究。旨在明确合金具有优异力学性能（尤其是低温下）的物理机制。通过原位中子衍射测试，将确定合金是否存在新的变形机制（如孪晶或马氏体相变），并揭示不同类型位错之间的竞争，最终阐明bcc高熵合金的DBT被显著抑制的机理。原位中子衍射是一种研究先进金属材料力学行为的强有力手段，借助这一手段申请人在前期研究中成功破译了fcc高熵合金的低温变形机制。中子衍射的结果将进一步与TEM分析和分子动力学模拟相互验证。本项目的开展能够提供bcc高熵合金缺乏DBT的独特见解，有助于开发具有优异力学性能的新型结构材料。

11210122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11210122.value: 高密度城市屋頂太陽能潛力精准評估及大規模分佈式光伏繫統整體設計優化

11210122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11210122.value: Prof Chan, Antoni B. Dr Tse , Chung Fai, Norman

11210122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11210122.value: 可再生能源應用對於高密度城市的脫碳和可持續發展具有重要意義。為實現脫碳目標，香港積極推動太陽能應用，實施超高上網電價，即正常電價的 300% 至 500%。香港有超過 45,000 座建築物，但準確描述其多樣化的太陽能潛力具有挑戰性且仍然缺乏。 建築太陽能潛力主要來自屋頂和立麵。現有的研究已經從它們的總表麵積估計了各自的潛力。然而，常見的障礙物（如屋頂冷卻塔和立麵裝飾結構）會大大減少可用麵積，從而減少可應用的太陽能潛力，這些障礙要麼被忽視，要麼被過度簡化，從而導緻表徵精度低。事實上，城市規模的障礙物識別（包括檢測、定位和度量）具有挑戰性，由於障礙物的複雜特徵，如不規則形狀、隨機分佈和時變數量，傳統方法無法實現有效識別。另一方麵，由於缺乏準確的表徵，現有的設計方法無法快速準確地識別出具有豐富的太陽能潛力或其他理想特徵的建築物，從而無法識別出最適合光伏應用的建築物，導緻大規模整體設計效果不佳。 為了實現準確表徵，我們將開發深度學習和 3D-GIS（地理信息繫統）集成的表徵方法。鑑於其在圖像識別方麵的強大性能，深度學習將被用於障礙物識別。然而，單獨的深度學習可能會錯誤地識別屋頂和外牆之外的障礙物。因此，將集成 3D-GIS 數據，提供精確的建築幾何形狀、位置和方向，防止此類錯誤髮生。然後通過納入障礙物考慮，從空間和時間角度準確表徵建築太陽能潛力。為實現大規模的設計優化，我們將基於太陽能潛力的精準表徵進行整體設計優化。爲應對大規模分佈式繫統設計所帶來的複雜計算，我們將嚐試採用兩種方法解決，即基於分解的串行優化和基於近似的並行優化。 通過利用先進技術提高表徵精度和增強大規模設計性能，該項目將有助於加速可再生能源在高密度城市的開發和應用，從而有助於相關的城市脫碳和可持續發展。

11210222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11210222.value: 實際約束下多智能體系統的分佈式優化協同控制及其應用

11210222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11210222.value: The distributed optimal coordination of networked multiple dynamical systems has experienced significant advances in recent years because of its great potential in a wide range of applications. Typical examples include cooperative source-seeking with multi-robot systems, formations of unmanned ground/aerial vehicles, and the coordination of distributed energy resources in power systems. Distributed optimal coordination entails the development of distributed control strategies to drive a team of networked agents toward an optimal solution that minimizes the sum of the local cost functions assigned to individual agents. Distributed control strategies refer to the control laws for individual agents that rely on information only from the agent itself and from its neighbors. Such strategies are preferred because they significantly reduce the communication load while greatly enhancing the robustness and flexibility of networked dynamical systems. Considerable research effort in recent years has been devoted to distributed optimal coordination for networked multiple dynamical systems. Most existing works on the topic assume that communication network topologies among agents are undirected graphs or, at most, balanced digraphs. Moreover, the proposed control strategies rely on certain global information about network connectivity and/or objective functions and are thus not fully distributed. However, in many practical scenarios, these assumptions about communication network topologies and global information are hardly satisfied for various reasons, including complex environments and hardware limitations. Instead, communication network topologies among agents in practical scenarios are often unbalanced digraphs, and the required global information is often not available. This project aims to develop a framework to address the fully distributed optimal coordination problems of multi-agent systems with general agent dynamics over unbalanced digraphs. The main challenges of these problems lie in the imbalance of the communication topologies, the lack of global information, as well as the complexity of general agent dynamics. This project will develop novel fully distributed adaptive output feedback control strategies and establish the optimality and stability of the resulting closed-loop multi-agent systems over unbalanced directed communication topologies. The developed control strategies will be consolidated and validated through their application to source-seeking with multiple mobile robotic vehicles. It is expected that the results from this project will address many theoretical hurdles to meeting the demanding challenges faced by distributed optimal coordination of networked dynamical systems in real-world applications. 多智能體系統的分佈式最優協同因其在工業及軍事等領域的廣泛應用前景成為近年的研究熱點，典型的工程應用包括網絡化多機器人系統的尋源、無人地面/空中飛行器的編隊以及電力系統中的分佈式能源協調。分佈式最優協同控制問題旨在開發分佈式的控制策略，在推動網絡化多智能體系統完成協同控制指標的同時，還可以使分配給單個智能體的局部成本函數之和實現最小化。分佈式控制策略指的是利用通信網絡拓撲與鄰居進行資訊互動，並且只使用來自於鄰居與其自身的資訊來構造控制律，這種控制策略不僅顯著减少了通信負載，同時也大大增强了網絡動態系統的魯棒性和靈活性。然而，現時針對多智能體系統的分佈式最優協同問題的研究通常假設智能體之間的通信網絡拓撲是無向圖，或者至多是平衡有向圖。 此外，大多數現有工作中提出的控制策略均依賴於有關網絡連通性和/或目標函數的某些全域資訊，因此不是完全分佈式的。在許多實際場景中，由於各種複雜的環境和硬體限制等原因，這些關於網絡連通性和目標函數等全域資訊的假設很難得到滿足。事實上，在實際場景中，智能體之間的通信網絡拓撲通常是不平衡的有向圖，並且所需的全域資訊通常是不可使用的。因此，本項目旨在開發一個分佈式控制框架，以解决在不平衡有向圖上具有一般智能體動態的多智能體系統的完全分佈式最優協同控制問題。解决該問題的主要挑戰在於通信拓撲的不平衡性、缺乏全域資訊以及一般智能體動力學的複雜性。本項目將提出新型的基於自適應控制的完全分佈式輸出反饋控制策略，並在不平衡有向通信拓撲上建立閉環多智能體系統的最優性和穩定性。

11210622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11210622.value: 自動駕駛系統的不確定性的建模及處理

11210622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11210622.value: The cornerstone of an autonomous vehicle is driving safety, which is jointly determined by perception, prediction, motion planning, and control in an autonomous driving system. The performance of the above modules is highly subject to various uncertainties caused by adverse weather or imperfect deep machine learning algorithms. Moreover, the impact of uncertainties may propagate from an upstream task to its downstream tasks. In the literature, uncertainties are modelled separately in different tasks, which cannot capture uncertainties coherently, leading to either over-optimistic or over-conservative driving decisions. This project tackles the above critical problem by developing a unified framework to handle uncertainties in an end-to-end manner. In particular, uncertainties from perception and prediction will be quantified and represented in a unified format as a probabilistic occupancy map. To smoothly integrate existing motion planning algorithms into our framework, we will extend existing motion planning algorithms into their robust versions. In particular, for mathematical-based motion planning, we will derive probabilistic constraints from the probabilistic occupancy map so that traditional optimization approaches can handle uncertainties by planning the optimal trajectory satisfying the probabilistic constraints. For learning-based motion planning, we will derive potential collision probability from the probabilistic occupancy map and add it into the loss function of learning-based motion planning. In addition, to achieve a good balance between robustness and other performance metrics, we enable the motion planning task to output a safe driving corridor so that the control task can find the optimal commands to constitute the running trajectory bounded by the given safe driving corridor. To evaluate the robustness of an autonomous driving system as a whole as well as the robustness of individual tasks, we plan to develop a benchmark suite consisting of typical traffic scenarios in different weather conditions, feasible alternative trajectories, and safety metrics. In summary, the project will provide (1) a unified representation for different types of uncertainties which can be used across the pipeline of an autonomous driving system, (2) a new interface between upstream tasks and downstream tasks to inherit uncertainty consideration, (3) a generic approach to incorporate uncertainty awareness into existing motion planning and control algorithms, and (4) a benchmark suite tailored for robustness evaluation. This project will improve the robustness of autonomous driving systems and relieve the safety concern of the public towards autonomous vehicles. 自動駕駛汽車的基石是駕駛安全。駕駛安全是由自動駕駛系統中的感知、預測、運動規劃和控制共同決定的。上述模塊的性能高度受惡劣天氣或不完善的深度機器學習算法造成的各種不確定性影響。此外，不確定性的影響可能會從上游任務傳播到其下游任務。現有工作通常將不確定性在不同的任務中分別建模， 這樣非系統性的處理方法，容易導致過度樂觀或過度保守的駕駛決策。該項目通過開發一個統一的，端到端的框架處理不確定性。為了系統地對駕駛系統的不確定性進行建模，我們擬將來自感知和預測的不確定性將量化並以統一格式表示為概率佔用圖；為了將現有的運動規划算法順利集成到我們的框架中，我們將現有的運動規划算法擴展到其具備魯棒性的版本。特別是，對於基於數學的運動規劃，我們將從概率佔用圖導出概率約束，以便傳統的優化方法可以通過規劃滿足概率約束的最優軌跡來處理不確定性。對於基於學習的運動規劃，我們將從概率佔用圖推導出潛在的碰撞概率，並將其添加到基於學習的運動規劃的損失函數中。此外，為了在魯棒性和其他性能指標之間取得良好的平衡，我們使運動規劃任務能夠輸出安全駕駛區間，以便控制任務能夠找到最優命令來構成給定安全駕駛區間所界定的運行軌跡。為了評估整個自動駕駛系統的魯棒性以及單個任務的魯棒性，我們計劃開發一個基準套件，包括不同天氣條件下的典型交通場景、可行的替代軌跡和安全指標。總之，該項目將提供 (1) 不同類型不確定性的統一表示，使其可在自動駕駛系統的各個模塊上使用，(2) 上游任務和下游任務之間的新接口以繼承不確定性考慮，(3 ) 一種將不確定性納入現有運動規劃和控制算法的通用方法，以及 (4) 為魯棒性評估量身定制的基準套件。該項目將提高自動駕駛系統的魯棒性，減輕公眾對自動駕駛汽車的安全擔憂。

11210822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11210822.value: 利用表面張力加工柔性壓電材料、傳感器和能量採集器

11210822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11210822.value: Prof LI, Wen Jung Prof Zhang, Guangzu

11210822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11210822.value: Is there a flexible manufacturing way to create piezoelectric materials with customizable piezoelectric and mechanical properties? This fundamental question originates from the practical applications of piezoelectricity in sensors and energy harvesters and requires innovative solutions from mechanical and materials engineering. Solving this problem will greatly improve the performance of flexible electronics and mechanical energy harvesters, especially those interact with humans, while minimizing adverse effects on the host. One promising solution is offered by piezoelectric ceramic-polymer composite. However, for most existing composites where piezoelectric ceramic nanostructures are evenly infiltrated into polymers, the stiffness mismatch and spatial discontinuity between ceramic fillers and polymer matrix greatly hinder the force transmission, leading to the degradation of their piezoelectric performance. We propose to develop a simple, inexpensive and customizable method for fabricating piezoceramic composites with excellent piezoelectric properties and outstanding flexibility by utilizing the surface tension effect. Surface tension is widely observed in gas-liquid and liquid-liquid interfaces and has been extensively used in a variety of liquid-related industries. This proposal for the first time introduces the surface tension effect into the manufacturing of solid piezoceramic composites. Via this method, one can easily adjust the piezoceramic distribution, pattern shapes, thickness, elastic modulus, and even stretchability of composites, which will provide a large design freedom for sensors and energy harvesters. We further propose to explore structural engineering strategies of modulus grading and patterning to achieve a synergistic improvement in mechanical and piezoelectric properties. To develop the new surface-tension assisted manufacturing method, the following critical engineering challenges and scientific issues must be addressed: 1) forming and tuning surface-tension liquid films and sintering piezoceramic films; 2) theoretically and experimentally developing a design principle for the film formation, thickness and curvature control; 3) exploring modulus grading and geometric patterning strategies for customizing localized and global piezoelectric and mechanical properties; 4) demonstrating the technology at the device level by developing flexible shoe energy harvesters and stretchable fingertip sensor arrays. Details of our methodologies designed to address these issues are discussed in the proposal. We believe that the new technologies developed in this project will provide an entirely new paradigm for piezoelectric material fabrication with high piezoelectricity and flexibility, which could find applications in the advanced fields of smart materials, sensors, actuators, the Internet of Things, and medical and consumer electronics. 如何加工壓電材料實現機械性能和壓電性能的可定製化？ 這個基礎問題起源於壓電材料在能量採集器和感測器方面的應用，需要創新的解決方案。 一個很有前景的思路是開發壓電陶瓷-聚合物複合材料。 但是，大部分現複合材料，其陶瓷填料和聚合物基體之間的剛度失配和空間不連續性極大地阻礙了力的傳遞，導致其壓電性能下降。 我們建議開發一種簡單、廉價和可定製的方法，利用表面張力效應製造具有優異壓電性能和出色柔韌性的壓電陶瓷複合材料。 表面張力在氣-液和液-液介面中廣泛觀察到，並已廣泛用於各種與液體相關的行業。 該提議首次將表面張力效應引入固體壓電陶瓷複合材料的製造中。 通過這種方法，可以輕鬆調整複合材料的壓電陶瓷分佈、圖案形狀、厚度、彈性模組甚至拉伸性，這將為感測器和能量收集器提供很大的設計自由度。 我們進一步建議探索模量分級和圖案化的結構工程策略，以實現機械和壓電性能的協同改進。 該專案開發的新技術將為具有高壓電性和柔性的壓電材料製造提供全新的範式，可在智慧材料、感測器、執行器、物聯網、醫療和醫療等先進領域找到應用。

11211122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11211122.value: Tera-Hybrid: 集成智能反射面和無人機的太赫茲混合網絡

11211122.label: Project Objectives
11211122.value: Investigation of a hybrid network composed of THz/ mmWave/ RF bands Characterization of the coverage and rate performance of IRS-assisted THz hybrid network Assessment and resource optimization of the IRS-UAV assisted THz hybrid network
rows: Investigation of a hybrid network composed of THz/ mmWave/ RF bands
Characterization of the coverage and rate performance of IRS-assisted THz hybrid network
Assessment and resource optimization of the IRS-UAV assisted THz hybrid network

11211122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11211122.value: 太赫茲（THz）通信被視爲支持第六代（6G）無綫網絡的指數級流量增長的關鍵使能技術。然而獨立部署太赫茲節點的方式受限于其有限的覆蓋範圍和低穿透性，將難以提供廣泛的覆蓋。在設備層面，可以通過使用高增益定向波束成形來緩解太赫茲頻段的短傳輸範圍。然而，爲了太赫茲頻段能夠作爲6G網絡的關鍵使能技術並促進其在行業内的采用，開發能夠利用智能反射面和多跳傳輸技術來集成太赫茲，毫米波（mmWave）和射頻（RF）的網絡基礎設施以支持和補充太赫茲通信就顯得至關重要。 該項目旨在設計一個集成智能反射面（IRS）和無人機（UAV）的太赫茲、毫米波和射頻頻段的混合網絡。該項目的主要挑戰是缺乏一個分析框架去評估太赫茲網絡的性能和其對不同頻段的依賴性，由於太赫茲通信複雜的傳播特性導致這些仍然是懸而未決的問題。該項目將會利用包括太赫茲頻段的干擾模型，基於非泊松點過程的隨機幾何分析，以及基於智能反射面的多跳傳輸的信道分析等新技術概念。本項目所提出的網絡可以1）根據鏈路質量靈活利用由太赫茲、毫米波和射頻頻段組成的頻率資源池，2）為終端用戶提供最佳服務質量，3）實現廣泛無處不在的覆蓋範圍。我們的目標是開發一個分析框架來評估IRS-UAV太赫茲混合網絡的性能，包括可實現速率，覆蓋率，中斷概率和能量效率。除了干擾模型以外，我們還將考慮安裝在無人機和地面物體上的智能反射面對網絡的影響，并為IRS輔助的太赫茲網絡設計協作波束路由。 爲了驗證擬議網絡設計的性能，我們將會開發IRS-UAV 輔助太赫茲混合網絡的軟件測試平台，其中采用的傳播參數將直接從香港城市大學的設施測出。該項目的成功完成，將會為太赫茲、毫米波和射頻混合網絡建立性能基準，并且實現IRS-UAV太赫茲混合網絡的統一設計。該項目將大大有助於提升香港在無線通訊行業的全球競爭力。

11211422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11211422.value: 云计算中外包数据的安全且压缩的键值存储

11211422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11211422.value: Key-value (KV for short) store is one of the most popular types of data storage for big data in the cloud. For the concern of data security and privacy, many organizations encrypt their data and outsource the data to the cloud. As the data size ever increasing, it is also important to compress the data stored in the cloud. However, it is a challenging task to combine data encryption with compression. The principal goal of this project is to develop an efficient and secure scheme to compress and encrypt the KV stores outsourced to the cloud. There are three tasks of this project: 1) Develop a mathematical model for analysis of storage cost and bandwidth cost in a KV store with data compression and encryption, and determine the optimal pack size for compression to achieve the best trade-off between storage and bandwidth costs. 2) Design an encrypted and compressed KV store that achieves frequency-security and length-security efficiently. The system shall be secure that it hides access frequencies and lengths of KV pairs and shall be efficient that it incurs minimal bandwidth and storage overheads to achieve the specified security requirements. 3) Design the algorithms for the dynamic management of the KV system. It includes the support of insert/delete operations of KV pairs and the dynamic adaptation of the proposed security scheme under the change of access frequencies of KV pairs. 键值（简称KV）存储是云中大数据最流行的数据存储类型之一。出于对数据安全和隐私的考虑，许多组织对其数据进行加密并将加密后的数据外包到云端。随着数据量的不断增加，压缩存储在云中的数据是很重要的。然而，将数据加密与压缩相结合是一项具有挑战性的工作。本项目的主要目标是构建一种高效且安全的方案来压缩和加密外包到云端的 KV 存储。本项目有三个任务：1) 建立一个数学模型，用于分析KV存储中数据压缩和加密的存储成本和带宽成本，并确定压缩的最优包大小，以实现存储开销和加密开销之间的最佳平衡。2）设计一个可高效地实现频率安全和长度安全的加密压缩KV存储。该系统应能安全的隐藏键值对的访问频率和长度，并能以最小的带宽开销和存储开销为代价，高效地实现指定的安全需求。 3) 设计KV存储系统动态管理算法。包括对键值对的插入/删除操作的支持，以及当键值对访问频率发生变化时对所提出的安全方案的动态适应的支持。

11211922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11211922.value: 自驅動交互式傳感顯示設備中的顏色調控

11211922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11211922.value: User-interactive displays, which can detect and visualize sensible but invisible information such as touch, smell, and sound, are of great significance in the upcoming hyper-connected society. Interactive displays typically involve a stimuli-responsive sensor and a human-readable apparatus. To date, several interactive sensing displays have been developed for visualizing environmental changes in pressure, temperature, and humidity. These interactive displays are usually based on light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and alternating current-driven electroluminescence (ACEL) devices, which need an external electrical energy supply for light emission. Such operation mode causes energy dissipation and limits the widespread application of interactive displays. Ideally, there are rich energy resources in the natural environment, such as solar energy, thermal energy, and ubiquitous mechanical energy. Therefore, harvesting energy from the ambient environment, especially ubiquitous mechanical energy, can offer a sustainable solution to the energy supply issue of interactive displays. In previous attempts, interactive displays have been achieved by means of mechanical-to-optical energy conversion, known as mechanoluminescence (ML). However, ML processes are typically triggered by high threshold stress (in the order of MPa), leading to unsatisfactory brightness in many applications that can hardly be perceived under ambient light conditions. Besides, the sensitivity is limited because the ML signals merely reveal intensity contrast in response to stimulus variation such as dynamic change of stress. In this regard, we proposed to develop high-brightness interactive sensing displays based on triboelectrification-induced electroluminescence (TIEL) that can be excited by extremely weak stimuli (< 10 KPa). We seek to devise a class of novel devices that combine high-output triboelectric nanogenerators with multicomponent electroluminescent active layers. We aim to achieve self-powered, durable, and highly efficient systems that accurately visualize external stimulus change through multicolor switching. The developments will enable potential applications such as pressure mapping and personal information security, which are expected to render self-sustainable light and pave the way for new wearable electronics with reduced energy consumption. 交互式顯示設備能夠檢測並可視化觸感、氣味、聲音等敏感但不可見的信息，在即將到來的超連接社會具有重大意義。交互式顯示設備通常涉及刺激響應傳感器和人眼可讀器件。迄今為止，人們已經開發出多種交互式傳感顯示設備，並用於監測壓力、溫度和濕度等環境因素的變化。這些交互式顯示設備通常基於發光二極管(LED)和交流電驅動的電致發光(ACEL)器件，其操作過程需要持續的外部電能供應。這種操作模式導致能量耗散並限制了交互式顯示的廣泛應用。由於自然環境中存在豐富的天然資源，如太陽能、熱能和機械能，因此從周圍環境提取能量，尤其是隨處可得的機械能，可為交互式顯示設備提供可持續的能源供應。在前期研究中，交互式顯示已通過應力發光（ML）的形式實現機械力驅動。但是，ML過程通常需要高閾值應力（MPa級）觸發，導致在許多應用中顯示亮度不理想，在環境光下幾乎無法感知。此外，ML信號僅對動態壓力的變化有響應，因此靈敏度有限。對此，我們提出開發基於摩擦起電感應電致發光(TIEL)的高亮度交互式傳感顯示器，用以實現在極弱機械刺激（< 10 KPa）下的激發過程。我們尋求設計一類小型化、整合高輸出摩擦納米發電機與多組分電致發光活性層的裝置。我們的目標是實現自供電、耐用、高效的系統，準確地將外部刺激變化轉換為多色可視化信號。這些發展將使潛在的應用成為可能，例如壓力測繪和個人信息安全，這有望為構築可持續光源及低能耗的新型可穿戴電子設備鋪平道路。

11212422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11212422.value: 於房間火災中使用正壓通風機的研究

11212422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11212422.value: Positive pressure ventilators (PPVs) are increasingly used in building firefighting, referred to as ‘positive ventilation attack’. PPVs are intended to improve visibility and reduce air temperatures. However, firefighting with PPVs is only half as effective as fighting large, ventilation-controlled room fires in old buildings with small rooms used for mini-storage areas storing large amounts of combustibles. The addition of PPV air to such a fire causes a larger fire, faster heat release, and more toxic smoke. Therefore, operational guidance on PPV use is required to avoid converting ventilation-controlled fires into large fires. This guidance needs a scientific basis, especially for the effect of PPVs on room fires, which will be studied in the proposed project. Room fire dynamics will be studied in an example single room (4 m × 3 m × 2.8 m) under the action of a PPV. Firefighters reported difficulties judging whether the room with smoke coming out of a storage area was the fire room. To address this issue of complicated mini-storage geometry, the example room will be linked to another room (4 m × 9 m × 2.8 m) to study the action of PPV. This two-room model will be subjected to two sets of experiments at different scales (1:10 and 1:5). The PPV will supply air at various flow rates through an entrance door with various window-opening configurations in the example room. Fires with varying characteristics will be ignited under various ventilation conditions. The flame characteristics in the room model, such as colour, shape oscillations, and precision, will be investigated. Analytical studies on room fires were conducted under various ventilation conditions. The scale-model experiments will then be used to identify key hazardous scenarios for full-scale burning tests. The mathematical models of room fires will be developed to reproduce the observed burning behaviour in the room model under the action of PPVs. Numerical simulations using computational fluid dynamics will be applied to elucidate the fire-induced air flow. Scaling rules from the literature will be evaluated and modified to improve studying room fires with PPV. The proposed project’s findings will have a direct impact on rationalising and improving the deployment of PPVs during and after a fire. 正壓通風機越來越多應用於撲滅建築物火災，被稱為“正壓通風攻擊”。正壓通風機旨在提高能見度並降低氣溫。然而，在用作迷你倉儲物的舊建築物當中有多個細小房間存儲大量可燃物, 使用正壓通風機的效果並不理想。在這種火災中使用正壓通風機添加空氣會導致更大的火災、更快的釋放熱量和更多的有毒煙霧。因此，需要訂立使用正壓通風機的操作指南，以避免將通風控制的火災轉變為大火。該指南需要科學依據，特別是有關正壓通風機對房間火災的影響。這議題將會在此研究項目中進行研究。 在正壓通風機的作用下，將對一個示例房間（4 米 × 3 米 × 2.8 米）內的火災動力學進行研究。有消防員曾經指出在儲物倉火災中，難以判斷冒出煙霧的房間是否就是起火的房間。為了解決這個複雜的迷你倉佈局問題，示例房間會連接到另一個房間（4 米 × 9 米 × 2.8 米）, 以研究正壓通風機的作用。在這個兩房模型內, 會進行兩組不同比例的實驗, 分別是1比10和1比5。正壓通風機會通過示例房間中具有各種窗口配置的入口供應不同流速的空氣。在不同的通風條件下，會點燃具有不同特徵的火，並會對房間模型中的火焰特性，例如顏色和形狀等進行研究。在各種通風條件下對房間火災進行分析研究。然後，會利用比例模型實驗確定全尺寸燃燒測試的關鍵火災場景。此外，將會開發房間火災的數學模型，以重現在正壓通風機的作用下房間模型中觀察到的燃燒行為。將應用計算流體動力學的數值模擬來闡明火災引起的氣流，並會評估和修改文獻中的比例規則，以改進針對於房間火災使用正壓通風機的研究。此研究項目的結果將對改進火災期間和火災之後運用正壓通風機的部署產生直接影響。

11212722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11212722.value: Using magnetically powered microagents as carriers to deliver drugs or cells precisely is a promising technology for targeted therapy. However, imaging methods used for guiding in vivo microagent navigation are limited by low resolution and shallow penetration depth, which hinder the application of microagent delivery in real targeted therapy tasks. Therefore, studies should explore how to converge microagents to the desired position without sufficient support of real-time imaging feedback. Here, we propose a new solution by using a rotating gradient-based magnetic field to drive magnetic microagent swarms. In the proposed method, the gradient magnetic field can be rotated by sequentially energizing each coil of the electromagnetic coil system. With this method, a high magnetic field gradient concentrated onto a specific target site in a lesion tissue is generated, which will attract microagent swarms to automatically converge to the target site from different directions under the action of this equivalent centripetal force. After characterizing the relationship between the current inputs of coils and the location of the aggregation center, the target site can be adjusted in the entire workspace by changing the coil current inputs. This new magnetic driving mechanism has three important advantages. First, in comparison with traditional gradient-based magnetic actuation, it drives each microagent to rotate while moving forward, thereby reducing the viscous resistance and friction on microagents and improving their motion ability. The shape design of microagents remains unrestricted. Second, this method does not rely on a specific trajectory plan and real-time visual guidance to navigate microagents. In this way, it greatly simplifies its practical applications. Third, this method can drive different magnetic microagents despite variation in their physical properties such as size, shape, and materials. It is also not affected by the initial swarm distribution density. Experiments and preclinical studies will be conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in converging microagent swarms automatically without dependence on real-time image feedback. This research will provide a basis for using microagent delivery in clinical applications and precision targeted therapy. N/A

11212822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11212822.value: 液滴微流控多維度單細胞分析應用於精準免疫治療

11212822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11212822.value: 自然界中，許多動物(例如鯨魚)具有特異性的強化免疫系統，所以得到癌症的機率很低。免疫療法藉由強化患者本身免疫細胞治療癌症，預示著未來個性化醫療的可能。然而儘管免疫療法在許多案例中展示了成功的治療結果，因為患者個體差異，而造成不可預測的治療成效。這可能歸因於患者免疫細胞異質性和細胞產品與個別患者的相容性。這使得我們有必要對免疫單細胞多維度測量。包括表型，蛋白質分泌物，殺死癌細胞能力，與轉錄基因模組等。目前依然沒有可靠的高通量平台來大規模地多維度分析免疫單細胞。此計畫，我們將開發一種以膽固醇分子為基礎的高通量單細胞表型析技術。並將此技術應用於篩選具有免疫反應的免疫細胞，藉由多維度分析單細胞揭示免疫系統中單細胞異質性，實現個性化免疫治療。本研究涉及三個部分。第一，合成膽固醇捕獲抗體。膽固醇連接的抗體將錨定在細胞表面以捕獲其分泌的蛋白質。然後將捕獲的蛋白質標記與分析。第二，開發微流控液滴注射器細胞裝載裝置，將單個免疫細胞和單個癌細胞共同封裝在液滴中。捕獲被殺死癌細胞的降解蛋白。通過標記與分析這些捕獲蛋白質測量免疫細胞殺死癌細胞的效率。藉由分選與測序免疫細胞進行多維度分析（分泌組學+細胞毒性+轉錄組學）。第三，我們將展示兩種免疫療法應用：第一 藉由TCR-T免疫單細胞多維度分析，指導TCR-T免疫細胞製作流程，優化低成本的TCR-T免疫細胞製作工序。第二，篩選具有針對患者的HCC肝癌細胞特異性的TCR-T免疫細胞，藉由多維度分析選取具功能性且對於患者最佳的TCR 成功實現肝癌個性化免疫療法。

11212922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11212922.value: 基於人工神經網路之鋰離子電池穩定和火災安全的雙功能管理系統

11212922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11212922.value: Prof Lee, Wai-ming Prof WANG, Jian

11212922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11212922.value: 在全球工業的發展中，傳統燃料的廣泛使用帶來了大量的溫室氣體排放，這損害了環境並加速全球暖化。因此，開發新能源交通運輸系统如電動汽車（EV）等成為迫切需要。在儲能設備中，具有高能量密度、長壽命和高效率的鋰離子電池（LIB）一直被視為市場上流行的替代品和蓬勃發展。然而，它們的高能量密度和較低的熱穩定性的特性為熱安全問題帶來了關鍵挑戰。鑒於LIB對工作溫度敏感，研究人員正努力開發用於散熱和控制電池組中的電池溫度的電池熱管理系統（BTMSs）。 然而，目前的BTMSs大多是基於有限的參數設置進行設計或作出比對比，很難同時關注多個參數。某些未知或未納入設計的參數亦會導致一些研究差距而影響系統優化。機器學習技術的實現，或者更具體地說，人工神經網路（ANN），可以是進行系統優化的潛在方法。雖然之前的一些研究證明了使用ANN可以解決電池熱穩定問題的效率，但據我們所知，ANN在電池研究中的應用還處於起步階段，實現ANN到電池系統設計和優化的空間仍然很大。例如， LIB電池組的詳細溫度分佈尚未得到充分研究。 此外，因為電池火災不時會發生，更安全的BTMS還應該具有減輕電池熱失控（TR）的能力。然而，關於BTMS中智慧保護系統設計的可用資訊仍然非常有限。據我們所知，目前基於ANN的BTMS同時俱備雙重功能（即在正常使用中控制溫度和預測極端條件下的TR傳播）的相關研究仍然不缺乏。 本專案旨在為LIB開發一種基於ANN的雙功能的創新BTMS，從而有效地改善其熱安全和消防安全的管理。本研究將基於綜合數據（收集包括實驗數據和具有數學模型分析的CFD模擬結果）以建立和訓練ANN模型。本專案的成果可能為未來的BTMS設計提供新的參考和指導。

11213022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11213022.value: 配備人工智能科技的反應性分子動力學模擬 水泥水化過程

11213022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11213022.value: Cement hydration plays a significant role in determining the mechanical properties of cementitious materials. Indeed, hydrated cement paste, which is the key product of cement hydration, connects various constituents in concrete including coarse and fine aggregates, admixtures and additives together. With a thorough understanding of cement hydration, advanced material development of cementitious materials from the fundamental atomistic perspective becomes feasible and the strength of hydrated cement paste can be improved by several multiples. Traditional approaches of understanding cement hydration and its related products are mainly based on experimental and theoretical analyses, in which the fundamental steps and reaction mechanism during the cement hydration process can hardly be clarified. Such knowledge of cement hydration should be investigated using advanced technology that can provide detailed information from nanoscale. In recent decades, reactive molecular dynamics (MD) simulation has been adopted as a powerful tool to describe various chemical reactions involving bond breaking and formation. However, conventional reactive forcefield (ReaxFF) may not be capable of describing the entire cement hydration process accurately in view of the complexity of the involved materials and there is a great need for further refinement and optimization of ReaxFF parameters in cementitious materials. With the recent development of artificial intelligence (AI), a predictive model of cement hydration based on the integration of AI and ReaxFF is believed to be promising for addressing the existing limitation. The objective of this research is to investigate the hydration process of dicalcium silicate, which is more abundant than tricalcium aluminate and controls a larger number of engineering properties of cements, using reactive MD simulations equipped with AI technique, together with experimental validations. Here, a comprehensive database for the hydrated product of dicalcium silicate will firstly be developed, which will be used in the AI algorithm. Then, the selected AI algorithm will be programmed using C++ and Python such that it becomes compatible with the codes of MD simulations. Afterwards, the featured parameters will be trained and a correct predictive model will be derived with experimental validations using X-ray diffraction, fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy and nanoindentation. Synergizing the knowledge developed in these research tasks, this proposed research will provide fundamental knowledge of cement chemistry and it is envisioned that material engineers can easily predict the performance of cementitious materials using this AI assisted reactive MD simulation approach, which leads to more sustainable applications of cementitious materials in new construction and retrofitting industries. 水泥水化在决定水泥基材料的力學性能方面起著重要作用。硬化水泥漿體是水泥水化的重要產物，它將混凝土中的各種成分（包括粗骨料和細骨料、外加劑和添加劑）連接在一起。隨著對水泥水化的深入瞭解，可以實現從基礎的原子學角度開發以水泥基材料為基礎的先進材料，從而實現強度被提高數倍的硬化水泥漿體。研究水泥水化及其相關產物的傳統途徑主要基於實驗和理論分析，難以闡明水泥水化過程中的基本步驟和反應機理。因此，應使用可以提供納米級詳細資訊的先進科技來研究水泥水化的相關知識。近幾十年來，反應分子動力學（MD）類比已被用作描述涉及鍵斷裂和形成的各種化學反應的強大工具。然而，考慮到所涉及資料的複雜性，傳統的反應力場（ReaxFF）可能無法準確地描述整個水泥水化過程，並且非常需要進一步細化和優化水泥基材料中的ReaxFF參數。 隨著人工智能（AI）的最新發展，我們相信基於AI和ReaxFF集成的水泥水化預測模型可以解決現有研究的局限性。 本研究旨在通過配備AI科技的反應性MD類比以及實驗驗證研究矽酸二鈣的水化過程。矽酸二鈣的水化過程比鋁酸三鈣更豐富，進以控制著水泥工程性能。首先我們將首先建立和開發用於人工智能算灋的矽酸二鈣水合產物的數據集。然後，我們將使用C++和Python對選定的AI算灋進行程式設計，並使其與MD類比的程式碼相容。之後，我們將訓練特徵參數，並通過使用X射線衍射、傅立葉轉換紅外光譜、掃描電子顯微鏡和納米壓痕進行實驗驗證，得出正確的預測模型。 結合這些研究任務中開發的知識，本研究將提供水泥化學的基礎知識，幫助材料工程師使用這種人工智慧輔助反應MD類比方法輕鬆預測水泥基材料的性能，從而促進水泥基材料在新興建築業和建築翻新行業中的更永續的應用。
