11313222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11313222.value: Photodynamic therapy is emerging as a promising technique for cancer treatment. Several photodynamic therapeutic agents have been applied in clinical settings. The process involves the combined use of light, photosensitizers, and oxygen to execute energy or electron transfer, generating reactive oxygen species to eradicate tumor cells. However, traditional photosensitizers indirectly damage biomolecules in an oxygen-dependent manner, limiting their therapeutic efficacy in the hypoxic (oxygen-starved) tumor microenvironment. In addition, the short excitation wavelengths of classical photosensitizers limit the tumor types that can be cured by photodynamic therapy. In this proposed project, we aim to address the limitations of the current light-driven cancer treatments by developing a class of near-infrared (NIR)-activatable photooxidants that can directly damage survival-related intracellular biomolecules in an oxygen-independent manner. Our preliminary data show that when a Pt(IV) moiety is conjugated with a photosensitive ligand, the Pt(IV) complex but not the ligand displays remarkably strong photooxidative capability. Without the need of oxygen, the photooxidant can oxidize a variety of biomolecules that traditional oxidants cannot oxidize. More importantly, the photooxidant is able to enter cells efficiently, be activated by NIR light in a controllable fashion, and effectively oxidize intracellular biomolecules, leading to more than 222-fold increased photocytotoxicity compared with the clinical drug carboplatin in drug-resistant human cancer cells. Based on these preliminary data, we plan to design and synthesize a small class of Pt(IV) photooxidants in which different types of photosensitive ligands are conjugated at various positions of Pt(IV) motifs. The stability and photooxidative ability of the photooxidants will be examined. The cellular uptake, photocytotoxicity, and oxidative ability in drug-resistant cells, including cancer stem cells, will be determined. We will also investigate the cell death mechanism induced by these photooxidants. Moreover, the antitumor activity of any lead compound in vivo will be studied. The proposed research may provide a new paradigm in anticancer phototherapy by developing NIR-activatable Pt-based photooxidants with a distinct mode of action. Such new phototherapeutic modality to directly oxidize intracellular biomolecules may address the limitations of conventional photosensitizers, achieve improved therapeutic efficacy, and circumvent drug resistance. In addition, our proposed research may highlight the importance of the photooxidative ability of photoactivatable metal complexes and the resulting applications of this ability to anticancer chemotherapy. 光動力療法是一種具有極大潛力的新興腫瘤治療手段，受到了人們廣泛的關注，目前已有多個光敏劑進入臨床。光動力療法主要利用光敏劑在光照激活後能夠將電子或者能量轉移給氧氣的特性，在腫瘤細胞內生成大量的活性氧類物質來消滅腫瘤細胞。然而，傳統的光敏劑並不能直接攻擊腫瘤細胞，而實體腫瘤組織的乏氧微環境又極大地限制了光敏劑產生活性氧類物質的能力，從而導致傳統光動力療法對實體腫瘤的治療效果欠佳。此外，現有的光敏劑所需的激活波長較短，對人體組織的穿透能力較差，進一步限制了光動力療法在臨床腫瘤治療的應用範圍。在本項目中，我們計劃構建能夠被近紅外光活化、且能夠以不依賴氧氣的方式直接攻擊腫瘤細胞生存相關生物分子的光氧化劑來作為新一代光動力治療試劑。前期研究結果表明，將四價鉑前藥與特定光敏配體共價結合，所獲得的光敏四價鉑前藥表現出顯著強於光敏配體本身的光氧化能力，使得其能夠以不依賴氧氣的方式直接氧化、破壞多種難以被常規氧化劑氧化的生物分子，從而引起腫瘤細胞損傷。該四價鉑光氧化劑能夠有效地進入腫瘤細胞，在近紅外光照射活化後，其抗腫瘤活性比母體藥物卡鉑高出了222倍，並能夠有效地克服腫瘤細胞對鉑類藥物的耐藥性。在前期研究結果的基礎上，我們計劃通過將多種光敏配體與四價鉑前藥的不同配位點結合，設計合成一系列高效的四價鉑光氧化劑。將研究所合成配合物在生理環境中的穩定性和光激活特性，並通過細胞實驗研究所合成的光氧化劑光毒性、細胞攝入能力、光氧化能力。將重點研究這些光氧化劑對包括腫瘤幹細胞在內的腫瘤耐藥細胞的殺傷效果，篩選出具有潛力的先導化合物，並開展一系列實驗研究揭示光氧化劑的抗腫瘤機理，闡明相關的細胞死亡模式和信號通路。隨後，我們將在通過體內抗腫瘤實驗來進一步研究光氧化劑的抗腫瘤能力。本項目提出的鉑類光氧化劑是一類具有全新抗腫瘤機理的新型光學抗腫瘤配合物，其能夠以不依賴氧氣的方式來直接攻擊生物分子並消滅腫瘤細胞，不但有效地解決了傳統光動力療法在實體瘤乏氧環境中效果受限的痛點，同時能夠有效地克服腫瘤細胞對傳統化療藥物的耐藥性，極大地改善腫瘤的治療效果。同時，我們的研究也將展示金屬配合物的光氧化能力在其抗腫瘤過程中起到的重要作用，為進一步發展金屬抗腫瘤配合物提供了新的研究方向，並為開發新一代高效低毒的金屬抗腫瘤配合物提供了堅實的科學依據。

11313322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11313322.value: DNA紐結穿過納米孔以及該過程在測量DNA-DNA相互作用和DNA大角度彎曲中的應用

11313322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11313322.value: 納米孔不僅可用於測量單鏈 DNA 的序列，還可用於測量雙鏈 DNA 的構象特性。最近的納米孔實驗成功測量到雙鏈 DNA中自發形成的紐結。由於 DNA紐結對 DNA 物理參數極其敏感，原則上說，通過納米孔觀測DNA紐結，可以非常精確地測量 DNA物理參數的微小變化。然而，從 DNA紐結性質中提取 DNA物理參數並不是那麼直接，需要先得到兩者之間的定量關係。在這個研究項目中，我們將通過多尺度計算機模擬來建立DNA紐結性質與DNA物理參數之間的定量關係。該研究項目將會通過三個研究任務來實現。 首先，我們通過蒙特卡洛模擬來構建 DNA紐結概率 p_knot 與 DNA-DNA 相互作用強度之間的關係。 DNA-DNA 相互作用強度會用 DNA 等效硬球直徑 d_eff來量化。我們的初步結果顯示在 3 mol/L LiCl （氯化鋰）溶液中 d_eff < 2 nm，這表明 DNA-DNA 靜電吸引，這是一種違反直覺的現象。因為DNA帶負電，所以DNA之間通常是靜電排斥的。 其次，我們通過測量將 DNA 紐結結擠入納米孔所需的最小電壓或驅動力來研究DNA在大角度彎曲下的特性。最近的納米孔實驗觀察到，僅 250 mV 的電壓就可以將 DNA 結擠壓到 5 nm 的孔中，這表明 DNA 比預期的要軟得多。我們的模擬將揭示這種 DNA 軟化的機制並量化這種軟化。 第三，利用上述結果，我們將構建DNA穿過納米孔過程的相圖，包括紐結阻塞，紐結滑移，和紐結直接過孔三種情況。我們將通過朗之萬動力學模擬來構建該相圖。 總體而言，該項目將建立 DNA 物理性質與 DNA紐結之間的定量關係，這將使納米孔設備能夠精確測量 DNA-DNA 相互作用和DNA大角度彎曲的性質。我們的初步分析發現了，反直覺的 DNA-DNA 靜電相互作用以及DNA大角度彎曲下變軟。除了促進 DNA 分析技術的發展外，該結果還可用於定量理解生命體內 DNA 堆積方式，因為DNA堆積方式在很大程度上取決於 DNA-DNA 相互作用和DNA彎曲性質。

11314122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11314122.value: Metal halide perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) are a promising new-generation lighting technology with excellent optoelectronic properties and compatibility with low-cost solution processes. Over the past few years, PeLED efficiency has substantially improved, reaching external quantum efficiencies (EQEs) exceeding 20% for red and green PeLEDs and 12% for blue PeLEDs [1–3]. However, realising the potential of white PeLEDs (WPeLEDs) for solid-state lighting application represents a major challenge in this field, as an advanced LED design is needed to integrate different emission colours to generate white light. Although several reports have demonstrated the feasibility of constructing WPeLEDs using mixed perovskite phases [4], lanthanide metal doping [5 ], down-conversion methods [6] and tandem structures [7], WPeLED efficiency is unsatisfactory, lagging behind those of single-colour-emitting PeLEDs. Therefore, it is imperative to exploit new strategies to realise high-performance tri-colour WPeLEDs. In this project, we aim to develop high-performance tri-colour WPeLEDs with excellent EQEs, good colour-rendering properties and optimal operation stability, leading the evolution of WPeLEDs. To achieve white light emission, we propose a novel device architecture design that couples electroluminescence (EL) and down-conversion photoluminescence (PL) with complementary colours, i.e., an edge-cutting top-emissive PeLED structure consisting of a bottom blue PeLED driving cell and upper green and red perovskite layer down-converters. The top-emissive design will improve LED light extraction efficiency (LEE) by suppressing optical losses resulting from photon trappin in the glass substrate. An ultra-thin top transparent electrode will be introduced to optically couple the blue PeLED and the down-conversion layers, further reducing optical losses. The successful implementation of this proposed project will have far-reaching impacts for the development of high-efficiency and stable WPeLEDs, facilitating commercialisation. The optical design for improving LEE in this proposal is applicable to most LED materials and devices. 金属卤化钙钛矿发光二极管（PeLEDs）作为新一代照明技术，同时具有优异的光电性能以及低成本可溶液加工的优势。在过去的几年里，PeLEDs的发光效率取得了显著提高，红光以及绿光PeLEDs的外量子效率均超过20%，蓝光 PeLEDs 效率超过12%。然而，整合不同的发光颜色产生白光发射需要优异的器件设计，因此实现白光钙钛矿发光二极管 (WPeLED) 在固态照明领域的应用仍是一项重大挑战。尽管有研究表明，可通过使用混合钙钛矿相、镧系金属掺杂、下转换法 以及串联结构来实现 WPeLED，但 WPeLED 的效率仍不能令人满意，落后于单色 PeLEDs。因此，开发新策略来实现高性能三色 WPeLED 势在必行。在本项目中，我们将开发具有高EQE，高显色指数以及高稳定性的WPeLED，引领该领域的发展。为实现白光发射，我们提出了一种创新的器件结构，它将单色器件的电致发光与其互补色的下转换光致发光相结合，即由底部的蓝光 PeLED电致发光驱动单元以及上层的红光、绿光钙钛矿下转换层组成。其中顶发射器件的设计可以通过消除衬底模式中的光学损失来提高光取出效率。与此同时，通过引入超薄透明顶电极，可进一步耦合蓝光 PeLED以及顶部的下转换层，进一步降低光学损耗。该项目的成功实施，将对开发高效稳定的WPeLED以及促进其商业化产生重要影响，且本项目中用于提高LEE的光学设计适用于大多数LED材料与器件。

11314322.value: 基于二维半导体催化剂的电化学芯片在二氧化碳还原反应中的应用

11314322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11314322.value: 二氧化碳是目前全球最为关注的温室气体，是全球气候变化的核心推动力之一，人类目前的最佳应对策略，依然是全面减少人类社会的二氧化碳排放。然而，目前的全球减排进度远低于巴黎协定的最低标准。另一方，二氧化碳的捕捉和转化技术正逐渐成为减排以外的有效补充手段，得到了大量的关注。相对热转化等传统的二氧化碳回收技术，电化学二氧化碳还原技术能够直接通过电能将二氧化碳转化为乙烯、乙醇等化学品或化学燃料，是一种非常有前途的新型二氧化碳回收及转化技术，已成为近期的研究热点。高效廉价且稳定的电化学催化剂也正是目前二氧化碳还原技术的核心问题。然而，目前的二氧化碳还原反应的催化剂体系尚不完善，距离实际工业生产的要求有较大的差距，因此，开发新型催化剂体系迫在眉睫。在众多已开发的催化剂体系中，二维半导体催化材料由于其低廉的生产成本以及优异的催化性能，受到了一定的关注。与此同时，芯片电化学是近期出现的一种新型电化学测试方法，尤其擅长在复杂固液界面上研究纳米材料的电化学性能。本课题旨在开发一种针对二氧化碳还原反应的芯片电化学平台，通过结合芯片产业中成熟的微纳加工技术与生物医疗中常用的微流控技术，实现针对单个二维半导体纳米结构的二氧化碳还原反应研究。这种新型技术平台的成功研发，将有效的推进二氧化碳还原催化剂的研发，尤其将在新型二维纳米催化剂的研发中扮演重要的作用。

11314522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11314522.value: 生物素靶向的一氧化氮-酞氰自組裝納米粒用於克服腫瘤低氧耐光動力學治療的研究

11314522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11314522.value: Photodynamic therapy (PDT) has emerged as a compelling treatment modality for a range of superficial and localized cancer. It involves the excitation of a photosensitizer through light irradiation followed by interactions with endogenous oxygen to generate reactive oxygen species, particularly singlet oxygen, to cause cellular damage in tumor. Because of this unique mechanism, PDT exhibits various inherent superiorities, including the non-invasive nature, fast healing process, no apparent drug resistance, and few side effects. However, there are still some hurdles to be addressed to promote its clinical translation. The treatment outcome of PDT depends largely on the tumor specificity of the photosensitizers and the oxygen concentration around the tumor. To address the first issue, conjugation of photosensitizers with tumor-targeting ligands or control units that can activate the photosensitizers in the tumor microenvironment have been actively studied. For the second aspect, owing to the highly abnormal tumor microvasculature, tumor hypoxia is a common phenomenon, which is not favorable for PDT because of its oxygen-dependent nature. As a result, various approaches have been explored to improve the therapeutic efficacy of PDT against hypoxic tumors, including the use of oxygen carriers and in situ generation of oxygen through catalytic decomposition of hydrogen peroxide or reaction of peroxides with water. These approaches, however, still have some limitations, such as the tedious synthetic and fabrication protocols of the nanocarriers, low oxygen loading by the oxygen carriers, undesired reaction of peroxides with body fluids outside the tumor region, and the insufficient hydrogen peroxide level in tumor for in situ oxygen generation. In this proposal, we plan to design and synthesize a series of zinc(II) phthalocyanine-based photosensitizers substituted with a tumor-targeting biotin and different number of nitric oxide (NO)-releasing units that can self-assemble into nanoparticles in aqueous media. Upon biotin receptor-mediated endocytosis into cancer cells, the self-quenched phthalocyanine aggregates would be dissociated to restore the photosensitizing properties. The high intracellular glutathione level will trigger the release of NO, which can suppress the mitochondrial respiration and adenosine triphosphate production, thereby sparing more oxygen for PDT. It is expected that these self-assembled nanophotosensitizing systems with tumor-targeting and activatable properties, as well as an ability to inhibit cell respiration can exhibit NO-promoted PDT, particularly for eradication of hypoxic tumors. Using these nanosystems that can release different amounts of NO, we will further elucidate the roles of this fantastic gas in PDT using a series of in vitro and in vivo experiments. 光動力療法 (PDT) 已成為一系列淺表和局部癌症的引人注目的治療方式。它涉及通過光照射激發光敏劑，然後與內源性氧相互作用以產生活性氧，特別是單線態氧，從而在腫瘤中引起細胞損傷。由於這種獨特的機制，PDT表現出多種固有優勢，包括無創性、癒合快、無明顯耐藥性、副作用少等。然而，在促進其臨床轉化方面仍有一些障礙需要解決。 PDT的治療結果很大程度上取決於光敏劑的腫瘤特異性和腫瘤周圍的氧濃度。為了解決第一個問題，已經積極研究了光敏劑與腫瘤靶向配體或控制單元的結合，這些配體可以激活腫瘤微環境中的光敏劑。對於第二個方面，由於腫瘤微血管高度異常，腫瘤缺氧是一種普遍現象，由於其氧依賴性，不利於PDT。因此，已經探索了各種方法來提高 PDT 對缺氧腫瘤的治療效果，包括使用氧載體和通過過氧化氫的催化分解或過氧化物與水的反應原位產生氧氣。然而，這些方法仍然存在一些局限性，例如納米載體的繁瑣合成和製造方案、氧載體的低氧負載、過氧化物與腫瘤區域外的體液發生不良反應以及腫瘤中過氧化氫水平不足用於原位制氧。在本提案中，我們計劃設計和合成一系列基於鋅（II）酞菁的光敏劑，這些光敏劑用靶向腫瘤的生物素和不同數量的一氧化氮（NO）釋放單元替代，這些單元可以在水介質中自組裝成納米顆粒.在生物素受體介導的內吞作用進入癌細胞後，自猝滅的酞菁聚集體將被解離以恢復光敏特性。細胞內高水平的穀胱甘肽會觸發 NO 的釋放，從而抑制線粒體呼吸和三磷酸腺苷的產生，從而為 PDT 節省更多氧氣。預計這些具有腫瘤靶向和可激活特性以及抑制細胞呼吸能力的自組裝納米光敏系統可以表現出 NO 促進的 PDT，特別是用於根除缺氧腫瘤。使用這些可以釋放不同量 NO 的納米系統，我們將通過一系列體外和體內實驗進一步闡明這種奇妙氣體在 PDT 中的作用。

11314822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11314822.value: 含有偶極分子的電解質用於水性高能量雙離子的電池

11314822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11314822.value: 開發與可再生能源相結合的大規模儲能係統尤為重要。鋰離子電池（LIB）已成功應用於各種場景，但由於其著火和爆炸的問題，使得LIB不是絕對安全的候選者。水性電池是理想的選擇，因為它具有安全性和本質上低成本的天然優勢。然而，水系電池的主要缺點是輸出電壓低和比能量密度差。 電池的電壓和容量共同決定了它們的能量密度。電壓受到水性電解質狹窄的電化學穩定性視窗 (ESW) 的限制，這也限制了電極材料的選擇。拓寬水性電解質的 ESW 的一種可行方法是調節水氫鍵網絡和溶劑化鞘結構中的水分子。一個具有代表性的例子是“鹽包水”概念，但其缺點是成本高且化學環境太酸或太鹼。受工作原理的啟發，有一種很有前途的策略，即將小偶極分子引入水性電解質中，以破壞水分子之間的氫鍵網絡並改變溶劑鞘結構。 二維層狀材料中的陰離子插層具有較高的理論電位，例如超過 2 V。因此，通過將這種機制與具有較低工作電位的陽離子工作負極相結合，有望開發出一種高能水性雙離子電池。此外，全電池的輸出電壓可以通過優化陽離子和陰離子的嵌入能和溶劑化能以及它們的匹配來進一步控制。 在這個項目中，我們將開發基於乙醯胺、甘油和赤蘚糖醇的三種含有偶極小分子的電解質 (SMCE)，以擴大水性電解質的ESW。此外，為了獲得高性能的全電池，將引入加速成膜和提高離子電導率的功能性添加劑。還將探索基於具有寬 ESW 和寬工作溫度範圍的 SMCE 的高熵電解質。原型雙離子鋅石墨電池將基於 SMCE 設計，其中輸出電壓可以通過陽離子 Zn2+ 離子和不同陰離子的嵌入能和溶劑化能來調節。

11315522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11315522.value: 深度卷積神經網对絡特徵提取的逼近分析

11315522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11315522.value: In recent decades, deep learning, which is accomplished through deep neural networks (DNNs), has achieved remarkable breakthroughs and captured state-of-the-art performance in various applications, like speech recognition, computer vision, natural language processing. Among various architectures, deep convolutional neural networks(CNNs) are of special interest, which has been widely employed in numerous practical learning tasks such as classification of images, image captioning, and control-policy learning to play the board game Go. Despite the great success of deep learning, it is often deployed as a ``black box,'' to obscurely accomplish an input-output data fitting. The obscurity leads to the lack of interpretability and subsequent performance guarantees (e.g., stableness, accuracy, generalizability, robustness, and transferability, etc.) in deep network learning. Growing curiosity and concern about the black-box nature arise for the time being. Two of the central questions are 1) what the intermediate features or knowledge extracted by the network about the underlying information of data and 2) how it makes meaningful tasks like classification, detection, to be achieved finally. To open the ''black-boxes'' of deep networks, in this proposal we shall study feature extraction in classification learning and investigate the approximation analysis of feature extractors generated by deep CNNs. Precisely, we shall explore principled measures to evaluate the goodness of feature representations of source labeled data, which will be discriminative among multiple classes and compressible within a single class. Then theoretical analysis based on approximation theory and coding theory would be investigated to reveal the correspondence of the goodness of feature extractions to the classification error. The desired results will have an impact both for the theoretical analysis community and for the real practitioners in industries. In addition, the analysis produced may provide guidance for network design and algorithms that are more efficient and accurate. 近幾十年來，通過深度神經網絡 (DNN) 實現的深度學習取得了顯著的突破，並在語音識別、計算機視覺、自然語言處理等各種應用中表現出最先進的性能。在各種架構中，深度卷積神經網絡 (CNN) 具有特殊的意義，它已廣泛用於許多實際學習任務，例如圖像分類、圖像字幕和控制策略學習棋類遊戲。儘管深度學習取得了巨大成功，但它通常構建為為一個“黑匣子”用以完成輸入輸出數據擬合。這種模糊性的構建往往導致深度網絡學習缺乏可解釋性和後續的性能保證（例如，穩定性、準確性、泛化性、魯棒性和可遷移性等）。人們對於黑匣子性質的探究和疑問一日劇增。其中兩個突出問題是 1）網絡提取的關於數據底層信息的中間特徵或知識是什麼，以及 2）它如何最終完成分類、檢測等有意義的任務。在本提案中，我們將研究分類學習中的特徵提取，並研究深度 CNN 生成的特徵提取器的近似分析。確切地說，我們將探索對於評估特徵表示的度量使其在多個類別之間具有區分性，並且在單個類別中是可壓縮的。此外基於函數逼近和編碼的理論分析將用於揭示特徵提取的好壞與分類誤差的對應關係。預期的結果將對理論分析界和行業中的實際從業者產生影響。並且，由此產生的分析可以為網絡設計和更高效算法提供理論指導。

11315622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11315622.value: 具有寬電化學窗口的低鹽濃度水/非質子溶劑複合電解液的設計及其在鋅離子混合型超級電容器中的應用

11315622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11315622.value: With merits of high power output and long lifespan, supercapacitors well bridge the gap between traditional capacitors and rechargeable batteries, and therefore have been widely used for diverse commercial applications, such as hybrid electrical vehicles, grid power buffer, and energy harvesting systems. Compared with rechargeable batteries, supercapacitors can accept and deliver energy much more rapidly, and tolerate magnitude more charge-discharge cycles. However, the relatively low energy density of the supercapacitors is the bottleneck of their applications. Building a hybrid supercapacitor that consists of a battery-type anode and a capacitive-type cathode can improve the energy density of supercapacitors, and meanwhile maintain their power output. In the different configurations of hybrid supercapacitors, metallic Zn is an attractive anode material due to its high specific capacity, low redox potential, low cost, and natural abundance. However, the problems such as the low operation voltage of the hybrid supercapacitors and poor stability of metallic Zn anodes have impeded their practical applications. In this project, we will develop a dilute aqueous/aprotic electrolyte with a broad electrochemical window to improve the energy density and cycle stability of the Zn-ion hybrid supercapacitors. This project is based on the following concepts:1) the introduction of aprotic solvents in an aqueous solution is expected to regulate the solvation structure of electrolyte with enhanced interactions between water molecules and electrolyte ions, and broaden the electrochemical window of electrolyte; 2) a wide electrochemical window of electrolyte enables a higher operation voltage for the Zn-ion hybrid supercapacitors and increases their energy density; 3) the electrolyte with a wide electrochemical window is also favorable to prolong the lifetime of Zn-ion hybrid supercapacitors, because it can increase the Coulombic efficiency of repetitive Zn stripping/plating and slow down the galvanic corrosion of metallic Zn. In the project, a series of aprotic solvents (e.g., trimethyl phosphate, acetonitrile, propylene carbonate, and dimethyl sulfoxide) with distinct properties will be used to prepare electrolytes, and the impacts of aprotic solvent incorporation on the solvation structures and electrochemical windows of electrolytes will be studied. Moreover, the repetitive Zn stripping/plating behaviors and galvanic corrosion of Zn in the electrolytes will be systematically investigated, and the mechanism on how the solvation structures induced by aprotic solvents promote the stability of Zn anodes will be elucidated. The implementation of the proposed project will lead to further understanding, and insight into, the design and development of new electrolyte systems for high-performance Zn-ion hybrid supercapacitors. 得益于其高輸出功率和長循環壽命的優點，超級電容器在不同領域具有廣泛的商業應用，例如混合動力汽車、電網整流器和能量收集系統等。與可充電電池相比，超級電容器可以更快地傳輸能量，並且具有更長的循環壽命。但是，超級電容器的能量密度相對較低是制約其廣泛應用的瓶頸。構建一種由電池型負極和電容型正極組成的混合型超級電容器可以提高超級電容器的能量密度，同時保持其功率輸出。在不同的混合型超級電容器中，金屬鋅作為負極具有高比容量、低氧化還原電位、低成本、高儲量等優點。但是，鋅離子混合超級電容器工作電壓低、金屬鋅負極穩定性差的問題仍待解決。 在這個項目中，我們將設計一種具有寬電化學視窗的低鹽濃度水/非質子溶劑複合電解液，以提高鋅離子混合超級電容器的能量密度和循環穩定性。該專案的設計思路如下：1）在水溶液中引入非質子溶劑有望調節電解液的溶劑化結構，增強水分子與電解質離子之間的相互作用，拓寬電解液的電化學窗口； 2）提高電解液的電化學視窗有助於提高鋅離子混合超級電容器的工作電壓，進而提高其能量密度； 3）具有寬電化學窗口的電解液也有利於延長鋅離子混合超級電容器的壽命，因為它可以提高鋅沉積/剝離的庫侖效率，抑制金屬鋅負極的腐蝕。項目中將採用一系列具有不同性質的非質子溶劑（如磷酸三甲酯、乙腈、碳酸丙烯酯和二甲亞碸）構築複合電解液，研究非質子溶劑的引入對電解液溶劑化結構和電化學視窗的影響。此外，本項目將對鋅在電解液中的剝離/沉積行為和電偶腐蝕進行系統的研究，進而揭示非質子溶劑誘導的溶劑化結構對鋅負極穩定性的提升機制。該專案的實施將為高性能鋅離子混合超級電容器電解液的設計和構築提供理論和實驗基礎。

11315722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11315722.value: 濕化學合成貴金屬@1T'-過渡金屬二硫化物核殼異質結構用於高效析氫反應

11315722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11315722.value: 具有合理設計的形貌、組分和界面的異質結構擁有奇妙的特性，並且在廣泛的應用中，尤其是在催化方面，表現出優於其各個組分的優越性能。為了製備高性能的異質結構電催化劑，人們付出了巨大的努力來對其組成、暴露晶面、尺寸、 維數和形貌進行精細控制，以提高其催化性能。作為一個典型的例子，貴金屬@過渡金屬二硫化合物（TMD）核殼異質結構可以作為具有前景的各種催化反應的催化劑，例如電化學析氫反應（HER），這得益於貴金屬和 TMD 的內在催化活性以及這兩種成分之間的協同作用。 最近，納米材料的相工程（PEN）開闢了一條新途徑，可以實現對納米材料原子排列的精確控制，以調節其性質和功能。以前的研究表明，TMD 和貴金屬的晶相會顯著影響它們的物理化學性質和催化性能。因此，對貴金屬@TMD核殼異質結構晶相的可控調控可以為開髮用於各種催化反應的新型高性能催化劑提供有前景的策略。 然而，迄今為止，由於貴金屬@TMD核殼異質結構中的貴金屬和TMD均處於熱力學穩定相，因此目前仍缺乏合理調控貴金屬@TMD核殼異質結構晶相的研究。值得注意的是，我們最近的工作表明，具有非常規相的 Au 納米材料，例如 4H/fcc Au 納米棒，可以用作生長和穩定 1T'-TMD 單分子層（包括 MoS2 和 MoSe2）的理想模板，從而構建新型 4H/fcc-Au@TMD 核殼異質結構作為高效電化學 HER 的催化劑。 在本研究項目中，我們旨在開發簡便通用的濕化學合成策略，以控制合成各種新型貴金屬@1T'-TMD 核殼異質結構，並系統地研究它們基於結構的性質和催化應用研究，特別是電化學析氫反應。此外，我們將全面研究1T'-TMD納米結構在貴金屬上的形成機制，並揭示用於HER的貴金屬@1T'-TMD核殼異質結構的結構-性能關係。

11315822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11315822.value: 基於原子-光混合干涉儀的量子傳感

11315822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11315822.value: Quantum interference is at the heart of the second quantum revolution that is currently under way and exploits the entanglement nature in atoms and photons for information processing with superior speed and transmission with unbreakable security. While classical interferometric technique has been applied in gravitational wave detection with unprecedent precision, applications of quantum states of light to classical interferometers promise to give rise to even better sensitivity. Recently, we realized a novel type of quantum interferometer that is based on nonlinear interaction between waves. The interferometer is intrinsically quantum mechanical because of the quantum entanglement created in the nonlinear process. Compared to the traditional classical interferometers, it has a number of advantages, among which the most attractive is the coupling and interference of different waves. In this research program, we will study this new type of quantum interferometers but involve optical waves and atomic waves. Thus, the interferometers are sensitive to the phases of both waves. Our goal is to better understand the quantum nature of this newly invented interferometer, which is by itself a new paradigm in interferometry, and apply it to high precision measurement by using atoms as sensors but photons for detection. Here, we first study the quantum noise correlation between atom and light and use this correlation to reduce the quantum noise in order to enhance the sensitivity of the interferometer. Then, we will use the hybrid interferometers for probing atom's internal state change under the influence of external magnetic and optical fields. The study of magnetic influence on atoms will lead to highly sensitive magnetometers with accuracy beyond classical limit by employing the quantum entanglement between atom and light. The effect of light fields on atomic phase change allows one to make quantum non-demolition measurement of photon number of the light field. This paves way to study the fundamental yet elusive quantum measurement process. The program can lead to new approaches in quantum interferometry and open up a new way for quantum control and manipulations of quantum states of atomic and optical systems. The program involves precision phase measurement and thus has practical applications in quantum metrology. Potential industrial transfer of the quantum technology will be possible for sensing applications. The experiments are performed on tabletops, which are the perfect platform for training next generation quantum physicists and preparing them for the second quantum revolution. 量子干涉是目前正在進行的第二次量子革命的核心。它利用原子和光子的糾纏特性以得到超快的信息處理速度和無法破譯的傳輸安全可靠性。雖然經典干涉測量技術已經以前所未有的精確度應用於重力波探測中，量子態在經典光學干涉儀中的應用有望帶來更高的靈敏度。最近，我們實現了一種基於兩個波之間的非線性相互作用的新型的量子干涉儀。由於非線性過程中產生量子糾纏，干涉儀本質上是量子力學的。與傳統的經典光學乾涉儀相比，它有許多優點，其中最吸引人的是不同波的耦合和干涉。 在本研究計劃中，我們將研究這種新型的量子干涉儀，但同時涉及光波和原子波。因此，干涉儀對這兩種波的相位都敏感。我們的目標是更好地理解這種新式干涉儀的量子性質，其本身就是一種干涉測量的新方法，並且將之應用於高精度測量，其中我們使用原子作為傳感器，但使用光子進行測量。在這裡，我們首先研究原子和光之間的量子噪聲關聯，並利用這種關聯以減少量子噪聲，從而提高干涉儀的靈敏度。然後，我們將使用這個混合干涉儀來探測原子內部的狀態在外部磁場和光場的影響下所發生的變化。通過利用原子和光之間的量子糾纏來研究磁場對原子的影響將可以實現超越經典極限的高靈敏度、高精度的磁力計。光場對原子相位的影響使我們能夠實現光場的光子數的量子非破壞測量。這為研究非常基礎但又難以捉摸的量子測量過程鋪平了道路。 該項目將為量子干涉測量帶來新的方法，並為原子和光學系統量子態的量子調控開闢新的領域。該項目涉及精密相位測量，因此在量子精密測量學中實現具有實用價值的應用。這項量子技術的商業轉移將有可用於傳感的潛在應用。實驗將在簡單的光學平台上進行，這是培訓下一代量子物理學家的完美平台並為第二次量子革命做準備。

11316222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11316222.value: 增廣混合有限元方法: 分析, 應用, 以及和最小二乘方法的比較

11316222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11316222.value: In this project, we plan to study a special Galerkin/Least-Squares method, the augmented mixed finite element method, and its relation to the standard least-squares finite element methods (LSFEM). The LSFEM has many known advantages, it is automatically stable and optimal, the first-order system is physically meaningful, it has a natural and accurate a posteriori error estimator, and it is ideal to be used as a cost function in developing neuron network based algorithms. But the full least-squares system is often strongly coupled without integration by parts and there is little room to play with the formula. Thus, it is often hard to do certain analysis. Besides the full bona fide LSFEM, another idea to apply the LS philosophy is the so-called Galerkin/Least-Squares (GaLS) method. The GaLS method is a method combing the LS and Galerkin methods. Some LS terms are added to the original variational formulation to enhance the stability in GaLS methods. In this project, we consider a very special GaLS method, the augmented mixed finite element method. The central idea of the augmented mixed method is that some consistent terms (usually from constitutive equations and other relations of different physical quantities) are added as the difference of two squares instead of the usual least-squares terms. Other terms (usually from equilibrium equations) can still be added to the mixed weak problem in the least-squares forms to enhance the stability. As a partial LS method, the augmented mixed finite element method shares many properties with the classic LSFEM, it is also stable and approximates the physical quantities in their native spaces. Furthermore, since we only use LS principle partially, the system is more flexible and can have some properties that the full LSFEM does not have. In this project, we will study the robust and local optimal error analysis for augmented mixed finite element method, which is extremely important for problems depending on parameters. We will also study the goal-oriented a posteriori error estimates based on adjoints problem, which has many applications in science, engineering, and technology. Stokes problems with slip boundary conditions will also be studied. We expect that the proposed research will result in new insights and develop better numerical methods for computationally challenging problems. The results of the proposed research will provide powerful computational tools for many problems of mathematical interests and practical applications. 在這個項目中，我們計劃研究一種特殊的 Galerkin/Least-Squares 方法，即增廣混合有限元法，以及它與標準最小二乘有限元法 (LSFEM) 的關係。 LSFEM 具有許多已知的優點，它是自動穩定和最優的，一階系統在物理上是有意義的，它具有自然且準確的後驗誤差估計量，並且非常適合用作開發基於神經元網絡的成本函數算法。但是完整的最小二乘系統通常是強耦合的，沒有分步積分，並且幾乎沒有改變公式的空間。因此，通常很難進行某些分析。除了完全真正的 LSFEM 之外，應用 最小二乘思想的另一個想法是所謂的 Galerkin/Least-Squares (GaLS) 方法。 GaLS 方法是結合了最小二乘和 Galerkin 方法的方法。一些最小二乘項被添加到原始變分公式中，以增強 GaLS 方法的穩定性。在這個項目中，我們考慮了一種特殊的 GaLS 方法，即增廣混合有限元法。增廣混合法的中心思想是將一些一致的項（通常來自本構方程和不同物理量的其他關係）添加為兩個平方的差，而不是通常的最小二乘項。其他項（通常來自平衡方程）仍然可以以最小二乘形式添加到混合弱問題中以增強穩定性。 作為一種部分最小二乘方法，增廣混合有限元法與經典的 LSFEM 有許多共同的性質，它也是穩定的，並且在它們的原始空間中逼近物理量。此外，由於我們只部分使用了最小二乘原理，因此系統更加靈活，並且可以具有完整 LSFEM 所不具備的一些特性。在這個項目中，我們將研究增強混合有限元方法的魯棒和局部最優誤差分析，這對於取決於參數的問題極為重要。我們還將研究基於伴隨問題的面向目標的後驗誤差估計，它在科學、工程和技術中有許多應用。還將研究具有滑移邊界條件的斯托克斯問題。 我們期望所提出的研究將產生新的見解，並為具有計算挑戰性的問題開發更好的數值方法。擬議研究的結果將為許多數學興趣和實際應用問題提供強大的計算工具。

11316422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11316422.value: 用於提高金屬鹵化物鈣鈦礦太陽能電池性能和穩定性的一維雜化鈣鈦礦分子工程

11316422.label: Project Objectives
11316422.value: We will rationally design and synthesize new classes of 1D hybrid perovskites for passivating the surface and interfacial defects of 3D perovskites to improve the performance and stability of PSC simultaneously. We will systematically study and tailor the chemical structures of organic cations for 1D hybrid perovskites to achieve proper band alignment for mitigating the dynamics of charge carrier extraction and collection at the 3D perovskite interfaces. We will develop external stimuli responsive 1D hybrid perovskites that can be cross-linked to form robust passivation layer for enhancing the operational stability of devices. We will conduct comprehensive optical, electrochemical, and photo-physical characterization of passivated 3D perovskites based on the 1D hybrid perovskites. In addition, the morphological study of film in conjunction with crystallographic study on molecular components will be conducted to understand how the molecular structures of organic cations affect the charge-transporting properties of resultant materials. We will demonstrate a high-performance PSC with 27% PCE (area: 0.1 cm2) at the end based on the 1D hybrid perovskites passivated 3D perovskites developed in this project.

11316422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11316422.value: 與其它薄膜技術相比，基於鈣鈦礦材料簡單溶液處理而成的金屬鹵化物鈣鈦礦太陽能電池 可實現更高的光電轉換效率，其最高效率已達到25.7%。但是，此效率仍然低於肖克利-奎伊瑟極限模型預測的理論值。由鈣鈦礦活性層體相、表面和界面上的晶格缺陷引起的非輻射複合損失是進一步提高效率的主要障礙。目前，利用具有疏水性質的大有機陽離子形成的二維雜化鈣鈦礦被用作三維鈣鈦礦表面覆蓋層，可鈍化鈣鈦礦表面的缺陷。 然而，在溶液處理過程中，由異質二維鈣鈦礦量子阱引入的複雜電子態可能會成為鈣鈦礦太陽能電池中能量損失的重要來源。電荷載流子可以被捕獲在這些電子態中使得它們的遷移率降低並導致非輻射複合增加。這些鈍化誘導形成的電子態主要與二維鈣鈦礦的不同構象和非純相分佈有關。因此，通過控制鈍化層的相純度和厚度來抑制複雜的電子態形成，有助於減少載流子陷阱並改善界面處的載流子動力學。理想的替代鈍化策略應該在提高該鈦礦太陽能電池的性能和穩定性的同時又不會引入鈍化引起的電子態缺陷。 在本研究方案中，我們將 (1)合理設計和合成新型一維鈣鈦礦，以鈍化三維鈣鈦礦的表面和界面缺陷，提高鈣鈦礦太陽能電池的性能和穩定性； (2)系統地研究和調整一維鈣鈦礦的有機陽離子分子結構，以實現適當的能帶排列，改善鈣鈦礦界面處的電荷提取和收集動力學；(3)開發可交聯的依賴外部刺激的一維雜化鈣鈦礦，以增強鈣鈦礦和器件的穩定性；(4)對鈍化的三維鈣鈦礦進行全面的光學、電化學和光物理表徵，並對衍生的一維鈣鈦礦結構和 三維鈣鈦礦薄膜進行晶體學和形態學研究，以了解所得材料的結構-性能關係；(5)基於新開發的一維雜化鈣鈦礦和優化的鈣鈦礦組分，在項目結束時實現效率超過27% 的高性能鈣鈦礦太陽能電池。該項目實現的成果將為未來開發高效穩定的鈣鈦礦太陽能電池提供指導，還將助力香港成為基於可印刷鈣鈦礦太陽能電池的低成本清潔能源領域的研發前沿。

11316522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11316522.value: 通過控制光催化劑的光電荷轉移以調整產生太陽能燃料的選擇性

11316522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11316522.value: 光催化反應產生的太陽能燃料為解決清潔能源需求以及幫助社會邁向碳中和提供了解決方案。儘管氫能具有潛能，但氫的儲存、運輸和安全方面的挑戰促使人們考慮其他清潔燃料。將二氧化碳光化學還原成綠色甲烷或將水氧化成過氧化氫是兩個有趣化學反應。應用可再生資源生產的綠色甲烷和過氧化氫都是有價值的替代燃料。 由於光催化劑的電荷轉移難以掌握，綠色甲烷和過氧化氫的產生通常伴隨著其他副產物。在此項目中，我們將通過晶體、缺陷和表面功能改造的原理開發操縱電子轉移的創新方法。此項目將結合先進的時間分辨和光譜技術研究光催化劑表面的電荷特性。此項目的成功實施將擴大學術界對半導體電荷轉移的新知識，而且其應用不僅限於光催化。 以化學燃料（如綠色氫、綠色甲烷和過氧化氫燃料）的形式有效利用太陽能是此項目的最終目標。這將有助於開發具有更高效率、更高選擇性和穩定性的光催化劑。鑑於香港優越的地理位置和積極推行碳中和的長期目標，以太陽能燃料的形式利用陽光（通過光催化反應）是克服能源和環境問題的一個選擇。

11316822.value: 非線性近場動力學模型的廣義有限積分方法

11316822.label: Project Objectives
11316822.value: To investigate the nonlinear integro-differential equations of peridynamic models. Based on the recently developed finite integration method, efficient and effective numerical solvers for the peridynamic models will be devised. Numerical simulation of solutions for the peridynamic models will be performed to further investigate the characteristics and properties of the nonlinear waves resulted from the peridynamic models.

Based on the recently developed finite integration method, efficient and effective numerical solvers for the peridynamic models will be devised. Numerical simulation of solutions for the peridynamic models will be performed to further investigate the characteristics and properties of the nonlinear waves resulted from the peridynamic models.

11316822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11316822.value: 基於廣義有限積分法 (GFIM) 的最新發展，用於剛性偏微分方程的數值逼近，我們試圖在這個提議的項目中開發一種高效的數值算法，用於求解連續介質力學中近場動力學公式中出現的非線性波動方程。 GFIM 的主要優勢在於其使用均勻或非均勻離散化逼近高維問題的潛力。 由此產生的對角矩陣為 GFIM 在實現解的高度準確和穩定近似方面提供了另一個優勢。 具體來說，我們將使用隱式顯式 (IMEX) 和時間分割 (TS) 方案來近似時間變量，並使用 GFIM 來近似空間變量。 將GFIM與自適應點分配技術和無條件穩定積分方案相結合，將進一步提高數值算法的計算效率。

11316822.label: Realisation of objectives
11316822.value: Realiszation of objectives 1. To investigate the nonlinear integro-differential equations of peridynamic models. We had performed literature survey on the development of nonlinear peridynamic models. These peridynamic models are formulated in continuum mechanics resulting in higher dimensional nonlinear system of integro-differential equations. Due to the nonlinearity and integro-differential terms, numerical solutions are very difficult to be obtained by traditional mesh-based numerical methods such as finite difference or finite element methods. 2. Based on the recently developed finite integration method, an efficient and effective numerical solver for the peridynamic models had been devised. Numerical simulation of solutions for the peridynamic models had been performed to further investigate the characteristic and properties of the nonlinear waves resulted from the peridynamic models. Using these newly proposed nonlinear peridynamic models and the recently developed finite integration method (FIM), we extended the FIM to Fictitious Finite Integration Method (FFIM) which is a truly meshless computational method combined with the technique of fictitious points. This combined FFIM method inherits the meshless advantages and offers higher accuracy and efficiency for solving high order partial differential equations in both uniform and non-uniform discretization. Some numerical experiments are presented and numerical results show that the obtained simulations via the FFIM method are reliable and effective for approximating the solution of models formulation as high order partial differential equations to be investigated in the current project. A paper (Fictitious finite integration method for solving high order partial differential equations, Engineering Analysis with Boundary Elements, Vol. 152, pp. 235-242, 2023) on using this newly developed FFIM had been published at the Engineering Analysis with Boundary Element. Another paper on applying the numerical technique for solving the mathematical simulation problem related to Covid-19 pandemic had also been published at the journal of Frontier on Public Health (Implementation of the compulsory universal testing (CUT) scheme in Hong Kong: mathematical simulations of a household-based pooling approach, Brief Research Report, Frontiers in Public Health, 14 December 2022). The FFIM had been further extended to a Generalized Finite Integration Method (GFIM) with advantages of truly meshless and unconditional stable, which makes the GFIM superior in the numerical approximation of high dimensional complicated complex physical problems. Two journal papers were published for solving high dimensional financial derivatives (Generalized finite integration method with Laplace transform for option pricing under Black-Scholes and Heston models, Engineering Analysis with Boundary Elements, Vol. 164 (2024) 105751) and electrodynamic (Generalized finite integration method for 2D electrostatic and electrodynamic analyses, Mathematics and Computers in Simulation, Vol. 220, pp. 580-594, 2024) problems.

11316822.value: This project successfully investigated and developed a mathematical model for solving high dimension complicated and complex physical problems. Effective and accurate numerical method, Generalized Finite Integration Method, had been successfully devised to simulate the solutions of high dimensional financial derivatives and electrodynamical problems. Four SCI-indexed papers had been published at the journal of Engineering Analysis with Boundary Elements (SCI-indexed journal with impact factor 4.2), Mathematics and Computers in Simulation with impact factor 4.4), and Frontiers in Public Health with impact factor 3.4).

11316822.value: The developed numerical method, Generalized Finite Integration Method, has proven to be truly meshless and provide highly accurate and stable approximation to these kinds of nonlinear partial differential equations. Application of this generalized finite integration method to solve higher order partial differential equations in higher dimension is potentially feasible.

Extended application of the devised computational method has been successfully solved high dimensional problems in financial options and electrodynamic.

11316922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11316922.value: 數據驅動的非線性板理論

11316922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11316922.value: The emergence of Big Data and Data Science has the potential to revolutionise the mathematical modelling of complex physical phenomena. This project aims at contributing to realise this potential in Elasticity Theory in general, and in Plate Theory in particular. Elasticity theory predicts the displacements and stresses in elastic bodies subjected to external forces by means of mathematical models such us optimisation problems or boundary value problems of systems of nonlinear partial differential equations. Plate theory is the theory of elasticity applied to thin elastic plates that can be approximated by two-dimensional planar bodies (such as, e.g., steel sheets). All these models are built from two types of information: (1) absolute laws of physics (which apply to all bodies irrespective of the their specific nature). (2) empirical and observational data (which are specific to the elastic material of which the bodies are made). Classical Elasticity uses the empirical and observational data of (2) to define a ``constitutive law'' for the elastic material from which the body is made, then combines this constitutive law with the ``absolute laws'' of 1) to build one mathematical model for each elastic material. This freezes the model to a given set of data, in the sense that new data or new elastic materials cannot be included in the model. By contrast, the emerging new theory of ``Data-driven Elasticity'' directly combines (1) and (2) to build a mathematical model, thus skipping the intermediate step of defining a ``constitutive law'' in classical elasticity. This completely eliminates the errors of modelling the elastic material by means of a ``constitutive law''. Besides, by keeping the empirical and observational data in a separate set of ``big data", the mathematical model can be updated whenever new empirical and observational data become available. In addition, this new approach makes the model adaptable to new elastic materials, such that those created by new technologies for specific purposes. But to realise this potential, the new theory of Data-driven Elasticity has to be put on firm theoretical and computational bases, and show how the enormous knowledge acquired in classical elasticity, both qualitative and quantitative, can be incorporated in the new theory in a systematic way. This is the ultimate aim of this proposal. 大數據和數據科學的出現有可能徹底改變複雜物理現象的數學建模。該項目旨在促進在一般彈性理論中實現這一潛力，特別是在板理論中。 彈性理論通過諸如非線性偏微分方程系統的優化問題或邊值問題等數學模型來預測彈性體中受到外力的位移和應力。板理論是應用於可近似為二維平面體的薄彈性板的彈性理論。 所有這些模型都是根據兩種類型的信息構建的： 1) 絕對物理定律（適用於所有物體，無論其具體性質如何）。 2) 經驗和觀察數據（特定於製造物體的彈性材料）。 經典彈性使用 2) 的經驗和觀察數據來定義製造身體的彈性材料的“本構定律”，然後將該本構定律與 1) 的“絕對定律”結合起來構建一個每種彈性材料的數學模型。這會將模型凍結為一組給定的數據，即新數據或新彈性材料不能包含在模型中。 相比之下，新興的“數據驅動彈性”理論直接結合了1）和2）建立數學模型，從而跳過了經典彈性中“本構定律”的中間步驟。這完全消除了通過“本構法”對彈性材料建模的錯誤。 此外，通過將經驗數據和觀測數據保存在單獨的“大數據”集中，只要有新的經驗數據和觀測數據可用，就可以更新數學模型。這也使模型能夠適應新的彈性材料，例如通過新技術用於特定目的。 但要實現這一潛力，數據驅動彈性的新理論必須建立在堅實的理論和計算基礎上，並展示如何將在經典彈性中獲得的大量知識，無論是定性的還是定量的，都可以在新理論中納入系統的方式。這是本提案的最終目的。

11317022.value: 利用光功能過渡金屬配合物靶向 N 端半胱氨酸殘基，作為位點特異性生物偶聯、活細胞成像和光療應用

11317022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11317022.value: 這項目的目的是開發可以靶向N端半胱氨酸殘基的光功能過渡金屬配合物，並將這些配合物的發光特性和細胞光毒性用於生物診斷和治療。肽和蛋白質的化學修飾為生物醫學應用提供了新的分子工具。然而，由於缺乏區域選擇性，傳統的生物偶聯方法通常會導致異質標記，對偶聯物的表徵及對其性質控制帶來極大的困難。因此，人們致力於開發能夠對肽和蛋白質的特定位點進行選擇性標記的化學反應。由於含有N端半胱氨酸的蛋白質天然豐度低，而且該類殘基修飾能對肽和蛋白質的結構和功能產生較小的干擾，因此，近年來，與其他氨基酸（包括內部和C端半胱氨酸）相比，在N端半胱氨酸上提供單位點修飾的生物相容性反應受到了廣泛的關注。過去的十年，由於發光過渡金屬配合物具有良好的光物理特性和較高的單線態氧 (1O2) 產率，人們對將該類化合物用於傳感、生物成像和光治療產生了極大的興趣。我們設想通過將金屬配合物的發光和光化學特性與N端半胱氨酸修飾相結合會為診斷和治療提供新的生物試劑。在這個項目中，我們將對過渡金屬配合物進行功能化，使其對1,2-氨基硫醇基團具有反應活性，同時調節配合物的發光和1O2光敏特性。在我們的設計中，與含有N端半胱氨酸的肽和蛋白質的生物共軛不僅可以啟動金屬配合物磷光，而且能促進其1O2的生成能力，這在現有的有機生物共軛試劑中是很難實現的。這些特別設計的配合物將可以對活細胞中的蛋白質進行磷光標記、檢測蛋白質動力學以及構建新型光細胞毒性生物偶聯物。我們相信對N端半胱氨酸有反應活性的過渡金屬配合物的探索有助於構建具有豐富功能的新型生物偶聯物。這項目的結果將進一步強調光功能過渡金屬配合物獨特的功能，這將為生物分子相互作用、細胞活性和酶功能的探索提供新的見解。最終，這些創新的生物偶聯試劑將為診斷和治療相關的藥物和材料的開發提供前所未有的機會。

11317122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11317122.value: 超原子的電子結構和激發態動力學

11317122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11317122.value: As multi-atomic complex systems belonging to molecules, superatoms possess unique molecular orbitals that can be classified according to the symmetry of the electronic orbital angular momentum, similar to atoms. They are expected to show similar structural characteristics to atoms, and present profound and complex physical connotations in their interactions. Superatatoms are considered to be artificial motifs with both atomic and molecular characteristics, and research on them offers important prospects to simulate and even replace atoms so as to realize the function of the artificial motifs. Building new structures and even devices from superatoms offers a promising way to overcome the structural and functional limitations of atoms as motifs and develop high performance and even revolutionary applications of superatoms. In order to move towards the goal of advanced applications of superatoms, it is very urgent to reveal the underlying physics of superatoms at the atomic level in order to facilitate their applications. Building on the research in conventional atomic and molecular physics and using the related methodologies, this project will systematically study the electronic structures and excited state dynamics of several representative superatoms, focusing on their following characteristics: electron-vibration coupling, charge-energy transfer processes, electron transition between energy levels, and electron tunneling processes. Specifically, combining state-of-the-art first-principles calculations and dynamics simulations, we will investigate excited state dynamics and electron tunneling, possibly extending our investigation to complex systems involving environmental confinements. We will select several representative superatomic structures for study, including the widely reported C60, Au20 and carbon-based structures encapsulating coinage metals, as well as some of the boron and boron nitride cage structures we have recently identified, as the basic research systems. We expect to uncover the following of superatoms with focuses on their distinctions with those of atoms: the relationship between the electronic structures and excited state properties, the rules of electronic transition, oscillator strength, the features of electron delocalization, the characteristics of vibrational relaxation, internal conversion and intersystem crossing, electronic excitation induced isomerizations, the geometry and lifetime of excitons, the charge and energy transfer processes, the effects of environmental confinement on excited states, the chemical reaction processes related to excited states, and even the electron tunneling processes. The completion of the project will promote the development of superatomic physics and lay the foundation for future development in the relevant fields. 超原子作為屬於分子的多原子復雜系統，具有獨特的分子軌道，可以類似於原子根據電子軌道角動量的對稱性進行分類，有望表現出與原子相似的結構特征，並在其相互作用中表現出深刻而復雜的物理內涵。超原子被認為是具有原子和分子特性的人工基元，其研究為模擬甚至取代原子以實現人工基元的功能提供了重要的前景。用超原子構建新的結構乃至器件來發展高性能甚至革命性的超原子應用，為克服原子作為基元在結構和功能上的限制提供了一種很有前途的方法。為了實現超原子的先進應用這一目標，迫切需要在原子水平上揭示超原子的基本物理原理，以促進它們的應用。 在傳統原子和分子物理研究的基礎上，利用相關方法，系統地研究幾個具有代表性的超原子的電子結構和激發態動力學，重點研究其以下特征：電子-振動藕合、電荷-能量轉移過程、能級之間的電子躍遷和電子隧穿過程。具體來說，我們將用最先進的第一性原理計算和動力學模擬來研究超原子的激發態動力學和電子隧穿，並將我們的研究擴展到涉及環境限制的復雜系統。我們將選擇幾個具有代表性的超原子結構進行研究，包括廣泛報道的碳C60、Au20和內含貴重金屬的碳基結構以及我們最近確定的一些硼和氮化硼籠狀結構作為研究體系。我們將揭示以下超原子與原子的區別：電子結構和激發態性質之間的關系、電子躍遷規則、振子強度、電子離域的特點、振動弛豫的特點、內部轉換和系統間交叉、電子激發誘導異構化、激子的幾何和壽命、電荷和能量轉移過程、環境限制對激發態的影響、與激發態相關的化學反應過程、以及電子隧穿過程。該項目的完成將有助於促進超原子物理學的發展，為今後相關領域的發展奠定基礎。

11317322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11317322.value: 鈣鈦礦量子點自組裝手性微結構激光性質的研究

11317422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11317422.value: 開發一種針對多元離子鈣鈦礦太陽電池衰降過程中的原位缺陷探測技術

11317422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11317422.value: 基於溶液法製備的混合金屬鹵化物鈣鈦礦是一種新興光電材料。單節鈣鈦礦太陽電池（perovskite solar cells, PVSCs）的光電轉化效率（power conversion efficiency, PCE）已經提升到了25.5%，超過了傳統的多晶矽太陽電池。此外，多個研究團隊已經在基於MAPbI3的PVSCs上實現了優良的穩定性。然而，傳統的矽基太陽電池技術已經相對成熟，能以低成本實現大規模生產，這使得在如今的光伏市場上，鈣鈦礦要與硅競爭仍是非常具有挑戰性的。另一方面，儘管製備簡單，光電性質易調諧等特性使得鈣鈦礦在高效低成本光伏器件上充滿潛力，但無論是寬帶隙（＞1.8eV）還是窄帶隙（＜1.2eV）鈣鈦礦材料，均存在穩定性較差的問題。本質上來說，多元離子復合鈣鈦礦材料在不同環境下的離子解離機制尚不清楚，同時也缺乏切實可行的手段來有效地抑制其降解過程。因此，了解多元離子復合鈣鈦礦的內在降解機制，進而開發出提升材料穩定性的方法具有重要意義。 在本工作中，我們旨在開發一種原位高靈敏度的外量子效率（Highly sensitive external quantum efficiency, s-EQE）測試技術，用以確定PVSCs降解過程中的缺陷演變。該原位技術可以超高靈敏地來檢測器件工作中的缺陷情況，即使在器件工作的早期階段，也可以檢測到缺陷態所產生的極小光電流。技術上，我們將結合其他缺陷態探測方法如熱導納光譜法（Thermal admittance spectroscopy, TAS）等來完善原位s-EQE技術，並測試一系列缺陷態密度和能量可控的鈣鈦礦材料來進行驗證。這項技術將用以探究不同操作環境對寬帶隙（FAxMA1-xPb(IyBr1-y)3）或窄帶隙（FAxMAyCs1-x-yPbzSn1-zI3）鈣鈦礦材料中缺陷生長的影響。由於PVSCs的性能和穩定性對離子組分非常敏感，我們將系統地研究不同組分鈣鈦礦中材料降解與缺陷生長之間的相關性。此外，我們會進一步將該技術應用於探究不同性質的鈍化分子（如路易斯酸或鹼等）對鈣鈦礦缺陷生長的影響。最終，我們將理解多元離子復合鈣鈦礦中的降解機制，並為開發高穩定性的寬帶隙和窄帶隙PVSCs提供新的見解。

11317622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11317622.value: 關於散射異常的系統研究

11317622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11317622.value: When an electromagnetic wave impinges upon a structure, scattered waves propagate away from the structure in different radiation channels. A scattering anomaly occurs when the outgoing waves vanish in one or more radiation channels. The scattering anomalies give rise to interesting wave phenomena such as zero reflection, zero transmission, perfect absorption, mode conversion, etc, and they are useful techniques for manipulating electromagnetic waves including light. However, existing theories on scattering anomalies are incomplete and restricted to special cases. Standard numerical methods for simulating electromagnetic waves are not very efficient at computing the scattering anomalies. In this project, we propose a nonlinear eigenvalue formulation for the scattering anomalies and solve the nonlinear eigenvalue problem by a contour integral method. We also analyze the fundamental properties of the scattering anomalies, including their existence, their robustness, and their dependence on structural parameters. Our study paves the way for many more applications of scattering anomalies in electromagnetic and photonic devices. 當電磁波撞擊到某個結構上時，散射波在不同的輻射通道中向外遠離結構傳播。散射異常是指散射波在一個或多個輻射通道中完全消失的現象。有趣的散射異常現象包括零反射、零透射、全吸收、模式轉換等，可用來操縱電磁波（包括光波）。然而，現有關於散射異常的理論是不完整的，並且僅限於特殊情況。用於模擬電磁波的標準數值方法在計算散射異常方面不是很有效。在這個研究項目中，我們將散射異常轉化爲非線性特徵值問題，用圍道積分來求解非線性特徵值問題。我們還將分析散射異常的基本特性，包括它們的存在性、魯棒性以及它們對結構參數的依賴性。我們的研究有助于開發散射異常在電磁和光子器件中更多的應用。

11317722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11317722.value: 開發針對有毒和腐蝕性氣體的穩定的金屬有機骨架吸附劑：理解特定結合位點和吸附-解吸機制的重要性

11317722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11317722.value: Dr Gu, Qinfen Prof Zhou, Hong-Cai

11317722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11317722.value: Anthropogenic emissions of various toxic gases cause serious environmental problems and pose substantial health threats. Prominent examples of toxic gases include NO2, SO2, H2S, and NH3, generated from the burning of fossil fuels for energy production, various industrial processes, and agricultural activities. Mitigating the adverse impact of toxic gases requires effective gas treatment technologies – gas detection, removal, and conversion, which can be nicely enabled by selective gas adsorption in porous solids. The key to an effective gas adsorption operation is to have porous adsorbents capable of affording high selectivity, high capacity, high stability, and high regenerability. High adsorption selectivity and capacity assure effective enrichment of target toxic gases in adsorbents, while high stability and regenerability assure multiple reuses of adsorbent materials. However, few materials can simultaneously satisfy these four requirements because toxic gases are often of a highly reactive and corrosive nature. A dilemma exists in developing effective adsorbents – strong and specific binding sites, on one hand, are necessary to realize high adsorption selectivity and capacity, and on the other, are potentially detrimental to the stability and regenerability of adsorbents. In this project, we aim to resolve this dilemma by addressing the following questions: 1) How to design and develop metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) adsorbents that combine robust framework and specific binding sites, such that the inert scaffold metal nodes assure overall high material stability and active non-scaffold transition metal centers impart highly specific adsorption; 2) How to fine-tune the adsorption selectivity, capacity, and regenerability by varying non-scaffold transition metal, scaffold metal node, and organic linker of porphyrin MOFs, based on our successful proof-of-concept study on NO2 adsorption; 3) How to elucidate the gas adsorption-desorption mechanism via a combined experimental and molecular simulation study to enable rational adsorbents design and controlled handling of toxic gases by adsorption. The research on fundamentals of gas adsorption serves as the cornerstone of a suite of gas technologies for the treatment of toxic and corrosive gases, including gas detection, gas removal/filtration, and (catalytic) gas conversion. Thus, the new knowledge generated in this proposal will be invaluable to advance each of these adsorption-based gas technologies, which will potentially bring considerable environmental, health, and economic benefits. 人類活動造成的各種有毒氣體的排放造成嚴重的環境問題，並對健康構成重大威脅。有毒氣體的突出例子包括 NO2、SO2、H2S 和 NH3，它們產生於化石燃料的燃燒、各種工業過程和農業活動。減輕有毒氣體的不利影響需要有效的氣體處理技術——氣體檢測、去除和轉換，這可以通過多孔固體材料的選擇性吸附得以很好地實現。有效氣體吸附操作的關鍵是具有能夠提供高選擇性、高容量、高穩定性和高再生性的多孔吸附劑。高吸附選擇性和吸附容量保證了吸附劑對目標有毒氣體的有效富集，而高穩定性和可再生性保證了吸附劑材料的多次重複使用。 然而，因為有毒氣體通常具有高反應性和腐蝕性，很少有材料可以同時滿足以上四個要求。開發有效的吸附劑存在兩難境地——一方面，具有特異性的強相互作用結合位點是實現高吸附選擇性和容量所必需的，另一方面，強相互作用結合位點可能不利於吸附劑的穩定性和可再生性。 本項目旨在通過解決以下問題來解決這一困境：1）如何設計和開發結合了堅固框架和特定結合位點的金屬有機框架（MOF）吸附劑，從而使惰性支架金屬節點確保整體高材料穩定性和活性非支架過渡金屬中心賦予高度特異性吸附； 2）基於我們對NO2吸附的成功概念驗證研究，如何通過改變卟啉MOFs的非支架過渡金屬、支架金屬節點和有機接頭來微調吸附選擇性、吸附容量和可再生性； 3）如何通過結合實驗和分子模擬研究闡明氣體吸附-解吸機理，以實現合理的吸附劑設計和基於可控的吸附處理有毒氣體。 氣體吸附的基礎研究是用於處理有毒和腐蝕性氣體的一系列氣體技術的基石，包括氣體檢測、氣體去除/過濾和（催化）氣體轉化。因此，本研究項目產生的新知識對於推進這些基於吸附的氣體技術中的每一項都將是非常有價值的，本項目的成功將有望帶來可觀的環境、健康和經濟效益。

11317922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11317922.value: 基於電調製光譜和橢偏法优化有機電光材料的分子帶隙工程以实现超大的近共振光學非線性效应

11317922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11317922.value: The performance of organic electro-optic (EO) materials and hybrid devices have increased remarkably over the past decade, making them an exciting potential componentry for future 5G/6G technologies. However, recent research and development of organic EO (OEO) materials have been limited by the lack of reliable EO characterization techniques and an in-depth understanding of the structure-property relationships, and the frequent occurrence of incorrect and unreliable data-reporting of ultrahigh EO coefficients risks damaging the credibility and reliability of the field. Since the active dimension of hybrid nanoscale photonic devices has continued to shrink with footprints of tens of square micrometers, it offers a great opportunity to explore the possibility of maximizing the nonlinearities of OEO materials by operating at the wavelengths near the material absorption without significantly increasing optical losses. However, the study of the resonance-enhanced nonlinear coefficients of OEO materials has not been well supported by common measurement techniques for characterizing the EO coefficients of OEO materials include Teng–Man (TM) simple reflection, attenuated total reflectance (ATR), and Mach–Zehnder interferometric (MZI) technique, which are applicable only at discrete near-infrared (NIR) wavelengths in the low absorbing regions of poled films, with relative advantages and disadvantages of each method. This project aims to use the latest developments in electromodulation spectroscopy and spectroscopic ellipsometry, with the assistance of the ATR technique, to study the complex EO coefficients of poled polymers and molecular glasses. The selected OEO materials are the newly developed high-performance EO polymers and self-assembled molecular glasses exhibiting large EO coefficients at the telecom wavelengths, albeit with little understanding of their near-resonance properties and the origin of their large nonlinearities. Based on transmission-mode Stark effect EM spectroscopy and Kramers-Kronig analysis, we will study the electric-field-induced full spectral changes in optical absorption and refraction of materials and quantify their near-band-edge optical nonlinearities from electroabsorption and electrorefraction effects of poled films. Our approach would overcome the limitation of the classic qualitative two-level model and provide a quantitative understanding of near-resonance optical nonlinearities of organic EO materials. By analyzing the dispersion of complex EO coefficients of poled polymers in the NIR region, we expect that our study provides ample insight into molecular bandgap engineering of OEO materials for achieving performance breakthroughs of near-resonance optical nonlinearities greater than 10,000 pm/V in the second NIR window. It can inspire the exploration of high-speed, absorptive, or phase-shifting light-modulators for on-chip applications. 過去十年，有機電光材料和混合集成器件的性能有顯著提高，在未來 5G/6G 技術有很好的应用前景。然而，由於缺乏可靠的 电光表徵技術和對結構-性能關係的深入理解，以及不准確重现性差的超高电光係數的频繁报道，損害了該領域的健康发展。 由於混合納米級光子器件的有效尺寸持續縮小到幾十平方微米，提供了一個很好的機會，即探索材料吸收边附近的波長为工作波长，來实现有机电光材料非線性系数的最大化，而不顯著增加光學的可能性損失。然而，用於表徵有机电光材料的电光係數的常用測量技術，包括 Teng-Man (TM) 簡單反射、衰減全反射 (ATR) 和干涉技術（MZI)，並未很好地支持對有机电光材料的共振增強非線性係數的研究。 这些技術各有優缺點，但僅適用於極化薄膜低吸收區的離散近紅外 (NIR) 波長。 本項目旨在利用電調製光譜學和光譜橢偏儀的最新發展，在 ATR 技術的幫助下，研究極化聚合物和分子玻璃的复合电光係數。選擇的有机电光材料是新開發的高性能电光聚合物和自組裝分子玻璃，在通信波長下表現出大的电光係數，但以前對其近共振特性及其大非線性的起源知之甚少。基於透射模式Stark 效應电调制光譜和 Kramers-Kronig 分析，我們將研究電場极化薄膜的光学吸收和折射率的全光譜變化，並從電吸收和電折射效應，定量评估材料在近帶邊緣的非線性光學系数。我们的测试方法將克服經典定性兩能級模型的局限性，並精确认知有機电光材料的近共振光學非線性效应的。通過分析極化聚合物在近紅外區域的複合电光係數的色散，我們的研究将有望為有机电光材料的分子帶隙工程提供量化指导，從而在近红外二区能實現大於 10,000 pm/V 的、近共振光學非線性性能的突破。本研究可用於片上集成的高速、吸收或相移光調製器的探索。

11318322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11318322.value: 共軛寡聚物納米顆粒用於近紅外光激發的一型光動力癌症治療

11318322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11318322.value: 目前極需發展具有近紅外波段吸收的試劑用於腫瘤光動力治療，光動力治療是用一定波長的光源去激發光敏劑從而產生具有細胞毒性的活性氧物種來殺死癌細胞，近紅外光以其較深的組織穿透深度和較低的組織傷害表現出特殊的優勢。儘管目前光動力治療已經有了很大的發展，但是腫瘤的乏氧環境嚴重影響了其治療效果而且限制了光動力治療的廣泛應用，這種低氧特點嚴重的阻礙了大多數氧氣依賴型光動力治療試劑的活性氧物種產生。 發展具有優異近紅外光吸收和光動力治療效果的材料是當下的一個研究熱點，而且許多重要的研究論文也揭示了這類材料的巨大潛力(Nat. Chem. 2019, 11, 1041; Nat. Biomed. Eng. 2019, 3, 27; Nat. Photon. 2014, 8, 455; Nat. Comm. 2020, 11, 1735; 2020, 11, 357, 2019, 10, 2412)。目前已經有一些吸收峰超過800 nm的光熱治療試劑的報道，但是吸收峰超過800 nm的光動力治療試劑仍然非常稀缺。而且，大多數報道的光動力治療試劑主要是通過二型光動力過程產生單線態氧，眾所周知，單線態氧是一種依賴氧氣而產生的具有細胞毒性的活性氧物種，而腫瘤位置的乏氧環境嚴重地影響了這種氧氣依賴的光動力治療效果，相比之下，一型光動力治療可以產生低氧氣依賴的自由基而非單線態氧來殺死癌細胞。目前，只有一些可見光（400 - 600 nm）激發的一型光動力治療試劑被報道，而且只有很少的幾個一型光敏劑可以被大於700 nm的近紅外光激發。 在我們的初步研究中,項目主要負責人及其團隊製備了一批新型的可以在近紅外光激發下產生自由基、同時具有良好水分散性能的有機寡聚物納米顆粒，團隊發現在寡聚物分子上連一個穩定的自由基化合物可以提升其在乏氧環境中的自由基產生能力。在這個項目中，我們計劃繼續系統地研究這種高效的具有克服乏氧能力的寡聚物光敏劑，同時我們將建立挑選電子給體、受體、π橋以及自由基單元用來設計一系列覆蓋可見光和近紅外光波段的一型寡聚物光敏劑的分子設計規則，該研究擬取得的結果將為設計給體-受體以及給體-受體-自由基結構的一型寡聚物光敏劑材料提供指導。我們將會使用不同的細胞株來表征這些寡聚物納米顆粒的光動力治療性能以及生物安全性，最終，最優性能的納米顆粒將會被用來表征其在動物體內用近紅外激發的光動力性能和生物兼容性。

11318422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11318422.value: “森林大火”和相关模型的恢复和“雪崩”

11318422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11318422.value: 在統計物理中，自組織臨界性是一個十分有趣的現象，可以被用來解釋自然界中出現的復雜性。“森林大火過程”這一關於可被激化的媒介的模型，由Drossel和Schwabl在1992年引入，就是自組織臨界性的一個典型範例。在這壹過程中，新樹在格點上以1的強度出現，同時閃電以極小的強度zeta出現：當一棵樹被劈中，大火立即蔓延到所有與它相連的樹，所以包含此樹的一整個連通簇都會瞬間被大火燒掉。 雖然森林大火過程引起了許多關註，但人們對這一過程的長期行為所知甚少。研究這類問題極其睏難，因為有兩種相對立的效果互相競爭：假如有很多樹，導緻出現了大的連通簇，就會幫助大火蔓延。當大的連通簇被燒掉時，就會留出大片空地，導緻在一定時間內都很難形成新的大連通簇。由於這種非單調性，統計物理中用來研究格點模型的常規方法不能用來研究這類問題，人們需要引入新的技術和想法。這個研究計劃的目的正是在數學層麵上增進對於這類模型的理解，而研究方法來源於近年來在“近臨界性滲流”以及於之相關的其它過程中發展出來的一些突破性想法。 最近，我們得出了壹些新的結果，是關於一個有限盒裏的森林大火過程，其盒子的邊長是強度zeta的壹個合適的函數。證明過程中，我們精確地理解了臨界時間t之前出現的大火的累積效應 （t為普通滲流過程的臨界時間：如果沒有大火，那麼在這一時間將有一個無窮連通簇出現）。我們想利用這些結果，進而控製臨界時間t之後森林的恢複狀況。具體而言，當森林已經被大火嚴重破壞，需要多少時間才能有一個新的大連通簇出現？第一步，我們將研究另外一個相關的過程，即“自毀性滲流過程”。關於這一過程的一些性質已被了解，而我們計劃在幾個方麵上得到更好的性質。“森林大火”是個典型的模型，我們還希望我們的結果可以被應用到其它相似的模型上，比如關於傳染病的模型。 我們還計劃研究一個在近期工作中被髮現的“近臨界雪崩”現象：在任一格點週圍都圍繞着一序列被燒掉的連通簇。我們希望進一步理解這一雪崩現象的初始階段，以便描述隨機性是如何傳遞到更小範圍的。這將對一個在臨界點還沒燒掉的區域提供很有價值的信息。

11318522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11318522.value: 鞍点计算的动力学和算法的研究课题

11318522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11318522.value: 躍遷事件出現在許多受熱噪聲影響的重要動力和物理系統中，例如化學反應和相變。在低溫度極限下，根據大偏差原理，稀有事件的轉變可以描述為跨越相關過渡狀態的過渡路徑。這種過渡狀態連接兩個相鄰的局部最小值，作為過渡路徑的瓶頸，並且有它們自己的幾何結構。在數學上，這些過渡態是能量表面上的一階鞍點。鞍點不僅出現在稀有事件中，而且還一直是應用數學其他領域的重要課題，例如優化， 控制理論、博弈論等。不失一般性，我們首先考慮一階鞍點。雖然傳統梯度下降動力學未能找到它們，許多基於海瑟矩陣最小模式的數值方法在過去的十年中得到了發展和應用，其中包括項目主持人以前的一些工作，比如連續時間動力學的最平緩上升動力學（GAD）和離散迭代的最小化公式（IMF）。這些方法已成功應用於諸如作為原子模型和相場的數學模型。然而，新的場景和挑戰也提出了新的計算效率和魯棒性上的關鍵問題。 該項目的主要目的是在理論上建立一個更普遍和整體的理解，並在鞍點問題的數值上構建新的創新方法，致力研究理解和擴展現有的鞍點動力學和建模，並產生新的加速數值方法。 主要有三項任務： (1) 處理真實能量函數計算成本太高時的情況，我們提出代理模型，例如高斯過程。同時結合GAD、實驗設計和高效數據標註方法。我們通過使用主動學習的創新思想解決選擇最佳實驗樣本位置的關鍵問題。 （2）研究迭代最小化公式（IMF） 跟微分博弈模型之間的顯式聯繫，建立在能量面上的鞍點跟構造的博弈模型的納什均衡之間的數學關係。我們開發一個可以利用雅可比的辛部分來調整梯度方法尋找鞍點的算法。 (3) 對於概率空間上的自由能鞍點，在描述無限個粒子的極限的概率測度空間中，我們旨在通過使用開發在 Wasserstein 流形上的 GAD 和 IMF 理論，通過截面曲率等工具來製定相應的數值方案。

11318722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11318722.value: 以非監督機器學習揭示量子多體系統中的量子相變和建構序參量

11318722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11318722.value: Quantum phase transitions (QPTs) is one of the most active research fields in condensed matter physics. Understanding quantum phase transitions is essential for comprehending exotic condensed matter phenomena like topological materials and unconventional superconductors. However, identifying the quantum phase transition and characterising the quantum phases in interacting many-body systems remains a challenging task. The conventional technique depends on Landau's symmetry-breaking theory, which is based on the concept of local order parameters. However, determining a suitable order parameter that defines the transition is a difficult operation that necessitates prior knowledge of the symmetry of the system. Due to the absence of pre-existing symmetry and the fact that the order parameter is often non-local, such a method is generally difficult to apply for systems that display topological phase transitions. Machine learning has recently emerged as a viable approach for identifying phase transitions in many-body systems without relying on empirical knowledge. Machine learning's strength rests in its capacity to discover features or structures in data without the need for explicit programming. Machine learning has been found to be able to recognise phase transitions in a variety of simple classical and quantum models. However, characterisation of topological phase transitions or phases without a local order parameter, particularly in interacting quantum many-body systems, is still a work in progress. This proposed research has two main goals: 1) To use unsupervised machine learning techniques to identify QPTs in interacting many-body systems, particularly those with topological phases or phases without a local order parameter; 2) To derive the potential order parameter of various quantum phases with the aid of machine learning. Specifically, the autoencoder, a machine that is trained to best reconstruct the input in its output layer through learning an effective representation of the input data at a reduced dimension, will be used. The trained machine's ability to transfer the learned knowledge to other previously unseen models and thus its capability to play the role of an order parameter will also be investigated. The proposed study will contribute to the development of new tools for analysing QPTs in interacting quantum many-body systems, as well as the application of machine learning to address condensed matter physics challenges. This may also pave the way for future technological advancements, particularly in the field of quantum information science, where the topological state of matter may enable quantum computation. 量子相變是當今凝聚態物理其中一個最活躍的研究領域。深入探討量子相變有助我們理解凝聚態物理中的一些奇異相，如拓撲材料和非常規超導體。然而，在一個複雜的量子多體系統中識別量子相變點和找出能描述各個量子相的物理量是一項具挑戰性的任務。傳統研究依賴朗道的對稱破缺理論和相應出現的局域序參量。但是對於拓撲系統中，很多時候系統的對稱性并非顯而易見，序參量亦可能是一個非局域的量，朗道的理論則不一定能應用於研究這類系統的相變。 近年，機器學習於研究量子相變中提供了一種新的思維。在對系統對稱性沒有前設認知下，研究員通過訓練機器去提取輸入數據中的特徵，從而識別體系中的相變。這個方法已在一些經典的多體系統和一些簡單的量子模型中證實是可行的。至於拓撲相變和刻劃沒有局域序參量的量子相，特別是在強關聯系統中的應用，目前還是有很多未知的問題有待探索。 本研究項目有兩個主要目標：一）於量子多體系統，特別是具相互作用的拓撲系統和非局部域序參量所描述的相變體系，使用非監督機器學習識別它們的量子相變；二) 借助機器學習推導各種量子相的序參數。具體來說，項目會使用機器學習中的自編碼器進行探索。自編碼器為神經網絡的一種，訓練目標是讓機器最大程度於輸出層重構輸入層的數據，通過限制其中間層的維度，強迫機器學習輸入數據的特徵去區分不同的量子相。該項目將為研究具相互作用的多體系統中量子相變現象提供一套嶄新的工具，有助我們探測未知系統中的相變和了解新奇量子相的特徵。

11318822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11318822.value: 等離子體的動理學方程解的色散結構

11318822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11318822.value: In this project, we will investigate the dispersive behavior of solutions to some kinetic models describing the collisional plasma, such as Vlasov-Poisson-Landau and Vlasov-Poisson-Boltzmann systems. Compared to the classical Boltzmann equation for dilute gas, solutions to these models are expected to have dispersive behavior because of the dispersion mechanism induced by electrostatic field. Therefore, it is of importance to understand the effect of this mechanism on the dynamics of plasma in different scales of physical interest. In the weak collisional regime, the dispersion comes from the celebrated Landau damping, which has been investigated fruitfully and extensively. However, in the hydrodynamic regime the dispersion mechanism has not been clearly described and there are much less results in this direction. Based on our recent study on the spectrum structure and Green's function of linearized Vlasov-Poisson-Boltzmann system around a global Maxwellian, in this project we aim to further study the asymptotic relations between kinetic models and the limiting dispersive equations in some suitable scalings. The project contains three parts. In the first part, we will study the spectrum structure of the linearized system in some physical regimes. By formal asymptotic analysis, one can observe that at the low frequency regime, the linearized operator has two branches of eigenvalues that have the same asymptotics as those of linearized KdV equations. Hence, we propose to justify this spectrum structure rigorously. In the second part, by establishing some uniform regularity estimates, we aim to justify the propagation of nonlinear ions-acoustic waves that are governed by the KdV equation. The third part is about the understanding of the relation between steady kinetic systems and the solitary waves. We expect that the analytic approaches used in this project can be applied to other problems of hydrodynamic limits. The results to be obtained will not only provide some new understanding on the dynamical behavior of plasma, but also shed some light on the explanation of some physical phenomena such as Debye shielding and propagation of ions-acoustic waves. 在這個項目中，我們將會研究一類描述等離子體運動的動理學方程解的色散結構，其中最基本的模型是Vlasov-Poisson-Landau和Vlasov-Poisson-Boltzmann模型。相比較於描述稀薄氣體的Boltzmann方程，在這類模型中由於靜電場誘導的色散機制，所對應的解應當具有某種色散結構。理解這些結構如何影響等離子體於不同的物理尺度下的運動是非常重要的。在碰撞效應很弱的情形下，色散機制來自於朗道阻尼，最近也已經有非常多的工作來理解這一類型的機制。然而，在流體動力學極限框架下等離子體的方程解的色散機制幾乎沒有被研究過。這也是本項目所考慮的核心問題。 基於我們最近建立的Vlasov-Poisson-Boltzmann方程在平衡態附近的線性化算子譜及其格林函數理論，我們將進一步探尋在合適的尺度下，這些模型與經典的色散方程之間的關係。項目包含如下的三個部分：第一，我們將繼續研究在特定物理尺度下的線性化算子的譜結構。通過漸進分析，我們觀察到在低頻部分，線性算子的譜具有兩個分支的點譜，它們和線性KdV方程的譜高度近似。我們將通過數學分析嚴格驗證這樣的結構。第二，我們將建立解在這種特定的尺度下的一致估計。利用這些估計，我們將驗證在等離子體中聲波的傳播可以用KdV方程來刻畫。第三，我們將研究在穩態情形下的解是否含有孤立波的結構。我們希望在這個項目中可以發展一套數學工具用來研究其他流體動力學極限的相關問題。所期待的研究成果不僅可以提供一些關於等離子體運動的新想法，而且可以幫助我們更好地理解一些諸如屏蔽效應或者聲波傳播的物理現象。

11500022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500022.value: 變分不等式的多列生成算法

11500022.label: Project Objectives
11500022.value: Develop an approach for column generation of variational inequality (VI) problems with multiple column generation techniques. The resulting algorithm(s) will be derived with specific theoretical properties, such as the existence and uniqueness of solutions of the VI models. The central result will be proof of convergence under fairly general conditions and multiple column generation approach. Note that the resulting algorithms will not converge monotonically like the CG of optimization models. The validity and reliability of the new method will be tested in applications to energy market equilibrium models.
rows: Develop an approach for column generation of variational inequality (VI) problems with multiple column generation techniques.
The resulting algorithm(s) will be derived with specific theoretical properties, such as the existence and uniqueness of solutions of the VI models.

The central result will be proof of convergence under fairly general conditions and multiple column generation approach. Note that the resulting algorithms will not converge monotonically like the CG of optimization models.
The validity and reliability of the new method will be tested in applications to energy market equilibrium models.

11500022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11500022.value: Column generation (CG) is a method to solve large-scale mathematical programming problems such as optimization models and variational inequalities (VI) involving a vast number of variables. These models can be found in multi-cloud systems, multi-commodity economic equilibrium models, and transportation models. These models would become too large to be solved due to the rise of big data. For example, large-scale VI problems can be easily found in stochastic VI settings with large-scale scenario analysis. Even a well-established VI solver (PATH) has been found to terminate when attempting to solve a large-scale VI problem due to a lack of memory. By using column generation algorithms, such large-scale problems can be decomposed into smaller subproblems to be solved on several computers. Another motivation for using CG is to improve model development and maintenance efficiency by joining separately well-developed submodels when a converged solution is needed. CG involves solving a subproblem and a master problem iteratively. It is assumed that there are efficient solution methods to solve the subproblem and the master problem. However, it is well known that the CG algorithms converge rapidly at first but subsequently slowly, with a long tail of near-optimal solutions. As the final optimality gap cannot be closed, this long-tail convergence resulting in poor computational performance becomes a drawback. Other drawbacks are dual oscillations and primal degeneracy, and alternative dual optimal solutions in optimization models. In our experience, CG methods for VI problems inherit this long-tail convergence property. From the literature, three stabilization techniques of optimization models can be found to ease the above drawbacks. These techniques are the proximity of a stability center, smoothing techniques, and centralized prizes for stabilizing the iterative dual solutions from the master problems. It is worthwhile to explore the use of these three stabilization techniques for VI problems. Moreover, some methods of easing long-tail convergence with these stabilization techniques will be developed to enhance CG-VI's computational performance. According to the literature on applying CG to optimization models, the larger the number of columns of the subproblem used to initialize the algorithm, the more quickly the solution can be found. Following this principle, we aim to develop a general method of solving multiple types of the subproblem (i.e., solving different kinds of the subproblem) in each CG iteration. 列生成 (CG) 是一種解決大規模數學規劃問題的方法，例如涉及大量變量的優化模型和變分不等式 (variational inequalities, VI)。 這些模型可以在多雲系統、多商品經濟均衡模型和交通模型中找到。 由於大數據的興起，這些模型將變得太大而無法解決。 例如，在具有大規模場景分析的隨機 VI 設置中，可以很容易地發現大規模 VI 問題。 甚至一個完善的 VI 求解器 (PATH) 在嘗試求解大規模 VI 問題時也會因內存不足而終止。 通過使用列生成算法，這樣的大規模問題可以分解成更小的子問題，在多台計算機上解決。 使用 CG 的另一個動機是通過在需要融合解決方案時加入單獨開發的子模型來提高模型開發和維護效率。 CG 涉及迭代地解決子問題和主問題。假設有有效的解決方法來解決子問題和主問題。然而，眾所周知，CG 算法起初收斂迅速，但隨後收斂緩慢，具有接近最優解的長尾。由於無法關閉最終的最優性差距，這種導致計算性能差的長尾收斂成為一個缺點。其他缺點是對偶振盪和原始退化，以及優化模型中的替代對偶最優解。根據我們的經驗，VI 問題的 CG 方法繼承了這種長尾收斂特性。從文獻中可以找到優化模型的三種穩定技術來緩解上述缺點。這些技術是穩定中心的接近度、平滑技術和用於穩定主問題的迭代對偶解決方案的集中獎勵。值得探討將這三種穩定技術用於 VI 問題。 此外，將開發一些使用這些穩定技術緩解長尾收斂的方法，以提高 CG-VI 的計算性能。 根據有關將CG應用於優化模型的文獻，用於初始化算法的子問題的列數越大，可以越快找到解決方案。 遵循這一原則，我們的目標是在每次 CG 迭代中開發一種解決多種類型子問題（即解決不同類型的子問題）的通用方法。

11500322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500322.value: 在抑郁症治疗中利用人工智能系统：潜在机制和促进因素

11500322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11500322.value: Prof Cenfetelli, Ron Dr Huang, Lei Dr Yan, Aihua

11500322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11500322.value: Mental illnesses, such as depression, have become a global medical crisis. Social stigma and insufficient mental healthcare workers are two major barriers for depressed patients to receive effective treatment. Leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) -enabled depression treatment system (AI system) is a possible way to remove these barriers because the presence of an AI system (vs. physician) can alleviate patients’ perception of social stigma, and AI can interact with a large number of users simultaneously. However, patients’ decision to accept an AI system depends on many other factors. Therefore, we propose to adopt a patient-centered approach to investigate the independent and joint effects of social stigma, task uncertainty, AI characteristics, and facilitating factors on patients’ decision to adopt and use the AI system. Study 1 will investigate patients’ preferences in care providers (i.e., AI, physician, and AI–physician hybrid) in depression treatment. AI–physician hybrid refers to an AI–physician task assembly in which the AI system interacts with patients at the front end and physicians verify the diagnosis results at the back end. We will also investigate the impacts of two contingent factors (social stigma and task uncertainty) and the possible underlying mechanisms (i.e., privacy concern and trust) that lead to the patients’ preference in care providers. Based on the results of Study 1, we expect that the barriers (e.g., low trust) in the use of AI or AI–physician hybrid in depression treatment can be identified. Study 2’s overarching objectives are to examine how the barriers could be mitigated or resolved through AI characteristics (empathy and explainability) and facilitating factors (company reputation and government regulation). Thus, Study 2 will explore the impacts of these AI characteristics and facilitating factors on patients’ initial use and reuse intention. Care providers’ empathy is a key characteristic that patients with depression value the most during consultations for depression treatment. Thus, we will investigate how AI empathy can alter patients’ privacy concerns and trust, which affect their initial use. Furthermore, we will explore how AI vendor reputation and government regulation can facilitate the impacts of empathy on privacy concerns and trust. Lastly, we will examine whether patients’ reuse intention will be contingent on AI explainability. Collectively, the results of these studies will benefit AI developers, public health policymakers, hospitals, and, most importantly, patients with depression. The outcome will lead to higher general well-being, a healthier workforce, fewer healthcare costs, and higher gross domestic product (GDP). 抑郁症等精神疾病已成为全球性的医疗危机。社会污名和医疗工作者不足是抑郁症患者接受有效治疗的两大障碍。在抑郁症治疗中利用人工智能系统 （AI系统）是消除这些障碍的一种可能的方法，因为AI系统的存在可以缓解患者对社会污名的感知，而且人工智能可以同时与大量患者互动。然而，患者是否接受AI系统还取决于许多其他因素。因此，我们建议采用以患者为中心的方法，研究社会污名和任务不确定性对患者采用AI系统的影响。研究首先将调查患者在抑郁症治疗中对护理提供者(即AI、医生和AI-医生结合)的偏好。AI-医生结合是指前端由AI系统与患者进行交互，后端由医生对诊断结果进行验证。我们还将研究导致患者对护理提供者偏好的两个调节因素(社会污名和任务不确定性)和可能的潜在机制(即隐私担忧和信任)。这些研究的结果将有利于AI系统开发人员、公共卫生政策制定者、医院和抑郁症患者。其结果将导致人民更高的总体幸福感、使社会有更健康的劳动力和更高的生产总值。

11501522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11501522.value: 在U-統計數值基礎上經驗風險最少化分法去解決大數據挑戰的研究

11501522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11501522.value: 用大數據的來臨為統計學帶給了機遇, 但也帶來了挑戰。其中一個機遇是可以在龐大的整體中找到有用的資料作決策用途。但如果計算在單一算機上進行，就算以今天的電腦動力和記憶 ，大數據也會帶來計算上的問題。一個普遍的解決方法, 是運用「劃分與征服」方法把龐大的數據分成可以處理的較少數據, 存儲於不同的算機內並進行獨立分析, 再把這些獨立的結果合併為最終決策。 這方法是今天最普及的大數據解決方法。 在這基礎上, 學者研發了很多機器學習的計算方法。但這些分佈算法在統計學上的有效性卻有待探究。傳統上, 統計程序的有效性是建立於中央計算的模式上, 但當計算是用分佈模式進行, 這些程序未必能保持它們的有效性。 這研究項目的重點集中在成對錯誤函數及經驗風險最少化empirical risk minimzation (ERM) 的基礎上, 分佈算法的運用。ERM is在統計學中常用到的一般估計原理, 而成對錯誤函數的例子也能在很多領域中找到。在這設置下的經驗風險估計器是個U-統計數值。眾所週知, 當計算最少的U-統計數值類型的經驗風險時,計算複雜性會隨着數據樣本的上升而有二次方的上升, 這無疑令中央計算無法進行。不但如此, 多不勝數的數據樣本也令計算完整的U-統計數值出現困難。後者是分佈計算在成對課題上的主要問題, 起源於目標函數不能分隔的觀察數值, 這令現有分佈算法未能應用。此研究項目的目的,是要研發在U-統計數值基礎上新的ERM分佈計算方法。 在這提議上, 我們提出一套有系統的方法去解決以上的問題。, 在我們的初步分析, 確定所提出的分佈方法能夠與基於中央計算的U-統計數值有同等的效率。我們將進一步研究它們的性質, 發展有效性的推理分法, 這包括協方差的估計法及制定重複計算法, 為求進一步改善效率。除此之外, 我們會用模擬方法去求證理論的可信性, 用實際數據去評估提出的分法的實用性, 及提供軟件給予別的研究員使用及改良。要求的資金主要用作聘請研究助理去進行經驗實例分析。

11501722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11501722.value: 考虑沟通渠道的用户阻塞的个性化客户营销

11501722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11501722.value: Prof Mookerjee, Vijay Prof Xu, Sean Xin

11501722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11501722.value: 现代信息技术允许创建与客户互动的个性化渠道，例如即时消息、移动应用程序和社交媒体帐户。这些渠道允许公司分发个性化促销信息影响客户购买。然而，通过个性化渠道发送侵入性营销信息也面临破坏客户关系的风险，并导致客户阻止公司未来的通信。我们中的许多人可能有挂断电话推销员、阻止应用程序通知或在日常生活中取消关注社交媒体帐户的经验。 考虑到个性化沟通渠道的脆弱性，企业有必要优化其客户参与活动，以平衡短期经济回报和长期客户关系。在解决这个问题的道路上，文献中有两个问题没有得到充分研究：1）个人客户与公司的联系如何受到对客户的个性化促销活动的影响，特别是在移动和社交营销环境中。 2) 考虑到通信受阻的可能性，如何制定客户参与活动策略以产生更高的客户价值。 在查看文献中的这些空白时，该项目计划利用真实世界的数据来检查移动应用程序和社交网络环境中通信渠道的阻塞，这可能会受到促销信息的频率、时间、风格和产品的影响。在此过程中，项目将考虑客户的异质性，他们可能对相同的参与活动有相反的反应。然后该项目将建立一个动态优化模型并设计一个合适的算法来优化公司的长期回报。所提出的算法和模型可以通过模拟和实验进行评估。 从理论的角度来看，所提出的研究将加深我们对客户和公司之间个性化沟通渠道稳定性的理解。从实践的角度来看，研究中提供的策略和算法将对现代公司进行个性化客户广告有用。作为在大数据时代的国际金融中心，香港有很多金融公司高度依赖基于信息技术的沟通渠道与世界各地的异类客户进行互动。该研究的结果将有助于他们的长期成功。此外，疫情的发展导致香港和全球的在线服务快速增长。该项目的研究结果也将有助于这些新的（和小型的）在线公司管理他们与对侵入性通信越来越敏感的客户的关系。

11502122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502122.value: 多產品採購決策：基於特徵的替代、數據驅動和偏好學習

11502122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502122.value: 在開發協助多產品（項目）採購決策的分析工具中，一個具有挑戰性的問題是如何利用產品的屬性（特徵）來解決替代效應。 這個問題具有挑戰性是因爲歷史銷售數據很少能捕捉到一個產品的銷售是由其基礎需求引起的，還是來自另一個缺貨的產品的替代。 當新產品被引入到一個現有品種 (assortment) 的產品中時，這個問題會進一步加劇，因爲沒有關於其需求的歷史數據。然而，如果一個公司過去一直在銷售該品類的類似產品，並持有相關記錄； 就服裝而言，記錄包括產品特徵的豐富信息，如顏色、面料、設計風格、銷售季節、價格等。 這樣的特徵信息將在購物者選擇一種產品時發揮重要作用。直觀地說，對產品需求的預測是通過將到達的購物者的 "選擇 "與面對 "類似的 "可選購產品集的過往購物者的 "選擇 "聯繫起來進行的。 我們建議研究零售商根據交易數據確定所有產品的初始訂單數量的問題；這些數據記錄了每個產品的特徵信息，過去的購物者從一個品種中購買了哪些產品，以及在他們 "購物 "的時候有哪些產品。 我們不會假設購物者的價值分佈模型，而只是假定，選擇是根據他們對可用產品的排名順序做出的，而這又是由產品特徵決定的。也就是說，一個產品被購買而不是其他產品被購買，是因爲購物者對它的排名（ranking）最高。 (不購買也被認爲是一種選擇。) 因此，個人的排名順序可以從數據中部分觀察到。然後，通過衡量產品之間相似性的排名核來學習個人的排名順序--偏好。接下來，購買單個產品的近似概率被估計出來，銷售季節的平均利潤被推導出來，在此基礎上確定最佳訂單數量。 估計的一致性和漸進最優性將被確立，近似策略也將被開發。合成和真實數據將被用來進行全面的數字實驗，以測試分析框架和解決方案的有效性，並獲得管理洞察。

11502222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502222.value: 初創公司在電子平台的生存狀況：亞馬遜對其平台電商企業影響的研究

11502222.label: Project Objectives
11502222.value: We assess whether Amazon's own product introductions on its platform decrease the sales of competing third-party products listed by startups. We identify competing products in two ways: (1) those listed on the platform that have identical product classifications as Amazon's newly introduced products and (2) those recommended as alternatives to Amazon's own products to shoppers by Amazon's algorithm (e.g., products that are "also viewed" by other shoppers). We hypothesize that startup products targeted by Amazon experience a decline in sales. By studying this product sales channel, we contribute to the academic literature by establishing, for the first time to our knowledge, a relationship between product competition and product sales for platform-dependent startups. Understanding the nature of product competition on digital platforms is valuable to entrepreneurs when considering listing certain products for sale online. Regulators interested in making policy to ensure fair competition on digital platforms may also draw insight from this analysis. We assess whether the removal of the "Buy Now" button on a product's webpage has a negative impact on a product's sales. If the button is missing, shoppers instead see a hyperlink titled "Available from these sellers" and must navigate through more webpages to buy a product. These extra steps imposed on shoppers can lead to fewer completed purchases. Since 2017, Amazon allegedly removed these buttons for products that have been listed on other digital platforms at lower prices. We hypothesize that the removal of these buttons leads to immediate decreases in product sales. Our study therefore contributes to the academic literature by exploring the product sales impact from platform design changes. This analysis is valuable for startup founders as it quantifies the relationship between online shopper behavior and product sales. We assess whether the decrease in product sales from the two empirical settings described above undermines overall startup performance, which we measure by the likelihood and amount of venture capital (VC) financing secured over a period. New rounds of VC financing indicate startup growth. We hypothesize that Amazon's anticompetitive platform interventions reduce a startup's ability to obtain additional VC rounds. Our study contributes to the academic literature by quantifying the degree in which startup success is linked to actual sales growth on digital platforms. This analysis is useful in risk management for startup founders and in designing policy to promote entrepreneurship for regulators. We assess whether the decrease in product sales from the two empirical settings described above undermines startup survivability, which we measure by the likelihood of going bankrupt or being acquired. We hypothesize that Amazon's anticompetitive platform interventions increase both bankruptcy likelihood and chances of being targeted for acquisition. Liquidation is expected for many platform-dependent startups if they cannot generate income. This analysis contributes to the academic literature by quantifying the degree in which startup survivability is linked to actual sales growth on digital platforms. This analysis is useful in risk management for startup founders and in designing policy to promote entrepreneurship for regulators. We assess whether the decrease in product sales from the two empirical settings described above undermines product innovation, which we measure by the quantity and quality of new patents filed and whether new products are introduced on Amazon by platform-dependent startups. Online retail platforms can expedite product development as customers can provide real-time feedback, which can be incorporated in subsequent iterations of existing products. We hypothesize that Amazon's anticompetitive platform interventions discourage startups in investing in R&D and in exposing their entire portfolio of products on Amazon. With less income, startups have less resources to devote to product development. This analysis is useful in risk management for startup founders and in designing policy to promote investments in innovations for regulators. We verify that Amazon's anticompetitive platform interventions are less effective on platform-dependent startups with stronger intellectual property protection, as measured by their patent portfolio size. Products with weak intellectual property protection could be more vulnerable to imitation products made by Amazon. Confirming this prediction would provide additional empirical support for the product sales channel and inform third-party sellers of a potential strategy to insulate themselves from losing sales to Amazon's own products. We write papers publishable in top tier finance journals.
