11502222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502222.value: The growth and development of online retail giants such as Amazon.com has given many startups online platforms to conduct a large portion of their sales over the Internet. Using Amazon's retail platform, startups theoretically have access to millions of customers, can set their own prices, and determine how their products are shipped, all without the need to invest in expensive physical overhead (e.g., physical stores, warehouses). However, with nearly 40 percent of all U.S. online sales occurring on its platform, Amazon possesses significant clout over all its third-party sellers. For example, Amazon has recently been reported to not only have coerced several startups to remove products from other platforms that are listed at lower prices, but to also have introduced private-label brands that compete directly with third-party products. The breadth and depth to which these actions influence platform-dependent startups has yet to be systematically explored in the academic literature. In this project we fill this knowledge gap by determining whether Amazon's anticompetitive interventions in its own platform undermine startup performance and survivability. The current knowledge gap may be caused by decreased scrutiny from regulators of the online retail marketplace secondary to the benefit of lower product prices afforded to online consumers which likely overshadows the financial struggles of online platform-using startups. Unfortunately, platform-dependent sellers cannot afford to lose access to a platform's massive customer base and are financially constrained to the point where they must comply with any changes to the platform's rules and conditions, many of which may discourage competition and product innovation. Amazon's retail platform is an ideal environment to evaluate this likelihood since we observe the product sales channel. Using the universe of product information, sales, prices, and startup seller information, we study the economics of Amazon's digital platform and the role it plays in facilitating or hindering entrepreneurship. We seek to determine whether Amazon's unilateral changes in its platform's ecosystem has a detrimental impact on startup survival and performance. Specifically, we investigate how startup product sales, product innovation, likelihood of securing venture capital financing, and likelihood of going bankrupt or being acquired are affected by Amazon's private-label brand introductions and the removal of the "Buy Now" button on the webpages of certain products for which Amazon's algorithms detect lower prices from other online retailers. Our goal is to establish empirically a source of potential sales risk born on startups that are locked to a particular digital platform. Amazon.com 等在線零售巨頭的發展和成長使得許多初創公司透過在線平台實現了其大部分的銷售。使用亞馬遜的零售平台，初創公司理論上可以接觸到數百萬客戶，可以自行定價，並確定產品的運輸方式，而不需要投入較多資金在實體開銷（例如實體店、倉庫）。然而，由於近 40% 的美國在線零售都透過亞馬遜，亞馬遜對其所有第三方賣家擁有巨大的影響力。例如，據報導，亞馬遜最近不僅要求幾家初創公司將他們在其他平台價格較低的產品下架，且引入了亞馬遜自有品牌產品，與旗下第三方產品直接競爭。亞馬遜的舉措對依賴其平台的初創公司的影響的廣度和深度尚未在學術文獻中被系統地探討。在這個項目中，我們通過確定亞馬遜對其自身平台的反競爭干預是否會破壞初創公司的業績和生存能力來填補這一知識空白。當前的知識差距可能是由於在線零售市場監管機構的審查減少，其次是在線平台給消費者提供了較低價格的產品，可能掩蓋了使用在線平台的初創公司的財務困境。不幸的是，依賴平台的賣家不能失去來自平台的龐大客戶群，並且其在財務上的限制使得他們不得不遵守平台規則和條件的任何變化，其中許多可能會阻礙競爭和產品創新。亞馬遜的零售平台是評估此課題的最佳管道，因為我們觀察了產品銷售管道。通過產品信息、銷售、價格和初創賣家信息，我們研究了亞馬遜數字平台的經濟及其在促進或阻礙創業方面所起的作用。我們試圖研究亞馬遜對其平台生態系統的單方面變化是否會對初創企業的生存和業績產生不利影響。具體而言，我們調查了亞馬遜的自有品牌產品介紹，以及亞馬遜網頁上“立即購買”按鈕的移除，亞馬遜算法從其他在線零售商處檢測到較低價格的某些產品，將如何影響初創公司的產品銷售、產品創新、獲得風險投資融資的可能性，以及破產或被收購的可能性。我們的目標是憑經驗研究鎖定在特定在線平台的初創公司的潛在銷售風險來源。

11502422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502422.value: 基於有限信息的魯棒機制設計

11502422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11502422.value: Dr HU, Zhenyu Ms WANG, Ruiqin

11502422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502422.value: Revenue maximization when selling a single item to a single buyer with private valuation is an important topic in mechanism design and is a fundamental building block for more complicated models that involve multiple items or multiple interacting buyers. Its applications appear in a rich range of domains including economics, marketing, and revenue management. A well-designed selling mechanism should be individually rational such that the buyer is willing to participate in the mechanism and at the same time, be incentive-compatible such that no buyer would misreport his valuation. It is well known that as long as the seller knows the buyer's valuation distribution, the strategy of posting a fixed price, named the posted price mechanism, is then optimal. In practice, however, the distribution of the buyer's valuation is rarely known precisely. Rather, the seller often only has a confident estimation of certain statistics, such as maximum and mean, of the buyer's valuation, or a collection of historical data. In such a case, optimality of the posted price mechanism can be fragile---if the seller does not have full information about the buyer's valuation distribution, the seller may achieve a higher revenue if using a selling mechanism beyond the posted price mechanism. This motivates us to study the general problem of finding a robust selling mechanism when the seller has limited information on the valuation distribution. In this project, we adopt the robust optimization framework and assume the seller merely knows that the buyer's valuation distribution belongs to an information set of probability distributions that can have its own emphasis in characterizing its member distributions. The seller then seeks an optimal selling mechanism that performs the best with respect to the most adverse distribution that may arise from the information set. We plan to explore this problem with single-buyer and single-item as a starting step and then extend along the following directions. First, the seller can follow different decision criteria (such as the Hurwicz criterion or regret criterion) to guide her decision-making under uncertainty. Second, there could potentially be multiple buyers competing for multiple items through an auction. Third, is there any easy-to-implement heuristic with performance guarantees? Finally, we are keen on applying our theoretical results into practical problems such as online advertising. 在不清楚買方估值的情形下，賣方採用何種定價策略售賣單一產品以最大化其期望收益是機制設計領域的一個重要問題，也是拓展到其他更複雜的售賣模型（例如多買方或多產品）的基礎。這一問題可以廣泛應用於包括經濟、營銷和收益管理在內的多個領域。一個合理的定價策略必須同時滿足個體理性（即買方願意考慮該定價策略）和激勵相容（即買方會如實根據自己的估值做出選擇）。現有文獻研究指出，當賣方知道買方的估值分佈時，簡單的固定價格策略已經是最優的定價策略。 然而現實中，賣方往往並不知道買方的估值分佈。相反，賣方僅僅知道買方估值分佈的有限信息，例如均值和方差等數據統計量，或者一些歷史估值數據。在僅知道估值分佈的有限信息的情形下，固定價格策略並不是最優的，賣方可以通過採用更複雜的定價策略獲取更高的收益。這促使我們研究應該採取怎樣的定價策略以最大化期望收益。 本課題中，我們採取魯棒優化的方法並假定賣方僅知道真實的買方的估值分佈源自某一個信息集。作為一個分佈族，該信息集裡的每一個分佈都滿足相同的分佈信息。賣方的最優定價策略考慮信息集裡的最壞情形並最大化最壞情形下的期望收益。我們首先研究單買方單產品模型，併計劃從多個角度拓展本課題的研究。一、除了考慮最壞情形之外，賣方也可以考慮其他決策準則，如Hurwicz決策準則或最小後悔度準則等。二、研究多買方或多產品的拍賣模型。三、尋找簡單易用又有表現保證的定價策略。四、將理論結果應用在實際場景中，例如在線廣告。

11502622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502622.value: 抗生素使用的最优控制：管理患者的期望和医生的处方行为

11502622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502622.value: The overuse (or abuse) of antibiotics often leads to antibiotic resistance in bacteria. This is one of the largest public health challenges faced by our society. Governments and organizations around the world have called for the prudent use of antibiotics. Rules and guidelines have been set up for the use of antibiotics. Yet, antibiotic abuse is still commonly observed in many countries and regions. The underlying driving forces for this phenomenon include the patients' preference towards antibiotics and the financial incentives associated with health practitioners. Some patients merely wish to be treated with antibiotics to recover faster without considering the antibiotic resistance incurred in the future, and health practitioners are often paid each time they dispense an antibiotic. To treasure the antibiotics resources, it is important to find the optimal usage of it over the time. Past studies mainly consider it as a first-best control problem, without taking patients' preference and doctors' financial incentives into consideration. In this project, we plan to investigate the optimal control of the antibiotic usage with a consideration of both patients' and doctors' behavior issues. In our preliminary studies, we have tried to set up susceptible–infected–susceptible (SIS) infectious disease models to characterize the dynamics of the development of antibiotic resistance in a population. We also proposed a way to calculate patients' perceived utility when they recognize side-effects of antibiotic usage. Successful completion of this project will offer insightful suggestions to policy makers on how to best control the usage of antibiotics over time. 抗生素的过度使用（或滥用）通常会导致细菌对抗生素产生耐药性。这个是我们社会面临的最大公共卫生挑战之一。政府和世界各地的组织都呼吁谨慎使用抗生素， 并且制定规则和使用抗生素的指南。然而，抗生素滥用仍然在许多国家和地区普遍存在。驱动这种现象的潜在原因包括患者对抗生素的偏好和健康服务提供者相关的激励措施。一些患者只是希望接受抗生素治疗，可以更快地恢复而不考虑产生的抗生素耐药性，医疗从业人员经常从抗生素处方中获得额外的报酬。珍惜抗生素资源，找到最佳随着时间的推移如何使用抗生素的方法。过去的研究主要认为它是一个最佳控制问题，没有考虑到患者的偏好和医生的激励问题。在这个项目中，我们计划考虑患者和医生的行为问题， 并且在此基础上研究对抗生素使用的最佳控制。在我们的初步研究中，我们试图建立易感-感染-易感（SIS）传染病模型描述人群中抗生素耐药性动态发展。我们还提出了一种方法来计算副作用对患者的负效用, 并基于此来对患者使用抗生素情况进行建模。该项目的成功完成将对医疗决策者提供有益的见解， 并就如何随着时间的推移最好地控制抗生素的使用向政策制定者提出建议。

11502922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502922.value: 用非挑戰的方式挑戰現狀 - 以支配補償的視角看待詢問式建言

11502922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11502922.value: Prof KIM, You Jin Dr Newton, Daniel Prof Romney, Alex

11502922.label: Project Objectives
11502922.value: To study the effectiveness of voice inquiry in contributing to endorsement among dominant leaders. To examine a new mechanism – leader sense of power – in explaining the hypothesized relationship while controlling for a known alternative mediator, leader sense of threat. To resolve inconsistent views with respect to how direct employees should speak up to their leaders to secure endorsement
rows: To study the effectiveness of voice inquiry in contributing to endorsement among dominant leaders.
To examine a new mechanism – leader sense of power – in explaining the hypothesized relationship while controlling for a known alternative mediator, leader sense of threat.
To resolve inconsistent views with respect to how direct employees should speak up to their leaders to secure endorsement

11502922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502922.value: It is often assumed that dominant leaders resist employee voice due to their confident, assertive, and forceful tendencies. Yet these leaders are also tasked with endorsing and implementing subordinate voice for the betterment of their organization. This presents a theoretical and practical puzzle as to how voicers might secure endorsement for change-oriented initiatives from dominant leaders. Drawing upon dominance complementarity theory (Kiesler, 1983), we unpack this puzzle and propose that voice inquiry, defined as speaking up with improvement-oriented suggestions in the form of an inquiry, is an effective way to secure endorsement, which refers to leader acceptance and implementation of employee suggestions from dominant leaders. Voice inquiry thus enables employees to challenge the status quo in a non-challenging way. Building on recent research that has emphasized inquiry as an effective means of exercising influence and improving the quality of relationships (Van Quaquebeke & Felps, 2018), we predict that voice inquiry conveys a sense of submission that complements dominant leaders. We hypothesize that the implicit confirmation of leaders’ positive self-views through voice inquiry will induce a heightened sense of power, that is, the feeling of being influential and in control of a dyadic relationship. In turn, this heightened sense of power will be associated with increased levels of endorsement. We further predict that although voice inquiry may help enhance endorsement, the sense of power induced by voice inquiry may motivate dominant leaders to engage in credit claiming, which refers to leaders’ taking credit for employees’ ideas. We will examine our hypotheses using a longitudinal moderated mediation design with multiple sources (participants and their leaders) and cross-lagged panel data across three time waves to provide a strong causal test of the hypothesized relationship. In sum, our work investigates a potential benefit (increased endorsement) and cost (increased credit claiming) of speaking up in the form of inquiry, it thus represents a novel line of research in the voice literature that has important practical implications for how employees can speak up more effectively in the workplace. 人們通常認為，主導型領導由於其自信、果敢和強勢的傾向而抵制員工的建言。然而，這類領導有責任認可和實施下屬的建言，以改善其組織。這提出了一個理論和實踐上的難題，即建言者如何獲得主導型領導對其變革型倡議的支持。借鑒支配補償理論（Kiesler, 1983)，我們對這一難題進行解讀，提出詢問式建言，即員工以詢問的方式提出以改善為導向的建議，是獲得認可的有效途徑，而認可是指主導型領導對建議的接受和實施。因此，詢問使員工能夠以一種非挑戰的方式挑戰現狀。最近的研究強調詢問是一種施加影響力和提升關係品質的有效手段，在此基礎上，我們預測詢問傳達了一種能夠補償主導型領導的服從感。我們假設，通過詢問對領導者積極的自我觀點進行的隱性確認，會誘發出更高的權力感，即在二元關係中具有影響力和控制權的感覺。反過來，這種權力感的增強將與認可度的提升產生關聯。我們進一步預測，儘管詢問式建言可能有助於增強認可度，由其誘發的權力感可能會激勵主導型領導進行邀功，即領導者把員工的想法歸功於自己。我們將使用一個縱向的有調節的仲介設計來檢測我們的假設，該設計有多個來源（參與者及其領導）和跨越三個時間波段的交叉滯後面板資料，以對假設的關係提供一個有力的因果檢驗。 總而言之，我們的文章研究了以詢問的形式發聲建言的潛在好處（增加認可度）和成本（增加領導邀功的可能），這代表了建言文獻中一個新穎的研究方向，並對員工如何在工作場所更有效地發聲有重要的實踐意義。

11502922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11502922.value: Speaking up can help get support for new ideas, but some people hesitate to do it directly because it might upset their boss or create problems for themselves. This raises the question of whether there are better ways to suggest improvements without directly challenging their leader. To solve this, the concept of "voice inquiry" is introduced, which means asking questions about suggestions for improvement instead of making statements. This approach is seen as more respectful and can make leaders feel more powerful, which encourages them to support the ideas. The research involved different studies with employees and leaders to explore how voice inquiry works and how it can lead to more support from leaders, especially when those leaders are very dominant. Overall, the findings show that this question-based approach can be an effective way to gain endorsement for new initiatives.

11503222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11503222.value: 貿易成本和中國的電子商務：物流企業的角色

11503222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11503222.value: E-commerce plays an increasingly important role in our lives, especially during the COVID-19 lockdown. The success of e-commerce is impossible without an efficient logistics network that delivers goods quickly and cheaply. Nevertheless, e-commerce logistics services have not benefited every region equally. The cost of delivering a parcel in Huangnan, a western Chinese city, was almost 20 times higher than in Jinhua, an eastern city, in 2020. Moreover, the e-commerce logistic sector is highly concentrated, with the eight largest firms capturing more than 82% of China's market share in 2020. This project will study the relationship between the market structure of the logistics sector and the inter-regional e-commerce trade cost in China. We will collect data from China's largest logistics platform for e-commerce. Combined with e-commerce trade data and other data published by governments, we aim to uncover new phenomena on logistics, trade cost, and e-commerce in China. We will develop a quantifiable trade model with endogenous trade costs due to imperfect competition between logistics firms. The model will be consistent with the new stylized facts and generate novel predictions about logistics, trade, and the spatial distribution of economic activities. We will then estimate the model and quantify the impact of trade policies and competition policies on trade costs and the welfare gains from e-commerce. 電子商務在我們的生活中扮演著越來越重要的角色，尤其是在新冠病毒大流行（COVID-19）期間。 沒有高效的物流網絡，使得貨物的交付快速和廉價，電子商務的成功是不可能的。 然而，電子商務物流的服務並沒有平等地惠及每個地區。 2020年，中國西部地區黃南藏族自治州的包裹投遞成本幾乎是東部地區金華市的20倍。此外，電子商務物流行業高度集中，八家最大的中國物流公司佔據了2020年中國市場的份額超過82%。 本項目將研究中國物流行業市場結構與區域間電子商務貿易成本之間的關係。 我們將從中國最大的電子商務物流平台收集數據。 結合電子商務貿易數據和政府公佈的其他數據，我們旨在揭示物流、貿易成本和電子商務的新現象。 我們將建立一個由於物流公司之間的不完全競爭形成內生貿易成本的可量化貿易模型。 該模型將與數據揭示的新事實保持一致，並產生關於物流、貿易和經濟活動空間分佈的新預測。最後，我們將估計模型並量化貿易政策和競爭政策對貿易成本和電子商務福利收益的影響。

11503322.label: Co - Investigator(s)

11503322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11503322.value: 在這個研究項目中，我們提出了一個基本問題，考慮到個人或家庭（以下簡稱代理人）的不同背景，例如年齡、文化、教育、道德、對死亡風險的態度等，他們將如何以最佳方式應對大流行——在一個人人都理性且見多識廣的自由社會中。我們的目標是在大流行不確定性下開發和分析一個全面的、動態的決策模型，該模型足夠通用，同時易於處理，並從理論上和經驗上研究模型預測。 與現有文獻相比，我們的模型將表現出以下新穎特徵。 •無症狀和有症狀的疾病傳播 •路徑依賴的感染概率，受過去和當前行為的影響 •具有可觀察和不可觀察特徵（或私人信息）的異質個體 •疾病的隨機傳播率 •決策問題是信息不完整的動態博弈 據我們所知，迄今為止，上述考慮因素尚未納入大流行相關文獻的分析中。目前的項目將有助於沿著這些現實維度邁出第一步。 我們將推導出一個連續的公共反應均衡（類似於在這種情況下的完美貝葉斯均衡），並描述大流行期間每個時期代理人的最佳行動。我們將證明，用於模擬疾病傳播的凹匹配函數的常見假設意味著公眾反應兩極分化，即，部分代理人會發現在每個時期選擇“安全第一”行動以最小化他們的感染概率是最佳的，而其餘的的代理人選擇零保護的“照常生活”行動。動態比較靜態分析將顯示更有可能生病或預計一旦感染會遭受更多痛苦的代理人傾向於選擇安全第一的行動，而對於不太容易生病和痛苦的代理人則相反。然而，一個搭便車的問題將阻止所有代理人選擇安全第一的行動，即使這樣做是社會最優的。 為了證明我們模型的有效性，我們將在實證分析中調查人們對各種預防措施的反應。我們計劃利用兩個數據源：（a）從 29 個國家和地區收集的調查數據集（b）使用移動設備的位置記錄獲得的個人移動數據集。第一個數據集使我們能夠分析哪些個體特徵決定了人們對 Covid-19 大流行的反應，而第二個數據集有助於獲得預防行為的異質選擇分佈及其對 Covid-19 大流行的影響。 該項目的長期影響將是學術和政策方面的雙重影響。可以想像，通用模型將鼓勵許多後續學術論文，要么銳化或進一步擴展該項目產生的主要成果的範圍。從政策的角度來看，一個與人們的喜好不相符的社會政策，會引起社會摩擦，不太可能奏效。了解人們在自由行動時的行為，將為尋找社會最優目標和實施最優政策的最佳方法提供有價值的見解。

11504022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11504022.value: 政治黨派、共同基金投票和公司治理

11504022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11504022.value: 在過去的二十年裡，政黨隸屬關係已成為一種顯著的社會認同。作為日益加劇的政治兩極分化的一部分，人們傾向於將共同黨派人士歸類為他們的內群體成員，而反對黨派人士則歸類為他們的外群體成員。隨之而來的與政治黨派關係相關的群體內偏袒和群體外敵意在政治和日常生活中以多種方式表現出來。該項目旨在通過研究共同基金經理在對代理投票提案進行投票時是否以及如何出於政治動機來研究政治黨派在資產管理行業中的作用。 我們研究共同基金經理的投票行為是否受到他們與投資組合公司首席執行官的政治親和力的影響。我們通過共同基金經理和公司首席執行官對政治候選人的個人競選捐款來識別他們的政治黨派。我們預計，政治黨派偏見會促使基金經理在需要 CEO 的説明時向其求助——尤其是在關鍵和有爭議的代理提案中。我們預計，這種支援不是由“交換條件”驅動的，即以更好的基於資訊的交易策略的形式為基金經理提供更好的業績，而是因為希望幫助一位具有共同政治傾向的 CEO。鑒於這種幫助難以證明是合理的，我們預計具有政治動機的資產管理公司在對無爭議提案進行投票時會進行信號干擾。 鑒於群體外的威脅往往會增強群體內的偏袒，我們預計，當執政政黨的政治色彩與基金經理和公司首席執行官所共有的黨派偏見不同時，這種投票行為會被放大。此外，我們預計，當公司遇到激進事件時，例如管理層特別需要幫助的附錄 13D 檔和證券集體訴訟，以及存在對基金的更大聲譽問題時，這種投票行為會更加突出。經理——即支持 ESG 排名較差的公司的 CEO。 我們會進一步研究政治傾向的基金如何影響投資組合公司的公司治理品質。我們預計，通過在代理提案中扭曲共同基金的投票激勵，政治親和力將降低股東監督的有效性並導致不利的治理結果。我們預計，政治親和基金的存在會降低收購公告的回報，降低 CEO 離職績效的敏感性，並導致市場估值下降。

11504322.value: 數據驅動的共享單車站點庫存衝平衡系統

11504322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11504322.value: Dr CHEN, Wewei Prof YU, Yimin

11504322.label: Project Objectives
11504322.value: The ultimate goal is to develop an end-to-end data-driven bike-sharing rebalancing optimization system considering spatial-temporal demand substitution. The proposed framework consists of a deep learning predictor to model the substitution effect from the historical bike system data and a data-driven decomposition-optimization algorithm for proactive system rebalancing optimization. To develop a GCN-LSTM bike demand prediction model with a GCN unit for spatial substitution effect embedding and a sequence of LSTM units for modeling the temporal substitution dynamics in a bike transition network. To design a data-driven decomposition-optimization algorithm that decomposes the large-scale multi-vehicle routing problem into multiple small-scale one-vehicle routing problems. To empirically examine the operational impact of the spatial-temporal demand substitution on rebalancing operations and evaluate the performance of the proposed system using real-world data.

11504322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11504322.value: 共享單車已經廣泛應用於城市的最後一公里通行。 由於共享單車需求的地理位置和時間不平衡，共享單車需要在不同站點中進行實時庫存重平衡，以維持單車站點的庫存量。 優化共享單車重平衡有兩個挑戰。 （1）在考慮時空需求替代的情況下，在站點級別準確預測客戶騎車與還車需求；（2）在存在異常值和替代站點的情況下，高效優化大規模共享單車系統中多個庫存調度卡車的行駛路徑。 本項目考慮時空需求的替代關係，為共享單車系統的數據驅動再平衡優化問題提供解決方案。 首先，我們提出了用圖卷積網絡來捕捉起始站點到目的站點的在地理空間上的需求分佈，並使用長短期記憶單元的序列模型分析時間維度的需求變化，以實共享單車的時空維度下的需求預測。 為了解決優化再平衡車輛的調度路徑，我們提出了一種分割-聚類-聚合算法。該算法將多個調度車輛路徑優化問題分解為小型的單調度車輛路徑優化問題。當調度目標超過車輛容量時，我們的分割求解算法允許多個調度車輛共同滿足單個站點的調度需求。最後，我們將使用真實共享單車系統數據進行實驗，用於驗證時空需求替代關係對自行車需求預測精度的影響和數據驅動優化系統的性能。 本項目通過將多源自行車系統數據、氣象條件和需求替代的時空動態關係融合到基於深度學習的預測模型，以提高站點層面的自行車需求預測準確性。 該數據驅動的優化系統集成了需求預測和異質性下的再平衡優化來提供一個預測優化框架。因此，我們可以高效有效地解決大規模的共享單車再站點庫存重平衡問題。 我們將為使用傳統數學分解的大規模車輛路徑優化問題提供一種通過數據驅動的替代方法。

11505322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11505322.value: 可變年金套期保值能否解釋超額隱含波動率之謎?

11505322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11505322.value: Excess implied volatility is a key stylized fact in derivative markets. Excess volatility is the fact that the relationship between short-dated and long-dated option implied volatility deviates strongly from an entire class of rational models – long-dated volatility moves “too much” relative to predictions from models given movements short-dated volatility. The leading explanation for this stylized fact is investor behavioral mistakes. I describe how a large and often neglected market participant can drive these effects. Variable Annuity guarantees embedded in insurance company liabilities drive a very particular set of exposures for derivatives dealers. Ultimately, dealers are forced to purchase long-dated volatility after an increase in short-dated volatility, and they are forced to sell long-dated volatility after a decrease in short-dated volatility. This mechanism can potentially explain the excess volatility puzzle and makes unique predictions - absent in alternative explanations - about the products and times in which the excess volatility effect will be stronger. 超額波動是金融衍生工具市場中一個關鍵的典型事實。超額波動是短期和長期期權隱含波動率在整組理性模型中偏離的結果 —— 相對於模型對短期波動率變動的的預測，長期波動率變動得“太多”。投資者的行為錯誤是此典型事實的主要解釋。我描述了這些大量且常被忽視的市場參與者如何推動這些影響。多變的保證年金嵌入在保險公司的負債中，為衍生工具交易商帶來了一組特定的風險敞口。最終，交易商在短期波動率上升後被迫買入長期波動率，然後在短期波動率下降後被迫賣出長期波動率。這種機制可能可以解釋超額波動率的謎團並提出獨特的預測 —— 不存在另外一種解釋 —— 關於決定超額波動強弱的產品和時間。

11505422.label: Major findings and research outcome
11505422.value: The research findings are published by Pricing under Consumer Habituation: The Optimality of aFamiliarity-Based Threshold Policy. Production and Operations Management, accepted, November, 2025; https://doi.org/10.1177/10591478251399862 In this article, we analyze the long-run optimal customized dynamic pricing strategy in the presence of consumer habituation for time/frequency-based consumption. The consumer’s willingness to pay is determined by past consumption via the habitual level of consumption. We formulate the seller’s continuous-time profit maximization problem over an infinite horizon as an optimal control problem and derive the closed-form value function and optimal pricing strategy. We identify a key condition on the willingness-to-pay function that captures both the magnitude of the habituation effect and the saturated willingness to pay, which plays a central role in determining the seller’s optimal pricing policy. When consumers retain interest even at high levels of habitual consumption, always selling by pricing at their current willingness to pay is optimal. In contrast, if consumers lose interest when saturated, the optimal policy becomes a cutoff strategy, where the seller offers the product only when consumption remains below a critical threshold and prices out consumers beyond it. We further examine the resulting pricing and consumption dynamics and characterize an equilibrium habitual level of consumption at which randomized promotions can be optimal. Furthermore, our key findings qualitatively hold under random consumer valuation, but with richer patterns. Our work provides a tractable, closed-form characterization of the optimal dynamic pricing policy under consumer habituation, offering a more nuanced understanding of the strategic implications of an inverted U-shaped willingness-to-pay.

11505422.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11505422.value: We also investigate the dynamic pricing under satiation and habit formation, which is more general than consumer habituation. That constitutes a new project which we are currently working on. For firms, they can utilize the pricing strategies we derived in practice in customized pricing.

11505422.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11505422.value: This study explores the best way for a seller to price products for long-term customers based on their specific habits. Researchers found that the "sweet spot" for pricing depends on how much a customer's interest drops as they consume more. Key Findings The "Always Selling" Strategy: If a customer stays interested even when the product becomes a daily habit, the seller should keep prices steady and matched to what the customer is willing to pay. The "Take a Break" Strategy: If a customer gets "burned out" or saturated, the seller should actually stop offering the product (or price it very high) once a certain threshold is hit. This allows the customer's habit to "reset," making the product exciting again later. Promotions: In some cases, offering random discounts is the best way to keep the habit at a level that maximizes profit. Essentially, the research shows that if a product is prone to "habituation," the most profitable move isn't always to sell as much as possible, but to manage how often the customer uses it to keep their interest high.

11505522.value: 高維時變預測：針對結構突變和平滑變動的統一方法

11505522.label: Project Objectives
11505522.value: Forecast instabilities have been a long-standing issue that has drawn tremendous attention from economic and financial scholars. Rolling window and break detection methods have been increasingly doubted, resulting in controversial conclusions on the predictability of individual forecasts owing to information loss and prediction inaccuracy attributed to the random abandonment of data points. However, existing nonparametric prediction methods suffer inconsistent estimations in the face of sudden economic shifts. This proposal puts forward a new time-varying forecast combination approach that allows for various forms of time-varying weights, including abrupt breaks, smooth changes, and mixtures. We believe that it will become a critical and reliable choice for academia and empirical practitioners to effectively learn the time-varying predictability ability that a forecast model can exhibit throughout a time period. In recent years, there have been ongoing technological developments, preference alternations, implementation of new regulation policies, and structural shifts in economic conditions. Individual forecasts are becoming increasingly sophisticated. The existence of a single forecast model that can completely dominate the ultimate universe of predictions throughout history seems too good to be true. In practice, scholars in the economics and finance fields indicate a lack of discrimination between existing economic models, such as predicting heterogeneous risk premia from different assets. This results in new challenges in forecasting. This project proposes a new forecast combination approach, in which the relative importance among competing predictions may vary according to economic periods. This study examines how to align forecasts with varying degrees of adaptability and eliminate the limitations of a single forecast by receiving diversification gains and using all the information relevant to the variable to be predicted. Existing studies are inadequate in ensuring prediction consistency in the face of increasingly available individual forecasts, which often results in contradictory predictions when considering different sets of individual forecasts. This project proposes a new approach for forecasting with many predictors in the face of instabilities. Particularly, we allow the number of predictors to be larger than the sample size. In sharp contrast to existing forecast combination literature, which engages in two-step procedures with stringent assumptions on time variation, our method allows for abrupt, smooth, and dual-type time variation in high-dimensional predictive regression. In this study, two critical scenarios that are closely related to empirical studies are considered. First, it is always the same set of individual predictors with solid forecastability power on the variable to be predicted. In contrast, all the remaining candidate individual predictors are redundant in all the periods. Among this fixed set of functioning individual forecasts, they may exhibit time-varying relative importance in the prediction. In contrast, the acting forecast models with nonzero predictive power change over time. Meanwhile, the predictive power of each acting forecast model may also vary over time. This implies that there exists a time-varying sparsity. For both cases, this study establishes the corresponding estimation consistency for the time-varying weights. It also derives selection consistency for each situation. With the help of this new method, empirical practitioners can confidently distinguish the set of individual forecasts that exhibit strong predictive power throughout a time period and identify periodic forecasts. This study further examines how the changes in their relative importance in different periods can be estimated accurately, given technological developments, changes in preferences and skills, structural shifts in economic conditions, and deceptiveness to new regulatory rules. This study carefully addresses these critical questions. The newly proposed approach will consistently estimate time-varying weights of various forms, including abrupt structural breaks, smooth structural changes, and integration of both. In the asset pricing literature, it is critical to explain why different assets demand different risk premia. Recent studies, which have become "useless," document many vital factors and predictors in predicting asset returns. It is unclear whether they are losing their predictability ability due to financial market abandonment or prediction inadequacy only. This study intends to join existing individual forecasts and reevaluate their time-dependent predictability ability by employing our new high-dimensional time-varying forecast combination method. This project will provide empirical practitioners with an easy-to-implement computer algorithm compiled into an R package for ease of use. It will also help to disseminate the influence of the research output of this proposal.

11505522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11505522.value: In recent years, scholars from the economics and finance fields have noted an increase in the number of individual forecasts. Empirical asset pricing studies also indicate that a forecast’s predictability power changes over time. Moreover, the relative importance of individual forecasts among competing predictions may vary according to economic periods. In the presence of many predictors, forecasting combinations with instabilities, which provide the opportunity to exploit a richer base of information used for time series forecasting dynamically and adaptively than conventionally, have become increasingly popular. The out-of-sample performance and evaluation of a time-varying predictive regression model directly rely on the formulation of time-varying parameters. However, the underlying form of the time-varying weights that individual forecasts exhibit on the variable to be predicted is unknown. Empirical studies often employ rolling window methods to make time-varying forecasts. However, this approach is limited in that it arbitrarily eliminates the data. In contrast, assuming specific functional forms for time variation mainly used for estimation and computation simplicity cannot recover the actual time-varying dynamics. Smoothed nonparametric estimation methods, such as local and global estimation approaches, can help reduce misspecification errors in parametric models. However, these methods are not consistent in abrupt structural breaks. Therefore, unsurprisingly, existing studies often document spurious and even controversial conclusions on the forecasting ability of the asset and bond returns of the same individual forecast when using different window sizes or different sampling periods. Thus, it is not clear how forecasts with nonzero predictive powers can be correctly distinguished from redundant ones in the face of increasingly available forecasts. Further, related studies have not examined how the changes in their relative importance in different periods given technological developments, changes in preferences and skills, structural shifts in economic conditions, and deceptiveness to new regulatory rules can be estimated accurately. Moreover, it is not clear whether the disappearance of forecasts can be attributed to estimation inadequacy or their actual abandonment by financial markets. Therefore, it is crucial to propose a new forecast combination method that can manage many individual forecasts, whose relative importance can change over time. We develop a new approach for forecasting with many predictors, in the face of instabilities. Particularly, we allow the number of predictors to be larger than the sample size. In sharp contrast to existing forecast combination literature, our method allows for abrupt, smooth, and dual-type time variation in high-dimensional predictive regression. 經濟和金融領域中涉及的預測變數的數量正顯著增多。實證資產定價研究還表明，變數的可預測性會隨著時間而變化。此外，預測變數的相對重要性也可能因經濟時期不同而產生變化。在存在大量預測變數的情況下，帶有時變特徵的預測組合變的尤為重要。相對于傳統方法，預測組合可以對時間序列的預測提供更穩定且有效的刻畫。 時變預測回歸模型的樣本外表現和評估直接依賴于時變參數的設定是否合理。然而，預測變數表現出的時變權重的基本形式是未知的。實證研究通常採用滾動窗口方法來進行時變預測。但是，這種方法的局限性在於它會損失大量的數據信息。相反，假設某種特定的時變函數形式無法刻畫實際的時變機制。平滑的非參數估計方法，例如局部和全局估計方法，可以幫助減少參數模型的模型誤設。然而，這些方法無法處理突發結構變動。因此，現有的研究結果經常顯示出具有爭議的結論。 因此，面對越來越多的可用預測變量，如何正確區分具有非零預測能力的預測變量十分重要。本課題提出的方法可以允許大量的預測變量存在，這些預測變量的相對重要性會隨時間而變化。與現有的預測組合文獻形成鮮明對比的是，我們的方法允許高維預測回歸中的突然、平滑和雙重類型的時間變化。

11505622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11505622.value: 審計師如何應對網絡安全風險：人力資本投資和跨客戶影響

11505622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11505622.value: The digital economy has led to an ever-increasing stream of data. The World Economic Forum estimates that, by 2025, there will be 463 exabytes of data created each day. While the potential economic value of data is substantial, firms are also facing more and more challenges in cybersecurity. According to the cybercrime magazine, the worldwide cybercrime costs are expected to grow from $3 trillion US dollars in 2015 to $10.5 trillion by 2025. Due to the integrated nature between firms’ Information Technology (IT) and data control and their financial reporting controls, auditors also face the challenges brought by cybersecurity risk. Not only could client firms’ data breach directly affect their financial data, but firms’ cybersecurity deficiency could imply weakness of the internal control system for financial reporting. As a result, regulators worldwide stress the necessity for auditors to seriously consider cybersecurity risk in executing their risk assessment, tests of controls, and other relevant audit procedures (Veen 2016). The auditing standard AS5 explicitly requires that “the identification of risks and controls within IT is not a separate evaluation. Instead, it is an integral part of the top-down approach” in an integrated audit. The PCAOB board member, Kathleen M. Hamm, emphasizes the importance of the auditor evaluating the nature and extent of a cybersecurity breach and the potential impact on the client’s operations and financial statements. He also contends that the auditor should consider whether the breach indicates a deficiency in the client’s internal controls over financial reporting (Hamm 2019). Given that the auditors are generally professional accountants who are not specialized in cybersecurity, it would be more efficient to seek advice and cooperation from IT experts. Regulatory institutions suggest using cybersecurity IT experts when auditors identify significant risks of material misstatements arising from cybersecurity problems (AAA 2015; AICPA 2018; ISCA 2018; CAQ 2020). Hence, it is timely and important to examine how auditors respond to client firms’ cybersecurity risks. Do auditors invest in cybersecurity personnel to increase their ability to embrace cybersecurity challenges? Do auditors play a role in facilitating their clients’ cybersecurity preparation? We intend to provide the first evidence on these questions by utilizing cybersecurity breaches as an exogenous shock to auditors’ assessment of cybersecurity risks. We will examine whether auditors respond to cybersecurity risks by investing more in cybersecurity IT human capital, as well as urging their non-breached clients to increase their cybersecurity IT hirings and cybersecurity disclosures. 數字經濟帶來了不斷增長的數據。據世界經濟論壇估計，到2025年，每天將產生463 EB的數據。儘管數據的潛在經濟價值巨大，但企業在網絡安全方面也面臨著越來越多的挑戰。根據網絡犯罪雜誌的預計，到2025年，全球網絡犯罪成本將從2015年的3萬億美元增長到10.5萬億美元。由於公司的信息技術（IT）和數據控制以及其財務報告控制之間的相關性，審計師也面臨著網絡安全風險帶來的挑戰。客戶公司的數據洩露不僅會直接影響其財務數據，而且公司的網絡安全缺陷可能意味著財務報告內部控制系統存在缺陷。因此，全球監管機構強調，審計師在執行風險評估、控制測試和其他相關審計程序時，必須認真考慮網絡安全風險（Veen 2016）。審計準則AS5明確要求“識別IT內部的風險和控制不是一項單獨的評估。相反，它是綜合審計中‘自上而下’法的一個組成部分”。PCAOB董事會成員Kathleen M. Hamm強調審計師評估網絡安全漏洞的性質和程度以及對客戶運營和財務報表的潛在影響的重要性。他還認為，審計師應考慮網絡安全漏洞是否表明客戶對財務報告的內部控制存在缺陷（Hamm 2019）。 鑒於審計師通常是專業會計師，並不擅長網絡安全，因此向IT專家尋求建議和合作將更為有效。監管機構建議，當發現由網絡安全問題引起的重大錯報風險時，審計師應諮詢網絡安全IT專家（AAA 2015；AICPA 2018；ISCA 2018；CAQ 2020）。因此，研究審計師如何應對客戶公司的網絡安全風險是適時且重要的。審計師是否引進網絡安全人員以提高他們應對網絡安全挑戰的能力？審計師是否在幫助客戶做好網絡安全準備的方面發揮作用？我們打算利用網絡安全漏洞作為審計師對網絡安全風險評估的外生衝擊，為這些問題提供第一手證據。我們將研究審計師是否通過加大對網絡安全IT人力資本的投資，以及敦促其尚未被網絡入侵的客戶增加其網絡安全IT人員招聘和網絡安全披露來應對網絡安全風險。

11505922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11505922.value: 國際政治關係和全球供應鏈

11505922.label: Project Objectives
11505922.value: Construct a unique dataset for this project and future research This project will compile a unique and innovative dataset that allows us to quantify the degree of firm internationalization activities and the overall exposure to global political risk. We will provide a detailed description of the data-clean procedure and hope that this description will help other scholars handle these databases. This dataset will be extremely useful for future research on international business and finance. We plan to make the relevant data publicly available upon the content of data vendors. Identify a new influencing factor of global supply chain management. This project is the first paper to study how the bilateral country political conflict affects the global supply chains. Existing literature exclusively focuses on the country-level political risk without considering the political interaction between home and foreign countries. We believe that the bilateral political relationship is critical, as demonstrated in how the U.S. and China trade war shaped the supply chains of U.S. and China firms. Document the relation between pollical risk and global value change adjustment. We conduct a series of tests (see the detailed research proposal) to shed light on how firms adjust their supply chains and organizational structures in response to increasing political risk. These pieces of evidence are essential for business leaders and policymakers. Examine the consequence of MNC's retreat on host countries. In facing the rising political risk, MNC may reduce operations in foreign countries. This retreat of MNC could have a detrimental effect on the economy of foreign countries. This issue is a severe concern for countries that have relied on foreign investments to promote economic growth in the past decades, such as China. We examine this vital issue and expect to provide some policy suggestions.

11505922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11505922.value: 近年來，國際雙邊政治衝突增加，不斷惡化的全球政治環境對跨國企業的全球供應鏈部署構成極大的挑戰。跨國公司必須把政治風險納入其設計構建供應鏈的戰略中。 而國際供應鏈的調整勢必對企業，國家乃至全球的經濟產生深遠而廣泛的影響。本課題旨在研究企業如何應對政治風險來調整其供應鏈，以及供應鏈調整之後的產生的後續影響。 我們意圖構建一個獨特的数据集從國際供應鏈採購，企業內部組織結構以及海外國際銷售收入三個方面來度量一個企業的國際化程度。然後，我們側重於研究海外投資國的政治風險以及母國和投資國的雙邊政治衝突如何影響企業的行為。具體而言，我們著重研究以下三個問題： 1. 面對日益增加的海外政治風險，企業是否會把其海外投資撤回母國，還是轉移到第三國？ 2. 面對母國和海外投資國的雙邊政治衝突，跨國企業如何調整其海外供應商和海外分支機搆的部署？ 3. 如果跨國公司從海外投資國撤資，是否會對投資國的相關行業的產出和就業造成影響。 相比現有文獻， 本課題的創新點如下： 1. 我們從多角度來刻畫一個企業的國際化程度 2.我們不僅考慮單邊的政治風險，而且著重考察雙邊政治衝突。 3. 我們不僅考察供應商-客戶之間的關係， 還考量企業內部的組織結構。

11506122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11506122.value: 投資衝擊、失業和資產價格

11506122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11506122.value: 該項目將尋求瞭解特定投資技術 (IST)（也稱為體現在資本上的技術）衝擊對失業波動和資產價格的影響。宏觀勞工文獻研究了 IST 衝擊如何影響失業波動（例如，Aghion 和 Howitt (1994)； Mortensen 和 Pissarides (1998)；Hornstein、 Krusell 和 Violante (2007)； Michelacci 和 Lopez-Salido (2007))。資產定價文獻研究了 IST 衝擊如何影響宏觀風險溢價和股票收益的橫截面（例如，Papanikolaou（2011）； Kogan 和 Papanikolaou（2013）； Kogan 和 Papanikolaou (2014))。然而，IST衝擊如何共同影響失業波動和資產價格仍未得到探索。這個項目將填補這一空白，同時考慮到失業波動與資產價格之間的關係（例如，Hall (2017)；Petrosky-Nadeau、Zhang 和 Kuehn (2018)；Kuehn、Simutin 和 Wang（2017）；Bai 和 Zhang（2021))。

11506322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11506322.value: 銀行的科技知識專長與債務融資成本：來自銀團貸款的證據

11506322.label: Project Objectives
11506322.value: To propose a measure of banks’ technology expertise with borrowers To establish causal links from banks’ technology expertise to loan pricing To shed light on how heterogeneous bank characteristics affect the financing of innovation
rows: To propose a measure of banks’ technology expertise with borrowers
To establish causal links from banks’ technology expertise to loan pricing
To shed light on how heterogeneous bank characteristics affect the financing of innovation

11506322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11506322.value: Innovation is the engine of economic growth (Solow, 1957). However, the inherent information asymmetry problem with innovation activities can lead to credit rationing or increased cost of debt, resulting in insufficient innovation investment (Mann, 2018). As financial intermediaries specializing in collecting private information for delegate monitoring, banks play critical roles in reducing capital market friction, especially for opaque borrowers such as innovation-intensive firms. Acknowledging the critical role of the banking sector, a growing literature has examined the impact of bank activities on the financing of innovation. In this proposed project, we examine how a most relevant dimension of bank expertise, banks’ technology expertise, affects the pricing of bank loans. Theoretically, a bank’s higher technology expertise with a borrower can help reduce the information asymmetry and agency problems in bank loans and lead to a lower cost of debt. However, it may also suggest a bank’s excessive exposure to specific technologies and result in a higher cost of debt. We propose a measure relying on the technology distribution of collateralized patents in a bank’s portfolio to capture the bank’s technology expertise. In recent years, using intangible assets such as patents as collateral becomes a popular mechanism to mitigate the market friction for debt financing (Mann, 2018). We argue that banks can gain technology expertise through the process of valuation and monitoring of pledged patents. We will employ the USPTO Patent Assignment Database to identify patents pledged to a bank and to calculate the technology expertise. We then plan to use a bank M&A setting, which exogenously changes a bank’s technology expertise with a borrower, to establish causal links from banks’ technology expertise to loan pricing. The impacts of loan syndication structure and borrower innovation performance will also be investigated. 創新是經濟增長的引擎（Solow, 1957）。 然而與創新相生相伴的信息不對稱問題可以導致信貸供應的不足，或者信貸成本的上升，從而導致創新投資的不足（Mann, 2018）。銀行作為專門收集私有信息並進行監督的金融仲介，在減少資本市場的摩擦中有著重要的作用，特別是對於諸如創新密集型企業的較為不透明的融資企業而言。認識到銀行領域的重要作用，已有的一些文獻研究了銀行如何影響針對創新的融資。在這個研究計畫中，我們將研究銀行知識專長中與創新融資最相關的一個維度——銀行的科技知識專長，如何影銀行貸款的融資成本。在理論上，銀行對借款公司有更高的科技知識專長，借款公司在創新方面的信息不對稱對銀行而言會更低，也能減少相應的代理問題，從而可以降低銀行貸款的融資成本。然而，更高的科技知識專長可能也意味著銀行在某些技術領域的風險敞口較大，從而導致更高的融資成本。 我們計畫用銀行的貸款組合中的專利抵押來衡量銀行對不同科技的知識專長。近年來，使用無形資產（例如專利）來進行抵押成為了一個減少融資市場摩擦的越來越常見的機制（Mann, 2018）。我們認為，銀行可以通過對接受的專利抵押物的估價和監督來學習相關的科技知識，積累專長。我們將採用美國專利局的專利交易數據庫來識別抵押給銀行的專利並計算銀行的科技知識專長。進一步的，我們將使用銀行間的收購、並購案例作為研究的場景，用收購並購帶來的外生的技術知識專長變化來建立銀行科技知識專長對融資成本的因果影響關係。我們也將同時考察銀行的科技知識專長怎樣影響借款公司的銀團貸款結構，以及創新效率。

11506322.label: Realisation of objectives
11506322.value: We have developed the bank technology expertise measure. In addition to the originally proposed patent based measure, we also constructed a labor-input based measure. for the second objective, however, we use various settings to establish causal impact from bank technology expertise but fail to find such impact on loan pricing;. As such, the third objective is not achieved.

11506322.value: While the original proposed paper is not developed due to that we do not find significant impact of bank expertise on loan pricing, we utilize the labor input data funded by this project to work on a project that examine how the non-discrimination of certain labor groups (i.g. LGBT groups) affect the loan pricing and capital structure of firms. This project is developed into a working paper "LGBT Employment Nondiscrimination and Capital Structure". This paper was presented at CAAA 2023 conference, and now under 2nd round revise and resubmission at Journal of Banking and Finance.
