11506722.value: 公司创新-人力资源视角

11506722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11506722.value: 科技创新是驱动社会生产力进步的关键因素。相应的，了解现代公司的创新活动具有重要的理论与实践意义。现有的关于公司创新的研究多关注于公司的总体研究经费投入。想要进一步深入的了解公司的创新活动，研究人员需要探索新的数据资源。本研究旨在利用大数据文本分析对公司的关于科技人员的招聘信信息来深入研究公司的创新活动。

11507022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11507022.value: 用於投資組合優化及非均衡數據的回歸樹模型

11507022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11507022.value: Prof FENG, Guanhao Mr He, Xin

11507022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11507022.value: Investors face the problem of how to allocate capital among investible assets to optimize their portfolio according to their own utilities all the time. The common practice is to estimate the mean and covariance of returns from historical data and create mean-variance efficient portfolios or using more advanced strategies. However, a critical problem is that the cross-sectional data of returns is imbalanced. For example, investing in ETFs has become increasingly important for the rise of robot advisors, and we have witnessed hundreds of ETFs created in the recent two decades. First, given many ETFs are created for similar purposes for different demands of investors, grouping them into the same leaf portfolio helps ease the high-dimensional investment decision. Second, many ETFs have been introduced, restructured, or replaced in recent decades, and our P-Tree helps with this imbalanced data issue. This proposed research project aims to provide a novel approach to optimize portfolio using imbalanced data by the customized regression trees named Panel Tree, or P-Tree. Our approach is applicable to various groups of assets such as individual stocks, ETFs, bonds, industry portfolios, etc. Furthermore, the P-Tree framework is flexible enough to incorporate existing methods on shrinkage estimation of mean and variance, and robust portfolio optimizations. We aim to provide a unified model originated from the Classification and Regression Tree (CART) model (Breiman et al., 1984) in machine learning, with a bespoke split criterion using economic intuition from portfolio optimization. The tree partitions the cross-sectional data of assets into non-overlapping groups by the asset characteristics, each group is economically a portfolio (leaf portfolio), which could be equal weighted or value weighted portfolio of asset within the leaf. Besides, our framework can incorporate the above approaches on shrinkage estimator, robust portfolio or regularization on weights straightforwardly. 投資者時常需要考慮如何根據自己的效用優化投資組合，分配資金在不同的投資標的。常見的方法是從歴史數據估計投資標的收益的平均值和協方差矩陣，創建均值-協方差有效、最小方差等投資組合。然而一個關鍵的睏難是歴史數據併非平均，不同股票的歴史收益數據點個數併不同。比如，ETF在最近二十年流行，有數百記的ETF誕生。他們創建的時間點不同因而歴史月收益率觀測值數量不同。併且估計他們的協方差矩陣是一個高維度的困難問題。 本研究提出一個新的、基於機器學習回歸樹的方法優化投資組合。我們開發新的包含經濟學含義的回歸樹算法，併且支援非平均長度的數據。樹的生長判定准則包含了經濟學模型，目標是最優化投資組合策略。整個框架可以囊括已有的各種收縮、穩健投資組合優化的方法。

11507522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11507522.value: 市場仲介機構的最優雙邊信息提供及其後果

11507522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11507522.value: In many real-world markets, products and services are not sold directly from producers to consumers but instead pass through intermediaries. In the information era, market intermediaries collect a large amount of consumer data, such as personal characteristics and purchase histories. The consumer data, if disclosed to producers, can help producers develop better predictions of consumer demand than those obtained through traditional means. At the same time, with advanced information technology, the intermediaries can help the producers determine how best to display product information on their platforms to consumers and, therefore, affect how consumers learn about products. Consequently, these intermediaries provide valuable two-sided information provision service to producers and can sell the service as products to producers. For instance, Amazon discloses a significant amount of consumer information to sellers and helps sellers present product information to consumers via photos, certificates, descriptions, and reviews; both services are priced and sold to sellers through subscription options in the Amazon Seller Central. In the proposed project, I will study the optimal mechanism for two-sided information provision by the intermediaries described above. Several previous papers, including one coauthored by the PI, have studied the optimal design of intermediaries that provide information to either only the consumers or only the producers. In this project, in contrast, I will consider two-sided information provision by an intermediary--a more realistic environment in which the intermediary provides information to both producers and consumers. More specifically, I will characterize the optimal mechanism for selling two-sided information for an intermediary and study the market equilibrium outcomes. First, I will consider a market regime in which the intermediary does not play an active role in the trading of products, except that it provides information to consumers and producers and sell the service as products to producers. The mechanism design problem for such intermediaries involves a high-dimensional allocation space without single-crossing preferences. Preliminary results have been developed to simplify the representation of two-sided information structures. In the proposed research, I will develop tools to further simplify the problem and fully characterize the optimal mechanism. I will also study other market regimes. For example, I will consider environments in which the intermediaries, in addition to providing information, can actively participate in the pricing of products. The theoretical exercises would help us understand how different market arrangements affect the two-sided information provision by intermediaries and guide the regulation of these intermediaries in practice. 在許多現實世界的市場中，產品和服務不是直接從生產者出售給消費者，而是通過中間商。在信息時代，市場仲介機構收集了大量的消費者數據，如個人特徵、購買歷史等。生產者可以利用消費者數據對市場需求做出更好的預測。同時，借助先進的信息技術，仲介可以幫助生產者確定如何在其平台上向消費者最好地展示產品信息，從而幫助消費者了解產品及做決策。因此，這些仲介機構提供雙向的信息，並可以將雙向信息作為產品出售給生產者。例如，亞馬遜向賣家披露了大量消費者信息，並幫助賣家通過照片、證書、描述和評論向消費者展示產品信息；這兩類信息的提供模式通過亞馬遜賣家中心的訂閱選項定價並出售給賣家。在擬議的研究項目中，我將研究上述仲介機構提供雙向信息的最佳機制。之前的幾篇論文，包括由我合著的一篇論文，研究了僅向消費者或僅向生產者提供信息的仲介機構的優化設計。相比之下，在這個項目中，我將考慮仲介提供的雙向信息。更具體地說，我將試圖用數學推導出仲介銷售雙邊信息的最佳機制，並研究其市場結果。首先，我將研究一個簡化的市場：仲介機構在產品交易中不發揮積極作用，只是向消費者和生產者提供信息，並將服務作為產品出售給生產者。此類仲介的機制設計問題涉及沒有“單交叉偏好”的高維分配空間。在這類簡化市場裡，我已經研究出初步結果以簡化雙邊信息結構的表示。在擬議的研究中，我將開發工具來進一步簡化問題並推導出最優機制。我還將研究其他市場制度。例如，我將考慮仲介機構除了提供信息外，還可以積極參與產品定價的環境。這個理論研究將有助於我們了解不同的市場安排如何影響仲介機構的雙向信息提供，並在實踐中指導對這些仲介機構的監管。

11508222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11508222.value: 沒有現金支付的動態合約

11508222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11508222.value: Dr Krasikov, Ilia Dr Lamba, Rohit

11508222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11508222.value: Consider a designer who has a long-term project in which he must decide whether to assign up to one unit of good to one agent in every period. The agent receives a positive payoff from consuming the good in every period. However, the associated social benefit is identically and independently distributed across time and is privately known to the agent. The good is assigned based on the agent’s reports. In each period, the designer can verify an agent’s private information at a cost and punish the agent by burning a fraction of her surplus. There are no monetary transfers. There are several important economic environments roughly corresponding to this model. For example, every year, a developing aid agency such as the World Bank must decide whether to allocate a grant to a local organization to serve some beneficiary groups. The local organization privately knows how the grant will benefit the intended groups. The development aid agency can evaluate the benefit by reviewing the recipient’s report and limiting the grant size it manages in the future. However, it cannot recover the funds allocated to the organization or disbar it from future grant applications out of humanitarian concerns. A funding agency must decide whether to give a grant to a researcher to support their new project every year or every few years. The researcher privately knows the intellectual merits of their projects. The funding agency can evaluate a project's impact by reviewing the researcher's final report and limiting the grant size they receive in the future. However, it cannot recover past grants or disbar the researcher from future grant applications. In this project, we study the design of optimal mechanisms in the environments described above and the properties of optimal mechanisms. These theoretical exercises help us understand how repeated interactions affect the characteristics of optimal mechanisms and provide guidance for the use of different mechanisms in practice. Several earlier papers have studied this problem in a static model in which the designer and the agent interact only once. In this project, instead of considering a static allocation problem, we consider a dynamic allocation problem, in which the designer and the agent interact repeatedly. As a first step of the analysis, we analyze two special cases: pure limited punishments and pure costly verification. More work is required to characterize the optimal mechanism in the general environment and to study their properties. 考慮一個設計者，他有一個長期項目，他必須決定是否在每個時期將最多一個單位的物品分配給一個代理人。該代理人在每一時期從消費該物品中獲得正收益，但相關的社會效益是代理人的私有信息 且在不同時期內獨立同分佈。設計者根據代理人報告的實惠收益進行物品的分配。在每個時期，設計者可以付出一定的成本以驗證代理人的私有信息，並通過減少分配的物品來懲罰代理人。設計者和代理人之間沒有現金支付。 這個模型可以涵蓋幾個重要的經濟問題。例如，一個為發展中國家提供援助的機構，如世界銀行，每年必須決定是否撥出一筆資金給一個地方組織以為一些目標群體服務。只有該地方組織知道這筆贈款將如何惠及目標群體。援助機構可以通過審查該地方組織的報告來評估其產生的社會收益，並限制其在未來管理的資金規模。但是出於人道主義考慮，它不能收回分配給該組織的資金，也不能禁止該組織在未來申請資金。再例如，一個研究資助機構每年或每隔幾年必須決定是否給一個研究人員提供資助以支持他們的新項目。只有研究人員知道他們項目的科研價值。資助機構可以通過審查研究人員的最終報告來評估其項目的影響，並限制他們在未來獲得的資助規模，但它不能收回已經提供的資助，也不能禁止研究者在未來申請資助。 在這個項目中，我們將研究在上述這類問題中的最優機制的設計以及最優機制的屬性。這些理論研究將幫助我們了解設計者和代理人之間長期的互動如何影響最優機制的特性，並為實踐中使用不同機制提供指導。

11508422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11508422.value: 對於違反和規避規則的懲戒研究

11508422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11508422.value: Dr Sivanathan, Niro Dr Wang, Cynthia

11508422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11508422.value: 人們不僅違反組織規則；他們還經常規避規則。規避規則需要遵守規則的文字但違反其精神。儘管規避規則構成了對規則的違反和顛覆（即，它違反了規則的精神），但是在現實生活中，對於規避規則的懲罰可能有很大差異。例如，在東京奧運會期間，丹麥奧林匹克田徑自行車隊繞過了國際自行車聯盟 (UCI) 對襪子高度的嚴格規定，在他們的脛骨上使用了織物膠帶以獲得空氣動力學優勢。儘管公眾對此強烈批評和抱怨，但 UCI 只發布了官方警告，丹麥隊最終以銀牌登上獎牌領獎台（Croxton, 2021）。相比之下，在 2014 年美國橄欖球聯盟冠軍賽中，新英格蘭愛國者隊在戰勝印第安納波利斯小馬隊的比賽中被指控使用癟了的足球規避規則後，美國國家橄欖球聯盟 (NFL) 對球隊處以 100 萬美元的罰款(有史以來最大的罰款之一), 並在下賽季的前四場比賽中對他們的明星四分衛湯姆布拉迪 (他本人否認有任何不當行為)進行了停賽處罰（MacMullan,2015）。 儘管規避規則在組織中很普遍(Katz,2010；Rieley,2020；Wang, 2019), 但它在組織研究中的調查不足。我們的研究會調查人們對於規避規則如何實施懲罰。特別是，我們致力於了解人們所依賴的懲罰理由會如何會影響他們對於規避規則和完全違反規則所做出的懲罰決定。我們建議，威懾理論和罪有應得理論（這兩個關於懲罰使用的兩大思想流派）代表了關於如何懲罰規避規則的兩種相反觀點。具體而言，考慮威懾心態和考慮危害或不端行為的程度可能會導致人們對規避規則做出的不同懲罰決定。此外，我們還將調查兩個重要的背景因素，我們期望這些因素能夠緩和規避規則對懲罰決策的影響。我們提出了五項互補研究來調查人們如何判斷和解釋違反規則與規避的行為，以及這些判斷和解釋如何影響到他們的懲罰決定。

11508722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11508722.value: 全渠道零售商訂單執行挑戰

11508722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11508722.value: To stay competitive, many retailers operate online and physical retail channels to attract customers with different shopping preferences. When retailers take an omnichannel approach and integrate their online and physical channels, they face new opportunities and challenges. This proposal focuses on the opportunities and challenges in omnichannel order fulfilment. Apart from in-store customers, an omnichannel retailer serves customers who order products online or use both retail channels to complete their order. The first challenge faced by an omnichannel retailer is deciding how to fulfil the online orders. When a retailer receives an online order, he incurs significant shipping cost to bring the products from his warehouse to the customer’s home. However, an omnichannel retailer may operate a physical store near the customer’s home, and he can choose to ship the order from the local store to reduce shipping cost. Choosing to ship from the physical store comes with the opportunity cost of using inventory meant for potential in-store customers. Furthermore, a physical store is not designed for preparing online orders, and the picking cost in the physical store can be much higher than in the warehouse. In addition, an omnichannel retailer may offer the option to ``buy online, pick-up in-store’’ (BOPS), where customers can reserve selected products online and pick up their order in the physical store after a few hours. BOPS allow customers to receive their orders quickly and avoid out-of-stock situations upon a store visit. The second challenge faced by an omnichannel retailer is deciding which products to offer under BOPS. From the retailer’s perspective, BOPS avoids shipping cost, but it faces the same picking cost as online orders. Furthermore, customers are unlikely to order under BOPS if they cannot reserve everything on their shopping list due to the hassle of travelling to the store. These orders consume in-store inventory, and can be unprofitable if the associated picking cost exceeds the order’s profit margin. This proposal studies the optimal fulfilment problem for an omnichannel retailer who strategically uses the in-store inventory to reduce the shipping cost of online orders and to satisfy customers who complete their purchases via BOPS. I model the problem as a dynamic program, but computing the optimal policy is hampered by the curse of dimensionality. Hence, I will use approximate dynamic programming to construct policies with provable performance guarantees, and use these policies to extract managerial insights for improving omnichannel order fulfilment. 爲了保持競爭力，許多零售商經營在線和實體零售渠道，以吸引具有不同購物偏好的顧客。 當零售商採取全渠道方式整合在線和實體渠道時，他們面臨着新的機會和挑戰。 除了服務親臨到店的顧客之外，全渠道零售商還爲在線訂購産品的顧客服務。 全渠道零售商面臨的第一個挑戰是如何履行在線訂單。 收到一個在線訂單後，零售商需要花費大量的運輸成本將産品從倉庫運到客戶的家。 全渠道零售商則可從客戶家附近經營着一家實體店調動産品，從以減少運輸成本。但從實體店發貨會消耗爲到店顧客準備的庫存。此外，由於實體店不是專門爲網上訂單而設計的，分揀的人力成本也比較高。 全渠道零售商還可以提供“在線購買，店內取貨”（BOPS）的選項。客戶可以在線預訂購物，並在數小時後到實體店取貨。 BOPS使顧客能夠迅速收到産品和避免到店後出現缺貨的情況。 全渠道零售商面臨的第二個挑戰是決定在BOPS選項下提供哪些産品。 BOPS避免了運輸成本，但它和在線訂單有相同的分揀成本。 此外，如果BOPS無法提供顧客購物清單上的所有産品，顧客就有可能什麼都不買而避免去店鋪的時間。 BOPS訂單也會消耗店內庫存。如果它的分揀成本超過了訂單的利潤，全渠道零售商則可能無利可圖。 此項目研究全渠道零售商的訂單履行問題，該零售商戰略性地使用店內庫存以減少在線訂單的運輸成本，並滿足BOPS選項下的訂單。此項目採用近似動態規劃，提出高效的答案，並提取管理見解。

11508822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11508822.value: 共同基金的投資組合選擇

11508822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11508822.value: The seminal work by Berk and Green (2004) models the fund managers’ skill as a universal return on all capital. In real life, fund managers have different skills in investing different assets and even different types of stocks. To the authors’ knowledge, this project is the first to fill this gap in the literature and explicitly study the portfolio choice of mutual fund managers when investing in different assets. In our model, assets are heterogeneous because fund managers have different skills, the cost of investing in them is different, or they attract fund flows differently. After solving the model, we will calibrate it to match standard empirical facts on mutual funds. In the end, we will empirically test the model using mutual fund data. Notably, we plan to use the difference in the self-disclosed segment information as an empirical proxy to distinguish between well-known and opaque stocks. We will show that investing in different stocks will have a different impact on attracting fund flows. Thus, we can test the model’s implication using mutual funds’ portfolio choice. 伯克和格林（2004）在其開創性的論文裡將基金經理的技能建模成一種對於所有資本的普遍性的收益。實際上，基金經理對於不同種類的資產甚至不同種類的股票都會有不同的技能。本課題將明確研究基金經理在面對多種資產時的投資組合選擇。據作者所知，本課題在相關文獻中尚屬首次。在我們的模型中，資產的異質性表現在基金經理對於它們有不同的技能，投資它們的成本不同，或者它們對資金流的吸引力不同。在解出模型後，我們將通過匹配共同基金的實證事實來校準模型。最後，我們將使用共同基金數據對模型進行實證檢驗。特別地，我們計畫使用公司主動的信息披露來區分透明的和不透明的公司。我們將表明投資這兩類公司的股票對共同基金吸引資金流有不同的影響。因此，我們可以通過共同基金對於這兩類公司的投資組合來檢驗我們模型。

11509122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11509122.value: 智能溯源及假新聞防範系統開發與研究

11509122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11509122.value: Fake news and rumors have long plagued social media users. Users who are unsuspecting of questionable social media posts may forward them to peers in their social media communities, who may in turn reshare it to their own communities, exacerbating the viral spread of fake news and rumors. The core problem here is how to thwart the chain of fake news circulation. Previous research shows inconsistent effectiveness of IT artifacts in solving the problem. One factor likely to have been overlooked in previous research is source authenticity. If news originates from reliable sources, it can increase trustworthiness; otherwise, it increases suspicion. We can use IT artifacts to alert social media users to suspicious sources of messages and increase users’ hesitance to reshare potential fake news. To fully address this problem, we present this research proposal to use a design-science approach to develop a message source authentication system with the help of non-fungible token (NFT) technologies. We call this system “Authenticity NFT.” NFT has several unique advantages. First, it uniquely represents an original piece of literary work. The decentralized technology is tamper-proof and can effectively deter forgery. Second, NFT facilitates ownership verification and makes false claims to authorship of an original message impossible. Third, NFT allows for source tracing and facilitates the identification of original source of information. With the Authenticity NFT system, we aim to answer two broad research questions: (1) How does the source authenticity of social media posts make users more aware of potential fake news? (2) Can source authentication system thwart the chain of circulation of fake news on social media? We answer these questions using a controlled laboratory experiment and a field experiment. In the control experiment, we test whether social media users pay attention to source authenticity when they encounter new social media posts. In particular, we are interested in examining whether the absence of an NFT icon in some posts raises users’ suspicion of possible fake news. In the field experiment, we plan to deploy Authenticity NFT to a social media site and observe its effect on curbing fake news circulation over time. We plan to use a difference-in-difference approach to examine the treatment effect of Authenticity NFT in thwarting the chain of fake news circulation. This research has important implications for both research and practice in combating fake news. 假新聞和謠言長期以來一直困擾著社交媒體用戶，對可疑社交媒體帖子毫無戒心的用戶可能會將假新聞社交帖文轉發給其他同行，而後者又可能將其轉發至自己的社交社區，從而加劇了假新聞和謠言的病毒式傳播。通過開發與研究智能溯源及假新聞防範系統，我們旨在回答兩個廣泛的研究問題：（1）如何通過社交媒體帖文的來源真實性，讓用戶更加了解潛在的假新聞及其轉發的風險？ （2）智能溯源系統能否阻止假新聞在社交媒體上的傳播鏈條？我們將使用實驗室對照實驗和現場實驗來回答這些問題。在對照實驗中，我們將測試社交媒體用戶在遇到新的社交媒體帖文時，會否注意其來源的真實性。在現場實驗中，我們計劃將智能溯源及假新聞防範系統部署到社交媒體網站，並隨著時間的推移觀察其在遏制假新聞傳播方面的效果。我們計劃使用差異中之差異法來檢驗該系統在阻止假新聞傳播鏈中的處理效果。這項研究對打擊假新聞，具有重要的研究和實踐意義。

11510022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11510022.value: 縮小割裂：结合人工智能驅動的智慧健康設備及應用與人情味支持助力慢性病患者

11510022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11510022.value: Prof Fang, Yulin Prof Sun, Yongqiang

11510022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11510022.value: Chronic illnesses such as cancer and diabetes are leading causes of death globally, resulting in substantial economic costs for many countries. Smart health devices and applications (SHDA) and technological advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are considered promising approaches to reducing healthcare costs and improving chronic illness care and health communication. AI-powered SHDA is being used as a surrogate for formal support that medical professionals typically provide. Through deep analysis of extensive patient data, SHDA can formulate and deliver personalized care messages to patients in apps that family members can also use for informal support of these patients. Few studies, however, have investigated whether or how SHDA affect health behaviors and psychological wellbeing, two key outcomes of illness management. To fill this void, this project extends optimal match theory of social support and matches the three main aspects, type of support, source of support, and stage of patients’ illness management with patient needs. Working with a start-up company operating an AI-powered SHDA platform for diabetes management in mainland China, participants will be drawn from about one million diabetic patients who use the platform daily. Study 1 will use a multi-wave survey to measure how the two types and two sources of support messages delivered via SHDA apps can jointly influence patients at the early and late stages of illness management. Study 2 will conduct a field experiment to validate Study 1 results, comparing the types (informational/ emotional) and sources (app/ family member) of patient support at these two stages. In another field experiment, Study 3 will explore whether AI can effectively act as a surrogate or supplementary tool for family members in delivering emotional support to patients. Four versions of these support messages will be designed and delivered via the company’s SHDA platform. Participants’ health behaviors and psychological states will be measured several times over one year. To the best of our knowledge, the project will be the first to develop a theory-based contingency model for AI-powered SHDA and empirically examine the matching effects of the social support types and sources. Results will provide managerially actionable guidelines on how social supports for patients can deliver optimum chronic illness management. By uniting patients, healthcare providers, and family members to combat and manage patients’ chronic disease, the divide between informational and emotional supports provided by AI-powered SHDA apps and the (patient-preferred) “human touch” offered by family members and close others can be narrowed. 糖尿病以及癌症等慢性病是全球死亡的主要原因，給許多國家造成巨大的經濟損失。 智慧健康設備及應用（SHDA）和人工智能（AI）技術的進步被認為是降低醫療成本、改善慢性病護理和健康知識傳播的有效途徑。 人工智能驅動的SHDA正逐漸替代通常由醫療人員提供的專業化支持。 通過對大量患者數據的深入分析，SHDA可以在應用程序中制定並向患者傳遞個性化的護理信息，患者家人也可以使用這些信息對患者進行非專業支持。 然而，現有研究很少有探討SHDA能否影響或如何影響患者的健康行為和心理健康這兩個慢性病管理的重點問題。 為填補現有研究空白，此項目拓展了社會支持的最優匹配理論，將支持類型、支持來源和患者疾病管理階段等三方面要素與患者的需求進行匹配。此項目將與一家中國大陸的初創公司合作，該公司主要運營一個人工智能驅動的SHDA糖尿病管理平台。項目的參與者將從該平台約100萬名糖尿病患者用戶中隨機抽取。 研究1將使用多波的調查來追蹤檢驗通過SHDA傳遞的兩種類型和兩種來源的支持信息會如何影響到疾病管理的早期和後期的患者。 研究2將進行現場實驗來驗證研究1的結果，比較兩個不同維度支持信息對早期和後期患者的效果：支持類型（信息/情感）和來源（APP/家人）。研究3將進行另一個現場實驗，探討人工智能是否可以有效地替代或者補充家人向患者提供的情感支持。這些支持信息將設計成四個版本，並發佈於公司的SHDA平台。同時，我們將多次測量參與者一年內的健康行為和心理狀態的變化。 據我們所知，此項目將是第一個基於理論為人工智能驅動的SHDA建立權變的模型，並是首次實證檢驗了社會支持類型和來源之間的匹配效果。結果將為患者及其家人就如何提供社會支持以實現最佳的慢性病管理提供可操作的指南。通過聯合患者，醫療保健服務提供者和家人來共同對抗和管理慢性病，可以縮小SHDA提供的支持與家庭成員和其他親密關係提供的（患者偏好的）「人情味」支持之间的割裂。

11510122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11510122.value: 多產品的動態定價是一個常見但具有挑戰性的問題。作為一種常用的解決方法，動態規劃面臨幾個主要的挑戰。首先是所謂“維度的詛咒”。由於產品多，動態規劃必須保持一個高維狀態空間，同時還要處理一個高維策略空間。其次是為了構建離散時間動態程序，必須離散化狀態，時間和價格通常也是如此。為了模型的可求解性，離散化經常會相當粗糙，因此會導致顯著的性能損失。最後，到目前為止，該問題的可處理規模仍然有限，並且往往與實際的規模相形見絀。這加劇了對粗略近似的需求，從而進一步減少了解決方案的性能表現。 鑑於上述挑戰，在本項目中，我們提出了一種數據驅動的滾動水平魯棒性優化方法。假設我們有一些有限的交易數據，我們將首先構造以數據驅動的方式為模型參數設置不確定性。二是建設穩健的求解穩健最優價格的優化模型。值得注意的是，在這樣的模型中，價格是獨立於狀態的。因此，我們將採用滾動水平的方法，即每當我們進入一個新週期，我們會重新求解模型，但是只實施當前週期的定價決策，通過這種方式來反映初始庫存水平對於決策的影響。第三，我們將開發一個高效的算法求解魯棒優化模型。求解效率非常重要，因為所設想的優化模型涉及二元變量，需要反复求解。我們提議的方法提高了模型的可解性，有機會提供更好的定價決策，有著更廣泛的適用性。 我們獲得了一個關於酒店房間預訂的數據集。這將使我們能夠在真實環境中驗證和試驗我們的方法。完成該項目將對現有的定價文獻做出重大貢獻，並對行業實踐產生非常積極的影響。

11600222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11600222.value: 文類重構與文化生產：現代中國英雄評傳的興起，1902-1919

11600222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11600222.value: The proposed project will explore how Chinese intellectuals forged critical biographies depicting national heroes to achieve their political and cultural agendas in the early decades of the twentieth century. Scholars have reached a consensus on the key role played by new genres in generating and disseminating novel ideas in modern China. Most studies have examined a broad range of new genres of texts such as textbooks, encyclopedias, dictionaries, and political novels. However, critical biographies have remained understudied. According to my observation, critical biographies that flourished in the late Qing and early Republican periods constitute a distinct genre written in classical Chinese and characterized by full-length narratives and polemical arguments. By viewing these critical biographies as a new genre of text, I will demonstrate that they were reconfigured by integrating various indigenous and foreign (particularly Japanese) sources, including biographies, polemical essays, textbooks, and political novels. Furthermore, I will examine how these cultural products were circulated together with their generic models and ideas through intellectual, educational, and commercial networks to serve a new function of political, civic, and moral education. The proposed project will specifically focus on two of the most influential series of critical biographies. The first series is Liang Qichao’s works on national heroes. I will explore how the author shaped his arguments by reconciling two types of Japanese biographies—historical treatises on Meiji Restoration and books on self-cultivation—with his polemical essays On the New Citizen and how he remodeled his narratives by appropriating traditional Chinese and modern Japanese biographies, as well as his own and Meiji political novels. The second series is the Commercial Press’s Books for Youth, which consists of 29 biographies of both Western and Chinese heroes. I will examine how the editors of the series assimilated the generic model established by Liang and the elements of Japanese and Chinese biographies, as well as ethics textbooks, and how the series has been circulated through the expansion of the new education system. By revealing the political, intellectual, and educational trends intertwined with these cultural products, the proposed project will contribute to a comprehensive understanding of the role played by critical biographies in shaping the cult of national heroes. By highlighting the hybrid and transcultural nature of this new genre, the proposed project will seek to illustrate the tensions between the foreign and the indigenous, as well as between the traditional and the modern that characterize the Chinese cultural transition.

11600522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11600522.value: 學習軟實力：中國和日本在蒙古的國際援助項目

11600522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11600522.value: Prof FOSSATI, Diego Dr Lim, Guanie

11600522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11600522.value: 本研究將全面比較中國和日本過去三十年在蒙古的國際援助項目。中國近年開始改變國際發展策略，例如減少向大型基建借貸融資、增加對外援助項目，並與非政府組織合作，落實建設社區能力的國際援助項目，以展現軟實力，緩減日益嚴重的抗議和反華情緒。令人驚訝的是，此舉不但顯示中國參考日本國際援助的做法，更意味著中國正進一步實行去中心化的放權管治。因此，我們需要有系統地研究中國是否及如何仿效日本，通過國際援助項目改善形象、贏取民心。同時，本研究亦著力回應另一個長遠的發展問題——究竟受援民衆對施援國家的認受性，會否及如何影響雙方政府施行國際合作項目的過程和成效。 中國近年一改以往硬銷基建工程的作風，轉而開展更多國際援助項目，由此，「軟實力」理論為研究中國逐漸軟化的國際發展政策，提供了一個合理框架，以解構分析相關政策目標、影響和實施等問題。本研究將結合不同方法，包括文獻追蹤、全國問卷調查和四個案例比較，多方驗證中國是否受日本影響而採用國際援助政策，提升國際形象、改善民眾的接納度和落實合作機制。 取材研究蒙古有三個原因：首先，蒙古國民因歷史發展和地緣政治關系，對中日兩國有著大相迴異的印象——日本將其國家重塑爲一個正面可靠的夥伴，而中國則日益被認為是一個別有用心的強國。因此，如果國際援助項目可以改變中國在蒙古的形象，這種軟化的方法也必可應用在其他地方，研究蒙古的情況因而變得尤其重要；其次，中國於1999年推出“走出去”政策，第一個目的國家便是蒙古，而日本也是在90年代末蒙古放棄社會主義制度時開展在當地的國際發展項目，比較中日在蒙古同期推行的不同國際合作項目，有助分析兩國政策的異同及影響；最後，本研究的主要研究員去年剛完成一個報告，分析日本在蒙的一個國際援助項目，對有關背景十分熟悉，並建立了廣泛的研究網絡，有助開展本項目。 最後，本研究團隊兼具跨地域和學科的成員，擅長探討軟實力的理論和分析政府和地方人員的國際合作發展策略。我們將研究不同管治背境的國際援助項目，從中歸納經驗，一方面爲決策者在制定國際發展政策時提供參考，以配合他們和受援國的發展需求和意願，確保有關項目成效的可持續性。另一方面，我們的研究結果也將惠及受援國的社區持份者，讓他們認識如何有效地回應和影響由不同政府主導的國際援助項目，以取得雙贏而長遠的發展結果。

11601022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11601022.value: 中國司法場域中家庭教會宗教自由之邊界

11601022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11601022.value: This project seeks to explore the judicial approach to restricting the freedom of Protestant house churches from a socio-legal perspective, given that China has established a comprehensive legal system. Through a mix of analytical literature review, in-depth fieldwork in China (including interviews with church leaders, human rights lawyers, judges, etc., as well as contextual analysis of relevant judicial decisions), this project will produce and disseminate fundamental knowledge about the approach adopted by China’s courts to Protestant house churches in an illiberal context. 隨著中國確立了具有自身特色的法律制度，從而使得有必要從法律與社會的角度來探究家庭教會在中國司法場域中行使宗教自由權的具體情形。通過實證研究的方法（包括訪談等），該課題試圖對中國司法場域中家庭教會在法律及社會中所呈現的形態進行探討。

11601422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11601422.value: 隱性用戶影響、顛覆性技術和第三方專業人士的服務質量：來自線上公共法律服務的實驗證據

11601422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11601422.value: Dr Ding, Chunyan Prof WALKER, Richard Mark Ms Zheng, Ruoting

11601422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11601422.value: The way public goods and services are delivered has changed substantially in recent years with the widespread use of computer technologies and the extensive involvement of third-party professionals. In the modern legal world, computer technologies allow service providers and users to interact and communicate online without geographical constraints. Given the exponential growth of automation and artificial intelligence (AI), certain legal tasks and services (e.g., legal document analysis, legal practice automation) can be performed more efficiently by machines. In the proposed study, we will focus on the global emergence of state-led public legal e-services and address the following research question: How do technological innovations and third-party professional involvement advance the delivery of public legal services and address justice issues in the digital era? In answering this question, the proposed project will draw on (1) the street-level bureaucrats literature that emphasize discretion among frontline public service providers, (2) linguistic communication research on the importance of service users’ communicative cues, and (3) the influence of cognitive biases on the acceptance of technology by specialists. Our findings will offer an in-depth understanding of how public e-service quality is shaped by hidden citizen/client influence via e-communications and how legal professionals respond to the increasing use of AI techniques. This project will consist of two studies. Study 1 will seek to uncover the role of the hidden user influence by answering two key questions: 1(A) How does perceived user deservingness (i.e., needed and earned deservingness), as reflected in online legal inquiries, affect third-party lawyers’ prioritization of legal advice? and 1(B) Do citizens’ online communicative cues (i.e., addressing with titles and showing emotion) elicit extra-role behavior from third-party lawyers? Study 2 will aim to evaluate smart public services by examining the monitoring role of modern AI-based performance-assessment tools (2A) and the acceptance by human legal professionals of AI-based legal assistance tools for offering public legal consultations (2B). We will use a multimethod design consisting of (1) focus-groups comprising lawyers who have participated in the signature public legal service e-portal in China (known as 12348), service users of the e-portal, policymakers in justice departments, and technical vendors and (2) two interconnected lab experiments among of senior law school students from five mainland universities. This project will provide significant insights into the development of contractual public services in the digital era and contribute to novel solutions by informing the development of effective models of digital public legal services. 近年來，隨著計算機技術的廣泛使用和第三方專業人員的積極參與，公共物品和公共服務的提供方式發生了重大變化。在當代法律界，信息技術的發展使得法律服務提供者可以不受地域限制地與客戶進行在線互動和交流，某些法律任務和服務甚至可以由機器完成和提供（例如，法律文件分析、法律實踐自動化等）。本項目聚焦於正在興起的線上公共法律服務，分析和探討技術創新和第三方專業人士的參與如何推進公共法律服務的完善並解決數字時代的司法問題。本項目基於以下重要文獻對該問題進行了解析：（1）強調前線公共服務提供者的自由裁量權的街頭官僚文獻，（2）關於用戶線上交流中的語言特徵的語言學研究，以及（3）認知偏差對專家接受新技術的影響。 我們的研究將有助於深入了解線上公共服務的質量是如何被用戶隱性特徵以及法律專業人士對人工智能技術的接受度和使用度所影響。具體而言，本項目包括兩項不同研究。研究一試圖通過回答兩個關鍵問題來揭示隱藏的用戶影響的作用。在研究1(A)裡，我們著眼於線上公共法律諮詢過程中用戶應得性（即需要的和獲得的應得性）如何影響第三方法律顧問對諮詢案件的優先排序。在研究1(B)中，我們聚焦於用戶的不同溝通策略（例如稱呼方式和情感表達）是否會引起第三方法律顧問的積極角色外行為。研究二旨在通過研究基於人工智能的新型績效評估工具的監督作用（2A）以及法律專業人士對人工智能工具協助的接受程度（2B）來評估智能公共服務。本項目將採用混合方法設計，包括（1）對參與中國公共法律服務線上平台的律師、用戶、司法部門和技術供應商群體進行多個焦點小組訪談，以及（2）來自內地五所大學的法學院高年級學生參與的兩項實驗室實驗。本項目將為數字時代的政府公共服務外包的發展提供重要見解，並為開發數字公共法律服務的有效模式提供新的解決方案。

11602622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11602622.value: 華語電影中的女性作者文化史：1916-1949

11602622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11602622.value: 由哥倫比亞大學圖書館開放給讀者免費獲取的「女性電影先鋒計劃」，由世界各地的學者撰寫的文章和條目，介紹了許多女性在電影製作中跨越國家和父權界限的案例，是一部正在進行中的女性電影史的項目。受此啟發的本項研究追溯活躍於1916 至 1949 年間的華語電影女性作者，包括擔任過導演、編劇和監製的女性；而「華語電影」的地理位置，跟隨中國移民的歷史地圖和中國電影的跨國發行路線，涵蓋香港、上海、新加坡、好萊塢、紐約和其他東南亞和拉丁美洲城市。 美國加州的黃女娣於 1916 年在奧克蘭創作、製作和導演了故事片《關武帝》，被公認為第一位華裔女編劇兼導演。九年後，1925年謝采貞在上海執導並主演了《孤雛悲聲》。與此同時，舞台和電影編劇濮舜卿開始為長城電影公司寫作。1928年左右，加拿大出生的女演員林楚楚為民新電影公司撰寫了《再世因緣》；女演員王漢倫和楊耐梅各自製作一部電影，成為中國最早的女性製片人。1930年代初，上海女演員艾霞和胡萍也各自為明星公司編劇並主演了一部電影。1930 年代後期，舊金山出生的伍錦霞和香港出生的尹海靈成為香港最早的女性編劇兼導演。太平洋戰爭前不久，伍返回美國、尹則於 1940 年移居新加坡，兩人繼續寫作和導演。1940 年代，伍在美國導演和製作了四部粵語有聲片。與此同時在日據的上海，作家、翻譯家盛琴僊在 1944 年至 1945 年間寫了三部電影劇本，著名作家張愛玲也在 1947 至 1948 年間寫了兩部，達到了女性作者的又一高峰。 本項目旨在構建一部以女性作者為主體的早期華語電影文化史，描繪她們在本地及跨洋製作中，如何將自己的性別、種族和流散/移民經歷積極融入作品中。我們希望找到三個問題的答案。首先，女性如何獲得機會拍攝她們想拍的電影？其次，在男性主導的行業中，她們如何應對國內和跨國電影製作？第三，她們是否影響了後代電影人以及我們今天對電影文化和產業的理解？

11603722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11603722.value: 犯罪小說、其橋段及有關第二次世界大戰期間戰爭暴行的描繪

11603722.label: Project Objectives
11603722.value: To provide a detailed reading of the operations of crime fiction tropes (e.g., the presence of a detective figure; an investigative pattern in relation to concealed past events; a narrative focusing on a quest for justice; textual patterns involving the disruption and reaffirmation of the social order) in relation to the representation of Second World War-era atrocity. To expand the study of atrocity fiction beyond its current confines to include texts that are either explicitly part of the crime fiction tradition or exploit crime fiction tropes for aesthetic and ethical impact. Why is this strand of atrocity fiction (which might be called atrocity crime fiction) so widespread, appearing in both high and low cultural forms and circulating across and between multiple national literary cultures? Why has it received less critical and theoretical attention than have other approaches to the representation and memorialisation of atrocity? Does atrocity crime fiction offer advantages compared to other forms of atrocity literature, and if so, what are they? To investigate crime fiction’s engagements with a global history of atrocity in the years before, during and after the Second World War. The study will examine fictional representations of historiographically dominant atrocities, such as the Holocaust (1933-1945), as well comparatively neglected atrocities linked to Soviet crimes of the pre-war years (e.g. the Holodomar from 1932-1933 and the Stalinist purges of 1936-1938), the Spanish Civil War (1936-1939), the Sino-Japanese War (1937-1945), the war in the Pacific (1941-1945) and the Eastern Front (1941-1945). To explore the different ways in which crime fiction tropes have been used by different national traditions and authors to represent atrocity. This will enable a transnational understanding of the ways that crime fiction is used to comprehend and process a global history of atrocity and to develop a broad picture of crime fiction as a transnational form of engagement with a traumatic collective past. To chart the development of atrocity crime fiction over time (e.g. from the immediate post-War era into the twenty-first century) and in relation to adjacent generic forms (such as the thriller and the espionage novel) that play an important part in the representation of the Second World War.

11603722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11603722.value: 茲比格涅夫·布里辛斯基形容20世紀歷史為「生靈塗炭」，遭受屠殺的人數遠遠超越人類可理解的能力範圍（7），出於政治動機而帶來的暴力令約一億八千七百萬人遇害。第二次世界大戰正是這場人類浩劫的主因，期間發生種種暴行，如納粹大屠殺、針對平民發動大規模炸彈襲擊、使用原子武器等，釀成四至五千萬平民死亡（Jewell et al. 387）。 二戰過後，文學發展著眼於從倫理及審美學的角度審視當時的社會面貌。狄奧多·阿多諾曾批評，在奥斯威辛集中營慘劇發生後，寫詩是蒙昧的行為（‘Cultural’ 34）。相反，克勞德·朗玆曼則堅稱小說能批判屠殺暴行 （qtd. in Norris 100）。不論如何，有關戰爭暴力的小說，或運用想像力來嘗試理解暴力的作品，紛紛在國際文壇興起，更成為文學研究的重要課題。可是，儘管學術界十分著重見證文學（Engdahl 5）及高雅戰爭小說的價值，卻往往忽視類型小說與戰爭暴行的關係，尤其是犯罪小說。事實上，犯罪小說與戰爭中的歷史事件環環相扣，傳統文學探討二戰時期的戰爭罪行時，亦常廣泛採用犯罪小說的橋段。 為了填補這片空白，本研究將探討描繪二戰暴行的二十及二十一世紀國際犯罪小說，集中分析二戰時期的重大事件，包括納粹大屠殺，以及同時期其他相對受忽視的議題。本研究亦會深入剖析對暴力有露骨描寫的犯罪小說，以及運用了獨特描寫技巧的文學作品中，如何利用犯罪及偵探的意象來描繪二戰暴行，並尋問為何描寫戰爭暴行的小說中常傾向於運用意象。再者，本研究會進一步聚焦於在小說中寫現實苦難所衍生的問題，以及犯罪小說對廣泛戰爭文學的形式和主題作何貢獻。此外，這項研究將探究這些作品在國際文學市場如何流通。 本研究將包括多篇文章及一本專著，以探討小說中對於戰爭暴行的複雜描寫，並對有關戰爭及集體記憶的文學研究範疇作出貢獻。

11604422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11604422.value: 中國史料數碼化的早期歷程探析，1980-2009：以五個基本的數據庫項目為中心之考察

11604422.label: Project Objectives
11604422.value: To examine the development of historical source digitisation efforts that were active in the 1980–2009 period, combining both the humanistic and technical aspects of digitisation in an analytical history that speaks to both historians of China and digital humanities experts. To investigate the role of humanities scholars in designing and using digital technologies during the early years of this prehistory phase of Chinese digital humanities. To gain first-hand perspectives by conducting in-depth interviews with the key players involved in five important and longstanding digitisation projects in Hong Kong, mainland China, and Taiwan, including the construction of electronic text databases dealing with the massive ‘Twenty-five Standard Histories’ and the _Siku quanshu_ to elucidate the processes through which these computational platforms were funded, constructed, and designed. To illuminate the processes employed to construct these digital systems by studying and contextualising their artefacts, such as digital bibliographies, digitised full-texts, database interfaces, workflow documents, and project publications, and to use these artefacts to carry out the proposed analytical study. To harness the insights from this research project to write a critical history of the digital humanities in a non-Western region with a very active but largely disorganised digital research community; this will help historians and humanities scholars to critically scrutinise the origins and development of the digital utilities that historians customarily rely heavily on in their research.

11604422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11604422.value: In this digital era, scholarly research, including that of China’s historians, is profoundly affected by digital technologies. A wealth of digitised material is amassing, and digital tools are becoming more powerful. Using computers to digitise historical sources, however, is not new and has a history of over 40 years in the Greater China region. This proposed project will analyse the development of early digitisation efforts within the Chinese humanities and investigate digitisation activities from the 1980s, when computers first became more widespread in Greater China, until the formal emergence of the digital humanities paradigm there in 2009. This 30-year foundational phase constitutes the ‘prehistory’ of the Chinese digital humanities. Both the large amount of source material and the linguistic features of Classical Chinese present unique technical challenges when digitising, organising, and processing texts. The 1980–2009 period was a phase during which scholars addressed those challenges and paved the way for more sophisticated digital research. Based on first-hand perspectives and materials, this project conducts case studies of five foundational digitisation projects that occurred during this time. In-depth interviews with relevant retiring individuals will be conducted to gain timely perspectives on the construction of the electronic databases and tools that, today, are crucial for studying China’s history. These early digitisation projects digitised fundamental historical sources from premodern China, such as the ‘Twenty-five Standard Histories’ and the _Siku quanshu_. Rather than assuming that the development of digital research databases and tools occurred as linear processes, this project will investigate how such digital utilities came into being through difficult negotiations between early digital humanists and the relevant humanistic and technical decisions made by scholars and database architects. In so doing, this perspective on early Chinese digital explorations enables us to examine the impact of digital technologies on Chinese historical research from within the humanities field, which has previously almost always been interpreted from outside the field. The digitisation of Chinese historical material was far from a purely technical matter; it benefitted from extensive input from experts in traditional Chinese culture. Digitisation also poses issues for humanities scholars regarding the formation, representation, and reorganisation of knowledge. These collaborative input and issues will be explored in the project as part of the prehistory of Chinese digital humanities. This research will allow historians to examine both the humanistic and technical aspects of this critical phase of premodern China scholarship, and more importantly, their intersections. 當今研究中國史之學者已受到數碼科技的深刻影響。無論是史料的大規模數碼化，還是研究工具效能的提升，都通常和數碼化息息相關。這種趨勢並非新事物——大中華地區各機構和研究者至今（2022年）對中國史料的數碼化已進行超過四十年了。本研究項目會分析1980年代以來中國各機構對歷史資料的早期數碼化工作，尤其是中國人文學科中從業人員進行的相關工程。這個項目關注的時代斷限，是1980年代電腦在大中華社會變得普遍，一直到2009年「數碼人文」（數位人文、數字人文）的學術範式出現之間之階段。這段長約三十年的歷程，可說是中國數碼人文的「史前史」。中國史料浩如煙海，且其語言和其他特點皆為數碼化帶來諸多技術挑戰。無論是對材料的重整或是處理，都有不少障礙是數碼化的從業者需要面對的。他們在這個階段處理了大量的類似問題，並為其後更複雜、高階的數碼研究奠定了重要基礎。基於一手角度和研究材料，這個項目將針對五個基本的數碼化項目進行個案研究。本項目會對相關學者，尤其是已經退休的主事者和參與者進行訪談，希望能及時地瞭解相關數據庫和數碼工具當時是如何建成的。例如，這些項目完成了「二十五史」和《四庫全書》文本的數碼化，是當今學者都非常依賴的。類似數據庫和數碼工具的發展從來都不是線性的過程，而是早期數碼人文學者和技術人員面對諸多艱難考驗，進行解難而得出的成果，需要兼顧人文學術和技術的雙重需求。通過對這些議題進行研究，本項目會從人文學科的領域本身剖析數碼科技對中國歷史研究的深遠影響——這種影響過去往往是從技術角度來討論，而不是從人文學科領域來立論。從人文學科的領域理論，能夠引出一項重要反思——中國史料的數碼化絕對不僅僅是一種技術工作而已，而必然需要傳統中國文化的專家投入大量心血，提出學術見解的一項事業。數碼化也為人文學者如何形成、表現和重整人文知識提出了許多新問題，值得專門探研。這些合作而成的集體工作是中國數碼人文「史前史」的重要一環。歷史學者在研究這段歷程時要充分地兼顧人文學術和技術這兩個不可或缺的方面，才能進而分析兩方面相交而產生的諸多議題。

11604822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11604822.value: 宋代《詩經》比興詮釋中的鳥獸草木知識

11604822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11604822.value: 孔子曾督促學生研讀《詩經》，認為《詩經》不僅有助於理解與實踐儒家倫理，還能“多識於鳥獸草木之名”。自漢代以來，研究《詩經》中的鳥獸草木，成為《詩學》學重要分支。但是，中國古人看重的並不是博物學知識本身；相反，他們最看重的，是在自然界的鳥獸草木與人類社會的倫理觀念之間建立對應關係，將鳥獸草木知識的解釋轉變為詩歌寓意的比興詮釋。 宋代是一個變革的時代。宋人不僅在《詩經》學領域懷疑甚至推翻漢代以來的權威見解，還在思想學術上辨析理氣、人情、格物致知，重新闡釋了自然法則與社會原則的同一性。宋人憑藉新的方法論，對《詩經》中的鳥獸草木及其對應的倫理觀念，做出了很多新的解釋，比如重新思考鳥獸草木與倫理觀念的對應原則及方式、鳥獸草木的現實性與虛構性、如何想像式閱讀鳥獸草木的寓意等。因此，本計劃不是研究宋代的博物學知識，而是梳理宋代學者在新的知識體系中，如何重新建構《詩經》鳥獸草木知識的比興寓意。

11605622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11605622.value: 多式聯運香港：通過聲景和氣味記錄感官文化遺產

11605622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11605622.value: Dr Aletta, Francesco Dr Liew, Kongmeng Prof MATSUDA, Yudai Dr Xiao, Jieling

11605622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11605622.value: 感官文化遺產結合了物質和非物質遺產，在社區中創造了認同感和凝聚力。在城市研究中，對於日常非正式習俗的分析, 通常依靠視覺圖像、文本和檔案材料, 來描述具有文化意義的地點和實踐。相比之下，聲學環境通常不是敘事的一部分，嗅覺環境亦很少被記錄。在當代香港快速而深刻的變化背景下，這些城市構造中的重要線索有被忽視的風險，甚至可能在被記錄下來之前就消失了。因此，如果不慎重考慮和記錄以聲音和氣味為代表的感官文化遺產，我們真的可以聲稱了解城市嗎？該項目旨在保護香港一些受到威脅的標誌性遺址，並更準確、更豐富地了解具有重要文化意義的地點、儀式和社會習俗，從而更好地欣賞文件遺產。同時，該項目還會闡明城市景觀、聲音景觀和氣味景觀之間的交叉模式關係。为此，我們提出了多模式研究方法，將聲音和氣味作為沈浸式城市體驗的核心組成部分，並記錄大量具有香港特色場所的樣本，其中重點關注街頭食品（街頭小食）、中國寺廟（寺廟 [佛祖、天后……]）和街市（傳統市場）。數據庫將通過該項目設立的網站開放獲取，並與近期啟動的國際化聲景-氣味景觀項目相鏈接。這不僅符合當前對本地文化遺產詳細記錄的需求，亦有助於支持跨學科合作，還將成為未來香港城市規劃縱向研究的重要資源，以及與其他城市進行跨文化研究的參考點。對於研究方法，我們將發展從復雜的物理環境中系統收集和分析數據的能力，將聲音和嗅覺測量與視頻的捕捉和敘事相結合。現場數據是兼具主客觀方面的，包括 360˚ 視頻、3D 音頻（全景聲）和“氣味印記”（空氣樣本的氣相色譜-質譜分析），亦包括觀察者在感官漫步時，對視覺、聽覺和嗅覺環境進行的結構化註釋，以及與利益相關者的訪談。該項目形成的數據庫將服務於環境心理學、多模態感知和感官統合方面的進一步研究。這還會為未來在博物館、畫廊和商業場所的虛擬旅遊、藝術、遊戲、電影和空間設計的多感官應用奠定基礎。

11605722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11605722.value: 公司合規與大數據治理: 中國的企業社會信用制度

11605722.label: Project Objectives
11605722.value: To understand the novel Corporate Social Credit System (CSCS) in China and its design characteristics, operation, and rationale. While there is no uniform regulation on evaluation standards published by the central government, our project intends to investigate the standards adopted in each province at the local level and find out the commonalities and differences. To find out the scoring distribution of public companies in different provinces and examine the variations in scores under different evaluation indicators. This part of the investigation may inform the companies about the potential strategies for improving scores. To analyze the potential behavior modification effect of CSCS from the components of the evaluation standards and the distribution of the scores. To examine the determinants of CSCS and its implications. The variables of interest include corporate governance, financial condition (leverage ratio and profitability), formal linkages to the party-state (state-owned enterprise indicator, state shareholding), and political connection of a firm. The results will have far-reaching implications on corporate behavior and the future of Chinese state capitalism.

11605722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11605722.value: 中國企業社會信用體系（CSCS）是一個大數據項目，旨在評估在該國註冊的所有商業實體的“誠信”，它與類似的個人誠信評估系統並行運行。然而，現有文獻較多關注的是個人社會信用體系，較少關注企業的相應制度。 CSCS 對合規和不合規公司實施一套相應的獎勵和懲罰制度，這代表了一種自動篩選的前瞻性策略，以確定允許哪些企業得進入市場並從中受益。 CSCS除了是一個RegTech項目，使政府能夠使用大數據評估公司並相應地進行個性化監管，CSCS也是一個企業合規計劃，由國家和黨制定標準並建立聯合惩戒機制，增加違規行為的違法成本。因此，所有在中國開展業務的企業都必須了解 CSCS 的設計和運營。 2014年，國務院印發了《社會信用體系建設規劃綱要（2014-2020年）》，對制度進行了全面的指導，其後許多下級政府部門皆參與建立信用體系。其中頂層設計，例如獎懲制度和數據收集和存儲政策，是在國家層面訂立的。而每個省、市和縣政府則負責建立具有地方特色的社會信用評價體系。最終，各個地方政府將在全國各地建立各別的數字化評估系統。由於地方政府可以制定適合當地情況的評估標準，因此通過比較研究了解地方政府採用的標準之間的異同，是了解CSCS設計特點的關鍵第一步。此外，為了了解 CSCS 的實務運作與影響，本研究將通過收集省級政府公佈的公共信用分數來研究分數的分佈和相關決定因素。本實證研究將探討“誠信”在中國的真正含義，並深入了解 CSCS 對企業行為和經營績效的潛在影響。本研究的目的是進一步了解 CSCS，一個發展中的社會治理項目，及其對企業行為修正和中國國家資本主義的影響。

11605722.label: Realisation of objectives
11605722.value: All the objectives of this project have been achieved. 1. Objective 1: To understand the novel Corporate Social Credit System (CSCS) in China and its design haracteristics, operation, and rationale. To understand the novel Corporate Social Credit System (CSCS) in China, we have examined all relevant rules and regulations published by the central and local governments. The CSCS is administered at the central level by the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), a powerful state planning agency, and the People’s Bank of China, the central bank. The State Administration for Market Regulation, an antitrust authority, is also involved, as it collects a large amount of data on enterprises and maintains a “heavily distrusted entities list” ( yanzhong weifa shixin mingdan), which is fed into the sanctioning mechanism of the CSCS. An inter-ministerial conference composed of numerous government agencies and Party bodies coordinates the sharing of information and imposition of sanctions. 2. Objective 2: While there is no uniform regulation on evaluation standards published by the central government, our project intends to investigate the standards adopted in each province at the local level and find out the commonalities and differences. Publication of the 2014 Planning Outline touched off a waterfall effect of government agency involvement in the CSCS at descending levels of government. But the CSCS in operation today is not a unified, standardized system. Overarching design features such as grading and punishment systems and policies on technical issues such as the scope of data collection and storage are established at the national level. Each provincial, city and district government is responsible for setting up a CSCS to score firms registered in its locality. A digitized evaluation system to generate a score for each registered enterprise will eventually be established locally throughout the country. 3. Objective 3: To find out the scoring distribution of public companies in different provinces and examine the variations in scores under different evaluation indicators. This part of the investigation may inform the companies about the potential strategies for improving scores. While most provinces have published rules about social credit scores, no other province has made the scores public except for Zhejiang province. Hence, we could not explore the score distribution and determinants in other provinces due to the unavailability. 4. Objective 5: To examine the determinants of CSCS and its implications. The variables of interest include corporate governance, financial condition (leverage ratio and profitability), formal linkages to the party-state (state-owned enterprise indicator, state shareholding), and political connection of a firm. The results will have far-reaching implications on corporate behavior and the future of Chinese state capitalism. Implementation of the CSCS at the local level is most advanced in Zhejiang province. That is why we chose to conduct empirical study in Zhejiang province. The first journal article that we published is on the CSCS scores of public companies headquartered in Zhejiang. The article is published with The China Quarterly, a top regional study journal published by the Cambridge University Press. In this paper, we find no significant evidence that more profitable firms or firms with better governance (proxied by more independent boards of directors) receive higher overall scores. However, highly leveraged firms, subject to higher default risks, are associated with lower total scores. Perhaps most importantly, we find that, all else being equal, politically connected firms receive higher overall scores in Zhejiang than unconnected firms. The channel for this result is a “social responsibility” category that valorizes awards from the government and contributions to causes sanctioned by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). This finding underscores the potential of the CSCS to incentivize corporate fealty to the CCP’s industrial and social policies. 5. Objective 4: To analyze the potential behavior modification effect of CSCS from the components of the evaluation standards and the distribution of the scores. Our working paper examines the behavioral impact of the Corporate Social Credit System (CSCS) by analyzing three years of CSCS scores (2021–2023) for firms headquartered in Zhejiang Province. The results indicate that, on average, companies improved their scores over time, suggesting active efforts to comply with CSCS requirements. Notably, the most significant improvements occurred in categories related to tax evasion and administrative penalties, implying that firms prioritized resolving outstanding tax liabilities and regulatory fines—likely because these issues can be addressed with relative ease, assuming sufficient cash flow. In contrast, we observed minimal progress in the social responsibility category, possibly because improvements in this area (e.g., receiving government awards) depend more on external recognition than corporate initiative. Additionally, contributions to CCP-sanctioned charities did not increase substantially during this period, potentially due to economic constraints from the COVID-19 pandemic. These findings suggest that firms focus first on remedying straightforward compliance issues, while broader social responsibility measures remain a secondary priority.

11605722.label: Major findings and research outcome
11605722.value: Our research investigates the implementation and behavioral effects of China’s Corporate Social Credit System (CSCS), focusing on firms in Zhejiang Province—a pioneer in local-level CSCS adoption. Through two key studies, we analyze how firms interact with the system and adapt their behavior in response. The first study, published in The China Quarterly, examines CSCS scores of publicly listed firms in Zhejiang. Contrary to expectations, we find no significant link between profitability or corporate governance (proxied by board independence) and higher CSCS scores. However, firms with high leverage—and thus greater default risk—tend to receive lower scores, suggesting financial stability is a factor in evaluations. Most notably, politically connected firms consistently achieve higher overall scores, primarily due to advantages in the social responsibility category, which rewards government-bestowed awards and contributions to CCP-sanctioned causes. This finding highlights the CSCS’s role in incentivizing alignment with the Party’s policy priorities, reinforcing corporate-political ties. The second study, a working paper, tracks CSCS score trends from 2021 to 2023, revealing behavioral adjustments among Zhejiang-based firms. On average, scores improved over time, indicating active compliance efforts. The most pronounced gains occurred in areas like tax compliance and administrative penalties, suggesting firms prioritize rectifying easily addressable infractions (e.g., clearing tax debts or fines) when financially feasible. In contrast, progress in social responsibility—such as charity donations or government awards—remained stagnant, likely because improvements in this category depend on external validation rather than unilateral corporate action. The economic downturn during COVID-19 may have further dampened charitable contributions. Together, these findings demonstrate that firms respond pragmatically to the CSCS, first addressing straightforward compliance issues while deprioritizing more complex or politically mediated categories. The system’s design appears effective in curbing financial and regulatory misconduct but may inadvertently reinforce reliance on political connections for higher scores. These insights contribute to broader debates about the CSCS’s efficacy, equity, and influence on corporate behavior in China. Research outcome are presented in Part C.

11605722.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
11605722.value: Despite data limitations to Zhejiang Province, this research can advance by examining how the CSCS impacts government enforcement efficiency—a pillar of China’s precision governance strategy. Key questions include whether the system streamlines regulatory targeting (e.g., reducing inspections for compliant firms) or boosts tax compliance. Qualitative methods like interviews with regulators in Zhejiang and other provinces could assess CSCS’s role in improving interagency coordination, while comparative case studies of enforcement actions (e.g., tax audits) might reveal operational impacts across regions. Within Zhejiang, firm-level analysis could compare how state-owned and private enterprises adapt to CSCS incentives, and sector-specific studies might identify industries disproportionately affected by the system. Researchers should also explore unintended consequences, such as firms prioritizing short-term score metrics over long-term investments. Next steps should integrate quantitative analysis of Zhejiang’s enforcement outcomes (e.g., penalty reductions for high-scoring firms) with interviews of corporate and regulatory stakeholders. This mixed approach would clarify whether the CSCS achieves its goals of efficient oversight and reduced compliance burdens—or inadvertently generates bureaucratic complexities. Such insights are critical for understanding China’s evolving regulatory landscape and the real-world efficacy of scoring systems in governance.

11605722.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
11605722.value: This study examines China's Corporate Social Credit System (CSCS) through Zhejiang Province's implementation, where the system is most developed. We found two key patterns: First, while the CSCS penalizes financially unstable firms, it disproportionately rewards politically connected companies through its social responsibility category, which values government awards and approved donations. This suggests the system may inadvertently favor firms with established political ties. Second, companies actively work to improve scores, but focus on easily fixable issues like tax compliance and penalty payments rather than more complex social responsibility metrics. The pandemic further reduced charitable contributions, highlighting how economic conditions affect score-driven behavior. These findings reveal both the strengths and unintended consequences of China's regulatory experiment. The CSCS effectively incentivizes basic compliance like tax payments, but its design may create uneven playing fields by advantaging well-connected firms. For policymakers, these insights underscore the need to balance compliance incentives with system fairness. For businesses and researchers, they demonstrate how scoring systems reshape corporate priorities in predictable yet sometimes problematic ways. The study provides valuable evidence about how China's innovative approach to corporate governance functions in practice, with implications for similar regulatory systems globally.

11605922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11605922.value: This study examines public sentiment and perception towards the legal system in Hong Kong subsequent to the 2019 Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill protest. Following a crackdown (including mass arrests, prosecutions, and sentencing) on those who participated in the civil unrest which occurred in late 2019, and the subsequent enactment of The Law of the People’s Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, police enforcement actions, prosecutorial decisions, court convictions and sentencing rationales became a major source of contention in Hong Kong’s politics. The increase in scepticism and hostility towards the legal system and legal authorities has, on occasion, transformed into radical action – sometimes involving the use and threat of violence – targeted at both law enforcement officers and judges. Examining the source of public resentment towards the legal system and its potential consequences is therefore crucial. Building on studies that confirm the constitutive role social media plays in shaping public opinions and alternate realities, this study is the first to examine, through digital content analysis, perceptions and sentiments towards the legal system in a deeply polarised Hong Kong. It studies how these opinions and emotions are formed over time, their antecedents and intensity, the factors and significant events that triggered them, how they are narrated and expressed in the digital domain and how they may affect behavioural tendencies. It draws upon a set of established frameworks in criminology concerning procedural justice, legitimacy and legal cynicism as an analytical lens to offer explanations for Hong Kong’s rapid decline from a law-abiding society, where the public cherishes the rule of law and respects the legal system, to a society where legal authorities are sometimes viewed with contempt. This study will provide empirical evidence to better our understanding of the current state of Hong Kong’s legal system, generate novel insights on the impact of social media on legal socialisation and enrich the theoretical and methodological frameworks of the process-based model in criminology and socio-legal studies. 本研究旨在了解香港在2019年反修例風波和社會動盪後，公眾對香港法律制度的情緒(sentiments)和觀感(perceptions)。 2019 年的反修例風波及社會動盪後，多名示威參與者被逮捕、起訴及判刑。其後，全國人大頒布了《中華人民共和國香港特別行政區維護國家安全法》於香港實施。這些重大的社會事件，令香港的法律制度受到關注。警方的執法行動、政府的起訴決定、法院的判決和量刑也往往受到爭議。 本項研究希望透過社交媒體的網絡數據分析，了解在社會極度分化後公眾對香港法制的情緒和觀感，包括這些情緒和觀感是如何隨著時間的推移而形成 、 觸發情緒/觀感的事件和原因 、 情緒的強度 、 情緒/觀感在網絡領域如何被敘述和表達。此外，本研究亦借鑑犯罪學，了解程序公義 、 執法公正 、 法律犬儒主義等 (legal cynicism)、如何影響行為傾向(behavioural tendencies)，例如守法觀念或對執法者的蔑視及對抗。 本研究將提供經驗證據(empirical evidence) 理解當前香港法律制度的現狀，也為社交媒體在法律社會化(legal socialisation)的角色，和以程序為本(process-based) 的犯罪學和社會法律研究(socio-legal studies) 提出新的見解

11606422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11606422.value: 減輕香港對南亞和東南亞移民的偏見：關於“什麼”、“如何”和“是否”的混合方法調查

11606422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11606422.value: As a multi-cultural society, Hong Kong witnesses a long-standing prejudice against ethnic minority immigrants. South and Southeast Asian immigrants, who make up 70% of all immigrants in Hong Kong (Census and Statistics Department, 2017), face unfair treatment in work and rent, as well as a generally unfavorable attitude from the Chinese residents (Equal Opportunities Commission, 2016). Although the government and various NGOs devoted substantial efforts to helping ethnic minorities integrate into the society, existing initiatives mostly target the immigrants rather than the population holding the prejudice. Activities that foster positive contacts between ethnic minorities and Chinese residents are mostly offline, small-scale, and community-based, making it difficult to motivate the population as a whole. Building on decades of successful research on intergroup contact, this research tests the effectiveness of using indirect intergroup contacts to reduce prejudice against South and Southeast Asians in Hong Kong. Compared with offline contacts, indirect contacts are easily implemented and readily reflected in our daily information consumption activities such as reading comments and observing interactions on social media, making it ideal for impacting the population at large. The proposed research features 4 progressive studies, combining qualitative and quantitative research methods. It structures the investigation along a what-how-if framework: what the contact should be like, how should the contact take place, and if people should be given flexibility in choosing the form of contact. Study 1 identifies real-life intergroup contact stories as well as perceptions about the relevant norms and contextual factors regarding contacts between Chinese residents and South and Southeast Asian immigrants in Hong Kong. Study 2 develops victim narratives from the information collected from study 1 and tests its effectiveness on prejudice reduction. Study 3 embeds the victim narratives in messages reflecting different forms of indirect intergroup contact and tests their comparative effectiveness. Study 4 investigates to what extent flexibilities should be given to best enhance outcomes of the indirect intergroup contact and to motivate people in making more direct contacts with ethnic minority immigrants. The significance of this research is multifold. Theoretically, it fills gaps in intergroup contact research by 1) using interventions developed based on real-life scenarios and 2) considering how flexibility in the contact shapes its outcomes, both of which are strongly called for in recent literature on intergroup contact (Harwood, 2021; White et al., 2021). Empirically, the research generates evidence-based, context-specific, and readily implemented messages that can be applied in campaigns by various institutions. 作為一個多元文化的社會，香港長期存在對少數族裔移民的偏見。佔香港移民總數 70% 的南亞和東南亞移民（政府統計處，2017 年），在工作和租金方面面臨不公平待遇，以及中國居民普遍不利的態度（平等機會委員會，2016）。儘管政府和各種非政府組織在幫助少數民族融入社會方面付出了巨大努力，但現有的舉措主要針對的是移民，而不是持有偏見的人群。促進少數民族與中國居民積極接觸的活動大多是線下、小規模、社區化的，難以調動全體民眾的積極性。 這項研究以數十年來關於群體間接觸的成功研究為基礎，測試使用間接群體間接觸來減少香港對南亞和東南亞人的偏見的有效性。與線下接觸相比，間接接觸更容易實施，也很容易反映在我們日常的信息消費活動中，例如閱讀評論和觀察社交媒體上的互動，非常適合影響廣大人群。 擬議的研究包含4 項漸進式研究，結合了定性和定量研究方法。它根據以下框架構建調查：群體間接觸應該是什麼樣的，應該如何進行，以及人們應該在選擇群體間接觸形式方面具有多少靈活性。研究 1 將收集現實生活中的群體間接觸故事，以及對中國居民與香港的南亞和東南亞移民之間接觸的相關規範和背景因素的看法。研究 2 從研究 1 收集的信息中發展受害者敘述並測試其減少偏見的有效性；研究 3 將受害者的敘述嵌入反映不同形式的間接群體間接觸的信息中，並測試它們的相對有效性；研究 4 將調查應給予間接群體間接觸多大程度的靈活性，以最好地提高其效果，並激勵人們與少數民族移民進行更直接的接觸。 這項研究的意義是多方面的。從理論上講，它通過以下方式填補了群體間接觸研究的空白：1) 使用基於現實生活場景開發的干預措施；2) 考慮接觸的靈活性如何影響其結果，這兩者在最近關於群體間接觸的文獻中都被認定為迫切需要發展的研究方向（Harwood， 2021；White et al.，2021）。該研究將產生基於證據的、針對具體情況的、易於實施的信息，以應用於各種機構的宣傳活動中。

11606522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11606522.value: 系統情境對協作行動的影響

11606522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11606522.value: Much research has been conducted on the forces influencing collaborative actions. However, the literature has focused exclusively on interactions between collaborating partners developing joint capacities for actions. The circumstances that form the socioeconomic and political context for these collaborations have largely been ignored. These contextual forces are known as the system context in the popular Collaborative Governance Regime (CGR) model in which the system context is portrayed as having only an indirect effect on collaborative actions. Context is not considered a driving force for collaborative actions, which proceed directly from dynamics that build on principled engagement and the partners’ shared motivation to initiate joint actions (Emerson et al. 2012). However, this portrayal differs from what I have anecdotally observed in collaborative activities between Hong Kong and mainland China. In this context, sociopolitical circumstances have appeared to play a critical and sometimes dominant role in driving collaborative actions, at least before the enforcement of the National Security Law in 2020. For example, political parties in the Hong Kong legislature have framed current issues in ways that led to funding delays for collaborative projects. Similarly, legal action launched by an environmental group to press for more environmental impact analysis has postponed a collaborative project. The gap in the literature is not merely theoretical—that the current models lack explanatory power. More importantly, it indicates that contextual forces might be overlooked as the foundation that shapes or drives collaborative actions, and as the condition for collaborative capacity building. Failing to consider these contextual circumstances can lead to the lack of responses to them, putting the collaboration at risk of disruption or even complete collapse. Addressing the role played by contextual influences will not only contribute to a better theoretical explanation of collaborative actions, but will also help policymakers articulate policy actions during contextual uncertainties. Methodologically, I propose to collect data about major collaborative projects between Hong Kong and mainland China in several key policy areas: service delivery, transportation infrastructure development, environmental policy, and technology and innovation. The unit of analysis is “collaborative friction”— the resisting forces between partners during collaborations. This unique and innovative concept allows data collection of the collaborative process, thereby capturing detailed procedural and institutional variations. Complementary to project-level data, also collected, the friction-level data will allow conducting quantitative analysis with a large sample size. Together, the project-level and friction-level data should provide a complete picture of this issue. 目前已有大量研究關注協作行動（collaborative actions）的驅動因素。這些研究大多關注協作夥伴之間的互動以及由此形成的聯合協作能力，而協作行動的環境，包括當下的社會、經濟和政治背景，在一定程度上被學者們忽略了。在分析協作治理的一般性分析框架——協作治理機制（Collaborative Governance Regime，CGR)中，這些來自環境的影響因素被稱為系統情境（system context），一般僅對協作行動產生間接的、無關緊要的影響。根據CGR模型，協作行動的驅動力被理解為由原則性參與（principled engagement）和共享動機（shared motivation）建立的聯合協作能力，而系統情境往往不被視為影響協作行動的驅動因素（Emerson et al. 2012）。 然而，這種理解跟筆者在香港政府和內地地方政府的協作活動中所觀察到的事實有所不同。在2020年《國家安全法》實施之前，社會政治環境似乎在影響協作行動方面發揮了關鍵作用，有時甚至是主導作用。例如，在立法會中，政治團體可能會提出某些特別議題導致協作項目的資金延遲（比如關於國民教育在學校課程中的地位的辯論）。類似地，環保組織也可能會發起更多環境評估，進而推遲協作項目的開展。 文獻空白不僅僅是理論上的：這一反差表明的問題不僅是當前模型對協作行動的解釋力有限，更重要的是，作為形成並推動協作行動的基礎，系統情境的作用在協作實踐中被忽視了，傳統的協作行動相關文獻只是將系統情境視為協作能力建設的前置因素（conditions）。如果協作者缺乏對系統情境的考察，忽視對其適當響應，那麼協作將被置於中斷的風險中。理解系統情境扮演的重要角色不僅有助於從理論上更好地解釋協作行動，還將有助於政策制定者為應對系統情境不確定性（contextual uncertainties）做出必要的政策準備。 在研究方法上，本研究將收集香港政府與內地地方政府之間重大合作項目的數據，這些數據涵蓋多個政策領域，例如服務提供、基礎設施、環境保護以及技術創新等。研究的基本分析單元是 “協作摩擦（collaborative friction）”，即協作夥伴之間在協作行動過程中產生的阻力。基於這一創造性概念，本研究將收集協作過程層面的數據，從而捕捉詳細的程式性和制度性差異。作為對項目級數據的有益補充，協作摩擦層面的數據將有助於實現以較大樣本量進行定量分析。通過對這兩類數據的聯合分析，本研究將對研究問題提供較為全面完整的回答。

11606822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11606822.value: 法官的性別重要嗎？對中國涉家庭暴力離婚案件的實證研究

11606822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11606822.value: 儘管中國政府在2015年頒布了《反家庭暴力法》、針對家庭暴力行為採取了一系列的法律措施（例如強制報告、告誡、人身保護令、臨時庇護場所）以保護受害人，家庭暴力仍然是中國大陸一個嚴重的社會問題。 根據有關涉家暴離婚訴訟的數據顯示，法院對家暴受害者提出的離婚申請經常不予批准。目前的研究文獻也揭示，就法院判決涉家暴離婚問題的條文規定與法律實踐大相徑庭，不同法院對如何認定家庭暴力、及家暴行為是否足以證明夫妻感情確已破裂等法律問題亦存在較大分歧。由於91%涉家暴離婚案件中的原告為女性，涉家暴離婚訴訟即可被視為典型的女性問題。而法官在行使自由裁量權以決定是否批准離婚申請時，亦受到其自身對傳統家長制文化觀念和性別意識的影響。雖然部分地方法院正推行法律改革，由女性法官主導家事法庭以保障女性當事人在家事訴訟中的權利，但是女性法官在涉家暴離婚案件中行使自由裁量權時是否較少受到傳統家長制文化影響、是否具有較強的性別意識、是否更傾向於作出對女性當事人有利的判決尚未可知。目前還沒有實證研究來討論法官性別對涉家暴離婚案件審判的影響，而本研究旨在填補此研究空白。通過實證的數據分析和實驗性的虛擬情景分析，本項目將著重討論如下三個問題：（1）在涉家暴離婚案件審理中就批准離婚申請和判予損害賠償問題上，女性法官是否更傾向作出有利於女性當事人的判決？（2）就如何理解“家庭暴力行為”、如何認定證明家暴行為的證據、如何理解家暴行為與判決離婚的關聯性、是否認同家暴行為足以證明夫妻感情確已破裂等問題上，女性法官的判定是否有別於男性法官？（3）法官性別對涉家暴離婚案件審判的作用是否還受到法官其他個人因素（例如法官的年齡、婚姻狀況、審判經驗、職稱）和個案特性（例如離婚申請的次數、是否牽涉子女撫養問題、受害人的經濟狀況）的影響？本研究項目將就中國法官性別對涉家暴離婚案件審判的作用提供豐富的實證數據，並為影響法官是否批准家暴受害人離婚申請之關鍵因素的因果效應從法官性別差異的角度提供法社會學的分析。與此同時，本研究的發現將為由女性法官主導的家事法庭改革提供實證性意見、為立法者、法院、警方等利益持份者就如何通過訴訟合理協助家暴受害人找到婚姻出口提供建議。作為法官性別對中國民事審判影響的第一個研究，本項目也將對相關的國際學術討論貢獻中國經驗。

11607322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11607322.value: 基於違背預測機制的通用前額葉-感知皮層腦迴路:使用透顱磁力刺激和事件相關光學信號審視前注意監測

11607322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11607322.value: Dr WANG , Yang Dr XIAO, Xue-Zhen

11607322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11607322.value: The human brain is constantly monitoring the environment for unexpected changes without conscious awareness. For example, when we are fully engaged in work at a coffee shop, our brain can automatically detect environmental changes through different sensory modalities (e.g., the cry of a baby, the appearance of a waiter in the peripheral vision). A prediction violation mechanism based on the predictive brain principle has been proposed. Human brains automatically seek regularities embedded in the environment to establish prediction models for anticipating future events. A mismatch between an incoming event and the prediction elicits an error signal. When the deviation from the prediction is salient, the prediction error initiates a model updating process to improve future predictions and triggers remedial actions. We postulated a generic feedback mechanism involving a frontal-sensory-frontal cortical brain network. The early frontal cortex is responsible for non-modality-specific prediction model establishment and fitting process, the sensory cortices (e.g., superior temporal and occipital cortices; STC and OC) are responsible for modality-specific prediction error generation, while the late IFC is involved in non-modality-specific prediction model updating process. Our previous brain imaging studies consistently demonstrated similar frontotemporal and fronto-occipital cortical mismatch responses in pre-attentive auditory (Tse et al., 2006, 2008, 2013) and visual (Tse et al., 2021) change detection, respectively, with an optical brain imaging method, the Event-related Optical Signals (EROS). EROS measures the change in optical properties associated with neuronal brain responses and can localize cortical responses temporally and spatially in the millisecond and sub-centimeter range to unfold the brain activation sequences hypothesized by the prediction violation hypothesis. Our other studies (Tse et al., 2018; Xiao et al., 2020) combined a brain stimulation method, the Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) with EROS and demonstrated the causal connection from the early frontal to temporal cortex for prediction model establishment and fitting in the auditory modality. However, empirical works supporting the generic fronto-sensory cortical network underlying the prediction violation mechanism have not been completed. Previous studies have not investigated the causal STC-to-late IFC connection related to prediction model updating in auditory change detection; the existence of the causal early IFC-to-OC-to-late IFC connections in visual change detection remains unknown. Three experiments are proposed to investigate these causal functional connections with the TMS-EROS method to lay support for the generic fronto-sensory cortical network and the prediction violation mechanism in pre-attentive detection. 人類大腦一直在持續無意識地檢察環境中出現的超出預期的改變。例如，當我們全身心的在咖啡店投入工作的時候，我們的大腦自動的通過不同的感知覺來探測環境中的變化（例如嬰兒的哭聲，眼角餘光中出現的服務員）。之前的研究提出了基於大腦預測原則的預測違背機制。人類大腦自動尋找環境中存在的規律來建立對於未來事件的預測模型。預測和正在發生的事情不匹配的時候會引發錯誤信號。當顯著偏離預測的時候，預測錯誤會啟動大腦的模型自動更新過程來提高對未來的預測和引發對應的行為。我們提出一個通用的反饋機制包括前額葉-感知覺皮層-前額葉的腦迴路。早期的前額葉負責非特定感知覺的預測模型的建立和匹配過程，感知覺皮層（例如顳葉和枕葉）負責特定感知覺的預測錯誤信號的產生，晚期的前額葉參與非特定感知覺的預測模型的更新過程。我們以前的腦成像研究通過事件相關光學成像（EROS）持續的表現了相似的前額葉-顳葉和前額葉-枕葉的聽覺（Tse et al., 2006, 2008, 2013)和視覺的失匹配反應(Tse et al., 2021). EROS測量大腦神經反應相關的光學性質的改變，並且可以在時間和空間上以毫秒和釐米為單位的確定皮層的反應，從而揭示了違背預測假設提出的大腦激活順序。我們的其他研究(Tse et al., 2018; Xiao et al., 2020)結合腦刺激方法（經顱磁刺激）和EROS展示了早期前額葉到顳葉的鏈接在聽覺的預測模型建立中的作用。然而，基於違背預測機制的支持非特定感知覺的皮層腦迴路的研究還沒有。之前的研究沒有涉及基於違背預測機制的聽覺變化探測中的顳葉-晚期前額葉的鏈接。視覺變化探測中涉及的早期前額葉-枕葉-晚期前額葉的因果鏈接也不知道。我們提出了三個實驗通過TMS-EROS 結合的方法來檢驗支持非特定感知覺的前額葉-感知覺皮層的腦迴路以及前注意監測的違背預測機制。

11607522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11607522.value: 提升香港海事服務：關於海事強制措施包括船舶扣押和責任限製程序的批判性評估和優化

11607522.label: Project Objectives
11607522.value: Collect and analyse the in rem claims and the applications for limitation of liability filed at the Hong Kong Register. Identify the changes in the use of actions in rem over the period 1999-2019 for claims related to a) mortgages; b) shipping incidents and c) general commercial claims. Relate the observed changes in the usage of the admiralty jurisdiction of the Hong Kong’s courts with observed changes at global, regional and local scale, in the financial markets and in safety and legal practices. Examine the changes in the number of applications for limitation of liability filed and resolve whether these have operated as alternative, to ship arrest, security for claims which are subject to limited liability. Examine the relative attractiveness of the Hong Kong arrest system by comparing it with the corresponding systems in the Guangzhou Maritime Court and at Singapore, the regional competitors. This involves an analysis of the arrest actions in the Guangzhou Maritime Court and a comparative analysis of the legal and procedural framework. This includes a comparison of the ship arrest procedure in the context of underlying company and liquidation law arrangements. Examine the role alternative security in support of arbitration or by the establishment of a limitation of liability funds have in reducing ship arrest. Evaluate the role of arrest within the security provision framework and identify policy options for making Hong Kong more attractive to the maritime industry.

11607522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11607522.value: Hong Kong is the 4th largest ship register in tonnage and the 8th largest container port in the world (UNCTAD, 2020). Equipped with an efficient and mature ship arrest system available through, the action in rem, under the Admiralty jurisdiction of the Court of First Instance, it is also an important forum for claimants to obtain financial security for claims against shipowners through ship arrest. However only certain claims are entitled to an action in rem. Mortgage, collision damage, loss of life and personal injury, crew wages, cargo damage, and provisions and services to the ship claims are amongst the claims entitled to an action in rem. Arresting the ship prohibits the shipowner from using it until security is provided. For each claim only one ship can be arrested thus the claimant must decide when and where it will apply for ship arrest taking into account the efficiency and the procedural requirements for arrest at the various ports of call. Ports offering advantages to claimants take the lion’s share in ship arrests. Preliminary research in the Hong Kong’s Admiralty register has revealed that the number of the admiralty in rem claims has been reducing over time (Figure 1). It is unknown whether this reduction concerns all types of claims entitled to ship arrest and whether it expresses a general decline in Admiralty enforcement or is constrained to Hong Kong. The project will distinguish between the various categories of in rem claims and examine whether they are all in decline, thus answering the first question. The project will further research the reasons for the decline in admiralty proceedings by considering three potential factors. First, by taking into account the changes in the underlying financial, commercial and maritime safety parameters which affect the number of maritime claims and which may affect the number of in rem proceedings. Second, by undertaking a comparative analysis of the arrest system of Hong Kong with that of its regional competitors, namely Singapore and the Guangzhou Maritime Court. Third by examining how the provision of alternative security in the form of the establishment of a limitation of liability fund and also within the context of alternative dispute resolution, in particular arbitration, has affected ship arrest. The aim is to evaluate the current strengths of Hong Kong in balancing the interests of creditors and shipowners and suggest improvements to the legal maritime services including ship arrest.

11608122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11608122.value: 在世界貿易組織打官司還是不打官司？ WTO爭端引發決定因素的比較調查

11608122.label: Project Objectives
11608122.value: The project aims to fill a gap in the existing literature on WTO litigation. The scholarship on this theme has drawn conclusions based only on the cases that were actually filed before the WTO’s dispute settlement body. Such cases only form a tip of the iceberg. In fact, studies have indicated that a mere 10% of foreign trade barriers are challenged before the WTO. Such an approach has led to a misleading characterisation of trade interactions as conflictive when they are actually cooperative or, in certain cases, vice versa. More importantly, existing studies have been unable to shed light on the considerations that shape the decision of a Member to pursue a case before the WTO. The project aspires to fill this gap and examine the factors that play a role in a State’s decision to use the WTO DSM. The project will not only identify the highly visible disputes at the WTO but will also examine all of the cases that could have been filed at the WTO. To determine the number of cases that could have been pursued at the WTO, the entire spectrum of trade barriers that gave rise to potential disputes will be studied. Based on an in-depth study of the universe of all potential disputes arising from foreign trade barriers, the project aims to investigate the considerations that drive dispute initiation at the WTO. The project will construct a dataset that will contain data on both the potential and actual cases filed before the WTO by four prominent WTO members in the period between 2010 and 2020. Finally, the project will lay down the contributions that are made by State (e.g. trade policy officials) and non-State (e.g. representatives of interest groups, social movements, and thinks tanks) actors to the definition of the global trade policy agenda. This will be studied with the help of extensive and authentic data on non-disputes.
