11608122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11608122.value: The dispute settlement mechanism (DSM) adopted by the World Trade Organization (WTO) is rarely an effective tool of redressal. Driven by the profuse echoes of domestic producers and their aspirations to make a mark on and access foreign markets, States initiate trade disputes at the WTO. Much to their dismay, the majority of such disputes are not litigated, while the ones that are, are not litigated effectively. The project will examine the disputes initiated at the WTO as part of a larger universe consisting of potential cases that could have been pursued before the WTO but were never taken forward (“non-disputes”). The questions to consider herein are: what is the rationale behind the use of the WTO DSMs by States? How do States select which disputes to take to the WTO? What conditions stimulate the effective functioning of an international institution like the WTO? The project aims to adopt a neutral approach to overcome bias leading to methodological errors. The absence of a neutral approach in the past has led to incorrect inferences about sovereign interactions in international trade law, partial explanations of governments’ preferences vis-à-vis dispute initiation, and uninformed deliberations by stakeholders involved in the definition of the global trade policy agenda. Through comparative investigation, the research is conclusively able to analyse how the four key members of the WTO – China, the US, India, and the EU – choose to pursue WTO litigation by (1) constructing an original Global Trade Barriers Open Data Index (GTB-ODI) of the entire set of potential and actual WTO disputes concerning these WTO members in the 2010-2020 period and (2) assessing reasoning and explanations behind various hypotheses concerning governments’ decisions to initiate WTO disputes by adopting a sequential mixed method approach, which derives its roots from a combination of statistical analyses of the GTB-ODI and in-depth four case studies. Driven by the profuse echoes of domestic producers and their aspirations to make a mark on and access foreign markets, States initiate trade disputes at the WTO. Much to their dismay, the majority of such disputes are not litigated, while the ones that are, are not litigated effectively. The project will examine the disputes initiated at the WTO as part of a larger universe consisting of potential cases that could have been pursued before the WTO but were never taken forward (“non-disputes”). The questions to consider herein are: what is the rationale behind the use of the WTO DSMs by States? How do States select which disputes to take to the WTO? What conditions stimulate the effective functioning of an international institution like the WTO? 世界貿易組織（WTO）採用的爭端解決機制（DSM）很少是有效的補救工具。 在國內生產商的強烈呼聲和他們想要在國外市場留下印記和進入國外市場的願望的推動下，各國在 WTO 發起了貿易爭端。 令他們沮喪的是，大多數此類糾紛沒有被提起訴訟，而那些被提起訴訟的糾紛也沒有得到有效的訴訟。 該項目將審查在 WTO 發起的爭端，將其作為更大範圍的一部分，其中包括可能在 WTO 之前追究但從未提出過的潛在案件（“非爭端”）。 這裡要考慮的問題是：各國使用 WTO DSM 背後的基本原理是什麼？ 各國如何選擇將哪些爭端提交世貿組織？ 什麼樣的條件可以促進像 WTO 這樣的國際機構的有效運作？

11608722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11608722.value: 比較WELLFOCUS正向心理治療與提升敘事及認知能力療法

11608722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11608722.value: Dr Chiang, Chung Lim Vico Mr Chu, Hon Wai Prof Mo, Phoenix Kit-han Prof Wong, Daniel Fu Keung Prof Yanos, Philip

11608722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11608722.value: 根據香港食物及衛生局的資料，2017年香港約有45,000人被診斷出患有思覺失調。思覺失調是一種影響個人、家庭和社會的精神疾病。雖然現時已實施了一系列的醫療服務，但本港對促進思覺失調患者康復和身心健康的心理療法仍然有限。首席研究員已就優化WELLFOCUS正向心理治療 (PPT) 進行試點研究，證實它能有效促進中途宿舍內思覺失調患者的康復。在此基礎上，首席研究員計劃將另一種復康療法 ── 提升敘事及認知能力療法 (NECT)，應用於香港思覺失調患者的治療。因此，我們的研究目標是：（1）進一步調適並優化WELLFOCUS PPT和NECT於本地中途宿舍思覺失調患者的應用，（2）比較優化WELLFOCUS PPT和NECT在改善思覺失調患者的自我效能、自我標籤、強項運用、康復、意義建構、症狀緩和以及身心健康方面的效用，（3）了解這兩種治療的介入過程和機制。 研究採用序列探索型混合設計 (QUAN-QUAL)。量性研究方面，採用隨機候補對照設計。我們從十五所中途宿舍招募 198名思覺失調患者。其中五所中途宿舍將被隨機分配到試驗組1接受優化WELLFOCUS PPT，另外五所中途宿舍到試驗組 2接受 NECT ，而其餘五所到試驗組 3（接受常規治療的候補名單對照組）。我們將在每所中途宿舍舉辦兩個小組，每組包括7名思覺失調患者。優化WELLFOCUS PPT和NECT的調適將基於專家評審和試點研究結果。每項介入措施將於一年中的不同時期實施，並分别持續大约五個月。我們將在介入前（T1）、介入後（T2）和完成介入後六個月（T3）邀請參加者填寫相同的問卷。並將採用多層次迴歸分析法對比即時和持續效果。質性研究方面，我們將進行半結構訪談以了解參與者在接受介入期間的經歷，特別是探討促使他們透過介入受益的因素。解釋現象分析法將用於指導訪談及其分析。 本項研究融合了先進的心理治療介入措施，以促進思覺失調患者的身心健康和康復，並豐富對思覺失調患者的現有療法。這是一項以實證為基礎的研究，將為強化介入提供實證數據，並為潛在的變化機制和未來的模型構建提供啟示。本研究將促進治療方向的轉變，從以問題為中心和藥物導向，過渡到著重思覺失調患者的康復和身心健康並以個人強項為基礎的正向心理治療導向。經過驗證的介入措施可以作為常規活動納入中途宿舍和醫院，以促進思覺失調患者的康復。研究團隊會向其他學者、學生、社工、職業治療師和護士傳遞知識和技能，以用於幫助思覺失調患者。隨著思覺失調患者的病情改善和康復，醫院和中途宿舍便可以騰出更多的位置給輪候者，長遠而言更可降低醫療和福利開支。透過介入有效性的證據逐步累積，我們可以敦促政府推行對思覺失調患者的心理治療介入，以補充和強化藥物療法，從而為醫療保健政策的改變作出貢獻。介入的手冊將上載到網站作本地和國際宣傳，使全球思覺失調患者受惠。我們亦將建立一個全球平台，就不同的精神健康介入措施進行國際性的分享和交流。

11610022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11610022.value: 根據香港政府統計處2019年的資料顯示，香港65歲及以上的老年人口比例將從2019年的17.6%增加到2038年的30%。因此在未來的二十年裡，老年人對財務和醫療資源的需求將會翻倍。在香港暫未推行全民退休保障的情況下，退休人士需要維持其財務水平和個人資源狀況平穩，才能跟得上因壽命延長而導致的成本上升。隨著預期壽命的延長，部份人士意識到了退休準備的必要性，但只有極少數人真正付諸實行。最近一項關於香港退休人士的長期追蹤研究發現，44.4%的準退休人士 (即於6個月內退休) 並沒有額外為自己的退休生活儲錢（Yeung & Zhou, 2017）。與有準備的準退休人士相比，未做準備的人士將面臨更多的退休適應和心理健康的風險。這些趨勢表明，許多香港人可能會在老年階段陷入第一次財困。本研究旨在辨識有效的方法來鼓勵青年（18-39歲）和中年（40-64歲）的香港在職人士規劃自己的退休生活。 這個項目將包括三個部分。第一部分是一個實驗研究，旨在研究參與者接觸年長的未來自我後對其退休儲蓄分配的影響。第二部分是為期5天的日記研究，旨在利用5天的寫作任務來延長第一部分測試對參與者未來自我的連續性操控的效果。在實驗環節結束後的兩週後，將評估有參與寫作任務及沒有參與寫作任務的參與者在退休儲蓄和其他退休準備活動之間的差異。第三部分將評估未來自我對各領域退休準備在6個月後的影響。 此研究有望在以下三個方面推進退休規劃的學術及應用範疇之發展。首先，此研究將目前關於退休準備的工作延伸到非財務領域，例如心理和社會方面的準備。第二，此研究通過減低由接觸年老的未來自我時所產生的潛在負面反應，以改良實驗程序。第三，此研究將會闡明為期5天寫作任務對於延長有關退休準備的未來自我連續性在短期和中期（分別為2週和6個月）的影響下的實驗性效果。

11611422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11611422.value: The ongoing climate change has devastating impacts on wildlife and humankind. Among the most critical drivers of the current environmental crisis are the growing demands associated with contemporary urban lifestyles, with cities being responsible for about three-quarters of all energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. In Asia, one of the fastest urbanizing regions globally, populations adopting consumeristic lifestyles are increasing the depletion of natural resources at unprecedented levels. In this geographic context, the by-product of an unbridled expansion of mega-urban agglomerations is a patchwork occupation of peri-urban zones, which shape confined islands of development and consumption in an ocean of dross. Concurrently, the coronavirus pandemic has massively impacted the mental health of socially alienated urban inhabitants with limited access to natural resources. Responding to concomitant challenges of climate change, increased urbanizations and an ongoing health crisis, urbanists in Europe, America and Asia have recently conceptualized the Horizontal Metropolis Model: a form of dwelling emerging at the interlink of urban infrastructures and bioregional ecologies, blurring canonical distinctions between the city and the countryside. The Horizontal Metropolis provides job opportunities in the industrial and service sectors while ensuring inhabitants can also access nature. These proximities foster agricultural activities, drastically reduce food miles, and facilitate social interaction and community engagement. More than simply a conceptual model, the Horizontal Metropolis has developed into an analytical and research-by-design protocol, providing a framework for achieving environmental stewardship, place attachment and a sense of belonging. This project explores whether the Horizontal Metropolis Model can help improve the wellbeing of residents in Hong Kong, a region at the epicentre of intense spatial transformations. For that exploration, the project examines two revelatory cases selected from Hong Kong’s New Territories: the middle course of Sheung Yue River in the North District and Shap Pat Heung, Yuen Long District. The project will adopt a mixed-method approach that integrates the following: (1) morphological analysis of the historical transformation of peri-urban settlements; (2) systematic investigation of the condition of peri-urban agriculture in Hong Kong's New Territories; and (3) research-by-design exploration on the shaping of community-based, participatory and interdisciplinary design strategies for socially engaged, environmentally sensitive and culturally literate forms of (peri-) urbanization. This research will act as a catalyst for an international scholarly debate on the Horizontal Metropolis. Detailed estimates of prospect allocation of population, jobs, facilities and infrastructures will offer crucial policy insights, explicitly addressing the “Northern Metropolis” blueprint. 正在發生的氣候變化對野生動物和人類產生了毀滅性的影響。 考慮到四分之三的能源消耗和溫室氣體排放發生在城市，那麼在導致目前環境危機的最關鍵的因素中，與當代都市生活方式密切相關的需求增長則是重中之重。 亞洲是全球城市化速度最快的區域之一，採用消費主義生活方式的人口正在以前所未有的速度消耗自然資源。 在這個地理背景下，超大城市群無節制擴張產生的副產品是對城郊地區的拼縫式佔領，如同浮渣漂泥的海洋中形成一個個封閉的發展和消費島嶼。 同時，新冠病毒大流行極大地影響了城市居民的心理健康，尤其是那些生活在社會邊緣、自然資源匱乏的居民。 為了應對氣候變化以及城市化加劇帶來的持續健康危機，歐洲、美洲和亞洲的城市學家們最近提出了“水平都市模型”的概念：一種在城市基礎設施和生物區域生態的相互聯繫中出現的居住形式，這種形式模糊了城市和鄉村之間的典型差異。 水平都市不僅能夠給工業和服務業部門提供就業機會，還能確保居民有機會接近大自然。 對大自然的親近進一步推動農業活動、大大降低食物里程、並促進社會互動和社區參與。 因此，水平都市不僅僅是一個簡單的概念模型，它已經發展成為分析和設計研究的協議，為實現環境管理、場所依賴和歸屬感提供了一個框架。 本研究旨在探討水平都市模型是否有助於改善處於空間轉型中心的香港居民的福利。 具體來講，本研究關注兩個香港新界區內具有啟示意義的案例：北部區的雙魚河中游和元朗區十八鄉。 我們將採用混合研究方法來整合以下內容：（1）對香港新界城郊地區居民點的歷史轉變進行形態分析; （2）對香港新界城郊地區的農業進行系統調研; 以及（3）通過設計研究，探索如何塑造以社區為基礎的，參與性的和跨學科的設計策略，以實現具有社會參與的、環境敏感的和文化素養的（城郊）城市化形態。 本研究旨在成為國際學術界關於水平都市討論的催化劑。 研究中對人口、工作、設施和基礎設施的分配設想的詳細估計將提供重要的政策見解，用以充分明確地處理“北部都會區”的策略藍圖。

12101022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12101022.value: 自噬溶酶體途徑損傷在柏金遜症中的機制研究：HMGB1-TFEB相互作用的新應用以及中藥化合物的潛在治療作用

12101022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12101022.value: Dr Medina, Diego Luis Prof Song , Juxian

12101022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12101022.value: 柏金遜症（Parkinson’s disease, PD）是最常見的運動障礙相關神經退行性疾病，影響著全球約有700萬到1000萬PD患者。PD的主要病理特征是中腦多巴胺能神經元的進行性喪失和異常蛋白質聚集體（包括α-突觸核蛋白（α-synuclein, SNCA））的積累。不幸的是，目前治療PD的藥物只能補充多巴胺水平，但不能阻止疾病的進展。 自噬溶酶體途徑（autophagy-lysosomal pathway, ALP）是一種降解蛋白質聚集體和受損細胞器高度保守的細胞機制。轉錄因子EB（TFEB）和高遷移率族蛋白B1（high mobility group protein 1, HMGB1）是ALP的兩個正向調節因子，在PD患者的多巴胺能神經元的細胞核中觀察到TFEB和HMGB1水平降低。我們和其他研究人員之前已經證明了SNCA和引起PD的神經毒素如何通過負向調控TFEB或HMGB1來抑制ALP。更重要的是，我們從中藥中發現了一些天然化合物或其衍生物，它們可以靶向調節HMGB1或TFEB以促進ALP，從而減輕動物模型中的PD病理進程。隨後，我們提出了一個科學假設：是否激活HMGB1和TFEB能夠進行潛在的PD治療？在我們的初步研究中發現：1）HMGB1和TFEB在體外和體內生理上相互作用；2）小分子TFEB激活劑促進TFEB與細胞核中HMGB1的結合；3）HMGB1和TFEB相互依賴地調節自噬和溶酶體的生物合成；4）野生型（wild-type, WT）和突變型A53T的SNCA與HMGB1和TFEB結合；5）過表達的SNCA抑制HMGB1-TFEB相互作用。基於這些新數據，我們假設多巴胺能神經元中的HMGB1-TFEB相互作用缺陷會導致PD中ALP損傷和有毒蛋白聚集體的積累，而靶向HMGB1和TFEB的中藥化合物組合可能對PD具有更好的治療前景。 在本項目中，我們將通過實現三個研究目標來檢驗這一假設：（1）驗證HMGB1是否是TFEB的轉錄共激活因子；（2）剖析HMGB1-TFEB相互作用在體外和體內過表達SNCA和神經毒素MPTP誘導的ALP損傷中的作用；（3）評價同時靶向HMGB1和TFEB的中藥化合物組合在PD動物模型中的神經保護作用。本研究成果將提升我們對HMGB1-TFEB複合體在ALP中調控機制的認識，揭示其在PD發病機理中的關鍵作用，更重要的是為靶向調節HMGB1-TFEB複合體的PD治療提供合理的藥物研發策略。

12101222.value: 晚期黑色素瘤是最致命的癌症之一。大約一半的黑色素瘤患者攜帶BRAF（V600E）突變。用選擇性BRAF(V600E)抑制劑（BRAFi），如維羅非尼，治療BRAF（V600E）突變的黑色素瘤有很好的效果，但是大部分患者8個月內產生耐藥。已證實MEKi（絲裂原活化蛋白激酶激酶抑制劑）單用或與 ICB（免疫檢查點阻斷抗體）聯用可以延緩 BRAFi 耐藥出現，但患者仍會在 15 個月內耐藥。一些小分子化合物已被測試用於治療BRAFi耐藥腫瘤，然而，不幸的是，由於它們引起的嚴重不良反應，臨床結果沒能得到改善。多靶點、低毒性的中藥化合物在抗耐藥方面具有優勢。通過篩選，我們發現雙氫青蒿素（DHA，一種獲批的抗瘧疾藥物，青蒿素的活性代謝物）可降低獲得性維羅非尼耐藥黑色素瘤細胞A375- VR和Colo829- VR的存活率，並誘導細胞凋亡。重要的是，DHA的預防性給藥可顯著抑制小鼠A375-VR腫瘤的生長，而不影響小鼠體重。並且，DHA能延長荷A375-VR黑色素瘤小鼠的生存期。RNA-seq 分析顯示，A375- VR細胞中的癌基因FLI1（Friend白血病病毒整合基因1）的mRNA水平比在不耐藥的A375黑色素瘤細胞中高，而DHA消除了伴隨耐藥的FLI1上調。我們還發現，與A375細胞相比，多個FLI1下游基因的mRNA水平在A375- VR細胞中發生了改變，而DHA逆轉了大部分基因的改變。並且，DHA能夠下調A375-VR細胞和小鼠A375-VR異種移植瘤中FLI1的蛋白水平。據報導，FLI1 在 BRAFi 耐藥黑色素瘤細胞中上調； 並且沉默 FLI1 能夠減緩維羅非尼耐藥黑色素瘤細胞的生長。因此，我們假設DHA通過抑制FLI1表達來克服黑色素瘤對維羅非尼的耐藥。本研究的目的如下。 1) 在荷黑色素瘤小鼠模型上研究DHA克服維羅非尼耐藥的作用，並監測DHA的毒性; 2) 建立FLI1在DHA克服黑色素瘤細胞對維羅非尼耐藥中的角色; 和 3) 確定DHA是否能克服黑色素瘤細胞對其它BRAF(V600E)靶向治療藥物耐藥。 本研究將首次證明DHA通過，至少部分通過，抑制BRAF(V600E)突變型黑色素瘤中的FLI1表達以克服維羅非尼耐藥。這一貢獻將是重要的，因為它是系統研究的一個步驟，它將促進開發DHA和其它可能的FLI1抑制劑作為治療BRAFi耐藥黑色素瘤的輔助藥物。 1) 在荷黑色素瘤小鼠模型上研究DHA克服維羅非尼耐藥的作用，並監測DHA的毒性; 2) 建立FLI1在DHA克服黑色素瘤細胞對維羅非尼耐藥中的角色; 和 3) 確定DHA是否能克服黑色素瘤細胞對其它BRAF(V600E)靶向治療藥物耐藥。 本研究將首次證明DHA通過，至少部分通過，抑制BRAF(V600E)突變型黑色素瘤中的FLI1表達以克服維羅非尼耐藥。這一貢獻將是重要的，因為它是系統研究的一個步驟，它將促進開發DHA和其它可能的FLI1抑制劑作為治療BRAFi耐藥黑色素瘤的輔助藥物。

12101322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12101322.value: 黃芪多糖經口服進入PP結後保護骨髓作用中的關鍵角色

12101322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12101322.value: 已知黃芪多糖具有保護骨髓、血細胞和造血幹細胞的作用，但是因為黃芪多糖不吸收、不消化，所以相關的作用機制尚不明暸。 前期研究發現黃芪多糖RAP口服後可以在小腸經M細胞轉運快速進入PP結，並引起較強烈的免疫反應。這一轉運通路在人體上也得到了證實，並發現GP2為關鍵的介導受體。但是還不知道，RAP如何影響遠距離的骨髓和造血幹細胞。 初步研究在骨髓中發現了RAP的螢光信號，提示RAP可能在PP結激活了某些免疫細胞，被轉運到了骨髓，直接作用於造血幹細胞。這些特殊的免疫細胞可能在黃芪多糖保護骨髓作用中扮演了關鍵角色。為了驗證此假說，本項目計劃： 1.確認RAP在PP結中激活的抗原呈遞細胞，及相關作用機理； 2.確認該細胞是否轉運RAP到了骨髓； 3. 確定RAP或被激活的免疫細胞影響造血幹細胞的作用機理。 本項目的預期結果將有助於揭示口服多糖影響免疫系統的作用機制，促進多糖相關新藥的研發。

12101722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12101722.value: OsABA8ox2基因調控水稻幼苗形態建成和籽粒灌漿中的作用

12101722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12101722.value: 幼苗形態建成和籽粒灌漿是水稻生命週期中兩個重要的過程，前者為水稻冠層的快速建立提供了堅實的基礎，後者則是水稻產量形成的關鍵階段。前期大量的研究證明了脫落酸（ABA）在這兩個生物學過程中起著關鍵作用，並對其生理機制做了詳細的解析。脫落酸在植物中的含量由其生物合成和降解之間的拮抗作用共同決定。然而前期的許多研究均集中在ABA生物合成和信號通路的生物學功能上，對於ABA降解過程的生物學功能和作用機制研究不多，尤其是在幼苗形態建成和籽粒灌漿這兩個生物過程中ABA降解所起的作用及其分子機制極少有間報道。 我們在前期研究中鑒定到一個脫落酸降解基因OsABA8ox2, 該基因在調控水稻幼苗建成和籽粒灌漿上具有多效性。過表達OsABA8ox2基因(OsABA8ox2OE)可抑制水稻幼苗建成和籽粒灌漿，而利用CRISPR/Cas9技術敲除該基因(OsABA8ox2KO)則可在不影響幼苗建成的情況下顯著提高水稻弱勢粒的灌漿。施加外源脫落酸或者過氧化氫可恢復OsABA8ox2OE株係根的生長，而OsABA8ox2KO株係則對脫落酸表現出極度敏感的表型。有趣的是，提高或者抑制脫落酸合成或降解的其他基因，如OsNCED3或OsABA8ox3，均沒有出現以上表型，說明OsABA8ox2基因在這兩個生物學過程中起著獨特的功能。 基於此，本項目將利用植物分子生物學方法及反向遺傳學技術等手段揭示OsABA8ox2基因及其他相關基因調控幼苗建成和籽粒灌漿過程中脫落酸含量的分子機理，同時深入研究OsABA8ox2調控幼苗建成及籽粒灌漿的分子機制。此外我們還希望通過基因編輯技術對現有優良水稻品種進行改良以創造具有更高灌漿效率的新種質。本項目的研究結果將加深我們對植物激素調控水稻生長發育相關規律的認知，為提高水稻產量的栽培和育種技術提供基因資源和遺傳材料。

12102022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12102022.value: 擬南芥帶NAD端帽的RNA可能調控與能量代謝有關的基因的表達

12102022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12102022.value: RNA modifications play a critical role in controlling gene expression. In eukaryotic cells, one of the best-known RNA modifications is addition of the methylated guanosine (m7G) cap to the 5′ end of an mRNA molecule. In recent years, some RNA molecules in prokaryotes and eukaryotes have been found to contain a non-canonical cap, such as the NAD cap, indicating additional complexity in gene regulation through RNA capping. However, the role of the NAD cap remains elusive. NAD is a vital molecule in energy metabolism, and it is conceivable that NAD capping is influenced by cellular energy status and might in turn mediate gene expression to rewire energy metabolism. We have developed multiple methods to identify and characterize NAD-capped RNAs (NAD-RNAs) in Arabidopsis and other organisms. Using our newly developed methods, we have found that NAD-capped RNAs are widespread in bacteria; while in eukaryotes, NAD-RNAs are produced mainly from genes involved in energy metabolism. Our recent findings suggest that NAD-RNAs most likely act as regulatory RNAs. In this proposal, we will use methods developed in our lab to understand the effect of energy status on production of NAD-RNAs in Arabidopsis and to define a possible role of NAD capping in regulating expression of genes involved in energy metabolism. Our study will address a new layer of regulation in energy metabolism and advance the new field of NAD-RNA biology. RNA修飾對調控基因表達起著關鍵作用。在真核細胞中，研究最清楚的一類RNA修飾是在信使RNA (mRNA) 分子的5’ 端添加甲基鳥苷 (m7G)。最近的研究發現一些RNA分子含有其它帽子結構，比如煙酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸 (NAD) 帽子，提示通過RNA加帽來調控基因表達有著更加複雜的模式。目前對於NAD帽子的功能尚不清楚。 NAD是能量代謝中關鍵的分子。所以NAD加帽過程可能受細胞的能量狀態影響，NAD加帽可能會反過來影響能量与代謝相关的基因表達。 我們已開發多個用於在擬南芥和其他物種中鑑定和分析帶NAD帽子的RNA (NAD-RNA) 的方法。我們發現NAD-RNA在細菌中廣泛存在, 但在擬南芥中NAD-RNA主要產生於參與能量代謝的基因。我們的研究發現提示NAD-RNA很有可能起調控作用。在此項目中，我門將用開發的方法來研究細胞能量狀態對NAD-RNA產生的影響，以及NAD加帽對調控能量代謝相關基因表達的可能作用。我們的研究將探索一種新的能量代謝的調節方式，推動NAD-RNA生物學領域的發展。

12102222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12102222.value: 貝殼 DNA 作為深海蛤蜊的系統發育、種群遺傳學和共生關係的檔案

12102222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12102222.value: Dr Chen, Chong Dr Little, Crispin

12102222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12102222.value: The low temperature deep-sea environment is assumed to be ideal for preservation of DNA, but this hypothesis has not been critically tested. Using deep-sea vesicomyid clams that are known to rely on their endosymbiotic bacteria for nutrition, we propose to test this hypothesis through a study of the shell DNA involving radioisotope dating to determine their age and high-throughput metagenomic analysis of the host clams and their endosymbionts. We will use current and subfossil shells to streamline a workflow of DNA extraction and data analysis including assessment of DNA yield and damage, species identification based on DNA marker genes, and phylogenetic analysis to determine their relationships with other vesicomyid clams and their symbionts. We will also assess the temporal changes in clam population genetics by comparing current and subfossil shells. Furthermore, we aim to determine the phylogenetic position of both the clam host and endosymbiont for a species of vesicomyid known only from subfossil shells. Overall, our study is the first to explore the use of deep-sea molluscan shells as DNA archives for population genetics, phylogenetics, symbiosis, and palaeogenomics, and contributes to our understanding of deep-sea species diversity and genetic diversity – one of the key objectives of United Nations Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development (2021-2030). It also allows us to test the hypothesis that deep-sea environments preserve shell DNA better than shallow-water environments. 低溫深海環境被認為是保存 DNA 的理想環境，但這一假設尚未經過嚴格檢驗。使用已知依賴其內共生細菌獲取營養的深海 蛤蜊，我們建議通過對涉及放射性同位素測年的殼 DNA 的研究來檢驗這一假設。我們將使用現代和亞化石殼來簡化 DNA 提取和資料分析的工作流程，包括評估 DNA 產量和損傷、基於 DNA 標記基因的物種鑒定以及系統發育分析，以確定它們與其他蛤蜊及其共生體的系統發育關係。我們還將通過比較現代和亞化石殼來評估蛤種群遺傳學的時間變化。此外，我們旨在的一種的蛤的亞化石殼確定其宿主和內共生體的系統發育位置。總體而言，我們的研究將首次探索深海軟體動物貝殼作為種群遺傳學、系統發育學、共生學和古基因組學DNA 檔案的可行性，其結果有助於我們瞭解深海物種多樣性和遺傳多樣性這一聯合國海洋科學促進可持續發展關鍵的十年（2021-2030）目標。它還將使我們能夠檢驗深海環境比淺水環境更好地保存貝殼 DNA這一科學假設。

12102322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12102322.value: DKK1 N結構域與Linker 2之間的相互作用在調節DKK1 C結構域介導的免疫抑制性腫瘤微環境中的作用

12102322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12102322.value: Prof Li, Peng Prof ZHANG, Ge

12102322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12102322.value: 免疫抑制性腫瘤微環境(TME)是癌症免疫治療的關鍵屏障，是導致免疫檢查點抑製劑無效的可能原因之一。髓源性抑制細胞 (MDSCs) 可以抑制 TME 中的 T 細胞反應並促進腫瘤增殖。 β-連環蛋白的下調對於免疫抑制 TME 中的MDSCs積累至關重要。 Dickkopf-1 (DKK1) 可以下調 MDSCs 中的β-連環蛋白並促進免疫抑制性 TME形成。 DKK1 的表達水平與 MDSCs 的數量呈顯著正相關，與各種癌症中 CD8+ T 細胞的浸潤水平呈負相關。 DKK1 的高表達也與多種癌症的惡化和無疾病存活期短有關，因此DKK1是癌症免疫治療中的靶點之一。在臨床試驗中，利用靶向 DKK1 C 端結構域的治療性抗體來實現對DKK1的抑制，該抗體在與免疫檢查點抑製劑（PD-1 抗體）的聯合治療中表現出疊加的療效，但在單一藥物治療中則作用有限。因此，了解DKK1在調節免疫抑制性TME中的作用機制，將有助於開發下一代DKK1抑製劑，並優化腫瘤免疫治療的效果。 DKK1中有5個結構域，包括信號序列、Linker 1、N端結構域、Linker 2和C端結構域。據報導，DKK1 的 C端結構域可以與 LRP6 結合，下調 MDSCs中的 β-連環蛋白並調節免疫抑制性 TME。為了進一步驗證 C 端結構域的作用，我們開發了一種靶向 DKK1 C 端結構域的 DNA 適配子 (AptDKK1-C) ，作為研究 DKK1 C 端結構域作用的藥理學工具。我們發現 AptDKK1-C 可以減少 MDSCs的積累並抑制體內腫瘤生長，但其療效有待進一步提高。據報導，DKK1的N端結構域可以和C端結構域競爭與LRP6結合。通過分子建模，我們發現Linker 2 與N 之間可能存在相互作用，因而影響N 和C 之間的相互作用。基於以上數據，我們推測N端結構域和Linker 2之間的相互作用可以促進C端結構域與LRP6的結合，從而增強DKK1 C端結構域介導的免疫抑制性TME。在前期研究中，我們通過遺傳學方法，發現利用基因突變去除 Linker 2 可以增強 AptDKK1-C 在體外抑制 DKK1 與 LRP6 結合和恢復MDSCs 中 β-連環蛋白表達的作用。為了使用藥理學方法去進一步研究 Linker 2 和 N 端結構域之間相互作用的作用，我們篩選並選擇了靶向 Linker 2的 DNA 適配子(AptDKK1-L2)來作為藥理學工具。我們發現聯合使用 AptDKK1-L2 和 AptDKK1-C可以在體外協同抑制 DKK1與 LRP6結合併恢復MDSCs中β-catenin的表達。更重要的是，AptDKK1-L2可以減少黑色素瘤 (B16) 腫瘤小鼠模型體內中 MDSCs積累和腫瘤生長。在本研究中，我們將進一步在體內驗證上述假設，包括使用 AptDKK1-L2 作為藥理學工具去阻斷 DKK1 的 N 端結構域與 Linker 2 之間的相互作用，並使用 AptDKK1-C 去抑制 C 端結合域和 LRP6的結合。該研究將有助於開發下一代DKK1抑製劑，達到對免疫抑制性TME的優化抑制效果。

At the optimal dose, mCRP could get the highest binding to AptmCRP3 and the greatest inhibition of TRAP5b expression. (2) Confirming the optimal dosing interval of the mCRP aptamer AptmCRP3 in Leflunomide hyporesponsive CIA rats. Within the optimal dosing interval, AptmCRP3 can effectively bound mCRP and inhibit TRAP5b expression.

2. Objective 2 is to examine the effects of AptmCRP3 monotherapy and the combination of AptmCRP3 with Leflunomide in the CRPhigh CIA rats: Previously, we found that CRP siRNA monotherapy partially attenuated bone erosion when compared to a non-sense siRNA. When combined with Leflunomide, CRP silencing compensated the limited efficacy of Leflunomide in attenuating bone erosion in the CRPhigh CIA rats. Mechanically, dissociation of nCRP to mCRP increase the level of free mCRP, and these free mCRP play a functional role in inducing osteoclastic differentiation and bone destruction. We speculate that pharmacological blockage of mCRP by a single-stranded oligonucleotide (AptmCRP3) may mimic the therapeutic effects of CRP silencing in the CRPhigh CIA rats and be more suitable for developing future treatment strategies in RA patients. We expect that AptmCRP3 monotherapy would partially attenuate bone erosion when compared to vehicle in the CRPhigh CIA rats. When combined with Leflunomide, AptmCRP3 would compensate the limited efficacy of Leflunomide, leading to adequate attenuation of bone erosion in the CRPhigh CIA rats.

3. Objective 3 is to test the toxicity of AptmCRP3 monotherapy and the combination of AptmCRP3 with Leflunomide in the CRPhigh CIA rats: To date, no study reveals the toxicity of AptmCRP3 in preclinical studies or clinical treatment of RA. In this objective, we will examine the toxicity of AptmCRP3 monotherapy or a combination of Leflunomide with AptmCRP3 in the CRPhigh CIA rats. We expect that AptmCRP3 monotherapy or combination of Leflunomide with AptmCRP3 would have no obvious effects on the examined hematology and biochemistry parameters when compared to Leflunomide monotherapy.

12200022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12200022.value: 當學習索引遇到區塊鏈：設計、算法和性能評估

12200022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12200022.value: 近年來，區塊鏈技術已用於越來越多的中心化應用。它讓互不信任的對等方能夠共同維護可驗證的分佈式數據庫。但是，為了保持數據完整性和支持數據溯源，每個區塊鏈節點都必須存儲和維護整個賬本狀態，這會產生高昂的存儲成本並延長數據搜索時間。本項目旨在探索新興的學習索引技術以優化區塊鏈系統性能。最近對學習索引的研究表明，它們相對於 B+-tree 和 R-tree 等傳統索引具有優勢。其核心思想是用學習模型替換每個索引節點中的定向鍵，以提高搜索效率並減少存儲開銷。但是，由於以下挑戰，我們不能將現有的學習索引直接應用於區塊鏈系統。首先，現有的學習索引不支持區塊鏈系統所需的數據認證和溯源。其次，區塊鏈使用長哈希字符串作為索引鍵，這與現有學習索引所考慮的數字鍵不同。第三，現有的學習索引專注於讀優化的內存數據庫，而區塊鏈系統具有頻繁狀態更新和磁盤存儲等特性。為了應對這些挑戰，本項目提出一種用於區塊鏈系統的新型Merkle 學習索引，並將使用真實世界的區塊鏈工作負載評估其性能，以證明所提出解決方案的實用性。

12202422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12202422.value: 一種同時實現仿生表面的形貌功能和多重穩定性的材料設計策略

12202422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12202422.value: Prof Pugno, Nicola M. Prof Wang, Zuankai

12202422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12202422.value: 仿生表面的相關研究一直是物理學和材料科學中各種新理論的源泉。當材料的表面具有某些的特徵結構時，它可以實現自潔、防冰、抗菌、減阻、集水、油水分離、無動力液體輸送、傳熱改善和海水淡化等功能。儘管製造功能表面的方法層出不窮，但業界仍缺乏製造在實際應用中可以長效保持功能的仿生表面的方法。通常，仿生表面功能性是由表面特定的三維形貌和材料性質決定的。然而，製造和使用過程中的應力、異物污染以及材料老化都會使得仿生表面特性發生改變從而喪失功能。有些研究工作在追求拒水材料的穩健性方面取得了一定進展，但都不可避免地犧牲了結構自由度，從而使得仿生功能高度受限。迄今為止，同時實現多功能表面形貌和的耐用性仍然是一個未解決的問題。本研究旨在為解決這個問題提供一些新思路。 在此我們提出，至少有一種可行方法來製造穩定耐用的仿生表面，使得表面的魯棒性和由形貌帶來的功能性之間不會衝突，且這一方法適用於已報道過的的大多數仿生表面幾何形狀。為了在不犧牲形貌自由度的情況下實現材料的耐用性，我們提出使用整塊連續的惰性材料來製作仿生表面，並為此開發了一種新型微加工方法。一方面，由於材料的固有惰性，該表面對熱、光、化學品、老化以及剝脫具有出色的抵抗力；另一方面，基於理論建模和實驗研究，我們初步發現了一個幾何準則，該準則賦予單級柱結構出色的機械強度，這與前人研究的普遍假設不同。此外，在遭受外力破壞時，表面結構雖會發生非彈性形變但仍可維持原有的功能性，這與“非彈性變形會導致材料失效“的普遍假設不同。在初步工作中，我們已經創建了三個示例，在 Teflon 表面上進行精細 3D 結構的構造，其功能和魯棒性均同之前的報道持平甚至超過。據我們所知，這是第一個同時實現定制功能性表面微結構和多重穩定性的方法。在這個項目中，我們將對其原理展開系統研究，並將這一方法充分發展為製作仿生表面的通用方法。憑藉共存的穩定性和功能性，我們預計大量研究人員將改變他們對仿生表面的基本認知，並尋找其他創造創新功能材料和實施仿生技術的可能性。

12203122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12203122.value: 復雜數據學習：基於互信息的深度學習 (MIGDL) 框架

12203122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12203122.value: The goal of this project is to design, analyze, and demonstrate a Mutual-Information-Guided Deep Learning (MIGDL) Framework. This novel framework aims to systematically address the fundamental challenges of modeling and prediction with complex data, i.e., learning capacity characterization, feature adaptation, and model adaptation. The rapid development of deep learning has offered a scientifically grounded solution to various problems in data analytics. Nevertheless, the design of deep learning methods for real-world applications remains a fundamental challenge. This challenge is encapsulated in the questions of: (i) How a deep model's learning capacity with respect to a specific learning task and dataset can be quantitatively characterized, such that the most appropriate model can be designed; (ii) How a deep learning model's current structure and learning performance can be used to decide what must be further acquired from the data; and (iii) How a deep learning model based on the existing structure can be adapted to enable the information in further acquired data to be most effectively extracted and utilized. To answer these questions, we will develop a MIGDL framework to characterize the behaviors of deep learning models via mutual information. The MIGDL framework will comprise the following three important and interrelated components: (1) A Capacity characterization module (C-Module) to analytically characterize and quantitatively describe the capacity of a learning model to extract useful information from data, given a learning target; (2) A Feature adaptation module (F-Module) to determine what kind(s) of data must be further acquired to effectively complement the extracted/learned information, with respect to the learning target; and (3) A Model adaptation module (M-Module) to determine which part(s) of the existing model must be further adapted to make the optimal use of the data newly acquired by the F-Module, corresponding to the learning target. The analytical validation of the properties and the empirical evaluation of the performance of our MIGDL framework will contribute to fundamental developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning. More importantly, this project could lead to answers to the following important open question, as stated above: How can a deep model's learning capacity with respect to a specific learning task and a dataset be quantitatively characterized, such that the most appropriate model can be designed? This project will also nurture talents in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics by creating research and practice opportunities for undergraduate and postgraduate students. 該項目致力於設計、分析和演示基於互信息的深度學習 (MIGDL) 框架。這個新穎的框架旨在系統地解決複雜數據建模和預測的基本挑戰，即學習能力表徵以及特徵與模型相互適應和改進。深度學習的快速發展為數據分析中的各種問題提供了科學的解決方案。儘管如此，為實際應用設計深度學習方法仍然是一項基本挑戰。具體問題如下： (i) 如何量化地表徵深度模型關於給定學習任務和數據集的學習能力，從而設計出最合適的模型； (ii) 如何使用深度學習模型的當前結構和學習性能來決定必須從數據中進一步獲取什麼； (iii) 如何調整深度學習模型的現有結構，從而最有效地提取和利用進一步從數據中所獲取的信息。為了回答這些問題，我們將開發一個 名為MIGDL的學習 框架，通過互信息來表徵深度學習模型的行為。 MIGDL 框架將包括以下三個重要且相互關聯的組件： (1) 能力表徵模塊 (C-Module)，用於分析表徵和定量描述學習模型在給定學習目標的情況下從數據中提取有用信息的能力； (2) 一個特徵自適應模塊（F-Module），用於確定必須進一步獲取哪些類型的數據，以有效補充已提取/學習的信息； (3)模型適配模塊(M-Module)，用於確定必須對現有模型的哪些部分進行進一步適配，以優化利用F-Module新獲取的數據。我們將對MIGDL 框架的性能進行分析與評估，這將有助於人工智能和機器學習的學科發展。更重要的是，該項目可以回答數據科學中一個重要的開放性問題：如何對特定學習任務和數據集的深度模型的學習能力進行定量表徵，從而設計出最合適的模型?該項目還將通過為本科生和研究生創造研究和實踐機會，培養人工智能、機器學習和數據分析方面的人才。

12203322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12203322.value: 新型兩相厭氧消化系統的產氫調控及其機理探究

12203322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12203322.value: 廚餘垃圾（FW）約占香港城市固體廢棄物的34%。厭氧消化（AD）是一種可以將有機固廢轉化爲生物能源的技術。理論上，兩相AD系統處理廚餘垃圾的穩定性及效率相較於單相AD更高，但由於其較高的投資成本及有限的甲烷提升，目前只有10%的AD工廠運行兩相系統。近年來，我們研發了一種新型的兩相AD系統，即將其酸化相的氣體收集並轉移至產甲烷相再利用，通過刺激嗜氫型產甲烷路徑，該系統的甲烷產量提升約31%。研究發現，優化該系統酸化相的產氫代謝對於提升整體產甲烷性能至關重要。但是，氫氣的實際產率通常遠低於理論產率（即4 mol H2/mol葡萄糖）。因此，如何有效提高廚餘垃圾發酵產氫是亟需解決的關鍵問題。 在酸化相，一般產酸代謝可分爲產氫發酵途徑和非產氫發酵途徑。然而，產酸過程中還原當量的減少是限制產氫產量增加的主要因素。從理論上講，促進丙酮酸脫羧形成乙醯輔酶A和加速NADH代謝途徑是提高產氫的關鍵策略。然而，乳酸和/或NADH的積累可能會減少乙醯輔酶A的形成，並增加還原性副產物（如乳酸、乙醇和丙酸）的形成，從而導致電子當量從H2轉移。為了有效提高產酸期間的氫氣產量，理解廚餘垃圾產酸過程中的NADH/NAD+轉化及促進產氫代謝路徑（即丁酸發酵路徑）的生化機制至關重要。 基於此，該專案旨在通過調控（如pH、氧化還原電位等），分析對應的代謝產物、微生物群落及其功能基因的改變，探究酸化相的產氫代謝機理。聯係產氫性能與相關機制可探明廚餘垃圾產酸過程中的抑制因素，並提出可行的調控策略。另外，還將利用外源性功能微生物構建生物強化系統，以加速產酸中間體的轉化，提高產氫代謝的電子轉移效率。總體上，本研究項目將開發一種高效的產氫系統，通過強化氫營養型途徑提升廚餘產甲烷。另外，該項目的成功實施亦將為有機固廢的厭氧消化技術提供一些新的理論見解。

12300322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12300322.value: 機器學習中Stiefel流形優化問題的非線性特徵方法

12300322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12300322.value: 現代機器學習的核心可以被視為利用約束優化從現實世界的數據中提取知識。有監督、無監督的多視角子空間學習 (MvSL) 產生許多Stiefel 流形上的優化問題，其中投影矩陣的正交性對於保存距離、魯棒性和更好的降噪等非常重要。 Stiefel 流形上的優化問題在數值計算上具有挑戰性。當然可以應用通用優化方法，但通用優化方法對於大規模數據科學應用來說太昂貴甚至不可行。出於這個原因，讓從業者甚至研究人員常見通過改變正交性約束來輕鬆解決問題, 因為改變正交性約束會將問題簡化而簡化後的問題等價於線性特徵值問題, 然後許多成熟的數值技術便可以很容易地應用。不幸的是，這種做法解決的是錯誤的問題，並且經常產生次優性效果。在這個項目中，我們將建立一個實用的解決方案框架，來解決 Stiefel 流形上的優化原問題而不是修改後的問題。具體來說我們計劃建立有效的求解與特徵向量相關的非線性特徵值問題 (NEPv) 的數值方法, 我們的新方法可以充分利用MvSL問題具有的內在結構。數值上，利用自洽場 (SCF) 迭代和大量求解特徵值問題資源來有效地解決所涉及的 NEPv問題。從理論上講，可證明基於我們解決方案框架的方法要么是全局收斂的，要么至少是局部收斂的。 人工智能的應用已經滲透到我們社會的每一個角落，而香港作為大灣區的一部分，在引領大數據時代的新技術前沿發展方面具有獨特的地位。我們計劃創建一個軟件套件系統來實現我們研究獲得的關於Stiefel 流形上來自 MvSL優化問題高效求解方法。預計在該項目完成後，MvSL 的最新技術水平將顯著提高。我們這個項目對正交多視角機器學習將提供堅實的數學和數值基礎。

12300922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12300922.value: 求解表面對流控制方程的混合核方法

12300922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12300922.value: 通過結合適當的高分辨率技術，我們的目標是開發無網格數值方法，用於求解可能包含衝擊和/或不連續性的光滑表面上的偏微分方程 (PDE)。我們關注粘性和非粘性標量雙曲線守恆定律，並研究在許多工程應用中具有零或非常慢擴散傳輸的二階擬線性擴散對流 PDE，即大佩克萊特數。眾所周知，無網格線法和各種類型的橢圓 PDE 求解器（在時間上具有有限差分離散化）在具有中等佩克萊特數的 PDE 上都能很好地工作。無網格半拉格朗日方法在求解表面上的純平流偏微分方程方面也顯示出前景。該項目從對現有無網格 PDE 求解器的文獻回顧開始。我們對求解具有邊界條件的開放曲面上的偏微分方程時的數值性能感興趣，以便確定用於平滑區域的良好候選對象。請注意，（某些基於核的）曲面 PDE 求解器的所有可用誤差估計和收斂分析僅適用於封閉曲面。在理論方面，我們專注於無網格半拉格朗日方法，以確保我們正確使用（域類型）積分器（在表面上）。該項目的第二部分將專注於開發時間相關的嵌入方法。我們推測對流和/或擴散-對流偏微分方程中的速度場存在一些擴展，因此恆沿法線解可以求解相應的嵌入偏微分方程。完成這項分析任務後，嵌入式 PDE 很容易用文獻中的 ENO/WENO 型沖擊捕獲算法求解。作為概念證明，本提案中提出的初步二維結果顯示出在捕獲解決方案中的衝擊和不連續性方面取得了可喜的結果。最後的任務是組裝一種混合算法，該算法根據數值解的規律性在表面的不同部分上運行無網格和 ENO/WENO 求解器。該項目將以表面上各種基準 PDE 的數值模擬結束。

12301822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12301822.value: 拓撲聲學態在合成維度中的絕熱泵浦

12301822.label: Project Objectives
12301822.value: Objective 1: Develop the theory and experimental platform for the pumping of two or more synthetic dimensions. Building on the recent development of single-parameter-modulating acoustic waveguide systems, we will explore new degrees of freedom in acoustic waveguides with the goal to establish an acoustic platform for topological pumping involving multiple driving parameters. This objective is essential for the close-loop pumping of the degenerate states comprising topologically charged nodal surfaces. Objective 2: Investigate multi-state adiabatic evolution of topologically charged nodal structures. We will design tight-binding models with two or more synthetic dimensions that can produce TCNSs. Investigations on the Berry curvature distributions on the TCNS will be conducted. Holonomic adiabatic evolutions of the eigenstates on the TCNSs will be analyzed in detail. The outcomes of different encircling loops will be compared with the intention to identify physical consequences relating to the distribution of Berry curvature. Objective 3: Realize adiabatic evolution in an optimized acoustic pumping structure. Based on the experimental platform developed in Objective 1 and the theoretical models found in Objective 2, we will design realistic acoustic waveguide systems to demonstrate the adiabatic evolutions of the degenerate eigenstates on the nodal surface. Different evolutions may require different experimental systems to demonstrate. Numerical optimization methods will be used to minimize the size and cost of the experimental systems. Objective 4: Explore new applications of topological acoustic pumping. Explore potential applications relating to acoustic topological pumping. rows: Objective 1: Develop the theory and experimental platform for the pumping of two or more synthetic dimensions. Building on the recent development of single-parameter-modulating acoustic waveguide systems, we will explore new degrees of freedom in acoustic waveguides with the goal to establish an acoustic platform for topological pumping involving multiple driving parameters. This objective is essential for the close-loop pumping of the degenerate states comprising topologically charged nodal surfaces.

Objective 2: Investigate multi-state adiabatic evolution of topologically charged nodal structures. We will design tight-binding models with two or more synthetic dimensions that can produce TCNSs. Investigations on the Berry curvature distributions on the TCNS will be conducted. Holonomic adiabatic evolutions of the eigenstates on the TCNSs will be analyzed in detail. The outcomes of different encircling loops will be compared with the intention to identify physical consequences relating to the distribution of Berry curvature.

Objective 3: Realize adiabatic evolution in an optimized acoustic pumping structure. Based on the experimental platform developed in Objective 1 and the theoretical models found in Objective 2, we will design realistic acoustic waveguide systems to demonstrate the adiabatic evolutions of the degenerate eigenstates on the nodal surface. Different evolutions may require different experimental systems to demonstrate. Numerical optimization methods will be used to minimize the size and cost of the experimental systems.

Objective 4: Explore new applications of topological acoustic pumping. Explore potential applications relating to acoustic topological pumping. Potential directions include but not limit to: energy transfer, multiplexing, wave steering. This objective will be pursued in parallel with the first three objectives.

12301822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12301822.value: In the 1980s, topology – a mathematical tool that categorizes the geometries of manifolds – was used to examine the global properties of Bloch bands, which are compact surfaces in the Brillouin zone. It succeeded in explaining and predicting physical phenomena in natural materials, such as the quantum Hall effect. Since then, the application of topology in physics has successfully reshaped the research landscape of physics. In recent years, saliently designed artificial wave-based systems in electromagnetism, photonics, and acoustics have proven to be versatile and reliable platforms for studying topological physics. The convenience offered by these platforms has, in return, fuelled the theoretical aspect of topological physics. One such development is the diverse realizations of synthetic dimensions – artificial degrees of freedom that mathematically map to dimensionalities orthogonal to the system’s real/reciprocal dimensions. By the inclusion of synthetic dimensions, many physical systems that were beyond reach became realizable. A prime example is higher-dimensional topological systems, e.g., a four-dimensional topological insulator, for which synthetic dimensions are a necessity. In this proposed project, we leverage synthetic dimensions to design and realize topological semimetal phases with one or more topologically charged nodal surfaces – two-dimensional energy surfaces comprised of two or more degenerate states. Unlike topological charge-carrying nodal points such as a Weyl point, the nodal surface has a finite area, and its topological charges are due to the contribution of distribution of Berry curvatures. The Berry curvature on the nodal surface can possess structures that lead to a new layer of topological physics. We plan to perform adiabatic pumping of the degenerate states comprising the nodal surfaces as an efficient tool to study the distributions of Berry curvature and to reveal any physical consequences. The degenerate states will engage holonomic parallel transport on the charged nodal surfaces by the slow variation of the synthetic dimensions over closed loops, generating non-trivial and gauge-independent unitary transformation. Such adiabatic pumping will be experimentally realized using acoustic waveguide systems, in which two or more waveguide parameters that play the role of synthetic dimensions will be modulated along the propagation direction. We envision the findings will shed light on the details of Berry curvature distributions, thus leading to new topological insights of charged nodal surfaces. The results may also be useful for applications of robust state permutations or non-Abelian phenomena. 拓撲學在能帶中的應用成功地解釋和預測了天然材料中的物理現象，例如量子霍爾效應。此後，拓撲學在物理學中的應用成功地重塑了物理學的研究格局。近年來，在電磁學、光子學和聲學領域突出設計的基於人工波的系統已被證明是研究拓撲物理的通用且可靠的平台。這些平台提供的便利反過來又推動了拓撲物理學的理論發展。其中一項發展是合成維度的多樣化實現。通過合成維度，許多遙不可及的物理系統變得可以實現。一個典型的例子是高維拓撲系統，例如，四維拓撲絕緣體，合成維度是必要的。 本課題擬利用合成維度來設計和實現具有一個或多個拓撲節點表面的拓撲半金屬相 。與外爾點等拓撲節點不同，節點表面的面積是有限的，其拓撲電荷是由於貝裡曲率分佈的貢獻。節點表面上的貝裡曲率可以擁有導致拓撲物理新層的結構。我們計劃對節點表面上的簡併態進行絕熱泵浦，研究貝裡曲率分佈並揭示任何物理後果的有效工具。通過閉環上合成尺寸的緩慢變化，簡併態將在節點面上進行和樂平行傳輸，從而產生非平凡且與規範無關的酉變換。這種絕熱泵浦將通過聲波導系統實驗實現，其中兩個或多個起合成尺寸作用的波導參數將沿傳播方向進行調製。我們設想這些發現將揭示貝裡曲率分佈的細節，從而導致拓撲節點面的新見解。該結果也可能有助於實現魯棒態置換或非阿貝爾現像等應用。

12302022.value: 有限混合模型是一種非常靈活的統計模型，常用於研究收集數據的異質性。然而，在不知道有限混合模型成分個數的情況下，模型存在可識別性問題，因而無法準確估計模型。所以將有限混合模型擴展或應用於其他更通用的應用並不容易。本項目基於確定有限混合模型的混合分量數量的現有方法，我們研究了有限混合模型的兩種應用或擴展。我們希望提供一些見解，看看是否可以結合觀測數據的先驗信息或更詳細的有限混合模型結構， 從而更準確地估計有限混合模型。 首先，眾所周知，多變點檢測在工業和金融計量經濟學研究中有廣泛的應用。具有多個變點的隨機多元觀測序列可以看作是從有限混合模型生成的有序觀測值。混合成分的數量由觀察到的隨機多元維數序列所包含的變點的個數決定。觀測的順序位置決定了觀測產生的混合分量。從這個觀點來看，多變點檢測的問題可以轉化為確定有限混合模型中的成分個數的選擇問題。此外，還可以通過觀測序列的先驗順序信息同時確定變化點的位置。基於有限混合模型的分量數確定的數量，並結合觀察者的先驗信息，我們提出了一種靈活穩健的方法來檢測多元隨機觀測序列中的多變點的個數及其位置。所提出的方法可以同時檢測局部、尺度和其他多維隨機序列變化。我們研究了變化點檢測的一致性，並研究了漸近統計特性以及所提出方法的模型估計效率。 其次，專家系統的混合（MoS）是有限混合模型的本質擴展。它假設每個觀察到的隨機向量的有限混合模型中的混合權重由相應的協變量確定。然後系統可以自適應地遵循分治策略從數據中學習。現在MoS在不同的科學領域都有廣泛的應用。雖然它是一個廣義的有限混合模型，但每次觀察的混合權重都會隨著這樣的觀察者或相應的協變量而改變。確定有限混合模型成分個數的經典正則化方法不能直接應用於混合模型專家系統。本項目，基於組選擇技術，提出或擴展了一種正則化方法來確定專家系統的專家個數。研究所提出方法的一致性、魯棒性和效率。所提出的方法還用於分析來自不同科學領域的異構數據。利用我們所提出的方法，我們進一步研究擴展的分層混合專家系統（HME。 本研究的新穎之處在於研究了具有先驗數據信息或詳細模型結構的有限混合建模的統計效率和計算可行性。當混合成分個數未知時，建立克服有限混合建模效率低下的基本框架，從而可以消除實際應用中靈活的有限混合建模障礙。

12302122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302122.value: Laser desorption/ionization mass spectrometry (LDI-MS) imaging has a much higher channel throughput than optical imaging and can detect known or unknown biomolecules. This unique technical feature of mass spectrometry imaging puts it in a pivotal position in medical discovery. However, the resolution of MS imaging is much lower than optical imaging, limiting its application in biomedical research. Therefore, the development of mass spectrometry screening of molecular composition at the cellular and subcellular resolution is the central goal of contemporary matrix-assistant laser desorption/ionization (MALDI)-MS imaging. High spatial resolution MS imaging can be achieved by improving the laser optical system of the mass spectrometer. State-of-art values on the spatial resolution of commercial MS imaging systems range from 5-20 μm, which is far below the need for subcellular resolution. Although sub-cellular resolution can be achieved through the development of more advanced mass spectrometry laser optical systems, the commercialization of instruments and their applications may take ten years later. This project will develop a multiplex and subcellular resolution protein imaging method based on a commercially available imaging system by physically expanding the size of tissues. The strategy is based on expansion microscopy. As the gel expands, the tissue expands in an equal proportion. Then targeted proteins will incubate with photocleavable mass-tags labeled antibodies. The photocleavable linker is broken when the laser is excited, and MS will detect the dissociated and ionized mass tags. It is expected a 2.5 to 1μm resolution could be achieved using typical commercial instruments, which is a remarkable improvement from its original 10μm resolution. The technology to be developed is an independent sample pretreatment process so that it can be universally applied to a variety of MS platforms. It can proportionally improve the resolution of a wide range of MS imaging systems. Since the sample expansion and the mass spectrometer laser optical system are orthogonally independent, the combination of this method and the next-generation higher resolution mass spectrometry imaging system is expected to provide imaging resolution comparable to that of conventional optical microscopes. Compared with optical microscopes used for protein immunofluorescence imaging, this method can provide higher channel throughput. This research reduces the reliance on instruments and will have a broad and immediate boost to medical and biological research. This research also lays the foundation for the development of next-generation label-free expansion MS imaging strategies. 基质辅助激光解吸/电离（MALDI）质谱成像（MSI）具有比光学成像高得多的通道通量。它是一种软电离质谱，可以检测已知或未知的内源性生物分子。MALDI质谱成像的这一独特技术特点使其在医学发现中处于举足轻重的地位。然而，质谱成像的分辨率比光学成像低得多，限制了它在生物医学研究中的应用。因此，发展细胞和亚细胞分辨率成像方法是当代基质辅助激光解吸/电离质谱成像的核心目标。高空间分辨率MSI可以通过改进质谱仪的激光光学系统来实现。商业质谱成像系统的空间分辨率的极限在5-20微米之间，这远远低于亚细胞分辨率的需要。尽管亚细胞分辨率可以通过开发更先进的质谱激光光学系统来实现，但仪器的商业化及其应用可能需要十年之久。 本项目另辟蹊径，原创性的提出，在商业化成像系统的基础上，通过物理上扩大组织的尺寸，开发一种亚细胞分辨率的成像方法。该策略受基于光学检测的膨胀显微镜技术的启发，对包埋于凝胶的样本进行物理扩张。随着凝胶的膨胀，组织也以相同的比例膨胀。然后，目标蛋白将与可光解离质量标签标记的抗体孵化。当激光激发时，质谱将检测到解离的质量标签，进而得知抗体特异性识别的蛋白的信息。预计使用典型的商业仪器可以达到2.5至1微米的分辨率，这比其原来的5-20微米的分辨率有显著的提高，并达到亚细胞分辨率要求。本项目将开发的技术是一个独立的样品处理过程，因此它可以普遍应用于各种质谱平台。它可以按比例提高各种质谱成像系统的分辨率。由于样品扩张和质谱激光光学系统是正交独立的，该方法亦可和下一代更高分辨率的质谱成像系统结合，并有望提供与传统光学显微镜相当的成像分辨率。与用于蛋白质免疫荧光成像的光学显微镜相比，这种方法可以提供更高的通道通量。这项研究减少了对仪器的依赖，将对医学和生物研究产生广泛而直接的推动作用。这项研究也为开发下一代面向代谢物的无标签扩张质谱成像奠定了基础。

12302122.label: Realisation of objectives
12302122.value: All objectives outlined in the original application were fully achieved, with progress meeting or exceeding the planned milestones. A novel and orthogonal strategy to enhance the spatial resolution of mass spectrometry imaging was successfully established, originally targeted to achieve a 4–5-fold improvement over the instrument’s native performance. Through systematic optimization of the expansion process, sample anchoring, and imaging parameters, the final platform achieved a tenfold resolution improvement without any hardware modification, significantly surpassing the initial target. This substantial enhancement enables subcellular molecular mapping with a level of detail that was previously inaccessible using conventional MALDI MSI approaches. A complete and reproducible workflow for tissue and cell expansion was developed, incorporating optimized sample preparation, controlled hydrogel embedding, uniform isotropic swelling, and MALDI MS analysis. The procedure was validated across multiple tissue types, including delicate and heterogeneous biological specimens, ensuring broad applicability. MS-compatible expansion conditions were identified and optimized to achieve high molecular retention and accurate preservation of spatial molecular distribution. A robust dehydration anchoring strategy was implemented, allowing expanded sections to remain firmly attached to conductive ITO-coated slides throughout imaging. Photocleavable mass-tag antibody probes were successfully applied to enable targeted molecular detection in an MSI-compatible format, with the photocleavable site responding reproducibly to laser irradiation for controlled mass tag release. The integrated MALDI MS imaging method, further enhanced with MALDI-2 post-ionization, markedly improved ion yields, signal-to-noise ratios, and molecular coverage. This combination allowed the visualization of dendritic and fine anatomical structures in mouse brain tissue, as well as intracellular protein and lipid distributions in cultured cells, with spatial fidelity preserved at the subcellular level. The feasibility of high-resolution label-free imaging in expanded samples was also demonstrated, offering comprehensive molecular coverage without specific labeling. This achievement not only confirmed the robustness of the methodology but also established a solid foundation for future development of a universal label-free expansion mass spectrometry imaging platform, with broad potential impact in neuroscience, cancer pathology, and other areas of biomedical research.

12302122.label: Major findings and research outcome
12302122.value: This project delivered the first fully integrated expansion-based MALDI mass spectrometry imaging platform capable of achieving subcellular molecular imaging for proteins, lipids, and metabolites. The original goal was to improve spatial resolution by 4–5 times relative to the native capability of the mass spectrometer; through systematic optimization, the platform achieved a tenfold improvement without hardware modification, representing a major technical advance. A reproducible and MS-compatible expansion chemistry was implemented, ensuring high molecular retention and preservation of spatial distribution during isotropic sample swelling. A stable dehydration anchoring strategy was established to keep expanded sections firmly attached to conductive slides. Photocleavable mass-tag antibody probes were applied successfully for targeted molecular detection, and the integration of MALDI-2 post-ionization with the expansion workflow substantially enhanced ion yield, signal-to-noise ratio, and analyte coverage. These advances enabled imaging of fine anatomical features in mouse brain and intracellular structures in cultured cells with unprecedented clarity, and demonstrated the feasibility of label-free, high-resolution imaging. The outcomes have generated data for two manuscripts submitted to high-impact journals and have provided a strong basis for further funding proposals.

12302122.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12302122.value: The next phase will focus on increasing resolution to the 200–300 nm range by further optimizing the expansion factor and gel composition, extending the method to FFPE tissues for retrospective clinical studies, and integrating ion mobility spectrometry to improve isomer resolution in expanded samples. The combination of tenfold spatial resolution improvement, high molecular coverage, and compatibility with both targeted and label-free detection provides a strong platform for further technological development. This will expand its applicability in neuroscience, cancer pathology, and single-cell molecular profiling, ensuring the method continues to make impactful contributions to both fundamental research and translational applications.

12302122.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12302122.value: Mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) enables scientists to visualize the distribution of molecules directly in tissues, but its spatial resolution is typically much lower than that of optical microscopy. This project developed a new approach, termed expansion mass spectrometry imaging (ExMSI), in which biological samples are physically enlarged before imaging. Physical expansion increases the apparent distances between molecular features, enabling existing instruments to resolve much finer details without hardware modification. The original goal was to achieve a 4–5-fold improvement in resolution; the method ultimately achieved a tenfold enhancement, allowing the visualization of subcellular structures with molecular specificity that were previously inaccessible. The approach is applicable to both targeted detection using molecular probes and label-free imaging that captures a broad spectrum of biomolecules. These capabilities open new opportunities for investigating complex biological processes and diseases, such as cancer and neurological disorders, by providing molecular maps at an unprecedented level of detail.

12302522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302522.value: 多元應變函數資料的統計模型與推論

12302522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302522.value: In recent decades, with rapid development in data collection and storage technology, multivariate functional data are increasingly common in various fields of study. For example, movement of a subject in a series of activities is monitored with accelerometers and gyroscopes in gait analysis, daily temperature, precipitation and other meteorological variables at a weather station are recorded, etc. One goal of this research project is to make inference about the underlying population based on such multivariate functional data at hand. When there may be sub-populations, testing equality of the corresponding vectors of mean functions, i.e. analysis of variance of the multivariate functional data, is a fundamental problem. Several tests have been proposed and studied to achieve this goal in the univariate case, but only a few methods have been developed in the multivariate case and them have their own limitations. We propose and study a new test that takes into account dependence between different functional observations on the same subject and heteroscedasticity in the matrices of covariance functions. Our test is based on asymptotic null distribution of the proposed test statistic, thus is computationally fast. Further, since the asymptotic null distribution is generally skewed, we utilize chi-square approximation which is superior to normal approximation in this case. Theoretical results will be derived to demonstrate asymptotic properties including consistency and power of our test. Extensive simulation studies will be conducted to examine finite sample performance of the proposed method and compare it with existing methods. The proposed method will be applied to analyze the above-mentioned motivating datasets to demonstrate its utility. In some cases, in addition to the group effect there may be some covariate effects and trend that are important in their own rights. For example, there may be a trend component if the multivariate functional data are collected along time. Another goal of this research project is to extend our model and testing procedure to accommodate the trend and covariate effects based on multivariate functional linear models or semiparametric models for multiple functional responses. While the studied problems emerge as the need to understand the complex and dynamic structures behind the multivariate functional responses, the literature so far on semiparametric regression for multivariate functional responses is limited. We will conduct a simulation study and apply the proposed method to analyze some multivariate functional time series data sets concerning climate change and traffic flow. 近幾十年來，由於數據收集與儲存技術的快速發展多元應變函數資料在許多研究領域中越來越常見。例如，在步態分析中一連串人體的移動以加速測試儀和陀螺儀記錄下來，氣象觀測站記錄當地每天的氣溫、降雨量和其他氣象資料等。本研究計畫的一個目標是利用這類多元函數資料對其背後的群體結構和機制做統計推論。當多元函數資料來自一些不同的子群體時，檢定這些不同的子群體產生的多元函數資料俱有相同的多維均值函數，也就是多元函數資料的變異分析，是一個根本問題。文獻中已經有一些單元函數資料變異分析的統計假設檢定方法，也有少數幾個多元情況下的方法但是他們它們各有一些限制。本研究計畫將探討一個新的能夠應付不同子群體俱有相異斜方差矩陣以及不同多元函數觀察值俱有相依性的多元函數資料變異分析方法。我們的方法將基於所提出檢驗統計量的在虛無假設下漸近分佈所以能夠快速計算，另外，由於此漸近分佈一般來說是右偏的，在這情況下我們使用比常態分佈逼進更佳的卡方分佈分佈。我們將推導這個新的多元函數資料變異分析方法的大樣本理論性質，包含它的一致性和檢定力。我們也將執行大量的模擬實驗用以檢視它的有限樣本表現並且和現存的方法做比較，和將它應用前面提到的實際數據分析。此外，除了子群體效應以外多元函數資料可能還含有一個趨勢函數和其他的自變數效應，例如它們是在一段時間內收集的。故本研究計畫的另一個目標是將我們的方法推廣到更一般的多元應變函數資料線性模型或是半參數模型。雖然這些研究課題亟待被解決，目前文獻中關於多元應變函數資料線性模型或是半參數模型的探討非常有限。我們將進行模擬實驗和應用到氣候變遷分析和交通流量分析。

12302622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302622.value: 建立脂肪和肥胖相關蛋白FTO作为RNA N6-甲基羥化酶的新功能

12302622.label: Project Objectives
12302622.value: To ascertain the in vitro activity of FTO as a RNA hydroxylase To determine the structure and binding affinities of FTO-RNA substrate complexes To understand the biological roles of hm6Am

To understand the biological roles of hm6Am

12302622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302622.value: 核糖核酸（ribonucleic acids, RNA）化學修飾，或稱為RNA表觀遺傳學，在基因調控中發揮多種作用。 N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）是最常見，且最被廣泛研究的RNA化學修飾之一。 m6A參與基因調控，並與癌症發展和病毒感染相關。 m6A可通過去甲基化酶去除。迄今為止，發現了兩種人類m6A去甲基化酶：脂肪和肥胖相關蛋白（fat mass and obesity associated protein, FTO）和AlkB同系物5（AlkB homologue 5, ALKBH5）。研究表明，異常表達的FTO和ALKBH5蛋白具有促癌作用（如FTO蛋白可以促進急性骨髓性白血病，ALKBH5蛋白可以促進膠質細胞瘤），因此FTO和ALKBH5蛋白是潛在的抗癌靶標。儘管FTO和ALKBH5具有重要的生理作用，兩者在催化機制和生理作用方面的差異尚不清楚；明確這些差異有助於理解FTO和ALKBH5的去甲基酶活性在腫瘤發展中的作用，從而幫助我們更加精準地制訂抗腫瘤療法。現有基於FTO和ALKBH5的活性的研究表明它們具有不同的生物學功能。據報導，FTO介導的m6A去甲基化產物包括N6-羥甲基腺苷（N6-hydroxymethyladenosine,hm6A）、N6-甲酰腺苷（N6-formyladenosine, f6A）和去甲基腺苷（demethylated adenosine, A）。我們的前期研究通過高通量質譜及核磁共振發現：在FTO催化的初始階段，hm6A是其唯一的產物且沒有去甲基腺苷A的產生，這提示FTO是一個RNA羥化酶，而非脫甲基酶。近期研究發現：FTO還可以將RNA5’帽位置的N6,2'-O-二甲基腺嘌呤 (m6Am）去甲基化。我們的結果也顯示：FTO對RNA 5′帽附近的m6Am的活性明顯高於對其內部的m6A的活性，這與近期已發表的研究結果一致。根據現有研究報導及本項目前期研究結果，我們提出以下工作假說：FTO是一種作用於RNA 5′帽附近的m6Am羥化酶，該過程可產生一種新的、具有重要基因調控功能的RNA修飾物：N6-羥甲基-2′O-甲基腺苷（hm6Am）；RNA5′帽附近的hm6Am可能是FTO的催化功能及其促癌機制之中未曾發現的重要環節。在本項目中，我們將（1）確定FTO對RNA 5′帽附的m6Am的體外羥化酶活性；（2）對FTO-m6Am底物複合物進行結構和生物物理研究；（3）研究5′cap-hm6Am對包括RNA穩定性、剪接和翻譯在內的基因調控的作用。本項目的研究結果有助於我們區分FTO與ALKBH5在體內的生理作用，從而進一步了解不同的去甲基化酶如何影響不同癌症的發展。這項研究也將有助於針對RNA去甲基化酶選擇性抑製劑的設計。重要的是，這個項目的成功還將為通過RNA羥化進行基因調控開闢新的研究方向。

12302722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302722.value: 輪胎橡膠中醌類化合物的質譜代謝組學研究

12302722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302722.value: N-(1,3-dimethylbutyl)-N'-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine (6-PPD) is a globally ubiquitous tire rubber antioxidant. Its quinone product, 6PPD-quinone, has been found to be highly toxic and can cause acute mortality of coho salmon in Pacific Northwest before they spawn in freshwater streams, a phenomenon called “Urban runoff mortality syndrome”. Recent scientific reports indicates that this emerging pollutant is pervasive in different environmental media, including urban road runoff and watersheds, dust, and fine particulate matters, which are closely related to human activities. However, there is the paucity of research on its biotoxicity to human health. In this proposed study, we aim to investigate possible toxicological effects of human exposure to 6PPD-quinone. Firstly, in vivo cell and in vivo mouse models will be established. Cell cytotoxicity and mouse mortality induced by 6PPD-quinone exposure will be determined, which are expected to provide initial evidence to indicate toxicity of 6PPD-quinone. Secondly, mass spectrometric methods will be developed and applied for analysis of biotransformation products of 6PPD-quinone in the samples of cells, tissues, and body fluids. The results will clarify whether 6PPD-quinone and its downstream metabolites can enter the circulatory system and accumulate in various organs (e.g., liver, kidney, spleen, and lung). Thirdly, nontargeted and targeted metabolomics approaches will be utilized for the investigation of perturbed metabolites induced by 6PPD-quinone exposure. Dysregulated metabolic pathways between control and exposed groups will be examined. Collectively, the results of this proposal may provide new insights into 6PPD-quinone induced toxicity at the cellular and molecular levels. N-(1,3-二甲基丁基)-N'-苯基-對苯二胺 (6-PPD) 是一種全球普遍存在的輪胎橡膠抗氧劑。其醌類產品 6PPD-醌被發現具有毒性，導致太平洋西北部的銀鮭在淡水溪流中產卵之前急性死亡，這種現象稱為「城市徑流死亡綜合癥」。最近的科學報告表明，這種新興汙染物普遍存在於不同的環境介質中，包括與人類活動密切相關的城市道路徑流和流域、灰塵和細顆粒物。然而，關於其對人體健康的生物毒性的研究很少。在研究中，我們旨在調查人類暴露於 6PPD-醌可能產生的毒性影響。首先， 將建立體外細胞和體內小鼠模型，研究由 6PPD-醌暴露引起的細胞毒性和小鼠死亡率，提供 6PPD-醌毒性的初步證據。其次，將開發質譜方法並將其應用於細胞、動物組織和體液樣品中6PPD-醌的生物轉化產物的分析。闡明6PPD-醌及其下遊代謝物是否可以進入循環系統並在各個器官（例如，肝、腎、脾和肺）中積累。第三，非靶向和靶向代謝組學方法將用於研究由 6PPD-醌暴露引起的擾動代謝物，檢查對照組和暴露組之間失調的代謝途徑。該研究結果可能將為 6PPD-醌在細胞和分子水平上誘導的毒性提供新的見解。

12302922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12302922.value: 使用多組學研究細顆粒物在飲食引致肝病過程中的影響

12302922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12302922.value: Prof Tian, Liang Prof Wong, Carmen Chak Lui

12302922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12302922.value: 隨著人均脂肪和糖類消耗量的迅速增加，肥胖、慢性肝病、糖尿病等代謝疾病的患病率逐年攀升。非酒精性脂肪肝（ NAFLD） 是一種最常見的慢性肝病，有機會發展出各種肝臟疾病及引起很多其他健康問題。細顆粒物（即 PM2.5）是全球範圍内引致最多疾病和死亡的環境風險因素。不論是流行病學數據還是實驗室研究都顯示，包括 NAFLD在内的一系列非傳染性疾病的發病率和流行率均與PM2.5暴露 水平呈現相關性。然而，對於PM2.5 毒性如何影響 NAFLD的發生發展，尤其是其中的分子機制，我們仍然知之甚少。本項目的研究將通過小鼠模型，使用質譜 (MS) 多組學方法來研究，在不均衡飲食導致 NAFLD的過程中， PM2.5 引起的毒性變化如何加速疾病發生。我們將把正常小鼠隨機均分為四組，一半的小鼠（其中兩組）將餵食標準飲食，而另一半則餵食高脂、高糖、高膽固醇食物。同時，小鼠將飼養在一個模擬現實世界的暴露系統中，兩種飲食飼養的小鼠，將各有一組暴露於與外界環境相似的PM2.5污染中。每隔四個星期收取一部分小鼠樣品，用以跟踪 NAFLD 的發生和進展。然後我們將結合使用蛋白質組學、磷酸化蛋白質組學、代謝組學、脂質組學等多種組學分析手段，考察在血液、肝臟和其他組織中，過度能量攝入 與 PM2.5 暴露各自及聯合引起的分子變化。通過應用包括機器學習在内的數據分析方法，從這些組學數據中探究各個組織器官的變化過程及其相互關聯。并通過不同組小鼠之間的差異比較來發掘受到實驗chu’li 影響的、與NAFLD 病變過程相關的通路和關鍵蛋白。進一步的，我們將運用細胞生物學及分子遺傳學手段在人體細胞中驗證這些蛋白的作用和功能。該研究意在揭示 PM2.5 對 NAFLD 進程的不良作用，其結果有望從分子及多器官層面瞭解高糖、高脂攝入對 NAFLD 發展的影響，尤其是PM2.5 毒性在其中發揮的作用。本項目的研究將為我們理解 PM2.5毒理學效應如何加速飲食誘導肝病發生的分子機制提供更全面深入的信息。

12303422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12303422.value: 過渡金屬催化的碳-膦键的不對稱交叉偶聯反應合成膦手性化合物

12303422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12303422.value: 這個世界充滿了手性。手性化合物在醫藥、農藥以及材料科學領域發揮著重大的作用。眾多有用的手性分子的經典合成方法是有機合成，更準確的說，是不對稱合成。在不對稱合成的各種方法中，不對稱催化又最為有效和具有吸引力。隨著不對稱催化反應的發展，許多新的機遇與挑戰都將湧現。 不對稱催化是有機合成中一個廣闊且令人興奮的領域。2001年的諾貝爾化學獎頒發給了William S. Knowles, Ryoji Noyori和K.Barry Sharpless，因為他們在不對稱金屬催化領域的傑出貢獻。今年，諾貝爾化學獎再次花落不對稱催化領域， Benjamin List和David MacMillan因為在小分子催化領域的開創性工作獲得2021年諾貝爾化學獎。高效手性催化劑的發展在這個領域起了重要的作用。與手性卡賓、雙烯和噁唑啉配體比較，手性膦配體是過渡金屬催化和小分子催化領域中最高效和被頻繁使用的配體。爲了應對手性膦配體的特殊需求，發展新型的方法來構築高光學純的膦手性有機膦化合物具有重要意義。 過渡金屬催化的膦化合物與芳基、烷基親電試劑的不對稱交叉偶聯反應，是合成膦手性和碳手性含膦化合物最為高效和直接的策略。盡管如此，催化的不對稱P−C交叉偶聯反應還存在極大挑戰，僅有幾例報道，其原因可能在于過量的膦底物會與手性配體競爭金屬催化劑的配位點而抑制催化劑活性。因此,發展新型的高效的催化體系實現不對稱P−C交叉偶聯反應具有重要的研究意義。通簡潔高效和模塊組合化的大量構建手性有機膦化合物，將為解決不對稱催化領域中的挑戰性課題創造新的機會。從這個方面來說，碳-膦键的不對稱交叉偶聯反應將為不對稱催化領域做出極其重要的貢獻，進而造福全人類。

12500022.value: 不少傳統的社區合作社，都希望能從資本主義市場經濟中超脫出來，因此拒絕接受和使用法定貨幣，改為發行自己的社區代用券。有趣的是，自從區塊鏈與加密貨幣興起之後，我們在很多去中央化交易平台上都看到類似的行為。他們紛紛推出自己的代幣，令「首次代幣發行」（ICO）蔚然成風。監管機構對「首次代幣發行」有很大疑慮，普遍認為是「首次公開募股」（IPO）的變種，主要目的是在規避監管的情況下行「首次公開募股」之實。這個研究項目從一個不同的角度去理解「首次代幣發行」。交易平台即便沒有募股的需要，在一定條件下也會想發行自己的代幣，因為可以收取鑄幣稅（seigniorage）。所以「首次代幣發行」不是每次都是「首次公開募股」的變種，監管機構不應一成不變的用監管「首次公開募股」的方法來監管「首次代幣發行」。但這不代表「首次代幣發行」就不用監管。代幣的氾濫，會帶來對法定貨幣的擠兌，會損害法定貨幣的市場價值。這是對使用法定貨幣的市民的一種界外效應。對「首次代幣發行」的監管應該從這個角度去思考。

12501222.value: 協同消費中的共享：悖論視角

12501222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12501222.value: Prof Belk, Russell Prof Yim, Chi Kin (Bennett)

12501222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501222.value: 正如服務主導邏輯 (SDL) (Vargo and Lusch 2004) 所確立的那樣，價值共創勢在必行，而且它似乎與新興的共享經濟特別相關 (Naddem et al. 2021)。共享經濟包含多種相關實踐，預計到 2025 年，這些實踐的總市值將達到 3350 億美元（Pwc 2015）。協作消費 (CC) 代表了廣泛採用的共享經濟版本（Bardhi and Eckhardt 2012），例如兩個著名的 CC 平台 Airbnb 和 Uber，其市值分別為 10 美元和 180 億美元（Martin 2016 ）。共享經濟的這種表現形式涉及作為關鍵價值共同創造者的同行服務提供者和客戶，他們依靠在線平台作為服務使能者，以貨幣補償但不轉移合法所有權的方式進行交換。 雖然最近關於 CC 的作用和成果的研究相當多，但他們主要採用客戶的視角來建立他們對共享平台功能的期望和評估（有關評論，請參見表 1）；較少的調查包括服務提供商的觀點。然而，這些評估對於發展 CC 至關重要，因為只有在客戶和服務提供商的積極、共同參與下才能成功地共同創造價值。尤其是供應商的服務質量，直接影響到客戶的滿意度、回購意願以及對共享平台品牌形象的認知。此外，客戶熱情地採用 CC 來滿足他們的服務需求（Zervas et al. 2017），但軼事證據表明服務供應嚴重短缺。到 2022 年，美國 Airbnb 用戶數量可能達到 4560 萬；但到 2021 年，Airbnb 房東的數量只有 290 萬。增加服務提供商的數量將有利於整個共享經濟：它可以吸引更多尋求更多差異化產品的客戶，並促使共享平台上的新房源（Tucker and Zhang 2010 ）。因此，我們需要更好地了解服務提供商的分享經驗，以闡明如何激發他們的參與和積極分享。 在此背景下，我們的目標是從悖論的角度（Smith and Lewis 2011；Zhang et al. 2015）檢驗服務提供商（即所有者）的共享體驗，正如 CC 上下文中的悖論共享概念所揭示的那樣。也就是說，服務提供商在共享中同時面對看似相互競爭但相互關聯的元素並隨著時間的推移持續存在。因此，該提案整合了與心理所有權和角色有關的理論： 1. 開發一種對矛盾共享新概念的多維測量。 2. 通過以下方式研究矛盾共享對服務提供者共享經驗和服務結果的影響 I．將所有者-共享者角色張力作為一種潛在機制，將矛盾共享的影響引導至服務結果。 II．測試一個矛盾共享與角色張力之間的倒 U 形關係。 3. 揭示改變這種矛盾共享對角色張力的曲線效應的條件（供應商、客戶和平台特徵）。 4. 檢查角色張力對客觀和主觀服務結果的影響。 該提案代表了在 CC 環境中開發矛盾共享結構的第一次嘗試。採取同行服務提供商的觀點也有助於更全面、更細緻地了解 CC 中的價值共創過程。我們的結果為在其他相關背景下研究和採用矛盾共享提供了新方向。我們還對所有者-分享者角色緊張的心理機制提出了新的見解。參與 CC 的各方如果想要妥善管理 CC，就必須注意矛盾分享對角色張力的曲線效應及其可以減弱的條件。

12501322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501322.value: In this proposed research, we investigate the effect of corporate tax incentives on bank financial reporting choices. Specifically, we propose to examine the effects of changes in bank income tax rates on the timeliness of bank loan charge-offs. Timely write-off of delinquent loans allows banks to maintain a healthy balance sheet and enables investors to better assess bank risk and uncertainties. However, the decision to charge-off delinquent loan involves considerable judgement and discretion, and verification is costly to regulators. Despite the regulatory guidelines and the tax rules that align the timing of loan charge-offs with regulatory objectives, both anecdotal evidence and academic research suggests that banks do not appear to adhere to the regulatory guidelines and write-off bad loan on a timely manner (Liu and Ryan 2006). In light of bank regulators’ concern about banks do not charge off delinquent loans on a timely manner, a natural question to ask is how policy can be designed to improve the timeliness of charge-offs. In addition to generating fiscal revenue, tax policies are often used by governments to induce taxpayer behavior, such as effort, spending, and innovation. In this proposed research, we examine a potential benefit of aligning the tax deductibility of loan losses with loan charge-offs to improve the timeliness of loan charge-offs. To study our research question, we develop an empirical framework to measure loan charge-off timeliness, an area that received little attention from prior research. To our understanding, our proposed research is the first to empirically measure the timeliness of loan charge-offs. In addition to our main research question, we are interested in the potential moderating effects of the incentives of two important stakeholders of banks: the IRS and bank regulators. Considering the opposing incentives of the two regulators, our second and third research questions focus on the two cross-sectional predictions: (i) the effect of state tax rate increases on accelerating charge-offs is more pronounced when the bank is subject to low enforcement level from the IRS, who have an incentive to deter overstating charge-offs for tax deduction purposes, and (ii) the effect of state tax rate decreases on delaying charge-offs is more pronounced when banks are subject to more lenient regulation. These cross-sectional analyses enhance the identification of a tax effect and highlight the significance of regulators in affecting banks’ response to tax incentives. 在此提議計劃中，我們旨在研究公司稅務激勵對銀行財務申報選擇的影響。具體來説，我們計劃研究銀行所得稅變化對貸款衝銷及時性的影響。及時衝銷拖欠貸款有利於銀行維持一個健康的資産負債表，同時也讓投資者能夠更好地評估銀行的風險及投資不確定性。然而，衝銷拖欠貸款的決定涉及大量的主觀判斷以及斟酌。對監管機構來説，核實衝銷的準確與及時性的代價也相當高昂。雖然存在有關的監管條例以及相應的稅收條例，大量的事實與研究証據表明，銀行似乎並沒有嚴格地遵守相關條例並及時地衝銷拖欠貸款（Liu and Ryan 2006）。鑒於銀行監管機構對銀行是否及時衝銷拖欠貸款的關注，一個自然而然的問題是我們應該如何製定政策從而能夠改善衝銷拖欠貸款的及時性。除了産生財政收入，稅收政策常常被政府用於引導納稅人的諸如投入，精力和創新的行爲。在這個研究計劃中，我們嚐試研究將放貸損失的稅收減免與貸款衝銷相匹配所帶來的可能的效益以及這種效益對提高衝銷拖欠貸款及時性的影響。爲了研究這個問題，我們建立了一個實証框架以便更好地衡量被先前的研究廣泛忽略的衝銷拖欠貸款的及時性問題。據我們了解，我們的這一研究提議將是首次對衝銷拖欠貸款的及時性進行實証衡量。除了這個主要研究問題，我們也感興趣於其他兩方主要利益相關者（國稅局以及銀行監管機構）及其動機帶來的緩和作用。鑒於這兩類監管機構相悖的利益動機，我們進而研究以下兩個問題並主要注重於橫向比較研究。第一是我們希望研究當國稅局對誇大衝銷金額以求稅務減免的銀行的執法力度較弱時，州稅增加對加快衝銷拖欠貸款及時性的效用是否更強。第二是當銀行受到比較寬鬆的監管條例約束時，州稅減少對於減慢衝銷拖欠貸款及時性的效用是否更強。這兩個橫向比較研究增強了對於稅收效果的識別，同時也強調了政策對於銀行對稅收激勵反應的重要性。

12501722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12501722.value: 時間規劃類型如何影響人們對環境負責的消費

12501722.label: Project Objectives
12501722.value: This project aims to provide evidence of how scheduling styles of event-time versus clock-time influences consumers’ responses to environmentally friendly products. Specifically, I propose that, compared with clock-time scheduling, event-time scheduling is more likely to boost consumers’ preference towards environmentally friendly products. In addition, this project considers intertemporal connectedness as an underlying explanatory mechanism for the proposed effect. That is, the connectedness or interdependence of activities highlighted in event-time scheduling (in contrast to clock-time scheduling) will activate a more general disposition to think about the past, present, and future as being interrelated. This perception has been termed “intertemporal connectedness” (Sarial-Abi et al. 2017). Intertemporal connectedness helps mitigate temporal discounting—the phenomenon that hinders the farsightedness needed to discover the longer-term benefits environmentally friendly products offer. The research also investigates boundary conditions for the proposed effect. That is, the effect is expected to diminish when an intervention for perceived intertemporal connectedness is employed (i.e., when study participants are temporarily made to feel intertemporal disconnectedness [see details in proposed Study 4A] or when they are exposed to marketing information highlighting intertemporal connectedness [see details in proposed Study 4B]). Theoretically, the study will contribute to the literature on responsible consumption (i.e., green consumption) by identifying scheduling styles—a consumer characteristic prevalent in everyday lives and consumers’ consumption journey, as a novel antecedent determining consumers’ preference for environmentally friendly products. Compared to other factors influencing consumers’ willingness to pay more for environmentally friendly products (e.g., consumer knowledge and value; Laroche, Bergeron, and Barbaro-Forleo 2001), scheduling style is a variable that marketers can directly adopt by incorporating it into their marketing mix (e.g., designing sales promotions in event-time or clock-time). This research also aims to contribute to the growing literature on scheduling style. First, despite the significance of scheduling style in consumption-related activities, it has been under-researched in consumer behaviour research. The current empiricism will be the initial effort to introduce scheduling style into the marketing domain, as well as link it to preference for environmentally friendly products—an important social sustainability issue. Second, the current work will contribute to the scheduling style literature by uncovering intertemporal connectedness as a new psychological consequence of scheduling style that drives consumers’ green consumption. Practically, this research aims to offer actionable recommendations for how to boost consumers’ willingness to purchase environmentally friendly products. In the proposed studies, I will design a series of methods that elicit event-time or clock-time scheduling, which marketers can use to influence consumers’ purchase intentions of environmentally friendly products. In a broader sense, this research will provide implications for public policy makers responsible for designing policy directed at increasing citizens’ responsible consumption behaviour and for managers focusing on long-term benefits of a decision rather than focusing on conventional short-term rewards. For example, given the important role CEOs play in corporate decision making, it can be an interesting direction to explore whether CEO’s scheduling style is associated with corporate engagements in business decisions or activities that lead to long-term benefits.

12501722.label: Realisation of objectives
12501722.value: Given the ubiquity of scheduling styles in consumers' daily lives, we decided to expand our research scope into a greater level of consumer perspective. Specifically, we not only look at how scheduling style impacts consumers' responses towards environmentally friendly products but also investigate its impacts on various consumers' socially responsible consumption behaviors (e.g., consumers' self-control behavior). We also added a company-perspective of looking at how CEO's adopting different scheduling styles impacts companies' sustainable behavior, to further enhance the interdisciplinary nature of this research project. We did not focus on self-control mechanism in the second project as such mechanism is not applicable when examining the effect of scheduling style on sustainable behavior. More importantly, as sustainable behavior is one dimension of an important concept of “corporate social respoinsibilty (CSR)” (i.e., environmental or social (E&S) responsibility dimension in CSR), we expand the research scope as how top managers’ scheduling styles impact company’s CSR engagement, to further enhancing the societal impacts and meaningfulness of this project. Consumer-perspective: Based on committee’s feedback regarding our mid-term report, I “focus on the core objective of showing that ‘compared with clock-time scheduling, event-time scheduling is more likely to boost consumers’ preference towards self-control’ and documenting the mechanism.” In a working paper, my collaborators and I investigate the impacts of scheduling style on self-control behavior directly (Tang, Huang and Su, working paper): Self-control dilemmas often experienced by consumers include vice versus virtue food choices, preferences for an immediate but small versus a delayed but larger premium in marketing promotions, and financial decisions involving credit card usage. This paper proposes scheduling style—an under-researched concept that describes how consumers arrange and organize activities along a time continuum—as a novel antecedent of self-control. Compared with clock-time scheduling (which allocates activities to separate timetable slots), event-time scheduling (which organizes activities on a to-do list according to the order in which they are to be completed) boosts consumers’ self-control. This effect is found across various consumption contexts. Furthermore, this effect is mediated by intertemporal connectedness, which is a perception highlighted in event-time scheduling but not clock-time scheduling. Thus, the effect diminishes when an intervention for perceived intertemporal connectedness was employed. This research not only makes strong theoretical contributions, it has important practical implications for the marketplace, where both consumer scheduling and self-control dilemmas are ubiquitous. Company-perspective: We have worked diligently to demonstrate how scheduling style influences company’s corporate social responsibility activities. In a working paper, which receiving Revision Invitation from Journal of Applied Psychology, a top business journal, my collaborators and I tackle on this important direction (Bu et al., working paper): Scheduling is about arranging and organizing activities along a time continuum. This study examines the implications CEOs’ scheduling styles pose for their strategic decisions in the social domain. Scheduling activities sequentially in event-time, rather than allocating each task a separate time slot in clock-time, involves viewing the arranged activities and their associated time slots as interrelated or connected rather than as separated or isolated, and subsequently poses psychology implications for holistic thinking tendencies rather than narrowly analytic thinking. The holistic thinking of CEOs with an event-time (clock-time) scheduling style will thus tend to consider more groups of sftakeholders over a broader range (narrowly consider a smaller group of stakeholders), leading to greater (less) engagement with corporate social responsibility (CSR). We predict a positive (negative) relationship between CEOs’ event-time scheduling (clock-time scheduling) and CSR. We further propose that the role of event-time scheduling (clock-time scheduling) becomes weaker (stronger) when CEOs have to focus on narrow and short-term issues due to various contextual factors—for example, when CEOs face increased performance pressures or when their firms face stronger competition. We develop a novel measure of CEO scheduling styles using a named-entity recognition (NER) algorithm, and validate it using human rating measures by surveys and measures from a supervised machine-learning categorizer (ML categorizer). Analyzing the language content of Q&A sessions given by 2,625 CEOs of U.S. listed firms during quarterly earnings conference calls from 2009-2018, we find strong support for our predictions. Additional data and mediation tests also provide convergent evidence.

Specifically, I propose that, compared with clock-time scheduling, event-time scheduling is more likely to boost consumers’ preference towards self-control (e.g., selecting environmentally friendly products).

That is, the connectedness or interdependence of activities highlighted in event-time scheduling (in contrast to clock-time scheduling) will activate a more general disposition to think about the past, present, and future as being interrelated. This perception has been termed “intertemporal connectedness” (Sarial-Abi et al. 2017). Intertemporal connectedness helps mitigate temporal discounting—the phenomenon that hinders the farsightedness needed to discover the longer-term benefits of self-control behavior (e.g, purchasing of environmentally friendly products).

The research also investigates boundary conditions for the proposed effect. That is, the effect is expected to diminish when an intervention for perceived intertemporal connectedness is employed (i.e., when study participants are temporarily made to feel intertemporal disconnectedness or when they are exposed to marketing information highlighting intertemporal connectedness.

Compared to other factors influencing consumers’ willingness to pay more for environmentally friendly products (e.g., consumer knowledge and value; Laroche, Bergeron, and Barbaro-Forleo 2001), scheduling style is a variable that marketers can directly adopt by incorporating it into their marketing mix (e.g., designing sales promotions in event-time or clock-time).

In the proposed studies, I will design a series of methods that elicit event-time or clock-time scheduling, which marketers can use to influence consumers’ purchase intentions of environmentally friendly products. 12501722.label: Major findings and research outcome
12501722.value: “Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city” (Proverbs 16:32). Self-control challenges are ubiquitous in daily life and have a profound impact on consumer well-being (Dzhogleva and Lamberton 2014; Newman and Brucks 2016; Wilcox and Stephen 2013). This research demonstrates how scheduling style—the way consumers arrange and organize activities in their daily life—influences self-control. Across seven studies, we show that event-time (vs. clock-time) scheduling highlights intertemporal connectedness, which in turn enhances self-control behaviors. We provide support for our proposed underlying mechanism related to intertemporal connectedness with both measurement-of-mediation (Study 3) and moderation-of-process approaches (Studies 4 and 5). The effect is demonstrated with both measured (Pilot Study) and situationally induced scheduling styles with various manipulation methods—such as recommendations or arguments in articles (Studies 1 and 3), consumers’ engagement in scheduling a travel trip (Studies 2 and 5), online promotional messages (Study 4), and in-store point-of-sale materials (Study 6). Moreover, the effect generalizes across various self-control situations—including BMI (Pilot Study), food choice (Studies 1, 5, and 6), financial decision (Studies 2 and 4), promotion preference (Studies 3). In sum, we provide convincing evidence for our proposition that reliance on event-time (vs. clock-time) scheduling facilitates self-control, and that this effect results from intertemporal connectedness being highlighted in event-time scheduling. By inducing scheduling style with marketing-related touchpoints and showing the effect on self-control with real behavioral consequences, we also demonstrate the strong marketing relevance and external validity of our proposition.

12501722.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12501722.value: This work opens up avenues for future research. First, future research could examine other consequences of scheduling style on consumer well-being. For example, intertemporal-related thinking has been associated with the feeling that one has a meaningful life (Sarial-Abi, Vohs Hamilton, and Ulqinaku 2017). In addition, self-control facilitates thinking, feeling, and acting in ways that promote a meaningful life (van Tongeren et al. 2018). Future research could examine whether event-time (vs. clock-time) scheduling leads to a stronger sense of the meaningfulness of life. Second, while the current research demonstrates the effect of scheduling style on self-control in various contexts (e.g., food choice, financial decisions, etc.), future research could further explore this effect in other important domains of self-control, such as sustainable consumption, where self-control decisions have greater social consequences and implications (Young et al. 2010). Finally, it will be intriguing to look at situational factors influencing consumers’ adoption of clock-time versus event-time scheduling, and maybe a possible reciprocal effect of self-control on scheduling style—does a consumption goal of being self-control to avoid hedonic consumption lead to adoption of event-time over clock-time or vice versa?

12501722.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12501722.value: In a clock-time scheduling style, people fit tasks into a predefined timetable with specified start and end time points. In contrast, in an event-time scheduling style, people schedule time according to the sequence of tasks to be completed, without predefined start and end points. Because event-time scheduling relies on task sequencing based on completion time, it highlights the interdependence among tasks and time, and ultimately decreases the time discounting of future benefits relative to current gratification. This research introduces to the marketing academic literature scheduling styles, opening a new avenue in a research field. It shows how time management influences self-control, offering a practical solution to growing societal challenges like overconsumption, overspending, and waste. For consumers, sequencing their to-do lists based on the innate demand of tasks rather than an external timetable can help foster self-control, as demonstrated in healthier financial and dietary habits. For marketers, leveraging event-time scheduling can promote services and products as non-indulgent and achieve better responsible marketing for consumer welfare. Furthermore, event-time scheduling can also be leveraged by policymakers and organizations to structure public health interventions like smoking cessation programs or workplace frivolous tasks, motivating finish and self-control behaviors in general for overall societal welfare.
