12502022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12502022.value: 需求對期權價格影響的不對稱性

12502022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12502022.value: The option market makers increases ( price increases (decreases) when retail investors buy (sell) them. By default, people would consider this demand impact to be symmetric; the magnitude of price increasing (decreasing) would be proportional to the amount of the security net purchased or sold. This project proposes that the demand impact on the options price is not symmetric. When investors buy options, the options market makers increase option prices. When investors sell options, the options market makers reduce the options prices, but with a much smaller magnitude. We argue this is because the margin requirement of naked short position reduces the leverage of the options, resulting in shorting options is not an optimal strategy for informed traders. 期權價格上漲（下跌）隨投資者買（賣）變化。這種需求對期權價格影響一般認為是對稱的。價格上漲（下跌）的大小和買（賣）的數量正比。 但我們認為需求對期權價格影響是不對稱的。當投資者買，做市商提高價格。當投資者賣，做市商降低價格， 但降低的輻度要比上漲的要小。原因是對做市商來說，當投資者買時，對沖更困難

12503222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12503222.value: 20世纪中国的技术进步基于书籍的测量

12503222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12503222.value: Existing measures of long-term technological changes using R&D expenditure, total factor productivity, patented inventions, or exhibition data from international technology fairs are plagued by problems such as measurement error, selection bias, and limited coverage of data. Data availability is particularly a problem for countries that only industrialized more recently, such as China. For example, the effective patent system was only established in China in 1985. In this research project, I propose measuring China’s technological changes over the last century at the aggregated and sectoral levels using the numbers of books, and research articles published in the field of science and technology between 1911 and 2000. This approach allows me to construct a reliable, direct measure of the technological changes that took place each year over a long period of time. I can also link this sectoral-level proxy of technological changes with industry- or product-level data on economic activity—including firms’ investment, employment, and trade—to study the impact of technology shocks on economic activity. Furthermore, using measures of technological advancement based on different sources of knowledge (international knowledge diffusion or independent invention), I can further compare the effects of technology shocks from different sources. Finally, I plan to collect data on patients after 1985 (since the issue of China's Patent Law) and compare them it against my book-based measure to verify the validity of the later. 经济学现存的关于长期技术进步的测量，如基于研发投入，TFP，专利数量，以及技术博览会产品等，都存在测量偏误，选择偏误，以及可得性有限等问题。特别是像中国这样的后发工业化国家，以上等测量基本都只有到近年数据方可得。本研究，基于Alexopoulos and Cohen (2009)文章的方法，试图使用专业类图书出版的数量构造一个关于中国过去一世纪 (1911-1990年) 技术进步的测量。 该研究不但能够提供一个长期对技术进步总体的，可靠的年度测量，更可以提供各个分支科技领域，乃至于不同的只是知识传播来源(国际技术传入或自主研发)，可比的技术进步测量，从而帮助我们理解不同的知识传播途径对于后发工业化国家科技进步的影响。

12504122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12504122.value: Prof Chang, Xin Dr Fu, Kangkang

12504122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12504122.value: 綠色基建指的是用以改善當地生態環境及應對氣候變化的基礎設施建設項目，例如可再生能源，低碳交通，水資源管理和衛生系統，污染控制，和生態系統服務等基建項目。根據經濟合作與發展組織的估計，為實現《巴黎協定》的減排目標，從現在起到2030年，每年將產生價值約6.9萬億美元的綠色基建需求。儘管綠色基建領域已展現出巨大的投資機遇，我們卻在如何彌補綠色基建投資需求和實際投資的資金缺口方面知之甚少。在這個項目中，我們旨在研究使用項目融資這一融資渠道的綠色基建項目，揭示這一類項目的決定因素，並量化它們的實際作用和環境影響。 項目融資是指“由一個或多個發起人為投資資本資產所設立的，具有法律獨立性的項目公司，其資金來自於無追索權債務和發起人提供的股本”。鑑於近期綠色金融市場的迅猛增長，基於綠色項目融資（一種主要以銀行貸款募集資金，專門用於環境保護和氣候友好型基礎設施項目的融資方式）的研究是非常重要和及時的。 我們採用一個囊括國際基礎設施建設項目的數據庫，以綠色債券原則為指導，根據募集資金用途標準來定義綠色基建項目。為了探討綠色基建投資的決定因素，我們首先將研究環境風險較高的城市是否更有可能啟動綠色基建項目。在融資方面，我們將研究採用“赤道原則”的銀行和具有環境、社會和管治偏好的機構投資者是否更有可能為綠色基建項目提供資金。對項目融資而言，貸款的償還是基於獨立且擁有單一用途的項目本身產生的未來現金流。我們將利用這一特徵，探討綠色基建項目專項資金這一因素對於項目融資的貸款合約，貸款的違約率，以及貸款回收率的影響。具體而言，我們將研究綠色基建項目是否具有較低的過渡風險、合規風險、代理成本，是否具有更可驗證的項目現金流，能否取得更有力的政府支持等，從而導致綠色項目融資的貸款擁有更優惠的合同條款，更低的違約概率，和更高的貸款回收率。此外，我們還將進一步研究綠色基建項目如何影響當地的環境和氣候。 綜上， 本項研究旨在揭示綠色基建項目融資的重要性，同時拓展對支持全球向綠色經濟轉型的融資工具的理解。此外，對作為國際金融中心的香港應如何推動綠色基建融資這一重要問題，本項目亦有重要的政策指引意義。

12613322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12613322.value: 香港－基督新教中文聖經的國際出版及發行中心，1951-1965

12613322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613322.value: Drawing on unpublished and underutilized archival materials from Hong Kong and overseas, this project aims to study how Hong Kong evolved from a city occupying a relatively peripheral position in the enterprise of Chinese Protestant Bible publishing and distribution in Republican China (1912-1949), into the world centre for such enterprise between 1951 and 1965, with a focus on the work of the Hong Kong Bible House (HKBH) and its overseas sponsoring Bible societies, namely the British and Foreign Bible Society (BFBS), the American Bible Society (ABS) and the National Bible Society of Scotland (NBSS). Its findings will enhance our understanding of Hong Kong’s historical role as a space facilitating the international movement of people, capital and ideas from a religious perspective in general, and Hong Kong’s contributions in the modern history of Chinese Protestant Christianity in particular. This project will consist of three parts. The first part will study the background of Hong Kong’s evolution into the world centre for Chinese Protestant Bible publishing and distribution. It will explore the favourable conditions for such evolution, and explain why the China Bible House (CBH), the de facto national Bible society in China, the governance of which the BFBS, the ABS and the NBSS were involved in, established an emergency office in Hong Kong but not elsewhere in 1949 in response to the political changes in Mainland China. The second part will study the development of the HKBH, the successor to the CBH’s Hong Kong emergency office, as a Chinese Protestant Bible publisher and distributor during the 1950s within the context of the Cold War geopolitical climate. It will particularly examine how the HKBH, capitalizing on its sponsoring Bible societies’ distribution networks in their home countries and overseas, developed a transnational Bible distribution network that helped support the religious life of Chinese Protestant communities outside Mainland China, such as those in Taiwan, Singapore, the United Kingdom and the United States, by ensuring a steady and reliable supply of affordable Bibles published by the HKBH to cater for their pastoral and evangelistic needs. The third part will focus on the HKBH’s history from 1960 to 1965, i.e. its final years as the sole agency jointly supported by the overseas Bible societies to work among Chinese-speaking people, examining why, despite its organizational changes, notably the independence of its branch in Taiwan, the HKBH’s significance to transnational Chinese Protestant Bible publishing and distribution was unaffected. 本研究將以尚未出版或得到充分利用的檔案資料為基礎，旨在透過考察香港聖經會（今稱香港聖經公會）及支持該會的海外聖經公會（英國聖經公會、美國聖經公會和蘇格蘭聖經公會）之聖經事工，探討1951至1965年間，香港如何由一個在基督新教中文聖經出版及發行事業上處於相對邊緣地位的城市，演變成為基督新教中文聖經的國際出版及發行中心。本研究將剖析香港具備哪些有利其地位轉變之條件，並探究香港聖經會如何在冷戰地緣政治處境中，以及在支持該會的海外聖經公會之協助下，發展跨國中文聖經發行網絡，向中國大陸以外的華人基督新教徒穩定可靠地供應在香港出版、價格相宜的中文聖經，以支持他們的宗教生活。此外，本研究也會檢視為何香港聖經會在其臺灣分會獨立後，仍能在基督新教中文聖經出版及發行事業佔有重要地位。本研究的成果將使我們加深對香港在近代中國基督新教史上的貢獻之認識，並從宗教面向進一步了解香港作為促進國際間人員、資金與意念流動的場所之歷史角色。

12613522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12613522.value: Prof Chan, Ka Shing Kevin Dr Choi, Anna Dr Hinz, Lisa Prof Ho, Rainbow Tin Hung Prof Lai, Hor-Yan Angel

12613522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613522.value: Background: The worsening trend in Hong Kong adolescents’ psychological health issues, such as depression and anxiety, is alarming. Overwhelming academic stress, sociopolitical instability and the global epidemic have diminished hope for adolescents and lowered their level of resilience in face of life challenges. Because limited public psychological services have little effect in resolving the growing crisis, cost-effective, community-wide, and alternative treatments, such as art therapy, are in great demand in dealing with emotional issues of youth in an early phase. Objectives: This proposed project as a randomized controlled trial (RCT) aims at testing the effectiveness of an art therapy (AT) program for improving signs of emotional issues of adolescents during the turbulent period. The project further investigates the mechanisms about how AT treats depression and anxiety by fostering resilience and hope. Design: 128 participants from secondary school will be recruited from a randomized controlled trial. Secondary school students aged between 11 and 14 who report mild to moderate symptoms of depression and anxiety with HADS total scores between 8 and 14 will be recruited and randomly assigned to either an AT group with eight 2-hour sessions twice a week or a control group with treatment as usual (TAU). The time spent on each batch of participants is approximately 20 weeks. Including the recruitment phase and the intervention phase each takes 4 weeks, the post-intervention data collection phase takes 8 weeks, and the final supplementary group meeting takes 4 weeks. Analysis: Intervention efficacy will be analysed using mixed-design analysis of variance (ANOVA) (within-subject factor: T0 to T3; between-subjects factor: AT vs. TAU) at four time-points: baseline, post-intervention, four weeks and eight weeks after the intervention. Hierarchical linear modeling (HLM) will be used to analyse the full range of trajectories across the four-time points. Expected results: The primary outcomes are expected that hope and resilience of participants will be improved while depression and anxiety will be reduced, and there will be individual differences in the treatment effects after the intervention. Secondary outcomes include significant mediated effects from the type of treatment to the slope factor of the outcome variables through the slope factor of the process variable. Conclusion: The study results with the established AT model will help build a Use-of-Art protocol. Through different stages of implementation, this model will be transferred to social workers as a sustainable service in a community-wide setting. N/A

12613622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12613622.value: 一項改善自閉症兒童同理心溝通的介入訓練：隨機對照試驗

12613622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12613622.value: Prof Han, Yvonne Ming Yee Prof Lau, Kwok Wai Dr Lui, Ming

12613622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12613622.value: 摘要 自閉症譜系障礙（ASD）與認知同理心，即對他人的感受和想法理解的困難有關。儘管有證據顯示，自閉症人士具有相對上健全的情感同理心，但他們在回應別人的情緒時，通常表現出不符合社會典型規範的口語表達、面部表情和身體語言 (Fletcher-Watson & Bird, 2020)。然而，同理心的溝通對於建立密切的人際關係至關重要。因此，大多數的自閉症人士在建立人際關係上存在困難。重要的是，近年的研究發現，孤獨感是預測自閉症人士的精神健康問題（比如焦慮和抑鬱）的一個重要指標 (Schiltz et al., 2020)。 由於同理心溝通可有助於社交人際關係的建立，進而改善精神健康，本研究旨在探究同理心溝通訓練對自閉症兒童的有效性，及對於他們的社交生活、精神健康方面的影響。文獻顯示，儘管目前有許多旨在改善自閉症兒童情緒認知的訓練項目，但仍然缺少針對自閉症兒童同理心溝通方面的訓練。有研究顯示，部分運用心智理論和遊戲介入（如早期丹佛模式）的干預，能有效地促進同理心的回應(Dawson et al., 2010; Holopainen et al., 2018)。然而，這些研究中，許多都是單樣本或樣本量很小的研究。 本研究將會以實驗方法和充足的樣本量來檢驗同理心溝通干預訓練的有效性。干預中訓練員將運用視覺指導框架來教導同理心的回應，利用視頻模式的反饋來改善參與者在與人談話時表達同理心的口語回應和提問。為評估干預的效果，本研究將會採用多種評估方法，包括觀察參與者在對話時同理心的回應、量度參與者同理心情緒引發的膚電反應，父母評估參與者同理心的報告，和參與者在故事任務中的口頭回應。干預訓練一年後，研究員將進行後續評估，以瞭解該干預對參與者的社交人際關係和精神健康的長期影響。我們希望自閉症兒童通過學習與他人溝通時運用符合社會規範的口語表達同理心，改善自閉症兒童的社交生活和身心健康。

12614422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12614422.value: 和解及其怨憤：在德國、北愛爾蘭和西巴爾幹半島對尋求正義和真相的壓抑

12614422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12614422.value: In his seminal work, Civilisation and Its Discontents (1930), Sigmund Freud challenges the near-universal espousal of civilisation (die Kultur) as a virtue and social process, while ignoring the great costs and sacrifices that such a project demands. The over-suppression of deep-seated human needs renders the otherwise humanity-serving endeavour a source of unnecessary suffering for those who “fail” to be civilised. The “discontent” (das Unbehagen) or dissatisfaction with such a condition is thus expressed as an earnest call for the reform of civilisation. In the past three decades or so, there has also been a sustained effort to promote “reconciliation” among historical enemies around the globe, not the least by the European Union, whose self-identity as a peacebuilder and model reconciler in regional conflicts has been buttressed by the Nobel Peace Prize of 2012. Yet, there has also been growing resentment among those – not the least within Europe itself – directly affected by the project of reconciliation, whose needs for justice and for truth have time and again been sacrificed in the name of peace and mercy. Like the “uncivilised”, the unreconciled are subject to social pressure to let go or to feel the guilt imposed upon them for “blocking” society from moving forward. As they say in Northern Ireland, “Reconciliation is a dirty word” (McEvoy et al. 2006). Such discontents and resentments with regard to political reconciliation and their sources are the subject of the proposed four-year project. Built upon its principal investigator’s previous and ongoing work on “coming to terms with the past” in different regional contexts, the project takes seriously the lingering “resentments” and “nasty unreconcilability” (Améry 1966: 115) of victims and survivors of atrocities committed in Europe in the last century. It investigates the nature of such resentments at political reconciliation in selected post-conflict European cases. Using process tracing and triangulated comparative historical analysis, the project examines the cases of reunified Germany, post-accord Northern Ireland and the disintegrated former Yugoslavia to theorise on “premature reconciliation” and “false reconciliation” as the twin mutations of the otherwise commendable enterprise that are responsible for lingering resentments of victims and survivors of past atrocities. In terms of impact beyond academic outputs (e.g. in International Journal of Transitional Justice, Journal of Peace Research), the project endeavours to contribute to the discussion on “reconciliation” in Hong Kong where the abuse and misuse of the concept have likewise aroused reservation (Shen 2020). 弗洛伊德在其名著《文明及其不滿》(Das Unbehagen in die Kultur, 1930) 中挑戰人們對文明 (die Kultur) 作為一種美德和社會過程的推崇，卻忽略了這樣的一個項目所需的巨大成本和犧牲。過度壓抑人類根深蒂固的需求使這場為人類效力的努力成為那些 “未成功” 變得文明的人不必要的痛苦來源。因此，對這狀況的 “不滿” (das Unbehagen) 就成為對文明改革的熱切呼求。 在過去約三十年的時間裹，亦有一股堅持不懈的努力去促進全球不同歷史仇敵之間的 “和解” (reconciliation)，當中不可或缺的，是歐盟的努力。2012 年的諾貝爾和平獎進一步強化了歐盟作為地區和平建設者和 “和解模範” 的自我身份認同。然而，那些直接受到和解項目影響的人 –– 包括身處歐洲的這些人 –– 也越來越不滿，因為他們對正義和真相的需求一次又一次地在和平與慈愛的名義中被犧牲。與 “未文明” 的人一樣，“未和解” 的人也感到社會壓力要放手，否則便要因 “阻礙” 社會前進而感到加緒於其身上的罪疚感。正如在北愛爾蘭有人說：“和解是一個骯髒的詞”。 這種對政治和解的不滿和怨憤及它們的根源正是本四年研究項目的主題。此項目建基於其首席研究員之前和正在進行的、針對 “面對過去” (coming to terms with the past) 在不同區域背景下的研究工作上，認真看待二十世紀在歐洲犯下的暴行的受害者和倖存者揮之不去的 “怨憤” (resentments) 和 “不可修和性” (unreconcilability)。它聚焦三個在歐洲的後衝突個案，研究這種對政治和解的怨憤的本質。這研究項目以過程追蹤法和三角比較歷史分析法，考察統一後的德國、簽訂和平協議後的北愛爾蘭和解體後的西巴爾幹半島，以建立理論解釋為何 “未成熟的和解” 以及 “假和解” 作為本應值得推祟的政治和解的雙生突變，是受害者和倖存者的怨憤根源。就學術成果以外的影響而言，此項目致力於為香港關於 “和解” 的討論作出貢獻 –– “和解” 概念的濫用和誤用同樣導致這地方的人們對和解存疑。

12615622.value: 將人類活動和其他自然或社會現象量化（或轉換成數據點）的技術，促成了各式各樣的科技。數據化這種現代科技趨勢，將我們生活的多方面變成了電腦化數據，可以在記錄和分析後提煉出新見解或創建新的價值。由於數據科技在當代社會中廣泛應用，各種技術的自動化、普遍性、連接性和欠缺透明度，往往在實現社會公義方面帶來獨特的道德挑戰。這些技術大大提高了預測和控制公民活動的可能性，並讓國家和私營公司有能力對人口進行特徵側寫和分門別類。數據在經濟層面也日益重要。新的資訊科技和以人工智能驅動的演算法可以將與人類和社會相關的數據轉化為利潤。數據越來越被視為寶貴的經濟資產。最後，由於數碼工具為市民提供了很多主動參與政治和社會的機會，數據化也改變了公民參與的條件和格局。然而隨著社交媒體平台興起並成為主要資訊來源，使用者也較傾向使用那些少與持不同觀點用戶互動的社交媒體網絡。 在此背景下，本研究計劃將探討在社會數據化下實現社會公義所需要的條件。與大多以演算法說明公義的研究不同，本研究計劃將採用關係平等主義的觀點。此觀點認為平等的價值不完全取決於資源分配，而是在於社會關係的質素。由於數據化正從根本改變著社會以至我們與其他人之間的社會關係，因此，研究所採用的關係方法將為數據化引伸的關鍵問題提供重要見解。本研究計劃將回應以下研究問題。我們應該如何理解數據化下人們對社會公義的訴求？數據化有否造成壓制性的社會關係？數據化和人工智能驅動的演算法是在加強還是窒礙個人自主？向互聯網公司或社交媒體平台提供個人資料的人有沒有被（錯誤地）利用？我們需要哪些公民權利與義務，才能在日益數據化的社會中提供應有條件，確保每位成員都享有平等的社會地位？

12615922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12615922.value: 糾正網絡不實資訊：基於事實與基於邏輯的糾正策略干預

12615922.label: Project Objectives
12615922.value: To respond to the worldwide threat of misinformation by putting forth an educational strategy that empowers individual user correction against online misinformation. Despite policy and legislative attention put to combat misinformation, we are dealing with a multi-layered problem that demands multiple solutions to be implemented simultaneously. However content control and information restriction measures are insufficient and short-term. A bottom-up strategy is needed to educate citizens as active participants in developing a healthy digital information environment for everybody. We expect that building skills in correction will give individuals the tools to address false information. With these tools, they can expand the reach of authorities and algorithms and correct misinformation as it spreads. To explore layering-multiple intervention strategy by combining traditional media literacy training with corrective strategies training and corrective exposure. Specifically, the current research will test empirically: a) the effectiveness of training on misinformation correction on participants’ likelihood of offering correction, the kind of corrective action made, the perceived strength of it, as well as participants’ self-efficacy in getting quality media information; b) the effectiveness of fact-based vs logic-based strategies of training on misinformation correction; and c) the effectiveness of misinformation correction on reduction of related misconceptions and its enduring effects. To study corrective strategies in a non-Western context where extant literature has mainly focused on corrective efforts in the U.S. and to pave way for further research in comparing the effect of corrective strategies across different cultures given that misinformation is a global phenomenon. Through various impact activities, to raise Hong Kong public's awareness on the importance of a healthy digital information-environment, and to take initiatives in promoting individual users’ responsibility to reject low-credibility information, to be able to report or correct misinformation in order to stop the spread of it. To provide bi-weekly research supervision to up to 5 undergraduate research interns (non-credit bearing). To engage 15 university undergraduate student volunteers in intergenerational impact activities supporting vulnerable public’s (i.e., elderly) engagement in the digital information environment.

12615922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12615922.value: 研究指出，大部分糾正網絡不實資訊的行為皆由官方發起或由電腦演算法帶動。個人用戶遇上不實資訊時，往往不知道如何應對。不實資訊在緊密的網絡年青社群中尤為廣傳。因此，我們探討一個讓年輕人識別並糾正網絡不實資訊的教育案方。 現行教育以媒體素養訓練方式介入，旨在建立一個廣博基礎，著重培育使人們能分辨資訊究竟是不實還是可靠的能力。這些預防性策略是否能讓人們在識別不實資訊後作出進一步的糾正行為，則未獲實證支持。 針對不實資訊的糾正策略研究主要集中於以事實為本的糾正方式，如：事實查證。但現有研究指出，以事實糾正的方式並不能直接取締人們思想上根深蒂固的情意聯繫；而以邏輯為本的糾正方式則提供判斷事實真確性的思維準則，可改善人們對正確資訊的接納程度。 本研究旨在填補以下空白：供提實證數據去了解兩個糾正策略的應用及成效。探討學習本身對提升糾正行為的動機以及減低錯誤信念的形成的成效。 研究一將測試一個多層次多重性介入策略的成效：針對參加者的糾正行為和動機，在傳統媒體素養訓練中加入糾正策略訓練（三個測試狀況分別為以事實為本、以邏輯為本及對照組別）及擴闊糾正經驗（兩個測試狀況分別為有接觸糾正經驗及沒有接觸糾正經驗）。研究二將採用隨機實驗設計比較三個組別，以測試糾正不實資訊對減低錯誤想法的果效。 研究研影響包括：釋出「開放教育資源」、舉辦跨代活動以及發佈研究結果。預期糾正不實資訊的訓練會帶來整體性的正面影響，而以邏輯為本的糾正策略更為有效。有關訓練可為傳統媒體素養課程加入嶄新的元素。研究結果將為本地相關研究提供新的方向，同時亦提供一個教育方案，為公民社會建立一群具識別並糾正網絡不實資訊的能力的年輕人。

12616222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12616222.value: 中國頁岩氣開發的甲烷排放量化評估

12616222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12616222.value: Prof Li, Jianfeng Prof Lo, Tek Sheng Kevin Dr Lu, Xi

12616222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12616222.value: 本研究將構建針對中國頁岩氣開發過程中甲烷排放的定量評估方法，並在此基礎上對中國最大的頁岩氣生產區塊，涪陵和長寧頁岩氣田的甲烷排放進行量化評估。通過收集采氣區域内不同時空的甲烷濃度原始數據，來估算生產區不同生產環節的排放强度。本研究將首次編制中國頁岩氣開發的甲烷排放清單，以填補頁岩氣行業現有的排放數據空白，提高對其全球變暖效應爭議的認識，並為中國的甲烷減排行動提供科學依據。 中國擁有世界上最大的頁岩氣資源，但在頁岩氣資源的開發過程中可能產生嚴重的環境影響，特別是甲烷洩漏。甲烷是一種強效溫室氣體，在20年的時間尺度上其全球變暖潛能值是二氧化碳的84-87倍。甲烷排放可能發生在整個頁岩氣生產和供應鏈的任一個環節。來自石油和天然氣行業的甲烷排放使全球大氣中的甲烷濃度達到創紀錄的水平。頁岩氣生產過程中產生的甲烷排放是否超過了其燃燒過程中低碳排放所帶來的效益，學界一直存在激烈的爭論，且研究結果存在很大爭議。這對頁岩氣資源的未來發展提出了重大挑戰，尤其是在中國，中國承諾到2030年達到溫室氣體排放峰值。然而，由於中國缺乏甲烷監測和報告的相應法律法規，目前尚無可用的甲烷排放數據來源，這對制定低碳戰略和採取減碳行動構成了重大阻礙。 本研究旨在：(1)通過收集原始數據，建立中國頁岩氣生產甲烷排放數據集；(2) 編制頁岩氣開發行業的甲烷排放清單；(3)評估頁岩氣開發的溫室效應。涪陵和長寧是中國頁岩氣開發最重要的兩個生產區塊，佔中國頁岩氣總產量的71%以上。使用車載移動監測設備對區域内甲烷的濃度進行監測，通過反演高斯擴散模型估算區域内不同污染源的排放强度。 研究團隊已與這兩個產區的頁岩氣生產作業者建立了聯繫，並於2020年11月在涪陵完成了初步的實地考察並獲得了初步數據，在此基礎上對研究方案和方法進行了修訂和完善。

12616922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12616922.value: 晚年抑鬱症是老齡化社會中常見的健康問題。晚年抑鬱症與長者生活質素差、高疾病發病率（如：身體殘疾、認知衰退）以及死亡風險（如：自殺）相關。相對於輕中度抑鬱者，重度抑鬱者可能出現較嚴重的精神病症狀（如：妄想）並且有更高的死亡率和殘疾率。所以， 對輕中度抑鬱症狀進行及時有效的治療能夠顯著地預防抑鬱症狀惡化或是更嚴重的精神病症狀，這對輕中度抑鬱長者尤為重要。 傳統的中等強度持續訓練 (MICT)（如：八段錦氣功）已被證明能夠有效地預防和緩解長者的抑鬱症狀。然而，在以往的MICT項目中，患有心理疾病的長者參與度及依從性較差。高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）作為一種新型的鍛煉方式在近年逐漸流行起來。HIIT包含反覆進行的高強度訓練及隨後的恢復性訓練。眾多實證研究表明，HIIT對於促進長者的體適能及心理健康方面有著與MICT相類似甚至更好的干預效果。並且相比MICT，HIIT的時間效率更高、安全風險更低、更加有趣以及參與者依從性更高。 目前HIIT對抑鬱長者健康益處的實證研究相對缺乏。本研究目標在於評估一項16周的HIIT干預方案對改善香港患有輕中度抑鬱的長者之抑鬱症狀及其他健康相關指標方面的有效性。本項目將招募9個社區長者中心的144名輕中度抑鬱長者。採用集群隨機化，參與本項目的長者中心將被隨機分到三個組別中的任意一組，包括HIIT組、MICT控制組（八段錦氣功）、以及非運動控制組（康樂工作坊）。首要觀測指標為客觀評估的抑鬱症狀，即唾液皮質醇。次要觀測指標包括主觀報告的抑鬱症狀、體適能、睡眠品質以及生活質素。觀測指標測試時間點為：干預前、干預後以及干預完成3個月後的跟進測試。我們預計相比於其他兩個控制組，HIIT組的長者在抑鬱症狀及其他健康相關指標上會獲得更多的改善效果。研究結果將對未來心理疾病的預防和治療產生影響，對促進香港長者健康老齡化具有重要意義。

12617022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12617022.value: 老年人閱讀中文句子時的網膜近側加工之眼動追蹤研究

12617022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12617022.value: Dr Pan, Jinger Dr Yan, Ming

12617022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12617022.value: The eye-tracking technique is a popular tool in psycholinguistic research of reading. By monitoring where the readers look at and when their eyes move as they read, researchers can infer the underlying reading processes. It is shown that readers obtain information for reading not just from the fixated word in foveal vision, but also from words in the parafovea. The region of effective vision in reading comprehension is called “perceptual span”. Readers can extract various information from parafoveal vision, including word form, pronunciation, and meaning (Yan et al., 2010). Most reading research has been conducted with alphabetic scripts. Given the unique features of logographic Chinese, it is not surprising that some reading processes are different across scripts (Tsang & Chen, 2012). One interesting difference is the effect of aging. While old English readers (> 65 years) make longer forward movements (saccades) and skip words more often than young readers, old Chinese readers make shorter forward saccades and skip words less often. The opposite pattern has been explained by the higher visual complexity of characters and the absence of spaces between words in Chinese, which make parafoveal processing particularly challenging for old Chinese readers because of their visual and cognitive declines associated with normal aging (Wang et al., 2018). Although this explanation makes intuitive sense, there are no existing studies that directly examine “how much” and “what kind of” information is available in the parafoveal processing of old Chinese readers. The proposed project aims to fill this research gap. The perceptual span size and the type of information extracted in the parafovea will be directly examined, and compared with young readers (university students), in two eye-tracking experiments that adopt the moving window paradigm and boundary paradigm. Specifically, readers will be shown different amounts and types of parafoveal information to see how the manipulations influence reading speed and performance. In addition, given that the lack of inter-word spaces and high visual complexity of characters may contribute to the inefficient parafoveal processing of old Chinese readers, an experiment will also test whether providing colour cues to word boundaries, which is helpful to beginning Chinese readers (Pan et al., 2021), can help improve parafoveal processing of old Chinese readers. Theoretically, the proposed project will help understand how visual and cognitive declines influence Chinese reading. Practically, it will provide insights in improving reading performance of old Chinese readers. 眼動追蹤是研究閱讀之心理加工的一種常用方法，透過監測閱讀時，讀者眼睛注視的地點和時間，研究人員能推論背後的加工過程。研究顯示，讀者不但能從注視點的網膜中央區提取字詞的資訊，也能從網膜近側提取資訊，此一閱讀時的有效視力範圍稱為「知覺廣度」。前人指出，讀者能從網膜近側提取各種資訊，包括字形、字詞的讀音和意思 (Yan et al., 2010)。 過往的閱讀研究大多在英文等字母文字進行，而中文採用語素文字體系，有眾多字母文字沒有的特點，引致各種獨特的閱讀加工過程 (Tsang & Chen, 2012)。其中一個有趣的分別，就是年老的影響。在英文閱讀中，65歲以上的老年人，常比年輕讀者作出更長的向前眼動，他們也更常跳過一些詞語不讀，可是，老年的中文讀者，卻比年輕人作出更短的向前眼動，也更少跟過字詞不讀，換言之，中英文的情況正好相反。這個差異，可能與中文字的視覺複雜程度和中文詞語沒有用空間分隔有關，這些中文的特徵，使老年讀者因視力和認知能力下降而受限的網膜近側加工更受挑戰 (Wang et al. 2018)。雖然此說法有其合理性，至今卻未有研究直接檢視老年中文讀者的網膜近側加工能提取「多少」和「甚麼」訊息。 此提案旨在有系統地研究此前人未及的題目，眼動實驗一和眼動實驗二採用移動窗口範式和邊界範式，直接探討老年中文讀者的知覺廣度和他們在網膜近側能提取的訊息種類，並把結果和年輕讀者作比較。在實驗中，不同量和種類的訊息會呈現到讀者的網膜近側，藉此測試這些實驗操縱怎樣影響閱讀速度和表現。此外，基於前人指出，中文詞語間沒有空位分隔並有較高的視覺複雜程度，可能減弱老年中文讀者的網膜近側加工效率，眼動實驗三故而探討，利用顏色提示中文詞言的分隔，能否改善老年讀者的的網膜近側加工 (此方法已獲Pan et al., 2021 證明能幫助初學中文者)。 在理論層面，此研究提案能促進了解視力和認知能力下降與中文閱讀之關係。在實用層面，也能提示如何改善老年中文讀者的閱讀表現。

12617322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12617322.value: 粵語話語虛詞的意義，功能，與用途：帶有教學材料的研究專著項目

12617322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12617322.value: 這項擬議的研究將描述和定義二十個最常用的粵語話語虛詞，這二十個虛詞不包括在先前的研究中已經定義的七個話語虛詞。哪些是最常見的虛詞將使用自然發生的語言數據進行量化確定。 這些話語虛詞將使用 Besemeres 和 Wierzbicka (2003: 3) “一般研究話語標記的模型”。本研究的結果將作為一本書。除了描述和定義話語虛詞，本書將提供每個虛詞在話語中的使用的示例。將創建一個免費的在線資源來補充這本書，建議它如何可以使用並提供課程計劃和教學材料與自然數據的剪輯（參見 Su 和 Tao，2018）。這種教學資源將有益於粵語教師和學習者。 這研究的理論含義與話語虛詞表達各種語用意義的特色有關。例如，句末虛詞咩 (me1) 將一個陳述變成一個表達驚喜的問題。它的意思相當於英語中的一個高升調：你隻狗死咗咩？（“Your dog died?!”）。這項研究將擴展我們對粵語話語虛詞語義的知識，揭示它們的意義如何與其他語言中的話語虛詞（或語調）的意義交集。這將告訴我們語言如何表達說話者的理念，認識論情態和說話者立場，亦是一個間接的方式幫助我們理解。語調是語言的一個非常難以學習的方面（例如，Ladd，2008；Wakefield，2020）。這項研究將非常提高被定的粵語話語虛詞的數量，并且這些定義很容易了解。有利於教師和學習者，與想要作對比分析的語言學家。 社會影響來自為粵語學習者提供有用的資源來理解並適當使用極難獲得的話語虛詞（Yip & Matthews，2000）但仍然必需要學習因為它們在日常對話中無處不在。這將特別有利於需要學習流利粵語，以便融入社會並在工作環境取得成功。

12618322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12618322.value: 以社區為本的智慧社會學習方式達致零碳目標: 三大亞洲城市(京都、首爾、香港)的跨文化研究

12618322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12618322.value: Dr Cheung, Darren Man-wai Prof Cheung, Lewis Prof Choi, Byron Koon-kau Dr Chun, Kwok Pan Dr Chung, Him Prof Fogg-Rogers, Laura Dr Kim, Hana Prof Lo, Alex Dr McLellan, Benjamin Dr Siu, Alice Dr Woo, Karen L.Y. Prof Yun, Sun-Jin

12618322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12618322.value: 世界各國需要實現碳中和和深度脫碳來避免發生災難性的氣候影響。然而，現行的政策及市場運作並不足以有效實現進取的碳中和目標。公民參與在實現碳中和目標這個議題上日趨重要。在智能電錶和家庭儲能系統等智慧能源技術的支持下，家庭可以從被動的終端用戶轉變為能源轉型的積極參與者；他們可以在家庭、社區的節能和生產可再生能源方面發揮積極作用。然而，在不同國家、城市和地方社區環境下，人類和智慧科技的互動形式及其影響各不相同。家庭如何及在什麼條件下與社區、公用事業和政府建立積極關係，從而實現由終端用戶主導的智慧能源轉型？ 本研究項目以智能終端用戶主導的能源轉型為主題，以跨領域的比較案例研究方法進行分析。本研究涉及三個東亞城市（京都、首爾和香港）共150 個家庭，旨在探索如何將智慧社會學習過程擴展至社區節能和太陽能應用上，從而徹底改變住戶的能源應用模式。本研究將透過跨文化角度建構概念框架，並嘗試概念化終端用戶主導的能源轉型的社會學習機制。在智能電網發展的背景下，本研究將社會學習定義為通過社交互動進行學習，並強調以下三方面： (i) 由數據啟發的構想（能源終端用戶期望能夠及可以做什麼）； (ii) 實驗（在社區環境中嘗試創新的地方倡議）；及 (iii) 協商性參與（例如權衡利弊後做出理性的決定）。本研究將透過跨文化角度比較三個城市的公共價值觀、社會規範和家庭能源習慣，探索能源文化在塑造和阻礙終端用戶智能社會學習中的重要性。 本研究項目為期30個月，本研究將透過跨領域、綜合研究方法來構建數據集，以測試三個城市中每個案例社區的家庭能源行為變化。本研究將結合應用程式數據（以智能用電感應器為基礎的大數據分析）、碳代幣奬勵計劃和社區參與活動進行定量及定性分析。定量數據包括實時電力消費量、太陽能發電和碳代幣交易的數據；定性數據包括家庭訪談、構想研討會、協商性對話和焦點小組會議。

12618422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12618422.value: 如何鑄造古代中國的雙音鐘：設計與製造技巧

12618422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12618422.value: Dr Fang , Qin Dr Liu , Haiwang Prof Qin, Xu Mr Wang , Lihua Mr Wilson, Keith Dr Yiu, Josh

12618422.label: Project Objectives
12618422.value: Studying the history of ancient Chinese bells by revealing the mysteries of casting two-tone bells Searching for archaeological evidence that bells were replicated Exploring how ancient Chinese bells could have been replicated, with the assistance of 3D technology Conducting simulation experiments to cast bells of various sizes
rows: Studying the history of ancient Chinese bells by revealing the mysteries of casting two-tone bells
Searching for archaeological evidence that bells were replicated
Exploring how ancient Chinese bells could have been replicated, with the assistance of 3D technology
Conducting simulation experiments to cast bells of various sizes

12618422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12618422.value: Ancient Chinese bells are possessed of a distinctive acoustic characteristic: a single bell can sound two different tones. An entire set of these bells, a chime-bell set, sounding tones at fixed intervals, has a musical range and flexibility that might be equivalent to an ensemble. These special features, along with the sophistication of musical theories as evidenced by the inscriptions on the bells are exciting yet mysterious discoveries in world music history and archaeology. This project proposes to examine how the two-tone bells were cast and investigate their design and technical origins. The two-tone quality was not achieved by calculation or devising an innovative bell design; even today this would be very difficult. We hypothesize that the two-tone bells were made by replicating existing bells with already-known tones. The first two-tone bell might have been a chance discovery. But to cast numerous two-tone bells necessitated bell casters’ experience and knowledge of existing bells with known tones. The casters managed to control the sizes, shapes, decorative patterns, and acoustic properties of the bells over years of collecting bells and replicating them. We have identified bells from the Henan area, which are highly similar in size, shape, and tones. These bells might have been replicated, which would have involved various types of knowledge and technical know-how. We will use Henan bells, along with other archaeologically excavated bells, to search for more bells of the same size, shape, and tones. We also will also conduct simulation experiments by casting bells of various sizes. By relying on the assistance of our partner foundries and modern 3D technologies, we will replicate existing bells from collections in museums and archaeological institutes to investigate how their size, shape, and decorative patterns impact the bell tones. We hope to create innovative methodologies and generate new data about the production techniques that were used to make ancient Chinese bells. 先秦時代中國的銅鐘很特別：一個鐘可以發出兩個音。一套編鐘，有固定的音程，其音域與自由度可以媲美現代的合奏樂。這些特點加上銅鐘上的銘文所顯示的成熟的音樂理論，是世界音樂史與音樂考古的謎團，使人疑惑，也令人為之着迷。 此課題意欲探討雙音鐘是如何製成的，其設計與製造技術源頭又在何處。雙音的技術不是靠計算出來的，也不是靠憑空想像、設計出來的——即使在今天也難以達成。我們假設新的雙音鐘是由複製具有已知雙音的鐘而來。第一個雙音鐘可能是偶然發現的。但鑄造越來越多的雙音鐘，則需鑄鐘匠人的經驗與知識，他們知道當時所存的雙音鐘。匠人要控制所鑄銅鐘的大小、形狀、紋飾，以及其音色特點，他們需要長年累月去收集與複製銅鐘。我們已辨認到某些在河南的銅鐘，具有排常相似的大小、形狀、音色。這些銅鐘可能是複製而來的，當中涉及諸多知識層面與技術。我們會利用這批河南的銅鐘，以及其它地方出土的鐘，去搜尋更多相似大小、形狀、音色的銅鐘。我們會設計模擬實驗，鑄造大小不一的銅鐘。我們會與合作夥伴與工場利用3D掃描技術，複製博物館與考古所的銅鐘，以探索銅鐘的大小、形狀、音色是如何變化的。我們希望可以提出一些新穎的方法，生成新數據，讓我們可以更進一步探討中國古代銅鐘的設計與製作技巧。

12619022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12619022.value: 未出版的 17 世紀法國大鍵琴音樂的數字版，和開放獲取資料庫

12619022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12619022.value: Recent studies by Bruce Gustafson (1990, 2018) and other scholars have greatly expanded the 17th-century French harpsichord repertory through newly-rediscovered manuscripts, adding not only new names of composers and musicians, but also new works and additional versions of known pieces. The scholarly discoveries have promptly led to the publication of facsimile and modern editions of music by Jacques Champion de Chambonnières, Jean Henry D’Anglebert, Jean-Baptiste Lully and other named composers. However, many works, including pieces composed and/or copied by Marc Roger Normand Couperin (1663–1734), more than 40 unmeasured preludes and many dances and non-dance pieces, remain largely inaccessible to modern musicians. Indeed, the repertory contained in sources rediscovered since 1990 remains a mystery to many modern harpsichordists, as the source information is currently scattered across numerous publications, including book chapters (Gustafson 2018, Chung 2019c), journal articles (Fuller 2000, Moroney 2005, Gustafson 2010, Chung 2020a) and websites (Gustafson 2007, Chung 2018b). The lack of modern editions and a single centralised source of reliable information has seriously impeded the performance and further study of this significant repertory. The proposed research will make 300 significant and previously unpublished pieces from recently rediscovered manuscripts accessible to musicians in a clear, modern format. We aim to reach a wider audience by publishing these pieces online rather than in conventional printed editions. We will include an introduction addressing the historical background of the manuscripts and what they add to the lineage of 17th-century harpsichord music, in addition to practical performance issues such as the relationship between notation and performance. New editorial policies will be tailored to this repertory, as the prescriptive nature of Urtext (lit. original text) editions is ill suited to most pre-1800 music and to the expectations of today’s increasingly sophisticated musicians. One innovative feature of this project is the provision of an online, open-access catalogue that will allow users to search pieces using a combination of criteria, such as names of composers and scribes, work titles, genres, keys, and other elements. This online resource will also provide access to up-to-date research by linking each piece to scholarly information, including the original source, concordances, facsimile editions and modern writings. The catalogue will include 3-5 sample facsimiles of each major scribe so that users can study the handwriting and other nuances of the original notation. Bruce Gustafson (Bruce Gustafson, 1990, 2018) 和其他學者近年通過新發現的手稿樂譜發掘不為人知的音樂家、作品及樂曲版本，大大擴充了既有十七世紀的法國古鍵琴曲目。他們的學術發現促成這些古樂的摹真本和現代版的出品，使Jacques Champion de Chambonnières, Jean Henry D’Anglebert, Jean-Baptiste Lully 等作曲家不少的音樂得以問世。可是，許多作品包括Marc Roger Normand Couperin (1663–1734) 所創作及/或抄寫的超過四十首無小節線前奏曲以及多首舞曲和其他類型的作品尚未出版以致現今的音樂家難以參閱。 尤其自1990年被重新發現的作品目前分散在各類出版物中，包括書章 (Gustafson 2018, Chung 2019c)、期刊文章 (Fuller 2000, Moroney 2005, Gustafson 2010, Chung 2020a) 和網頁 (Gustafson 2007, Chung 2018b)，由於這些樂曲未被編訂成現代版及系統化整理，現代古鍵琴演奏家無法進一步細讀並演奏這類珍貴的音樂作品。 擬議研究將以清晰、現代的格式呈現最近發現的手稿樂譜，讓音樂家可以參閱三百篇未被發表的重要作品。我們的目標是透過網絡而非傳統的印刷發佈這些作品來吸引更廣泛的受眾。除了探索記譜和演奏之間的關係等實際演奏問題外，我們還將介紹手稿的歷史背景以及它們對十七世紀古鍵琴音樂譜系的影響。此外，由於原典版樂譜 (Urtext) 規範式的建議大致不適用於公元1800年以前的音樂並且未能符合當今日益成熟的音樂家的期望，我們將會就這曲目制定新的編輯政策。 該項目的一個創新特點是有條理的網上開放訪問目錄，允許用戶使用組合單元搜索作品，例如作曲家和樂譜抄寫員的姓名、作品名稱、種類、調號等關鍵詞。這資料庫還將會連接每首樂曲與其相關的學術信息包括源本、各版本的對照、摹真本和現代著作，為用戶提供最新的研究資訊。該目錄將舉列每個樂譜抄寫員的三至五份摹真本以便用戶探究原稿的筆跡與細微的色彩。

12619222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12619222.value: 中國如何在新冠肺炎時代對世界發聲：中國在歐洲的政治宣傳與動員

12619222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12619222.value: Prof Ceccagno, Antonella Dr Mette, Thunoe Dr Tran Sautede, Emilie Dr Tseng, Yu-chin

12619222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12619222.value: 這個 GRF 項目是一項跨學科比較研究的第三階段，該研究調查中國如何對世界發聲。我們的先期研究(2020) 以及對中國推特外交的後續研究(2021-2022) 檢驗了全球宣傳/說服的競爭性敘事的出現，以及通訊的一般商品化如何讓地緣政治的言說變得更複雜。在國際關係、全球傳播與離散研究的交會點上，本提案旨在透過論證僑民與公眾外交宣傳的中心性，作出實證性與科學性的新發現。 近期關於僑民治理、政策和策略的文獻大量激增，反映了穿越國界、主動與海外僑民社群接觸的國家數量正在不斷增加，並藉此形塑了跨國關係。各國根據其政權的性質，帶著各自不同的目的，正直接把觸角伸向其海外公民。 透過我們對中國作為移民送出國，以及北京對歐洲和歐洲華人社群進行宣傳的個案研究，我們打算將威權僑民國家這個新穎想法加以概念化。我們的研究項目聚焦在雙重焦點：也就是將僑民送出國的國家(中國) ，以及接收僑民的歐洲國家。我們小心地選擇了七個歐洲國家，這些國家與中國和其他歐盟國家各有不同程度的交往，包括了捷克共和國、法國、德國、意大利、匈牙利、塞爾維亞和英國。 我們將研究的核心課題：『中國如何對世界發聲？』 分成四個探索的方向，各有其相應的研究方法： (1) 中國的宣傳如何描述這個黨國的看法、角色以及價值觀？ (2) 中國在新冠肺炎時代的僑民策略包含哪些內容？ (3) 中國僑民對中國在境外擴展影響力，有何看法與反應？ (4) 歐洲民眾與國家對中國的全球政治宣傳，有何看法與反應？ 利用我們在前兩個研究項目中收集到的大量數據，我們會使用計算機資料分析，以及社會建構主義的言說分析法，再加上更多透過案頭研究與田野質性訪談以收集傳統質性資料，這些訪談針對歐洲不同層次的華人華僑， 包含了對中文社群媒體的探究，尤其是微信群。 最終來說，本項目會加深公眾對中歐緊張關係下歐洲華人移民的理解，也能為歐洲與中國的決策者提供現成可用的專業知識。

12619422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12619422.value: 如何改變人的時代：二十世紀中葉日本馬克思主義知識分子對烏托邦的討論

12619422.label: Project Objectives
12619422.value: To provide a detailed account of representative Japanese Marxist intellectuals’ critical discussions of utopia. To extract diverse expressions of utopian desire as transformative practices in an individual’s own time, based on Hani’s and Hanada’s discourses. To identify how intellectual currents carrying utopianism and Marxism intersected in mid-twentieth-century Japanese intellectual discourses. To articulate commonalities and differences between Hani’s and Hanada’s critical engagement with utopian ideas. To elucidate the implications of Hani’s and Hanada’s work in relation to contemporaneous social and political contexts.

To extract diverse expressions of utopian desire as transformative practices in an individual’s own time, based on Hani’s and Hanada’s discourses.
To identify how intellectual currents carrying utopianism and Marxism intersected in mid-twentieth-century Japanese intellectual discourses.
To articulate commonalities and differences between Hani’s and Hanada’s critical engagement with utopian ideas.
To elucidate the implications of Hani’s and Hanada’s work in relation to contemporaneous social and political contexts.

12619422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12619422.value: Over the course of the modern period, utopian thinking has played a crucial role in intellectual history. Since the end of the Cold War, utopia has often been dismissed as an abstract fantasy or even a nightmare that leads to totalitarianism. Still, after the official end of the ideological rivalry with the dissolution of the Soviet Union, the absence of a clear alternative system made the idea of utopia an object of scholarly investment. In this context, revisiting historical discourses on utopian thought and measuring their potential has become an important task for contemporary scholarship. This research project will contribute to this effort by examining Japanese intellectuals’ discussions of utopia in the mid-twentieth century and exploring utopia’s transformative potential for global academic discourse. The proposed research will focus on the works of two Japanese Marxist intellectuals, Hani Gorō (1901–1983) and Hanada Kiyoteru (1909–1974). Both worked actively as leading intellectuals in mid-twentieth-century Japan and shared some important features such as a revolutionary stance, mastery of contemporary theory in humanities/social science, and historical interest in Japanese modernity and the European Renaissance. Through the interwar and wartime periods, both wrote texts that provided critical perspectives on past utopian literature and utopian projects. It was not unusual for Marxists to criticize utopianism, as Engels was critical of utopian socialism, but what was perhaps most important was that Hani and Hanada did not completely repudiate utopian thought, instead examining its potential by exploring alternative social spaces in reality or focusing on utopian “desire” itself. Recent utopian studies tend to direct our attention to a utopian “impulse” or “desire” that seems omnipresent in everyday life and culture, an impulse that is deemed irreducible to a deliberate utopian program. Based on such insights, my project will reveal the alternative desire-driven visions of utopia offered by Hani and Hanada. By revealing a new example of dialogue between Marxism and utopianism from Japan, this research will enrich the existing literature in utopian studies and global intellectual history. Furthermore, the project will carefully situate Hani’s and Hanada’s discussions within the historical development of utopian thought in Japan as well as ongoing utopian/transformative movements. In so doing, this project will also confirm the role and significance of Hani’s and Hanada’s work on utopia in Japanese social and cultural history. 烏托邦思潮在現代思想史所扮演的角色舉足輕重。自冷戰結束，烏托邦此一概念被貶抑為虛妄的幻想，甚至是導致極權興起的惡夢。儘管如此，自蘇聯解體引致的意識形態對壘終結起，因缺乏明確的意識形態系統，烏托邦成為了具學術潛力的概念。在這脈絡下，對烏托邦思想歷史論述的再探討，以及對其潛力的評估，就變成現今學術界其中一個重要的任務。本項目將透過評估二十世紀中葉日本知識分子對烏托邦的討論，並探討「烏托邦」此一概念在全球學術論述下的可塑潛力，為上述學術任務作出貢獻。 本項目以兩名日本馬克思主義知識分子：羽仁五郎（1901－1983）及花田清輝（1909－1974）的著作為重心。兩者皆於二十世紀中葉，作為知識分子領袖，活躍於日本文壇。此外，兩者具有不少關鍵的共通點，如支持革命、精通現代人文及社會科學理論，並在歷史研究範疇上，皆偏好日本現代性及歐洲文藝復興。在戰前及戰時期間，兩者皆以其文章，為過去的烏托邦文學及烏托邦計劃提供批判性的視野。馬克思主義者批判烏托邦主義的情況並不罕有，如恩格斯就曾批評烏托邦社會主義。但最為重要的是，羽仁五郎及花田清輝並非完全揚棄烏托邦思想。他們反而透過探索現實中的另類社會空間，或者集中研究「對烏托邦的欲望」本身，從而對烏托邦的潛力作出評價。 現今有關烏托邦的研究讓我們關注於日常生活及文化中無處不在的，對烏托邦的衝動，或是欲望——那是一股被認為終將導向烏托邦建設的衝動。根據上述洞見，本項目將揭示屬於羽仁五郎及花田清輝的，一個另類的、由欲望所驅動的烏托邦視野。本項目將透過揭示日本「馬克思主義——烏托邦主義」學術對話的新例子 ，拓展現存有關烏托邦主義及全球思想史的研究。再者，本項目將慎重地研究羽仁五郎及花田清輝在烏托邦議題上的討論，於日本烏托邦思想發展史，以至現今烏托邦運動的定位，從而確立上述兩者之烏托邦相關著作於日本社會、文化史的角色及重要性。

12619422.label: Realisation of objectives
12619422.value: Objective 1: To provide a detailed account of representative Japanese Marxist intellectuals' critical discussions of utopia. In my article, I examined the representative Japanese Marxist intellectuals' discussions of utopia. Through my analysis, I provided the detailed description of critical discussion of utopia. For example, I traced Hanada's critical discussion of the pursuit of utopian space to escape from difficult socio-economic situations. While he recognized the difficulty of such an attempt, he did not completely reject it. In the end, I clarified that he tried to evaluate the potential of utopian desire. Objective 2: To extract diverse expressions of utopian desire as transformative practices in an individual's own time, based on Hani's and Hanada's discourses. My study explored diverse ways Japanese Marxist intellectuals discussed the subject of utopia. In the case of Hani's discussion, city space emerged in his discussion as an important subject of utopia. In the case of Hanada's discourse, the subject of drifters in the past was examined as a way to articulate the expressions of utopian desire. They examined these subjects in order to envision the possible transformation of society or intervention into existing discourses. Thus, my study revealed various expressions of the utopian desire in relation to transformative practices. Objective 3: To identify how intellectual currents carrying utopianism and Marxism intersected in mid-twentieth-century Japanese intellectual discourses. In my research, I focus on the discourses of leading Japanese Marxist intellectuals in the mid-twentieth century. However, when I selected them, I particularly chose the discourses that incorporated the subject of utopia. In doing so, I was able to show how the discussion of Marxism in Japan was related to that of utopia. In this way, my methodology allows me to explore the intersection of the intellectual currents carrying utopianism and Marxism. Objective 4: To articulate commonalities and differences between Hani's and Hanada's critical engagement with utopian ideas. In my analysis of intellectual discourses on Marxism and utopianism, I pay attention to their commonalities and differences. First of all, Hanada and Hani shared the broader historical perspective, which emphasized materialistic view of history and saw the trajectory of world history based on development stages. With this perspective, they both found the important utopian practices in the age of the Renaissance. However, how they examined them is different. In the case of Hani, he emphasized the role of utopian space, though he was critical of its role in Japanese history. However, Hanada was more critical about the function of space. Rather he paid attention to the role of temporality or disruptive intervention into the space itself. In this way, my study articulates both commonalities and differences of their discourses. Objective 5: To elucidate the implications of Hani's and Hanada's work in relation to contemporaneous social and political contexts. The contemporaneous social and political contexts are important to understand Hani and Hanada's work. When they started examining the history of the Renaissance and discussing the subject of utopia, there was a serious oppression of liberal/Marxist discourses by the Japanese government and expansion of the Japanese empire. I revealed that their historical research was a way to intervene into the ongoing situation by exploring the critical perspectives. Therefore, my research paid attention to historical contexts of their work and clarified political implications of their work.

12619422.label: Major findings and research outcome
12619422.value: Through my research, I examined Japanese Marxist intellectual discourses on the subject of utopia in the mid-twentieth century. These discourses shared the similar materialistic view, there were different approaches toward the subject of utopia. Though Marxists tended to be critical of utopian ideas, I revealed that some Japanese Marxist intellectuals kept exploring the radical potential of the utopian desire. On the one hand, a famous Marxist historian Hani Goro traced the history of cities as utopian space and located the radical potential in its development. On the other hand, a Japanese cultural critic Hanada Kiyoteru critically examined the utopian narrative and found its potential in the figure of drifter. Furthermore, my research also discovered that such Marxists' discussions had significant implications in relation to contemporaneous politics. I particularly examined those intellectuals' relationship with ongoing war and oppression of radicals and clarified how their historical studies were closely related to their attempt to criticize the ongoing policy and produce alternative discourses. In this way my research revealed the complicated relationship between the subject of utopia and Marxist intellectual discourses in Japan and its important political implications during the mid-twentieth century. I shared these findings through my conference presentation and publication.

12619422.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12619422.value: In regard to the further development of this project, first of all, I plan to share my research outcomes with a broader audience through conferences or the courses I am teaching at university. Based on the feedback I will receive from such activities I will try to expand my perspective and write additional research paper in the future. In that research paper, I also want to integrate the analysis of other contemporaneous Japanese intellectual discourses on the subject of utopia and expand the perspectives of my current project. In doing so, I will be able to not only identify the universal aspect of Japanese Marxist discourses on the subject but also articulate their uniqueness more clearly.

12619422.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12619422.value: My research project examines Japanese Marxist intellectuals' discussions of utopia in the mid-twentieth century and explores their transformative potential. Currently, the absence of a clear alternative system made the idea of utopia an object of scholarly investment. In this context, revisiting historical discourses on utopian thought and measuring their potential has become an important task for contemporary scholarship. My research pays attention to the fact that Japanese intellectuals such as Hani Goro and Hanada Kiyoteru wrote texts that provided critical perspectives on past utopian literature and utopian projects in the mid-twentieth century. My research explores their works and reveals that they address the potential of utopianism by exploring alternative social spaces in reality or focusing on utopian “desire” itself. By revealing a new example of dialogue between Marxism and utopianism from Japan, this research contributes to enrich the existing literature in humanities and social science.

12619622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12619622.value: 数码時代數學教師評估素養的促進與阻礙因素：工具的開發與驗證

12619622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12619622.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof DeLuca, Christopher Prof Leung, Allen Yuk-lun Dr Zhao, Maggie Yue

12619622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12619622.value: 数码技術的進步為教師提供了許多改進教育評估的機會。然而，許多教師缺乏通過数码或非数码評估工具衡量和支持學生學習的能力。當2019冠狀病毒病疫情迫使学校暂停面授並推動在線教學時，這一弱点越發明顯。因此，通过調查以了解教師的評估素養並確定数码時代評估實踐的促進和阻碍因素（前因）至關重要。然而，系統性回顧研究顯示幾乎沒有證據能支持當前的評估素養度量工具的有效性或可靠性。此外，大多數研究忽視了評估素養中的数码成分，而其他側重於数码評估的研究则忽略了傳統評估方法（例如觀察和問答）的價值。此外，沒有任何已發布的工具能夠度量教師通过整合数码和非数码評估工具（数码時代的評估素養或 ALDE）以评估和支持學生學習的能力。 由于数学科是大多數教育系統的必修科目，本研究項目專注於该科目。通過開發和測試一份度量工具來調查数码時代數學教師的評估素養 (M-ALDE)，同时研究當地教師的 M-ALDE剖面圖，並探索和檢驗 M-ALDE 的促進和阻碍因素。以我們在理論框架中對 M-ALDE 的定義為基礎，基於對專家和資深教師的焦點小組訪談的定性分析，我們將開發潛在的測試題目、讓數學專家檢查它們的結構效度（substantive validity）和內容效度（content validity）、並對在職教師的焦點小組訪談進行定性分析以改進測試題目。然後我們為每個 M-ALDE 維度的題目識別背後的潛在因素，測試所識別的因素的單維性，確定每個題目的質量，區分 M-ALDE 維度（知識、實踐和情感），並確定M-ALDE在隨機子樣本上的專家評估與教師自我報告之間的關係（外部效度）。以此，我們可以驗證新度量工具的信效度。 基於 600 位教師對該度量工具的作答，我們將調查他們的 M-ALDE 剖面圖。同時通過焦點小組訪談，調查M-ALDE的促進和阻碍因素。然後我們將使用定量數據檢驗定性分析中確定的促進和阻碍因素與 M-ALDE 的關係。 簡而言之，本研究項目將為 M-ALDE 提供一份度量工具。研究人員可以將其用於相關研究，例如 M-ALDE 如何促進學生學習。關於當地教師的 M-ALDE 剖面圖及其促進和阻碍因素的研究結果將有助於深入了解當地教師的 M-ALDE，幫助利益相關者提高在職教師的 M-ALDE，並最終改善學生的學習。

12619722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12619722.value: 飲食傳統：一個驢皮明膠（阿膠）視覺的社會史

12619722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12619722.value: Donkey hide gelatin, or ejiao 阿膠, has been part of the Chinese apothecary for over 2,000 years. In Chinese pharmacology, ejiao is a powerful tonic that restores the vigour of the sick and improves the vitality of the depleted. More recently, it has come to be hailed as a modern-day panacea. Historically, genuine ejiao was extremely scarce. Limited by the need to use skins from a particular donkey breed and water from a specific well in Shandong province, ejiao was a luxury accessible only to the gilded few. But in China’s recent age of prosperity, ejiao has experienced exponential growth in demand and production. Donkey breeds from all over the world have entered supply chains, and ejiao has become independent of geographical specificity. This has led to a severe shortage of donkeys in the Global South that threatens to extinguish the animal as a species, comparable to the effects of trafficking in pangolin scales or rhino horn. The decimation of donkeys not only threatens biodiversity but also drastically impacts on the human communities that live and work with them. Once a matter of small herds and artisanal workshops in a remote part of Shandong province, this currently unfolding story is a case study in the disruptive use of a species – a rupture that has had devastating effects on some of the world’s poorest communities. The story of donkey gelatin is also firmly interlinked with China’s rise as a global power, most recently with the infrastructure provided by the Belt and Road Initiative launched in 2013. My project seeks to illuminate the historical constellation of technologies, cultures of bodily care, medical conceptions, market forces, infrastructure, global capital and neoliberal ideologies that led to the current upsurge in demand and production of ejiao, and it seeks to trace the global entanglements and social lives of ejiao as a complex commodity. It will provide a synthetic account of ejiao from a cultural history, ethnography, and science and technology studies perspective, while also addressing the larger issues of loss of biodiversity and the commodification of life that arise from the exponential increase in the production and consumption of ejiao over the past 20 years. 阿膠在二千多年來都是中醫藥的其中一部分。在中醫藥中，阿膠是一個強效的滋補品，被認為能夠使病者恢復元氣，提高虛弱者的活力。直到近年，更被認為是現代的靈丹妙藥。在歷史的長河裡，真正的阿膠極為稀缺。由於製作阿膠需要特定的驢皮和山東省特定一口井中的井水，阿膠是一種極少數人才能用的奢侈品。然而，在中國最近的繁盛時代，阿膠的需求與產量都經歷著極高的增長。當世界上不同種類的驢都進入了供應鏈，阿膠的製作不再受到地域限制。這導致了驢子在全世界面臨嚴重短缺，與穿山甲和犀牛角貿易帶來的影響相當，驢子現面臨著種族滅絕的危機。驢子的滅絕不僅威脅著生物多樣性，更對與驢子工作和生活的人類社會造成極大影響。驢子的市場價格飆升導致驢子的數量急劇下降，並刺激了遙遠國家偷獵和盜竊工作用的驢子。阿膠的故事曾經是山東偏遠地區的小驢群和手工作坊的故事，而現在以此展開的，是一個破壞物種的案例研究——這種破壞對於世界上一些最貧窮的社區造成了毀滅性打擊。簡而言之，驢皮明膠是一個世界歷史的故事。 本研究計劃旨在闡明歷史中，科技、身體護理的文化、醫學觀念、市場的力量、基礎建設和資本的觀念如何到時現時對阿膠的需求和產量，以及追溯阿膠作為一個商品的社會生活及其如何與全球糾纏一起。本項目以文化史、民族學、科技技術的視角，對阿膠進行綜合描述，與此同時，會解答過去二十年間，因阿膠需求和產量的增加而導致生物多樣性的喪失和生命商品化的現狀。

12620422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12620422.value: 古代中國和羅馬的監控思想

12620422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12620422.value: “Ideologies of Surveillance in Ancient China and Rome” proposes to investigate the theories behind population enumeration and surveillance in the ancient world. The project will be primarily concerned with the early China, from the Warring States through Han periods (5th century BCE – 2nd century CE), though it will also make comparisons with the Roman Republic and early Roman empire (6th century BCE – 2nd century CE). The project will discuss theorizations of population surveillance in early China and Rome, and, through a case study, how these theories were practically impelemented. This discussion will engage with theories of historical and contemporary surveillance. The project contends that, despite the limited technological capabilities of ancient states, they nevertheless attempted to monitor and regulate the behaviour of their subjects. The ancient states implemented practices to enumerate their populations, to make records of their property and dependents, and to assess their liability for taxation, as well as labour and/or military service. In early China, this registration was performed both by officials who were required to annually update the lists of subjects, and by the people themselves, who were legally required to report any changes to their status, such as a birth or death in the family. In Rome, citizens were likewise required to report themselves, their dependents, and their property every five years to the censors. While there are few extant records of these census exercises, evidence suggests that both states were gathering large amounts of data on their population. These systems of population registration were not merely for statistical purposes, nor simply to evaluate the tax and military/labour liabilities of the subject body. Rather, these practices of registration were also closely connected to practices of behaviour modification: the “linked liability” lian zuo 連坐 system in China, and the censors’ duty to regulate the morals of the population (regimen morum) in Rome. While surveillance is generally considered to be a modern phenomenon, reliant on modern technologies, “Ideologies of Surveillance in Ancient China and Rome” argues that there was a surveillance mentality in the ancient world, which sought to monitor and regulate the population, despite the lack of advanced technologies. In so doing, the project seeks to connect the ancient world to later histories of surveillance, and to the field of contemporary surveillance studies. By examining surveillance practices and theories in societies lacking modern technology, we can understand some of the principles that underlie contemporary surveillance. “Ideologies of Surveillance in Ancient China and Rome” proposes to investigate the theories behind population enumeration and surveillance in the ancient world. The project will be primarily concerned with the early China, from the Warring States through Han periods (5th century BCE – 2nd century CE), though it will also make comparisons with the Roman Republic and early Roman empire (6th century BCE – 2nd century CE). The project will discuss theorizations of population surveillance in early China and Rome, and engage with theories of historical and contemporary surveillance. The project contends that, despite the limited technological capabilities of ancient states, they nevertheless attempted to monitor and regulate the behaviour of their subjects. The ancient states implemented practices to enumerate their populations, to make records of their property and dependents, and to assess their liability for taxation, as well as labour and/or military service. These systems of population registration were not merely for statistical purposes, nor simply to evaluate the tax and military/labour liabilities of the subject body. Rather, these practices of registration were also closely connected to practices of behaviour modification. While surveillance is generally considered to be a modern phenomenon, reliant on modern technologies, “Ideologies of Surveillance in Ancient China and Rome” argues that there was a surveillance mentality in the ancient world, which sought to monitor and regulate the population, despite the lack of advanced technologies. In so doing, the project seeks to connect the ancient world to later histories of surveillance, and to the field of contemporary surveillance studies. By examining surveillance practices and theories in societies lacking modern technology, we can understand some of the principles that underlie contemporary surveillance. 「古代中國和羅馬的監控思想」旨在調查古代世界的人口統計與背後的監控思想。本研究項目以古代中國為本，涵蓋戰國時期到漢代（約公元前5世紀 - 公元2世紀），並輔而羅馬共和國和早期羅馬帝國時期（約公元前6世紀 - 公元2世紀）作比較研究。本項目將探討古代中國和羅馬的人口監控思想，並檢示歷史上和當代的監控研究理論。 本項目認為，儘管古代國家的可用技術有限，它們仍然試圖監控和規範其臣民的行為。古代國家往往透過人口登記，掌握臣民的財產和家屬資訊，並據此評定他們的課稅、力役和兵役。但這些措施同時也是古代國家監控、規範和矯正臣民行為的方法，並非純粹的數字統計或稅務評估。 雖然監控通常被認為是一種依賴新科技的現代現象，但本研究項目認為欠缺現代科技的古代世界，亦有相當深入的監控思想與心態。本項目旨在將古代世界與其後的監控歷史聯繫起來，分析古代社會的監控理論與實踐，以理解當代監控理論原則的一些歷史源流。

12620722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12620722.value: 華人基督徒的跨國宗教交流及其社會文化影響：以世界華人福音事工聯絡中心（1974-2021）為例的研究

12620722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12620722.value: Because Chinese Protestant Christians exist in large numbers in many parts of the world, they assure that Chinese Protestant Christianity a transnational phenomenon. The complex relational matrix establishes Chinese Protestant churches as a complex nexus of relationships developing in transnational religious and socio-cultural exchanges. This project seeks to investigate the characteristics of transnational exchanges of Chinese Protestant Christians and their socio-cultural impacts through the history of The Chinese Coordination Centre of World Evangelism (CCCOWE). Based in Hong Kong, The CCCOWE is arguably the first and—with 75 district committees globally—the most developed transnational and interdenominational Chinese indigenized Protestant Christian organization. CCCOWE informs and shapes the religious and cultural life of millions of overseas Chinese Christians. It alleviates theological and ancestral local divisions of overseas Chinese Christian communities. It also initiates Christian social participation in moral and environmental issues that many Chinese have challenges negotiating. With its activities and ministries, the organization has evolved into a significant religious, political, and social force in the communities that it serves; emerging as a power center that exerts influence other than the traditional denominations and local church councils. The ministries of CCCOWE articulate and redefine the very understanding of “Chinese” identity in dozens of emerging global communities. It contributes additional complexity to the concept of Protestant Christian and Chinese identity. This project will explore four key questions 1. What are the religious and socio-cultural factors that led to the founding of CCCOWE? 2. How do Protestant Chinese churches located in different countries connect and interact with each other through CCCOWE, and what are the distinctive characteristics of these relationships? 3. How do religious discourses that develop within the CCCOWE circulate among Chinese churches and what is the pattern of the flow of transnational and transcultural dissemination, influence, and evolution? 4. What are the characteristics of the relationships between religious discourses, Chinese identity construction and socio-cultural impacts of the ministries of CCCOWE? By employing a historical analysis focused on various published and unpublished documents, oral histories, and ethnographic interviews conducted in major global centers of Chinese Protestantism, my work will provide a fresh, comprehensive, and novel overview and an innovative analytic assessment framework that will allow us to better understand the religious transnational influences of Chinese Protestant diaspora and its recent growth. The project will result in three peer reviewed articles on the transnational interaction of Chinese Christians and a comprehensive monograph on CCCOWE. 華人基督新教教會及信徒遍佈世界不同地方，令華人基督教信仰本身便是一種跨國現象。複雜的宗教、族群與地域關係令華人基督教信仰的跨國宗教和社會文化交流，發展成複雜關係紐帶。本研究項目旨在通過世界華人福音事工聯絡中心（CCCOWE）的歷史，探討華人基督新教的跨國交流的特點及其對社會文化的影響。 世界華人福音事工聯絡中心總部設在香港，它可以說是第一個並且最高度發展的華人基督新教跨國和跨宗派組織。它在全球擁有 75 個地區委員會，推動並塑造數百萬海外華人基督徒的宗教和文化生活。它減低了海外華人基督教群體的神學和祖籍籍貫分歧，還促進他們的社會參與，使他們應對道德和環境問題的挑戰。憑藉其活動和各地區委員會，該組織已發展成為重要的宗教、政治和社會力量，影響不同地方的教會和華人群體。 它的工作也重新定義了不同地區華人基督徒的“中國人/華人”身份理解。它使新教基督徒和華人的身份認同更形複雜。 本項目將探討四個關鍵問題 1. 導致世界華人福音事工聯絡中心成立的宗教和社會文化因素是什麼？ 2. 分佈在不同國家的華人基督教會如何通過世界華人福音事工聯絡中心相互聯繫和互動，這些關係有哪些的特點？ 3. 世界華人福音事工聯絡中心的宗教論述如何形成及在華人教會內傳播？其跨國和跨文化傳播、影響和演變的模式是什麼？ 4. 世界華人福音事工聯絡中心各部委的宗教論述、華人身份建構和社會文化影響之間的關係有什麼特點？ 通過對各種已發表和未發表的文獻、口述歷史和在全球主要華人基督新教群體進行民族志訪談的分析，本研究將提供一個全面的概述和分析框架。這將使我們能夠更好地了解華人基督新教信徒的宗教跨國影響。該項目將產生三篇關於中國基督徒跨國互動的同論文和一本關於世界華人福音事工聯絡中心的綜合專著。

12621022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12621022.value: 新出土戰國版《詩經》：《安徽大學藏戰國竹簡》之詩歌研究 新出土戰國版《詩經》：《安徽大學藏戰國竹簡》之詩歌研究

12621022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12621022.value: The investigators will embark on a fascinating thought experiment: how were old songs of the “Guó fēng” (Airs of the States) experienced by people in the Warring States period (453–221 BC)? The investigators will continue their work with the newly discovered Ānhuī University Manuscripts and place their readings within the larger framework of studies of the early Shījīng and pre-Hàn hermeneutic traditions. The project aims to show that, for Warring States communities with expertise in the tradition, writing out songs later collected in the Shījīng would not be for memorisation, but rather for interpretation, and for seeking, creatively and flexibly, to provide semantic fixity to the already fixed aural forms of the songs. 本項目將以一引人入勝的問題作為切入口：戰國時期(453–221 BC)的人們如何傳頌《詩經》中的國風？該研究將最新出土的《安徽大學藏戰國竹簡》置於漢代之前《詩經》經學傳統的大背景下進行解讀，旨在闡明：對於戰國時期受經學影響的士人而言，記錄並收集於《詩經》中的篇目並非為了留存記憶，而意在為固定音樂表達形式的詩義尋求創造性、靈活性的詮釋。

12621322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12621322.value: 滅絕之譯：博物館在關於滅絕事件及生態危機展示中的翻譯、展覽實踐及參觀者參與

12621322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12621322.value: Prof Christie, Stuart Colin Fraser Dr Hung, Ruth

12621322.label: Project Objectives
12621322.value: To delineate a typology of exhibitionary approaches and practices used in exhibiting and “translating” extinction events in the greater Chinese museum context To conduct a cross-cultural comparison of such practices between museums in greater China, and museums in the Anglo-American milieu To explore the visitor experience and assessment of such exhibitions through the analysis of data-sets of online reviews To understand how visitors from different linguacultural backgrounds use bi- or multilingual and multimodal resources to construct meaning through their interactions with exhibits in the museum space To examine the extent to which the use of translation in bi- or multilingual exhibitions reflects epistemological and museological differences in the presentation of extinction, and how this impacts on the visitor experience To contribute to the emerging discussion, in the international museum milieu, around questions of visitor engagement in the exhibiting of extinction events, and to situate those questions in a cross-cultural perspective To provide an opportunity for public engagement, in the form of a symposium and public workshop, with a view to encouraging debate around issues of translation, display and culturally distinct understandings of extinction
rows: To delineate a typology of exhibitionary approaches and practices used in exhibiting and “translating” extinction events in the greater Chinese museum context
To conduct a cross-cultural comparison of such practices between museums in greater China, and museums in the Anglo-American milieu
To explore the visitor experience and assessment of such exhibitions through the analysis of data-sets of online reviews
To understand how visitors from different linguacultural backgrounds use bi- or multilingual and multimodal resources to construct meaning through their interactions with exhibits in the museum space

To examine the extent to which the use of translation in bi- or multilingual exhibitions reflects epistemological and museological differences in the presentation of extinction, and how this impacts on the visitor experience

To contribute to the emerging discussion, in the international museum milieu, around questions of visitor engagement in the exhibiting of extinction events, and to situate those questions in a cross-cultural perspective

To provide an opportunity for public engagement, in the form of a symposium and public workshop, with a view to encouraging debate around issues of translation, display and culturally distinct understandings of extinction

12621322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12621322.value: This project explores questions of translation in the visitor understanding of extinction events and ecological crises as presented in museum exhibitions. Museums are important centres not only for education, but also for the presentation of debates around sometimes challenging topics. Extinction events, ecological crises, loss of biodiversity and species, and the effects of human progress on the environment, represent a cluster of closely related topics that pose important questions for museum curators. These include how existing collections can be reinterpreted to highlight extinction, how contrasting modes of interaction such as the mourning of loss and the call to constructive action can be balanced in the museum environment, as well as how visitors can be engaged more actively in the exploration of extinction and in the co-creation of museum exhibits on the subject. Despite this, researchers have largely approached these issues from a monolingual, monocultural perspective, thus neglecting how differences of language and cultural background shape the experience of extinction-themed exhibitions. The project approaches these issues through the lens of translation, viewing the museum exhibition space as a “translation zone”, a space in which many forms of translation take place. These include translation at the broad level of cultural representation (exhibitions “translate” cultures into concrete interpretations), and at the interlingual level, where two or more languages are translated to aid different language-speaking visitors in making sense of the exhibition message. At the level of the visitor experience, translation of a different kind happens: museums have the power to change visitors, making them reconsider their existing assumptions and how the issues presented relate to them. The project begins with a landscape study of museums and exhibitions of extinction and ecological crisis, mapping the scope of museum coverage of this theme across museums in greater China and the Anglo-American museum sector. It aims through this to provide a comparative understanding of the ways in which the exhibition of extinction has been approached, as well as how far these presentations give access to non-local visitors through the provision of multilingual translated resources. It then proceeds to a consideration of visitor experiences of such exhibitions, first at the broad level, through the analysis of online visitor reviews. In the second part of the project, two case studies of visitor experience are undertaken with a view to understanding in more depth how visitors to extinction exhibitions differently engage with multilingual resources in the production of meaning. 本研究項目將探討博物館有關滅絕事件和生態危機展覽中涉及參觀者觀感的各種翻譯問題。博物館不僅是重要的教育場所，同時也可以針對某些尖銳問題展示各種爭議。滅絕事件、生態危機、生物多樣性及物種的喪失、人類進步對環境的影響等，構成了密切相關的一組主題，向博物館策展人發出了重要的提問，例如：如何對現有藏品重新解讀，以突出滅絕的主題？在博物館環境中如何平衡地应用不同的互动模式，如哀泣失去和呼喚積極行動之間的平衡？如何讓參觀者更加主動參與，探索滅絕主題、成為展覽的共創者？目前，研究者大多從單一語言、單一文化的角度開展這些問題的研究，忽視了不同語言、不同文化背景對滅絕主題展览觀感的影響。 本研究項目將從翻譯的視角切入對這些問題的探討。研究把博物館展覽空間視為一個“翻譯区”，在這個空間發生著多種形式的翻譯，其中既有廣義的文化表征层面（展覽把文化“翻譯”成具體的解讀），也有語際翻譯層面，展覽文本通過翻譯以兩種或更多的語言展示，以助不同語言的參觀者理解展覽的信息。在參觀者體驗這一層面，又發生著另一種翻譯：博物館具有改變參觀者的力量，促其反思自身既有的想法，思考展示在其面前的事物與自己的關係。 研究首先全面概覽有關滅絕和生態危機的博物館及展覽， 以釐清大中華地區及英、美博物館對這些主題的展示面貌。概覽的目的是通過比較來了解滅絕主題的展覽手法，以及這些展覽如何通過多語言翻譯資源，為非本地參觀者提供展覽信息。研究項目的第二部分首先對網上參觀者評論進行分析，探討此類展覽參觀者的總體觀感；其次，將開展兩項參觀者觀感案例研究，以便更為深入地了解滅絕展覽參觀者如何利用多語言資源並藉此生成意義。

12622622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12622622.value: 全球化，經濟制度，權力關係：包容性增長在東亞

12622622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12622622.value: Dr Kang, Nahee Dr Kong, Tat Yan Dr Siu, Yu Kwan Kaxton

12622922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12622922.value: 腦中的生產線？中國農民工在零工經濟中的選擇與經歷

12622922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12622922.value: The rise of the gig economy has created a labor market characterized by a prevalence of freelance work, such as food delivery and ride-hailing. Proponents claim that gig jobs bring the masses flexibility and autonomy. Critics see it as a new form of capitalist exploitation, causing severer alienation and control. Despite propagating the experience of “being your own boss”, this highly contentious form of work has profound implications for the wellbeing and life prospects of gig workers, including the erasure of work-life boundaries and new forms of safety risks and social isolation. In China, emerging gig platforms have drawn many rural migrant workers out of working at factories and construction sites, enabling surplus rural laborers to participate in the urban labor market in a new way. Migrant gig workers have flexible work hours and more extensive spatial and social engagement in the city than traditional industrial workers. Yet, gig workers are subject to pervasive surveillance and controls by platform-based algorithms, leading to distinct and even hazardous practices. Questions including how the labor market of the gig economy drives new migration patterns and family split arrangements, how gig jobs create new options and constraints in the city and how migrant gig workers respond to algorithmic control to harness and/or fall victim to the new techno-economic system remain underresearched. This study uses mixed methods to unpack the tension between gig platforms’ algorithmic control and Chinese rural migrant workers’ negotiation for choice and autonomy. Questionnaire survey data will be analyzed in a comparative framework to contrast the conditions and experiences of gig workers with those of regular workers in terms of migration, family arrangements, daily practices, and life prospects. Participant observation, focus groups and interviews will be used to unravel how migrant workers engage with the gig economy and are subject to its unconventional form of surveillance and control. From the context where gig platforms have prevailed with little regulatory oversight, the analysis will contribute to theory building on how platform-based algorithmic control affects work and life. It will also update knowledge on the contemporary conditions of China’s rural migrant workers. Our findings will inform policies to facilitate techno-economic innovations and to prevent safety hazards and negative social impacts. The study will also generate data for international comparative analysis on the effects of platform capitalism on the workforce structure and employment and labor conditions in the twenty-first century. 零工經濟的興起創造了一個以“自由職業”為特徵的勞動力市場，例如外賣送餐和網約車服務。支持者聲稱，零工工作給從業者更大靈活性和自主權。批評者認為零工經濟只是一種新的資本主義剝削形式，對工人造成更嚴重的異化和控制。儘管零工經濟平台常常以鼓吹“做自己的老闆”吸引更多人參與，但這種極具爭議的工作形式對從業者的福祉和生活狀況有著深遠的影響，包括消除了工作與生活的邊界，以及製造了新的安全風險和社會隔離狀況。在中國，新興的零工平台將許多農民工從工廠和建築工地中吸引出來，使農村剩餘勞動力以一種全新的方式參與到城市勞動力市場中。與傳統產業工人相比，零工經濟從業者在城市中有更靈活的工作時間安排和更廣泛的空間與社會參與。然而，在平台算法的廣泛監控下，他們的工作方式與傳統產業工人截然不同，並且存在新的安全隱患。一系列針對零工經濟的問題仍然沒有得到充分的研究，包括：零工經濟的勞動力市場如何催生新的移民模式和家庭分離安排？零工工作如何為農民工在城市就業和生活帶來新的選擇和限制？以及農民工如何應對算法控制以利用新技術，亦或成為新技術經濟系統的受害者？ 本研究綜合使用多種研究方法探索零工平台的算法控制與中國農民工的選擇和自主權之間的矛盾。在一個比較研究框架中分析問卷調查數據，對比參與平台經濟的農民工與傳統行業中的農民工在遷移、家庭安排、日常實踐和生活前景等方面的狀態和經歷。參與者觀察、焦點小組討論和深度訪談將用於揭示農民工如何參與零工經濟並應對其數字監控。在當前中國城市中零工平台缺乏有效監管的背景下，這項研究將有助於建立關於零工平台的算法控制如何影響從業者工作和生活狀況的一般理論。本研究還將更新有關當前中國農民工生存狀態的一般知識。分析結果將為促進新技術經濟模式創新，以及為防止相關安全隱患和消極社會影響提供政策建議，還將為新興的平台資本主義對二十一世紀勞動力市場結構及就業和勞動狀況的影響提供國際比較分析所需的中國相關數據。

12623122.value: 重新檢視傳譯 “共性”：通過整合大型語料庫而進行的傳譯數據探勘

rows: To expand three interpreting corpora, CEPIC, EPIC and EPICG, and enhance their data compatibility;
To compare and develop methods for the unification of metadata and data structure transformation of the three corpora;

12623122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12623122.value: For years, interpreting researchers have been obsessed with the possible “universals”, i.e. the general language features associated with interpreting. There have been debates over if or what “universals” may exist in such a complex activity of language transfer, and more recently the exploration of linguistic features shared in constrained language use. Empirical studies on this topic, although substantial in number, are usually hindered by the limited size and variety of data. The proposed study, tapping into the recent developments in Corpus-based Interpreting Studies (CIS) and text mining, aims to readdress the issue of interpreting “universals” based on a collaborative effort to develop re-engineered mega-size corpora. The project consists of two major steps. The first part involves the integration of existing and comparable interpreting corpora through a process called “re-engineering”. The corpora selected for integration include the Chinese/English Political Interpreting Corpus (CEPIC), the European Parliament Interpreting Corpus (EPIC), and the European Parliament Interpreting Corpus Ghent (EPICG), of which the investigators of the proposed project have served as either main or co-developers. These corpora also cover a variety of European languages, in addition to Chinese and English. The re-engineered corpora will then share a unified framework to make data comparable across different sub-corpora and language sets. They will be uploaded to a searchable platform for follow-up analyses. The second part of the project is comprised of analyses pivoting on the notion of interpreting “universals”. Apart from examining existing measures of such “universals” and features of constrained language, the project employs tools and methods available in text mining to explore the mega-size interpreting corpora data, the very thought of which was impossible back in the years when the concept of “universals” in interpreting was raised. Corpus-driven in nature, the project aims to answer three research questions (RQs): RQ1: What may be the linguistic and text features that make interpreted speeches deviate from its source speeches? RQ2: What may be the linguistic and text features that make interpreter speech different from non-mediated speech in the same language? RQ3: What may be the linguistic and text features that make interpreting different from its written counterpart, i.e. translation? The three RQs provide comparisons on three dimensions. In particular, RQ1 focuses on possible shared linguistic strategies employed by interpreters. RQ2 extends the comparison to a level between mediated and non-mediated language, and RQ3 further extends it to the two modes of mediated language (spoken vs. written). 多年以來，傳譯研究人員致力於研究傳譯“共性”——即傳譯可能存在的普遍語言特徵。有研究探討於傳譯這種複雜的語言轉換中，“共性”是否存在，或以何種方式存在。近來研究亦討論“受限語言”的共同特徵。雖然相關議題不乏實證研究的支持，但是常受限於有限的數據大小和多樣性，因而難以推進。 本研究基於語料庫語言學以及文本數據探勘的最新發展，通過協作整合大型語料庫，重新探討傳譯中可能存在的“共性”。項目分兩階段進行。第一階段是整合現有的傳譯可比語料庫，包括中英政治傳譯語料庫（CEPIC）、歐盟議會傳譯語料庫（EPIC）以及根特歐盟議會傳譯語料庫（EPICG）。本項目組成員為上述語料庫的主要或合作開發者。所選語料庫除包括中英文外，亦包括數種歐洲語言。通過語料庫整合工程 ，本項目將建立統一化的數據框架，實現不同子語料庫及語言之間的數據對比。整合後的語料庫將上傳到可搜索平台進行分析。 項目的第二階段主要涉及有關傳譯“共性”的分析。本研究將審視傳譯共性及受限語言特徵的量度方法，並運用數據探勘的方法及工具分析整合後的大型語料庫。此類大型分析可開啟傳譯“共性”提出之時及研究初期無從著手的新探索領域。 本研究於語料庫驅動的基礎上，回答三個研究問題： 一，傳譯語言與原文語言相比，有哪些語言及語篇特徵差異？ 二，傳譯語言與非經傳譯的同種語言相比，有哪些語言及語篇特徵差異？ 三，傳譯語言與同為受限語言的筆譯語言相比，有哪些語言及語篇特徵差異？ 上述三個研究問題針對三個層面進行比較分析。問題一著重分析傳譯員採用的語言策略；問題二把比較分析的領域擴展到通過和沒有通過第二語言媒介進行的溝通之間的異同；而問題三進一步分析通過兩種模式（口語和書面）的語言媒介溝通之間的區別。

12623322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12623322.value: 僑民商網和電影業網絡：光藝公司及何啟榮家族研究 （1930-1970 ）

12623322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12623322.value: The history behind artistic creations is as important as the creation itself. This project draws on recent scholarship in film studies and diaspora studies to address the business history of creativity. Grounded in primary historical sources, it aims at rediscovering the institutional networks and human links between HK and Singapore within its multi-cultural environment of filmmaking and film-consumption. To achieve this, it investigates the shared film heritage of HK and Singapore from the 1930s to the 1960s through the lens of a border-crossing, vertically-integrated enterprise–Kong Ngee– in its South China and Southeast Asian context. Situated in a critical and contested time and space, Kong Ngee filmmakers not only created films catering to the taste of the post-war baby boomers, they responded to competing visions of city and nation-building in Asia. 藝術創作背後的歷史與「藝術品」本身的價值，同樣值得我們深究。這項目以一手資料為基礎，旨在重建活躍在星港兩地的何啟榮家族及其旗下的「光藝」電影公司歷史。在二戰結束後的亞洲，光藝電影人不僅創作了迎合戰後嬰兒潮一代口味的影片，還回應了多個亞洲城市（和國家）的振興願景。

12623622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12623622.value: 以機械學習探討學生在方塊編程過程中的運算思維軌跡

12623622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12623622.value: Prof Leung, Allen Yuk-lun Prof Lui, Andrew Kwok Fai

12623622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12623622.value: testing 近年來，學校對編程和運算思維 (CT) 的興趣重新冒起。編程在學校課程中的強勢回歸, 部分是由新的方塊的編程語言的出現引發的，例如 Blockly 和 Scratch，這些語言使年輕學習者能夠構建複雜的電腦程式而不會因句法問題而超負荷。編程的復興也受到社會對未來勞動力的需求的推動，許多教育工作者和研究人員將運算思維視為 21 世紀學生的關鍵素養。 儘管對塊編程在學生學習的情感和認知領域的教育益處進行了大量研究，但仍不清楚作為初階程式編寫員的年輕學習者如何通過編程活動發展他們的運算思維能力。儘管已經有關於驗證運算思維能力量表的研究，但對於學生的學習過程和他們的運算思維發展模式如何預測他們的學習成果知之甚少。一些研究試圖通過分析學生的編寫程式中語法來描述 運算思維發展模式。然而，僅憑句法評估不足以辨別高階運算思維發展模式以及運算思維發展與學生學習成果之間的關係。 為了解決這一差距，我們提出了一種機器學習方法來分析學生的編程軌跡模式及其與不同教學環境中學生運算思維能力的關係：個人學習、部分協作學習和協作學習。為了描繪編程軌跡，我們將使用機器學習算法將學生在學習過程的不同階段提交的程式轉換為代碼嵌入，這是描繪程式句法和高階語意特徵的低維向量代碼。此代碼轉換是基於從 Scratch 存儲庫中可用的方塊代碼的大數據集分析得來的嵌入碼。這些代碼嵌入將進一步輸入機器學習算法，以根據學生的編程軌跡預測學生的學習成果。 這項研究將以多種方式為該領域做出貢獻。首先，對學生編程軌蹟的實證分析將加深我們對問題解決過程的理解，從而開發出更有效的教學法。其次，本研究的結果將為驗證現有模型以提供促進運算思維的最佳實踐的框架。第三，從方法論的角度來看，這項研究的結果將為學習編程和其他學科學科的更具適應性的學習環境的發展提供信息。

12623922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12623922.value: 新自由主義觀念、管理主義與社會福利的倫理關係

12623922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12623922.value: Dr Fung, Kwok-kin Prof Hung, Suet-lin Prof Peng, Chenhong

12623922.label: Project Objectives
12623922.value: To develop a model to examine the factors that shape social workers’ ethical judgments in professional decision-making; to examine the influence of neoliberal values on ethical judgments in social work; to examine the influence of the code of ethics in social workers’ decision-making process; to explore the common factors that contribute to the ethical dilemmas facing social workers in Hong Kong; to examine the deliberation process of social workers when tackling these ethical dilemmas; to develop best practices for social workers to approach ethical decision-making; and to inform policy makers of the necessary revisions to the current model of social service delivery.

to examine the influence of neoliberal values on ethical judgments in social work;
to examine the influence of the code of ethics in social workers’ decision-making process;
to explore the common factors that contribute to the ethical dilemmas facing social workers in Hong Kong;
