13501722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501722.value: 刷臉支付，自我相關以及差異化消費行爲

13501722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13501722.value: Dr Dahl, Darren Dr Huang, Liang Prof SU, Lei

13501722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501722.value: Facial payment is a novel payment method first used in 2017 in China and then rapidly adopted worldwide. However, consumer researchers and business practitioners have yet to systematically examine the theoretical and practical implications of this new payment method. To bridge this gap and build on the literature on facial recognition, the self, and consumer privacy, the PI proposes to investigate an important behavioral consequence of facial payment. Specifically, the PI posits that facial payment (vs. other forms of payment) can render a purchase decision more self-relevant, which in turn increases divergence in consumer behavior. The PI contends that this effect can be produced by both the execution of a facial payment and the mere anticipation of such a payment. Hence, it affects both pre- and post-purchase behaviors. The PI further speculates that this diverging effect will diminish in self-relevant domains and reverse when privacy concerns are made salient. Thirteen studies are proposed to test these hypotheses through a combination of laboratory, field, and neuroimaging data. Thus, the proposed project will examine the theoretical underpinnings of facial payment and, in doing so, contribute to the literature on payment method, self-concept, and consumer privacy. Methodologically, the proposed project will devise research paradigms and stimuli that could benefit future research on facial payment. Practically, the proposed project will generate actionable recommendations for a wide range of businesses (e.g., retail, restaurant, hotel, and service businesses), both online and off. 刷臉支付是一種2017 年在中國首次使用，隨後在全球迅速普及的新型支付方式。然而，消費研究人員和從業者尚未系統地研究這種新支付方式的理論和實踐意義。爲了填補這一空白，本研究試圖在面部識別、自我和消費者隱私的文獻的基礎之上研究刷臉支付的重要行為後果。具體而言，本研究主張刷臉支付（相對於其他支付形式）可令購買決策更關乎消費的自我概念，從而使得消費行爲更富差異化。本研究進一步指出此種影響既可通過實際的刷臉支付，也可以通過對刷臉支付的預期達成。因此，刷臉支付既會影響購買之前，也會影響購買後的行為。 PI 進一步推測，這種分歧效應將在本就與自我概念相關的消費領域中減弱，並在隱私問題變得突出時逆轉。為檢驗這些假設，本研究提出了共計十三個組合了實驗室、田野和神經影像學數據方法的實驗。理論而言，本項目將研究面部支付的理論基礎，並為支付方式、自我概念和消費者隱私方面的文獻做出貢獻。在方法論上，本項目將對刷臉支付的研究方法和刺激物設立先例并希望其將有利於刷臉支付的未來研究。實際應用層面，本項目將為綫上以及綫下的各種企業（例如零售、餐廳、酒店和服務企業）提供可行的建議。

13501922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501922.value: 气候变化风险认知和市场监管机构的反应：来自保险业的证据

13501922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501922.value: Climate change is the defining challenge of our time, and one that will impact the way we live for the decades to come. The rising appreciation of climate change risk has led to a fast-growing body of research which examines the potential impacts on our economy, financial markets, and individuals’ beliefs and reactions. A recent study has shown that among various climate change related risks that will affect businesses and individuals, regulatory risk’s perceived importance as “the first-order risk over the coming five years is consistent across all subgroups (i.e., faculties, the private-sector, and public-sector professionals)”(Stroebel and Wurgler, 2021). However, we still know very little about whether climate change risk will affect the regulators’ decision-making and regulatory actions. This study will fill this gap in the literature by investigating whether and how climate change risk perception will affect insurance regulators’ approval of insurance price change for insurance policies that are exposed to climate change risk. Moreover, there is an ongoing debate about whether climate change is actually happening and, if so, how severe will be the consequence. So far. most empirical studies have focused on the direct effect of climate change and pay little attention to the institutional factors that alter the effect of individuals’ risk perception of climate change. Therefore, this study will also explore societal trust and its moderating effect on the climate change risk perception of state insurance regulators. We choose the U.S. property-casualty (P&C) insurance industry as the focus for this study because of two unique advantages. First, insurance industry is on the front line in the battle against climate change. Few empirical studies have examined the impacts of climate change on the insurance market and insurance firm operation, both of which are critically important for managing climate change risk. Second, the insurance industry is heavily regulated and therefore provides an ideal setting to investigate the interactions between climate change risk and regulators’ reactions. This study will contribute to the strand of literature on insurance regulation by showing that part of the distortion may be explained by regulators’ beliefs about climate change risk. This study will also contribute to the strand of literature on the factors affecting regulatory intervention by showing that the insurance price regulation may be affected by regulators’ perceptions of climate change. Third, this study will contribute to the strand of literature on societal trust by exploring the moderating effect on climate change risk perception.

13502322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502322.value: 媒体避税新闻报道与同行业公司对管理层实际税率预测的策略性披露

13502322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13502322.value: Dr Wang, Ke Prof Wang, Zheng

13502322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502322.value: In recent years, corporate tax scandals have become the headline issues of newspapers and other publications. The intensive media coverage about tax affairs has attracted lots of negative publicity and caused backlash against the concerned firms from various stakeholder groups. Focusing on firms in the spotlight, prior studies have examined the consequences of media coverage on tax avoidance, including stock market reactions, consumer purchase behavior, and employee perceptions. However, no studies have examined the responses to the media tax coverage from non-covered peer firms, which can be significantly different from the other stakeholders of the media-covered firms. The proposed study aims to fill the void by investigating how non-covered peer firms respond to tax avoidance news by strategically altering their management voluntary effective tax rate (ETR) forecast behavior. According to prior information spillover literature, tax avoidance news may impose two distinct effects on non-covered peers. First, it can induce negative publicity on non-covered peers because the public may generalize the tax avoidance behavior taken by one firm to other peers. Meanwhile, it also offers opportunities for peers to improve product-market competitive positions by attracting customers switching from the media-covered tax-aggressive firms which are under public scrutiny of “immoral” tax behavior. We argue that facing these two opposite effects, non-covered peers’ responses to tax news varies with their tax positions. Specifically, tax non-aggressive peers may strategically disclose more information about their “fair share” of future tax payment following the media tax coverage to distance themselves from the media-covered tax- aggressive firms and hurt media-covered firms’ reputation, which, in turn, help them gain more advantages in the product market. In contrast, non-covered tax-aggressive peers may issue fewer management voluntary ETR forecasts following the tax news, because the low future ETR estimates in ETR forecasts will further exacerbate the reputational damage caused by tax avoidance news. We will employ a cohort-based matching difference-in-differences methodology to examine whether non-covered tax non-aggressive (aggressive) peers issue more (fewer) management voluntary ETR forecasts following the tax avoidance news. We will also investigate the product-market consequences of this strategic disclosure behavior. Motivated by firms’ growing concerns about tax-related reputational risk, our study will provide the first empirical evidence on firms’ strategic actions to peers’ adverse tax news. This will enhance our understanding of strategic disclosure behavior that aims to gain product-market competitive advantages. It will also add to the literature on tax-related reputational costs, tax-related disclosures, and media coverage. 近年来，公司避税丑闻经常成为各大报纸媒体的新闻头条。媒体对公司避税行为的频繁报道为被报道公司带来了大量的负面影响，也招致了来自不同利益相关者的抵制。现有文献着眼于被报道公司，检验了避税新闻产生的影响，例如如何影响股价反应，消费者购买行为，以及员工对公司的认知。然而除了被报道公司，避税新闻也可能对同行业其他公司产生影响，但这一影响并未被现有文献检验。本课题意图填补这一空白，检验同行业未被报道的其他公司如何通过策略性改变管理层实际税率预测来应对避税新闻。 根据信息溢出效应相关文献，某公司的避税新闻可能对未被报道的同行业其他公司产生两种相反的效应。一方面，当某一公司的激进避税行为被曝光后，公众往往会将避税行为推衍到同行业其他公司，认为其他公司也存在同样的避税行为，为同行业其他公司带来负面影响。另一方面，某一公司的避税行为被曝光后， 同行业其他公司可能因此获得了提高产品市场竞争力的机会。他们可能会利用顾客对被曝光公司的抵制情绪，吸引顾客从被曝光公司转移到同行业其他公司。我们认为，面对这两种相反的效应，同行业其他公司对避税新闻的反应可能取决于自身的避税情况。具体来说，非激进避税公司可能会策略性的多披露未来的缴税状况，彰显自身足额缴税，与被曝光公司划清界限，以吸引更多顾客，提高产品市场竞争力。然而同行业激进避税公司在避税新闻之后可能更加不会披露管理层对未来实际税率的预测，以避免加重由于避税新闻带来的负面影响。 我们将利用双重差分法检验在某公司的避税行为被媒体曝光后，未被报道的同行业（非）激进避税公司是否发布更少（多）的管理层实际税率预测。我们也会检验这种策略性披露行为带来的产品市场上的后果。鉴于公司对税务相关的声誉风险日渐重视，本课题将首次检验公司如何策略性应对同行业其他公司的税务丑闻，也有助于学术界理解公司为获得产品市场竞争优势采用的策略性披露行为。同时，本课题也会对税务相关声誉成本，税务相关披露，和媒体方面的研究做出贡献。

13502622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502622.value: 疫情极大地改变了服务业的市场需求，导致一些厂家的服务能力过剩，其他厂家的服务能力短缺。如今，厂家之间共享产能、更好地满足市场需求已经变得很常见。例如，疫情期间，盒马面临需求不断增长的巨大压力，于是便制定了员工分享的企业战略。在这项战略下，超过5000名来自西贝莜面村和其他线下餐厅的员工被借调到盒马（否则，这些雇员可能会因原餐厅的需求萎缩而失业）。京东物流、苏宁物流和沃尔玛也推出了类似的员工共享计划来应对疫情期间的员工短缺问题。招聘猫等线上平台也已经推出了鼓励员工分享的各种措施。因而，产生一些重要的研究问题：企业应该如何指定员工分享计划？员工分享的利益应如何在不损害行业利润的前提下分配给各个参与者（考虑到分配对市场参与者决策的影响）？员工分享对消费者和整个社会有何影响？商业环境如何影响上述问题的答案？ 库存文献已经研究了制造业中的生产能力共享，在这些研究中需求是外生的。但是，在服务业中，实际需求率取决于消费者的等待时间，而这方面并没有多少服务能力共享的研究工作。为了填补这一重要的研究空白，我们计划研究有多个服务提供商的服务系统，顾客可以根据等待时间内生地决定需求率。在给定的服务能力水平下，服务提供商根据潜在市场规模和分配规则确定如何重新分配服务能力。然后，服务提供商做出定价决策，而顾客则做是否购买服务的决定。为了回答我们的主要研究问题，我们将分析没有服务能力共享的离散式系统和有共享的系统，研究一些常用的分配规则（例如Shapley值和 the nucleolus)）是否导致 core allocation, 并通过比较有共享和没有共享两种系统来研究服务能力共享对消费者和社会福利的影响。 该项目将帮助服务业的管理层理解如何和其他厂家共享服务能力，如何在参与者之间分配服务能力共享带来的利益。该研究也将帮助决策者更好地理解服务能力共享如何影响消费者和整个社会，以便他们更有效地管理服务能力共享的实践（例如，是否允许服务能力共享等等）。

13600522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13600522.value: 間接網絡效應及其政策意義：中國電動車市場的實證分析

13600522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13600522.value: 當間接網路效應存在時，政府可以直接補貼一項技術或補貼其互補技術從而加速該項技術的普及。最優政策的選擇取決於間接網路效應相對於直接政策效應的規模。 在早前的研究, 有學者比較了電動汽車應用方面和環境方面的替代政策的有效性，包括降低電動汽車購買成本和刺激充電基礎設施方面的投資。然而，他們的結論受社會經濟因素影響，例如：消費者對價格(電動汽車補貼)的敏感度、充電樁網路的規模以及車輛特徵(例如行駛里程)，這些因素通常會表現出跨市場或時間的變化。因此，他們的結論可能無法推廣到一般情況中。此外，間接網路效應可能因不同品質和不同基礎設施條件的市場而有所差異，特別是當前電動汽車行業處於技術快速變革階段，因此。兩種補貼政策的相對效率可能會隨著技術的發展和產品品質分佈的顯著變化而變化。 考慮到電動汽車行業處於技術快速變革階段的特性，我們需要先確定前人提出的政策含義是否適用於該行業的不同發展階段或不同的社會經濟環境，這是非常重要的。例如，目前中國擁有全球最大的充電樁網路，而且目前大多數電動汽車的續航里程都比以前要長得多；然而，中國消費者對價格更加敏感，因為他們的收入遠低於以往研究中的水平。因此，電動汽車和充電樁補貼方案之間的可替代性可能與以往的研究完全不同。這些實證證據將對電動車市場的管理和政策制定有著重要的影響。 本項目利用中國電動汽車銷量和充電樁數量的資料，估算電動汽車普及與充電站基礎設施之間的相互間接網路效應，並評估電動汽車購置補貼和充電樁補貼的有效性及效率問題。我們還研究了採用不同技術特徵的充電基礎設施的間接網路效應的異質性，以及替代補貼政策對差異化電動汽車消費者的異質福利效應。我們利用2016-2019 年中國市場的電動汽車銷量和充電樁數量的數據，去估算電動汽車需求和充電樁網路規模的函數，這呈現了不同市場的電動汽車銷量、政府補貼和充電樁網路的變化。我們進行了反事實分析，利用估算的需求和充電樁網路的函数去檢查電動汽車和充電樁補貼對電動汽車推廣的有效性，並評估其福利效應。 該項目具有重要的意義。實證結果可為政府的決策提供參考。例如，香港政府一直向個人提供首次登記稅（FRT）優惠和向企業提供利得稅減免來推廣電動汽車。此外，政府宣佈籌備一項 20 億港元的試點資助計畫，以促進私人住宅停車場安裝充電基礎設施（“EVCEI”）。考慮到消費者價格敏感度的差異後，我們認為這兩種補貼有效性的分析和一般結論也適用於這些政策。此外，實證證據也有助於香港與珠三角地區的政策協調，以及在“大灣區”建立統一的環境標準。

13601922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13601922.value: 香港職業健康差異調查

13601922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13601922.value: 背景 職業健康差異是指不同的社會經濟地位和種族的僱員所面對的職業安全、死亡、疾病和負面健康結果的不對等情況。研究指出，與本地出生的僱員相比，非本地僱員遭受的職業安全風險比較高，職業幸福感也相對較低。大多數研究將原因歸結為非本地僱員較多從事高風險工作。正如 Leong 等人（2017 年）和 Tetrick（2018 年）所建議，未來的研究需要進一步了解導致職業健康差異的潛在機制。 本研究旨在測試一個了解職業健康差異的研究框架。研究將會分成兩個研究項目： 基於工作需求-資源模型（Bakker & Demerouti, 2007），研究 一 將檢驗工作需求和資源的差異是否會導致本地僱員和新移民的大陸僱員之間的職業健康差異。研究 二 將探討文化適應相關的因素，包括種族歧視、文化適應壓力以及社會支持的對職業健康差異的影響。目的在於評估這些文化適應因素是否在JD-R 因素以外對了解職業幸福感方面提供額外的解釋力。 方法 研究 一 是一項橫斷面研究(cross-sectional)問卷調查，目的旨在收集內地新移民僱員和本地僱員的數據。這些參與者的回答將與他們的性別、年齡、職業和工作任期相匹配。參與者將報告他們對工作要求、工作資源、職業幸福感（例如，情緒倦怠、工作投入）、職業健康的看法，以及他們對過去一年健康狀況的主觀評估。研究 二 將是一項三波追蹤式研究（中間間隔六個月），目的旨在了解在香港的內地新移民僱員的工作狀況。除了研究一中使用的問題以外，研究參加者亦會回答額外的問題，包括種族歧視經歷、文化適應壓力和社會支持網絡等。完成問卷調查的參與者將會獲得超市優惠券以作獎勵。 貢獻和影響 本研究將帶來豐富的理論和實踐意義。在理論層面，本研究將驗證一個可用於解釋職業健康差異機制的綜合模型。在政策方面，研究結果將為不同持份者制定政策，以支持不同工作組的職業健康。

13602122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13602122.value: 誰更易受到以人為中心的僅僅擁有權效應影響？

13602122.label: Project Objectives
13602122.value: To fill the research gap regarding the mere ownership effect. Prior studies of the mere ownership effect have primarily focused on how mere ownership alters people’s evaluation of the “object”. This project proposes an original and novel idea that mere ownership also alters people’s evaluation of the “self”. To provide empirical evidence supporting the person-focused mere ownership effect. To test the hypothesis that Easterners are more likely than Westerners to rely on external objects for self-enhancement. In other words, Easterners are more likely than Westerners to perceive the self as having greater efficacy when they merely own a functional object. To test if independent-interdependent dimension of culture can account for the cultural differences in the person-based mere ownership effect.

13603522.label: Project Objectives
13603522.value: To submit multiple papers to leading journals in philosophy on the topics dealt with by this project. 13603522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13603522.value: Something might be more similar to one thing than it is to another thing. For example, everything else being equal, a gold cube is more similar to a gold sphere than it is to a silver sphere. Such facts about resemblance raise a number of difficult questions, two of which are: i) Is all resemblance subjective, and if not, to what extent is resemblance objective? ii) To the extent that the facts of resemblance are objective, can these facts, or at least some of them, be explained in terms of other facts, and if so, how? In this research project, I will develop a novel and systematic theory of resemblance that answers these and other questions. In answer to the first question, on the moderate objective theory of resemblance I will develop, while ordinary resemblance judgements are partially subjective, there is also an important objective constraint on them which corresponds to the objective similarity relations out in the world. In answer to the second question, I will argue that facts regarding resemblance can be explained in terms of the sharing of respects of similarity and similarity with regard to resemblance families. On this account, respects of similarity correspond to certain privileged properties (which may be called resemblance properties) and resemblance families are sets of properties and relations, such as the set of specific masses and the set of specific distances, whose members stand in distinctive similarity relations to each other. For example, with respect to the resemblance family that is the set of masses, being 2 kg is more similar to being 3 kg than it is to being 4 kg. This research project will also provide an explanatory account of the resemblance properties, resemblance families and the similarity relations on these families. This will involve providing an account of the resemblance facts in terms of what fundamental resemblance properties there are, what fundamental resemblance families there are, and what fundamental relations of similarity there are on these resemblance families. As well as providing a systematic theory of resemblance, the project will also apply this theory to shed light on several topics in metaphysics where resemblance plays an important role, such as what disjunctive facts are, whether disjunctive facts can ground other facts, and what the correct principles of grounding are.

13604122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604122.value: 香港 南亞少數族裔勞工，平台化「不穩性」與抗逆對策 - 一項跨界別、跨學科研究

13604122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13604122.value: Dr AU YEUNG, Tat-chor Prof ZHANG, Yin

13604122.label: Project Objectives
13604122.value: To examine the ethno-racial reasons behind the persistent employment, underemployment, and workplace aggression facing South Asians across job sectors in Hong Kong. The research goes beyond existing relevant studies by delving into entrenched cultural 'structures' that could underpin educational, economic, policy and social 'exclusion' of South Asian minorities in Hong Kong. To adopt an 'intersectional model' of race, class, and gender, in the understanding of work inequalities in the context of Hong Kong. By establishing this model, the research would gain a comprehensive understanding by identifying common (and combined) threads between race and gender discrimination in workplace, and how it could vary across (ethnic minority) workers of different socio-economic background. To investigate the diverse precarities and inequalities that ethnic minority workers experience in 'platformed' work in Hong Kong. ‘Platformed 'or 'gig’ work is seen as an emergent and increasingly dominant business form relying on digital media. This objective would contribute to an interdisciplinary approach, combining labour studies and digital media studies in Hong Kong. To examine the tactics (including media use, inter-ethnic interactions, and organized reactions) employed among ethnic minority workers in response to the perceived precarities in digitised economy. The research adopts an 'ethnic minority workers' perspective, with an aim to unpack the complexity and dynamics embodied/embedded in workers' coping strategies.

13604122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604122.value: This project seeks to employ an ethnic minority perspective to gain a comprehensive understanding into the struggles that South Asian workers face in their (gig) labour practices, and the level of tactical agency they exercise, through media use and (inter-ethnic) collective actions. Studies have shown that South Asian residents in Hong Kong face exclusion from the job market, manifested in unemployment or under-employment, that could stem from a structural neglect of their educational needs, and a lack of access to social resources and networks. The government has responded to the issue in recent years by increasing public expenditure on ethnic minority education and services, but these efforts are not yet reflected in the job market. The recent rise of the digitised platform economy has brought with it a surge in ‘gig' work, which intensified during the outbreak of COVID-19, and created new job opportunities for young South Asians, most notably in food delivery. However, media coverage of some incidents in early 2021 triggered a flurry of seemingly ‘racist’ acts by customers directed against South Asians. These incidents not only exposed the exaggerated ‘precariousness’ of ‘gig work’ for the South Asian minority workers, but also the presence in Hong Kong society of deeply entrenched racial stereotypes, discrimination, and possibly racism. The proposed study will represent a pioneering attempt to address this complex issue by articulating the ‘intersectionality’ of race, labour, gender (and class) in the context of Hong Kong, Specifically, the study will adopt cultural studies approaches, to address: i) How the rise of platform(ed) labour has exposed the racial, labour, and spatial inequalities in Hong Kong; ii) How the experiences of racial minority food delivery workers can shed light on the labour conditions that ethnic minorities face in Hong Kong; and iii) How could racial minorities find tactics of ‘resilience’ in platform(ed) labour. The study will adopt an inter-disciplinary approach, by combining textual analyses, ethnographic methods, and quantitative surveys, to gain an up-to-date understanding of labour conditions of South Asian workers across job sectors in the platform economy. The ultimate aim will be to articulate a ‘race-labour subjectivity’ by arguing for measures to enhance the tactics and agency of ethnic minority youths in the post-COVID era, which could contribute to policy making, resource distribution, advocacy and public education, towards the realisation of job equality and ethno-racial inclusiveness in Hong Kong. 摘要 本研究試圖以少數族裔視角來全面了解南亞裔勞工在他們的(零工經濟)勞動實踐中所面臨的掙扎，以及他們通過運用媒體與(族裔之間)集體行動所行使的對策式能動性的程度。過往研究顯示，香港的南亞裔青年一直面臨就業市場的排斥，包括失業及就業不足。這或由於結構上忽視了他們的教育需求，以及缺乏得到社會資源和網絡的機會。近年來，政府已「意識」到此問題，因而增加了對少數族裔教育和服務的公共開支。然而，這些努力(尚未)反映於就業市場上。近年數碼平台經濟的興起帶來了 「零散工作/勞動 」的飛速發展，尤其是在COVID-19疫情開始之時，為南亞裔青年創造了新的工作機會，尤其於食物外賣速遞方面。 然而，2021年初發生與疫情相關的事件，引發媒體熱議，以至顧客對南亞人的「種族主義」行為。 這些事件不僅暴露了南亞族裔勞工在 「零散工作」中的 額外「不穩定性」，而且亦反映社會上根深蒂固的種族成見、歧視、甚至 社會中的種族主義。 因此，此研究作開創性嘗試，通過闡明種族與勞工（及階級）之間的 「多元交織」來解決當中的複雜性。於概念上，本研究將 「種族 」角度融入勞工研究的一個關鍵視角，填補了本地學術界的一個嚴重空白。運用文化研究的方法，研究會具體觸及： 甲、平台化勞動的興起如何暴露了香港的種族、勞工和空間不平等現象？ 乙、 少數族裔外賣速遞員的經歷如何揭示這些族群在香港持續面臨的僱傭條件？ 丙、少數族裔如何在平台化勞動中找到 「抗逆性」的策略？ 本研究採用跨學科的方法，將文本分析、民族誌方法和定量調查結合起來，以研製一種能確切針對當前南亞勞工在平台經濟及不同崗位所面對的的僱傭情况。研究的最終目的是闡明一在 「種族-勞工-主體性」，主張採取措施加強少數族裔青年在後疫情年代的對策性及能動性，籍以能有助於政策建議、資源分配、倡議宣傳及公眾教育，以實現香港的就業平等及種族包容。

13604222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604222.value: 傳統中國的戰爭與公共財政，第一階段，宋元時期 1127-1294

13604222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13604222.value: Prof CHEN, Xifeng Mr HA, Yiming Prof LI, Chunyuan Prof ZHOU, Quyang

13604222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604222.value: This collaborative project seeks to explore the relationship between finance and warfare in Chinese history. In this first stage, we will focus on how military mobilisation and state finance changed during the Song-Yuan transition. In the Song, warfare was characterized by marketisation and the Song court depended on indirect taxation and later public debt to fund its military. Yet in the Yuan, a steppe model of hereditary military households, designated arbitrarily by the state, became predominant and military labour became demonetised and much more coercive. This in turn had implications for state finance and state fiscal institutions, as well as on the relationship between the state and local society. The PI and Co-PIs will combine qualitative analysis with quantitative data to shed light on changes in the nature and size of military expenditures during the Southern Song and the early Mongol-Yuan, paying particular attention to how different modes of military mobilisation impacted the way to sustain the war. The team will adopt a macro-historical perspective with micro-historical case studies, with each team member focusing on a specific region and on regional conditions, institutions, and how the region interacted with other regions and the central government. Combined, the project will be able to examine the dynamic relationship between state power and local elite, as well as militarisation and the sources and structures of public finance during the Southern Song and the Yuan. This will allow us to develop a conceptual framework to describe the continuities and discontinuities in the formation of the state apparatus of Song-Yuan China and to identify the different types of state power based on the connection between military mobilisation and public finance. With such a framework, we seek to expand to stage two of the project in the future, where we will extend our study of military finance and state-building to the Yuan-Ming transition. In the third stage, we seek to undertake a global comparison of warfare and finance, especially between China and Western Europe. 本課題試圖從軍事-財政角度探索南宋-元時期軍事動員與公共財政的變化，並進一步闡明國家財政、戰爭和地方社會之間的緊密關系。南宋軍事動員高度貨幣化，政府主要依賴包括征榷在內的消費稅來承擔軍事開支，後來又轉向公共信用手段如川引、會子等來籌措軍費。而忽必烈建立元朝後，繼承了蒙古時期植根於遊牧生活的軍事動員方式，其內容包括各色戶等、世襲和封建以及人頭稅為核心的實物和勞役制度。故元代軍事的強大不依賴於貨幣化收入，而強調對征服地區人口的直接控制和利用。這些不同的軍事動員方式產生了不同形式的財政需求，特別是南宋的高度貨幣化財政需求和蒙元的去貨幣化財政需求之間存在巨大差異和對立。為了因應這些數額巨大而緊急的軍事需求，南宋和蒙元也因是而確立和發展了各具特色的財政制度，並對地方社會產生了重要而不同的影響。 本課題只是宋元明時期戰爭與公共財政之關系研究項目的第一期，時間下限為至元三十一年（1294）忽必烈去世，為此由專門數名宋史和元史學者組成研究小組，香港嶺南大學劉光臨教授擔任課題負責人。就方法論而言，我們主要采用描述性的定性研究，並以有關數據收集和分析輔助之，同時我們也特別關注區域性的軍事組織構成及其支出以及相應的軍政制度變化，並將視線投射到地方社會所受影響及其回應方式。比較南宋和蒙元兩種不同的軍事動員模式及其影響是我們研究的核心，然後再進一步分析其不同的財政來源、規模以及與市場的親近或疏離程度，最後歸納這些軍事-財政制度對國家權力的不同塑造方式以及對地方社會的影響。

13606522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13606522.value: With the increasing number of older people and people with disabilities and chronic diseases, more young and adult grandchildren will be involved in providing care for grandparents. Most research studies on informal carers have focused on adult children caring for older parents and mutual support among older couples. The caregiving of grandchildren for grandparents is an under-researched topic with limited literature. This lack of evidence has no doubt contributed to the fact that there are no specific services for this group of carers in Hong Kong. Furthermore, researchers suggest that future research should examine how cultures and ethnicities shape the caregiving behaviour of grandchildren. This study will aim to fill an existing research gap by investigating the reasons for young and adult grandchildren taking care of their grandparents, the challenges they face and their service needs. In particular, it will critically examine the role of traditional filial piety and the social exchange theory in shaping the meaning of caregiving of grandchildren and their relationships with grandparents. The study will adopt in-depth interviews to gather qualitative data from 35 respondents according to the criteria of gender, age, income and caregiving role. Because there is no sample frame for this group of carers, the respondents will be recruited via referrals from non-governmental organisations and open recruitment. The interview contents will be transcribed verbatim. Then, content analysis will be applied to examine the key themes. Academically, this study will fill a research gap by illustrating how traditional Chinese filial piety shapes the meaning of the caregiving of grandchildren in Hong Kong society. Practically, the findings will illustrate caregiving pressures and their impact on the social, psychological and physical health of this group of carers. The findings will inform professionals in designing tailor-made support services to address the needs of grandchildren-caregivers. 隨著老齡人口、殘疾人士和慢性病患者數量增加，越來越多年輕和成年孫兒為祖父母提供照顧。現時有關照顧者的學術文獻大多集中研究成年子女照顧年長父母和年長夫婦之間互相支援，欠缺孫兒跨代照顧祖父母的研究，而香港亦沒有為這類照顧者提供特定的支援服務。本研究將調查年輕和成年孫兒照顧祖父母的原因，他們面臨的挑戰及服務需求，以填補現有文獻不足。此研究亦會探討傳統孝道和社會交換理論如何塑造及影響孫輩照顧祖父母。研究採用質性研究方法，以深度訪問搜集三十五名受訪者的意見，並根據性別、年齡、收入和照顧者角色選取被訪者。由於這類照顧者沒有抽樣框架，受訪者將透過非政府組織和公開渠道招募。訪問內容將整理成文字稿，並根據研究主題分析資料。這項研究除填補現有文獻不足外，亦會探討香港社會的中國傳統孝道如何影響孫輩跨代照顧祖父母。研究又會探討跨代照顧者的護老壓力及對他們造成的社交、心理和生理健康的影響。研究結果將有助專業人士量身定制支援服務，以滿足跨代照顧者的服務需求。

13608122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13608122.value: 古代中國同性戀文獻資料集

13608122.label: Project Objectives
13608122.value: This project aims to contribute to the study of early Chinese society (antiquity to roughly 220 CE) by compiling a comprehensive sourcebook of primary sources (including original texts and new translation) on homosexual relationships, practices, and commentaries. They were a distinct social group in early China that shows up in various margins of the extant corpus. Such a sourcebook, with a systematic and thorough presentation of these texts, would help stimulate further research on the history of homosexuality and gender relations in the ancient world. Beyond the field of Chinese history, this sourcebook would also appeal to a wide variety of scholars whose research engages with the global history of homosexuality and gender studies in various ways. It will be accessible to non-China specialists, and allow the early Chinese case to contribute to the wider field of the study of homosexuality in the global ancient world across Eurasia and the Americas. The proposed sourcebook will also serve a pedagogic purpose. No such sourcebook exists at this time, in Chinese, English, or any other major scholarly language. University instructors can easily assign relevant portions of this sourcebook in their undergraduate classes on the history of early China, homosexuality and gender studies in Chinese history or the ancient world at large.

14100122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14100122.value: 以靶向 GLP-1 信號通路修復認知老化的機制

14100122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14100122.value: Dr Ip, Bonaventure Yiu-ming Prof Mok, Vincent Chung-tong

14100122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14100122.value: Age-related neurovascular dysfunction is an important contributor to cognitive impairment in vascular dementia (VaD) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Our previous investigations have uncovered a close relationship between endothelial and blood-brain barrier (BBB) dysfunction in the aging brain. We revealed that subtype-dependent single-cell transcriptomic changes of endothelial cells (ECs) in aging are associated with BBB functions, energy metabolism and AD pathogenesis. Importantly, through the treatment of exenatide, a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) agonist (GLP-1RA), these pathological changes can be reversed. Supported by clinical trials and meta-analysis which demonstrated reduced incidence of cognitive decline in diabetic mellitus (DM) patients treated with GLP-1RA, we hereby aim to investigate the neuroprotective benefits of GLP-1RA in age-related vasculopathy. Treatment-associated downregulation of activation- and neurodegenerative disease-related transcripts in microglia and unique expression of GLP-1R in microglia suggests the action of exenatide on reducing microglial priming in the aged brain plays a key role in the functional changes. In conjunction with our pilot clinical trial to investigate the use of GLP-1RA in cerebral small vessel disease, we will study (1) the functional benefits accompanying the reversal of age-related brain EC transcriptomic changes by GLP-1RA treatment. In this regard, comprehensive behavioral tests and various treatment regimens will be examined. We will also study (2) the dependence of the neurovascular benefits of GLP-1RA on microglia via generating an inducible microglial GLP-1R knock-out model by crossbreeding transgenic mice. Given the high tolerability of GLP-1RA in both DM and non-DM patients, there is astounding translational potential in expanding the use of GLP-1RA to treat cognitive impairment. Our study is imperative in providing critical insights into mechanisms underlying neurovascular defects in aging and its pharmacological reversal by GLP-1RA, which will guide further therapeutics development for ameliorating neurovascular dysfunction in aging, VaD and AD. 與衰老相關的神經血管功能障礙是血管性癡呆和阿爾茨海默病的重要致病因素。我們之前的研究揭示了老化大腦中血管內皮和血腦屏障功能障礙之間的密切關係: 衰老過程中內皮細胞的單細胞轉錄組變化具亞型依賴性, 與血腦屏障功能、能量代謝和阿爾茨海默病發病機制有關, 而通過胰高血糖素樣肽-1 受體 (GLP-1R) 激動劑 (GLP-1RA) 艾塞那肽的治療，可以逆轉這些病理變化。在臨床試驗中，使用 GLP-1RA 治療可降低糖尿病患者的認知能力下降發生率，而在此研究中我們旨在探索 GLP-1RA 在自然衰老所致血管病變中的神經保護作用。小膠質細胞在衰老和神經退行性疾中被激活, 以及GLP-1R在小膠質細胞中的獨特表達, 皆表明艾塞那肽可能以減少老年大腦中小膠質細胞激活, 從而在防止損傷性功能變化中發揮關鍵作用。我們將通過敲除小膠質細胞的GLP-1R, 綜合行為測試和各種治療方案以研究(1) GLP-1RA 逆轉與衰老相關的腦細胞轉錄組變化的機制；(2) GLP-1RA 的神經血管益處對小膠質細胞的依賴性。我們的研究對於深入了解衰老中神經血管缺陷的機制及其GLP-1RA逆轉這一缺陷的藥理作用至關重要，這將指導開發進一步的治療方案，以改善衰老、血管性癡呆和阿爾茨海默病中的神經血管功能障礙。

14100822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14100822.value: 輔助生殖技術中基於人工智慧的形態動力學分析技術和廢棄胚胎培養液中拉曼光譜檢測技術的新型整合性無創性胚胎篩選方法

14100822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14100822.value: Dr CHAN, David Yiu Leung Prof CHOY, Kwong Wai Richard Prof Li, Tin Chiu Dr Zhao, Mingpeng

14100822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14100822.value: 背景： 不孕症是一個全球性問題，影響約 10% 育齡夫婦。體外受精技術 (IVF) 是不孕症的有效治療方法。但是IVF的臨床妊娠率只有約35%。目前的胚胎篩選的策略仍然採用形態學評估。它的主要局限性有：1）單一時間點的胚胎形態學評估忽略了早期胚胎整個發育過程中的整體形態學資訊； 2)無法篩選非整倍體，除非結合侵入性植入前遺傳學非整倍體檢測技術 (PGT-A)。然而，傳統PGT-A 成本高、周轉時間長以及活檢過程的技術挑戰，都限制了它在臨床實踐中的廣泛應用。為了解決這個問題，我們嘗試建立一種新型的非侵入性胚胎篩選方法。該方法結合了： 1) 人工智慧 (AI) 增強的延時成像（time-lapse)下的高級形態動力學 (MK) 評估技術；2) 對廢棄胚胎培養液進行基於代謝組學分析的拉曼光譜 (RS) 技術。我們的預實驗結果顯示：AI輔助下的MK評估技術使胚胎篩選的準確性提高了9.36%；RS 技術檢測胚胎非整倍體的敏感性和特異性分別達到了 80.4% 和 81.4%。此外，該方法能夠在受精後 30 小時內評估胚胎並給出結果，並且與傳統侵入性PGT-A 相比，成本更低。 假設： 整合MK 和 RS兩種技術可以實現更好的胚胎評估與篩選。 目標： 1) 研究形態變化和代謝組學分析對預測胚胎發育潛力和倍性狀態的應用價值； 2) 建立一個有效的綜合胚胎評估方法；3) 通過多中心隨機對照臨床試驗，驗證該綜合方法對於提高臨床妊娠率的價值。 材料與方法： 招募接受體外受精治療的不孕夫婦。胚胎將培養與具有延時成像功能的培養箱，並收集每個胚胎的廢棄培養基。在第一階段，將通過對胚胎的回顧性分析，建立基於AI 增強的 MK技術 和 RS 技術的整合性胚胎篩選模型。在第二階段，將進行一項多中心隨機臨床對照試驗以驗證該模型。 預期結果和影響： 1）改善IVF臨床實踐中胚胎篩選策略，縮短不孕治療時間，從而產生顯著的長期影響； 2) 提供與傳統侵入性PGT-A技術性能一樣的更便宜和可信的非侵入性胚胎評估技術，從而解決全球面對IVF 實踐中的胚胎篩選難題； 3) 對某些無法採用傳統PGT-A 治療的夫婦，例如卵巢儲備功能低下者，提供替代方案。

14101322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14101322.value: RNA m6A甲基化修飾在KRAS突變型結直腸癌中的作用

14101322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14101322.value: Dr Chen, Huarong Prof Yu, Jun

14101322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14101322.value: 大腸癌（CRC）是香港第一大癌症。 KRAS是一個CRC的主要致癌基因。我們通過比對KRAS野生型和突變型的CRC細胞和動物模型，發現突變型 KRAS 顯著誘導 m6A 修飾。與此一致，突變型 KRAS 通過抑制自噬介導的蛋白質降解來提高 m6A 修飾酶METTL3和 m6A讀取酶YTHDF1的表達。為了進一步研究KRAS 誘導的 m6A 的信號通路，我們進行了 m6A-seq、RNA-immunoprecipitation-seq 和 RNA-seq，發現 BCL9L 為KRAS 突變誘導 m6A 修飾的主要下游基因。 BCL9L與細胞因子-細胞因子受體通路密切相關。 BCL9L 沉默免疫抑制細胞因子 TGFβ1-3、LIF 和 TIMP1 的下調，預示m6A-BCL9L 軸可能參與抗腫瘤免疫。在KRAS突變型CRC的動物模型，發現Bcl9l的m6A和表達水平上調，並與 TGFβ1-3、LIF 和 TIMP1 呈正相關，而與 CD8+ T 細胞浸潤呈負相關。通過CD8+ T 細胞與KRAS 野生型和突變細胞的條件培養基共培養，表明突變型 KRAS 抑制CD8+ T 細胞的增殖和活性。 BCL9L 敲低完全消除了這種影響。因此，我們假設 m6A-BCL9L 是 KRAS 突變 CRC 的新治療靶點。本課題 4 個目標：1）研究 m6A-BCL9L 軸在免疫抑制中的作用； 2）研究m6A-BCL9L軸介導的免疫抑制的分子機制； 3) 研究m6A-BCL9L軸的藥理靶向結合ICB治療的療效； 4) 評估m6A-BCL9L軸的臨床意義。這些研究將探討 m6A-BCL9L 軸在 KRAS 突變 CRC 免疫抑制中的潛在作用和臨床意義。

14101722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14101722.value: 血清生物指標在早期類風濕性關節炎病人中預測高解析度定量電腦掃描關節侵蝕的角色-推導及驗證研究

14101722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14101722.value: Prof Griffith, James Dr Kwok, Kitty Dr Lee, Jack Jock Wai Dr Lee, Ka Lai Violet Prof Qin, Ling Prof Tam, Lai-Shan Prof Wong, Chun Kwok Dr Yim, Cheuk Wan Dr Ying, King Yee Shirley Prof YU, Wei-chuan

14101722.label: Project Objectives
14101722.value: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is the commonest inflammatory arthritis with prevalence up to 0.9%. Although the control of disease improved significantly with the introduction of biological or synthetic targeted therapy, a significant proportion of patients still develop bone erosion and remain burdened by functional disability as a result of joint damage. Clinical disease remission might not be equivalent to complete abrogation of structural progression. Importantly, choices of therapy, even expensive advanced agents, are largely empirical. The exact pathophysiology of this autoimmune joint disease is unknown. Although inflammation, over-expression of cytokines/chemokines/growth factors and erosion are clearly evident, whether bone or synovium is the primary site of the pathology and the complex interplay of all these factors are yet to be well defined. It is also possible that certain mediators are particularly important in bone remodeling independently of inflammation which could be potentially targeted by specific therapeutic agents. High resolution peripheral quantitative computer tomography (HR-pQCT) is a novel imaging technique which is capable of offering excellent non-invasive assessment of bone microstructure which opens up the opportunity for accurate monitoring of bone erosion changes serially. It is now also possible to measure the serum levels of multiple cytokines/chemokines/growth factors implicated in the pathogenesis of RA in a single sample using multiplex ELISA assays which could serve as potential biomarkers. In the current longitudinal derivation and validation study, we would like to test the hypothesis that the baseline or early change of these serum protein biomarkers can predict erosion progression on HR-pQCT in patients with early RA. We are also interested to study the association of serum protein biomarkers with other disease outcomes, the differential association of serum protein biomarkers with erosion in patients treated with various therapies, and the association of biomarkers and bone erosion status with functional disability. If the selected serum protein biomarkers are proven to be able to predict joint damage or even response to specific treatments, they will be of great value in clinical decision making. Patients with early RA could have serum protein biomarkers checked at baseline and thus be risk stratified for the development or progression of bone erosion. With the ever expanding biological or synthetic targeted therapeutic armamentarium, personalized advices and appropriate treatment can be offered as early as possible aiming at modifying the disease course. Serum protein biomarkers can also be checked regularly after the institution of treatment to assess the response or change in prognostic risk. Timely titration of medications can be made accordingly. The ultimate aim would be to prevent structural damage and functional disability in patients with RA. With successful risk stratification by serum protein biomarkers, expensive advanced therapies can be reserved for RA patients in need. Health care resources can be allocated more cost-effectively. The overall socio-economic costs of the disease could be improved. The detailed longitudinal examination of the association of inflammation, various cytokines/chemokines/growth factors and bone changes in this study can also improve our understanding the pathogenesis of RA which would be provocative for further mechanistic research. Whether certain serum biomarkers are causes or consequences of bone damage and whether these associations are independent of inflammation would be of great scientific interest. There is also a possibility of identifying novel pathways or mediators important in the pathogenesis of RA. Potential molecular therapeutic targets identified would be pivotal for designing newer therapeutic agents against RA with higher potency and less side effect. The large amount of HR-pQCT image data generated from the study could also help the development of imaging analysis soft-ware, in particular artificial intelligence (AI) assisted algorithm which also has commercialization potential. The current largely investigational role of HR-pQCT might be changed in the future. On top of the clinical and scientific significance, the results of this study will also be of broader value and societal interest. We would consider the possibility of patent application, commercialization and entrepreneurship if the application of serum biomarkers is proven to be promising. We plan to present our findings in local and international conferences. We will publish our results in peer-reviewed journals. The information can also be disseminated to the public via community health seminars or various media channels. Our clinical study is also of educational value and might be an example of how translational research could impact health for students. Medical students will be updated regarding the progress and results of the study. Interested students can participate in the conduction of the study. The epidemiological techniques and bio-statistical methods will be introduced. On top of exposure to the cutting edge knowledge in the field of rheumatology research, importantly they can have real life clinical study experience and patient contacts. They will also be encouraged to critically appraise research papers. The overall aim is to prepare the medical students for the future career as knowledgeable and caring doctors capable of conducting scientific research.
rows: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is the commonest inflammatory arthritis with prevalence up to 0.9%. Although the control of disease improved significantly with the introduction of biological or synthetic targeted therapy, a significant proportion of patients still develop bone erosion and remain burdened by functional disability as a result of joint damage. Clinical disease remission might not be equivalent to complete abrogation of structural progression. Importantly, choices of therapy, even expensive advanced agents, are largely empirical.

The exact pathophysiology of this autoimmune joint disease is unknown. Although inflammation, over-expression of cytokines/chemokines/growth factors and erosion are clearly evident, whether bone or synovium is the primary site of the pathology and the complex interplay of all these factors are yet to be well defined. It is also possible that certain mediators are particularly important in bone remodeling independently of inflammation which could be potentially targeted by specific therapeutic agents. High resolution peripheral quantitative computer tomography (HR-pQCT) is a novel imaging technique which is capable of offering excellent non-invasive assessment of bone microstructure which opens up the opportunity for accurate monitoring of bone erosion changes serially. It is now also possible to measure the serum levels of multiple cytokines/chemokines/growth factors implicated in the pathogenesis of RA in a single sample using multiplex ELISA assays which could serve as potential biomarkers.

In the current longitudinal derivation and validation study, we would like to test the hypothesis that the baseline or early change of these serum protein biomarkers can predict erosion progression on HR-pQCT in patients with early RA. We are also interested to study the association of serum protein biomarkers with other disease outcomes, the differential association of serum protein biomarkers with erosion in patients treated with various therapies, and the association of biomarkers and bone erosion status with functional disability.

If the selected serum protein biomarkers are proven to be able to predict joint damage or even response to specific treatments, they will be of great value in clinical decision making. Patients with early RA could have serum protein biomarkers checked at baseline and thus be risk stratified for the development or progression of bone erosion. With the ever expanding biological or synthetic targeted therapeutic armamentarium, personalized advices and appropriate treatment can be offered as early as possible aiming at modifying the disease course. Serum protein biomarkers can also be checked regularly after the institution of treatment to assess the response or change in prognostic risk. Timely titration of medications can be made accordingly. The ultimate aim would be to prevent structural damage and functional disability in patients with RA. With successful risk stratification by serum protein biomarkers, expensive advanced therapies can be reserved for RA patients in need. Health care resources can be allocated more cost-effectively. The overall socio-economic costs of the disease could be improved.

The detailed longitudinal examination of the association of inflammation, various cytokines/chemokines/growth factors and bone changes in this study can also improve our understanding the pathogenesis of RA which would be provocative for further mechanistic research. Whether certain serum biomarkers are causes or consequences of bone damage and whether these associations are independent of inflammation would be of great scientific interest. There is also a possibility of identifying novel pathways or mediators important in the pathogenesis of RA. Potential molecular therapeutic targets identified would be pivotal for designing newer therapeutic agents against RA with higher potency and less side effect. The large amount of HR-pQCT image data generated from the study could also help the development of imaging analysis soft-ware, in particular artificial intelligence (AI) assisted algorithm which also has commercialization potential. The current largely investigational role of HR-pQCT might be changed in the future.

On top of the clinical and scientific significance, the results of this study will also be of broader value and societal interest. We would consider the possibility of patent application, commercialization and entrepreneurship if the application of serum biomarkers is proven to be promising. We plan to present our findings in local and international conferences. We will publish our results in peer-reviewed journals. The information can also be disseminated to the public via community health seminars or various media channels.

Our clinical study is also of educational value and might be an example of how translational research could impact health for students. Medical students will be updated regarding the progress and results of the study. Interested students can participate in the conduction of the study. The epidemiological techniques and bio-statistical methods will be introduced. On top of exposure to the cutting edge knowledge in the field of rheumatology research, importantly they can have real life clinical study experience and patient contacts. They will also be encouraged to critically appraise research papers. The overall aim is to prepare the medical students for the future career as knowledgeable and caring doctors capable of conducting scientific research.

14101722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14101722.value: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is the commonest inflammatory arthritis affecting 0.35% of the population in Hong Kong. Although the control of disease improved with the introduction of biological or synthetic targeted therapy, a significant proportion of patients still develop bone erosion with progressive joint damage resulting in disability and impaired quality of life. It remains largely unknown who will respond to a particular treatment and who will have destructive joint disease. Recent breakthroughs in RA research have been the better understanding of the role of various cytokines, chemokines and growth factors in the pathophysiology of bone erosion. The serum level of these mediators are thus potential biomarkers predicting the development of joint damage and even response to specific treatments. High resolution peripheral quantitative computer tomography (HR-pQCT) is a novel imaging technique which is capable of offering accurate and detailed assessment of bone changes. In this study, we would like to investigate the role of serum protein biomarkers in predicting bone erosion progression on HR-pQCT in patients with early RA. This is a 2-phase study. Candidate biomarkers will be derived from a retrospective cohort of 117 early RA patients with stored serum samples and serial HR-pQCT images. These biomarkers or their combinations will then be validated in a prospective, multi-centered cohort of patients with early RA. For the validation study, a total of 110 patients will be recruited. They will be treated to clinical disease remission using conventional, biological or synthetic targeted therapies according to local guidelines for 2 years. Serial serum samples will be collected. HR-pQCT of the metacarpal joints will be done at baseline and then yearly for 2 years. The primary outcome is the association of baseline or early change (baseline to month 3) of serum protein biomarkers with bone erosion progression status on HR-pQCT. Secondary outcomes include the optimal predictive cut-off values of biomarkers for bone erosion progression, the association of serum protein biomarkers with other disease outcomes, the differential association of serum protein biomarkers with erosion in patients treated with various therapies, and the association of biomarkers and bone erosion status with functional disability. The results of this study could improve the management of patients with RA by identifying those at risk of structural damage progression and enabling a personalized usage of advanced therapies. The pathogenesis of the bone erosion and its relationship with various cytokines/chemokines/growth factors in RA could also be better delineated.

14101722.label: Realisation of objectives
14101722.value: All the proposed objectives have been achieved. Additionally, a post-hoc analysis was performed to examine whether applying a more comparable outcome definition in both cohorts would improve the discriminatory ability of the multi-biomarker model. The erosion progression definition of the validation cohort was re-specified to focus on MCPJ 2 only instead of MCPJ2-4 which yielded a progression rate of 24.7% (24/97). The resultant AUC in the validation cohort improved from 0.57 to 0.64 (sensitivity 79.2%, specificity 37.0%).

14101722.label: Major findings and research outcome
14101722.value: A total of 92 patients in the derivation cohort and 97 patients in the validation cohort were included in the final paired analysis for both biomarkers and erosion progression. Despite the high SDAI remission rates in the derivation (40.2%) and validation (45.3%) cohorts, substantial proportions of patients had erosion progression on HR‑pQCT (derivation cohort 7.6%, validation cohort 38.1%) at the end of follow-up. Patients with erosion progrssion in the derivation cohort had lower baseline serum concentrations of multiple growth factor, chemokines and cytokines compared to non-progressors. Many of the serium protein biomarkers dropped over the first 3 months in non-progressors whereas patients with erosion progression had stable or increasing concentrations. Using LASSO dimentionality-reduced multivariate modeling in the derivation cohort, the broad biomarker panel (comprising baseline PDGF‑BB, Basic FGF, TRAIL, MIP‑1α/β and IL‑1ra concentrations) achieved an AUC of 0.75 (sensitivity: 71.4%, specificity: 82.4%) for discriminating patients with or without bone erosion progression after adjusting for age, gender and disease activity. Application of the same algorithm in the validation cohort yielded an AUC of 0.572 (Sensitivity: 71%, Specificity: 34.8%). The AUCs of individial biomarkers ranged from 0.73 to 0.68 in the derivation cohort. Further analyses showed baseline serum IL‑1ra correlated positively with baseline SDAI and HAQ‑DI as well as with subsequent improvements in both measures on follow-up. No associations were found between biomarkers with changes in conventional radiographic scores. Among patients who were given b/tsDMARDs, higher baseline MIP‑1β concentration was associated with a lower risk of erosion progression after adjustment. Higher baseline PDGF‑BB was protective in both biologic‑exposed and biologic‑naïve patients. Significant interactions between baseline IL-1ra level and erosion progression status for functional outcomes were found. Higher baseline IL‑1ra was associated with worse baseline HAQ‑DI, greater improvement in HAQ‑DI over time, and a more pronounced difference between patients with or without erosion progression. A post-hoc analysis was performed. The erosion progression definition of the validation cohort was re-specified to focus on MCPJ 2 only instead of MCPJ2-4 to allow a a more comparable outcome definition in both cohorts. The resultant discriminatory ability of the biomarker model improved from AUC of 0.57 to 0.64 in the validation cohort. The detailed findings were presented in the draft manuscript attached in Part C.

14101722.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14101722.value: Our findings provided further evidence that stable clinical disease in RA is not equivalent to structural remission. Composite serum multi‑biomarker models have the potential to predict erosion progression beyond conventional disease activity indices. Patients with RA could have serum biomarkers checked and thus risk stratified. The use of newer cellular or molecular therapies could be prioritised to patients at risk of damage progression. The goal is to allow personalized approach aiming at preserving patient function and quality of life more cost-effectively. Further prospective studies in larger homogenous cohorts will be performed to validate these findings. Clinical trials comparing structural outcomes assessed by advanced imaging with treatment adjusted according to serum multi-biomarkers versus clinical indices are warranted. Examination of the extensive list of serum growth factors, chemokines and cytokines provided coherent information linking inflammation, bone remodeling and functional outcomes in RA. The association of higher baseline level and early decrease of biomarkers in non-progressors suggested a phenotype characterized by high inflammatory burden but substantial capacity for recovery once inflammation is controlled. Further research employing gene microarray strategy using peripheral blood mononuclear cells could help better delineate the molecular mechanisms underlying the interplay between inflammation and joint destruction in RA.

14101722.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14101722.value: Paired imaging and biomarker analyses were done in 92 patients in the derivation group and 97 patients in the validation group of patients with early rheumatoid arthritis. At the end of follow-up, bone damage worsened despite stable clinical disease. Multiple blood biomarkers could satisfactorily predict bone damage progression independent of the standard clinical assessment. Individual biomarkers were also modestly associated with damage worsening, disease activity and patient function. In clinical practice, patients with rheumatoid arthritis could have blood biomarkers checked with the risk of joint damage assessed. Advanced expensive therapies could be prioritised to patients at risk of damage worsening. The goal is to allow individualized treatment approach aiming at preserving patient function and quality of life more cost-effectively. Examining multiple blood biomarkers also provided information improving our understanding of the mechanism of rheumatoid arthritis. Further larger studies will be performed to confirm these findings.

14101922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14101922.value: RNA m1A修飾在結直腸癌中的作用和機製研究

14101922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14101922.value: Dr Wong, Chi-chun Prof Wu, William Ka Kei

14101922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14101922.value: 結直腸癌(CRC)是香港最常見的癌癥，闡明其發病機製具有重要意義。RNA甲基化在RNA的轉錄後調控中起關鍵作用，我們之前的研究揭示了RNA m6A甲基轉移酶METTL3通過m6A-GLUT1-mTORC1促進CRC發生。除了m6A外，我們觀察到與鄰近正常組織相比，CRC中的RNA N1-甲基腺苷(m1A)水平顯著升高，提示CRC發病過程中RNA m1A修飾失調可能發揮重要作用。為了尋找在CRC發病過程中重要的m1A調控蛋白，我們分析了50多個CRC細胞系的CRISPR/Cas9 dropout篩選數據，發現m1A修飾酶TRMT6和TRMT61A是CRC細胞增殖和存活的必需基因。與相鄰的正常組織相比，CRC組織中TRMT6和TRMT61A的mRNA和蛋白質水平均上調。此外，高TRMT6和TRMT61A mRNA表達提示CRC患者預後較差。TRMT6和TRMT61A可以形成穩定的復合物，從而穩定各自蛋白的表達。與此一致，CRC組織和不同的CRC細胞系中TRMT6和TRMT61A蛋白表達顯著正相關。在功能上，敲低TRMT6或TRMT61A的表達顯著抑製了CRC 細胞的增殖、克隆形成和細胞遷移。此外，敲低TRMT6或TRMT61A表達會導致細胞周期停滯在S期和G2/M期，並誘導細胞雕亡的產生。機製上，通過分析過表達TRMT6/TRMT61A細胞的m1A-seq數據，我們發現TRMT6/TRMT61A催化了癌癥相關信號通路中的基因的m1A修飾，尤其是p53和細胞周期信號通路。TRMT6或TRMT61A表達的下調會增加細胞中p53蛋白的表達，從而激活p53信號通路並提高p53靶基因的轉錄。基於這些結果，我們提出以下實驗方案：（1）在體外CRC細胞系、CRC類器官和體內轉基因小鼠模型中闡明TRMT6/TRMT61A在CRC發生發展中的作用；(2) 闡明TRMT6/TRMT61A介導的m1A修飾促進CRC發生發展的機製；(3) 研究TRMT6/TRMT61A作為CRC患者預後分子標誌物的潛力。本研究將首次揭示RNA m1A甲基化在CRC中的重要性。該項目成果將促進我們對RNA修飾調控結直腸癌發病機製的理解，有助於開發用於結直腸癌預後和治療的新策略。

14102122.value: 青光眼是世界範圍內不可逆失明的主要原因。在青光眼發病過程中，視網膜神經纖維層（RNFL）的損傷引起逐步嚴重的視野縮窄，而該視野受損過程是不可逆的。原發性開角型青光眼（POAG）是青光眼中一類主要亞型。早期的POAG是無症狀的。但在症狀被患者感知到之前，不可逆的損傷已經發生。病人往往在嚴重視野損傷發生後才能注意到症狀並尋求醫治。因此，獲得能預測POAG發病或者評估其發展快慢及嚴重程度的生物學標記物，對醫生爲患者提供及時有效的處理方案尤為重要。 青光眼是一類複雜的疾病，由多種不同的風險因素共同作用所致，例如年齡，眼壓 (IOP) ，以及基因因素。目前已有超過五十個基因組區域的單核苷酸多態性位點（SNPs）被發現與POAG有相關。然而，人們對基因拷貝數變異 (CNV)與POAG的相關性知之甚少，尚有待被進一步探索。端粒是位于染色體末端的重複編碼序列，被認爲是CNV的一種特殊類型。每次DNA複制的時候，端粒長度都會縮短。與此同時，衰老也會帶來端粒縮短。端粒的縮短被認爲同許多年齡相關疾病有關，例如心臟病，老年性黃斑點退化等。但是現階段對端粒長度(TL)在POAG的作用尚缺乏相關數據。 在我們前期研究中，我們發現，與健康人群相比，POAG患者有著更長的平均端粒長度(TL)，同時，在患者群體中，CNV亦更頻繁發生。因此在這項研究中，我們的目標是在基因組層面上，確認並進一步識別TL及CNV與POAG的相關性。我們已經在香港招募了四百名POAG患者，（其中二百名患者是高眼壓青光眼患者(HTG)，而另外兩百名患者眼壓在正常範圍內(NTG)），我們還招募了兩百名年齡和性別均與患者匹配的健康對照。在汕頭市，我們亦招募了四百名POAG患者（其中二百名HTG患者，兩百名NTG患者），以及二百名健康對照。所有參與者均接受了全面的眼科臨床檢查，確認無其它眼部或全身性疾病。我們將每4-6個月對每位患者進行複診檢查，直至三年或以上。在研究過程中，患者的臨床數據，包括發病年齡、眼壓、視野和RNFL厚度將會被收集（部分已經被收集）。在開始收集同第三年的回訪中，患者的靜脈血樣本將被收集（部分已被收集）。我們將對香港受試者進行相關性分析來得出初步結果。主要分析TL同基因組中CNV與POAG發病風險同疾病進展的相關性。在香港受試者中得出的相關性結果會在在汕頭受試者中進行進一步驗證。POAG的相關症狀同參數和TL或者CNV的相關性會作爲次要結果在此研究中被進一步分析。

14102422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14102422.value: 低濃度阿托品治療控制近視 (LAMP) 第 5 期研究：7 年隨訪以評估治療停止策略，停藥與逐漸減藥

14102422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14102422.value: Prof Chen, Lijia Prof Pang, Chi Pui Prof Tham, Clement C. Prof Wu, Pei-chang Dr Yip, Benjamin Hon-kei Dr ZHANG, Xiujuan

14102422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14102422.value: Myopia is a global health threat. In 2050, about 50% and 10% of world’s population will be myopic and highly myopic, respectively. High myopia is associated with excessive eyeball growth, leading to many sight-threatening complications. The outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic has remarkably exaggerated myopia rates among children due to home confinement. Our LAMP study previously found that low-concentration atropine could effectively reduce myopia progression along a concentration-dependent. However, both our study and previous ATOM studies observed a “rebound phenomenon”, with faster progressions of myopia occurring following treatment cessation, the higher concentration the larger rebound. Yet our preliminary results also demonstrated that 55.45% of children did not progress in the fifth year after treatment cessation. The determinants of myopia progression after treatment cessation are currently not well established. Optimal treatment cessation strategy on “how to stop treatment” to minimize rebound, and “who can stop treatment” is currently unknown. To meet this research gap, we will conduct Phase 5 of the LAMP study with seventh-year follow-up to determine treatment cessation strategies. The study design is based on previous ATOM studies and our LAMP Phase 3 study, which demonstrated a concentration-dependent rebound effect: the higher the concentration, the better the treatment efficacy, but also the greater the rebound. 260 subjects receiving atropine drops during Phase 4 will be recruited for follow-up at 6-month intervals for 2 years, over year 6 (pre-cessation phase) and year 7 (cessation phases). All recruited children will be randomized into Stop and Taper groups at a 1:1 ratio. During the pre-cessation phase, the Stop group will receive 0.05% atropine eye drops for a full year, while the Taper group will receive 0.05% atropine for 6 months and then 0.025% atropine for another 6 months. During the cessation phase, treatment administration will stop for all children and they will be monitored for one year. The primary outcomes include 1) spherical equivalent (SE) progression and axial length (AL) elongation between Stop and Taper groups. 2) the associated factors of myopia progression after treatment cessation. We hypothesize that the overall treatment efficacy for the Taper group will be better than that for the Stop group. In summary, the current proposal will provide answer to questions of “how to stop treatment” (evaluation cessation approaches) and “who can stop receiving treatment” (risk factors of progression following treatment cessation) to establish a treatment cessation strategy of low-concentration atropine for myopia control. 近視是一個威脅到健康的全球性問題。到 2050 年，世界上大約 50% 和 10% 的人口將分別有近視和高度近視。高度近視與眼球過度生長有關，導致許多威脅視力的併發症。由於COVID-19 大流行的爆發所致居家隔離，顯著增加了兒童的近視患病率。我們之前的 LAMP 研究發現，低濃度的阿托品可以有效地減少近視的進展，治療效果與濃度成正比。然而，我們的研究和之前的 ATOM 研究都觀察到了“反彈現象”，即停止治療後近視進展更快，濃度越高反彈越大。然而，我們的初步結果表明，55.45% 的兒童在停止治療後的第五年沒有進展。停止治療後近視進展的因素目前尚未完全確定。關於“如何停止治療”以盡量減少反彈以及“誰可以停止治療”的最佳治療停止策略目前未知。 為了填補這一研究空白，我們將進行 LAMP 研究的第 5 階段，並進行第七年的隨訪以確定治療停止策略。該研究設計基於之前的 ATOM 研究和我們的 LAMP第3階段研究，該研究證明了濃度依賴性反彈效應：濃度越高，治療效果越好，但反彈也越大。在第 4 階段正接受阿托品滴劑的 260 名受試者將被招募參加第5階段研究。第5階段研究，第 6 年（停藥前階段）和第 7 年（停藥階段），將會以 6 個月的間隔進行為期 2 年的隨訪。所有被招募的兒童將按 1:1 的比例隨機分為停藥組(Stop)和逐漸減藥組(Taper)。在停藥前階段，停藥組(Stop)將接受0.05%阿托品滴眼液一整年，而逐漸減藥組(Taper)將接受 0.05% 阿托品 6 個月，然後再接受 0.025% 阿托品 6 個月。在停止階段，將停止對所有兒童的治療管理，並對他們進行一年的監測。主要結果包括1) 停藥組(Stop)和逐漸減藥組(Taper)之間的等效球面度數 (SE) 進展和眼軸長度 (AL) 伸長。2）停藥後近視進展的相關因素。我們假設逐漸減藥組(Taper)的整體治療效果將優於停藥組(Stop)。 綜上所述，目前的提案將回答“如何停止治療”（評估停止方法）和“誰可以停止接受治療”（停止治療後進展的風險因素）的問題，以建立低濃度的治療停止策略阿托品用於控制近視。

14102522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14102522.value: 生長激素釋放激素受體在實驗性自身免疫性葡萄膜炎小鼠模型中調節 T 輔助 17 細胞分化

14102522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14102522.value: Prof Chan, Sun-on Prof Pang, Chi Pui

14102522.label: Project Objectives
14102522.value: Our preliminary results showed that the GHRH-R antagonist MIA-602 suppressed degenerative retinal changes in experimental autoimmune uveoretinitis (EAU) mice based on the real-time measurements. Also, GHRH-R inhibition led to less Th17 cell differentiation. As EAU is generated by T helper 1 (Th1) and T helper 17 (Th17) cells, we should proceed to quantify the T cell subpopulation in MIA-602 treated EAU mice and in the genetic knock-out Ghrhr-/- EAU mice. The first objective is to further investigate the impacts of GHRH-R on total Th1, Th17, T helper 2 (Th2) and regulatory T (Treg) cell differentiation, total T cell abundance, T cell activation, proliferation and apoptosis. Comprehensive cytokine expression in T cells will also be investigated. As the less Th17 cells in the GHRH-R inhibited animals observed in part 1 were likely caused by multiple mechanisms, our preliminary data on the naïve T cell in vitro differentiation experiment suggested that the lower potential of naïve T cell differentiating to Th17 cells was one of the underlying mechanisms that led to less Th17 cells in GHRH-R inhibited animals. To study the roles of GHRH-R in determining T cell differentiation, the second objective is to investigate the impacts of T cell subpopulation (Th1, Th2, Th17 and Treg) differentiated from naïve T cells isolated from wild type animals and subjected to treatment with GHRH-R antagonist MIA-602, as well as in naïve T cell isolated from genetic knock-out Ghrhr-/- mice. To go to deeper details, T cell activation, proliferation and apoptosis, and cytokine expression in these in vitro differentiated T cells will also be investigated. Recently, we have published a study on the GHRH-R signaling in another uveitis animal model, the lipopolysaccharide induced acute ocular inflammation model, in which the ocular inflammation was caused by an infectious mimic agent in contrast to the EAU model. These two models had ocular inflammations caused by different mechanisms. Our findings showed a direct interaction between GHRH-R and JAK2 kinase, which are complementary to our current preliminary work of treating EAU mice with JAK2 inhibitor ruxolitinib. JAK2 inhibition is able to reduce ocular inflammation symptoms and Th17 cell differentiation. These results suggest the involvements of JAK2 in the GHRH-R signaling pathway in the EAU mice. Accordingly, to delineate the differential mechanisms of GHRH-R agonist MR-409/ GHRH-R antagonist MIA-602 and ruxolitinib for the treatment of ocular inflammation to provide a therapeutic basis, the third objective will study the EAU severity and T cell subpopulation distribution in wild type and Ghrhr-/- EAU mice treated with JAK2 inhibitor ruxolitinib. The involvements of the JAK2 in the GHRH-R pathway will be directly tested by naïve T cells in vitro differentiation towards various T cell subpopulation with co-treatment of MR-409/MIA-602 and ruxolitinib.

14103522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14103522.value: RNA 結合蛋白在 3D 基因組中新的調控功能的研究

14103522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103522.value: Our genome in the cell is organized in a delicate three-dimensional (3D) structure. Hi-C technology has revealed the hierarchical arrangement of the 3D genome at compartment, TAD (topologically associating domains) and loop levels. Emerging evidence unequivocally supports that the 3D genome organization instructs pivotal gene regulatory information underlying major biological processes impacting development, differentiation, and diseases. Understanding how chromatin is organized within the nucleus and how this 3D architecture influences gene expression thus becomes the current frontier in gene regulation. TAD integrity is essential for proper gene expression and transcription factor CCCTC-binding factor (CTCF) is believed to play main role in TAD organization. However, bludgeoning evidence indicates that other mechanisms such as active gene transcription could also mediate TAD organization independently of CTCF. In this study, we aim to dissect the previously unknown mechanisms underlying TAD organization that is executed by RNA binding proteins (RBPs) such as RBFox2. Although conventionally known as post-transcriptional regulators of gene expression, findings from our pilot studies suggest that RBPs may have unprecedented functions in orchestrating the formation/maintenance of TADs. Specifically, by harnessing and integrating a large number of high throughput sequencing datasets including Hi-C, RBP ChIP-seq, GRO-seq, CLiP-seq, RNA-seq etc. from K562, HepG2 and C2C12 myoblast cells. We found many RBPs are enriched at TAD boundaries and regulate TAD insulation strength. Furthermore, we found that RBP binding to TAD boundaries might be associated with nascent promoter transcription, thereby it is likely that RBP/transcription synergistically demarcate TADs independent of CTCF binding. These findings lead us to hypothesize that RBPs possess unprecedented gene regulatory function at 3D level through co-transcriptional binding of nascent promoter transcripts. Three objectives are proposed (1) To complete computational analysis of how RBPs/transcription demarcate TAD organization; (2) To further experimentally elucidate how RBFox2 actively drives TAD organization; (3) To further demonstrate how RBFox2 regulation of TAD promotes myoblast differentiation. Once completed, this study will for the first time uncover RBP function in TAD organization thus will enhance our knowledge foundation of 3D genome for future therapeutic development of treating relevant human diseases. 我們細胞中的基因組以精細的三維 (3D) 結構組織。 Hi-C 技術揭示了 3D 基因組在隔室、TAD（拓撲關聯域）和loop水準上的分層排列。新出現的證據明確支持 3D 基因組調控影響發育、分化和疾病的主要生物過程的關鍵基因調控資訊。瞭解染色質在細胞核內的組織方式以及這種 3D 結構如何影響基因表達因此成為基因調控的前沿。 TAD 完整性對於適當的基因表達至關重要，轉錄因數 CCCTC 結合因數 (CTCF) 被認為在 TAD 組織中起主要作用。然而，有力的證據表明，其他機制，如主動基因轉錄也可以獨立於 CTCF 介導 TAD 組織。在這項研究中，我們旨在剖析以前未知的 TAD 組織機制，這些機制是由 RBFox2 等 RNA 結合蛋白 (RBP) 執行的。儘管傳統上被稱為基因表達的轉錄後調節因數，但我們的試點研究結果表明，RBP 在協調 TAD 的形成/維持方面可能具有前所未有的功能。具體而言，通過利用和整合來自 K562、HepG2 和 C2C12 成肌細胞的大量高通量測序數據集，包括 Hi-C、RBP ChIP-seq、GRO-seq、CLiP-seq、RNA-seq 等。我們發現許多 RBP 在 TAD 邊界處富集並調節 TAD 絕緣強度。此外，我們發現 RBP 與 TAD 邊界的結合可能與新生的啟動子轉錄有關，因此 RBP/轉錄可能協同劃分 TAD，而不依賴於 CTCF 結合。這些發現使我們假設 RBP 通過新生啟動子轉錄物的共轉錄結合在 3D 水準上具有前所未有的基因調控功能。提出了三個目標 (1) 完成對 RBP/轉錄如何劃分 TAD 組織的計算分析； (2)進一步通過實驗闡明RBFox2如何主動驅動TAD組織； (3)進一步證明TAD的RBFox2調控如何促進成肌細胞分化。一旦完成，這項研究將首次揭示 TAD 組織中的 RBP 功能，從而增強我們對 3D 基因組的基礎知識，為未來治療相關人類疾病的治療發展奠定基礎。

14103622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14103622.value: 利多卡因降低慢性術後痛的隨機對照研究

14103622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103622.value: The primary aim of this randomized controlled trial is to determine the effectiveness of lidocaine, given during surgery and continuing for the first postoperative day, to prevent chronic postsurgical pain in women having breast cancer surgery. Advances in surgery has provided curative treatment to a large proportion of women with breast cancer. Despite its benefits, a substantial number of patients continue to suffer pain in their surgical wound for months or years after surgery. In our previous studies (funded by RGC), 13.5% of women reported distressing pain 12 months after breast cancer surgery. This was associated with significant limitations of daily activities and poorer quality of life. Lidocaine, an amide local anesthetic with membrane stabilizing properties, has been shown to decrease peripheral wind-up and central sensitization in experimental pain model and may therefore reduce the risk of chronic postsurgical pain. In a meta-analysis of six trials, including our pilot trial (n=545), lidocaine decreased the risk of chronic postsurgical pain, pooled odds ratio (95% confidence intervals): 0.46 (0.28–0.74), p<0.001. Although these are encouraging results, the sample size (median=89) was limited with few events (n=95), so that it is not possible to draw firm conclusion regarding the treatment effects. In this respect, an adequately powered clinical trial evaluating the potential benefit of lidocaine on chronic postsurgical pain has been rated as a priority for research in contemporary anesthesia. We propose to conduct an international, randomized trial to compare the effect of perioperative lidocaine infusion with a placebo (normal saline) on chronic postsurgical pain in 4,400 women at 12 months after major breast cancer surgery. Our secondary goals are to determine the effect of lidocaine on functional capability, mood and quality of recovery during the year after surgery. The expected findings of this trial will be of considerable scientific, social and economic significance. As millions of women undergoing breast cancer surgery worldwide every year, an effective intervention to prevent chronic postsurgical pain would spare millions of patients from the distress of disabling pain, life-long medications and repeat interventions. The findings could also be readily translated into practice, because all perioperative clinicians are familiar with the clinical use of lidocaine. 這項隨機對照試驗的主要目的是確定在手術期間並持續至術後第一天給予利多卡因，以預防接受乳腺癌手術的女性出現慢性術後疼痛的有效性。 外科手術的進步為大部分患有乳腺癌的女性提供了(積極治療)治愈性治療。儘管它有好處，但仍有大量患者在手術後數月或數年內繼續出現手術傷口疼痛。在我們以往的研究（由 RGC 資助）中，13.5% 的女性表示在乳腺癌手術後 12 個月還感受到令人痛苦的疼痛。這疼痛與日常活動上的限制及生活質量下降明顯有關。利多卡因是一種具有穩定特性的酰胺類局部麻醉劑，已被證明可減少實驗性疼痛模型中的外周纏繞和中樞敏感化，因此可降低慢性術後疼痛的風險。在包括我們的試點試驗 (n=545) 在內的六項試驗的統合分析中，利多卡因降低了慢性術後疼痛的風險，綜合優勢比率（95% 置信區間）：0.46 (0.28-0.74)，p<0.001。儘管這些結果令人鼓舞，但樣本量（中位數=89）有限，事件很少（n=95），因此無法就治療效果得出確切結論。在這方面，一項充分有力評估利多卡因對慢性術後疼痛的潛在益處的臨床試驗的臨床試驗，已被評為當代麻醉研究的優先事項。 我們建議開展一項國際性的隨機試驗，比較在術中和術後接受同等劑量的利多卡因與安慰劑（生理鹽水）輸液，對 4,400 名女性在乳腺癌手術後 12 個月內對慢性術後疼痛的影響。我們的次要目標是確定利多卡因對術後一年內身體活動能力、情緒和康復質量的影響。 該試驗的預期結果將具有相當大的科學、社會和經濟意義。由於全球每年有數百萬女性接受乳腺癌手術，因此預防慢性術後疼痛的有效治療措施將使數百萬患者免於遭受因為疼痛令日常生活受長期限制、終生藥物治療和重複治療而產生的痛苦。因為所有手術全期臨床醫生都熟悉利多卡因的臨床使用，所以這些發現很容易地轉化為臨床實踐。

14103722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103722.value: 固醇的吸收是一個有關健康的課題。人和動物合成的固醇叫膽固醇，而植物合成的固醇叫植物固醇。人體內的膽固醇可以自身製造亦可以從飲食中吸收。高膽固醇的攝入可增加患上心臟病的風險。膽固醇在小腸內的吸收高達65%以上，而植物固醇的吸收卻只有2%左右。研究發現植物固醇的攝入可降低患上心臟病的風險。為甚麼小腸會選擇性吸收膽固醇和植物固醇呢? 有研究指出這是因為腸壁細胞上的ATP 結合家族 (ABCG5 和ABCG8) 轉運蛋白會迅速從腸上皮細胞把植物固醇轉運到腸道，以阻止其吸收。不過，這個解釋不能完全詮釋上述問題，因為ABCG5和ABCG8 亦可以將膽固醇轉運到小腸。 我們假設除了ABCG5和ABCG8的轉運機理之外，低植物固醇的吸收率可能與乙醯輔酶A轉乙醯酶2 (ACAT2)有關。ACAT2在腸道的作用是把膽固醇轉化成膽固醇脂，以利於膽固醇的吸收。由於結構不同，而ACAT2可能不能把植物固醇轉化成相應的植物固醇酯，所以導致植物固醇吸收率低。本研究目標﹕(1) 合成六種不同結構和側鏈的固醇；(2) 測試它們對ACAT2酯化反應和與ABCG5和ABCG8的互相作用；(3) 檢視它們吸收效率和對血液膽固醇的影響；(4) 研究它們對於血管功能影響。本課題利用黃金倉鼠作為動物實驗對象或 Caco-2 細胞作為膽固醇吸收實驗模型。 我們成功合成五種固醇(A-G)和植物固醇F(穀固醇)作比較。固醇A是3β-甲氧基膽固醇；固醇B是3β-乙氧基膽固醇；固醇C沒有側鏈；固醇D有3個碳較短的側鏈；固醇E 有較長14個碳的側鏈；固醇F有分枝側鏈而乙基在第24碳上。我們之前進行兩個預備實驗，結果顯示固醇A到E容易吸收而不影響血液中膽固醇含量。相反，固醇F有多個分枝側鏈，所以不被吸收。而且固醇F可以有效降低血液中膽固醇含量。這樣清楚顯示固醇結構不同，其吸收率不同。我們的興趣是對以上各種固醇在小腸吸收過程中和轉運體、蛋白和酶，尤其是ACAT2、ABCG5和8相互作用做進一步研究。這研究結果將會為合成降低膽固醇藥物或補充劑奠定基礎。

14103822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14103822.value: 提升乳腺癌康復者的整體自尊感:隨機對照試驗

14103822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14103822.value: Prof Chan, Aileen Wai-kiu Dr Choi, Kai-chow Dr Liu, Ting Prof So, Winnie Kwok-wei

14103822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103822.value: 乳癌是全球婦女最常見的癌症。乳癌不僅在香港女性癌症死亡原因中排行第三位，而且對其康復者造成了極大的身體及心理創傷。自尊在乳癌康復者的幸福感中發揮著重要的作用，它能幫助乳癌康復者恢復正常生活並健康成長。運動能透過減低乳癌康復者的身心困擾來提升她們的自尊感，以達到最佳的整體健康狀態和生活質量水平。運動與自尊模型（EXSEM）支持了運動如何改善自尊的假定機制，即透過身體自我價值領域及其次領域（身體狀況，外表吸引力及肌力）的中介作用來提高整體自尊感。衆所周知，乳癌及其治療對上述次領域產生了不良影響，但關於日常運動對乳癌康復者自尊的影響的證據卻不那麽令人信服。因此，有必要探索針對乳癌康復者的具體運動模式。 太極對身體狀況、肌力及外表吸引力的潛在益處使其成爲適合乳癌康復者的運動。太極還可以解決運動依從性的常見障礙。太極改善的身體健康可能透過EXSEM的機制來提高自尊感。然而，在有限的研究中，方法學的局限性使得太極改善乳癌康復者自尊的證據不那麽令人信服。因此，此爲期34個月的項目旨在透過一個三臂臨床隨機對照試驗，比較24式太極組與快步走組和對照組對225名乳癌康復者自尊的影響。 干預組的參加者會接受為期9星期，每星期3次（每次60分鐘），合共27次小組形式的太極訓練。此外，她們還會接受1次個人化的健康諮詢，2次小組健康教育課程(每星期1次)。快步走組的參加者會接受為期9星期(每星期5天，每天36分鐘)的快步走練習。對照組會被要求維持平日的活動即可。快步走組和對照組都將參加各自的小組健康教育課程，以避免受試者間的干預沾染和注意偏移。所有參加者在基線、參與計劃後第十二週及第三十六週會被安排量度包括個人自尊感、運動自我效能、身體功能、心理健康、生活質量及幸福感等成效。混合效應模型將會用於量度干預效果。路徑分析將會用於檢驗EXSEM的擬合度。研究結果將為乳癌康復者的循證太極干預提供重要的實踐信息。

14104022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14104022.value: 透過激活組織駐留幹細胞祖細胞促進半月板組織再生

14104022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14104022.value: Ms Sun, Jing Prof Tuan, Rocky Sung Chi Mr Zhu, Xiaobo

14104022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104022.value: Menisci, the cartilage cushions in the knee joint, carry 50-85% of the joint load. A torn meniscus is one of the most common injuries of the knee joint. Current clinical treatments for meniscus tears are suturing and meniscectomy, which cannot avoid or prevent the progression of an injury to joint degeneration. As current treatments are palliative, research is now focused on developing effective cell-based therapies that allow in situ regeneration of the injured meniscus. We have investigated tissue-specific stem/progenitor cells in human adult cartilage and found capacities of these cells for repair and regeneration, migration, and chondrogenesis in reaction to injury and trauma. We have proven the ability of articular cartilage resident stem/progenitor cells to regenerate large osteochondral defects in clinical applications (Stem Cells Transl Med, 2016). The poor healing of the meniscus at the inner zone is similar to the poor healing of articular cartilage due to a lack of blood supply, a limited number of resident cells, and a low chance of extracellular matrix (ECM) remodelling. The meniscus resident cells, primarily fibrochondrocytes, are highly responsive to mechanical signals from load bearing. While the potential of meniscus tissue-resident stem/progenitor cells for the treatment of meniscus injuries in human adults has not been established, recent findings showed their role in tissue repair via activation of Gli1 signalling in mouse models. Sonic hedgehog (SHH) is another key member of the Hdegehog (Hh)/Gli signalling pathway. SHH is known as a crucial regulator of embryonic cartilage formation, but its role in the repair of damaged meniscus tissue is not known. In pilot studies using a hydrogel-based bio-actuator to provide load-bearing cyclic strain to human meniscus tissue-specific stem/progenitor cells (hMeSPCs), we observed a well-defined dynamic changes in the pericellular ECM under biomimetic mechanical loading. Furthermore, our preliminary data also indicated that stem cell activation and ECM deposition involve activation of SHH signalling. With the aim of native tissue regeneration, we hypothesise that biomimetic loading and the activation of SHH signalling in hMeSPCs can enhance the in situ healing of meniscus injuries. The hypotheses will be tested by: (1) characterising/optimising mechanoactivation of hMeSPCs in vitro, and (2) evaluating mechanoactivated hMeSPCs for meniscus healing in vivo. The successful implementation of this project will lay the scientific and technological foundations for new and advanced cell-based therapeutic strategies for the management of meniscus tears. 半月板是膝關節中的承重軟骨墊，半月板撕裂是膝關節最常見的損傷之一。目前的臨床治療包括縫合和半月板切除術，然卻無法阻止損傷向關節退化發展。本研究旨在開發促進損傷半月板原位再生的細胞療法。 我們的前期研究證實了成人軟骨中組織特異性幹/祖細胞的存在，並發現這些細胞能響應組織損傷進行遷移和軟骨分化以促進組織內部的修復和再生。我們前期的臨床實驗同樣證明了關節軟骨駐留幹/祖細胞具有促骨軟骨大面積缺損再生的能力(發表於Stem Cells Transl Med，2016)。半月板的內側軟骨與關節軟骨結構類似，都是無血管、少細胞、胞外基質重塑能力弱，缺乏自我修復能力的軟骨組織。 半月板組織的原位細胞主要包括纖維軟骨細胞，其對力學信號高度敏感。半月板原位的其他細胞還包括了組織特異性的幹細胞/祖細胞。目前半月板組織駐留幹/祖細胞是否具有治療成人半月板損傷方面的潛力還有待確定，但最近一項小鼠實驗表明半月板組織駐留幹/祖細胞可以通過激活Gli1信號傳導對受損組織進行修復。Sonic Hedgehog (SHH)是Hdegehog (Hh)/Gli信號通路的另一個關鍵因子，參與了胚胎軟骨形成，其在修復成體受損半月板中的作用尚未報道。我們在預實驗中使用了自製水凝膠生物反應器為人源半月板組織特異性幹/祖細胞提供了循環力學刺激，觀測到了在仿生力學載荷下細胞的激活和胞外基質的動態變化，並且發現了SHH信號通路參與了幹細胞、祖細胞的激活以及細胞外基質的生成和重塑。綜上，為實現半月板組織的原位再生，我們提出以下假說：半月板組織特異性幹/祖細胞可由力學刺激及SHH信號進行激活，並能促進組織損傷的原位癒合。本研究將進一步對力學及其相關信號激活半月板組織特異性幹/祖細胞的條件進行優化，並且評估激活的半月板組織特異性幹/祖細胞在體內半月板損傷癒合中的作用，為半月板撕裂細胞治療的新策略提供理論基礎和臨床前數據。
