14120522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14120522.value: 小鼠後腸中骶神經嵴細胞的遷移和分化

14120522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14120522.value: Dr Burns, Alan J. Prof Cheung, Martin Chi Hang Prof Sham, Mai Har Prof TSUI, Kwok Wing Stephen

14120522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14120522.value: 腸神經系統 (Enteric nervous system) 是胃腸道的內在神經系統, 用作調節大多數重要的胃腸道活動，包括蠕動。整個腸神經系統包括不同亞型的腸神經元和神經膠質細胞，都起源於神經嵴細胞（Neural crest cells）。在早期胚胎發育過程中，通過長距離遷移，神經嵴細胞到達發育中的腸道，並定殖整個胃腸道，從而形成腸神經系統。一般認為，神經嵴細胞在長距離的遷移中，以及/或者在它們分化過程中發生的錯誤，是導致腸神經元缺失的先天性腸神經病的可能原因。後腸是橫結腸和遠端結腸的前身，它的腸神經系統起源於位於兩個軸向水平的神經嵴細胞: 迷走神經嵴細胞和骶骨神經嵴細胞。由於腸神經系統的大多數腸神經節由迷走神經嵴細胞形成，所以關於後腸中神經嵴細胞發育的大部分資訊都源於對迷走神經嵴細胞的研究。然而對骶神經嵴細胞在後腸腸神經系統中作用的研究還是不足, 不足的情況在齧齒和哺乳動物中尤其明顯。 此前，我們已經繪制了骶神經嵴細胞在進入腸道前，從神經管到後腸的遷移路徑，並且識別了一些對於調節骶神經嵴細胞在進入後腸前的遷移起重要作用的分子。在這研究項目中，我們建議研究骶神經嵴細胞在進入後腸之後的遷移和分化。我們有以下的假設：這些骶神經嵴細胞是後腸腸神經系統的組成部分，它們能夠產生遠端結腸中特定的神經衍生物。在初步的研究中，我們集中探討了當迷走神經嵴細胞和骶神經嵴細胞在後腸中初次接觸時，這些細胞形態的動態變化。同時，我們也開發了一種先進的子宮外移植方法以研究骶神經嵴細胞在體內的分化。這裡，我們提出以下的研究方向：（1）確定在與後腸腸神經系統整合的不同階段中，骶神經嵴細胞的動態遷移行為以及其分化；（2）尋找對調節骶神經嵴細胞在後腸中的遷移有重要作用的分子和信號通路；（3）確定體內骶神經嵴細胞在後腸中的表型分化。此研究的結果將提供以下三方面重要的資訊: 骶神經嵴細胞如何整合到後腸腸神經系統，一些調節骶神經嵴細胞在後腸中遷移的分子以及骶神經嵴細胞在體內的神經衍生物。這些資訊將會增進我們對於後腸腸神經系統發育的理解以及提供一些關於腸神經病發病機理的見解。

14121222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14121222.value: 使用高通量 DNA 測序和生物信息學工具分析泥蟹的過敏原譜和代謝特徵

14121222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14121222.value: Prof AU, Shannon Wing-ngor Prof Leung, Ting Fan

14121222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14121222.value: Allergic diseases are common in developed countries, causing significant social and economic burden. The mud crab, which is the study focus of this project, is one of the prevalent causes of allergic sensitization and food-triggered anaphylaxis. In addition, mud crab is an important economic food resource in Hong Kong and Mainland China. Within the common mud crab species, S. serrata and S. paramamosain are the most predominant species in the Southern coast of China. In this study, a chromosome-level genome of S. serrata will be constructed using high throughput DNA sequencing and bioinformatics techniques. Furthermore, we will identify additional allergen groups as well as members of known allergen groups by immunoblotting and mass spectrometry using the proteomes predicted from the genomes of S. serrata and S. paramamosain. Finally, based on the S. serrata genome established in this study and related genomes collected from the public databases of the National Center for Biotechnology Information, the specific genes and metabolic pathways associated with the special features of mud crab will be unveiled using bioinformatics tools. We can anticipate that the establishment of a well-characterized panel of mud crab allergens should contribute to the development of component-resolved diagnostics and precision treatment of mud crab allergy. Concerning the genetic background underlying the metabolic characteristics of the mud crab, a deeper understanding of the special features of this economically important species should be beneficial to the future improvement of the mud crab culture and transport. 在發達國家，過敏性疾病是很常見的疾病，造成了嚴重的社會和經濟負擔。泥蟹是本項目的研究重點，也是過敏性致敏和食物引發的過敏反應的常見原因。此外， 泥蟹是香港及中國內地重要的經濟食物資源。 在常見的泥蟹種類中，S. serrata 和 S. paramamoosain 是最多的中國南部沿海的優勢品種。本研究將使用高通量 DNA 測序和生物信息學技術建構染色體水平的 S. serrata基因組。此外，我們將使用從 S. serrata 和 S. paramamosain 的基因組預測的蛋白質組以及通過免疫印跡和質譜技術分析已知過敏原組的成員和其他新發現的過敏原組。 最後，基於本研究建立的 S. serrata 基因組，以及從美國國家生物技術中心的公共數據庫中收集的信息，我們將使用生物信息學工具揭示與泥蟹的特徵相關的特定基因和代謝途徑。我們可以預見建立一個明確的泥蟹過敏原譜應該有助於開發泥蟹的組分分辨診斷和更精密地處理螃蟹過敏。而更深入了解泥蟹代謝特徵的遺傳背景，將有利於未來改良泥蟹的養殖和運輸。

14121322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14121322.value: 闡明奇異變形桿菌代謝物屍胺在調節克羅恩病炎症表型及免疫反應中的作用

14121322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14121322.value: 克羅恩病是一種複雜且易復發的慢性腸道炎症性疾病。其往年發病率在亞洲地區相對較低，然而近年來卻呈現快速增長趨勢。由於城市化程度不斷提高，香港成為亞洲地區發病率最高的國家之一。雖然遺傳易感性、環境暴露因素及腸道微生物失調已被假定與克羅恩病的發展相關，但其病因依然難以琢磨。在過去的二十年間，腸道微生物在克羅恩病中的作用已經被廣泛證實，然而最近的結果顯示，微生物代謝物通過調控腸道炎症反應及調節宿主免疫在很大程度上也參與了疾病的發展。奇異變形桿菌是一種屬於變形桿菌門的兼性厭氧菌，我們的團隊已經證實其與克羅恩病的發生及發展相關，然而其產生的代謝產物在克羅恩病中的潛在作用機制仍未可知。我們初步數據顯示，奇異變形桿菌與腸道菌群失調及代謝紊亂相關，奇異變形桿菌的存在會導致擬桿菌門及變形菌門擴增，厚壁菌門及放線菌門減少。與奇異變形桿菌陰性的病人及健康人相比，奇異變形桿菌陽性的克羅恩病人具有特殊的代謝物譜，其中胺類物質及甘油磷脂的比例較高。通過多重比較，我們發現屍胺，一種奇異變形桿菌分泌的代謝物，在奇異變形桿菌陽性的病人中含量也相應增加。腸道內屍胺有利於變形桿門及梭桿菌門的細菌生長，屍胺含量與克羅恩病活動指數（CDAI）呈正相關。將屍胺暴露於正常腸上皮細胞會誘導細胞變態反應及細胞死亡。因此，我們推測屍胺可以誘導腸道炎症並且是克羅恩病發展的重要參與因素。 為了證實我們的推測，我們提出四點目標：1）評估奇異變形桿菌代謝物屍胺，在體外改變菌群組成及代謝的作用；2）探討屍胺在克羅恩病中的作用及其潛在機制；3）闡明屍胺在調節克羅恩病免疫微環境中的作用；4）挖掘屍胺對於克羅恩病人的臨床意義。此項目將結合宏基因組測序、代謝組學分析及分子生物學的多學科研究方法。本項目的發現將確定屍胺在克羅恩病發病機制中的功能、機制及臨床意義，並且將為細菌代謝物在克羅恩病發展過程中的作用提供新的見解和方向。

14212422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14212422.value: 邏輯電路的表征學習及其在電子設計自動化領域的應用

14212422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14212422.value: Electronic design automation (EDA) has been the key enabling technology for the semiconductor industry. With the ever-increasing circuit design complexity, most EDA solutions are based on heuristics algorithms, which solve every problem instance from scratch according to some manually tuned parameters in the algorithms. In the past decade, deep learning (DL) models have achieved unparalleled performance in various domains. Applying DL to EDA problems has also become a trending topic as we could potentially achieve better solutions with knowledge accumulated from past successful designs. Many proposed solutions directly apply well-researched DL techniques (e.g., reinforcement learning or graph neural networks) to solve specific EDA problems. While demonstrating promising results, such design methodology ignores the unique properties of logic circuits and suffers from weak transferability. Motivated by the hugely successful pre-trained DL models in the computer vision and natural language processing domains, in this project, we investigate the fundamental problem of how to effectively and efficiently represent logic circuits as pre-trained models. To tackle this problem, we need to answer the following research questions: (i). How to construct a circuit dataset that facilitates effective and efficient representation learning? (ii). How to design the supervision tasks that effectively reveal circuit properties? (iii). How to build an effective DL model that is capable of harnessing the information embedded in the circuits? As circuits can be modeled as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), we plan to approach the above research problems by introducing a novel DAG neural network model trained on a carefully-crafted set of representative circuits, namely DeepGate. As for the supervision tasks, we propose using the circuit probabilities that provide rich structural information embedded in the circuits as the first step. Other possible supervision tasks (e.g., logic inference and circuit equivalence) will also be explored in this project. In contrast to existing DL-based EDA solutions, DeepGate explicitly considers the relational inductive bias in circuit graphs, enabling more effective representation learning for logic circuits. With well-trained representations for logic circuits, we then apply it to several long-standing EDA problems by finetuning the model for specific EDA tasks. The expected research outcome is to achieve state-of-the-art performance at a much shorter runtime than existing heuristic-based EDA solutions. 電子設計自動化（EDA）是半導體行業的關鍵技術。目前，大多數EDA解決方案基於啟發式算法，針對每個問題實例都要從頭來解決。深度學習技術通過在大量數據中學習，可以積累成功經驗，在很多領域取得了巨大的成功。近年來，將深度學習技術用於EDA問題也成為研究熱點，現有工作都是將相對成熟的深度學習技術（如強化學習）直接應用來解決特定的EDA問題。雖然取得了不錯的效果，這類研究工作忽略了邏輯電路的獨特屬性，在不同EDA任務之間也不具備遷移型。 在計算機視覺以及自然語言處理領域大獲成功的預訓練模型的啟發下，我們在本項目中研究如何通過預訓練對邏輯電路進行高效的表征學習，從而可以應用到多項下游的EDA任務。為此，我們要回答以下三個研究問題：（i) 如何構建一個有利於高效表征學習的電路數據集？（ii) 如何設計能夠有效獲取電路特征的自監督任務？（iii）如何設計針對邏輯電路的神經網絡模型？由於邏輯電路可以被建模成一個有向無環圖（DAG），我們計劃設計一個全新的DAG神經網絡模型來解決上述問題。我們準備首先使用每個邏輯門的概率作為自監督任務，從而同時學習到電路的邏輯功能和結構信息。此外，我們也準備將邏輯推理以及電路等價性作為自監督任務，進一步提升表征學習的能力。 在得到邏輯電路的有效表征後，我們準備將其應用於多個EDA任務。我們的預期成果是在這些任務上比現有啟發式EDA方案在運算時間更少的前提下達到更好的性能。

14212522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14212522.value: 連續時間馬爾可夫決策過程的強化學習的對數遺憾界

14212522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14212522.value: Reinforcement Learning refers to the problem of an agent learning how to map states to actions so as to maximize the reward over time in an unknown environment. It has received considerable attention in the Operations Research and the Artificial Intelligence communities in the past decades. Most of the current studies on reinforcement learning focus on algorithm design and theoretical analysis for discrete-time dynamical systems, and relatively less attention has been paid to continuous-time systems. In this project, we study reinforcement learning for controlled systems modelled by continuous time Markov decision processes. We focus on the infinite-horizon average-reward setting, where the agent/learner aims to learn from data a policy that optimizes the long-run average reward. The performance of the agent is measured by the total regret, which quantifies the loss incurred by the need of exploring sub-optimal actions to learn the system dynamics. Our objective is to derive problem-dependent regret lower bounds (that are logarithmic in the time horizon T) satisfied by any algorithm for online learning in continuous time Markov decision processes, and to design efficient learning algorithms that achieve the logarithmic rate. The proposed research will advance the theoretical foundations of continuous-time reinforcement learning and lead to a better understanding about the fundamental performance limits of learning algorithms. It will provide insights about what type of continuous-time decision problems are easier and more difficult for reinforcement learning, which can potentially benefit the design of problem specific solutions. The proposed research will also lead to the development of new algorithms for learning and controlling continuous-time dynamical systems, which can be potentially used in many applications such as the optimal control of epidemic processes. 強化學習是指智能體學習如何將狀態映射到動作的問題，以便在未知環境中最大化累積的收益。在過去的幾十年裡，它在運籌學和人工智能領域受到了相當大的關注。目前關於強化學習的研究大多集中在離散時間動態系統的算法設計和理論分析上，而對連續時間系統的關注相對較少。在這個項目中，我們研究由連續時間馬爾可夫決策過程建模的控制系統的強化學習。我們專注於無限期平均獎勵，其中智能體旨在從數據中學習優化長期平均獎勵的策略。智能體的性能是通過總遺憾來衡量的，它量化了探索次優動作以學習系統所帶來的損失。我們的目標是推導出任何在線學習算法在連續時間馬爾可夫決策過程中滿足的與問題相關的遺憾下限，並設計實現有效的學習算法。擬議的研究將推進連續時間強化學習的理論基礎，並更好地理解學習算法的性能限制。它將提高我們關於學習連續時間決策問題難度的認識，這可能有利於問題特定解決方案的設計。擬議的研究還將開髮用於學習和控制連續時間動態系統的新算法，這些算法可能會用於許多應用，例如流行病過程的優化控制。

14212822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14212822.value: 配電網約束下分佈式能源快速頻率響應的優化

14212822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14212822.value: The increasing shares of highly variable and low-inertia wind and solar generation are threatening power system stability. Alleviating this threat calls for active participation of distributed energy resources (DERs, such as controllable loads, batteries, and solar photovoltaics) in power system dynamics and control, particularly the fast frequency response including inertial response and primary frequency control. However, the fact that these DERs are integrated into distribution networks makes it difficult to analyze and optimize the interactions between DER control and frequency dynamics--because the former is restricted by complicated physical and operational constraints of distribution networks, while the latter arises from the bulk transmission network that connects distribution networks with synchronous generators. In this project, we aim to develop a systematic framework for DERs to provide fast frequency response to the transmission network, under realistic nonlinear alternating-current (AC) power flow models and voltage safety limits of distribution networks. Backed by rigorous mathematical analyses and accurate software simulations, the proposed framework will be distinguished from related work by the following features: (1) At the distribution level, the capabilities of DERs to provide fast frequency reserve can be quantified under realistic nonlinear distribution network models. This shall make our framework more reliable than existing efforts based on simplified (e.g., linearized) models. (2) At the transmission level, the power exchanges at substations can be optimized to respect the safety limits of the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF), frequency overshoot, settling time, and steady-state error, while achieving a desired trade-off between these metrics. Compared to other studies that considered similar criteria, our framework will include the limits on fast frequency reserves exerted by distribution network constraints. (3) The proposed framework will be extended to incorporate different volt/var control strategies of DERs. Analytical and experimental studies will reveal the impact of these strategies on fast frequency reserve and response. 為緩解日益增加的易變性、低慣量風力及太陽能發電對電力系統穩定性的威脅，分佈式能源（可控負載、電池、光伏逆變器等）需要主動參與電力系統的動態與控制，尤其是快速頻率響應（包括慣量響應和一次調頻）。然而考慮到分佈式能源併入配電網的現實，難以分析和優化分佈式能源控制與頻率動態之間的交互：前者受到配電網複雜的物理和運行約束，而後者發生於連接配電網和同步發電機的輸電網。 本項目旨在開發一套系統性框架，使得在實際的配電網非線性交流潮流模型和電壓安全限制下，分佈式能源可向輸電網提供快速頻率響應。依託嚴密的數學分析和精確的軟件仿真，該框架與相關工作有如下顯著區別： 其一，在配電網側，我們將在實際的非線性配電網模型下量化分佈式能源提供快速頻率儲備的能力，相比基於簡化（如線性化）模型的現有工作，我們的框架更加可靠。 其二，在輸電網側，我們將優化變電站處的電力交換來滿足頻率變化率、超調、穩定時間、穩態誤差的安全限制，並在這些指標之間達到理想的平衡。相比其他考慮類似指標的研究，我們的框架將包含配電網約束施加於快速頻率儲備的限制。 其三，我們的框架將被擴展到包含各種分佈式能源電壓/無功控制策略的情況。我們將通過分析與實驗來揭示這些控制策略對快速頻率儲備和響應效果的影響。

14213322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14213322.value: 使用非侵入性屏氣定量自旋鎖磁共振同時量化肝脂肪含量、脂肪酸組成和纖維化以評估非酒精性脂肪性肝炎

14213322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14213322.value: Prof Chu, Chiu Wing Winnie Mr Hou, Jian Dr Leung, Ho Wai Howard Prof Wang, Yi-Xiang Dr Wong, Vincent Wai Sun

14213322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14213322.value: 目標 開發一種快速、穩定的非侵入性的基於屏氣自旋鎖磁共振技術以同時量化肝臟脂肪含量、脂肪酸組成和纖維化來評估非酒精性脂肪性肝炎(NASH)。 背景 非酒精性脂肪肝是一全球健康問題。它包括簡單的脂肪變性和在肝臟中出現炎症的 NASH。脂肪含量、纖維化和炎症是評估 NASH 的三個重要組成部分。肝活檢是目前診斷 NASH 的金標準。但是肝活檢是侵入性的。現有的非侵入性方法在評估 NASH 上仍有很大的局限性。 一些研究指出探測脂肪酸組成有潛力用來評估代謝紊亂和炎症。但是這種測量不能用於評估纖維化。肝纖維化的特徵是肝臟中富含膠原蛋白的結締組織過度沉積。大分子質子分數 (MPF)是一種反映組織中大分子水平的磁共振參數。對MPF的定量成像有潛力來探測肝纖維化。但是迄今并無研究給出炎症對 MPF 測量的具體影響。總之，使用非侵入性成像方法評估NASH仍然具有挑戰性。 項目描述 基於我們之前開發的自旋鎖磁共振技術，我們將研發一種快速採集技術來同時量化肝臟的脂肪含量、脂肪酸組成和纖維化。我們會在一個14秒的屏氣内完成單層數據采集。我們的方法不需要額外的硬件，也不需要注入造影劑。我們將在志願者身上測試我們方法的可重複性。為了評估其臨床價值，我們將在本研究中招募 120 名受試者（60 名患有單純性脂肪變性，60 名患有 NASH）。我們將使用組織學分析作為金標準，並評估我們提出的方法在診斷NASH上的臨床價值。 項目意義 該項目將為 NASH 的評估提供一種非侵入性診斷技術。我們提出的磁共振技術也有可能應用於其他臨床目的。

14213622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14213622.value: The focus of this proposed project is to investigate the triboelectric charge generation using liquid-solid and liquid-liquid interfaces, develop technologies that promote the charge density, current density, and output power density, and explore applications in ocean-wave energy harvesting and self-powered wireless sensing. 70% of the Earth’s surface is covered by ocean representing an immense untapped clean and renewable energy source of over 75 TW, which is able to satisfy energy demands around the world. To effectively harvest energy from ocean waves, efforts have been devoted to developing triboelectric nanogenerator (TENG) technology to efficiently capture the low-frequency ocean-wave energies. However, current TENG designs rely on the solid-solid interface which suffers from several disadvantages including high friction, low durability, low contact intimacy, and increased likelihood of breakdown discharge as demonstrated in our previous studies. With these effects, severe energy losses are possible within the solid-solid-interface TENGs and negatively impact overall output, energy conversion efficiency, and long-term stability. The proposed studies are therefore imperative in both fundamental and practical contexts to encourage paradigm-shift strategies to address these issues. Here we propose to develop a liquid-liquid-solid ternary-interface (LSTI) TENG involving both liquid-solid and liquid-liquid interfaces, which can address the problems inherent in the solid-solid interface and improve output performance. The ternary interface design can further promote triboelectric charge generation by providing multiple interfaces and minimizing exposure to air. By optimizing the type of liquid and the structure employed, we hope to achieve volumetric current density of > 20 mA/m3 and power density of ~100 W/m3 at 1 Hz, exceeding values previously reported with solid-solid-interface TENGs. We will demonstrate the high-output water-wave energy harvesting and self-powered wireless sensing in lab settings and in the ocean environment. This project will provide a novel solution that improves output performance when harvesting energy from ocean waves through the liquid-solid and liquid-liquid interfaces. The LSTI-TENG will have a simple, easy-in-fabrication, low-cost configuration, and will provide ultrahigh charge density and excellent output performance. In addition, this LSTI-TENG is able to work in multiple modes which is ideal for harvesting energy from irregular ocean waves and may provide long-term solutions in addressing the worldwide energy crisis and achieving carbon neutrality. Further, we will demonstrate a self-powered wireless sensing system to monitor the ocean waves which is desirable for the marine explorations. N/A

14213922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14213922.value: 簡易結締組織工程：具有順應性和生長因子固定區域的可減輕壓力並誘導多組織形成的3D 打印一體支架

14213922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14213922.value: 三維 (3D) 打印技術已經革新了現代產品設計和製造。當應用於空間性可控的多組織形成的先進組織工程技術時，有望生產出實用且經濟有效的再生醫學應用產品。很多結締組織損傷和疾病（例如肩袖撕裂）會對多組織單元 （例如從硬到軟、骨到肌腱的附著）產生負面影響。然而這些多組織單元的協調作用對於個體活動性和個人生活質量至關重要。由於骨骼和肌腱的機械性能不匹配、組織癒合不良以及現有移植物方面的限制，使得骨-肌腱修復具有挑戰性。 儘管在生物材料製造和肌肉骨骼分化方面的研究取得了許多進展，但很少有針對多組織修復的簡便易行的解決方法。這對擴大到工業級或醫療點（醫院內）生產和獲得產品監管部門的批准提出了挑戰。具體來說，最先進的方法涉及復雜的多材料支架和/或生長因子（GF）、藥物或細胞的複雜組合，以實現成功修復所需達到的生物機械穩健性和生物活性，並取得了不同程度的成功。 在本項研究中，我們專注於利用一種具有強大機械性能和生物活性的支架進行簡易製造和多組織分化。我們將從機械性能方面評估這種使用順應性減少壓力以實現持久修復和肩功能恢復的3D 打印的一體移植物（目標 1）；通過生物學評估移植物固定化的生長因子混合物在體外刺激細胞同時分化纖維軟骨細胞和肌腱細胞以進行多組織再生的能力（目標 2）；並評估移植物在體內的生物機械性能和生物學性能（目標 3）。 初步研究證明了本項目具有很高的可行性：(i) 我們的生物材料是在室溫和大氣環境條件下製造的，具有類似肌腱的機械性能和優越的移植物屬性（相比於臨床可用的移植物），並且作為 3D 打印的一體支架，可通過順應性減少壓力，(ii) 可以在體外通過單一GF混合物同時誘導纖維軟骨和肌腱樣細胞多組織分化，(iii) 以及GF固定的生物材料在兔肩袖損傷模型中可誘導約 1 厘米的肌腱再生。 本研究推進了以下技術和概念性知識：(i) 輕鬆製造具有減壓能力的一體支架和 (ii) 通過單一 GF 混合物促進多組織形成。本研究有望生產出一種可承受關節負荷，促進持久修復和多組織癒合的具有臨床應用前景的移植物。該移植物將具有廣泛的組織工程應用潛力。

14214022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14214022.value: 基於工頻電磁輻射感知的無基礎設施室內定位

14214022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14214022.value: Indoor localization is an essential service for both manufacturing automation and consumer IoT applications. In factories, autonomous guided vehicles need localization for transportation. As people are spending more time in enclosed buildings, indoor localization is important to improve people's living qualities. For example, continuous locating children, the elderly, and people with disabilities is vital for activity monitoring and timely health supports in homes and care facilities. Visitors' location awareness provides seamless multimedia guides in museums. However, most existing indoor localization approaches rely on extra infrastructures, e.g., Wi-Fi access points, Bluetooth beacons, and QR codes, which introduce excessive overhead to the deployment of localization systems. Powerline electromagnetic radiation (EMR) is the compound induced by the alternating current of powerlines, whose amplitude varies in spatial and is time-independent. Thus it is especially suitable for indoor localization technologies. Existing approaches leverage powerline EMR to localize objects by actively injecting multiple frequencies into power lines or leveraging bulky and expensive measurement units, which are ill-suited for industrial and home localization applications. In this proposal, we aim to design an infrastructure-free indoor localization system called EMRLoc that relies on the EMR signals induced from power lines. EMRLoc contains three major designs. First, we will develop EMRSense, a compact powerline EMR sensor with a three-axis coil inductor. To the best of our knowledge, this will be the first IoT sensor specially designed for passively capturing powerline EMR. With the onboard compass, EMRSense can capture fine-grained powerline EMR data regardless of the variations of postures and movements. Second, we will explore the extra EMR energy induced by power lines using off-the-shelf IoT devices. When EMRSense is not available, we can also exploit the inertial measurement unit (IMU) circuits installed on existing IoT devices (e.g., smartphones and smartwatches) to extract the induced powerline EMR energy. Finally, we will develop EMRLoc, an end-to-end indoor localization system based on the powerline EMR fingerprints captured by either EMRSense or existing IMU devices. We will leverage deep learning-based techniques to classify the pre-defined points of interest (POIs). Specifically, EMRLoc adopts supervised contrastive loss to improve the localization robustness of the neighborhood points around POIs. Meanwhile, EMRLoc can adapt to new or significantly changed environments with limited labeled data using the few-shot learning algorithm. EMRLoc can work together with other localization signals for complementary advantages. We will extensively evaluate EMRLoc in real-world settings such as residential buildings, offices, museums, shopping malls, and conference halls. 室內定位是自動化工業生產和消費物聯網應用的一項基本服務。工廠中自動導引車的運輸任務需要依賴定位。隨著人們越來越多的時間在建築內，室內定位對於提高人們的生活質量非常重要。例如，持續地定位兒童、老人和殘疾人對於家庭和護理機構的活動監測和及時的健康支持至關重要。位置感知也有助於向博物館參觀者提供無縫的多媒體指引。然而大多數現有的室內定位方法都依賴於額外的基礎設施，例如Wi-Fi接入點、藍牙信標和二維碼，這給定位系統的部署帶來了額外的開銷。電力線的交變電流會產生工頻電磁輻射，其幅值隨空間變化且與時間無關，因此它特別適用於室內的定位技術。現有方法利用工頻電磁輻射的方法依賴於主動向電力線注入多個頻率或利用笨重且昂貴的測量單元來定位對象，這不適合工業和家庭的定位應用。 在本提案中，我們的目標是設計一種稱為EMRLoc的無基礎設施室內定位系統。該系統將使用電力線感應的電磁輻射信號。 EMRLoc包含三個主要設計：首先，我們將開發 EMRSense，一種帶有三軸線圈電感器的小型工頻電磁輻射傳感器。據我們所知，這將是第一個專門為被動採集工頻電磁輻射而設計的物聯網傳感器。借助羅盤傳感器，EMRSense可以捕獲細粒度的工頻電磁輻射數據而不受姿勢和運動的影響。其次，我們將使用現成的物聯網設備探索由電力線引起的額外EMR能量。當EMRSense不可用時，我們還可以利用安裝在現有物聯網設備（例如智能手機和智能手錶）上的慣性測量單元電路來提取感應工頻電磁輻射能量。最後，我們將開發EMRLoc，這是一個基於EMRSense或現有IMU設備捕獲的工頻電磁輻射指紋的端到端室內定位系統。我們將利用基於深度學習的技術對預定義的興趣點進行分類。 EMRLoc採用有監督的對比學習來提高興趣點周圍的定位魯棒性。同時，EMRLoc可以使用少樣本學習算法適應標記數據有限的新環境或顯著變化的環境。 EMRLoc可以與其他定位信號一起工作以獲得互補優勢。我們將在住宅樓、辦公室、博物館、購物中心和會議廳等現實環境中廣泛評估EMRLoc。

14214122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14214122.value: 聯邦學習中的差分隱私研究

14214122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14214122.value: The availability of massive data at mobile devices has led to a surge of interest in developing artificial intelligence (AI) services at the edge of next-generation wireless systems. To harvest mobile devices’ computing power and facilitate distributed machine learning, federated learning (FL) has emerged as a new paradigm where mobile devices collaboratively train an AI model without uploading their local data to the server. FL appears to be an appealing solution for data privacy preservation, as local data are retained on mobile devices. Unfortunately, recent research shows that the model parameters exchanged during FL iterations are susceptible to privacy risks. As a result, data privacy remains a primary concern that hinders mobile devices from participating in FL. Differential Privacy (DP), a rigorous notion of statistical data privacy, has recently gained immense popularity in the machine learning and statistical analysis community. Practical deployment of DP has been successfully piloted by Google, Microsoft, Apple, and the U.S. Census Bureau. Latest research efforts have extended DP to protect data privacy FL systems. It is, however, noted that privacy preservation significantly compromises the FL accuracy, especially in a wireless environment where every round of model-parameter exchange is susceptible to privacy breaches. To render differentially private FL a viable technology in future mobile systems, this project endeavors to investigate the joint design of communication and computation to greatly improve the privacy-learning tradeoff in wireless FL. In particular, we plan to focus on the following important tasks: (1) to understand how advanced PHY-layer signal processing can be leveraged as a means of post-processing to amplify privacy and improve the privacy-learning trade-off in wireless FL systems; (2) to design an optimal device scheduling strategy to achieve privacy amplification without compromising FL accuracy; and (3) to derive the optimal computation-to-communication ratio that hits the best balance between privacy preservation and learning accuracy. Specifically, we plan to conduct our research in the context of over-the-air computation, which exploits the signal-superposition property of wireless multi-access channels to compute the model aggregation via concurrent transmission of multiple devices. Federated learning is an essential building block of mobile edge intelligence in future wireless networks. Local data privacy is undoubtedly a pressing issue that must be identified, understood, and effectively tackled. If successful, this project will greatly advance the state-of-the-art and accelerate the massive adoption of differentially private FL in next-generation wireless networks. 移動大數據激發人們在下一代無線系統邊緣開發人工智能 (AI) 服務的興趣。聯邦學習 (FL) 已成為分布式移動學習的新範式，在聯邦學習中，移動設備無需將本地數據上傳到服務器即可協同訓練 AI 模型。 最近的研究表明，在 FL疊代期間交換的模型參數容易受到隱私風險的影響。因此，數據隱私仍然是阻礙移動設備參與 FL 的主要問題。 差分隱私 (DP) 最近在機器學習和數據統計領域中廣受歡迎。谷歌、微軟、蘋果和美國人口普查局已成功試行 DP 的實際部署。最新的研究工作已將 DP 擴展到FL系統中的數據隱私保護。然而，值得注意的是，隱私保護會顯著損害 FL 的訓練準確性，尤其是在無線環境中。 為了使差分隱私 FL 在未來的移動系統中成為一種可行的技術，該項目致力於研究通信和計算的聯合設計，以極大地改善無線 FL 中的隱私學習平衡。我們計劃專注於以下重要任務：（1）了解如何利用 PHY 層信號處理作為一種後處理手段來放大隱私並改善無線 FL 中的隱私學習平衡； (2) 設計最優的設備調度策略，在不影響FL精度的情況下實現隱私放大； (3) 推導出在隱私保護和學習準確性之間達到最佳平衡的最佳計算與通信比率。 聯合學習是未來無線網絡中移動邊緣智能的重要組成部分。本地數據隱私無疑是一個必須理解和有效解決的緊迫問題。如果成功，該項目將極大地推進最先進的技術並加速差分私有 FL 在下一代無線網絡中的大規模採用。

14214622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14214622.value: 分佈式鍵值存儲的分離冗餘管理

14214622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14214622.value: Distributed key-value (KV) stores improve the performance and scalability of data management over traditional relational databases and have been widely adopted in the modern storage infrastructure for hosting data-intensive applications. To provide fault tolerance, state-of-the-art distributed KV stores often adopt replication, which distributes multiple exact copies of KV objects across storage nodes for protecting against data loss in any storage node. However, replication exacerbates the read/write amplifications in internal storage management of individual storage nodes and leads to significant performance degradations. Our earlier experiments find that state-of-the-art distributed KV stores manage all replicas in the same index structure and incur significant read/write amplifications that grow beyond the redundancy overhead. Also, replication incurs significant storage overhead and poses scalability concerns in the face of the ever-increasing amounts of KV objects. In this research, we examine a new storage paradigm called decoupled redundancy management, whose idea is to separately design index structures and storage management policies for the primary copies (i.e., the original copies) and the redundant copies (i.e., the additional copies for fault tolerance) of KV objects. Decoupled redundancy management provides two benefits. First, it alleviates the storage management overhead in the index structures, thereby improving I/O performance. Second, it provides flexibility for designing different index structures for the primary copies and the redundant copies to address different performance requirements. This research has the following objectives. (1) We start with replication-based KV storage and present a tunable replica logging design, such that the redundant copies of KV objects are maintained in append-only logs with tunable ordering for balanced read and write performance. (2) We extend replication to erasure coding to significantly reduce storage overhead, and further present a tunable parity logging design, such that the parity chunks are maintained in append-only logs with tunable merging operations for balanced update and recovery performance. (3) We apply our tunable logging designs for the emerging zoned storage hardware and design zone-aware data placement with minimal write amplification. (4) We prototype a full-fledged distributed KV store with decoupled redundancy management and evaluate its performance in real-world networked environments. Our findings on decoupled redundancy management will open a new research direction for distributed KV stores with high performance, fault tolerance, and space efficiency guarantees. Our research also enriches Hong Kong government policies, by proposing novel storage solutions for supporting the cloud and big data analytics platforms that are recently launched by the Hong Kong government. 分佈式鍵值 (KV) 存儲相比傳統關係數據庫提高了數據管理的性能和可擴展性，並已廣泛用於現代存儲基礎架構中託管數據密集型應用程序。為了提供容錯能力，最先進的分佈式 KV 存儲通常採用複製方案，即跨存儲節點分發 KV 對象的多個精確副本，以防止任何存儲節點中的數據丟失。然而，複製方案加劇了單個存儲節點內部存儲管理中的讀/寫放大，並導致顯著的性能下降。我們早期的實驗發現，最先進的分佈式 KV 存儲在相同的索引結構中管理所有副本，並且會產生超出冗餘開銷的顯著讀/寫放大。此外，面對不斷增加的 KV 對像數量，複製方案會產生巨大的存儲開銷並帶來可擴展性問題。 在這項研究中，我們研究了一種稱為分離冗餘管理的新存儲範式，其思想是分別為主副本（即原始副本）和冗餘副本（即故障的附加副本）設計索引結構和存儲管理策略KV 對象的容差。分離冗餘管理提供了兩個好處。首先，它減輕了索引結構中的存儲管理開銷，從而提高了 I/O 性能。其次，它為主副本和冗餘副本設計不同的索引結構提供了靈活性，以滿足不同的性能要求。 本研究有以下目標。 (1) 我們從基於複製方案的 KV 存儲開始，並提出了一種可調的副本日誌設計，這樣 KV 對象的冗餘副本在僅追加的日誌中維護，具有可調的順序以實現平衡的讀寫性能。 (2) 我們將複製方案擴展到糾刪碼以顯著降低存儲開銷，並進一步提出了一種可調奇偶校驗日誌設計，使得奇偶校驗塊維護在僅附加日誌中，並具有可調的合併操作，以實現平衡的更新和恢復性能。 (3) 我們將可調日誌設計應用於新興的分區存儲硬件，並設計具有最小寫入放大的區域感知數據放置。 (4) 我們對具有分離冗餘管理的成熟分佈式 KV 存儲進行原型設計，並評估其在真實網絡環境中的性能。 我們在分離冗餘管理方面的發現將為具有高性能、容錯性和空間效率保證的分佈式 KV 存儲開闢新的研究方向。我們的研究還通過提出新的存儲解決方案來支持香港政府最近推出的雲和大數據分析平台，從而為香港政府政策提供新的方向。

14214822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14214822.value: 具有空中計算的共存通信網絡

14214822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14214822.value: With the development of the Internet-of-Things (IoT), the number of smart devices is growing tremendously. Many of these devices, such as sensors, generate data to be subsequently collected on servers. Traditionally, different devices use multiple access technologies, such as time division multiple access (TDMA) or frequency division multiple access (FDMA), to transmit to the access point. However, the result can be poor bandwidth efficiency, high latency, and low freshness of data. On the other hand, in the event that data from different devices are to be aggregated, it may be possible and even beneficial to allow multiple nodes to transmit simultaneously so that the signals are combined wirelessly over the channel, which is the basic idea of over-the-air computing. While there are considerable results attempting to optimize isolated IoT/sensor networks with over-the-air computing, the interaction between the IoT/sensor network with over-the-air computing and other co-existing networks, such as the cellular network, is still an open problem. With the proliferation of IoT/sensor networks, we anticipate that such interactions will be very common in the future and therefore urge to address this issue. The goal of this project is to fill this research gap by investigating the optimization and co-existence of general communication networks and IoT/sensor networks with over-the-air computing. We would consider different models that integrate different technologies into co-existing networks. The co-existence of different types of networks in the same space at the same spectrum poses a great challenge to interference management. We would consider different techniques, including non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA), interference alignment, and etc., to tackle the problems. We would also try to optimize the IoT/sensor network via power control, opportunistic transmission and energy harvesting. We expect that our results would enhance the design and implementation of co-existing communication systems with over-the-air computing. 隨著物聯網（IoT）的發展，智能設備的數量增長巨大。其中許多設備（例如傳感器）會生成待處理的數據，隨後收集在伺服器上。傳統上，不同的設備使用多重訪問技術，例如時分多址 (TDMA) 或頻分多路訪問 (FDMA)，傳輸到接入點。但是，結果可能是低帶寬效率，高延遲和低數據新鮮度。另一方面，如果要聚合來自不同設備的數據，允許多個節點同時傳輸是可能的，甚至是有益的，以便信號在信道上以無線方式組合，這就是空中計算。雖然在嘗試優化單一採用空中計算的物聯網/傳感器網絡方面取得了相當的成果，採用空中計算的物聯網/傳感器網絡與其他網絡共存，如蜂窩網絡，仍然是一個懸而未決的問題。隨著物聯網/傳感器網絡的普及，我們預計這種互動在未來將非常普遍，因此敦促解決這個問題。這項目的目標是研究具有空中計算能力的網絡和通用通信網絡的優化和共存。我們會考慮將不同技術整合到共存網絡中的不同模型。不同類型的網絡在同一空間和相同的頻譜共存對干擾管理提出了很大的挑戰。我們會考慮不同的技術，包括非正交多址 (NOMA)，干擾對齊等，以解決問題。我們也會嘗試通過功率控制、機會傳輸和能量收穫來優化物聯網/傳感器網絡。我們希望我們的結果將加強具有空中計算能力的共存通信網絡的設計和實施。

14215722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14215722.value: 用於分析智能網絡的排隊和資源分配問題的在線強盜方法：方法、算法和應用

14215722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14215722.value: 排隊模型已廣泛用於抽象許多現實世界的應用，包括電信中的交通調度、製造系統中的容量規劃和交通系統中的擁塞控制。事實上，排隊模型在互聯網設計的早期發揮了至關重要的作用。然而，分析排隊模型通常並不容易。為了在這些排隊模型的性能指標上獲得封閉形式的解決方案，需要對到達和服務過程施加限制性假設。有時，即使施加了這些假設，封閉形式的解決方案也很難推導出來，或者產品形式的解決方案可以不存在。現實生活中很多系統的設計，工程師往往對到達時間和服務時間過程一無所知，因此很難進行任何協議優化，此外，資源分配過程中存在不同的操作約束，而這些約束對許多應用都非常重要。因此，如何在沒有任何先驗知識的情況下優化具有各種約束的隊列之間的資源分配這些隊列的參數具有重大挑戰。 在這項研究中，我們的主要目標是開發一種新的方法來提供對這些未知排隊參數的無偏估計，同時在在線設置下執行資源分配，同時執行系統約束（即工作之間的公平性）。 此外，資源分配策略需要是漸近最優的，同時滿足應用程序指定的約束。 開發這種方法具有挑戰性，因為我們必須實時提供這些排隊參數的無偏估計，但我們還需要考慮適當數量的資源分配的時變和連續行動（或決策）空間。 此外，許多應用程序的性能度量通常本質上是非線性的，這給設計正確的分配策略增加了額外的挑戰。 本研究考慮開發基礎數學理論和算法框架 "智能網絡的在線資源分配''。 除了理論和算法發展，我們計劃將這一新理論應用於與我們的合作者合作的新興網絡應用程序。該項目將為計算機科學和其他學科提供新的理論原理工程學科，將為香港和中國眾多互聯網公司帶來利益。

14215822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14215822.value: 從高階單環方向研究寬帶連續時間德爾塔-西格瑪調製器

14215822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14215822.value: Analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) for wideband (50MHz or wider) signals are essential for wireless receivers for new generation of wireless-LAN standards, the long-term evolution advanced standard (LTE-A), and the fifth-generation (5G) technology standard, among others. Continuous-time (CT) Delta-Sigma modulators (DSMs) are considered the ADC of choice for these applications due to their high power efficiency, inherent alias rejection, and easy input driving. For a DSM, a wide bandwidth leads to a low oversampling ratio (OSR) because the sampling frequency (Fs) is limited by the technology used. Under this constraint, it is challenging to achieve a high signal-to-quantization noise ratio (SQNR) for the DSM. A high modulator order is a natural solution to achieve a high SQNR under a low OSR. However, a high-order DSM of any existing single-loop architecture is hard to stabilize, or leads to a small peak out-of-band gain (OBG) of its noise transfer function, which reduces the SQNR. The multi-stage noise shaping (MASH) architecture is a solution to the stability problem, but has the severe problem of noise leakage. For these reasons, state-of-the-art single-loop and MASH wideband DSMs have their orders limited to 4. Among the 4th-order ones, the highest OBG is 2.85. Using a noise-shaping (NS) quantizer can also increase the order of a DSM, but requires a clock rate several times Fs, which lowers the maximally achievable bandwidth of the DSM. Therefore, it is of tremendous scientific and practical value to develop a stable single-loop wideband CT DSM architecture that (a) has an order > 4, (b) has an OBG > 2.85, and (c) does not need a clock rate exceeding Fs. Furthermore, a power-efficient circuit method to implement the DSM will be significant. In this project, we will first investigate a new single-loop CT DSM architecture to achieve an order of 6 and an OBG > 4.5 by using a new quantizer, called NS flash. We will then investigate a circuit method that uses only three amplifiers to realize the 6th-order DSM for high power efficiency. We plan to develop 100-MHz bandwidth CT DSMs in 28nm CMOS to validate the theory. The project will generate new insights into the stability of high-order DSMs, create new architecture that enables never-before-seen order and OBG, and introduce new circuits that improve the power efficiency for wideband CT DSMs. This project will also lay a foundation to expand the bandwidth limit of CT DSMs. 寬带（50MHz或更寬）信號的模數轉換器（ADC）對於新一代無線局域網標準（WLAN）、長期演進高級標準（LTE-A）和第五代（5G） 技術標準等的無線接收器至關重要。 連續時間（CT）德爾塔-西格瑪調製器（DSM）因其高能效、固有的混疊抑制功能和輸入端易於驅動而被認為是上述應用的首選ADC。 對於DSM，因為最高採樣頻率（Fs）受到所用製程限制，寬带寬會導致低過採樣率（OSR）。 在這種約束條件下，實現DSM的高信號量化噪聲比（SQNR）具有挑戰性。 高調製器階數是在低OSR下實現高SQNR的自然解決方案。 然而，任何現有單環結構的高階DSM要麼很難穩定，要麼其噪聲傳遞函數的帶外增益（OBG）峰值很小，導致低SQNR。多級噪聲整形（MASH）架構是一種穩定性問題的解決方案， 但存在嚴重的噪聲洩漏問題。 出於這些原因，目前先進的單環路和MASH寬带DSM的階數限制為4。 在四階DSM中，最高OBG為2.85。 使用噪聲整形（NS）量化器也可以增加DSM的階數，但需要數倍於Fs的時鐘速率，這降低了DSM的最大可實現带寬。 因此，開發一種穩定的單環寬帶CTDSM架構具有巨大的科學和實用價值，該架構應具有以下特點：（a）調製器階數>4;（b）帶外增益OBG>2.85;（c）不需要超過Fs的時鐘速率。 此外，開發低功耗電路以實現這種DSM將具有重要意義。 本項目首先將研究一種新的單環CTDSM架構，通過使用稱為NS flash的新量化器以實現6階和OBG>4.5。 接著，我們將研究一種僅使用三個放大器以高能效實現六階DSM的電路方法。 我們計劃在28nm CMOS製程中開發一帶寬為100MHz的CTDSM，以驗證理論。 本項目將對高階DSM的穩定性產生新的見解，創建新的架構，實現前所未有的高階和OBG， 並引入新的電路，提高寬帶CTDSM的能效。 本項目還將為擴展CTDSM的帶寬上限奠定基礎。

14216022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14216022.value: 主動視觸覺引導半自動膀胱微結構檢查

14216022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14216022.value: Prof Meng, Max Qing-Hu Prof Ng, Chi-fai Prof Yuan, Wu

14216022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14216022.value: 膀胱癌患者的5年生存率反映了早期診斷的重要性和轉移性膀胱癌檢測不充分的後果。因此，迫切需要原位檢查癌症組織橫截面微觀結構，以改善結果及最大限度地减少與癌症相關的死亡率。 膀胱內膜鏡檢查可以實現非破壞性非侵入性內部身體成像，可用於癌症的早期檢測和分期，允許在癌症的早期階段部署治療性干預措施。因爲缺乏機器人導航以獲得所需的視野和最佳的組織接觸，膀胱內膜鏡病變檢查具有挑戰性。 爲了應對這些挑戰，我們提出了一種新型的內窺鏡視覺觸覺伺服，以實現對不規則可變形膀胱中膀胱內目標的自適應接近，對下層組織微觀結構進行半自動掃描。這項研究可以提高準確性，這對手動內窺鏡檢查是不切實際的，未來以實現腔內機器人和視觸覺導航，允許在膀胱區域定位病變。

14216122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14216122.value: 理解具結構非光滑非凸優化問題的計算複雜度

14216122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14216122.value: 現代數據科學、機器學習和信號處理中的應用經常會出現具結構的非光滑非凸優化問題。這類問題迄今並沒有高效的求解算法。就算是尋找一個近似定點的計算複雜度，文獻裡的結果也不多。本項目旨在找出對不同結構的非光滑非凸優化問題，它們近似定點的計算複雜度下界為何。本項目的成果將解決一系列關於非光滑非凸優化問題的計算複雜度的公開問題，並為設計能有效求解這類問題的算法提供新的思路。

14216222.value: 用於在體診斷和引導光動力治療宮頸管疾病的診療型可見光光學相干斷層掃描內窺鏡

14216222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14216222.value: 宮頸癌是女性生殖系統的主要惡性腫瘤，也是影響全球女性的第四大常見癌症。早期發現和有效治療癌前病變（鱗狀上皮內病變或 SILs）對於降低宮頸癌的發病率和死亡率至關重要。目前， 陰道鏡引導下活檢聯合宮頸刮宮術（ECC）是診斷SILs的臨床標準。 SILs主要起源於宮頸的轉化區（TZ）。但是，TZ 的位置隨年齡而變化。絕經後，TZ 通常移至宮頸管，轉變成陰道鏡部分或完全不可見的形態，即II/III 型。由於缺乏視覺引導和對可疑區域的定位，在宮頸管內進行活檢和ECC是很困難的，導致宮頸管內SILs檢出率低，甚至漏診。 目前，子宮切除術和宮頸錐切術等手術仍然是宮頸癌和SILs的一線治療方法。然而這些侵入性的手術嚴重影響了女性的生殖健康。作為一種新興的微創技術，光動力療法 (PDT) 是一種很有前途的手術替代方案，可在提供有效治療的同時保留生育能力。然而，使用 PDT 治療宮頸管內病變並不容易。這主要是由於缺乏一種有效的方法可在宮頸管內提供準確的診斷、劃定腫瘤區域、引導靶向治療、監測劑量並評估治療效果。 為了解決上述臨床難點，本項目將研製一種診療型宮頸管光學相干斷層掃描內窺鏡 ，即Tendo-OCT。 Tendo-OCT 結合可見光 OCT (vis-OCT) 的高分辨率和光譜成像能力與靶向 PDT 治療功能，實施“即看即治”的診療方法用以治療宮頸管內的疾病。在本項目中，我們將 (1) 開發便攜式 Tendo-OCT 系統和內窺鏡，實現超高分辨率（1.5 µm），用於分辨宮頸管內組織病變和實時疾病檢測；(2) 開發基於光纖束的微型 PDT 導管，用於在宮頸管中進行定向和可控性的激光照射，以實現靶向治療；(3) 利用血紅蛋白的內源性光譜特性，開發新型的血管造影和血氧測量技術，用於評估疾病和監測PDT的劑量和治療效果； (4) 使用患者離體宮頸組織驗證Tendo-OCT ，並通過動物實驗驗證其臨床潛力。

14216322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14216322.value: 金融工程中最優交易執行問題的强化學習算法

14216322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14216322.value: Financial engineering develops quantitative methods to solve decision-making problems in finance. The prevailing approach in the literature is to first estimate the parameters of the model that describes the environment from data and then derive the optimal decision policy from the estimated model. However, it is well-known that some model parameters are difficult to estimate well from data. Furthermore, the estimation error can be amplified through an optimization procedure, making the optimal policy based on the estimated model less optimal in practice. Reinforcement learning (RL) seeks the optimal decision through exploration and exploitation without first knowing the model parameters, and thus it provides a natural alternative to overcome the drawback of the prevailing approach. In this project, we develop reinforcement learning algorithms for the optimal trade execution problem, which is of fundamental importance in financial engineering. In this problem, the decision maker decides how to split a large order into smaller ones to execute over a time horizon to minimize market impact. In practice, the market impact parameters are difficult to estimate, making RL an attractive approach for this problem. Although there already exist various RL algorithms for the optimal execution problem, they are mainly applications of general-purpose RL algorithms with adaptation and many of them did not consider risk in the objective. Moreover, these algorithms may not be easily interpretable and may suffer from convergence issues. In this project, we introduce a new approach to develop RL algorithms for the execution problem. We expect to extract analytical insights by solving the stochastic control problem with exploration, based on which we can design new interpretable RL algorithms with good convergence properties that properly account for risk. 金融工程開發量化的方法來解決金融中的決策問題。 文獻中通行的辦法是對決策環境進行建模，從數據中估計模型的參數，然後基於估計的模型做出最優決策。然而眾所周知的是，一些模型的參數非常難以估計，而且參數的估計誤差會在優化的過程中被放大，從而導致基於估計的模型得到的最優策略在現實中不是最優的。 强化學習不需要事先知道模型的參數，它通過不斷探索與使用來尋找最優決策，因此它很自然地提供了一種另外的辦法來剋服通行的辦法的缺陷。 在這個項目中，我們考慮金融工程中一個非常重要的問題：最優交易執行問題， 並開發强化學習的算法來解決它。 在這個問題中，決策者決定如何將一個大的交易單分拆成一系列小單在一個給定的時間段裡面執行，使得交易的市場影響成本最低。在現實中，關於市場影響的參數難以估計，這使得强化學習對解決該問題很有吸引力。 儘管文獻中已經存在各種各樣的强化學習算法來解決最優交易執行問題，它們主要是一些通用强化學習算法在該問題中通過適當修改後的應用，並且很多算法在目標中沒有考慮風險。另外， 這些算法可能不容易解釋，並且在收斂方面存在問題。在本項目中，我們引入一個新的方法來開發强化學習的算法去解決交易執行問題。通過解帶探索的隨機控制問題，我們期望得到一些解析的信息。利用它們我們可以開發出新的强化學習的算法，他們可以解釋，收斂性良好，並且恰當地考慮了風險。

14216622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14216622.value: 彈性軟體致動器和柔性電子聚合傳感器的設計用於中風後手功能的復康

14216622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14216622.value: Prof LEUNG, Thomas Wai-hong Prof Li, Zheng

14216622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14216622.value: Stroke is the leading cause of disability and robot-assisted rehabilitation is one of the approaches used to support a clinical programme in stroke neurorehabilitation. It assists physical therapists in conducting intensive post-stroke physical treatment and involves the active participation from stroke survivors to improve their motor function. However, most rehabilitation robots for post-stroke rehabilitation do not completely take the impairment level into account of individual subjects in order to maximise the voluntary efforts from the stroke survivors in the training. Moreover, robotic systems are usually made of rigid materials such as steel and aluminium, which may hinder the natural movement of the limbs. Therefore, researchers are devoted to developing soft robotic systems in the laboratory by taking advantage of soft materials. While some researchers were able to mimic some grasp functions, the existing challenges are to overcome the nonlinear properties of the soft actuator in the control systems; and to overcome the spastic condition on the stroke survivors’ fingers to open their hands in the soft robotic finger design. The research proposed in this project aims at investigating new control algorithms and feedback sensing technologies to enhance the design and performance of the soft robotics hand. First, the soft robotic hand will be designed to improve the range-of-motion(ROM) in subjects suffering from spastic finger joints with an elastomer-based soft actuator. Full ROM would be generated on each individual finger to overcome its spasticity to facilitate functional movement. Secondly, the joint angle sensor using flexible electronic polymers will be developed and embedded into the soft actuators, such that the condition of individual joint angle in each finger can be accurately measured for monitoring the ROM and joint stiffness. Thirdly, the human motion intention control will be developed by electromyography(EMG) signals, to promote the patient’s voluntary motor efforts during the training. The assistive ROM and torque provided by the robotic system can be constantly adjusted, based on individual finger condition, i.e. real-time ROM and joint stiffness. A pilot clinical trial to verify the performance of subjects after stroke wearing soft robotic hand will be conducted. Simultaneous EMG and kinematic signals acquisition will be performed to evaluate the neurophysiological changes of the stroke patients before and after the robot-assisted training. The success of this control and feedback system is an essential and important step to move the soft robotic system out of the laboratory to provide clinical rehabilitation training for stroke survivors. 中風是致殘的主要原因，機器人輔助康復是其中之一用於支持中風神經復康臨床項目的方法。它有助於物理治療師進行密集的中風後物理治療，並涉及中風倖存者的積極參與，以改善他們的運動功能。然而，大多數用於中風後復康的機器人並沒有完全採取考慮到受試者的損傷程度。此外，機器人系統通常由鋼和鋁等剛性材料製成，可能會阻礙四肢的自然運動。因此，研究人員致力於開發軟體機器人，通過利用軟材料。雖然一些研究人員能夠模仿一些抓取功能，現有的挑戰是要克服的控制系統中軟執行器的非線性特性；並克服中風倖存者的手指痙攣狀態，無法在機器人中張開雙手手指設計。該項目中提出的研究旨在調查新的控制算法和反饋傳感技術，以提高軟機器人性能。 首先，軟機械手將被設計為提高運動範圍，以克服其痙攣狀態以促進功能性運動。二、關節角度傳感器採用柔性電子聚合物將被開發並嵌入到軟機器人中，可以準確測量每個手指的各個關節角度，以監測關節僵硬。三、是開發人體運動意圖控制，並且機器人系統提供的輔助和扭矩，以促進患者在治療期間的自主運動培訓。臨床試驗以驗證中風後受試者進行佩戴機械手的表現。將同時評估中風的神經生理學變化。控制和反饋系統是軟體機器人系統的重要步驟，為中風倖存者提供臨床復康數據。

14217022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14217022.value: COSMOS: 微流控生物芯片之共同合成工具

14217022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14217022.value: The emergence of continuous-flow microfluidics has led to a revolution in biochemistry and biomedicine. On such a microscale lab-on-a-chip system, complex biochemical assays can be executed efficiently without any human intervention. However, they require a large number of control ports and the corresponding control logic to generate required pressure patterns for flow control, which complicate their advantages and prevent their wide adoption. In this project, we propose the first flow-control co-synthesis tool for microfluidic biochips called COSMOS, that incorporating high-level synthesis, physical design, and control system design simultaneously. Given a predetermined number of allowed control ports, COSMOS can generate biochip architectures with high execution efficiency and the corresponding control systems with optimized timing performance. Moreover, the overall cost of a biochip can be reduced and the tradeoff between control system and execution efficiency of biochemical applications can be compromised. In the end, we expect that COSMOS can lead to high execution efficiency, low platform cost, as well as excellent timing performance, while satisfying the given control-port constraints when designing a microfluidic biochip. We believe COSMOS has a transformative impact on how future microfluidic very-large-scale-integration (mVLSI) biochips are designed. 連續微流控生物芯片的發明帶來了生物化學及生物醫學的應用及技術演進。在這樣一個微型芯片實驗室系統上，複雜的生化實驗無需人工干預即可有效地執行檢測。然而，這些芯片需要大量的控制端口和相應的控制邏輯來生成流量控制所需的壓力輸入，造成芯片設計及控制系統的難度大幅增加。本計畫提出了第一個流量控制合成的微流控生物芯片工具：COSMOS，它結合了高階綜合、物理設計和控制系統設計之共同優化功能。COSMOS可以生成具有高執行效率的架構和相應的控制系統，並優化時序性能之生物芯片。如此一來，可以降低生物芯片的總體設計及製造成本，以及優化控制系統與生化應用執行效率之間之權衡。最後，我們期望COSMOS能夠對未來微流控生物芯片超大規模集成的設計具有革命性的影響。

14217322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14217322.value: Graphs are widely used to represent entities and their relationships. For instance, on online social media, users can be mapped to nodes and friendships can be mapped to edges, which builds a social graph. On real-world graphs, there are many important graph mining tasks, like link prediction, node classification, and graph reconstruction. In the past decade, graph embedding, which learns a low-dimensional representation for each node in the graph that preserves the graph topology, has attracted a plethora of research works as it gains superb effectiveness on almost all graph mining tasks. Recent progress on graph embedding shows that the latest solutions with proximity matrix factorization (PMF) gain superb performance on graph mining tasks like node classification and link prediction. However, the state-of-the-art PMF-based solutions still work on graphs with hundreds of millions of edges, while real-world graphs may include billions of edges and even trillions of edges. How to scale the PMF-based methods to massive graphs with billion-edge graphs and even trillion-edge graphs with commodity servers without compromising the effectiveness is a challenging task. In addition, real-world graphs, e.g., Facebook and Tencent social graphs, are dynamically changing. For dynamic graphs, existing companies typically update the graph embedding periodically, say every week according to Tencent, to reflect the changes. A straightforward solution is to compute the graph embedding from scratch, which is adopted by Tencent. This is computationally redundant, since the updates may be rather small compared to the original graph. Therefore, it is more desirable to incrementally update the embedding according to the past graph embedding result. This tends to be more efficient and saves a huge amount of computational resources. Moreover, the graph setting might be more complicated in real scenarios. For example, graphs might include attributes; graphs might be more suitable to be represented as hypergraphs; graphs may be heterophilous where connected nodes are prone to have different properties or labels. How to devise scalable graph embedding algorithms under more complicated settings is also a challenging task. Motivated by this, the project aims to: (i) design effective and scalable PMF-based graph embedding algorithms; (ii) devise efficient and effective algorithms to update the embedding on dynamic graphs; (iii) devise effective and scalable algorithms under more complicated graph settings. As an outcome, the project is expected to develop new graph embedding frameworks that scale to trillion-edge graphs under various graph settings while providing high effectiveness. 圖被廣泛用於表示實體及其關係。例如，將線上社交媒體中的用戶作為節點，好友關係作為邊，可以構建一個社交圖。現實世界的圖上存在許多重要的圖挖掘任務，如鏈路預測、節點分類和圖重構。圖嵌入為圖中每個節點生成一個能夠保留圖拓撲結構的低維度表示，在幾乎所有的圖挖掘任務上都獲得了極好的效果，因此在過去十年中吸引了大量的研究工作。 圖嵌入上的最新進展表明，採用鄰近矩陣分解的最新方法在節點分類和鏈路預測等圖挖掘任務上獲得了卓越的性能。代表最前沿水平的基於鄰近矩陣分解方法已經能適用於具有數億條邊的圖，然而現實世界的圖可能包括數十億條甚至數萬億條邊。在不影響效果的前提下，如何將基於鄰近矩陣分解的方法擴展到具有十億邊甚至萬億邊的超大圖以及商用服務器上是一項極具挑戰性的任務。 此外，現實世界的圖是動態變化的，例如 Facebook 和騰訊的社交圖。對於動態圖，現有公司通常會周期性的更新圖嵌入，例如騰訊每週更新圖嵌入，以反應圖的變化。一個直接的方法是重新從頭開始計算圖嵌入。騰訊採用的正是這種辦法。這種方法在計算上是冗餘的，因為與原始圖相比，需要更新的部分可能相當小。因此，更理想的方法是在過去圖嵌入結果的基礎上增量式地更新圖嵌入。這往往更有效，並且能節省大量的計算資源。 更進一步，現實場景中圖的設定可能會更複雜。例如，圖可能帶有特徵屬性；圖可能更適合被表示為超圖；圖可能是異質的，即圖中相連的節點傾向於擁有不同的特徵屬性或標籤。如何在更複雜的設定下設計可擴展的圖嵌入算法也是一項具有挑戰性的任務。 受此啟發，本項目旨在：（i）設計有效且可擴展的基於鄰近矩陣分解的圖嵌入算法； (ii) 設計高效且有效的算法來更新動態圖上的圖嵌入； (iii) 設計有效且可擴展的算法用於更複雜的圖設定。本項目的預期成果是開發新的圖嵌入框架，在不同圖設定下都能夠擴展到萬億邊級別的圖，同時保證算法效果。

14217622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14217622.value: Graph is a very expressive model to represent real-world entities and the relationship among them. In many real scenarios, the graph topological structure may evolve over time; the features of graph nodes may also change over time. This leads to a dynamic graph which consists of a sequence of graph snapshots. For example, a social network evolves dynamically with newly registered members, the changes of members' profiles, and the formation or dissolution of friendship among members. The dynamic graph setting is applicable to many other networks. In this project, we focus our study on dynamic graphs. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been proposed and achieved great success on various graph learning problems, e.g., community detection and node classification. However, some studies find that the deep learning architectures are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. For example, in the image domain, small perturbations in pixels of an input image can fool a deep learning model to change the predicted class. Similarly, in the graph domain, GNNs are also susceptible to adversarial attacks on the input graph, in the form of perturbations on nodes or edges. Existing studies on making GNNs robust to such attacks are limited to static graphs. Research on dynamic graphs is still missing. We aim to investigate robust learning (i.e., defending against adversarial attacks) for GNNs on dynamic graphs. The most effective method of defense in the image domain is adversarial training, i.e., training GNNs with adversarial examples. However, research on adversarial attacks on dynamic graphs is limited. Thus, we first study how to generate adversarial graph examples for attack purposes. We formulate this as a constrained graph generation problem and design a new framework to study the adversarial attack and the corresponding defense strategies. Specifically, we will first study the adversarial attack in two representative sub-tasks: adversarial attack for dynamic community detection and adversarial attack for dynamic graph classification. In the second stage, we will study the corresponding defense strategies against the adversarial attack, namely robust dynamic community detection and robust dynamic graph classification. Note that graphs in real applications are massive. Thus we will take the scalability issue into consideration in our solutions. We plan to evaluate the effectiveness and practicability of our proposed techniques on real social networks and payment networks for fraud detection. The success of this project will contribute to both the theoretical development of adversarial learning on dynamic graphs and the practicability to real applications beyond academia. 圖是一個有很強表達能力的模型，用來表示現實世界的實體和關係。 在許多實際場景中，圖的拓撲結構可能隨時間變化; 圖節點的特徵也可能隨著時間而改變。這將產生由一系列圖快照組成的動態圖。例如，社交網絡因為新會員註冊，會員資料的變化，以及會員之間友誼的形成或解除，而動態變化。動態圖在許多其他應用的網絡也很常見。在這個項目中，我們將重點研究動態圖。 圖神經網絡已經被運用在各種圖學習問題上，例如社區檢測和節點分類。然而，現有研究發現深度學習架構容易受到對抗性攻擊。例如，在圖像領域，在圖像上進行微小擾動可以欺騙深度學習模型來改變預測的類別。在圖數據領域，當節點或邊受到干擾，圖神經網絡也容易受到對輸入圖的對抗性攻擊。現有研究只在靜態圖上開展了對圖神經網絡的魯棒性研究，而在動態圖上的研究還沒有。 我們的目標是研究動態圖上的圖神經網絡的魯棒學習。圖像領域最有效的防禦方法是對抗訓練，即用對抗樣本訓練圖神經網絡。然而，目前對動態圖的對抗性攻擊研究是有限的。因此，我們首先研究如何為攻擊目的生成對抗圖實例。我們將此問題定義為帶約束的圖生成問題，並設計一個新的框架來研究對抗性攻擊和相應的防禦策略。具體來說，我們將首先在兩個有代表性的子任務中研究對抗性攻擊：對動態圖社區檢測和動態圖分類進行對抗性攻擊。第二階段，我們將研究相應的防禦策略, 即魯棒動態社區檢測和魯棒動態圖分類。由於實際應用中的圖規模非常大，我們也將在我們的解決方案中考慮可擴展性問題。我們將評估我們提出的技術在真實社交網路和支付網路上的有效性和實用性。 該項目的成功將推動在動態圖上的對抗學習的理論發展和實際中的應用。

14217822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14217822.value: 利用優化結構和運動框架下的混合機制進行 MRI 引導的機器人腦出血抽吸

14217822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14217822.value: Dr Chang, Hing Chiu Charles Prof Wong, George Kwok-chu Dr Zhou, Jianshu

14217922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14217922.value: 雜亂環境下無人系統的協同搜索與追逃

14217922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14217922.value: The last decade has witnessed explosive development of cooperative control of multi-agent systems due to their successful applications in, for example, search and rescue, security surveillance, logistic delivery, film production, and many others, to name a few. Compared with single agent, the superiority of multi-agent systems for the control and cooperation of unmanned vehicles, such as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), is apparent and has been widely reported in the literature. The high scalability of multi-agent systems can achieve tasks that could not be performed by single agent systems. However, as the rapid development of the autonomous vehicles in industry, they have also become an attractive tool to criminals. More and more safety incidents happened (either intentionally or accidentally), and they are further threatening the safety of the public and the society. It is thus an urgent problem to develop advanced strategies to search and track intruding agents. Such problems are often referred to as search and pursuit-evasion problems. The objective of search and pursuit-evasion problems is to design an effective and efficient strategy to capture a randomly walking evader, which is also the focus of predicting target trajectories. Most available results for the cooperative control of multi-agent systems assume that the group of agents are operating in obstacle-free environments, such as open spaces. The challenges of search and pursuit-evasion problems using unmanned vehicles in cluttered environments lie in generating a safe, fast, and feasible trajectory by considering obstacle avoidance, tracking performance, and line of sight. In such a case, probabilistic models, which are able to handle uncertainties and priorities, are effective methods to represent possible target locations. In this project, we propose to develop an advanced search and pursuit-evasion strategy that enable multi-agent systems, specifically UAVs or drones, to search and track an evader cooperatively and autonomously in cluttered environments without obstacle and inter-vehicle collisions. It aims to provide a standard search and pursuit-evasion framework for general multi-agent unmanned systems. The proposed research, once realized, is expected to play an instrumental role for unmanned aerial systems in preventing safety incidents caused by intruding agents from happening and thus avoiding casualties and property losses. Its scientific, social and economic impacts are obvious and highly significant. 過去十來年，因為多智能體系統在搜索和救援、安全監控、物流配送、電影制作等許多領域的成功應用，我們見證了它們的爆炸式發展。與單智能體相比，多智能體系統，如無人飛行器、無人地面車輛等無人系統控制與協作方面的優勢顯而易見，並已在文獻中得到廣泛報道。多智能體系統的可擴展性可以實現單個智能體無法完成的任務。然而，隨著自動無人載體在工業上的快速發展，它們也成為了犯罪分子的誘人工具。越來越多的安全事件（有意或無意）發生，進一步威脅著公眾和社會的安全。因此，開發先進的策略來搜索和跟蹤入侵無人載體是一個緊迫的問題。這樣的問題通常被稱為搜索和追逃問題。 搜索和追逃問題的目標是設計一種有效且高效的策略來捕獲隨機行走的逃逸者，這也是預測目標軌跡的重點。多智能體系統協作控制的大多數可用結果都假設智能體組在無障礙環境中運行，如開放空間。在雜亂環境中使用無人載體的搜索和追逃問題的挑戰在於通過考慮避障、跟蹤性能和視線來生成安全、快速和可行的軌跡。在這種情況下，能夠處理不確定性和優先級的概率模型是表示可能目標位置的有效方法。 在這個項目中，我們建議開發一種高級搜索和追逃策略，使多智能體系統，特別是無人機，能夠在雜亂的環境中協作和自主地搜索和跟蹤逃逸者，而不會出現障礙物和載體間的碰撞。它旨在為通用多智能體無人系統提供標準的搜索和追逃框架。擬議的研究一旦實現，預計將對無人機系統在防止入侵智能體引起的安全事件發生，從而避免人員傷亡和財產損失方面發揮重要作用，其科學、社會和經濟影響是顯而易見的。

14218022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14218022.value: 實現效用下的分散投資問題

14218022.label: Project Objectives
14218022.value: We plan to study a discrete-time portfolio diversification problem in which an agent trades a stock and a risk-free asset and derives realization utility from stock sales and utility of wealth at a terminal time. We plan to study the implications of our model for diversification, follow-on purchase, and repurchase behavior. We plan to study a continuous-time portfolio selection problem in which an agent trades a stock and a risk-free asset and derives realization utility from stock sales and utility of wealth at a terminal time. This problem can be formulated as a stochastic singular control problem that has not been studied in the literature, and we plan to establish the dynamic programing principle and the HJB equation for this problem. Finally, we plan to develop efficient algorithms to solve the HJB equation and study the implications of the model for investors’ trading behavior.

We plan to study the implications of our model for diversification, follow-on purchase, and repurchase behavior.

We plan to study a continuous-time portfolio selection problem in which an agent trades a stock and a risk-free asset and derives realization utility from stock sales and utility of wealth at a terminal time. This problem can be formulated as a stochastic singular control problem that has not been studied in the literature, and we plan to establish the dynamic programing principle and the HJB equation for this problem. Finally, we plan to develop efficient algorithms to solve the HJB equation and study the implications of the model for investors’ trading behavior.

14218022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14218022.value: In neoclassical finance, it is typically assumed that investors derive utility from their consumption and wealth only. Abundant empirical and experimental evidence, however, shows that it is not the case: There are other sources of utility. In particular, using neural data, some recent studies show that regret, which results from the comparison of the outcome of a decision with the outcome of an alternative, but unchosen decision, is an additional source of utility derived in financial decisions, and realization utility, which is a source of utility derived by investors when they sell financial assets and experience gains and losses, is linked to regret. Models of realization utility have become popular recently and are able to explain some empirical findings of investors’ trading patterns, such as the disposition effect. These models, however, make an unrealistic assumption that investors hold one asset only, e.g., a stock or a risk-free asset, at each time. Moreover, in these models, after selling a stock, the investors either immediately or never buy back the stock. Thus, these models cannot explain the so-called follow-on purchase and repurchase patterns that are observed in empirical and experimental studies. In this proposal, we consider dynamic trading problems in which an agent can diversify her investment in a stock and a risk-free asset. As in the classical models, the agent derive utility from her wealth at a terminal time. In addition, the agent derives realization utility every time she sells some shares of the stock. The objective of the agent is to maximize the sum of the realization utility and terminal wealth utility. We consider both the discrete-time setting and the continuous-time setting. With the former setting, we are able to directly compare our model implications with the experimental studies on the follow-on purchase and repurchase patterns. With the continuous-time setting, we are able to derive a more tractable solution by formulating the trading problem as a stochastic singular control problem. The existing methods of studying singular control problems cannot apply to our problem directly, so we plan to develop new approaches or adapt the existing methods to our problem. In both the discrete-time and continuous-time settings, in addition to studying whether our model can generate the follow-on and repurchase patterns as documented in the empirical and experimental studies, we also plan to study whether realization utility induces diversification. 在新古典金融中，研究者通常假設投資者的效用只來源於他們的消費和財富。然而,近期的實證和實驗證據表明投資者在交易中還會獲得其他效用。特別地，最近的一些基於神經數據的研究表明投資者會由於後悔事先沒有選擇更好的決策而產生負面的效用。實現效用，一種由投資者賣出金融資產時的盈利或損失產生的效用，通常被認為和投資者在投資中可能產生的後悔有直接的聯繫。 近年來，研究者提出來了一些實現效用的模型，並成功地用這些模型解釋了一些關於投資行為的實證現象，譬如處置效應。然而，這些模型都假設在任何時刻，投資者只能持有一個資產，譬如一隻股票或者無風險資產。這樣的假設顯然是不合理的。而且，在這些模型裡面，每當賣出股票後，投資者要麼馬上購買下一隻股票要麼永遠不再購買股票。因此，這些模型無法解釋後續購買和回購這兩個在實證和實驗研究中觀測到的股票交易的現象。 在這個提案中，我們考慮投資者可以分散投資的動態交易模型，也就是說投資者可以同時持有股票和無風險資產。就像在新古典金融中，投資者的財富會產生效用。同時，在每次賣出股票的時候，投資者會有實現效用。投資者的目標是最大化他的總效用。 我們不僅考慮離散時間的情形，也考慮連續時間的情形。在第一種情形中，我們能夠直接比較模型的結論和關於股票後續購買和回購的實驗結果。在第二種情形中，通過把我們的動態交易模型寫成一個隨機奇異控制問題，我們預期能得到更為顯式的模型的解。然而，現有的解決隨機奇異控制的方法並不能直接應用於我們的問題，所以我們計劃提出一套新的工具來解決我們的問題。除了研究我們的模型是否能產生實證和實驗研究中證實的股票後續購買和回購的現象，我們還計劃研究實現效用是否會導致分散投資。

14218322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14218322.value: 視覺導航玻璃體注射機器人研發

14218322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14218322.value: Intravitreal injection is a popular approach of treatment of many ophthalmic diseases including retinal vein occlusions, AMD, etc. This is an important procedure performed on a daily basis, and a few hundreds of patients are being treated every day at the Hong Kong hospitals. The frequency and the significantly increasing number of patients, with the advancement of the aging society, have led to tremendous pressure to ophthalmologists, it is highly demanded that the procedure be performed more efficiently and effectively. Aiming at a more efficient solution, in this project we will develop an image-guided robotic system that can automatically perform the intravitreal injection with efficiency and guaranteed safety under the supervision of the surgeon. The technical challenges in developing such a robotic system include the design of a safe and a compact robotic injection system, real-time and high-precision sensing of 3D geometry and movement of eyes, and on-line motion planning and control of the robot for a safe procedure. This project will tackle those challenges by carrying out the following tasks: 1) optimizing the design of an injection robot, developed in our early work, so as to improve the safety and the performance; 2) designing a real-time and robust high-precision 3D imaging system for capturing 3D geometry and motion of the glass-like reflective eyeball up to the accuracy of 0.1mm; and 3) developing novel image-based methods for planning the injection position for the robot and controlling the injection action with guaranteed safety. The performance and safety of the robot will be analyzed theoretically. In addition, a prototype of the robot will be built and experiments will be carried out to validate the performance in a simulated environment or by cadavers. Since the developed robotic system will have the potential of being directly used in the local hospitals, the outputs will certainly contribute to the technology development and services of local healthcare. 玻璃體腔內注射是治療視網膜靜脈阻塞、老年性黃斑變性等許多眼科疾病的常用方法。 這是醫院每天都需要進行的重要手術，其中香港醫院每天就有數百名患者接受此項治療。隨着社會老齡化的日益加劇，眼科疾病的發病率和患者數量急劇增加，這給眼科醫生的治療工作帶來了巨大的壓力。如何更高效的進行玻璃體腔內注射治療，已成爲迫切需要解決的問題。在本項目中，我們提出了一種高效的解決方案，將開發一種基於視覺導航的機器人系統，該系統可以在外科醫生的監督下高效、安全地自動進行玻璃體腔內注射。這種機器人系統的開發存在的主要技術挑戰包括：安全且緊湊地機器人注射系統設計，眼部實時高精度的3D形狀重建和位姿估計，安全且高效的機器人在線運動規劃和控制。該項目將通過完成以下任務來解決這些挑戰： 1）對我們早期工作中開發的注射裝置進行優化設計，以提高其安全性和精度等注射性能。 2）設計一套實時且魯棒的高精度紅外3D成像系統，用於捕捉具有一定反光和透光特性的眼球的3D幾何形狀和隨機運動，其測量精度可達0.1mm。 3）開發創新性的基於圖像的方法來規劃機器人的注射位置和控制注射動作，以保證機器人自動注射的安全性。 我們將對機器人的性能和安全性進行理論上的分析和驗證。此外還將搭建機器人的原型機並進行實驗，以驗證機器人系統在模擬環境中和屍體上的工作性能。 鑑於開發的機器人系統將具有直接應用於當地醫院的潛力，其產出必將有助於當地醫療保健的技術發展和服務。

14218422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14218422.value: VLSI 布線上的 GPU 加速

14218422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14218422.value: Routing is an indispensable step in physical design of VLSI circuits, and it is also the most time consuming step in the physical synthesis process. Today’s complex circuits can contain up to or even more than tens of millions of cells and nets, with wires being routed on more than 15 layers of metals. The routing process is slow and complex, and it can easily consume hours for global routing and even days for detailed routing for large circuits on high-end multi-threaded CPUs. It will be very useful if we can speed-up this time consuming step significantly by ten or even more times. This may be possible with GPU speedup but the sequential nature of net routing will make it very difficult. In this project, we aim at solving this challenging problem of speeding up global and detailed routing by making use of the rapidly advancing GPU hardware resources. Both global routers and detailed routers consist of a number of basic steps, and a successful overall speedup will need to speed up every one of them, including pattern routing, A*-search and rip-up and re-route, etc. A powerful technique used in many of these operations is maze routing, which is well known to be slow but flexible and resulting in high quality solution. A recent study by the PI’s group has shown that this maze routing algorithm on a regular grid graph can be sped up by more than 20 times on average using GPU. It is exciting to see how this maze routing engine can be applied and used to speedup both global and detailed routing. As mentioned above, this will require one to investigate how every step in a router can be solved using GPU in order to give an overall reduction in run time. Being able to achieve these will be a key to effectively speed up the whole physical synthesis flow. With the increasing complexity of VLSI circuits, the success of this project will be impactful to both the academia and industry. 布線是超大規模集成電路的物理設計中不可缺少的步驟，並且這也是物理綜合過程中最耗時的步驟。當今複雜電路包含多達甚至超過數千萬個單元和網絡，連線超過 15 個金屬層。布線過程耗時且複雜，使用高端多線程CPU對大型電路進行全局布線需要幾個小時，詳細布線更是需要幾天。能夠將這個耗時的步驟顯著加快十甚至更多倍會非常有用。這可能可以通過 GPU 加速來實現，但網絡布線的順序特性使其變得非常困難。在這個項目中，我們的目標是解決這一挑戰性的問題，利用快速發展的 GPU 硬件資源加速全局和詳細布線。 全局布線和詳細布線都包含一些基本的步驟，要想得到整體的加速，我們需要加速每一個步驟，包括模式布線，A*搜索和拆除重布線等。許多這些操作中使用的核心技術是迷宮布線，它是公認的耗時但靈活且能夠給出高質量結果。 負責人團隊最近的一項研究表明，使用GPU可以讓這種迷宮布線在規則網格上平均加速20倍以上。如何應用這個迷宮布線引擎來加速全局和詳細布線是一件令人興奮的事情。正如前面提到的，要整體減少運行時間，我們需要研究如何將布線器的每一個步驟都使用GPU完成。能否實現這些將會是能否有效加速整個物理綜合流程的關鍵。隨着超大規模集成電路複雜度的增加，這個項目的成功將會同時影響學術界和工業界。

14218522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14218522.value: 藉由邏輯分區管理展現分區命名空間固態硬碟之全面潛能

14218522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14218522.value: NAND flash-memory based solid-state drives (SSDs) have made tremendous success in dominating the storage market share in the past decades. Nevertheless, to maintain the decades-old block interface, the conventional SSDs must entail substantial expenses in terms of poor performance predictability and high operational cost. Fortunately, the NVMe zoned namespace (ZNS) has emerged as a new storage interface to circumvent this “block interface tax”. ZNS features an abstraction that exposes the logical address space of a ZNS SSD as fixed-sized zones, where every zone must be written sequentially and aligned to the flash block boundaries for reset. Nevertheless, according to our investigation, the inflexibility in managing zones and multi-ZNS SSDs in the current ZNS subsystem may largely limit the adoption of ZNS SSD, resulting in the sub-optimal performance. In view of this, this research aims to unveil the full potential of ZNS SSD by enabling a generic and flexible management. Particularly, this research will first conduct a comprehensive experimental study to understand how different zone organizations would affect the performance of storage systems based on a self-developed ZNS SSD prototype and evaluate framework. Based on the derived insights, this research will further devise a novel Logical Zone Management (LZM) that can enable the host system to flexibly restructure the fixed-sized physical zones of ZNS SSDs into “configurable logical zones” of “zoned logical volumes”. To this end, this research urges the ZNS SSD to expose a two-dimensional grid map of physical zones with the implication that physical zones located at different columns can be operated independently. Such a small revision of ZNS interface can bring big flexibility in restructuring physical zones into logical zones and volumes for satisfying different needs of various storage systems. Particularly, with the proposed LZM, the logical zones and volumes can be created to not only make a trade-off between bandwidth and isolation but further support different RAID levels, each of which can provide a different balance among data redundancy, performance improvement, and the available capacity. To demonstrate the merits of the proposed LZM, this research will also extend the evaluation framework to support the concurrent execution of multiple applications on multiple ZNS SSDs. This project is particularly important for Hong Kong, since its success will lead the way to unveil the full potential of the next-generation ZNS SSD and bring significant commercial values and benefits to all possible service users/providers, ranging from end-user, enterprises, to government units. 在過去數十年間，基於 NAND 快閃記憶體之固態硬碟於存儲市場占有率取得了巨大的成功。然而為了能維持行之有年的塊存儲介面，常規的固態硬碟必須付出在性能可預測性與設備成本兩大面向的巨大代價。所幸，非揮發性記憶體通訊協定（NVMe）中所規範之分區命名空間（ZNS）已成為了規避塊存儲介面代價之新興存儲介面。ZNS 定義了一種新興的抽象將固態硬碟之邏輯地址空間詮釋為固定大小之分區，其中每一個分區皆必須被順序性地寫入且由實體快閃記憶體塊所組成以利資料抹除與重置。 然而，基於我們的研究，現行 ZNS 子系統欠缺了管理分區與多 ZNS 固態硬碟的靈活性，使得 ZNS 固態硬碟之佈建與性能最佳化受到大幅限制。有鑑於此，此研究旨在發展一套通用且靈活的邏輯分區管理來展現並發揮 ZNS 固態硬碟之全面潛能。此研究將首先發展 ZNS 固態硬碟原型與測試框架，並透過一系列全面性的實驗研究來了解不同的分區組成對於不同存儲系統之性能影響。基於所獲得的實驗結果，此研究將更進一步發展一套創新的邏輯分區管理，來讓主機系統能將固定大小的實體分區重組為可彈性配置的邏輯分區與分區邏輯捲軸。為實現此目的，此研究主張 ZNS 固態硬碟應能提供其內部實體分區的二維網格規劃，以對外描述實體分區之間的可獨立操作性；我們認為，此對於 ZNS 存儲介面之微小改動，將可大幅提升實體分區重組的靈活性以滿足各式存儲系統之不同性能需求。具體而言，此研究所提出的邏輯分區管理將可靈活地在帶寬與性能獨立性間達成不同平衡，並重組出支持不同獨立磁碟冗餘陣列（RAID）級別之邏輯分區與分區邏輯卷軸；其中，不同的 RAID 級別能提供在資料冗餘、性能提升與有效空間之間之不同平衡。為了展現邏輯分區管理的實際價值，此研究也會在測試框架中支持多應用之併發執行與多 ZNS 固態硬碟之管理。 此研究將能展現並發揮次世代 ZNS 固態硬碟之全面潛能，並有益於所有潛在的系統服務提供者與使用者─從個人、企業乃至政府部門。因此，此研究對香港的資訊科技發展極為重要。
