14219022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14219022.value: 短短幾年，短視頻分享服務在全球範圍內呈現爆發式增長。然而，這些系統的特徵和行為遠未得到充分理解。我們最近對中國一頂級短視頻服務的測量研究表明，短視頻流媒體帶來了與傳統流媒體服務截然不同的獨特挑戰。不僅他們的內容非常不同，他們的用戶的行為也不同，對流媒體質量的期望也不同。因此，儘管自適應視頻流媒體取得了許多進步，但現有的短視頻服務提供商仍然在其服務中主要採用簡單的固定比特率流媒體。可是大多數短視頻用戶是通過智能手機使用服務，因此流媒體必須通過移動或無線網絡進行，而這些網絡的帶寬可能會有很大差異，並且容易出現隨時間變化的快速帶寬波動，因此構成挑戰。當前的服務提供商通過視頻比特率的保守選擇、網絡資源的過度分配或兩者兼而有之來彌補智能自適應流媒體的不足，但這些都是次優的。正如我們的試點研究發現的那樣，根本原因是當前的自適應流媒體算法，即使是最先進的算法，都不能很好地用於短視頻流媒體。這提案旨在從四個方面解決這些快速增長的短視頻服務中的這一基本挑戰。首先，我們與短視頻提供商合作，了解和製定衡量服務體驗質量和關鍵績效指標的現實指標。其次，我們研究了比特率適應之外的新適應技術，以解決視頻質量和短視頻流性能之間的衝突要求。第三，受我們測量研究結果的推動，我們追求一種網絡感知的適應方法，使短視頻提供商能夠利用其服務分析來優化未來的流媒體。第四，我們探索一種流式適配和傳輸協議優化的集成方法。最後，通過我們與兩家主要的短視頻服務提供商和一家 CDN 提供商的合作，我們有可能將來自該項目的新穎設計部署到他們的生產平台中，從而在現實環境中對設計進行驗證和評估。

14219322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14219322.value: 利用波感知主動補償之水空光無線通信的性能最大化

14219322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14219322.value: The ocean has abundant resources that lead to the proliferation of underwater applications, including deep-sea mining, oceanic ecosystem monitoring, and tactical surveillance. An underwater remotely operated vehicle (ROV) is favorable for these activities as it is agile, versatile, and free from putting operators in dangerous situations. Optical wireless communication (OWC) links can unleash the ROV from the tether length constrain and allow multi-ROV operation in a common space. To further increase the coverage, it is desirable for ROV to transmit data, through the water-air link, to an airplane or unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) used as a relay/regenerator to forward the data to a control station. For the water-air channel, OWC is a better choice than using acoustic or RF signals as the latter two suffer from low bandwidth and high attenuation, respectively. The main issue for water-air OWC is the light refraction at the dynamic water surface that results in beam wandering. This problem is challenging but potentially solvable with ingenious solutions and will be studied in this proposal to develop a robust and high-speed water-air OWC system. The water-air communication channel is much different from the free-space optical communication (FSO) channel. Studies on wave-induced impairment and mitigation are minimal. A straightforward remedy is to enlarge the beam coverage area while sacrificing the power budget. Beam tracking is a more efficient solution as a more concentrated beam can be steered back to the receiver timely, ensuring high intensity and stability of the received power. Hence, an efficient beam tracking system is highly desirable for a high-speed water-air OWC system. This requires a fundamental understanding of the water-air communication channel. It is interesting to find whether an alternative optical path exists for beam steering to re-establish connection when the light beam is deflected severely and falls out of the optical detector area. In addition, optical wavefront distortion by wave should be compensated to maximize the channel capacity. A deformable mirror (DM) has been used in the FSO system to compensate for air turbulence-induced wavefront distortion. Is DM or other compensation schemes also applicable for water wave-induced wavefront distortion? In summary, we will investigate the use of wave information to facilitate wave-aware beam steering and wavefront compensation for mitigating wave-induced impairments and maximizing water-air OWC system performance. This project is strategically vital not only to Hong Kong, a coastal city with abundant marine resources, but also to the safeguarding of the marine ecosystem. 豐富的海洋資源導致了水下應用的激增，例如深海採礦、海洋生態系統監測和戰術監視。水下遙控潛水器 (ROV)因其靈活、用途廣泛且不會將操作員置於危險境地等特性，有利於用來開展這些活動。光無線通信 (OWC) 鏈路可以使ROV 不再限制於繫繩長度，並且可以在公共空間中進行多 ROV 操作。為了進一步擴大覆蓋範圍，ROV 需要通過水-空鏈路將數據傳輸到用作中繼器/再生器的飛機或無人駕駛飛行器 (UAV)，繼而通過它們將數據轉發到控制站。對於水-空氣通道，光無線通信是比使用聲學或射頻信號更好的選擇，因為後兩者分別受到低帶寬和高衰減的影響。水-空氣 OWC 的主要問題是動態水面的光折射導致光束漂移。這個問題具有挑戰性，但可以通過巧妙的解決方案來解決，並將在本提案被研究，以開發一個強大的高速水-空氣光無線通信系統。 水-空通信信道與自由空間光通信（FSO）信道有很大不同。對波浪引起的損傷和緩和的研究很少。一個直接的補救措施是在犧牲功率預算的同時擴大波束覆蓋區域。光束跟踪是一種更有效的解決方案，因為它可以將更集中的光束引導回接收器，確保接收功率的高強度和穩定性。因此，高效的光束跟踪系統對於高速水-空氣光無線通信系統來說是非常可取的。這需要對水-氣通信通道有一個基本的了解。有趣的問題是，當光束嚴重偏轉並掉出光學檢測器區域時，是否存在可重新建立連接的替代光路來用於光束轉向。此外，應補償由水波引起的光波前失真來使信道容量最大化。 FSO 系統中已使用變形鏡 (DM) 來補償空氣湍流引起的波前失真。 DM 或其他補償方案是否也適用於水波引起的波前失真？總之，我們將研究使用波浪信息來促進波浪感知光束轉向和波前補償的技術，以減輕波浪引起的損傷並最大限度地提高水-空氣 OWC 系統的性能。 此項目不僅對香港這個擁有豐富海洋資源的沿海城市，而且對保護海洋生態系統都具有重要的戰略意義。

14219422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14219422.value: 互聯網應用中以LSM-tree鍵值存儲作為存儲引擎的數據庫去冗餘研究

14219422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14219422.value: 在當今互聯網服務和應用程序（如社交網絡）中，數據庫負載表現出不同的數據模式，例如，多為寫密集型、具有相對簡單和固定的數據結構；此外，一些系統採用昂貴的閃存存儲，為了節省成本，系統對存儲空間的使用非常敏感。為了滿足這些新需求，基於LSM-tree（Log-Structured Merge-tree）的KV存儲以其高寫性能及空間利用率、可擴展性好等特點成為這些互聯網應用的數據庫存儲引擎。 一個典型的例子是Facebook的MyRocks: 與傳統的MySQL結構不同，MyRocks用基於LSM樹的存儲引擎RocksDB取代了原來的基於B-tree的存儲引擎InnoDB。 在此類的數據庫系統中，由於KV存儲是為NoSQL數據庫而不是專門為存儲引擎設計的，存在不必要的冗餘。 我們的初步研究表明，如果可以消除這種冗餘，讀寫性能將有極大的提升潛力。 本項目旨在解決以下兩個問題：（1）日誌冗餘。在一個以基於LSM-tree的KV存儲為引擎的數據庫系統中，數據庫層有一份日誌（例如MySQL中的二進制日誌）；而KV存儲也包含一份預寫日誌（WAL）。為了保證崩潰一致性，每次寫入或更新數據都需要將WAL刷入磁盤；因此，消除WAL可以大大提高性能。雖然這可以通過簡單地關閉KV存儲中的WAL來實現，但數據庫層需要在崩潰恢復中重播整個日誌，這將帶來不可接受的開銷。我們將研究跨層協調機制，將KV存儲中的持久化信息傳遞到數據庫日誌中，作為崩潰恢復的“檢查點”。一個重要的觀察是，數據庫日誌中的所有更改以及KV存儲中相應的KV操作都是基於現有的串行調度；因此，這些更改和操作一定存在相應的順序關係。我們將研究其內在聯繫，研究應該傳遞什麼樣的信息，並通過開發基於Epoch高效崩潰恢復機制來解決KV存儲中多個列族的持久化速度不同的挑戰。（2）在終止的事務中進行冗餘的讀/寫操作。作為數據庫存儲引擎，事務處理是KV存儲必須提供的重要功能之一。然而，目前KV存儲主要採用基於鎖的併發控制機制，對共享KV進行讀寫訪問的併發事務將會在開始時或者執行中被鎖中止。這對於OLTP工作負載尤其不可取，因為最近的事務往往只訪問或更新一小部分熱的KV數據。現有的解決方案很大程度上利用了外部方法，即在KV存儲之外增加了一個額外的多版本併發控制（MVCC）層，但其引入了不必要的語義差距，帶來了額外的性能、存儲及垃圾回收開銷。在這個項目中，我們將設計新的基於KV的MVCC機制，以巧妙地將MVCC整合進KV存儲中。 本項目致力於改進互聯網及應用技術，考慮有效互聯網及應用在支持香港成為國際商業、貿易及金融中心上的重要性，對香港有着特別的意義。

14219922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14219922.value: 基於液滴微流控的單細胞線粒體全長基因組測序平臺開發

14219922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14219922.value: Prof Ma, Suk Ling Prof Tang, Nelson Leung-sang

14219922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14219922.value: The mitochondrial genome, though smaller than its nuclear counterpart, is an essential factor in the regulation of energy metabolism, signalling pathways, and cell death. Since the first identification of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations in 1988, accumulating evidence has supported correlations of age-related mtDNA defects with the development of mitochondrial diseases, including cancers, premature ageing syndromes, lung diseases, diabetes mellitus, and neurodegenerative disorders. However, the peculiar features of mitochondria, which are controlled by both the nuclear and mitochondrial genomes, render mtDNA prone to mutation, which results in more complex changes than those seen in nuclear DNA. Therefore, it has been difficult to correlate specific mtDNA mutations to the diverse clinical phenotypes associated with mitochondrial diseases. Recent advances in sequencing technologies have offered many valuable insights into complex biological systems ranging from cancer genomics to diverse microbial communities, particularly in terms of the characterisation of individual cells. Nevertheless, few studies have addressed mtDNA profiling at the single-cell level due to the lack of techniques enabling such analysis. The proposed project will aim to develop a new droplet microfluidics-based platform that can effectively isolate mtDNA from single cells with minimal contamination for subsequent analysis. No currently available competitive technology possesses the combined capacities of good mtDNA detection sensitivity and sequencing coverage, a high throughput, and time and cost efficiency. Once the proposed platform is successfully established and validated, it will allow researchers to elucidate the molecular mechanisms of rare mtDNA variations that underlie mitochondrial dysfunction related to ageing and the aforementioned mitochondrial diseases. Furthermore, the ability to profile mtDNA mutations is anticipated to reveal features of the onset, progression, and treatment responses of mitochondrial diseases. We have teamed up with clinical partners to formulate protocols suitable for clinical settings in parallel to our technological developments. We expect that this combined effort will increase the speed at which the proposed technology will reach the identified beneficiaries, both locally and globally. If successful, the proposed project will represent an important opportunity to translate scientific excellence in Hong Kong into societal impacts in the near future, thus helping transform the Greater Bay Area into an international powerhouse for combating mitochondrial diseases and ageing. 雖然線粒體基因組比核基因組小，但卻是細胞能量代謝，信號通路及凋亡中起調節作用的重要因素。自1988年第一次確定了線粒體基因組突變以來，越來越多的證據表明線粒體疾病（例如：癌症、早衰症、肺部疾病、糖尿病以及神經退行性疾病）的發展與年齡升高導致的線粒體缺陷有關。然而，線粒體同時受到核和本身基因組控制，其獨特特點使得線粒體基因組更容易發生突變，從而導致相較於核DNA更加複雜的變化。因此，將特定的線粒體基因組突變與線粒體疾病的各種臨床表現關聯起來一直存在困難。 最近測序技術的發展為瞭解複雜的生物體系提供了許多有價值的見解，這些生物體系既包括癌細胞基因組和各種各樣的微生物系統也包括單個細胞。即便如此，由於技術缺乏，目前很少有研究能夠在單細胞層次分析線粒體基因組。這個研究項目旨在開發一種新的基於液滴微流控的平臺，在沒有污染的情況下，為後續分析實現單細胞線粒體基因組的分離。目前，還沒有技術有能力同時兼有高線粒體DNA檢測靈敏度和測序覆蓋度、高通量、以及時間和成本優勢。一旦平臺成功建立起來並得到驗證，將使得研究人員能夠闡述衰老及其他線粒體疾病中與線粒體功能失調相關的罕見線粒體基因組突變的分子機制。更進一步，分析線粒體基因組突變的能力將會揭示線粒體疾病的發生，發展以及治療反應中的特點。我們已經與臨床醫生組成團隊，制定了適應臨床環境和我們技術開發的方法。期能藉由共同的努力使該技術加速惠及本地和全球的指定受益群體。如果成功的話，本項目將會是一個把香港的卓越研究轉化成社會影響的重要機遇，因此也會推動粵港澳大灣區建設成為國際抗擊線粒體疾病和老齡化的重要一員。

14220022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14220022.value: 面向高導熱的一維晶體聲子流體動力學研究

14220022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14220022.value: Dr Bai, Xue Dr Yao, Yimin Prof Zeng, Xiaoliang

14220022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14220022.value: Moore's Law, a rule of thumb that has come to dominate computing hardware, states that the number of transistors on a microprocessor chip doubles every two years or so. However, the law began to fail in the early 21st century, when the features began to shrink below about 90 nanometers. As electrons had to transit faster and faster through smaller and smaller silicon circuits, chips began to become very hot. Heat dissipation is a very challenging topic in modern electronics. Therefore, effective thermal management is extremely important. There are several techniques for cooling, namely different types of heat sinks, thermally conductive composites, fans and forced air cooling, heat pipes, thermoelectric coolers, etc. Nevertheless, exploring and preparing ultra-high thermal conductivity materials is the most fundamental and straightforward solution. Materials with ultrahigh thermal conductivities are desirable for thermal management application in modern electronics, which can be directly used to fabricate highly thermally conductive devices for efficient thermal transferring. To apply different materials into thermal management application, comprehensive understanding of heat transport has become critical not only for thermodynamics and statistical mechanics, but also for a wide range of engineering applications. However, understanding and engineering thermal conductivity of materials has been a sustained challenge because of the difficulty in modeling multi-body interactions and the complex nature of thermal measurements. At the end of the last century, with the rapid development of micro-/nano-fabrication and nanotechnology, a few of the conventional physical laws (e.g., Fourier's Law) are no longer valid for heat conduction on a nanoscale. Therefore, more studies are needed to explore thermal properties of materials on a nanometer scale, so as to provide desired materials for thermal management in modern electronics. Phonon hydrodynamics, a non-Fourier heat conduction transport phenomenon, is associated with ultrahigh thermal conductivity that is endowed by nature in low-dimensional materials. When the characteristic diameter of a one-dimensional material is reduced to tens or a few nanometers, the intrinsically ultra-high thermal conductivity properties of the material are demonstrated. We postulate that it is originated from the so called ‘hydrodynamic effect’ in heat conduction. In this proposal, we intend to conduct a comprehensive investigation of ultrahigh thermal conductivity in one-dimensional crystals. We aim to reveal the mechanism behind this fascinating phenomenon by combining experiment and simulation. Furthermore, we expect to alleviate the severe heat dissipation challenge of the aforementioned by exploiting the intrinsic ultrahigh thermal conductivity properties of the material. 摩爾定律 - 一個已經主導了計算硬體的經驗法則，指出微處理器晶片上的晶體管數量每兩年左右翻一番。 由於運算速度增加，晶片開始變得非常熾熱。 在現代電子學中，散熱是一個非常具有挑戰性的課題。 因此，有效的熱管理具有極其重要的意義。目前有幾種冷卻技術，即不同類型的散熱器、導熱復合材料、風扇和強制空氣冷卻、熱管、熱電冷卻器等。 然而，探索和制備超高導熱材料是最基本和最直接的解決方案。超高導熱材料是現代電子領域熱管理應用的理想材料，可直接用於製造高導熱器件，實現高效的熱傳輸。為了將不同的材料應用到熱管理應用中，關於熱傳輸的全面瞭解不僅對熱力學和統計力學，而且對於廣泛的工程應用都至關重要。然而，由於多體相互作用建模的困難和熱學測量的復雜性，理解和表徵工程材料的熱導率一直是一個持續的挑戰。上世紀末，隨著微/納米製造技術和納米表徵技術的快速發展，一些傳統的物理定律(如傅立葉定律)已不再適用於納米尺度的熱傳導。 因此，需要更多的研究來探索納米尺度下材料的熱學性能，為現代電子的熱管理提供所需的材料。 聲子流體力學是一種非傅立葉熱傳導輸運現象，它與自然界賦予的低維材料超高的熱導率有關。 當一維材料的特徵直徑減小到幾十納米或幾納米時，材料具有本質上超高的導熱性能。 我們假定它起源於熱傳導中所謂的“流體動力效應”。 在本專案中，我們計畫對一維晶體中的超高熱導率進行全面的研究。我們的目標是通過實驗和模擬相結合，來揭示這一引人注目現象背後的機制。此外我們也希望利用材料固有的超高導熱性能來緩解上述日益嚴重的散熱挑戰。

14220622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14220622.value: 基於光聲原位感知的神經外科柔性機械人系統賦能骨質疏鬆脊柱手術功能優效

14220622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14220622.value: Prof Liu, Li Prof Meng, Max Qing-Hu Prof Ren, Hongliang Dr Wong, Yu Chung

14220622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14220622.value: The world is faced with a rapid growth of the aging population. Alongside population aging, the incidence of osteoporosis and resultant fragility fractures has been markedly increasing, imposing a high socio-economic burden on the eldercare and healthcare system. Vertebral compression fracture is the most common type of osteoporotic fractures, leading to back pain and neurological dysfunction. Spinal fusion surgery is an alternative solution to alleviate pain and restore functionality if non-surgical therapy fails. Such surgery aims to stabilize the spine of osteoporostic vertebraes by drilling tunnels followed by screw implantation for pedicle fixation. However, a mismatch between complex anatomical constraints of the vertebrae and rigid nature of the drilling tool and screws forces surgeons to implant pedicle screws into low Bone Mineral Density (BMD) regions of osteoporotic vertebraes, resulting in post-operative complications associated with screw loosening and pullout. In addition, another major complication like cortical breach is caused by screw misplacement due to missing in situ tissue characterization, leading to vascular/neurological injuries. In general, functionally accurate spinal fusion of osteoporotic vertebrae is to achieve an expected functional outcome without complications, which is the ultimate objective surgeons pursue. However, current existing neurosurgical robotic systems only consider geometric accuracy of robotic positioning, and are ill-suited to be deployed in the context of osteoporosis. Hence, our objective of this project is to improve functional accuracy of spinal fusion of osteoporotic vertebrae by developing and validating a new-generation of image-guided, photoacoustic (PA) sensor-enhanced steerable neurosurgical robot and associated flexible pedicle screws for osteoporotic spine stabilization. Hence, the proposed specific aims are: Aim 1: Develop a biomechanical simulation module to plan bone density optimized curved drilling trajectories based on volumetric BMD within the osteoporotic vertebrae estimated by pre-operative quantitative computed tomography (QCT); Aim 2: Develop a robotic steerable drill equipped with a PA sensor and Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) sensors to aid in navigating through osteoporotic vertebrae and thereafter implanting flexible pedicle screws for complication-free spine stabilization; Aim 3: Develop a multi-scale navigation system that fuses the pre-operative QCT, intra-operative ultrasound (US) and in situ PA imaging for enhanced contextual visualization and tissue perception. Both FBG sensors and QCT/US imaging provide spatial guidance for steering through curved trajectories while PA enables in situ tissue sensing for fine orientation adjustment; Aim 4: Validate the steerable drill and flexible pedicle screws assisted by surgical navigation in simulated bone phantom and cadaveric spines. 世界正面臨人口老齡化。伴隨老齡化的加劇，骨質疏鬆症脆性骨折的發生率正明顯增加，造成沉重的社會及經濟負擔。脊椎壓縮性骨折是最普遍的骨質疏鬆症脆性骨折，易產生後背疼痛和功能障礙。一旦保守治療失敗，脊柱融合手術是緩解疼痛和恢復功能的有效解決方案。該手術通過植入椎弓根螺釘來穩定骨質疏鬆脊椎。然而，鑒於椎體解剖結構的複雜性和剛性骨鑽螺釘器械之間的不匹配，使外科醫生被迫將螺釘植入骨質疏鬆脊椎的骨密度（BMD）低的區域，導致螺釘鬆動風險提升誘發術後併發症。此外，另一個主要併發症是螺釘穿透錐體皮質骨，導致毗鄰血管及神經損傷，其原因是錐體內組織原位骨密度辨識功能缺失導致螺釘誤放置。一般而言，骨質疏鬆性脊柱融合的功能優效是神經外科醫生追求的終極目標。然而，現有的脊柱手術機械人系統只關注定位精度優效，且不適用於骨質疏鬆脊柱融合術等複雜場景。因此，我們這個專案的目標是通過開發和驗證新一代基於多尺度圖像引導、原位光聲感知增強的脊椎外科柔性機械人系統及相配套的柔性椎弓根螺釘，賦能骨質疏鬆脊柱融合術功能優效。 因此，擬議的具體目標是： 目標1：開發生物力學仿真模組，根據術前電腦斷層掃描定量成像（QCT）估計骨質疏鬆脊椎的BMD，進而規劃以高骨密度為導向的非線性柔性鑽道； 目標2：開發集成光聲內窺探頭和FBG感測器的可轉向柔性骨鑽機械人系統，使其在骨質疏鬆脊椎內進行導航，然後植入柔性椎弓根螺釘，實現功能優效的脊柱融合固定； 目標3：開發一個多尺度圖像導航系統，將術前QCT、術中超聲（US）和原位內窺光聲成像相融合，以增強全局-局部全方位感知。FBG感測器和QCT/US成像為柔性骨鑽導航提供全局空間引導，而原位光聲使能局部組織感知，進而精細調整柔性骨鑽方向； 目標4：在脊柱仿體和屍體上驗證可轉向柔性骨鑽機械人及配套的柔性椎弓根螺釘的系統性能。

14220822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14220822.value: 柔性可變形、張拉整體纜索驅動並聯機械人的設計與控制

14220822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14220822.value: Dr Caro, Stephane Prof Shao, Zhufeng Prof Tang, Xiaoqiang

14220822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14220822.value: Cable-driven parallel robots (CDPRs) are a type of parallel mechanism where multiple cables control the movement of the end-effector tool. CDPRs have meaningful applications for various industries, such as building construction, large-scale manufacturing and maintenance of utilities, due to its model simplicity, high payload capabilities and ability to operate in large spaces. The primary components of a CDPR include a moving end-effector, a set of robot winches controlling the length/force of cables and a support frame for the robot winches to be installed onto. In existing works, CDPRs always require a strong frame to ensure minimal frame deflection. This ensures that the cable attachment points do not move, as assumed in the ideal robot model to maintain high accuracy in the system kinematics. However, this inherently results in the need of a bulky robot frame, diminishing the CDPR’s advantages in being lightweight and easily transportable. In this project, a novel class of CDPRs with deformable frames (D-CDPRs) is proposed. Three types of D-CDPRs will be studied: a) CDPRs mounted on bendable support poles; b) CDPRs with a closed tensegrity frame structure that can be easily deployed and foldable; and c) CDPRs with tensegrity support poles that can be easily deployed and foldable. By allowing the frame of the CDPR to be deformable, there are several significant unprecedented advantages: 1) truly lightweight CDPRs that can be easily set up and transported; 2) increased system capabilities, including larger workspace and lower energy consumption; 3) inherent cable attachment reconfiguration as the frame deforms; and 4) increased system safety and robustness to model uncertainty and impact that a rigid frame cannot withstand. To achieve such advantages, the following major challenges will be addressed: 1) the deforming frame significantly complicates the kinematics and dynamics modelling of the CDPR; 2) mechanism analysis of D-CDPRs, including workspace, reconfiguration, stiffness and vibration analyses, need to be addressed; 3) design of the structures of the support poles and the tensegrity frame to satisfy desired deforming behaviours; 4) development of adaptive and learning controllers to achieve accurate control performance in the presence of model uncertainties introduced by the deforming robot frame. The developed methods will be validated through simulation models and experimentation on hardware prototypes for the three D-CDPR types. The potential applications for the proposed D-CDPRs include building construction and deployable service robots in complex and harsh environments. 纜索驅動並聯機械人（CDPR） 是一種並聯機械裝置，以多根纜索控制終端效應器的運動。 CDPR 因其簡單的建模、高效的載荷量和擁有在大空間內運動的能力，在建築施工、大型製造和維修等各個行業都有重要的應用。 CDPR 的主要組成部分包括一個移動的終端效應器、一組用於控制纜索長度和力度的絞盤和一個框架用於固的絞盤。現有的CDPR 總需要一個堅固的框架結構來防止框架變形。就如理想機器人模型中所假設的，剛性框架能確保纜索的繫著點固定，從而保持機械人系統的精度。然而，剛性框架結構會導致框架變得笨重，從而削弱了 CDPR 在輕型並易於運輸的優勢。 在這項目中提出了一種具有可變形框架的新型CDPR （D-CDPR）。這項目將會研究三種 D-CDPR模式，分別把CDPR安裝在： 一）可彎曲支撐桿上； 二） 封閉的纜索支柱網絡（張拉整體），易於展開和折疊； 三） 張拉整體組成的支撐柱組，易於展開和折疊。通過允許框架變形，將帶來幾個前所未有的優勢： 一）真正輕量級的 CDPR，並且易於安裝和運輸；二）增加機械人的能力，包括更大的工作空間和更低的能耗； 三）框架變形時允許纜索重新配置； 四）提高機械人的安全性，及為剛性框架無法承受的不確定性和衝擊提供強韌性。為了實現這些優勢，本項目將解決以下主要挑戰：一）變形框架顯然會使 CDPR 的運動學和動力學建模複雜化； 二）需要對 D-CDPR 的機構進行分析，包括作業空間、結構重組、剛度和振動分析； 三）設計支撐桿和張拉整體框架的結構以滿足所需的變形行為； 四）開發自適應和學習控制系統，使得在變形框架帶來的模型不確定性情況下，仍能實現準確的控制。所開發的方法將通過電腦模擬模型和對三種的 D-CDPR 類型的硬件原型的實驗進行驗證。擬議的 D-CDPR 的潛在應用包括建築機械人和在複雜和惡劣的環境中快速部署的服務機械人。

14221122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14221122.value: 金屬有機骨架納米纖維過濾網的研發及其在室內顆粒物控制的應用

14221122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14221122.value: Prof Mo, Jinhan Prof Zhang, Li

14221122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14221122.value: Indoor exposure to airborne particles is associated with various adverse health effects, such as respiratory infection, heart disease, lung cancer, and Alzheimer’s disease. Traditional high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters can effectively remove indoor particles, but such filters usually cause a high pressure drop, and thus high operating costs. Therefore, it is worthwhile to develop novel high-efficiency air filters with low pressure drop for efficient indoor particle control. Compared with traditional HEPA filters, nanofiber filters fabricated by the electrospinning technique cause a lower pressure drop because of the slip effect, and they are thinner, more flexible, and more lightweight. Meanwhile, metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), a class of hybrid crystalline porous nanomaterials composed of metal ions and organic ligands, have proven to be effective in capturing airborne particles because they have large surface areas, adjustable pore sizes, and high polarity or charge separation. Therefore, electrospun nanofiber filters would be more efficient in particle removal if embedded with MOF nanocrystals. However, few studies on the development of MOF-embedded nanofiber filters for indoor particle control have been reported in the literature. This project will start with the development of an efficient and scalable fabrication method for embedding MOF nanocrystals into electrospun nanofibers. Zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) will be used as the MOF because of ZIF-8’s high polarity, large pore sizes, and high zeta potential. An immersion method with careful tuning of the fabrication parameters for in-situ growth of ZIF-8 onto polyacrylonitrile (PAN) nanofibers will be developed to shorten the fabrication time. To enhance the filter performance, understanding the mechanisms of particle removal by the MOF-embedded nanofibers is crucial. This project will experimentally probe three potential mechanisms, including the electrostatic effect, enhanced roughness, and particle/MOF bonding. Based on the understanding of the mechanisms, the project will then optimize the design and fabrication processes to obtain ZIF-8-embedded PAN nanofiber filters with maximized particle removal efficiency and low pressure drop. The optimized filters will be installed in portable air cleaners and mechanical ventilation systems in real-life environments, and their performance will be evaluated by long-term field tests. The proposed project will enhance our understanding of the mechanisms of particle removal by MOF-embedded nanofiber air filters. The filter development will improve the particle removal efficiency, which in turn will help to reduce indoor exposure to airborne particles. The findings will advance the development of this novel filtration technology for efficient indoor particle control. 室內空氣中的顆粒污染物可能導致多種健康風險，例如呼吸道感染、心臟疾病、肺癌、阿茲海默症等。傳統的高效過濾網可以有效去除室內顆粒物，但是其壓降損失很高，從而導致較高的運行能耗。因此，研發新型的高效低阻空氣過濾器對於室內顆粒物的高效控制至關重要。 相較於傳統的高效過濾網，利用電紡技術制備的納米纖維過濾網由於存在滑移效應，可以有效降低壓降損失。此外，納米纖維過濾網通常很輕薄很柔軟，可為不同應用提供更多可能性。另一方面，金屬有機骨架由於其較大的表面積、可調整的孔徑、以及強極性，亦被證明可有效捕捉顆粒物。因此，如果可以將金屬有機骨架嵌入納米纖維過濾網，其過濾效率有望得到提升。然而，文獻中對於金屬有機骨架納米纖維過濾網的研發及其在室內顆粒物控制的應用還鮮有報道。 本項目首先將研發一種高效且可規模化的制備方法，以用於制備金屬有機骨架納米纖維過濾網。此制備方法基於浸泡法，並且通過調整制備參數以縮短金屬有機骨架在納米纖維過濾網上的合成時間。此外，我們還將通過實驗測量，研究靜電作用、粗糙度、和顆粒物-金屬有機骨架結合等顆粒物捕捉機理。基於對機理的深入研究，本項目將優化這種新型過濾網的設計和制備過程，以達到高效過濾的標準，並且降低壓降損失。最後，我們會將經過優化設計的過濾網安裝於空氣淨化器和機械通風系統中，通過長期測試以評估其在實際室內環境中的顆粒物控制效果。 本項目將有望提升我們對金屬有機骨架納米纖維過濾網的顆粒物捕捉機理的認知。若研發成功，這種新型過濾網可以提升顆粒物過濾效率，從而降低室內顆粒污染的暴露及其健康風險。本項目的研究結果有望推動這種新型過濾技術的發展，為高效室內顆粒污染控制提供更多選擇。

14221322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14221322.value: 基於時域和頻域Talbot效應的可編程光信號處理方案

14221322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14221322.value: Dynamic resource management is much needed for today’s communication network due to time and location dependent data traffic patterns. Programmable optical processing offers an attractive means to support this objective, thanks to its versatility in dealing with signals of diverse multiplexing schemes, modulation formats, and data rates. To achieve the programmability at the physical level, it is often necessary to control different properties of the optical waves. A promising solution is to adopt phase-controlled temporal and spectral Talbot effects. The optical power can be redistributed in the temporal or spectral domain through spectral phase filtering or temporal phase modulation, respectively. The optical transformation is essentially lossless and noiseless. Specifically, the temporal or spectral repetition period of an optical wave can be multiplied or divided by any rational number to support the generation, processing, and detection of data at variable rates. Such multiplication and division can also result in mitigation of pulse-to-pulse intensity and phase variation, or noiseless amplification in the temporal or spectral domain. Unfortunately, linear Talbot processing schemes are seldom integrated with ultrafast nonlinear processing of signals to unleash its full potential in communications and other applications. In this proposal, we aim at marrying these two technologies to establish a new subfield of programmable hybrid optical processing that combines their advantages. We will investigate new functionalities enabled by merging Talbot effects with third order nonlinear processing. In particular, the hybrid processing will be applied to the generation and detection of communication signals in a Nyquist wavelength-division-multiplexing (WDM) system supporting a programmable data rates up to 5.6 Tb/s using advanced modulation schemes. A programmable optical frequency comb generated by Talbot processing and cross phase modulation (XPM) will provide the carriers for Nyquist data pulses. At the receiver, ultrafast optical sampling and detection of the Nyquist data pulses will be achieved by XPM-based nonlinear interferometer. Programmable Talbot array illuminator will be applied for tuning the temporal aperture and the magnification in the optical sampling to maximize the detection performance. We will design the new schemes for optical processing, perform theoretical analysis and simulation, build the experimental setups, analyze the measurement results against the theoretical prediction, and identify the sources for imperfections. In addition to using dispersive and nonlinear fibers for the processing, we also propose an integrated solution on silicon photonics platform based on custom-designed chirped waveguide Bragg gratings and dispersive phase filters, and silicon waveguides for ultrafast XPM processing. 在現今的通信網絡當中，數據的流量會隨着時間和地域而改變，因此，網絡效率高度依賴動態的信息資源管理。 可編程光信號處理為實現這目標提供了有利的方案，因為它可以應用於在不同的復用技術、調制格式和數據速率上的光信號。為了實現物理層面上的可編程性，我們需要控制光的相關屬性。目前，一種有效的解決方案是采用基於相位控制的時域或頻域的Talbot效應。 光功率可以通過在時域或頻域的相位控制來實現功率的重新分配。這種光功率再分配基本上是一種無損耗以及無噪音的處理方式。 具體來說，光信號的時間或光譜的重復周期可以乘以或除以任何有理數，以此來支持可變速率光信號的產生、處理和檢測等功能。這種光信號處理方式還可以減輕光脈沖間的振幅和相位抖動，以及在時域或頻域進行光信號的無噪音放大。 但是，線性Talbot光信號處理技術很少與光信號的超快非線性的處理技術相結合，以釋放其在通信或其他領域應用中的全部潛力。 在這項提案中，我們的目標是將這兩種技術充分結合，以建立一個新的可編程光學處理方式。我們將探索如何通過結合Talbot效應和三階非線性技術來產生新功能。具體來說，混合光信號處理將被應用於奈奎斯特波分復用（WDM）系統中通信信號的產生和檢測。該系統使用先進的調制方案並支持高達2.64Tb/s的可編程數據速率。由Talbot效應和交叉相位調製（XPM）產生的可編程光頻率梳將為奈奎斯特數據脈沖提供載體。在接收器上，基於XPM的非線性幹涉儀將實現對奈奎斯特數據脈沖的超快速光學采樣和檢測。可編程的Talbot陣列照明器將被用於調整光學采樣的時間孔徑和放大率，以提高檢測性能。我們將設計新的光學處理方案，進行理論分析和模擬，搭建相關實驗平臺，對照理論預測分析和實驗測量的結果，以及確定最終數據的誤差來源。 除了利用色散和非線性光纖進行光信號處理，我們還提出了一個基於矽光子學平台的解決方案，以定制設計的啁啾波導布拉格光柵或色散相位濾波器、以及矽波導上超高速XPM處理來實現目標。

14221422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14221422.value: 堆疊鈣鈦礦/量子點結構的基礎研究與發光二極管應用

14221422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14221422.value: This project aims at developing the fabrication methods and device physics models for stacked perovskite/quantum dot structures with tunable charge-injection and energy-transfer properties, thus enabling high performance light-emitting devices. Colloidal quantum dots (QDs) exhibit outstanding luminescence efficiency and spectral stability, superior color purity and wide color gamut, demonstrating great potential in high-resolution display and high-color-rendering-index lighting applications. However, the power efficiency and stability of electrically driven QD-based LEDs (QD-LEDs) are still limited, due partially to the lack of suitable charge-transporting materials to pair with the QD emitter to generate efficient electroluminescence. The recently merged lead halide perovskites may provide a solution to this bottleneck as they can be low-temperature processed (thus compatible with QD device fabrication) and possess excellent semiconducting properties such as tunable direct bandgap, high carrier mobility and high photoluminescence efficiency. In particular, the band edges of wide-bandgap (~ 3eV) perovskites are well positioned with respect to the energy levels of visible-light QDs, allowing for efficient charge injection and counter-charge blocking. The exploration for perovskite-integrated QD-LEDs has only started very recently: a high-efficiency infrared QD-LED with a QD-in-perovskite emissive layer has been demonstrated, revealing perovskites can also serve as an efficient energy-transfer host for QDs. Despite this promising start, theoretical guidelines and fabrication know-hows for hybrid perovskite/QD LEDs are yet to be established. In this project we seek to explore the device structures capable of merging the merits of halide perovskites and QDs for energy-efficient light emission. To construct the model system, we select colloidal CdSe QDs for visible-light emission, lead chloride perovskites (APbCl3) for charge transport and 2D perovskites for modulating interface charge- and energy-transfer. Firstly, we will investigate film deposition and post-deposition treatment and passivation methods for creating pinhole-free APbCl3 charge-transporting layers. Secondly, we will establish composition tuning and surface modification protocols to adjust the electronic properties of APbCl3 and 2D perovskite films. In parallel, we will examine the charge injection efficacy at the electrode/perovskite and perovskite/QD interfaces and identify proper material combinations and interface modification methods to ensure efficient charge injection at all interfaces across a device. Finally, we will fabricate a series of stacked QD/perovskite structures and devices to holistically characterize the direct charge-injection and energy-transfer processes in the hybrid perovskite/QD devices and explore how these processes can be coordinated through material selection and device engineering to achieve high-performance LEDs. The findings can be extended to enhance other light-emitting device platforms. 該項目旨在開發具有可調電荷注入和能量轉移特性的堆疊鈣鈦礦/量子點結構，通過制備方法的創新和器件物理模型的研究，實現高性能發光器件。 膠體量子點 (QD) 具有出色的發光效率和光譜穩定性、高色純度以及寬色域，在高分辨率顯示和高顯色指數照明應用上已顯示出巨大潛力。然而，基於 QD 的 電驅動LED (QD-LED) 的功率效率和穩定性仍然有限，其中一重要原因是缺乏合適的電荷傳輸材料與 QD 匹配以產生有效的電致發光。近年來發展迅速的鹵化鉛鈣鈦礦半導體可能為這一瓶頸提供解決方案。此類鈣鈦礦可進行低溫加工（因此與 QD 器件製造兼容）並具有出色的半導體特性，例如可調諧直接帶隙、高載流子遷移率和高光致發光效率。更重要的是，寬帶隙（~3eV）鈣鈦礦的能帶邊緣相對於可見光量子點的能級匹配良好，極為有利於電荷注入和反電荷阻擋。近期學界已開始鈣鈦礦集成 QD-LED 的探索，並實現了基於 QD-in-perovskite 發射層的高效紅外 QD-LED，證明了鈣鈦礦也可以作為 QD 的高效能量轉移主體。儘管有這個良好的開端，關於鈣鈦礦/QD LED 的理論模型和制備技術還十分缺乏。 在這個項目中，我們將探索能夠融合鹵化物鈣鈦礦和量子點優點以實現節能發光的器件結構。為了構建模型系統，我們將選擇用於可見光發射的膠體 CdSe QD、用於電荷傳輸的氯化鉛鈣鈦礦 (APbCl3) 和用於調製界面電荷和能量傳輸的二維鈣鈦礦。首先，我們將研究用於制備高性能 APbCl3 電荷傳輸層的薄膜沉積和沈積後處理方法。接下來，我們將建立成分調整和表面改性的協同優化，以調整 APbCl3 和二維鈣鈦礦薄膜的電子特性。同時，我們將檢查電極/鈣鈦礦和鈣鈦礦/量子點界面處的電荷注入效率，並確定適當的材料組合和界面改性方法，以確保在器件的所有界面處有效地注入電荷。最後，我們將製造一系列堆疊的 QD/鈣鈦礦結構和器件，以全面表徵混合鈣鈦礦/QD 器件中的直接電荷注入和能量轉移過程，並探索如何通過材料選擇和器件設計來協調這些過程，以實現高性能 LED。這些發現可以進一步擴展到其他發光器件平台。

14221522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14221522.value: 應用於機器人-環境交互控制的可變形、調節傾角的六旋翼無人機和靈活的空中操作執行器以及受限空間內組裝操作中的混合微分動態規劃框架

14221522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14221522.value: Prof Chen, Benmei Prof Floreano, Dario Prof Gan, Dongming Dr Ma, Xin

14221522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14221522.value: 無人機可以替代人類完成例如礦業勘探、排雷、高空操作等危險作業。但對無人機來說，在狹小空間內進行精準、複雜的組裝操作仍是一個巨大挑戰。近些年，螺旋槳平行安裝式的傳統四旋翼無人機已經得到了廣泛的應用，但是其無法在六維空間內進行全驅動。在過去的十年裡，面向精密空中操作的要求，許多全驅動和過驅動多旋翼無人機被開發出來，但是，它們有很多缺陷：（1）無法改變的幾何外形，致使其在受限空間內航行能力較差；（2）無法動態調節其在空間的橢力球，限制了其在空中的可操控性；（3）缺乏能夠輸出足夠輸出力的輕質、大剛度、高靈活度的空中執行器；（4）空氣動力學模型不精確，忽略了傾斜角和受限空間對空氣動力學模型的干擾；（5）變形過程中所產生的慣性及重心的變化，致使無人機控制不穩定；（6）缺乏用於組裝操作的穩定、快速優化控制器。 本項目的整體目標是開發可變性、可調節傾角的六旋翼無人機以及用於空中安裝操作（例如鑽孔、擰螺絲）的剛柔混合執行器。此設計有兩個創新點：（1）結構：提出了一個新型的六旋翼結構，此新型設計的六個螺旋槳可以靈活變形及調節傾斜角度，保證無人機可以通過變化形狀來實現在受限空間內的航行，同時也可以通過動態變化螺旋槳傾角來獲得更高的可操控性；（2）設計新型的輕質、高剛度的剛柔混合執行器，並將其裝配進無人機，以實現空中鑽孔、抓物、擰螺絲等精準操作。除了結構上的創新之外，我們將針對新型六旋翼提出慮及變形和螺旋槳傾斜影響的新型空氣動力學模型。此外，在控制器開發上也有兩個創新點：（1）提出一種自適應飛行穩定控制框架，此控制器通過在變形過程中估計無人機慣性和重心變化來增強無人機在受限空間內的空中控制能力和航行能力；（2）開發了混合微分動態規劃框架，此控制框架在考慮空氣動力學、環境與目標相互作用約束以及無人機力輸出要求的基礎上可穩定的實現無人機的操控。此外，我們還開發了一款以人為中心的實時虛擬夾具觸覺感知系統，該系統即使在無人機和用戶輸入設備出現誤配的複雜工作環境中，也能為用戶提供直觀的遠程動作控制。 所提出的裝配有柔性執行器的無人機將會是第一款能夠保證良好環境適應性和空中操控性的無人機。我們的控制方法也將首次考慮螺旋槳傾角對空氣動力學的影響，並解決變形飛行穩定控制問題。我們的研究成果可能成為非傳統無人機設計、建模與控制的基準。研究的項目會讓無人機能夠在受限內空間內進行更多的空中動作，實現在各種環境干擾下的穩定控制，執行與物理環境交互時的精準、靈活安裝操作。總的來看，為了提高操作的安全性和效率，該系統最終能夠通過遠程操控實現複雜的空中安裝操作，為實現高空組裝操作以及其他危險條件下組裝操作提供一個新的辦法。

14221822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14221822.value: 透過“輔助接收者”獲得多用戶信息論中的新外界

14221822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14221822.value: Multiuser information theory deals with fundamental limits of communication and compression in a system where multiple senders and receivers share a common medium. Unlike a point-to-point communication system - where these limits have been solved in a seminal paper by Shannon in 1948 - the fundamental limits are not computable for most of the basic building blocks of the multiuser settings. The PI, along with his collaborators, has spent the considerable part of the last decade investigating fundamental scenarios in multiuser information theory and have been quite successful in making progress on various fronts for broadcast channels and interference channels. This proposal directly stems from a very recent and interesting series of works done by the PI and his collaborators, where a family of new outer bounds have been developed that strictly outperformed the best known bounds for the three most fundamentals open settings in multiuser information theory - the broadcast, interference, and relay channels. The recent bounds were just the first-cut effort, by us, to show the power of the auxiliary receivers approach. This proposal attempts to study this novel approach in detail to understand the fuller impact of these strategies to the fundamental settings. Currently the auxiliary receiver based bounds have a few shortcomings: the choice of the "good" auxiliary receivers is not well understood; and consequently the tightest form of the outer bounds may not be computable. These issues dwelve into non-convex optimization problems over probability simplices, another pursuit that may be of independent interest to other communities. Thus this proposal intends to undertake a detailed study of this new and interesting approach to establishing outer bounds. 多用戶信息論旨在研究多位通訊者共享信道時通訊和壓縮的理論極限。在1948年，香農在一篇影響深遠的論文中解決了單用戶通訊中的理論極限。然而，在大多數基礎多用戶通訊場景中的信道容量仍未解決。 近十年，首席研究員和其合作者投入不少時間研究多用戶信息論中的基本場景，在各種廣播信道和干擾信道中取得不少研究成果。這份研究提案源自首席研究員和其合作者的一系列工作。我們在三種最為基礎的多用戶通訊信道（廣播信道、干擾信道和中繼信道）中發現了一組新的外界，比已知的外界更優。這是我們初次使用“輔助接收者”的方法來獲得這些新外界。這份提案旨在更仔細地研究這種嶄新的手法，使我們在這些基礎場景中獲得更緊的外界。 目前這些使用“輔助接收者”所得的外界有一些局限性，我們還未充分了解如何挑選好的“輔助接收者”，從中所獲得的最優外界也未必可計算。這些問題源自於標準單體上的非凸優化問題，其他研究社群亦可能對此問題感興趣。

14222222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14222222.value: VI-Drive: 基礎設施輔助自動駕駛中實時協同感知的邊緣系統

14222222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14222222.value: 自動駕駛有可能徹底改變交通出行方式和安全。預計到 2030 年每年將有超過 1000 萬輛汽車配備 L2/L3（部分/有條件的自動化）功能。一個新興的有前途的方案是基礎設施輔助自動駕駛，其中智能路邊基礎設施例如配備計算和傳感單元的燈柱幫助車輛實現防撞、導航等各種關鍵服務。這種方案的一個關鍵使能技術是如何通過基礎設施-車輛傳感器融合實現實時協作感知。然而，實現這一願景之前需要解決幾個重大挑戰，包括在資源有限的路邊基礎設施上支持並發實時深度學習任務，高效融合異構基礎設施和車輛傳感器（例如，激光雷達、攝像頭和雷達），它們的視野不僅顯著不同，而且隨時間變化很大。為了應對這些挑戰，我們提出以下研究任務：1）支持路邊基礎設施並發實時深度學習任務的邊緣系統。利用深度學習的獨特計算特性，我們對單個路邊單元聯合優化模型壓縮和調度優先級，智能調度多個路邊單元之間的任務以通過模型推理減少計算開銷。 2) 一種新穎的基於語義的 3D 點雲配準方法，以厘米級精度對齊基礎設施和車載 LiDAR 點雲。由於允許車輛和基礎設施獨立地從他們的點雲中獲取語義信息，這種方法可以帶來用於基礎設施輔助自動駕駛的高度可擴展架構。 3)一種毫米波 (mmWave) 雷達相機融合方法，利用路邊毫米波雷達和車載攝像頭，在具有挑戰性的天氣條件下實現強大的感知能力。通過採用了一種新穎的解耦深度網絡，我們僅使用少量雙模態數據即可訓練網絡架構。 4) 利用基礎設施僅從單目車載攝像頭重建高清 3D 地圖，顯著降低生成 3D 駕駛地圖的成本。 5)在兩個測試平台上進行廣泛實驗進行系統驗證。

14222722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14222722.value: 基於人因工學的自適應人機協作學習和控制方法研究

14222722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14222722.value: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) can bring a new level of flexibility and efficiency to the industry, from robots that execute tasks while sharing their workspace with humans to robots that accomplish a task while physically interacting with humans. One of the most typical scenarios is that the human and robot co-manipulate an object. In this scenario, the shortcoming due to robots’ limitations in observing and adapting to the human dynamics can result in inefficient collaboration and unergonomic interaction, i.e., with various human states traditionally identified ergonomic non-efficient and unproductive. This challenge has contributed to the growth of musculoskeletal disorders in manufacturing and logistics industries, and urged new generation of HRC technologies based on cognitive ergonomics. The proposed research “Learning and Control of Adaptive Co-Manipulation in Human-Robot Collaboration Based on Cognitive Ergonomics” (Ergo-HRC) will address this shortcoming and technical challenges by developing methods that enables robots to work adaptively and efficiently with human workers within which the system can efficiently observe human dynamics in real-time, learn anticipatory models from demonstration, and apply it to the control loop of adaptive human and robot co-manipulation framework. In Ergo-HRC, we will exploit a fully sensorized environment and accompanying computational tools, enabling the measurement of interactive process between robots, humans and environment in HRC tasks. A dataset will be created to capture the human data when performing co-manipulation tasks. The dataset includes multi-modal data, e.g., visual, biosignals, motion, force. Then data-driven models are built to learn the presentation of behaviors of the human agents (either as assistant or as assisted) as well as their ergonomics factors, such as mental processes (e.g., attention) and conditions (e.g., mental workload, fatigue). Learning will be achieved by switching the roles of the assistant agent and the assisted agent which will speed up the learning from demonstration (LfD). As an encoding policy, novel methodology to encode the representation of behaviors of the human and robot co-manipulation in a joint graphic neural network model will be exploited for regression and model predictive control for adaptive collaboration behaviors for robots. We will concentrate on task scenarios that human and robot co-loading a box and co-assembling with increasing complexity from purely reactive behaviors to anticipative and personalized behaviors. The robot is a mobile robot with human level features (two arms and one torso). Ergo-HRC will have profound socio-economic impacts by improving workers’ wellbeing and contributing to productivity of modern industry. 人和機械人的協同操作（人機協作）是未來一項關鍵的柔性製造領域的相關技術。本研究課題旨在針對人和機器人在時間和空間上形成協同並需要實現物理交互的場景，比如共同操作一件物體，研究一個新穎有效的人機協同自適應控制方法。為此，首先引入認知人因工學概念，基於觀察和學習人類之間的協作，構建數據集並對此過程中的人因工學因素進行學習和識別。於此同時，學習一套更加有效的人機雙臂協作交互行為以及機械人自主雙臂操作行為的表征。接著，將以上两點納入人機協作共享及柔順控制框架，即實現機械人在人機協作中考慮人因工學對人類的影響，並進而自適應地調整自身的柔順配合行為。最後，此研究的關鍵技術將應用到一台雙臂協作移動機械人並在相關場景中進行測試驗證。

14222822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14222822.value: 條件子圖中的模式匹配

14222822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14222822.value: Pattern matching queries are variants of conjunctive/first-order-logic queries on binary relations and extract vital information about a pattern's occurrences in a massive data graph. Of particular importance are pattern counting and pattern enumeration: the former finds the number of occurrences of a pattern (e.g., "how many triangles are there in the friendship graph of Facebook?"), and the latter reports all those occurrences (e.g., "list all the triangles in the aforementioned friendship graph). These queries are essential graph-analytic operations in numerous areas, including social networks, data mining, e-commerce, communication, software engineering, transportation, bioinformatics, etc. They, on the other hand, are notoriously expensive: the computation is often intolerably long even if the target pattern involves just a small number of vertices and edges. This project plans to develop innovative methods to accelerate pattern matching by resorting to pre-computation. We aim to design data structures and algorithms to support pattern counting/enumeration on graphs dynamically generated by user predicates (rather than one common graph). An example is "count/enumerate all the triangles exclusively formed by people whose annual salaries are in [50k, 100k]". The condition "salary in [50k, 100k]" is ad-hoc and can be replaced with many other predicates, which can differ in the interval specified, the attributes involved, or even nature (e.g., range predicates vs. rank predicates). The technical challenge is effectively reducing the query time by shifting part of the computation to the preprocessing stage. The research will respond to the industry's intense and urgent demands for indexing structures and algorithms of the above kind due to their imperative role in sustaining the performance of graph-management systems. A primary goal of our scientific investigation is to understand the inherent tradeoff between space consumption and query time, depending on the pattern graph and the class of user predicates. We expect the project's findings to advance the theory on conjunctive queries, boost practical systems' efficiency, enhance end-users' experience, strengthen companies' competitiveness, and contribute to open-source development. 模式匹配查詢是處理圖數據的重要工具。其中，特別重要的是模式計數和模式枚舉：前者查找一個模式的出現次數（例如，Facebook的友誼圖中有包含多少個三角形子圖？），而後者則將一個模式的所有實例報告出來（例如，“列出上述友誼圖中的所有三角形子圖）。這兩種查詢是許多應用中的關鍵操作，包括社交網絡、數據挖掘、電子商務、網絡管理、軟件工程、交通運輸、生物信息學等。 本項目旨在研究如何支持在動態生成的圖上（而不是在一個靜態的圖上）進行模式計數和枚舉。例如，如果只考慮Facebook中年薪五萬到十萬中的用戶，那麽友誼圖中包含多少個三角形子圖呢？又如何將它們一一枚舉呢？注意這裏“年薪五萬到十萬”是用戶實時給定的不可預知的條件，而隨著此條件的改變，計數和枚舉的結果都相應地改變。本項目將設計新的數據結構和算法來顯著加快此類的計數和枚舉操作。 我們期待本項目的發現能有助于推進圖理論的發展，提高圖系統效率，提升終端用戶體驗，增強企業競爭力，並爲開源開發做出貢獻。

14222922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14222922.value: 探索推薦系統中的語義和結構信息

14222922.label: Project Objectives
14222922.value: To explore the semantic information using knowledge graph and design and implement a set of robust algorithms to model the noisy real-world recommender system To examine the structure information using hyperbolic space and related embedding methods in order to design more efficient algorithms to make more accurate recommendations To investigate the combined semantics and structure information with the knowledge graph and hyperbolic space for a more robust recommender system
rows: To explore the semantic information using knowledge graph and design and implement a set of robust algorithms to model the noisy real-world recommender system
To examine the structure information using hyperbolic space and related embedding methods in order to design more efficient algorithms to make more accurate recommendations
To investigate the combined semantics and structure information with the knowledge graph and hyperbolic space for a more robust recommender system

14222922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14222922.value: There are considerable graph-structured data in the real world, and learning graph representation can achieve many valuable tasks, such as recommending new collaborators to a researcher in academic networks, finding new items for users in e-commerce networks, and discovering the crucial substructures in a medical knowledge graph. The fundamental challenges in solving these tasks are: (1) how to encode semantic information into the meaningless ids of user and item; (2) how to consider the inherent structure in the network and find an appropriate embedding space to encode graph structures like node, edge, or subgraph and the features of nodes; (3) how to incorporate both the semantic and structure information for more accurate predictions. Recent years have seen a surge in learning on a recommender system based on graph neural networks. Instead of using hand-picked features, graph neural networks seek to learn high-quality embeddings for recommender systems that encode important features and structural information into a low-dimension representation. Existing methods mainly unify the historical interactions with the meaningless user ids and make recommendations based on their potential common preferences. These methods usually su↵er from the sparsity of interactions and the cold start problem. In this proposal, we would like to tackle the semantics challenge by incorporating knowledge graph (KG) into recommender systems, to enhance recommendation e↵ectiveness. As one of the semantic information, KG usually contains much more fruitful facts and connections about items and users. On the other hand, most recommendation methods are built in Euclidean space, which may under- estimate the underlying structure in the recommendation networks, resulting in sub-optimal embedding quality and low recommendation e↵ectiveness. To tackle this problem, we would like to leverage hyperbolic space to fit the power-law distribution in the recommender system. E↵ectively the use of hyperbolic space may help to represent hierarchical information in KGs better resulting in a higher accuracy in recommendations. 14223422.label: Project Objectives
14223422.value: Physical Modeling and Robust Deformation Monitoring The purpose of this research is to develop an innovative InSAR remote sensing method to monitor land subsidence at large scales and millimeter level accuracy with unprecedented details. Physical modeling in laboratorial and real scenarios will be designed and conducted to investigate the microwave sensing mechanisms under different configurations of target properties and microwave operating conditions. To mitigate atmospheric effects, robust estimators with deep learning-based atmospheric removal will be developed for the time-series deformation analysis. Considering that deltaic metropolitan regions may include high-coherence urban areas and low-coherence suburban areas, persistent scatterer (PS) and distributed scatterer (DS) will be jointly detected in SAR images to increase the point density. Intelligent Land Subsidence Pattern Recognition The aim is to intelligently identify the spatial and temporal patterns of land subsidence by deep learning of multi-disciplinary data from InSAR and optical remote sensing, geology, hydrology, geomorphology, and meteorology. Multi-scale, multi-temporal, multi-angle, and multi-dimensional data will be unified to the same spatial and temporal scales using format transformation, spatiotemporal interpolation, and downscaling/upscaling methods. An innovative YOLOv4 network with adaptive bounding box will be trained using synthetic and real data to identify the spatial pattern (location and spatial extent) of subsidence. A deep Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) network will be developed to identify the temporal pattern of subsidence (e.g., constant, seasonal, accelerated and decelerated trends) as well as change points of trends through time-series deformation analysis. Risk Assessment The main objective of this study is to identify potential risks by the combined use of multi-source data and expert knowledge in an advanced geographic information system (GIS). The monitored deformation and identified patterns will be verified using in-situ data, followed by further enhancement of monitoring and pattern recognition methods as appropriate. Using multi-source big data analytics, it is feasible to identify the main driving forces of land subsidence and the significance levels of influential factors. GIS analysis will be conducted with a multi-level and multi-phase strategy to facilitate not only overall inspection but also detailed investigation of possible problematic areas. The system can assist the public and private sectors to identify potential risks for carrying out maintenance and remedy actions.

14223422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14223422.value: Land subsidence, the lowering of the Earth’s land surface, is a potential geo-hazard under the combined effects of natural and anthropogenic activities. Metropolitans, usually clustered in deltaic areas, are susceptible to ground subsidence due to the natural compaction and consolidation of sediments. With rapid urbanization, anthropogenic activities, especially groundwater extraction and underground constructions, may exacerbate this problem. Land subsidence and infrastructural deformation are threatening the geological stability, aquifer-system storage capacity, civil infrastructural safety, and flooding susceptibility in deltaic metropolitan regions. We have seen many subsidence-induced problems in recent years. For instance, the underground construction of the Shatin to Central Link in Hong Kong led to the excessive settlement of 23 buildings adjacent to the To Kwa Wan station. In some cases, the consequences may be catastrophic. For instance, the recent Florida building collapse killed 97 people. Increasing tragedies are wake-up calls for us to enhance the resilience of our society against land subsidence for sustainable development of the socio-economic environment. This project aims to develop innovative synthetic aperture radar (SAR) interferometry (InSAR) remote sensing methods with multi-source big data analytics to map regional and local land subsidence in deltaic metropolitan regions, and advance fundamental scientific knowledge of land dynamics and their interactions with influential factors for risk assessment. Remote sensing has distinct advantages over conventional engineering methods, namely, (i) large-scale monitoring capacity; (ii) high spatial density of points; and (iii) cost-effectiveness with no need for any instruments on the ground. Artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, especially deep learning, provide an intelligent big data analytical tool to recognize the spatiotemporal patterns of land subsidence. The deliverables include: (i) a cutting-edge millimeter-level InSAR deformation monitoring method with robust estimation and deep learning-based atmospheric removal; (ii) an innovative and intelligent land subsidence spatiotemporal pattern recognition method using multi-source big data analytics; (iii) An advanced multi-level and multi-phase risk assessment system based on expert knowledge and geographic information system (GIS) analysis; and (iv) publications and presentations in the international journals, conferences and workshops. The deliverables of this project will be transferable to subsidence-prone areas all over the world, especially deltaic metropolitan regions, to support regional sustainable development. The scientific achievements from this project will also have impacts on the investigation of sea level change, groundwater cycle, geological evolution, earth dynamics in which an enhanced understanding of the dynamic mechanisms of land subsidence is also critical. 地面沉降，即地球陸地表面的下沉，是一種在自然和人類活動的綜合影響下的潛在地質災害。通常聚集在三角洲地區的大都市，由於河流沉積物的自然壓實和固結，容易受到地面沉降的影響。隨著城市化進程的加快，城市人類活動，特別是地下水開採和地下施工活動，會進一步加劇這一問題。地面沉降和基礎設施變形正在威脅著三角洲大都市區的地質穩定性、含水層系統儲存能力和民用基礎設施安全，同時增加了城市的洪水易感性。近年來，我們可以看到許多由地面沉降引起問題的事例。例如，香港沙中線（沙田至中環）的地下工程導致土瓜灣地鐵站附近的23棟建築物過度下沉。在某些例子中，後果可能是災難性的。例如，最近佛羅里達州的建築物倒塌造成97人死亡。日益增多的悲劇給我們敲響了警鐘，要求社會提高應對地面沉降的能力，以促進社會經濟環境的可持續發展。 本研究旨在開發具有多源大資料分析能力的創新型合成孔徑雷達（SAR）干涉測量（InSAR）遙感方法，以繪製三角洲大都市區區域和局部地面沉降圖，並推進土地動力學及其與影響地面沉降因素相互作用的基礎科學知識，以進行風險評估。與傳統工程方法相比，遙感具有多方面的明顯優勢，即：（一） 大範圍監測能力;（二）高空間密度測量點覆蓋;（三） 低成本，無需在實地安裝任何工具。人工智慧（AI）技術，特別是深度學習，提供了一種智慧的大資料分析工具，可以識別地面沉降的時空模式。成果包括：（一） 一種尖端的毫米級InSAR形變監測方法，包括基於深度學習的可以穩健估計並去除大氣的模組;（二）一種創新、智慧的基於多源大資料分析的地面沉降時空模式識別方法;（三）一個基於專家知識和地理資訊系統（GIS）分析的先進的多層次、多階段風險評估系統;（四） 在國際期刊和會議上發表論文和報告。該項目成果將同樣可以應用於世界其它沉降易發地區，特別是位於三角洲的大都市地區，以支援這些區域的可持續發展。該專案的科學成果也將對海平面變化，地下水迴圈，地質演化，地球動力學的學術研究產生影響，其對地面沉降動力學機制的進一步理解也將是至關重要的。

14223422.label: Realisation of objectives
14223422.value: The main objectives of this research project have been successfully achieved. The following section will delineate how each specific goal was accomplished by providing a detailed overview of the corresponding research outputs. Task A1: Physical modeling in laboratorial and real scenarios This sub-task was completed using the Radar Scattering Measurement System (RSMS) at CUHK. Laboratory experiments generated multi-band (X, C, L) data with multiple polarizations and incidence angles. Movable planar, dihedral, and trihedral corner reflectors (CRs) were fabricated to simulate different scattering mechanisms. By comparing pre-set and measured displacements, we quantified the effects of target characteristics and operating conditions on InSAR, achieving a precise characterization of microwave scattering. Cases of land subsidence from soil consolidation, groundwater extraction, and excavation were studied, with GPS data collected for in-situ validation. The integrated lab and field analysis significantly advanced the understanding of microwave sensing mechanisms. Task A2: Robust deformation monitoring for PS and DS This subtask focused on robust deformation monitoring for PS and DS targets. A bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) model was developed to adaptively correct atmospheric delays by decomposing InSAR time-series into trend and seasonal components. This was complemented by the creation of robust M-estimators and ridge estimators for deformation gradient estimation and network adjustment, significantly mitigating atmospheric errors. Furthermore, the traditional PSInSAR methodology was enhanced through advanced distributed scatterer interferometry, enabling the joint detection of high- and low-coherence targets via a dual-layer network, which increased measurement point density by 3 to 6 times. Ultimately, the research successfully generated highly reliable deformation velocity maps and time series, forming a critical data foundation for subsequent multi-source big data analysis. These achievements are directly reflected in the publications listed in Section C (Articles 4, 11, 14). Task B1: Multi-source data unification This subtask (B1) focuses on multi-source data unification, aiming to establish a comprehensive data foundation for the intelligent identification of land subsidence. The research systematically collected heterogeneous, multi-disciplinary data from various sources, including InSAR and optical remote sensing imagery, Quaternary sediment thickness, groundwater levels, land reclamation data, atmospheric water vapor, digital elevation models (DEM), as well as soil moisture and land use data. To address the disparities in these datasets regarding format, scale, temporal phase, and dimensionality, the research prioritized the development of methods for matching, coupling, and complementary conversion of multi-source data. A systematic technical framework for data unification was constructed. Leveraging big data analytics, efficient integration of data with diverse spatiotemporal, spectral, and angular characteristics was achieved. This effort resulted in a standardized, multi-dimensional dataset amenable to collaborative analysis, thereby providing essential support for subsequent mining of subsidence patterns. These achievements are directly reflected in the publications listed in Section C (Articles 2, 3). Task B2: Spatial pattern recognition In the subtask (B2), spatial pattern recognition of land subsidence was investigated using a multi-channel Oriented Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Oriented R-CNN). First, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) was applied to the InSAR-derived deformation field obtained from Task A2 for frequency-domain analysis, effectively separating regional and local subsidence signals. Band-pass filtering was then used to extract intermediate-frequency components as input features for local subsidence characterization. Given the widespread, morphologically diverse, and directionally variable nature of local subsidence, an Oriented Region Proposal Network (Oriented RPN) was employed to generate rotated bounding boxes. These were parameterized via a six-parameter representation (center coordinates, width, height, and bidirectional offsets) to accurately capture the spatial contours of subsidence bowls. The network was designed with a multi-channel input architecture capable of simultaneously processing InSAR deformation maps and 11 types of multi-source auxiliary data integrated in Task B1—including geological, land use, topographic, and climatic datasets. Multi-scale features were extracted using a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN), and rotation-invariant feature representation was achieved through a Rotated Region of Interest Alignment (Rotated RoIAlign) module, significantly improving recognition accuracy of local subsidence areas in complex environments. The proposed method achieved an Average Precision (AP) of 84.7% for detection and a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 79.8% for classification on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area dataset, successfully enabling automated discrimination of seven categories of subsidence causes. The resulting high-resolution spatial subsidence products provide reliable input for subsequent time-series analysis and multi-level risk assessment. These achievements are directly reflected in the publications listed in Section C (Articles 5,10). Task B3: Temporal pattern analysis Subtask B3 employed a SAR-Transformer network to analyze InSAR time-series deformation by decomposing signals into physically interpretable components. The model incorporated a dual-branch architecture—equipped with timestamp encoding to handle irregular SAR acquisitions—to separate long-term trends and seasonal variations automatically. Through its trend branch (ReLU-activated) and seasonal branch (Tanh-activated), the network derived three key indicators: velocity, acceleration, and thermal amplitude, capturing nonlinear patterns such as accelerating or decelerating settlement with acceleration values up to ±15.9 mm/year². By leveraging a multi-head attention mechanism, the model identified deformation phases linked to diverse factors—including concrete shrinkage and reclamation consolidation—without manual parameter tuning. It integrated multi-temporal ancillary data from Task B1 and was trained on 120,000 synthetic samples simulating real-world physical behaviors. Compared to conventional curve-fitting and STL methods, the SAR-Transformer reduced reconstruction mean absolute error by 58.32% and mean absolute percentage error by 8.84%, providing high-precision temporal dynamic indicators essential for risk assessment in Task C2. These achievements are directly reflected in the publications listed in Section C (Articles 6, 8). Task C1: Comparison, validation and analysis Subtask C1 focused on validating InSAR-derived deformation results and analyzing their driving mechanisms. By integrating field measurement data (e.g., leveling data from the reclaimed area of Hong Kong International Airport, GPS data from western Shenzhen) with auxiliary materials such as historical Google Earth imagery and media reports, the reliability of spatiotemporal deformation patterns obtained in Tasks A and B was systematically verified, along with an analysis of uncertainties in the validation process. Furthermore, the study investigated interactions between surface-sediment consolidation, groundwater level changes, underground construction, artificial loading, and ground subsidence, clarifying the significance levels of various triggering factors and their underlying mechanisms. These findings deepen the scientific understanding of coupled effects between human activities and natural processes, provide critical insights for optimizing deformation monitoring and identification methods, and support multi-level risk assessment in Task C2. These achievements are directly reflected in the publications listed in Section C (Articles 1, 9, 11). Task C2: Multi-level and multi-phase risk assessment This study adapts the landslide risk assessment framework for ground subsidence, using multi-temporal InSAR to build a subsidence sample library and enhance identification of slow deformation. A meta-learning approach extracts common subsidence features for rapid adaptation in urban environments. A GIS-based system employs SHAP analysis to identify key triggers like groundwater extraction and generates color-coded risk maps. Regular high-resolution SAR updates enable multi-scale assessment, from regional trends to individual structures. This integrated framework provides updatable, multi-level decision support for delta cities, with demonstrated methodological superiority as reflected in Section C (Articles 1, 9).

14223422.label: Major findings and research outcome
14223422.value: This project has successfully developed an integrated InSAR monitoring and intelligent interpretation technology system for urban surface deformation. The research achieved breakthroughs in three key technical areas: 1) Through controlled laboratory experiments and field validation (Subtask A1), the microwave scattering mechanisms of typical ground objects were precisely characterized. For complex delta environments, a highly robust InSAR deformation monitoring technology was developed, utilizing a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) model for adaptive atmospheric delay correction and an enhanced joint detection method for PS and DS targets, which increased measurement point density by 3-6 times and significantly improved the reliability of InSAR measurements (Subtask A2). 2) Deep learning models were innovatively applied for spatiotemporal pattern recognition, including proposing an Oriented R-CNN for the automatic identification and cause-based classification of settlement basins (Subtask B2), and constructing a SAR-Transformer network to accurately extract physical patterns from deformation time series, outperforming traditional methods (Subtask B3). 3) Rigorous validation and mechanistic analysis were conducted using multi-source in-situ measurement data (Subtask C1), leading to the development of a multi-level landslide risk assessment system (Subtask C2). This system improved assessment accuracy by 3%-10% compared to conventional methods, providing precise and updatable decision support for landslide risk management in delta metropolises like Hong Kong. The core research findings have been published in 15 journal papers (see Part C) and contributed to the training of one PhD student. The impact of these research outputs has gained significant recognition within the industry, exemplified by awards such as the First Place Award of the Student Honors Paper Competition from the American Association of Geographers Remote Sensing Specialty Group (2023) and the Grand Prize in the China Geographic Information Industry Association's "2023 Science and Technology Progress Award in Geo-information" secured with RGC funding support. These accolades fully acknowledge the project's breakthroughs in elucidating microwave sensing mechanisms of typical targets, achieving robust InSAR deformation estimation in complex environments, and developing deep learning-based spatiotemporal evolution pattern recognition, thereby providing crucial scientific and technical support for the prevention and control of urban geological hazards.

14223422.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14223422.value: Building upon the InSAR and intelligent interpretation technology system developed in this project, future efforts will focus on expanding its application to landslide disaster prevention. The specific development path includes: extending the monitoring scope from delta cities to global landslide-prone areas, integrating multi-source data such as meteorological and geological survey data to improve landslide risk identification accuracy; further optimizing deep learning algorithms to enhance the predictive capability for spatiotemporal evolution patterns of slow-moving landslides under complex terrain and extreme rainfall conditions; and constructing a transferable dynamic landslide risk assessment platform to achieve multi-level prevention and control—from regional trend analysis to individual landslide early warning. Through continuous improvement of the technology chain and cross-regional application validation, this initiative will provide more precise and efficient decision-making support for global landslide disaster prevention and mitigation.

14223422.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14223422.value: This project addresses a critical issue facing coastal cities like Hong Kong: land subsidence, or the gradual sinking of the ground. This sinking, caused by factors like construction and groundwater extraction, can damage buildings and infrastructure, posing a serious risk to public safety. To tackle this, our research has created a sophisticated monitoring and early-warning system. Using satellite radar technology (InSAR), we can now detect tiny, millimeter-scale ground movements over vast urban areas. We combined this with artificial intelligence (AI) to intelligently analyze the data, identifying not just where the ground is sinking, but also patterns that help predict future risks. A major achievement was significantly improving the accuracy and reliability of these measurements, even in challenging urban environments. The outcome is a practical, multi-level risk assessment system. It helps authorities understand settlement risks from a city-wide scale down to individual buildings, enabling proactive prevention and ensuring safer urban development. The project's success is demonstrated by 15 scientific publications, the training of a PhD student, and prestigious awards from international and national geographic information associations, confirming its significant contribution to making our cities more resilient and secure.

14223622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14223622.value: 等離子體與雙金屬催化劑用於轉化二氧化碳和水製取化學品與燃料

14223622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14223622.value: Global society relies on fossil carbon sources for chemicals and transport fuels. Due to the increasing global concerns for climate change due to CO2 emissions and heightened need for achieving carbon neutrality and sustainable development, CO2 conversion to sustainable chemicals and fuels using renewable energy has become an important strategy for carbon neutrality. However, CO2 conversion still faces three major challenges. First, CO2 conversion requires high temperatures under high pressures and thus capital and energy-intensive and costly. Second, CO2 hydrogenation requires pressurized H2 which is expensive because of separate unit and energy-intensive processes for H2 production. Third, conversion of CO2 requires highly active and selective catalysts, but conventional catalysts developed for CO hydrogenation are not effective for selective CO2 conversion to chemicals and fuels. With an ultimate goal of developing sustainable supply of chemicals and fuels, we propose to develop novel nonthermal plasma-catalytic process with effective catalyst for direct conversion of CO2 and H2O to methanol and ethanol. The proposed work explores unique solutions to the above 3 major problems with low-temperature plasma-enhanced direct catalytic conversion of CO2 and H2O to value-added chemicals and fuels such as ethanol. The specific objectives are to (1) develop dielectric barrier discharge plasma-catalytic processing to improve the energy efficiency for CO2 conversion at low temperatures under atmospheric pressure; (2) use H2O directly to provide hydrogen in situ for catalytic CO2 hydrogenation thus eliminating the need for separate processes and operating units for H2 production; (3) identify effective bimetallic catalysts for non-thermal plasma activation of both H2O and CO2 and their conversion with high selectivity to methanol and ethanol at low temperatures (120-180 oC) under atmospheric pressure. Using nonthermal plasma can activate both CO2 and H2O at low temperatures, but little has been reported on the effective catalysts that facilitate the CO2 and H2O conversion to desired products such as alcohols under plasma catalytic conditions. Several bimetallic catalyst formulations that show promise for activation of CO2 and H2O will be screened first, and selected promising catalyst formulation will be further tailor-designed and examined as hollow nanostructured catalysts for plasma-catalytic conversion of CO2 and H2O to chemicals and fuels. Both postgraduate and undergraduate students will be trained in this project. Outcome includes publications in leading journals, presentations at professional conferences and public lectures. The proposed work is an innovative research and anticipated to have major impacts on the advance of the field. 全球社會依賴化石碳基能源生產化學品和運輸燃料。由於二氧化碳溫室效應和大氣中二氧化碳排放量大幅增加，全球對氣溫升高等氣候變化的擔憂日益增加。為實現碳中和及可持續發展，利用可再生能源將二氧化碳轉化為化學品和燃料已成為碳中和的一個重要戰略途徑。然而，二氧化碳轉化仍面臨三大挑戰。首先，二氧化碳 轉化需要在高溫高壓下的反應，因此能源消耗和設備投資成本高。其次，二氧化碳 加氫需要高壓氫氣，由於用於氫氣 生產的能源消費和分離提純的設備費用，使得工藝成本昂貴。第三，二氧化碳 的轉化需要高活性和選擇性的催化劑，但為一氧化碳 加氫開發的傳統催化劑對於將二氧化碳 轉化為化學品和燃料的選擇性或活性很低。因此，以建立化學品和燃料的可持續供應鏈為最終目標，我們提議開發有效催化劑與非熱等離子體複合的新型催化工藝，用以將 二氧化碳 和 水 直接轉化為甲醇和乙醇。擬議的工作將探索上述 3 個主要問題的獨特解決方案，即低溫等離子體和催化劑複合直接做低溫催化轉化二氧化碳和水為高附加值化學品和燃料（如乙醇）。具體目標是 (1) 開發包括有效催化劑的介質阻擋放電等離子體催化工藝，在常壓及低溫轉化二氧化碳以提高能量效率； (2) 直接使用水原位提供氫氣用於催化二氧化碳加氫，無需用氫氣及單獨的氫氣生產單元和分離工藝操作，從而大幅降低二氧化碳轉化過程成本； (3) 探明有效的雙金屬催化劑，用於水和二氧化碳的非熱等離子體活化及其在常壓低溫條件下以高選擇性轉化為甲醇和乙醇。使用等離子體可以在低溫下激活二氧化碳或者水，但很少有關於在非熱等離子體催化條件下促進二氧化碳和水轉化為高附加值產物（如乙醇）的有效催化劑的探討。本研究將首先篩選幾種有望活化二氧化碳和水的雙金屬催化劑，然後選擇有前景的催化劑組成將進一步探討用於將二氧化碳和水的等離子催化轉化為化學品和燃料的納米結構催化劑。研究生和本科生都將在該項目中接受培訓。成果包括在主要研究期刊上發表文章，在專業學術會議上發表演講和公開宣講。擬議的工作是一項創新研究，預計將對該領域的發展產生重要影響。

14300022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14300022.value: 綜合光動力、反义寡核苷酸和化學療法的多合一寡核苷酸藥物開發

14300022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14300022.value: 聯合療法通常利用多種不同機制的治療方式來實現疊加或協同治療效應，這是當前癌症治療的基礎。同時，這種治療方式具有抑制耐藥性發展的潛力。化學療法和放射性療法一般會聯合使用作為輔助治療方法。然而，嚴重的副作用和耐藥性通常會降低治療效果，非靶向治療也會損傷周圍正常細胞和組織。研究人員一直在為聯合治療這一領域作出貢獻。儘管可以實現增強的癌症治療效果，但通常程序比較繁瑣，所以需要開發更先進的治療技術和方法。為了解決這問題，我們提出聯合光動力療法、反義療法和化學療法的基於寡核苷酸一體化治療劑。該寡核苷酸系統包括三部分，即（1）作為光敏劑裝載載體的G-四鏈體，（2）用於反義處理的具有硫代磷酸酯骨架的序列和（3）用於攜帶嵌入藥物的反義互補鏈，並可以被內源性有義鏈取代。這種載體可以通過分子間相互作用將光敏劑和化學藥物輸送到病變細胞進行治療。與現有療法相比，這項工作具有幾個先進的特點。 (1)利用固相寡核苷酸合成的優勢，可以很容易地合成核酸鏈，並且可以通過共價鍵連接或與氫鍵進行雜交。 (II)通過選擇合適的寡核苷酸序列，它們可以作為藥物載體、靶向片段和治療藥物。 （三）治療劑主要以寡核苷酸為主，生物相容性高，治療作用後易於排出體外。 (IV)選擇鋅酞菁(ZnPc)作為與G-四鏈體絡合的光敏劑。 ZnPc 在產生單線態氧時具有高量子產率（DMF 中ΦΔ = 0.56）。此外，它在紅色可見光區有很強的吸收，可增強對內部組織透光能力。在本項目中，我們將研究該系統的光譜學研究、負載效率和單態氧產生效率，進而研究其腫瘤靶向性和治療效率。該多功能系統有望成為一種有前景的高效靶向抗腫瘤治療藥物，並且有潛力應用於協同其他治療方法的抗腫瘤聯合治療。

14300122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14300122.value: 廣義Springer纖維的一些基本問題

14300122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14300122.value: Representation theory is a branch of modern mathematics that studies abstract algebraic structures by representing them as linear algebraic data. A new and important direction is the (generalized) affine Springer fibers, introduced by Kottwitz and Viehmann and by Lusztig. Roughly speaking, a generalized affine Springer fiber describes the intersection of a linear structure (the Iwahori double cosets) and a highly nonlinear structure (a regular semisimple conjugacy classes) inside a loop group. The geometric structure of generalized affine Springer fibers encodes the information of orbital integrals of Iwahori-Hecke algebra, which plays a role in the representation theory of loop groups. Recent work of the PI and many other experts shows that the generalized affine Springer fibers have a lot of similarity with another important objects in arithemetic geometry, the affine Deligne-Lusztig varieties. In this proposal, the PI makes a conjecture on the connection between the generalized affine Springer fibers and the affine Deligne-Lusztig varieties. The PI plans to establish such a conjecture and answer several fundamental questions on the generalized affine Springer fibers: the nonemptiness patterns, the dimension formula and the description of the irreducible components. The research combines the methods and results from arithmetic geometry, combinatorial, and representation theory and will advance our knowledge of these fields' connections. 表示論是現代數學的一個分支，它通過將抽象代數結構表示為線性代數數據來研究它們。一個新的重要方向是由 Kottwitz 和 Viehmann 以及 Lusztig 引入的（廣義的）仿射 Springer 纖維。粗略地說，廣義仿射 Springer 纖維描述了一個環群裡的線性結構（Iwahori 雙陪集）和高度非線性結構（正則半單共軛類）的交集。廣義仿射 Springer 纖維的幾何結構編碼了 Iwahori-Hecke 代數的軌道積分信息，在環群的表示理論中發揮了作用。 PI 和許多其他專家最近的工作表明，廣義仿射 Springer 纖維與算術幾何中的另一個重要對象，仿射 Deligne-Lusztig 簇有很多相似之處。在這個研究課題中，PI 對廣義仿射 Springer 纖維和仿射 Deligne-Lusztig 簇之間的聯繫進行了猜想。 PI 計劃證明這個猜想並回答關於廣義仿射 Springer 纖維的幾個基本問題：非空模式、維數公式和不可約分支的描述。該研究結合了算術幾何、組合和表示理論的方法和結果，並將增進我們對這些領域聯繫的認識。

14300422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14300422.value: Every year, there are on average 100 volcanic eruptions with about a dozen volcanoes erupting at any given time. Volcanic eruption hazards are very diverse. In the near field (tens of kilometres), pyroclastic flow and lahar can destroy whatever lies in their path. At the regional scale (thousands of kilometres), eruption ash plumes can cause significant disruption to air travel. Large volcanic eruptions can even cause global cooling and have been linked to several mass extinction events in Earth’s history. Fortunately, the largest eruptions are often preceded by detectable changes in seismic, deformation, and geochemical signals related to magma movement that can help us anticipate their occurrence. However, these volcanic unrest signals are not always immediate precursors of an eruption, and many eruptions have occurred without recognized precursory unrest. Earthquakes with predominantly low-frequency energy (1-5 Hz) have been observed deep (10-60 km depth) beneath various volcanoes. These events, usually referred to as deep long-period earthquakes (DLPs), are generally inferred to be related to magma and fluid movements at depth. In some cases, they also manifest as an early eruption precursor. For example, a large number of DLPs was detected preceding the 1991 Mount Pinatubo eruption in the Philippines, hours before other precursory signals near the surface were recognized. However, DLPs remain relatively understudied compared to regular earthquakes mainly because they are difficult to detect using traditional seismic data processing methods. For this project, we propose to first compile a high-quality, global dataset of DLP seismic waveform. Using this dataset, we will then train a machine-learning-based model to automatically detect DLPs. Finally, we will apply this model to characterize the evolution of DLP activity at a number of volcanoes, and investigate their relationship with shallow volcanic activity as well as magmatic structures and processes at depth. Our compiled DLP waveforms will be a valuable benchmark dataset for other researchers interested in developing new methods to detect and characterize DLPs. Our machine-learning model will open the door to more complete and systematic characterisation of DLPs at volcanoes globally. The results from investigating DLP activity at various volcanoes will improve our understanding of the physical processes related to DLPs as well as their utility for eruption forecasting. 全球每年大約會有100 次火山噴發。火山爆發的危害是多樣話的。在數十公里內，火山碎屑流和泥流可摧毀其路徑上的任何東西。 在數千公里的距離，火山羽流可對航空旅行造成重大干擾。大型火山爆發甚至會導致全球冷卻並與地球史上幾次大規模滅絕事件有關。 幸運的是，大型火山噴發之前經常可檢測到與岩漿運動有關的地震活動，地殼變形和地球化學變化等信號，可以幫助我們預測火山即將噴發。然而，這些火山動亂信號並非每次都是噴發的前兆，許多噴發也會在沒有識別到前兆的情況下發生。在許多火山地下深處（10-60 公里深）會觀察到以低頻能量（1-5 赫茲）為主的地震。這些深低頻地震通常被認為與岩漿和流體運動有關，也是一些火山噴發的前兆。例如，在 1991 年菲律賓皮納圖博火山噴發之前就檢測到了大量深低頻地震。然而，與普通地震相比，我們對深低頻地震的了解仍然相對不足，主要因為它們很難被傳統的地震數據處理方法探測到。在這個項目中，我們將湊合一個高質量的深低頻地震數據集，並利用這個數據集來訓練一個能自動檢測深低頻地震的機器學習模型。這將提高我們研究全球深低頻地震物理機制的能力。

14300722.label: Project Objectives
14300722.value: To develop a reliable methodology for measuring the self-field critical current density of thin superconductors under pressure down to ~100 mK To use pressure to tune these superconductors and to use the pressure evolution of the self-field critical current density to detect a quantum phase transition hidden beneath the superconducting dome To extract the superfluid density from the self-field critical current density in the limiting case that the sample is thinner than the penetration depth; to use the temperature dependence of the superfluid density to infer the superconducting gap symmetry and to probe the pressure evolution of the superconducting gap, thereby helping us understand the nature of the superconducting phase.
