14307422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307422.value: This project aims to explore the unified picture of heterogeneous and homogeneous nucleation with rate process, in a colloidal system whose nucleation mode can be continuously tuned from heterogeneous to homogeneous nucleation. Crystallization is a ubiquitous phenomenon which plays a crucial role in many fundamental and applied research fields, such as epitaxial growth, photonic crystals, and pharmacy. The formation of crystallites is triggered by the thermal fluctuations in the metastable liquid phase accompanied by the rearrangement of particles, through which the local translational and rotational orders extend to long-range. The classical nucleation theory (CNT) assumes that nuclei directly emerge as a one-step process, under the competition between interfacial energy and chemical potential difference. However, huge discrepancies between theory and experiment for the growth of crystals are observed and the kinetic details for symmetry transformation remains far from being well understood. In particular, the heterogeneous and homogeneous nucleation are typically treated as two distinct crystallization modes and a unified picture is lacking. In recent decades, the phase behaviors of colloidal systems have drawn lots of attention since the time and spatial scales of colloids are proper for single-particle level observation during phase transition. We, therefore, prepare a monodisperse colloidal suspension as the model system to systematically investigate the transition kinetics in heterogeneous and homogeneous crystallization. By theoretically defining and experimentally measuring the transition rates, i.e., the transition probabilities among all intermediate structures, described under the framework of kinetic reaction theory, we intend to construct a unified picture of heterogeneous and homogeneous nucleation in the aspect of kinetics. The applicant's group has an extensive and strong background in studying phase behaviors of colloidal systems. We have studied the glass transition and homogeneous nucleation of colloidal systems and illustrated their dynamics of structural reorganization (PRL 2012, Nature Physics 2014). Based on our excellent track record, we propose this three-year project with a total budget around US$200,000, to further study this important issue of a unified picture of two nucleation modes. Our study should bring new knowledge to the physics of crystallization and provide technical guidance to precisely control the nucleation and the growth of crystals. 本項目旨在使用一種特殊的膠體系統，其成核模式可以從異質成核連續調整到均質成核，并通過速率常數來探索異質和均質成核的統一物理圖像。 結晶是一種普遍存在的現象，在許多基礎和應用研究領域中發揮著至關重要的作用，例如外延生長、光子晶體和藥學。微晶的形成是由亞穩態液相中的熱波動伴隨粒子的重排觸發的，通過這些重排，局部平移和旋轉對稱序延伸到長程。經典成核理論 (CNT) 假設在界面能和化學勢差之間的競爭下，臨界尺寸的原子核通過熱擾動直接出現。然而，觀察到的晶體生長實驗和理論之間存在巨大差異，並且對稱性變換的動力學細節仍未得到很好的闡明。尤為值得一提的是，異質和均質成核通常被視為兩種不同的結晶模式并缺乏統一的物理圖像。 最近幾十年來，由於膠體的時間和空間尺度適合相變過程中的單粒子水平觀察，膠體系統的相行為引起了很多關注。因此，我們製備了一種單分散膠體懸浮液作為模型系統，系統地研究異質和均質結晶的轉變動力學。通過在動力學轉變速率的單顆粒尺度測量，我們計劃在動力學方面構建異質和均質成核的統一圖景。 申請人的團隊在研究膠體系統的相行為方面具有良好背景。我們研究了膠體系統的玻璃化轉變和均質成核，並說明了它們的結構重組動力學（PRL 2012，Nature Physics 2014）。基於我們過去的研究背景，我們提出了這個總預算為 HKD870,000，為期三年的項目，來進一步研究兩種成核模式的統一物理圖像。我們的研究將為結晶物理學帶來新的發現，並為精確控制晶體的成核和生長提供有益的技術指導。

14307622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307622.value: 基於調和波貝爾特拉米特徵的幾何先驗圖像模型

14307622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307622.value: 圖像處理在各種應用中起著至關重要的作用，例如醫學圖像，安全系統，計算機圖形學等。當對物體形狀（稱為“形狀先驗”）有一定了解時，將此信息運用到圖像模型中將有助於獲得更準確和可靠的結果。然而，找到一種有效的、易於集成到圖像模型的形狀先驗表示是一個巨大的挑戰。在該提案中，我們的目標是開發圖像模型，使其在不同任務中可以使用通用的形狀先驗。更具體地說，我們將探索將新開發的形狀先驗表示（稱為調和波貝爾特拉米特徵（HBS））集成到擬共形（QC）圖像模型中的可能性。調和波貝爾特拉米特徵是根據QC理論定義的，因此它可以自然地融入QC理論中，以開發各種結合形狀先驗的模型。本提案將探討三個主要目標。首先，我們有興趣使用HBS開發結合形狀先驗的QC圖像模型。這將涉及兩項主要的任務。其一是開發同時進行圖像配準和圖像分割的形狀先驗模型。圖像配準和圖像分割是相輔相成的，利用對物體形狀的先驗知識同時解決這兩個問題，被認為是更準確、更穩健的方案。另一個任務是開發具有形狀先驗的圖像恢復模型。對於模糊的、扭曲的、有噪聲的圖像，我們提出了結合了帶有形狀先驗的QC分割與圖像質量提高的模型，它將很有可能可以很好地完成這項任務。該提案的第二個目標是將HBS擴展到更一般形狀。儘管HBS是一個很好的圖形特徵，但它主要是為單連通圖形設計的。因此我們希望改進HBS，來表示更常見的多連通圖形。這將大大提高HBS的通用性，以表示更一般的圖像的形狀先驗，並最終運用到更通用的圖像模型中。我們在本提案中的最後一個目標是開發高效的算法，用於計算我們提出的結合形狀先驗的圖像模型，並將這些模型運用在具體的任務中。為此，我們將考慮應用深度學習技術來訓練卷積神經網絡（CNN），以有效地獲得結果。

14307722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307722.value: 中國食品消費和生產的未來趨勢通過氮梯級流動對中國區域空氣質素的影響

14307722.label: Project Objectives
14307722.value: To develop an integrated regional air quality modeling system that can simulate responses of Chinese air pollution to crop-specific and livestock-specific changes in food production and agricultural land use To conduct a comprehensive analysis on how different future scenarios of Chinese food consumption patterns and dietary choices will drive food production and agricultural emissions from now to 2050, under various socioeconomic and technological assumptions To conduct model experiments to quantify how different future pathways of Chinese food consumption and production will affect air pollution in China, and identify the more sustainable pathways that can enhance both food security and environmental health
rows: To develop an integrated regional air quality modeling system that can simulate responses of Chinese air pollution to crop-specific and livestock-specific changes in food production and agricultural land use

To conduct a comprehensive analysis on how different future scenarios of Chinese food consumption patterns and dietary choices will drive food production and agricultural emissions from now to 2050, under various socioeconomic and technological assumptions

To conduct model experiments to quantify how different future pathways of Chinese food consumption and production will affect air pollution in China, and identify the more sustainable pathways that can enhance both food security and environmental health

14307722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307722.value: The proposed research aims to assess how future trends in Chinese food consumption and production, with a focus on dietary changes, will influence air quality and health in China. Agriculture is one of the major sources of reactive nitrogen compounds to the atmosphere. These compounds include ammonia and nitrogen oxides, which are released to the atmosphere mostly from chemical fertilizer and animal wastes in livestock raising, leading to a cascade of environmental problems. Over the past few decades in China, the rapid rise in food production has substantially increased reactive nitrogen emissions, driven mostly by population growth and a widespread dietary shift toward heavier meat and dairy consumption, contributing to air pollution with severe implications for human health. The future paths of Chinese food consumption patterns and dietary choices will continue to shape air quality and health in China, and the overall effects will be further complicated by simultaneous changes in population, land use, farming practices and climate. We therefore propose to use a state-of-the-art air quality modeling system to examine how future trends in Chinese food consumption and production will affect air quality and health. New model capacities to represent food-specific changes in agricultural emissions and land use will be developed. We will then examine how food consumption and production patterns will evolve from now to year 2050 under three distinct scenarios that cover a comprehensive range of possible socioeconomic paths with different assumptions of income growth, cropland extent, agricultural technology, and climatic conditions. For each scenario, we will perform model experiments to quantify the subsequent impacts on reactive nitrogen emissions, fine particulate matter and ozone air quality, and public health. We will also test whether such impacts will be further modified by changes in other factors such as climate and anthropogenic emissions from non-agricultural sectors. We will further assess how much a population-wide adoption of healthier, less meat-intensive diets can curb air pollution and save healthcare costs, and what equivalent agricultural technological progress has to be made to offset the excess air pollution from the current trend of rising meat and dairy consumption. The anticipated findings are vital for promoting better policy making and public awareness concerning air quality and food-related health issues, and help advance more sustainable food systems and consumer preference that are beneficial for both people’s health and the environment. 本研究項目旨在評估中國食品消費和生產的未來趨勢，尤其是飲食習慣的變化，將如何影響中國的空氣質素和人類健康。農業是大氣中包括氨和氮氧化物等活性氮化合物的主要來源之一，主要從化肥和畜牧業中的動物糞便釋放到大氣中，導致一連串的環境問題。在過去的幾十年裡，由於人口增長和人們食用更多的肉類和奶製品，中國食品產量快速增長，大大增加了活性氮的排放，導致更嚴重的空氣污染，對人類健康構成威脅。中國食品消費模式和飲食選擇的未來路徑將繼續影響中國的空氣質素和人類健康，而人口、土地利用、耕作方式和氣候的同步變化將使整體影響進一步複雜化。因此，我們將使用最先進的空氣質素模擬系統來研究中國食品消費和生產的未來趨勢將如何影響空氣質素和人類健康。將開發新的模型功能來代表不同糧食的農業排放和土地利用的變化。然後，我們將研究在三種不同的情景下，從現在到 2050 年，食品消費和生產模式將如何演變，這些情景涵蓋了一系列可能的社會經濟路徑，對收入增長、農田範圍、農業技術和氣候條件進行了不同的假設。對於每種情景，我們將進行模型實驗，以量化對活性氮排放、細顆粒物和臭氧空氣質量以及公共衛生的影響，並將測試這些影響是否會因氣候和非農業部門的人為排放等其他因素的變化而進一步改變。我們將進一步評估全民採用更健康、肉類較少的飲食可以多大程度抑制空氣污染並節省醫療成本，以及必須採取哪些等效的農業技術進步來抵消當前肉類和奶製品的消費上升趨勢造成的過量空氣污染。預期的研究結果將促進更好的政策制定，幫助公眾對空氣質量和食品相關健康問題認識更多，並有助於推動更可持續的食品系統和消費者偏好，對人類健康和環境均有好處。

14307822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307822.value: 粘彈性流體中的細菌近界面運動行為之實驗研究

14307822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307822.value: In this project we propose to carry out a biophysical study on the near-surface swimming behavior of flagellar bacteria in viscoelastic polymeric fluids, using a combination of multiscale microscopy and single-cell tracking techniques. Many bacteria live in natural and clinical environments with abundant macromolecular polymers. Flagellar motility in these polymeric fluids is essential to diverse microbial processes, such as bacterial dispersal and colonization. Polymeric fluids commonly display viscoelasticity and non-Newtonian rheological behavior; these fluid properties have been shown to profoundly affect bacterial swimming. More recent work primarily studied bacterial swimming behavior in the bulk of polymeric fluids. However, geometrical confinement or solid surfaces are prevalent in the living environment of bacteria, and it is unclear how bacteria swim near solid surfaces in polymeric fluids. In this project we propose to study near-surface swimming behavior of flagellated bacteria in viscoelastic polymeric fluids both at single-cell and population levels. The research plan stems from our recent finding that bacteria display several unusual behavioral patterns near surfaces immersed in polymeric fluids. Here we plan to further investigate the consequence of these novel behavioral patterns on bacterial dispersal near surfaces and biofilm formation, and to study how flagellated bacteria respond to shear flows of viscoelastic polymeric fluids during near-surface motion. The project lies at the interface of biology and physics. As motility is a crucial component of bacterial life, our study will deepen the understanding of bacterial transport and surface colonization in macromolecular environments. On the other hand, the obtained results will offer novel experimental phenomena to enrich the knowledge of low-Reynolds number hydrodynamics of microorganisms, and may shed light on the locomotion of artificial helical microswimmers in polymer-rich physiological environments pertinent to biomedical applications. 本項研究旨在結合多尺度顯微成像及單細胞追踪技術探索細菌在粘彈性高分子液體中的近界面運動行為。在自然界和臨床條件下，細菌通常生活在充滿高分子聚合物的環境裡。細菌在這類環境中的諸多運動過程，譬如群體擴散和定植，依賴於鞭毛和高分子液體的相互作用。高分子液體具有粘彈性和非牛頓流變行為，這些流體性質對細菌的鞭毛運動具有深遠影響。近年來人們對細菌在高分子液體中運動行為的研究側重於體相。細菌常常受到固體界面的約束。然而，細菌在高分子液體中的近界面運動行為尚不清楚。我們在前期研究中發現細菌在高分子液體中的近界面運動呈現不尋常的模式。在本項目中，基於前期研究結果，我們計劃在單細胞尺度及群體尺度進一步研究這些新穎的運動模式對細菌擴散和微生物膜形成的影響，並研究鞭毛細菌在近表面運動過程中如何響應高分子液體的剪切流動。此項目涉及物理學和生物學的交叉領域。運動是細菌生命週期的重要過程，因此本項目的研究結果會加深我們對細菌輸運和表面定植的認識。同時，相關結果會對微納米自驅動機器在生物醫學應用環境下的運動行為帶來新的啟發。

14307922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14307922.value: 關於平穩性測試：效率、最優性、可解釋性和一般性

14307922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14307922.value: 平穩性檢驗對於時間序列分析很重要。它在許多領域都有應用，包括計量經濟學、工程、地球系統科學等。雖然現有多種平穩性檢驗方法，然而對於檢測幾乎不明顯的變化上，它們通常效率低下且次優。其中一些更需運用複雜的原理來定義檢驗方法，因此它們的結果難以量化，亦不能用外行術語作簡單解釋。該項目旨在為這個存在多時的問題提供新的見解，並提出六個階段的框架進行深入研究：（一）原理和方法，（二）效率和最優性理論，（三）比較，（四）解釋，（五）一般性，以及（六）實施和應用。 第一階段：原理與方法。我們引入了一種直觀的非平穩性度量。我們會按步引導出本項目提出之檢驗方法，以便定義出一個自然的統計量，並由不一致的方法調整為一致的方法，然後再調整為超高效和最優的方法。我們通過使用推測理論和初步的模擬實驗證明了我們框架的有用性。 第二階段：效率和最優性理論。我們概述了研究理論性質的途徑，並利用示例討論理論的結果，再將估計理論和測試理論聯繫起來。初步結果證明了我們的框架是可行的。 第三階段：比較。我們研究了非平穩性的可檢測結構，並考慮了一個具有挑戰性的平均結構。該結構在存在誤差的情況下幾乎不會被注意到。據我們的推測，本項目所提出的測試方法在檢測微小變化和不斷上下擺動的結構方面比一些常用的測試更強大。 第四階段：解釋。我們透過短期和長期的誤差變異性進行比較來解釋我們提出的平均變異性。它使我們能夠定義出兩個信噪比指標。由於指標已標準化，只可取值從0到1之間，因此使用者可以輕鬆解釋非平穩性的強度。此研究方向亦產生了一副產品，可用以測試相關平均穩定性。 第五階段：一般性。我們提出的框架中一個吸引人的特點是它可以靈活地擴展到其他問題。我們舉了兩個例子來說明這些想法。其中之一將平均平穩性檢驗推廣到更廣義的趨勢平穩性檢驗。它測試平均結構是否比某個特定結構更具可變性。另一個例子將一階平穩性檢驗擴展到二階平穩性檢驗。 第六階段：實施和應用。我們提出了有限樣本調整方法來處理小樣本量和強相關性的問題，並提出了所提出方法的一些應用。

14308322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14308322.value: 求解帶有振蕩的非線性Helmholtz方程的PML以及有限元方法的數學分析

14308322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14308322.value: 非線性Helmholtz方程是許多重要應用中非常有效的數學模型，例如，波在非均勻或非線性介質中的傳播。這些模型方程大多是在整個空間中定義的，伴隨著一些指定物理波離開非均勻或非線性介質時的衰減條件。 實際應用中最具挑戰性的任務是構建和分析用於求解非線性Helmholtz方程的穩定的數值解。對於非線性Helmholtz方程的數值方法的穩定性和收斂性，文獻中還找不到多少研究，更沒有嚴格的數學理論。從分析和應用的角度來看，這是一個有很大挑戰性的基礎數學研究課題，特別是在非線性Helmholtz方程的解高度振蕩的情況下，例如，當波穿過兩種不同物理介質的界面時。 對於這些非線性Helmholtz方程的數值求解，第一個關鍵步驟是將無限域中的原始非線性方程轉換為有限區域上的方程。完美匹配層技術已被證明是適合許多數學模型轉換的最有效的數學方法之一。本項目研究工作的一個主要目標是證明完美匹配層技術得出的近似解是穩定的，並且指數收斂到無限域中原始非線性Helmholtz方程的解。第二個關鍵任務是構建有效的數值方法來求解有限域中的完美匹配層技術得出的近似方程。這是另外一項極具挑戰性的數學課題，主因是方程高度非線性和振蕩，這也使得分析數值解的穩定性和收斂性變得極為困難。為此，我們將提出一些有效的有限元數值方法，以及分析有限元解的穩定性和收斂性的理論框架。

14308422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14308422.value: 強健二元性和最佳停止問題

14308422.label: Project Objectives
14308422.value: Develop duality framework for robust consumption-investment decisions subject to model ambiguity. This first objective does not include an optimal stopping feature. Develop duality framework for robust consumption-investment and stopping decisions subject to model ambiguity. Apply the results in Objective 1 to insurance and pension problems including robust pension scheme under model ambiguity. Apply results of Objective 2 to an insurance problem involving stopping time. A specific target is the robust retirement timing and planning subject to model ambiguity. Apply results of Objective 2 to an consumption problem with stopping feature. A specific target is the consumption ratcheting problem with investment.
rows: Develop duality framework for robust consumption-investment decisions subject to model ambiguity. This first objective does not include an optimal stopping feature.
Develop duality framework for robust consumption-investment and stopping decisions subject to model ambiguity.
Apply the results in Objective 1 to insurance and pension problems including robust pension scheme under model ambiguity.
Apply results of Objective 2 to an insurance problem involving stopping time. A specific target is the robust retirement timing and planning subject to model ambiguity.

14308422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14308422.value: The dual approach is a powerful tool for stochastic control problems in financial mathematics because of its advantages in handling various model environments, such as a general class of objective functions and constraints on controls. Recently, the importance of model ambiguity found in financial economic applications has stimulated various studies on the dual approach for robust decision making and the corresponding theory is often known as robust duality. This project aims to develop new framework for robust duality when the decision-making process involves an optimal stopping feature and encounters model ambiguity. In other words, the decision maker has to find the best decision time for his action and that action is irreversible when he is uncertain about the appropriate choice of probabilistic models. Therefore, his decision timing and actions are based on the worst-case scenario from all possible models. The new theory attempts to explain for the sparse decision rule in control and the robust stopping time in the dual space. In addition, new algorithms are then constructed to solve many related financial economic problems. 二元性方法能有效解決很多隨機優控問題，尤其金融數學方面的應用。它的優點在於其廣泛應用性，尤其是處理一般的目標函數和受限制的控制變量。近年有研究把二元性推廣至強健控制及應用於金融經濟學。這課題一般被稱為「強健二元性」。本項目旨在建立一個嶄新的強健二元性理論，針對在不確定建模的情況下，作出最優停止的決策。換句話說，當決策者不能確定哪一個隨機模型是正確時，應怎樣決定最好的決策時間及作出一個不可逆轉的行動呢？本項目考慮在最惡劣的情況下作出最優的選擇。我們會建立新的理論：利用二元空間，建構強健停止時間特徵及其決策理論。最終，把這些理論化為嶄新的演算法，用以解決對應的金融經濟學問題。

14308622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14308622.value: 雜多酸基電解液在低溫水系液流電池中應用的系統研究

14308622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14308622.value: 本項目旨在研究雜多酸基 (POM) 電解液的設計原理、探索其降解機制並研究其在低溫水系液流電池的應用前景。我們將系統地研究反荷陽離子和聚陰離子結構/組成對雜多酸基電解液的物理化學性質 和電化學性質的影響。我們將開發適用於低溫 (負20度C到負40度C) 的高體積容量、高功率密度的雜多酸基水系液流電池，並研究其降解機理。 水系液流電池 (ARFBs) 是一種安全的長時儲能技術，是實現間歇式可再生能源大規模利用的關鍵。然而，水系電解液在極寒天氣下，易發生電解液凍結、動力學減緩和溶解度下降等問題。這些問題限制了水系液流電池在極寒環境下的使用。目前發展最為成熟的全釩水系液流電池 (VRFBs) 的衰減隨使用溫度的降低而加劇。這是由於在零度以下時，負極側的二價/三價態的釩電解液會出現活性物質析出和動力學減緩。 在本項目中，我們期望通過開發雜多酸基電解液來解決上述問題並實現高功率低溫水系液流電池，原因如下：(i) 聚陰離子表面豐富的氧原子會破壞水分子之間的氫鍵，從而降低電解液凝固點；(ii) 由於雜多酸的共軛結構，雜多酸基的活性物質可以快速可逆的進行多個電子得失；(iii) 通過調節陽離子、雜原子、配原子和基本結構單元，可以改變雜多酸基電解質的溶解度。在此，我們會系統的研究Keggin型和Dawson型雜多酸並開發適用於低溫(負20度C到負40度C)的高體積容量、高功率密度的雜多酸基水系液流電池。我們將利用原位電化學質譜、電化學阻抗譜和其他光譜方法 (核磁共振光譜、紅外光譜、紫外光譜和拉曼光譜) 研究基於雜多酸基的低溫水系液流電池電解液的降解機理，包括電池運行過程中雜多酸分子的結構變化、電池電阻的改變和活性物質的穿梭。

14308922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14308922.value: π-擴展膦配體的合理設計：鈀-芳烴-行走和歸屬應用在高度空間受阻偶聯過程中的基礎研究

14308922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14308922.value: Palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling processes have proven their unique and magnificent roles as versatile protocols for assembling structurally diversified arene-containing molecules, which often constitute fundamental scaffolds in pharmaceuticals and materials. These convergent methods have revolutionized the traditions of performing complex organic synthesis from readily available electrophilic and nucleophilic components. At the center of these synthetic technologies, new catalyst types which enable challenging and/or problematic bond construction processes to be proceeded smoothly and efficiently should be tremendously valuable. Thus, fundamental catalyst exploration is particularly central to contemporary catalysis research for fulfilling the ever-growing needs of innovative organic synthesis. Any promising development of new bond-construction methodology for extremely steric hindered aromatic building blocks would remarkably advance the existing coupling strategies and put forward of catalysis sciences. The purposes of this project are (1) to rationally design a new family of highly tunable pi-wall-extended phosphine ligands that fit for transient proximal-pi-chelation framework, thus offer effective alleviation for steric bulkiness relief / steric hindered coupling reactions; (2) to carry out in-depth investigation towards the fundamental aspects, scopes and limitations of the underdeveloped palladium-catalyzed extremely steric congested cross-coupling reactions and other related arylation processes; (3) to extensively carry out relevant mechanistic investigation using both experimental and theoretical approaches, for acquiring more fundamental knowledge in this catalysis science. This project is aimed to explore new opportunities and potentials in cross-coupling reactions. The fundamental knowledge attained during the course of catalyst development and manipulation, and the rationale of proximal ligand coordination, i.e. Pd-arene-walking, would be of significant value for academic interest and potential industrial applications. The proposed study is based on our solid proof-of-concept initial results, together with our previous success in the ligand and catalyst design and synthesis, and also our extensive experiences in aromatic bond-construction research. These new areas are anticipated to provide us an excellent opportunity in making a substantial advancement to the frontier of catalysis research and put forward of establishing a favorable foundation for fine-chemical industry in Hong Kong and Greater Bay Area. 鈀催化的交叉偶聯過程已證明其作為組裝結構多樣化的含芳烴分子的通用方案具有獨特而重要的作用，這些分子通常構成藥物和材料中的基本支架。這些融合方法徹底改變了從容易獲得的親電和親核組分進行複雜有機合成的傳統。在這些合成技術的中心，能夠順利有效地進行具有挑戰性和/或有問題的鍵構建過程的新催化劑類型應該是非常有價值的。因此，基礎催化劑探索對於滿足創新有機合成不斷增長的需求的當代催化研究尤為重要。 對於極位阻芳族結構單元的新鍵構建方法的任何有希望的發展都將顯著推進現有的偶聯策略並提出催化科學。該項目的目的是（1）合理設計一個新的高度可調的π壁擴展膦配體，適合瞬態近端π螯合框架，從而為空間體積減輕/空間受阻偶聯反應提供有效的緩解； (2) 深入研究落後的鈀催化極度空間擁擠交叉偶聯反應和其他相關芳基化過程的基本方面、範圍和局限性； (3) 運用實驗和理論的方法廣泛開展相關的機理研究，以獲得更多的催化科學基礎知識。 在催化劑開發和操作過程中獲得的基礎知識，以及近端配體配位的基本原理，即 鈀-芳烴-行走，對於學術興趣和潛在的工業應用具有重要價值。擬議的研究基於我們可靠的概念驗證初步結果，以及我們之前在配體和催化劑設計和合成方面的成功，以及我們在芳烴鍵構建研究方面的豐富經驗。這些新領域有望為我們提供一個極好的機會，讓我們在催化研究的前沿取得實質性進展，並為香港和大灣區的精細化工產業奠定良好的基礎。

14309022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14309022.value: p-局部測量下多參數量子估計的不相容性

14309022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14309022.value: High precision measurement is one of the main driving forces for science and technology. By utilizing quantum mechanics effects, such as entanglement and coherence, quantum metrology promises higher precisions than classical metrology. There is now a good understanding on the ultimate precision limit for the single-parameter quantum estimation. However, for practical applications, such as imaging and spectroscopy, multiple parameters are often involved, for which the highest precision remains largely unknown. This is mainly due to the incompatibility of the measurements, as the optimal measurements for the estimation of different parameters are typically incompatible, which makes the simultaneous achievement of the highest precisions for all parameters impossible. Understanding the tradeoff induced by such incompatibility is a central task in quantum metrology. When collective measurements on infinite identical quantum states can be performed, the tradeoff induced by the incompatibility can be characterized by the Holevo bound. Practically, however, the measurements can only be collectively performed on a finite number of states, under which the tradeoff is little understood. This project aims to provide systematic methods to characterize the tradeoff induced by hierarchical measurements that acts collectively on different finite number of quantum states. The incompatibility of the measurements in multi-parameter quantum estimation is closely related to the uncertainty relations of multiple incompatible observables. The tools developed in this project can also be used to strengthen the uncertainty relation of multiple incompatible observables, which improves a fundamental tool that has wide applications. In the preliminary work, the PI and the collaborators have developed a new bound on the precision limit in multi-parameter quantum estimation under the local measurement. This provides the necessary tools for the proposed study and we are confident that the proposed project can be carried out successfully with fruitful results. 高精度測量是科學技術的主要驅動力之一。通過利用量子力學效應，例如糾纏和相干，量子計量學承諾比經典計量學更高的精度。現在對單參數量子估計的最終精度極限有了很好的理解。然而，成像和光譜學等實際應用通常涉及多個參數，其最高精度很大程度上仍然未知。這主要是由於估計不同參數的最佳測量通常是不兼容的，使得同時實現所有參數的最高精度不可能。理解由這種不相容性引起的權衡是量子計量學的核心任務。 當可以對無限個相同的量子態進行集體測量時，由不相容性引起的權衡可以通過 Holevo 界來表徵。然而，實際上，測量只能在有限個量子態上進行集體測量，在這些狀態下，權衡仍然很少被理解。該項目旨在提供系統的方法來表徵由分層測量引起的權衡，這些測量共同作用於有限數量的量子態。 多參數量子估計中測量的不相容性與多個不相容的可觀測量的不確定性關係密切相關。本項目開發的工具還可用於加強多個不相容可觀測量的不確定性關係，完善了具有廣泛應用的基礎工具。在前期工作中，PI和合作者對局部測量下多參數量子估計的精度極限提出了新的界限。這為擬議的研究提供了必要的工具，我們相信擬議的項目能夠成功實施。

14500022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500022.value: 異質面板數據模型的反事實估計

14500022.label: Project Objectives
14500022.value: This project will propose new methods to estimate counterfactual outcomes based on heterogeneous panel data models. This project will study the asymptotic properties of the new methods by showing the consistency of the new estimators and deriving their asymptotic distribution. This project will examine the finite sample performance of the new methods through Monte Carlo simulations, and provide empirical applications of the new methods.

This project will study the asymptotic properties of the new methods by showing the consistency of the new estimators and deriving their asymptotic distribution.

14500022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500022.value: In Rubin's potential outcome framework, estimation of counterfactual outcomes is a fundamental problem of causal inference. For example, to assess the impact of an earthquake in a region on its economic growth in the subsequent year, we would need to know what its "counterfactual" economic growth would have been if the earthquake had not happened. Panel data provide rich information for modeling counterfactual outcomes. In this project, we propose a new heterogeneous panel data model to estimate counterfactual outcomes. There are three appealing features in the model. First, the counterfactual outcome can depend on observable covariates in a heterogeneous way, the effects of which can vary over both the individual and time dimensions. Second, we allow the dimensionality of the covariates to be large. Third, the counterfactual outcome also can depend on unobservable factors, i.e., the interactive fixed effects. Compared with the existing panel data models, our model allows a more general form of heterogeneity, therefore better reflect many realistic situations in empirical studies in economics. We propose an iteration estimation procedure to estimate the model. In our model, the number of unknown parameters is high dimensional, and therefore it is crucial to find an initial consistent estimator for the iteration. For this, we propose an estimator based on the L1-norm and nuclear-norm regularization, which is a solution to a convex problem and easy to solve. After estimating the model, we can impute the counterfactual outcome straightforwardly. In this project, we will systematically study the asymptotic properties of our new methods. Monte Carlo simulations will be conducted to show the finite sample performance of our methods. Empirical applications will be provided to demonstrate the usefulness of our new methods. 在Rubin的潛在結果框架中，反事實結果的估計是因果推理的一個基本問題。例如，要評估一個地區的地震對其下一年經濟增長的影響，我們需要知道如果地震沒有發生，它的“反事實”經濟增長會是什麼。面板數據為反事實結果建模提供了豐富的信息。在這個項目中，我們提出了一種新的異質面板數據模型來估計反事實結果。該模型具有三個特徵。首先, 可觀察的協變量可以以異質方式來影響反事實結果，其影響可能在個體和時間維度上有所不同。其次，我們允許協變量的維數很大。第三，反事實結果也可能取決於不可觀察的因素，即交互固定效應。與現有的面板數據模型相比，我們的模型允許更普遍的異質性形式，因此更好地反映了經濟學實證研究中的許多現實情況。我們提出了一種疊代估計程序來估計模型。在我們的模型中，未知參數的數量是高維的，因此找到疊代的初始一致估計量至關重要。為此，我們提出了一種基於 L1 範數和核範數正則化的估計量，這是一個凸問題，易於解決。在估計模型之後，我們可以直接估算反事實結果。在這個項目中，我們將系統地研究我們的新方法的漸近特性。將進行蒙特卡羅模擬以顯示我們方法的有限樣本性質。將提供實證應用來證明我們的新方法的有用性。

14500222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14500222.value: 收入性別差異，居住地選擇，和工作地選擇

14500222.label: Project Objectives
14500222.value: Analyze the patterns in the gender commute gap, gender pay gap, and residential sorting using US and China data. I will examine how the gender commute and pay gaps evolve over the life cycle and whether the changes are synchronous. To provide evidence on the importance of considering endogenous home location choice, I will also analyze how these gaps are affected by marriage or childbirth and determine whether any changes in the gender commute and pay gaps upon marriage and childbirth coincide with changes in couples' residential neighborhoods. I will use the American Community Survey (ACS) and a dataset of home mortgages in Beijing to compare the US with China. Although the gender commute and pay gaps exist in both countries, they have very different geographic distributions of jobs and amenities where jobs and high-quality schools are more concentrated in the city center in China than in the US. Therefore, these countries have different patterns in residential sorting and commuting mode. I will provide descriptive statistics to show the similarities and differences between the two countries, which facilitate the cross-country comparison in the last objective. Develop a collective model to improve the current understanding of household decision making on residential and work locations. In this model, the couple jointly determines where to live and whether and where to work for the husband and wife. The choice of home and workplace locations determines commuting distance, which involves monetary and time costs. Amenities (including school quality) at the residential location and the couple's time on home production produce household's public goods. Couples bargain over their private consumption and time allocation to work, home production, and leisure, which is subject to their budget and time constraints. In the proposed model, men and women differ in three aspects, namely, 1) wage offer distribution, 2) home production efficiency, and 3) bargaining power. The model incorporates the following channels to explain the gender commute gap: (1) the labor supply channel, where women search for jobs in a smaller radius than men, and (2) home choice channel, where couples choose to live closer to the wives' workplace to avoid the job turnover of working wives. Structurally estimate the model and conduct counterfactual experiments. I will estimate the model using the US data. I will use the model estimates to decompose the gender pay gap into the aforementioned three differences between men and women. I will also conduct policy experiments to quantify the effects of different policies on the gender pay gap, gender commute gap, and residential sorting. Policies include (1) expansion of public transit and freeways, (2) housing market policies (e.g., housing vouchers and improving neighborhood amenities in the city center), (3) labor market policies (e.g., tax cuts and creating jobs in the suburbs), and (4) flexible work-from-home policy in the post-pandemic world. Furthermore, I will quantify the relative importance of the labor supply and home choice channels in the gender pay gap to examine whether assuming an exogenous residential choice will overestimate the policy impact on the gender pay gap because the residential choice can alleviate the gender pay gap by choosing to live closer to the wife's workplace. Comparing the US with China. I will also estimate the model and conduct counterfactual experiments using data from China. I will compare the efficiency of the aforementioned four policy instruments between China and the US. I will then simulate the model to predict the residential sorting and gender pay gap if China followed the same distribution of jobs or amenities as the US. Comparing these two countries can shed light on the future of developing countries in reducing inequality and congestion.

14500222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500222.value: Aim: The proposed project will study the effect of commuting costs on the gender pay gap by accounting for endogenous residential location choices and the husband's and wife's work location choices. Background: Previous studies document that female workers, on average, spend less time commuting than male workers. Using the American Community Survey (ACS), I show that both gender pay and commute gaps increase after marriage and childbirth and that such increased gaps coincide with changes in the residential neighborhood. These results suggest that residential and work locations are interconnected and highlight the importance of developing a model that considers households' joint decisions on housing and job locations. Project description: The proposed project will initially provide empirical evidence on how the gender commute gap, gender pay gap, and residential neighborhood evolve over the life cycle. I will then develop a collective household decision model in which a couple chooses a residential location and determine whether and where the husband and wife work through bargaining. I will estimate the model using data from the US and China and conduct counterfactual experiments to examine how (1) the expansion of public transit/freeway, (2) housing market policies, (3) labor market policies, and (4) the pandemic affect residential sorting and couples' labor supply decisions. I will use the above model to quantify the relative importance of the labor supply and home choice channels in the gender pay gap. I will compare China with the US through counterfactual experiments where China is assumed to have the same distribution of jobs or amenities as in the US. Significance of the project: Previous studies relate the gender commute gap to labor supply. They treat the location of residence as exogenous and propose that the gap results from women searching and accepting jobs that require shorter commutes. Therefore, women's distaste for commutes enlarges the gender pay gap. I propose that conditional on the work location, couples may choose to live closer to the wife's workplace, thereby avoiding the job turnover of working wives and narrowing the gender pay gap. This proposed project is the first to develop a model that considers the couples' endogenous residential and work locations simultaneously. Moreover, I analyze the gender pay gap in a collective household decision framework than an individual decision model. This proposed project will provide policymakers with new insights by providing different policy instruments to alleviate the gender pay gap and congestion in big cities. 目的：擬建項目將通過考慮內生居住地點選擇和夫妻工作地點選擇來研究通勤成本對性別薪酬差距的影響。 背景：之前的研究表明，女性員工平均比男性員工花費更少的通勤時間。我使用美國社區調查 (ACS) 表明，性別工資和通勤差距在結婚和生育後都會增加，而且這種增加的差距與住宅區的變化相吻合。這些結果表明住宅和工作地點是相互關聯的，並強調了創建一個考慮家庭共同決定住房和工作地點的模型的重要性。 項目描述：擬議項目最初將提供關於性別通勤差距、性別薪酬差距和住宅社區如何在生命週期中演變的經驗證據。然後，我將開發一個集體家庭決策模型，在該模型中，一對夫婦選擇居住地，並通過談判確定夫妻是否工作以及在哪里工作。我將使用來自美國和中國的數據來估計模型，並進行反事實實驗，以檢驗 (1) 公共交通/高速公路的擴張、(2) 住房市場政策、(3) 勞動力市場政策以及 (4) 疫情如何影響住宅分類和夫妻的勞動力供應決策。我將使用上述模型來量化勞動力供給和家庭選擇渠道在性別薪酬差距中的相對重要性。我將通過反事實實驗將中國與美國進行比較，假設中國的工作或便利設施分佈與美國相同。 項目意義：之前的研究將性別通勤差距與勞動力供應聯繫起來。他們將居住地點視為外生因素，並提出這種差距源於女性尋找和接受需要較短通勤時間的工作。因此，女性對通勤的厭惡擴大了性別薪酬差距。這篇文章提出了一個新的觀點，根據工作地點，夫妻可以選擇離妻子工作地點較近的地方，從而避免工作妻子的工作更替，縮小性別薪酬差距。這篇文章首創了同時考慮夫妻內生住宅和工作地點的模型。此外，本項目採用集體家庭決策框架分析性別薪酬差距，而不是個人決策模型。該擬議項目將通過提供不同的政策工具來緩解大城市的性別薪酬差距和擁堵，為政策制定者提供新的見解。

14500322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500322.value: Economists have long been interested in people’s expectations of economic fundamentals, government policies, and market outcomes. It is important to understand how people forecast economic fundamentals and policies, and how these predictions would interact with each other, shape peoples’ beliefs on market trends, and finally affect their investment and consumption decisions. However, it is difficult to empirically study these questions due to the limitation of measuring expectations on different aspects at the same time. Although there is a growing literature using survey data to gauge belief and forecast, researchers have criticized that the survey method may bias the results due to voluntary responses of respondents. In this project, we extract information from the text of the section “Managers’ Expectations on Macro-economy, Markets, and Industries” in the fund managers’ reports required by the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC). This section contains managers’ expectations on fundamentals, policies as well as markets. We plan to conduct comprehensive textual analyses using deep learning techniques on their expectations of these dimensions. In particular, we would analyze the structure of the reports and construct forward-looking measures of sentiment (the first moment) and uncertainty (the second moment) for fundamentals, policies, and markets, respectively. With these comprehensive measures, we are interested in exploring driving forces of fund managers’ expectations on fundamentals, policies, and markets. Potential candidates include economic conditions, market dynamics, and fund performance and characteristics. We then plan to study interactions between fundamental and policy expectations of fund managers, and aim to answer important questions on how these interactions would affect fund managers’ expectations of market dynamics. Finally, we will link fund managers’ expectations to fund portfolio and return data, and study how expectations predict portfolio allocations and fund performance. We would also like to investigate investors’ responses to fund managers’ expectations by examining quarterly fund flows. 長期以來，經濟學家一直都對人們的預期感興趣。這包括對經濟基本面，政府政策，市場結果的預期。我們需要了解人們如何預測經濟基本面和政策，以及這些預測如何相互作用，塑造人們對市場趨勢的信唸，最終影響他們的投資和消費決策。然而，這些問題的實証研究非常具有挑戰性，因爲經濟學家們需要同時測量不同方面的期望。 儘管越來越多的文獻使用問捲調查來測量信唸和預期，但研究人員批評説，由於受訪者是自願選擇回答問捲調查的，這樣會使結果産生偏差。在本項目中，我們從中國証監會要求的基金經理報告“經理對宏觀經濟、市場和行業的預期”的文本中提取信息。本部分包含經理對基本面、政策和市場的預期。我們計劃使用深度學習技術對這些維度的期望進行全面的文本分析。特別是，我們將分析報告的結構，並分別爲基本面、政策和市場構建前瞻性的情緒（第一矩）和不確定性（第二矩）指標。 我們會研究哪些因素影響了基金經理對基本面、政策和市場預期。潛在候選因素包括經濟狀況、市場動態以及基金業績和特徵。然後，我們計劃研究基金經理的基本面和政策預期之間的相互作用，並旨在回答有關這些相互作用將如何影響基金經理對市場動態的預期的重要問題。最後，我們將基金經理的預期與基金投資組合和回報的數據聯繫起來，並研究預期如何預測投資組合配置和基金業績。我們還計劃根據資金流動的情況來調查投資者對基金經理預期的反應。

14500522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500522.value: Remanufacturing is an industrial process that restores end-of-life goods to their original working condition. Different from manufacturing that transforms raw materials into finished products, remanufacturing relies on used end-of-life goods as principle materials, thus conserving energy and materials, reducing waste and pollution. Due to its large economic and environmental values, remanufacturing has been widely adopted in many industries (e.g., consumer products, electrical apparatus, machinery, and motor vehicle parts) in recent years. In response to industrial needs, researchers have started to study remanufacturing (or hybrid manufacturing/remanufacturing) inventory systems since the 1970s. Most of the existing studies assume that unsatisfied demand is backlogged (i.e., customers observing stock-out wait until products are available). While the backlogging assumption facilitates technical tractability and has practical applications, lost sales often fits better the remanufacturing practices. Nevertheless, lost sales, combined with positive production lead times which are typical in practice, brings great challenges for the firms to manage their remanufacturing inventory systems. Due to lost sales, the firms need to keep track of on-hand and pipeline inventories separately, leading to high-dimensional state space. For such systems, the optimal policy is in general intractable due to the “curse of dimensionality” and henceforth the literature primarily focuses on developing effective heuristic policies. In this project, we propose to develop near-optimal approximation algorithms with provable worst-case performance guarantees for two classes of lost-sales remanufacturing inventory systems with positive lead times. The first class is hybrid manufacturing/remanufacturing systems with positive and identical lead times, and the second class is pure remanufacturing systems with positive lead times. For each class of the systems, we propose to develop a near-optimal approximation algorithm with a provable worst-case performance guarantee, and conduct an extensive numerical study to evaluate its numerical performances. If successful, this project will not only fill an important gap in the literature on lost-sales remanufacturing inventory systems with positive lead times, but also have a broad impact on practitioners by providing effective decision tools for managing these challenging systems. 再製造是一種將報廢產品恢復至其原始工作狀態的工業過程。不同於將原材料轉換成最終產品的製造過程，再製造以報廢產品為主要生產材料，進而節省能源與材料，並減少浪費和污染。由於其巨大的經濟和環境價值，近年來再製造已廣泛應用於許多行業（如：消費品、電器設備、機械和自動車部件）。為滿足工業界需求，研究人員早在二十世紀七十年代便開始研究再製造（或混合製造與再製造）庫存系統。大多數現有文獻都假定未滿足的需求會被延期到未來滿足，也就是假定客戶在觀測到缺貨時會持續等待產品到貨。儘管這一假定便於技術上的處理並且有一定的實際應用，缺貨損失假定通常更符合再製造實踐。然而，由於再製造通常需要生產提前期，缺貨損失給企業管理再製造庫存系統帶來了巨大的挑戰。由於未滿足的需求會損失掉，企業需要分開記錄在庫和在途庫存，從而導致高維狀態空間。由於維數災難，這類系統的最優控制策略通常是無法計算的。因此，現有文獻主要集中在開發有效的啟發式算法。在這壹項目中，我們計劃對兩類生產提前期為正的缺貨損失再製造庫存系統開發具有可證最壞績效擔保的近似算法。第一類系統是具有相等且正的生產提前期的混合製造與再製造庫存系統，第二類是具有正的生產提前期的純再製造庫存系統。對於每一類系統，我們計劃開發一個具有可證最壞績效擔保的的近似算法，並通過廣泛的數值算例來評估其數值績效。如果獲得成功，該項目的研究成果將不僅填補當前缺貨損失再製造庫存系統研究文獻的一項重要空白，還將為從業人員提供有效的決策工具來管理這類非常具有挑戰的庫存系統。

14500622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500622.value: The literature on outside directors underscores the information inflow from outside directors to the firm and the significance of the informational benefits of having outside directors. However, outside directors can also expose private information about the firm to outsiders for their own private benefits such as financial gain, gaining extra directorships, and better compensation. Such information outflow or leakage can pose a significant threat to the firm because outside directors have considerable access to confidential in-depth information about the firms they govern as directors. We test how firms compose their board of directors when an information leakage potentially threatens firms, given outside directors’ access to critical firm information and their effectiveness as a vehicle of information. Specifically, we examine how the board composition in terms of the number of outside directors differs between firms facing risk of short selling, a context where information leakage exposes firms to a significant danger. In a short-selling-prone environment, leakage of confidential (often negative) information about the firm poses an extremely costly threat to firms and managers. Therefore, we propose that firms facing an increased short-selling risk do not welcome outside directors because of the possible leakage of confidential information through outside directors, which can cause significant damage. Using a randomized policy experiment known as the Regulation SHO experiment where a short-selling restriction for a randomly selected group of pilot firms was removed, we will test if firms facing an increased short-selling risk will reduce the number of outside directors in the board and this effect will be strengthened by outside directors’ personal and professional network. This study highlights the unexplored risk posed by outside directors as a conduit of outbound information and adds another reason that outside directors may not benefit firm because they may leak unfavorable and confidential information to the outside. Therefore, firms should consider the trade-off between outside directors’ contributions in terms of their monitoring and advising functions and the increased risk of information leaks when outside directors are present on the board. 14500822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14500822.value: Instrumental variable (IV) method is a signature method in empirical economic studies. In applications, it is common to have weak instruments and (or) invalid instruments (these are referred to as non-ideal IVs in this proposal, in contrast to the textbook IV definition of strong and valid IVs). The project aims to provide robust inference procedure in modern economic studies using large scale observational data. We propose a new type of instrumental variable estimator which is robust to many weak instruments (a large number of weak IVs) and model uncertainty regarding the IV validity. This is the common yet difficult situation when applying the IV approach. We plan to detect invalid IVs (which then can be eliminated) via regularized estimation procedures. We also propose a hypothesis test of IV validity when the number of instruments is allowed to grow faster than the sample size. We aim to apply the proposed method in an empirical study of mutual fund performance and the revealed environmental, social and corporate governance (ESG) concentration using textual data. 工具變量方法是實證經濟學研究的一個代表性的方法。在實際問題中，研究者會經常遇到弱工具變量和無效工具變量（在本課題中，這些被稱之為“非理想”的工具變量，即與教科書中的理想工具變量形成反差）。這個問題在實際當中較為普遍，然而目前仍是學術研究當中的一道難題。本課題旨在提供一個穩健的統計推斷方法，並將之用於大維度的觀測數據上面。我們希望提出一個新的工具變量方法，使其能夠在大量弱工具變量和非有效工具變量情況下具備因果推斷的穩健性。我們提供用正則化的方法來檢測無效工具變量，並提出一個新的統計假設檢驗，可以在低維或者高維模型下，獲得較高的檢驗功效。課題組還將把上述統計方法應用在基於互惠基金文本大數據的實證研究。

14500822.label: Realisation of objectives
14500822.value: The research proposal aimed to advance econometric methods for causal inference in the presence of non-ideal instrumental variables (IVs), focusing on the main methodological objectives: (1) developing methods for valid causal effect inference with a large set of non-ideal IVs, (2) proposing an IV estimation procedure robust to weak and potentially invalid IVs, and (3) developing a hypothesis testing procedure to assess the overall validity of an IV set. The PI is very grateful for the support from RGC, which significantly expedite the progress of the project. Two papers, Lin et al. (2024), referred to as Output 1, and Fan, Guo, and Mei (2025), referred to as Output 2, published in the Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B and Journal of Business & Economic Statistics, respectively, directly address these objectives. Specifically, Objective 1: Developing Econometric Methods for Valid Inference with Non-Ideal IVs. The first objective sought to develop methods for valid causal effect inference amidst a large set of IVs with uncertain validity status amid weak instruments. Both papers make significant strides in this direction by addressing the challenges posed by weak and invalid IVs in high-dimensional settings. Lin et al. (2024) tackles the identification and estimation challenges in linear IV models with many weak and potentially invalid IVs. The paper introduces the concept of the "sparsest rule" assumption, equivalent to sparsity in non-convex penalized estimating equations, to address identifiability issues. It extends prior work by relaxing restrictive assumptions like the majority rule (Han, 2008) to a more flexible plurality rule (Guo et al., 2018), enabling identification without prior knowledge of IV validity, and utilizing the identification condition in the computing algorithm. The proposed method leverages weak IVs for estimation, using techniques like the Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP) to ensure global minimization and robust identification. Simulations and empirical applications regarding body mass index (BMI) on diastolic blood pressure (DBP) demonstrate improved performance over existing methods like TSHT and CIV, particularly in finite samples with weak IVs. Fan, Guo, and Mei (2025) complement this by developing a heteroscedasticity-robust overidentifying restriction test for high-dimensional IV models, allowing the number of covariates and IVs to exceed the sample size. The proposed Power-enhanced Maximum (PM) test, based on the maximum norm and a quadratic form, enhances power to detect invalid IVs, especially when many are locally invalid. The test’s scale invariance and robustness to heteroscedastic errors make it suitable for data-rich environments in modern economic research. The empirical study on trade and economic growth illustrates its ability to detect invalid IVs (e.g., energy usage, business environment) where existing tests like the modified Cragg-Donald test fail. Both papers advance econometric methods for non-ideal IVs, with Lin et al. focusing on estimation and Fan et al. on testing, collectively ensuring valid inference in complex scenarios. The objective is substantially achieved, though further work could explore non-linear models or additional robustness checks. Objective 2: Proposing an IV Estimation Procedure Robust to Weak and Potentially Invalid IVs The second objective aimed to propose an IV estimation procedure robust to both weak and potentially invalid IVs. Lin et al. (2024) directly addresses this through a comprehensive estimation framework. The paper proposes a penalized IV estimation approach that accommodates many weak and invalid IVs by leveraging the sparsest rule and MCP. This method ensures robustness by targeting identification conditions and providing a sparse structure, even when IV validity is unknown. Unlike previous methods (e.g., Kang et al., 2016; Windmeijer et al., 2019), which exclude weak IVs, the proposed approach uses weak IVs to estimate parameters and identify valid IV sets, as demonstrated in Theorem 2. The use of robust estimators like LIML further enhances its applicability in scenarios lacking strong IVs. Simulation results (Table 2) show that the proposed weak and invalid IV robust (WIT) method outperforms traditional methods like TSLS and LIML in low-dimensional settings, with lower Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) and competitive Coverage Probability (CP). The empirical application further validates its robustness, offering stable estimates despite weak and invalid IVs. Output 2 indirectly supports this objective by providing a debiased Lasso-based estimator that ensures asymptotic normality under high-dimensional settings, facilitating robust inference. However, the primary contribution to estimation robustness comes from Lin et al., which fully realizes this objective through a theoretically sound and empirically validated procedure. Objective 3: Proposing a Hypothesis Testing Procedure for IV Set Validity The third objective was to develop a hypothesis testing procedure to assess the overall validity of an IV set. Fan, Guo, and Mei (2025) fully achieve this through the PM test. The PM test is designed to test overidentifying restrictions in high-dimensional IV models, accommodating large numbers of covariates and IVs and heteroscedastic errors. It combines a maximum norm-based M test with a quadratic form-based Q test to enhance power, particularly for detecting many locally invalid IVs. Theorems 2 and 3 establish the test’s asymptotic size and power, showing superior performance compared to chi-square type tests and the modified Cragg-Donald test. The empirical study of trade on growth demonstrates the PM test’s effectiveness in rejecting the null hypothesis for a set of 16 IVs, including potentially invalid ones, at the 1% significance level, while the M test and MCD test are less conclusive. The test’s ability to handle high-dimensional data and its robustness to heteroscedasticity make it a significant advancement over existing methods. Regarding the empirical project in objective 4, the PI has tried several dataset and two different topics, although the research design is promising, the empirical finding is mixed and sometimes nonsignificant. A full working paper is written. Due to above reason, the PI has not been able to publish it. The PI would keep working on this area, keep finding interesting empirical results and formulate the theory and hypotheses behind those findings, but at the same time the research focus might lean toward the methodology side. The PI would like to keep pursuing the causal inference in observational studies, using real world data and in many different application fields. For one such pursuit, the PI has developed easy-to-implement software packages/codes on his own GitHub website. The two papers mentioned in this report are fully implementable with user manuals, examples, and codes. The PI thanks the generous support from the RGC again, and hope the practitioners would gradually utilize the new methods developed by this project.

14500822.label: Major findings and research outcome
14500822.value: First, this project addresses identification challenges in linear instrumental variable (IV) models with many weak and potentially invalid instruments. The findings highlight that IV estimation is identifiable even when instruments are individually weak and with uncertain valid/invalid status, as long as the valid instruments are the largest “group” among all IVs, defined as the “sparsest rule” in the paper. The PI extends prior work by accommodating weak IVs, introducing a "sparsest rule" for identification, which is also aligned with the surrogate penalty functions such as Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP). The study proposes an estimator, WIT, which leverages weak IVs to improve finite-sample performance over methods like TSHT and CIV. Second, this project introduces a heteroscedasticity-robust overidentifying restriction test (PM test) for high-dimensional linear IV models, allowing more covariates and instruments than observations. The test combines a maximum-norm-based statistic (M test) with a quadratic-form-based statistic (Q test) to enhance power, particularly against alternatives with many locally invalid instruments. Unlike the modified Cragg-Donald test, the PM test is scale-invariant and handles heteroscedastic errors. Theoretical results show the PM test’s asymptotic normality and superior power when the number of instruments grows. An empirical study on trade’s effect on economic growth (using 2018 data) demonstrates the PM test’s ability to reject invalid instruments (e.g., energy usage, business environment) at stricter significance levels than the M test or MCD, highlighting its practical utility in data-rich environments. The direct research outcome include two papers, Lin et al. (2024), referred to as Output 1, and Fan, Guo, and Mei (2025), referred to as Output 2, published in the Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series B and Journal of Business & Economic Statistics, respectively. These two journals are world leading journals in statistics/economics/econometrics fields. The PI also developed implementation software package/codes on his GitHub website, which is accessible to everyone.

14500822.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14500822.value: The research by the PI opens avenues for advancing instrumental variable (IV) methods in high-dimensional settings. Future developments could refine sparse penalty techniques and power-enhanced tests for non-linear IV models and different models such as dynamic panel data, improving robustness to misspecification. Integrating machine learning for instrument selection and exploring semi-parametric approaches could further enhance identification and testing accuracy. For empirical applications, particularly in corporate finance and management, these methods could be applied to study causal inference in observational studies, such as the impact of governance structures or innovation policies on firm performance, leveraging high-dimensional datasets. A proposed course of action includes developing open-source software implementing these IV methods, fostering collaboration with econometricians and practitioners. Applying these tools to real-world datasets will validate their practical utility further.

14500822.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14500822.value: When empirical researchers want to understand causal relationships, like how trade impacts economic growth, they often use instrumental variables (IVs) to isolate true effects in noisy data in terms of confounding. However, many IVs are weak or invalid, making results unreliable. This project tackles this problem to ensure trustworthy conclusions. The project shows that when IVs are weak and invalid, standard methods fail to give meaningful causal inference. The PI proposes a new approach using a "sparsest rule" to pick the best IVs, even in complex datasets, ensuring accurate causal estimates. The PI also develops a testing procedure to spot invalid IVs, even when data includes many control variables. The test is powerful, and works with real-world data when the dataset is high-dimensional. Overall, these studies improve causal inference by handling many non-ideal IVs, making research in fields like economics, epidemiology, and health more reliable. The methods help researchers draw valid conclusions from big, complicated datasets, guiding better public policies and firm decisions.

14501422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14501422.value: Colleges or academic programs care not only about applicants' abilities but also their motivations and passions. For example, a medical school may prefer applicants who care about patient welfare. However, the true motivations of the applicants are hard to discern. If a medical school admits solely by test scores, it may screen out many public-spirited applicants who do not have the highest test scores. In this project, I propose to study the optimal admissions mechanism when student motivations are unobservable. For convenience, I will refer to the academic units in my model as "colleges." In my model, there are two colleges, A and B, and a continuum of applicants. Each student is characterized by a test score and a type that captures the student's motivations. There are three types: one is enthusiastic about college A, another is enthusiastic about college B, and the last is a middle type who wants to go to college but that is not particularly enthusiastic about either college. I assume that College A is more popular than college B so that middle types prefer college A to college B. Colleges prefer enthusiastic students with high test scores, but they can observe only applicants' test scores but not their types. If college A admits strictly by test scores, it will admit many who are not passionate about it. In a simple example, I show that college A could screen out some of the less committed applicants by allocating some of the places randomly through a lottery. The lottery enlarges the pool of viable candidates. Applicants who are enthusiastic about college A but do not have the highest test scores can now apply to college A. The increased number of applicants drives down the chance of winning the lottery, which causes some middle-type applicants, who would otherwise apply to college A, to switch to college B. College A would gain as a result. College B may or may not gain depending on the parameters of the model. The example illustrates that the common practice of admitting students with the best credentials could be suboptimal. In this project, I will analyze the problem in a general model. The plan is to derive the optimal admissions mechanism when student motivations are unobservable and compare it to the equilibrium outcome when each college chooses its own admissions policy independently. The results will contribute to the ongoing debate on meritocracy. N/A

14502022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502022.value: Since the early 2000s, there has been significant growth in trading volume around the close around the globe, as some institutional investors are mandated to execute at the closing price. As a result, many markets have introduced closing auctions to handle the surge of trading volume near the close. Many studies have examined the closing auction and find that it facilitates price discovery and enhances liquidity. This study proposes to examine the order flows in the closing auction session to understand its relationship with the price movement and trading activity in the continuous trading session. Based on a propriety dataset provided by the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEx), we obtain information on the composition of the order flows, such as at-auction orders (AO) and at-auction limit orders (ALO). We will examine the following issues: (i) the relationship between the intraday trading volume during the continuous trading session and the volume at the closing auction session; (ii) the relationship between the rollover orders from the continuous trading session and the at-auction limit orders; (iii) the relationship between the at-auction orders and at-auction limit orders; and (iv) the return predictability of at-auction orders and at-auction limit orders. This study will contribute significantly to the academic literature as it will be among the first set of studies to investigate the order flows in the closing auction. Results of this project will also be of direct relevance to exchanges and regulators, and our study will provide insights into improving the closing auction mechanism. 自 2000 年代初以來，全球交易量顯著增長在全球範圍內關閉，因為一些機構投資者被要求在收盤價。因此，許多市場引入了收盤拍賣來處理收盤附近成交量激增。許多研究已經檢查了收盤拍賣並發現它有助於價格發現並增強流動性。本研究建議檢查收盤拍賣時段中的訂單流以了解其關係隨著持續交易時段的價格變動和交易活動。 基於在香港證券交易所（HKEx）提供的專有數據集上，我們獲得有關訂單流組成的信息，例如競價訂單 (At-auction order) 和 競價限價單 (At-auction limit order), 我們將研究以下問題： (i) 連續交易時段日內交易量之間的關係以及收市拍賣時段的成交量的關係； (ii) 來自連續交易時段的訂單和競價限價訂單的關係； (iii) 競價盤與競價限價盤的關係； (iv) 競價單和競價限價單的回報可預測性。 本研究將對學術文獻做出重大貢獻，因為它將是第一批 研究調查收盤拍賣中的訂單流。該項目的成果將也與交易所和監管機構直接相關，我們的研究將提供對完善收盤競價機制的見解。

14502022.label: Realisation of objectives
14502022.value: We conducted analysis based on the 4 objectives in original application, and found the following results: Objectiv #1: We find a positive association between trading volume during the closing auction session (CAS) and trading volume in both the morning and afternoon sessions. These results are robust when trading activity is measured using the trade-to-order ratio. Objective #2: There is a robust positive relationship between rollover orders from the continuous trading session (CTS) and at-auction limit orders (ALO) during the CAS. However, this relationship is dampened on days of heightened uncertainty. Objective #3: We observe a negative relationship between rollover orders from the CTS and at-auction orders (AO) during the CAS. This relationship also weakens when uncertainty is higher. Objective #4: ALO is positively related to future stock returns over the next few days, while AO does not show a significant relationship. A paper is written and now under submission.

14502022.label: Major findings and research outcome
14502022.value: The study utilizes a proprietary dataset from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEx), containing data on at-auction orders (AO) and at-auction limit orders (ALO). We empirically examine four hypotheses: 1. Relationship between CTS and CAS Trading Activities: Institutional investors often trade near market close, preferring to execute most trades during the CAS. High trading volumes and low costs may prompt some orders to be placed during the CTS to mitigate the risk of unexecuted orders at day's end. Our results indicate a strong relationship between trading volume in the CTS (morning or afternoon) and the CAS. 2. Rollover Orders and ALO during CAS: According to HKEx rules, unexecuted CTS orders are automatically rolled over to the CAS, provided they fall within a ±5% price limit, becoming ALOs. Traders can cancel or amend these orders depending on market conditions. Our findings show a strong positive relationship between rolled-over CTS orders and ALOs, though this is weaker during periods of higher uncertainty. The relationship holds for both buy-side and sell-side orders. 3. Rollover Orders and AO during CAS: Liquidity providers absorb rollover order imbalances from the CTS by submitting auction market orders (AO) during the CAS. We find a negative relationship between rollover imbalance and AO imbalance, indicating that liquidity providers submit market orders during the CAS to partially counteract order imbalances from the CTS. 4. Information Content of ALO and AO: ALO may be submitted by informed traders with long-lived private information, allowing them to trade patiently. AO is more likely submitted by liquidity providers and may not contain information. Our analysis shows that ALO can predict subsequent stock returns, while AO cannot.

14502022.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14502022.value: Many stock exchanges worldwide have seen significant growth in trading volume near market close, as institutional investors are often required to execute trades at the closing price. Hong Kong introduced closing auctions to manage this surge. Prior research has documented the effectiveness of closing auctions in price discovery, but has not examined order flows during the closing session. Using a proprietary HKEx dataset, we are the first to investigate order flows in the closing auction, focusing on their roles in liquidity provision and price discovery. We demonstrate the considerations behind submitting market and limit orders in the closing auction, their interaction, and how both types are affected by information risk. Limit orders are more likely submitted by informed traders with long-lived private information. In the closing auction, limit orders demand liquidity, while market orders provide liquidity. This project offers direct insights for exchanges and regulators to improve the closing auction mechanism.

14502722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502722.value: Internet-based online platforms have penetrated billions of people’s daily lives in various areas such as social media, online shopping, and transportation. Platforms publicly traded in the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, such as Tencent, Alibaba, Meituan, Xiaomi, Kuaishou, etc., together are worth more than 10 trillion HK dollars, which means more than one quarter of the market capitalization of the entire HK Stock Exchange. The prosperity of these platforms relies heavily on the enormous data they own, and the data analytics methodologies that drive their strategic and operations decisions. Randomized experiments (a.k.a. A/B tests) have now become a ubiquitous and critical data-driven decision tool to efficiently evaluate and optimize their strategies. In practice, a large-scale online platform like Facebook usually launches thousands of experiments everyday to fast iterate their business operations such as product designs and recommendation algorithms. Consequently, each user of the platform is independently treated by thousands of A/B tests simultaneously. This triggers interesting and important research questions for platforms to best leverage the power of A/B tests: • How to estimate and infer the overall treatment effect of multiple independent experiments on a platform? • Without observing the outcomes of all experiment combinations, how to identify the optimal experiment combination? Platform managers usually assume the treatment effects of different experiments are linearly additive, so the optimal combination is all the experiments with a positive average treatment effect. However, we observe from the real data of a large-scale online video-sharing platform (Platform O) that linear additivity does not hold and that the overall treatment effect of multiple experiments varies for different users. The non-additivity and heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) of multiple experiments pose significant challenges to address the aforementioned research questions. In this project, we aim to develop a new framework to estimate and infer the overall treatment effect of multiple experiments and identify the optimal experiment combination with partially observable outcomes. We propose a novel deep learning and semiparametric statistics framework to estimate the HTE of any experiment combination for each user on the platform. Furthermore, we derive the asymptotic normality of the HTE estimator for statistical inference. We further test our theory using both simulated data and the real data of Platform O. Finally, based on our theoretical framework, we seek to develop a systematic experimentation method for a platform to launch, iterate, and optimize multiple A/B tests in an adaptive fashion. 互聯網在線平臺已經深刻的影響了數以億計網民在社交網絡、電商和交通等生活的方方面面。在港交所上市的互聯網平臺企業，如騰訊、阿裏巴巴、美團、小米和快手等，其市值之和超過10萬億港幣，即超過港股總市值的四分之一。互聯網平臺企業的繁榮發展依賴於其擁有的海量數據，以及先進的數據分析方法來驅動其商業決策與業務增長。隨機實驗（又稱為A/B實驗）已經成為互聯網平臺無處不在極其重要的數據驅動決策工具來評估與優化平臺運營策略。事實上，大型互聯網平臺如Facebook每天同時會上線上千個不同的A/B實驗，從而快速叠代其產品設計與推薦算法策略。因此，平臺上每個用戶通常同時被成百上千個實驗獨立命中。這就啟發我們嘗試解決如下有趣且重要的研究問題來充分發揮A/B實驗的巨大潛力： • 如何對平臺多個獨立A/B實驗的總體效果進行估計？ • 在不能觀測到所有實驗組合效果的情況下，如何識別出最優實驗組合？ 在現實平臺運營中，管理者通常會直接假設不同實驗的效果是線性可加的，所以最優實驗組合是平凡的：所有正收益的實驗集合。但是，我們在與某大型短視頻平臺（記作平臺O）的合作中發現，多實驗組合的效果並不能由單個實驗效果簡單線性疊加得到。同時，實驗疊加的效果對於平臺不同的用戶也不盡相同。這些觀察均對解決上述兩個核心研究問題帶來了巨大的挑戰。 在本項目中，我們致力於開發一種新的數據分析框架來對多實驗組合效果進行估計與推斷，並在無法完整觀測到所有可能得實驗組合的情形下準確有效地找到最優實驗組合。在本項目前期工作中，我們提出了一種新的結合深度學習與半參數統計的框架來估計任意實驗組合的異質性因果效應（HTE），並證明相關估計量的漸進正態分布性質。基於這個理論框架，我們將探索設計新的實驗方法幫助大型互聯網平臺上線、叠代並自適應地優化其海量A/B實驗。
