14502822.value: 歷史 vs. 社會期望: 環境動盪時期績效回饋與跨國公司子公司終止決策

14502822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502822.value: 跨國公司何時會終止他們的外國子公司? 突發的環境危機, 比如2019冠狀病毒疫情, 如何影響跨國公司的終止子公司的決定? 為什麼有些跨國公司更容易受到危機的影響. 這些重要問題能夠對跨國公司的全球經營提供實踐指導意義. 我們基於企業行為理論來回答上述問題. 企業行為理論關注有限理性條件下管理者的決策問題, 並且越來越多地被用於研究跨國公司的行為. 根據這一視角, 當跨國公司的績效表現低於自身過去的績效表現(歷史期望)或者同行公司的績效表現(社會期望), 跨國公司會從事更多的子公司終止決策以精簡業務和快速扭轉局面. 然而, 鮮有研究解釋什麼時候和為什麼某種期望會比另外一種期望更重要, 從而限制了對管理者的指導意義. 利用COVID-19作為一項自然實驗, 我們比較在環境動盪時期歷史和社會期望對於跨國公司子公司終止決定的不同影響. 該環境動盪意外地改變了環境的不確定性和多樣性程度. 我們同時探索邊界條件來解釋跨國公司對環境動盪時期的異質性反應. 我們預測在環境動盪時期, 相比於績效低於歷史期望, 績效表現低於社會期望時跨國公司會從事更多的子公司終止決策. 由於社會比較能夠提供更容易獲得的且相關的資訊, 增長的環境不確定性使得與同行比較更加普遍. 通過這些資訊管理者可以評估跨國公司的現狀, 從而做出子公司終止決策. 然而, 突然變化的環境多樣性使得動盪前和動盪過程中的歷史比較變得不恰當. 進一步地, 我們認為由於學習和緩沖效應能夠對社會比較的資訊角色產生替代作用, 社會期望的影響會受到跨國公司先前類似經歷(我們研究情境中的非典型肺炎)和冗餘資源的限制. 實證檢驗上, 我們將收集日本跨國公司的數據, 並使用COVID-19所提供的自然實驗情境作為一個外生衝擊. 通過研究能夠改變管理者期望-設定過程的條件, 該研究計畫能夠推動企業行為理論的發展. 通過展示子公司的終止決定基於績效期望和解釋為什麼面臨同樣危機的公司的表現會不同, 該研究計畫也將進一步填補對跨國公司和組織應對危機的文獻空白. 綜上, 這些貢獻會為那些致力於保護疫情期間業務連續性的管理者和政策制定者提供實踐指導.

14502922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14502922.value: 異質社會規範下的社區建立與公共池資源管理

14502922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14502922.value: Prof Lien, Jaimie Wei Hung Prof Zheng, Jie

14502922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14502922.value: Many regions around the world struggle with the integration of newcomers into their existing communities. While it is ideal to think that new members of society can integrate seamlessly into the local environments, in reality, the introduction of sizable populations of individuals from different socio-cultural backgrounds into a region often results in social conflict, often accompanied by each group developing negative perceptions of the other group. In this project, we examine one specific possible channel for this phenomenon, differing norms regarding the use and extraction of resources in the public domain among existing and new residents. We utilize an experimental approach to examining the effectiveness of two different types of policies on successful maintenance of a common pool resource (CPR). In the laboratory experiment component, we cultivate two populations of different norms about the individual level of extraction from a common pool resource: one population which extracts the Nash equilibrium amount, which is an over-extraction compared to what is socially optimal; the other population extracts less than the equilibrium amount but closer to the social optimum. We then match members of the former group into communities of the latter group, according to the treatment policies in question. Our first set of treatments addresses the ideal distribution of a fixed number of equilibrium playing residents in a society of individuals extracting closer to the socially optimal level. We consider three different ways to allocate such individuals into different communities in the society, to test which yields the best social outcome. Our second set of treatment addresses whether an admissions procedure can assist with the common pool resource problem. We consider three different admissions procedures, the allocation of community slots randomly, based on effort, and based on a knowledge quiz of existing social norms in the local population. The aim of these treatments is to evaluate the degree to which local norms can sustain an incoming population of different norms, and whether certain distributional and admissions procedures can assist in this cause. In the field experiment component, we test whether socializing and friendship opportunities between two groups can lead to increased regard for the public domain through volunteerism in both Hong Kong and mainland China. Surveys and community activities allow for observation of whether social integration attempts at the interpersonal level can increase the regard for local public resources among non-local originating individuals. 世界上許多地區都面臨著新移民如何更好地融入現有社區的問題。雖然理想情況下，社會的新成員可以無縫融入當地環境，但實際上，將具有不同社會文化背景的大量個體引入一個地區往往會導致社會衝突，並通常導致不同群體對彼此持負面態度。 在本研究項目中，我們考察上述現象的一個具體可能管道，即現有居民和新居民在公共領域資源的使用方面存在不同的規範。我們利用實驗方法來檢查兩種不同類型的政策對成功維護公共池資源 (CPR) 的效果。 在實驗室實驗部分，我們首先形成兩個在公共池資源提取水準方面具有不同規範的群體：一個群體提取納什均衡水準，而這與社會最優水準相比，屬於過度提取；另一個群體提取水準低於納什均衡水準，更接近於社會最優水準。然後，根據設計的相關政策，我們將前一群體中的成員匹配到後一群體中去。 我們的第一組實驗研究在一個接近公共池資源社會最優提取水準的群體中引入固定數量的提取水準為納什均衡水準的居民，其最理想的分配政策是什麼樣的。我們考慮三種不同的方式來將這些個體分配到社會中的不同社區，以測試哪種方式會產生最佳的社會結果。我們的第二組實驗考察准入制度是否有助於解決公共池資源問題。我們考慮三種不同的准入制度，即隨機分配社區，基於努力水準分配社區，以及基於對當地現行社會規範的知識測驗成績來分配社區。設計這些實驗的目的是評估當地社會規範可以在多大程度上維持具有不同社會規範的傳入人口，以及某些分配政策和准入制度是否可以説明實現這一目標。 在實地實驗部分，我們利用香港和中國大陸的志願者來測試兩個群體之間的社交和友誼是否可以改善對公共資源的使用。通過調查和社區活動等方式，我們可以觀測到人際層面的社會融合嘗試是否可以改善非本地居民對本地公共資源的態度。

14503122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14503122.value: Prof Iyer, Ganesh Prof Lin, Song

14503122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14503122.value: The availability of comprehensive customer data and advancement of data analytics tools have automated many business decisions, such as pricing, targeting, and advertising, which are used to be made by human managers. In this project, we explore how competitive firms employ algorithms to estimate demand and based on the estimates, make strategic decisions to maximize expected profit. Different algorithms essentially mean different model selections, which tradeoff variance and bias differently under the general framework of supervised learning. From this perspective, our project aims to study firms’ competition in model selections for demand estimation and explore how competition moderates individual firms’ variance-bias tradeoff. We plan to achieve this research goal in two steps. First, we focus on one specific decision of the firms—targeting. It is important for firms to decide which customers to target in the market. Historically, this is mostly done through market research. Recently, there is an ongoing trend that targeting decisions have been automated by algorithms in real time based on customer behavioral data. Moreover, targeting has become a playground for experimenting new machine learning algorithms. Therefore, we consider targeting to be a great starting point to study algorithmic competition. To be more specific, we construct a model of two firms, each appointing a data analyst to estimate demand for multiple consumer segments by running a Lasso regression. Based on the estimates reported by his analyst, each firm devises a targeting policy to maximize estimated profit. The firms face the general tradeoff between bias and variance in choosing the tuning parameter of the Lasso regression. We have completely solved the monopolistic benchmark and find that a monopolistic firm always prefers the OLS regression to a Lasso. For the main model of duopolistic competition, our preliminary numeric studies reveal a promising interesting finding: competition may drive firms to choose a Lasso regression, which is a less flexible algorithm that introduces bias. This implies that more flexible algorithms such as deep learning are more valuable to firms with greater monopoly power. Next, we would like to explore a general class of strategic decisions of the firms, such as targeting, pricing, advertising, product design, etc. We plan to focus on two important cases, where the firms’ decisions are either strategic substitutes or complements. By building on the intuition from the study on targeting, we would like to understand the general impact of firms’ competition on their model selections based on the bias-variance tradeoff. 大數據和機器學習等數據分析工具的快速發展已經使得很多商業決策變得自動化，例如定價、定位目標客戶和廣告。這些決策過去往往是由商業管理者人工做出。在這個研究項目中，我們探索相互競爭的公司如何使用算法來估計需求，並根據估計做出戰略決策以最大化預期利潤。不同的算法本質上意味著不同的模型選擇，它們在監督學習的一般框架下意味著不同的權衡方差和偏差的方式。從這個角度來看，我們的研究項目旨在研究企業在需求估計模型選擇中的競爭，並探索競爭如何影響每個企業的方差和偏差的權衡。

14503222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14503222.value: 政府轉移支付與區域間不平等：來自中國的理論與實證

14503222.label: Project Objectives
14503222.value: This project aims to develop a novel quantitative framework to conduct economic analysis on the spatial effects of government redistribution policy in developing countries that have experienced dramatic economic growth, structural transformation, globalization, and migration. Although the study focuses on China, this analytical framework is also useful for other developing countries. This project aims to construct a comprehensive spatial data set of China during 1995 and 2015 for the current project and future economic analysis on the spatial economy in China. First, We will collect a comprehensive data set covering provincial output, employment, and capital stock, and the inter-province migration from population census and inter-regional trade from inter-regional input-output tables. Moreover, we will also construct a unique fiscal data set that covers the central and provincial government budgetary fiscal revenues, expenditures, and intergovernmental transfers, as well as the non-budgetary government revenue and expenditure such as government funds. This project will document important stylized facts on spatial inequality and the central government redistribution policy and the provincial government expenditure. First, we will document the fact that the spatial inequality across provinces has presented an interesting inverted U-shape. Meanwhile, we will also check the patterns of regional convergence during 1995-2005 and during 2005-2015, by using various macroeconomic variables. Second, the central government has significantly strengthened its capacity of redistribution after the tax-sharing reform in 1994. The central government transfer as a share of national GDP has risen from 3% in 1995 to about 8% in 2015. Moreover, since 2005 the central government has set the target of ``equalization of public services across regions" in the ``Eleventh Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development", and poured massive resources into the poor provinces through central government transfer. Thus, this project will also document the key institutional reforms of the Chinese public finance system and characterize the rising progressivity of central government transfer and provincial government expenditure. We will conduct extensive empirical analysis on the effects of intergovernmental transfers on local government expenditure and local output, and explore the channels of how local government expenditure affects local economies. We will develop a spatial general equilibrium model featuring non-homothetic preference, trade, migration, structural change, and government redistribution policy. The model captures important elements of the Chinese economy such as inter-province migration and intra-province rural-urban migration, inter-regional domestic trade and international trade, and structural change. We also introduce the government sector into the model in which the central government collects tax revenues and then redistributes them back to different provinces, and the local governments provide amenities for their residents. We will use the model to show how government redistribution policy changes the spatial allocation of economic activities such as the flow of migrations, inter-regional trade, and the spatial distribution of sectoral activities, and income inequalities. The model allows us to conduct various counterfactual experiments to show the effects of government redistribution policy in 2015, as well as to estimate the efficiency loss due to the progressive redistribution policy. For example, we can remove the net transfer completely, or reset the net transfer scheme as the one in 2005 or as the optimal transfer policy. The model also enables us to quantify the contributions of trade cost, migration cost, TFP, and structural transformation in the reduction of spatial inequality. We will also examine the trade-off between reducing income inequality and aggregate productivity--redistribution may help to reduce regional income inequality, but it also may lead to larger misallocation and therefore lower aggregate productivity. We will also examine alternative policies that could potentially reduce regional income inequality without lower aggregate productivity, for example, lowering costs for migration and trade.

14504022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14504022.value: 空氣污染與居民線上消費

14504022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14504022.value: Prof Agarwal, Sumit Prof Wang, Long

14504022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504022.value: 空氣污染是世界上最重要的環境問題之一。空氣污染領域的大量研究表明，空氣污染会對人的心理、情緒和行為造成影響。然而，由於缺乏微观家庭消費數據以及識別空氣污染外生性變化的挑戰，現有的研究缺乏將空氣污染與家庭消費直接聯繫起來的證據。尤其是在過去幾年，電子商務的飞速发展以及新冠病毒的爆發，都促使居民消费逐渐從店內消費轉向在線消費。 因此，在電子商務時代，探索影響家庭在線支出的因素尤為重要。為了填補研究空白，该項目使用基於2017-2019年的微观在線消费數據集来探索空氣污染对在线消费的因果影響。該項目利用了導致南北空氣質量的外生變化的秦岭淮河线供熱政策来解决由於遺漏變量偏差和潛在內生性帶來的測量誤差。該項目首先研究空氣污染如何影響各類商品的在線消費。更具體地說，是否與健康相關的商品、必需品和非必需品呈現出異質的消費化反應？其次，該項目估計空氣污染對各種消費者的因果影響行為和異質反應。除此之外，该项目将考察線上消費的動態變化并研究消費模式的變化是否長期持續跑。最後，該項目將利用在線關鍵字搜索指數探討空氣污染引起異質反應的潛在機制。

14505922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505922.value: 貨幣政策對中國現代銀行體系風險承擔的影響

14505922.label: Project Objectives
14505922.value: The transmission mechanism of monetary policy is an essential topic for both policymakers and academia. Currently, there is a question that the literature needs to address: how the monetary policy influences the risk-taking of the banking system in the presence of shadow banking. In this project, I intend to fill in this gap. I will take advantage of the micro-level data from China's traditional banking and shadow banking sectors to address the above empirical questions. In particular, the data include bank-issued wealth management products (an important segment of shadow banking), municipal corporate bonds, and bank loans with land collateral. I will collect, compile, and, more importantly, draw linkages between the different data sets. A vital issue to address is the empirical strategies that allow me to identify the exact transmission mechanisms. I will employ the unexpected monetary policy shocks estimated by macro models available in the literature to test banks' responses and shadow banks at the micro-level. In addition, I will also take advantage of the implementation of a key regulatory constraint, i.e., the Basel III accord, to help identify the transmission mechanism. The research outcome could primarily help policymakers design and utilize monetary policy instruments by taking into account the possible reactions of the entire banking sector. Therefore, policymakers could avoid potential unintended consequences of relevant macro policies.

14505922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505922.value: Monetary policy is the most common instrument that each country's central bank uses to fight against typical economic downturns or severe crises such as the current Covid-19 pandemic. The study of the transmission mechanism of monetary policy has always been an important subject in economics. The impacts of monetary policy on the real economy work through the banking system because it is banks that directly interact with the central bank of a country and decide how much credit is extended to the real sector and at what rates. Therefore, the study of monetary policy's transmission primarily focuses on the operation of the banking system. The modern banking system has undergone a substantial change in the past two decades. The shadow banking sector has been expanding consistently, and its current role in the banking system is as critical as the traditional banking sector. The so-called shadow banking refers to banking activities outside the radar of bank regulators like central banks. On the one hand, bank regulators do not monitor the financial activities of shadow banks as closely as those of regular banks; on the other hand, in distressed scenarios, shadow banks do not enjoy the backstop offered by bank regulators. Although shadow banks also conduct financial intermediation as regular banks do, the risk preference and lending behaviors could be pretty different between the two types of financial firms. In this project, I intend to emphasize the risk composition of regular bank credit and shadow bank credit. A series of questions will be addressed in this project. Do shadow banks choose to hold more safe assets or risky assets when they expand in the presence of contracting monetary policy? If shadow banks decide to hold more safe assets, do they replace the risky assets with relatively safe ones, given their limited lending capacity? It is crucial to have clear answers to these questions because they show whether shadow banking neutralizes the traditional transmission mechanism of monetary policy or transforms the conventional channel in the wider circle of the modern banking system. 貨幣政策是各國央行用來應對一般經濟衰退或嚴重危機（例如當前的 Covid-19 大流行）的最常用工具。貨幣政策傳導機制的研究一直是經濟學的重要課題。貨幣政策對實體經濟的影響通過銀行系統發揮作用，因為銀行直接與央行互動，並決定向實體部門提供多少信貸以及以何種利率提供信貸。因此，貨幣政策傳導的研究主要集中在銀行體系的運行上。在過去的二十年裡，現代銀行體系發生了巨大的變化。影子銀行部門一直在不斷擴張，其目前在銀行體系中的作用與傳統銀行部門同等重要。所謂影子銀行，是指於央行等銀行監管機構監控之外的銀行活動。一方面，銀行監管機構對影子銀行的金融活動沒有像傳統銀行那樣密切監控；另一方面，在陷入困境的情況下，影子銀行無法享受銀行監管機構提供的支持。雖然影子銀行也像普通銀行一樣進行金融中介服務，但兩類金融公司的風險偏好和借貸行為可能有很大不同。在此研究項目中，我計劃強調傳統銀行信貸和影子銀行信貸的風險構成。本項目旨在回答如下一系列問題。在貨幣政策收縮的情況下, 當影子銀行擴張時, 它們是選擇持有更多安全資產還是風險資產？如果影子銀行決定持有更安全的資產，在放貸能力有限的情況下，它們是否會用相對安全的資產替代風險資產？對這些問題有明確的答案至關重要，因為它們表明影子銀行是中和了傳統的貨幣政策傳導機制，還是在更廣泛的現代銀行體系中改變了傳統渠道。

14506222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506222.value: 私人企業標的財務數據在併購公告的披露

14506222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14506222.value: Prof CHAU, Yuen Kit Prof KOO, Minjae

14506222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506222.value: Merger and acquisition (M&A) activities constitute an important part of the global economy. Despite the abundance of M&A transactions, academic studies often fail to conclude that M&A transactions create value for the acquiring firm, partly due to difficulties in measuring M&A performance. For instance, while examining the M&A announcement returns is the most commonly used method, it relies on the assumption that the market can accurately estimate the expected value creation based on the available information. However, the vast majority of M&A transactions involve private targets with little public information. In these private acquisitions, the information available to the market is likely a function of acquirers’ disclosure choice during deal announcements. However, anecdotal observations suggest that acquirers may not voluntarily disclose accounting information on the target. Thus, it is unclear to what extent we can rely on the market announcement returns to assess the value creation for acquirers that involve private targets, especially those without any disclosures of the targets’ financial information. Utilizing a sample of private acquisitions by public acquirers from the United States, this proposed project aims to investigate the current status regarding the disclosure of private targets’ accounting information during deal announcements. The project will investigate the determinants of the voluntary disclosure decision on the target’s financials by acquirers in private acquisitions and the implications of the disclosure choice on the market’s assessments of M&A transactions. The data collected by the project should also help elucidate the nature of data captured by various commonly used financial databases containing target financials. 併購活動是我們全球經濟的重要組成部分。儘管併購交易大量存在，但學術研究往往無法得出併購交易是否正在為收購公司的股東創造價值的結論，部分原因在於難以衡量併購績效。不少研究用併購公告收益去衡量併購績效, 但此方法要依賴市場可以有效地利用公開信息去定價的假設。 然而，大多數併購交易都涉及私人企業作為標的, 而私人企業很少公開自身的財務數據。在這些併購中，市場可獲得的信息很可能依賴收購方選擇性披露的數據。但是, 收購方可能不會主動披露有關目標公司的大量財務數據。因此，尚不清楚我們可以在多大程度上依賴市場公告回報來評估涉及私人企業標的併購交易對收購方的價值創造。 本項目以美國上巿公司作為收購方及私人企業作為標的的併購案為樣本，旨在研究在交易公告期間私人企業標的財務數據的披露現狀。此外，該項目還將研究收購方自願披露目標公司財務狀況的決定因素，以及此披露選擇對市場對併購交易評估的影響。最後，該項目應有助於闡明一般財務數據庫捕獲的有關目標財務數據的情況。

14506422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506422.value: 股權眾籌與初創公司成長

14506422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506422.value: Crowdfunding is an Internet-based fundraising practice that helps entrepreneurs raise funding for their early-stage projects from regular people worldwide. Since the business model came out in the mid-2000s, it has become popular and gained a lot of attention from both practitioners and policymakers. Equity crowdfunding allowing for the sale of equity or bond-like shares in a startup received the most attention from policymakers and regulators as a promising means to finance aspiring innovative startups. Despite its importance, data and research on equity crowdfunding are somewhat limited because of the later start and the longer horizon required to measure success. Our research team received data directly from the largest equity crowdfunding company in Korea. The dataset that we secured contains all the projects listed on the platform and all the projects' investments. With this data, we would like to examine the impact of equity crowdfunding on startup performance. We will examine whether equity crowdfunding can help startups survive and grow. In addition, we will uncover some mechanisms to drive its positive effect. We expect that this project can provide several impactful implications. By better understanding the impact of equity crowdfunding on startup performance, our project can advise crowdfunding platforms in helping startups' survival and growth via crowdfunding. We want to inform crowdfunding platforms of whether equity crowdfunding helps startups grow and if so, how. Our research can also tell startups how equity crowdfunding can help them to make the most use of equity crowdfunding. Finally, our study can inform regulators and policymakers about how to regulate equity crowdfunding. For instance, many countries, including South Korea, have a regulation regarding the definition of professional investors and the scope of startups that can use equity crowdfunding. Our project can shed light on the importance of professional investors in helping startups via equity crowdfunding and provide insights for equity crowdfunding sustainability. 眾籌是一種基於互聯網的集資方式，它幫助創業者向大眾募集資金以支持其項目的初期發展。自2000年代初該商業模式問世以來，它已廣泛流行，並受到從業者和政策制定者的密切關注。其中，股權眾籌模式允許初創公司出售股權或類似債券的股票，逐步成為一種為優秀創新創業公司提供融資資金的有力手段，進而得到政策制定者和管理者的重點關注。儘管該股權眾籌模式很重要，但由於其起步較晚，且衡量其成功與否所需的時間較長，因此有關股權眾籌的數據和研究在一定程度上受到很大限制。 我們的研究團隊從韓國最大的股權眾籌公司直接獲取到相關數據，該數據集包含公司平台上列出的所有項目及其獲得的投資。借助這一數據，我們計劃研究股權眾籌對創業公司業績的影響。我們將探討股權眾籌是否且如何幫助初創公司生存和成長，揭示推動其積極影響的機制，並總結提供有影響力的管理啟示。通過了解股權眾籌對創業公司業績的影響，我們的項目可以幫助眾籌平台更好地服務於初創公司的融資需求，也同時幫助初創公司更好地利用股權眾籌模式支持其早期發展。最後，我們的研究可以為政策制定者如何監管股權眾籌活動提供建議。例如，包括韓國在內的許多國家對股權眾籌中可參與的初創公司範圍，及專業投資者的定義，都已有明確規定。我們的項目將闡明專業投資者通過股權眾籌活動幫助初創企業成長的重要性，並為股權眾籌模式的可持續性提供見解。

14506522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506522.value: 企業內部的平等和多元化已經成為了大眾關註的重要議題。在新古典企業理論框架中，企業由企業家建立且企業家負責雇傭一群具有共同願景的員工為企業的目標一起努力；同時，有別於市場機製，企業內部的資源分配基本依賴於基於雇傭勞動合同的等級製度。企業的以上兩個特點造成了員工中的少數和弱勢群體容易在工作過程中受到歧視。首先，由於他們通常來自不同的文化背景和持有不同的價值觀點，他們的工作申請和職業發展更加容易在追求共同企業價值的過程中被忽視。再次，因為在企業內部很難定義管理者權威的邊界，少數和弱勢員工也更容易被管理者欺壓和利用。為了解決這些重要的企業平權和多元化問題，很多國家的立法和執法者已經開始行動起來，但是立法和執法的實際效果並不顯著。2020年全球性別報告指出性別工資差異(同一個工作中女性員工比男性員工的工資低)在過去的10年裏面只下降了1%。 另一方面，我們看到市場參與者卻能夠在促進企業平等和多元化的過程中起到越來越重要的積極作用。舉例來說，投資者已經要求諸多企業向美國平權委員會報備平權數據，比如耐克、穆迪、沃爾瑪等。在這個研究中，我們將延續使用Cen, Han, Liu, and Wu (2021)中的EEO指標，同時構造每一個賣方和買方分析員的平權敏感指數。用這兩個指標，我們可以研究以下幾個問題：1）哪些賣方和買方分析員的平權敏感指數更高？2）對賣方分析員來說，他們的平權偏好體現投行的平權偏好嗎？3）賣方和買方分析員的平權偏好會影響他們分析的公司的平權偏好嗎？4）在公司電話會議中，首席執行官的平權偏好和參會者的平權偏好是如何相互影響的？

14506522.label: Realisation of objectives
14506522.value: Regarding Objectives 1 and 2: These foundational objectives—to construct a novel measure of corporate EEO commitment and to understand the drivers of these practices—have been fully and successfully achieved. The project's core innovation is the creation of a validated, text-based measure derived from the sentiment and originality of EEO statements in online job postings (using Burning Glass Technologies data and the VADER algorithm). This measure was then operationalized to investigate fundamental economic influences. The findings are robustly presented in the project's outputs: the first paper demonstrates the measure's utility in tracing the diffusion of EEO practices through supply chains, while the second paper employs it to link corporate equality to consumer spending and innovation. Therefore, these objectives are not merely achieved but have yielded significant scholarly contributions. Regarding Objective 3 (Institutional Investor Preferences): During the research process, we made a pivotal discovery that redirected our inquiry. We found that the EEO preferences of buy-side and sell-side financial institutions are not necessarily autonomous or leading indicators. Instead, our analysis revealed that institutional preferences largely mirror those of a firm's core operational stakeholders—specifically consumers and supply-chain partners ("Main Street"). This insight was further substantiated by findings in a related thesis chapter, which indicated that institutional investors cater to their clients' prosocial preferences following societal shocks like the BLM movement. Consequently, we concluded that to understand the true drivers of corporate EEO behavior, we must first decode the influence of these primary stakeholders. This logical progression led us to dig deeper for Objective 3 in favor of the more foundational economic reasons of EEO, which are thoroughly examined in our finalized papers on supply chain diffusion and conscious consumers. The implication is clear: once the EEO preferences of consumers and supply-chain partners are accounted for, the behavior of Wall Street institutions largely aligns with traditional value-maximization principles, reflecting rather than determining mainstream stakeholder values. Regarding Objective 4 (EEO Washing): This objective was not fully achieved, primarily due to a significant shift in the empirical landscape during the project timeline. Our data revealed that the pronounced trend in corporate EEO statements, which peaked around the 2020 Black Lives Matter event, gradually vanished during the second term of the Trump presidency. This societal and regulatory backlash created a diverging shareholder opinion on EEO, materially reducing firms' incentives to engage in "EEO washing" for reputational gain. With the fading of the strong social pressure that might motivate symbolic rather than substantive commitment, the central phenomenon we aimed to investigate lost its empirical prominence. Therefore, pursuing this objective became less viable and less critical to understanding the core, enduring mechanisms of EEO adoption, which we successfully captured through our focus on supply-chain and consumer channels.

14506522.label: Major findings and research outcome
14506522.value: This project constructs a novel measure of corporate commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) by analyzing the sentiment of EEO statements within online job postings, using data from Burning Glass Technologies. The measure, derived from the VADER algorithm, quantifies the enthusiasm and originality of a firm's stated commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). Our original aim was to assess how the EEO preferences of buy-side and sell-side financial institutions shape corporate practices. However, we encountered three pivotal challenges: EEO trend peaked around 2020 BLM event and gradually vanished during Trump's second presidency (the reason to terminate Objective 4); a crowded field of contemporaneous competing research on institutional EEO preferences (the reason to terminate Objective 3); and the key realization that Wall Street's preferences largely mirror those of core corporate stakeholders—specifically consumers and supply-chain partners ("Main Street"). Consequently, we redirected our focus to investigate these more fundamental influences from major stakeholders. Our first paper, "Equal Employment Opportunity in Supply Chain" (published in Production and Operations Management, 2025), examines the diffusion of EEO practices through supply chains. We document a lead-lag pattern, where principal customers' EEO commitments are followed by those of their dependent suppliers. This effect strengthens with customer bargaining power, indicating suppliers cater to client preferences. Using the 2017 "Big Three" investor diversity campaign for causal identification, we show that this diffusion enhances female employee retention, revealing significant social benefits alongside economic motives. The second paper, "Rise of Conscious Consumers" (under review), explores how consumer EEO preferences impact corporate behavior. We find a positive correlation between corporate workplace equality and household spending, driven by two channels. The preference channel is evidenced by stronger correlations following exogenous shocks to social consciousness, like the #MeToo and Black Lives Matter movements, particularly among minority groups. The innovation channel shows that workplace equality predicts higher patent output and quality, and the correlation with spending is more pronounced in innovative industries. A chapter of my PhD student Hanru Han's thesis, "Do Investors Value Corporate Workforce Equality?", finds that investors revise their beliefs about equality and diversity risks following the massive BLM movement. Second, investors’ tastes for corporate equality strengthened after the 2020 BLM movement. Third, institutional investors cater to their clients’ prosocial preferences.

14506522.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14506522.value: 1. Publish the second paper from this project. 2. Use the same methodology to identify other important social trends in job posts, such as political ideology alignment or AI adoption. 3. EEO is clearly vanishing in Trump's second presidency. While it is no longer possible to study EEO washing, we can use the measure to examine the determinants of EEO backlash across US firms.

14506522.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14506522.value: This research creates a new way to measure a company’s genuine commitment to equal opportunity by using an algorithm to analyze the tone of EEO statements in job posts. Originally focused on Wall Street investors, the team found a more powerful driver of change: the everyday demands of consumers and business partners. Three key findings reveal this impact. First, corporate equality practices spread through supply chains. When a major company commits to diversity, its suppliers tend to follow suit, especially if that customer has significant leverage. This leads to tangible benefits, like improved retention of female employees. Second, “conscious consumers” reward fair workplaces with their spending. This effect surged after major social movements like #MeToo and Black Lives Matter, particularly among minority groups. Companies with fairer workplaces were also found to be more innovative. Third, the 2020 BLM movement fundamentally shifted investor behavior, making them more attentive to diversity risks and more likely to align with their clients’ social values. Ultimately, this research demonstrates that the push for workplace equality is being driven from the ground up, not just by corporate policy, creating real social and economic benefits.

14506622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506622.value: Platforms are becoming increasingly dominant in the operations of marketplaces. While facilitating online transactions, well-known platforms such as Amazon, Alibaba, and Jingdong start to directly participate in competitions by offering products of their own brands. This raises significant antitrust concerns about whether the platforms become too centralized, which can hurt the consumers in the marketplaces. In this project, we consider a platform that manages a networked marketplace with both third-party sellers and platform-owned sellers. Sellers and buyers are divided into different types, and we represent the compatibility between different types with a bipartite graph. Different sellers and buyers are heterogeneous in their costs and preferences. The platform has an objective of maximizing its profit from two components in the marketplace: (1) the direct sales from the platform-owned sellers, and (2) the commissions from the transactions of the other sellers. While maximizing its profit, the platform needs to guarantee the social welfare of the third-party sellers and the buyers. To model the transactions in the marketplace, we consider a general equilibrium setting. The outcome of the equilibrium can be impacted by the platform's decisions. As the problem includes complex equilibrium constraints, the profit maximization problem with a welfare guarantee is not straightforward. We plan to investigate whether there is a tractable formulation for the profit-maximizing equilibrium with a guarantee on the participants' welfare. One of the goals is to shed light on the antitrust discussions about the impact of the platform's participation in transactions. Moreover, we want to investigate how the network positions of the sellers and the buyers impact the platform's profit performance given different levels of social welfare guarantee. Besides this, we are interested in what types of sellers the platform should include in its own brand for profit maximization purpose. Finally, we plan to collect data from companies and provide managerial insight based on the data. 平台在市場運營中的主導地位越來越重要。儘管促進在線交易，知名平台，如亞馬遜、阿里巴巴和京東開始通過提供自己的產品直接參加比賽品牌。這引發了對平台是否成為過於集中，這可能會傷害市場上的消費者。在這個項目中，我們考慮一個管理網絡市場的平台，同時第三方賣家和平台自有賣家。賣家和買家分為不同的類型，我們用 a 表示不同類型之間的兼容性二分圖。不同的賣家和買家的成本和成本是異質的喜好。該平台的目標是從兩個組件中最大化其利潤 在市場上：（1）來自平台擁有的賣家的直接銷售，以及（2）來自其他賣家交易的佣金。在實現利潤最大化的同時，平台需要保障第三方賣家和買家的社會福利。 為了模擬市場交易，我們考慮一般均衡設置。平衡的結果可能會受到平台決策的影響。作為問題包括複雜的均衡約束，利潤最大化問題福利保障並不簡單。我們計劃調查是否存在利潤最大化均衡的易處理公式，並保證參與者的福利。目標之一是闡明關於反壟斷的討論平台參與交易的影響。此外，我們希望調查賣家和買家的網絡位置如何影響平台的不同程度的社會福利保障下的利潤表現。除此之外，我們是對平台應在自有品牌中包含哪些類型的賣家以獲取利潤感興趣 最大化的目的。最後，我們計劃從公司收集數據並提供基於數據的管理的啟示。

14506722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506722.value: 基於消費的併購模型：對併購浪潮的影響

14506722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506722.value: It is well documented that mergers and acquisitions (M&A) activities cluster within industries and over time, which is referred to as merger waves. It is important for us to understand what drives merger waves, because M&A transactions are arguably the most influential form of investments that reallocate capitals across firms. To understand the impacts from macroeconomic conditions, we plans to develop and estimate a consumption-based structural model of M&A, which generate the countercyclical market risk premium and procyclcial interest rate. Intuitively, the market volatility is countercyclical. That is, the market volatility is high in bad times and low in good times. Intuitively, the countercyclical market volatility and market risk premium help to generate the procyclical merger waves, because firms are precautionary and therefore reluctant to make investments in response to heightening market uncertainty in bad times. However, the interest rate is procyclical. A low interest rate in bad times implies a low financing cost for investments, therefore boosting M&A activities. Thus, this positive effect from the low interest rate might offset the negative effect from the heightened market volatility and risk premium. It is not clear that merger activities will be dampened during recessions, without rigorously evaluating their relative impacts. In this research, we use the consumption-based valuation framework to discipline the magnitude of the interest rate and the market risk premium, because the aggregate consumption determines the interest rate and market risk premium in equilibrium. We plan to quantitatively assess the interaction between macroeconomic conditions and aggregate merger activities. 有據可查的是，併購活動會隨著時間的推移在行業內聚集，這被稱為併購浪潮。了解推動合併浪潮的因素對我們來說很重要，因為併購交易可以說是在公司間重新分配資本的最具影響力的投資形式。 為了解宏觀經濟條件的影響，我們計劃開發和估計基於消費的併購結構模型，該模型產生逆週期市場風險溢價和順週期利率。直覺上，市場波動是反週期的。也就是說，市場波動性在壞時高，在好時低。直觀地說，逆週期市場波動和市場風險溢價有助於產生順週期的合併浪潮，因為公司是預防性的，因此不願進行投資以應對經濟不景氣時市場不確定性的加劇。 然而，利率是順週期性的。糟糕時期的低利率意味著投資的融資成本低，因此促進了併購活動。因此，低利率帶來的積極影響可能會抵消市場波動加劇和風險溢價帶來的消極影響。在不嚴格評估其相對影響的情況下，尚不清楚合併活動是否會在衰退期間受到抑制。 在本研究中，我們使用基於消費的估值框架來約束利率和市場風險溢價的大小，因為總消費決定了均衡的利率和市場風險溢價。我們計劃定量評估宏觀經濟條件與總體併購活動之間的相互作用。

14506922.value: 本研究將考察監管信息環境對中國 P2P 借貸平台大規模崩潰的影響。在創辦初期，這些網貸平台被看成是可以服務於中國金融體系和填補傳統銀行空缺的金融創新，獲得了廣泛讚譽，因此並沒有得到嚴格有效的監管。然而，在過去十年中，中國出現了大規模的 P2P 借貸平台倒閉事件，這促使當局對該行業提出了一系列的監管與打擊。截止2020年11月，幾乎所有運營平台都已全部清零。平台數量急劇上升和下降同時也意味著是金融科技行業受到的監管和監控的不足。 本研究擬使用中國 P2P 借貸平台的獨特數據集，以平台與當地監管機構的物理距離作為“監管距離”的衡量，研究調查信息環境在監管監控和平台倒閉率中的作用。我們假設隨著監管距離的增加，監管機構與平台之間的信息不對稱會加劇，從而導致監管監控更少，平台倒閉率更高。 由於 P2P 借貸平台的選址是非隨機的，有可能那些遠離當地金融機構的平台是為了有意躲避監管審查，從而使其隱藏的欺詐活動不那麼容易察覺。為了解決這種內生性問題，我們借鑒Duchin et al. (2020)以及 Ehrlich & Seidel (2018) 的方法進行雙重差分(DID) 分析。我們將使用如下兩個外生衝擊：1）政府辦公室的搬遷； 2）地方金融辦與P2P借貸平台之間運輸成本的突然變化，來建立監管距離與 P2P 借貸平台崩潰之間的因果關係。 總體而言，本研究強調了獲取本地軟信息的重要性，論證了監管機構的監控與指導對確保金融科技公司的生存能力的重要性。關於金融科技和 P2P 借貸的先前文獻主要研究了借款人和貸款人之間的信息不對稱，很少有研究檢查對於平臺本身的監控和監管。 我們的研究還對金融市場中軟信息與硬信息的這部分文獻做出貢獻。由於中國的金融科技公司沒有硬性規定需要向公眾發布財務報表，對很多市場參與者來說，特別是投資者和監管機構，平台的運營和風險管理相對不透明。當硬信息難以獲得時，市場參與者收集特定環境的軟信息變得尤為重要。我們的研究將展示監管距離在軟信息傳輸和收集中的作用，為中國金融科技行業的監管提供獨特見解。為了達到更為有效的監管，我們提議地方金融監管部門需要與金融科技公司保持及時的監控和溝通。

14506922.label: Realisation of objectives
14506922.value: All the objectives outlined in the original proposal have been successfully achieved. 1) Soft Information and Regulatory Monitoring: We investigated how soft information facilitates regulatory monitoring in China's FinTech sector, particularly in P2P lending platforms. Our findings demonstrate that proximity between regulators and platforms enhances oversight and reduces information asymmetry. 2) Regulation-Related Information Environment & Platform Collapse: We examined the impact of the regulatory information environment on P2P platform stability, using geographic distance as a proxy for information opacity. The results confirm that closer regulatory proximity reduces collapse likelihood. 3 & 4) Soft Information & Collapse Likelihood: We formulated and tested the hypothesis that greater soft information collection (proxied by physical proximity) decreases platform failures. Empirical evidence supports that closer regulator-platform distance improves monitoring effectiveness and communication. 5) Causal Identification via DID Analysis: Using differences-in-differences (DID) methodology, we established causality by exploiting exogenous shocks—government office relocations and transportation cost changes—to confirm that a stronger information environment reduces collapse rates. 6) Fraud Detection via Big Data: We developed a statistical detection method leveraging big data analytics to identify fraudulent loan requests in P2P lending, enhancing risk assessment capabilities. 7) Contribution to Literature: Our research bridges gaps in the literature by differentiating the roles of soft and hard information in financial regulation, particularly in FinTech and P2P lending.

14506922.label: Major findings and research outcome
14506922.value: Our study provides robust empirical evidence on the critical role of government monitoring in ensuring the stability of fintech firms, with a focus on China's P2P lending platforms. The key findings and contributions are as follows: 1. Proximity Matters for Platform Survival: We demonstrate that a 10% increase in driving distance between P2P platforms and regulatory offices leads to a 0.071% higher likelihood of platform collapse, highlighting the importance of close regulatory oversight. 2. Causal Evidence via Exogenous Shocks: Using a difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we establish causality by exploiting two exogenous shocks: 1) Government office relocations, which altered regulatory distances. 2) Subway station openings, which reduced transportation costs and improved monitoring efficiency. These natural experiments confirm that reduced regulatory distance lowers collapse risk. 3. Mechanisms: Information and Resource Constraints: We identify two key channels through which regulatory distance affects platform stability: 1) Information exchange: Closer proximity facilitates better communication and soft information collection. 2) Resource constraints: Distant regulators face higher costs in conducting inspections and enforcement. 4. Policy Implications for Fintech Regulation: Our findings underscore the importance of onsite monitoring in sustaining online lending platforms, suggesting that regulators should optimize their geographical distribution to enhance oversight effectiveness. These major findings and results have been disseminated through conference presentations and peer-reviewed publications, with additional manuscripts under review. The study contributes to the broader discourse on fintech regulation, offering actionable insights for policymakers seeking to balance innovation with financial stability.

14506922.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14506922.value: This study opens several promising avenues for future research and practical applications in fintech regulation. Extending this analysis to other fintech sectors—such as digital banking, cryptocurrency exchanges, and crowdfunding platforms—could reveal whether similar geographical dynamics influence their stability. Comparative studies across different regulatory jurisdictions, including the U.S., EU, and emerging markets, would further illuminate how institutional frameworks shape monitoring effectiveness. Beyond physical distance, future research should explore alternative measures of regulatory oversight, such as the frequency of on-site inspections and the adoption of digital monitoring tools. Advanced techniques like machine learning could analyze unstructured regulatory reports or news data to quantify monitoring intensity more precisely. From a policy perspective, collaborating with regulators to design experiments—such as optimizing the geographical distribution of supervisory offices or testing RegTech solutions like AI-driven compliance checks—could yield actionable insights. To advance this agenda, we propose forging partnerships with financial authorities and fintech firms to access richer datasets, securing funding for cross-country comparisons, and developing predictive models to simulate regulatory impacts under different monitoring regimes. By pursuing these directions, this research can evolve into a robust framework for fintech regulation.

14506922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14506922.value: This research looked at how close government regulators need to be to effectively monitor online lending platforms in China. We discovered that when these platforms are located farther away from regulators, they're more likely to fail. Just a 10% increase in distance raises the collapse risk by 0.07%. Why does this matter? Because it shows that physical proximity helps regulators do their job better - they can gather more accurate information and respond faster to problems. We proved this by studying what happened when government offices moved or new subway stations opened, which naturally changed how easy it was for regulators to visit platforms. Our findings are especially important as more financial services move online. They suggest regulators should either locate offices near fintech companies or develop better digital tools for remote monitoring. This could help prevent platform failures and protect investors worldwide. The study provides concrete evidence for policymakers trying to balance innovation with consumer protection in fast-growing digital finance markets. It also offers a model that could be applied to other types of financial technology beyond just lending platforms.

14507122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507122.value: Censorship—the suppression or prohibition of speech or writing—is a hallmark of authoritarian regimes, which influences citizens’ beliefs, attitude, and preferences and shapes aggregate outcomes, such as economic growth. Nevertheless, knowledge of the impact of censorship on the creation and diffusion of knowledge is very limited. The proposed study will focus on the creation of the Siku Quanshu (Complete Library in Four Branches of Literature), the largest collection of books in Chinese history, and identify the effects of censorship on knowledge production in historical China. The creation of the Siku Quanshu began in approximately 1772, and the first version was completed in 1784. Massive censorship accompanied the creation of this encyclopedia, during which thousands of books were banned, edited, or censored. We will divide the books into 44 categories, count how many were included in and excluded from the Siku Quanshu, and then calculate the share of excluded books of the total number of books in each category as a proxy for censorship. We hypothesize that after the Siku Quanshu was established, due to the self-censorship of scholars and publishers, book categories with a higher level of censorship yielded less knowledge, as measured by the number of books printed in each category annually. While the Qing dynasty was conducting this massive censorship campaign, Europe was experiencing the intellectual and philosophical movement known as the Enlightenment. An influential type of publication that emerged from and spread the ideas of the Enlightenment across Europe and beyond was the encyclopedia, which contributed to the advent of the First Industrial Revolution. Although the main target of censorship in China was books reflecting anti-Manchu sentiment, many works on science and technology were also banned. We will focus specifically on science and technology to examine the extent to which censorship decreased the production of useful knowledge. The findings may shed light on why China failed to spearhead its own industrial revolution and explain the so-called “Great Divergence” between China and Europe in the 19th century. Moreover, this study will also provide insights into censorship in general. 審查制度——壓制或禁止言論或寫作——是專制政權的重要標誌。 它影響公民的信仰、態度和偏好，並塑造經濟增長等總體經濟指標。 然而，關於審查制度如何影響知識的創造和傳播的研究卻非常有限。 擬議的研究將關注於中國歷史上最大的藏書《四庫全書》，以此為例研究審查制度對中國歷史知識生產的影響。 《四庫全書》的創作大約始於1772年，第一個版本於1784年完成。 伴隨著這本百科全書的創建，清朝政府進行了大規模的文化審查。 在此期間，成千上萬的書籍被禁止，編輯或修改。 本研究專案將會把所有書籍分為四十四類，計算有多少被納入和排除在四庫全書之外，進而計算排除書籍佔所有書籍的比例。 比例越高意味著此類書籍受到更嚴厲的審查，而嚴厲的審查也會對後繼此類書籍的創作和傳播產生負面影響。 當清朝進行這場大規模的審查運動時，歐洲正在經歷啟蒙運動。 這一運動為第一次工業革命的到來做出了重要貢獻。 雖然清中國審查的主要目標是反映反滿情緒的書籍，但許多關於科學和技術的作品也被禁止。 我們將特別關注科學和技術類書籍，評估審查制度在多大程度上減少了此類知識的產生。 這些發現能够解釋為什麼中國未能引領自己的工業革命，並有助於我們理解十九世紀中國和歐洲之間的“大分流”。

14507222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507222.value: China's property rights are often considered insecure and poorly enforced, potentially jeopardizing prosperity of the Chinese economy. Despite the undisputable pre-eminence of property rights, there are surprisingly few attempts to measure its enforcement in urban China. This project aims to fill the blank. Moreover, we will investigate the underlying forces that determine the evolution of property rights protection in recent China. We will also estimate empirically the effects of changes in property rights protection and evaluate quantitatively their welfare implications. We will extract information from hundreds of thousands of judicial documents about lawsuits between creditors (plaintiffs) and debtors (defendants). A comprehensive set of indicators including the number of the lawsuits, their durations, the recovery of the debt and the extent to which court decisions are fair and impartial will be used to measure property rights protection. The large pool of judicial data allows us to capture rich heterogeneity across regions, ownerships and over time. We will construct province-year-specific indices that keep track of the evolution of property rights protection in the province. We will also construct indices conditional on the characteristics of debtors and creditors. This will be done by matching the debtors and creditors with firm registration records from China's State Administration for Market Regulation and other firm-level datasets. The independence of property rights protection can thus be examined by testing whether court decisions are affected by the characteristics of debtors and creditors. It is particularly interesting to measure the favor China's judicial system gives to state-owned enterprises and its recent changes. Some preliminary results suggest that property rights protections have improved significantly in recent years. The next question is to understand why. Some important reforms on the judicial system were implemented in the last decade. These reforms were first experimented in some cities and then gradually rolled out to the whole country. These cross-city and over-time variations allow us to test if the reforms improve the measured property rights protections. Using, again, the same cross-city and over-time variations, we will also try to estimate the effects of a more secure property rights on firm entry and growth. Finally, we will use a calibrated dynamic general equilibrium model to evaluate the welfare implications of the improved property rights protection in recent China. 中國的產權通常被認為不安全且執行不力，可能危及中國經濟的繁榮。儘管產權具有無可爭議的卓越地位，但令人驚訝的是，很少有人嘗試衡量其在中國的執法情況。本項目旨在填補空白。此外，我們還將研究決定中國近期產權保護演變的潛在力量。我們還將根據經驗估計產權保護變化的影響，並定量評估其福利影響。

14507222.label: Realisation of objectives
14507222.value: Constructing regional indices of property rights protection using online judicial documents faces big challenges because of the unanticipated change in the data availability. As stated in the mid-term report, “the number of judicial documents involving individual businesses declined from about 250 thousand in 2019 to 82 thousand in 2022, indicating the sharp decline in the coverage … The deteriorating data completeness and representativeness also hinder the progress of our research on the implications of property rights protection.” In addition, we have been advised by various legal experts avoiding using judicial documents to quantify property rights in China. Therefore, we decided to remove “property rights protection” from our objectives and focus entirely on the rise of tens of millions of individual business owners (IBO) and its welfare implications. While private property rights are not directly measured, the remarkable surge in IBO in the second half of the 2010s would be inconceivable without strong private property rights protections. Our evidence for effective internal self-financing through intertemporal consumption-saving adjustments and external financing through fintech lending also rejects weak private property rights protections for IBO in China. Objective 1: Extract information from hundreds of thousands of judicial documents and individual-level data from millions of small business owners to construct city-specific indices of property rights protection and financial frictions. On this data part, we put together the universe of business registration records from China's State Administration for Market Regulation, covering 77.9 million registration records as of year-end 2023, transaction-level data of 30 million active “Mashang” (merchants utilizing QR code–based payment systems) from Alipay's digital payment service aggregated to 42 thousand Chinese urban polygons at weekly frequency, and a random sample of 5 million active Mashang with detailed individual-level daily data. This rich dataset enables us to conduct sophisticated empirical analyses at multiple levels of granularity — from highly localized urban polygons down to individual merchant establishments — at daily and weekly frequencies. Objective 2: Reveal the underlying forces for regional heterogeneity in property rights protection and financial frictions. Objective 3: Estimate the effects of property rights protection and financial frictions on business entry and growth. We show that both internal and external financing contribute to Mashang's expansion in response to business opportunities. The spatial reallocation of consumption toward areas with new shopping malls would not benefit local Mashang (a key empirical finding for our quantitative analysis that will be reported below) if financial frictions prevented them from expanding in response to emerging business opportunities. Our unique access to highly granular Mashang transaction data combined with county-level lending information across various financing channels enables empirical and quantitative analyses previously unfeasible. We estimate the severity of working capital constraints by examining how Mashang owners adjust their consumption-saving behavior in anticipation of future business opportunities. Our identification strategy employs upcoming national holidays as predictable demand shocks, leveraging regional variation in exposure to holiday-related business surges due to spatial differences in business compositions. We quantify the results in a dynamic model and find that working capital constraints can be significantly mitigated by Mashang's self-financing and external fintech financing mitigate, both contributing to Mashang's resilience to shocks. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations indicate that in the absence of the external financing mechanisms, the welfare gains from the entry of Mashang would be reduced by 2.1 percent. Objective 4: Calibrate a dynamic general equilibrium model to evaluate quantitatively the welfare implications of the improved property rights protection and financial frictions in recent China. On this measurement part, we develop a spatial equilibrium model and derive a tractable welfare formula, from which welfare gains can be transparently measured. In the formula, within- and between-location elasticities of substitution play a central role. To identify the two elasticities, we use local projections to estimate the impact of new shopping mall opening to Mashang’s revenue conditional on their distance to the new mall: Mashang within 1km experience a significant 4% revenue increase, with this effect diminishing with distance and becoming negative beyond 5km. Through the lens of the model, the spatial gradients of the impacts are determined by within- and between-location elasticities of substitution, which can therefore be inferred from the empirical results. Counterfactuals reveal sizable, spatially heterogeneous welfare gains from both new malls and Mashang entry. At the aggregate level, reducing the number of Mashang establishments by 50 percent at the end of 2018 — equivalent to the annual change in IBO that year — would decrease aggregate welfare by 2 percent. Eliminating mall entry during the same year — representing a 2.5 percent reduction in mall stock — would reduce aggregate welfare by 1.3 percent.

14507222.label: Major findings and research outcome
14507222.value: The main research output of this project is the paper: “Measuring Gains from New Services: Evidence from Millions of Individual Business Owners”. Our study on the empirical estimation of elasticities of substitution and the measurement of welfare gains also spillovers to the paper “Non-Tariff Barriers in the US-China Trade War”, which has been conditionally accepted by AEJ Macro. China has undergone rapid tertiarization since the mid-2000s. The number of individual business owners (IBO) in China increased from 3.5 to 16 million between 2014 and 2019, with more than 80 percent of them concentrated in consumer services. However, the welfare implications of this proliferation of service providers remain ambiguous. When consumer demand can be spatially reallocated, new services may generate positive agglomeration effects by attracting customer inflows that benefit incumbent services in the same area. Yet this very agglomeration mechanism simultaneously creates negative spillover effects for incumbent service providers in adjacent localities, as demand is diverted away from these neighboring areas. In this project, we develop a parsimonious spatial equilibrium model to analyze these mechanisms and to measure the gains from new services. The quantitative results hinge on within- and cross-location elasticities of substitution. To estimate the elasticities, we exploit the openings of new shopping malls as quasi-natural experiments affecting incumbent Mashang revenues in both proximate and neighboring areas. Our empirical results show that Mashang within 1km experience a significant 4% revenue increase, with this effect diminishing with distance and becoming negative beyond 5km. This distinctive spatial pattern, characterized by both the positive local effect and the gradient of effects relative to distance, enables us to identify the within- and between-locality elasticities of substitution. We next conduct counterfactual analyses to quantify welfare gains from new service providers. Our first show that reducing the number of Mashang establishments by 50 percent at the end of 2018 — equivalent to the annual change in IBO that year — would decrease aggregate welfare by 2 percent. We also find that the welfare impact of new service establishments exhibits substantial spatial heterogeneity within and across cities. The spatial reallocation of consumption toward areas with new shopping malls would not benefit local Mashang if financial frictions prevented them from expanding in response to emerging business opportunities. We estimate the severity of working capital constraints by examining how Mashang owners adjust their consumption-saving behavior in anticipation of future business opportunities. Our identification strategy employs upcoming national holidays as predictable demand shocks. We find that working capital constraints can be significantly mitigated by Mashang's self-financing and external fintech financing mitigate, both contributing to Mashang's resilience to shocks. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations indicate that in the absence of the external financing mechanisms, the welfare gains from the entry of Mashang would be reduced by 2.1 percent.

14507222.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14507222.value: This project introduces a transparent framework for measuring welfare gains from new service providers in a spatial equilibrium context. We find substantial welfare gains from the massive entry of new service establishments. The strong local agglomeration effect serves as a cornerstone of our quantitative findings. However, this effect deserves further investigation, as small service providers' capacity to capitalize on local agglomeration opportunities cannot be taken for granted. Our research reveals that both internal and external financing alleviate working capital constraints for Mashang establishments, suggesting that policies aimed at reducing financial frictions could substantially amplify the local agglomeration effect and thereby enhance welfare gains from service sector expansion. Our model also allows us to evaluate the spatial allocation efficiency of shopping malls and Mashang establishments. Both the variety effect and spatial reallocation of consumer demand generate significant externalities that are not internalized by individual service providers, leading to socially suboptimal spatial distribution of these establishments in the spatial equilibrium. We leave this for future study.

14507222.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14507222.value: We measure welfare gains from the rapid expansion of new services in China using transaction data from 30 millions of digitally enabled active individual business owners (“Mashang”) across 42 thousand urban polygons. A parsimonious spatial equilibrium model decomposes gains into the standard variety effect and a spatial consumption reallocation effect, with the latter governed by within- and between-locality elasticities of substitution. We identify these elasticities by estimating the spatial impacts of new shopping mall openings on Mashang sales: Mashang within 1km experience a significant 4% revenue increase, with this effect diminishing with distance and becoming negative beyond 5km. The strong local agglomeration effect implies services are more substitutable across localities than within localities. Counterfactuals reveal sizable, spatially heterogeneous welfare gains from both new malls and Mashang entry. We also show that both internal and external financing contribute to Mashang's expansion in response to business opportunities.

14507322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507322.value: 在美國，製藥行業經常出現在新聞和公眾關注中——有時是出於錯誤的原因。儘管製藥公司在創新、為消費者提供新藥和延長壽命（開發 Covid-19 疫苗的反應速度就是一個例子）方面取得了顯著成功，但他們也被指控在以下情況下收取非常高的價格專利保護。 但是，專利的授予期限有限（在美國為 20 年），並且藥物需要大量時間才能通過所有試驗階段並獲得美國食品和藥物管理局 (FDA) 的批准，然後才能上市。上市，這佔用了可用於專利保護的時間。儘管任何新藥都有一段獨占期（最長 7 年），但在藥物上市後不久，專利到期就迫在眉睫。專利到期導致仿製藥進入，利潤被壓低至接近於零。在美國，2010 年後的時期，非常多的製藥公司面臨著許多主要藥物的保護期到期，這種現像被稱為“專利懸崖”。 專利到期的獨特之處在於，它們代表了對利潤的外生負面衝擊，這些衝擊是提前知道的。公司有多種選擇來為此類衝擊做準備，例如，更多地投資於研發和開發新藥，收購其他公司的藥物組合有很長的到期時間（或有前途的藥物），等等。雖然成功的公司能夠駕馭自己的專利懸崖，但不成功的公司需要產生更多的內部現金流。 這些不成功的公司籌集更多內部資金（用於研發或安全方面的更多投資）的一種方法是提高藥品價格。然而，他們面臨摩擦，因為更高的價格導致“憤怒”，並受到保險公司的抵制，他們可能威脅要將該藥物置於其“處方”的不利“層級”，這意味著更多的自付費用消費者。因此，製藥公司的議價能力——尤其是那些在新藥開發或收購方面運氣不佳的公司——很可能在其提高價格、繼續創新和/或在未被收購的情況下生存的能力方面發揮重要作用。 在本文中，我們計劃使用關於藥品價格和銷售的新數據，以及來自 FDA 關於藥品引入、專利保護和仿製藥進入（以及其他特徵）的數據來研究藥品價格如何變化導致專利懸崖，具體取決於該公司現有的專利組合、正在開發的藥物管道以及與保險公司的議價能力。因此，我們的研究將產品價格與財務約束和公司的議價能力在粒度層面上聯繫起來。我們假設當大公司（具有更大的議價能力）遭遇專利懸崖（以不成功的管道為條件）時，他們可以提高藥品價格。當小企業（沒有議價能力）受到打擊時，它們無法提高價格來支持後續創新，從而成為低收購溢價的收購目標，採取收購防禦措施，更有可能破產。這樣的結果意味著，當前的知識產權保護製度鼓勵了大型製藥公司的形成，這些公司可以更好地利用專利保護所賦予的議價和市場力量。

14507322.label: Realisation of objectives
14507322.value: The research project, culminating in the paper "Cannibalization, Competition, and New Product Introductions," has successfully addressed its core objectives by providing robust empirical evidence on how brand-name pharmaceutical firms respond to generic competition. Using Paragraph IV challenges as a quasi-natural experiment, the study demonstrates that competitive threats accelerate innovation. The central finding is that this response is driven not by entry deterrence, but by the mitigation of the incumbent’s own cannibalization costs. This overview details how each of the four primary objectives was systematically fulfilled. Objective 1: Study manufacturer responses to generic entry threats (marketing, pricing, and new product launches). This objective was comprehensively met by establishing a clear causal link between the threat of generic entry and the subsequent strategic actions of incumbent firms. New Product Launches & Marketing: The study’s central finding is that a Paragraph IV challenge prompts incumbents to accelerate new product launches. Challenged firms showed a 2.9 percentage point higher quarterly launch likelihood (a 40.8% increase), an effect concentrated in products within the same therapeutic category where cannibalization risk is highest (Table 4). This acceleration of the "market launch"—the first appearance of sales—inherently reflects an intensification of the entire commercialization process, including marketing and distribution, as firms work to migrate customers to a new, patent-protected product. Pricing Strategies: The project found that firms simultaneously employ a "harvesting" strategy for the threatened drug. Following a new product launch triggered by a Paragraph IV event, the unit price of the original, challenged drug significantly increases (Table 6). This is interpreted as an attempt to maximize revenue from the remaining loyal customer base, demonstrating a sophisticated, multi-pronged response to competitive pressure. Objective 2: Specifically examine responses to Paragraph IV challenges. The research design was centered on this objective, using Paragraph IV challenges as a clean, exogenous shock to competition. Methodology: A robust stacked difference-in-differences (DID) design was employed to ensure causal inference. Each "treated" drug line that received a Paragraph IV challenge was matched with three "control" drug lines from different firms with the closest ex-ante probability of being challenged. This process balanced key characteristics like sales potential and patent strength, isolating the effect of the challenge itself (Table 3). Dynamic Effects: The model's validity was confirmed through dynamic analysis, which showed no pre-existing trends in launch behavior between the groups. The increase in product launches begins only after the Paragraph IV event, typically within six months, reinforcing a direct causal link between the threat and the strategic response (Figure 1). Objective 3: Focus on the strategy of “product hopping.” The project directly investigated this strategy and, in doing so, produced a novel finding that significantly refines the concept of "product hopping." Distinguishing Innovation from ‘Hopping’: The study carefully distinguished between "line extensions" (new versions with the same active pharmaceutical ingredient, or API, akin to traditional product hopping) and more innovative "new product lines" (different API in the same therapeutic class). Key Finding: The analysis in Table 4 reveals that the accelerated launch effect is statistically significant and economically large for new product lines. In contrast, the launch rate for simple line extensions remained statistically unchanged. This pivotal finding shows that the primary response to a competitive threat is to accelerate the commercialization of a substantively new therapy, not just a trivially modified version of the old drug. This reframes the strategic response as a pro-competitive acceleration of creative destruction rather than a simple anti-competitive tactic. Objective 4: Uncover an “entry deterrence” component. This objective was rigorously tested, leading to a conclusion that challenges the initial premise of entry deterrence and provides a more compelling alternative explanation. Empirical Disproof of Entry Deterrence: The project tested the entry deterrence hypothesis and found evidence to the contrary. New product launches following a Paragraph IV challenge were not associated with a lower likelihood of actual generic entry. In fact, they were correlated with a higher likelihood and faster arrival of the generic competitor (Internet Appendix Table IA6). Uncovering the True Mechanism: Having ruled out entry deterrence, the paper advances and proves a more powerful explanation: the alleviation of cannibalization costs. A Paragraph IV challenge devalues the future expected profits of an incumbent’s existing drug. This dramatically lowers the opportunity cost (the "cannibalization cost") of launching a new, substitute product from the pipeline. The launch is therefore a rational reallocation of resources toward a new source of profit once the old one is credibly threatened. The fact that these new launches were found to decrease sales of the threatened drug before the generic competitor even entered the market provides direct evidence of this cannibalization effect at work. Conclusion In summary, the research project has fulfilled the grant application's objectives. It provides detailed evidence on how brand-name firms respond to Paragraph IV challenges through accelerated product launches and strategic pricing. Crucially, the research refines the initial hypotheses, demonstrating that the strategic response favors the launch of genuinely innovative therapies over simple "product hopping," and that this response is driven by the mitigation of cannibalization costs, not entry deterrence. The findings highlight a critical channel through which competition fosters creative destruction and accelerates the delivery of innovation to consumers.

14507322.label: Major findings and research outcome
14507322.value: This research examines how concerns about "cannibalization"—where a new product erodes the sales of a firm's existing products—shape corporate product launch strategies. The central argument, supported by evidence from the pharmaceutical industry, is that the threat of competition significantly reduces these cannibalization concerns, thereby accelerating the commercialization of new innovations. The study's empirical setting focuses on Paragraph IV certifications, which are legal filings by generic manufacturers signaling their intent to challenge a brand-name drug's patent. This event serves as a competitive shock that lowers the expected future revenue of the incumbent's existing drug, thus decreasing the opportunity cost of cannibalizing it with a new pipeline product. The primary finding is that following a Paragraph IV challenge, incumbent firms become significantly more likely to launch new products. Specifically, the quarterly launch likelihood increases by 2.9 percentage points, representing a substantial 40.8% rise over the baseline rate. These accelerated launches are concentrated in the same therapeutic category as the threatened drug, indicating they are direct substitutes. The study provides compelling evidence of this cannibalization in action: the sales of the threatened drug subsequently decline, but this effect is observed only when the firm introduces one of these new, related products. The authors rigorously test and rule out alternative explanations, such as shifts in market demand, reverse causality, or entry-deterrence motives. Furthermore, the research uncovers that firms often strategically delay the market launch of already FDA-approved drugs, with an average post-approval delay of 1.46 years. This delay is found to be longer when a firm's existing products in the same category are highly profitable (i.e., when cannibalization costs are high) but is significantly shortened once a competitive threat from a generic manufacturer emerges. Overall, the findings highlight a critical mechanism through which competition fosters "creative destruction," pushing firms to overcome internal hurdles and bring valuable innovations to the market more quickly.

14507322.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
14507322.value: The research opens several paths for further development. First, the empirical strategy used for pharmaceuticals—linking unexpected competitive shocks to firms’ launch behavior—can be applied to other industries (tech hardware, automobiles, consumer electronics) to test whether competition similarly accelerates “self-disrupting” product launches. Cross‑industry comparisons could show where cannibalization is most binding and how regulation shapes responses. Second, richer firm‑level and product‑level data could be used to study welfare and distributional effects: How much sooner do patients/consumers gain access to superior products? How are profits, prices, and health outcomes affected? Structural models could quantify cannibalization costs and simulate policy counterfactuals (e.g., different exclusivity or patent regimes). Third, the project can be extended backward in the innovation cycle, examining whether anticipated launch delays feed back into R&D investment, project selection, and portfolio design. A proposed course of action is: (1) broaden the analysis to other therapeutic areas and countries; (2) gather data on marketing expenditures to directly link launch acceleration to commercialization effort; (3) and build a structural model of multiproduct firms facing entry threats to evaluate the impact of competition policy reform on launch delay and innovation incentives.

14507322.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
14507322.value: This research investigates why a company might delay releasing its own new, better product. The core reason is a fear of "cannibalizing"—or eating into—the sales of its current successful products. Using the pharmaceutical industry as a case study, the paper finds a key trigger that overcomes this fear: the threat of competition. When a company learns a rival (like a generic drug maker) is preparing to enter the market, it quickly launches its next-generation product. The logic is simple: the old product's future profits are at risk anyway, so there's less to lose by replacing it. The value of this research is that it proves how essential competition is for consumers. It acts as a powerful force that pushes companies to stop protecting old cash cows and release their latest innovations. This process ensures that new technologies and better products reach the public much faster, driving progress that benefits everyone.

14507522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507522.value: 研究證明領導者的意識形態（如政治傾向，價值觀，宗教信仰）和個性特征（如自戀自大等）深刻影響公司決策和表現，但鮮有研究探討領導者的人性認知差異，尤其是最基本的人性意識形態差異：性本善還是性本惡？性本善的意識形態確信人本性誠實，大方，獨立而復雜，相反，性本惡的意識形態相信人本性險惡，自私而簡單，從而必須用規章製度和強製手段來規範人性。 領導者相信性本善還是性本惡？這種關於人性的意識形態差異如何影響公司業績？這是本項目的研究目標。本研究遵循 upper echelons 理論建立了基本論點：性本善/惡的意識形態差異導致不同領導行為，從而導致不同的公司表現。具體而言，信奉性本善的領導者會通過指示性領導行為而影響公司表現，相反，信奉性本惡的領導者會限製授權類領導行為而從影響公司表現。同時，領導風格和女性領導者的比率會影響上述基本模型。 本研究計劃調研400家中國公司。基本貢獻如下：1. 通過研究最基本的人性意識形態而擴大意識形態研究的範圍， 2. 通過探索人性意識形態的作用機製而進一步發展upper echelons理論， 3. 通過展示女性領導者的調節作用而促進女性領導研究

14600522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600522.value: 背景： 全球超過一半人口居住於都市社區，這個比例預計在2050年時將上升至68%。綠色植被是都市社區的重要組成。目前已經有一些研究報導綠色植被能改善公眾健康，但這些研究都不是以大型的縱向性隊列為基礎的。大型縱向性隊列研究通常能提供更加可靠的研究發現。此外，目前進行的研究大部分是在西方國家實施的，而且主要針對心血管疾病，未能對其它疾病進行研究。雖然東西方國家在文化、人種、人口密度及社區規劃上有很大不同，綠色植被對亞洲人群健康影響的研究非常少。關於綠色植被如何影響人群健康的路徑也不清楚。相關的假說包括綠色植被能夠降低空氣污染、提高人群的運動水準。此外，社會經濟狀況可能也會影響綠色植被與健康的關聯。 項目： 我們建議運用在香港和臺灣的兩個現存的大型縱向性隊列進行此項研究。此兩個隊列包含了67萬居民從1996年至2019年的人口學、社會經濟狀況、生活方式、體育運動以及醫療健康等方面的資訊。在我們以前的研究中，我們還獲得了這些居民的空氣污染暴露資料。我們計畫在本研究中，運用美國太空總署的衛星資料，評估香港和臺灣兩個地區的社區綠色植被覆蓋情況。之後，我們會用Cox回歸模型分析綠色植被與各種健康結局的關聯。我們還會分析人群社會經濟狀況、體育運動水準以及空氣污染在綠色植被與健康關聯中的角色。 意義： 進一步明白綠色植被與健康之間的關聯會有助於我們更精准地制定健康政策和都市社區規劃政策。這對亞洲人群健康尤其重要，因為亞洲正處於一個快速城市化的進程之中。
