14600622.value: 觀察或模仿有經驗的治療師是輔導員訓練的重要部分。然而，只觀看正面示範的話，實習輔導員或會感到無法達到模仿對象的水平而變得焦慮或自我批評，從而影響到實習輔導員的自我效能感。相反地，觀看正面和負面示範或許能夠讓實習輔導員從正面互動中把負面的互動分辨出來，及時修補破裂，以減低對輔導過程和結果的不良影響。 除了觀察不同的輔導示範外，輔導示範的描述對實習輔導員也十分重要，實習輔導員可以透過示範及描述了解合適及不合宜輔導技巧以提升輔導效能。本研究運用了治療師同理心量表 (TES; Decker et al., 2014) 中描述治療師的同理心行為的九個特質作實習輔導員的學習項目。希望透過治療師同理心量表所示範的特質提升實習輔導員的輔導技巧。 在這項研究中，八對由自願者組成的輔導員-受導者組合將進行及錄影三場輔導節。受訓的評分員將使用治療師同理心量表來對每一個十五分鐘的輔導片段進行評分。治療師同理心量表分數最高的六個片段和分數最低的三個片段將分別成為治療師同理心的正面和負面範例。實習輔導員於實習前被隨機分配到兩個組別，第一組將觀看表現高同理心的三個片段和表現低同理心的三個片段並進行評分（正面+負面範例）。另一組將觀看並評價六個表現出高同理心的片段（正面範例）。這兩個組別將與上一學期的對照組根據實習輔導員焦慮、自我效能、同理心、輔導質素以及他們的受導者心理症狀和幸福感進行比較。(對照組成員只閱讀治療師同理心量表的特質但不會觀看示範影片或對影片進行評分)。三組的實習輔導員亦會受邀去寫下他們對不同訓練內容的體驗。 除了研究觀察和評估同理心示範對訓練結果的影響外，此研究還將提供廣東話輔導課程的影片，這影片可以作為輔導員及其他助人專業訓練的影片。這將彌補香港輔導員教育的不足。

14600722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600722.value: 嵌入型採掘：應對地方資源詛咒的中國經驗

14600722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600722.value: Natural resources such as fuels and nonfuel minerals are crucial for sustaining economic development and meeting industrial and energy consumption needs. But resource extraction generates environmental and economic damages, arouses social conflicts in mining areas, and undermines the welfare of local citizens. Such adverse impacts of resource extraction, increasingly recognized as the local resource curse, plague many resource-rich countries including China and pose empirical and theoretical challenges for policy and scholarly circles. To cope with the local resource curse, Chinese local governments in mining areas, through their extensive administrative and political control over the resource sector, try to create linkages between mining companies and local communities and mobilize the former to contribute to local development and governance and share resource wealth with the latter in both formal and informal ways. We define such practices as embedded extraction and argue that it is one strategy that the Chinese government uses to mitigate the local resource curse and preserve regime legitimacy and stability. This project will systematically investigate the mechanisms and effects of embedded extraction in three interconnected parts. First, combining archival research and case studies of officially recognized resource-rich cities, we will investigate how the Chinese government establishes linkages between mining businesses and local communities and explain the cross-regional variations in local practices. Second, focusing on the coal industry in Shanxi Province, we will examine whether and how mining companies participate in local development and governance and explain the differences in their behaviors. Third, based on comparative case studies and field research in selected mining villages, we will scrutinize how embedded extraction affects the welfare of local citizens and whether it can address the unbalanced distribution of the benefits and costs of the resource sector. This project will make both theoretical and practical contributions. Theoretically, it advances the resource curse discourse by examining the active roles the state can play to address the local resource curse. It also enhances our understanding of Chinese politics by revealing the nuanced strategies the Chinese state uses to intervene in the economy and control the society. Practically, the research findings can generate useful policy implications for resource management in not only China but also other resource-rich countries. They also provide empirical evidence to evaluate the effectiveness of the Chinese government’s industrial and social policies. 能源與礦產資源對維持經濟發展以及滿足工業化和能源消費需求至關重要。但是資源採掘會破壞礦區環境、對當地居民帶來經濟和福利損失、並激發社會矛盾。這些資源開發的負面效應在包括中國在內的很多資源豐裕國家和地區都存在。學術與政策研究界已經意識到“地方資源詛咒”的危害性，但是目前尚無系統的政策解決方案和理論論證。 為了應對地方資源詛咒，中國眾多資源型地方政府試圖通過廣泛的行政與政治控制手段來加強採掘業企業與地方社區的聯繫，並動員礦企通過正式或非正式的渠道與當地居民分享資源財富及參與地方發展與治理。本研究將這些應對措施稱之為“嵌入型採掘”，並認為這是中國政府用來緩解地方資源詛咒和維持政權合法性與穩定性的重要策略之一。 本研究項目將從三個方面系統探討“嵌入型採掘”的機制與效果。第一，我們將結合政策文件研究和對官方認定的資源型城市的案例分析來考察中國地方政府如何建立礦企與地方民眾之間的連接並解釋地方政策之間的差異。第二，我們將聚焦山西省的煤炭行業，考察礦企如何參與地方發展與治理並解釋企業行為的差異。第三，我們將通過田野調查與比較案例研究分析嵌入型採掘如何影響地方民眾的福祉並考察其是否能解決資源採掘的成本與收益分配不均的問題。 此項研究兼具理論與現實意義。理論上我們將深入分析國家在應對地方資源詛咒方面的積極作用以推進現有的資源詛咒研究；我們對於中國政府對經濟社會的干預措施的研究也將進一步加深學界對中國政治的理解。此外，本研究的現實意義在於其對中國和其他資源豐裕國家的資源管理政策具有借鑒價值，同時也可提供經驗證據以評判中國當前產業政策和社會政策的有效性。

14601022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601022.value: 香港的死者安置方式設計

14601022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601022.value: Dr Gould, Hannah Prof Toulson, Ruth

14601022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601022.value: Hong Kong suffers a shortage of columbarium niches. The government would prefer the public to use alternative, land savings means to house the cremains of their deceased ancestors, but the public has not embraced the alternatives proposed by the government. The government has been slow to approve new public columbaria or license private ones, while many private parties also actively protest plans to build new columbaria or other facilities for housing the dead in their neighborhoods. This project investigates the reasons behind the public's preference for columbarium niches and explores alternative deigns for memorializing the deceased. The project is comparative and the PI will work with research teams undertaking similar research in Singapore, Tokyo and Taipei. The project will also involve building a research network of professionals concerned with memorialization in Hong Kong, including funeral home directors, coffin shop proprietors, religious practitioners, architects with experience in designing columbaria and other forms of memorial, and city planners in the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (the Hong Kong government department tasked with approving columbaria and proposing alternatives). The project is both academic and applied. Academically the project will explore the cultural meanings of giving a home to the dead. These meanings will be analyzed in several ways: in relation to the present moment of Hong Kong history with its high rates of immigration and emigration and fears of mainland takeover and a dissolution of Hong Kong identity; in comparative fashion with those discovered in Singapore, Tokyo, and Taipei; and in relation to evolving ideas of family and kinship. Practically, the project will be directed at solving a significant problem for Hong Kong society--finding culturally adequate places to house the dead. The network built by the project will continue to address the problem after the end of the project. The project will also disseminate findings and information on alternatives across East Asia to the general public through video and the government. 香港面臨著骨灰龕位短缺的問題。政府更希望公眾使用替代性的、節省土地的方式來安放已故祖先的骨灰，但公眾並未接受政府提出的替代方案。政府在批准新的公共或許可私營骨灰安置所方面進展緩慢，而在社區中建造新的骨灰安置所或其他安置死者的設施的計劃，亦常常遭到區內私人團體的大力抗議。本研究計劃考察公眾偏向選擇骨灰龕位的原因，並探討紀念死者的替代設計。本研究具有比較性，研究者將與在新加坡、東京和台北進行類似研究的研究團隊合作。本研究亦將在香港建立一個與紀念死者相關的研究網絡，包括殯儀館館長、棺材店從業者、宗教人士、具有設計骨灰龕及其他紀念形式經驗的建築師，以及食物環境衛生署（負責批准骨灰安置所和提出替代方案的香港政府部門）內部的城市規劃師。 本研究計劃既是學術性的，也是應用性的。在學術上，該項目將探索給死者安家的文化意義，並從幾個方面進行分析：關於香港當前的歷史時刻，高企的移民率、對大陸將佔據主導而香港身份認同喪失的恐懼；與新加坡、東京和台北之發現的比較；與不斷發展的家庭和親屬關係觀念之關聯。應用上，研究旨在解決香港的一個重要問題——尋找文化上適當的地方來安置死者。研究中建立的網絡，將在本計劃結束之後繼續處理這一問題。該計劃亦將把東亞地區安置死者的替代性方式的相關發現和資訊，透過影片和政府傳達給公眾。

14601122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601122.value: 以腦電圖分析精神分裂症的內在語言障礙

14601122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601122.value: Dr Chan, Sau Man Sandra Mr Chung, Lawrence Kin Hei Prof Whitford, Thomas Dr Wong, Wing Ho

14601122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601122.value: 研究目的： 是項研究之目的旨在試驗以內在語言的內在前向機制作為理論框架解釋精神分裂症的幻聽 ，以及與聲音情感強度的相互作用。 研究背景： 幻聽是精神症狀，指一個人在沒有外在來源下感知到聲音，而精神分裂症患者經歷的幻聽通常帶負面內容、令人情緒痛苦，並必需治理。 主流的神經認知理論認為幻聽實際上是一種自生的內在語言，但因未能準確地抑制內在語言的實際感官結果，所以內在語言被誤認為是外在和陌生的。這種「內在前向機制」缺陷被概念化為精神分裂症中幻聽的基礎。 此研究領域存在兩個知識缺口：（i）雖然內在前向理論已透過外在言語在精神分裂症患者中進行實驗，但未有患者數據說明能應用在內在語言上。（ii）儘管幻聽遍被描述為負面的，感官抑制的內在語言之實驗範式只集中於無意義的音素。 研究簡介： 實驗設計： 是項研究會從頭皮表面量度腦電圖並使用新的實驗範式，比較聽覺皮質對於中性和負面內在語言的抑制，以及比較精神分裂症患者與健康對照的反應。 研究對象： 40 名有幻聽症狀的精神分裂症患者，40 名沒有幻聽症狀的精神分裂症患者，以及 40 名年齡匹配的健康對照。 假設： 在中性詞語的刺激下，有幻聽的患者會對內在語言出現異常的N1抑制反應。 與中性詞語相比，兩組患者在負面詞語的刺激下，會對內在語言出現更大的N1抑制異常（即是，較少抑制）。 與健康對照相比，有幻覺的患者對中性詞語與負面詞語的N1抑制差異會更明顯，而沒有幻覺患者的差異介於兩組之間。 有幻覺的患者中，（對中性詞語和情緒詞語）異常的N1抑制會與幻聽的嚴重程度相關。 研究的重要性： 對需要護理的精神分裂症患者， 幻聽通常是負面和痛苦的經歷。情緒內在語言的感官抑制之研究發現會告知患者和醫生耐藥性幻聽下的神經機制，並闡明干預和治療的可能目標。

14601222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601222.value: 比較上海, 香港及台北的網上約會虐待: 一個科技女性主義分析

14601222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601222.value: Ms Lü, Pin Prof Nakano, Lynne Yukie Prof Shen , Hsiu-Hua Prof Wang , Xiying

14601222.label: Project Objectives
14601222.value: To collect data through focus group interviews with young adults aged between 18-35 in the three research sites to explore how gender, sexuality, and ethnicity may shape understandings of the boundaries and expectations of dating, as well as knowledge and interpretations of what constitute abusive behaviors in a dating relationship. Eight focus groups, consisting of two all-male groups, two all-female groups, one mixed gender group, one sexual minority group, one ethnic minority group, and one expert group, will be conducted in each field site. Each focus group will consist of 6 participants, making a total of 48 focus group participants in each field site. To collect qualitative data on the nature and dynamics of cyber dating abuse by interviewing victims aged 16–35 from three Chinese cities: Hong Kong, Shanghai and Taipei. We incorporate in our definition multiple forms of cyber dating abuse, including threats via mobile phone, emails and SMS; monitoring and checking a partner’s social networking page without permission; sharing of sexts and/or personal information and/or details of intimate relationship dynamics without the partner’s consent; and online/technology-facilitated stalking (‘a pattern of repeated, unwanted attention and contact by a partner’ that raises safety concerns for the victim and those close to him/her). Although the focus of this study is cyber dating abuse, we also collect data on offline physical, psychological and sexual dating violence in order to examine the relationship between the online and offline worlds. To fill four knowledge gaps in the relationships between technology, gender and dating violence. First, to examine the victims’ perceptions, subjective experiences and responses to cyber dating abuse. Second, to compare whether men, women, and gender non-normative respondents may differ in their understanding of, experiences with and responses to cyber dating abuse. Third, to identify and explain how specific online cultural and legal contexts may shape perpetration, processes and responses to cyber dating abuse. Fourth, to examine the similarities and differences in consequences for dating violence experienced offline and online. To generate new theoretical understanding of the relationships between technology, gender and dating violence in non-Western contexts. We propose to achieve this objective through a comparative study of three Chinese cities. Hong Kong, Shanghai and Taipei were chosen as the research sites because they have roughly similar levels of socioeconomic development and Internet usage and have the same cultural heritage. They differ, however, in non-government organization (NGO) activism and the legal frameworks to promote gender equality and combat intimate partner violence and cyber dating abuse. Differences in legal frameworks and civil society provide an opportunity to explore how institutional and legal contexts may shape victims’ understanding and responses to cyber dating abuse. To use a technofeminist framework to analyse how gender and technology might be mutually constitutive. This framework guides researchers to analyse how dating violence perpetrated in the virtual world and gender norms and power inequalities in the material world may be mutually constitutive. For example, whether/how technology and new media provide a new venue for the expansion of dating violence perpetrated offline and whether/how online social interactions may trigger dating violence offline can be explored. The framework also inspires us to explore whether/how gender differences in exposure and mastery of technology/new media may shape gendered vulnerability, understanding and responses to dating violence perpetuated via technology and in the cyber space; and whether/how gender norms/gender stereotypes, gender inequalities in resources and power in the material world may influence perpetration and responses to dating violence perpetrated in the virtual world. To convey the findings to the public to increase public awareness of the problem, and to rights-based groups and NGOs so they can review whether their existing measures to assist cyber dating abuse victims have met the specific needs of different groups of victims. As a result of the general lack of research on the role of technology and gender on dating violence in Chinese societies, there is a lack of systematic evidence on the different types of cyber dating abuse, the contexts in which it occurs, the harm it causes, as well as the responses of different groups of victims. These knowledge gaps have hampered societal discussions on how cyber dating abuse can be combated and effectively prevented. Our research would be a significant step forward to fill these knowledge voids and facilitate societal and NGO discussion on how to combat the problem. To produce evidence-based policy suggestions to help policymakers review existing laws related to cyber dating abuse and to draw the attention of law enforcement agencies to the needs of different groups of victims so that they could develop effective procedures and mechanisms to handle complaints of cyber dating abuse. Currently, dating abuse perpetrated online is often minimised or trivialised because law enforcement personnel may not recognise its seriousness or may consider the harm caused by abuse perpetrated online as much less serious than that sustained as a result of offline abuse. Inadequate law enforcement responses may also be related to vague, unspecified or non-existent legislation and to inherent difficulties in combating cyber abuse because of the involvement of third parties in cyber space and its escalation into cyber bullying.

14601322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601322.value: 探討家長參與由促導員帶領的接納與承諾閱讀療法對照顧神經發育障礙兒童的成效：隨機對照試驗

14601322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601322.value: Prof Boyd, Roslyn Prof Chien, Wai Tong Dr Whittingham, Koa

14601322.label: Project Objectives
14601322.value: Raising a young child with neurodevelopmental disorders is challenging for many parents. The research context as stated in the “Other Information” below has clearly illustrated the importance of interventions in moving beyond supporting parents regarding their knowledge and skills in parenting to their psychological health. Grounded by the PI and Co-Is’ solid groundwork in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), parenting interventions and bibliotherapy, the proposed randomised controlled trial primarily aims to test the hypothesis that the Facilitator-guided Acceptance and Commitment Bibliotherapy (FAB) will yield significantly greater effects than general parenting advice in reducing parenting stress (primary outcome for parents) and emotional and behavioural symptoms of young children with neurodevelopmental disorders (NDD) (primary outcome for children) at 1-week and/or 6-month post-intervention. The proposed trial also tests the hypothesis that the FAB will yield greater effects than general parenting advice in reducing symptoms of depression and anxiety, as well as improving the psychological flexibility of parents in caring for their young child with NDD at 1-week and/or 6-month post-intervention. Apart from examining the effects of FAB on parental psychopathology, the proposed trial will test the hypothesis that the FAB will yield greater effects than general parenting advice in improving parenting behaviour and reducing the use of health care and rehabilitation services in young children with NDD at 1-week and/or 6-month post-intervention. Given the innovativeness of the proposed FAB, focus-group interviews will be conducted to explore the perceived benefits, satisfaction, strengths and limitations of FAB from the perspectives of parents.
rows: Raising a young child with neurodevelopmental disorders is challenging for many parents. The research context as stated in the “Other Information” below has clearly illustrated the importance of interventions in moving beyond supporting parents regarding their knowledge and skills in parenting to their psychological health. Grounded by the PI and Co-Is’ solid groundwork in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), parenting interventions and bibliotherapy, the proposed randomised controlled trial primarily aims to test the hypothesis that the Facilitator-guided Acceptance and Commitment Bibliotherapy (FAB) will yield significantly greater effects than general parenting advice in reducing parenting stress (primary outcome for parents) and emotional and behavioural symptoms of young children with neurodevelopmental disorders (NDD) (primary outcome for children) at 1-week and/or 6-month post-intervention.

The proposed trial also tests the hypothesis that the FAB will yield greater effects than general parenting advice in reducing symptoms of depression and anxiety, as well as improving the psychological flexibility of parents in caring for their young child with NDD at 1-week and/or 6-month post-intervention.

Apart from examining the effects of FAB on parental psychopathology, the proposed trial will test the hypothesis that the FAB will yield greater effects than general parenting advice in improving parenting behaviour and reducing the use of health care and rehabilitation services in young children with NDD at 1-week and/or 6-month post-intervention.

Given the innovativeness of the proposed FAB, focus-group interviews will be conducted to explore the perceived benefits, satisfaction, strengths and limitations of FAB from the perspectives of parents.

14601322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601322.value: 神經發展障礙 (NDD) (例如: 專注力不足及過度活躍症 (ADHD)、自閉症譜系障礙和發展遲緩等）是一種常見於學齡兒童的慢性障礙，而近年NDD診斷的數目更一直攀升。由於神經發展障礙會影響兒童在處理情緒 、行為 、人際關係及社交能力，照顧這些孩子無疑會讓父母倍感壓力，甚至出現焦慮和抑鬱的症狀。眾所周知，父母的負面情緒健康會加劇患有NDD子女的情緒和行為問題，但基於實證以及有效的心理干預以同時照顧NDD子女及其父母的需要是極為稀缺。 目前大多數的親職實證研究只著眼於培養親職技巧上，並不能正視父母的心理需要。 我們的研究團隊近年致力推行多項以專業治療師帶領的接納與承諾治療 (ACT) 臨床試驗研究，各項研究都發現以ACT導向的親職工作坊或課程都能提升NDD子女及其父母的心理健康 ， 而效果至少維持6個月或以上。考慮到未來ACT在本地及國際上的可擴展性，我們建議採用一個以自學為本，再由受訓的促導員以接納與承諾閱讀療法，為NDD家庭提供育兒和心理支援。 是次隨機對照試驗一共會招募154名患有神經發展障礙兒童的家長，參加者將會隨機分配到由促導員帶領的接納與承諾閱讀療法 (FAB) 工作坊或教授親職技巧的工作坊。FAB 是一個為期 12 星期、以 ACT 為基礎的自學課程。此課程將由四個網上課程及四場由促導員帶領的小組（每場大約1.5 小時）所組成，課程會以傳統華人家庭文化為背景，以接納與承諾治療為基礎，探討如何有效面對育兒挑戰以及與負面情緒相處。參加者需在課程開始前接受一次基線評估、課程完結一星期後及六個月後接受跟進評估。本計劃透過比較上述兩組參加者接受介入服務前後的變化，探討FAB在父母的親職壓力和表現、抑鬱和焦慮症狀、心理靈活性、子女的情緒和行為症狀 ，以及使用醫療與康復服務的成效。完成FAB工作坊的家長將被邀請接受訪談， 分享參與過程的經驗和感受。

14602222.value: 為急症科護士提供的體驗式及多媒體培訓以執行預前照顧計劃的成效

14602222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14602222.value: Prof Chan, Helen Yue Lai Dr Choi, Kai-chow Prof Chow, Ka Ming Dr Kwan, Wai Man Cecilia Ms Ng, Hiu Yim Nancy Dr Robinson, Jackie

14602222.label: Project Objectives
14602222.value: To evaluate the effectiveness of a multi-media experiential advance care planning (MEACP) training programme, guided by the experiential learning model and theory of planned behaviour, in enhancing nurses’ performing skills, knowledge, confidence, attitudes and actual practice in supporting patients’ decision-making on ACP. To evaluate the effectiveness of such an intervention in enhancing adherence to patients’ expressed preference for care. 14602222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602222.value: Background: Advance care planning (ACP) is the process of ongoing communication among patients, families and healthcare professionals regarding planning for preferred future care in the event that patients become frail and unable to make their own decisions. Given that a significant proportion of deaths occur in acute care wards in Hong Kong, nurses working in such settings are expected to be involved in providing end-of-life care and to lead ACP implementation. However, nurses in these settings in fact have only low-level involvement in ACP discussions, because of limited training in ACP conversations. Objectives: Guided by the Theory of Planned Behaviour and Experiential Learning Model, the aim of this study is to examine the effectiveness of a multi-media experiential training programme in advance care planning for nursing staff in acute care settings, and to ascertain whether it enhances their decision support skills and practice. The study also aims at examining the mediating effects of nurses’ knowledge, confidence and attitudes on the provision of ACP discussion. Study design: The study adopts a cluster randomised controlled trial with 12 weeks follow-up. A total of 234 eligible nurses working in 26 acute care hospital wards will be randomised at ward level in a 1:1 ratio into either control or intervention arms which will receive, respectively, no ACP education or the multi-media experiential training programme including webpage and mobile applications, a training workshop with enhanced lectures and role play. Guided by the Theory of Planned Behaviour, we will conduct path analysis to assess the role of nurses’ knowledge, attitudes and confidence on the nurses’ skill performance on decision support after the intervention. Contribution of the study: This will be the first randomised controlled trial to evaluate the effectiveness of an innovative and comprehensive training programme of this kind for nurses working in acute care settings. The findings of the proposed research will help to inform the implementation and embedding of such a programme, which will be novel and significant, in acute care settings. The online training materials and experiential learning strategy will help equip nurses with appropriate attitudes, knowledge and skills to conduct ACP effectively, addressing patients’ and families’ needs and preferences for their end-of-life care. 摘要 背景：「預前照顧計劃」是指病人、病人家屬和醫護人員間，透過不斷的溝通來預先商討一旦病人變得衰弱和精神上不能自決時，所期望的醫療及照顧計劃。鑑於香港急症病房出現死亡的數字 較舒緩病房為高，大眾期望在急症病房工作的護士會能夠提供臨終照護和帶領實施預前照顧計劃。不過，由於急症科護士接受有關預前照顧計劃對話的訓練不足，現時他們在預前計劃的參與程度只有很低。 目的：按照計劃行為和體驗學習理論，本研究的目的是探討以體驗式及多媒體培訓方式訓練急症科工作護士有關執行預前照顧計劃的成效，以及查明訓練能否提升護士的照顧決策能力和實踐。是次研究也旨在探究護士的知識、自信心和態度在預前照顧計劃討論中的中介效應。 研究設計： 本研究採用集群隨機對照試驗，並設有為期十二個星期的追蹤研究。總共有234 名合資格、分別在二十六間急症病房工作的護士，將會以一比一的比例隨機分派至對照組或實驗組。被派進實驗組的護士將接受一個以網頁和流動應用程式進行的體驗式及多媒體培訓，以及一個包含講課和角色扮演的培訓工作坊；而被派進對照組的護士則不會接受任何有關預前照顧計劃的培訓。按照計劃行為理論，我們會以路徑分析評估護士在接受訓練後，他們的知識、態度和自信心在他們決策能力表現中所擔當的角色。 研究貢獻：本研究將會成為第一個隨機對照試驗，以用作探討一個專為急症科護士而設、全新且全面的訓練之成效。研究結果將有助日後在急症病房實施和結合訓練。網上的訓練資源和體驗式學習策略亦為護士配備良好的態度、知識和技巧以有效地執行預前照顧計劃，和了解病人和病人家屬在臨終照護中的需要和期望。

14602522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14602522.value: 馴龍記：從結構-技術關係視角分析中國新國土空間規劃體系

14602522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602522.value: Goal: We propose a novel and nuanced conceptualization to explain how planning politics has shaped China’s new spatial planning (SP) system in four Pearl River Delta cities. Instead of misinterpreting the recentralised SP system leading to the end of political struggles, we hypothesise that actors from various scales and sectors battle to reassert their power over SP through various technologies, obstructing everyday planning practice to fulfil local ecological civilization (EC) goals. The form of struggles varies across cities due to their different political-economic and land use contexts. A critical review of planning policies and interviews with key players will be conducted to verify our hypothesis. Significance: SP is Chinese leaders’ most important tool to realise their goal of remoulding China into an ecological civilization that exemplifies environment-friendly forms of development. By ensuring food security (China’s top policy priority given the sheer size of its population), SP is increasingly recognized as a remedy for the rapid loss of farmland to urbanisation. Thus, the Chinese central government undertook a SP reform in 2018 to ‘tame the dragons’ by consolidating, under a new central ministry established to manage natural resources, the planning functions previously devolved to growth-oriented local governments and fragmented across multiple policy sectors. However, not only has the new SP system been ineffective in regulating local land use violations, it has given rise to wider and deeper conflicts. Why does the new system fail to resolve conflicts? Answering this question has both academic and policy significance: Assessing how the system operates and uncovering the perplexing causes of the impasses will provide a springboard to further academic debate on China’s planning politics and inform policies oriented to increase system effectiveness. Novelty: One focus of planning politics studies is on the political struggles within the institutional structures, i.e. actors at which governance scale and in which policy sector can have a greater say over SP. These studies have downplayed how institutional structures can be enforced. Another focus is on how technologies are critical to governments’ attempts to shape institutions and individuals to make land use decisions in particular ways. Both types of studies have offered insightful, albeit one-sided, explanations of the mechanisms of planning politics. Building on these studies, we propose the concept of ‘structure-technology nexus’ to examine such politics as a process that involves concurrent struggles over the institutional structures and the technologies deployed to enact such structures. 研究目標：本研究提出“結構-技術關係”這一全新概念，深入研究政治因素如何影響珠江三角洲四個城市的國土空間規劃。主要論點為，空間規劃體系的再集權並不意味著政治爭鬥的結束；相反，各級政府及各部門之間繼續進行著權益博弈，並通過各類技術手段影響空間規劃的日常運作，阻礙城市實現既定的生態文明建設目標。由於不同城市具有不同的社會經濟條件和土地利用現狀，政治影響規劃的方式也不盡相同。本課題將批判性地回顧規劃政策，訪談規劃從業者，用以佐證上述論點。 研究意義：空間規劃是中國政府實現環境友好型生態文明建設的最重要工具。由於中國人口眾多，快速城鎮化加速耕地面積減少，糧食安全成為‘國之大者’，空間規劃被認為是解決此問題之良藥。有鑑於此，中央政府於2018年開始國土空間規劃改革，組建自然資源部，將以往下放給地方政府和散佈於各政府職能部門的規劃權力重新收回。我們稱這一過程為‘馴龍’。 但是，新建立的空間規劃體系依然無法有效管理土地使用，甚至導致了更廣、更多的矛盾。規劃失效的根源是什麼？回答這個問題具有學術和政策意義。瞭解新規劃系統如何運作，摸清其陷入僵局的原因不僅豐富了中國規劃政治的學術談論，也讓我們為提高規劃體系效率找到應對之策。 創新：空間規劃如何受政治制約是學術研究熱點。其中一類研究關注規劃體系內的政治博弈 -- 到底哪一級政府/哪一個政策部門在空間規劃過程中享有更多話事權。此類研究的缺陷在於淡化了規劃體系的權力結構到底是如何實現的。另一類研究則關注政府如何應用技術手段塑造個體行為，使得各機構和個人按照某種路徑做出土地利用選擇。這兩類研究都對政治作用於規劃的機制提出了富有見地的解釋，但是兩者都具有片面性。建基於現有研究，我們提出用“結構-技術關係”理論探索規劃政治的博弈過程，以及其對規劃制度建構和技術應用的影響。

14603122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14603122.value: 透過創業技能培訓和在家環保企業工作試驗以提升中風人士自顧能力的成效：一項隨機對照試驗

14603122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14603122.value: Prof Chau, Janita Pak-chun Dr Choi, Kai-chow Prof Li, Sissi Jingyu Prof Radford, Kathryn Alice Dr Yeung, Jonas Hon-ming

14603122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603122.value: Introduction Over the last decade, the global incidence of stroke in adults under the age of 65 has increased by more than 25%. For these working-age stroke survivors, returning to work is a priority outcome of rehabilitation. However, vocational interventions aimed at assisting survivors in returning to the competitive labour market resulted in a less than 50% return-to-work rate. According to emerging evidence, self-employment has the potential to provide survivors with new job opportunities while improving their psychosocial outcomes. Aim This project will investigate the effects of an 8-week theory-driven online/hybrid Self-employment Skill Building Intervention (SSI) on the rate of self-employment, self-efficacy, life satisfaction, and psychosocial outcomes among working-age stroke survivors. Methods A 2-arm, assessor-blind, randomised controlled trial will be conducted. Individuals aged 18−65 years old, clinically diagnosed with a first-ever/recurrent ischaemic/haemorrhagic stroke, living at home, and unemployed for at least 6 months will be recruited from community-based organisations, housing estates, and the Labour Department. A sample size of 156 participants (78 per group) is expected. Eligible participants will be randomly assigned to receive usual care or SSI with usual care. SSI is an online/hybrid intervention based on Bandura’s self-efficacy and outcome expectation principles that assist survivors in becoming self-employed by developing entrepreneurial skills. It consists of one home visit, three online individual sessions, and four online group sessions held once a week for eight weeks. Participants will learn how to run their businesses by engaging in a home-based trial business that repurposes unused items. Outcomes including self-employment rate, self-efficacy, life satisfaction, emotional well-being, and community reintegration will be measured before SSI, immediately post-SSI, and 3 months post-SSI. The intention-to-treat principle will be used in the analysis. The generalised estimating equations model will be used to compare the differences in outcomes between two groups over time. Semi-structured interviews will be conducted with participants to elicit feedback on SSI. Discussion and significance We anticipate that SSI will create a new vocational rehabilitation model for working-age survivors through self-employment in socially-oriented businesses, and ultimately be integrated into existing clinical guidelines, vocational rehabilitation services, and disability employment policies. The trial business of repurposing unused items will contribute to larger environmental protection efforts. Furthermore, SSI is expected to evolve into a social firm that will provide new job opportunities for survivors, and form a multi-skilled partnership network among self-employed survivors for mutual support. Social and workplace inclusion of survivors is expected to be promoted. 對於六十五歲以下、處於工作年齡的成年中風人士來說，重返工作崗位是其中一項重要的復康目標。根據新的研究數據，自僱模式有可能為成年中風人士提供新的工作機會，改善心理社會結果。 研究目的 本研究的目的是評估一項為期八星期的線上/混合自僱工作技能培訓計劃 (SSI) 對工作年齡中風人士的自僱工作率、自我效能、生活滿意度和心理社會結果的影響。 研究方法 將進行一項隨機對照試驗。我們會從社區組織、屋苑和勞工處招募年齡在十八至六十五歲、臨床診斷為首次/復發性缺血性/出血性中風、在家居住和失業至少六個月的人士。預計招募一百五十六名參加者（每組七十八人）。符合條件的參加者將被隨機安排接受常規護理或 SSI 及常規護理。評估會在進行 SSI前、完成SSI後和三個月後進行，評估包括自僱率、自我效能、生活滿意度、心理狀況和重投社區程度。參加者亦會接受半結構訪談，以了解他們對 SSI 的意見。 討論及重要性 我們預計SSI 將為工作年齡的成年中風人士創造一種新的職業復康模式，並融入現有的臨床指引、職業復康服務和殘疾就業政策。

14603222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14603222.value: 漢語方言中接觸引發的音韻及詞彙演變――莆仙閩語及海南閩語的案例研究

14603222.label: Project Objectives
14603222.value: To reconstruct the contact history of Pu-Xian Min and Hainan Min through in-depth comparisons with Proto-Southern Min and their donor languages (i.e. Eastern Min in the case of Pu-Xian, and Ong-Be and Hlai in the case of Hainan); To identify lexical and phonological changes in Pu-Xian Min and Hainan Min induced by contact with their neighboring languages; To compare the outcomes of borrowing and imposition, two major types of contact-induced transfer, with special reference to Pu-Xian Min and Hainan Min; To develop a new theory or update existing theories about the role(s) of language contact in the formation of new dialects.
rows: To reconstruct the contact history of Pu-Xian Min and Hainan Min through in-depth comparisons with Proto-Southern Min and their donor languages (i.e. Eastern Min in the case of Pu-Xian, and Ong-Be and Hlai in the case of Hainan);
To identify lexical and phonological changes in Pu-Xian Min and Hainan Min induced by contact with their neighboring languages;
To compare the outcomes of borrowing and imposition, two major types of contact-induced transfer, with special reference to Pu-Xian Min and Hainan Min;
To develop a new theory or update existing theories about the role(s) of language contact in the formation of new dialects.

14603222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603222.value: Pu-Xian Min (PXM) and Hainan Min (HNM) are intriguing cases from the perspective of language transfer. They descended from a common ancestor, Southern Min, then went their separate ways from the mainstream due to contact with other languages. PXM, spoken in the cities of Putian and Xianyou in eastern coastal Fujian, was heavily influenced by Eastern Min, whereas HNM, the lingua franca of northern, eastern and southern coastal areas of the Hainan Province, has a distinctive imprint from the Kra-Dai languages Ong-Be and Hlai. PXM and HNM are prime examples of what Winford (2005) called ‘borrowing’ and ‘imposition’ respectively. This project investigates the phonological and lexical changes induced by borrowing and imposition through systematic comparisons of PXM and HNM. Our goals are to reconstruct the contact history of these two clusters of Min and to verify contact-induced phonological and lexical changes in them. The project consists of 3 phases. First, PXM and HNM will be reconstructed. The reconstructed forms of the dialects, as opposed to their modern forms, will form the basis of our subsequent analyses. Second, PXM and HNM will be examined in the light of Winford’s (2005) suggestion that changes resulted from imposition are more systematic and predictable than those resulted from borrowing. If the suggestion is valid, phonological and lexical changes will be more systematic and predicable in HNM than PXM. Third, we will investigate whether type of transfer (i.e. borrowing vs imposition) is a factor affecting the borrowability and the borrowability scale of loanwords, as seen in the cases of PXM and HNM. This project will offer new perspectives on the formation and development of Southern Chinese dialects, in which language contact plays an important role. 從語言接觸的角度看，莆仙閩語和海南閩語是兩個非常有意思的案例。這兩片閩語都源自閩南語，在發展的過程中都和其他語言發生過接觸。莆仙閩語主要流行於福建省的莆田市和仙游縣，受過閩東語強烈的影響；海南閩語是海南省北部、東部和南部沿岸地區的通用語，帶有明顯的臨高語和黎語 (俱屬壯侗語系語言) 的痕跡。我們認為：莆仙閩語和海南閩語的經歷，正好分別屬於 Winford (2005) 框架下語言接觸的兩大類型――「借用」(borrowing) 和「施加」(imposition)。本計劃的目的，是通過構擬這兩個方言片的接觸史，釐清它們在音韻和詞彙層面上的演變。計劃包含三個階段：(一) 構擬莆仙閩語和海南閩語的接觸史；(二) 檢驗這兩個方言片是否符合 Winford (2005) 對不同語言接觸類型的預測；(三) 以這兩個方言片為例，考察哪一類型的接觸會影響借詞的「可借用性」(borrowability) 及「可借用性等級」(scale of borrowability)。本計劃會為南方方言的形成提供嶄新的視角。

14603622.label: Project Title(Chinese)

14603622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603622.value: This proposal seeks to address the insurgence of anti-Asian sentiment during the COVID-19 pandemic by examining whether the COVID-19 threat exacerbates implicit foreigner bias towards Asian Americans. More importantly, it aims to investigate the individuals' risks factors that make people more prejudiced during the COVID-19 pandemic. We posit that multiple psychological factors underlie prejudice towards Asians during COVID-19. In particular, we focus on the need for cognitive closure (i.e., the need to minimize ambiguity in times of uncertainty), race essentialism (i.e., the beliefs that there are inherent differences among races), and national collective narcissism (e.g., the belief that one's nation's exceptionality is not recognized). We contend that COVID-19 exacerbated prejudice towards Asian Americans among individuals who score high on these characteristics because (1) it brought a high level of uncertainty and was (2) highly radicalized (e.g., originating from Chinese's eating habits) and politicized (e.g., named a China virus). This project thus serves to illuminate how a global health crisis and its handling within a nation can lead those with pre-existing risk factors to have increased bias towards minority racial groups. For example, Trump's politicization of COVID-19 as a "China virus" potentially exacerbated the antagonistic attitudes that those with high national collective narcissism held and confirmed their paranoia that other countries are consistently seeking to undermine them, which in turn caused them to exclude Asians from the national group, seeing them as perpetual foreign. To test these ideas, we will conduct five empirical studies to uncover the psychological underpinnings that give rise to anti-Asian sentiments during the COVID-19 pandemic using a Person x Situation (P x S) model. We believe the insights we gain from this present study can help policymakers formulate better strategies that would enhance solidarity and reduce scapegoating against minority groups when faced with crises (e.g., pandemics).

14604722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14604722.value: 檢討一個以「同伴協助、以康復為中心的自我疾病管理為基礎的課程」對近期發病的思覺失調症成人患者之成效: 為期18個月的的隨機對照試驗

14604722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14604722.value: Dr Cheung, Eric FC Prof Gray, John Richard Prof Lubman, Dan I Ms Yip, Annie LK

14604722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14604722.value: 精神病是一種主要的破壞性精神疾病，佔香港和全球三分之一的精神病人口/住院人數，並以廣泛的認知、情緒和行為問題為特徵。這些往往導致不良的心理社會功能和高複發風險/率。最近的證據表明，首發精神病患者會在發病的前三年內復發並重新入院；如果不及早得到適當的治療和康復，其中一半會發展成慢性綜合症。不同的心理社會干預方法在改善患者的症狀、藥物依從性和復發方面提供了顯著的益處，但在其他心理社會健康狀況中，特別是在長期內，效果不一致和不確定。由於衛生資源不足，以及在慢性病護理的最低專業支持下越來越重視自我護理和同伴支持，社會心理干預應優化精神病患者心理健康和康復的自我管理。鑑於上述挑戰/機遇，一項針對精神病成人患者的創新性精神病自我管理計劃可促進他們在疾病管理中的自我效能並促進康復，當 PI 將其納入需求時，已在對照試驗中顯示出初步益處以首發精神病門診患者為基礎的教育計劃。 這項多中心隨機對照試驗採用重複測量、三組設計來檢查/比較兩種替代干預措施（同伴促進、以康復為重點的自我疾病管理計劃、Peer-RESIM 和心理教育小組計劃）之間的效果，以及僅針對 198 名中國首發精神病患者（每組 66 人）在 18 個月的隨訪中進行常規護理（即在招募時以及乾預後 1 週、9 個月和 18 個月測量的患者結果） .廣義估計方程檢驗將用於比較個體研究結果的平均值變化，並進行 Kaplan-Meier 生存分析以分析 18 個月隨訪期間各組之間再次住院的相對風險。據推測，與其他兩組相比，Peer-RESIM 參與者將顯著改善患者的康復和功能（主要結果）和/或若干次要結果（例如，精神狀態、再次住院和服務滿意度）在 18 個月的隨訪中。 主要結果的臨床顯著變化將根據 Jacobson 和 Traux 的標准在組內和組間進行評估，以檢查對患者的臨床益處。還將進行焦點小組訪談，以從同伴促進者和參與者的角度探討 Peer-RESIM 的感知利益、服務滿意度和優勢/局限性。在 Peer-RESIM 中發現了顯著的好處，這種干預可以被當地的社區精神保健服務採用，並在其他國家複製，以改善以康復為導向的早期精神病護理。

14605022.label: Project Title(Chinese)

14605022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605022.value: Learning design through drawings has been, and continues to be, the most fundamental method of studying architecture (Cuff, 1980). In spite of the importance of imparting drawing knowledge, the education of the architect-to-be in this domain remains in deep deficit today. Both supporters and skeptics have declared the “Death of Drawing” (Scheer, 2014; Mitchell, 1989). However, pitting the digital against the hand-drawing is not a constructive debate. Instead, activating “collective drawing” as a system to capitalise on the benefits of “relational collaboration” is a more productive reframing of the problem, as it can be a positive ingredient in today’s design education. Not all collaborations are equal. Relational collaboration is derived through an exchange of tacit knowledge (Hagel, 2009). It offers creative autonomy while learning from others. It is cultivated through a carefully designed learning environment and framework including the rules of engagement, atmosphere, time, and space (Hwang, 2021). It is a scalable collaboration contingent upon the creation of others. Unlike “transactional collaboration” that works in a linear progression, vis-a-vis Fordist division-of-labor, which is unsuitable for the creative process. Collective drawing is a unique genre of drawing practice that involves the creative inputs of multiple participants (Journeaux, 2020). This approach of the collective contribution challenges singular authorship and explores multiple perspectives. Therefore, it encourages shared conversation, imagination, responsibility, and working together. Pilot collective drawing workshops conducted at CUHK showed great satisfaction in participants’ feedback, with increased dynamic capabilities, and creative design synthesis in the works. To expand on our pilot research, this project seeks to: Prepare a survey for drawing pedagogy of nine high ranking schools of architecture; Produce a detailed comparative analysis, focusing on two exemplar drawing pedagogies as case studies; Test the dynamic capabilities of collective drawing to stimulate relational collaboration at three schools of architecture in Hong Kong and East Asia; Evaluate the effectiveness of the current practices and establish best practice blueprints/ schemes in drawing pedagogy. Drawing is so ingrained with the act of design that the Italian word ‘disegno’ carries the dual meaning of ‘design’ and ‘drawing’. By drawing/ design collectively, the project aims to sow the seeds of imagination and collaboration in the young minds of the would-be architects. Furthermore, at a time when researchers are seeking innovative Design Thinking collaboration mechanisms. The expected outcome of the project can offer positive contributions to the engagement process and therefore impact the broader collaborative environment at large. 通過繪圖學習設計一直是並且繼續是學習建築的最基本方法（Cuff，1980）。 儘管傳授繪圖知識很重要，但該領域的準建築師教育今天仍然嚴重不足。 支持者和懷疑者都宣稱“繪畫之死”（Scheer，2014；Mitchell，1989）。 然而，將數字與手繪相提並論並不是一個建設性的辯論。 相反，將“集體繪圖”作為一個系統來利用“關係協作”的好處是對問題的更有效的重構，因為它可以成為當今設計教育的積極成分。 並非所有的合作都是平等的。 關係協作是通過隱性知識的交流產生的（Hagel，2009）。 它在向他人學習的同時提供創造性的自主權。 它是通過精心設計的學習環境和框架培養的，包括參與規則、氛圍、時間和空間（Hwang，2021）。 這是一種可擴展的協作，取決於其他人的創建。 與以線性進展方式進行的“事務性協作”不同，相對於福特主義的分工，這不適合創作過程。 集體繪畫是一種獨特的繪畫實踐類型，涉及多個參與者的創造性投入（Journeaux，2020）。 這種集體貢獻的方法挑戰了單一的作者身份，並探索了多種觀點。 因此，它鼓勵共享對話、想像力、責任感和共同工作。在中大舉辦的試點集體繪圖工作坊對參與者的反饋非常滿意，作品的動態能力和創意設計綜合能力有所提高。 為了擴展我們的試點研究，該項目旨在： 準備九所高等建築學院的繪畫教學法調查； 進行詳細的比較分析，重點關注兩種典型的繪畫教學法作為案例研究； 在香港和東亞的三所建築學院測試集體繪圖的動態能力，以促進關係合作； 評估當前實踐的有效性，並在繪圖教學法中建立最佳實踐藍圖/計劃。 繪畫與設計行為如此根深蒂固，以至於意大利語單詞“disegno”具有“設計”和“繪畫”的雙重含義。 通過集體繪圖/設計，該項目旨在在未來的年輕人心中播下想像力和協作的種子。 此外，此時研究人員正在尋求創新的設計思維協作機制。 項目的預期結果可以為參與過程做出積極貢獻，從而影響更廣泛的協作環境。

14605722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14605722.value: 中國公司章程制度研究

14605722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605722.value: The aim of this project is to explore empirically the important question: what is the role and workings of corporate charters in mainland Chinese listed firms. The corporate charter, also known as a company’s constitution or articles of association, is the company’s most fundamental document. The charter regulates how a company is organised and managed. Importantly, it contains provisions on the rights and powers of shareholders in the governance of the company. Although the comparative literature on corporate charters and charter amendments is rapidly expanding, the role and workings of Chinese corporate charters remain largely under-studied and under-theorised. The proposed project attempts to fill this important gap, and in doing so to significantly enhance our understanding of corporate governance both in mainland China and more generally. The project will investigate both the initial charters of Chinese listed companies at the time of their public listings (“IPOs") and any subsequent, “midstream” amendments to those charters. It draws on two unique, hand-collected datasets on IPO charters and charter amendments, as well as qualitative data on the behavioural strategies of companies’ incorporators, controllers, managers and outside shareholders in respect of the charters to be obtained with the support of a network of collaborating PRC securities regulators. The project will present new insights into, among other things, the patterns of firm-level variations in corporate charters (in particular, substantive deviations from China’s semi-mandatory model charter in the case of IPO charters, and customized or innovative provisions in the case of midstream charter amendments); the determinants of the observed variations; and the impact of those variations on Chinese listed firms. It is anticipated that the systematic and empirical analyses of company constitutions in China, which this project offers, will inform and help to generate a more empirically-based theory, thereby advancing our understanding of the role that corporate charters play in the protection of minority shareholders and the development of national securities markets, with particular reference to China but also more generally. The importance of such an understanding is enhanced by the fact that major China-based corporations are now becoming significant global players. 本課題旨在通過實證方法研究中國大陸上市公司章程的作用和運作。 公司章程（corporate charter）也被稱為公司的內部憲章（company’s constitution），其為公司最基礎的文件。章程規範公司的組織和治理。尤為重要的是，其規定了股東在公司治理中的權利。對於公司章程和章程修訂的比較法研究正方興未艾，但是中國上市公司章程的作用和運作問題，依然缺乏系統研究和理論化。本課題旨在填補這個研究空缺，以期加深對中國大陸公司治理的研究。 本課題將研究上市公司在上市之初的初始章程，以及之後對初始章程的修訂。相關研究將建基於兩個資料庫，即初始章程資料庫和章程修訂資料庫。此外，研究工作還將通過與中國大陸相關監管方的合作，研究上市公司發起人、實控人、高管以及外部股東就公司章程的相關行為策略。本課題將試圖呈現全新的實證研究視角，例如公司層面章程的差異性（特別是初始章程與中國證監會公司章程指引的差異，以及章程修改中引入具有創新性和適配性的條款）、這些差異的決定因素、以及這些差異對中國上市公司的影響。 本課題希望通過對中國上市公司章程系統性和實證性研究，提出基於實證研究的相關理論，以加深對於公司章程在保護中小股東和證券市場發展中所發揮作用的認知。本課題立足中國經驗，同時也充分借鑒國際比較研究成果。中國企業發揮的全球影響力與日俱增，這也凸顯了本課題研究的重要性。

14606222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14606222.value: 許多正接受透析治療的末期腎病患者正面對治療費用高昂及收入大幅減少等疾病引致的財務問題。以本港患者為例，其貧窮及失業率比整體人口高。雖然財務問題有機會影響患者的身心健康，但目前大多數研究以估算腎病相關成本為主，而財務支援也集中於患者的物質需要。財務毒性這個嶄新概念客觀評估財務負擔，同時考慮由財務問題帶來的困擾，當中包含患者對財務負擔的心理與行為適應。這概念有助全面了解患者的財務狀況，並建構應對財務毒性及其影響因素的措施。 我們在文獻回顧的基礎上提出一個概念框架，以描述財務毒性、影響因素和結果之間的關係。雖然財務毒性在腎病患者中具重要意義，大多數現有研究集中在癌症患者身上。由於兩者在患病軌跡和治療方式方面有所不同，框架的適用性有待查證。本研究旨在發展對腎病患者財務毒性的理解。我們將採用順序混合研究法來探索這個多元概念。當中的定性研究將了解患者如何理解和體驗財務毒性。之後的定量研究將使用統計分析驗證這些發現。在最後階段，我們將整合定性與定量發現，製定適用於腎病患者的概念框架和教材。這套教材將由患者和醫護人員共同評核其相關性。 本研究將首次評估腎病患者的財務毒性，並開發一套教材以協助醫護人員和患者應對疾病帶來的財務問題。這概念框架將涵蓋加劇財務毒性的各項影響因素，並解釋財務毒性如何影響結果。我們期望研究結論為醫護人員及慈善團體提供一個更全面可靠的方法，評估及處理患者的財務需要。

14606322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14606322.value: 多模式伴侣支持應對干預對提升已完成乳癌治療的更年期前婦女及其伴侣性調適的成效：隨機對照試驗

14606322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14606322.value: Prof Chan Yip, Carmen Wing-han Dr Choi, Kai-chow Prof McCarthy, Alexandra Leigh

14606322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14606322.value: Breast cancer (BRC) is the leading female cancer in Hong Kong. Incidence rose substantially by 76.5% in the last decade, from 2,616 in 2008 to 4,618 in 2018. On average, around one third of all new BRC cases were women aged under 50 and the youngest case reported was 25 years old. While survival improves with advances in medical detection and treatment, these women will nonetheless experience detrimental treatment-related effects well into older age. Of note, 50%-90% of women (especially those who are premenopausal at the time of treatment) report changes in sexuality, such changes may detrimentally affect their intimate relationships, ultimately leading to poor quality of life. Systematic reviews indicate the effectiveness of couple-based interventions to promote sexual health in this context. However, sexual health is seldom addressed in cancer rehabilitation plans in Hong Kong and such intervention requires specialised training in this area. Hence the rigour and effectiveness of such interventions are unknown in the local context. Online-based interventions for sexual health are emerging forms of psychosexual intervention. A search of PubMed, Cochrane Library and the trial registries ClinicalTrials.gov and ISRCTN indicate that no study has investigated the effects of an innovative multimodal couple-based intervention on sexual health outcomes when the woman has been treated for breast cancer. This novel study therefore aims to 1) investigate the effects of a multimodal couple-based sexual health intervention for pre-menopausal BRC women and their partners to provide personalised psychosexual care; and 2) understand participants’ experience of, and compliance with the intervention. Premenopausal BRC women (N=160) and their partners will be recruited, with the dyads randomised into intervention (n=80) or attention control (n=80) groups. The intervention group will receive the intervention over eight weeks. The intervention comprises five face-to-face and virtual individual couple counselling sessions combined with online reading, a discussion forum, and telephone calls. The intervention is based on Level I-II evidence and a robust theoretical framework. The attention control group will receive usual care plus telephone calls comprising general greetings and reminders to complete follow-up surveys. The primary outcome is sexual adjustment at three months. Secondary outcomes include relationship quality and quality of life at three months. The project will adhere to the CONSORT-EHEALTH checklist. Qualitative interviews will explore the participants’ experience of, and compliance with the intervention. This study will provide the first pragmatic evidence of the effectiveness of multimodal couple-coping intervention for addressing this unmet BRC rehabilitative need.

14606622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14606622.value: 視覺工作記憶分塊的大規模實驗研究

14606622.label: Project Objectives
14606622.value: Objective 1: How featural information is represented in visual working memory? I will conduct a large-scale experiment (10,000 randomly generated displays × 400 trials/display = 4,000,000 trials) which will systematically measure human observers’ visual working memory performances on featural patterns. In a featural pattern, four squares will always be placed on the same locations, and the colors of these four squares will be chosen randomly (and independently) from a color wheel. Then, this data set will be analyzed by both machine learning and conceptual models to reveal the underlying factors. The resulting model will tell us how featural information is chunked, and more generally organized, in visual working memory. Objective 2: How spatial and featural information are jointly represented in visual working memory? The original plan was a large-scale experiment (10,000 randomly generated displays × 400 trials/display = 4,000,000 trials) that will systematically measure human observers’ visual working memory performances on spatial-featural patterns. Due to the rather deep budget cut, I will be able to complete only approximately half of the original plan. The data won't be as comprehensive as planned but should still be very useful.

14606622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14606622.value: 儘管傳統工作記憶模型通常把儲存的信息描述為離散彼此無聯繫的個體，最近的研究顯示個體被作為整塊儲存。廣泛來說，有些視覺刺激因為更規則而更容易記住（Brady & Tenenbaum, 2013; Brady & Alvarez, 2015）。 一項最近研究（Huang, 2021）證明了大規模實驗在相關研究問題（空間工作記憶）上的有效性。在本課題中，我提出開展兩項大規模實驗（各4百萬次測試）：其一關於特征信息的工作記憶（具體來說排成2乘2陣列的4個隨機顏色），另一項關於空間和特征信息的鏈接的視覺工作記憶 （具體來說，6個隨機顏色隨機分布在一個4乘4陣列上）。我將用機器學習和概念模型來分析這些實驗的結果，以揭示影響這些視覺刺激的工作記憶的主要因素和機制。 這些實驗將展現為網頁遊戲，在網上搜集數據。先期嘗試（花費58000港幣，完成49萬次測試）證明了網上數據搜集方式的可行性。

14606922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14606922.value: 精神健康的環境因素：一項使用地理生態瞬時評估的研究

14606922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14606922.value: Mental health issues (e.g., anxiety, depression) are significant global health issues, affecting about one-third of adults in the world and constituting some of the top global burdens of disease. Past studies have found that the natural, built and social environments in cities have considerable impacts on people’s mental health. The proposed study seeks to examine the impacts of these environments on people’s mental health while addressing the attendant methodological issues (the uncertain geographic context problem [UGCoP] and the neighborhood effect averaging problem [NEAP]) and taking into account the temporality of exposures and activity contexts. It will also consider the mediating effects of perceived exposures and the positive aspects of mental health (e.g., happiness, life satisfaction). With Hong Kong as the study area, it will use geographic ecological momentary assessment (GEMA) that integrates conventional ecological momentary assessment (EMA) with GPS tracking and mobile sensing to collect individual-level data to provide more accurate assessments of people’s environmental exposures and the impacts of such exposures on their mental health. By addressing the major methodological issues and limitations of past studies, the results of the proposed study will provide reliable scientific evidence for developing effective policies and improving urban designs through facilitating the creation of healthy living environments, which will in turn significantly benefit the residents of the study area in the long run. The findings will also reveal whether there is significant environmental injustice in people’s exposures to various environmental factors that increase or mitigate their mental health symptoms. Disadvantaged social groups that are particularly vulnerable to harmful environmental exposures and mental health issues will be identified. The study will suggest policies and measures for addressing the predicaments of these disadvantaged groups. 精神健康問題（例如焦慮、抑鬱）是重要的全球健康問題，影響著世界上約三分之一的成年人，並構成了一些全球最嚴重的疾病負擔。過去的研究發現，城市的自然、建成和社會環境對人們的精神健康有相當大的影響。這項研究的目的是了解這些環境因素對人們精神健康的影響，同時解決相關的方法學上的問題（例如地理情境不确定性問题和鄰里效應平均問題），並考慮到暴露的時間性和活動的環境因素。它還將考慮感知暴露的中介效應和精神健康的積極方面（例如幸福、生活滿意度）。這項研究將以香港為研究區，並利用地理生態瞬時評估，將傳統生態瞬時評估與全球定位系統追踪和移動傳感相結合，收集個體層面的數據，以更準確地評估人們的環境暴露和這種暴露對他們的精神健康的影響。通過解決過去研究的主要方法學上的問題和局限性，這項研究的結果將為制定有效的政策和通過促進創造健康的生活環境來改進城市設計提供可靠的科學證據，並且從長遠來說亦將極大地造福於研究區和香港內的居民。研究結果還將揭示人們在暴露於各種環境因素中是否存在嚴重的環境不公正，並提出解決的政策和措施。

14607322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14607322.value: 量刑一致和判刑因素：香港和英格蘭及威爾斯的比較

14607322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14607322.value: 量刑準則旨在提供一個透明機制，以倡導量刑一致，並確保司法平等。雖然法庭案件應逐案審理，但作出判刑的方式不應存在大幅度偏差。不同司法管轄區已趨向更廣泛地執行量刑準則，藉此推動量刑一致。在英格蘭及威爾斯，其量刑委員會已制定了針對多數常見罪行的量刑準則；而香港上訴法院亦於較低程度下制定了量刑準則，以便下級法院跟從。然而，還有多種因素可能影響最終判刑結果，其中包括法律內外之因素。 至今就香港量刑實質情況進行的研究甚少，尤其是以比較角度進行的研究。就此，本研究比較了香港和英格蘭及威爾斯兩地的量刑情況。本研究探討不同的量刑和背景因素對於判刑結果的潛在影響。在法官酌情權內，其中一個重要領域是法官對於控辯雙方分別提出的加刑和減刑因素的衡量。加刑因素指加重判刑的因素，而減刑因素則指減輕判刑的因素。現有的量刑準則就沒有詳盡地羅列加刑或減刑因素。這些因素可包括能加重被告罪責的事宜，或者其所造成的損害等加重罪行嚴重性的事宜。這些因素亦可包括跟被告的個人狀況和背景有關，而跟有關罪行沒有直接關係的事宜。 故本研究務求通過實證分析，考量了已編碼的香港區域法院和高等法院「判刑理由」報告，以及英格蘭及威爾斯「皇室法院量刑調查」的數據，以揭示法官就三項罪行 — 包括販運毒品罪、襲擊罪及盜竊罪 — 進行判刑時所考慮的相關因素。本研究目的是確定各種因素就量刑準則方面影響判刑的程度，以及這個影響是否因不同法律工作者而出現差異。本研究項目的成果有望就看似不能預測的判刑因素提供全面說明，從而為法律執業者提供有力支援。

14608022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608022.value: This study offers an in-depth enquiry into East-Asian digital youth who make use of social media and hyper-cute avatars to partake in aspects of civic engagement and social change. They largely belong to a generation of “digital natives” who have developed their affective and social skills on digital platforms. They are familiar with hyper-cute/kawaii aesthetics and the fantasy characters of Japanese ACG (Animation, Comics & Games), which they appropriate and recreate as avatars by means of profile images, animated gifs, memes, digital stickers and/or emoticons in public and private communications. They use hyper-cute icons or avatars such as Pepe the Frog (佩佩蛙), Little Grape (提子), Pandaman (熊猫人) Wang Yao (王耀) and A-Bian Doll (扁娃) to pursue a sense of belonging in the world of civic engagement. The study will combine computational big data analysis and online ethnography, more specifically representative and theoretical sampling methods, to research how hyper-cute avatars are used on social media platforms such as Weibo, Lofter, Instagram, TikTok, and Bilibili. The study will set up online case-studies in China, Taiwan and Hong Kong to examine how digital youth pursue "cuteness activism" across these regions. While these avatars may enable expressions of cultural pride and belonging, they have also contributed towards resentment and intolerance towards cultural/political/sexual others. The study will carry out social media analysis by archiving and analysing massively used avatars and how they are embedded in spirited conversation threads about local and/or international politics. These archives of avatars will be further annotated and evaluated in reference to other aspects of social life by means of participant experiences and focus groups. In this way the study will compare how cute avatars represent local and East-Asian styles of expressing affective, social and civic engagement. N/A

14608222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608222.value: 戰間期的帝國主義，國際主義，與全球勞動治理

14608222.label: Project Objectives
14608222.value: This project is pressing and important for two reasons. First, while there is now a century of international law, standards and jurisprudence pertaining to labor rights, those obligations and standards are not only under-complied with, but not even very well-known outside of small circles. Moreover, to the extent there is compliance with such obligations and standards, that compliance is sharply differentiated across regions and jurisdictions. Second, while international governance has evolved substantially since the inter-war period, international organizations still struggle to understand how to most effectively advance their mandates. While the proliferation of international institutions is positive to the extent more substantive issue areas can be addressed, to the extent new institutions operate parallel to rather than in complementarity with existing institutions, optimal effectiveness is lost. This research project offers a means of better understanding, reflecting upon, and contributing to addressing both aspects of this contemporary situation. By examining international labor governance in the inter-war period, in which the first steps were being taken to form a system of global governance, the project will explore one central part of the process through which the contemporary system was formed. By exploring the differences within the ILO’s engagement with different jurisdictions, and the different results of those engagements, the project will cast light on the relative utility of different forms of international action. And by exploring the substantive standards that were developed, their shortcomings both as such and in terms of their limited application, and the ongoing manner in which those limitations manifest themselves today, the project will cast light on and increase pressure for reform of labor law regimes that do not comply with international standards. In particular and in more detail, the project has five disaggregable aims, outlined below. First, the project aims to address the limited availability of clear and accessible information concerning the legal regimes governing labor that existed across the colonial world in the inter-war period. The project will do this by exploring and presenting in a clear and consolidated fashion the laws concerning labor governance applicable in the different case study contexts considered over the course of the time period considered. This will provide a helpful precursor to the future development of a comprehensive database of relevant laws in the period. Second, by considering the effectiveness of the ILO’s approaches in different contexts, the project aims to produce insights pertaining to the potential of different international strategies to produce reforms in relationship to varying national contexts. These insights may be helpful to contemporary international organizations, which continue to struggle to find the most effective ways to produce national level reforms. The study will be particularly interesting in this context insofar as the ILO was an early example of an international organization open to external inputs, presenting an interesting point of comparison in relation to many contemporary international mechanisms, which while similarly open to external inputs receive those inputs in different manners. Third, by highlighting the difference between the ILO’s approach to labor governance in the non-colonial and colonial regions of the world, the project aims to direct attention to, and to challenge, the structural inequalities in international governance that attended an early moment in the foundation of the contemporary international system. One aim in doing so is to strengthen pressure for reform of contemporary global governance institutions, directed both towards the ability of representatives of different jurisdictions to influence their policies, and the creation of stronger mechanisms aimed at responding to national-level actors. Fourth, the project aims to strengthen the global network of actors working in support of labor rights issues. This will be done by bringing together civil society, academic and international actors, including in and through the process of preparing, disseminating and advocating for implementation of the measures outlined in the Policy Reform Report. Forging closer connections between such actors will help to ensure that academic work is informed by the challenges encountered in practice, that policy proposals put forward in practice reflect cutting edge academic insights, and that maximum pressure is generated for progressive reform. Fifth and finally, the project aims to contribute to the reform of contemporary restrictive labor practices. The project will advance this aim through the production of a Policy Reform Report. The report will identify contemporary restrictive labor laws and practices stemming from and relating to the restrictive practices employed in the inter-war period, challenge those laws and practices by highlighting their colonial legacy, and outline clear and specific measures through which those laws and practices may be reformed.

14608222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608222.value: This project will explore four closely related questions: what approaches towards colonial labor governance were adopted by the International Labor Organization (‘ILO’) in the inter-war period; how effective was the ILO in producing change in labor regimes across the colonial world in practice; what variation was there in terms of the ILO’s impact across colonial, regional and jurisdictional contexts; and what causal factors may be hypothesized to have caused that differentiation? While the turn of the century period saw some labor law reforms undertaken in the colonial world, including the British colonial world in particular, progress was sharply limited. The end of the First World War was followed by major developments in international governance, including the creation of the League of Nations and the ILO. The formation of the ILO represented a victory for the forces of gradualist progressive labor law reform in the non-colonized world. A separate regime with far less demanding rules was carved out relative to the colonized world from that applicable elsewhere, however. Nonetheless, some standards were developed, including the Forced Labour Convention, the Forced Labour (Indirect Compulsion) Recommendation, the Forced Labour (Regulation) Recommendation, and the Recruitment of Indigenous Workers Convention. This project will explore the approach of the ILO towards enforcing labor standards relative to workers in the colonized world in practice, and to what extent the ILO’s work was impactful, in relation to a collection of case studies. These case studies will be selected with a number of factors in mind, including regional and imperial diversity as well as levels of ILO engagement. The case studies chosen may be amended as the project proceeds, in light of information obtained. The initial plan is to study six jurisdictions from across three empires: Hong Kong and Kenya, from the British Empire; Angola and Mozambique, from the Portuguese Empire; and French Cameroon and French Indochina, from the French Empire. In addition to academic outputs, the insights of the research will be used to generate a Policy Reform Report that places contemporary labor rights restrictions in the States considered in the context of their colonial history, and urges reform of laws and policies that fail to comply with international standards. 本研究試圖探討四個互相關聯的問題：國際勞工組織（International Labor Organization）在間戰期對待殖民地勞動關係治理的態度；該組織在各殖民地推行勞動法律制度的變革是否有效；國際勞工組織在不同殖民地、不同區域和不同法域背景下造成的不同影響；造成這些差異的根本原因。 儘管世紀之交的勞動法律制度在各殖民地，特別是英國殖民地中，不同程度地發生着變革，但相關進展仍然十分有限。隨著第一次世界大戰的終結，全球治理出現了新的局面，其中就包括國際聯盟和國際勞工組織的相繼設立。國際勞工組織的建立首先標誌著殖民地以外地區以漸進式改良勞動法律制度為主張的變革力量取得了一定勝利。另一方面，相比非殖民地地區，廣大殖民地世界依舊適用著一套顯著降低標準的勞動保障制度。儘管如此，新的標準依然一定程度上得到了發展，包括引入《強迫勞動公約》(Forced Labour Convention）、《關於強迫勞動（非直接強制）的建議書》 (Forced Labour [Indirect Compulsion] Recommendation）、《關於（規制）強迫勞動的建議書》 (Forced Labour [Regulation] Recommendation），以及《招募本地工人公約》(Recruitment of Indigenous Workers Convention)等。 本研究將從相關案例中探尋國際勞工組織在面對殖民地存在的強迫勞動現象時，關於推動改善勞動保障標準的態度及其影響。相關案例的選擇將同時考慮包括地區、宗主國之間的差異，以及國際勞工組織介入的程度等不同因素。隨著研究工作的進一步開展，所選取的案例也會相應調整。初步計畫選擇包括三個宗主國在內的六個地區：即英帝國治下的香港和肯尼亞；葡萄牙帝國治下的安哥拉和莫桑比克；以及法蘭西帝國治下的喀麥隆和法屬印度隻那。除相關學術成果外，本研究還將結合殖民史，針對當代美國勞動權益保障和國際標準之間的差異，就相關法律法規和政策的不足提出改革方案。

14608422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608422.value: 國際刑法中定罪後的司法： 來自香港和其他成熟的國內法律體系的經驗

14608422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14608422.value: Prof Gordon, Gregory Steven Prof Young, Simon Ngai Man

14608422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608422.value: Is the post-conviction phase of modern international criminal law (ICL) serving the interests of justice? Since the Nuremberg Trials ICL project was resurrected post-Cold War via prosecutions for 1990s Balkan ethnic cleansing and Rwandan genocide, various mass atrocity architects and perpetrators convicted by the International Criminal Tribunals for the former Yugoslavia and Rwanda have been given relatively light sentences (sometimes no more than 20 years) and routinely released well before the prescribed imprisonment period. Moreover, these early release decisions, which have been the model for subsequent international criminal mechanisms (e.g., the Special Court for Sierra Leone and the International Criminal Court), are plagued by lack of due process, transparency and resource commitment to investigate release eligibility and/or assure adequate supervision post-release. In contrast, mature domestic justice systems, such as those of Hong Kong, the United States (US), and France, punish comparable crimes, e.g., mass murder or other violent offenses motivated by group hate, much more severely and are far more restrictive in commuting the sentences handed down. Additionally, the attendant sentencing and early release processes in these jurisdictions bear the hallmarks of due process, transparency, and proper resource investment. This project will identify lessons for ICL from a comparative domestic law study of appropriate punishment criteria, and empirical data for sentencing consistent with such criteria, for the most serious crimes in relation to the possibility for early release. It will also discern best policies and practices – both in terms of procedure and infrastructure – for early release decisions and supervised release in the three chosen domestic systems: Hong Kong, the US and France. The latter two have been selected as good common law and civil law representatives, respectively. Moreover, these countries were two of the principal framers of the Nuremberg Charter, which gave birth to ICL (including its punishment/early release components, from which modern ICL has strayed). Hong Kong, with its “one country two systems” legal framework, incorporating British and Mainland Chinese influences, is an excellent hybrid model and, given its core English legal lineage, largely represents the UK, another of the four framers of the Nuremberg Charter (the now defunct USSR being the fourth). Moreover, these three jurisdictions provide an excellent geographic comparative sample, covering Asia, the Americas and Europe. Thus, as a bonus, the comparative analysis of the domestic jurisdictions studied may also yield recommendations for improvements in one or more of those individual jurisdictions. 現代國際刑法(ICL)定罪後的階段是否為正義服務？在紐倫堡審判後 , ICL 項目在冷戰後通過起訴 1990 年代巴爾幹種族清洗和盧旺達種族滅絕而復興，前南斯拉夫和盧旺達國際刑事法庭定罪的各種大規模暴行策劃者和肇事者的刑期相對較輕（有時沒有超過 20 年）並且通常在規定的監禁期之前就被釋放。此外，這些提前釋放的決定，因缺乏適當程式、透明度和資源來調查釋放資格和/ 或確保發佈後有足夠的監督，已成為其後國際刑事機構的模式（例如，獅子山問題特別法庭和國際刑事法院）。相比之下，成熟的國內司法系統，例如香港、美國和法國的司法系統，對類似的犯罪行為（例如大規模謀殺或其他出於群體仇恨動機的暴力犯罪）的懲罰要更爲嚴厲，在減刑中限制性也更大。此外，這些司法管轄區伴隨的量刑和提前釋放程式具有正當程式、透明度和適當資源投資的特點。 該項目將比較成熟的國內司法系統關於適當懲罰的標準， 和與此類標準一致的量刑經驗資料，以此來探討ICL 提前釋放極嚴重罪行罪犯的經驗教訓。它還在三個選定的國內系統：香港、美國和法國，分辨最佳的政策和法律實踐。 其中包括提前釋放和監控下釋放罪犯的程式和基礎結構。其中，美國和法國是良好的普通法和民法系統代表。此外，這些國家是紐倫堡憲章的兩個主要制定者，它催生了 ICL（包括現代 ICL 偏離的懲罰/提前釋放部分）。香港以其“一國兩制”的法律框架，融合了英國和中國大陸的影響，是一個優秀的混合模式。鑒於其核心的英國法律血統，它在很大程度上代表了英國，英國是《紐倫堡憲章》的四個制定者之一（現在解散的蘇聯是第四個）。此外，這三個司法管轄區提供了出色的地理比較樣本，涵蓋亞洲、美洲和歐洲。因此，作為附加的優點，是次比較分析也可能為改進相關司法管轄區提出一些建議。

14608622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608622.value: 侵害性電子信息在香港的非刑事規制

14608622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608622.value: Online harassment, cyber-bullying, doxxing, intimate image abuse and other abusive digital conduct cause significant harm to individuals and society. Legal regulation in Hong Kong has long failed to respond adequately to these forms of ‘hurtful digital communications’ (HDC). The Government is now partially addressing these shortcomings through the introduction of new criminal offences. Yet while criminal law has an important role to deter seriously harmful behaviour, it focuses on the perpetrator rather than the victim, and on punishment rather than prevention, restoration and compensation. This research project adopts a victim-centred approach, and so asks how the civil and administrative law of Hong Kong can be reformed to supplement the criminal law and provide victims of HDC more effective forms of redress. The research project will systematically identify and map different types of hurtful digital behaviours as they typically occur in Hong Kong, and consider the effectiveness of the current model of regulation. After reviewing comparator jurisdictions, the project will propose a comprehensive and integrated approach to the regulation of HDC in Hong Kong beyond criminal prohibition. It will proceed in three stages. The first stage will use empirical research to establish a typology of HDC in Hong Kong as well as seek stakeholder views on appropriate legal responses. It also involves a stock take of current methods of regulation, both at common law and in legislation, in Hong Kong. This stage will generate a new framework that describes the continuum of hurtful digital behaviours as they occur in practice and identifies gaps in the current system. It ensures that our project speaks to practical local experiences, rather than assuming evidence gathered elsewhere reflects the situation in Hong Kong. The second stage will be doctrinal legal research into overseas laws and practices. It compares the laws of Hong Kong with the relevant regulatory approaches adopted or considered in selected other jurisdictions. The laws encompassed are civil causes of action against harassment, privacy invasion and other intentional wrongs, as well as administrative schemes directed at harmful digital content, including ‘take-down’ requirements for intermediaries and end-users, as well as data protection laws. In the third stage, a comprehensive set of non-criminal legal reforms will be developed and proposed for Hong Kong. These proposed reforms will seek to reduce the problem of HDC and enhance victim protection and empowerment, whilst also being conscious that any attempts to regulate online activity will necessarily implicate other important values including free expression. 網絡空間中的不當行為，如網絡騷擾、霸凌、“起底”個人隱私，以及私密影像的濫用等都對個人和社會造成嚴重損害。在香港，法律手段尚不能有效應對這些“侵害性電子信息” (hurtful digital communications)。政府正試圖通過將該等行為列入新的刑事犯罪等方式儘可能地彌補現有的法律漏洞。然後，儘管刑事法律規定在遏制相關侵害行為上具有重要作用，但刑事規定本身更加注重懲戒而非預防，更加關注加害者而非受害人，從而忽略了對損害結果的補救和賠償。本研究側重受害人視角，重點討論如何對現有的香港民事和行政法律規範進行改進，以便給受有害電子信息侵擾的一方提供更多有效的救濟途徑，以彌補當前刑事法律規制的不足。 本研究計畫系統性地根據香港社會中較為普遍的網絡侵害行為加以分類，從而進一步評價香港社會現有法律制度的規制效果。本研究將通過對其他法域的比較，共分三個階段，全面、綜合地就刑事措施以外的規制手段給出建議。 第一階段將通過實證研究，結合各利益相關群體對合理措施的意見，對香港社會中存在的侵害性電子信息進行分類討論。同時亦將分別從普通法和成文法的視角，對香港現有的法律規範進行梳理。這一階段將試圖从理論層面對實踐中普遍存在的網絡侵害行為進行描述並指出現行制度的不足。本研究將特別注重面向香港本土社會生活實踐，而非一味假定來自其他地方的經驗能夠反映香港的社會現實。 本研究第二階段將採用法教義學方法研究域外法及其相關實踐。通過有選擇地比較香港和其他一些地方的法律制度，將對包括網絡騷擾、侵犯隱私權等故意侵權行為在內的民事訴由，以及行政規制下的各類保護措施（如要求網絡中介服務商和終端用戶刪除有害信息，以及數據保護的相關法律規定等）進行梳理。 第三階段將針對香港提出修訂非刑事規制措施的全面意見。這些建議將試圖在減輕侵害性電子信息帶來的危害的同時，更加注重受害者一方的保護和權益平衡，同時還會充分考慮對包括言論自由等其他網絡空間重要價值的潛在影響。

14608922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608922.value: 幼稚園教師情緒勞動及其前因與結果的工作要求—資源分析：三城記

14608922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14608922.value: Dr Huang, Sheng-hua Dr Liu, Sheng-nan Prof Tian, Guo-xiu Dr Wang, Hui Dr Zheng, Xin

14609022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14609022.value: 競爭的新方式：香港如何適應新的國際稅收秩序

14609022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14609022.value: 香港作為商業和金融中心的吸引力長期以來倚賴於其 "低稅政策"，而這在香港《基本法》中亦有規定。然而，最近的國際稅收政策的改革和持續的發展已經大大削弱了香港的相對稅務優勢。本項目旨在分析新的國際稅收秩序對香港的影響，並探討為保持競爭力香港可以采取的稅收及非稅收措施。 本項目的第一部分將分析近期國際稅收改革和趨勢對香港作為國際金融和商業中心的吸引力的影響。將要考慮的因素之一是其他國家企業所得稅稅率的降低和采用地域稅基的情況。在20世紀80年代，經合組織國家的法定企業所得稅稅率很少低於45%，而到2020年，這些國家的平均法定企業稅稅率下降到了23%。另一個將被考慮的因素是國際稅收改革，該等改革降低了在低稅率地區投資的吸引力，例如BEPS項目和全球最低稅率的國際協同。 本項目的第二部分將研究香港和其他低稅率地區如何對國際稅收環境的這些變化做出反應。在遵守新的國際稅收標準的同時，香港並沒有考慮這些變化對其利用稅收政策吸引商業活動的長期戰略的影響。在過去的幾年裏，盡管稅收優惠作為吸引投資的手段的有效性在下降，但香港還是采取了更多的優惠稅收制度。香港政府現在正在考慮是否應該根據最近的國際稅收發展來修改這些制度。 本項目的第三部分將把討論範圍擴大到現有政策之外，探討香港可以采取的新政策和措施，以保持和提高其國際吸引力。這些政策可能包括符合新的國際稅收標準的稅收措施以及非稅收措施。這一部分將討論與這些政策相關的問題和挑戰。

14609122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14609122.value: 在一帶一路沿線國家分階段停止使用煤炭：傳統管制和市場主導的方法

14609122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14609122.value: Prof Bogojevic, Sanja Prof DELINA, Laurence Mr Pirzada, Ashan Prof Quan, Nguyen Hong Mr Suryadi, Beni Dr Wang, Peng

14609122.label: Project Objectives
14609122.value: INFLUENCE THE DEBATE ON THE DECARBONIZATION OF THE BELT AND ROAD ENERGY INFRASTRUCTURE Although the 2015 BRI Vision and Actions aims to promote the development of low-carbon energy, significant investments have been in coal-fired power generation, undermining both global decarbonization efforts and the energy transition in BRI countries. Focusing on three key destinations for Chinese foreign investments in coal-based infrastructure along the BRI (Indonesia, Pakistan and Vietnam), this project aims to influence the debate on the transition away from coal through legal reform in host BRI countries. CONTRIBUTE TO UNDERSTANDING LEGAL PATHWAYS TO PHASE OUT COAL WITH LEAST RESISTANCE As illustrated by the recent arbitration claims against regulated phase out decisions in Canada and the Netherlands, international investment protection presents a potentially significant threat for states deciding to move away from coal. This project aims to contribute to the debate on decarbonization by examining different legal pathways to the phasing out of coal, taking into account the obstacle of investment protection. The decarbonization measures necessary to limit the global temperature rise in accordance with international commitments will unavoidably result in stranded assets for the carbon-intensive industry. Law has a crucial role to play in navigating the resistance from vested interests in coal-fired power generation, and accelerating the transition away from coal. CONTRIBUTE TO UNDERSTANDING THE ROLE OF ELECTRICITY REGULATION FOR DECARBONIZATION By contrast to the mandatory closure of coal-fired power plants, electricity market reform and carbon pricing can contribute to the closure of coal-fired power plants through market forces. Under the market-based approach to coal phase out, electricity market regulation plays a determining role in the achievement of decarbonization. This project aims to contribute to understanding the environmental function of electricity regulation and of electricity market reform, with a focus on developing economies where access to electricity remains a challenge. INFLUENCE THE DEBATE ON THE PHASING OUT OF FOSSIL SUBSIDIES Electricity law can either contribute to the closure of coal-fired power plants by exposing these to competition from the cheapest energy sources, or artificially protect them from renewable energy and the cost of carbon. This project aims to better understand the regulatory obstacles to the phase out of coal through market forces, including explicit and hidden subsidies to coal-fired power generation under the domestic electricity regulation of the countries studied. GAIN UNDERSTANDING OF THE ROLE OF DOMESTIC LAW IN DECARBONIZING CHINESE FOREIGN ENERGY INVESTMENTS President Xi announced in September 2021 that China will not build new coal-fired power plants abroad. However, the phasing out of existing investments will eventually depend on the laws of the host BRI countries. This project aims to understand the role that the electricity and climate laws of BRI countries play for Chinese investments in coal-fired power generation, taking into account the necessity to close all coal-fired power plants by 2040 in order to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050 (International Energy Agency, 2021). CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT LAW ALONG THE BRI Despite their importance for global decarbonization efforts, and the scale of the national energy and environmental challenges, the BRI countries studied in this project have received relatively limited attention in the energy and environmental law literature. This project aims to contribute to the development of energy and environmental law in the region, and to the energy and environmental law scholarship more generally, by engaging in a rigorous study of the legal aspects of coal phase out in three carbon-intensive jurisdictions.
