15100222.value: 通過多焦視網膜電圖預測藥物性（0.05%阿托品）和非藥物性（多區正向光學離焦 (DIMS) 眼鏡）療法對不同近視加深速率兒童的控制成效

15100222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15100222.value: Dr Chan, Jonathan Cheuk Hung Dr Choi, Kai Yip Dr Choy, Bonnie Nga Kwan

15100222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100222.value: 近視風潮席捲全球，研究估計於2050 年時近視患者將佔全球一半人口。尤甚，香港青少年的近視患病率於目前近 80%，因此控制近視顯得十分重要。在香港，阿托品眼藥水是常見近視控制的藥物性治療，而多區正向光學離焦 (DIMS) 鏡片是目前流行的光學（非藥物性）治療。 在我們團隊的 GRF2017研究計劃，追蹤了 61 名兒童18 個月，以研究 0.01% 阿托品治療對他們的影響。研究對象會通過我們團隊在 GRF2013研究計劃中開發的改良多焦視網膜電生理圖 (mfERG) 進行測量，從而預測這些兒童未來的近視進展為快或慢。根據結果，阿托品 (0.01%) 可有效控制預計進展速度較快的兒童的近視，但對預計進展速度較慢的兒童沒有顯著效果。我們的實驗結果可以解釋在各個不同研究中，0.01% 阿托品所產生爭議性的成效。 基於不同研究中所報告的較佳的近視控制成效，更高濃度（0.05%）的阿托品最近受到推崇。然而，尚未有研究具體指出，在不同近視加深速率的兒童於使用 0.05% 阿托品時，其近視控制成效會否有所不同。另外，新型 DIMS 鏡片利用多個小透鏡以造成週邊正向光學離焦，已在學童中顯示出顯著的近視控制效果（約 60%）。然而，尚未有研究具體指出，在不同近視加深速率的兒童於使用DIMS鏡片時，其近視控制成效會否有所不同。 最近的研究顯示，L/M 視錐細胞比可能與近視發展有關。根據我們團隊 GRF2013 的 mfERG 研究結果，視網膜在決定未來近視進展有著不可或缺的角色。另外一項研究顯示，mfERG 反應的特徵與 L/M 錐體的反應有關。因此，我們推測mfERG 反應之所以能預測兒童的近視進展，可能與 L/M 視錐細胞反應的貢獻有關，並且 L/M 視錐細胞反應可能是近視發展的關鍵因素。 是次擬議的研究是一項為期 18 個月的縱向隨機試驗，旨在通過其初始 mfERG 反應，在預測不同近視加深速率的兒童中，應用 0.05% 阿托品療法，或驗配 DIMS 鏡片後的近視發展。這將有助於闡明使用 0.05% 阿托品和DIMS 鏡片來控制具有不同近視加深速率的兒童的近視控制成效。是次視網膜電生理研究將有助於確定 L/M 視錐細胞在青少年近視進展中的角色以及在阿托品和 DIMS 治療下，視網膜電生理的變化。

15100322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100322.value: 背景：耳念珠菌是一種新興的真菌病原體，由於其具有院內暴發和多重耐藥性的傾向，對全球健康構成嚴重威脅。世界各地爆發了對所有三類抗真菌藥物具有抗性的耳念珠菌菌株。然而，其抗性機制在很大程度上是未知的，需要立即研究。在白色念珠菌和釀酒酵母中，它們的細胞外囊泡分泌物被證明可以分別促進對氟康唑和卡泊芬淨的抗真菌藥物的保護作用。在 耳念珠菌中，只有一篇論文描述了 耳念珠菌细胞外囊的特徵，而且該方法採用耗時的肉湯培養基純化方法。 假設：我們假設耳念珠菌细胞外囊可以用快速固體培養基純化，傳統肉湯培養基純化的细胞外囊和固體培養基純化的 细胞外囊具有相似的功能。我們還假設耳念珠菌细胞外囊負責促進细胞外囊的耐藥機制。 目的：我們將通過肉湯和固體培養基的方法純化耳念珠菌细胞外囊，並比較它們之間的细胞外囊。其次，我們將調查耳念珠菌细胞外囊是否會促進 耳念珠菌和其他念珠菌的抗真菌藥物耐藥性。第三，我們將闡明耳念珠菌细胞外囊如何調節抗真菌敏感性的機制。 試點數據：從固體和培養基方法純化的耳念珠菌细胞外囊可以將敏感的耳念珠菌菌株調節為兩性黴素 B。添加细胞外囊後 MIC 增加高達 16 倍。 實驗設計：我們將比較兩種 EV 純化方法之間的 EV 貨物。然後在添加 EV 的情況下對耳念珠菌的三類抗真菌藥物進行抗真菌 MIC，並調查耐藥性是否與细胞外囊有關。我們將通過選擇性降解通常富含细胞外囊的不同類別的貨物來確定哪些细胞外囊成分可能導致耐藥機制，通過無表達 CRISPR-Cas9 驗證它們，並使用來自耳念珠菌突變體的细胞外囊重複抗真菌 MIC。 意義：快速固體细胞外囊淨化方法可以大大減少時間和工作量，通過將環境污染風險降到最低也更安全。如果快速固體培養基方法能夠替代傳統的耗時耗力的液體培養基方法，將對真菌學和细胞外囊領域有很大的好處。此外，目前的提案將解決耳念珠菌耐藥機制中的主要問題。它可能會增進我們的知識並幫助制定針對真菌感染的治療策略。

15100422.value: 結核分枝桿菌小分子抗毒劑的發現——從高通量篩選到感染模型驗證

15100422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15100422.value: Dr Kao, Richard Yi Tsun Prof Ma, Chun Hang

15100422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100422.value: 背景：結核病 (TB) 仍然是傳染性人群死亡的主要疾病。多重耐藥與毒力增強相結合是治療及控制結核病的最大挑戰。抑制結核分枝桿菌毒力 (抗毒劑) 最近已成為一種治療結核病的新方向。在之前資助的項目中，我們的團隊使用了多組學分析和熒光斑馬魚感染模型以揭示 結核分枝桿菌毒力增強的分子機制。我們發現 phoP 和 IdeR 的過表達增強了結核分枝桿菌在人類巨噬細胞內生長，亦有利於入侵斑馬魚中樞神經系統。 假設：抑制 phoP 和 IdeR 表達可能會損害結核分枝桿菌在巨噬細胞內的存活，促進宿主的免疫系統根除細菌。 目的：發現和驗證小分子化合物作為結核分枝桿菌的抗毒劑。 試點：我們開發了一個基於 lux 啟動子報告質粒的高通量篩選平台，以確定牛分枝桿菌 BCG 中的 phoP 和 IdeR 啟動子活性 對 320 種抗病毒化合物的治療作出反應。基於全基因組 RNA-seq 分析，一種化合物 ST-193 被鑑定為潛在的抗毒劑，因為它失調了負責硫脂生物合成、鐵代謝和氧化應激反應的 phoP 和 ideR 途徑。人類巨噬細胞和斑馬魚感染模型還表明，該化合物可以損害 結核分枝桿菌的細胞內生長並避免感染高毒性海分枝桿菌的斑馬魚中樞神經系統入侵。 設計：將使用基於 lux 的篩選平台篩選 3,957 種藥物再利用化合物庫，以了解它們抑制 BCG 中 phoP 和 IdeR 啟動子活性的能力。 phoP 和 IdeR 及其下游基因網絡的失調表達將使用 RT-qPCR 和 RNA-Seq 進行驗證。化合物的細胞毒性將使用乳酸脫氫酶測定來確定。將在BSC和耐藥 結核分枝桿菌中測定化合物的最低抑菌濃度和殺菌濃度及其與一線抗結核藥物的部分抑菌濃度。將評估所選化合物對 THP-1 巨噬細胞內 lux 標記的耐藥性和高毒性結核分枝桿菌的細胞內存活的影響。多重熒光斑馬魚模型將用於確定這些化合物是否可以抑制感染高毒性海分枝桿菌的動物模型中結核病的發展。 意義：該項目將為結核病提供一組新的抗毒力療法，以應對耐藥性結核病的上升趨勢和超毒力菌株的出現

15100822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15100822.value: 太極拳預防陣發性偏頭痛發作的效果評價及機制探索

15100822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15100822.value: Dr Chen, Xiangyan Prof Gao, Gemma Yang Prof HUI, Stanley Sai-chuen Prof Lau, Alexander Yuk-lun Dr Tyrovolas , Stefanos Prof Yeung, Wing-Fai

15100822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15100822.value: People with repeated migraine attacks endure pain and have impaired social and personal lives. Public do not consider migraine as serious because it does not cause death, is not contagious, and is mostly episodic. Whereas the public health importance lies in its causality with pain, disability, and increased disease burden. Non-pharmacological treatments play an important role in migraine prophylaxis, given that these treatments are relatively safe and highly tolerable. Several studies have found that aerobic exercise can significantly reduce frequency of migraine attack and alleviate pain. As a mind-body aerobic exercise, Tai Chi's potential therapeutic efficacy on the migraine prophylaxis remains largely unknown. The proposed study aims to examine the clinical efficacy of 24-week Tai Chi training in the prophylaxis of episodic migraine comparing with standard prophylactic medication in Hong Kong Chinese women, and to explore the mechanism of Tai Chi's intervention effect by examining the associations of changes in migraine features with neurovascular and neuroinflammation variations. A two-arm individual level non-inferiority randomized controlled trial is designed. A total of 220 local women diagnosed with episodic migraine between 18–65 years will be randomly assigned to one of two groups: 1) a Tai Chi training group receiving the 33-short form Yang-style Tai Chi training; or 2) a standard prophylactic medication group receiving the regular medication prescribed by a neurologist. The intervention period will be 24 weeks with another 24 weeks of follow-up. The frequency of migraine attacks, migraine days, intensity, and duration of headache will be recorded in a migraine diary at the baseline, 24th weeks, and 48th weeks. Other outcomes, including migraine-related disability, stress, sleep quality, fatigue, and body composition will be measured at these three time points. The clinical efficacy will be determined by comparing the differences of outcomes throughout the trial between the two groups. The functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging and Transcranial Doppler will be used to measure the white matter lesions and cerebral vasculature activity, respectively; and the inflammatory markers will be tested during the trial for Tai Chi participants. The mechanism of intervention effect will be explored by analyzing the changes and associations of migraine features with the process of these neurovascular functions and inflammatory markers during and after the Tai Chi training. Given the importance of reducing disease burden and financial cost of migraine attacks, the findings of this study will provide new insights into the role of Tai Chi as a migraine prophylaxis. 偏頭痛反復發作讓人疼痛難忍，並影響個人的社會交往和生活。公眾並不太重視偏頭痛，因為偏頭痛不會直接致死，不具有傳染性，而且多數情況下是陣發性的頭痛。然而，從公共衛生角度來看，其重要性在於偏頭痛與疼痛、殘疾以及增加的疾病負擔之間存在因果關係。非藥物治療在預防偏頭痛發作中扮演著重要角色。因為非藥物治療相對安全和耐受。相關研究發現，有氧運動可以明顯降低偏頭痛發作的頻率，並減輕發作時的疼痛。而太極拳作為一種身心有氧運動，在預防偏頭痛方面的潛在療效，目前仍不為人所知。 本研究旨在比較24週太極拳訓練和標準預防用藥對患有陣發性偏頭痛的香港華人女性預防頭痛發作的臨床療效，並通過檢驗干預前後偏頭痛特征變化與神經血管和神經炎症因子變化之間的關系，來探討太極拳療效的作用機理。 本研究為一項非劣效性、雙臂、個體水平的隨機對照試驗。研究對像為220名年齡在18-65歲之間，被診斷為陣發性偏頭痛的香港華人女性。參加者將被隨機分為兩組：1) 接受三十三式楊式太極拳訓練的干預組； 2)由腦神經科醫生開出標准預防性用藥的對照組。干預期為24週，並隨訪24週。偏頭痛發作頻率、發作天數、頭痛強度和持續時間將會用偏頭痛日記進行記錄，記錄節點為基線，第24週和第48週。其他結局變量，包括偏頭痛相關殘疾、壓力、睡眠質量、疲勞和身體成也將分別在這三個時間點進行測量。通過比較整個試驗中結局變量在兩組間的差異，來確定太極干預的臨床療效。本研究將應用核磁共振成像和經顱多普勒技術分別檢測參加者腦白質病變程度和腦血流活動情況，並檢測血液炎性標志物水平變化。干預效果的機制探討將通過分析在太極拳訓練前後偏頭痛特征與神經血管功能、炎性標志物的水平變化來獲得。 考慮到減輕偏頭痛疾病負擔和經濟成本的重要性，基於此研究的發現將為太極拳在預防偏頭痛發作中的作用提供新的認識。

15101422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15101422.value: 血腦屏障中自噬的失衡與三方基序 (TRIM) 家族蛋白的作用 - 腦白質高信號產生之細胞機制的一個新推定

15101422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15101422.value: Prof CHAN, Kannie Wai Yan Dr Chen, Xiangyan Dr Tse, Kai Hei

15101422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15101422.value: 由於磁力共振 （MRI）的進步，當血腦屏障發生滲漏，神經成像技術可以偵測到腦內自由擴散的液體在掃描下產生腦白質高信號 (White matter hyperintensity, WMH)。 我們和其他人之前曾表明，腦白質高信號體積與衰老大腦的認知能力下降之間存在顯著相關性。在腦白質高信號病變中, 髓鞘束和少突膠質細胞 (oligodendrocyte, OL) 的喪失可能會破壞正常的神經傳遞並導致認知障礙。最近，全基因組關聯研究將基因座 17q25 識別為對腦白質高信號發展具有最大風險的區域之一。重要的是，在這區域發現了三方基序 (TRIM) 家族中的兩個成員 TRIM47 和 TRIM65 的變體位。這些三方基序成員變體位在大腦中的生物學功能知之甚少。 大腦和血液之間的直接界面是腦血管系統的內皮細胞 (endothelial cells, ECs)。最新的研究表明，腦血管內皮細胞通過自噬適應動態血流來維持血腦屏障的完整性。自噬是細胞穩態的關鍵過程。高血壓是一種高發病率但無症狀的都市疾病。在是次研究項目中，我們集中假設高血壓會導致腦血管系統的血流顯著減少並引發內皮細胞自噬失效，然後導致是血腦屏障滲漏和產生腦白質高信號。一些已知的三方基序家族成員會通過與不同階段的自噬控制蛋白（ULK1、Beclin1、LC3、LAMP1/2）相互作用來促進自噬，但是TRIM47 和 TRIM65 在 內皮細胞自噬過程中的作用仍然未知。 在腦血管疾病小鼠模型中，我們初步發現 Trim47， 而非 Trim65，的表達與腦白質高信號的形成之間存在顯著相關性。重要的是，我們對單細胞 RNAseq 數據的後設分析以及組織學研究和數碼生物庫的搜索 同時 證實了 Trim47 是由腦內皮細胞選擇性地表達。鼠腦源性內皮細胞系 (b.End3) 的細胞培養研究揭示了 Trim47 蛋白在細胞核和細胞質中的雙重定位。而且，Trim47 在自噬過程中與自噬標誌物 LC3 密切相關。令人驚訝的是，Trim47 的基因沉默下放大了內皮細胞的自噬。我們通過超級電腦和超分辨率顯微鏡中驗證了 Trim47 和自噬機制的蛋白質有交互作用並有可能是自噬的調節劑。 在是次研究項目中，我們主要假設 Trim47 通過抑制腦內皮細胞來獨特地控制自噬。在高血壓環境或遺傳變異攜帶者中，這種調節可能變成失衡，最終加劇了血腦屏障發生滲漏並形成腦白質高信號。我們提議在久經確立的高血壓小鼠模型（Apoe-/- 和 BPH/2J) 和新的 Trim47-/- 小鼠模型中驗證我們的假設,並有兩個目標。 (1) 我們旨在破譯三方基序家族蛋白在腦白質高信號產成的過程中如何影響腦內皮細胞自噬調節中的功能 ; (2) 在臨床前模型中，研究TRIM47對恢復自噬的作用及對腦白質高信號產的影響 。

15102022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102022.value: 聆聽病人康復過程和心聲: 隨機對照試驗測試電影浮生心理療法對中國香港兒童癌症康復者的抑鬱症狀，自尊，和生活質量的有效性

15102022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15102022.value: Prof Bressington, Daniel Prof Chan, Godfrey Chi-fung Ms Chiu, Sau Ying Dr Lam, Ka Wai Katherine Dr Mak, Yim Wah Dr Tyrovolas , Stefanos Prof Wong, Frances Kam-yuet

15102022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102022.value: 研究背景：兒童癌症對康復者的心理健康構成嚴重的影響。與西方不同，在中國的兒童癌症康復者受宿命論影響，主要採取以情緒為中心的應對策略。因此，在西方使用的心理干預措施並不能照顧中國兒童癌症康復者的心理需要。利用電子科技講述自己的個人病歷 <又名: 電影浮生> 是一種以情緒為中心的心理療法，從理論上更切合中國兒童癌症康復者的心理需要。但現時中西研究針對此心理療法在中國兒童癌症康復者只有少數。 研究目的：本研究旨在測試電影浮生能否減少中國兒童癌症康復者的抑鬱症狀，增強他們自尊，和提高生活質量的有效性。 研究設計：這是一項混合方法隨機等待名單對照試驗。我們將在香港兒童醫院招募 186 名 13 至 18 歲的中國兒童癌症康復者。參與者將被隨機分配到實驗組 (n=93) 或對照組(n=93)。實驗組的參與者將接受為期 4 天的電影浮生干預，而對照組的參與者將接受與實驗組相同程度和時間的安慰劑。兩組的參與者將會在基線，完成心理療法後，1個月、3個月、6個月的隨訪被邀請填寫一組經過驗證的問卷以評估他們的抑鬱症狀、自尊和生活質量。主要結果是參與者在六個月時出現的抑鬱症狀。協方差分析將用於測試電影浮生對抑鬱症狀、自尊和生活質量的有效性， 研究的貢獻：促進兒童癌症康復者的心理健康是醫護人員的主要責任。這個研究將彌補現有文獻的空缺，讓我們了解電影浮生這心理療法的有效性。如這心理療法有效 我們將能夠把這療法拓展到患有慢性或複雜疾病的中國病童。

15102122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102122.value: 第三杜氏藻與海洋細菌 PTMT 共生關係對第三杜氏藻的蛋白質翻譯速度和蛋白質質量的影響研究

15102122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102122.value: As global population will reach 8.6 billion in 2030, so demands on proteins for human consumption keep on raising. However, meat products usually have a high carbon footprint. Thus, it is urgent to develop other more sustainable protein sources to reduce dependences on the meat products. Beside plant-based proteins, microalgal species of Dunaliella are one of the potential sustainable protein sources that are safe for human and animal consumptions. As the microalgae are photosynthetic and grow in sea water, so cultivating the microalgae for protein has a low carbon footprint and a limited usage of freshwater. Unfortunately, growth rates of the microalgae are slow compared to bacteria and yeast. One of the solutions to increase the growth rates of the microalgae was to co-cultivate with marine microbes. Our research team has previously isolated a germ negative bacterium from an algal bloom in Tai Mei Tuk, Hong Kong. The genome of the isolated bacterium, PTMT was sequenced and assembled. Results of genetic analysis of PTMT has revealed that it is a novel bacterial species of Pseudoalteromonas. Surprisingly, PTMT was found to promote the growth of the microalgae, Dunaliella tertiolecta. Proteomic analysis has revealed that many ribosomal proteins in D. tertiolecta was over-expressed after co-culturing with PTMT for 5 days. Other studies on growths of yeast and bacteria demonstrated that microbes could increase their growth rates by over-expressing ribosomes to increase translation rates when cultured in amino acid rich mediums. Thus, it is suspected that PTMT may secret certain types of amino acid that promoted the growth of D. tertiolecta by increasing the microalgal translation rate. Beside the translation rate, it is also suspected that protein quality of D. tertiolecta may be altered due to the increase of the growth rate when co-culturing with PTMT. As D. tertiolecta was a potential sustainable protein source, the study on the symbiotic relationship between the microalgae and PTMT may result in novel cultivation techniques to increase the production of biomass of D. tertiolecta for human consumption and animal feeds. Thus, the effects of the co-culture of D. tertiolecta and PTMT on the translation rate and the protein quality of D. tertiolecta should be investigated. 人類對蛋白質的需求消費每年持續上升，科學研究表明，2030年全球人口即將達到86億。然而，肉製品通常含有高碳腳印，對我們保護環境造成巨大的壓力。因此，對可持續的蛋白質來源、減少對肉製品依賴方法的開發迫在眉睫。研究發現，除了一般植物蛋白質外，能夠被人類和動物安全食用的杜氏微藻，也是潛在的可持續蛋白質來源之一。微藻它的特殊性在於，能夠生長在海水里進行光合作用，因此，培養微藻只需消耗少量淡水和產生低碳足跡。技術的難點在於微藻的生長速度比細菌和酵母慢。前期的研究發現與海洋微生物共同培養能夠解決這個困難。我們的研究團隊成功的從香港大美督藻華樣本里分離了一種陰性細菌PTMT，並對 PTMT的基因組進行測序和組裝。結果表明PTMT是一種新的假交替單胞菌菌種，可促進第三杜氏藻的生長。且蛋白質組學分析發現，第三杜氏藻與 PTMT 共培養 5 天後，體內有許多核醣體蛋白過表達。從其他相關酵母和細菌生長的研究中可知，在富氨培養基中微生物能夠通過過表達核糖體來提高蛋白質翻譯,從而促進它們的生長。因此，我們推測PTMT 可能會分泌某些類型的氨基酸增加共培養的第三杜氏藻蛋白質翻譯的速度，從而促進第三杜氏藻生長。其次我們還發現，除了蛋白質翻譯速度，第三杜氏藻與 PTMT 共培養時，第三杜氏藻的蛋白質質量可能會隨生長速率的增加而提升。因此研究第三杜氏藻和PTMT之間的共生關係，能夠增加第三杜氏藻產量，使其成為潛在的可持續食物和動物飼料提供新的方法和理論依據。因此，研究第三杜氏藻和PTMT的共生關係對第三杜氏藻的蛋白質翻譯速度和蛋白質質量的影響是有必要的。

15102222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102222.value: 人工智能賦能超聲淋巴結定量評估用於頭頸癌患者管理

15102222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15102222.value: Prof Cai, Jing Prof Chen, Danny Z Prof Chu, Chiu Wing Winnie Prof King, Ann Dorothy Prof QIN, Jing (Harry)

15102222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102222.value: Metastasis to neck lymph nodes is a common manifestation in head and neck cancer. Clinically, an accurate assessment of neck lymph nodes is crucial for head and neck cancer patients because it can help treatment planning and patient prognosis prediction. Ultrasound is commonly used in the assessment of neck lymph nodes because it is non-invasive and easily accessible in hospitals and clinics. However, ultrasound diagnosis is subjective, laborious and the accuracy is completely dependent on the clinician and operator’s experience. To solve this important clinical problem, we propose to develop and evaluate multiple novel artificial intelligence (AI)-empowered techniques for lymph node ultrasound clinical applications. The proposed AI-empowered techniques will allow a fully automated segmentation of lymph nodes and classification of benign and metastatic lymph nodes in ultrasound images. These novel techniques have not been reported by any other research groups in the world. In our preliminary study, we tested deep learning-based convolutional neural network (CNN) models, and found that they can yield good accuracy in neck lymph node segmentation in ultrasound images (intersection over union, IoU: 0.81-0.86; F1 score: 0.858-0.8952). In the proposed project, we will further improve the segmentation techniques by combining the CNN models with emerging transformer models. We will also develop multiple radiomics-based classification models for ultrasound lymph node classification. We will use 2000 grey scale ultrasound images to develop the segmentation and classification models. In this project, we hypothesize that these novel AI-empowered techniques can yield high accuracy (≥90%) in automated segmentation of neck lymph nodes, and have better performance than radiologists in the classification of benign and metastatic lymph nodes. To test these hypotheses, we will compare computerized segmentation from the AI techniques with manual segmentation from radiology experts. We will apply dice similarity coefficient and IoU to analyze the accuracy of computerized segmentation. We will compare classification results of the AI techniques and radiologists, with the pathology results as the reference standards. We will apply receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves to analyze and compare the performance of the AI techniques and radiologists. We will evaluate the efficiency, accuracy and robustness of the AI models. Our multi-disciplinary research team includes experts in ultrasonography, head and neck imaging, AI and deep learning in medical imaging. With the collaborative effort of the team, the project will generate many useful outcomes that benefit many patients and clinicians, transform diagnosis across Hong Kong and beyond, and help global technology advancement. 頸部淋巴結轉移是頭頸癌的常見表現。在臨床上，頸部淋巴結的準確評估對於頭頸癌患者至關重要，因為它可以幫助制定治療計劃和預測患者預斷。超聲通常用於評估頸部淋巴結，因為它是無創的並且在醫院和診所中很普及。然而，超聲診斷是主觀的、費力的，其準確性完全取決於臨床醫生和操作者的經驗。為了解決這一重要的臨床問題，我們建議開發和評估多種新型人工智能 (AI) 賦能技術，用於淋巴結超聲臨床應用。所提議的人工智能技術將允許對超聲圖像中的淋巴結進行全自動分割以及良性和轉移性淋巴結的分類。世界上任何其他研究小組都沒有報導過這些新技術。在我們的初步研究中，我們測試了基於深度學習的捲積神經網絡 (CNN) 模型，發現它們可以在超聲圖像中的頸部淋巴結分割中產生良好的準確性（intersection over union，IoU：0.81-0.86；F1 得分：0.858 -0.8952)。在提議的項目中，我們將通過將 CNN 模型與新興的 Transformer 模型相結合來進一步改進分割技術。我們還將開發多個基於放射組學的超聲淋巴結分類模型。我們將使用 2000 張灰度超聲圖像來開發分割和分類模型。在這個項目中，我們假設這些新的人工智能技術可以在頸部淋巴結的自動分割中產生高精度（≥90%），並且在良性和轉移性淋巴結的分類方面比放射科醫生有更好的表現。為了檢驗這些假設，我們將比較人工智能技術的計算機分割與放射學專家的手動分割。我們將應用骰子相似係數和 IoU 來分析計算機分割的準確性。我們將比較人工智能技術和放射科醫師的分類結果，以病理結果作為參考標準。我們將應用接收器操作特徵 (ROC) 曲線來分析和比較 AI 技術和放射科醫生的性能。我們將評估人工智能模型的效率、準確性和穩健性。我們的多學科研究團隊包括超聲檢查、頭頸部成像、人工智能和醫學成像深度學習方面的專家。在團隊的共同努力下，該項目將產生許多有益的成果，使許多患者和臨床醫生受益，改變香港及其他地區的診斷方式，並幫助全球技術進步。

15102522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102522.value: 腸源性膽汁酸通過武田G蛋白偶聯受體5（TGR5）調控腎臟及腎外組織中維生素D代謝的研究

15102522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15102522.value: Dr Mok, Daniel Kam Wah Dr Poon, Chui-Wa Christina

15102522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102522.value: 足夠的維生素D對維持肌肉骨骼健康十分重要，並可以降低患肌肉流失症和骨質疏鬆症的風險。這些疾病會導致老年人骨折的風險增加，也會對社會造成重大的經濟成本。然而，近期的人類體內隨機對照試驗中證明單純補充維生素D並未明顯改善老年人的骨骼肌肉質量和性能，也不能降低其骨折發生率，因此有需要開發其他具有成本效益的方法來改善維生素D的代謝與水平。本研究團隊之前由RGC資助的研究項目(#PolyU 5402/04M)已證實齊墩果酸 (oleanolic acid; OA)作為膽汁酸膜受體TGR5的配體，是一種可以改善鈣平衡，提高活性維生素D（1,25(OH)2D）及骨骼性能的活性成分。同時，齊墩果酸可以提高腎臟及其他腎外組織中1,25(OH)2D活化酶（CYP27B1）的表達及活性。近期的臨床和臨床前研究表明膽汁酸是潛在的骨代謝調節劑，但膽汁酸調節骨骼和礦物質代謝的機制尚未明確。本研究項目假設腸源性膽汁酸通過激活TGR5調節腎臟及其他腎外組織中CYP27B1的活性。本研究首先擬在使用經抗生素處理的小鼠模型確定腸源性膽汁酸對腎臟及腎外組織（骨骼和肌肉）中CYP27B1表達和活性的影響；接著通過使用TGR5基因敲除小鼠研究TGR5在介導腸源性膽汁酸對CYP27B1影響的作用；最後通過體外實驗研究腸源性膽汁酸調節腎臟及腎外組織中CYP27B1表達及活性的機制。本研究將會增加我們對膽汁酸調節維生素D代謝的生理作用及相關機制的理解，並為使用TGR5配體改善肌肉骨骼健康提供科學證據。

15102622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102622.value: 多重抗药性蛋白IV相关信号通路对卵巢颗粒细胞的调节作用及其与多囊卵巢综合征的相关性

15102622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15102622.value: Prof Wang, Haitian Maggie Dr Yang, Jian Zhi

15102622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15102622.value: 卵巢功能障碍，如多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS），是女性不育的主要原因。卵巢体细胞包括颗粒细胞包围卵细胞形成卵泡这一卵巢基本功能结构。颗粒细胞具有生成卵巢激素、支持卵细胞、促进卵泡的成熟和排卵等生理功能。在以人工授精为基础的辅助生殖技术中，在临床采样卵细胞的过程中，其周围的颗粒细胞被无可避免地共同采集。因此，颗粒细胞中的生物标志物被认为可以用于安全评估卵细胞质量和预测人工授精结果。 然而，颗粒细胞功能是复杂的，其中的分子调控机制尚未得到充分认识。 由人类基因ABCC4编码的多重抗药性蛋白IV（MRP4）是一种跨膜转运蛋白。其被人熟知的功能是将细胞毒素和药物转运排出细胞外，因此被认为是潜在的癌症化疗药物的靶点。然而，其生理作用在很大程度上尚未被人认识。研究数据显示，MRP4在卵巢中表达，但其是否以及如何在卵巢中发挥作用仍然未知。 本课题组在前期关于子宫内膜的工作已经证明MRP4具有调节细胞信号通路（包括前列腺素E2，Wnt/β-catenin相关通路）的新作用，而这些通路与卵巢功能亦相关。在对MRP4敲除小鼠模型和人颗粒细胞进行初步分析后，我们的初步结果表明：MRP4在人和小鼠颗粒细胞中均有表达，并具有影响雌激素和抗苗勒管激素的产生、颗粒细胞增殖、颗粒细胞信号网络等作用。我们还初步观察到PCOS受试者的颗粒细胞中MRP4表达水平较非PCOS受试者显著下调。 因此，我们提出工作假设：MRP4通过调节相关信号通路（如Wnt/β-catenin、PGE2等通路）可能参与颗粒细胞功能，其异常可能与PCOS有关。 为了验证这一假设，我们将使用颗粒细胞特异性MRP4敲除小鼠模型以及其它细胞模型，结合分子生物学和生理学技术手段以及转录组和蛋白质组分析，进行以下三方面的研究包括：1）鉴定MRP4是否参与卵巢颗粒细胞功能；2）阐明MRP4依赖的信号通路在调节颗粒细胞功能中的作用；3）评估MRP4及其依赖的信号通路在PCOS受试者颗粒细胞中的表现。 研究结果将更好地理解颗粒细胞功能的分子控制。鉴定MRP4及其依赖的信号通路在颗粒细胞功能中的潜在作用将有助于开发卵巢相关疾病（如PCOS）诊断和治疗的新靶点以及辅助生殖技术中新的颗粒细胞生物标志物。

15102722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15102722.value: CD73：一種驅動肝癌乾性胞外腺苷累積的癌症相關成纖維細胞功能標誌物

15103022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15103022.value: 光感細胞和色覺在雛雞正視化中的作用

15103022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15103022.value: Dr Choy, Kit Ying Prof Lee, Terence Kin Wah Dr SHAN, Sze Wan Prof To, Chi-ho

15103022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15103022.value: 近視是世界上最常見的屈光異常。全球近視流行率近幾十年來顯著增加，估計到了 2050 年,其發病率將會影響世界人口的一半。此外，高度近視（-5D 或以上）將覆蓋 10% 或 10 億人。近視不僅僅是輕微的不便，因為高度近視與近視黃斑退化、青光眼、白內障等致盲的疾病有密切的關係。抗擊全球“近視疫情”刻不容緩, 我們需要更深入地了解近視發展的機制。 為了獲得最佳視力，我們的眼睛會調節其長度與光學聚焦點相匹配，使遠處物體的影像可以銳利地投射在視網膜上。這種活躍的驅動過程被稱為視力的"正視化"。眼睛長度與光學聚焦點之間的不匹配會導致影像落在視網膜前面或後面，分別導致近視或遠視。然而，到目前為止, 我們還不知道眼睛是如何調控它的生長以至焦點能銳利地投射在視網膜上。有科學家提出，顏色在正視化中的光學解碼起著重要作用，以便眼睛可以朝著最佳方向生長。早前的研究已指出有色覺問題的兒童的近視患病率顯著較低。同時動物研究已表明，不同的顏色光譜會影響眼睛屈光度的發展。雖然作為第一個介導視覺的細胞 - 視網膜中的視錐細胞和視桿細胞在屈光發育中起關鍵作用並不奇怪; 越來越多的證據已經表明視錐細胞和視桿細胞對正常和近視眼生長有重要角色。不同的視錐細胞可能會提供獨立的和相互競爭的信息. 這信息給予正常眼睛生長至關重要的光學資料。然而到目前為止，這些視錐細胞和顏色在解碼光學散焦方面的作用仍然難以捉摸。 我們建議研究光感細胞和色覺在眼部生長和屈光發育中的作用。利用其完善的色彩視覺系統，我們提出以小雞為近視模型，利用CRISPR/Cas9技術創造具有錐體或棒體敲除的轉基因雛雞。它使我們能夠揭示他們在屈光發展和解碼光信號的角色。這項研究將有助於我們對色彩視覺系統在調節眼睛的生長上的了解。有了這些知識，我們也許能夠開發出新的光學方法,更有效地控制人類近視發展。

15103522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15103522.value: 合成的水通道蛋白-4 模擬表位肽降低視神經脊髓炎譜系疾病相關視神經炎的神經細胞毒性：從模型構建到實驗研究

15103522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15103522.value: Prof CEN, Ling-Ping Dr CHAN, Ching Yan Noel Dr CHAN, Ho-lung Henry Dr CHAN, Kar-mun, Carmen Dr CHEN, Tingjun Dr Lam, Chun Wah Matthew Dr MAK, Chun Yue Andrew Dr SHAN, Sze Wan Prof THAM, Clement Chee-yung Prof TSE, Yan Yin Dennis

15103522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15103522.value: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) is a severe autoimmune inflammatory disease of the central nervous system that causes demyelination lesions and neuronal injury. The optic nerve is one of its predominant targets. So-called NMOSD-related optic neuritis (NMOSD-ON) often leads to permanent vision loss. The pathogenic mechanism of NMOSD is suggested to be the binding of serum IgG autoantibodies (aquaporin-4 antibodies, AQP4-IgG) to the aquaporin-4 (AQP4) water channel on the surface of astrocytes. The extracellular epitopes on the extracellular loops of AQP4 (Loops A, C and E) have been proposed as the crucial pathogenic epitopes for NMOSD. We have successfully synthesised AQP4 mimotope peptides for the three extracellular loops, and validated their effect in reducing neural cytotoxicity in in vitro astrocyte cultures, ex vivo spinal cord tissue and our established in vivo models of NMOSD-myelitis, which is another main manifestation of NMOSD. It is now necessary to establish whether the pathogenic mechanism of NMOSD in the spinal cord applies to NMOSD-ON. Validation of the effect of synthesised AQP4 mimotope peptides in reducing neural cytotoxicity is also needed for the NMOSD-ON form. Based on our previous success, we propose to first test the effect of synthesised AQP4 mimotope peptides in reducing AQP4-IgG cytotoxicity in ex vivo optic nerves, and then establish a novel longitudinal optic nerve-specific in vivo mouse model of NMOSD-ON by delivering AQP4-IgG near the optic chiasm of Thy-1 CFP transgenic mice which producing fluorescence on retinal ganglion cells (RGCs). We will monitor the retinal structure and integrity of the RGCs by in vivo imaging and monitor the visual function through electrophysiological experiments. After validating the reproduction of the pathological and immunological characteristics in the novel in vivo NMOSD-ON model, the location of the pathogenic epitope of AQP4 in NMOSD-ON will be indicated by individually blocking the combination of AQP4-IgG to the three extracellular loops of AQP4. Further, the effects of neutralised AQP4-IgG with different synthesised AQP4 mimotope peptides in reducing neural cytotoxicity will be longitudinally validated in the novel in vivo NMOSD-ON model. The establishment of the novel longitudinal in vivo model of NMOSD-ON and application of the synthesised AQP4 mimotope peptides to the optic nerve in this study will provide (1) an ideal platform for follow-up studies on the characteristics, mechanism and pathogenesis of NMOSD-ON and related new therapeutic developments, and (2) new implications for therapeutics targeting NMOSD/NMOSD-ON.

15103622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15103622.value: 由護士支援的流動應用程式是否比常規社區護理能更有效提升育有醫療複雜性兒童的父母對其子女症狀管理的自我效能 : 隨機對照試驗研究

15103622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15103622.value: Dr CHAN, Yuk Yee Kitty Prof Fowler, Cathrine Ms Ho, Mei Chi Jacqueline Dr Leung , Doris Yin-ping Prof Wong, Frances Kam-yuet Prof WONG, Kwan Ching

15103622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15103622.value: 內容摘要： 患有醫療複雜性兒童會有多系統性疾病，例如嚴重腦部發展問題或癌症。此等疾病可能引致早逝，同時也增加他們父母承受高壓力的風險。這些兒童最小會受到一個或多個生理和心理症狀的影響。這不但嚴重影響他們的生活質素，也增加其使用醫療服務。父母亦可能因缺乏管理兒童症狀的自我信心而感到挑戰。根據文獻記載，增加父母對管理兒童症狀的自我效能可以提升兒童的健康。現時，香港醫療機構有為育有醫療複雜性兒童的家庭提供家居護理服務。但由於護士人手嚴重短缺，加上近年新冠疫情令提供家居護理服務變得困難和有限。在此情況下，由護士支援父母管理兒童症狀的流動應用程式會是一個更合適的方法令護士和父母之間更容易接觸和溝通，以便獲得適時的護理支援。 這個隨機對照試驗研究目的是測試護士支援的流動應用程式對提升父母對其患有醫療複雜性的子女症狀管理的自我效能。120位父母會被邀請參與研究並隨機地被分為兩組: 護士支援的流動應用程式組和常規的社區護理組。研究會以護士支援的流動應用程式和接受常規的社區護理作為比較，以量度介入措施 [護士支援的流動應用程式] 和等待名單對照組 [常規的社區護理] 在提升父母在管理兒童症狀的效能。這次研究首要結果測量是父母的自我效能。次要結果測量是小孩的症狀負擔和健康服務的使用率。量度首要和次要結果測量的時間為研究前，研究後和研究後三個月。數據會以協方差分析和廣義估計式去分析結果。 若果護士支援的流動應用程式比常規社區護理能更明顯地增強父母對患有醫療複雜性兒童症狀管理的自我效能, 此正面研究結果有助推動和制定相關醫療政策、尋求更多資源以提供此服務給所有育有醫療複雜性兒童的家庭、提升兒科症狀管理和相關家居護理服務的質素。

15104822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15104822.value: 基于级联深度学习的对比自适应实时四维核磁共振技术的研发以及在核磁引导放疗中腹部肿瘤跟踪的应用

15104822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15104822.value: Prof Cai, Jing Dr CHANG, Tien Yee Amy Prof QIN, Jing (Harry)

15104822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15104822.value: Abdominal cancers are the leading cause of cancer mortality in Hong Kong and worldwide. For example, liver and pancreatic cancers are the third and fifth leading causes of cancer-related deaths respectively, in Hong Kong. Radiotherapy is playing an increasingly important role in the treatment of abdominal cancers in the era of precision medicine. In precision radiotherapy, it is of pivotal importance to manage respiratory motion to achieve more effective radiotherapy for abdominal cancers. Magnetic resonance-guided radiotherapy (MRgRT) is an emerging technique that provides on-line tumour tracking ability, holding great promise for efficient and effective management of respiratory motion. Current on-line tumour tracking in MRgRT uses a two-dimensional (2D) Cine magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) based tracking method which can only provide 2D tumour tracking with single image contrast for abdominal cancers and may introduce uncertainties to the treatment process. Four-dimensional (4D)-MRI is an emerging technique that can provide tumour and organ motion information in three-dimension (3D), holding great potential to improve on-line tumour tracking accuracy and efficiency. However, current 4D-MRI techniques still have two major deficiencies for on-line tumour tracking application: (i) imaging time is prohibitively long for real-time application; and (ii) inconsistent image contrast may limit the tumour visibility and compromise the tracking accuracy. These deficiencies have greatly hindered the application of 4D-MRI in on-line tumour tracking for abdominal cancers. To overcome these deficiencies, we will in this proposal develop and evaluate a novel contrast-adaptive real-time 4D-MRI method (CART 4D-MRI) tailored for on-line 3D tacking of abdominal cancer radiotherapy. To achieve this goal, we will (i) develop an end-to-end cascaded deep learning (DL)-based real-time 4D-MRI technique using ultra-fast multi-view image reconstruction and temporal-sequential deformable registration in a retrospective study to accelerate imaging time; (ii) develop a contrast-adaption technique for real-time 4D-MRI via an integrated DL-based contrast-invariant image registration and optimization method to provide personalized and optimized image contrast; and (iii) implement and evaluate the CART 4D-MRI technique for on-line abdominal tumour tracking application in a prospective patient study. The proposed CART 4D-MRI technique is advantageous over current MRgRT on-line tumour tracking methods for its adaptive image contrast and 3D tracking capability. CART 4D-MRI has great potential to optimize and expand the implementation of on-line tumour tracking to a greater extent. 15105322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105322.value: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by disturbances in communication, poor social skills, and aberrant behaviors. Prevalence of ASD is high, with recent statistics reported at 1 in 54 [1], making ASD one of the most prevalent childhood developmental disorders. School and daily activities are often challenges of great magnitude, even for high-functioning ASD children with typical intelligence. Particularly detrimental are the presence of restricted and repetitive stereotyped behaviors and uncontrollable temper outbursts over trivial changes in the environment, which often cause emotional stress for the children, their families, schools and neighborhood communities. Fundamental to these cognitive and behavioral problems is the disordered cortical connectivity and resultant executive dysfunction that underpin the use of effective strategies to integrate information across contexts. Brain connectivity problems affect the rate at which information travels across the brain. Slow processing speed relates to a reduced capacity of executive function to recall and formulate thoughts and actions automatically, with the result that autistic children with poor processing speed have great difficulty learning or perceiving relationships across multiple experiences. In consequence, these children compensate for the impaired ability to integrate information from the environment by memorizing visual details or individual rules from each situation. This explains why children with autism tend to follow routines in precise detail and show great distress over seemingly trivial changes in the environment. To date, there is no known cure for ASD, and the disorder remains a highly disabling condition. Recently, a non-invasive brain stimulation technique, transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (tDCS), has shown great promise as a potentially effective and cost-effective tool for reducing core symptoms such as anxiety, aggression, impulsivity, and inattention in patients with autism. This technique has been shown to modify behavior by inducing changes in cortical excitability and enhancing connectivity between the targeted brain areas [2]. However, not all ASD patients respond to this intervention the same way and predicting the behavioral impact of tDCS in patients with ASD remains a clinical challenge. This proposed study thus aims to address these challenges by determining whether resting-state EEG and clinical data at baseline can be used to differentiate responders from non-responders to tDCS treatment. Findings from the study will provide new guidance for designing intervention programs for individuals with ASD. 迄今為止，尚無已知的自閉症譜系障礙 (ASD) 治愈方法，並且該疾病仍然是一種高度致殘的疾病。最近，一種非侵入性腦刺激技術，經顱直流電刺激 (tDCS) 已顯示出作為一種潛在有效且具有成本效益的工具，可用於減輕自閉症患者的焦慮、攻擊性、衝動和注意力不集中等核心症狀。該技術已被證明可以通過誘導皮層興奮性變化和增強目標大腦區域之間的連通性來改變行為。然而，並非所有 ASD 患者都以相同的方式對這種干預做出反應，並且預測 tDCS 對 ASD 患者的行為影響仍然是一個臨床挑戰。因此，本研究的目旨在對自閉症譜系障礙青少年治療中使用 tDCS 結果利用機器學習進行評價。這項擬議的研究主要通過利用機器學習來確定靜息狀態腦電圖和基線臨床數據是否可用於區分對 tDCS 治療的反應者和無反應者。該研究的結果將為自閉症患者設計治療方案提供重要資料和新的發展方向。

15105522.value: Prof Han, Yvonne Ming Yee Prof Husain, Masud Dr Wong, Jing Jun

15105522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105522.value: 在不確定的環境中仔細尋找正確的信息對於引導適合的決策至關重要。有時，尋找信息在短期內可能代價高昂，但從長遠來看可能會帶來巨大的收益。例如，在管理資產時，人們可以投資於具有固定回報率的產品，例如定期存款。然而，人們也可以投資回報率不確定的產品，例如股票或加密貨幣。這需花費更多資源來獲取重要信息以估計回報，但從長遠來看可能會帶來顯著收益。因此，做出最佳決策需要在獲取信息與收益之間取得平衡。在此項目，我們展開基礎研究以開發一個模型描述如何在決策過程中靈活地保持信息與收益平衡。開發這樣一個模型對於進一步剖析大腦中的潛在計算機制至關重要。此外，這些知識將有助於識別一些表現出決策失調的精神病的特定障礙，並開發針對其功能障礙的有效治療方法。 我們的項目通過三項研究探討決策過程中的信息尋求。首先，我們提出了一項行為研究來開發計算模型，該模型將描述決策過程中信息搜索的關鍵因素。我們將招募健康人士參與一項決策任務，該任務要求他們在更有價值和多信息的選項之間進行選擇。我們將開發三個模型來描述人類的決策行為。我們預計，能夠靈活改變尋求信息偏好的模型將為最佳的模型說明參與者的決定。 其次，我們提出了一項腦成像研究，以研究決策過程中尋求信息的神經計算機制。我們將應用第一項研究中開發的最佳模型來分析神經數據。我們假設頂內溝、眶額葉皮層和前扣帶皮層具有尋求信息的信號，而腹內側前額葉皮層具有收益的信號。 第三，我們希望應用計算模型來捕捉表現出決策障礙的患者的特定缺陷。這將通過測試通常在行為上不太靈活的自閉症譜系障礙 (ASD) 病人來實現。我們假設他們的決策由較不靈活的決策模型來描述較佳。

15105622.value: 甲狀腺毒性週期性麻痹的風險因素及對健康的長期影響: 香港人口之大數據分析

15105622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15105622.value: Dr Cheung, Ching-Lung Dr Cheung, Elaine Yun-ning Prof Tan, Kathryn Choon-beng

15105622.label: Project Objectives
15105622.value: Reasons for undertaking the project • Thyrotoxic periodic paralysis (TPP) is a potentially fatal complication of thyrotoxicosis, characterized by recurrent hypokalemia, episodic muscle weakness and paralysis. • The pathogenesis of TPP remains unclear and a substantial portion of risk factors are yet to be identified, probably due to the small size of existing cohorts. • Our recent genome-wide meta-analysis revealed that TPP-associated genetic variants are implicated in monogenic muscular paralysis disorders, namely Andersen-Tawil syndrome (ATS) and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (CMT). In view of the possible fatal outcomes associated with ATS and CMT, it is important to examine whether the shared genetic factors of TPP with ATS and CMT will increase the risk of relevant long-term related outcomes, such as arrhythmic events and respiratory distress, among patients with TPP history. • The identification of risk factors and examination of long-term adverse effects of TPP are made feasible upon the establishment of a population-based registry with sufficient number of individuals with TPP history, using electronic medical records. Preliminary analysis • Based on a registry of 189 individuals with TPP recruited from a few public hospitals in Hong Kong from 1991 to 2011, these TPP patients had International Classification of Disease, 9th Revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-9-CM) diagnosis codes for both periodic paralysis (359.3) and thyrotoxicosis (242.XX) on the same date in the representative electronic medical database in Hong Kong maintained by the Hospital Authority, namely “Clinical Data Analysis and Reporting System” (CDARS). They also had undergone laboratory tests of blood potassium levels within 180 days of the diagnosis, and their blood potassium levels were less than 3.5 mmol/litre. Key issues being addressed (1): As TPP is rare, large study cohorts of TPP with long follow-up duration is unavailable globally to date. • The first objective of the proposal is to validate clinical data of thyrotoxicosis (including TPP) in CDARS and establish a population-based registry in Hong Kong. • Based on our preliminary analysis, individuals with thyrotoxicosis (ICD-9-CM: 242.XX) and TPP [ICD-9-CM: 359.3 and 242.XX, in addition to laboratory record of low blood potassium level (<3.5 mmol/litre)] will be retrieved. The diagnosis codes and blood potassium test records of 100 samples of thyrotoxicosis (no TPP) and 100 samples of TPP will be randomly selected, to validate against the clinical notes of the physicians and laboratory records of thyroid hormone levels. • Upon validation of the clinical data of thyrotoxicosis and TPP in CDARS, we will establish a population-based registry, comprising approximately 51,812 and 1,044 individuals with thyrotoxicosis and TPP respectively from 1 January 2001 to 31 December 2021. To the best of our knowledge, it will be the world’s largest cohort of TPP patients, given that TPP is a rare complication. • Electronic medical databases enable long-term follow-up of a large sample, as it can avoid loss to follow-up in conventional cohort studies. Key issues being addressed (2): A substantial number of risk factors are yet to be identified. • The second objective is to identify additional risk factors (comorbidity and medication use) of TPP. • For each individual in the population-based registry, the diagnosis and prescription records within the 5-year screening period prior to the first diagnosis of thyrotoxicosis / TPP (index date) will be retrospectively collected from CDARS. The presence or absence of each disease comorbidity and medication will be recorded in binary coding (either yes or no), and subsequently included in the logistic regression model to evaluate their association with TPP, compared to individuals with thyrotoxicosis (but not TPP). Key issues being addressed (3): The long-term adverse health outcomes in individuals with TPP history have not been examined. • The third objective is to examine the long-term outcomes in TPP patients. • Only individuals who had the first diagnosis of thyrotoxicosis/TPP between 1 January 2001 and 31 December 2011 in the population-based registry will be included. They will be followed from their first diagnosis dates of thyrotoxicosis/TPP for 10 years till 31 December 2021 (study end date), death, or the occurrence of health outcomes, whichever earlier. The potentially fatal outcomes of arrhythmia implicated in ATS patients and respiratory distress in CMT patients will constitute the primary analysis. Cox proportional hazards regression model will be adopted to assess the risk of various health outcomes in TPP patients, compared to individuals with thyrotoxicosis (but not TPP). Possible outcomes of the project • The validation of clinical data of thyrotoxicosis (including TPP) in CDARS will enable the establishment of a population-based registry, providing a sufficiently large sample and a long follow-up period. • The identification of additional risk factors of TPP will lead to early prevention of TPP among thyrotoxicosis patients, lowering the incidence of the life-threatening TPP. • If our proposed study reveals long-term adverse health outcomes of TPP, strategies on prevention, monitoring, early and timely intervention against the long-term adverse effects will be implemented. The incidence of adverse outcomes in individuals with TPP history is expected to drop, improving their long-term well-being and quality of life.

15105622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105622.value: Thyrotoxic periodic paralysis (TPP) is a potentially lethal complication of thyrotoxicosis, characterized by recurrent hypokalemia, episodic muscle weakness and paralysis. The occurrence of cardiopulmonary complications may be fatal. Due to TPP’s low prevalence (1.8% among thyrotoxicosis patients), the existing cohorts are usually of small sample size, and did not have sufficient power to identify risk factors of small effect size. Whether individuals with TPP history have long-term adverse outcomes have not been examined, mainly due to the restricted follow-up in existing cohorts. The aforementioned issues may be overcome by establishing a population-based registry using a representative electronic medical database in Hong Kong, namely “Clinical Data Analysis and Reporting System” (CDARS). Based on the clinical data retrieved from CDARS, it is extrapolated that the proposed population-based registry will comprise about 51,812 individuals who have first diagnosis of thyrotoxicosis (ICD-9-CM:242.XX) between 2001 and 2021. Approximately 1,044 of them will have TPP history [ICD-9-CM:242.XX and 353.9, and low blood potassium level (<3.5 mmol/litre) revealed by laboratory test records]. Upon validation of the clinical data in CDARS and establishment of the registry, we aim to identify additional risk factors of TPP, and examine whether individuals with TPP history will have long-term adverse outcomes. For each individual in the registry, the diagnosis and prescription records within the screening period prior to the first diagnosis of thyrotoxicosis/TPP will be retrospectively collected from CDARS. The presence or absence of each common disease comorbidity and medication (incidence>1%) will be included in the logistic regression model as potential risk factors to evaluate their association with TPP, compared to individuals with thyrotoxicosis (but not TPP). To examine the long-term adverse outcomes of TPP patients, we will only include individuals who had the first diagnosis of thyrotoxicosis/TPP between 2001 and 2011. They will be followed from their first diagnosis dates for 10 years till 31 December 2021 (study end date), death, or the occurrence of adverse outcomes, whichever earlier. Cox proportional hazards regression model will be adopted to assess the risk of various adverse outcomes in TPP patients, compared to thyrotoxicosis patients without TPP history. Upon identification of risk factors, early prevention of TPP among thyrotoxicosis patients is expected to lower the incidence of TPP. If the study reveals long-term adverse outcomes of TPP, prevention, monitoring and intervention against these outcomes will likely reduce the incidence of adverse outcomes among individuals with TPP history and improve their long-term health condition. 甲狀腺毒性週期性麻痹（TPP）是甲狀腺毒症的一種併發症，潛在致命風險。TPP的症狀包括重複發生的低鉀血症、不定期的肌肉無力和癱瘓，如遇心肺併發症則有可能致命。由於TPP的發病率低（於甲狀腺毒症患者中為1.8%），現有的TPP隊列樣本量通常較小，以致沒有足夠的統計功效識別影響較小的風險因素。至於TPP會否對患者的長期健康有不良影響，則由於現有隊列的隨訪時間較短，而未有相關硏究。然而，上述問題可以通過使用能代表香港人口的電子醫療資料庫「臨床數據分析及報告系統」（CDARS），建立一個TPP之數據庫來解決。根據從CDARS取得的臨床資料，我們推斷此數據庫將包括約51,812名在2001至2021期間首次被診斷為甲狀腺毒症（ICD-9-CM:242.XX）的個體，其中約1,044名患者有TPP病史[ICD-9-CM:242.XX及353.9，以及有低血鉀水準（<3.5 mmol/litre）之實驗室測試記錄]。在驗證CDARS中的臨床資料並建立TPP之數據庫後，本硏究旨在識別TPP未知的風險因素，並檢視有TPP病史的個體會否有長期的健康問題。我們將從CDARS追溯數據庫中每個個體首次被診斷甲狀腺毒症/TPP前篩查期內的診斷和藥物處方記錄，而每種疾病和藥物處方將被納入logistic回歸模型，以比較TPP患者及甲狀腺毒症(但沒有TPP）的患者於篩查期內之不同，從而評估與TPP相關的潛在風險因素。為了檢視TPP患者會否有長期的健康問題，我們將只包括2001年至2011年期間首次被診斷甲狀腺毒症/TPP的患者，並從其首次診斷日期開始追蹤10年，採用Cox比例風險回歸模型，以評估TPP患者與無TPP病史的甲狀腺毒症患者會否對各種健康問題有不同的關聯。在確定TPP的風險因素後，我們預期甲狀腺毒症患者或可提早預防TPP，以降低TPP的發病率。如是次研究揭示TPP會對患者的長期健康有不良影響，而針對這些影響及早預防、監測和干預，或可改善有TPP病史的個體的長期健康狀況。

15105822.value: 通過在最大曲率平面上施加控制力，能否提高青少年特發性脊柱側凸的矯形治療效果？

15105822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15105822.value: 青少年特發性脊柱側凸 (AIS) 是一種三維脊柱畸形，在青春期出現橫向彎曲和椎體旋轉，原因不明。儘管通常為中度 AIS 患者開具矯形器治療，但存在不一致和多樣化的矯形器設計以及患者對治療的依從性的挑戰，這將導致不可預測的治療結果。在目前的實踐中，脊柱矯形器的設計主要參考矯形前的冠狀位和矢狀位射線光片，並應用三點力系統，控制力和反作用力大致施加在相應的後外側和前內側方向。然而，兩張射線光片中呈現的脊柱側彎畸形並不能全面反映脊柱側彎的三維臨床特徵，並不能通過脊柱矯形器確定施加力的正確位置。當前研究小組提出了最大曲率平面 (PMC)（定義為脊柱的一部分投影到的垂直平面，顯示最大的脊柱曲率，以及冠狀面和矢狀面之間的位置）的概念，以揭示脊柱側彎矯形干預的三維臨床特徵。已經開發出一種準確且用戶友好的方法來估計 PMC，因此，脊柱矯形器的設計可以更加針對患者，並且施加力的位置對於控制脊柱側彎將更加科學和可靠。這項前瞻性隨機對照試驗研究是第一個將 PMC 概念應用於 AIS 患者脊柱矯形器設計的研究，並將比較這種新提出的 PMC 矯形器設計方法與傳統矯形器治療方法的治療效果在 AIS 的管理中。估計有 120 名受試者的樣本量。隨機化後，一半將分配到 PMC 矯形器設計方法（測試組），另一半將分配到常規方法（對照組）。除矯形器設計方法外，兩個受試者組將採用相同的治療方案。受試者對矯形治療和體育鍛煉的依從性將分別通過溫度傳感器和日誌進行監測。使用 PMC 方法對 8 名受試者進行的初步研究顯示，在矯形治療的前 12 個月內取得了可喜的結果。因此，這項擬議的大規模研究是值得的。如果它能夠進一步證明增強的矯形器治療效果，有助於在脊柱矯形器設計中製定患者特定的指南並優化矯形器治療方案，並且可以避免脊柱畸形惡化導致手術的機會。

15106222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15106222.value: 透過重複短高頻功能性及近紅外光譜預測緩解抑鬱症的疾病軌跡

15106222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15106222.value: Dr Chan, Kit Wa Prof Mak, Arthur Dun-ping

15106222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15106222.value: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is the world’s leading cause of disability according to the World Health Organization. MDD is highly recurrent, even if clinical remission is reached after successful treatment. In fact, the enormous burden of disability, mortality and financial costs is due to the recurrent and chronic nature of MDD. The reliable prediction of the recurrence of major depressive episodes (MDEs) based on a prognostic model that is informed by biological, neurophysiological or neuroimaging data would be highly valuable and lifesaving for many. However, such models are still lacking. Several lines of evidence point to abnormal prefrontal control over limbic emotion processing areas in MDD owing to diminished prefrontal excitability that seems to persist during MDD remission (rMDD). Prefrontal excitability in rMDD may thus be a trait marker of MDD and may potentially be indicative of disease recurrence. Yet, research investigating the potential utility of prefrontal excitability for predicting the recurrence of MDEs is lacking. Cortical excitability can be investigated using transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS); however, human studies have mostly probed cortical excitability of the motor cortex, a brain region not considered to be central in the neuropathology of MDD. Hence, knowledge of the effect of TMS on prefrontal excitability is limited. Moreover, whether immediate prefrontal modulation by TMS can predict the recurrence of MDEs in fully remitted MDD patients remains to be investigated. Thus, there is a need for research that aims to quantify the direct and immediate aftereffects of TMS on prefrontal function. Most importantly, with regard to precision medicine, there is a need for research that explores the utility of immediate prefrontal reactivity to TMS for predicting MDE recurrence. Here, we propose a research program that will exploit the combination of functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) with brain stimulation. Concurrent theta-burst stimulation (TBS)/fNIRS measurements will allow us to systematically investigate stimulation-induced modulation of blood oxygenation as a proxy for induced brain activity changes (TBS is a modern form of patterned TMS). The findings from this study will (1) elucidate the immediate effects of excitatory and inhibitory brain stimulation on prefrontal activity in rMDD and controls and (2) validate the potential utility of stimulation-induced brain modulation for the prediction of MDE recurrence. This research program will pave the way towards an affordable and easy to implement method of predicting MDE recurrence. Thus, our research proposal has high potential to inform neuroprognosis algorithms, as envisioned in precision medicine.

15106422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15106422.value: 揭示導致慢性骨髓性白血病發病機制和治療耐藥性的調控元件：新型長鏈非編碼 RNA 調控網絡的功能剖析

15106422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15106422.value: Dr CHOW, Eudora YD Prof Yip, Shea-ping

15107522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15107522.value: 探究PDIA5是否誘發肥胖中脂肪組織的線粒體功能性障礙、炎症反應和胰島素抵抗的新致病因子

15107522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15107522.value: 脂肪組織的炎症反應及其引起的功能性障礙是肥胖、2型糖尿病以及相關疾病的主要特徵。白色脂肪細胞是一種活躍的、動態的內分泌細胞，負責調控葡萄糖、脂質和能量的平衡 。白色脂肪細胞中的內質網(ER)和線粒體通過多種機制維持細胞內穩態，它們不僅能獨立工作，而且在生理功能上會相互通信。最近的研究表明，異常的內質網 -線粒體通信會引發胰島素抵抗，減少胰島素分泌，誘發炎症和破壞適應性產熱。上述的病變都有會導致肥胖誘發及加重2型糖尿病病情。然而，內質網 -線粒體通信的過程中是否能控制白色脂肪細胞的代謝功能尚不清楚。 蛋白質二硫化物異構酶家族A成員5 (Protein disulfide isomerase family A member 5, PDIA5)是一種ER駐留蛋白。早期的研究發現，PDIA5在癌細胞中能通過啟動轉錄因數6 (ATF6)來控制內質網應激反應。最近我們發現PDIA5在患有肥胖和2型糖尿病的人類和齧齒動物的脂肪組織中表達明顯升高。抑制PDIA5能減少血液中的脂多糖的含量(一種內毒素，肥胖時可誘導脂肪組織發炎)和棕櫚酸誘導脂肪細胞產生的促炎細胞因數的含量。在免疫螢光染色共定位實驗中，我們觀察到在線粒體去極化時PDIA5蛋白會轉移到線粒體中。當PDIA5的失活後，在應激條件下的線粒體會通過發生自噬（以清除受損的線粒體）從而改善其功能。 另一方面，在蛋白質組學分析中表明，PDIA5可以與Mitfusin 2 (MFN2，線粒體活性的主要調節因數) 達成相互作用。因此我們提出，在肥胖過程中，白色脂肪細胞中PDIA5表達的上升，可以通過蛋白與蛋白之間的相互作用，幹擾MFN2介導的線粒體活動，從而損害線粒體功能的假設。這一過程中，線粒體功能障礙會進一步誘導白色脂肪組織的炎症和胰島素抵抗，從而導致系統性葡萄糖調節的異常和肥胖中的2型糖尿病。 為驗證上述假設，我們將採用脂肪細胞PDIA5特異性敲除小鼠模型去探究缺乏PDIA5是否能夠：(1) 緩解肥胖誘導的脂肪組織功能障礙及其相關代謝紊亂; (2) 改善白色脂肪細胞內的線粒體功; (3) 研究內質網 -線粒體在維持白色脂肪細胞功能方面的相互作用及潛在機制，這將有望為肥胖及其相關的2型糖尿病 提供新的治療靶點。

15200922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15200922.value: 基於飛秒鐳射誘發熱彈性波與瞬態全場偏振微擾的非接觸式堆疊系統三維成像

15200922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15200922.value: 精密堆疊系統（例如可穿戴電子設備中的微電機系統與多層堆疊鋰離子電池）已被廣泛發展與應用。為保證使用穩定性及產品優良率，針對精密堆疊系統的可靠性與完整性測試是一項必要的工序。當前對於毫米及以上的尺度，基於超聲導波與表面波的技術已能提供足夠的檢測精度與實用性。而在微米及以下尺度，以掃描聲學顯微鏡與X射線為代表的形貌表徵手段可檢測小至納米尺度的結構。儘管已存在上述成熟的無損檢測技術，然而，針對数十至数百微米尺度的結構，當前的無損檢測手段仍然存在明顯的技術局限。这些局限主要包括於超聲導波的多模态和色散性、表面深度方向的有限传播能力，接触式检测，以及掃描聲學顯微鏡與X射線等离位观测的低效等。受制於此，现有的检测手段无法高效且精确地表征非透明堆叠系统中微米尺度的三维特征。 針對上述局限，該研究將致力於從基礎理論至試驗驗證，建立一套全新的檢測框架。 該檢測方案可以以完全非接觸的方式，對非透明堆疊系統中的微米級三維複雜內部結構進行精確、直觀和高效的成像。首先，将研究飛秒鐳射誘發熱彈性波的物理过程，及其与堆叠系统内部特征的相互作用机制进行理论分析与建模。所建立的理論模型將用於闡明：在光熱與熱彈耦合效應下，飛秒鐳射可激發具有太赫茲頻率的熱彈性體波，並在堆疊系統中傳播，最終與內部特徵（如介面，缺陷與損傷等）發生相互作用。為探測具有太赫茲頻率的熱彈性波，本研究擬開發一項基於橢偏法的光聲成像方法，其可瞬時捕獲飛秒探測鐳射束的全場偏振態。與內部結構相互作用后的熱彈性波可擾動探測鐳射束的偏振態，由此捕獲的全場偏振態將包含堆疊系統的內部特徵資訊。利用該成像方法並主動控制飛秒探測鐳射束的時延，將可獲得一系列對應於不同深度橫截面的二維形貌圖像，其可進一步用於生成三維層析影像，以可視化非透明堆疊系統中微米尺度的內部介面、缺陷和損傷等資訊。 所提議的方法將通過對（i）在襯底上包含內部電路/缺陷的指尖尺度微電機系統，和（ii）在熱障塗層中含有亞毫米級缺陷的航空發動機高溫合金葉片進行三維成像，進行試驗驗證。擬議的研究以工業需求為導向，結合了基礎理論研究與詳盡的試驗驗證，旨在提高當前無損檢測方法的能力以及增強結構複雜的堆疊系統的微觀可靠性。

15201322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15201322.value: 實時環境構建的聯邦分析：框架、算法和應用

15201322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15201322.value: 實時虛擬環境（VE）構建系統建立代表物理世界的虛擬環境。有越來越多的實時VE構建系統，例如高清地圖、元宇宙、AR/VR、數字孿生等。例如，高清地圖構建了代表道路環境的VE，是自動駕駛的關鍵使能技術。實時VE構建系統通常使用來自多個貢獻方的數據，例如，高清地圖利用來自社交車輛的數據。而目前人民對數據隱私的擔憂正在增加。這給實時VE構建系統帶來了新的挑戰。 最近，谷歌提出了聯邦分析（FA），這是一種新的分布式計算範式，其中數據保存在本地，只有從本地分析得出的見解才會發送到服務器以匯總結果。使用FA範式，可以用本地分析來掩蓋那些隱私相關卻和VE構造無關的對象，例如前車的車牌。然而，將FA和實時VE構建結合起來，引入了一個新問題：如何設計FA的本地分析來支持實時VE構建？這個問題具有挑戰性，因為保護隱私的本地分析，無論是識別和屏蔽隱私敏感對象還是提取VE構建相關對象，都可能需要大量的計算和通信資源，但邊緣設備卻有很多資源限制。 在本項目中，我們提出一個新的框架FAVER，它利用FA進行具有高資源利用率的實時VE構建。 FAVER可以被視為當前通用聯邦優化系統（例如 TensorFlow Federated、KubeEdge 等）之上的擴展。FAVER與應用程序無關。為了服務於具有特定資源約束的各種邊緣應用程序，FAVER可以生成一個執行鏡像，服務於不同場景，其中邊緣端瓶頸在於：（1）計算資源：我們使用隱私自適應機制優化計算資源；(2) 通信資源：我們通過保護隱私的拆分分析機制優化通信資源； (3) 融合來自不同傳感器的數據，例如攝像頭、激光雷達等：我們開發了一種隱私感知數據融合優化機制。我們將開發新的算法來滿足實時延遲要求並最大限度地提高VE構造的準確性。我們將提供一個FAVER的原型實現，並通過一個關於高精地圖構建和更新的應用案例來評估FAVER。 本研究將推進關於保護隱私的實時VE構建系統這個研究領域，我們提出新穎的研究問題和算法。我們將通過開發教育材料並與產業（例如華為）合作來試驗我們的框架和算法，從而擴大項目的影響。

15201722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15201722.value: 貨櫃港口擁堵：監控、韌性和對策

15201722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15201722.value: Prof WANG, Jin Prof YANG, Zaili

15201722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15201722.value: 嚴重的港口擁堵阻礙全球航運物流，引起多式聯運網絡的連鎖反應，對全球供應鏈的效率和可持續發展產生了嚴重的威脅。近年來，COVID-19的流行進一步加劇了港口擁堵。本項目旨在利用全球船舶衛星定位系統（AIS），開發一個包含新穎和切實方法的系統，減輕全球貨櫃港口的擁堵，提升全球航運網絡的韌性。 首先，本項目建立一個基於AIS的動態貨櫃港口擁堵監控平。AIS提供長期的全球覆蓋船舶航行記錄，方便研究者追蹤港口不同區域的船舶行爲。爲了准確地測量港口擁堵程度，即船舶在錨地等待時長，本項目提出基於空間密度的迭代多屬性聚類算法。這套算法需要更少的計算時間和人工投入即可監控全球範圍的港口擁堵。 其次，本項目調查影響港口從擁堵狀態恢復的主要因素。其中，港口相關因素包括船舶訪問頻率、港口可達性、港口位置、港口的網絡特性等。航運公司經常會採取取消掛靠某個港口，或者尋找附近的替代港口等方法來減輕港口擁堵對其的影響。這部分我們提出從AIS中提取這些因素的算法，並且通過建立基於動態系統理論的模型去測算這些因素對港口韌性的影響。 最後，港口和班輪公司對於擁堵有自己的處理對策，這些對策有時會相互作用削弱其實際作用。大型航運公司在某個港口增加一艘船舶的訪問會對自身產生更大的影響，因爲其掛靠港口的其他船舶都會受影響。因此，主要的航運公司有動機通過不同的方式内生化港口擁堵。另一方面，港口會給一些大型的航運公司提供優先靠泊的權利去保證這些公司不會減少他們的訪問。在這一部分，我們會建立模型和收集數據分析這些對策對港口擁堵的影響，從而提出有效的政策緩解擁堵。 利用高質高頻的AIS數據，本項目提出領先的方法和對策減少港口擁堵，提升全球供應鏈的可靠性。

15201822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15201822.value: 穿孔边界调节降波速结构里的声学黑洞现象

15201822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15201822.value: Prof YU, Xiang Dr Zhang, Xiaoqi

15201822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15201822.value: Wave manipulation through retarding structures is an emerging and enabling concept which is the cornerstone of numerous applications. The phenomenon of the Sonic Black Hole (SBH) can be produced inside a retarding structure to generate unconventional slow waves alongside significant energy focalization. Whilst alluding to promising solutions for conceiving acoustic wave manipulation and control devices, the phenomenon is less exploited as compared with its vibrational counterpart in the open literature, mainly due to some unsolved bottlenecking problems which hamper its realization as well as its subsequent applications. This project attempts to address some of these problems, of both fundamental and applied nature, to fill the existing gap in SBH research. More specifically, the concept of perforated boundary-modulated SBH retarding structure is proposed, in which perforated acoustic boundaries are incorporated into SBH elements. Perforation parameters can be tactically tuned to strike a balance between the required surface admittance variation of the sonic retarding structures and the energy dissipation with the goal of maximizing the SBH effects through simplified structural design. On top of the innovative SBH design, the study aims at 1) shedding lights on the physics underpinning the SBH phenomena through developing efficient numerical tools and conducting comprehensive numerical analyses; and 2) exploring a few SBH-induced wave manipulation functionalities. The significance of the project lies in its direct applicability to a wide range of applications such as noise mitigation or the design of wave manipulation devices, which are of direct benefit to both Hong Kong and beyond. From scientific research viewpoint, the problem under investigation is fundamental and generic in nature, which may generate significant scientific impact for advancing the state-of-the-art of wave manipulation engineering. 通過減速結構操縱声波是一個新興且可行的概念，它是眾多應用的基石。聲波黑洞 (SBH) 現象可以在減速結構內產生，以產生非常規的慢波以及顯著的能量聚焦。與公開文獻中的振動黑洞相比，該現象的研究較少，主要是由於一些未解決的瓶頸問題阻礙了其實現及其後續應用。該項目試圖解決其中一些基礎和應用性質的問題，以填補 SBH 研究中的現有空白。更具體地說，提出了穿孔邊界調製 SBH 延遲結構的概念，其中穿孔聲學邊界被結合到 SBH 元件中。可以對射孔參數進行戰術調整，以在聲波阻滯結構所需的表面導納變化和能量耗散之間取得平衡，目標是通過簡化的結構設計來最大化 SBH 效應。該項目可適用於廣泛的工程應用，例如降噪或声波操縱裝置的設計，從科學研究的角度來看，该研究會對基于声波操縱原理的最新工程技術的发展產生重大的科學影響。

15201922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15201922.value: 連續型可穿戴離子水凝膠發電機

15201922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15201922.value: Harvesting energy from the ambient or human body is absolutely necessary in order to remove the bottle-neck in wearable applications, where the generator devices with high specific densities of output power and energy are critical. Continuous-mode direct-current generators made ionic hydrogels are promising candidates among various harvesters investigated so far. Light and flexible ionic hydrogel generators, which combine ionic diffusion and redox mechanisms, may offer ample opportunities to efficiently convert thermal or hygral energy from the ambient in a continuous manner, thus, at least in principle, hold great promises to overcome the current hurdles of low specific densities of output power and energy of the harvesting devices. The proposed study in this project aims at gaining an in-depth understanding of the ionic hydrogel materials and their energy conversion mechanisms, so as to guide us for substantial enhancement of the device output performance of ionic hydrogel thermoelectric generators (IHTEG) and moist-enabled electric generators (IHMEG), eventually reaching the power of ~100 mW and energy of ~ 1 Wh per device, as required by many wearable electronic systems. The project will investigate several aspects of light and flexible IHTEGs and IHMEGs. First, we will identify the possible suitable ionic hydrogel systems that facilitate the continuous production of a sufficient number of ions, the generation and maintenance of large thermal or moisture gradience for the ion diffusion process, at the same time, being stable, safe, flexible, and easy to scale-up. Then, we will determine the effects of chosen types of ion species, electrode materials, gel electrolytes on the ionic diffusion and redox processes and the output power and energy of the ionic generators as functions of time. We will further proceed to find the effects of device structures on the output performance of the ionic generators. In addition, we will develop new models with characteristic functions to be used as engineering design tools of the continuous-mode flexible IGTEGs and IHMEGs, respectively. Finally, we will demonstrate a smart wearable system, powered by the newly developed ionic hydrogel generator, in monitoring muscle activity and circumference change of human lower limb. The research opens a new topic area of ionic hydrogel energy harvesting methods from heat and moisture surrounding the human body. Publications in top-tier scientific journals and patents will be the anticipated deliverables. 為了消除可穿戴系統應用中的瓶頸，從環境或人體採集能量是絕對必要的，其中具有高比輸出功率和能量密度的柔性發電機至關重要。由離子水凝膠製成的連續模式直流發電機是迄今為止研究的各種採集器中很有希望的候選者。結合離子擴散和氧化還原機制，它可以提供充足的機會以連續方式有效地從環境中轉換熱能或水能。因此，至少在原理上，有望克服目前採集設備的輸出功率和能量的比密度低的障礙。 本項目擬進行的研究旨在深入瞭解離子水凝膠材料及其能量轉換機制，以指導我們大幅提高離子水凝膠熱電發電機（IHTEG）和濕式電動發電機 （IHMEG）的輸出性能。最終達到每台設備約 100 mW 的功率和約 1 Wh 的能量，以滿足許多可穿戴電子系統的供電要求。 該項目將從幾個方面研究輕型柔性的 IHTEG 和 IHMEG。首先，我們將探索和確定可能合適的離子水凝膠系統，以促進連續產生足夠數量的離子，為離子擴散過程產生和維持的較高熱或水分梯度，同時達到穩定、安全、靈活和易於放大的目的。然後，我們將確定所選類型的離子種類、電極材料、凝膠電解質對離子擴散和氧化還原過程以及離子發生器的輸出功率和能量的影響。我們將進一步研究器件結構對離子發電機輸出性能的影響。此外，我們還將研發具有特徵功能的電機新模型，分別作為連續模式柔性IGTEGs和IHMEGs的工程設計工具。最後，我們將展示一個由新開發的離子水凝膠發生器驅動的智慧可穿戴系統，用於監測人體下肢的肌肉活動中的周長變化。 該研究開闢了一個新的主題領域，即用離子水凝膠從人體周圍的熱量和水分中採集能量的方法和理論。它極有可能揭示離子水凝膠材料熱濕離子擴散過程及其與電極之介面的工作機理，進而對發電機輸出的影響。它會建立具有高比功率和能量密度的輕型、靈活、安全和穩定的 IHTEG/IHMEG 的可量產製造方。另外用新開發的電源裝備智慧可穿戴展示系統。頂級科學期刊和專利將是預期的成果。

15202122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15202122.value: 供水系統粘彈性管道中的瞬態氣水流與波流相互作用研究

15202122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15202122.value: Prof BRUNONE, Bruno Prof LEE, Pedro

15202122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15202122.value: Air components, in forms of air-pockets, cavities or bubbles, commonly exist in water supply systems (WSSs), which may be resulted from either the release of dissolved air in water due to variations of temperature and pressure, or occurrence of air injection due to operations of system devices (pump or valve), or simultaneous emergence of these aspects in the system. The presence of such air components can lead to complex air-water flows, reduce pumping and piping efficiency, increase pressures experienced during surges and cause system damages (bursts or leaks). Various practices and experiences have widely demonstrated that such adverse impacts are particularly profound in viscoelastic/polymeric pipelines (e.g., PVC or PE) in WSSs. Consequently, it is necessary to investigate the dynamics of air-water flows formed in viscoelastic pipelines for effective WSS analysis. The situations of air component entrapping and air-water flows become even more severe and complex for unsteady flows. In WSSs, transient flows (highly unsteady flows or pressure waves) are commonly triggered and involved during system operations with flow and/or pressure changes. Under transient conditions in viscoelastic pipelines, external air can be easily intruded into pipeline due to the resulted low/negative pressures and the dissolved air in water can also be easily released due to the viscoelastic pipe-wall deformation during transient low/high pressure oscillations. Meanwhile, the sizes, states and locations of air pockets/cavities/bubbles and air-water flows can be frequently changed by transient flows in viscoelastic pipelines. From this perspective, understanding and modeling of complex transient air-water flows and the mechanism of wave-fluid interactions in viscoelastic pipelines are crucial to the WSS operation and management. This project is proposed to conduct fundamental and scientific research on transient air-water flows and wave-fluid interactions in viscoelastic pipelines (PVC and PE) in WSSs, with aims to: (1) investigate and understand the underlying mechanism on the formation and evolution of air-water flows in viscoelastic pipelines; (2) characterize and analyze the patterns of transient air-water flows and wave-fluid interactions in viscoelastic pipelines; (3) evaluate and quantify the influences and uncertainties of complex transient air-water interactions in viscoelastic pipelines. A comprehensive methodology of theoretical analysis, advanced numerical modeling and laboratory experimental tests is developed for this scientific research. The achievement and deliverables of this project are useful to fill the knowledge gaps in terms of the modeling of transient air-water flows and the mechanism of transient wave-fluid interactions in pipelines, thereby to advance the effective WSS management. 氣體組分在供水系統中很常見，並且可以在管道中以各種形式存在，例如氣穴、氣腔和氣泡等。一般而言，這些管道中的氣體可由以下三方面的原因產生：（1）溫度波動導致水中溶解氣體析出；（2）泵或閥門操作時所造成的氣體注入；或（3）這二者同時發生。當管道中存在氣體時，這會造成複雜的氣水流動現象，進而導致泵和管道運輸的效率下降，或者延長管道中瞬態壓力的作用時長，進而破壞系統，導致管路漏水甚至爆管。大量工程實踐和經驗表明，氣水相互作用導致的負面效應在粘彈性供水管道中更為明顯。因此，有必要針對粘彈性管道中的氣水兩相流動力學進行研究，從而進行有效的供水管網系統分析。 當非穩定流發生時，管道中截留的氣體和形成的氣水兩相流將變得更加複雜，其影響也更為嚴重。在供水系統中，瞬態流（即高度非穩定流或壓力波）常常因系統流量和壓力快速變化而被激發，並影響系統運行。在瞬態流條件下，粘彈性管道外的氣體很容易在發生負壓時侵入管內，同時由於粘彈性管路的變形，溶解的氣體也更容易在壓力波動的情況下從溶解的水中析出。此外，粘彈性管路中的氣穴、氣腔和氣泡以及氣水流動的大小，狀態以及位置也會在瞬態流條件下頻繁變化。從而，理解和模擬複雜的瞬態條件下的氣水兩相流以及粘彈性管道中波流相互作用機理對於運行和管理供水管道系統至關重要。 本項目旨在研究供水系統粘彈性管道（例如聚丙烯管和聚乙烯管）中的瞬態氣水兩相流和波流相互作用。其主要研究目的包括：（1）研究和理解粘彈性管道中氣水兩相流的形成與演化機理；（2）表徵和分析粘彈性管道中瞬態氣水兩相流和波流相互作用的各種模式； 以及（3）評估和量化粘彈性管道中複雜瞬態氣水相互作用的影響與不確定性。為此，本項目將發展一套綜合研究方法，包括基礎理論分析、先進數值模擬和實驗室試驗。本研究的成果可用於填補現有關於瞬態氣水兩相流模擬和管道瞬態波流相互作用機理方面的知識空白，從而實現高效的供水系統管理。

15202522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15202522.value: 適用於高動態場景的均勻顏色空間

15202522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15202522.value: Colors are commonly specified using coordinates in three-dimensional uniform color spaces (UCSs) for a wide range of applications (e.g., lighting, camera, and display). They allow accurate characterizations of perceptual differences between stimuli under various conditions, so that they can be used for color specification, adjustment, and reproduction. The widely used UCSs (e.g., CIELAB and CAM02-UCS) were all developed based on psychophysical experiments, in which human observers evaluated color differences or appearance of stimuli under various conditions. These stimuli were produced using either reflective surface color samples or conventional displays, so that their luminance were all below the diffuse white luminance and thus the viewing conditions were low dynamic range (LDR). The real scenes around us, however, always contain highlights (e.g., specular reflections and self-luminous sources) whose luminance are significantly higher than the diffuse white luminance, making the scenes high dynamic range (HDR). In addition, HDR displays, which can show highlights with luminance beyond the display diffuse white level, are becoming extremely popular recently and are used on smartphones, computer monitors, and TVs. HDR conditions, however, were not considered in the existing UCSs and were never carefully investigated before. Though some color spaces (e.g., hdr-CIELAB, ICtCp) are claimed to be applicable to stimuli under HDR conditions, they are either only applicable to a small luminance range (e.g., hdr-CIELAB) or designed for a completely different purpose from the existing UCSs (e.g., ICtCtp). The PI’s analyses and two pilot studies clearly suggested the failure of the existing UCSs in characterizing stimuli under HDR conditions. This project aims to investigate the perceptual differences of stimuli under various HDR conditions through psychophysical experiments. Human observers will perform color adjustments and evaluations under various viewing conditions. A UCS, which is applicable to stimuli under both HDR and LDR conditions, will be developed based on the experiment results and the datasets that were collected by the PI and Co-I for developing the existing UCSs, with the PI’s pilot studies revealing the encouraging results. This project will make great contributions to both academia and industry. It fills the research gap of understanding human perception under HDR conditions, which is an important topic in the International Commission on Illumination (CIE) Research Strategy. Moreover, this project is especially timely to the communities related to camera, display, and imaging systems. The UCS will help manufacturers to develop better solutions and systems to achieve high quality rendering and reproduction of real HDR scenes. 對各種不同的應用而言，颜色刺激一般通過一個三维的颜色空間来描述。這樣我們便可以描述在不同條件下各種顏色刺激視覺屬性的相互關係，從而實現顏色表徵、調節和複現。目前眾多使用廣泛的颜色空間（包括CIELAB和CAM02-UCS）都是基於一系列通過心理物理實驗所得到的色差以及色貌數據来建立的。這些心理物理實驗基本都是採用的反射式的颜色樣本或者傳統顯示器來產生各種颜色刺激，因而颜色刺激的亮度都低於白點亮度並且整個場景為低動態場景。 但是，現實場景中往往含有亮度高於白點亮度的高亮颜色刺激，因而成为高動態場景。此外，新型高動態顯示器也可以產生高於白點亮度的颜色刺激，並且這類顯示器已經變得越来越普及。相比之下，眾多用來描述顏色刺激的顏色空間並没有針對高動態場景。雖然近幾年有幾個顏色空間（例如hdr-CIELAB和Ictcp）考慮了高動態場景，但他們僅僅可以針對很小的亮度範圍或者關注的是完全不同的問題。項目申請人的初步分析以及兩項初步研究都已經充分論證了現行顏色空間無法適用于高動態場景。 本項目旨在通過開展心理物理實驗來探究高動態場景下顏色刺激的視覺感知。觀察者將在不同的高動態場景下對顏色刺激進行調節與評價。基於實驗結果，我們將建立一個可以描述高動態場景下顏色刺激的顏色空間。本項目將對於學術界和工業界具有巨大的影響力，解決顏色空間無法描述高動態場景的缺陷，並且可以為不同的應用（相機、顯示、影像系統）的顏色複現提供重要的工具。

15203222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15203222.value: 利用智能超表面实现智能信号反射：一个信道估计的框架

15203222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15203222.value: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) has recently emerged as a promising solution to cope with the data deluge expected in the future wireless networks. By smartly manipulating the propagation of incident electromagnetic waves, each RIS is capable of altering the channel properties to steer the signals to the base stations (BSs) or the users with focused energy. In general, the capability of an RIS-assisted network to construct channels with favorable characteristics depends on its capability to estimate the existing channels, since the RISs can merely change the channel properties by adjusting their reflection strategies, but cannot fundamentally create arbitrary channels. The acquisition of the channel state information (CSI) in RIS-assisted networks, however, is quite challenging. First, the RISs are not equipped with radio frequency chains to generate and decode pilot signals for channel estimation. Second, since the number of reflection elements in each RIS is vast, the overhead to estimate the channels associated with the RISs can be huge. In this project, we will tackle the above channel estimation challenges to enable smart signal reflection in RIS-assisted networks. First, we will focus on estimating the instantaneous cascaded user-RIS-BS channels when the RISs’ reflecting strategies are optimized in every coherence block. In this thread, we will first explore certain unique properties embedded in the user-RIS-BS channels, and then exploit them for designing dedicated channel estimation strategies to reduce the training overhead. Moreover, we will analytically quantify the performance of the proposed schemes and characterize the network throughput when the channel training overhead and estimation error are considered. Second, besides the instantaneous CSI based optimization mechanism, we will consider a statistical CSI based approach that is widely used in the literature. Under this scheme, based on the covariance matrices of the user-RIS-BS channels, the RISs’ reflection strategies are optimized to boost the long-term performance. Despite potential sacrifice of the dynamic optimization gain, this strategy can significantly reduce the training overhead, because statistical CSI changes much slowly compared to instantaneous CSI. In this project, we will propose efficient algorithms for estimating the statistical CSI and characterize the network throughput when the channel estimation costs are taken into account. The outcome of this project will lay a solid foundation for CSI acquisition in RIS-assisted networks, enabling better control of the RISs’ reflection strategies to create a smart propagation environment. 智能超表面最近成为一项能够处理未来无线网络中数据洪流的有效方案。通过智能地控制入射信号的传播特性，智能超表面可以改变信道的特性使得信号可以将能量集中到基站端或者用户端。因为智能超表面只能通过它们的反射策略来改变信道的性质，而不能任意地创造信道，因此，智能超表面构造有利信道的能力取决于其信道估计能力。然而，在智能超表面系统中获取信道是一个很有挑战的任务。首先，由于没有配备射频链路，智能超表面无法产生和解码信道估计所需的导频信号。其次，由于智能超表面的反射单元数目巨大，信道估计的开销也将十分巨大。 在这个项目中，我们将解决以上难题，以利用智能超表面实现智能信号反射。首先，我们将考虑估计实时的用户-智能超表面-基站串联信道，以使得智能超表面的反射策略可以在每个相关时间内更新。在这一方向，我们将考虑用户-智能超表面-基站信道的独有性质，并利用这些性质提出新的信道估计算法，以降低信道估计开销。并且，我们将从理论上分析以上机制的性能，同时在考虑信道估计开销和误差的前提下刻画网络吞吐量。其次，除了以上考虑的实时优化机制，我们也将考虑在学术界很流行的一种利用统计信道信息的优化机制。在这个机制下，我们可以利用信道的协方差矩阵这一统计特性来优化智能超表面的反射策略，以达到提升系统长期性能的目的。以上机制尽管无法实时优化反射策略，但是可以通过估计变化更慢的信道统计特性来降低信道估计的开销。在这个项目中，我们将提出有效的算法来估计统计信道信息，并且在考虑信道估计开销的情况下刻画网络吞吐量。这个项目预期将为解决智能超表面网络中的信道估计问题奠定坚实的基础，使得智能超表面可以更好地改变信道特性，实现智能通信。

15204022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15204022.value: 可持續重載冷拌半柔性路面材料中乳化瀝青與水泥注漿之間的相互作用機理表徵

15204022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15204022.value: Prof Bhasin, Amit Dr Cai, Xing Prof Oeser, Markus

15204022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15204022.value: Semi-flexible pavement (SFP) refers to the heavy-duty pavement built with grouted macadam, i.e., a porous asphalt (PA) with a high air void content filled with injected cementitious grouting material. Because of the special composition of semi-flexible grouted macadam (SFGM), SFP combines the positive properties of rigid pavement (strength against heavy loads) and flexible pavement (flexibility and no joints), making it an attractive paving alternative in heavy-traffic areas. However, due to the incompatibility between asphalt material and cement grout, cracking at the asphalt-grout interface can be a major concern for SFP. To address this problem, this study will explore the feasibility and performance of using asphalt emulsion, the dispersion of charged asphalt cement droplets in water, instead of conventional hot asphalt binder to build cold-mix PA for cold-mix SFP (C-SFP), and investigate the interaction mechanism between asphalt emulsion and cement grout in cold-mix SFGM (C-SFGM). The main motivations are: 1) asphalt emulsion and cement grout in C-SFGM may cure together and form a strong interface transition zone (ITZ) in-between after curing; and 2) using asphalt emulsion eliminates the heating process for PA construction while the relatively weak strength of cold-mix PA can be reinforced by the strong cement mortar skeleton. To achieve the objectives of this study, C-SFGM specimens with different cold-mix PA and cement mortar compositions and different grouting timings will be prepared, and their engineering properties at different curing stages will be characterized and compared with those of the conventional hot-mix SFGM. In parallel, to understand the interaction mechanism between the asphaltic and cementitious components of C-SFGM, multiscale characterization of C-SFGM will be conducted through various approaches, such as computed tomography scanning of the mixture and mortar, and scanning electron microscope, nano-indentation, and atomic force microscope infrared-spectroscopy tests of the asphalt-grout ITZ, followed by image-based multiscale numerical modeling of the mechanical behavior of C-SFGM. Integrated life cycle cost analysis and life cycle assessment will also be conducted to evaluate the overall economic and environmental performance of C-SFP compared with conventional SFP, flexible pavement and rigid pavement. Finally, the optimum composition and production condition of C-SFP will be recommended. It is expected that the outcomes of this study will benefit Hong Kong and potentially many other cities in two aspects, i.e., more durable road infrastructure, especially in heavy traffic area, with significantly reduced maintenance frequency and costs, and a more eco-friendly paving solution with reduced construction energy consumption and emission. 半柔性路面（Semi-Flexible Pavement, SFP）是一種由灌漿碎石鋪築而成的重載型路面。灌漿碎石是一種向大空隙瀝青混合料（Porous Asphalt，PA）中註入水泥灌漿料所形成的新型複合材料。由於半柔性灌漿碎石（Semi-Flexible Grouted Macadam，SFGM）的獨特組成，SFP兼具了剛性路面強度高與柔性路面無須接縫的優點，是特別適用於重載路段的鋪面材料。然而，由於瀝青材料與水泥灌漿材料之間的力學性能不匹配，瀝青-水泥灌漿材料界面開裂已成為SFP的主要病害。因此，本研究項目將著眼於冷拌半柔性路面（Cold-mix SFP，C-SFP）的可行性與性能研究，使用乳化瀝青（水包油型液態瀝青）替代傳統的熱拌瀝青成型冷拌PA基體，並研究冷拌半柔性灌漿碎石（Cold-mix SFGM，C-SFGM）中乳化瀝青與水泥灌漿料之間的相互作用機理。主要的立項依據包括：1）C-SFGM中的乳化瀝青與水泥灌漿料在共同經歷養生階段後可形成高強度的瀝青-水泥灌漿料界面過渡區；2）乳化瀝青的使用省去了PA成型中的加熱過程，而冷拌PA相對較弱的力學強度可通過水泥灌漿料次級骨架的強度加固。為實現研究目的，本項目在C-SFGM試件的準備過程中，將考慮不同類型冷拌PA基體、水泥灌漿料組成及灌漿時間的影響；表徵其在不同養生階段的力學性能，並與傳統的熱拌SFGM相比較。同時，為了揭示C-SFGM中瀝青與水泥類材料之間的相互作用機理，本項目將從形貌、化學組成、力學性能等方面對C-SFGM開展多尺度表徵工作。所涉及的試驗方法包括在混合料與砂漿尺度的計算機斷層掃描、在瀝青-水泥灌漿料界面過渡區尺度的掃描電子顯微鏡、納米壓痕、X射線粉末衍射和原子力顯微鏡紅外光譜測試、以及多尺度的數值模擬試驗。此外，本項目將開展綜合生命週期成本分析和生命週期評價，對比傳統的SFP、柔性路面及剛性路面，評估C-SFP的整體經濟環境效益。最終，本項目擬給出C-SFP的最優混合料組成設計和生產條件推薦方案。本項目的成果有望在以下兩方面惠及香港及眾多其它城市：建造更耐久的道路基礎設施從而大幅減少重交通區域的道路維修頻率和成本；提出更環保的路面鋪築方案從而減少建築能耗與碳排放。

15204322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15204322.value: 論激波湍流邊界層干擾的低頻非定常性

15204322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15204322.value: Prof WEN, Chih-Yung Dr ZHANG, Zijian

15204322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15204322.value: The interaction between a shock wave and a turbulent boundary layer is a fundamental problem in fluid mechanics, which is also of practical importance in aerodynamics and propulsion of high-speed flight vehicles. This flow phenomenon is frequently accompanied by a low-frequency, large-scale motion of the shock structure, the source of which is still an open issue and has attracted much attention and raised considerable debate. A preliminary study indicated that the low-frequency unsteadiness may stem from the global instability of the shock-induced separated flow. It is therefore proposed in this project to systematically investigate this plausible explanation by means of linear stability analysis, high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics, and wind tunnel experiments. The outcomes of this project are expected to identify the origin of the low-frequency unsteadiness for the first time and gain a better understanding of supersonic shock-wave/turbulent boundary-layer interactions. 激波湍流邊界層干擾是流體力學經典問題，同時對高速飛行器的空氣動力學和推進系統設計具有重要的現實意義。激波湍流邊界層干擾通常伴隨著一種激波結構的低頻大尺度運動。項目申請人的初步研究表明這種低頻非定常性可能源自激波誘導流動分離的全局不穩定性。因此，本項研究旨在通過穩定性分析、高保真度數值模擬和風洞實驗進一步探索這種可能性。所得成果有助于揭示低頻非定常性的物理機理。
