15206322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15206322.value: 克服欠定性: 基於中觀-宏觀交通網絡與多源數據的動態OD矩陣估計方法研究

15206322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15206322.value: Dynamic Origin-Destination (OD) demands, which depict the time-dependent travel needs between high-dimensional OD pairs on a road network, contain rich, high-granular, and anonymized information for understanding the spatio-temporal travel patterns in a disaggregated manner. The dynamic OD demand serves as the essential inputs and building blocks of the dynamic transportation operation and management systems for now and the future, and it could also steer the decision-making process in private sectors. Different from public transit and ride-hailing systems, in which the dynamic OD demand can be counted directly from transaction records, the dynamic OD demand on road networks is obtained by dynamic OD estimation (DODE) using indirect observations from multi-source data. For decades, the DODE problem has been studied extensively, and recent progress has been made by the team members to improve the solution efficiency on large-scale networks. However, one key challenge remains, i.e., the dimension of dynamic OD demand is much higher than that of the observations, making the DODE an underdetermined problem. How to overcome the underdetermination issue in DODE, especially on large-scale and congested networks, is still an open problem. This problem is also of special importance to Hong Kong, where the underdetermination issue is severe due to its dense city layout and high dimensional OD demand. In view of this, this project aims to overcome the underdetermination issue in DODE in order to obtain an accurate and reliable dynamic OD demand. In our preliminary studies, a link and bathtub-based model is developed to aggregate nearby traffic analysis zones (TAZs) into a region, and hence it significantly reduces the dimension of OD demand while maintaining the model accuracy. Additionally, the introduction of multi-source data could increase the dimension of observations. This project first time investigates the possibility of incorporating the link and bathtub-based networks with multi-source data. To this end, firstly we partition the network into the link and bathtub-based networks and model the flow dynamics using multi-source data; secondly, both simulation-based optimization and constrained mathematical programming-based methods will be developed for solving DODE on the link and bathtub-based networks; and lastly, the proposed methods will be comprehensively examined on a developed benchmarking platform. Additionally, cases studies will be conducted using real-world data in Hong Kong with policy implications. Through international collaborations, the project outcomes could advance the theories and methodologies for solving DODE problems, and the estimation results can support decision-making in dynamic traffic operation and management systems. 動態OD矩陣描繪路網中OD對間高維動態的交通需求，包含豐富、高精度、匿名的時空出行信息，是現在及未來交通管理系統中必不可少的基礎數據信息，也是各類出行服務提供商的重要決策依據。不同於公共交通及網約車服務，道路OD矩陣無法直接通過出行記錄獲得，而需要利用間接觀測數據進行估計。近幾十年來，動態OD矩陣估計方法得到了充分研究，本課題組成員亦在該領域中針對提升大規模路網下模型估計效率等方面做出過一定貢獻。然而，動態OD矩陣估計問題中欠定性問題依然存在，即所需估計的動態OD矩陣維度遠高於觀測數據維度。這一現象在大規模擁堵路網中對估計精度影響嚴重，因此解決動態OD矩陣估計中的欠定性問題對香港等超大城市尤為重要。鑒於此，本課題旨在通過研究解決欠定性問題獲得準確可靠的動態OD矩陣信息。在課題前期研究中，我們利用路段及Bathtub模型對交通分析區進行合並，從而顯著降低OD矩陣維度並維持估計精度。研究還發現引入多源數據可有效增加觀測數據維度。本課題首次探索利用路段及Bathtub模型與多源數據解決OD矩陣估計欠定性問題：首先利用路段及Bathtub模型分割交通網絡，其次利用多源數據建立動態交通流模型，然後開發基於仿真的優化方法與基於數學規劃模型的方法求解動態OD矩陣估計問題，進而與已有動態OD矩陣估計模型進行對比，最後利用香港路網及交通數據進行案例研究與政策指引。透過國際合作，項目成果可深化動態OD矩陣估計理論及方法，為交通管理系統提供可靠數據支持。

15206522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15206522.value: 对膨胀流中热化学非平衡现象的数值和实验的根本研究

15206522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15206522.value: Dr Hao, Jiaao Dr Wang, Qiu Prof WEN, Chih-Yung

15206522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15206522.value: Hong Kong China and mainland China has recently shown growing interest in the development of the aviation and aerospace industries. Hong Kong has set aside HK$100 million budgets to establish a training fund for aviation transport to attract young talents to enroll in the aero-industry. China has prioritized the development of its aerospace technology and invested huge resources to this cause, which is expected to continue in the foreseeable future. Hong Kong academia shall seize this golden opportunity and play an active role in her motherland’s endeavor. In this project, thermochemical nonequilibrium in rapidly expanding flow will be investigated via experimental and numerical techniques. Nonequilibrium expanding flow has important applications in atmospheric entry vehicles, as well as in the hypersonic wind tunnels used to design and build these vehicles and other hypersonic aircrafts. In these applications, the properties of gases deviate from ideal behaviors due to the extremely high temperature (up to tens of thousands of Kelvin depending on the velocity). Under these conditions, excitation of molecular internal energy modes and chemical reactions among reactive species would occur resulting in a phenomenon known as thermochemical nonequilibrium. This could have a significant impact on the aerothermodynamic characteristics and heating of hypersonic vehicles, as well as on the test conditions generated in hypersonic wind tunnels. Significant progress has been made in the past decade at understanding the thermochemical nonequilibrium behind shock waves. However, little progress has been made at understanding the thermochemical nonequilibrium under rapidly expanding flow conditions. What are the current uncertainties in predicting thermochemical nonequilibrium in expanding flows? Are post-shock nonequilibrium models applicable to expanding flows? If not, why is that the case? These are just some questions that has troubled the aerospace community for decades. In this project, validation quality experimental data will be obtained and numerical simulations based on the high-fidelity state-specific method will be conducted. The experimental and numerical data will be analyzed in detail to help address the aforementioned questions. To the applicants’ knowledge, this proposed study will be the first comprehensive experimental and numerical study on the thermochemical nonequilibrium of expanding flows conducted in China. It is envisaged that the outcome of this project will provide an academic foundation for the development of hypersonic flight vehicles and next-generation atmospheric entry vehicles for hypersonic transport and space exploration purposes. 在这个课题中我们将通过实验和数值技术来研究快速膨胀流中的热化学非平衡问题。对于进⼊⼤⽓的航空⻜⾏器，及在⾼超声速⻛洞中设计和建造这些⻜⾏器和其他⾼超声速⻜机时，非平衡膨胀流有着重要的应用。在这些应用中，由于温度极⾼(根据速度，温度可⾼达数万开尔⽂) ⽓体的性质偏离了理想⾏为。在这些条件下，因分⼦内能模式的激发以及不同化学物质之间产生的化学反应将导致⼀种被称为热化学非平衡的现象。因此会对⾼超声速⻜⾏器的空⽓动⼒学特性，⾼超声速⻜⾏器的升温，以及在⾼超声速⻛洞中产生的测试条件都产生重⼤影响。过去十年，我们在理解激波背后的热化学非平衡⽅⾯取得了重⼤进展。然⽽，对快速膨胀流动条件下的热化学非平衡的研究进展甚微。例如⽬前 预测膨胀流中的热化学非平衡的不确定性是什么？激后的非平衡模型是否适用于膨胀流？如果没有，为什么会这样？这些只是几十年来⼀直困 扰航空航天界的⼀些问题。在本课题中，我们将获得能验证的⾼质量实验数据，并基于⾼保真特定状态的⽅法进⾏数值模拟。 我们将详细分析实验和数值数据，以帮助解决上述问题。据我们所 知，本课题研究将是中国⾸次对膨胀流的热化学非平衡进⾏的综合实验和数值研究。预计课题研究的结果可以对开发⾼超声速⻜⾏器 ，开发用于空间探索和⾼超声速运输⽬的的下⼀代进⼊⼤⽓层的⻜⾏器，提供学术基本原理。

15207122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15207122.value: 跟我來：邁向以目標為導向的推薦式對話

15207122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207122.value: Building human-like conversation machines has been a long-standing goal in Artificial Intelligence (AI). From Apple Siri, Microsoft Cortana, Amazon Alexa to Google Assistant, AI-powered conversational assistants have increasingly penetrated into many aspects of people’s daily lives and E-commerce services. Though great technological progress has been made for human-machine conversation, existing systems are typically designed to make a passive response to a user’s need such as to book a restaurant or find the answer to a question. However, in certain scenarios it is essential to endow a conversation machine with the ability to proactively initiate appropriate topics and more importantly strategically lead a conversation to achieve an intended target, e.g., persuading a person to try a recommended item or comforting a person who is feeling frustrated. This drives us to develop key techniques to support target-guided conversation machines, which are highly desired yet under-explored. Limited by project time and funding resources, we focus on recommendation-oriented conversation in this project considering its great commercial value. The emerging challenges we face here are how to develop innovative strategies and effective mechanisms to equip machines with advanced capabilities of taking an active leading role and convincing people to follow the lead through multi-rounds of conversational interaction. Based on our preliminary study, we believe that the strategically planned conversation outline and the carefully selected promotional information are the two key aspects of a successful solution. We are committed to exploring the following critical and closely related research issues. (1) How to generate the user-tailored conversation plan that can guide a machine to effectively communicate with the user and smoothly transit among relevant topics towards the intended target? (2) How to dynamically update the plan to adapt to the actual conversation flow and make a compromise between engaging a user with his/her preference and reaching the machine’s target? (3) How to win the trust of the user and proactively spark his/her interest towards the target by appropriately advertising the target during the course of conversation? Shifting the paradigm from reactive to proactive is a revolutionary step forward towards truly intelligent human-like conversation machines. The research conducted in this project advances the technological development in this direction. We are confident to say that our research achievements and findings will provide insights for many applications that require to empower machines to take initiatives and persuasively lead conversations towards intended targets. 構建具有類似人類能力的對話機器人一直是人工智能的長期目標。從Apple Siri、Microsoft Cortana、Amazon Alexa到Google Assistant，人工智能對話助手越來越廣泛地滲透到人們的日常生活和電子商務服務的方方面面。儘管人機對話領域已經取得了巨大的技術進步，現有對話模型通常還是被設計為針對用戶需求而做出被動響應。然而在某些情況下，例如說服一個人去嘗試推薦的商品或者安慰一個正處於情緒沮喪狀態的人，我們必須賦予對話模型主動發起恰當對話主題的能力，更重要地是還要具備策略性地引導對話以達成預期目標的能力。這一現實需求激發了我們開發關鍵技術支持目標引導對話模型的願望。受限於項目時間和資助額度，考慮到其巨大的商業價值，我們在該項目中專注於以推薦目標為導向的對話方法研究。 我們所面臨的挑戰是如何開發先進的技術讓機器人具備通過多輪對話的互動來發揮主動引領作用並說服人們跟隨其引領的能力。基於我們的初步研究，我們認為包含策略規劃的對話大綱和精心挑選的促銷信息是成功解決方案的兩個關鍵方面。為此，我們將探索以下密切相關的關鍵研究問題。（1）如何生成用戶定制的對話計劃，輔助機器人與用戶進行有效溝通，並經由相關話題的設計順利過渡到預期目標？（2）如何動態地更新計劃以適應實際對話進程，並在吸引用戶參與對話與達成機器推薦目標之間做出協調？（3）如何在對話過程中贏得用戶的信任，通過適當的宣傳來主動激發用戶對目標的興趣？ 從被動式對話範式轉變為主動式對話範式是朝向具有真正智能的類人對話機器人邁出的革命性一步。我們有信心地說，該項目所從事的研究將推動這一方向的技術發展。我們的研究成果和發現亦將為需要賦予機器人主動性和說服力以引導對話朝著預期目標推進的其他領域應用提供參考見解。

15207322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15207322.value: 基於可解釋器的可信圖神經網絡魯棒性研究 against Adversarial Attacks

15207322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15207322.value: Prof Li, Qing Prof Tang, Jiliang

15207322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207322.value: With the extension of Deep Neural Networks to graph-structured data, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved significant success in various real-world applications. However, recent studies indicate that GNNs are vulnerable on two key aspects: (1) susceptibility to adversarial attacks, and (2) difficulty in explaining how they reach their decisions. To address these "untrustworthy" aspects, a tremendous amount of research on trustworthy GNNs has been initiated recently, with a main focus on a single aspect of trustworthy GNNs by treating adversarial robustness and explainability independently. However, these two key aspects are actually not independent of each other. Indeed, studying a single aspect alone is rather limited and inadequate to achieve full trustworthiness, and there is a pressing need to formally and comprehensively investigate interactions between these two key aspects of trustworthy GNNs. In this project, we propose to study possible (i.e., both negative and positive) interactions between adversarial robustness and explainability to enhance the trustworthiness of GNNs. Step-wise, we first perform empirical studies to validate that GNNs' explanations can act as an inspection tool to detect adversarial perturbations. Based on this, we further initiate a new problem towards their negative interactions: Can a GNNs model and its explanations be jointly attacked by maliciously modifying graphs? Although there exist quite extensive works on adversarial attacks for GNNs, adversarial attacks on either GNNs' explanations or both (i.e., GNNs model and its explanations) is a new problem, hence calling for new solutions. Therefore, in this project, we propose to develop a novel attacking framework on graphs, aiming at achieving the above joint attack. A deeper investigation further reveals that negative interactions can empower adversarial attackers to be more threatening since they can even misguide the explanations inspector, leading to huge concerns when applying GNNs on security-critical tasks. Given negative interactions, it is therefore desirable to study the opposite side: positive interactions, where we advocate a self-supervised contrastive learning framework to adversarially train GNNs model and its explanations against adversarial joint attack, so as to enhance GNNs' robustness via explainability for trustworthiness. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms, we plan to deploy our proposed methods in two diverse yet representative real-world tasks: (1) graph anomaly detection, and (2) knowledge graph-based explainable recommendation. Lastly, an experimental prototype system will be developed to manifest the process of our proposed frameworks, and extensive testing will be conducted by using real-world data to evaluate our proposed research. 隨著深度神經網絡向圖結構數據的擴展，圖神經網絡 (GNN) 在各種實際應用中取得了重大成功。然而，最近的研究表明，GNN 在兩個關鍵方面容易受到攻擊：（1）容易受到對抗性攻擊，和（2）難以解釋它們是如何做出決定的。為了解決這些“不可信”的問題，最近開始了大量關於可信 GNN 的研究，主要研究可信 GNN 的單一方面，即：通過獨立針對抗性魯棒性和可解釋性進行研究。然而，這兩個關鍵方面實際上並不是相互獨立的。事實上，僅僅研究一個方面是相當有限的，不足以實現完全的可信度，這迫切需要正式和全面地研究可信 GNN 的這兩個關鍵方面之間的相互作用。 在這個項目中，我們擬研究對抗性魯棒性和可解釋性之間潛在的相互作用，即：負面和正面，以提高 GNN 的可信度。逐步地，我們首先進行實驗性的研究，以驗證 GNN 的解釋可以作為檢測對抗性擾動的檢查工具。基於此，我們進一步針對它們的負面相互作用提出了一個新問題：可否通過惡意擾動，對GNNs模型及其解釋器進行圖的聯合攻擊？儘管針對 GNN 的對抗性攻擊存在相當廣泛的研究工作，但針對 GNN 的解釋或兩者（即 GNN 模型及其解釋器）的對抗性攻擊是一個新問題，因此需要新的解決方案。因此，在這個項目中，我們建議開發一種新穎的圖攻擊框架，旨在實現上述聯合攻擊。更深入的調查進一步表明，負面作用可以使對抗性攻擊者更具威脅性，因為它們甚至會誤導解釋檢查器，從而在將 GNN 應用於安全關鍵任務時引起巨大的擔憂。鑑於負相互作用，因此需要研究相反的一面：正面相互作用，我們提倡使用自我監督的對比學習框架來對抗性訓練 GNN 模型及其對對抗性聯合攻擊的解釋，從而通過可解釋性來增強 GNN 的魯棒性可信度。為了證明所提出算法的有效性，我們計劃將我們提出的方法部署在兩個不同但具有代表性的現實世界任務中：（1）圖異常檢測，和（2）基於知識圖的可解釋推薦。最後，將開發一個實驗原型系統來展示我們提出的框架的過程，並將通過使用真實世界的數據進行廣泛的測試來評估我們提出的研究。

15207522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15207522.value: 匿名去中心化金融：在公共区块链上的隐秘交易研究

15207522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15207522.value: Dr Guo, Yu Prof Xiao, Bin

15207522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15207522.value: 去中心化金融是通过可编程区块链中的智能合约技术实现的一种不可篡改的金融系统。由于以太坊交易是公开的，任何人可以通过查看交易详情、计算持有量并分析链上活动对其他用户信息进行分析。这种交易公开的属性严重阻碍了以太坊（和其他可编程区块链）的私有应用场景。 以上缺陷促进了匿名去中心化金融应用的发展。然而，目前匿名去中心化金融应用需要用户支付极高的交易费用以实现可靠的匿名性。此外，尽管去中心化金融应用通过激励机制吸引用户，但是这些激励对于矿工的吸引力远远低于交易费用。此外，这些激励机制的安全性依然是一个悬而未决的问题。本项目首先研究去中心化金融应用中的匿名技术，随后提出新的降低交易费用的方法。此外，我们设计了新的激励机制，并且为激励机制建立安全模型，进行安全分析。 该项目首先研究匿名去中心化金融应用中的底层密码技术，并且为交易过程的三个重要方面（交易生成、交易聚合和多矿池交易）提出了降低交易费用的新方案。在交易生成过程中，我们提出了新的技术来扩大匿名集合并同时降低交易费；此外，对于目前多笔交易的独立的验证过程，我们提出了新的聚合方案，可以通过一次检查，同时验证多笔交易；最后，为了提高多矿池交易的匿名性，我们提出了一种新的跨矿池匿名交易方案。 由于良好的激励机制可以大大降低交易费对用户造成的负担，我们进一步关注激励机制的效率和安全性。为了提高效率，我们提供了一些新的方案来减少不同操作的延时。为了增强安全性，我们提出了一个新的安全模型来分析现有的激励方法。最后，为了验证所提出的方案，我们设计了一个匿名去中心化金融应用，来评估现实环境中的交易费和处理时间。 该项目具有许多技术优点。在许多应用程序中，隐私已经成为了加密货币的重要关注点。但不幸的是，现有方案会产生高昂的交易费，提高交易成本。我们提出了新的匿名技术，在提高匿名性的同时，降低交易费。此外，现有激励机制存在效率问题，无法吸引矿工处理更多的请求。为此，我们设计了新的激励机制提并出了新的见解。最后，目前激励机制的安全性是一个悬而未决的问题。本项目针对激励机制，提出了新的安全模型。毫无疑问，本项目将对匿名去中心化金融应用产生重要影响。

15208222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15208222.value: 图神经网络隐私保护可解释性

15208222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15208222.value: 图神经网络 (GNN) 已成为图深度学习的最新技术，在包括医疗保健和金融系统在内的各个学科中表现出卓越的性能。数据隐私和模型可解释性是采用这种基于深度学习的人工智能系统的两个基本障碍。数据隐私主要涉及保护有关训练数据的信息，而模型可解释性提供了对模型对给定输入的决策的洞察。 该项目旨在从数据隐私和模型可解释性的相互作用中为 GNN 开发一个隐私保护和可解释的框架。先前对隐私保护和可解释的 GNN 的尝试是孤立地考虑可解释性或隐私​​。没有针对 GNN 解释的隐私风险做出努力，即解释可能会无意中泄露有关训练数据的信息。此外，尚未探索在隐私保护设置中训练的 GNN 的可解释性。 本项目将通过两个组成部分来弥补上述差距：（1）GNN解释的隐私风险和相应的对策； (2) 隐私约束对 GNN 可解释性的影响以及用于可靠解释的新解释器。第一阶段将通过评估已知隐私攻击的成功率，通过对抗性分析来调查 GNN 解释中的信息泄漏。然后，我们将提出新的隐私保护算法，用于计算基于差分隐私（DP）的 GNN 解释。 DP 允许我们在数学上提供可证明的隐私保证，但要付出解释效用的代价。我们建议使用各种特定于任务的特征来增强解释性能。 第二阶段将检查并正式分析使用隐私保护机制训练的 GNN 的可解释性。具体来说，我们建议从不确定性的角度评估解释质量。据我们所知，我们的工作将是第一次尝试在隐私约束下估计和利用对可靠 GNN 解释的解释不确定性。差分私有机制通常会为模型引入随机性，从而降低现有解释器的解释性能。由于解释是固有的“因果关系”，我们建议利用因果模型（例如，结构因果模型）来揭示 GNN 在隐私约束下的内部运作。因果模型将使我们能够识别输入和模型结果之间的因果关系。 该项目的成功将带来一系列符合香港 PDPO 和欧盟 GDPR 的变革性方法。它将显着加速基于 GNN 的 AI 系统在金融和医疗保健等最重视模型可解释性和隐私的各个行业的广泛部署。

15209022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15209022.value: 一種預測污水管道故障的新型建模方法

15209022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15209022.value: Prof GUO, Song Dr Liu, Catherine Chunling Prof Meguid, Mohamed

15209022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209022.value: The Hong Kong (HK) sewerage network (SN) includes 1700 km of sewers, 2300 km of stormwater pipes and 300 sewage pumping stations serving about 93% of the population. It collects 2.8 million m3 of raw sewage per day [16]. The SN has an average age of over 30 years where 15% of pipes are more than 50 years old with several sewers approaching their end of service life and with an expected increase in the number of structural and operational failures [17]. Operating this large inventory, in the heavily congested area of HK, is a complex exercise in inspection and rehabilitation activities. Acting proactively to predict areas of structural and operational failure is of paramount importance in reducing the impact of failure on society and the environment. Therefore, the main goal of the proposed research is to derive robust and novel models to identify sewer failures and predict the type and timing of failure. Previous research has investigated sewer failure, i.e., severe defects (cracks, fracture, in/exfiltration, overflow, and deposits), using structural, environmental and operational deterioration factors. However, these works suffer from (1) ignoring factors for which no data is available and (2) neglecting to include pipe defects in assessing sewer failure [5,13,15,29,47,48,60]. This leads to disagreement on the criticality and interdependencies among failure contributing factors. The proposed research will assist in developing novel defect-based sewer failure identification and prediction models using statistical and Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques due to their proven precision and high prediction capabilities. To understand the main causes of sewer failure, the proposed research will start by studying the critical factors and defects leading to such failure. The impact of soil and climate parameters on sewer failure will also be studied. Models to identify a sewer failure and predict its type/timing will accordingly be developed for different pipe diameters and materials in the HK environment. The performance of the proposed models will be assessed using the probability of positive/negative predictions of failure and of false/missed alarms. The accuracy of the proposed models will be validated using already collected data from the DSD (Drainage Services Department) and field experiments related to detected new failure locations. The proposed statistical and AI-driven approaches will help DSD and similar agencies worldwide to highlight those critical spots of high potential failure for further detailed investigation. This will enable agencies to correctly prioritize the efficient use of the available inspection and repair resources. 香港的污水管網系統由1700公里污水管，2300公里雨水管以及300個污水泵房组成，每天可收集280萬立方米的未經處理的污水，服務於約93%的香港人口。這些污水管道的平均使用年限已超過30年，其中15%的管道超過50年，一些污水管道的使用壽命甚至接近尾聲，可預見的結構和操作故障的數量也由此隨之增加。在嚴重擁擠的香港地區運營與維護這一龐大的管網系统是一項相當複雜的工作，所以我們應主動採取行動，對系統結構和操作方面存在的潜在威脅進行預測，這將在减少管網崩潰對社會和環境的影響方面上起到至關重要的作用。基於以上分析，此項研究的主要目的是建立一個新型可靠的預測模型，以實現對管網系統結構和操作故障時間的預測。 之前的研究主要從結構、環境和衰退等因素切入，調查了污水管道存在的故障，例如裂缝、破裂、滲入/滲出、外溢和淤積等。然而這些工作仍然存在以下問題：(1) 忽略了歷史可用數據對研究的作用；(2) 在評估污水管道故障時忽视了管道的缺陷；這使得各類故障因素之間的關鍵性和相互依賴性產生衝突。統計和人工智能 (AI) 是公認的具有高精度預測能力的技術，因此該項研究將應用人工智能技術，基於污水管道缺陷構建一個新型的故障識別和預測模型。 為了探索導致污水管道故障的主要原因，此研究將從導致故障的關鍵因素和缺陷出發，同時兼顧土壤特性和氣候參數的影響。為實現上述研究目的，將針對香港特定環境中不同直徑和材料的管道，開發一種用於識別污水管道故障且能預測故障發生時間的模型，並通過故障能否被正確預測以及能否及時預警的概率來檢驗該模型的性能。研究還將使用渠務署提供的數據以及利用最新故障的現場實驗來驗證該模型的準確性。這項以統計與人工智能技術驅使的研究將會為渠務署以及全世界的相關部門提供一個解决污水管道潜在故障的新思路，實現管道檢查與維護資源的合理配置。

15209322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15209322.value: 未來電網彈性評估—一種拓撲方法

15209322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209322.value: Secure and reliable electricity supply is of vital importance to support both economic and societal development. Traditional power system reliability evaluates the system performance of continuous service considering mainly high-probability incidents caused by equipment failures or human errors. Recent occurrences of catastrophic outages attributed to the climate change-related and cyber-attack related reasons remind the vulnerability of power grids and inadequacy of traditional reliability theories[1,2].The situation is further complicated considering the continuous penetration of many climate-dependent renewable generations, as well as the evolving system architectures with many self-organized sub-networks(e.g.microgrids) that are strongly interconnected. To deal with catastrophic events of high impact low probability caused by e.g. extreme weathers, new methods and theories governing the safety and risk management of complex power systems have to be developed. The ability of system to withstand those extreme disturbances with the uncertainties described above is best measured by system resilience, which characterizes the ability to anticipate and withstand external strikes, recover back to its pre-event state as quickly as possible and adapt to be better prepared to future catastrophic events. The research of how to assess and validate power system resilience is drawing growing attentions and is also the main theme of this project. By far, there are different metrics and assessment methods developed to evaluate power system resilience from either operational or infrastructure perspective. However, most existing methods adopt event-based approaches to assess system resilience considering the equipment fragility, preventative and emergency response plans etc. In addition, the simulation models adopted in existing approaches are usually customized according to one specific scenario and inapplicable to others. As such, how to study the resilience performance based on some generic but fundamental properties of power grids become an interesting yet challenging topic. Considering the evolving and complex structure of future power grids, this project aims at development of a novel framework for resilience analysis from the network topology perspective, which explicitly relates the intrinsic properties of a power grid with its resilience performance. The findings of the project will provide insightful analysis and corresponding countermeasures for resilience enhancements with respect to power system composition and architecture. Considering the fast development of smart grids locally and internationally, the models and methods arising from this project will undoubtedly bring forward significant benefits to further understand, analyze and reinforce power grid resilience, which is essentially meaningful for Hong Kong suffering multiple experiences of extreme weather annually like typhoons. 安全可靠的電力供應對於支援經濟和社會發展至關重要。傳統電力系統可靠性評估重點檢驗系統提供連續服務的性能，並主要考慮由設備故障或人為錯誤引起的高概率事件。最近發生的災難性停電事件歸因於(以往較罕見的)氣候變化相關和網路攻擊相關的原因，顯示出電網的脆弱性和傳統可靠性理論的不足之處。考慮到受複雜氣候影響的可再生能源的持續滲透，以及電力系統架構不斷發展導致出現許多具有高度互連的自組織子網路（例如微電網）， 未來電力系統的可靠性狀況會變得更加的複雜。應對由例如極端天氣造成的低概率高影響的災難性事故，有關未來複雜電力系統安全和風險管理的新方法和理論必須開發。 通過系統的彈性可以很好的衡量電力系統承受以上描述的具高度不確定性的極端擾動的能力，其表徵了系統預期並承受外部擾動打擊後能夠儘快恢復到事件前的狀態，並調整適應以更好地應對未來的災難性事件的能力。如何評估和驗證電力系統彈性的問題正在引起越來越多的關注, 這也是本專案的研究主題。到目前為止，從系統運行或基礎設施的角度，不同的指標和評估方法被開發並應用於評估電力系統彈性。然而，大多數現有的系統彈性評估方法都採用基於事件評估系統彈性，並主要考慮設備脆弱性和事故的預防和應急預案。此外，現有評估方法中採用的系統模擬模型通常是根據某特定事件場景定制的，並不適用於其他場景下的評估。因此，如何基於一些電網的通用但深刻的基本特性來評估系統彈性成為一個有趣但具有挑戰性的話題。 考慮到未來電網的演變和複雜結構，本專案旨在在開發從網路拓撲角度進行系統彈性分析的新框架，將電網的內在屬性與其彈性表現明確地關聯起來。該項目的研究結果將提供有見地的分析和以及從系統組成和架構角度增強系統彈性的策略。考慮到本地和國際範圍智慧電網的快速發展，該專案產生的模型和方法將無疑為進一步瞭解、分析和加強電網彈性帶來巨大裨益，這對每年面臨多次經歷颱風等極端天氣考驗的香港電網具有深刻意義。

15209822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15209822.value: 通過利用交易、流動性和真實市場對去中心化金融 (DeFi) 協議進行安全評估

15209822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209822.value: 在這個項目中，我們專注於安全評估DeFi 協議，尤其是通過利用交易、流動性和真實市場。我們將首先分析 DeFi 流動性池中的漏洞，這些漏洞決定了DeFi 生態系統的交易風險和安全性。現有的相關工作只關注簡單場景中的漏洞，不考慮具有多個受害者、對手和資金池的真實交易環境。我們將提出兩種新穎的攻擊方式，稱為 Chu-ko-nu 攻擊和流動性攻擊。Chu-ko-nu 攻擊可以適應有多個受害交易者的複雜場景。流動性攻擊允許對抗性交易者攻擊流動性提供者，他們是 DeFi 的重要組成部分。我們還將通過利用多個流動性池來優化提議的攻擊。 然後，我們將採取新的視角來分析 DeFi 數據，並通過以下方式調查潛在的嚴重攻擊：利用真實的市場 CeFi 數據。我們將訓練一個 AI 模型來獲得準確的 DeFi 加密貨幣價格預言。在此基礎上，我們將提出同時涉及 DeFi 的新型套利攻擊和漢堡攻擊。通過 CeFi 平台，可以提供新的套利機會，利用大的價格波動的市場，攻擊者獲得更多的利潤。 最後，我們將詳細闡述如何保護 DeFi 協議免受潛在攻擊以及如何進行安全評估。我們將提出三種實用有效的防禦策略。第一個實用策略允許 DeFi 用戶配置他們的交易以使攻擊無利可圖。第二策略可以防止用戶的交易暴露給攻擊者。第三個策略利用隨機順序的交易打包可以使礦工本身和 DeFi 生態系統受益。我們將實施在以太坊等現實世界區塊鏈平台中提出的攻擊和防禦方法，並利用 真實世界的 CeFi、DeFi 數據來評估主流 DeFi 協議的安全性。 我們的項目將實現以下四個目標。 (1) 與以往工作相比，關於 DeFi 漏洞，我們的分析和提出的攻擊可以適應現實世界的交易環境，有多個受害者、對手和流動資金池。 （2）我們將建立一個準確的AI模型，用新角度分析真實 CeFi 市場對 DeFi 的影響，研究潛在的對 DeFi惡意攻擊 。 (3)我們將提供實用高效的保護 DeFi 協議免受潛在攻擊並保護用戶資產的防禦策略。 (4) 我們將實施所提議的攻擊和防禦策略，並進行徹底評估現實世界系統中 DeFi 協議的安全性。

15209922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15209922.value: 基於差分隱私的逃逸性聯邦學習攻擊和防禦機制研究

15209922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15209922.value: 聯邦學習可以提高數據隱私性並減少計算與傳輸代價。然而，近期有相當多的研究發現聯邦學習在惡意用戶場景中顯得相當脆弱。許多攻擊，例如模型/數據投毒和隱私攻擊等，嚴重削弱了公眾對聯邦學習的信任感，阻礙了這一技術的廣泛應用。目前在學術界出現了檢測和抵禦此類攻擊的研究，然而它們都對攻擊者的策略進行了大量的規範和假設，使得這些研究往往只能停留在紙面上，因為如果攻擊者也得知此類檢測或防禦技術，它們的效用便大大下降。 本項目從一個全新的角度看待如何使此類攻擊更有效的進行逃逸。主要的思想是利用本地化差分隱私這一新技術。差分隱私通常被用來保護個人敏感數據免被以明文方式收集和實用，而本項目把這一技術應用到聯邦學習攻擊的逃逸策略中，例如可以將投毒攻擊中的毒餌通過差分隱私擾動，從而避開各類檢測和抵禦方法。 我們將此類新的攻擊應用於目前的聯邦學習系統中，並在此基礎上研究出更安全可靠的檢測和防禦技術，以使聯邦學習下的攻防技術得以螺旋式的上升，為下一代聯邦學習系統的安全性和可靠性提供更好的理論基礎，使聯邦學習真正成為高效、安全、保護個人隱私的分佈式學習系統，能廣泛應用於各類實際應用場景，如圖像識別、文本理解、語音識別、甚至是邏輯推理等。

15210122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15210122.value: 用于域自适应说话人验证的具有混合注意力表征的自监督说话人嵌入

15210122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15210122.value: Prof Chien, Jen-Tzung Dr Mak, Man-wai

15210122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15210122.value: We often heard from the news that millions of remote-service customers' personal records have been compromised. These security leaks cause concerns about the security of the remote services that everyone uses daily. The conventional approach to user authentication, such as usernames and passwords, is no longer adequate for securing these services. Many companies have now introduced voice biometrics as a complement to the conventional username-password approach. With this new authentication method, it is much harder for fraudsters to imitate legitimate users. Central to voice biometric authentication is speaker recognition technologies. While today's speaker recognition systems perform very well under the acoustic environment (source domain) for which they are trained, their performance will dramatically drop in unseen environments (target domains). This so-called domain mismatch hinders the commercialization of speaker recognition technologies. This project aims to develop machine learning algorithms to make a well-trained speaker embedding network amenable to a new acoustic environment without any labeled data from the new environment. All the learning algorithms need are some unlabeled speech samples from the new environment. We will apply data augmentation and spectral clustering to discover the contrastive properties between speaker embeddings obtained from intra-augmented utterances and inter-augmented utterances to achieve this goal. The contrastive properties lead to a self-supervised contrastive loss that enables the speaker embedding network to adapt to new acoustic environments. Leveraging the contrastive properties, we will employ teacher-student knowledge transfer to distill the knowledge from a well-trained teacher network to a student network. The latter is trained to maximize the mutual information between the teacher network's output and the student network's output. Another direction of this project is to enhance speaker embeddings' robustness against the diversity in acoustic environments, e.g., speech recorded by near-field microphones and far-field microphones. We will achieve this goal by reassessing the role of individual heads in multi-head attention models. In particular, we advocate a mixture representation with sparsity constraints for the attention weights, which leads to more efficient use of the parameters in the attention network. We will evaluate the proposed algorithms on massive data from Voxceleb, Voices 2019 Challenge, SdSV Challenge, and CN-CELEB. The project will provide insight into robust speaker verification with unlabeled target-domain data. It will also contribute to contrastive self-supervised learning, teacher-student knowledge distillation, and attention mechanisms in speaker embeddings. The proposed frameworks are also valuable to other applications (e.g., ECG classification) where only unlabeled data are available. 我們經常從新聞中得知數百萬遠程服務用戶的個人數據遭泄露的事件。這些安全漏洞引起人們對日常使用的遠程服務的安全性的擔憂。傳統的用戶身份驗證方法（例如用戶名和密碼）已不足以保證這些服務的安全性。許多公司現在已經引入語音生物識別技術作為傳統用戶名/密碼驗證方法的補充。使用這種新的身份驗證方法，欺詐者很難模仿合法用戶。語音生物特徵認證的核心是說話人識別技術。雖然今天的說話人識別系統在訓練它們的聲學環境（源域）下表現非常好，但它們的性能在未知的環境（目標域）中會急劇下降。這種所謂的域不匹配阻礙了說話人識別技術的商業化。 該項目旨在開發機器學習算法，使訓練好的說話人嵌入網絡能夠適應新的聲學環境，而無需來自新環境的任何標記數據。所有學習算法只需要來自新環境的一些未標記的語音樣本。我們將應用數據增強和譜聚類來尋找從類內增強話語和類間增強話語獲得的說話人嵌入之間的對比特性（contrastive properties），以實現這一目標。對比特性可以引出自監督對比損失，使說話人嵌入網絡能夠適應新的聲學環境。利用對比特性，我們將採用知識蒸餾的方法來將知識從訓練好的教師網絡提煉到學生網絡。後者被訓練以最大化教師網絡的輸出和學生網絡的輸出之間的互信息。該項目的另一個目的是增強說話人嵌入對聲學環境多樣性的魯棒性，例如近場麥克風和遠場麥克風記錄的語音。我們將通過重新評估單個頭在多頭注意力(multi-head attention)模型中的作用來實現這一目標。特別是，我們提倡對注意力權重使用具有稀疏約束的混合表示，這可以更有效地使用注意力網絡中的參數。 我們將在 Voxceleb、Voices 2019 Challenge、SdSV Challenge 和 CN-CELEB 的海量數據上評估所提出的算法。該項目將使用未標記的目標域數據對穩健說話人驗證提供深入的了解。它還將有助於自監督對比學習、知識蒸餾和說話人嵌入中的注意力機制的發展。不僅如此，所提出的框架對於只有未標記數據可用的其他應用（例如，ECG 分類）也很有價值。

15210222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15210222.value: 一種面向認知人機協作裝配的多模態智能策略學習方法

15210222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15210222.value: Human-robot collaborative assembly (HRCA), as one of the prevailing human-robot collaboration implementations in modern smart factories, allows seamless communication and collaboration between human operators and robots to fulfil various manufacturing assembly tasks in a shared workspace. Owing to its flexible automation capabilities, HRCA has been playing an ever-significant role to realize personalized production in mass efficiency, which combines the high accuracy, reliability, and repeatability of collaborative robots with the high flexibility and adaptability of humans to realize optimal productivity. Nevertheless, existing HRCA mainly undertakes either human-centred or robot-centered manner reactively, where operations are mostly conducted by following the pre-defined instructions, thus far from an efficient cognitive integration of robotic automation and human cognitions. Empowered by cutting-edge cognitive computing, industrial Internet-of-Things and robot learning, this research project aims to introduce an artificial intelligence-enabled approach towards cognitive HRCA. To achieve it, three critical issues should be well-addressed synergistically: 1) Reliable operator action prediction via multimodal human data. A multimodal neural network is utilized to extract action presentations by observation of RGB videos and 3D human skeletons. Meanwhile, a Bi-Gated Recurrent Unit agent is introduced to extract language features of collaborative task instructions. Then, fusion modules are used to learn semantic knowledge of human action patterns across visual-language cues for reliable prediction. 2) Holistic scene understanding of partially occluded objects and close-range collaboration. A high-resolution network-based 6-DoF object pose estimation method is presented to achieve object cognition, and to better deal with partial occlusion in HRCA. Meanwhile, a 3D point cloud semantic segmentation is introduced to effectively model the close-range HRCA environment with fine-grained scene details. 3) Strategy learning to ensure the adaptive robot decision-making for assembly task fulfillment. A graph convolutional network-based approach is presented to embed the multimodal data input, including human action, scene cognition, and subtask 3D point cloud for HRCA strategy searching. Meanwhile, to enable the strategy transfer for similar assembly tasks/properties, domain adaptation is implemented to effectively transfer assembly task rules from the source domain to the target domain based on the similarity evaluation. Moreover, for dissimilar tasks/properties, the proposed deep reinforcement learning-enabled approach can simulate different possible strategies and generate the optimal solution for adaptive robot planning accordingly. To validate their performance, a demonstrative case of the HRCA-based electric vehicle battery assembly process will be conducted with a comparative analysis. The success of this project can offer a valuable cognitive HRCA technology with higher automation flexibility and efficiency. 人-機器人協作裝配（HRCA），是現代智能工廠的主要實現手段之一。通過先進的工業物聯網、人工智能與機器人技術等，可以實現人與機器人之間的無縫通信與協作，在共享的工作空間中完成各種裝配製造任務。由於其高度柔性的自動化能力，HRCA在目前大規模個性化生產中發揮著越來越重要的作用，它將協作機器人的高精度、高可靠性和可重複性與人類的高靈活性和適應性相結合，實現最優的生產效率。然而，現有的HRCA主要採取以人為中心或以機器人為中心的主-從方式，其操作大多是按照預先定義的指令進行的，遠沒有實現機器人自動化和人類認知的有效融合。 本研究項目旨在提出一種面向認知人機協作裝配的多模態智能策略學習方法，主要包括三個方面：1)利用多模態人類數據進行可靠的操作人員行為預測。通過觀察RGB視頻和3D人體骨骼，利用多模態神經網絡提取動作呈現。同時，引入雙門循環單元代理提取人機協作任務指令的語言特徵。然後，利用融合模塊跨視覺語言線索學習人類行為模式的語義知識，從而進行可靠的預測。2)對局部遮擋物體的全面場景理解和近景人機協作。提出了一種基於高分辨率網絡的六自由度目標位姿估計方法，以實現對目標的認知，並更好地處理HRCA中的部分遮擋問題。同時，引入三維點雲語義分割，對場景細節粒度較細的近景HRCA環境進行有效建模。3)通過策略學習保證機器人對裝配任務的適應性決策。提出了一種基於圖卷積網絡的方法，嵌入多模態數據輸入，包括人體動作、場景認知和子任務三維點雲，用於HRCA策略搜索。同時，為了實現相似裝配任務/屬性的策略轉換，通過域適配實現基於相似度評估的裝配任務規則從源域有效地轉移到目標域。此外，對於不同的任務/特性，提出的深度強化學習方法可以模擬不同的可能策略，並據此生成自適應機器人規劃的最優解。 為了驗證所提出方法的有效性，本項目將對基於HRCA的新能源汽車動力電池模組裝配過程進行比較分析。該項目的成功執行將提供一套有價值的認知HRCA技術，用於實現更柔性的自動化裝配和更高的生產效率。

15210322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15210322.value: 考慮長期性能弱化影響的GFRP管約束混凝土嵌岩樁在橫豎向聯合載荷作用下的模擬研究

15210322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15210322.value: Prof Chen, Wenbo Prof YIN, Jian Hua

15210322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15210322.value: 目前，許多基礎設施都建於填海場地上。為了避免填海場地的過度沉降或差異沉降導致的建築物損壞，常採用樁基形式的基礎設計。但傳統鋼筋混凝土樁的耐腐蝕性較差，尤其是在沿海高鹽鹼應用環境中。而玻璃纖維複合材料（GFRP）具有良好的耐腐蝕性，因此受到廣泛關注和研究推廣。本项目的研究对象為一種新型的GFRP管約束混凝土嵌岩樁（簡稱為RGC樁）。樁中填充的混凝土為GFRP管提供支撐以克服其屈曲問題，而GFRP管為混凝土提供橫向約束從而提高混凝土的強度和延展性。並且，GFRP管的多種層壓結構可以有效承擔不同的載荷組合，無需添加額外的筋材，從而降低生命週期成本。 明確RGC樁在豎向和橫向動、靜荷載联合作用下的承載力和變形特徵，是其設計及應用的首要前提。此外，在沿海高鹽鹼性的應用環境下，GFRP的長期服役性能演化特徵也需要特别關注。然而，目前關於上述內容的研究十分匱乏。 為此，本项目將利用創新設計的恒溫控制加壓裝置，對GFRP管進行一系列不同程度的加速退化試驗，並使用退化後的GFRP管進行（1）在顆粒尺度的基於微觀力學的樁土介面剪切試驗；（2）在試樣尺度的RGC樁和GFRP管的標準試驗；和（3）複雜荷载條件下的RGC樁模型試驗。通過試驗結果的分析，明確GFRP管的長期服役性能退化規律及其與多種影響因素之間的關係，並將其引入現有的解析模型中。然後，通過單元體試驗和模型試驗對該模型進行驗證，並在驗證的基礎上進行參數分析，為RGC樁的設計應用提供理論依據和指導。 本項目將圍繞新型RGC樁在沿海高鹽鹼應用環境下的長短期服役性能進行多尺度的系統研究。鑒於RGC樁在沿海區域可持續建築中的廣闊應用前景和巨大潛力，本项目對RGC樁的設計和推廣應用具有重要的理論意義和實踐價值。

15210622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15210622.value: 精密玻璃碳熱解建模以用於高溫精密玻璃模壓

15210622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15210622.value: Allotropes of carbon intrigue researchers because of their unrivaled physical properties. Recently, considerable research has been conducted on the application of nanocarbon substances including nanotube and graphene. Additionally, a bulk form of carbon comprising randomly interlaced graphene sheets, named glassy carbon (GC), has also gained interest for developing lightweight structures, microelectromechanical devices, high-quality electrodes, and other applications under extreme conditions. Because GC can be used to manufacture crucibles and electrodes for high-temperature and highly corrosive applications, researchers have attempted to use GC to prepare molds for thermoforming glasses with high glass transition temperatures, such as aluminosilicate (used for screen covers) or silica glasses (used in high-power laser optics). Trial experiments have confirmed that GC molds outperform the conventional molding tools based on ceramic substrates and anti-stick coatings. The demonstrated ultralow adhesion and excellent reusability of GC, based on its ultrahigh thermal stability, chemical inertness, and hardness, make it a suitable candidate for achieving precision glass molding (PGM) at very high temperatures. However, because of its high hardness and brittleness, GC is extremely difficult, if not impossible, to be machined to achieve accurate and curved surface profiles for shaping precision optical components. Notably, the precursor of GC, a crosslinked polymer with high carbon yield, can be easily and precisely shaped. We hereby determine whether a precise GC geometry can be directly obtained through pyrolysis. Although the reaction kinetics involved in pyrolyzing a GC precursor are well documented, it is still unclear how a GC precursor reshapes during such a phase transformation process. To answer this question, we require formulations of the chemical reactions releasing gaseous molecules, transport of non-carbon species from the interior to surfaces, phase transformation resulting in GC, and associated eigenstrains and mechanical stresses leading to morphology evolution. These mechanisms constitute a complicated mechanochemical process that may be modeled using a set of partial differential equations. Based on this foundation towards achieving predictable GC geometries after pyrolysis and thereafter, precise GC products, this research will propose a computational model of pyrolysis to describe the reactions, mass transport, and structure rearrangements in the process of GC formation. Hence, we will conduct experiments and atomistic simulations to reveal fine details in pyrolysis-induced geometric changes and inherent diffusion-reaction processes. We will also establish a phase-field model to describe the complicated mechanochemical processes and verify the model by examining its predictability in the mold design and fabrication of a prototype. 碳的同素異形體（例如納米碳管和石墨烯）因其無與倫比的物理特性而吸引了研究人員對其進行了大量研究。其中由隨機交錯的石墨烯片組成的塊狀碳，稱為玻璃碳 (Glassy Carbon)，在開發輕質結構、微機電設備、高質量電極和極端條件下的其他應用也引起了人們的興趣。由於玻璃碳可用於製造用於在高溫和高腐蝕性環境中使用的坩堝和電極，研究人員們已嘗試使用玻璃碳來製備模具用於模壓具有高玻璃化轉變溫度的玻璃，例如鋁矽酸鹽（用於屏幕蓋板）或二氧化矽玻璃（用於高功率激光光學應用）。實驗數據表明玻璃碳模具優於基於陶瓷基底和防粘塗層復合的傳統模具。由於玻璃碳超高的熱穩定性、化學惰性和硬度，其展現出的超低粘附性和出色的可重複使用性使其成為實現高溫精密玻璃模壓的模具材料。然而，由於玻璃碳具有高硬度和脆性，人們難以通過切削加工來獲得精密光學元件所需的曲面輪廓。 值得注意的是，玻璃碳的前驅體是一種高碳產率的交聯聚合物，其易於被精密塑形。因此我們想確定能否通過熱解直接得到具有精密結構的玻璃碳。儘管已有的文獻對熱解玻璃碳前驅體所涉及的反應動力學有著充分的描述，但人們仍不清楚玻璃碳前驅體在這種相變過程中是如何改變形貌的。為了解決這個問題，我們需要定量描述釋放氣態分子的化學反應、非碳物質從內部到表面的傳輸、導致玻璃碳的相變以及導致變形的特徵應變和機械應力。這些機制構成了一個複雜的機械化學過程，可以使用一組偏微分方程對其進行建模，以此實現熱解玻璃碳幾何形狀的可預測性，從而為得到精密玻璃碳產品的建立基礎。為此，我們將進行實驗和原子級的模擬，以揭示熱解引起的幾何變化和內部擴散反應過程的細節。同時我們將建立一個相場模型來描述複雜的機械化學過程，並通過檢驗其在模具設計和原型製造中的可預測性來驗證模型。

15210722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15210722.value: 航空機組調度視角下團隊協作對航空公司運營成本與航班延誤影響研究

15210722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15210722.value: Prof Choi, Jason Tsan-ming Prof Wallace, Stein William

15210722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15210722.value: Airline cabin crews suffer a lot due to their irregular work-patterns and special lifestyle. Because of this irregular job nature, sometimes teammates become even more important than families. Recognizing this, airlines used to schedule cabin crews in teams for each aircraft type. However, nowadays, due to passenger demand variations, airlines are forced to operate with increasingly-diversified aircraft types, while each type has its own manpower requirements. Therefore, sticking to the team scheduling approach for each aircraft type would lead to severe cost-inefficiency. To reduce costs, many airlines are thus forced to schedule each cabin crew member individually with higher flexibility, to better cope with the different flight manpower demands of mixed aircraft types. However, being scheduled individually, cabin crews face frequent team changes and often have to work with different colleagues on each flight. They thus find it difficult to build workplace-friendship and usually feel alone. Therefore, cabin crew complaints on the poor teamwork led by this forever-changing workstyle are commonly seen nowadays, while airlines suffer from the resulting poor services and high turnover rates. This project aims to explore how to improve teamwork from the perspective of crew scheduling, i.e., increasing the chance that cabin crews can work together, while satisfying different flight manpower demands. Specifically, we will develop novel crew scheduling approaches with new teamwork construction strategies (e.g., constructing full/partial teams), and optimize the teamwork level for specific members. As teamwork construction brings higher complexity to optimization models, we will build acceleration strategies and constraint-reduction methods to improve solution efficiency. Besides, using the new scheduling approaches, the crew members operating a flight may come from different preceding flights in teams or/and individually. The delay of any preceding flight may cause operational disturbances for the flight. Therefore, we will further explore the flight delay risks led by the new crew scheduling approaches and develop new robustness strategies (e.g., using reserve crews). This project can truly benefit cabin crews by providing more chances of working together. However, constructing teamwork may sacrifice scheduling flexibility, bringing higher costs. We will thus explore the trade-off between teamwork and costs to help airlines better handle the increasing aircraft-type diversity. This project makes theoretical breakthroughs to the airline-crew-scheduling literature over the existing pure-team and pure-individual approaches. Moreover, by uncovering the impact of scheduling flexibility and teamwork on schedule generation, we can provide important insights for other shift-based/task-based personnel scheduling problems involving different manpower demand patterns. 由於工作的獨特性，航空公司客艙機組人員備受不規律生活方式的困擾。因此，對機組人員來說，工作夥伴有時甚至比家人還更加重要。意識到這一點，航空公司過去通常以團隊為基礎為各機隊制定機組人員工作計劃。然而，近年來，由於客流量的變化，航空公司的機隊多樣性不斷提高，而每種機型都有各自不同的人手需求。因此，採用傳統的以團隊為基礎的調度方法將導致運營成本大大增加。為了更好地滿足混合機隊的不同人手需求以降低成本，許多航空公司逐漸開始採用具有更高靈活性的個人調度方法。然而，當每個機組人員單獨進行排班時，他們將面臨頻繁的團隊變換，經常在每次執飛航班時需要與不同的同事共事。因此，機組人員很難建立深厚的工作友誼，因而常常感到孤獨。現如今，機組人員對這種工作形式的不滿已不可避免地導致服務態度差和高離職率的問題，使航空公司蒙受損失。本項目旨在探索如何從機組人員調度的角度提高機組團隊協作，即在滿足不同航班人手需求的同時提高機組人員能一起工作的幾率。具體來說，我們將會提出新的團隊構造方法（例如構造全團隊或部分團隊）以構建新的機組人員調度方法，並優化每一個機組人員的團隊協作程度。然而，構造團隊為優化模型帶來更高的求解難度。因此，我們將會提出加速方法和減少限制條件的方法以提高求解效率。此外，應用此項目提出的新調度方法時，執飛航班的機組人員可能來自不同的前序航班。因而任一前序航班的延誤都可能導致該航班的運營擾動。因此，我們將會進一步研究此新調度方法所帶來的航班延誤風險，並提出新的魯棒策略（例如利用備份機組）。此項目能為機組人員提供更多一起工作的機會。然而，提高團隊協作會使調度的靈活性大打折扣，由此帶來更高的運營成本。因此，我們還會探索團隊協作和運營成本之間的平衡，以更好地幫助航空公司應對日益增加的機隊多樣性。此項目在純團隊和純個人調度方法的基礎上為航空公司機組人員調度研究做出了理論突破。此外，通過揭示調度靈活性與團隊協作對排班計劃的影響，我們能為其他的以輪班為基礎或以任務為基礎的包含不同人手需求的調度問題提供重要的理論支持。

15211322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15211322.value: 新型定制矫形治疗方式对柔性扁平足女性膝关节疼痛的生物力学和生理影响

15211322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15211322.value: Dr Cheung, Jason Tak-Man Prof Liu, Yu Prof WANG, Yan

15211322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15211322.value: It is observed that women are biomechanically more vulnerable to suffer acute and overuse knee injuries and chronic knee pain. Having wider hips with more inward pointing thighs along with differences in leg muscles coordination might be potential biomechanical risk factors for excessive stress on the knee joints. Flexible flatfoot (FFF) is a common foot structure, characterized by a fallen foot arch and excessive rearfoot eversion under weight-bearing conditions. Women with flatfeet are expected to place an extra burden on their knees due to lower leg malalignment. Customized functional foot orthosis (FFO) have been widely used to correct foot deformities and alleviate lower limb or even back pain for individuals with FFF. However, the functional benefits and biomechanical rationale of customized FFO are inconsistent and inconclusive due to individualized subject characteristics and variations of prescribed orthoses. The conventional method for FFO prescription based on a subtalar neutral foot position proposed by Merton Root might need more evidence-based validation and the validity of such clinical practice remains questionable. The design of FFO depends largely on the experience of practitioner and the availability of orthotic materials, leading to subjective and inconsistent orthotic designs and performance. There is clearly a lack of consensus for the optimal foot orthotic treatment modality with respect to its structural and material designs. This study will establish an evidence-based FFO treatment modality for individuals with FFF and knee pain. A 3D foot shape capture to 3D printing fabrication process will be established for the design of flexible or rigid type of customized FFO, not only considering the arch support, but also outsole shape rolling function. A computational model of the knee-ankle-foot segment and coupled shoe structure will be built and validated by dynamic fluoroscopy and motion analysis to investigate the effects of FFO on internal loads among the major joint cartilages, ligaments, and musculotendon structures. The biomechanical and physiological influences of a customized 3D printed FFO on foot, ankle, and knee joints during walking and running will be revealed. The long-term effect of FFO on the physiological responses of knee joint will be investigated via magnetic resonance imaging analysis of cartilaginous structures. The key deliverable of this project will be an optimal design and fabrication guideline for the clinical prescription of 3D printed customized FFO, which can be applied in both clinical and commercial settings for treating flatfoot or other foot deformity related lower limb malalignment and joint pain. 据观察，妇女在生物力学上更容易遭受急性和过度使用性膝关节损伤以及慢性膝关节疼痛。臀部更宽，大腿向内指向腿部肌肉协调性差异可能是膝关节过度压力的潜在生物力学风险因素。柔性平脚（FFF）是一种常见的足部结构，其特点是足弓下落和后足过多承重条件下的外翻。由于小腿对线不良，扁平足的女性预计将给膝盖带来额外的负担。定制的功能性足部矫形器（FFO）已被广泛用于矫正足部畸形，减轻FFF患者的下肢甚至背痛。然而，由于个体化的主题特征和处方矫形器的变化，定制FFO的功能益处和生物力学原理可能不一致且不确定的。Merton Root提出的基于距骨中性足部位置的FFO处方的传统方法可能需要更多的验证，并且这种临床实践的有效性仍然值得怀疑。FFO的设计很大程度上取决于从业者的经验和矫形材料的可用性，导致主观和不一致的矫形器设计和性能。对于最佳的足部矫形治疗方式，在结构和材料设计方面显然缺乏共识。本研究将为患有FFF和膝关节疼痛的个体建立一种基于证据的FFO治疗方式。将建立3D脚形捕捉到3D打印的制造工艺，用于设计柔性或刚性类型的定制FFO，不仅考虑足弓支撑，还考虑外底形状滚动功能。通过动态透视和运动分析，建立膝踝足段和耦合鞋结构的计算模型，并验证FFO对主要关节软骨，韧带和肌肉腱结构内部负荷的影响。将揭示定制3D打印FFO在步行和跑步过程中对步行，脚踝和膝关节的生物力学和生理影响。FFO对膝关节生理反应的长期影响将通过软骨结构的磁共振成像分析来研究。该项目的关键可交付成果将是3D打印定制FFO临床处方的最佳设计和制造指南，该指南可应用于临床和商业环境，用于治疗与扁平足或其他足部畸形相关的下肢错位和关节疼痛。

15211522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15211522.value: 香港城市地區路邊汽車尾氣氧化及老化過程對氣相和氣溶膠中二次產物的貢獻研究

15211522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15211522.value: Prof Chan, Man Nin Prof Dal Maso, Miikka Prof HO, Kin Fai Prof Lee, Shuncheng Dr Tham, Yee Jun Prof Wang, Zhe Prof Zimmermann, Ralf

15211522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15211522.value: Vehicle emissions are an important source of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and particulate matters (PM) in urban areas. The emitted VOCs and particulate matters can undergo oxidation and further aging to form secondary products in gas- and particle-phase. Quantitatively understanding of secondary products from oxidation and aging processes of on-road vehicle emissions is one of the major concerns in the perspective of air pollution in Hong Kong. This proposal is aimed to update the current knowledge of the contributions of secondary products from atmospheric oxidation and aging processes of chemical complex mixture at a traffic dominant roadside site. Ambient measurements of atmospheric chemically complexes at the roadside site will be conducted to evaluate the chemical profiles of precursors from vehicle emissions. A combination of outdoor chamber and PAM reactors will be used to conduct oxidation and aging processes of roadside air under atmospheric conditions. The effects of gaseous pollutants (i.e., sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, and ammonia), varied oxidants (i.e., hydroxyl, chlorine, and nitrate radicals), and oxidation ages on secondary products formation from oxidation and aging of the roadside air will be examined. Proton-transfer-reaction time-of-flight mass spectrometry (PTR-ToF-MS) and high-resolution chemical ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (HR-ToF-CIMS) will be used to monitor gas phase precursors and oxidation products. A scanning mobility particle sizer (SMPS) will be used to measure aerosol volume concentrations and distributions in roadside air and reactors before and during the oxidation and aging experiments. Offline samples will be analyzed with ultra-performance liquid chromatography ultra-high-resolution mass spectrometry (UPLC-UHRMS) to characterize the particle-phase products in each experiment. Combining the chamber, PAM reactor and these state-of-art instruments will enable us to investigate the full dataset of precursors, intermediates and products and probe into the processes and contributions of secondary products from the oxidation and aging from urban roadside air. Overall, this project aims to provide updated information on secondary products from multigeneration oxidation of vehicle emissions, which will help on implemented mitigation measures, and effective strategic recommendations for the improvement of roadside air quality in Hong Kong. 機動車尾氣是城市地區大氣中揮發性有機物和有機氣溶膠的重要來源。機動車尾氣從尾氣管排放到空氣中後，這些揮發性有機物和一次有機氣溶膠通過被大氣氧化劑氧化和老化，進一步產生大量氣相和顆粒相二次污染物，對城市大氣污染造成更嚴重的影響。因此，為全面瞭解香港城市機動車排放產生的二次污染問題，本研究將在一個路邊站量化研究汽車尾氣經過氧化和老化產生二次有機污染物的過程。首先，通過觀測路邊站的空氣污染物，對汽車排放的一次污染物成分譜進行分析。通過對比得到的前體物成分譜，結合室外煙霧箱和氧化流動管反應器對汽車尾氣進行氧化和老化，並得到這些過程產生的二次污染物的成分譜。該實驗中將探究氣態污染物（如二氧化硫、氮氧化物和氨氣）、不同大氣氧化劑（羥基、氯和三氧化氮自由基）、不同氧化劑濃度等條件對汽車尾氣的氧化及老化過程的影響。該研究擬使用質子轉移反應飛行時間質譜儀和化學電離飛行時間質譜儀對氣態前體物和氧化產物進行檢測，利用掃描電遷移率粒徑譜儀和超高效液相色譜-超高解析度質譜儀分析有機氣溶膠的粒徑分佈、品質濃度以及化學成分。結合這些先進設備和儀器，本研究將鑒定並量化汽車尾氣排放的前體物、中間產物和多代產物，探究氧化和老化過程對城市路邊環境中二次污染物的貢獻。總的來說，該研究將為汽車尾氣排放及多代氧化產物的污染控制，及為有效提高香港路邊空氣品質提供資料和理論支援。

15211822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15211822.value: 香港郊區中層辦公建築和居住建築間能源共享研究以實現零耗能社區能源自給性及經濟優化性

15211822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15211822.value: 在過去的十年間，大量的研究集中在“零耗能建築(ZEBs)”的主題,因其常常被認爲是未來建築業界（主要包括商用和居住建築）的最終目標。一個被觀察到的有趣現像是，在不同的個體零耗能建築間因不同的用戶行爲模式或建築可再生能源系統，而常常呈現出較爲互補的電力匹配性模式，尤其在商用和居住建築之間。這個現象引起了學術圈對於所謂“能源共享”的研究興趣，以便更好地利用有限的能源和儲能資源。然而，過去關於能源共享的傳統方法，正愈發受到新型零耗能建築(ZEBs)的最新發展而帶來的挑戰，尤其是當這些建築耦合了能源轉換、靜/動態電能存儲、及電網交互的多樣化特性。此外，電能共享在零耗能社區(ZEC)內也呈現出更加多維化的特徵：理論上，能源共享可以在任意兩個零耗能建築間進行，一是通過本地局部共享模式在相鄰建築間進行，或是通過遠程共享模式在遠距建築間進行。相應的，本項目的主要目標是研究位於香港郊區的中層辦公建築和居住建築間的電能共享潛力，以及研究所需的支持設施和控制策略，從而得到一個能夠通過共享電能和儲能資源以實現零耗能社區(ZEC)能源自給性和經濟優化性的的系統化指導準則。 為實現這一目標，本項目將邏輯性地開展以下步驟：(a)系統性地識別在香港郊區的中層辦公和中層居住零耗能建築(ZEBs)間的電能互補性潛力和特性，本項目的零耗能建築(ZEBs)將涉及典型的可再生能源和儲能資源、各類能量轉換、及電網交互特性。(b)研究具體的技術性解決方法以實現基於“相鄰模式”和“遠程模式”的電能資源共享方法。(c)對於能源共享設施的設計和控制進行多目標優化，以靈活性共享郊區零耗能社區中所包含的零耗能建築間的電能資源。(d)通過仿真技術，驗證電能共享設施的優化設計和控制方法，同時得到影響零耗能社區技術經濟可行性的關鍵設計和控制參數。本項目也將建立一套用以指導設計和控制電能共享設施的指導準側，將分別從需求端、產能端、以及儲能端的角度指導能源資源共享的設計和控制方法。

15212622.value: 使用高時空解析度區域數值天氣預報模型的集合對流層誤差改正來增強手機精密單點定位精度

15212822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15212822.value: 使用深度學習為道路交通噪音之聲景開發一個智能自動分級系統

15212822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15212822.value: Dr Chung, Fu Lai Dr Ma, Kuen Wai

15212822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15212822.value: 道路交通噪音一直都是城市環境中噪音污染的主要源頭之一。隨著城市現代化發展，單單只是控制噪音音量水平，並不足以消除噪音對市民健康和生活質素的影響。“聲景”是一個概念詞，用於表示人類對周遭聲音環境的感知，而不單只限於對響度的知覺。隨著生活水平的提高，近年來不同的政府機構及組織都開始意識到聲景的重要性。不過聲景評估是一個多維度的心理過程，傳統的數值分析和統計法都無法充分捕捉到現實生活中涉及的所有參數，並從中獲得聲音環境的一個整體聲景分級。然而，深度學習中的人工神經網絡方法為模擬人類對聲景的感知反應，提供了一個可行的方法。此外，PI 的研究團隊最近進行的工作發現人類對聲音的感知會引起多維度的心理影響。因此，PI 的研究團隊提出了一種多維度的聲音評估方法，運用了心理聲學指標和可靠且有效的心理測量量表，稱為心理聲學感知量表（PPS）。這工作成果提供了基礎去開發一個全新且從來沒有其他研究人員或是申請人所建立的智能工具。該工具會通過對 9 種基本感知和 4 種指定的感知反應（聲景評級、 SGs）。運用聲景評估的整合，再利用 PPS 和深度學習技術，將提供一個新穎的自動分級系統，幫助滿足公眾對提升生活質量的期望。 因此，本研究的主要目的是通過統計、計算和實驗開發一個自動分級系統 (AGS)，用於道路交通噪音的聲景分級，該系統將結合多維度聲景評估與最新的深度學習技術。開發的 AGS 將會是一個創新的評估工具，透過僅 15 秒長的聲音錄音，即可自動預測市民對道路交通噪音所感知到的SGs。任何非專業人士都可以輕鬆使用 AGS。該研究的意義在於，它產生了一個可靠、高效且用戶友好的整體聲景自動分級系統，為存在交通噪音問題的發達城市去評估環境中噪音問題的可接受程度。

15213122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15213122.value: 可調頻的超低頻擺在波浪能發電中的應用

15213122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15213122.value: 由於更小的環境影響，可再生能源已在全球範圍内成爲了傳統化石能源的重要替代品。在衆多選項中，海洋波浪能因爲分佈廣、可預測性強、能量密度高等顯著優點而備受青睞。粵港瓊沿岸有著中國最豐富的可開發波浪能資源。然而，相比於風力發電，目前海洋波浪能發電技術仍處於探索階段。在諸多波浪能發電裝置類型中，振動浮子式發電裝置具有經濟性、發電效率較高、易於小型化、可於深海區域獨立工作等優勢。 然而，如何有效地設計適配於波浪頻率（低於1 Hz）且頻率可調的浮子結構，是波浪能領域亟需解決的關鍵技術問題。本項目將探索一種新型的振子形式——雙質量擺，並將其應用於浮體中以構成新型的波浪能發電裝置。 該雙質量擺具備極低的自振頻率，且頻率可自適應調節，進而能與波浪頻率相適配，實現共振從而提高能量捕獲效率。 相比於現有的頻率調節技術，該雙質量擺擬採用一種新型、簡易、高效的頻率調節策略。 加裝該雙質量擺可使已有浮體（例如導航浮標）具備自供能的能力。本項目旨在通過解析、數值和試驗研究等技術手段，系統地研發該雙質量擺波浪能發電裝置。

15213322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15213322.value: 應用於視頻物聯網的可重構智能表面賦能的無線網絡的研究

15213322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15213322.value: Prof Liu, Liang Prof LU, HANCHENG

15213322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15213322.value: 視頻物聯網 (IoVT) 是新一代物聯網，其視覺傳感器為各種應用收集圖像和視頻數據。該系統由三個主要部分組成：視覺傳感、無線網絡和數據集成（見圖 1）。隨著 5G 的到來，當視覺傳感器節點可以通過無線網絡連接時，IoVT 最近的出現顯示出其巨大的潛力。然而，IoVT 仍然面臨著幾個具有挑戰性的問題，以適應通過無線網絡傳輸視覺傳感器端連續生成的體積視覺傳感器數據的需求。 該提案旨在通過新興的可重構智能表面 (RIS) 為 IoVT 採用的無線網絡賦能，以應對 IoVT 系統部署的技術挑戰。更具體地說，擬議研究的目標包括通過 RIS 面板研究視覺傳感器節點和無線基站之間的合適信道建模，以及設計用於視覺數據收集的上行鏈路策略以及功率控制和小區關聯以實現海量視覺數據的穩健和低延遲傳輸。本研究的另一個目標是結合連續消除解碼開發視覺數據的自適應分層編碼，以在 5G 無線網絡上實現對壓縮傳感器數據的期望不等差錯保護。 該 IoVT 系統在傳感器生成的數據量以及對此類視覺數據的分析結果採取快速行動的需求方面與傳統物聯網有著根本的不同。傳統的物聯網數據通常數據量很小，並且隨著時間的推移變得稀疏。然而，IoVT 傳感器不斷生成的視覺數據，給無線網絡帶來了挑戰，難以將它們及時傳輸到雲中心進行處理。此外，IoVT 系統通常部署用於需要雲中心和傳感器節點之間的低延遲網絡的實時應用程序。此外，IoVT 生成的視覺數據通常在傳輸之前進行壓縮，以適應帶寬限制。在無線網絡上傳輸視覺數據時，需要一種具有不等差錯保護能力的分層編碼。 RIS 賦能的擬議無線網絡策略有望解決上述具有挑戰性的技術問題。 擬議的研究包括理論分析和實驗驗證。在理論分析中，我們將重點關注幾個基本的網絡容量測量，包括 IoVT 傳感器和無線基站之間以及通過 RIS 面板的信道模型、視覺傳感器數據有效傳輸的上行鏈路模型、用於補償視在路徑損耗的功率控制在傳輸期間，以及以與預期基站相關聯的小區內的視覺傳感器節點的距離分佈為特徵的小區關聯。所有這些理論分析結果都將通過旨在模擬真實無線環境的實驗和為本項目設計的 RIS 進行驗證。將構建所有關鍵組件的測試平台，包括 IoVT 前端視覺傳感器、RIS 面板和用作基站的 AP 接入點。 擬議研究的結果將通過出版物和專利傳播。本項目開發的算法源代碼將上傳至開源平台，與研究社區共享。我們預計，一旦成功完成，擬議研究的影響將超越學術界，有利於 IoVT 在各種應用領域的創新部署。

15213422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15213422.value: 有交易成本的連續時間均值方差策略

15213422.label: Project Objectives
15213422.value: Propose an appropriate definition of the equilibrium strategy for continuous-time mean-variance portfolio choice with transaction costs, which is a time-inconsistent singular stochastic control problem. By contrast, the extant definition applies to regular control problems. Propose a suitable Lagrangian dual formulation for continuous-time mean-variance portfolio choice with transaction costs such that the resulting equilibrium mean-variance strategies are economically reasonable, where the key is to choose an appropriate functional form of the risk preference parameter. Our preliminary results show that those commonly used functional forms may lead to absurd equilibrium strategies. Propose a suitable constraint formulation for continuous-time mean-variance portfolio choice with transaction costs such that the resulting equilibrium mean-variance strategies are economically reasonable, where the key is to choose an appropriate functional form of the expected target. Develop an efficient numerical method to find equilibrium mean-variance strategies for the above formulations, due to the absence of analytical solutions. We will also study the convergence of the numerical method and investigate the properties of the strategies.

Our preliminary results show that those commonly used functional forms may lead to absurd equilibrium strategies.

15213422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15213422.value: The mean-variance (MV) portfolio choice is intuitively more appealing than the expected utility maximization. However, dynamic MV analysis suffers from its inherent time-inconsistency: an MV strategy that is optimal today may be suboptimal tomorrow. Since time consistency is a fundamental requirement of rational decision-making, one may seek a time-consistent strategy, such as the equilibrium strategy, which has been extensively studied recently. However, almost all of the literature on equilibrium MV strategies assumes no transaction costs. This project aims to incorporate transaction costs into continuous-time MV portfolio choice, which leads to a time-inconsistent singular stochastic control problem. We attempt to seek equilibrium MV strategies. The extant definition for the equilibrium strategy is restricted to regular controls, and it remains open how to define an equilibrium strategy for time-inconsistent singular control problems. We will first provide a modified definition of the equilibrium MV strategy in order to adapt to the presence of transaction costs. Then we will propose two suitable formulations: the Lagrangian dual formulation and the constraint formulation, such that the resulting equilibrium MV strategies are economically reasonable. Here the key is to choose an appropriate functional form of the risk preference parameter and of the expected target, respectively. Since analytical solutions are usually unavailable for singular stochastic control problems, we will develop an efficient numerical method to find and investigate equilibrium MV strategies for the above formulations. The proposed research, if successful, will shed light on the study of equilibrium strategies for general time-inconsistent singular stochastic control problems and advance our understanding of time-inconsistency with market frictions. 均值方差在直覺上比期望效用最大化更具吸引力。然而，動態均值方差分析有其固有的時間不一致：今天最優的策略明天也許是次優的。由於時間一致性是理性決策的一個基本要求，所以人們傾向於尋求具有時間一致性的投資策略，最近被廣泛研究的均衡策略就是其中一例。然而，幾乎所有基於均值方差的均衡投資策略文獻都假定沒有交易成本。本項目把交易成本納入連續時間均值方差問題，這是一個時間不一致的隨機奇異控製問題，我們試圖尋求均衡策略。現有的均衡策略定義僅限於常規控製問題，而如何定義時間不一致奇異控製問題的均衡策略尚未有定論。我們將首先給出均值方差均衡投資策略的一個修正定義，以適應交易成本的存在。然後，我們計劃提出兩種合適的模型：拉格朗日對偶模型和約束條件模型，我們希望以此得到的均衡策略在經濟上是合理的。這裏的關鍵是要選擇適當的風險偏好參數和預期目標的函數形式。由於奇異隨機控製問題通常沒有解析解，我們將設計一種有效的數值方法研究上述模型的均衡策略。上述研究如成功，將有助於更一般的時間不一致奇異隨機控製問題均衡策略的研究，並加深我們對有市場摩擦下時間不一致性問題的理解。

15213522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15213522.value: 基於光纖端面多模光機械微諧振器的超小型光學向量加速度計

15213522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15213522.value: This project aims to investigate synergetic optical and micromechanical resonances of a multimode optomechanical microresonator upon optical fiber end-surface and develop ultraminiature optical vector accelerometers for high-sensitivity monitoring of motions in highly integrated systems or harsh environments. Accelerometer is one of most common sensors that monitors the acceleration caused by motions and has great many applications ranging from consumer-electronics intelligentization to seismic activity monitoring. Although microelectromechanical system (MEMS) accelerometers currently dominate industrial and consumer-product applications, optical accelerometers are widely regarded as the most promising technology for high-requirement applications. Optical accelerometers can be made by either combing fiber-optic devices with mechanical design to form a microsystem or directly integrating a light source upon MEMS structure to produce optical MEMS accelerometers. Notably, a new type of optical accelerometers, called (cavity) optomechanical accelerometer, attracted great attention recently. It has a mechanically compliant component acts part of an optical cavity, in which optical and mechanical resonances can create synergetic effect to detect motions with an imprecision at or below the standard quantum limit. However, the reported optomechanical accelerometers adopt either less robust or relatively bulky components and cannot achieve vector acceleration measurement, which make them less competitive in many practical applications. Recently, we demonstrated a spirally-suspended optomechanical microresonator upon optical fiber end-surface by using an own-developed optical 3D micro-printing technology. The device has an extremely small size and employs a resonant enhancement mechanism for ultrasensitive acoustic sensing. The work showed that an innovative 3D micro-printing technology may offer a new means to develop ultracompact optomechanical microsystems for high-performance sensing. In this project, we aim to develop ultraminiature high-sensitivity large-bandwidth optical vector accelerometers via precision microengineering a high-quality-factor (high-Q) multimode optomechanical microresonator. An asymmetric clover-like multimode optomechanical microresonator will be delicately devised to harness multiple resonant vibration modes for optomechanically sensing both the magnitude and direction of acceleration. Our in-house optical 3D micro-printing technology will be further improved to precisely engineer micrometer-scale 3D suspended optomechanical microresonator upon optical fiber end-surface. Thanks to its inherent resonant-enhancement mechanism, such an optomechanical accelerometer with a deformable optical cavity may empower highly sensitive detection of high-frequency motions approaching standard quantum limit. The successful implementation of the project will create a new generation of optical accelerometers for ultrasensitive motion monitoring in highly integrated systems, which may pave a new pathway to improve control and navigation systems and upgrade gravimetry and seismology for sensing and protecting the planet. 本項目旨在研究一种光纖端面多模光機械微諧振器的光學和微機械諧振協同效应，開發可用於高度集成系統或惡劣環境中進行高靈敏度運動監測的超小型光學向量加速度計。 加速度計是監測運動引起加速度的最常見感測器之一，從智能消費電子产品到地震活動監測都有廣泛應用。 儘管目前微機電系統（MEMS）加速度計在工業和消費电子產品中佔主導地位，但光學加速度計被廣泛認為是高要求應用中最有前途的加速度感測技術。 光學加速度計可以通過將光纖與機械設計结构相結合構成微系統或直接在 MEMS 結構上集成光源形成光學 MEMS 加速度計來實現。值得注意的是，最近一種稱為(腔)光機械加速度計的新型光學加速度計引起了廣泛關注。它有一個柔性機械元件作為光學腔的一部分。 其中的光學和機械共振可以產生協同效應，可檢測不精確度等於或低於標準量子極限的運動。然而，目前所報導的光機械加速度計所採用部件的魯棒性較差或體積相對較大，且無法實現向量加速度測量，使它們在許多實際應用中競爭力不高。 最近，我們科研小組通過使用自主開發的光學 3D 微打印技術，在光纖端面上展示了一種螺旋式悬挂光機械微諧振器。 該諧振器具有極小的尺寸，並採用了共振增強機制，能用於超靈敏聲學感測。 這項工作表明，一種創新的 3D 微打印技術可為開發用於高性能感測的超緊湊光機械微系統提供一種新技術路線。 在本項目中，我們计划通過精密微工程化高品質因子（高 Q）多模光機械微諧振器，从而開發超小型、高靈敏度、大頻寬光學向量加速度計。我们將精心設計一種不對稱的四葉草狀多模式光機械微諧振器，利用多个諧振模式以光機械方式感測加速度的大小和方向。 我們將進一步改進實驗室现有光學 3D 微打印技術，從而在光纖端面精細設計和制备微米級 3D 懸挂式光機械微諧振器。 由於其固有的共振增強機制，這種具有可形變光學腔的光機械加速度計有望對接近標準量子極限的高頻運動進行高度靈敏檢測。 該项目的成功實施将开发出可用於高度集成系統中的新一代超靈敏運動監測光學加速度計。它有望為控制改進和導航系統升級，以及重力測量和地震感知等应用提供新途徑。

15214222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15214222.value: 氣溶膠輔助打印製備聚電解質納濾膜：建立製備-結構-性能關係以實現規模化製備和水處理應用

15214222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15214222.value: Sustainable water supply is facing significant challenges in many regions throughout the world because of population growth, urbanization, pollution, and climate change. For example, Hong Kong relies on over 70% freshwater import. The need to obtain a safe and reliable water supply from complex and unconventional sources has motivated the development of novel membrane technologies. A membrane serves as a barrier which effectively separates water from other substances. Among different types of membrane separation, nanofiltration (NF) is very attractive for advanced water/wastewater treatment, because it is capable of removing all pathogens and most organic and inorganic contaminants in a single treatment step and with affordable energy input. Current NF membranes are mainly polyamide-based, which exhibit excellent perm-selectivity in many NF applications. They however have a few technical limitations that hinder their more widespread applications, such as high fouling propensity (thus high operating costs) and susceptibility to chlorine degradation. Polyelectrolyte NF membranes have emerged as a promising alternative to polyamide membranes. A great variety of polyelectrolyte molecules can be assembled into a selective active layer via the layer-by-layer dip coating approach, rendering their versatile chemistry and distinctive structures/properties. These membranes have demonstrated high water permeability and selectivity, and furthermore, improved chemical stability and enhanced anti-fouling property. The fabrication process is also green without using any organic solvent. These advantageous features thus further increase the competitiveness of NF and would broaden its implementation in water treatment. However, the current greatest hurdle for their applications is the lack of scalability of the dip coating fabrication approach, which is physically constrained by the diffusive time scale. In response to the critical need for novel polyelectrolyte membrane fabrication, this project leverages a unique combination of expertise ranging from aerosol engineering, membrane technology, and water treatment, to develop an aerosol-assisted printing fabrication approach. The new approach utilizes the dynamics of droplet evaporation, dispersion, and deposition for polyelectrolyte delivery, which is fundamentally different from dip coating. It is much faster, more efficient, and easily scalable. With this approach, the membranes will be fabricated with much shorter time (down to minutes) and fewer materials (minimization of material waste), and can have similar, if not better, permeability and selectivity properties compared to those obtained via dip coating. Successful project outcomes will provide critically needed fundamental knowledge and engineering know-how to translate the research on advantageous polyelectrolyte membranes into tangible products, thus markedly accelerating their applications in advanced water and wastewater treatment. 由於人口增長、城市化、污染和氣候變化等原因，全球許多地區的可持續供水正面臨重大挑戰。香港依賴 70% 以上的淡水進口。從複雜的非常規水源中獲取安全可靠的水資源推動了新型膜分離技術的開發。膜作為一種屏障，可有效地將水與其他物質分離。在不同類型的分離膜中，納濾對深度水處理非常有吸引力，因為它能夠在單一的處理步驟中去除所有病原體和大多數有機和無機污染物。目前的納濾膜主要基於聚酰胺，其在許多納濾應用中表現出了優異的選擇-滲透性。然而，其更廣泛的應用正受一些技術缺陷所阻礙，例如易被污染（因此導致高運營成本）和易被氯降解。 聚電解質納濾膜是聚酰胺膜的潛在替代品之一。各種各樣的聚電解質分子可以通過逐層浸塗方法組裝成選擇性活性層，並具有多樣的化學性質和獨特的結構。這些膜展現出了高透水性和選擇性，以及化學穩定性和增強的抗污染性能。其製備過程環境友好，不使用任何有機溶劑。這些優勢可進一步提高納濾的競爭力，擴大其在水處理領域的應用。然而，此類膜的最大應用障礙是浸塗製備方法受限於物理擴散的時間尺度而缺乏規模化製備的可能性。 本項目將利用獨特的專業知識組合，從氣溶膠工程，膜技術和水處理等多方面，開發氣溶膠輔助打印製備聚電解質納濾膜的方法。該新方法根本優於傳統的浸塗法，利用液滴（氣溶膠）實現聚電解質的分散、輸送和沉積，其更快、更高效且具有規模化潛力。應用這個方法，膜的製備時間大幅縮短（低至幾分鐘），應用材料更少（最大限度地減少材料浪費），並且具有相同的（或者更優的）滲透和選擇性能。 本項目成果將提供急需的基礎和工程知識以推動聚電解質納濾膜轉化為產品，從而顯著加速其在水和廢水深度處理中的應用。

15214722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15214722.value: 地下連續墻的性能評估：從導管澆築過程到長期結構監測

15214722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15214722.value: Dr TAN, Daoyuan Prof YIN, Jian-hua Prof YIN, Zhenyu Prof ZHU, Hong-Hu

15214722.label: Project Objectives
15214722.value: To develop a new distributed optic fibre sensor for thermal properties and strain measurement, which can be implemented to provide life-cycle performance assessment of diaphragm wall. To propose a thermal based method for detecting the imperfections and assessing the concrete quality during tremie concrete placement as well as monitoring the leakage of panel joints throughout the service life. To propose a thermal based method for detecting the imperfections and assessing the concrete quality during tremie concrete placement as well as monitoring the leakage of panel joints throughout the service life.

15214722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15214722.value: Underground space development can provide a safe and effective solution to the urgent spatial need of rapid urbanization. In the last decades, diaphragm walling has been commonly used to support the excavation of underground spaces and sometimes acts as permanent structure to the underground space. However, the complicated construction process and invisible underground environment increase the risks of failure and water leakage at the joints between diaphragm wall panels during excavation due to imperfections in tremie concreting. Those risks are costly to repair and sometimes catastrophic. Although some new techniques, including crosshole sonic logging (CSL), have been developed to inspect the integrity of wall panels before excavation, a smarter way is to assess the concrete quality, inclusions, and voids during the tremie concreting process, thus making it possible to position, assess, and improve the construction quality of diaphragm wall structure in a timely manner. This makes monitoring during concreting procedure equally important to long-term monitoring of diaphragm wall structure for construction under cramped conditions in over-crowded urban Hong Kong. This project aims to develop practical methods for detecting defects and assessing concrete quality during the construction process of diaphragm wall based on distributed optic fiber sensing technology as well as long-term monitoring of water leakage hazards and structural performance, forming a life-cycle monitoring strategy for diaphragm walling. A self-heating composite fiber optic sensor will be developed to obtain high resolution, fully distributed temperature and strain data by pre-installing fiber optic cables into the diaphragm walls. The distributed temperature sensing fiber in the composite fiber optic cable will be capable of identifying concrete quality defects, inclusions and water tightness of diaphragm wall during tremie concrete placement and long-term monitoring of water leakage hazards based on the thermal properties of the surrounding materials; the distributed strain sensing fiber will be used for long-term structure monitoring of the diaphragm wall experiencing engineering activities such as dewatering, excavation, construction of neighboring buildings and tunnel boring machine launching. With reliable multi-reference data provided by the lifecycle monitoring strategy, digital twin (DT) of diaphragm wall can be developed for construction optimization and risk management during the development of underground space. DT of the existing structure can be further used to serve the design and construction of adjacent buildings, which will have huge impact on Hong Kong and other highly urbanized cities in the world. 地下空間能夠為人類發展的空間迫切需求提供可靠的解決方案。地下連續墻結構能夠為地下空間的開挖提供支撐，同時有充當地下空間的永久圍護結構的潛力。然而地下連續墻的施工相對于傳統的上層鋼筋混凝土結構來說頗為複雜，需要在土層中掘槽，採用導管澆築的方法形成鋼筋混凝土結構。由於澆築過程無法直接觀測以及進行品質評估,導致漏水等災害在開挖過程中時有發生，需要耗費大量人力物力進行補救，有時更是會引起災難性後果。雖然一些新技術包括聲波透射法已經被嘗試用來對牆身進行開挖前的完整性檢測，但是更明智的做法應該是在混凝土澆築過程中對混凝土品質、包含物和空腔等缺陷進行探查，從而使得對地下連續墻結構的施工質量評估、控制和缺陷及時修復成為可能。因此，本研究課題旨在基於分佈式光纖傳感技術建立針對地下連續墻結構在澆築過程中多種缺陷的探查和質量評估方法，以及混凝土結構在服役期間的滲漏水災害識別和結構受力的長期監測，形成地下連續墻全生命週期監測策略。項目將會研發具有自加熱功能的複合光纜，並且通過在地下連續墻的鋼筋籠上預先安裝光纖傳感器來獲得高解析度的全分佈式溫度-應變監測數據。複合光纜中的分佈式溫度傳感光纖能夠基於周圍材料的熱屬性來分辨導管混凝土澆築過程中的品質缺陷、內含物和水密性以及滲漏水災害的長期監測；分佈式應變光纖用來對基坑開挖、盾構機掘進等工程活動中地下連續墻的結構受力和開裂等關鍵指標進行長期監測。本課題的研究成果將為地下連續墻等岩土結構的數位孿生構築提供可靠的多參量信息，保障地下空間開發過程中的工程安全。

15215822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15215822.value: 用於增強場景解譯的多模態數據行星表面三維語義測圖

15215822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15215822.value: 由行星表面的三維幾何和語義信息解譯行星表面對於任何行星探索任務和科學研究都至關重要。行星表面的三維語義測圖是同時重建三維幾何信息和對行星表面具有語義屬性的對像進行測圖。三維幾何重建和語義測圖不是獨立的任務：語義信息為三維重建提供有用的約束，而三維信息也為語義測圖提供有用的線索。因此，通過三維幾何與語義信息的聯合推理，可以利用其各自的先驗信息和約束來優化兩者的性能，而這是對這兩個任務分開處理所不能達到的。近年來，計算機視覺和攝影測量領域對常規場景（如室內環境、街景）的聯合三維重建和語義分割進行了研究。然而，目前的研究很少涉及大範圍行星表面的自然場景。行星表面通常具有各種類型的自然地貌（如隕石坑、岩石、露頭、山脈、火山錐、隆起、河谷、沙丘），行星表面的圖像往往缺乏豐富的紋理信息，導致三維重建和語義測圖存在種種困難。本項目將研發創新方法，從多模態數據（如圖像、語義、激光測高和光譜數據）對行星表面進行聯合三維重建和語義測圖，以增強場景解譯的能力，支持行星探索任務和科學研究。 本項目的主要研究目標是： (1) 研發新的神經網絡模型，用於對行星表面圖像中的典型地貌和感興趣特徵進行二維語義分割，並利用二維語義分割結果對這些圖像進行配準； (2) 研發一種基於語義和幾何先驗信息的多模態行星數據聯合三維重建與語義測圖創新優化方法，以生成高質量的行星表面三維幾何模型和相關語義數據； (3) 研發一個語義豐富的在線三維信息系統，用於對多模態行星數據進行綜合可視化和分析，使多學科研究人員能夠協作以增強行星表面解譯能力。 本項目將促進行星測圖領域的科技進步。所研發的三維語義測圖方法將能夠生成比以往方法質量更好的三維幾何模型和語義數據。研發的方法將有可能通過將語義信息嵌入到三維幾何模型中來提供新一代的行星表面三維數據。研發的具豐富語義的在線三維信息系統將促進多學科研究合作，以增強場景解譯，支持行星探索任務和科學研究。本項目研究成果將有助於中國在未來幾年對月球、火星和小行星的探索任務。研究成果也將具有技術轉移到香港各領域應用的巨大潛力，例如城市土地覆蓋和土地利用的語義測圖，室內設施、街景和城市環境的三維語義建模和解譯以支持室內導航、自動駕駛、城市規劃、智慧城市建設等應用。

15216422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216422.value: 珠江口海洋垃圾的運輸及其對香港水域的影響：新型拉格朗日數值模型的搭建與應用

15216422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216422.value: Litter, which is omnipresent in the marine environment, is a constant threat to wildlife, a hindrance to human activities, incurs immense economic costs world-wide, is unsightly and reduces the recreational value of our coasts. Plastic, the main component of marine litter world-wide, is slow to decompose and breaks down into even smaller pieces, so-called micro plastics, the environmental impact of which is largely unknown. Sources of marine litter are varied and can be sea or land-based. Land-based sources include sewage outlets, recreational activities on the coast, illegal fly-tipping and river outlets. Sea based sources of marine litter are shipping, and fisheries including aquaculture, offshore installations and recreational sailing. In last decade, a great effort has been devoted to monitor the litter and plastic abundance in the marine and riverine environments, using direct sampling or remote sensing estimates. There is a rising concern regarding the accumulation of floating plastic debris in the open ocean, coastal areas and estuaries. However, the magnitude and the fate of this pollution are still open questions. Promising large scale monitoring methods are now based on satellite images; however, several issues must be solved in discerning the different categories of floating litter. At the same time, there is a urgent need to build adequate mathematical framework for an accurate prediction of the fate of floating litter debris. This project will focus on both of these challenges by attempting to bring the two approaches together. On one side, a refined mathematical framework will be suggested that relies on the description of the main physical processes driving the transport of floating litter. Based on the latter, numerical simulations will be performed on one study area, the Pearl River Estuary and the Hong Kong waters, with the aim to predict the main route of litter transport and accumulation areas. On the other side, remote sensing technique based on satellite imaging will be developed and coupled to the numerical model. The areal distribution of marine litter, with a special attention to macro-plastic debris, will be used to validate the numerical predictions. The proposed model will be used to understand the path of both land-based and sea-based litter and to evaluate its impact on the different coastal areas. The knowledge of the most probable affected coastline will help the definition of future policies in marine litter management.

15216622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216622.value: 基於仿生 MXene外泌體納米系統用於增強結合腫瘤相關的巨噬細胞極化的NIR-II 光熱免疫治療

15216622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15216622.value: Prof Li, Zhiyang Prof Wen, Feiqiu

15216622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216622.value: 傳統的癌癥治療方法包括手術、化學療法和放射療法，存在復發率高、療效低的問題，尤其是對於晚期和難治性癌癥患者。因此，迫切需要具有高效治療效果的創新癌癥治療方法。最近，癌癥免疫療法已成為一種很有前途的方法，通過幫助人類患者自身的免疫系統識別和殺死癌細胞，具有減少副作用和長期免疫記憶的優勢。然而，由於缺乏細胞毒性免疫T細胞，目前的癌癥免疫治療方法仍面臨某些患者反應率低等挑戰。在各種 T 細胞激活方法中，增加免疫原性細胞死亡 (ICD) 抗原暴露和調節免疫抑製性腫瘤微環境 (TME)，例如將免疫抑製性 M2 巨噬細胞重編程為免疫促進 M1 巨噬細胞是兩種有前途的方法。然而，單一類型的T細胞激活方法的使用以及缺乏合適的免疫治療納米系統限製了基於T細胞激活的免疫療法的廣泛應用。因此，通過增加抗原暴露和調節免疫抑製TME同時開發新型組合免疫治療納米平臺具有良好的腫瘤靶向性、有效的治療性載貨和高免疫治療功效的特點，具有非常重要的意義。 在這個項目中，我們提出了一種基於葉酸（FA）修飾的 MXene 量子點封裝的 M1 巨噬細胞外泌體（FA-MXene QDs-M1 Exosome）的新型近紅外-II（NIR-II）驅動的仿生免疫治療納米系統，具有良好的腫瘤靶向能力和增強的聯合免疫治療。在這裏，M1 巨噬細胞外泌體既充當裝載 MXene QD 的載體，又充當將免疫抑製 M2 巨噬細胞重編程為免疫促進 M1 巨噬細胞以激活 T 細胞的治療劑。 Ti2N MXene QD 可用作 NIR II 光聲成像造影劑和光熱免疫療法 (PIT) 的治療劑。 FA分子綴合在外泌體的脂質膜上以增強腫瘤靶向能力。當仿生納米系統進入腫瘤微環境時，它們將靶向葉酸受體過度表達的腫瘤細胞和腫瘤相關巨噬細胞。在這裏，NIR-II 觸發的光熱治療可以殺死癌細胞並增加垂死癌細胞的 ICD 抗原，從而激活細胞毒性 T 細胞進行免疫治療。此外，仿生納米系統可以將免疫抑製性M2巨噬細胞極化為抗腫瘤M1巨噬細胞，直接攻擊癌細胞，並通過釋放促炎細胞因子進一步激活細胞毒性T細胞。因此，預期增強的免疫治療功效。該仿生納米系統可以成為潛在的 NIR-II 驅動的聯合免疫治療平臺，具有良好的腫瘤靶向性、有效的治療貨物攜帶和增強的免疫治療功效。

15216722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216722.value: 纤维血管毛细床水分管理织物：冷却机制和制造技术

15216722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216722.value: As the world becomes increasingly health and environmentally conscious and demanding, the need for moisture management fabrics (MMFs) continues to grow at an unprecedented pace for their increasing use in performance apparel such as sportswear, activity wear, protective wear as well as military and healthcare applications. MMFs work to promote the wicking of sweat away from skin for reducing skin wetness and enhancing evaporative cooling. However, existing approaches of MMFs often make the entire garment wet and/or heavy. Preliminary experiments by the Principal Investigator (PI) indicated that a biomimetic based approach inspired by the capillary bed in the human or animal’s cardiovascular system hold potential in improving the performance of MMF. The branching structure of blood vessels in the capillary bed facilitates the exchange of nutrients and wastes in the large interstitial space with minimum flow resistance. In the similar way, the fibrovascular capillary bed (FCB) moisture management fabric facilitates the distribution of the sweat or the externally supplied water through the branching fibrovascular capillary channels over a wide outer surface area for efficient evaporative cooling without making the entire outer fabric surface wet. This project is aimed at extending the initial work so as to elucidate the underlining principles for the optimization of the FCB fabric as well as to develop scalable fabrication technologies. If successful, it will have wide application in the performance wear industry. 随着世界变得越来越注重健康、环保意识和要求越来越高，对水分管理织物 (MMF) 的需求继续以前所未有的速度增长，因为它们越来越多地用于运动服、活动服、防护服以及军事和医疗保健等高性能服装应用程序。 MMF 可促进汗液从皮肤上排出，以减少皮肤湿度并增强蒸发冷却。然而，MMF 的现有方法通常会使整件衣服变得潮湿和/或沉重。首席研究员 (PI) 的初步实验表明，受人类或动物心血管系统毛细血管床启发的仿生方法在改善 MMF 的性能方面具有潜力。毛细血管床的血管分支结构有利于营养物质和废物在大的间隙空间中以最小的流动阻力进行交换。以类似的方式，纤维血管毛细血管床 (FCB) 水分管理织物有助于汗液或外部供应的水通过分支的纤维血管毛细通道分布在较宽的外表面积上，以实现有效的蒸发冷却，而不会使整个外织物表面变湿. 该项目旨在扩展初始工作，以阐明优化 FCB 结构的基本原则，并开发可量产的制造技术。如果成功，它将在功能服装行业有广泛的应用。

15216922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15216922.value: 具有快速适应进化边缘环境的可编辑学习

15216922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15216922.value: 随着边缘设备计算能力的进步，直接在用户本地部署机器学习应用程序，而不依赖于云计算集中式框架成为可能，以获得更快的响应和更好的隐私。 这种情况极大地催生了边缘学习的出现，旨在充分利用无处不在的边缘设备及其微处理器、嵌入式传感器，更重要的是利用本地生成的数据，进行快速的机器学习训练和推理。 随着边缘设备的爆炸式增长，本地生成数据的统计信息和本地客户端的目标需求各不相同，时时变化，我们称之为进化的边缘环境。 在这个项目中，我们构建了一个全新的边缘学习框架，可以在进化边缘环境中以无处不在的协作方式自动设计、训练和编辑多个专用模型。 为了实现训练框架的快速适应和动态编辑，观察到需要克服以下挑战。首先，考虑到资源受限的边缘学习系统，跨不同设备数据的非独立同分布性通常十分严重。 计算、通信和存储空间的容量也各不相同。 在这种情况下，为所有边缘设备使用预定义的统一模型架构可能不是最佳选择。 其次，在实际应用中，使用边缘设备收集的训练数据可能数据量不足，而且几乎总是未标记的数据。 这对于分布式设备上的训练来满足实用性和可扩展性需求是具有挑战性的。 最后，研究界尚未研究如何支持模型以保护隐私的方式自主学习和适应新数据的能力。 为了应对上述挑战，我们开发了一种新颖的轻量级具有环境可适应性的边缘学习框架，以促进跨各种边缘设备上模型的部署、训练和编辑。为了探索边缘资源限制下可部署模型架构，我们设计了一种新颖的异构感知联邦神经网络搜索框架来选择轻量级个性化模型。为了在边缘设备有限数据上实现快速训练和适应，我们设计了小样本学习赋能的边缘学习框架，以在边缘设备上实现极其快速和通用的训练过程。然后，为了适应边缘设备的动态特性，特别是对于数据演化，我们在联邦学习环境中引入了灵活的任务级知识编辑。目标是在已有模型上实现快速编辑，同时仍然保留重要的通用知识。最后，我们开发了一个原型系统来评估所提出的轻量级适应性和可编辑学习框架。
