15500222.label: Major findings and research outcome
15500222.value: 1. From these analyses, eight critical reflections were derived, and a future research agenda was outlined. This agenda includes exploring positive enhancers of MHPW, advocating for holistic conceptualizations of MHPW, encouraging cross-cultural and interdisciplinary collaborations, assessing the impacts of technology on mental health, developing industry-specific assessments, diversifying research methodologies with multidisciplinary theories, conducting multi-level analyses of influencing factors, and investigating the pandemic’s long-term impact on career perceptions and mental health reforms within the industry. 2. Several research directions for different research subjects were identified: tourists employees, and the community. For tourists, the research topics included mental health, well-being, memorable experiences and wellness tourism. For research on employees, the focus included their mental health, psychological well-being and negative emotions. In studying the role of tourism in community mental health and well-being, research has explored community well-being and emotional solidarity and used a capital approach. This study discusses several new research directions based on past research trends, global trends and other relevant factors. 3. This study examined the multidimensional antecedents and outcomes of hotel employees’ mental health. Using data from 756 hotel employees in China, the findings indicate that three work stressors (job responsibility, job complexity, and teamwork) unexpectedly reduced mental health problems, while other work stressors (role ambiguity, role overload, job insecurity, superiors’ behavior, and pressure to respond to messages) increased depression, nervousness, and loss of peace of mind. Mental health dimensions influence coping strategies, with depression and nervousness linked to emotion-focused coping, and loss of peace of mind associated with self-solving, emotion-focused, and avoidance coping. Differences emerged between junior/senior employees and front-of-house/back-of-house staff in stressor impacts and coping behaviors. Theoretical implications highlight the nuanced conceptualization of mental health as a multidimensional construct beyond generalized indicators, and the context-dependent nature of coping mechanisms contingent on distinct psychological experiences. Managerial implications provide insights into developing targeted interventions and supportive organizational policies. 4. Structural equation modeling revealed that verbal abuse and discriminatory treatment significantly increased feelings of loneliness, which in turn led to intrusive thoughts and anti-corporate attitudes. While distress tolerance and emotion regulation moderated the effects of alienation and discrimination on loneliness, they had no buffering effect on verbal abuse. The findings emphasize the psychological mechanisms underlying employee responses to bullying and contribute to both social exchange theory and practical interventions aimed at promoting emotional resilience and safer workplace environments in the hospitality sector.

15500222.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15500222.value: 1. Findings offer pivotal directions for future research and aim to advance the understanding and enhancement of MHPW in the global hospitality and tourism workforce through impactful scholarship. 2. Future research needs to examine employees’ coping behaviors to overcome workplace bullying and identify their preferred solutions for hotels to exterminate these detrimental or stressful practices. 3. To enhance the generalizability and depth of future item development, subsequent research should aim to involve a wider array of stakeholders—such as mid-level managers, HR practitioners, and employees from varied hotel tiers (e.g., budget, boutique, and luxury). 4. Continuous monitoring and adjustments to organizational practices are necessary to align with the evolving needs and expectations of the workforce in the post-pandemic era. By adopting a flexible and employee-centric approach, hospitality organizations can foster a supportive environment that promotes employee well-being, engagement, and long-term commitment, ultimately contributing to the industry’s overall resilience and success.

15500222.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15500222.value: 1. This study offers several managerial implications for hospitality managers and organizations, providing insights into developing effective strategies to support employee mental health and foster adaptive coping mechanisms in the evolving post-pandemic work environment. 2. This study enhances the theoretical framework for mental health in the hospitality industry by separating mental health issues into specific domains, including depression, nervousness, and loss of peace of mind. 3. This conceptual study can help understand the new holistic research landscape of mental health and well-being. 4. The integrated bibliometric, network, and content analysis methodology provided a comprehensive analysis of the intellectual structure and development of this literature. 5. They add to the body of knowledge in the positive psychology literature by examining the relationship between different types of bullying behaviors and their distinct psychological impacts on employees’ well-being. 6. The findings have significant implications for theories of anti-corporate sentiment, particularly in understanding the psychological mechanisms that drive employees towards anti-corporate behavior. 7. The finding that verbal offense and discriminatory treatment are significant contributors to feelings of loneliness among hotel employees underscores the need for hotel management to integrate strict anti-bullying policies with intervention mechanisms against workplace loneliness.

15500322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500322.value: 风险投资人（风投）和创业者之间的合作是创新、就业和经济增长的重要引擎。在过去的四十年里，研究人员记录了风险投资或创业者如何使用合理的标准来寻找潜在的合作者。尽管如此，人们对他们的社交互动如何影响投资合作知之甚少。这是很遗憾的，因为研究人员和从业者都认识到，由于投资高度不确定和复杂，合作通常是通过增强沟通和建立信任的过程来是实现的，而这个过程是相当主观且互动的。与此同时，无论是风投还是创业者，都越来越多地使用 Twitter 等社交媒体进行互动，但这种看似随意的在线互动能否转化为正式的投资关系，却鲜为人知。因此，我们的研究将检验风投和创业者在社交媒体上的互动是否以及何时可以预测他们的投资合作。 整合来自创业融资、战略沟通、社交媒体和数字足迹文献的见解，我们的研究将引入一个新的心理构念-投缘默契，以捕捉风险投资人和创业者之间的相互吸引及和谐互动。首先，我们预测，当双方表现出共同的兴趣，积极回应对方，以相似的方式进行交流，并在社交媒体上同步讨论相似的话题时，风投和创业者更有可能形成投资合作。其次，当风投和创业者二人的物理或者社会距离较遥远时，社交媒体上的投缘默契对投资合作更有效。 我们计划使用大数据和机器学习方法来检验我们的假设。我们将首先使用 Pitchbook 数据库建立一个美国风投和创业者（2008-2021）数据库。然后，我们将在 Twitter 风投和创业者的数字足迹，并使用语言分析工具和主题建模算法构建投缘默契的指标。 我们的研究将推进创业融资和战略沟通研究。从理论上讲，我们用心理学的互动视角来补充经济学的理性决策视角，以理解风险投资人和创业者的投资合作。在方法论上，我们引入大数据和机器学习方法来研究创业融资背景下投缘默契的心理构念。在实践上，我们就社交媒体是否可以促进投资合作向风险资本家和企业家提供基于证据的建议。

15500522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500522.value: 卖空者获取信息渠道：來自《信息自由法案》的證據

15500522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500522.value: 卖空者是资本市场中重要參與者，對提高价格效率，发现不利的公司事件和纠正股票高估起到重要作用。 然而，卖空者如何以及在何处获得信息优势的问题仍不清楚。 在这项研究中，我们提出了一个卖空者获取信息的特定渠道优势：在美国《信息自由法案》（FIOA）保護下，通过向证券交易委员会（SEC）提交请求获取私有信息。SEC 公布了上市公司大量的财务信息以及其它披露信息，以允许公众访问。但是，有些文件，如 SEC 的调查，以及有獲取保密处理的公司重大合同不会在网上与公众共享。任何个人或组织可以通过向 SEC 提交 FOIA 请求来访问这些记录。证监会可能 要么批准FIOA请求并将 SEC 文件发布给请求者，要么引用某些豁免条件拒绝请求。 因此，我们有可能查看到卖空者是否通过向 SEC提出的 FOIA 请求进行私有信息获取。 由于我们不观察卖空者的身份，因此我们不能直接识别卖空者提交的 FOIA 请求。如果卖空者使用 FOIA 请求而获取私有信息，我们预计空头头寸的数量与通過FIOA获取私有信息的申請或者拒绝的频率呈正相关。 作为更直接的测试，我们测试做空报告所针对的股票以及通過FIOA申請或者拒绝的頻率。 通过 FOIA 获取私有信息不是无成本的，因此，我们接下来检查短期利润是否补偿了昂贵的努力 - 通过测试未来股票收益是否有隨FOIA 请求的批准和拒绝 频率而变化。最后，考虑到带有私有信息的做空报告会导致更大的价格下跌，我们测试了做空报告发布前后的异常收益是否隨报告包含通过 FOIA 请求获得的信息时，负面影响更大。

15500922.label: Project Objectives
15500922.value: To investigate how firms in competitive markets should tailor pricing strategies and follow trajectories to set prices over time to suit with the existence and scale of time-inconsistent behavior of consumers when making purchasing decisions. To investigate firms’ optimal product design, by building features that require consumers to exert learning efforts before enjoying enhanced benefits, and optimal selling mode as consumers exhibit time-inconsistent purchase behavior.

15500922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500922.value: Consumers weigh intertemporally discounted utilities to make purchase decisions. A widely used discounting scheme is exponential discounting, whereby consumers form rational expectations about future costs and payoffs, and their perceptions and preferences remain unchanged over time. However, empirical studies and experiments have indicated that exponential discounting is not applicable when people weigh the immediate future more heavily than the further future, which is quite prevalent in reality. Economics literature has proposed and verified the validity of hyperbolic discounting to capture this behavior. Under this scheme, consumers are likely to make time-inconsistent purchase choices when they ignore the time difference between incurring costs and receiving consumption payoff in the future. Specifically, consumers may irrationally postpone purchases, and, after the future arrives, change their minds on the products to purchase or even leave without purchasing. This is particularly prominent in the industries which sell investment, information, and innovative products, where consumers have to incur costs and exert efforts before receiving consumption benefit. We propose a study of the impact of consumers’ time-inconsistency on firms’ strategy adaptions. The main issues of academic importance and practical relevance are as follows. How should firms in competitive markets tailor pricing and product design to the existence and magnitude of consumers’ time-inconsistency? To what extent does this consumer behavior influence firms’ performance? What are the implications for consumers and social welfare? Premised on certain discounting functions to capture consumers’ time-inconsistency, detailed answers to these issues generate concrete insights into real phenomena and offer guidance for competing firms to adapt strategies to fit realistic consumer behavior. Given the prevalence of time-inconsistency in today’s market, the results of the proposed study can guide firms to adopt effective operations strategies to improve profit performance. In the meanwhile, they can advise policymakers on the value of educating consumers to maintain consistency in purchasing alongside valid means to regulate firms’ activities, to enhance efficiency and improve social welfare. While the proposed study focuses on pricing and product design to initiate the investigation into time-inconsistency, the framework leaves much room to embed more practical features and look into additional issues. The findings stemming from this research are hopeful to complement existing knowledge premised on time-consistent consumer behavior and shed novel light on industry practices. These are important for Hong Kong to maintain its competitiveness in the region, given the critical role played by investment, information and innovative industries in its economy. 消費者基於權衡經時間折扣的效用做出購買決定。在研究中被廣泛使用的折扣方案是指數折扣。在這種折扣方式下，消費者對未來的成本和收益做理性預期，他們的認知和偏好不受時間推移的影響。然而，實證研究和實驗發現，當人們，相對於未來的收益和成本而言，更重視近期發生的收益和成本時，指數折扣不適用。經濟學文獻提出並驗證了雙曲線折扣模型研究這種行為。在這種折扣方式下，當消費者忽略未來發生的成本和獲得回報之間的時間差時，他們很可能會做出時間不一致的購買選擇。具體來說，消費者可能會非理性地推遲購買，但是當未來到來後，改變原來購買產品的打算，甚至不購買就離開。這個現象在投資、信息和創新產品的行業尤為突出。這是因為，在這些行業中，消費者必須付出成本和努力才能獲得消費收益。 本項目中，我們研究企業如何通過調整戰略，以應對消費者時間不一致的購買行為。具有學術價值和實際意義的主要研究問題如下：競爭市場中的企業，應如何針對消費者時間不一致的購買行為的存在及其程度，來調整定價和產品設計？這種消費者行為在多大程度上影響企業的業績？對消費者和社會福利又有何影響？我們利用構建合理的折扣函數，對消費者的時間不一致性建模，對上述這些問題做詳細回答，對實際現像做出具體解釋，並為競爭企業調整策略以適應現實消費者行為提供實質性的指導。鑑於當今市場普遍存在時間不一致的情況，本項目研究的結果，可以指導公司採用有效的運營策略以提高利潤。同時，可以就引導消費者保持購買行為的一致性，以及規範企業行為、提高效率和改善社會福利，提供政策建議。擬議的研究雖然側重於定價和產品設計，但是其研究框架為嵌入更多的實際元素和研究相關問題留下了很大的空間。這項研究的結果，預計會對現有研究中基於時間一致的消費者行為的結論，有較大的補充，並為行業實踐提供新的啟示。鑑於投資、信息和創新產業在香港經濟中扮演的關鍵角色，本研究對香港保持其在區內的競爭力，有重要的意義。

15501022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501022.value: Abating carbon emissions is a research focus in the literature on sustainable operations. Goal setting is a vital part of a firm’s environmental management strategy formulation process. However, the literature provides limited understanding on whether goal setting can be a significant driver motivating firms to abate carbon emissions. The carbon neutrality goal setting of firms provides a suitable context to address this literature gap. The climate change agenda has received substantial attentions in recent years. The setting of national goals of achieving carbon neutrality has exerted pressure on the private sector to reduce carbon emissions. Recently, firms have announced corporate-level carbon neutrality goals to demonstrate their commitment. However, there are public concerns that such announcements are just greenwashing, and will only lead to a trivial improvement in environmental performance. The above theoretical and practical motivations lead this project to investigate the research question: Does a firm’s carbon neutrality goal setting improve its environmental performance? This project will adopt a natural experiment design and use firm’s environmental expenditure and greenhouse gas emission to measure environmental performance. This project aims to provide evidence of an abnormal environmental performance change after the firms’ carbon neutrality goal were set. This project will further explore the factors that may amplify the motivation effect of carbon neutrality goal setting. Specifically, this project will investigate the research question: In which circumstances does carbon neutrality goal setting have a greater positive impact on a firm’s environmental performance? Drawing from the lens of the goal setting theory, this project proposes that specific and ambitious goals can be more effective. In addition, firms with a higher managerial self-efficacy and environmental innovation capability can better improve environmental performance after the goal set. This project seeks to provide both significant theoretical contributions and practical implications. This project is the first academic research effort to investigate whether carbon neutrality goal setting can affect firm environmental performance. The expected outcome can advance the understanding of the antecedents of firm’s environmental performance from a fresh goal setting perspective. This project will also advance the understanding of the goal setting driving sustainable operations. Practically, this project will provide guidance for firms to take advantage of carbon neutrality goal setting to motivate themselves toward sustainability. 15501022.label: Realisation of objectives
15501022.value: Objective 1:To examine the impact of carbon neutrality goal setting on the firm’s environmental performance. To examine whether corporate carbon neutrality goals are merely symbolic or lead to substantive environmental improvements, we constructed a panel of 212 U.S.–listed manufacturing firms that publicly announced their first carbon neutrality goals between 2002 and 2022, matched to a control group of non announcing firms using propensity score matching. Firm year data on Scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse gas emissions (scaled by revenue) were obtained primarily from Bloomberg ESG. Using a difference in differences (DID) design with firm and year fixed effects, we compared emission trajectories over a three year window before and after goal setting. The analysis shows that announcing a carbon neutrality goal is associated, on average, with a 16.6% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emission intensity relative to the matched control firms, indicating meaningful improvements in internal operations and purchased energy use. This provides direct evidence for a “motivation effect” of goal setting on core environmental performance, consistent with goal setting theory in an operations management context. However, the same firms exhibit an average 24.9% increase in Scope 3 emission intensity after goal setting, and an estimated 18.3% increase in total emissions (Scopes 1–3) relative to the counterfactual. Additional analyses based on emission ratios confirm that the share of Scope 3 emissions in total emissions rises significantly while the share of Scopes 1–2 falls, consistent with a reallocation of emissions from internal operations to supply chain partners. Mechanism tests based on changes in property, plant and equipment (PP&E) further suggest increased reliance on outsourcing after goal announcements, reinforcing the carbon leakage interpretation. Taken together, these results indicate that corporate carbon neutrality goals do motivate firms to reduce operational emissions, but they can simultaneously induce supply chain carbon leakage that offsets or even reverses net environmental gains. This directly addresses Objective 1 by quantifying abnormal changes in environmental performance following goal setting, and by revealing that the “motivation effect” is scope specific rather than uniformly positive. While Objective 1 focused on environmental performance, the project also examined short term financial consequences as an important dimension of “performance” that conditions firms’ willingness to pursue aggressive environmental goals. The JBR paper employs an event study design on 146 pairs of U.S.-listed manufacturing firms with and without carbon neutrality goal announcements. The results show that stock markets react negatively to carbon neutrality goal announcements, and that this negative reaction is stronger when the goal is more ambitious (i.e., when the target year is earlier). These results highlight a tension: while our study shows operational emission improvements, investors initially penalise firms for taking on ambitious carbon neutrality commitments, likely due to concerns about the costs of implementation. This provides an important complement to the environmental performance evidence and confirms that carbon neutrality goal setting has real (and sometimes conflicting) implications across both environmental and financial dimensions. Overall, Objective 1 has been achieved. The project delivers rigorous, multi method evidence that corporate carbon neutrality goal setting leads to significant changes in environmental performance within firms and along their supply chains, and that these changes coexist with non trivial financial consequences. Objective 2: To explore the factors that may amplify the motivation effect of carbon neutrality goal setting on a firm’s improvement in environmental performance. Objective 2 aimed to identify organisational and contextual factors—relating to goal content, senior management and firm capabilities—that amplify the positive effects of carbon neutrality goals on environmental performance. This objective has been addressed across all three papers, with the study providing the main evidence on operational and supply chain capabilities. In the analysis, we examine three moderators that capture the strength of a firm’s external resource control over its supply chain: vertical integration, environmental supplier selection and supplier development. The DID models include interaction terms between the goal setting indicator and each moderator. The results show that: • Vertical integration significantly weakens the increase in Scope 3 emissions associated with goal setting. Moving one standard deviation above the mean in vertical integration attenuates the Scope 3 increase by about 36%. • Using environmental criteria in supplier selection reduces the positive effect of goal setting on Scope 3 emissions by around 80%. • Stronger supplier development practices (e.g., training, joint projects) reduce the Scope 3 increase by roughly 77%. These findings identify concrete operational levers through which firms can translate carbon neutrality goals into genuine supply chain decarbonisation rather than carbon outsourcing. They correspond directly to the “firm capability” aspect of Objective 2 and demonstrate how external resource control amplifies (or, in this case, salvages) the motivation effect of goal setting. Our additional analyses provides complementary evidence on governance mechanisms. At the supply chain level, sustainable supplier management by the MNE buyer strengthens the effect of the pledge on suppliers’ decarbonisation investment and reduces the degree of reporting–investment decoupling. At the corporate governance level, a higher number of green institutional investors in supplier firms increases the impact of the MNE pledge on suppliers’ decarbonisation investments and attenuates decoupling. These results reinforce the conclusion that goal setting is more likely to induce substantive action when supported by appropriate governance and capability conditions. In summary, Objective 2 has also been achieved. Across the studies, we identify a consistent set of conditioning factors—supply chain control, sustainable supplier management, green institutional investors—that determine whether carbon neutrality goals translate into real environmental improvements or remain symbolic.

15501022.label: Major findings and research outcome
15501022.value: This project set out to understand whether corporate carbon neutrality goal setting leads to genuine environmental improvement, and under what conditions such goals work rather than backfire. Across three empirical studies, we assembled large matched samples of U.S.-listed manufacturers and their international suppliers and used quasi experimental designs (event study, propensity score matching, and difference in differences). Focusing on environmental performance, our study shows that after announcing carbon neutrality goals, treated firms reduce their direct (Scopes 1 and 2) emissions by about 16.6% relative to matched controls, indicating that goal setting does motivate internal carbon reduction efforts. However, the same firms’ supply chain (Scope 3) emissions increase by roughly 24.9%, revealing substantial supply chain carbon leakage. In other words, firms partly “clean up” their own operations by shifting emissions upstream to suppliers. Our further analysis extends this leakage and decoupling logic to cross border supply chains. Using U.S. MNEs and their Chinese suppliers, it finds that buyers’ carbon neutrality pledges increase suppliers’ carbon emission reporting by about 32% but do not significantly raise actual decarbonisation investment, resulting in a 14.9% rise in reporting–investment decoupling. Regarding factors that shape the effects of goal setting, we find that firms with stronger supply chain control—via higher vertical integration, systematic sustainable supplier selection, and supplier development—can substantially curb Scope 3 leakage and achieve more genuine, system wide reductions. Another study complements this by showing that the stock market, on average, reacts negatively to carbon neutrality announcements, especially when goals are more ambitious; yet the negative reaction is mitigated when firms exhibit high operational efficiency, retain flexibility to use offsets, and have strong prior momentum in emissions reduction. Taken together, the project demonstrates that carbon neutrality goal setting and pledges do change behaviour and emissions, but they also create risks of value loss, leakage, and greenwashing. These outcomes depend crucially on goal ambitiousness, internal capabilities, and supply chain governance, thereby achieving both original objectives on performance effects and moderating factors.

15501022.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15501022.value: The findings open several promising avenues. First, the current analyses focus on listed firms in the U.S. and suppliers in China. Future work can extend the matched sample and DID designs to other sectors and institutional contexts (e.g. EU, emerging markets with stricter carbon laws) to examine how regulation and policy mixes alter the balance between genuine reductions and leakage/decoupling. Second, our data capture realised emissions and investments but not the micro processes behind target setting, internal negotiations, and supplier interactions. Building on these results, we plan qualitative case studies and surveys with sustainability and operations managers to unpack how goal ambitiousness, board/senior management self efficacy, and environmental innovation capabilities shape implementation choices.

15501022.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15501022.value: Many big companies now promise to be “carbon neutral” by 2040 or 2050. These promises sound good, but we still need to know: Do they really cut emissions, or just move them somewhere else? And how do investors and suppliers react? Using large datasets of listed firms and their suppliers, this project tracks what happens before and after companies announce carbon neutrality goals. We find that firms usually do reduce emissions inside their own factories and offices, but at the same time emissions from their suppliers often go up. Similarly, when multinational buyers pledge carbon neutrality, their suppliers improve carbon reporting but do not always invest enough in real emission cutting projects, creating a gap between “talk” and “action”. We also show that investors can worry about ambitious carbon neutrality goals, unless firms demonstrate strong efficiency and credible green capabilities. Finally, the research highlights ways to make carbon neutrality promises more trustworthy—such as tighter control of key supply chain stages, sustainable supplier selection and development, and the involvement of green minded investors.

15501522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501522.value: 本研究針對社會方面的可持續性研究，重點關注公司的多樣性、公平和包容性 (DEI) 公開承諾是否對公司的營運有影響。證券交易所的 DEI 法規要求上市公司在未來 2 至 3 年內遵守社會包容和董事會多元化目標。因此，它提供了一個理想的研究背景，可以針對 DEI 政策如何在自願和強制階段影響企業經營績效進行自然實驗。目前，上市公司的DEI承諾是自願的，因此董事會改善多元化的進展非常緩慢。 我們將調查所有在香港、中國大陸和海外（即美國、英國）上市的中國公司。通過制度理論的視角，DEI 承諾與企業績效的關係，並對相應股票市場的DEI規範和強制力量的正向調節，因為一些股票市場對 DEI 有更高的期望，而另一些則沒有。 這項研究針對董事會多元化和公司績效文獻開展。我們將每個樣本公司（具有 DEI 承諾）與控制公司進行匹配。然後，我們將使用事件研究分析來衡量 DEI 承諾的異常運營績效。我們旨在揭示 DEI 承諾與公司運營績效之間的因果關係，以及規範和強制壓力如何與這種關係產生相互作用。 本研究為公司製定 DEI 戰略提供了管理啟示。它還為金融監管機構（例如香港證券及期貨事務監察委員會）提供政策啟示，以促進香港和中國公司對 DEI的承諾。

15501522.label: Realisation of objectives
15501522.value: This project set out to examine the operational and performance implications of firms’ commitments to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI), with particular attention to the role of institutional pressures and the formulation of effective DEI strategies. Over the course of the project, the research design was refined to ensure rigorous identification, contextual relevance, and meaningful contribution to the operations management literature. Overall, the project has substantially achieved all stated objectives, while generating additional cross-country insights beyond the original scope. Objective 1 To investigate how DEI commitment could improve firms’ long-term operational performance. Extent of achievement. The original objective focused on long-term operational performance. During the project, the research team identified that a necessary first step is to establish whether and how DEI commitments are valued by capital markets, which aggregate investors’ forward-looking expectations about firms’ future operational and strategic outcomes. Accordingly, the project adopted an event study approach to capture investors’ immediate assessment of the expected long-term operational implications of DEI commitments at the time of disclosure. The project achieved this objective by quantifying market reactions to DEI commitment announcements in both China (Taiwan) and the United States. The results show a clear contextual divergence. In China (Taiwan), DEI announcements are associated with significantly negative short-run abnormal stock returns, suggesting that investors tend to interpret such commitments as costly, execution-intensive, or primarily compliance-driven. By contrast, in the United States, DEI commitment announcements generate significantly positive abnormal returns, indicating that investors perceive DEI commitments as credible signals of superior management quality, organizational capability, and long-term value creation. Together, these findings demonstrate that the expected long-term operational value of DEI is not universal, but instead depends critically on institutional context. The market-based evidence provides a rigorous, theory-consistent proxy for how investors assess the anticipated operational consequences of DEI commitments. Objective 2 To investigate how institutional pressures moderate the impact of DEI commitment on firms’ operations. Extent of achievement. This objective was fully achieved through a comparative, institutionally grounded research design. The project examines DEI commitments made by publicly listed firms in China (Taiwan), where DEI is emerging under multiple and sometimes competing institutional pressures, including domestic stock exchange ESG disclosure guidelines and external normative pressures from international capital markets, particularly US institutional investors and global supply chains. Empirically, the project shows that in China (Taiwan), stronger DEI disclosure signals amplify negative market reactions, while governance characteristics—such as board age and educational attainment—systematically moderate investor responses. In contrast, analysis of the US dataset reveals that stronger and more specific DEI signals amplify positive market reactions, consistent with DEI being more deeply institutionalized and normatively valued in the US market. These results provide direct evidence that institutional environments fundamentally shape how DEI commitments are interpreted and priced. Objective 3 To help firms formulate better DEI strategies that could maximize the long-term impact on firms’ operations. Extent of achievement. The project delivers clear, evidence-based guidance for firms designing DEI strategies. The findings indicate that DEI commitments are not automatically rewarded by markets and that their effectiveness depends on alignment with institutional context and governance capability. In markets such as the United States, where DEI norms are strongly institutionalized, credible and focused DEI disclosures are positively valued. In contrast, in China (Taiwan), firms face greater investor skepticism unless DEI commitments are supported by credible leadership and execution capacity. Additional outcomes and dissemination Beyond the original objectives, the project generated significant scholarly and training outcomes. The US-based analysis, which documents positive market reactions to DEI commitment announcements, has been published in Production and Operations Management. The comparative findings, including evidence from China (Taiwan), were presented at the 2023 INFORMS Annual Meeting by PhD student Li Fei, who was recruited and supported under this GRF funding. This demonstrates both strong academic impact and effective doctoral training. The comparative findings is under preparation for another manuscript for top-tier journal, such as Journal of Operations Management, Journal of International Business Studies Overall assessment Taken together, the project has substantially achieved its original objectives, while refining the research design to account for institutional heterogeneity. The contrasting evidence from China (Taiwan) and the United States highlights the context-dependent nature of DEI valuation and provides a strong foundation for future research on realized long-term operational outcomes.

15501522.label: Major findings and research outcome
15501522.value: This project examines how capital markets interpret firms’ public commitments to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI), with particular attention to the informational role of DEI announcements and the institutional conditions under which such commitments are perceived as value-enhancing or value-reducing. Grounded in signaling theory, upper echelon theory, and institutional theory, the study analyzes how DEI disclosure content, signal characteristics, and top management team attributes shape investor responses in a non-Western market context. The empirical analysis is based on a comprehensive collection of DEI-related disclosures by publicly listed firms in China (Taiwan). During the research period, firms listed on the Hong Kong and Mainland China stock exchanges did not make comparable DEI commitments. Using WisersOne, the project retrieved several hundred announcements, press releases, and news items issued between 2020 and 2024 that referenced DEI-related concepts. DEI disclosures by firms listed in China (Taiwan) are made under multiple layers of institutional pressure. Domestically, stock exchange regulations and ESG-related disclosure guidelines increasingly encourage firms to address workforce diversity, equality, and inclusion as part of sustainability reporting. Externally, many firms face normative and mimetic pressures from international capital markets, particularly from US institutional investors, global customers, and cross-border supply chains, where DEI norms are more deeply institutionalized. Consequently, DEI announcements in this setting often represent strategic responses to competing institutional logics, rather than purely intrinsic operational priorities. From the large initial corpus, the study applied a rigorous multi-stage screening process consistent with best practices in event-study research to isolate clean DEI commitment events. After excluding overlapping announcements, confounding corporate events, and firms with insufficient trading history, the final sample comprises 107 high-quality DEI commitment announcements. The event study results show that DEI commitment announcements are associated with significantly negative short-run market reactions in China (Taiwan). Stronger DEI signals amplify this negative response, while signal specificity does not significantly mitigate it. Governance characteristics further condition these effects: firms with older boards experience more adverse reactions, whereas higher educational attainment among directors attenuates the market penalty. This project also analyzed a large-scale US dataset, published in Production and Operations Management, which shows positive market reactions to DEI commitments. This contrast highlights the context-dependent valuation of DEI and the central role of institutional environments in shaping how DEI is priced by capital markets. The findings were disseminated through peer-reviewed publication (i.e., POM) and presented at the 2024 INFORMS Annual Meeting.

15501522.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15501522.value: This research can be further developed by exploiting emerging exogenous shocks and by consolidating the rapidly expanding literature on DEI in operations management. First, recent and anticipated regulatory and policy shifts affecting DEI-related initiatives in the United States following the re-election of Donald Trump provide a unique quasi-natural experiment. These policy changes generate sharp variation in firms’ incentives, disclosure practices, and implementation of DEI initiatives. Future research can leverage this setting using difference-in-differences or event-study designs to examine how changes in political and regulatory pressure alter firms’ DEI communications, operational decisions, and market valuations, both within the US and in comparison with firms operating in other institutional environments. Second, the project will be extended through the development of a systematic literature review of DEI research in operations management. This review will synthesize empirical and theoretical studies, clarify how DEI has been conceptualized and measured across OM contexts, and identify gaps related to operations, supply chains, workforce management, and performance outcomes. By mapping dominant theories, methods, and findings, the review will provide an integrative framework to guide future DEI research and support cumulative knowledge development in this emerging area.

15501522.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15501522.value: This research studies how investors react when companies publicly announce commitments to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). While DEI is widely discussed as a positive social goal, it is less clear how financial markets view such commitments as offering a positive impact. Using a large collection of company announcements and news reports, the project examined stock market reactions to DEI commitments made by listed firms in China (Taiwan) and compared them with firms in the United States. The findings show clear differences across markets. In the United States, investors generally respond positively to DEI announcements, suggesting that DEI is viewed as a sign of good management and long-term value. In contrast, in China (Taiwan), investors tend to react negatively in the short run, likely because they worry about implementation costs, managerial burden, or whether such initiatives are driven more by external pressure than by business needs. The study also finds that leadership matters: firms with more capable and better-educated boards face less investor concern when announcing DEI commitments. Overall, the research highlights that DEI is not valued in the same way everywhere and that companies need to consider local market expectations when designing and communicating DEI strategies.

15501822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15501822.value: 註意力經濟中通過人工智能挖掘視覺化社交媒體內容的商業價值

15501822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501822.value: The rise of visual social media is transforming visual stimulus into the primary rhetorical tool for social media influencers (SMIs) to vie for viewers’ attention. Although contemporary literature has shed light on the role of SMIs’ personal characteristics in shaping viewer engagement, we remain in the dark about how viewers are attracted and mobilized by SMIs’ actual content. This project attempts to address this knowledge gap by uncovering the attention-grabbing benefits of visual stimuli embedded in SMIs’ visual content. Visual attention is involved in every step of human decision-making because it selects, modulates, and sustains focus on information that is most relevant for behavior. However, few studies have investigated how attention affects the individual’s behavior in digital contexts. This project will draw upon the theory of visual attention to identify prominent visual stimuli embedded in SMIs’ content that can direct viewers’ bottom-up and top-down attention and to investigate the role of these stimuli in driving viewer engagement. Spurred by recent advances of artificial intelligence (AI) in computer vision, this project will explore the viability of employing AI to mimic and reconstruct viewers’ bottom-up and top-down attention elicited by visual stimuli. Key AI techniques such as convolutional neural network, visual representation learning, and attention mechanisms will be applied to analyze 5,487,350 posts created by 9,442 SMIs on Instagram. The effects of attention-grabbing visual stimuli on viewers’ levels of engagement (i.e., like, comment, and follow) will be examined at the individual and collective levels. At the individual level, this project will conduct an eye-tracking experiment to investigate how participants’ attention can be captured by attention-grabbing visual stimuli and how the orienting of attention drives their engagement intentions. At the collective level, econometric analyses will be employed to test the effects of visual stimuli with different attention-grabbing properties on SMIs’ performance in attracting likes, comments, and new followers. This project will be among the early research endeavors to investigate the attention-grabbing effects of visual social media content. It will contribute to the literature on social media by providing a novel theoretical explanation for why certain visual content can attract viewers’ attention and influence their engagements. It will also contribute to the general information systems literature by establishing AI as a novel method for comprehending visual-based interactions. Findings derived from this project are expected to guide SMIs in optimizing their visual content to best capture viewers’ attention and corner the market in the attention economy. 視覺化社交媒體的興起正在將視覺刺激轉變為社交媒體影響者 (SMI) 爭奪觀眾注意力的主要工具。儘管現有文獻已經闡明了 SMI 的個人特徵在影響用戶參與度方面的作用，我們對 SMI 如何通過實際內容吸引和動員用戶的認識仍有所欠缺。該項目試圖通過揭示嵌入在 SMI 視覺內容中的視覺刺激的引人注目的好處來解決這一知識差距。 視覺注意力涉及人類決策的每一步，因為它選擇、調節和保持對與行為最相關的信息的關注。然而，很少有研究調查注意力如何影響個人在數字環境中的行為。該項目將利用視覺注意理論來識別嵌入在 SMI 內容中的突出視覺刺激，這些刺激可以引導觀眾自下而上和自上而下的注意力，並研究這些刺激在推動觀眾參與中的作用。 在計算機視覺領域中人工智能 (AI) 最新進展的推動下，該項目將探索如何利用AI來模仿和重建觀眾由視覺刺激引起的自下而上和自上而下的注意力。卷積神經網絡、視覺表徵學習和注意力機制等關鍵 AI 技術將用於分析 Instagram 上 9,442 個 SMI 創建的 5,487,350 個帖子。將在個人和集體層面檢查引人注目的視覺刺激對觀眾參與度（即喜歡、評論和關注）的影響。在個人層面，該項目將進行眼動追踪實驗，以研究參與者的注意力如何通過引人注目的視覺刺激來捕捉，以及注意力的定向如何驅動他們的參與意圖。在集體層面，將採用計量經濟學分析來測試具有不同引人注目特性的視覺刺激對 SMI 在吸引喜歡、評論和新追隨者方面的表現的影響。 該項目將是研究視覺社交媒體內容吸引註意力的早期研究工作之一。它將通過提供新的理論來解釋為什麼某些視覺內容可以吸引觀眾的注意力並影響他們的參與，從而為社交媒體文獻做出貢獻。它還將通過將 AI 確立為理解基於視覺的交互的新方法，為一般信息系統文獻做出貢獻。該項目的調查結果有望指導 SMI 評估和調整其視覺內容，以最好地吸引觀眾的注意力並最大限度地發揮預期效果。

15502422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502422.value: 中國物流業受到的環境監管相比於製造業較少。為了中國的經濟增長，物流業在污染控制方面的要求相對寬鬆，這導致物流服務供應商在自願而非強制的基礎上採取綠色實踐。近年來的新冠大流行促進了線上交易的發展，貨運業務出現了增長。又由於中國在第14個五年計劃中重點提出碳中和，許多中國的物流服務供應商都面臨著需要減輕污染的壓力。但是，人們對中國物流業採用綠色實踐的種類、特性、程度和績效價值等瞭解不足。此外，中國的物流服務供應商不確定如何、何時以及為什麼綠色實踐（通過以環境可持續的方式處理和運輸貨物）會提高企業績效。因為物流行業在造成氣候變化方面普遍被忽視，但在減少污染和保護資源方面卻有著巨大的運營規模和範圍，這項研究將有助於瞭解中國物流業的綠色實踐。此外，目前缺少對物流業環境保護方面的研究來支援中國政府宣佈的環境目標（如2030年的碳排放峰值），所以這也突出了本研究的意義所在。本專案將採用多種方式方法來揭示中國物流業的以下問題：1）什麼是綠色實踐和應該採用哪些綠色實踐；2）這些綠色實踐在行為和技術特徵方面的性質是什麼；3）如何、何時以及為什麼採用這些綠色實踐可以提高企業績效；4）為什麼綠色實踐在中國大型物流企業與小型物流企業以及不同的物流子行業中被採用或不被採用的種類和程度不同。這項研究將填補物流業採用綠色實踐和其績效方面的研究空白。它還將為中國物流業改善綠色實踐及其績效價值，以及為其他國家規劃其綠色物流政策行動提供實踐和政策建議。

15502922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502922.value: Tourism has been one of the four pillar industries of the Hong Kong economy over the past decade. However, especially after the 2019-2020 Hong Kong protest, which led to decreased tourist arrivals by a third compared to the previous year, the tourism industry has been facing increasing challenges and competitions from Hong Kong’s neighbouring destinations in Asia. Furthermore, the Covid-19 pandemic has hit the global tourism industry including that in Hong Kong and other Asian countries badly. It is highly uncertain which destination’s tourism industry will recover and re-gain the regional competitiveness in Asia more quickly and strongly. Fierce regional competition can be expected in the post-Covid era. Meanwhile, Hong Kong and the neighbouring destinations are interdependent. In other words, tourism demand exhibits spatial spillover effects within the Asian region due to reasons such as multi-destination trips particularly by long-haul markets. Therefore, the complex interdependencies (i.e., competitive and complimentary relationships) of tourism demand among Asian destinations around Hong Kong indicate that a systematic approach is required to examine the interdependence of tourism demand for Hong Kong and its neighbouring destinations, through the measurement of spillover effects. This project will develop a state-of-the-art spatial econometric method which pools all destinations within a panel (i.e., an Asian tourism system) to measure direct, indirect and total spillover effects across destinations. As a methodological advancement, the global vector autoregressive (GVAR) model will be integrated into the spatial model to develop an innovative, cutting-edge Spatial GVAR model, which can further generate direct and indirect effects in response to shocks to certain destinations through impulse response analysis. The level of spillover effects of different destinations will be compared with Hong Kong in order to gain insights into Hong Kong’s tourism competitiveness relative to its competing neighbours in the system of Asia. Impulse response analysis will be conducted for policy simulations in the post-Covid era specifically to examine how potential economic shocks in the post-Covid era will affect the whole system and Hong Kong in particular. Such a comprehensive and rigorous analysis will provide important policy implications for relevant policymakers and the tourism industry in Hong Kong to respond effectively to possible fluctuations in economic situations in neighbouring destinations. This will allow Hong Kong’s tourism industry to recover from the pandemic more efficiently, maintain its regional competitive advantage and sustain its long-term healthy development and continuous contributions to the Hong Kong’s economy. 过去十年，旅游业一直是香港经济的四大支柱产业之一。然而，特别是在2019-2020年的香港抗议活动之后，游客人数比前一年减少了三分之一，从而导致旅游业一直面临着越来越多的挑战和来自亚洲邻近目的地的竞争。此外，新冠疫情的出现进一步打击了全球包括香港和亚洲其他地区的旅游业。在危机中，哪一个目的地的旅游业能更快、更有力地恢复并重新获得亚洲地区的竞争力，现在还很不确定。在后疫情时代，激烈的区域竞争是可以预见的。同时，香港和邻近的目的地是相互依存的。换句话说，由于一程多站旅行等原因,旅游需求在亚洲地区表现出空间上的溢出效应。因此，香港周边的亚洲旅游目的地之间复杂的相互依存关系（即竞争和互补关系）需要有一个系统的方法来研究。 本项目将开发一种最先进的空间计量经济学方法，将所有目的地汇集在一个面板中，用来衡量目的地之间的直接、间接和总溢出效应。在方法论革新的层面，GVAR模型将被整合到空间模型中，以开发一种创新的、前沿的空间 GVAR 模型。该模型可以通过脉冲响应进一步量化受到冲击后对于某些目的地的直接和间接效应。不同目的地的溢出效应水平将与香港进行比较，以了解香港相对于亚洲体系中竞争邻国的旅游竞争力。本项目还将针对后疫情时代的政策模拟进行脉冲响应分析，研究后疫情时代的潜在冲击将如何影响以香港为中心的整个系统。本项目全面而严谨的分析，将为相关决策者和香港旅游业有效应对邻近目的地经济形势可能出现的波动提供重要的政策启示，帮助香港旅游业更有效地从疫情中复苏，保持区域竞争优势，保持旅游业长期健康发展，从而持续为香港经济做出贡献。

15502922.label: Realisation of objectives
15502922.value: The objectives of this research have been substantially achieved. The study advanced the conceptualization of relative destination competitiveness by integrating interdependencies and spatial spillovers in tourism demand across Asia (Objective 3). This was operationalized through the development of sub-systems representing inbound arrivals to major Asian destinations from Hong Kong's principal source markets (including the United States, United Kingdom, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and New Zealand), enabling a market-specific analysis of competitive dynamics (Objective 2). Within this framework, the concepts of spill-in and spill-out were introduced to capture the bidirectional nature of spatial spillovers, offering a refined interpretation of interdependency mechanisms. The empirical estimation of these effects was facilitated by methodological innovations in spatial econometric modelling with a broader definition of spillovers (Objective 1). Specifically, the research extended the Spatial approach to decompose aggregate spillover effects into pairwise interactions from each demand system (Objective 4), thereby elucidating Hong Kong’s relative position within the broader Asian competitiveness landscape. Given that the project commenced during the COVID-19 pandemic, an additional investigation was undertaken to examine hotel demand resilience through the lens of spatial interdependencies and temporal dynamics, consistent with the project’s focus on interdependency and spillovers. This analysis assessed how shocks propagated across destinations and evaluated Hong Kong's relative capacity for demand resistance and recovery within the Asian tourism network. By applying the same spatial econometric framework to hotel demand, the study provided empirical evidence on resilience patterns and competitive positioning during crisis periods, thereby generating actionable insights for strengthening Hong Kong's tourism sector under conditions of heightened uncertainty (Objective 5). To ensure long-term relevance, the study further conducted two sets of empirical estimations comparing pre-pandemic and post-pandemic competitiveness positions among Asian destinations. These simulations offer strategic guidance for sustaining Hong Kong's tourism competitiveness and reinforcing its contribution to the regional economy in the post-COVID era (Objective 5).

15502922.label: Major findings and research outcome
15502922.value: This project's principal contribution lies in the novel conceptualization of destination competitiveness through the lens of interdependency and spatial spillovers in tourism demand. This conceptual advancement was operationalized via an enhanced spatial econometric framework, incorporating methodological innovations that allow for more precise estimation and decomposition of spillover effects. Drawing on large-scale empirical estimations of Asian destination systems across Hong Kong's major source markets, the study identified the relative competitiveness of destinations both in the pre-pandemic period and during post-pandemic recovery. The proposed framework uniquely captures the dynamic and evolving relationships (i.e., both complementary and competitive) among destinations, accounts for source-market heterogeneity, and recognizes that competitiveness is not static but shifts over time, particularly in response to major disruptions such as COVID-19. Empirical results reveal that complementary relationships dominate over direct competition within the Asian tourism network, although these dynamics vary by source market and temporal context. The net spillover analysis further identified destinations such as the Philippines and Taiwan, China, as consistent beneficiaries of positive spillovers, particularly from long-haul markets, while others exhibit heightened price sensitivity or act as significant spillover generators. From a practical perspective, these findings have substantial implications for tourism management and policy. The source-market-specific spillover framework enables destinations to design targeted strategies, such as fostering collaboration with complementary neighbors through joint marketing initiatives, which is especially advantageous for smaller destinations in the post-pandemic era, and adopting nuanced pricing strategies to position against competitors. Moreover, the results underscore the necessity of dynamic monitoring of competitor actions and market fluctuations, particularly in highly interconnected and price-sensitive markets such as Hong Kong and Macau.

15502922.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15502922.value: Although this project focused on Hong Kong and Asia as the empirical context, the novel conceptualisation of destination competitiveness incorporating interdependence and spatial spillovers, and the generic and advanced spatial spillover econometric framework can both be generalised to analyse destination demand systems globally. Meanwhile, this project focuses on the spillover perspective from the demand side of destination competitiveness only. Future research could consider the integration of multiple perspectives to develop a more comprehensive framework for analysing destination competitiveness.

15502922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15502922.value: This project explored how tourism destinations in Asia, including Hong Kong, influence each other's visitor numbers and competitiveness. Instead of looking at destinations in isolation, we studied how changes in one country, such as economic growth, exchange rates, or recovery from COVID-19, can "spill over" to others. Using advanced statistical models, we mapped these interconnections and measured both positive and negative effects between destinations. Our findings show that Asian destinations are often more complementary than competitive, meaning that growth in one place can benefit others. For example, some destinations consistently gain from these spillovers, while others are more sensitive to price changes. We also examined how these relationships shifted during and after the pandemic, providing insights into resilience and recovery patterns. The practical value of this research is significant: it helps tourism boards and businesses design smarter strategies. Destinations can collaborate with complementary neighbors for joint promotions or adjust pricing to stay competitive. For Hong Kong, these insights support policies that strengthen its position in Asia's tourism network and ensure long-term economic benefits.

15503022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503022.value: Nowadays, many original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) (both start-ups and well-established firms) develop innovative products in-house and procure critical components from external suppliers. Owing to the long lead time for capacity building, the supplier often needs to make capacity investments in advance and relies on the demand information provided by the OEM to determine capacity. However, historical sales data that can help in inferring market demand are not available. Therefore, the OEM needs to acquire demand information through market testing and share the obtained results with the supplier. These motivate us to consider the following research questions: How should an OEM design a demand information acquisition strategy for its innovative product? Can an OEM utilize the strategic information acquisition to persuade the supplier to build more capacity in the OEM’s best interests and, if yes, under what conditions? How does an OEM’s pricing ability affect the OEM’s information acquisition strategy and the system performance? Our proposed research project will investigate these questions. Specifically, we aim to examine the effects of the OEM’s strategic demand information acquisition for its innovative product. We will consider a supply chain consisting of an OEM that is launching an innovative product and a critical component supplier. The OEM negotiates with the supplier over the wholesale price and commits to conduct a costly market testing to acquire demand information. Building on the game-theoretical framework of Bayesian persuasion with costly information acquisition, we will determine the OEM’s optimal demand information acquisition strategy, the supplier’s capacity investment and the optimal wholesale price. We will also consider a scenario in which the OEM does not perform strategic information acquisition. A comparison between the equilibrium outcomes with and without strategic information acquisition will help us identify conditions under which the OEM can utilize its strategic information acquisition to persuade the supplier to build more capacity in the OEM’s best interests. In the baseline model, we assume that the retail price is exogenously given. Next, we will extend our analysis to a situation where the retail price is endogenously determined by the OEM. We will re-examine the OEM’s optimal demand information acquisition strategy, the supplier’s capacity investment and the optimal wholesale price. We will then compare the equilibrium outcomes in this situation with those obtained when the retail price is exogenously given. The results will help us understand how the OEM’s pricing ability affects the equilibrium information acquisition strategy and the system performance. 许多原始设备制造商(包括初创企业和成熟公司）在内部进行创新产品开发但从外部供应商采购关键组件。由于产能建设需较长时间，许多原始设备制造商(包括初创企业和成熟公司）在内部进行创新产品开发但从外部供应商采购关键组件。由于产能建设需较长时间，供应商往往需要提前进行产能投资并依赖原始设备制造商提供的需求信息来确定产能。由于缺乏历史销售数据，原始设备制造商需要通过市场测试获取需求信息与供应商分享。这促使我们考虑以下研究问题：原始设备制造商应如何设计其创新产品的需求信息获取策略？原始设备制造商能否利用战略信息获取来说服供应商增加产能？如果可以，什么条件？原始设备制造商的定价如何影响其信息获取策略和系统表现？具体而言，我们旨在研究原始设备制造商对其创新产品的战略需求信息获取。我们将考虑一个由进行创新产品推出的原始设备制造商和关键组件供应商组成的供应链。原始设备制造商和供应商进行价格谈判并承诺进行市场测试以获取需求信息。通过有成本的信息获取进行贝叶斯说服博弈，我们将确定原始设备制造商的最佳需求信息获取策略、供应商的产能投资和价格。我们还将考虑原始设备制造商不执行战略信息获取的场景。比较采用和不采用战略信息获取的均衡结果将帮助我们确定原始设备制造商是否可以利用其战略信息获取来说服供应商提高产能。在基本模型中，我们假设价格是外生的。接下来，我们将扩展到价格是内生的。我们将重新审视原始设备制造商的最优需求信息获取策略、供应商的产能投资和价格。均衡结果的比较分析可以帮助我们了解原始设备制造商的定价能力如何影响均衡信息获取策略和系统表现。

15503222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503222.value: Packaging is a ubiquitous part of everyday life but has a very short lifecycle. Large volumes of packaging are disposed after one use and are unable to be recycled in existing recycling systems. As a result, packaging waste is a major contributor to total global waste, making up 30% of municipal solid waste and generating more than 82 million tons of waste annually, and is considered a major environmental challenge by the United Nations. The apparel industry in particular exacerbates the packaging waste problem with large-scale globalised sourcing, manufacturing, and delivery activities. Being the largest apparel production hub contributing over 39% of the world’s apparel market, Chinese apparel manufacturers move large volumes of raw material, apparel components, and finished garments globally, generating astronomical volumes of packaging waste in the process. To address the environmental impact of packaging waste, China is banning the single-use packaging nationwide in 2022, along with similar initiatives in other countries, sustainable packaging (SP) adoption is salient amongst the apparel manufacturers. However, many Chinese apparel manufacturers are hesitant to use SP. One key reason is the lack of understanding on its cost impacts when the cost of disposable packaging is comparatively low. Another reason is the lack of knowledge of the performance impacts of different scopes of adoption, which range from single-firm remedy (e.g., eco-friendly materials) to comprehensive remedy (e.g., system-wide coordination and infrastructure for recovery and recycling). The third reason is that manufacturers are uninformed on how they can effectively drive the buy-in of their supply chain partners to use SP, especially when these partners are important to support such practices as extending packaging lifecycle through recovery, recycling, and reuse. This study addresses the apprehensions around the financial and environmental values of SP by employing a multi-method research design that includes topic modeling with machine learning, event studies, and mass survey. The results will contribute to insights into the (i) characteristics and current context of the adoption of SP by apparel manufacturers, (ii) performance values of SP at different levels of adoption, (iii) effective governance mechanisms that drive the adoption of SP by drawing on transaction cost economics and institutional theories, and (iv) managerial and policy insights that would increase and encourage the widespread use of SP in the apparel manufacturing industry in China. 包裝是日常生活中無處不在的一部分，但生命週期很短。大量包裝在使用一次後被丟棄，無法在現有的回收系統中回收。因此，包裝垃圾是全球垃圾總量的主要來源，占城市固體垃圾的 30%，每年產生超過 8200 萬噸垃圾。包裝廢棄物是聯合國面臨的一項重大環境挑戰。 尤其是服裝行業，通過大規模的全球化採購、製造和交付活動加劇了包裝浪費問題。作為佔全球服裝市場 39% 以上的最大服裝生產中心，中國服裝製造商在全球範圍內運送大量原材料、服裝組件和成品服裝，在此過程中產生了數量驚人的包裝廢料。為了解決包裝廢棄物對環境的影響，中國將於 2022 年在全國范圍內禁止一次性包裝，以及其他國家的類似舉措，可持續包裝 (SP) 的採用在服裝製造商中非常重要。然而，許多中國服裝製造商對使用 SP 猶豫不決。一個關鍵原因是當一次性包裝的成本相對較低時，對其成本影響缺乏了解。另一個原因是缺乏對 SP 採用不同範圍的性能影響的了解，範圍從單一公司補救措施（例如，回收的內容材料）到綜合補救措施（例如，系統範圍內的協調和回收和再循環的基礎設施）。第三個原因是製造商不了解他們如何有效地推動其供應鏈合作夥伴購買使用 SP，尤其是當這些合作夥伴對於支持通過回收、再循環和再利用來延長包裝生命週期等實踐很重要時。本研究通過採用包括機器學習、事件研究和大規模調查的主題建模在內的多方法研究設計，解決了對 SP 的財務和環境價值的擔憂。結果將有助於深入了解 (i) 服裝製造商採用 SP 的特徵和當前背景，(ii) SP 在不同採用水平下的績效價值，以及 (iii) 將增加和鼓勵 SP 在中國服裝製造業廣泛使用的管理和政策見解。

15503222.label: Realisation of objectives
15503222.value: We have achieved the project objectives through identifying the existing SP of firms and the related factors in affecting their implementation. To achieve Objective 1 and 2, we conducted an extensive systematic, thematic, and qualitative content analysis on Fortune 100 companies to identify the key characteristics of sustainable packaging (SP). This project revealed the key characteristics of SP include materials and properties, management practices of SP, and packaging waste management. In addition, we identified corporate strategies in SP, including cost control, operations redesign, and stakeholder engagement for firms to reap financial and environmental performance. We also found that SP is useful for firms to attract customers. In the process of the study, we also revealed that green innovation as a key factor affecting the success of adopting new practices like SP. It is found that stakeholder collaboration with the support of government helps heighten the chance of success of green innovation. We generate managerial and policy insights about how SP can be strategized, with the support of stakeholders, to achieve desirable results. With these results, we have published and submitted the following papers: Lau, Cheuk In Cherry, Wong, C.W.Y. (2024) “Achieving sustainable development with sustainable packaging: A natural-resource-based view perspective,” Business Strategy and the Environment, Vol. 33, Issue 5, pp. 4766-4787 Lau, Cheuk In Cherry, Wong, C.W.Y. “Strategizing carbon emission management to enhance financial performance: The role of sustainability signaling through ESG score and sustainable packaging in stakeholder engagement,” Strategic Management Journal, submitted

15503222.label: Major findings and research outcome
15503222.value: We collected data from various sources in multiple studies and generate a number of findings. First, adoption of sustainable packaging (SP) demonstrates firms’ commitment in being environmentally responsible, improving firms’ financial performance. Second, engagement of stakeholders is important for firms to enhance performance by enabling firms to make strategic decisions. Third, firms may strategize the implementation of SP with the focus on operations redesign, stakeholder management, and green innovation capability. Fourth, SP serves as a sustainability signal to the market that moderates the relationship between carbon emission and performance. Specifically, SP is particularly useful to firms with low-carbon emission to further heighten it’s perceived environmental commitment by engaging customers and showcasing their efforts in reducing environmental impact.

15503322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503322.value: The online food delivery sector has grown rapidly since the emergence of COVID-19: it has offered informal employment and an economic lifeline for many individuals who have lost their jobs amid the pandemic (Baum et al., 2020). These circumstances echo Heylighen’s (2017) assertion that the novel employment structure of the gig economy could help society recover from economic downturns; the hospitality industry’s non-contract workforce has shown strong resilience in the face of crises, such as the Asian tsunami (Baum et al., 2020). Perspectives on the gig economy’s employment structure fall into two camps. The first criticizes the gig economy’s destruction of a well-developed employment system to exploit workers (e.g., Lamberton, 2018), while the second praises this economy for making conventional hospitality work more meaningful (Lin et al., 2020). The contradictory relationship between the employment structure of the gig economy and that of the conventional hospitality industry is well-documented (Rubery, Keizer, & Grimshaw, 2016); however, their potential cooperation remains overlooked. On one hand, the gig economy’s perceived appeal in terms of working conditions (e.g., flexibility, limited stress, and entrepreneurial meaning) may shed light on deep-seated human resource problems in conventional hospitality (e.g., low job satisfaction and high turnover). On the other, established job welfare practices and greater security in this industry may point to solutions to possible worker exploitation within the gig economy. The proposed study aims to investigate how these employment structures can be improved from the perspective of food delivery workers. Findings are expected to provide actionable recommendations for reducing the currently high unemployment rate in hospitality and for accelerating economic recovery in the post-pandemic era. This project follows a four-phase mixed-method approach. Phase 1 is inductive and seeks to delineate the nature of food delivery work in both the sharing economy and the conventional hospitality industry. Phase 2 includes in-depth interviews with 30 food delivery gig and conventional workers to understand their employment experiences. Phase 3, building upon Phases 1 and 2, presents an online survey (in questionnaire format) designed to explore the respective strengths/weaknesses of these two employment structures and the development of food delivery workers’ job embeddedness and well-being in the gig economy. Phase 4 applies a modified Delphi method to engage human resource experts and frame practical recommendations for policymakers and human resource managers regarding the planning and development of food delivery services in the gig economy. 自 COVID-19 出現以來，在線食品配送行業發展迅速：它為許多在大流行中失去工作的人提供了非正規就業和經濟生命線（Baum 等人，2020 年）。這些情況與 Heylighen (2017) 的斷言相呼應，即零工經濟的新型就業結構可以幫助社會從經濟衰退中復蘇；面對亞洲海嘯等危機，酒店業的非合同工勞動力表現出強大的韌性（Baum 等人，2020 年）。關於零工經濟就業結構的觀點分為兩個陣營。第一個批評零工經濟破壞了發達的就業系統以剝削工人（例如，Lamberton，2018 年），而第二個則讚揚這種經濟使傳統的酒店工作更有意義（Lin 等人，2020）。零工經濟的就業結構與傳統酒店業的就業結構之間的矛盾關係是有據可查的（Rubery、Keizer 和 Grimshaw，2016 年）；然而，他們的潛在合作仍然被忽視。一方面，零工經濟在工作條件方面的感知吸引力（例如，靈活性、有限的壓力和創業意義）可能會揭示傳統酒店業中根深蒂固的人力資源問題（例如，低工作滿意度和高流動率）。另一方面，該行業的既定工作福利實踐和更高的安全性可能會為零工經濟中可能的工人剝削提供解決方案。擬議的研究旨在從食品配送工人的角度調查如何改善這些就業結構。預計調查結果將為降低酒店業目前的高失業率和在大流行後時代加速經濟復甦提供可行的建議。該項目採用四階段混合方法。第一階段是歸納性的，旨在描述共享經濟和傳統酒店業中食品配送工作的性質。第 2 階段包括對 30 名送餐工作人員和傳統工人進行深入訪談，以了解他們的就業經歷。第 3 階段在第 1 階段和第 2 階段的基礎上進行了一項在線調查（以問卷形式），旨在探討這兩種就業結構各自的優勢/劣勢以及食品配送工人在零工經濟中的工作嵌入和幸福感的發展.第 4 階段採用改進的德爾菲法，讓人力資源專家參與進來，並為政策制定者和人力資源管理人員就零工經濟中食品配送服務的規劃和發展提出切實可行的建議。

15505522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505522.value: 扭轉旋轉門：從私人會計到公共會計的審計師“迴旋鏢”經驗的檢驗

15505522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15505522.value: Prof Li, Chan Prof Tsang, Albert Hiu-leong

15505522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505522.value: 由於對會計師的需求和他們擁有的專業技能，公共會計專業人士轉移到私營行業是很常見的。然而，這種趨勢有時會發生變化，因為許多從公共會計轉向公共會計的人在幾年後又回到了公共會計。 2015年，安永會計師事務所甚至表示，其經驗豐富的新員工中有30%是回到該領域的前員工。本研究旨在檢驗審計師是否以及如何從這種“迴旋鏢效應”中受益於他們的工作經驗。儘管審計師-客戶旋轉門的經驗在文獻中得到了廣泛的研究，但沒有經驗證據表明審計專業的反向移動，即審計師從私營企業轉移到註冊會計師事務所，尤其是這種迴旋鏢轉變。了解這個問題很重要，因為在私營行業的經驗使人在專業和精神上都做好了更好的準備，以應對作為公共會計師的挑戰，它也可能損害審計師的獨立性。因此，尚不清楚審計合夥人的反向過渡如何影響其審計質量。 具體來說，我們使用手工收集的審計合夥人經驗數據，調查審計合夥人的經驗是否會影響他們的績效，即審計質量。我們還將研究審計合夥人的迴旋鏢經驗是否以及如何影響他們所從事的特定行業的市場份額。 對審計師如何從他們的迴旋鏢行業經驗中獲益的調查有助於研究個別審計師的特徵如何影響審計結果的文獻。與以往研究審計合夥人在審計公司發展的行業專業知識的影響的文獻不同，我們關注審計師作為內部人員從以前在某些行業工作中獲得的行業知識。這項研究還增加了新興文獻，這些文獻調查了先前行業經驗對各種經濟主體的影響。

15506722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15506722.value: 疫情防控资源配置与产能投资优化

15506722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15506722.value: Epidemics have always been one of the major threats to human survival and development. The on-going COVID-19 pandemic has claimed more than 4.9 million lives and caused massive-scale lockdowns worldwide. To fight epidemics, we need a variety of consumable resources such as personal protective equipment (PPE), medicine for treatment, vaccine for immunization, and testing reagent for diagnosis. During the COVID-19 pandemic, many of these resources unfortunately fell in dire shortage. Confronting the shortage, we have two questions to be answered: First, how to allocate the limited resources? Second, how to alleviate the shortage through capacity expansion? This project attempts to address these two questions from the perspective of operations management using optimization techniques. To answer the first question, we will first quantify the impact of resource allocation on epidemic transmission. Dynamic programs will then be proposed to allocate the resources across time and location so as to alleviate human loss and suffering caused by supply shortage. To tackle the second question, the decisions of capacity investment will be incorporated into the dynamic programs for resource allocation, which lead to the joint resource allocation and capacity investment models. These models will explicitly consider the practical restrictions of capacity expansion during epidemics and target to achieve a desirable tradeoff between the capital investment for capacity and the effectiveness of epidemic control. All these proposed optimization models are expected to be very challenging. We plan to characterize the optimal policies under certain simplifying assumptions and for some special cases. Numerical solution algorithms will be developed for the general models. Their performance will be analyzed theoretically and tested extensively using real epidemic data. We also expect to reveal managerial implications based on the structural properties of the optimal policies and the statistical analysis of the numerical results. In particular, we would like to study the effectiveness of various interventions such as lockdown, quarantine, and vaccination when the resource and capacity decision is optimized. We have obtained some results on the allocation of a single-type resource. The optimal policy has been characterized for certain cases. A preliminary case study of the COVID-19 outbreak in China has also been conducted. It suggests that the approaches developed in this project have the potential to significantly reduce the negative impact of supply shortage on epidemic control, which could benefit the entire society. 流行病一直是人类生存和发展的主要威胁之一。 持续的 COVID-19 大流行已夺去超过 490 万人的生命，并在全球范围内造成大规模封城。 抗疫需要个人防护用品（PPE）、治疗用药品、免疫用疫苗、诊断用检测试剂等多种消耗性资源。然而在 COVID-19 大流行期间却有许多资源严重短缺。 面对短缺，我们有两个问题需要回答：第一，如何分配有限的资源？ 第二，如何通过扩能来缓解短缺？ 本项目试图从运营管理的角度使用优化技术来解决这两个问题。 针对第一个问题，我们首先要量化资源配置对疫情传播的影响， 然后采用动态规划的方法，跨时间、跨地点分配资源，以减轻因供应短缺造成的人员损失和痛苦。 第二个问题需把产能投资决策纳入资源配置动态规划，构建出资源配置和产能投资联合优化模型。 这些模型将明确考虑疫情期间产能扩张的实际限制，从而在产能资本投资和疫情控制有效性之间实现理想的权衡。 所有这些优化模型都将非常具有挑战性。 我们计划在某些简化假设和一些特殊情况下刻画出最优策略。一般性模型将通过数值计算方法求解。 这些算法的表现将从理论上进行分析，并使用真实的流行病数据进行广泛的测试。 我们还希望根据最优政策的结构特性和数值结果的统计分析来揭示管理启示，特别在资源配置和产能决策最优时，针对各种干预措施，如封城、隔离和疫苗接种，的有效性进行研究。 我们已在单一类型资源的分配上取得了一些成果。刻画了某些情况下的最优策略，并对中国的COVID-19疫情爆发阶段进行了初步案例研究。这些结果表明该项目开发的方法有可能显著减少供应短缺对疫情控制的负面影响，从而造福整个社会。

15507122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507122.value: 网络安全问题正在成为企业的日常忧患。根据覆盖一百多个国家的 2020 年安联风险晴雨表调查，网络安全首次成为企业面临的主要风险。35% 的亚太地区风险管理高管将网络事件或网络威胁列为最重要的业务风险，其次是业务中断 。此外，2021 年 2 月，拜登总统签署了《美国供应链》的第 14017 号行政命令，要求对美国供应链进行全面审查，以确定漏洞和风险的确切位置。网络安全是该行政命令的一个重要方面。 在全球网络危机事件突出的情况下，网络风险也引起了学术界的广泛关注。关于网络攻击风险的文献分为三类：（1）此类攻击的决定因素,（2）这些攻击的后果, 以及（3）公司受到攻击后的纠正措施。第一类文献研究了影响网络攻击的可能性因素，例如技术委员会的存在 (Chichernea et al. 2018)，商业秘密 (Ettredge et al. 2018) 和审计质量 (Higgs et al. 2016)。第二类研究发现受到网络安全攻击的公司会有负异常回报（Kamiya et al. 2021）。Sun et al (2020) 发现数据泄露风险较小的公司更有可能成为收购者的目标。在补救措施方面，Nordlund (2018) 发现董事在违规公司的经验最终会增加连锁公司的网络安全风险监控。 Garg (2020) 发现公司在经历网络安全攻击后会显着增加现金持有量。Akey et al (2021) 表明，当企业发生降低声誉的数据泄露事件后，它们会增加企业社会责任投资并获得更高的社会责任评级。 在这个项目中，我们研究网络风险如何影响客户与供应商的关系。如今的供应链非常复杂，供应商和客户分布在多个地区。关系对于供应链的稳定性和成功至关重要。尽管学者们已经发现了许多可能影响供应链关系的因素，但数据泄露的威胁却很少受到关注。美国各州披露数据泄露的法律为我们的调查提供了理想的背景，因为它在企业数据安全方面产生了看似外生的跨州差异。 具体来说，我们研究了三个问题：首先，当供应商注册所在的州通过了数据泄露法案，这是否会降低客户与供应商关系终止的可能性；第二，上述影响是否因供应商在数据保护方面的投入而异；第三，上述影响是否取决于供应商对其主要客户的相对重要性。总体而言，我们的研究结果揭示了数据安全在供应链关系管理中的作用。

15507522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15507522.value: 用於高管薪酬的盈餘指標和用於股票估值的盈餘指標 - 區別和原因

15507522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507522.value: 2006 年證券交易委員會規則 33-8732A 要求擴大代理聲明披露與高管薪酬相關的信息，從而允許研究人員、監管機構和其他金融市場參與者直接觀察董事會在衡量公司業績時使用的已實現收益數字並確定高管薪酬支出（在本提案中表示為薪酬收入）。薪酬收益是董事會用於內部績效評估和高管薪酬的公司收益績效的衡量標準。與此相關的是，衡量公司盈利表現的另一個重要指標是來自公司外部的金融分析師提供的街頭盈利。 儘管董事會本可以方便地將 GAAP 收益用作薪酬收益，但最近的研究表明，薪酬收益與 GAAP 收益有很大差異。特別是，與 GAAP 收益相比，薪酬收益表現出更低的保守性、更高的持久性和更高的信息量。因此，有證據表明，薪酬收益主要是非公認會計原則的，並且可能與其他非公認會計原則的收益（例如街道收益）具有一些相似的屬性。 然而，薪酬收入主要起管理作用，而街道收入主要起估值作用。正如會計文獻中經常強調的那樣，會計的管理和估值角色可能對收益屬性有很大不同的要求（例如，Holthausen 和 Watts 2001；Kothari 等人 2010）。因此，一個有待回答的問題是補償收入和街道收入如何以及為什麼不同。這個問題的答案不僅對會計研究人員很重要，對會計準則制定者也很重要。除了估值（也稱為決策制定）之外，是否將管理作為一項單獨的財務報告目標（FASB 2010; IASB 2010; IASB 2018）一直是監管爭論的焦點。此外，薪酬收益是企業績效評價和高管薪酬實踐的重要組成部分，在公司治理和金融市場運行中發揮著至關重要的作用。 在本提案中，我們建立在信息環境理論、代理理論和補償合同理論的基礎上，提出關於補償收入和街道收入屬性差異的假設。使用大量人工收集的薪酬收入樣本，我們將對這些假設進行實證檢驗。除了對高管薪酬合同和績效評估的研究做出貢獻外，我們的研究還將對金融市場監管機構和公司治理中的其他利益相關者感興趣。

15508022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508022.value: We propose to study the implications of mandated climate risk disclosure in the United States insurance industry on insurers’ corporate activities related to climate risk. Climate risk is an undoubtedly important issue. There are concerted global efforts to promote measures that could reduce the negative impact of humanity’s activities on the earth’s climate. Climate risk disclosure is an important means by which to compel a firm toward better behavior in terms of the firm’s sense of social responsibility toward climate change. Historically, climate risk disclosures have almost always been voluntary, with no common disclosure framework, and important concerns such as disclosure self-selection and a lack of comprehensiveness and comparability have limited their usefulness. Now, interest in developing a common framework for mandated climate risk disclosure is increasing. In particular, there is a global push to follow the recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD), which would create mandatory climate-related financial disclosures for firms. Since 2009, different United States insurance state regulators have moved toward requiring that the largest insurers operating in the United States respond to an annual survey, the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Climate Risk Disclosure Survey (CRDS), about their approach toward climate risk. This survey includes eight questions on how insurers assess and manage risks related to climate change, and an additional question about the insurers’ own greenhouse gas emissions. Since 2020, regulators have allowed insurers to submit a report based on the TCFD framework in lieu of answering the eight questions in the annual CRDS; a growing number of insurers have chosen to submit the report. This project will begin by providing some descriptive analyses of the CRDS- and TCFD-based disclosures. For example, we will conduct trend analyses to determine whether insurers’ disclosures are improving and propensity of firms to switch to TCFD-based disclosures. We will then examine the impact of the CRDS in five areas: (1) environmental performance ratings; (2) green compensation for insurers’ CEOs; (3) share ownership of insurers by ESG funds; (4) environmental activists’ actions, specifically, shareholder proposals on improving insurers’ environmental performance; and (5) media coverage of insurers’ environmental issues. Our difference-in-differences research design will rely on the identification benefit provided by the CRDS’s staggered adoption by different states. We also plan to provide in-depth analyses based on the heterogeneity in the responses to individual questions in the CRDS and in the content of the voluntary TCFD reports.
