15508722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508722.value: 联合奖励计划把不同的商家联合在一起，形成一个联盟，顾客从任意一个商家消费而获得的奖励可以用于参与该计划的任意一个商家。虽然近些年联合奖励计划越来越流行，但是我们也看到一些失败的案例。一个有名的案例是Plenti忠诚计划在实施仅三年后便宣布停止该计划。Plenti把众多不同行业的商家，比如梅斯百货，Chili’s，AT&T，联合在一起，但是目前这些商家均已回归实施各自的独立奖励计划。这些现象引出以下一些问题：为什么这些商家放弃联合奖励计划？哪一种奖励计划更加有效的帮助商家建立客户忠诚和提高商家利润，联合奖励计划还是独立奖励计划？而且，不同的联合奖励计划的规模（包含商家的数量）也不相同，那么我们该怎么决定最优的规模大小，以及规模大小如何影响联合奖励计划的有效性？ 在该项目中，我们将研究如何设计最优的联合奖励计划，商家是否应该加入联合奖励计划，以及规模大小如何影响联合奖励计划的有效性。我们从最简单的情形开始分析：假设联合奖励计划包含n个独立且对称的商家，每个商家向顾客销售不可久存的商品。我们考虑一个连续时间的无限期的问题。顾客以参数为lambda的泊松过程的形式访问每个商家，如此，顾客访问该联盟的参数为n lambda。顾客在任何一个商家购买商品，均可获得一份奖励，而该奖励在过期之前适用于该联盟内的任何一个商家。联合奖励计划的负责人需要决定商品价格，奖励大小，有效期限，以及联盟的规模大小，来最大化该联盟的长期平均利润。 对于任意给定的联合奖励计划，我们将采用连续时间的动态规划来分析顾客的决策问题，其中该动态规划的状态代表的是顾客访问联盟时是否已具有奖励。然后，根据顾客的行为，我们将分析联合奖励计划的最优决策问题，并且与独立奖励计划的利润进行比较。最后，我们将分析如何决定联盟的规模大小。总而言之，该项目将从运营管理的角度研究决定如何设计最优的联合奖励计划，以期加深我们对联合奖励计划背后逻辑的理解。

15509422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15509422.value: 审计独立期间缩短的市场后果： 股票上市发行压价的证据

15509422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15509422.value: Prof Cheng, Agnes, C.S, Ms Wang, Ben

15509422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509422.value: Audit independence is crucial for maintaining audit quality and mitigating agency problems between management and outside investors. Since the last major revisions in accordance with the Sarbanes-Oxley Act in 2002, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) auditor independence rules have remained unchanged for nearly two decades. On December 30, 2019, the SEC decided to amend the definition of audit and professional engagement period for IPO firms. After this amendment, the look-back period, which is the time period under evaluation of audit independence, is surprisingly shortened from three years to one year for domestic IPO firms, and the rule remains unchanged for foreign IPO firms (i.e., one-year look-back period). This amendment has attracted great debates among policymakers, investors, and the public. While the SEC Chairman, Jay Clayton commented that the amendment “reduce or eliminate those adverse effects on auditor choice without detracting from the independence obligations of auditors and issuers,” the SEC Commissioners Allison Herren Lee and Caroline Crenshaw argued that updates “replace a clear standard with one that provides auditors greater discretion” and concluded that these changes “are disfavored by investors.” In addition, opposite to the continuing efforts of promoting strict corporate governance since the SOX Act, this amendment loosens audit independence regulations and hence is unexpected by investors. Despite heated discussions among policymakers, evidence on whether and how investors react to a shorter audit look-back period is rare. Therefore, empirical analysis of the real economic effects of this regulation change is urged for further discussions and assessments. In this research proposal, we plan to investigate how the SEC amendment about audit independence period influences IPO underpricing, which often serves as a proxy for investors’ compensation for their concerns of information asymmetry and litigation risk. Since the regulation change is effective on June 9, 2021, we categorize IPOs issued before June 9, 2021 as the pre-event group and IPOs issued after June 9, 2021 as the post-event group. According to the rule, only domestic firms are affected by the regulation changes. Therefore, we assign domestic IPO filers as the treatment firms and foreign firms that issue IPOs in the U.S. during the same time period as the control firms. We expect that this research can offer empirical evidence to better understand the economic consequences of this amendment. More importantly, we aim to provide policy implications to the regulators about this amendment. 摘要 利用一个准自然的实验，我们计划研究审计和专业介入期间对股票上市发行压价的影响。 2019年12月30日， 美国证券交易委员会突然改变了对美国公司的审计和专业介入期间从以前的三年突然改为一年。 外国公司在美国上市的审计和专业介入期间还是一年没变。 这个突然改变导致了行业和市场的剧烈争论。这个审计和专业介入期间的缩短好像有违审计独立的原则。 我们计划研究投资人是如何对审计和专业介入期间的缩短反应。我们的研究对观察投资人和审计独立的关系有重要的实践意义。

15509522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15509522.value: 杜兴微笑在随心支付商业场景下会降低来自消费者的外在激励

15509522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509522.value: This project builds on existing research findings (1) that Duchenne smiles can signal intrinsic motivation of the actor, and (2) that extrinsic rewards undermine intrinsic motivation, to argue that in business settings where customers could flexibility determine the amount of money to pay for the service (i.e., pay-what-you-want, or PWYW in short), customers choose to reduce, rather than increase their amount of payment for the service, when they observe more Duchenne smiles from the frontline workers. This effect at first sight seems to be in sharp contrast to what conventional wisdom predicts, but it is consistent with the reasoning that customers refrain from engaging in rewarding activities to maintain the frontline worker at the same if not even heightened level of intrinsic motivation to continue to deliver the same high-quality service. This project will build upon initial evidence of this effect from the live streaming business and generalize it in settings where Duchenne smiles are displayed in various formats (e.g., static pictures or dynamic videos) and where extrinsically rewarding activities vary (e.g., PWYW alone, or both PWYW and other engagement activities such as likes and comments). The project will also explore potential boundary conditions for this effect. 基于已有研究发现，(1) 杜兴微笑可以预示行动者的内在动机，以及(2) 外在激励会降低行动者的内在动机，本项目提出，在消费者可以自由决定产品或服务的价格(即随心支付，PWYW)的商业场景下，当他们看到出售产品或提供服务的一线工作人员的脸上显示更多杜兴微笑时，消费者会选择降低，而非增加他们的支付金额。这个结果粗看起来跟传统观点或直觉相违背，但它跟基于已有研究结果的推断一致：消费者通过克制自己的激励行为(这种激励对一线工作人员是外在激励)，使得一线工作人员的内在激励保持在同样，如果没有更高，的水平上，从而持续提供优质服务。 本项目将基于上述现象在直播场景下的初步实证结果，将这些结果推广到其他商业场景。在这些场景里，杜兴微笑会以各种方式呈现(比如静态图片，或动态视频)，外在激励也会变化(包括只有PWYW，或PWYW和其他互动激励方式共存，比如点赞和评论)。本项目也将研究上述现象成立的边界条件。

15510022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15510022.value: 老有所養，擁抱新事物：技術擬人化對老年消費者接受意願的影響

15510022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510022.value: 在科技日新月異的現代世界中，我們面臨著驚人的創新速度，從如何點餐到如何獲得醫療諮詢服務，我們的消費習慣也不断的發生變化。創新技術讓大多數人的生活變得更輕鬆，但也給老年消費者（即 65 歲及以上的消費者）帶來了巨大挑戰（聯合國，2020 年）。年長的消費者往往缺乏接受新事物所需的知識和學習能力。而且，就像質量越大慣性越大的物理原理一樣，老年消費者的轉換成本也明顯高於年輕消費者。 由於缺乏接受新事物的動力和能力，老年消費者面臨被時代潮流邊緣化的風險。 COVID-19 大流行極大地加劇了這一劣勢。在大流行之前，如果年長的消費者願意，他們可以堅持自己的舊習慣，從紙質報紙上獲取新聞、去線下雜貨店購物、以及使用傳統支付方式。 然而，COVID-19 大流行的突然爆發把幾乎所有活動都变成了線上，從而保证社交距離。不幸的是，這對數字素養低的老年消費者產生了不利影響（世界衛生組織，2021 年）。 該研究的目的是通過實驗方法，並结合關於老齡化效應、消費者信息處理和技術擬人化理論的研究，探討提高老年消費者改變意願的方法，以促進老年消費者的福祉。簡而言之，我們之前的研究（例如，Chen、Chen 和 Yang 2020，《消費者心理學雜誌》；Chen、Jiang 和 He，工作論文）和現有文獻（例如，Epley、Waytz 和 Cacioppo 2007；Wan 和 Chen 2021）已經發現擬人化框架有助於人们理解新事物。基於這些發現，我們建議，當營銷人員向年長消費者宣傳新技術時，例如安裝新的智能手機應用程序或嘗試新的支付方式時，使用擬人化框架來傳達技術信息將使信息更易於理解，並且相應地，會增強老年消費者的接纳意願。 在世界上幾乎每個國家，老年人的規模都在快速增長；因此，解決與人口老齡化相關的問題是十分迫切的（聯合國，2020 年）。該項目有可能通過提供一種可行且營銷人員可控的做法來增強老年消費者的改變意願，從而為老年消費者的福祉做出貢獻。我們的研究團隊由兩位過去密切合作的學者組成，他們都是消費者福祉領域的專家學者（例如，Chen 和 Sengupta，2014 ，《消費者研究雜誌》；Su、Monga 和Jiang，2021 《營銷研究雜誌》）和擬人化領域（Chen、Chen 和 Yang，2020 ，《消費者心理學雜誌》；Chen、Jiang 和 He，工作論文）。因此，我們有信心通過這個項目匯集我們的優勢，產出一流的論文成果。

15510222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15510222.value: 金融市場對崩盤風險感知和股票定價：國際研究

15510222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510222.value: Recent stock market turmoil highlights the importance of crash risk. Studies find considerable time-series variation in market crash risk and link time-varying crash risk to changes in real economy. Moreover, market crash risk can predict future market returns and command a risk premium and market crash risk is correlated with a state variable that affects investment opportunities. Motivated by the implication of business cycle theories that investors’ perceptions of uncertain macroeconomic fundamentals can contribute to economic fluctuations and affect asset price movements, we examine whether and how investors’ perceptions of uncertain crash risk play a role in the pricing of stocks in the U.S. and global stock markets. Pflueger, Siriwardane, and Sunderam (2020) propose a novel proxy for investors’ perceived risk, called the price of volatile stocks (PVS), which is the average book-to-market ratio of low-volatility stocks minus the average book-to-market ratio of high-volatility stocks. They argue that because PVS is constructed from market prices, it contains forward-looking information about investors’ subjective expectations for future market volatility. When PVS is low, market perceived risk is high. They find that high perceived risk is associated with low interest rates, a high cost of capital for risky firms, and future declines in investment and output. We borrow their idea to construct a market-based measure of perceived crash risk, called the price of crash-prone stocks (PCRS), which is the average book-to-market ratio of low-crash risk stocks minus the average book-to-market ratio of high-crash risk stocks. Low PCRS indicates high market perceived crash risk. Compared to existing measures of market crash risk, our measure is simple and easy to implement and it can be easily and readily extended to earlier years and the international setting. We then examine the pricing implications of PCRS in the cross-section of stocks in the U.S. and international markets. The potential contribution of our proposal is to document that PCRS is priced in the U.S. and international markets. The findings can benefit investors, fund managers, and policymakers. Understanding how time-varying crash risk affects stock prices is important for stock investors to hedge against such crash risk and make better investment decisions and can also help fund managers to design a better risk management system. Knowledge about the impacts of market crashes on real economy and the financial market can also facilitate policy makers to carry out policies to minimize adverse impacts of such extreme events. 最近的股市動盪凸顯了崩盤風險的重要性。研究發現市場崩盤風險存在相當大的時間序列變化，並將隨時間變化的崩盤風險與實體經濟的變化聯繫起來。此外，市場崩盤風險可以預測未來的市場回報並獲得風險溢價，而市場崩盤風險與影響投資機會的變量有相關。 受商業周期理論的啟發，投資者對不確定的宏觀經濟基本面的看法會導致經濟波動並影響資產價格走勢，我們研究投資者對不確定的崩盤風險的看法是否以及如何在美國和全球股市股票定價中發揮作用。Pflueger、Siriwardane和Sunderam(2020)提出了一種新的衡量投資者感知風險的指標，稱為波動性股票價格(PVS)，即低波動性股票的平均賬面市值比減去高波動性股票的平均賬面市值比。他們認為，由於PVS是根據市場價格構建的，因此它包含有關投資者對未來市場波動的主觀預期的前瞻性信息。當PVS低時，市場感知風險高。他們發現，高感知風險與低利率、高風險公司的高資本成本以及未來投資和產出的下降有關。 我們藉用他們的想法來構建一個基於市場的感知崩盤風險度量，稱為易崩盤股票的價格 (PCRS)，它是低崩盤風險股票的平均賬面市值比減去高崩盤風險股票的平均賬面市值比。低 PCRS 表明市場感知的崩盤風險高。與現有市場崩盤風險的衡量相比，我們的衡量簡單易行，可以很容易地擴展到早期和國際環境。然後，我們研究PCRS在美國和國際市場股票橫截面中的定價影響。 我們提案的潛在貢獻是研究PCRS在美國和國際市場上的定價。這些發現可以使投資者、基金經理和政策制定者受益。了解隨時間變化的崩盤風險如何影響股票價格對於股票投資者對沖此類崩盤風險並做出更好的投資決策非常重要，也可以幫助基金經理設計更好的風險管理系統。了解市場崩盤對實體經濟和金融市場的影響也有助於政策制定者實施政策，以盡量減少此類極端事件的不利影響。

15510422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15510422.value: 通过股票回购修复声誉——世界各地的证据

15510422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15510422.value: Prof CHEMMANUR, Thomas J Dr Shen, Yao Dr XIE, Jing

15510422.label: Project Objectives
15510422.value: Do dissent votes on director election induce firms to repurchase more shares in an international sample? Is the effect of dissent votes on repurchase stronger when the difference in tax rates for short-run and long-run capital gain is lower? Is the effect of dissent votes on repurchase weaker for countries with a higher individualism score? Does the effect of dissent votes on repurchase also hold for dividend payout? Does stock repurchase mitigate the effect of dissent votes on director turnover?
rows: Do dissent votes on director election induce firms to repurchase more shares in an international sample?
Is the effect of dissent votes on repurchase stronger when the difference in tax rates for short-run and long-run capital gain is lower?
Is the effect of dissent votes on repurchase weaker for countries with a higher individualism score?
Does the effect of dissent votes on repurchase also hold for dividend payout?
Does stock repurchase mitigate the effect of dissent votes on director turnover?

15510422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510422.value: Abstract Stock repurchases have attracted widespread attention from both academia and industry practitioners. For example, Kahle and Stulz (2021) find that net repurchases (after netting out equity issuance) has an average operating income of 4.8% before year 2000 and 19.27% for the 2000-2019 period. In year 2018, buybacks by S&P 500 companies reached an astounding 68% of net income, totalling over $800 billion (See, e.g., the article titled “Why Stock Buybacks Are Dangerous for the Economy”. Harvard Business Review January 7, 2020). Countries differ in their regulations with regard to repurchases. For example, U.S. legalized stock repurchase in 1982 while other major countries legalized repurchases at a later date. China, Russia, Japan, Greece, and Turkey legalized stock repurchase in 2005, 1995, 1995, 2003, and 2009, respectively, according to Wang, Yin, and Yu (2021). If a country has legalized repurchase for a long period or the firms residing in that county have better corporate governance, investors tend to hold a more favorable view on repurchases. Otherwise, investors may view repurchase as another form of earnings management that benefits CEOs and dependent directors. For example, firms may use repurchase to achieve EPS target tied to CEOs’ bonus (Cheng, Harford, and Zhang, 2015) and to meet analyst earnings per share forecast (Almeida, Fos, and Kronlund, 2016). We analyze repurchases in an international setting and focus on its role to cater to investors’ who cast dissenting votes (i.e., less voting support) on manager-sponsored director nominees. Dissenting votes can result in higher director turnover (Cai, Garner, and Walkling, 2009; Iliev et al., 2015; Aggarwal, Dahiya, and Prabhala, 2019) in both the U.S. and other countries. It is worthy to show the real impact of proxy voting, a form of low-cost activism, on firm policies such as payout policy which may weaken the effect of dissenting votes on director turnover. We argue that directors, who receive more dissent votes, may repair their reputation by inducing managers to repurchase more shares. Stock repurchases, if indeed perceived favorable by investors, will reduce the turnover likelihood of directors who have received more dissent votes in the previous year. The cross-country differences on tax rates, governance, and regulations of repurchase allow us to develop hypotheses regarding the effectiveness of repurchase to ease investors’ anger about incumbent directors. In summary, we will study the relation between director elections, corporate payout, and director turnover in an international sample. 股票回购引起了学术界和行业从业者的广泛关注。例如，Kahle 和 Stulz (2021) 发现净回购（扣除股票发行后）在 2000 年之前的平均营业收入为 4.8%，在 2000-2019 年期间为 19.27%。 2018 年，标准普尔 500 指数公司的回购达到了令人震惊的 68% 的净收入，总额超过 8000 亿美元（例如，参见题为“为什么股票回购对经济有害”的文章。哈佛商业评论 2020 年 1 月 7 日）。 各国对回购的规定各不相同。例如，美国在 1982 年将股票回购合法化，而其他主要国家则在以后将回购合法化。根据 Wang、Yin 和 Yu（2021）的说法，中国、俄罗斯、日本、希腊和土耳其分别在 2005 年、1995 年、1995 年、2003 年和 2009 年将股票回购合法化。如果一个国家长期将回购合法化，或者居住在该县的公司具有更好的公司治理，投资者往往对回购持有更有利的看法。否则，投资者可能会将回购视为另一种有利于 CEO 和独立董事的盈余管理形式。例如，公司可以使用回购来实现与 CEO 奖金挂钩的每股收益目标（Cheng、Harford 和 Zhang，2015 年）并达到分析师的每股收益预测（Almeida、Fos 和 Kronlund，2016 年）。 摘要 我们分析了国际环境中的回购，并专注于其在迎合对经理赞助的董事提名人投反对票（即投票支持较少）的投资者方面的作用。在美国和其他国家，反对票会导致更高的董事流动率（Cai、Garner 和 Walkling，2009 年；Iliev 等人，2015 年；Aggarwal、Dahiya 和 Prabhala，2019 年）。值得一提的是，代理投票这种低成本的激进主义形式对公司政策（如支付政策）的真正影响可能会削弱反对票对董事流动的影响。 我们认为，获得更多反对票的董事可能会通过诱导经理回购更多股份来修复他们的声誉。股票回购，如果确实被投资者认为是有利的，将降低在上一年获得更多反对票的董事的更替可能性。跨国公司在税率、治理和回购法规方面的差异使我们能够就回购的有效性提出假设，以缓解投资者对现任董事的愤怒。 总之，我们将在一个国际样本中研究董事选举、公司支付和董事流动之间的关系。

15510422.label: Realisation of objectives
15510422.value: The project intends to conduct a study on how the stock repurchase helps firms to cater to investors who cast dissenting votes (i.e., less voting support) on manager-sponsored director elections in the international setting. The findings can speak to how proxy voting, a form of low-cost activism, on firm payout policies. The project is related to Huang and Thakov (2013), who document that firms are more likely to buy back shares when the level of investor-management agreement is lower, with a sample of U.S. firms. Our initial research objectives are valid, while we have not got strong evidence to support our hypotheses with the data. We process the data on shareholder voting in the international firms, and note that the data coverage on non-US firms' proxy voting is limited. A direct consequence of the data omissions is that we cannot merge the shareholder voting data with other financial variables with a large sample of international firms. As a result, we cannot successfully conduct data analysis according to the original proposal. Nevertheless, as our research objectives are related to the broad line of studies on corporate payout policy, we pursue alternative settings along this line of research. Following the initial project objective (i.e. firms use payout as a mechanism to repair reputation), we test how firms change their payout policy around the adoption of corporation opportunities waivers (COWs) in nine U.S. states between 2000 and 2016. Corporate opportunity waivers allow managers to ignore the duty of loyalty in the course of their employment (e.g. explore new opportunities for themselves without first offering them to their employers). Agency conflicts may arise when managers’ interests diverge from those of shareholders. When corporate distribution is viewed favourably by investors, managers and directors can adopt a policy of high payouts (i.e. pay out more dividends and/or repurchase more shares) to “repair” their reputation for being disloyal when COWs allow them to prioritize their personal benefits over those of their current employer. We term it as “reputation repairment hypothesis”. On the other hand, when managers and board members are entitled to pursue their own external business opportunities, they can make fewer stock repurchases and even reduce cash dividends, diverting internal resources to alternative uses for their own benefit. We call it the “resource diversion hypothesis”. Despite introducing potential conflicts of interest, one important motivation for COW laws is to enhance the flexibility of contracts for both firms and investors, leveraging firms’ need for capital and fostering a more efficient corporate ecosystem. The contract flexibility resulting from COW laws reduces the pressure on managers to communicate private information through costly dividend payouts to obtain external financing (in particular, equity financing). Therefore, firms can distribute less after the passage of COW laws because managers’ incentives to signal are less. We label this alternative interpretation of the reduced distribution as “reduced signaling incentive hypothesis”. With the conventional DiD research design, we document a decline in corporate payout, both cash dividend and stock repurchase, to shareholders. We conduct cross-sectional tests to differentiate which hypotheses explain the reduction in payout better. We find results that both effects (the resource diversion incentive and the reduced signaling incentive) can be at play: the reduction in payout is greater in firms embedded with more agency problems and in firms with greater financing (especially the equity financing) dependence in the pre-COW period. We carry out additional analysis to evaluate the relative importance of the two competing hypotheses in explaining the change in corporate payout policy. Specifically, we investigate how the COW laws change the cost of equity capital for firms. If COW laws induce firms to reduce payouts because they improve firms’ financial contractability and facilitate managers and directors to coordinate resources when they can simultaneously serve multiple firms, we should observe a decrease in cost of equity capital; on the contrary, if COW laws motivate managers and board members to reduce distributions to shareholders because of self-serving purposes, we should observe an increase in the cost of capital after COW laws pass. With implied cost of equity capital estimates derived from analysts’ earnings forecasts, we find an increase in the cost of equity capital after the passage of COW laws. The finding suggests that COWs do not improve firms’ financing capacity significantly, as evidenced by the higher cost of equity capital in the post-COW period, and the resource diversion hypothesis may play a more important role in explaining the reduced corporate payouts. With these findings, we compose a working paper titled “Disloyal managers and corporate payout policy: evidence from corporate opportunity waivers”. Our study provides new findings on corporate payout policy in relation to corporate opportunity waivers.

15510422.label: Major findings and research outcome
15510422.value: With the passage of corporate opportunities waivers in nine U.S. states, we formulate three hypotheses: reputation repairment hypothesis, resource diversion hypothesis, and reduced signalling incentive hypothesis. We test the above predictions empirically and examine how corporate payouts change around the exogenous shock to the fiduciary officers’ duty of loyalty. The sample period spans from 2000 to 2022. We find that firms distribute less to shareholders after the duty of loyalty of fiduciary officers is relaxed, and the decline in distribution is manifested in both stock repurchase and cash dividend. While the decrease in payouts does not support the “reputation repairment hypothesis”, the finding can be interpreted to support both the “resource diversion hypothesis” and “reduced signaling incentive hypothesis”. In particular, the “resource diversion hypothesis” suggests that COWs should result in a greater reduction of distribution in firms with more conflicts of interest between external shareholders and insiders. In our cross-sectional analysis, we find that the decline in distribution is larger in firms where fiduciary officers have less monitoring (proxied by lower long-term institutional investors), have more external opportunities (proxied by higher industry Tobin’s Q) and/or CEOs have longer tenure and are thus more entrenched. Therefore, our findings suggest that the decline in corporate payout can be caused by agency conflicts. Meanwhile, the “reduced signaling incentive hypothesis” suggests that if COW laws enhance contracting flexibility, enabling firms to obtain external financing without using dividend payouts as a signal, then COW laws should result in a greater reduction of distribution in firms that rely more on external financing, especially equity financing (La Porta et al. 2000; Hail et al. 2014). We find evidence consistent with this conjecture as well. We conduct additional tests to gauge the relative importance of the above two competing hypotheses in explaining the change in corporate payout policy. A series of studies suggest that investors demand a higher rate of return for reasons such as a greater systematic risk resulting from overinvestment, inefficient merger and acquisition decisions, higher monitoring cost, and more severe information asymmetry, etc., when conflicts of interest between managers and shareholders are more severe. Therefore, we investigate how the COW laws change the cost of firms’ cost of equity capital. If COW laws induce firms to reduce payouts because they improve firms’ financial contractability when they can simultaneously serve multiple firms, they should be associated with a decrease in the cost of equity capital. On the contrary, if COW laws motivate managers and board members to reduce distributions to shareholders for self-serving purposes, we should observe an increase in the cost of capital after COW laws pass. Empirically, we find an increase in the cost of equity capital after the passage of COW laws. The finding suggests that on average, COWs do not improve firms’ financing capacity significantly, and the resource diversion hypothesis may play a more important role in explaining the reduced corporate payouts.

15510422.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
15510422.value: As corporate payout policy is a broad line of research, we can examine the relationship between corporate governance/managerial incentives and corporate payout in alternative settings. For example, the authors have been studying how the emergence of stakeholders may affect firms' payout policy. Extant studies have identified several interesting settings, such as the adoption of climate laws, the implementation of minimum wage requirements, the non-financial reporting mandate, and the establishment of environmental courts. We are considering how potential conflicts between shareholders and stakeholders may affect firms' payouts (either in terms of magnitude or format). Competing hypotheses can be developed along this line. On the one hand, firms may reduce corporate payouts when they encounter a stronger presence of stakeholders, possibly because they must allocate resources to meet the demands of different stakeholders. On the other hand, to maintain the relationship with shareholders (i.e., fund providers), firms may pay out more dividends to repair their reputation as "diverting resources away from shareholders". We believe that it is worthwhile to think of new arguments and develop new tests on corporate payouts by incorporating the latest changes in the business world.

15510422.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
15510422.value: COWs allow company managers to pursue their own business deals without offering them to their employers first. This can create conflicts if managers prioritize personal gain over shareholders’ interests. Some managers may try to “fix” their reputation by paying more dividends or buying back shares—we call this the “reputation repair incentive”. Others might cut payouts and redirect company funds for personal benefit—the “resource diversion incentive”. COWs also reduce the need for companies to prove their worth through big payouts, to the extent that COWs reduce firms’ incentive to “signal” their strength by paying high dividends—the “reduced signaling incentive”. Our research shows that after COW laws pass, companies pay less to shareholders (dividends and buybacks decline). This drop is bigger in firms with 1) more conflicts between managers and shareholders (resource diversion) and 2) greater reliance on outside funding before COWs (reduced signaling). We also checked if COWs help companies raise money more easily. If they did, borrowing costs (cost of equity) should fall. Instead, we find that costs rose, suggesting managers use COWs for personal gain rather than company benefit. In short, COWs lead to lower shareholder payouts, mostly because managers divert resources for themselves.

15511022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511022.value: 我們提議研究保險公司的強製性氣候風險披露對其所投資的公司的企業活動的溢出效應。氣候風險無疑已成為世界上最重要的話題之一。各國政府都在強調製定一個普遍適用的氣候風險披露框架來應對該風險。例如，在2021年6月5日，七國集團對於強製企業進行氣候風險披露這一措施表示支持。強製性氣候風險披露的必要性基於一個假設，即該披露可在推動企業在應對氣候變化時承擔更多的社會責任方面發揮重要作用。然而，關於強製性氣候風險披露的實際影響，學術界卻鮮有研究。 自2009年以來，美國不同的州保險監管機構開始要求在美國經營的最大的保險公司回應一項有關他們如何應對氣候風險的年度調查問卷，即全國保險專員協會的氣候風險披露調查。事實上，當證券交易委員會在考慮為上市公司製定一套強製性的氣候風險披露規則時，華盛頓州的保險事務專員邁克·克萊德勒鼓勵證券交易委員會的主席回顧一下美國保險監管機構在該方面已經積累的經驗。因此，除了對保險公司的影響外，對氣候風險披露調查的整體影響進行科學地調查，可以為政策製定者提供有用的信息。此外，由於保險公司是公司債券市場上的最大投資者，對於金融領域的研究人員來說，了解信貸供應商在被要求進行氣候風險披露時的潛在影響也有著重要的意義。 該項目主要研究三個問題。首先，我們將研究如果持有公司債券的保險公司被要求回應該調查問卷，該公司是否會增加其氣候風險披露。為了回答這個問題，我們將開發一個機器學習框架來提取嵌套在美國上市公司的電話會議、SEC 10K文件和ESG報告中的氣候風險披露。對於另外兩個問題，我們將研究如果持有公司債券的保險公司被要求回應該調查問卷，該公司是否會改善其環境績效和財務績效。我們將利用雙重差分法的研究設計，來獲取不同州對於氣候風險披露調查的交錯采用所帶來的識別效益。

15511222.label: Project Objectives
15511222.value: To study the secrets behind executives’ body language by proposing the concept of the motion index, a summary statistic that reflects the level of discomfort to which the executives’ body language is shown in the most engaging part of the Q&A session of the earnings conference videocasts. Over the past decade, publicly listed firms have been increasingly using live videocasts for earnings conferences to communicate with investors. Videos from the Q&A sessions of these earnings conferences may provide non-verbal cues embedded within body language as a proxy to materially impacting private information. Such non-verbal cues may contain rich information about the credibility of firms’ fundamentals that can be used to predict future performance. To develop a deep learning algorithm for computing a compact and explicable summary statistic of the levels of discomfort by executives in Q&A sessions of earnings conference videocasts. Given the richness of communication media, we can use deep learning algorithms to analyze the visual cues expressed in executives’ body responses. By transferring unstructured video-level data into well-structured quantitative information, the algorithm is predictive of future firm performance, financial misreporting, and product sales lift. With the advancement of AI-powered video mining technologies, we can extract visual cues (e.g., executives’ body language) to be a proxy for private non-accounting information. To understand investor behaviors and market reactions to executives’ body language and how they incorporate such non-accounting information into the equity market. The hypothesis behind the concept of motion index is that, if the body language reveals some hidden information, it can be used for predicting market reactions because such information may affect future cash flows and investor expectations with respect to firms’ short- and long-term stock returns, as well as analysts’ stock recommendations. More specifically, the more engagingly salient an executive is in a video, the more effective the video will be in predicting firm performance. To investigate the predictive ability of body language deception cues on accounting irregularities, particularly our proposed motion index, and whether it is useful for detecting deception, such as financial misreporting. Accounting statements play an important role in revealing the earnings performance of a firm. However, relying solely on accounting data cannot give adequate information for investors to evaluate firm performance. Thus, there is a sustained effort to find non-accounting information to make a better prediction. It would be interesting to investigate whether the motion index is positively associated with the likelihood of accounting misstatements. To estimate the causal effect of the proposed motion index on moderating product sales lift via the difference-in-differences method, by leveraging the variation in earnings conference hosting date. The hypothesis is that earnings videocasts with higher body motion will be more effective in moderating the product sales lift. The variation in executives’ body engagement over pixel space and video time is necessary for sales lift to materialize. To explore the generalizability of our deep learning algorithm in the context of a generic investor-related video on whether it can leverage the proposed motion index in a scalable way such that it can be easily computed for future earnings videocasts in any speaking language and optimized for prediction accuracy.

15511222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511222.value: This study investigates whether the levels of discomfort by firm executives, revealed through their body language in the Q&A sessions of earnings conference videocasts, relevant for predicting firm performance. A higher level of discomfort by executives is more associated with a firm’s negative future performance. We propose the concept of the motion index, a summary statistic that reflects the level of discomfort to which the executives’ body language is shown in the most engaging part of the Q&A session. Such motion is defined as the pixel-level discomfort-weighted body language intensity of the executives. The goal of this project is to develop a deep learning algorithm to predict the effect of executives’ level of discomfort on firm performance. We estimate the pixel-level discomfort of executives as a saliency map by customizing and fine-tuning a deep 4D convolutional neural network on video-level body language data. We mainly focus on three aspects. First, we study the prediction power of the proposed motion index with respect to firms’ short- and long-term stock returns, as well as analysts’ stock recommendations. Since the level of executives’ discomfort in response to audience questions may contain rich information about the credibility of firms’ fundamentals, it can be used to predict future performance. If investors react to executives’ body language, it is worth investigating whether analysts would react in a similar manner. Second, we investigate the predictive ability of body language deception cues on whether it is useful for detecting financial misreporting. In particular, we will study if it is positively associated with the likelihood of accounting restatements after controlling for other verbal and non-verbal predictors. Third, from the marketing perspective, we will estimate the causal effect of the proposed motion index on moderating product sales lift via the difference-in-differences method, by leveraging the variation in earnings conference hosting date. We conjecture that earnings videocasts with higher body motion will be more effective in moderating the product sales lift. For each of these three aspects, we will also develop managerial insights to understand the predictive power embedded within body language as a proxy to materially impact private information. Our results will establish theoretical foundations for the development of body language analytic algorithms in the context of earnings conferences that will have great impacts on financial predictions. The proposed study will also provide effective emerging techniques, and push forward the financial analytic frontier of this research area.

15511422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511422.value: Bessembinder et al. (2020) show that the global stock market wealth creation ($US 56.2 trillion) can be attributed to the top-performing 1.5% of stocks. Consistent with the observed concentration in wealth creation, there is a reallocation of economic activity toward superstar firms measured by their increased market power (Autor et al., 2020; De Loecker, Eeckhout, and Unger, 2020). Intangible inputs and investments such as market research, software development, and human capital, are substantial among superstar firms (e.g., Facebook, Alphabet, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon; MAMAA) as they improve organizational knowledge and create value, but they are typically categorized as the selling, general, and administrative (SG&A) expenses instead of costs or invested capital. Rajgopal (2021) points out that SG&A spending in fiscal year 2020 is larger than COGS among superstar firms. Therefore, measuring economic activities with intangibles is important. In this proposal, we rely on accounting data and present a unified approach that incorporates intangible inputs and investments into the measurement of production function building on the estimation of markup (De Loecker et al., 2020) and intangible outlays (Enache and Srivastava, 2018). First, we specify maintenance outlays from SG&A as variable inputs matched with current revenues. Second, we further specify investment outlays from SG&A as organizational capital and from R&D as knowledge capital by accumulating their unamortized values. Third, by estimating the associated production function, we obtain the intangible inputs and investments, and the output elasticity, to measure the markup and the operating profitability. The novelty of our study is to measure intangibles and production activities using a unified approach. We hypothesize that the intangible inputs increase the output elasticity as the revenue are responsive to the variable outlays from SG&A. In this case, the markup measure does not necessarily decline even though the profit rate solely based on COGS would be downward adjusted by the additional variable cost of intangible inputs. The growth rate of the intangible inputs, compared to COGS growth, should better predict the future revenue growth and the market power. We further hypothesize that the profitability measure adjusted by the intangible investments better measure the operating activities and should better predict the stock market performance. We will further study their systematic patterns based on the distribution of the markup and the operating profitability. As regulators have concerns about the market power particularly for digital giants, the results of the project should be useful and important. Bessembinder et al. (2020) 表明，全球股市財富創造（56.2 萬億美元）可歸因於表現最好的 1.5% 的股票。與觀察到的財富創造集中度一致，經濟活動向超級巨星企業重新分配，衡量其市場力量的增加（Autor et al., 2020; De Loecker, Eeckhout, and Unger, 2020）。市場研究、軟件開發和人力資本等無形投入和投資在超級明星公司（如 Facebook、Alphabet、微軟、蘋果、亞馬遜；MAMAA）中非常重要，因為它們提高了組織知識並創造了價值，但它們通常被歸類作為銷售、一般和管理 (SG&A) 費用，而不是成本或投資資本。 Rajgopal (2021) 指出，在超級明星公司中，2020 財年的 SG&A 支出大於 COGS。因此，要衡量經濟活動，使用無形資產是重要的方式。 在本提案中，我們依靠會計數據並提出了一種統一的方法，該方法將無形投入和投資納入基於加價估計（De Loecker et al., 2020）和無形支出（Enache and Srivastava, 2018）的生產函數測量）。首先，我們將 SG&A 的維護費用指定為與當前收入相匹配的可變投入。其次，我們通過累積未攤銷價值進一步將SG&A的投資支出指定為組織資本，將R&D的投資支出指定為知識資本。第三，通過估計相關的生產函數，我們獲得了無形的投入和投資，以及產出彈性，以衡量加價和經營盈利能力。我們研究的新穎之處在於使用統一的方法來衡量無形資產和生產活動。 我們假設無形投入增加了產出彈性，因為收入對 SG&A 的可變支出作出反應。在這種情況下，即使僅基於銷貨成本的利潤率會因無形投入的額外可變成本而向下調整，加價指標也不一定會下降。與 COGS 增長相比，無形投入的增長率應該更好地預測未來的收入增長和市場力量。我們進一步假設，由無形投資調整的盈利能力指標可以更好地衡量經營活動，並應該更好地預測股市表現。我們將根據加價分佈和經營盈利能力進一步研究它們的系統模式。由於監管機構對市場力量特別是數字巨頭的市場力量感到擔憂，因此該研究項目的結果應該是有用而且重要的。

15511522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511522.value: 機腹貨艙貨運對空運乘客有影響嗎？

15511522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15511522.value: Prof Brueckner, Jan K Prof Gaggero, Alberto A.

15511522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511522.value: Air transport markets can be separated into passenger and cargo markets (here and hereafter, whenever cargo is mentioned, it does not include passenger baggage). Those markets can be considered as independent on the demand side in the sense a change in the airfare will not directly affect the demand for belly cargo services, and vice versa a change in freight rates will not directly affect passenger demand. The picture changes for the supply side. 65 percent of worldwide air cargo was carried in the bellies of passenger aircraft in March 2019. During the Covid-19 pandemic, a large share of the big aircraft (widebody) fleet was grounded (partly in the desert) leading to a substantial drop in belly capacity and sharp increases in air cargo freight rates. This evidence suggests that passengers create an externality on shippers. This further suggests that airlines may be considered as two-sided platforms serving two sets of agents, passengers and shippers, where the decisions of one set of agents affects the other set of agents through an externality. While the evidence suggests that passengers create an externality on shippers, a largely open question is whether and, if so, how shippers create an externality on passengers. There are only few studies available which offer an integrated view of passenger and belly cargo markets. This proposal suggests three types of empirical studies which altogether provide a systematic analysis which attempts to detect externalities imposed by belly cargo businesses on passengers. The first considers the direct relationship between airfares and belly cargo volumes. The second considers the indirect relationship between airfares and belly cargo volumes via airline capacity. The third considers the relationship between passenger and belly cargo businesses via airline networks. Belly cargo volumes are highly imbalanced in the sense that cargo volumes substantially differ depending on the flight direction. The consideration of directional imbalances is an important feature of the proposed set of studies. Directional imbalances matter for pricing, capacity, and network choices. They matter for pricing because demand variations are associated with variations in the price elasticities of demand and, therefore, airfares and freight rates. They matter for capacity choices because, with directional imbalances, capacity constraints may be binding in only one direction. Finally, they matter for networks because entering volatile markets could be less attractive for risk averse airlines. 空運市場可被劃分為客運和貨運兩個市場。因為機票價格變動並不會直接影響機腹貨運需求，貨運費用也不會影響客運需求，這兩個市場的需求可被視為相互獨立的。但是兩個市場的供給卻不能視作相互獨立。2019年3月，全世界65%的空運貨物是通過機腹貨艙來進行運輸的。但在新冠肺炎期間大量飛機停飛，導致機腹貨艙運輸能力顯著下降，空運貨物運費飆升。這個案例表明，乘客會對貨物托運人產生外部性。这也意味着航空公司可被看作是同時服務於乘客和貨物托運人這兩種代理人的雙向市場。其中一種代理人可以通過外部性來影響另一種代理人。以上案例證明乘客對貨物托運人的外部性，那麼，貨物托運人是否也對乘客存在外部性呢？如果存在，這種外部性是怎樣產生的呢？過往文獻很少將客運市場和機腹貨運市場統一討論。 本研究提議包含三種實證研究，全面系統討論機腹貨運對客運的外部性。第一研究討論機票價格和機腹貨運量的直接關係。第二研究討論機票價格和機腹貨運量之間通過航空運力形成的間接關係。第三研究討論客運和機腹貨運通過航空空運網絡形成的關係。

15600322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600322.value: 動作思維對於有跌倒風險之香港老年人在充滿挑戰性的環境站立時之站姿穩定性及肌肉效率的影響 - 對復康之意義

15600322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15600322.value: Dr Capio, Catherine Mamaid Prof Masters, Rich Stanley William Ms Ng, Ada Fong Ting Prof Ng, Sheung Mei Shamay

15600322.label: Project Objectives
15600322.value: To examine the difference between older adults with high and low trait conscious movement processing propensities in the real-time (state) conscious movement processing propensity, postural stability, and muscle efficiency while standing in a challenging environment with different levels of standing task difficulties.
rows: To examine the difference between older adults with high and low trait conscious movement processing propensities in the real-time (state) conscious movement processing propensity, postural stability, and muscle efficiency while standing in a challenging environment with different levels of standing task difficulties.

15600322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600322.value: Maintaining a standing balance is the key capability for preventing falls in the older population. Nevertheless, older adults in an urban community can have difficulty securely maintaining their standing balance in a challenging environment. Weight shifting while standing was found to be among the most frequent causes of falling in older adults. Community-dwelling older adults often experience fall incidents while engaging in different everyday physical activities that require maintaining an appropriate standing balance. Regrettably, falls in older adults lead to a decline in their standing balance that further predisposes them to a high fear of falling. To address movement difficulties and the fear of falling while maintaining balance in an urban environment, older adults could focus their attention internally on their movement mechanisms during stance along with movement-related rules through conscious movement processing. However, the attempt of conscious movement processing in older adults has been found to interfere with their attention allocation to navigation of the environment and multitasking during movement execution. This is due to the fact that conscious movement processing requires the processing of movement-related rules that overload the working memory resources, causing movement failure and an increased risk of falling in older adults. The harmful effects of conscious movement processing could be stronger in a challenging environment requiring attention optimisation. However, the comprehensive effects of conscious movement processing propensity in older adults at risk of falling, while standing in a challenging environment remain unclear. This study aims to make a novel and significant scientific contribution by addressing critical knowledge gaps through the investigation of the effects of trait conscious movement processing propensity on real-time (state) conscious movement processing propensity, postural stability, and muscle efficiency in older adults at risk of falling with high and low trait conscious movement processing propensities, while standing in a challenging environment with different standing task difficulties. It is a critical and logical extension of our research team’s successfully completed research projects, and the research protocol has been proved to be feasible after a pilot study. The study results will contribute to our scientific understanding of the mechanisms of conscious movement processing in older adults while maintaining the standing balance in a challenging environment. It could ultimately inform future investigations for the development of the most appropriate psychomotor standing balance re-education intervention in rehabilitation so as to mitigate the effect of conscious movement processing and the risk of falling in older adults.

15600722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15600722.value: 中国农村父母患有严重精神疾病：家庭状况、对儿童的影响和潜在的服务提供

15600722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15600722.value: Dr Ku, Hok Bun Dr Leung, Sze Ming, Samuel Prof Wu, Qiaobing Ms Yang, Haiping

15600722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15600722.value: Despite the significantly higher prevalence of severe mental illnesses in rural China than in urban areas, the disproportionate concentration of resources for mental health care in larger cities leaves residents in smaller cities, towns, and the countryside at an enormous disadvantage. Families in which a member suffers from severe mental illness face many challenges; the situations are particularly difficult for the children in these families. In our local social work practice in Wuding, a rural county in Yunnan Province, we noticed that a number of the disadvantaged families we serve have members who suffer from severe mental illness. Many of these families live in extreme poverty. The children often lack proper parental care and are exposed to various risk factors, including discrimination, marginalization, social exclusion, and responsibilities for family caregiving. The current mental health care and social service provisions can barely meet their needs. This proposed project will examine the experiences and the unmet needs of the children of patients diagnosed with severe mental illness in rural China. It addresses three major questions: What are the impacts of having a parent diagnosed with severe mental illness on the family situation and dynamics? How do the family situation and dynamics affect children living with, and/or caring for, these parents? What social services and support are required to meet the potential mental health and related socio-economic and developmental needs of these children? In collaboration with the Wuding Zhengxin Social Work Service Center, we will recruit 40 to 50 families in which there is a member suffering from severe mental illness and there are children aged 6 to 15. Using a critical realist ethnographic approach, we will collect extensive qualitative data about the lived experiences of these children and their families. The project will also involve local policy-makers and social service providers by means of in-depth interviews and workshop discussions. The comprehensive data collected will play a key role in understanding the experiences of these children and their families, and identifying their essential needs in the context of rural China. Theoretical and empirical insights generated by these data will give local government officials, mental health professionals, social service providers, and social work educators the information necessary to address relevant and timely policy issues and social service needs. Intervention and training programs that are developed based on these research findings will be applicable to many localities facing the same issues in similar contexts. 这个项目关注中国农村父母患有严重精神疾病的家庭状况、对儿童的影响和潜在的服务提供。主要的研究问题有三个：父母被诊断出患有严重精神疾病对家庭状况和动态有怎样的影响？家庭状况和动态如何影响同住和/或照顾父母的孩子？什么社会服务和支持可以满足这些孩子的心理健康和相关的社会经济和发展需求？我们将与正心社会工作服务中心合作，招募40至50个家庭，父或母患有严重的精神疾病，有6至15岁的儿童。使用批判现实主义民族志方法，我们将收集有关这些孩子及其家人经历的定性数据。该项目还将通过深入访谈及研讨会讨论与当地的政策制定者和社会服务提供机构一起推动政策倡导和服务提供。

15601022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601022.value: 有特殊教育需要的兒童和兒童受傷害

15601022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601022.value: Prof Brownridge, Douglas A. Dr CHEN, Mengtong Dr Ho, Frederick Ka Wing Prof Ip, Patrick Prof Lo, Kin Ming Camilla

15601022.label: Project Objectives
15601022.value: To estimate the prevalence of child (poly)victimization among children with different types and severities of special educational needs (SEN). To investigate the associations between SEN and (poly)victimization; in particular, whether children with SEN are at higher risk of (poly)victimization than children without SEN, and whether exposure to different types of victimization and polyvictimization varies according to SEN types. To examine the roles of child-related factors (health-related quality of life and social integration) and family-related factors (male dominance, Chinese face, parental stress, IPV victimization, and father involvement in childcare) in the association between SEN and (poly)victimization.
rows: To estimate the prevalence of child (poly)victimization among children with different types and severities of special educational needs (SEN).

To investigate the associations between SEN and (poly)victimization; in particular, whether children with SEN are at higher risk of (poly)victimization than children without SEN, and whether exposure to different types of victimization and polyvictimization varies according to SEN types.

To examine the roles of child-related factors (health-related quality of life and social integration) and family-related factors (male dominance, Chinese face, parental stress, IPV victimization, and father involvement in childcare) in the association between SEN and (poly)victimization.

15601022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601022.value: Background Victimization significantly impairs the mental and physical health of children with special educational needs (SEN). Previous studies fail to consider the severities of victimization and disabilities, running the risk of equating victimization experiences among mild and severe types of SEN. Moreover, little attention has been paid to family-related factors in the association between victimization and SEN. These gaps will be addressed by the proposed study. Objectives The proposed study will provide evidence by showing whether specific types of SEN are associated with particular types of victimization and polyvictimization. The roles of child-related and family-related factors in the association between having SEN and risk for (poly)victimization will be interrogated to understand potential risk and protective factors. Study Design A representative sample of 4,150 students, including 1,750 students with SEN and 2,400 students without SEN, studying at special schools, ordinary primary schools, or ordinary secondary schools in Hong Kong will be sampled using a multi-stage stratified procedure. Parents/guardians of students studying in Primary 1 to Secondary 6 will be recruited as respondents for the proposed study. Students in secondary school who can respond to a short questionnaire regarding their experiences with victimization will be invited to complete a brief survey. The parent version of the questionnaire will include items on child-related factors (health-related quality of life and social integration) and family-related factors (male dominance, Chinese face, parental stress, IPV victimization, and father involvement in childcare), to examine their role in the association between SEN and (poly)victimization. Contributions of the Study The proposed study will extend existing knowledge on the victimization of children with SEN by providing empirical evidence of the possible mechanisms underlying the increased risk of (poly)victimization. By including different types and severities of SEN and victimization in the analysis, we will identify the profile of victimization and associated factors that are essential for understanding and preventing victimization in this vulnerable population. Specifically, it could inform risk stratification and identify students with SEN who are most likely to benefit from risk and care management. The findings of the proposed study will contribute to education by introducing a safety protocol in schools. We will engage with the Education Bureau for the inclusion of the safety protocol in the procedural guide which is the existing protocol for all relevant government departments, NGOs and schools for responding to child abuse. We will improve the procedural guide by including specific and needed information related to the victimization of students with SEN. 研究背景 兒童受傷害嚴重影響有特殊教育需要（special educational needs, SEN）兒童的身心健康。目前尚未有研究考察兒童受傷害的嚴重性與殘疾之間的關係，因而可能存在將輕度和重度SEN所經歷的傷害程度等同的風險。此外，較少研究探討家庭相關因素在兒童受傷害嚴重性和SEN之間的作用。本研究擬解決這些不足。 研究目標 本研究將考察特定類型的SEN是否與特定類型的（多重）傷害有關。我們也將進一步探討兒童和家庭相關的保護性和危險性因素在SEN和（多重）傷害之間所起的作用。 研究設計 本研究將采用多階段分層抽樣的方法，調查4,150名有代表性的學生樣本，包括1,750名在香港特殊學校、普通小學或普通中學就讀的有特殊教育需要的學生，以及2,400名沒有特殊教育需要的學生。我們將招募小一至中六學生的家長/監護人，並同時邀請能夠填寫關於傷害經歷問卷調查的中學生參與研究。父母版本的問卷將包括兒童相關因素(健康相關的生活質量和社會融合)和家庭相關因素(男性主導地位，中國人的面子，父母壓力，親密關係暴力和父親參與育兒)，以考察這些因素在SEN和（多重）傷害之間的作用。 研究貢獻 本項目將擴展SEN領域已有的成果，為（多重）傷害的風險增加的潛在機制提供實證證據。我們通過理清不同類型及嚴重程度的SEN與傷害的關系來鑒別傷害的概況及其相關的因素，這將有助於我們理解和預防該弱勢群體所受到的傷害。具體而言，研究結果將揭示不同的風險層級以辨別最有可能從護理風險管理中受益的SEN兒童。此項目也將促進教育，為學校引入安全草案提供參考。研究團隊將與教育局討論協商將此安全草案納入到現有相關政府部門、非政府組織和學校應對虐童事件的程序指南中。我們將考慮納入SEN兒童受傷害的具體和必要的信息以改良現有的服務程序。

15601322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601322.value: 對污染者付費原則在控制航運溫室氣體排放中的應用潛力和問題的批判性評估

15601322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601322.value: Various measures have been adopted to control Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions from shipping, including measures adopted by the International Maritime Organization (IMO), and those adopted at domestic/regional levels. Nevertheless, there is an alarming increase in negative impacts on climate change as a result of GHG emissions from shipping. It is clearer than ever that a more effective approach to controlling GHG emissions from shipping is urgently needed. According to research surrounding the polluter-pays principle (PPP) and its function, the polluter shall, inter alia, pay: (1) the costs of pollution control by authorities; (2) the emergency response and clean-up costs; and (3) compensation to pollution victims. It is argued that PPP is reflected in the ship-source pollution law in different ways: some laws may take a preventive approach, including prevention measures and charges with consequences for failure to comply, whereas some others use a curative approach by imposing civil liability and compensation for environmental damage. As a result, the role that the PPP plays, if any, in the regime for controlling GHG emissions from shipping, is thus questionable. However, despite a wealth of literature surrounding the PPP and its function, as well as the many discussions about measures for controlling GHG emissions from shipping, there still lacks an in-depth study on the inter-relations between the PPP and ship emissions, particularly as to the role that the PPP plays, if any, in the regime, and as to how this principle can be better applied for the control of shipping emissions. Accordingly, this proposed study aims to fill in this research gap by: (1) examining the status quo of shipping decarbonization regulations; (2) scrutinizing PPP and discussing how and to what extent it has been applied, together with the problems involved and the way forward; and (3) suggesting an effective framework and specific measures based upon PPP that will bring about more effective control of shipping emissions. The aim and all objectives of this proposed research will be achieved within the proposed 36 months by employing different research methods, which will include a comprehensive literature review, a legal empirical study, and a legal comparative study. The study can offer theoretical and practical contributions: charting the main drawbacks in the current shipping decarbonization regulations, analysing the role that can be played by PPP, and debating how and to what extent PPP can be applied in achieving better control of GHG emissions from shipping. 包括國際海事組織以及各國或地區各個層面採取的措施，目前已經存在多種措施來控制航運造成的溫室氣體排放。儘管如此，因航運導致氣候變化的負面影響不斷增加，所以迫切需要找到更有效的方法，來減少航運對環境的影響。 根據圍繞污染者付費原則及其作用的研究，一般來說，污染者應支付：（1）污染控制費用；（2）應急回應和清理費用；以及（3）對污染受害者的賠償。這個原則以不同的形式反映在船舶污染治理的法規中：一些法律可能會採取預防措施；而其他一些則會要求相關責任人對環境損害承擔民事責任和賠償。所以，如何在航運減排的法律制度中引用這個原則是值得深入探討的。 然而，儘管有大量關於污染者付費原則以及其功能的文獻，以及關於控制航運溫室氣體排放措施的討論，但關於污染者付費原則與船舶排放的相互關係，以及如何更好地將這個原則應用於控制航運溫室氣體排放尚缺乏深入研究。因此這項擬議的研究旨在填補這一研究空白。本研究的所有研究目的和範圍將在36個月內通過採用不同的研究方法來實現。改研究可以提供理論和實踐方面的貢獻：它能展示目前航運脫碳法規存在的缺點或者局限性，分析污染者付費原則可能發揮的作用，並討論如何以及在多大程度上運用污染者付費原則以實現更好的控制和減少航運溫室氣體排放。

15602422.value: Dr Fu, Xiaoxiao Dr Liu, Tingting Dr Yu, Luodi

15602422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602422.value: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种普遍性发育障碍。多年来，人们对 ASD 的看法发生了显着变化，从被认为是一种罕见的精神疾病变成了一种相对普遍的现象，从被高度污名化到逐渐被公众接受（Grinker，2020）。鉴于他们独特的认知处理方式，ASD人群越来越多地被视为神经多样性人群而非神经典型性人群。因此，世界卫生组织在2019年呼吁社会更加关注 ASD 人群的基本人权，包括教育、健康和休闲方面的权利。 ASD 人群的庞大规模、快速增长、及其对旅游的渴望以使其成为酒店和旅游业的潜在细分市场。ASD 人群更喜欢在淡季旅行以避开人群，这有助于减少季节性对目的地和度假村的影响。ASD 人群也倾向于重复行为，因此更有可能成为忠诚的回头客。鉴于这一市场潜力，旅游业的一些部门已采取一些措施主动迎合ASD人群及其家人的需求。例如，皇家加勒比国际在 2014 年推出了一项自闭症友好计划；温哥华国际机场开发了一个资源包，以帮助ASD 人群及其家人。然而，即使得到了更多的行业关注，关于 ASD 人群旅游行为的学术研究依旧乏善可陈。 本研究旨在从批判性理论的视角探索患有ASD 儿童及其家人的亲身旅行经历。具体而言，本研究旨在揭示这一人群的出游障碍和旅游带来的益处；他们在出行前、中、后的情感体验；及其旅行经历的主观意义。本研究的研究目标将通过对ASD 人群完成的文学作品进行叙事分析、深入访谈和问卷调查来实现。 该研究还将为旅游相关企业制定ASD友好型企业指南，以帮助相关行业为ASD 人群创造一个无障碍的环境。此外，本研究也将产生社会影响。通过传播学术和非学术成果，我们希望在短期内提高该群体对其内在旅行需求的认识，进而激励利益相关者修改行业惯例，构建对ASD 人群友好的旅行环境，最终促进ASD人群和旅游行业的和谐融合。

15602622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15602622.value: 婦女衛生與日常科學：全球視野下二十世紀20至50年代的中国婦女生育與健康

15602622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15602622.value: 本研究計劃將圍繞「婦女衛生」這一概念，集中探討20世紀20至50年代婦女生育和健康如何凸顯為一個糅合了民族主義、全球科學與技術以及本土醫療實踐的多面向議題。作為一個歷史範疇，婦女衛生有兩層涵義：一是從公共衛生層面而言，指國家對發展婦女生育建立的制度、政策和採取的措施；另一層涵義則是指依託大眾媒介、現代西方醫學、中醫、全球貿易、商品以及技術而產生的一個根植於日常生活和新興消費主義的知識和實踐場域。以後者為關注點，本計劃試圖挖掘那些建立在信息、專業知識、經驗、意見和技術基礎之上的有關婦女生育的本土化努力。知識分子、專業醫療從業者、醫藥及衛生用品廣告商及製造商，甚至公眾都不同程度地介入了對婦女生育健康和衛生的討論和形塑之中。這些源自下層力量的知識和技術將會在20世紀50年代社會主義初期中國發起的關於婦嬰衛生的科普運動、以及後來更為廣闊深入的接生改革運動中得以復現和延續。 借用當下科學與技術研究領域新興的「日常科學」（vernacular science）這一概念及相關研究成果，本計劃亦將「婦女衛生」視為一個有效的分析範疇，並以此為切入點，檢視二十世紀中國全球以及本土語境中，婦女衛生與日常科學如何創造性地整合和協調以下幾個方面的矛盾和張力：專業醫學知識和本土日常實踐及信仰，全球和本土技術，以及專業技能和具體經驗。現有研究通常認為，中國近現代婦女生育文化和理念的形成主要是建立在外國醫療機構團體和人員（如傳教士和慈善機構）以及國民政府發起的生育改革運動等基礎之上。本計劃則認為，現代中國的婦女生育改革和文化其實在很大程度上受到本土而非外國的影響，其現代面貌的成型更多源自下層的努力而非國家支持和贊助的自上而下的改革。

15603422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15603422.value: 再現"海之南"：重探海南島在歷史與文化想象中的地位

15603422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15603422.value: 作為大中華地區僅次於臺灣的第二大島，海南島的形象在具有異域魅力的邊疆和具有社會經濟發展潛力的邊境之間搖擺不定。當現有的關於中國的歷史和文化研究在很大程度上以大陸為中心，這個關於海南的多種再現形式的項目卻試圖質疑並挑戰長期以來中心-週邊、大陸-島嶼、邊界-領土和陸地-海洋的概念和歷史學二元對立。無論在哪個學科，這些二元對立往往在現代中國的研究中作為範式慣例發揮作用，。 本項目涵蓋並探討了從19世紀末到20世紀80年代對海南的各種視覺和文字表述。這些表述以不同的方式構建了關於這個島嶼現實。首先，是由製圖學目光的投射而製成的海南地圖。它們包括十九世紀中期清政府的官方地圖，以及二十世紀二十年代至四十年代由一位法國傳教士、國民黨官員和 "海南之王"（一位日本商人和情報收集者）繪製的各種島嶼地圖。其次，本項目還將分析不同的權威體系製作的海南研究報告和規劃項目。這些體系包括20世紀20年代至30年代的國民黨政府，二戰期間的日本殖民政府及其臺灣機構，以及50年代中期的共產黨和國民黨政府。 在光譜的另一端，本項目還會研讀遊記和人類學文獻中發現的對海南的文字表述。在1883年至1936年期間，來自大陸的漢族人、西方遊客和探險家、日本人和黎族精英生產的文學作品。最後，項目也會討論有關於海南的視覺和電影再現。影片包括20世紀20年代和30年代的民族志紀錄片，50年代的宣傳戰爭片，60年代以女性革命者為主角的革命舞蹈和京劇電影，以及70年代關於海南華僑的文革後電影。 通過研究這些文本，本項目旨在勾勒出海南作為一個寶庫的輪廓，這一輪廓能夠為改變迄今為止被邊緣化的島嶼歷史，從而為將其置於其適當的位置提供證據和資源，並促進人們對其從19世紀到20世紀的分裂和變化的身份的關注。項目也考慮到了海南相對於大陸的從屬地位，以及它自己的大陸性，正如它與周圍群島和海外華人社區的關係中所體現出來的那樣。這些多方面的身份，在不同的表述中被建構和肯定，使島嶼流動和多孔的邊界的動態變得具體化。

15605022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15605022.value: 香港的住屋環境在貧窮對健康的影響中有何作用：混合方法研究

15605022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15605022.value: Prof Chiu, Rebecca Lai Har Dr Han, Yaeeun

15605022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15605022.value: Past research found that lower-income people’s health is inferior to that of upper-income people in Hong Kong. In view of Hong Kong’s rising poverty rate and health inequality, alleviation of potential health risks among lower-income people has received increasing policy attention. Meanwhile, many lower-income people in Hong Kong are facing acute housing difficulties posed by the notoriously unaffordable housing prices in the market and the prolonged waiting time for public rental housing (PRH) allocation. Despite the establishment of some evidence on the health effects of housing, there is a lack of comprehensive understanding of how housing, an important social determinant of health, influences in the negative impact of poverty on health. This proposed research aims to ascertain the role of housing in influencing the effects of poverty on health and examine whether and to what extent subsidised housing programs can mitigate the adverse health effects of poverty. It will build on a conceptual model of ‘housing niche’ that explains the causation of health inequalities by relating health to the residential environment and societal infrastructure (e.g., policies). An explanatory sequential mixed methods design will be used, involving collecting data through a quantitative cross-sectional survey and qualitative semi-structured interviews across PRH, transitional housing, and subdivided housing, the three major types of housing in which lower-income people live in Hong Kong. Based on the collected data, we will first establish how income poverty is associated with lower-income people’s health. Second, we will measure the breadth and severity of multidimensional housing disadvantages among lower-income people and examine whether and to what extent housing disadvantages mediate the association between income poverty and health. Third, we will explore the psychosocial, material, and behavioural pathways linking housing disadvantages and poor people’s health. Finally, we will compare the relations between poverty, housing disadvantages, pathways, and health aross the three housing types to evaluate the extent and ways that PRH and transitional housing contribute to mitigating the adverse health effects of poverty. The findings will contribute to the literature on housing and health inequality by examining the key housing factors and pathways underlying the relation between poverty and health and elucidate the context, processes, and meanings of the effects of income poverty and housing on health. This research will also inform policy formulation that aims to alleviate lower-income people’s housing difficulties and reduce health disparity in Hong Kong. 過往研究發現，香港低收入人士的健康狀況遜於高收入人士。鑑於香港貧窮率及健康不對等情況增加，政策越來越著重於減輕低收入人群的潛在健康風險。同時，由於樓價難以負擔，加上公屋輪候時間過長，香港有不少低收入人士正面臨嚴重的住屋困難。雖然已有一些證據可證實住屋對健康的影響，但對於住屋這個健康的重要社會因素如何左右貧窮對健康的負面影響，仍欠缺全面的了解。 這項擬議的研究目的在於確定住屋在左右貧窮對健康的影響方面有何作用，並探討住屋補貼計劃是否可以減輕貧窮對健康的不利影響，以及其效用之高低。本研究將以「住屋利基」概念模型為基礎，該模型透過聯繫健康與居住環境及社會基礎設施（例如政策），解釋健康不對等的原因。研究將採用解釋型序列混合方法設計，包括透過對公屋、過渡性房屋及劏房這三種香港低收入人群居住的主要住屋類型的量化橫向調查及質化半結構式訪談收集數據。 我們將根據收集到的數據，首先確定收入貧窮與低收入人群健康的關係。其次，我們將會衡量低收入人群中多方面住屋弊病的範圍及嚴重程度，並探討住堅弊病是否會調節收入貧窮與健康之間的關聯，以及該調節效果的高低。第三，我們將會探究連結住屋弊病與窮人健康的心理、物質及行為途徑。最後，我們將比較三種住屋類型下的貧窮、住屋弊病、途徑及健康評估之間的關係，以評估公屋及過渡性房屋對減輕貧窮對健康產生不利影響的程度及方式。 透過研究決定貧窮與健康之間關係的關鍵住屋因素及途徑，並闡明收入貧窮及住屋對健康影響的背景、過程及意義，這些發現將有助於住屋及健康不對等的相關研究。這項研究亦將為政策制定提供更多資訊，以緩解香港低收入人群的住屋困難及縮小健康差距。

15605522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15605522.value: 獲認可護士課程中學生的經驗和選擇：香港高等教育改革中的職業／專業培訓

15605522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15605522.value: Dr Cheung, Kin Prof Siu, Judy Yuen-man

15605522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15605522.value: 最近幾十年香港迎來了高等教育的大規模擴充，越來越多的年輕男女，特別是來自低下層家庭和公開考試成績不理想者，都有機會接受專上教育。同時，專上教育課程亦變得更多元化。學生可以通過選擇各種不同的課程而獲取不同種類和等級的資歷、職業路徑和向上流動的機會。與其選擇某些學術課程，許多人寧願進入新興的專業課程（以前稱為職業課程），以便獲取專業資歷以及一份穩定高薪的工作。本計劃旨在探討高等教育中專業／職業培訓學生的撰擇決定、學習經驗，以及向上流動的策略。

15605822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15605822.value: 個人化飲食行為改善計劃 ± 運動訓練 改善 社區長者的肌少型肥胖症：隨機對照試驗

15605822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15605822.value: Prof KOR, Pui Kin Patrick Prof Lai, Claudia Kam Yuk Dr Lee, Paul Hong Prof LO, Ka Hei Kenneth Prof Ng, Sheung Mei Shamay Prof Woo, Jean

15605822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15605822.value: 肌少型肥胖症一旦出現，可以令身體各方面互相影響，大大增加長者患心臟代謝疾病，身體其他疾患，住院和死亡的風險。相比單獨的肌肉減少症或肥胖症，肌少型肥胖症對長者健康的影響更甚，而其患病普遍率分別高達20.4%(女性)和27%(男性)。 有效的改善方案必需要能增加患者的肌肉量同時又減少其體內脂肪。現時的研究顯示運動比營養管理更有效改善肌少型肥胖症的問題。營養管理的成效不一致，可能是由於研究實行的時間短，研究參與者對營養建議的遵從性低。營養改善方案是否成功，取決於參與者對飲食方案的堅持，故此，必須加入促進參與者堅持飲食行為改變的技巧，以使營養管理方案成功。 本研究的目標是探討配合個人而設計的飲食行為改善方案和運動訓練 (同時或個別進行) 如何幫助患有肌少型肥胖症長者，改善身體狀況和功能。研究團隊建議的飲食改善方案採用經測試證明有效的「健康行動過程」模型，加入行為改變技巧，以提升參與者的自我健康管理效能。 研究是一項四組隨機對照試驗，招募 380 名肌少型肥胖症長者，參與者會隨機分配到以下四組的其中一組： • 結合組：提供為期 24 週的結合方案，包括：配合個人情況制定飲食行為改善方案和運動訓練。 • 運動組：提供為期 20 週的運動訓練。 • 飲食行為改善組：提供為期 24 週 的 飲食行為改善方案，加上健康講座。 • 對照組：提供有關的健康講座 。 研究團隊預期結合組、運動組和飲食行為改善組的參與者在接受方案後，效果會顯著較對照組的參與者更佳。此外，結合組參與者會比其他三組有更大的改進。 本研究團隊提出的方案如證實能夠有效協助長者減輕或預防肌少型肥胖症，對公共衛生的影響會十分深遠，日後亦可以根據本研究所之結果，為其他人士如：患有肌肉減少症、肥胖或有體弱症狀人士制定類似治療方案。

15607622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15607622.value: 年齡對心理理論的影響：一項使用適合老齡和文化情境的心理理論評估工具的研究

15607622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15607622.value: Dr CAO, Yuan Prof Chan, Raymond Chor-kiu Prof Pachana, Nancy Ann Dr Wang, Yi

15607622.label: Project Objectives
15607622.value: To design an age- and context- appropriate assessment tool for examining theory of mind in older adults. To the best of our knowledge, no such tool currently exists. We will therefore develop and validate a theory-of-mind assessment tool that is suitable for use with young and older adults. This tool will comprise social interaction scenarios that are familiar to people at either end of the adulthood continuum, and will be invaluable for future research and clinical applications. This tool will operationalise theory of mind as having four components (viz., cognitive-first order, cognitive second-order, affective first-order, and affective second-order), rather than treating it as a unitary construct. To understand the underlying mechanism of age differences in theory of mind, which is a notable gap in the research in this field. In particular, we will examine whether theory of mind is affected by familiarity, cognitive ability or the level of emotional motivation involved in a task. The resulting findings will enhance our understanding about theory of mind.
rows: To design an age- and context- appropriate assessment tool for examining theory of mind in older adults. To the best of our knowledge, no such tool currently exists. We will therefore develop and validate a theory-of-mind assessment tool that is suitable for use with young and older adults. This tool will comprise social interaction scenarios that are familiar to people at either end of the adulthood continuum, and will be invaluable for future research and clinical applications. This tool will operationalise theory of mind as having four components (viz., cognitive-first order, cognitive second-order, affective first-order, and affective second-order), rather than treating it as a unitary construct.
