16102322.value: 使用實時三維納米精度跟踪顯微鏡研究單個 GABA 能突觸小泡在活神經元中自發釋放的胞吐作用和遷移率

16102322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16102322.value: Prof Kang, Byung-Ho Prof Yung, Wing Ho

16102322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16102322.value: Neurons communicate by releasing neurotransmitters from synaptic vesicles in presynaptic terminals. Recent studies have shown that the spontaneous (i.e., activity-independent) release of neurotransmitters plays an important role in neuronal function and in synaptic development. Moreover, impaired spontaneous release of synaptic vesicles has been implicated in several neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders. However, our understanding of spontaneous synaptic vesicle release is quite limited. Specifically, the exocytosis and mobility of single inhibitory synaptic vesicles undergoing spontaneous release has not been investigated, even though spontaneous release occurs frequently in mature inhibitory synapses and given that inhibitory synaptic transmission plays a critical role in maintaining the delicate balance between neuronal excitation and inhibition. Importantly, changes in this balance have been shown to underlie several neurological disorders, including autism spectrum disorder, schizophrenia, and epilepsy. Recently, we built an advanced real-time three-dimensional nanometer-accuracy tracking microscope, which allows us to track single synaptic vesicles loaded with a quantum dot (QD) with an accuracy of ~20-30 nm in three dimensions. Using this microscope, we have studied the exocytosis and mobility of single synaptic vesicles in living neurons and found that synaptic vesicles from the readily releasable pool (RRP) in excitatory synapses lie close to their fusion sites. Furthermore, we specifically labeled GABA-containing vesicles in inhibitory mature neurons and found that their evoked release is highly dynamic, providing rapid inhibitory synaptic transmission without synaptic fatigue in the neuronal network. However, the exocytosis and mobility of single inhibitory vesicles undergoing spontaneous release has not been investigated, limiting our knowledge regarding inhibitory neurotransmission and underlying neurological disorders. Therefore, we will test our working hypothesis that the exocytosis and/or mobility of GABAergic synaptic vesicles undergoing spontaneous release may differ from GABAergic vesicles undergoing evoked release. In this proposal, we will measure the exocytosis and mobility of single GABAergic vesicles undergoing spontaneous release in rat mature hippocampal and striatal neurons using real-time three-dimensional nanometer-accuracy tracking microscope, electron microscopy, and electrophysiology. We will also examine the release sites of spontaneously releasing GABAergic synaptic vesicles. Finally, we will examine whether and how neuronal activity affects the exocytosis and/or mobility of GABAergic synaptic vesicles labeled via spontaneous release. These results will provide new important insights into differences between spontaneously releasing GABAergic vesicles and vesicles undergoing evoked release. Thus, this project will advance our understanding of inhibitory neurotransmission and facilitate the development of new therapeutic approaches for treating a number of neurological disorders associated with altered inhibitory neurotransmission. 神經元通過從突觸前末端的突觸小泡釋放神經遞質進行交流。最近的研究表明，神經遞質的自發（即與活動無關）釋放在神經元功能和突觸發育中起著重要作用。此外，突觸小泡的自發釋放受損與幾種神經發育和精神疾病有關。然而，我們對自發突觸小泡釋放的理解非常有限。具體而言，尚未研究在抑制性神經元中自發釋放的單個囊泡的胞吐作用和流動性，儘管自發釋放經常發生在成熟的抑制性突觸中，並且鑑於抑制性突觸傳遞在維持神經元興奮和抑制之間的微妙平衡中起著關鍵作用.重要的是，這種平衡的變化已被證明是幾種神經系統疾病的基礎，包括自閉症譜系障礙、精神分裂症和癲癇症。 最近，我們構建了一種先進的實時三維納米精度跟踪顯微鏡，它使我們能夠在三個維度上以約 20-30 納米的精度跟踪裝載有量子點 (QD) 的單個突觸小泡。使用這台顯微鏡，我們研究了活神經元中單個突觸小泡的胞吐作用和移動性，發現興奮性突觸中易釋放池 (RRP) 中的突觸小泡靠近它們的融合位點。此外，我們特別標記了抑制性成熟神經元中含有 GABA 的囊泡，發現它們的誘發釋放是高度動態的，在神經元網絡中提供快速抑制性突觸傳遞而沒有突觸疲勞。然而，尚未研究自發釋放的單個抑制性囊泡的胞吐作用和流動性，這限制了我們對抑制性神經傳遞和潛在神經系統疾病的了解。 因此，我們將檢驗我們的工作假設，即自發釋放的 GABA 能突觸小泡的胞吐作用和/或流動性可能與誘發釋放的 GABA 能小泡不同。在本提案中，我們將使用實時三維納米精度跟踪顯微鏡、電子顯微鏡和電生理學測量大鼠成熟海馬和紋狀體神經元中單個 GABA 能囊泡自發釋放的胞吐作用和流動性。我們還將檢查自發釋放 GABA 能突觸小泡的釋放部位。最後，我們將檢查神經元活動是否以及如何影響自發釋放標記的 GABA 能突觸小泡的胞吐作用和/或移動性。 這些結果將為自發釋放 GABA 能囊泡和經歷誘發釋放的囊泡之間的差異提供新的重要見解。因此，該項目將促進我們對抑制性神經傳遞的理解，並促進開發新的治療方法來治療與抑制性神經傳遞改變相關的許多神經系統疾病。

16102422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16102422.value: Growing plant is able to perceive both internal and external force signals to shape its growth pattern. In response to various forms of forces, the whole plants undergo developmental and morphological alterations, i.e. thigmomorphogenesis. These morphological changes also occur at both cell and tissue levels. Some of these changes are able to enhance plants’ resistance to pathogens. In the case of directional movement, such as touch force-guided root growth, the plant organ goes around the physical barrier through the thigmotropic response. In the case of thigmonasty, the force-induced organ movements, such as tendril curling and/or leaf movement, the direction of organ movement is independent to the source of force signal. Although it has been shown that a touch force signal is able to induce a calcium spike, and the gene expression in plants is rapidly up-regulated in response to a mechanical stimulation, little is known about the sensors of force signals, calcium-dependent protein kinase pathways and force-signaling components in plants. To identify the early force signaling components and PTM proteins in response to touch-specific calcium spike, we have performed SILIA-based quantitative phosphoproteomic analysis on 40-sec force stimulated Arabidopsis previously. As a result, we have identified a total of 24 force-responsive phosphopeptide groups, many of which are indeed kinases and phosphatases, which may constitute a sophisticated network of phosphor-relay mediating force signal transduction (Figure 1). In this study, we propose to apply 4C quantitative interactomics, molecular genetics and cell biology to study the functions of interactors of a representative calcium dependent protein kinase (CDPK), a putative force signaling component discovered from our previous PTM phosphoproteomics. The molecular and cellular roles of this CDPK and its immediate interactors will be elucidated for their function in force signaling. We will aim at identifying the substrates of the calcium dependent protein kinase or/and the regulators of the CDPK and performing molecular, cellular and reverse genetic studies on these mass spectrometry-identified CDPK's interactor(s). This multidisciplinary approach should clarify some roles of force signaling components in the mechano-response of Arabidopsis. The molecular and cellular study of the important major component(s) of the mechanically responsive phosphoproteome will provide information on the molecular mechanisms, post-translational modification networks and protein-protein interactions underlying thigmotropism, thigmonasty and thigmomorphogenesis. We expect that these findings will contribute to our understanding of the complex force signaling and to the enhancement of crop productivity for providing food security for billions of people around the world. 生长中的植物能够感知内外力信号来塑造其生长模式。响应各种形式的力，整株植物经历发育和形态的变化。这些形态变化也发生在细胞和组织水平。其中一些变化能够增强植物对病原体的抵抗力。在定向运动的情况下，例如触摸力引导的根系生长，植物器官通过触动反应绕过物理屏障。在 触须运动的情况下，力引起的器官运动，例如卷须和/或叶片运动，器官运动的方向与力信号的来源无关。尽管已经表明触摸力信号能够诱导钙尖峰，并且植物中的基因表达响应于机械刺激而迅速上调，但人们对植物中力信号、钙依赖性蛋白激酶通路和力信号成分的传感器。 为了识别响应触摸特异性钙尖峰的早期力信号成分和 PTM 蛋白，我们之前对 40 秒力刺激的拟南芥进行了基于 SILIA 的定量磷酸蛋白质组学分析。因此，我们总共确定了 24 个力响应磷酸肽基团，其中许多确实是激酶和磷酸酶，它们可能构成一个复杂的磷中继介导力信号转导网络（图 1）。在这项研究中，我们建议应用 4C 定量相互作用组学、分子遗传学和细胞生物学来研究代表性钙依赖性蛋白激酶 (CDPK) 的相互作用子的功能，CDPK 是从我们之前的 PTM 磷酸蛋白质组学中发现的推定的力信号成分。该 CDPK 及其直接相互作用物的分子和细胞作用将被阐明它们在力信号传导中的功能。我们的目标是确定钙依赖性蛋白激酶的底物或/和 CDPK 的调节剂，并对这些质谱鉴定的 CDPK 相互作用物进行分子、细胞和反向遗传学研究。这种多学科方法应该阐明力信号成分在拟南芥机械响应中的一些作用。对机械响应性磷酸化蛋白质组的重要主要成分的分子和细胞研究将提供有关趋触向性、触须和触须形态发生的分子机制、翻译后修饰网络和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的信息。我们希望这些发现将有助于我们理解复杂的力信号，并有助于提高作物生产力，为全球数十亿人提供粮食安全。

16102522.value: 通過網絡生物學研究 MAP3K3突變的腦海綿狀血管畸形藥物再利用的關鍵調控通路和可操作靶點

16102522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16102522.value: 腦海綿狀血管瘤 (CCM) 是通常會導致顱內出血或中風的血管異常。目前主要的治療方法是手術切除，具有包括額外腦出血和神經功能缺損等嚴重的風險。因此，迫切需要開發非侵入性療法。 最近的研究顯著提高了對 CCM 發病機制的理解。 Ren等人使用小鼠模型闡明了 PIK3CA 突變可通過類癌機制促進 CCM 形成。利用全外顯子組測序，我們小組和其他人獨立描繪了CCM 的體細胞和種系突變圖譜，突出了 MAP3K3中的體細胞激活突變，該突變與三個 CCM 基因的功能喪失突變表現出相互排斥的模式。值得注意的是，與 CCM 基因缺陷的患者不同，MAP3K3 突變病例通常表現出類似爆米花的外觀，從而能夠對 CCM 病變進行非侵入性基因分型。然而，這種現象的分子機制仍然難以捉摸。在此項目中，我們將對類似爆米花樣的 CCM 病變進行系統生物學研究，以揭示關鍵的調控途徑和可操作的目標，在此基礎上建立臨床前模型，用於計算篩選 CCM 的口服藥物。 我們假設不同亞型的 CCM 具有不同的激活通路，因此對靶向治療的反應也不同，就像個性化癌症醫學中的情況一樣。憑藉在功能基因組學、系統生物學和腦血管疾病方面的廣泛專業知識，我們的團隊有能力檢驗這一假設並應對上述挑戰。作為該提案的初步研究，我們建立了一個 MAP3K3 突變斑馬魚模型，該模型在血管畸形和出血方面概括了人類的CCM 表型。此外，我們對來自 MAP3K3 突變體和野生型病例的 CCM 病變進行了單細胞 RNA 測序分析。我們的初步分析表明，MAP3K3 突變體 CCM 內皮表現出有趣的 α/γ 干擾素反應途徑活性升高。 在這個項目中，我們旨在增加患者和細胞數量以鞏固初步結果並進行全面的系統生物學分析，以構建 CCM 內皮中 MAP3K3 突變驅動的基因調控網絡。隨後將確定關鍵調控因子，在此基礎上，我們將使用分子對接和分子動力學 (MD) 模擬篩選特定的化合物。最後，將利用人內皮細胞系和 MAP3K3 突變動物模型研究優先藥物進行臨床前篩選。如果成功，我們不僅將闡明 MAP3K3 突變如何驅動爆米花樣表型，還將提供潛在臨床研究的候選化合物列表。

16102722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16102722.value: Eukaryotic cells contain membrane-bound intracellular compartments (organelles) which are comprised of distinct populations of proteins. These proteins carry out the biochemical and physiological processes necessary for the function of the organelle in which they reside. A central question in cell biology has been to understand how cells target proteins to the locations in which they function. For one organelle – the Golgi - answering this question has proven to be particularly complex. The Golgi functions as the cell’s protein sorting hub and as such Golgi-resident proteins must be identified and retained, whilst non-resident proteins directed elsewhere in the endomembrane network or be secreted from cells. Whilst the last decades have seen tremendous progress in our understanding of protein sorting mechanisms some important facets remain enigmatic. RGC-funded research from my laboratory identified Vps74p (yGOLPH3) as a sorting receptor of numerous Golgi resident membrane proteins termed glycosyltransferases. Vps74p was discovered in budding yeast cells but is an evolutionarily conserved protein whose mammalian counterpart (GOLPH3) functions similarly. The cytoplasmically orientated N-termini of some clients are known to bind Vps74p / GOLPH3 directly, but the location on Vps74p/GOLPH3 to which clients bind is yet to be established. The identification of small molecules that can inhibit Vps74/GOLPH3 client association may provide novel therapeutics (antifungals / Vps74p) and chemotherapeutic adjuvants (GOLPH3). GOLPH3 is an oncogene which is amplified in numerous cancers. We seek to identify client binding sites on Vps74p. To achieve this, we will leverage our preliminary findings which indicate that some clients (notably the glycosyltransferase Mnn4p) bind Vps74p at the same or a site directly adjacent to the location at which PI4P binding Vps74p. This observation hampers physiological studies as PI4P binding to Vps74p is required for the protein to bind to the trans Golgi, and because amino acid substitutions that disrupt PI4P binding in cells also disrupt client binding in biochemical studies. To circumvent this conundrum, we have designed a tandem version of Vps74p in which a PI4P-binding module from FAPP1 has been introduced between the Vps74p dimers together with intrinsically fluorescent protein mNeon. This construct is functional and allows uncoupling of PI4P and client binding within each of the Vps74p dimer. Using a targeted amino acid substitution approach for both biochemical and cell biological experiments we hope to establish the requirements for and location at which Mnn4p binds Vps74p. 真核生物擁有由不同群組蛋白質組成的被膜結構包裹的區域（細胞器）。這些蛋白質在它們所在細胞器中發揮了至關重要的生化與生理作用。細胞如何將蛋白質定位到它們工作的位置是一個細胞生物學中重要的問題。在高爾基體這個細胞器中，這個問題尤為複雜。在細胞中，高爾基體承擔了蛋白質分選中心的作用。因此，常駐於高爾基體的蛋白質必須被識別並且保留在這裡，而其他蛋白質會被引導到內膜網絡的其他地方或者被分泌到細胞以外。儘管在過去幾十年中，對蛋白質分選機制的研究有了很大的進展，一些重要的部分仍未被解答。在我的實驗室由RGC資助的研究中，我們發現蛋白質Vps74p（GOLPH3）是一類海量的高爾基體常駐蛋白質糖基轉移酶的分選受體。儘管蛋白Vps74p在出芽酵母菌被發現，但是這是一種在生物進化過程中被保守的蛋白質。它在哺乳動物細胞中的對應蛋白GOLPH3就擁有相似的功能。我們已知一些受質蛋白質朝向細胞質中的氨基端可以直接與蛋白Vps74p/GOLPH3結合，但是具體結合的位置還無從得知。同時，GOLPH3是一個在多種惡性腫瘤中被大量擴增的致癌基因。識別可以抑制蛋白Vps74p/GOLPH3與受質蛋白質結合的小分子化合物可能會啟發新穎的抗真菌治療方法（Vps74p）或者化療佐劑（GOLPH3）。因此我們想要先識別蛋白Vps74p上受質蛋白質的結合位點。為了達成這個目的，我們將會充分利用我們前期的一個發現：一些受質蛋白質（尤其是糖基轉移酶Mnn4p）在蛋白Vps74p上的結合位點與PI4P（磷脂酰肌醇-4-磷酸）在蛋白Vps74p上的結合位點相同或直接相鄰。這個發現給相關細胞生理學的研究帶來了難題。因為蛋白Vps74p與反面高爾基體的結合需要它與PI4P的作用，同時我們在生化實驗中也發現導致細胞中蛋白Vps74p無法與PI4P作用的氨基酸替換也干擾了它與受質蛋白質的結合。為了克服這個難題，我們設計了一個串連版本的蛋白Vps74p。其中，一個來源於蛋白FAPP1的可以與PI4P結合的結構域和自體螢光蛋白mNeon被插入了蛋白Vps74p的二聚體之間。這個構造擁有正常功能，並且可以解耦蛋白Vps74p與PI4P或是受質蛋白質的結合。之後我們就可以在生化實驗和細胞生物學實驗中使用有指向性的氨基酸替換策略，希望通過這個研究我們可以了解糖基轉移酶Mnn4p和蛋白Vps74p結合的所需條件和位點。

16102722.label: Realisation of objectives
16102722.value: All three objectives were addressed, and a manuscript describing our findings has been reviewed and conditionally accepted by the Cell Press journal “iScience). Funding of this work by the RGC is acknowledged. A PDF of the manuscript (the revised version) accompanies this report. 1. In vivo analysis of Vps74p client fate with the various VPS74 mutants Vps74 is a member of the GOLPH3 family of Golgi membrane protein sorting receptors. We identified an evolutionarily conserved region on this protein family that is predicted to be proximal to the membrane binding interface and as such a likely client interaction site. This was verified by generating a series of amino acid substitutions to these regions (variants). The vps74 variants were introduced into cells expressing 2. In vitro analysis of Vps74p client binding (Mnn4p) with the various VPS74 mutants The experiments supported our vivo studies (conducted under objective 1) and served to define the client binding site more directly (at least for one client – Mnn4). In an orthogonal approach we isolated a suit of nanobodies that bind to Vps74 (and to the human GOLPH3 proteins). This study was not one of the objectives of this proposal. One of the nanobodies were identified bound to the client binding site and as such corroborated our in vitro mixing data. These data are also included in our iScience manuscript. 3. In vitro analysis of the role of PI4P association with Vps74p and client binding Part of the client binding site also includes amino acids previously shown to be required for PI4P binding. Amino acid substitutions to these residues also disrupted client interaction with Vps74 in in vitro mixing assays. This finding indicates that the binding sites for clients and PI4P overlap with one another. Our in vitro mixing experiments with a soluble form of PI4P and Vps74 were not successful, and we could therefore not determine whether binding to PI4P is required for / augments client binding or if the two binding interactions are antagonistic. We were able to examine the effect of depleting the PI4P kinase Pik1 on client retention using Vps74-mNeon as a proxy. Pik1 was expressed as fusion to an auxin-inducible degron, and we followed loss of Golgi membrane binding of Vps74 overtime as Pik1 levels were reduced. Based on this study it seems unlikely that PI4P is required for coincident detection of clients by Vps74. 16102722.label: Major findings and research outcome
16102722.value: Vps74 and its mammalian counterpart GOLPH3 are COPI associated protein sorting adaptors that function to maintain the cisternal distributions of a diversity of Golgi integral membrane protein clients by binding to their short cytoplasmically exposed N-termini. We have successfully identified the client-binding site on yeast GOLPH3 (Vps74) which maps to two evolutionarily conserved loops on the membrane-facing surface, and includes residues mediating binding of GOLPH3s to PI4P, as well as the membrane-binding beta hairpin. As an orthogonal approach, we isolated an inhibitory anti-Vps74 nanobody (which also binds to GOLPH3s) with which we corroborate the client-binding site and reveal that Sac1 and Arf1 binding to Vps74 blocks client access. We also identified an additional mode for the recruitment of Vps74 to Golgi membranes whereby the adaptor binds directly to its client N-termini. This study elucidates the molecular mechanism of Vps74 and identifies an inhibitory GOLPH3 nanobody with potential therapeutic applications.

16102722.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16102722.value: There are two areas for follow up from this study. The first involves a more detailed investigation of the application nanobodies (or affibodies) that target the oncoprotein GOLPH3. We have already identified several nanobodies that block the ability of GOLPH3 to bind to Golgi membranes or to it protein clients. Of course, a significant challenge will be to devise methods for targeting the nanobody to tumors / cancer cells. Additionally, nanobodies contain 1 essential pair of di-sulfide bonds, and such bonds form poorly in the cytoplasm (where GOLPH3 / Vps74) reside. This is not an issue for affibodies. We will generate a synthetic surface display library and screen for affibodies that block the function of GOLPH3 in cells. The second area for potential follow-up is to identify the kinases / phosphatase involved in phosphorylation of the N-terminus of Vps74 / GOLPH3. Many of these sites (which have been mapped) are likely to be evolutionarily conserved. It will be interesting to establish how if this post translational modification modulates the activity of Vps74 / GOLPH3. The use of proximal labeling methods such as Turbo-ID should be able to identify candidate kinases / phosphatase.

16102722.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16102722.value: Vps74 and its mammalian counterpart GOLPH3 are COPI associated protein sorting adaptors that function to maintain the cisternal distributions of a diversity of Golgi integral membrane proteins. Most protein residents of the Golgi are involved in a process term glycosylation. Glycosylation is an enzymatic reaction in which sugars are added to proteins as well as to various components that make up biological membranes – lipids. The composition and distribution of Golgi resident proteins is crucial for normal cell function. A key question to be answered about the Golgi then is: How are resident proteins retained in this organelle? In this study we identify the binding site for a subset of Golgi membranes on the sorting adaptor Vps74. We also show that this bindings site is also conserved on the Vps74’s mammalian equivalent – GOLPH3/3L. GOLPH3 is an oncogene, and amplification of GOLPH3 in tumors is a poor prognostic marker of treatment outcome. Our findings provide novel insight into the function of the GOLPH3 family proteins and identify a reagent (a nanobody) with possible therapeutic applications.

16103122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16103122.value: 在人口老齡化加速的背景下，老齡化相關的慢性疾病現已成為全球人類的一類主要致死因素。由於阿爾茨海默症（AD）在老年人群中的發病率高且無有效干預措施，已成為一類主要的健康威脅。現有遺傳和流行病學研究表明AD是一種遺傳性疾病，且具有許多遺傳風險因子調控人群罹患AD的風險。在眾多遺傳風險因子中，載脂蛋白E ε4等位基因（APOE-ε4）作為與疾病最相關且研究最熱門的AD遺傳風險因子，其在不同人群中對AD風險具有不同程度的影響作用。值得注意的是，我們最近的研究表明，載脂蛋白E （APOE）基因座周圍的非編碼區域對調節AD風險和APOE表達水平等方面起到關鍵作用。更進一步，我們鑑定出由APOE-ε4標記的長片段單倍體基因型，其與APOE-ε4相比具有更強的AD風險效應，並且在不同人群中具有出不同的頻率（Zhou等人，自然-通訊，2019年）。這些證據共同表明APOE基因座周圍的非編碼遺傳因子在調控APOE-ε4 相關的AD風險中具有重要作用。然而直到現在，我們尚不清楚具體有哪些遺傳因素能調控APOE-ε4 相關的AD風險，以及該過程中潛在的生物學機制。 因此，在這項擬定的研究中，我們希望通過對我們已收集及已發表的AD遺傳學隊列開展關聯分析，以鑑定出能調控APOE-ε4 AD風險的遺傳因子（包括突變位點以及單倍體基因型）。隨後我們將通過對組織和單細胞水平開展基因型─表達水平的關聯分析，探究這些遺傳因子是否能調節APOE的表達水平。更進一步，我們將通過數據分析及實驗手段探究這些遺傳因子調節APOE表達的潛在機制。首先，我們將通過查詢表觀遺傳學數據庫來探尋這些鑑定出的遺傳因子是否位於基因表達的調控區域。然後，我們將通過查詢轉錄因子數據庫以及開展基於人工智能的計算機模擬分析，探究這些遺傳因子是否能影響特定轉錄因子與DNA的結合。此外，我們將通過開展電泳遷移變動分析（EMSA）以及微量熱泳動(MST)驗證這些遺傳因子對轉錄因子結合DNA的影響效果。特別地，為了研究特定的轉錄因子是如何調節APOE的表達，我們將使用染色質免疫沉澱測序（ChIP-seq）探尋其在人腦組織中是否與特定基因組區域（表達調控區域或包含候選遺傳因子的區域）相結合。最後，我們將在人源神經細胞模型中敲除或過度表達特定轉錄因子，並對APOE表達水平進行檢測，從而探究特定轉錄因子對APOE表達的調控作用。這些發現對於闡明APOE在人體的調節機制，以及APOE-ε4在AD和其他相關人類疾病中的作用具有重要意義。

16103222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16103222.value: 生命成簇出現 — 有絲分裂驅動蛋白在四倍體化後中心體聚集的綜合分析

16103222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16103222.value: 四倍體化發生在正常發育和腫瘤生成期間。該過程的潛在機制包括有絲分裂滑移、細胞融合、核內複製和胞質分裂失敗。四倍體化後多餘的中心體會在有絲分裂過程中形成混亂的多極紡錘體。儘管如此，某些細胞類型能通過中心體聚集的機制以進行雙極有絲分裂，使它們能夠避免四倍體化後的染色體不穩定性。數種有絲分裂驅動蛋白已被證明或涉及多餘中心體的聚集。這些包括正端導向驅動蛋白如 KIF11 和 KIF15，以及負端導向驅動蛋白 KIFC1。協調中心體聚集的精確途徑在很大程度上仍未得到解決。解決這些問題的部分挑戰可歸咎於可用工具的限制和所涉及重疊路徑的數量。使用包括透過有絲分裂滑移、細胞融合和胞質分裂失敗誘導四倍體化在內的策略，我們計劃研究不同驅動蛋白在經常進行多極有絲分裂的細胞中的作用。通過利用嶄新的基因組編輯和誘導型降解決定子工具，我們計劃創建不同有絲分裂驅動蛋白的條件缺陷以系統地描述它們在中心體聚集中的貢獻。另一個研究方向將是探究四倍體化後肝細胞通常更傾向于雙極有絲分裂的分子基礎。最後，我們計劃研究在有絲分裂過程中不同有絲分裂驅動蛋白的蛋白水解是如何被後期促進複合體/周期體調節。由於有絲分裂驅動蛋白在正常和異常細胞分裂中都發揮著重要作用，並且與抗癌療法有著錯綜複雜的聯繫，破譯它們在編排多餘中心體聚集中確切的功能範圍將對健康和疾病產生深遠的影響。

16103522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16103522.value: 斑马鱼的视觉触发僵立行为与刺激选择

16103522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16103522.value: All animals have a common set of responses to threatening stimuli, including freezing or escaping. Many species respond to a potential but not immediate threat by becoming motionless, or freezing, whereas a rapidly approaching predator will trigger escape. The decision to execute these defensive behaviors must be balanced against the need to find food, which can put the animal at risk. Within vertebrate systems, it remains unknown how animals decide whether to feed, freeze, or flee. We propose to use zebrafish larvae as a model system to investigate how freezing behavior is evoked by visual stimuli. Zebrafish have a relatively simple visual system, and we can take advantage of genetic tools to label and manipulate neurons. In addition, zebrafish larvae are transparent, which facilitates functional imaging in the intact organism. We will first characterize visually induced freezing, and then use functional imaging to identify the neurons that respond to the stimulus and are activated when larvae freeze. We will artificially activate these neurons to verify their role in the behavior. We will then investigate how freezing interacts with hunting behavior, and whether the neurons that control hunting are inhibited by the freezing stimulus. These experiments will describe a novel visual behavior in zebrafish, and shed light on how the neurons controlling different behaviors interact to produce the most adaptive response. 所有动物对威胁性刺激都会有一套共同的防御反应，包括僵立或逃跑。许多物种对潜在但并非直接的威胁的反应是变得一动不动，也称僵立，而当捕食者迅速靠近时，会引发动物的逃跑行为。寻找食物的需求会让动物处于危险之中，因此动物需要在防御行为与觅食需求之间取得平衡。我们仍然无法知道脊椎动物是如何决策是否进食，僵立，或者逃跑的。 我们提出使用斑马鱼幼鱼作为模式动物来研究僵立行为是如何被视觉刺激触发的。斑马鱼有一套相对简单的视觉系统，我们可以利用遗传工具来标记和操纵神经元。此外，斑马鱼幼鱼是透明的，这有利于在完整的生物体内进行功能成像。我们将首先描述视觉触发的僵立行为特征，然后使用功能成像来分别确立对视觉刺激作出反应和幼鱼僵立时激活的神经元。我们将人工激活这些神经元以验证它们在行为中的作用。然后，我们将研究僵立与捕猎行为如何相互作用，以及控制捕猎的神经元是否被僵立视觉刺激所抑制。这些实验将描述斑马鱼的一种新的视觉行为，并阐明控制不同行为的神经元如何相互作用以产生最适应的反应。

16103622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16103622.value: PRRC1和FAM84B在COPII介導的內質網輸出中的功能

16103622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16103622.value: 分泌路徑是真核細胞中必不可少的細胞過程。外殼蛋白複合物 II(COPII) 調節貨物蛋白從內質網(ER)的輸出。這個過程是分泌途徑的第一步。高效的COPII介導的ER輸出依賴於COPII在ER膜上的組裝和拆卸。COPII在ER膜上的組裝促進COPII 將貨物蛋白裝入ER產生的囊泡中。COPII的拆卸使得COPII的亞基從ER膜上釋放出來，釋放出來的COPII亞基可以行駛下一次貨物篩選。 SAR1是調節COPII組裝和拆卸的主要蛋白。GTP結合的SAR1通過招募SEC23/24異二聚體啟動COPII組裝，形成內層COPII。隨後，內層COPII招募SEC13/31異四聚體，它可以聚合併驅動膜變形以產生COPII囊泡。SAR1的GTP水解觸發COPII分解。最近，我們開發了一種大規模的囊泡形成結合定量質譜分析的實驗方法。利用這種方法，我們發現兩種細胞溶質蛋白（FAM84B 和 PRRC1）以GTP依賴性的方式與囊泡膜結合併調節ER輸出，但其機制尚不清楚。 我們的分析表明PRRC1定位於ER的出口 (ERES)並與COPII相互作用。FAM84B也與 COPII有相互作用。PPRC1的敲低增強了COPII在膜上的組裝，而FAM84B的敲低降低了COPII的膜組裝。因此，我們假設PRRC1和FAM84B是調節COPII在ER膜上的拆卸和組裝的細胞溶質因子。為了驗證這一假設，我們將首先揭示依賴PRRC1或FAM84B被富集到COPII囊泡中的貨物蛋白。然後我們將測試PRRC1和FAM84B是否調節COPII 在ER膜上的拆卸和組裝。隨後，我們將揭示PRRC1和FAM84B如何調節COPII在ER 膜上的拆卸和組裝的分子機制。這些分析將闡明調節COPII膜結合的細胞過程，為真核細胞分泌途徑提供重要見解。

16103822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16103822.value: Stem cells support normal development and maintain adult tissue homeostasis through their ability to self-renew and generate differentiated cells. In the organisms ranging from Drosophila to humans, concerted actions of the niche and intrinsic factors are known to be critical for stem cell development. Niche-derived signals control both stem cell self-renewal and multi-lineage differentiation by working with critical intrinsic factors [1]. The Drosophila ovary is an effective model for studying stem cell self-renewal and differentiation at the molecular and cellular level because of versatile genetic tools and exceptional cell biology. RNA 5-methylcytosine (5mC) is one of the most abundant RNA modifications in eukaryotic cells, and it has been shown to regulate mRNA stability and nuclear export in the vertebrate embryo and cancer cells [2]. Our recent publication has shown that 5mC-containing mRNAs are abundant in the Drosophila ovary, and that cold-shock domain-containing protein Yps, which preferentially recognizes 5mC RNAs, controls germline stem cell (GSC) maintenance and differentiation, indicating the importance of the 5mC RNA modification in adult stem cell development [3]. Human homolog YBX1 can functionally replace Yps to support Drosophila GSC development, confirming their functional conservation from Drosophila to humans [3]. Although many protein-coding mRNAs in germ cells carry 5mC RNA modifications, it remains largely unclear how these modifications modulate the expression of individual proteins for controlling GSC maintenance and differentiation. Our preliminary study discovered that yps genetically interacts with bam, which encodes a master differentiation factor, to promote GSC progeny differentiation. Yps physically associates with Piwi family proteins, Piwi and Aub, and is likely required in germ cells to repress transposable elements (TEs) and thus maintain genome stability. Yps also interacts with the proteins involved in RNA binding, splicing and translation, suggesting that RNA 5mC modification utilizes multiple molecular mechanisms in controlling germline development. Finally, we have also identified potential 5mC methyltransferase responsible for the 5mC RNA modification in the Drosophila ovary. Based on our published and preliminary studies, this project is designed to investigate the functions of the 5mC RNA modification in regulating GSC lineage development by studying Yps and other new 5mC RNA pathway components. Therefore, this work will provide novel insight into the biological importance and regulatory mechanisms of the newly discovered mRNA 5mC modification in adult stem cell development. The knowledge gained from this study could benefit to the stem cell-based therapy for degenerative diseases and the fight against cancer and aging. 幹細胞具有自我更新和分化的能力，能夠支持正常發育並維持成体組織的穩態。從果蠅到人類，微环境和內在因子的協同作用對乾細胞發育至關重要。微环境來源的信號通過與關鍵內源因子協同工作，來控制干細胞自我更新和多譜系分化。果蠅卵巢是在分子和細胞水平上研究幹細胞自我更新與分化的優異模型，因為它具有豐富多樣的遺傳工具和卓越的細胞生物學特性。核糖核酸(RNA) 5-甲基胞嘧啶 (5mC) 是真核細胞中最豐富的RNA修飾之一，已被證明可調節脊椎動物胚胎和癌細胞中的 mRNA 穩定性和細胞核輸出。我們最近發表的研究表明，果蠅卵巢中含有豐富的含有 5mC修飾的mRNA。含有冷休克結構域的蛋白質YPS通過優先識別5mC RNA，控制生殖幹細胞 (GSC) 的維持和分化，表明了在成體幹細胞發育中5mC RNA修飾的重要作用。YPS在人類中的同源蛋白 YBX1可以在功能上取代YPS以支持果蠅GSC的發育，證實了它們從果蠅到人類的功能保守性。儘管生殖細胞中的許多蛋白質編碼的 mRNA 攜帶5mC修飾，但仍不清楚這些修飾如何調節單個蛋白質的表達以控制GSC維持和分化。 我們的初步研究發現，yps 與編碼關鍵分化因子的 bam 基因具有遺傳學上相互作用，以促進 GSC 後代分化。YPS還能夠與Piwi 家族蛋白 Piwi和Aub相互作用，發揮在生殖細胞中抑制轉座因子 (TE)的功能，從而維持基因組的穩定性。YPS還能夠和參與 RNA 結合、剪接和翻譯的蛋白質相互作用，這表明 RNA 5mC 修飾利用多種分子機制來控制生殖係發育。最後，我們還確定了潛在的 5mC 甲基轉移酶，負責果蠅卵巢中的 5mC RNA修飾。該項目旨在通過研究YPS和其他新的 5mC RNA 通路成分來研究 5mC RNA修飾在調節 GSC 譜係發育中的功能。因此，這項工作將為新發現的mRNA 5mC修飾在成體幹細胞發育中的生物學重要性和調控機制提供新的見解。從這項研究中獲得的知識將有助於利用乾細胞治療退行性疾病以及對抗癌症和衰老。

16104122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16104122.value: 歸納細胞質 DNA在神經退行性疾病中的特徵

16104122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16104122.value: Ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T) is a rare, devastating disorder that begins in early childhood. Patients show deterioration of motor control, compromised immune systems, and elevated incidence of cancer. Unfortunately, no cure is currently available, and A-T patients often do not survive to adulthood. The disease is caused by mutation in a key protein in DNA damage response, Ataxia Telangiectasia Mutated (ATM). While dysregulation of acquired immune systems in A-T has been long known, it was recently shown that innate immune responses are also affected. ATM activity disruption leads to the activation of inflammatory pathways in different cell types. Specifically in microglia, the immune cells of the brain, this is linked to elevated DNA in the cytoplasm. The neuroinflammation observed in A-T animal models and patients is termed “sterile inflammation”, as it occurs in the absence of invading pathogens. In a recent study, we found that upon ATM inhibition, cytoplasmic DNA (cytoDNA) is actively released from the nucleus. We developed cytoDNA-seq, an approach to capture and sequence these molecules, and found that cytoDNA are derived from AT-rich, inactive repetitive sequences. When these elements are released into the cytoplasm, they induce a potent immune response. While we characterized these sequences from ATM deficient microglia, it is unclear whether the phenomenon is shared among different cell types. Preliminary results show that ATM inhibition in other cell types, including astrocytes and mouse embryonic stem cells, similarly lead to cytoDNA accumulation. In this study, we will profile cytoDNA from a range of purified cell types in a A-T mouse model. We will analyze cytoDNA fragments from both immune and non-immune cell types. Additionally, by employing state-of-the-art epigenomic assays, we will elucidate the distinct epigenomic landscapes in terms of histone modifications and chromatin states of the nuclear sequences that are excised to produce cytoDNA in different cell types. This will provide a deeper understanding into the mechanisms of cytoDNA release. Furthermore, given our preliminary results showing that cytoDNA accumulation also occurs in a mouse model and patients of Alzheimer’s Disease (AD), another neurodegenerative disorder, we will also investigate whether cytoDNA contents differ between distinct disease models. Taken together, these experiments aim to better characterize cytoDNA and its associated immune response in neurodegenerative diseases. The resulting findings could contribute to novel strategies to combat sterile inflammation. 共濟失調毛細血管擴張症 (A-T) 是一種罕見的破壞性疾病，始於兒童早期，患者會表現出活動控制機能惡化、免疫系統受損和癌症發病率升高等的症狀。不幸的是，目前沒有治愈方法，而且 A-T 患者通常無法存活到成年。此疾病是由 DNA 損傷反應中的一種關鍵蛋白Ataxia Telangiectasia Mutated (ATM) 突變引起的。雖然由 A-T 所引起的獲得性免疫系統失調早已為人所知，但最近發現先天免疫反應也會受到影響。 在很多不同細胞類型中，中斷ATM 活動會導致炎症，特別是在大腦負責免疫的小膠質細胞中，這與在細胞質中含有大量的 DNA 有關。在 A-T 動物模型和患者中觀察到的神經炎症被稱為“無菌性炎症”，因為它發生在沒有病原體入侵的情況下。在最近的一項研究中，我們發現在抑制ATM後，細胞質 DNA (cytoDNA) 會從細胞核中釋放。之後我們開發了一種捕獲和測序這些分子的方法cytoDNA-seq，並發現 cytoDNA 來自於富含 AT 的無活性重複序列，當這些元素被釋放到細胞質中時，它們會誘發強力的免疫反應。 雖然我們從 缺少了ATM 的小膠質細胞中表徵了這些序列，但尚不清楚這種現像是否存在於其他細胞類型。初步結果表明，在星形膠質細胞和小鼠胚胎幹細胞中抑制ATM同樣會導致DNA 積累在細胞質中。所以在這項研究裏，我們將會用 A-T 小鼠模型中分析來自一系列純化細胞的細胞 DNA，以及來自免疫和非免疫細胞類型中的 cytoDNA 碎塊。此外，通過採用最先進的表觀基因組分析，我們將闡明組蛋白修飾和核序列的染色質在產生細胞 DNA後的表觀基因組景觀。這將對細胞DNA釋放機制有更深入的了解。鑑於我們的初步結果表明 cytoDNA 積累也發生在另一種神經退行性疾病阿爾茨海默病 (AD) 的患者和小鼠模型中，我們還會研究不同疾病之間的 cytoDNA 含量是否存在差異。這些實驗旨在更好地表徵神經退行性疾病中的細胞DNA及其相關的免疫反應，由此發現可能有助於對抗無菌炎症的新策略。

16201622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16201622.value: 解鎖共取代 Ba 基鈣鈦礦空氣電極的性能和穩定性機制：通往高性能可逆質子陶瓷燃料電池的途徑

16201622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16201622.value: Prof Ciucci, Francesco Prof Jung, WooChul

16201622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16201622.value: 可逆燃料電池是一種富有前途的新興技術，可以幫助向可持續的脫碳經濟過渡。這些設備在正向（燃料電池）運行期間從氫氣中產生碳中性電能，並在反向（電解池）運行期間從電能中產生氫氣，從而實現出色的熱力學效率。傳統的可逆燃料電池使用氧離子導體電解質，要求工作溫度為 800–1000 °C。如此高的溫度需要復雜的輔助系統和昂貴的材料配合，從而阻礙了商業可行性。為了降低工作溫度，可以用質子導體電解質代替氧離子導體的電解質，從而實現在 400-600°C 之間的有效運行。然而，在較低的溫度下，空氣電極緩慢的反應動力學限制了這些可逆質子陶瓷電池 (RePCCs) 的性能，使得用於 RePCCs 的空氣電極的開發成為一個至關重要的研究領域。雖然已經證明含鈷和鋇的鈣鈦礦是性能最好的空氣電極材料之一，但加入這些元素會降低鈣鈦礦的化學穩定性。這些材料背後潛在的機理仍未完全了解。特別是，尚不清楚是否以及如何優化 Co 含量和晶格應變以同時最大化性能和耐用性。 為了彌合這一差距，該項目將揭示在 RePCC 應用中含鈷和鋇的鈣鈦礦空氣電極的性能和退化的機制。將使用 BCFZ (BaCoxFe0.875-xZr0.125O3 x = 0, 0.125, 0.25) 作為模型材料進行實驗和計算相結合的研究。利用對稱電池和全 RePCC 的常規實驗將記錄 Co 含量對 BCFZ 電化學活性和穩定性的影響。同時，高度受控的外延薄膜將會在 RePCC 的特定條件下分析，以供測量材料相和成分作為 Co 含量、深度和時間的函數。同時，從頭算模擬將用於構建相圖，闡明化學物質之間的相互作用，並指導進一步的實驗分析。 最後，獲得的機理見解將用於優化 BCFZ 空氣電極的性能並製造穩定、高性能、實驗室規模的 RePCC。通過上述研究，這項工作有望驗證基礎發現和機理在現實世界中的適用性。了解這些燃料電池的降解機制將指導未來的 RePCC 研究，並促進這些有前途的設備的原型設計和商業化。

16202422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16202422.value: 植物移除對非飽和土斜坡穩定性的影響：三維離心機和數值模擬

16202422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16202422.value: Despite the beneficial effects of plant on slope stability, plant removal is inevitable for various practical reasons such as improving drivers’ line of sight of traffic, the risk of collapse of leaning slope-side trees, plant diseases and changes of land use. When plants are removed, roots (1) lose their ability to take up water and induce soil matric suction and (2) decay with time, causing a gradual reduction of the reinforcement effects in shallow soil. Although plant removal provides better visibility and improved access to the travelling public in the short term, unplanned plant removal results in slopes that are deteriorating and failing in the long term. Quantitative and scientific investigation of the effect of plant removal on slope stability is lacking. No standards or guidelines exist for any strategic plant removal scheme. A major challenge to studying this problem is the long time required for plant roots to decay (in years) and measuring time-dependent changes in the hydrology and stability of unsaturated soil slopes. This project will develop and apply novel 3-D centrifuge and numerical modelling techniques to comprehensively and systematically investigate the effects of root decay on slope destabilisation and to reveal the underlying mechanisms. New 3-D printed plastic root analogues with realistic root architecture, representative root mechanical properties and the ability to simulate root-water uptake will be created. The plastic will be chemically decomposed by various types and concentrations of solvents to simulate the effects of the decay-induced decline in root mechanical properties. The new root analogues will be used for subsequent centrifuge model tests, where the changes in hydrology and stability of unsaturated soil slopes following different plant removal patterns and different degrees of root decay under various rainfall conditions will be measured. To interpret the behaviour observed in the centrifuge, 3-D finite-element numerical modelling employing an improved constitutive unsaturated soil-root interaction model will be carried out. The new model permits the modelling of the effects of unsaturated soil-root relative movement (hence interfacial shearing) and root breakage upon shearing. The new physical and numerical modelling techniques created in this project will substantially advance researchers’ ability to model and study geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering problems related to soil-root mechanical interaction such as design of vegetated soil cover for landfills and tree stability. The new datasets generated will provide engineers with new insights into the mechanisms and conditions by which root decay can promote slope destabilisation. 儘管種植植物對提高斜坡穩定性有著積極的影響，但考慮到不同的現實因素，例如阻擋駕駛員的行車視線、斜坡傾斜導致樹木倒塌的風險、植物病害以及土地用途的轉變等，植物移除是不可避免的。隨著植物的移除，根系(1)失去了吸水的能力，從而產生土壤基質吸力，(2)隨著時間的推移衰敗，導致對淺層土壤的加固作用逐漸減小。雖然移除植物可以在短期內為遊客提供更佳的視野並改善出行條件，但長此以往，無計劃的植物移除會導致斜坡失穩。植物移除對邊坡穩定性的影響缺乏定量和科學性的研究，而目前尚未出現與植物移除決策方案有關的標准或規範。研究這個課題的一個主要挑戰是植物根系衰敗速度緩慢(以年為單位)，測量週期較長。此外，非飽和土坡的水文特徵和穩定性同樣具有實效性，相關數據的監測的時間成本較高。 本項目將採用並開展新穎的三維離心機及數值模擬技術，全面及系統地模擬根部腐爛對斜坡失穩的影響，同時研究其潛在機理。通過3D打印得到的新型塑料根類似物將具有真實的根系結構，典型的根的力學特性和模擬根吸水的能力。將塑料根狀類似物通過不同種類和濃度的溶劑進行化學分解，以模擬腐爛引起的根系力學性能下降的影響。該類新型根狀類似物將用於其後的離心機模型實驗，從中將觀測到在不同的植物移除方式/順序下以及降雨條件下不同衰敗程度的根係對非飽和土斜坡水文特質和穩定性的影響。為了解析離心機實驗中觀測到的土壤行為，本研究將採用最新創建的非飽和土-根相互作用本構模型進行三維有限元數值模擬。新模型是一個改進的 Timoshenko 梁單元，可以同時模擬根系-非飽和土的相對運動（即根的拔出破壞）和根係由於受到剪切力而產生的斷裂破壞。 本項目中新創建的物理和數值模擬方法將極大提昇科研人員在研究與非飽和土-根系力學相互作用有關的岩土和地質環境工程問題時的能力，例如垃圾填埋場植被層的設計和樹木穩定性問題。最新數據成果將為工程師在了解根系衰弱進而促進或緩解邊坡失穩的機理和條件提供新的見解。

16202722.value: 路網中基於預測的路徑規劃查詢處理方法研究

16202722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16202722.value: 數據庫管理系統（DBMS）能夠管理大量的底層數據並支撐多樣化的上層應用，而高效的查詢處理算法(Query Processing)逐漸成為數據庫管理系統的核心。 儘管數據庫管理系統可以處理複雜的查詢，並有效地從大型數據庫中檢索信息，但隨著機器學習的發展， 其所要面臨的一個新挑戰是如何高效統一地處理機器學習模型預測的數據和存儲在數據庫中的數據。在這種背景下，預測性查詢處理（Predictive Routing Query Processing）應運而生。預測性查詢處理的目的是建立一個統一的方法來查詢存儲在DBMS和模型預測的數據，以便可以(1)像傳統的數據庫系統一樣最小化數據訪問成本，(2)在給定的查詢背景下，通過必要的及時調整和適當的數據反饋來選擇最佳的預測模型。這種新的查詢優化器的目標是提高預測性查詢處理執行的效率和準確性。 在該項目中，我們主要針對路網中的預測性路由查詢處理（Predictive Routing Query Processing in Road Networks）。預測性路由查詢處理是時空數據庫、智能交通系統、智能城市、汽車導航和廣泛的基於位置的服務應用的基本構建模塊。對於一個路網來說，每個路段都可能至少對應一個成本，而路由查詢是指為給定的一對節點在路網中找到一條成本之和最小的路徑。這種成本可以是一個路段的長度，行駛時間，車輛穿越該路段的二氧化碳排放或燃料/電力消耗，也可以是交通擁堵費。目前，已有文獻中常見的解決方案假定（1）成本是靜態的（例如，路段長度，從限速得出的旅行時間或從歷史數據計算的平均旅行時間），或假定（2）成本函數是靜態的（即使用預定義的函數f=(t, e)來返迴路段e在起始時間t時的成本）。對於大多數應用來說，假設成本是靜態的是不切實際的，因此近年來人們也進行了關於時間依賴的路由查詢處理（Time-dependent Routing Query Processing）的研究。然而，如果只使用預定義的成本函數，時間依賴的路由查詢處理仍然不實用，因為它們不能適應實時信息（如e附近或靠近時間t時的交通數據）。 為解決以上問題，本項目將探討利用各種歷史和當前數據（如空間軌跡、來自傳感器的道路交通數據、事件和道路事故報告以及天氣數據），開發出高效的預測性路由查詢算法以便在應答路由查詢時生成對整個時空的預測。該項目旨在回答以下問題：給定一個查詢，我們能否做到及時（Just-in-time）預測，從而在查詢所需的空間區域和預期的時間範圍內，為該查詢提供最合適的模型？因此，該預測性路由查詢處理需要一種新的查詢優化範式，這種查詢優化範式可以結合數據庫和機器學習模型，通過使用為查詢量身定做的實時預測算法來達到更準確的查詢結果。區別於目前已有的針對整個時空進行預測的模型，這種查詢優化範式可以限制查詢所需要的區域，以便減少查詢處理所需要的時間。因此我們的目標是為數據庫和機器學習模型開發一個新穎的、高度集成的模型構建和查詢處理框架來支持高效的預測性路由查詢處理。 具體來說，在該項目中，我們將（1）設計一個增強的建模框架（Enhanced Information Modelling Framework），該框架可以對數據和預測模型進行建模；（2）開發有效的算法，為給定的查詢估計一個安全和閉合的時空區域，以促進及時的模型選擇和模型調整；（3）增量式生成路網畫像（Profile），以便維持時間依賴的路由索引來支持高效的路由查詢；（4）建立一個原型系統（Research Prototype）來評估和展示我們的解決方案，為需要精確路徑規劃的應用提供最大的下游效益。該項目的負責人是該領域內的知名學者，其在時空數據庫、基於機器學習的時空預測和路由規劃方面有著豐富的研究經驗。該項目將會產生重大的研究和應用影響，將朝著一般預測性查詢處理邁出關鍵的一步，並為數據科學研究開闢新的方向。

16202922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16202922.value: 基於交通公平的自動駕駛網約車平台監管問題

16202922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16202922.value: Autonomous vehicle (AV) technology could revolutionize urban mobility. It enables inexpensive mobility services that are on-demand, door-to-door, and around-the-clock. This offers great opportunities for improving transport equity: underserved areas and disadvantaged groups may significantly benefit from autonomous mobility-on-demand services that reduce transport costs, fill transit gaps, and connect people to employment and education opportunities. However, these benefits are not guaranteed. Without well-designed regulation, market incentives may drive AV deployment in the opposite direction: for-hire AVs may flock to high-demand areas of the city for better earning opportunities; transit riders may be drawn away, causing a collapse of public transit services; induced demand and zero-occupancy trips may cause heavier traffic on the busiest roads of the city. The disruptive potential of AV technology can be devastating. We propose this project to assess the equity impacts of AVs and investigate regulatory policies that guarantee the benefits of AV technology reach underserved areas and transportation-disadvantaged groups. We consider a ride-hailing platform that delivers on-demand mobility services with AVs to maximize its profit. In this context, we will explore (a) how autonomous mobility-on-demand (AMoD) services affect spatial and social equity if AV deployment is driven purely by market incentives; (b) how AMoD services complement or disrupt public transit in different areas of the transportation network; (c) what policies can minimize the disruptiveness of AVs and maximize their benefits to ensure an equitable mobility future. To this end, we will develop a spatial equilibrium model for multiclass passengers with various income levels to characterize both spatial and social equity. In our model, the ride-hailing platform determines ride fares, AV fleet size, and vehicle dispatching strategies to maximize its profit, public transit agencies adjust service frequencies in response to transit demands, and multiclass passengers choose among AMoD, public transit, AMoD bundled with transit, and other transport options to minimize their travel costs. We will use this model to investigate how market incentives of the for-profit platform lead to systemic and structural inequity in the multimodal transportation system, and how regulatory policies interact with these incentives to bridge inequity gaps. Overall, the proposed research will provide a solid foundation for understanding the disruptive potential of AVs and designing thoughtful regulations to stimulate AV deployment in the positive direction. This is of paramount importance for building an equitable mobility future, where technological innovation and policy innovation join forces to enable an accessible and inclusive mobility ecosystem for all. 自動駕駛技術將為城市交通系統帶來深刻的變革。基於自動駕駛技術的網約車服務可以極大地降低平台的運營成本，為乘客提供全天候、點對點的即時出行服務，並以此提高偏遠地區和弱勢群體的交通可達性。然而，單純依靠市場力量很難達成以上目標。一方面，網約車平台更偏向於向城市中心地區調度車輛以提高運營利潤；另一方面，網約車過度集中於城市中心地區可能加劇與公共交通系統的競爭，降低交通系統的整體運行效率。因此，我們極需研究如何通過監管政策引導自動駕駛技術在城市交通網絡中的合理運用。 基於以上原因，我們將在本項目中量化分析自動駕駛網約車對交通公平可能存在的負面影響，並深入研究如何通過制定監管策略引導自動駕駛網約車平台的健康發展，提高交通系統的公平性。我們將考慮一個基於自動駕駛技術的網約車平台，並在此背景下重點研究以下問題: (a) 完全基於自由市場的自動駕駛系統將對城市交通公平性產生怎樣的影響；(b) 在不同城市區域內自動駕駛系統與公共交通系統之間的競合關係； (c) 如何制定監管策略以引導網約車平台通過自動駕駛技術提高交通系統的公平性。為研究以上問題，我們將提出一個基於自動駕駛網約車與公共交通的網絡模型，通過優化理論刻畫網約車平台在交通網絡中的決策行為。該模型將幫助我們系統研究自動駕駛網約車市場對交通公平的影響，並深刻理解調控策略與網約車市場的相互作用。這對於政府相關部門制定有效的調控策略，提供公平的交通服務具有重要的現實意義。

16203122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16203122.value: 基於準可逆網絡的可復原的圖像處理通用框架

16203122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16203122.value: 圖像處理算法已經被大眾廣泛地應用在生成引人注目的美圖並用作分享，而原始圖像往往因為需要節省空間在處理過後會被刪掉。原始圖像包含沒有被修改過的細節可以有效地用來進一步圖像編輯、檢視或者法律訴訟，我們可以從處理後的圖像恢復原始圖片嗎？為了解決這個問題，我們將會研究一個可復原的圖像處理通用框架，它可以模仿圖像處理算法生成對應的圖像、也可以從處理後的圖恢復原始圖像。在這個框架中，我們會開發一個全新的準可逆（幾乎但不完全可逆）網絡結構去代表可復原的圖像處理算法，它包含一個可逆的分支和一個不可逆的分支去平衡我們模型的圖像處理和復原能力。此外，一個考慮了壓縮的新優化訓練方式會被實現，從而使得框架能夠對於圖像壓縮有魯棒性。我們會在大型數據集上開展實驗去評估我們的框架並通過可控實驗分析不同模型設計。更進一步，我們會在此框架下開發其實際用途。總結來說，該提議的研究有三個項目目標： 1. 開發準可逆網絡結構。我們會開發一個準可逆的網絡結構作為一個通用框架來逼近複雜的圖像處理算法，同時可以從處理後的圖像高精準地恢復原始圖像。 2. 實現考慮壓縮的優化。我們會為準可逆網絡實現一個考慮壓縮的新優化訓練方式，使處理後的圖像保存成PNG或JPEG時，框架可以對於圖像的數值量化以及JPEG壓縮有魯棒性。 3. 提議的實驗。我們會在三個大型圖像數據集上、針對十種圖像處理算法、開展大量實驗來評估我們提出的可復原圖像處理框架，包括跨數據集驗證。另外，我們會通過可控實驗來分析我們的準可逆網絡來進一步提升我們的模型。 相關研究的源代碼和數據將會被公開給學術圈與工業界。

16203222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16203222.value: 二維 MoS2 晶體管的低溫特性

16203222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16203222.value: Quantum computing technology with quantum algorithm has attracted increasing attention because of their potential to solve classically intractable problems. However, the quantum bits or qubits are fragile, and they usually need to be operated in the milli-Kelvin temperature domain to maintain its coherency. Although qubits can interface with their processing circuits at room temperature, the recent trend is to set the temperature of controlling circuit or part or a part of it such that it is close to that in which qubits operate to improve scalability with the number of qubits. This trend has revived the interest in electronic circuits operating at cryogenic temperature. In addition to low temperature, quantum manipulation also facilitated at low dimension using nano-transistors. Although the study of nano-transistors has entered the realm of 2D transistors, cryogenic circuit research remains focused on traditional bulk transistors. Hence, articles related to the cryogenic behaviors of transistors made of 2D materials are rare. To combine the most recent progress in semiconductor device technology and emerging applications in cryogenic conditions, we propose to study the cryogenic behaviors of 2D transistors. In particular, we will study the cryogenic operation of MoS2 transistors as they are one of the most widely studied materials. However, we expect that a large part of the findings can be generalized to other types of 2D transistors. MoS2 transistors can be constructed with many different material systems and structures. In terms of geometrical structure, we will study the top and bottom gate structures with top source/drain contacts, representing two different operation modes. In terms of material, the gate dielectrics can be amorphous oxide or another insulating 2D material, such has h-BN. The choice of gate material affects the interface properties at cryogenic conditions. The gate material can be a conventional metal or again another 2D material, such as graphene. The contact metal can form either a Schottky (using platinum) contact, resulting in a tunnelling transistor; or an ohmic contact (using Scandium), resulting in a normal enhancement mode MOSFET. The use of graphene as a van der Waals contact will also be studied. With the structure and material system determined, MoS2 transistors will be fabricated and characterized to reveal their characteristics at cryogenic temperature. The new understanding of 2D semiconductor devices at cryogenic temperature that will result from this project can inspire many new approaches to manipulate information in the quantum realm. 具有量子算法的量子計算技術因其解決經典難題的潛力而備受關注。然而，量子比特或量子比特是脆弱的，通常需要在毫開爾文溫度域中運行以保持其相干性。雖然在室溫下仍然可以讓量子位與其處理電路連接，但最近的趨勢是讓控制電路或控制電路的一部分的溫度接近量子位的工作溫度。這重新喚起了人們對在低溫下工作的電子電路的興趣。 除了低溫之外，還需要使用納米晶體管在低維度上進行量子操作。雖然納米晶體管的研究已進入二維晶體管領域，但低溫電路研究仍主要使用傳統的體晶體管技術。很難找到有關二維材料製成的晶體管的低溫行為研究的文章。為了結合半導體器件技術的最新進展和低溫條件下的新興應用，我們提議研究二維晶體管的低溫行為。特別是，我們將研究 MoS2 晶體管的低溫操作，因為它是研究最廣泛的材料之一。但我們預計大部分研究結果可以推廣到其他類型的 2D 晶體管。 由於 MoS2 晶體管存在許多材料和結構變化，我們必須對要研究的結構做出任何決定。在幾何結構方面，我們將研究具有頂部源/漏接觸的頂部和底部柵極結構。它代表兩種不同的操作模式。在材料方面，柵極電介質可以是非晶氧化物或其他絕緣二維材料，例如具有 h-BN。澆口材料的選擇會影響低溫條件下的界面特性。柵極材料可以是傳統金屬，也可以是另一種二維材料，如石墨烯。最後，接觸金屬既可以形成肖特基接觸（使用鉑）提供隧道晶體管，也可以形成歐姆接觸（使用鈧）提供正常增強模式 MOSFET。還將研究使用石墨烯作為萬德華接觸。隨著結構和材料體系的確定，晶體管將被製造和表徵，以揭示它們在低溫下的特性。 低溫半導體材料和器件可以為創新的量子計算應用提供基礎。對低溫半導體器件的新的和不斷改進的理解可以激發許多在量子領域操縱信息的新方法。

16203322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16203322.value: 控制从基于过程变量到质量 - 注塑案例的研究

16203322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16203322.value: Today’s competitive market means that manufacturing processes need to shift closed-loop control from being based only on the process variable to being also based on quality. Building on the applicant’s team extensive experience of injection molding process control, this proposal proposes to develop quality closed-loop control based on injection molding weight. Injection molding is one of the most important manufacturing processes and is vital to the economies of Hong Kong and the Great Bay Area. Weigh is the most important injection molding property and is closely related to other qualities such as dimensions. Two problems must solved in this project to achieve closed-loop control using weight. (1) Predicting and estimating the evolution of weight over time in real time. This estimate has a certain confidence level which must be evaluated over time and used effectively within a closed-loop control cycle. (2) Using the above estimates, designing control methods to ensure the weight requirement with minimizing material cost. The successful completion of this project will not only resolve the academic challenges associated with estimating and controlling within-cycle injection molding quality but also will pave the way forward for injection molding to shift from the conventional process variable based closed-loop control toward quality based closed-loop control and consequently enhancing the competitive advantage of Hong Kong’s economy. 当今的市场竞争需要从制造过程的闭环控制从传统的基于过程变量转变为基于质量。 根据申请人团队在注塑过程控制方面的丰富经验，本项目的申请人建议开展注塑重量闭环控制，注塑是香港和大湾区经济中最重要的制造之一，而重量是最重要的注塑质量，并与其他品质如尺寸等密切相关。 本项目研究两个问题。 （1）如何实时预测重量和时间的演变， 这估计具有一定的置信水平以及这种置信水平如何随时间评估并用于环闭环控制中。 (2)根据上述估算，如何设计重量控制，以确保符合规格的重量（质量）要求和精益生产，降低材料成本。 这项计划的成功完成不仅可以解决与周期内注塑成型质量估计和控制有关的学术挑战而且为注塑成型从传统的过程变量闭环控制转向质量闭环控制铺平道路，从而增强香港经济的竞争优势。

16203922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16203922.value: Mr Chen, Chao Prof Qiu, Li

16203922.label: Project Objectives
16203922.value: Investigating the definition of phase to a more general class of nonlinear systems. Integrating of gain and phase in nonlinear system analysis. Studying the connection between the nonlinear system phase defined from an input/output point of view and the state space model of the nonlinear system.
rows: Investigating the definition of phase to a more general class of nonlinear systems.
Integrating of gain and phase in nonlinear system analysis.
Studying the connection between the nonlinear system phase defined from an input/output point of view and the state space model of the nonlinear system.

16203922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16203922.value: The concept of phase has for a long time been associated with a complex scalar or a complex scalar valued function. This has led to very successful applications to SISO LTI system theory via the transfer functions of such systems. Recently, the concept of phase has been extended to complex matrices and complex matrix valued functions. A brand new phase theory for MIMO LTI systems is now under development and is gradually taking shape. Three GRF projects have been funded to support this line of research. We expect that in a few years a rich and complete phase theory for MIMO LTI systems will become available. Now we ask the following question: can we extend the phase theory to nonlinear systems? There is a quantum jump from linear systems to nonlinear systems, due to the lack of transfer functions for the latter. Our preliminary study however suggests that a nonlinear system phase can indeed be defined, at least for input-output stable systems. This definition complements the gain of nonlinear systems and extend the definition of passivity in a quantitative way. Based on the phase definition, a nonlinear small phase theorem can be obtained, complementing the nonlinear small gain theorem. Our preliminary study sheds light on a new phase theory for nonlinear systems, complementing the existing theory based on mostly the gain concept and extending the the existing theory based on passivity. The initial success in our preliminary study opens the door to a large number of research problems. It will take multiple years for the new research results to form a theory. In this project, we will take the first few steps. We will mainly study the following three problems: 1. Extend the phase definition to a class of input-output unstable nonlinear systems (called semi-stable systems) and extend the small phase theorem to cover such systems. 2. Integrate the new phase techniques with the existing gain techniques so to effect 1+1>2. 3. Connect the phase techniques with the popular Lyapunov techniques for nonlinear state space systems. 自18世紀以來，相位的概念就與複數或複值函數緊密相連。在基於傳遞函數的單輸入單輸出線性時不變系統的理論中，相位的概念有著非常成功的應用。近年來，相位的概念已被推廣至複矩陣與複值矩陣函數之中。一個全新的多輸入多輸出線性時不變系統的相論正在茁壯成長並逐漸成型。圍繞該相論的研究方向已獲得三個優配研究金項目的支持。我們預計不需幾年，一個豐富且完整的多輸入多輸出線性時不變系統的相論將得以呈現。現在，我們提問：能否拓展該相論使其適用於非線性系統？由於非線性系統傳遞函數模型的缺失，從線性系統到非線性系統存在著巨大的跳變。然而，我們的初步研究表明，對於輸入輸出穩定的這一類非線性系統，其相位可以明確定義。該相位定義互補於非線性系統的增益定義，同時從定量的角度拓展了系統的無源性定義。基於此定義，我們建立了非線性小相位定理，該定理互補於非線性小增益定理。我們的初步研究為非線性系統相論的建立指明了方向，該相論將互補於現有主流的基於增益的理論，并拓展了基於無源性的理論。我們初步研究的成功帶來了大量的新研究問題。預計多年後，這些新研究問題所產出的成果將形成一個完整的相論。本項目中，我們將踏出首要幾步，主要研究下述三個問題：1. 推廣相位的定義至一類輸入輸出不穩定系統（稱為半穩定系統），並拓展小相位定理使其適用於此類系統。2. 集成新開發的相位技術與現有的增益技術，使其產生1+1>2的效果。3. 針對由狀態空間表達的非線性系統，將新開發的相位技術與現有主流的李雅普諾夫方法相結合。

16204022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16204022.value: 通過無棱鏡微分UV顯微鏡研究彈性基薄膜屈曲變形

16204022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16204022.value: 可拉伸微電子器件是生物傳感，醫學治療、人類健康和無線通信等眾多技術應用的基礎。在柔性電子產品的各種先進製造技術中，力學自組裝方法特別適用於在軟基底上製造複雜的三維可拉伸結構。力學組裝是通過設計薄膜的屈曲實現的。基於各種成熟的光刻技術，許多功能材料和微結構可以集成到器件設計中。與 3D 打印等技術相比，採用力學自組裝方法製備的柔性電子器件有更好的材料兼容性和結構多樣性。 對於通過力學自組裝方法製成的柔性微系統，三維表面形貌的精度及其從平面到預屈曲、屈曲和後屈曲的演變對於器件性能和功能耐用性至關重要。這是一個多尺度力學問題，涉及從納米缺陷到毫米結構的各種變形機制。在該領域，三維結構表徵通常通過納米壓痕原子力顯微鏡和掃描電子顯微鏡進行。作為基於掃描的探針，很難在足夠大的視場內捕捉薄膜器件的動態變形行為。最近發明的微分乾涉光學顯微鏡 (DInM) 可以彌補這些掃描電子顯微鏡的不足。該方法基於連續介質力學理論，將光學微分與表面變形梯度之間的數學關係理論化，從而可以在幾毫秒內精確確定大視場的表面變形，從而實現時間分辨的機械性能測量。然而，光學衍射效應限制了成像分辨率，而且 Nomarski 棱鏡限制了結構表徵的軸向分辨率。 為了突破分辨率限制，以便我們可以在納米級分辨率下測量彈性體基板上薄膜的結構變形，我們利用強相干的紫外光源來構建無棱鏡的 DInM。基本原理類似於我們之前的可見光反射 DInM 系統，但光學微分由一對帶有紫外線反射塗層的鏡子來實現。通過轉向鏡的連續可變旋轉，可以將紫外光分成兩束正交偏振光束，相差幾納米。微分紫外光將成為確定屈曲過程中薄膜局部變形的探針。我們將使用這個定量光學系統對彈性體基板上具有不同幾何形狀、厚度和佈局的矽薄膜進行系統研究。根據時間相關的微力學數據，我們將繪製薄膜屈曲過程的動態應變分佈圖，從而指導可拉伸微系統的機械設計。該項目的成功將為在微納米尺度下實時表徵三維全場變形提供有利的測試方法。

The system configuration will be optimized based on Specific Cooling Power (SCP), Coefficient of Performance (COP), fatigue life, and Specific Driving Force (SDF).

16204422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16204422.value: 綠色冷卻倡議在全球範圍內開發高效、環保的冷卻技術以取代依賴具有高全球變暖潛勢的氫氟烴製冷劑的傳統蒸汽壓縮冷卻系統， 以減少溫室氣體排放。形狀記憶合金 (SMA) 的彈熱效應利用再生熱交換器與彈熱循環相結合，以保持有用的溫度跨度和冷卻能力, 被認為是有潛力替代傳統冷卻技術的固態製冷劑。迄今為止，大多數研究都集中在彈熱材料的材料科學和工程上。然而，在設計彈熱蓄熱器結構以實現系統的最佳性能時，對傳熱方面的關注不足。此外，大多數彈熱製冷樣機壽命有限不適合實際應用。因此，在本提案中，我們的目標是通過採用具有新穎設計的 SMA 結構來提高冷卻能力和疲勞壽命，以應對高性能和耐用的彈性熱系統中所需的對流熱傳遞和壓縮載荷。 我們將應用數值和實驗相結合的方法，從基礎到實際方面系統地研究再生彈熱系統。我們的初步研究表明，使用 SMA 管可以將疲勞壽命提高到 7000 萬次壓縮循環，但由於可用表面積有限，熱傳遞仍然很低。因此，我們將關注對結構配置對於熱和機械方面的影響。為了了解系統的熱力學和熱傳遞，我們將對帶有再生熱交換器的彈熱裝置進行數值模擬，該裝置循環工作於一個管狀 SMA 結構而傳遞潛熱。我們開發的模型將指導我們評估重要結構參數，並建立設計彈性熱量組件的指南。根據模型的預測，我們將對具有擴大比面積的 SMA 結構進行拓撲設計和力學分析，同時避免可能的屈曲。由於 SMA 的高強度及其對溫度的敏感性，將尋求新的製造方法來加工 SMA 結構。結合強化傳熱、機械穩定性、防屈曲等方面對管徑、壁厚、管長等幾何參數進行優化。最後，我們將整合這種優化的彈熱冷卻系統設計，並在測試平台上評估彈熱製冷樣機的實驗性能。

16204822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16204822.value: 基於合作博弈的多模式交通系統資源分配與收益共享研究

16204822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16204822.value: The past decade has witnessed a significant increase in the diversity of urban transport services. Ranging from conventional mass transport, to shared mobility and on-demand transit services, these mobility solutions coexist in transport networks, competing vigorously with each other. Intensified competition and travelers’ demands for higher service levels have increased the operating costs of transport service providers (TSPs). An effective way of reducing operating costs is cooperation between TSPs, whereby different providers form a coalition, pool their mobility resources and serve each other’s customers. Prominent examples include Mobility-as-a-Service platforms, cooperative schemes between public transport and ride-sourcing such as Uber Transit and first-and-last-mile services in dense but spatially large cities, like Beijing. Cooperative platforms facilitate centralized resource allocation, and can thereby improve resource utilization rates and aggregate profits. However, this does not necessarily lead to a fair distribution of gains among TSPs without a proper revenue sharing rule. TSPs are selfish entities who seek to maximize their own profits. They will form coalitions only when cooperation brings them increased profits. To ensure stable cooperation, we aim to design revenue sharing rules that make TSPs better off and achieve system efficiency, while taking into account TSPs’ decentralized resource allocation decisions. Cooperative and non-cooperative game theory will be used to study this problem. The research activity will include: First, we will develop a two-stage game model, in which the first-stage solves the revenue sharing problem in a cooperative game, taking into account TSPs’ resource allocation decisions in a non-cooperative game in the second stage. Efficient revenue sharing methods will be designed to stabilize the coalition. Second, we will incorporate demand elasticity in the second-stage non-cooperative game. This leads to TSPs’ resource allocation game being an equilibrium problem with equilibrium constraints (EPEC), which may result in an empty core for the cooperative game. We will develop efficient algorithms to solve the EPEC and design an external pricing instrument. Third, we will design a heuristic revenue sharing rule that does not require TSPs to share private demand information, meanwhile achieving an acceptable approximation of the optimal solution. This rule can be applied in practice without solving complicated models. This project will investigate theoretically interesting and practically important issues in multimodal transport systems, providing analytical and practical tools to stabilize multimodal coalitions. We will conduct numerical experiments using real data provided by our industrial partner, Beijing Transport Institute, to demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed approaches. 在過去的十年中，城市交通服務的多樣性顯著增加。從傳統的公共交通，到共享出行，再到按需交通服務，這些出行方式共存於城市交通網絡中，互相形成激烈的競爭關係。這種競爭的加劇以及出行者對於更高服務水平的交通需求，增加了各交通服務公司（TSP）的運營成本。而合作能夠有效降低運營成本，即各交通服務公司形成統一聯盟，整合交通運輸資源，為彼此的用戶提供服務。具體的實例包括出行即服務平臺（Mobility-as-a-Service），公共交通與網約車服務之間的合作計劃，如Uber Transit，以及人口密集的大型城市（如北京）的最初和最後一公里服務。 合作的交通平臺通過整合集中配置交通資源，能夠有效提高資源利用率和總利潤。然而，將總利潤公平地分配給各交通服務公司離不開合理的收益共享規則。各交通服務公司著眼於實現自身收益最大化，只有當能從合作中獲益，他們才會同意形成聯盟。因此為了保證合作的穩定性，本研究將利用合作與非合作博弈理論，考慮各交通服務公司分散的資源分配策略，制定收益共享規則，以確保各交通服務公司獲利，且實現整體交通系統的高效運營，也即收益最大化。本研究包括以下三個方面： 第一，我們將建立一個兩階段的博弈模型。第一階段基於合作博弈解決收益共享問題，考慮第二階段的各交通服務公司的資源分配策略。我們將制定高效的收益共享規則以穩定交通服務公司之間形成的聯盟。 第二，我們將在第二階段的非合作博弈中引入需求彈性。這將導致交通服務公司的資源分配非合作博弈成為一個帶有均衡約束的均衡問題（EPEC），而這可能使得合作博弈存在空核，我們將提出有效的算法來解決該問題並設計相應的外部定價機制。 第三，我們將設計一種啟發式收益共享規則，該規則無需使用各交通服務公司持有的私人需求信息。該規則相較於最優解能夠確保一定的近似率，同時無需求解複雜的模型，從而能更廣泛地被應用於實際中。 本項目以多模式聯運交通系統為背景，探究理論與實踐中存在的關於多模式交通公司聯盟的資源分配與收益共享問題。我們將使用真實數據進行實例分析，驗證所提出的收益共享規則的高效性與穩定性。

16205122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16205122.value: 通過複雜系統方法抑制環形燃燒器網絡中的熱聲不穩定性

16205122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16205122.value: The escalating threat of climate change is forcing the electricity generation industry to decarbonize. Gas turbines are central to this effort as they can switch between transitional fossil fuels and carbon-neutral fuels, such as biofuels and hydrogen. Moreover, gas turbines can start up at short notice, making them ideal for balancing the electricity grid against intermittent supply from renewables such as wind and solar. However, even when fueled with pure hydrogen, gas turbines emit nitrogen oxides (NOx), endangering public health and the Earth's ecosystems. Lean premixed combustion is effective in reducing NOx emissions, but it also raises the risk of thermoacoustic instability. This problem is caused by constructive interactions between unsteady flames and sound. If not adequately controlled, it can produce strong self-excited flow oscillations in gas turbines, limiting their efficiency, reliability and operability. Currently, both passive and active control techniques are available to suppress thermoacoustic oscillations. However, most of these techniques were developed on single-combustor systems. Industrial gas turbines typically feature a can-annular architecture, with multiple can-type combustors arranged around the annulus. Although each combustor is thermodynamically isolated from its neighbors, acoustic communication can still occur between combustors via a cross-talk opening near the combustor exit. The thermoacoustic modes in such multi-combustor systems are more complex than those in single-combustor systems because they depend not only on the intra-combustor flame-acoustic interactions but also on the inter-combustor acoustic interactions. To date, however, little work has been done to develop control strategies for such multi-combustor systems. We propose to take a complex systems approach to develop new strategies for suppressing thermoacoustic oscillations in ring networks of multiple combustors. We will perform experiments on a lab-scale combustion network, treating each combustor as an individual self-excited thermoacoustic oscillator. We will first implement passive control via mutual synchronization by exploring how modifications to the coupling and oscillator (combustor) parameters can influence the emergence of collective states such as chimeras and amplitude death. We will then implement active control via forced synchronization by exploring how open-loop external forcing can influence the efficacy of the passive control strategies identified earlier. Finally, we will use the experimental data to build representative low-order network models, and analyze those models to discover new ways of suppressing thermoacoustic oscillations in ring networks of multiple combustors. This project will enable mutual and forced synchronization to be synergistically combined for the development of future generations of low-emissions gas turbines. 不斷嚴峻的氣候變化促使發電行業脫碳迫在眉睫。 燃氣輪機是這項變革的核心，因為它們可以從化石燃料過渡到碳中和燃料（例如生物燃料和氫）。 此外，燃氣輪機可以在短時間內啟動，是風能和太陽能等可再生能源產生的間歇性供應電能的理想互補對象。 然而，即使使用純氫作為燃料，燃氣輪機也會排放氮氧化物 (NOx)，危及公眾健康和地球生態系統。 貧燃預混燃燒雖可有效減少 NOx 排放，但也會增加熱聲不穩定的風險。 這個問題是由不穩定的火焰和聲音之間的相互作用引起的。 如果控制不當，它會在燃氣輪機中產生強烈的自激流動振盪，從而限制燃氣輪機的效率、可靠性和可操作性。 目前，被動和主動控制技術都可用於抑制熱聲振盪。 然而，這些技術中的大多數都是基於單燃燒器系統上開發的。 工業燃氣輪機通常採用環管式結構，即多個罐式燃燒器於環形空間內排布。 儘管每個燃燒器與其相鄰燃燒器在熱力學上是隔離的，但燃燒器之間仍然可以通過燃燒器出口附近的開口進行聲學通信。 這種多燃燒器系統中的熱聲模式比單燃燒器系統中的熱聲模式更複雜，因為它們不僅取決於燃燒器內的火焰-聲學相互作用，還取決於燃燒器間的聲學相互作用。 然而，迄今為止，很少有工作為這種多燃燒器系統開發控制策略。 我們建議採用複雜系統方法來開發新的控制策略來抑制多燃燒器的環形網絡中的熱聲振盪。 我們將在實驗室規模的燃燒網絡上進行實驗，將每個燃燒器視為一個單獨的自激熱聲振子。 我們將首先通過相互同步來實現被動控制，探索對耦合和振子（燃燒器）參數的修改如何影響集體狀態的出現，例如嵌合體和振盪湮滅。 然後，我們將通過探索開環外部強迫如何影響前面確定的被動控制策略的功效，通過強制同步來實施主動控制。 最後，我們將利用實驗數據建立具有代表性的低階網絡模型，並分析這些模型以發現抑制多燃燒器環形網絡中熱聲振蕩的新方法。 該項目將使相互和強制同步協同結合，以開發下一代低排放燃氣輪機。

16205222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16205222.value: 一種自由氯原位生成一氧化二氯策略用以去除高濃度氯離子污水中難降解有機污染物的評估

16205222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16205222.value: Prof Ao, Zhimin Prof Ling, Li Dr Xiang, Yingying

16205222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16205222.value: High chloride-containing wastewaters, for example, saline sewage resulting from seawater toilet flushing in Hong Kong, and concentrated leachate, may contain elevated concentrations of organic pollutants and pose adverse impacts on human and aquatic organisms. Many of these organic pollutants are recalcitrant to conventional wastewater treatment processes. Their removal by advanced oxidation and activated carbon adsorption processes is often resource and energy intensive. Dichlorine monoxide (Cl2O) is an overlooked but highly reactive free chlorine species that can degrade the recalcitrant organic pollutants in water. Cl2O gas has been used in industry as a bleaching agent. However, the on-site generation of this explosive gas demands high energy and safety measures. In freshwater, aqueous Cl2O has been theoretically estimated to be produced at practically irrelevant free chlorine concentrations of a few hundred mgCl2/L. Our recent investigation revealed that by adding 2 mgCl2/L free chlorine to water at chloride concentrations of no less than 0.20 M, 1,4-dimethoxybenzene and carbamazepine, two chlorine-resistant pollutants, were rapidly degraded. We hypothesize that the high chloride concentrations drive the in-situ transformation of free chlorine to Cl2O. This provides the possibility to make use of Cl2O to degrade recalcitrant organic pollutants in high chloride-containing wastewaters by simple free chlorine addition at practically relevant concentrations. In this proposed project, we will quantitatively investigate the formation of Cl2O as a function of pH, concentrations of chloride and free chlorine, and in the presence of common cations and anions using a stopped-flow spectrophotometry approach. We will determine the rate constants between Cl2O and 21 organic pollutants commonly detected in wastewaters and establish the quantitative structural-activity relationship of the reactivities between Cl2O and the organic pollutants through statistical models with quantum chemical descriptors calculated from density functional theory. We will reveal the chemical transformations of model organic compounds and the formation of chloro-organic byproducts by Cl2O. We will also examine the elemental composition of dissolved organic matter (DOM) and track the potential precursors in DOM that lead to the formation of emerging chloro-organic byproducts by Cl2O, based on Fourier transform-ion cyclotron resonance-mass spectrometry methods. In addition, genotoxicity of the treated wastewater and the emerging chloro-organic byproducts that contribute largely to the genotoxicity will be examined by inter sample rankings analysis. The results from this study will substantiate the implementation of this novel strategy of Cl2O generation by free chlorine addition to degrade recalcitrant organic pollutants in high chloride-containing wastewaters. 高濃度氯離子污水中可能含有較高濃度的有機污染物，例如垃圾滲濾液及香港海水沖廁產生的含鹽污水等，因此會對人類和水生生物造成不利影響。這些有機污染物往往較難被傳統污水處理過程所去除。雖然它們能夠被高級氧化或活性炭吸附工藝去除，但是會消耗大量的資源和能源。一氧化二氯(Cl2O)是一種高活性但往往被忽視的自由氯物質。它可以去除水中難降解有機污染物，其氣體已在工業中被用作漂白劑。然而，Cl2O氣體的現場生產是一種高能耗過程，且需要額外安全措施來防止其爆炸。在淡水中，Cl2O水溶液的產生理論上需要加入幾百毫克氯每升濃度的自由氯來實現，這在實際水處理工藝中無法實現。我們最近的研究表明，在氯離子濃度不低於0.20摩爾每升的水中，僅添加2毫克氯每升自由氯即可迅速去除1,4-二甲氧基苯和卡馬西平這兩種耐氯污染物。我們推斷高濃度的氯離子推動了自由氯原位轉化為Cl2O。該方法只需添加低濃度的自由氯，即可產生Cl2O去除高氯離子污水中的難降解有機污染物。本項目中，我們首先將使用停流分光光度法定量研究Cl2O的形成與pH值、氯離子和自由氯的濃度以及常見陽離子和陰離子的量化關系。其次，我們將測量Cl2O與污水中常見的21種有機污染物之間的速率常數，使用統計模型和密度泛函理論計算的量子化學描述符，建立Cl2O與有機污染物之間的結構-反應活性的定量關系，並將揭示模型有機化合物在Cl2O作用下的化學轉化機製以及含氯有機副產物的形成機製。我們還將采用傅裏葉變換-離子回旋共振-質譜分析法鑒定溶解性有機物中的元素組成，並追蹤其中與Cl2O反應形成新興含氯有機副產物的潛在前驅物。此外，我們還將通過樣品間的排名分析，鑒定處理後污水的遺傳毒性和主要導致遺傳毒性的新興含氯有機副產物。研究結果可以為該自由氯原位生成一氧化二氯的策略去除高濃度氯離子污水中難降解有機污染物的實際應用提供有效指導。

16205322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16205322.value: 回答知識圖譜複雜查詢的學習方法

16205322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16205322.value: 自 2012 年 Google 發布其第一個知識圖譜產品以來，知識圖譜就引起了廣泛關注。圖結構數據自然地為高階查詢提供了解決方案。最近，基於機器學習的方法，通過從複雜的邏輯查詢和答案中學習來解決傳統推理方法所面臨的挑戰。然而，這些方法無法回答“是什麼”、“有多少”和“為什麼”的問題。在這個項目中，我們將提出新的學習問題來回答複雜的知識圖譜查詢，並開發相應的基準數據集和機器學習方法和評估方法。對於“是什麼”和“有多少”的查詢，我們將利用以實體為中心的知識圖譜，例如 Freebase 和 NELL，設計開發新的基準數據集。對於常識性的“為什麼”的查詢，我們將利用新穎的以事件為中心或以情境為中心的知識圖譜，例如 ATOMIC 和 ASER，並使用人工標注來驗證答案的正確性。

16205422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16205422.value: 差分隐私下的关系型数据库查询

16205422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16205422.value: As more value is being extracted from data, privacy concerns over personal data collection and analysis have also grown. Strict laws and regulations are now being enacted across the world to govern the use of personal data, regardless of whether or not data analysis results are released to the public, to a third party, or even just for internal use within an organization. Among the many privacy standards, differential privacy (DP), already deployed by Apple, Google, Microsoft, and the US Census Bureau, has emerged to become the de facto notion of private data protection, due to its rigorous mathematical definition of individual privacy. While how to answer simple statistical queries under DP has been extensively studied, with many cases being solved to optimality, the existing DP mechanisms for queries over a relational database are far from satisfactory, often returning results with little to none utility (although privacy is satisfied). Since the most sensitive and the most valuable information is predominately managed by relational databases and queried using relational query languages such as SQL, a huge demand exists for better DP mechanisms for relational queries. This project aims to meet this demand. In contrast to existing DP mechanisms for relational queries that are mostly heuristics based, we will take a principled approach and study the fundamental trade-off between privacy and utility, namely, the degree of accuracy that the query answer can achieve while satisfying a given level of privacy. A key notion to be used is instance optimality, which guarantees that the utility of the DP mechanism is optimal not only in the worst case, but over any instance of the database. After laying down the theoretical foundation, we will also take it to practice, and build a system prototype that is able to answer a wide class of relational queries privately. 随着从数据中提取更多的价值，对个人数据收集和分析的隐私问题也越来越多。现在世界各地都在制定严格的法律和法规，以管理个人数据的使用，无论数据分析结果是否向公众、第三方或甚至只是在一个组织内部使用。在众多隐私标准中，已经由苹果、谷歌、微软和美国人口普查局部署的差分隐私（DP），由于其对个人隐私的严格数学定义，已经成为事实上的私人数据保护概念。虽然如何在DP下回答简单的统计查询已被广泛研究，许多案例被解决到最佳状态，但现有的DP机制对关系型数据库的查询远远不能令人满意，经常返回几乎没有效用的结果（尽管隐私得到满足）。由于最敏感和最有价值的信息主要由关系型数据库管理，并使用关系型查询语言（如SQL）进行查询，因此对更好的关系型查询的DP机制存在巨大需求。 本项目旨在满足这一需求。与现有的主要基于启发式的关系型查询的DP机制相比，我们将采取一种原则性的方法，研究隐私和效用之间的基本权衡，即查询答案在满足给定的隐私水平的同时可以达到的精确程度。要使用的一个关键概念是实例最优性，它保证DP机制的效用不仅在最坏的情况下是最优的，而且在数据库的任何实例上也是最优的。在奠定了理论基础之后，我们还将把它用于实践，并建立一个系统原型，能够私下回答广泛的关系查询。
