16505322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505322.value: The place of residence is one of the most important decisions in a person’s life. A major determinant for locational choices is one’s job. Firm relocation can thus have significant implications for workers’ family arrangement and well-being. Firm relocation is an important issue in economies around the world. When firms relocate, understanding how workers (and their families) re-optimize on where to live is important. This study examines the causal effect of firm relocation on workers’ family arrangement and health outcomes. Only a few credible studies are found on this topic because of the endogeneity in relocation decisions: individuals who move to a certain region may differ in observable and unobservable characteristics from those who do not. Most previous studies have limitations in identification, and focus only on family arrangement outcomes. To the best of our knowledge, this study is the first attempt to offer a comprehensive analysis of the causal effect of firm relocation on workers, their families, and their health outcomes. Specifically, this study investigates the above causal effects on family and health outcomes using one of the largest relocation projects in the world. The South Korean government relocated 153 public institutions (51,700 employees) from the Seoul Metropolitan Area to other regions across the country. The “Plan for Relocation of Public Institutions” was announced in 2005 as a means to curb the growing imbalance in development between Seoul (the capital city) and the other regions. As of 2020, all agencies subject to the policy have completed their relocation. To compare the outcomes of workers in the firms that moved and those that stayed, we use a dynamic difference-in-differences (DID) approach. Rich administrative data are collected from the National Health Insurance System (NHIS), which covers the entire population of South Korea. The data enable us to link individuals to their employer, household members, residence address, health care utilization, and health screening results. Thus, this study identifies all individuals employed in the public-sector firms of our interest. The data include information on family members, so that we are able to measure family formation and dynamics (i.e. marriage, separation, and birth). 16505422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505422.value: Our proposed project will allow us to address the fundamental question of how the preferences of people or companies (“players”) for near-term versus long-term advantages (“time preferences”) affect the pathways to successful cooperation in a social dilemma situation. For our investigation, we plan to use an infinitely repeated Cournot duopoly game in which a more severe punishment path than reversing back to the stage-game Nash equilibrium is sometimes available, depending on a player’s time preferences. We will use this game to experimentally compare two punishment paths that are well established and explored in the theoretical repeated game literature: Nash reversion (NR) and “stick-and-carrot” (SC) punishment. Theory suggests that when players are moderately patient, cooperation can be achieved by a) SC but not NR if the present biases of the players are sufficiently small, or b) by NR but not SC if the present biases of the players are sufficiently large. We aim to test this theory and thus provide insights into how policy-makers can facilitate cooperation among different people or organizations confronted with real-world social dilemma situations. 我们提议的项目将使我们能够解决基本问题，即如何个人或公司（“参与者”）对近期与长期的偏好优势（“时间偏好”）如何影响在社会困境中成功合作的途径。对于我们的调查，我们计划使用无限重复的古诺双头垄断博弈，其中比倒退更严厉的惩罚路径阶段博弈纳什均衡有时是可用的，这取决于玩家的时间偏好。我们将使用这个博弈来实验性地比较两条惩罚路径在理论上的重复博弈文献中得到了很好的确立和探索：纳什回归（NR）和“大棒和胡萝卜”（SC）惩罚。理论表明，当玩家有适度的耐心，合作可以通过 a) SC 而不是 NR 如果玩家的当前偏差足够小，或者 b) 由 NR 而不是 SC，如果当前玩家的偏见足够大。我们的目标是检验这一理论，从而提供洞察政策制定者如何促进不同人群之间的合作或组织面临现实世界的社会困境

16505422.label: Realisation of objectives
16505422.value: Investigating Time Discounting in Repeated Cournot Duopoly Games: Our research aims to explore how individual preferences regarding near-term and long-term benefits, specifically time discounting, influence outcomes in a repeated Cournot duopoly game within a controlled laboratory setting. Through Experiment I, we manipulate payment timing to assess the impact of effective discounting on participants' cooperation and punishment strategies. Our findings reveal that individuals' time preferences significantly shape their behavior in repeated interactions, providing valuable insights into the role of time discounting in economic decision-making. Exploring the Relationship Between Effective Patience and Cooperation: We seek to examine whether the frequency of cooperation among individuals in the game is positively related to their effective patience. By analyzing participants' behaviors across different payment timing conditions in Experiment I, we establish a clear relationship between effective patience and cooperation rates. Our results indicate that individuals exhibiting greater effective patience are more inclined to engage in cooperative behavior, highlighting the importance of patience in fostering collaboration in economic interactions. Studying Punishment Preferences Among Present-Biased Players: Our research also investigates which punishment options, including the “stick-and-carrot” strategy and Nash reversion, are favored by present-biased players as a pathway to cooperation. In both experiments, we compare the effectiveness of various punishment strategies, focusing on present-biased individuals' preferences. The results demonstrate that these players are more likely to favor immediate corrective actions, such as explicit punishment mechanisms, over reverting to Nash equilibrium. This finding underscores the significance of understanding how time preferences influence punishment choices in promoting cooperation. Understanding Punishment Options in Supportive Cooperative Contexts: Finally, we aim to understand which punishment strategies are favored by players to sustain cooperation when both players are supportive of collaborative outcomes. In Experiment II, we compare the dynamics of the Cournot game with and without the explicit punishment option, while varying continuation probabilities. Our findings indicate that when cooperation is mutually supported, the availability of a stick-and-carrot strategy enhances cooperation rates compared to Nash reversion. This underscores the critical role of a rich action space in maintaining cooperation in repeated interactions. Through our comprehensive examination of these objectives, our research contributes to a deeper understanding of the interplay between time preferences, cooperation, and punishment strategies in repeated games. We believe that the insights gained from this study will have significant implications for economic theory and practice, particularly in contexts where cooperation is essential.

16505422.label: Major findings and research outcome
16505422.value: We investigate cooperation and punishment in indefinitely repeated games where punishments more severe than Nash reversion (NR) are feasible. In a three-action Cournot stage game (cooperate A, defect B, explicit punish C), stick-and-carrot (SC) punishments can be implemented, whereas in a Prisoners’ Dilemma (PD), only NR is available. Our study includes two lab experiments that combine these environments with calibrated manipulations of time preference and continuation probability. (i) In Experiment I, we vary effective patience through payment timing in the Cournot game. We find that Round 1 cooperation remains largely unchanged across treatments, indicating that cooperation is sustainable in all conditions. However, when a one-step deviation occurs, the allocation of punishment weight shifts: in the treatment theoretically classified as SC-only with lower long-run patience, responses to (A,B) transition from immediate defection (B) towards explicit punishment (C), both in the realized path and in elicited plans. (ii) In Experiment II, under standard payments with δ=0.80 held constant, we observe that the PD shows significantly higher post-deviation defection compared to Cournot. In contrast, Cournot displays higher Round 1 cooperation and conditional cooperation (over A,B), along with a positive use of C that is absent in the PD. Within the Cournot framework, reducing δ from 0.80 to 0.60 has only modest effects; if anything, the lower-δ treatment sees a slight increase in the use of C after deviations. Overall, our findings suggest that the availability of punishment options and the richness of the action space play a more significant role in shaping how subjects discipline defections than do modest changes in δ.

16505422.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16505422.value: Our research on cooperation and punishment in repeated games has several avenues for further development: 1. Expanding Game Environments: Future studies could explore additional game frameworks, such as public goods games or trust games, to understand how different structures impact cooperation and punishment dynamics. 2. Longitudinal Studies: Conducting longitudinal studies would provide insights into how cooperation and punishment strategies evolve over time, revealing the long-term effects of different mechanisms. 3. Diverse Populations: Including diverse demographics in our participant pool would enhance the generalizability of our findings and help tailor interventions based on varying responses to cooperation and punishment. 4. Field Experiments: Implementing field experiments in real-world settings could validate our lab findings and provide practical implications for policy and organizational behavior. Proposed Course of Action: - Develop new experimental designs incorporating varied game structures. - Secure funding for longitudinal and field studies. - Publish results in academic journals and present at conferences to disseminate findings and gather feedback.

16505422.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16505422.value: In our research, we examine cooperation and punishment in games played repeatedly over time, focusing on two types: the Cournot game, where players can cooperate, defect, or explicitly punish, and the Prisoners’ Dilemma, which only allows for basic punishment. We conducted two experiments to explore how different factors influence cooperation and punishment. In Experiment I, we varied payment timing in the Cournot game to assess player patience. We found that cooperation in the first round remained steady, indicating effective collaboration. However, when players deviated from cooperation, their responses shifted. In scenarios with lower patience, they were more likely to choose punishment over simply defecting. In Experiment II, we maintained a consistent payment method and observed reactions after deviations. We discovered that players in the Prisoners’ Dilemma were significantly more likely to defect compared to those in the Cournot game. The Cournot game showed higher cooperation and a willingness to use punishment. Reducing patience slightly had minimal impact on cooperation, but players did use punishment a bit more. Overall, our findings suggest that having punishment options and a variety of actions available is more crucial for promoting cooperation than merely adjusting player patience.

16505522.label: Project Objectives
16505522.value: This study aims to propose a new linguistic information processing cost measure for financial texts. The new measure is based on the linguistic predictability theory in psycholinguistic and cognitive science. The basic rationale of this measure is that, in reading task, the neural processor of human can anticipate upcoming continuations based the context formed by previously encountered words. Extensive event related potentials (ERP) research has shown that this phenomenon is related to the human language processing: linguistic comprehension would be facilitated if the language is more predictable. Drawing the language model from natural language processing literature, I plan to develop a deep learning model to calculate the language predictability measure. The model will be trained specifically on financial texts in order to capture the financial context. In order to validate the new linguistic measure for information processing cost, I plan to study the determinants of this new measure. That is, I try to examine under what circumstances the company's disclosure will exhibit different levels of language predictability. This project will also investigate the informativeness of management discussion and analysis (MD&A) section of 10-K filings with the new measure. Specifically, the impact on stock market return and volatility, future firm performance and firm misconduct in financial reports will be studied.

16505522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16505522.value: In this research, I propose a new method to measure information processing cost in company’s textual disclosures. The new measure is based on the linguistic predictability theory in psycholinguistic and cognitive science. The basic rationale of this measure is that, in reading task, the neural processor of human can anticipate upcoming continuations based the context formed by previously encountered words. Linguistic comprehension would be facilitated if the language is more predictable. I adopt a deep learning-based language model to estimate this language predictability. Moreover, I plan to investigate the informational role of language predictability in the management discussion and analysis (MD&A) section of 10-K filings. In the preliminary study with a small data sample, I find that firms with poor performance and complex business environments have highly unpredictable language usages in MD&A sections. In the proposed study, I will investigate the effect of MD&A language predictability on firm’s stock market performance, future firm performance and misconduct in financial reports. 在这个研究中，我提出一个新的方法用来衡量公司披露中的文字信息的处理成本。这个新的量化标准是基于语言学和认知科学中的语言可预测性理论。基本原理是，当人进行阅读文字的时候，人的神经处理单元可以根据上下文里面之前的文字预料接下里将会出现的文字。这个预测可以帮助更准确的理解文字的含义。我使用深度学习中的语言模型来计算语言可预测性。接下来，我计划研究使用这个新的语言可预测性来提取公司10-k年报中的MD&A部分的文字中的信息量。在一个数据量很小的初步研究中，我发现绩效不好或者比较复杂的商业环境的公司，在他们的年报的文字中有更低的语言可预测性。关于这个课题在将来的研究中，我会深入探索年报的语言可预测性对衡量公司股票市场表现，公司将来的业绩，以及公司的违规行为的影响。

16505522.label: Realisation of objectives
16505522.value: 1. I realized the first resarch objective. We introduce the language predictability score (LPS) as a new measure of readability based on surprisal theory. According to surprisal theory, predictable words are easier to process because readers actively anticipate what comes next and integrate them into the preceding context more easily than unexpected words. Conversely, when highly anticipated words are not encountered, some additional processing may be triggered to reanalyze, revise, or override an accruing contextual representation, and the brain may even engage in learning a new language pattern. 2. I realized the second resarch objective. We apply one of the most advanced LLMs in the extant literature, GPT-2, which was developed by OpenAI, to measure the language predictability of words in corporate disclosures. We obtain the pre-trained GPT-2 model from OpenAI and fine-tune it using the textual data from our MD&A sample. The parameters of the pre-trained model are further optimized during the fine-tuning process. For each calendar year, we employ the MD&As from the preceding five years (excluding the current year) as the training data to fine-tune the GPT-2 model. This approach aims to mimic the language understanding of investors, whose domain-specific knowledge is likely acquired from the recent past and evolves over time. By excluding the current year, we prevent the model from utilizing in-sample data to generate predictions. 3. I realized the third resarch objective. As the first study to introduce language predictability as a much-needed readability measure for business documents, we investigate the economic determinants that drive the variation in the language predictability of MD&As. Negative earnings: Negative earnings imply a higher processing cost because they are less persistent than positive earnings It is difficult for investors to understand the valuation implications of negative earnings because they cannot easily be incorporated into valuation models. Operational complexity: Some firms have complexities (e.g., more product lines or services, complicated supply chains or distribution networks, subsidiaries, complicated business models) that increase the processing cost of their disclosures. We measure the operational complexity (NBSEG) using the logarithm of the number of business segments at the end of the fiscal year. Significant firm events: Firms undergoing significant and unusual events, such as changes in their operating segments resulting from merged or disposed businesses, face higher uncertainty and are likely to have more complex disclosures. We measure these events using Change_NBSEG (the natural logarithm of one plus the absolute change in a firm’s number of business segments compared to the previous fiscal year). Forward-looking disclosures: Forward-looking statements in MD&As are less predictable than statements about firms’ past performance because the future is uncertain, and investors are less likely to anticipate managers’ future strategies. We include FLS, calculated as the ratio of the forward-looking sentences in the current MD&A, as a determinant of language predictability. Special items: Firms with a significant amount of special items are more likely to experience some unusual events. The occurrence of special items represents extraordinary transactions or events that are not part of a company's regular operations. Thus, the presence of special items may lead to the language used in annual reports becomes less predictable as companies strive to explain and disclose the impact of these irregular transactions or events accurately. We investigate the relation between LPS and the above factors using a multivariate regression model. We also include the following control variables as additional determinants: (1) book-to-market ratio (Log(BtoM)), measured as the natural logarithm of the book-to-market ratio of year t, (2) market value (Log(MVE)), measured as the natural logarithm of market capitalization of year t, (3) pre-filing stock momentum (PreALPHA), measured as the intercept from a Fama-French three-factor model estimated prior to the filing date, (4) pre-filing stock volatility (PreRMSE), measured as the pre-filing return root mean squared error measured from a Fama-French three-factor model using trading days [−252, −6], and (5) NASDAQ, an indicator variable that equals one if the firm traded on NASDAQ and zero otherwise. We also include year and Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) industry fixed effects as determinants to control for the unobservable characteristics that are common for all firms in a given year, and those common for all firms within an industry, respectively. 4. I realized the fourth research objective. We investigate how the language predictability of MD&As affects the information environment after the 10-K filing date. We predict that, when the language used in MD&As is less predictable, it is more difficult for market participants to extract value-relevant information from such disclosures, leading to a higher stock return volatility in the period immediately following the filing of the disclosures. We also predict that disclosures with lower language predictability can be more challenging for analysts to process, resulting in greater analyst forecast dispersion and lower forecast accuracy. We test the predictions by examining the association between MD&A language predictability (LPS) and the post-filing stock return volatility (PostRMSE), analyst forecast dispersion (Dispersion), and analyst earnings forecast accuracy (AFE). Specifically, PostRMSE is the root mean squared error (RMSE) of the post-filing returns, estimated from a Fama-French three-factor model using trading days [6, 28], multiplied by 100. Dispersion is the standard deviation of the post-filing analyst forecasts for the next fiscal quarter’s earnings divided by the stock price immediately before the 10-K filing. AFE is the absolute value of the post-filing analyst forecast error of the next fiscal quarter’s earnings scaled by the stock price at the fiscal quarter end. Notably, higher values of AFE indicate less accurate analyst forecasts. Appendix A contains detailed variable definitions. More importantly, we include firm fixed effects in all regressions to address the endogeneity concerns that potential time-invariant firm characteristics may influence the relation between readability measures and the market outcome variables capturing investor processing difficulty. We also run the above regression separately for the other existing readability measures to compare the effect of LPS on capital market participants, namely, (1) the Fog index of MD&As (Fog Index), (2) the Bog index of the report (Bog Index), (3) the logarithm of the 10-K file size (Log(File Size)), and (4) the logarithm of the number of words in the MD&As (Log(Word Count)). It is unclear in the extant literature whether the readability of MD&As has any influence on sophisticated market participants. Because LPS takes into account readers’ prior knowledge, we predict that, when the language in an MD&A is less predictable, analysts find it difficult to process; that is, analysts have more diverse interpretations of a firm’s disclosure and face greater challenges to integrating the information into earnings forecasts. Our results show that after controlling for firm fixed effects, LPS is negatively and significantly associated with both Dispersion and AFE (at the 0.01 level). This result is consistent with our prediction that less predictable language in MD&As increases analysts’ processing costs. Specifically, a one-standard-deviation increase in LPS leads to decreases in Dispersion and AFE that are 3.61% (-0.0570*0.739/1.168) and 3.06% (-0.0547*0.739/1.321) of their standard deviations, respectively. By contrast, There are no significant relations (at the 0.05 level) between the Fog Index, Bog Index, or Log(File Size) and analyst forecast dispersion. Additionally, we observed a positive association between Log(File Size) and analyst forecast accuracy.

16505522.label: Major findings and research outcome
16505522.value: In this study, we propose a new measure of readability based on the concept of language predictability, which has strong theoretical roots and experimental support in psycholinguistics and cognitive science. We argue that it is conceptually appropriate for measuring the readability of corporate disclosures because it considers the context in which words are read and gauges the difficulty of comprehension from the perspective of the target audience. Specifically, reading difficulty for a text increases when the words encountered as the continuation of the preceding words (i.e., the context) are more unexpected for a target audience with certain types of language ability, domain knowledge, and backgrounds. Implementing the concept has become technologically feasible thanks to the recent advancement of LLMs such as GPT-2 and BERT that are sufficiently powerful to imitate the language ability of a general population or, with fine-tuning strategies, the ability of a special population. Using a large sample of MD&As, we show how to implement language predictability using GPT-2. In the validation tests, we find that our readability measure, LPS, distinguishes coherent text from incoherent text that consists of the exact same words and classifies the boilerplate content (repeating and generic language) in MD&As as predictable, while the existing measures (i.e., the Fog and Bog indexes and file size), by contrast, are not able to do so. We show further that the LPS of MD&As has a significant impact on the post-filing information environment. Specifically, after controlling for firm fixed effects, we find that lower language predictability in the MD&A section of an annual report is associated with larger post-filing stock return volatility as well as greater dispersion and lower accuracy in analysts’ earnings forecasts. Contrary to the arguments put forth by Bonsall et al. (2017) that the clarity of disclosures does not affect the processing cost of sophisticated information intermediaries such as analysts, we find strong and consistent evidence that the readability of corporate disclosures measured by language predictability indeed impacts analysts’ processing costs. We also find that the readability of non-boilerplate content has a significant influence on analysts while that of boilerplate content does not. This finding suggests that analysts can identify boilerplate language and may consider it irrelevant. Overall, this new measure of readability contributes important new insights to the literature on processing costs. Given its conceptual appeals and technological feasibility, we believe this measure has great potential to broaden textual research in accounting and finance. Future research can assess its usefulness in measuring readability of other qualitative business documents, such as conference call transcripts, news articles, social media text, and regulatory announcements. We have finished writing the paper and the paper is under preparation in submitting to one of the top business journals.

16505522.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16505522.value: I plan to study our proposed new measure in other context of company disclosure. Conference call is an ideal channel for investors to understand company's operations and planning. It would be impactful if the measure can extract and summarize the complex information from the conference call meeting transcripts.

16505522.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16505522.value: We propose a new readability measure, the language predictability score (LPS), to assess the processing costs associated with comprehending corporate disclosure text. Our measure has strong theoretical roots and experimental support in psycholinguistics and cognitive science. Unlike the three most commonly used readability measures (i.e., the Fog index, the Bog index, and file size), the LPS measures readability based on the context of words and the target audience of the text. We use the large language models GPT-2 and BERT—which, after pre-training and fine-tuning, imitate the language ability of investors—to estimate the LPSs of a large sample of management discussion and analysis (MD&As) of annual reports. In validity tests, we show that the LPS identifies incoherent text as less readable and boilerplate content as more readable. In the main tests, we show that, after controlling for firm fixed effects, the LPSs of MD&As are significantly associated with post-filing stock return volatility as well as dispersion and accuracy in analysts’ earnings forecasts and that the LPS outperforms the Fog index, the Bog index, and file size in explaining analysts’ processing costs.

16506122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16506122.value: 多服務系統的定價模型：排隊效應對捆綁銷售的影響

16506122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506122.value: Bundling is a pervasive marketing strategy. Examples include buffets which are bundles of different foods, and all-inclusive tickets to amusement parks that allow entry to various rides and attractions. Many studies show that bundling enables firms to extract consumer surplus “when it reduces the dispersion in their willingness to pay”. In this project, we intend to take a closer look at the bundling strategy in the service sector characterized by a congestion effect, a prominent feature that differentiates the service sector from other consumer sectors. The presence of a congestion effect, which is common in service provision, implies that customers often have to queue for their requested services. The experience of waiting in a queue diminishes the appeal of a target service and reduces customers’ willingness to pay for that service. In this project, we will demonstrate the critical impact of queuing and congestion on a monopoly firm’s decision on whether to bundle or unbundle multiple services. The goals of this project are threefold: to develop simple, realistic models that capture the essence of several multi-service queuing contexts of interest; to identify the effect of queuing and congestion on a monopoly service firm's optimal bundling and pricing strategies; and to propose possible solutions to strengthen the economic benefits of bundling or remedies to overcome its disadvantage. Understanding the performance of bundling in congested service settings is crucial for the optimal planning of the service sector in Hong Kong, which contributed to 93.1% of the region’s gross domestic product (GDP) in 2018. Bundling is a widespread strategy in service-oriented businesses such as amusement parks and restaurants that offer buffets or set menus. A notable exception is the recent transition of Ocean Park Hong Kong from a full-price admission ticketing scheme to a pay-as-you-go scheme. This draws attention to the question of how bundling performs in congested service settings where customers incur disutility from waiting in lines. The potential beneficiaries of the proposed project are the general service sector. Many service firms regard bundling as an effective marketing strategy to manage multiple services. The proposed project will help these firms gain a better understanding of the performance of bundling when the services they provide are capacity-constrained and subject to congestion-prone delays. This project will also delineate the scope and applicability of other operational measures, such as priorities, and demonstrate how they can be leveraged in conjunction with pricing and bundling for better revenues and profits. 捆綁銷售是常用的營銷手段：自助餐把各種食物捆綁銷售，遊樂園把各種遊樂設施捆綁銷售。研究表明捆綁銷售可以讓企業通過降低消費者消費意願的分散程度來汲取消費者盈餘。在此項目中，我們計劃研究捆綁銷售在服務業中的應用。服務業有一個顯著特徵，那就是排隊效應，這個特徵將服務業同其他產業區分開來。 排隊效應在服務系統中非常常見。大部分的排隊經歷並不愉快，這使得排隊獲得服務的吸引力有所下降，從而降低消費者排隊購買服務的意願。在此項目中，我們將呈現排隊效應對服務性企業捆綁銷售的影響。我們為此項目設置了三個目標：1. 建立簡單、符合實際的模型來刻畫多服務排隊系統的本質；2. 研究排隊效應對服務性企業捆綁銷售和定價模式的影響；3. 提出可行的方案來增強捆綁銷售的經濟效應或者減輕捆綁銷售的不利影響。 理解捆綁銷售在服務系統中的應用對香港的服務業至關重要。香港的服務業在2018年佔到了整個地區GDP的93.1%，而捆綁銷售在其中有廣泛應用，例如遊樂園銷售套票，餐館銷售自助餐和套餐。有一個例外是香港海洋公園，它最近完成了從銷售套票到銷售單票（消費者玩多少買多少）的轉變。這激發了我們對捆綁銷售的研究，尤其是它在服務業中的運用。 此項目的受眾是服務型企業。此項目將會幫助服務型企業更好地理解捆綁銷售的適用性和局限性，尤其是當這些企業的服務系統具有強烈的排隊效應。此項目還將研究如何運用其他運營手段，比如服務顧客的優先級次序，與捆綁銷售結合起來最大程度地提升企業盈利和消費者盈餘。

16506522.value: 基于奖励的众筹中项目发布时间对其支持程度的影响

Explore how the extent and rationality of herding vary across different project categories. Provide implications for platform owners, project creators, and backers.

16506522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506522.value: Reward-based crowdfunding platforms enable entrepreneurs to raise funds for their creative projects from a large number of backers across the globe. Unlike institutional or angel investors, individual backers may lack the knowledge and expertise to fully assess the quality of crowdfunding projects. However, potential backers can observe others’ choices before deciding themselves, which may give rise to herding. Herding can be either rational or irrational. If individuals make unbiased inferences based on the information gained from observing others’ decisions, herding is rational. In contrast, if individuals neglect the factors behind others’ choices and follow them blindly, herding is irrational. The existence of irrational herding may lead to skewed resource utilization and generate socially undesirable outcomes. In this proposed research project, we aim to shed light on the rationality of backers’ herding behavior by leveraging the role of launch time, a factor that affects the initial demand of projects independent of their intrinsic quality, in shaping the decisions of subsequent backers. If backers are engaging in rational herding, the initial popularity from better launch time should not significantly affect the level of subsequent support. However, if different launch times also lead to different levels of backer support in the later period of fundraising, this would suggest the existence of irrational herding. In addition, we plan to explore how the extent and rationality of herding vary across different project categories. This research will make several important contributions. First, it will enrich the literature on factors that may drive the success of crowdfunding campaigns by investigating the role of project launch time, a subtle but important factor that has been overlooked previously. Second, it will contribute to the literature on herding by providing insights into the rationality of backers’ herding behavior in reward-based crowdfunding. Third, the results from this research bear important implications for platform owners, project creators, and backers. 基于奖励的众筹平台使企业家能够从全球大量支持者那里为他们的创意项目筹集资金。与机构或天使投资者不同，个人支持者可能缺乏全面评估众筹项目质量的专业知识和能力。但是，潜在的支持者可以在做决定之前观察他人的选择，从而导致羊群/从众效应。从众可以是理性的，也可以是非理性的。如果个人根据观察他人决策获得的信息做出正确的决定，则从众行为是理性的。相反，如果个人忽视他人选择背后的因素而盲目追随，从众是非理性的。非理性从众的存在可能导致资源利用的倾斜，并产生社会不良后果。在这个拟议的研究项目中，我们旨在通过利用项目发布时间对其支持程度的影响来探索从众行为的合理性。项目的发布时间是一个与内在质量无关但会影响初始需求的因素。如果支持者在进行理性从众，那么更好的发布时间带来的初始人气应该不会显著影响后续支持的水平。但是，如果不同的发布时间也导致了后期募资的程度不同，则说明存在非理性从众行为。此外，我们计划探索不同项目类别中从众行为的程度和合理性如何变化。这项研究将做出几个重要贡献。首先，它把项目的发布时间作为一个可能推动众筹活动成功的因素。研究这个以前被忽视的微妙但重要的因素将会丰富众筹领域的文献。第二，它通过探讨羊群效应在众筹平台的存在和合理性促进对于羊群效应的研究。第三，这项研究的结果对平台所有者、项目创建者和支持者具有重要意义。

16506622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16506622.value: The Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) launched by China in 2013 has received massive global attention and engendered profound impact. Chinese state-owned enterprises (SOEs) are usually in charge of implementing these projects, with host-country firms as partners or subcontractors. In addition, China is pushing forward third-party cooperation under the BRI, allowing third-country multinational enterprises (MNEs) to also play a proactive role in BRI projects. Given the various parties involved and the intricate relationships among them, BRI project implementation can be quite complex. The global spread of the COVID-19 pandemic further added uncertainty. In this study we propose to apply institutional and geopolitical perspectives to examine what influences the selection of a local firm or third-country MNE to participate in a BRI project. We also propose to investigate the resilience of BRI projects by looking into BRI projects’ survival during the COVID-19 pandemic. We will conduct both quantitative and qualitative studies to address these research questions. We propose to portray the selection of a local firm or third-country MNE to participate in a BRI project as a one-tier bargaining game between China and a host country. Institutions and geopolitics influence the legitimacy of Chinese SOEs in a host country and the relative bargaining power between China and the host country, shaping the likelihood of a local firm or third-country MNE participating in BRI projects. We argue that although having local and third-country firms involved in BRI projects can help build legitimacy and increase the likelihood of a project’s survival during the pandemic, the relationship depends on public sentiment towards China in the host country and also on China’s medical support to the host country during COVID-19. To have a more nuanced understanding of how to improve the resilience of BRI projects, we propose to supplement our quantitative analyses with a qualitative study on the key factors affecting project implementation during the pandemic. We will interview key stakeholders in two BRI projects in Indonesia and Vietnam respectively. The BRI serves as a unique context where firms and government agencies jointly shape future political landscapes. Studying it should help deepen theoretical understanding of firm strategy and geopolitics. We hope to illuminate how institutional and geopolitical dynamics affect the cooperation between Chinese and foreign firms in BRI projects and how to improve the resilience of such projects to major global disturbances. 中国在2013年启动的“一带一路”倡议受到了全球广泛关注并产生了深远影响。中国国有企业通常负责实施这些项目，东道国企业作为合作伙伴或分包商。此外，中国还积极推进“一带一路”倡议下的第三方合作，允许第三国的跨国企业积极参与“一带一路”项目。“一带一路”项目涉及各方，关系错综复杂，实施过程十分复杂。新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情在全球蔓延，进一步增加了不确定性。在本研究中，我们提议从制度和地缘政治的视角来研究是什么影响了东道国当地企业或第三国跨国公司参与“一带一路”项目。我们还提议通过考察“一带一路”项目在新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情期间的生存状况，研究“一带一路”项目的韧性。我们将进行定量和定性研究来解决这些研究问题。 我们提议将选择东道国当地企业或第三国跨国公司参与“一带一路”建设的过程刻画为中国与东道国之间的一层谈判博弈。制度和地缘政治影响着中国国有企业在东道国的合法性，以及中国与东道国之间的相对谈判力，从而影响东道国当地企业或第三国跨国公司参与“一带一路”项目的可能性。我们认为，尽管让东道国当地企业和第三国跨国公司参与“一带一路”项目有助于建立合法性，增加项目在新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情期间存活的可能性，但这种关系取决于东道国对中国的公众情绪，也取决于中国在新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情期间对东道国的医疗支持。 为了更精确地理解如何提高“一带一路”项目的韧性，我们建议在定量分析的基础上，对新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情期间影响项目实施的关键因素进行定性研究。我们将分别对在印度尼西亚和越南进行的各一个“一带一路”项目的主要利益相关者进行深度访谈。 “一带一路”是一个由企业和政府机构共同塑造未来政治格局的独特情境。研究它有助于加深对企业战略和地缘政治的理论理解。我们希望阐明制度和地缘政治动态如何影响中外企业在“一带一路”项目中的合作，以及如何提高此类项目面对重大全球动荡时的韧性。

16507322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16507322.value: 具有動態條件依賴的圖形 copula GARCH 模型及其在金融和風險管理中的應用

16507322.label: Project Objectives
16507322.value: To develop the graphical copula GARCH (GC-GARCH) model and its Bayesian estimation procedures. To investigate statistical methods for determining the ordering of risk factors and the choice of conditional pairwise copulas in the GC-GARCH model. 16507322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16507322.value: Volatility modeling of financial returns is a key domain of research and exploration in econometrics and in the finance industry as volatility (commonly known as the standard deviation of financial returns) is a key measure of return variation and market risk. Studies in volatility modeling have been extended to multi-dimensional perspectives where multiple financial returns are modeled simultaneously to capture dependence in returns or possible co-movement patterns of financial assets. Recently, it has been recognized that multi-dimensional modeling can lead to computational challenges especially when aiming to simultaneously model a large number of returns dynamically. Existing volatility modeling methods are either hardly scalable or unable to model nonlinear dependence successfully due to usual distributional restrictions, for example, multivariate normal assumptions of returns. A class of volatility models able to handle a large number of financial return time series and capture nonlinear relationships among financial returns is crucial for sustaining the success of financial development in the information age. With the availability of big financial data and demand for accurate financial risk assessments on large portfolios, it is a pressing issue to develop a practical modeling scalable framework able to incorporate empirical stylized facts and nonlinear dependence in financial returns, and also to assess impacts of extreme financial events, pandemics or natural disasters. In this proposed project we aim to develop a volatility modeling framework, its statistical inference methods and to investigate its financial applications. The core idea of this project is to integrate ideas of the seminal capital asset pricing theory, graphical models and copulas, a statistical concept to capture nonlinear dependence. Bayesian methodologies will be developed for estimation and prediction under the proposed volatility model. Financial applications on asset allocation, tail risk calculation and systemic risk management will be investigated in the proposal. Findings from this project will advance volatility modeling in a high-dimensional setting, benefiting practitioners in the finance industry, financial technology developers and regulators by extending their success in sustainable finance with the leverage of big data, cutting-edge analytical tools and modern information technology. 金融回報的波動率建模是計量經濟學和金融業研究和探索的關鍵領域，因為波動率（亦即金融回報的標準差）是回報變化和市場風險的關鍵衡量標準。波動率建模的研究已擴展到多維角度，其中同時對多個金融回報進行建模，以捕捉回報的依賴性或金融資產可能的聯動模式。近來人們認識到多維建模可能會導致計算挑戰，尤其目標是對大量回報同時動態建模的情況。由於通常的分佈限制（例如，回報的多元正態假設），現有的波動率建模方法難以擴展，或者無法成功地模擬非線性依賴性。新類型能夠處理大量回報時間序列並捕捉回報之間非線性關係的波動率模型對於保持資訊時代金融發展的成功至關重要。 隨著金融大數據的可用性和對大型投資組合準確金融風險評估的需求，開發一個實用的建模可擴展框架將經驗程式化事實和財務回報的非線性依賴性結合起來，並評估極端金融事件、流行病或自然災害的影響是一個迫切的問題。在這個提議的項目中，我們的目標是開發一個波動率建模框架、它的統計推斷方法並研究它的金融應用。該項目的核心思路是整合開創性資本資產定價理論、圖形模型和 copula 這個捕捉非線性依賴的統計概念。貝葉斯方法將被開發用於在提議的波動率模型下進行估計和預測。提案將研究資產配置、尾部風險計算和系統性風險管理的金融應用。該項目的研究結果將在高維環境中推進波動率建模，通過利用大數據、尖端分析工具和現代信息技術擴大可持續金融領域的成功，使金融行業從業人員、金融技術開發商和監管機構受益.

16507322.label: Realisation of objectives
16507322.value: In this project, we developed a financial time series model with the use of hidden graphical structures in financial variables. In addition, copula functions were incorporated in the hidden graphs to allow more flexibility in modeling the distribution of financial time series. Primary project results were documented in Chan, Chu and So (2024a) “Graphical copula GARCH modeling with dynamic conditional dependence”. In the paper, we addressed objectives 1 to 3 of this project to develop a graphical copula GARCH model, Bayesian inference methods for estimating the unknown graph and unknown parameters, and Bayesian predictive approach for forecasting dynamic covariance, conditional quantiles. We also demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed graphical copula GARCH model in portfolio management, which addresses objective 4 of this project. The working paper, Chan, Chu and So (2024a) was submitted for publication and is available in https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15582. One limitation of the model in Chan, Chu and So (2024a) is that the graph governing the dependent structures of financial variables is fixed over time. We extended our early works to allow the graph to change over time. A main idea is to model the time series of “edge addition” and “edge detection” of graphs over time, from which we can learn the graph at time t from the graph at time t-1 using the number of edges added and deleted at time t. The above methodology and related findings were documented in Chan, Chu and So (2024b) “Dynamic Bayesian Networks with Conditional Dynamics in Edge Addition and Deletion”. We also illustrated how we can form efficient portfolios using the proposed dynamic network models. The working paper, Chan, Chu and So (2024b) was submitted for publication and is available in https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.08965. In the two working papers, Chan, Chu and So (2024a, 2024b), we assumed a typical case that there is one type of network linkage. We are working on an extension to consider multi-view networks, which can accommodate more than one network linkages. It is expected that this extension will be completed and submitted for publication by the end of 2025. A preliminary version of the paper, Chan, Chu and So (2024c) “Multi-view dynamic network modeling” is attached in this report.

16507322.label: Major findings and research outcome
16507322.value: In the working paper Chan, Chu and So (2024a) “Graphical copula GARCH modeling with dynamic conditional dependence”, we developed a multivariate financial time series model with the dependence structure determined by a latent graph. We also built in copula functions within the graph to allow flexible modeling of the distribution of high-dimensional financial return variables. A statistical challenge is to estimate the latent graph and the copula functions from the data. In the paper, we developed a Bayesian method which effectively estimates the unknown graph and parameters in the model and facilitates Bayesian prediction for portfolio and risk management. In the working paper Chan, Chu and So (2024b) “Dynamic Bayesian Networks with Conditional Dynamics in Edge Addition and Deletion”, we introduced two count data time series. One is to represent the number of newly added edges from time t-1 to time t and the other is to represent the number of edges deleted from the graph at time t-1. Through the two count data time series, we did structural learning for a time series of graphs, from which the graphical pattern governing the dependence structure of the time series variables can be time-varying. Bayesian inference methods were developed for the proposed model. There is also an on-going paper focusing on a multi-view network model. A main focus is to have more than one network linkage to study the relationships of financial variables. Bayesian statistical methods were developed and tested using simulated and real data. Preliminary results were presented in a working paper attached in this report.

Investigate alternative statistical methods for estimating latent graphs and unknown parameters. 3. Explore more applications of the proposed network models in business and social sciences. 4. Continue on the study of the statistical properties of the multi-view network model specification in Chan, Chu and So (2024c).

16507322.value: A main objective of this project is to develop network-based statistical models for analyzing multiple financial time series. Through uncovering hidden network structures in financial time series, we can learn complex relationships among financial returns. It was demonstrated in the research findings that the proposed network-based models can effectively handle portfolio and risk management problems. It is expected that the proposed models can also be applicable to other business and social sciences problems, especially if we can extend the methodology in this project to model networks with more than one type of network linkages.

16508322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16508322.value: 公司经常在其财务报告中使用非公认会计准则收益。因为不包括准则要求的某些项目，例如重组费用，资产减值，或与并购相关的成本，这些替代性业绩指标不符合公认会计准则。在这项研究中，我们提出非公认会计准则的绩效指标可以在有效契约和激励创新方面发挥积极作用。由于突破性创新通常涉及多次暂时性的失败，因此坚持克服这些失败是最终成功的必要条件。这就是为什么创新项目通常被构建为准自治的组织单元，其暂时失败可以报告为重组费用、资产减值和并购活动的成本。我们认为，将与创新有关的中期业绩从非公认会计准则绩效指标中排除有助于激励企业高管更努力地启动创新项目，并坚持纠正在项目实施过程中出现的中期问题。非公认会计准则的衡量标准也有助于将公司高管的注意力集中在内部产生的关于项目中期进展的信息上，从而提高公司的决策效率。根据我们的理论观点，我们预期经常性的报告非公认会计准则收益会提高公司创新的数量和质量（以专利数量和引用来衡量）。我们还发展了一系列和高管，公司和运营环境的特征相关的截面预测。我们进一步研究经常性的报告非会计准则收益是否与公司的创新投资活动正相关。总之，我们的研究为解释非公认会计准则绩效指标如何产生积极的实际经济影响的一个重要机制提供了新的思路：通过提高与管理者的契约效率。

16508322.label: Realisation of objectives
16508322.value: We have achieved the three objectives through our empirical analysis. To achieve the first objective, we estimate the effect of routine non-GAAP reporting on a firm’s innovation output and innovation efficiency. We measure innovation output using patent count and patent citation. We use the innovation output-to-input ratio as our measure of innovation efficiency, where innovation input is based on R&D investment. To achieve the second objective, we conduct several cross-sectional analyses conditional on corporate governance mechanisms related to (i) the CEO characteristics, (ii) the corporate board characteristics, and (iii) the investor characteristics. To achieve the third objective, we test the effect of routine non-GAAP reporting on a firm’s R&D investment. We measure routine non-GAAP reporting as the proportion of quarters with non-GAAP reporting during the previous two years. We use a firm’s R&D expenses scaled by total assets in the next three years as our measure of innovative investment activities. We document our empirical results in the attached working paper " Non-GAAP Reporting and Innovation Efficiency." In our working paper, we first document the motivating effect of non-GAAP reporting on firm innovation (input and output), then demonstrate a downside of this motivation effect (i.e., lower innovation efficiency). Our working paper originally focused on the motivating effect of non-GAAP reporting on innovative activities. However, two recent papers (McClure and Zakolyukina 2024; Ahn et al. 2025) also suggest that non-GAAP reporting can motivate corporate managers to increase their investment in tangible and intangible capital. To differentiate from these studies, we have revised our paper to focus more on the downside of this motivating effect, which is novel. We argue and predict that while non-GAAP reporting helps motivate innovative activities, this motivating effect can come at a cost of lower innovation efficiency. Our results confirm this prediction. Our study also highlights the importance of governance mechanisms in mitigating the negative effect of non-GAAP reporting on innovation efficiency. Our paper is currently under review at Review of Accounting Studies, a top accounting journal.

16508322.label: Major findings and research outcome
16508322.value: We find that routine non-GAAP reporting in the past is positively associated with both the inputs and outputs of corporate innovation activities in the future. Importantly, we also find that routine non-GAAP reporting is associated with lower innovation efficiency, providing new insights into the real economic effects of non-GAAP financial reporting. Consistent with the theoretical prediction that the relation between non-GAAP reporting and innovation efficiency is influenced by the quality of corporate governance, our results from our cross-sectional analyses indicate that the negative effect of the routine use of non-GAAP measures on innovation efficiency is mitigated by several widely used corporate governance mechanisms. These results highlight the importance of effective corporate governance in mitigating the potential overmotivating concerns of non-GAAP reporting.

16508322.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16508322.value: Our paper is currently under review at a top academic journal, Review of Accounting Studies. We will further improve the paper by incorporating comments and suggestions received during the review process. We plan to circulate our findings broadly in the future. We will share our research results with the wider community by drafting non-technical research summaries for publication with the aim of informing firms, corporate monitors, market participants, and regulators.

16508322.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16508322.value: Our study contributes to the literature on non-GAAP reporting. In this area, a recent stream of research investigates the effect of non-GAAP reporting on firm investment. We find that non-GAAP reporting is associated with increased investment in innovation activities, consistent with the motivating effect of non-GAAP reporting on innovation projects. Importantly, we find that this motivation effect can come at a cost of lower innovation efficiency. Our study also adds to the literature by documenting the role of corporate governance in mitigating the adverse effect of non-GAAP reporting on innovation efficiency. Our evidence suggests that, in addition to the effect of non-GAAP reporting on motivating investment, researchers should consider the governance mechanisms firms have to deploy concurrently to ensure that innovative activities translate into performance improvements. Finally, our findings have important implications for regulators and standard setters. The SEC has repeatedly expressed concerns about the potential for reported non-GAAP measures to mislead investors. Focusing on the influence of non-GAAP reporting on firms’ real economic performance, our results suggest that while non-GAAP reporting can help solve the well-known problem that managers tend to underinvest in R&D activities due to managerial incentives, it can have an unintended consequence by decreasing innovation efficiency.

16600322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16600322.value: What does it mean to belong, for people from South Asian backgrounds in Hong Kong? Working in the tradition of linguistic ethnography, with trans-generational groups of South Asians alongside a photographer and in collaboration with a partner support organisation, we explore experiences of belonging through oral narratives and participatory photography. Belonging is a person’s experience of identity in relation to affinity with a place, a space or a community, and the project aims to understand how people from across generations in South Asian communities in Hong Kong define, understand, find and negotiate their belonging. This work addresses a specific, urgent social need. South Asians in Hong Kong continue to experience systemic discrimination, unequal access to education, employment, and public services, and barriers to participation in civic activities. The minoritisation they face is brought into stark relief by the Covid-19 crisis and by recent political change. This renders established and essentialized ideas of belonging in terms of cultural and linguistic homogeneity inadequate and in need of challenge and scrutiny. The project studies the experience of belonging from an emic or insider perspective. We will recruit a diverse sample of people from South Asian backgrounds, thereby enabling us to explore how belonging and settlement are shaped by intersecting concerns of age, gender, language, culture, ethnicity, education and social class. Using an approach informed by narrative research and participatory arts research methods, we ask: (1) How does belonging emerge in and through narrative and photography? (2) How (with participants and our partner) can we develop innovative approaches to researching belonging? and (3) How can our theoretically-grounded understandings of belonging be used to inform policies, practices and public debate on social integration? The project will achieve societal impact by providing an evidence base to inform social policy, promoting equality for South Asians in Hong Kong. It will embed the learning in practice through the co-production of a website where digital stories based on oral narratives and photographs are displayed, and a community-based exhibition of the narratives and photographs. The findings and outputs will be further disseminated through a stakeholder symposium and a public- and policy-facing report published in collaboration with the partner organisation. The work will be presented at two key academic conferences, and the project will produce three high-impact journal articles in the field of the sociolinguistics of mobility. The dataset will be archived for future researchers’ use. 在香港，归属感对具有南亚背景的人来说意味着什么？我们秉承着语言民族志的传统，与跨代的南亚群体和摄影师以及伙伴支持组织合作，通过口头叙事和参与式摄影探索归属感的体验。归属感是一个人与一个地方、一个空间或一个群体的亲和力相关的身份体验，该项目旨在了解在香港的跨代南亚群体如何定义、理解、寻找以及协商他们的归属感。此项目解决了一个特定的、紧迫的社会需求。在香港，南亚群体持续遭受系统性的歧视，在获得教育、就业和公共服务方面受到不平等的待遇，在参与公民活动方面面临障碍。新冠肺炎危机和最近的政治变革突显了他们所面临的少数族裔化。这使得在文化和语言同质性方面的既定和本质化的归属观念变得不充分，并且需要受到质疑和审视。 该项目从主位或局内人的角度研究归属感的体验。我们将招募具有南亚背景的多元化样本，从而使我们能够探索归属感和聚居地是如何通过年龄、性别、语言、文化、种族、教育和社会阶层的交叉问题而形成的。采用叙事研究和参与式艺术的研究方法，该项目的研究问题包括： （1）归属感是如何通过叙事和摄影出现的？ （2）我们如何(与参与者和我们的合作伙伴一起)开发研究归属感的创新方法？ （3）我们对归属感基于理论的理解如何用于为有关社会融合的政策、实践以及公众辩论提供信息？ 该项目将通过为社会政策提供证据基础，促进香港南亚群体的平等，从而产生社会影响。该项目将通过联合制作一个网站，展示基于口头叙述和照片的数字故事，以及一个基于社区的叙述和照片展览，将学习融入实践。研究结果和产出将通过参与者研讨会和与伙伴组织合作出版的面向公众和政策的报告进一步传播。该项目的研究成果将在两个重要的学术会议上发表，并且在流动的社会语言学领域发表三篇高影响力的期刊文章。该数据集将被存档以供未来研究人员使用。

16601022.value: Prof Mah, Ngar-yin Daphne Prof Tam, Kim-Pong

16601022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601022.value: Pandemic lockdowns and Hong Kong’s unusually long, hot days and nights in 2020 have increased residential electricity use in the city by 8.7% compared to that of 2019. Energy demand, especially for cooling, will continue to increase with more frequent weather extremes. Vulnerable individuals, households, and social groups are at risk of being energy insecure in their homes or at the workplace. Energy insecurity refers to the lack of access to and inability to afford safe and sustainable energy, and exists across several forms of energy services, from lighting to cooking to cooling, as well as for powering medical and other health-related devices. However, the Hong Kong government has yet to recognize energy insecurity in its official statistics and energy policy. Knowledge is scant on the groups that constitute as Hong Kong’s energy poor, their spatial location, their intersectional vulnerabilities that lead to higher risk of energy insecurity, the overlapping impacts of energy insecurity on their wellbeing and dignity, and their coping mechanisms. With little attention focused on energy insecurity in the city’s research and policy landscapes, this proposed project will use mixed-method research to address these gaps. A survey dataset from a sample of 1,000 respondents from various vulnerable strata will be quantitatively analyzed using the energy justice framework, complemented with ethnographies and case studies, with attention to intersectionality. Energy justice aims to ensure that all individuals are able to access safe, affordable, sustainable, and modern energy services that allow them to maintain a dignified lifestyle, as well as to have the opportunity to engage in and lead in decision-making. The proposed project will adopt a multidimensional framework with four building units: vulnerability, impact, coping, and response. ‘Vulnerability’ includes the physical, socioeconomic, and climatic determinants of vulnerability that increase the energy insecurity risk of a particular individual, household, or social group. ‘Impact’ explores how energy insecurity threatens the financial, social, health, and environmental well-being of the identified vulnerable populations. ‘Coping’ describes how energy insecure individuals or groups produce their adaptive capacity via improvisation and implementation of extreme energy conservation measures. ‘Response’ normatively examines how policy and programmatic interventions can address, if not eliminate, energy insecurity. The study’s outputs will lead to novel insights that can provide inputs into future decision- and policymaking, aimed at recognizing and addressing this type of deprivation in Hong Kong and possibly in other similar dense urban areas in the world. 摘要：因疫情封鎖居民甚少離開家居，再加上經歷不尋常的長時間酷熱天氣，香港在2020年的住宅用電量比起2019年增加了 8.7%。隨著極端天氣事件愈加頻繁，能源需求——尤其是製冷需求——將繼續增長。弱勢人士、家庭及社會群體在家中或工作場所都面臨著能源不安全的風險。能源不安全是指人們無法獲得及無法負擔安全、可持續能源的狀況。從照明、煮食到製冷，再到為醫療和其他與健康相關的設備供電，能源不安全的隱患在多種能源服務形式中存在。然而，現時香港政府尚未在其官方統計數據和能源政策中定義能源不安全。對於香港的能源貧窮群體、他們身處的地理位置、各種導致能源不安全的脆弱性因素、能源不安全對其福祉和尊嚴的疊加影響以及他們的應對策略等，整個社會知之甚少。由於能源不安全在香港的學術研究和政策環境中甚少受到關註，本建議計劃將使用混合方法來彌補研究空白。我們將使用能源正義框架，對來自不同弱勢階層的一千名受訪者的調查數據集進行定量分析，並輔以民族誌和案例分析進行交叉性研究。能源正義旨在確保所有人都能獲得安全、可負擔、可持續的現代能源服務，使人們能夠保持有尊嚴的生活方式，並有機會參與和領導決策。擬議計劃將採用一個多維分析框架，包括四個構建單元：脆弱性、影響、應對和政策響應。 「脆弱性」是指包括物理、社會經濟和氣候等加劇個人、家庭或社會群體的能源不安全風險的脆弱因素。 「影響」探討了能源不安全如何威脅被確定為弱勢群體的財產、社會生活、健康和環境福祉。 「應對」指能源不安全的個人或群體如何即興或有計劃地實施嚴格的節能措施來提高適應能力。「政策響應」規範性地評估了公共政策和政府幹預如何應對（如果不能消除）能源不安全問題。是次研究的成果將為未來的政府決策和政策製定帶來新的洞見，為香港以及世界上其他類似的人口密集型城市地區識別和應對可能存在的能源剝奪問題提供政策建議。

16601122.value: 動態規範訊息的使用與氣候變化政策的民眾支持度

16601122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601122.value: 氣候變化帶來環境變遷，威脅人類生活。要減緩氣候變化，各國必須實施減排政策，而這些政策能否落實，大眾的支持至為關鍵。有見及此，本研究期望通過實驗解答以下問題：引述其他國家目前為減緩氣候變化所作的努力，以及指出近年減排政策越趨盛行，能否推動大眾支持自己國家的減排政策？而其背後的心理過程為何？本研究將有助識別傳播氣候變化信息的有效策略，並填補過去研究的不足，有望為香港特區政府及環團提供有參考價值的資訊。

16601622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601622.value: 邁向 1.5°C 生活模式：是什麼推動香港的可持續消費選擇？

16601622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16601622.value: Prof Mukhopadhyay, Anirban Dr Timmer, Vanessa

16601622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601622.value: What motivates people to engage in more ‘sustainable’ behaviours? Research shows that even environmentally-conscious individuals struggle to make consumption choices that are aligned with societal sustainability goals. It is even more challenging to influence the behaviours of those who are less-, or un-motivated by environmental concerns. On the other hand, people do make ‘sustainable’ consumption choices, even when their underlying motivations are unrelated to the environment. They may be motivated by financial considerations, status, or taste factors – and when these align with sustainability, the net result of their choices may be positive. Thus, policymakers, businesses, and civil society groups working towards sustainability goals are left with a conundrum. Sometimes, even the most dedicated sustainability warriors engage in problematic behaviours; sometimes those with little concern for the environment make choices that contribute to sustainability. Given the increased importance of the Sustainable Development Goals and carbon dioxide emissions reductions targets for policymakers globally, there is increasing attention to the role that individual consumption choices play in meeting these societal goals. One key element of sustainability will require the design of products and activities that enable people to consume sustainably, while still appealing to the preferences and motivations that are meaningful to individuals in their socio-economic and cultural contexts. The goal of this project is to understand how megacities like Hong Kong shift towards more sustainable lifestyles, and the factors that would motivate people in Hong Kong to engage in habits and behaviours that support sustainability goals. This project will adapt and extend previous work from Finland and Canada to the Hong Kong context. We will engage with local individuals, NGOs, think tanks, and businesses to develop hypotheses about the underlying motivational profiles of Hong Kongers. We will test those hypotheses via a survey of 1500 Hong Kong residents. We will use cluster analysis to extract the “Hong Kong consumption motivation clusters”, and to translate these into consumer profiles that can be used to target products and programs to support sustainable lifestyles. Throughout the project, we will work closely with interested parties in the Hong Kong community, to produce research that is both academically important, but also locally impactful. This will be the first study of this kind in Hong Kong and will contribute a unique understanding of the Hong Kong context into scholarly and practical literature that is largely dominated by European and North American cultural perspectives. 什麼能夠促使人們更會實踐“可持續”的行為研究表示，即使具有環保意識的人也很難作出符合社會需要的可持續發展目標的消費選擇, 所以要令那些對環境問題甚少動機的人實踐“可持續”更具挑戰性。另一方面，即使人們的潛在動機與環保無關, 他們也會不自覺地作出“可持續”的消費選擇。他們的動機可能是財務考慮、地位或品味因素——當這些因素與可持續性一致時，他們選擇的最終結果可能是有利的。因此，致力於實現可持續發展目標的政策制定者、企業和民間社會團體面臨著一個難題。有時候，即使是最投入的”可持續發展戰士“也會做出問題行為；反而那些不太關心環保的人士往往會作出有助於可持續性的選擇。鑑於可持續發展目標和二氧化碳減排目標對全球政策制定者的重要性日益增加，人們越來越關注個人消費選擇在實現這些社會目標中所起的作用。可持續性的一個主要元素將會需求重新設計產品和活動，使人們能夠可持續地消費，同時仍然可吸引在其社會經濟和文化背景下對個人有意義的偏好和動機。 此項目的目標是了解更多像香港這樣的大城市如何轉向更可持續的生活方式，以及了解促使香港人養成支持可持續發展目標的習慣和行為的因素。 此項目將調整和擴展芬蘭和加拿大過去的工作以適應香港的情況。我們將會與當地市民、非政府組織、智囊團和企業探悉，就香港人的潛在動機特徵提出假說。通過對1500名香港居民的調查來檢驗這些假說。我們將使用聚類分析來提取“香港消費動機集群”，並將其轉化為消費者概況，可用於針對支持可持續生活方式的產品和計劃。在整個項目中，我們會與香港社區的相關方密切合作，開展既具有學術意義又具有當地影響力的研究成果。這將會是香港首次作此類研究，並將對主要由歐洲和北美文化觀點主導的學術和實用文獻應用於香港本地的獨特理解。

16601722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16601722.value: 家庭流动资产异质性和货币政策

16601722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16601722.value: Recent research emphasizes the role of liquidity friction in the banking sector or interbank market and studies how it can affect the credit allocation and conduct of monetary policies. Meanwhile, empirical evidence suggests that households differ significantly in their holdings of liquid assets; more wealthy households usually hold more liquid assets than less wealthy households. Lack of liquid assets implies that these households may have difficulties in using their wealth to smooth their consumption. In this project, we intend to develop a two-country new Keynesian open economy macroeconomic model with household heterogeneity in liquid asset holding. In such a setting, the allocation of liquidity and the liquidity premium will be central issues in the conduct of monetary policy. We will first investigate how the international monetary transmission mechanism will be affected by the liquidity premium and asset holding heterogeneity within countries and between countries. Then we examine the optimal monetary policy and to what extent the monetary policy should respond to the liquidity premium and household heterogeneity. Finally, we consider the dominance of the USD assets in the global liquidity supply and study the optimal allocation of global liquidity and its welfare implications. 最近的一些研究强调了流动性摩擦在银行业或银行同业拆借市场中的作用，并研究它如何影响信贷分配和货币政策的传导机制。与此同时，实证表明，家庭持有的流动资产存在着显著的不同；较富裕的家庭通常比不那么富裕的家庭持有更多的流动资产。缺乏流动资产意味着在存在流动性摩擦时，这些家庭可能无法利用他们的财富来减少消费波动。但是，这些研究通常集中在封闭经济模型。在本研究中，我们打算把家庭持有流动资产的异质性引入两国新凯恩斯主义开放经济模型。这样的模型设定中，流动性分配和流动性风险溢价将成为货币政策操作中的核心因素之一。 我们将首先研究一国内和国家之间的流动性风险溢价和流动资产持有量的差别会如何影响货币政策传导的国际机制。然后我们分析货币政策应在何种程度上应对流动性风险溢价和家庭持有流动性资产的异质性，并在此基础上研究最优货币政策。最后，美国以及美元在全球流动性供给上拥有主导地位， 我们将分析这些因素会如何影响全球流动性的优化配置和社会福利。

16602022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16602022.value: Prof Dou, Winston Prof Tian, Di Prof Wu, Wei

16602022.label: Project Objectives
16602022.value: Theoretically, we would like to push the frontier of the literature by developing a framework with imperfectly competitive talent markets. The model will have the minimum amount of ingredients to elucidate the core theoretical mechanisms of talent competition clearly. At the same time, the model will provide several testable predictions. Empirically, we will construct a model-consistent measure of talent competition and link it to firm/industry characteristics. Based on this measure, we will test the model's predictions and provide new cross-sectional patterns of stock returns. Quantitatively, we will develop a full-fledged model based on our simple theoretical framework. The parameters of the full-fledged model will be calibrated to the data using the method of moments. We will use the model to study the quantitative importance of our proposed theoretical mechanism in terms of rationalizing the patterns observed in the data, the implications for asset prices and competition strategies, among others.
rows: Theoretically, we would like to push the frontier of the literature by developing a framework with imperfectly competitive talent markets. The model will have the minimum amount of ingredients to elucidate the core theoretical mechanisms of talent competition clearly. At the same time, the model will provide several testable predictions.

Empirically, we will construct a model-consistent measure of talent competition and link it to firm/industry characteristics. Based on this measure, we will test the model's predictions and provide new cross-sectional patterns of stock returns.

Quantitatively, we will develop a full-fledged model based on our simple theoretical framework. The parameters of the full-fledged model will be calibrated to the data using the method of moments. We will use the model to study the quantitative importance of our proposed theoretical mechanism in terms of rationalizing the patterns observed in the data, the implications for asset prices and competition strategies, among others.

16602022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602022.value: 现如今，在各行各业，公司对关键人才进行争夺十分普遍。然而，企业之间对于人才的竞争，如何影响企业的风险敞口和收益率？这仍是一个未解之题。为回答这个问题，本研究项目计划构建一个全新的理论模型框架，用以分析企业对关键人才的策略性争夺对资产价格在总体和横截面层面的影响：一方面，人才争夺有强周期性，竞争强度自身能构成了一个全新的风险因子，从而影响总体折现率和收益率；另一方面，因管理制度等因素存在差异，不同行业的企业间人才争夺强度各不相同。通过提出这一模型，我们将开创性地探索决定行业层面人才竞争强度和股票收益的行业本质特征。 本研究项目的创新点有三个方面。理论上，本研究将推动文献前沿，建立一个具有非完全竞争的核心人才市场的模型。实证上，本研究拟建立一个和模型相契合的关于总体的和行业间的人才竞争强度指标，并基于这个指标对模型预测做实证检验。定量上，本研究项目拟建立一个全面量化模型，对实际数据给与解释。

16602122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602122.value: 抗戰盟軍譯員與他們在大陸、台灣和美國的生命軌跡

16602122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602122.value: Focusing on the more than 4,000 Chinese interpreters for the American and British allied forces in the China-Burma-India Theater during World War II, this project examines their diverse backgrounds, varied wartime experiences, and divergent postwar trajectories in three different societies. Using interdisciplinary source materials—including archival documents, oral history, memoirs, reportage, poetry, and literature—this book will weave together the interpreters’ personal history with the larger military, political, diplomatic, and social history of World War II, the Chinese Civil War, the Korean War, and the Cold War across the Taiwan Strait and across the Pacific Ocean. With an eye for the human experience in all its complexity, this project examines the experiences of these elite young men and women who served their nation and its allies in war, made difficult choices after the war, and, for those who stayed in the PRC, paid a heavy price for their service. Analytically, this research interrogates the contested and changing meanings of loyalty for these young men and women across time and space. It also examines elite choice at several key junctures in war and revolution: whether to volunteer to serve as interpreters in the Second World War; whether to embrace or flee the communists in the Chinese Civil War; for those Chinese students studying in the United States, whether to return to China or stay in the United States in the 1950s; for those who stayed or returned to China, whether to speak up in the One Hundred Flowers Movement in 1956–1957 that preceded the Anti-Rightist Campaign; and how to survive the Cultural Revolution. 太平洋戰爭爆發後，中國政府動員四千餘名大學生為中緬印戰區的美英盟軍服務。本研究試圖重建這批大學生翻譯在戰爭中的經歷，也探尋他們在戰後的內戰與冷戰時期在大陸、台灣和美國的迥異抉擇與錯綜複雜的生命軌跡。利用跨學科的原始材料——包括檔案、口述歷史、回憶錄、報告文學、詩歌和文學——本研究將這批翻譯的個人生命史與二戰、中國內戰、韓戰與冷戰時期的軍事、政治、外交與社會史交織、融匯於一體。 這批投筆從戎的翻譯都是中國的精英，他們在抗戰中為祖國及盟國服務，在戰後作出艱難而迥異的抉擇，而那些留在大陸的譯員為他們的抗戰經歷付出了沉重的代價。本研究著眼於個人經歷的複雜性，審視在不同時期、不同地域，他們的「忠誠」的演變與衝突。

16602322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602322.value: 中国高校毕业生的迁移：1985-2020

16602322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602322.value: The migration of graduates in China has never been as significant as at present. It used to small in volume and unidirectional from the (City of) Higher Education Institutions (CHEIs) to the (City of) Hukou Origin (CHO), under the government’s planning and assignment systems. Since 1984, the private sector and market forces have been growing and attracting graduates to the National Growth Centers (NGCs) and overseas, while the public sector and planning institutions, such as hukou, remain important in influencing migration and family decisions. Recently, millions of overseas graduates have returned to NGCs. Here, we propose to study the migration of graduates in China, an important topic that remains understudied. Previous studies have focused on interregional migration and its economic consequences in the destination regions while neglecting overseas migration and impacts on the origin regions. We will adopt a comprehensive and dynamic approach by integrating domestic with overseas migration, market forces with state influences, and employment with settlement as the complete sets, mixed conditions, and joint objectives of migration. The sequential migration of graduates can thus be viewed as embedded choices of SPACE (across cities or countries), EMPLOYMENT (between the state and private sector), and MODE (between split and complete household). The integrated processes of migration cannot be effectively studied without high-quality microdata. Fortunately, we have the access to China’s recent census microdata, which contains complete records of migrating members in their previously registered households, member’s detailed socio-demographics, and a series of places of birth, hukou, current residence and residence five years ago. The unique data allows us to define migration across cities, and then distinguish them by residence (into domestic and overseas migration), by sequence (into primary, onward, and return migration) and by mode (into solitary, couple and family migration). We will first document trends and patterns from 1985 and onwards. We will then develop a multinomial and multimode logit model to explain graduates’ embedded choices of a sequential migration, employment and mode, to identify those who are likely to migrate sequentially, and what socioeconomic, environmental, institutional and political factors are important for their migration and settlement. Finally, we will examine the impacts of migration of graduates on both the origin and destination regions as well as the nation as a whole, identify implications for hukou and education reforms, and explore migration as an instrument to maximize the potential of human capital in the future growth of a knowledge-based economy. 中国高校毕业生的迁移目前成为一个重要课题。旧时代计划经济体制下，毕业生数量少，由国家分配，大多从高校所在城市(CHEIs)回到户口所在地(CHO)。自1984 年改革以来，私营部门在增长，市场力量在加强，吸引了众多高校毕业生到沿海经济发展中心区域(NGC)，还有不少求学海外。公营部门和计划机制， 特别是户口，仍在影响毕业生和家庭迁移。近年来，数百万海外毕业生回国，流向沿海发达地区。 我们申请中国高校毕业生迁移这一课题，首先是因为这方面的研究欠缺，再有是其日益增长的重要性。以前研究集中在毕业生国内跨区域迁移及其对目的地经济影响，而忽略了海外迁移（留学和海归）及其对出发地的影响。针对于此，我们采取了全面性和动态化的两个方式，结合境内和海外，市场和计划，及就业和安居三方面，分别作为毕业生迁移的研究主体，条件和目的。按此设计，高校毕业生的序列迁移可视为以下三方面的选择：空间(跨市/跨境)、部门（公/私营就业）和规模（单/双/多家庭成员）。研究如此复杂过程需要高质量的微观数据。我们从中国最近的人口普查原数据着手，其记录包含了所有户籍成员（包括迁出者）的完整记录、每个人社会人口特征和系列地址（出生地，户口地，现居住地及五年前居住地）。有这样结构独特地址详尽的数据，我们就能够准确定义高校毕业生迁移，按其居住地分跨市/跨境迁移、按次序分初迁、再迁和返迁，和按规模分单/双/多成员迁移。我们将首先分析1985 年后的毕业生迁移的趋势和形态模式。然后，我们会构建一个多元多形态的 logit 模型来完整解释毕业生迁移中对次序、就业和规模的三方面选择，来确定谁最可能迁移，哪些社会、经济、环境、制度和政治因素最重要。最后，我们将研究人才迁移对来源地，目的地乃至整个国家的影响，促成户口和教育改革，最大限度发挥人力资本潜力，发展成未来知识导向型经济。

16602522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16602522.value: 中華帝國的極限：清中前期滇緬邊疆的銀礦業與族群建構的歷史人類學研究

16602522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16602522.value: This research aims to investigate the relationship between shifting ethnic identities and networks as they linked to the Qing imperial state and variations in local power structures. It focuses on comparing the formation of Muslim and the Lahu communities in the context of the rise of gentry power in communities on the Sino-Burmese frontier from the 1640s to 1830s. This study will help historians and anthropologists understand the construction of ethnicities in southwest China. The peculiar situation on the Sino-Burma frontier was that ethnic change was closely related to the growth of religious teachings of the Unity of Three Teachings in Yunnan. This was led by local agents influenced by the syncretic religion of native acharyas of Vajrayana Buddhism, Confucianism and Taoism. Diverse religious teachings became the force which pushed the reconstruction of local communities and were a major means for interaction with the Qing state. To analyze this process, the PI focuses on the rapid social change in the mountains area that arose due to the rise and decline of the silver mining industry. The dynamism of communal reconstruction was connected to the geo-politics of the Sino-Burmese frontier in the territories of the Dai chieftains. After the Sino-Burmese war, many unemployed miners actively participated in religious mobilization of indigenous communities near the silver mines. Gradually, they established a Buddha-King polity for political resistance against the chieftains and the Qing government. The social mobilization of this militarized Buddha-King system resulted in the construction of a new Lahu ethnic identity after the closure of the silver mines. Meanwhile, some miners resettled at several newly opened mines, but clashes between bands of miners led to another wave of ethnic mobilization between groups of the Hui Muslim and the Han from the 1810s to the 1830s, which were under the jurisdiction of prefectures directly administrated by Qing officials near Dai chieftain territory. The different modes of governance by Dai chieftains and Qing officials caused the Lahu and Hui to mobilize in divergent ways. Thus, the similarities and differences seen in ethnic construction were connected with the expansion and contraction of silver mining and the role of political agency in the militarization of local societies against the Qing state. 本研究以少數民族族群身份的轉變與社會網路發展的關係為切入點，考察清朝的國家體制與西南邊疆地域社會的多樣性之間的歷史地理關係。研究以拉祜族和回族為例，具體討論清代早中期的滇緬邊疆地方士紳作為社群精英的興起與發展的條件與過程。從歷史人類學研究方法出發，重點研究中國西南邊疆從1640至1830 年代族群建構的社會經濟條件與歷史過程，尤其是在滇緬邊疆山區的各大銀礦區，基於“三教合一”的宗教理念而發展起來的礦山秘密社會和宗教結盟團體成為促成社群組織和族群關係改變的重要文化機制。清代中華帝國的西南邊疆地域社會的重構是在地方能動者的領導下實現的，而地方精英作為社會能動者，在長期的歷史過程中受到了儒、佛、道「三教合一」的地方性意識形態的深入影響。根植於明朝中後期在滇西發展起來的「三教合一」的社會思潮，在不同的社會政治與經濟條件下，不同方式的宗教派別逐漸發展起來併與國家體制的變革相配合，成為推動社群關係重構的重要動力。本研究因此聚焦於滇緬邊疆山區各大銀礦的發展和衰落的歷史過程，分析研究滇緬邊疆社會在清中前期近兩個世紀的社會變化過程中不同社群和族群身份重構的動態過程與撣傣土司與府州縣地區的政治地理的關係。在1760年代的清緬戰爭之後，隨著銀礦業的衰落，大量失業礦工投身於礦區周邊山區社會的宗教動員，一個基於「三教合一」宗教理想建立起來的佛王體系在滇緬邊疆山區在募乃銀礦周圍的山區建立起來，經過佛王和他們的弟子們長期在山區村寨推行的政治文化動員和社會整合，由此建立起來的政治力量逐漸能夠與各傣族土司和清朝政府對抗。經過一個多世紀的發展，基於山區社群關係的拉祜族文化身份也隨之發展建立起來。在邊疆各大銀礦衰落封閉的同時，另外一批轉移到其它新開礦區的礦商和礦工也逐漸捲入了以礦工幫派為組織單元的礦山衝突和回民礦工與漢民礦工相互對立的衝突之中，這一衝突過程隨著山區礦業的最終衰落，從1810年代至1830年代逐漸從滇緬邊疆和雲南中西部礦區蔓延到各地鄉村和城市，形成了更廣泛的士紳領導下的地方軍事化與漢、回對立的族群動員和社會政治對抗。在土司體制和府州縣體制這兩類不同的司法與行政管理體系下，礦業的發展與衰落引發了一系列山區、壩區鄉村和城市的社會變革和地方軍事化與不同地域集團的政治競爭，倂發展成為拉祜、回民相對於漢人的兩種類型的文化與族群身份的動員。簡言之，在中華帝國邊緣發展起來的族群建構的不同方式與類型與銀礦業的發展和地方政治能動性通過地方軍事化的發展，逐漸成為清末與清政府對抗的地方性政治力量。

16603522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16603522.value: “元首”的接班人：纳粹德国的宪法理论与群策至上（Conciliarism）

16603522.label: Project Objectives
16603522.value: To reconstruct the history of debates within the Nazi Party about the nature of the Führer's succession and especially the role ascribed to a future Nazi senate. To shed new light on the history of the Senate Chamber (Senatssaal) designed by Paul Ludwig Troost for the "Brown House," the Nazi Party headquarters in Munich, its iconography, and the directives Troost may have received as part of his architectural commission. To understand how German jurists, Nazi Party officials, and educators theorized and rationalized the constitutional structure of the Nazi regime and the Führer's succession. To generalize from the results of #1–3 to theorize about the nature of political thought in Nazi Germany, more broadly.
