16603522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16603522.value: This project investigates the history of political thought in Nazi Germany. In particular, it aims to understand how Germans sought to rationalize and communicate the structure of the regime. Most existing studies have either taken a biographical approach, focusing on the life and times of an individual scholar, or attempted to reconstruct the history of a discipline, such as constitutional law. This project adopts a different perspective by examining a theme of fundamental importance for the history of the Third Reich: What did it mean for the Führer to have a successor, and how was that successor to be chosen? Though the “leadership principle” was undoubtedly a central tenet of Nazi political thought, this project hypothesizes the existence of a subterranean current of conciliar thinking in Nazi Germany, one that aimed to routinize the Führer’s charisma by institutionalizing it within constitutional structures. Only the barest outline of the numerous efforts to provide for an orderly succession can be found in the standard political histories of the Third Reich. This project approaches the topic from the perspective of intellectual history, with the goal of shedding new light on how constitutional lawyers, Nazi officials, and Hitler himself made sense of the Führer’s place—and the potential transience of that place—within the Nazi political system. The long-running debate over Hitler’s succession cut to the heart of what it meant to think “politically” in this non-liberal political order. One task of this project is to reconstruct the internal debates over the Führer’s succession in Nazi Germany, focusing in particular on proposed plans for a Nazi senate to select the most worthy candidate. It will explore the material culture associated with these debates by investigating of the history of the “Senate Chamber” constructed by Paul Ludwig Troost for the Munich headquarters of the Nazi Party. Secondly, it will examine the voluminous (and seldom studied) literature published during the Third Reich that attempted to explain how the regime “worked.” It was produced by constitutional lawyers, such as Erich Becker, Hans Bernhard Brauße, Carl August Emge, Reinhard Höhn, Ernst Rudolf Huber, Otto Koellreutter, Günther Küchenhoff, Herbert Krüger, Gottfried Neeße, and Carl Schmitt, as well as by numerous less-remembered Nazi Party officials and educators. Special attention will be paid to Ernst Rudolf Huber, whose constitutional writings placed the issue of succession in the center of constitutional theory in the Third Reich. 本项目研究纳粹德国的政治思想史。具体而言，它致力于解读：彼时的德国人是如何为其政权之结构作合理化解释及宣传推广的。现有研究大多采取以下二者之一：传记法，即专注于学者个体的人生及所处时代；或者，试图再现某一学科（譬如宪法）的历史。本项目另辟视角，审视德意志第三帝国历史上一个至关重要的主题：对“元首”而言，有接班人意味着什么；以及，接班人是如何被选中的？毋庸置疑，“领袖原则”是纳粹政治思想的核心信条；不过，本项目假定纳粹德国存在一股群策至上（conciliar）思潮的暗流，致力于将“元首”的个人魅力在宪法的框架下制度化，从而使之有章可循。为实现“元首”的有序继任，纳粹进行了大量努力；然而，历数关于德意志第三帝国政治史的一流著作，相关论述可谓凤毛麟角。对于宪法学家、纳粹官员，乃至希特勒本人，他们是如何理解纳粹政治体制中“元首”这一职位及其潜在的易变性的呢？本项目从思想史角度出发，希求为解答这一问题添砖加瓦。希特勒之后的“元首”继任问题，在纳粹德国内部引发了旷日持久的讨论；该讨论直击以下问题：在这个非自由的政治体系中，以政治的眼光看待问题，究竟意味着什么？ 本项目致力于重现纳粹德国关于“元首”继任问题的内部讨论，并且重点关注纳粹拟定的计划——让理事会来推举最佳人选。本项目将从保罗·路德维希·楚斯特（Paul Ludwig Troost）为位于慕尼黑的纳粹党总部建造的“理事会大厅”（Senate Chamber, "Senatsaal"）的历史入手，探究与上述讨论相关的物质文化。此外，在德意志第三帝国，曾有海量出版文献试图解释其政治体制是如何运作的，却鲜见后人研究；本项目将重点审视这类文献。这类文献出自宪法学家笔下，例如艾里希·贝克（Erich Becker）、汉斯·伯恩哈德·布豪斯（Hans Bernhard Brauße）、卡尔·奥古斯特·埃姆格（Carl August Emge）、莱因哈德·霍恩（Reinhard Höhn）、恩斯特·鲁道夫·胡伯（Ernst Rudolf Huber）、奥托·科赫特（Otto Koellreutter）、君特·库申霍夫（Günther Küchenhoff）、赫伯特·克鲁格（Herbert Krüger）、戈特弗里德·尼瑟（Gottfried Neeße）以及卡尔·施密特（Carl Schmitt），还有诸多鲜为人知的纳粹党官员及宣教人员笔下。本项目将着重研究恩斯特·鲁道夫·胡伯（Ernst Rudolf Huber）——他的宪法学著作将“元首”继任问题置于德意志第三帝国宪法理论的核心。

17100222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17100222.value: 使用一種新型氟化銀復合物以阻止齲壞進展

17100222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17100222.value: Prof Tang, Jinyao Dr Yin, Iris Xiaoxue

17100222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100222.value: 研究背景 全球有24億人患有齲齒，這占到全球人口的35%，美國牙科協會推薦使用氟化氨銀處理齲齒。氟化氨銀具有抗菌性和再礦化性，能有效阻止齲齒的進展(即形成靜止齲)。氟化氨銀具有簡單、無痛、無創、便宜、不產生氣溶膠等優點。然而，氟化氨銀會將齲損部位染黑，使外觀不美觀，導致患者對效果不滿意，並拒絕使用。我們合成了一種新型的氟化銀復合物，目前已獲專利。與氟化氨銀相比，氟化銀復合物不導致變色且細胞毒性更小。鹼性氟化銀復合物抑制牙本質齲的膠原纖維降解過程中內肽酶的酶活性，但尚需進一步研究氟化銀復合物實現靜止齲的機制。 目的 1）評估氟化銀復合物溶液對多種致齲生物膜結構、活力及動力學的影響； 2）評估氟化銀復合物溶液對齲齒中礦物質及有機物含量和顏色變化的影響。 方法 我們發明了一種含有鹼性 (酸鹼值為9.5) 、百萬分比濃度為100,000氟化銀復合物的氫氧化鈉溶液，該溶液中銀離子不沉澱。使用人类第三磨牙製作牙本質切片。將每個切片切成三塊以行三種不同處理。製備156 個牙本質塊，使用多種致齲生物膜脫礦後得人造齲損。將牙本質塊均勻地分成三組，分別使用 1) 氟化銀復合物溶液、2) 38%氟化氨銀溶液（陽性對照組）或 3) 去離子水（陰性對照組）進行處理。處理過後放置在電腦控制的人工口腔中致齲。使用掃描電子顯微鏡和共聚焦激光掃描顯微鏡以及計數菌落形成單位來檢測細菌生物膜的結構、活力和動力學。使用掃描電子顯微鏡、倫琴射線衍射、傅里葉變換紅外光譜和分光光度法檢測牙本質塊的表面形態、元素含量、晶體特徵、膠原降解和顏色變化。再用 126 個牙釉質塊重複上述實驗（除膠原降解檢測）。 預期實驗結果和影響 我們期望這種新穎、生物相容佳且不染色的氟化銀復合物溶液具有抗菌和再礦化特性。若能成功證實氟化銀復合物的防齲效果及其不染色的特性，則可以將其轉化臨床應用以靜止齲坏。該研究結果的適用性和對齲齒管理的益處將是巨大的。

17100522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17100522.value: 比較多尺度深度學習及標準放射學演繹於電腦掃描預測肝細胞癌微血管浸潤：一項多中心隨機試驗

17100522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17100522.value: Prof Cheung, Tan To Dr Chiu, Keith Wan-Hang Dr Ho, Siu Lun Dr Ji, Ren Prof Lee, Victor Dr Lo, Cheuk Lam Regina Prof Mak, Lung Yi Dr Vardhanabhuti, Varut Vince Prof Yu, Philip Leung Ho Prof Yuen, Richard Man Fung

17100522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100522.value: 肝細胞癌（HCC）是東亞地區最常見的癌症之一，具有高致死率。微血管浸潤 （MVI）為腫瘤影響臨床前景的關鍵因素，這只能通過手術標本的組織學取樣在術後進行評估。在手術前透過電腦掃描（CT）預測MVI 準確度一直未如理想。 人工智能是一種新興的模式，可以徹底改變醫療保健和醫學成像。我們的跨學科研究團隊一直在開發由創新科技局研究基金支持的深度學習算法，通過對比 CT 準確診斷 HCC。我們發明了一種獨特的深度學習模型，該模型考慮了 CT 的多相特性，並且是四項專利申請的基礎。我們的 MS3DCN-NAS 模型基於超過 4,000 個肝髒病變，在診斷 HCC 方面的診斷準確率為 98.6%。除了實現準確的診斷，深度學習還能在術前 CT 上識別 MVI 的存在嗎？在我們對 270 例經組織學證實的 HCC 的 CT 的初步分析中，我們已經實現了 MVI 的 85.8% 的診斷準確率。 我們提出以下兩階段研究。對於第一階段，我們將在雲端算平台上基於 1,318 張收集的 HCC CT 圖像和可用的相應組織學訓練我們的深度學習模型。將確定 MVI 的診斷性能。然後，我們將繼續進行 前瞻性驗證，這將是一項隨機試驗，前瞻性地將我們完成的深度學習模型與 CT 上 HCC 圖像的標準放射學解釋進行比較，以預測 MVI。主要研究成果將是我們的深度學習模型在預測 MVI 時的診斷準確性。我們還將分析影響診斷性能的臨床、腫瘤學、放射學和技術因素。 我們提出的項目可能有助於 MVI 的早期診斷，並具有很高的專利申請和商業化潛力。它可以促進更全面的腫瘤學管理，包括輔助新輔助治療和手術切除的決策，允許對 HCC 進行更個性化的管理，從而有機會長遠減低 HCC致死率。

17100622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17100622.value: IL-17/CEBPb 信號通路調控的星形膠質細胞內補體C3高表達在圍術期認知功能障礙中的作用機制

17100622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100622.value: Neuroinflammation can be critical in reestablishing brain homeostasis but can also inflict harm. It may be initiated by triggers both intrinsic and extrinsic to the brain and its presence underlies many neurological and neurodegenerative conditions as well as in the aging brain. When triggered by surgery, neuroinflammation contributes to perioperative neurocognitive disorders (PND) such as delirium or delayed cognitive recovery. In clinical settings, there are currently no effective therapies for either prevention or treatment of PND. Given the global burden of surgery is estimated at hundreds of million major procedures per year, the number of patients potentially vulnerable to PND is substantial and there is an urgent need for the development of therapeutic strategies. Multiple mechanisms underpinning postoperative neuroinflammation have been delineated and inflammatory cytokines were suggested to be involved. However, our previous work indicates that cytokines may not solely be responsible for the prolonged cognitive impairment after surgery. From our preliminary results, we found that complement C3 from astrocytes may be critically involved in the progression of PND. C3 is an important protein for innate immunity. In the central nervous system, C3 plays an important role in regulating neuronal and synaptic function and dysregulation of C3 is frequently observed in other neurocognitive impairment models. Our preliminary data suggest that surgery triggers up-regulation of C3 and astrocyte is the source of this. Inhibition of C3 in the brain could reverse the synaptic and cognitive deficits in postoperative animals. Further exploration suggest that IL-17 and CEBPb molecules maybe the potential stimulators for the C3 up-regulation after surgery. We hypothesize that astrocytic C3 is the critical link between postoperative neuroinflammation and cognitive dysfunction throughout the perioperative period and this C3 up-regulation depends on IL-17/CEBPb activities. In the current proposal, we aim to first confirm the potential responders and effectors regarding the role of astrocytic C3. C3 downstream signalling and synaptic function will be examined in cell culture, wild type and astrocytic C3 knockout mice. The regulatory role of IL-17/CEBPb in stimulating astrocytic C3 will further be examined in culture and animals. If our hypothesis is correct, we will provide viable molecular targets for clinical evaluation in an attempt to mitigate the development of cognitive dysfunction following postoperative neuroinflammation. Given the global burden of surgery is estimated at hundreds of million major procedures per year, the findings from this proposal could potentially benefit a vast number of patients. 神經炎症是一把雙刃劍：一方面維持大腦內穩態平衡，另一方面也會給大腦帶來傷害。自身或外在因素都能引起神經炎症的發生。它的發生和發展是很多神經系統障礙、神經退行性病變以及大腦衰老的重要因素。同時，手術也可以導致神經炎症的發生，並進一步促進術後認知障礙，例如術後譫妄或延遲的認知恢復。目前在臨床工作中，圍術期認知功能障礙尚無有效的治療或干預措施。考慮到全球每年數以萬計的手術量，我們預期將會有大量的病人患有圍術期認知功能障礙的病症，因此研究有效的治療措施是當務之急。 目前與術後神經炎症相關的不同分子機制作用的已被闡明，細胞因子就是其中之一。然而我們的前期研究結果表明細胞因子並非是唯一導致術後認知障礙的關鍵因素。我們還證明了星形膠質細胞分泌的補體C3參與術後認知障礙的進程。補體C3是固有免疫重要的分子。在神經系統中它還參與調節神經及突觸功能的重要作用，然而在不同的模型中發現：調節異常的C3與神經認知損傷高度相關。 我們的預實驗結果表明手術能導致C3上調，而星形膠質細胞是重要的來源。抑制C3能逆轉突觸和認知的功能障礙。對此我們提出假設：星形膠質細胞分泌的C3是術後神經炎症進一步導致認知障礙的重要因素，而C3的上調依賴於IL-17/CEBPb信號通路調控。在本項目中，我們首先確認星形膠質細分泌C3的重要作用，進一步在體外細胞實驗，野生型小鼠和條件性星形膠質細胞C3敲除小鼠中闡明C3下游分子機制及對突觸功能的影響，最後在細胞實驗及動物模型中初步證明IL-17/CEBPb信號通路對C3的調控作用。若我們的假設成立，則我們將為臨床提供更有潛力緩解術後認知功能障礙的分子靶點。考慮到全球每年手術的病人數以萬計且日益增多，本項目的研究成果將會使大量病人受益。

17100822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100822.value: Background: The emerging infectious disease COVID-19 has caused considerable burden in Hong Kong and across the world. Although vaccine is available, multiple outbreaks still occurred in the regions aiming at zero COVID-19, such as China. Therefore, understanding transmission dynamics of COVID-19 and the effectiveness of public health and social measures (PHSMs) is still critical to guide control policy. One feature of COVID-19 transmission is superspreading events, but the causes of such phenomenon, and its implications on population transmission dynamics and disease controls are unclear. Purpose: We propose to analyze the case data of COVID-19 in Hong Kong, to characterize the heterogeneity of infectiousness, and the association of infectiousness between index and secondary cases. After that, we will use the fitted results to conduct extensive simulations to determine the impact of the heterogeneity of infectiousness on population transmission dynamics. Methods: We will use the branching process framework to fit the distribution of household and non-household secondary cases, since the transmission risk would be likely different among household and non-household settings and the number of household contacts are limited. Then, we will use the observed Cycle threshold (Ct value) trajectories to predict the Ct value at symptom onset for each case, which would be used as a proxy measure of individual infectiousness. Therefore, we could estimate the association of infectiousness of index and secondary cases. Finally, we will use the results from fitted model to conduct extensive simulations by extending the branching process models to incorporate heterogeneity of infectiousness, and the correlation of infectiousness of index and secondary cases, to determine their impact on disease controllability, the duration of outbreaks and case numbers, and effectiveness of isolation and quarantine, and potential of other control measures, such as mass testing and tracing contacts of contacts. Potential implications: This study proposes a framework to determine the heterogeneity of infectiousness and the correlation of infectiousness of index and secondary cases, and conduct extensive simulation to determine their impact on population transmission dynamics. Accurately determining the effectiveness of control measures with accounting for heterogeneity of infectiousness would be critical to guide control policy. Given the high heterogeneity of infectiousness and the potential of superspreader can generate superspreaders, aggressive control measures may be needed and have a non-linear impact on disease control. The framework can also be applied to other disease such as influenza. 背景：新型冠狀病毒肺炎疫情蔓延，對香港以及全球公共衛生體系帶來了巨大的沖擊。雖然新冠疫苗可以降低新冠病毒的感染風險，但在中國等堅持「動態清零」防控策略的國家與地區，仍有多處疫情發生。因此，了解新冠疫情的傳播動態以及公共衛生和社會防控措施的有效性，對於指導防控政策的製定仍然起到至關重要的作用。新型冠狀病毒的傳播特點之一是超級傳播事件（superspreading events）的存在，這一現象對疫情傳播有重要影響，但目前其出現的原因，及其對人群中疫情傳播動態和疾病防控的影響尚不明確。 目的：本研究使用香港新型冠狀病毒確診病例數據，分析個體傳染力的異質性，以及首代病例（index和二代病例之間傳染力的關聯。在此之上，本研究利用擬合的結果進行模擬，以確定傳染力異質性對人群疾病傳播動態的影響。 方法：首先，考慮到家庭內傳播和家庭外傳播的風險不同，而且家庭內傳播的病例有限，因此本研究以負二項分布框架來擬合兩種傳播病例的分布。其次，本研究使用新冠病毒核酸檢測Ct值的變化規律軌跡來預測每個病例出現感染癥狀時的Ct值，使用Ct值替代表示個體傳染力，並以此對首代病例和二代病例之間傳染力的關聯進行分析。最後，應用模型擬合的結果，以分支過程模型為基礎，建立帶有傳染力異質性的傳播模型進行模擬，探討個體傳染力異質性以及首代病例和二代病例之間傳染力相關性：1）對於疫情可控性的影響；2）對於疫情爆發的持續時間和病例數的影響；3）對於隔離管控措施有效性的影響；4）以及對於其他防控措施（例如大規模核酸檢測和次密接的追蹤管控）的潛在影響。 結論：本研究提出了一個研究框架，旨在探究傳染力異質性以及首代病例和二代病例之間傳染力相關性對於人群疾病傳播動態的影響。在考慮傳染力異質性的前提下，準確估計防控措施的有效性對指導防控政策的製定和資源配置具有重要意義。鑒於較高的異質性會產生超級傳播事件，使得少數個體具有極強的傳染能力，因此需要采取積極的防控措施，然而防控措施對疾病控製的影響效果可能為非線性的。本研究提出的框架可推廣應用於其他疾病，如流感。

17100822.label: Realisation of objectives
17100822.value: This project achieved the three original objectives by integrating Hong Kong, based empirical evidence from linked transmission pairs with a contact-structured transmission model (agent-based model, with household, workplace, school and community layer) calibrated to reproduce plausible epidemic dynamics in Hong Kong. The central idea was to quantify (i) how infectiousness varies across individuals, (ii) whether infectiousness in an index case is measurably related to infectiousness in the secondary case they infect, and (iii) how these features change key transmission metrics and the effectiveness of control measures when implemented in a Hong Kong contact structure. For Objective 1 (to characterize the heterogeneity of individual infectiousness of COVID-19 by contact types), we used Ct value to proxy individual infectiousness (Dong et al, Meng et al.), and a transmission model to estimate the heterogeneity of infectiousness of primary cases (Tsang et al.), using Beijing, Hong Kong, and Guangzhou datasets respectively. All of them support a substantial heterogeneity in individual infectiousness of cases. Then, we further represented Hong Kong transmission using a structured contact model with households, schools, workplaces, and community interactions, and then introduced explicit individual-level heterogeneity in infectiousness. We examined multiple heterogeneity levels (implemented as different dispersions of a log-normal infectiousness distribution) and summarised heterogeneity both at the individual level (how unevenly individual reproduction numbers are distributed) and at the cluster level (how concentrated transmission is in the largest infection clusters). Even without index–secondary dependence (IDC = 0), transmission in Hong Kong simulations was markedly clustered: the top 5% of infection clusters accounted for 29%–56% of all transmission for the ancestral SARS-CoV-2 scenario and 25%–45% for the Omicron scenario, across heterogeneity settings. When index dependence was introduced (IDC increased), clustering intensified. At IDC = 0.8, if index dependence was applied only within households, the top 5% of clusters accounted for 30%–61% (ancestral) and 26%–51% (Omicron). If index dependence was allowed to operate across all settings, concentration rose much more sharply, reaching 67%–97% (ancestral) and 57%–97% (Omicron). These results characterise heterogeneity in a way that is directly interpretable by contact type: household-restricted dependence produces modest additional clustering, whereas dependence operating across multiple contact types can generate extremely concentrated, cluster-driven spread. For Objective 2 (to estimate the relationship between infectiousness of index and secondary cases for COVID-19), we analysed Hong Kong infector–infectee pairs using minimum PCR cycle-threshold (Ct) values as a proxy for viral burden (lower Ct implies higher viral load and, on average, higher infectiousness). In 908 linked Hong Kong transmission pairs, we found a statistically robust positive association between index and secondary minimum Ct values (P < 0.001). The mixed-model fit indicated that the relationship is detectable but not deterministic in routine Hong Kong data: the conditional R² was 0.18 while the marginal R² was 0.07, consistent with substantial additional variability introduced by factors such as within-household clustering, timing of testing relative to infection, and measurement noise. In practical terms, the Hong Kong data show that index–secondary similarity in viral burden exists and is measurable, but it is partially masked by real-world heterogeneity in detection and observation. For Objective 3 (to estimate population transmission dynamics and the effectiveness of control measures while accounting for heterogeneity), we embedded both heterogeneity and index dependence into a Hong Kong transmission model and quantified how key epidemic metrics change. Under no intervention and with no index dependence (IDC = 0), the ancestral SARS-CoV-2 scenario in Hong Kong produced a basic reproduction number R₀ = 2.0 to 3.1, a generation interval of 6.9 to 7.0 days, and an overall attack rate of 62.0% to 69.4% across heterogeneity settings. For the Omicron-like scenario, baseline transmissibility and speed were higher: R₀ = 4.7 to 7.1, generation interval 3.7 to 3.8 days, and attack rate 89.1% to 92.6%. When index dependence increased, we observed systematic shifts that matter for control: generation intervals consistently shortened and attack rates increased, particularly when index dependence was allowed to operate beyond households. We then evaluated Hong Kong-relevant non-pharmaceutical interventions implemented in escalating intensity: symptomatic testing and isolation (with daily isolation probabilities P = 0.1, 0.3, or 0.5, and isolation occurring one day after symptom onset), and contact tracing with quarantine (80% daily tracing probability, 14-day quarantine for COVID-19, with a one-day lag from isolation to tracing). Isolation reduced transmissibility by 70% within households and 90% in other settings, while quarantine reduced transmissibility by 40% within households and 80% in other settings. Across strategies, more intensive interventions lowered attack rates, but index dependence changed epidemic speed and peak burden even under interventions. In particular, in household-only dependence, the relationship between IDC and peak burden was approximately linear; under no intervention, each 0.1 increase in IDC increased peak daily incidence by about 100–400 cases in the Hong Kong synthetic population (larger increases in more transmissible scenarios), with smaller increases under stronger interventions. Under all-settings dependence, peak burden accelerated more sharply once IDC exceeded about 0.6, emphasising that strong intergenerational dependence can erode the predictability and controllability of outbreaks unless detection and response are rapid. Overall, all three objectives were achieved using Hong Kong data and a Hong Kong contact structure. The main limitations were those inherent to routine surveillance for Objective 2, particularly variability in test timing, addressed by explicitly adjusting for testing delays and by validating the mechanism in simulation under controlled conditions. The integrated outputs provide a coherent Hong Kong-focused account of infectiousness heterogeneity, intergenerational dependence, and their implications for control.

17100822.label: Major findings and research outcome
17100822.value: First, linked transmission-pair analysis in Hong Kong demonstrates that infectiousness is not fully independent across generations of infection. Using minimum Ct values as a proxy for viral burden, analysis of 908 Hong Kong infector–infectee pairs found a statistically significant positive association between index and secondary cases (P < 0.001). Model fit statistics indicate that this relationship is detectable but modest in routine conditions: conditional R² = 0.18 and marginal R² = 0.07, consistent with substantial unobserved variation driven by within-household clustering and heterogeneous testing delays. Second, Hong Kong transmission dynamics are strongly shaped by heterogeneity and become even more cluster-driven when index dependence is present. In Hong Kong simulations with no index dependence (IDC = 0), the top 5% of infection clusters accounted for 29%–56% of all transmission for ancestral SARS-CoV-2 and 25%–45% for Omicron, depending on the assumed heterogeneity level. At IDC = 0.8, clustering increased to 30%–61% (ancestral) and 26%–51% (Omicron) if dependence was restricted to households, and to 67%–97% (ancestral) and 57%–97% (Omicron) if dependence applied across all settings. This quantifies, in a Hong Kong context, how index dependence can amplify superspreading-like dynamics. Third, key Hong Kong epidemic metrics shift in ways that matter for preparedness and intervention design. Under no intervention and IDC = 0, the ancestral scenario produced R₀ = 2.0–3.1, generation interval 6.9–7.0 days, and attack rate 62.0%–69.4%, while the Omicron-like scenario produced R₀ = 4.7–7.1, generation interval 3.7–3.8 days, and attack rate 89.1%–92.6%. As IDC increased, generation intervals shortened and attack rates increased, with larger effects when dependence extended beyond households. Finally, control effectiveness depends not only on intervention intensity but also on index dependence. Under household-only dependence, each 0.1 increase in IDC increased peak daily incidence by roughly 100–400 cases under no intervention in the Hong Kong synthetic population, while stronger interventions dampened (but did not eliminate) this increase. These findings support rapid detection and timely isolation/quarantine as especially important when infectiousness can propagate across generations.

17100822.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17100822.value: The next step is to strengthen Hong Kong-specific inference on the magnitude of index–secondary dependence by improving measurement of viral burden timing. Because routine Ct measurements are sensitive to when a person is tested, future work will prioritise richer Hong Kong line-list integration of symptom onset, exposure windows, and repeated testing where available, allowing tighter reconstruction of peak viral burden and reducing attenuation of the observed association (noting that the current Hong Kong estimate is significant but modest: conditional R² 0.18, marginal R² 0.07). On the modelling side, we will formally calibrate the index-dependence coefficient and heterogeneity parameters jointly to Hong Kong outbreak features (including observed cluster-size distributions) with uncertainty quantification. This will support policy evaluation of operational refinements such as accelerated tracing and quarantine prioritisation for households linked to low-Ct index cases, and stress-testing of strategies under plausible delays in testing and isolation.

17100822.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17100822.value: People with COVID-19 do not all spread the virus equally. Some people pass the virus to many others, while most infect few or none. This project studied why that happens and what it means for controlling outbreaks. We used contact-tracing data to link infected people with the people they likely infected. We then compared PCR test results between these linked pairs. PCR tests report a “Ct value,” where a lower number usually means a higher amount of virus. We found that people infected by someone with a high viral amount tend to also show higher viral amounts themselves, especially in households. This suggests that infectiousness is partly “passed on” across generations of infection. We then built computer simulations that include households, schools, workplaces, and community contacts, and that also include control measures like testing, isolation, and quarantine. The simulations show that if high infectiousness can be passed on, outbreaks can grow faster and form larger clusters, and delays in testing can make control much harder. These results support the value of rapid testing and prompt isolation/quarantine, particularly for household transmission.

17100922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17100922.value: Information obtained by animals about their surroundings informs their decisions and therefore drives their actions – their behaviour. In this proposal, we outline an innovative series of experiments on responses to novel food, food preferences and manipulated foods that use of sensory information to investigate neophilia, preferences and training. These not only inform us about the biology of a specific species, but link a universal challenge, acquiring food, to the topics of information use, personality, and learning, which are among the most widely studied areas of animal behaviour. We have shown previously that Asian elephants, based on smell alone, consistently choose higher over lower quantities of food. The greater the difference between the quantities, the more likely they are to successfully choose the larger one. In this study, we aim to build upon this finding by focusing on the use novel and manipulated foods to investigate how elephants respond to the foods, how they are integrated into their suite of known-food preferences and how they can learn about foods using olfactory information. We will conduct a novel food experiment by presenting two new food items, one of higher caloric value and one lower to the animals that they have no previous exposure to, to find how these are responded to in comparison to each other and integrated into their known preferences. Finally, we will analyse whether elephants can be trained to avoid a modified food item. Our findings will contribute to understanding the impact of novelty on making food choices, specifically designing our experiments to use the olfactory cues specifically. They also have management and welfare implications, as the results are relevant for informing interactions with caretakers and use of food enrichment. They will also put Asian elephants in the context of other species that have been studied in this way, such as birds, pigs and fish species, to include the large-bodied, social and endangered elephants in this important field within behavioural ecology. 動物透過周圍環境的信息作出決定，從而驅動牠們的行為。本研究計劃概述了一系列關於動物對新穎和加工食物偏好的實驗，這些實驗利用感官信息來調查牠們的偏好。這項研究不但讓我們了解亞洲象這個物種，而且將動物對食物的獲取，與信息使用、個性和學習聯繫起來，這是動物行為學中最廣泛研究的領域之一。我們在之前的研究得出，亞洲象會透過氣味選擇較高的食物量而不是較少量的食物。數量之間的差異越大，牠們就越有可能選擇較大量的食物。我們會把早前的調查結果作為基礎，再作研究，目標是通過使用新穎和經過加工的食物研究大象對食物的反應，了解牠們如何使用偏好以及嗅覺選擇食物。我們會向大象展示兩種牠們以前沒有接觸過的食物，一種熱量值較高，另一種熱量值較低，以了解大象如何把新穎的食物整合到牠們已知的食物中並作出選擇。最後，我們將分析是否可以訓練大象避免食用加工食品。我們的研究結果將有助了解新穎食物如何影響大象使用嗅覺作出選擇。結果還可以幫助照顧者改良對大象的管理，以改善動物福祉。其他調查曾經使用這種方式研究動物，例如鳥類、豬和魚類，這項研究可以將亞洲象納入這個研究領域，提供新的觀點，將這種大型、群居和瀕臨滅絕的大象納入行為生態學。

17101022.value: 視覺脊髓神經炎中B型淋巴細胞功能及布魯頓氨酸激酶抑制劑治療的研究

17101022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101022.value: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) is a central nervous system (CNS) inflammatory disorder characterized by optic neuritis and myelitis. The majority of patients have autoantibodies targeting aquaporin-4 (AQP4) water channel (AQP4-IgG) detected in sera. AQP4-IgG-positive NMOSD patients have underlying AQP4 autoimmunity. AQP4 is highly expressed by CNS astrocytes. AQP4-IgG are directly pathogenic and trigger neuroinflammation, demyelination and neuronal injury. Although the etiology of AQP4 autoimmunity in NMOSD is uncertain, B lymphocytes are definitely important as production of AQP4-IgG requires B cell differentiation to AQP4 autoreactive memory B cells, and plasmablasts and plasma cells which secrete AQP4-IgG. The exact role of B cells in NMOSD pathophysiology is uncertain, and there is no available animal model with AQP4 autoimmunity. We aim to establish a mouse NMOSD model with AQP4 autoimmunity and explore the role of B lymphocytes in the model. We hypothesize that B cells present the autoantigen (AQP4) to activate T lymphocytes to differentiate to AQP4 autoreactive T follicular helper (Tfh) cells in germinal centers. Tfh cells drive the development of follicular B cells to AQP4-autoreactive memory B cells, plasmablasts and plasma cells. As B cell activation involves B cell receptor (BCR) signaling that requires Bruton’s tyrosine kinase (BTK), an enzyme critical for BCR signaling activities, we hypothesize that evobrutinib, a BTK inhibitor, is therapeutic in NMOSD. We have preliminarily established a NMOSD mouse model with AQP4 autoimmunity, NMOSD-like spinal cord pathologies and motor impairments by AQP4 gene immunization. Using this model, we shall study the frequencies of various B and T cell subtypes in peripheral blood and/or secondary lymphoid tissues of mice with AQP4 autoimmunity. 17101622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101622.value: 神经嵴细胞发生于神经板缘，其发生取决于涵盖多重信号及转录因子的基因调控网络的协调合作。此协调合作赋予了神经嵴独特的调控状态，使其有别于神经祖细胞和非神经外胚层。虽然一些神经嵴决定基因(SOX9, SNAIL2 和 FOXD3)对神经嵴发生的表达转录调控和功能影响已被充分阐明。但值得注意的是，SOX9和SNAIL2存在内含子的这一特性赋予其转录后调控这一新的可能调节水平。而且，关于神经嵴剪接体组分的特性尚缺乏研究。本科研团队的前期研究显示广谱表达的剪接因子的抑制可导致神经嵴发生的异常，其中的分子机制尚不明确。综上，确定直接参与神经嵴决定基因表达的剪接体组分及阐明其作用方式将助力神经嵴的病理发生研究，以期为相关疾病的解决提供新思路。 本科研团队运用CRISPR/Cas9的前期研究显示鸡胚体干神经嵴决定基因SOX9和SNAIL2 的表达需要广谱表达的PHF5A-SF3B1 复合体的参与， 其调控水平存在于pre-mRNA剪接。此研究结果也被下述实验结果进一步证实：作用于PHF5A-SF3B1复合体内含子结合的剪接调节剂的使用会导致神经嵴细胞的异常发生，神经嵴决定基因表达的的剪接异常，却不影响神经嵴决定基因在体节（区别于神经嵴的另一组织）的表达。上述研究结果提示神经嵴组织拥有区别于其他组织的对于PHF5A-SF3B1表达及其对内含子结合异常的易感性。此标书的目的如下：(1) 确认PHF5A及SF3B1 的敲除对SOX9 和SNAIL2 剪接的影响；(2) 探究PHF5A和SF3B1 对RNA的结合水平差异及其相互作用对神经嵴决定基因的剪接的影响；(3) 阐明神经嵴细胞对于PHF5A-SF3B1 复合体失调易感性的分子机制。本研究团队将运用分子生物学、生物化学及组学的方法，在鸡胚发育背景下研究上述有关神经嵴形成的转录后调控问题。如研究成功，本项目将为PHF5A-SF3B1 复合体在神经嵴决定基因表达的pre-mRNA 剪接层面的调节提供分子机制，此调节的重要性在于可决定神经嵴发生方向即细胞命运。研究结果将在剪接调节层面丰富神经嵴基因调控网络，为表达异常的广谱剪接因子导致的神经嵴疾病提供研究支持。

17101922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17101922.value: AMBRA1通過調節線粒體功能調控肝細胞癌的腫瘤幹性和腫瘤發生

17101922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17101922.value: 肝細胞癌是一種在全球範圍日益增多的侵襲性實體腫瘤。 手術切除和肝移植是最有效的一線治療方法。 然而，大多數病人（超過70%）發現病情時已經處於疾病晚期，不符合手術或者肝移植治療的指標。 經動脈化療栓塞的姑息治療以及用多靶點酪氨酸激酶抑製劑、血管生成抑製劑和免疫檢查點抑製劑的靶向治療，對晚期的肝細胞癌患者治療作用有限，因此有必要更好瞭解肝細胞癌發生和進展的分子機制以產生新的療法。 越來越多的人認識到，肝臟腫瘤是一種異致性腫瘤，包含具有不同複製、致瘤、自我更新以及耐葯能力的腫瘤細胞。 尤其是腫瘤幹細胞（CSCs），在腫瘤內具有高度可塑性的幹細胞樣的細胞亞群，已經被認為是腫瘤發生和進展的驅動因素。 我們的研究團隊致力於研究不同亞型肝CSCs的識別和表徵。 近年來，我們不斷發現各種內在的調節因數和蛋白，它們是肝腫瘤幹細胞腫瘤幹性產生的重要驅動因素，賦予不同細胞過程功能異質性，包括TKI耐葯、血管生成、應激反應以及對微環境的適應和相互作用。 除了表型和功能異質性外，一些研究也揭示了肝CSCs的代謝異質性。 他們已經確定了不同亞群肝CSCs的非典型能量代謝特徵。 然而關於肝CSCs代謝重程式設計的研究較少，我們仍然未完全瞭解肝CSCs複雜的生物組成以及代謝可塑性與腫瘤乾性信號通路的交集，這阻礙了開發針對肝CSCs代謝缺陷的新治療。 為了尋找在HCC中調節腫瘤干性和腫瘤發生中發揮重要作用的臨床相關關鍵基因，我們使用了之前描述的方法（Nature 2018），對癌症基因組圖譜（TCGA - LIHC 數據集）的肝細胞癌數據集進行了腫瘤幹細胞性評分（TSS），該評分顯示了幹細胞樣表型的程度。 對TSS評分高和TSS評分低的患者的轉錄組進行基因集合富集分析（GSEA），通路富集分析顯示，TSS評分高的患者組線粒體呼吸（ OXPHOS）相關通路上調最多。 Beclin-1調控的自噬啟動分子（AMBRA1）是HCC患者與TSS負相關最高的基因。 我們的初步研究結果表明，肝內AMBRA1的缺失引發了HCC腫瘤的形成。 轉錄組學和GESA分析表明AMBRA1在OXPHOS中發揮關鍵作用，並鑒定c-MYC為AMBRA1在 HCC患者中的潛在降解靶點。 AMBRA1缺失增強了線粒體功能，使HCC細胞線粒體功能相關基因mRNA水準升高。 此外，我們發現AMBRA1在人類HCC中表達較低，相應的核c-MYC表達較強。 綜上所述，我們假設AMBRA1的缺失重塑了線粒體功能，以支援肝癌中通過c-MYC/OXPHOS軸來維持腫瘤發生和肝CSC。 我們的工作旨在闡明AMBRA1通過調節線粒體呼吸機制以促進腫瘤干性和肝臟腫瘤發生中的功能和調節作用，同時也將評估AMBRA1的臨床意義和預後價值，以作為未來指導個人化治療的新型生物標誌物 。

17102022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102022.value: 開發高通量構建和分析精確CRISPR碱基编辑器平台

17102022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102022.value: Technology development for installing precise genetic changes in the genome has important implications for genetic disease modelling and correction. Conventional nuclease-dependent approach that relies on homology-directed repair (HDR) for precise DNA editing suffers from low efficiency and an excess of undesired by-products of random insertions or deletions (indels). Base editing and prime editing are two major advances of the CRISPR-Cas-derived genome editing tools that are better suited for correcting point mutations without generating double-stranded DNA break (DSB). Both systems harness components from the RNA-programmable CRISPR-Cas DNA binding system for directing DNA-modifying components to desired target sites for genetic correction. Different types of base editors are designed for making different DNA base conversions. The targeting base has to be positioned within the editing window which is restricted by PAM availability and it may give bystander edits. The currently available base editors have restricted editing scopes whereas prime editor is more versatile as it allows all types of small genetic changes by reverse transcribing any template sequence carried by pegRNA into DNA substrate to be incorporated for a local sequence change. However, prime editor is less characterized than base editor. Both system has non-negligible off-target effects which limit their applications. To expand the applicability of base and prime editing in a wide range of research and therapeutic contexts, there is a need to scale up the engineering and characterization of them from the currently one-by-one to a high-throughput approach. Leveraging on our established CombiSEAL platform, we are able to perform scalable assembly of engineered variants of base and prime editors by fusing base and prime editing components with different Cas proteins, and by introducing different sets of mutations to enhance their efficiency, specificity and editing repertoire. To address the challenge of analyzing the editing outcome of a library of variants, here we aim to develop and validate a system that incorporates artificial guide RNA target into the same variant-expressing DNA construct as a window to monitor and quantify on- and off-target editing events of a library of variants in a massively parallel way via deep sequencing. Our proposed work raises the current capability to engineer base and prime editors in a pool format which cuts down the time and cost needed for the process of optimizing, profiling, and selecting variants that are most suitable and efficient for a particular sequence context and application. 開發在基因組中進行精準變異的技術對遺傳疾病建模和突變校正具有重要意義。傳統的基於核酸酶進行同源基因引導的修復（Homology-directed repair, HDR）雖然精確但存在效率低和產生過多的隨機插入或刪除 (indels)副產物的問題。鹼基編輯（base editing）和先導編輯（prime editing）是衆多CRISPR-Cas 衍生的基因組編輯工具中的兩大進步，它們可以在不產生雙鏈 DNA 斷裂 (DSB) 的情況下糾正點突變。這兩個系統均利用可編程 的RNA及 CRISPR-Cas DNA 結合組件，將 DNA 修飾組件引導到所需的目標位點進行基因校正。不同類型的鹼基編輯器可用於進行不同的 DNA 鹼基轉換。需修改的目標鹼基必須定位在限制性PAM 序列的編輯窗口內。然而編輯過程可能也會修改窗口内其他鹸基，產生新的突變 （bystander edit）。當前可用的鹼基編輯器具的編輯範圍有限，而先導編輯器則具有更為廣泛的應用。將 pegRNA 攜帶的任何模板序列逆轉錄到 DNA 底物中，先導編輯可以修改一定範圍内所有類型的小型遺傳變異。但是先導編輯器的特性不如鹼基編輯器研究地清楚。兩種系統都具有不可忽略的脫靶效應，這限制了它們的應用。為了擴展鹼基編輯和先導編輯在生物研究和醫學治療中的適用性，需要將對於它們的改造和表徵工作從目前的逐項研究擴大到高通量方法。利用我們已建立的 CombiSEAL 平台，我們能夠大規模的組合鹼基編輯或先導編輯組件與不同的 Cas 蛋白。在此基礎上引入不同的突變集合來提高其效率、特異性和編輯範圍。為分析編輯器變體庫編輯結果，我們致力於開發並驗證一個全新的分析平台。該平台將同一段人爲設計的向導 RNA （guide RNA）靶標整合到所有變體表達載體中，通過深度測序的方法大規模地分析並量化變體庫的編輯結果。我們提出的以文庫形式進行篩選的方案將提高目前對鹼基編輯器和先導編輯器的改造能力，從而減少優化、分析和選擇最適合特定序列和應用的變體所需的時間和成本。

17102322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17102322.value: 發展比例性螢光蛋白傳感器作花粉研究

17102322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102322.value: We were the first group to introduce three novel sensors for monitoring dynamic changes in ATP, NADPH, and NADH/NAD+ ratio in different subcellular compartments of various tissues in live plants. This new technique is superior to the conventional in vitro methods that require prior extraction and thus cannot provide real-time or subcellular information. Pollen tube growth, the most rapid growth process in plant cells, consumes a huge amount of energy. By monitoring the specific endogenous fluorescence property of NAD(P)H under an excitation wavelength of 340 nm, earlier studies showed that there was oscillation of NAD(P)H in growing lily pollen tubes. However, whether oscillatory signals are produced by either or both NADH and NADPH could not be determined by fluorescent measurements. Moreover, the subcellular locations of these oscillatory NAD(P)H signals were also unclear. A lack of proper fluorescent probes or dyes specific for NADPH and NADH leads to a lack of understanding on their dynamic changes during pollen tube growth. In this project, we will employ our novel sensors to study the dynamic changes of ATP, NADPH, and NADH/NAD+ ratio in plastids and the cytosol, and changes in pH in the mitochondria and cytosol, and whether their levels oscillate during pollen tube growth. We will also monitor the mobility and movement of plastids and mitochondria during pollen tube growth. By making use of specific inhibitors (e.g., actin, myosin, microtubule, and mitochondrial electron transport chain inhibitors) and T-DNA mutants (myosin mutants, Rpo1, RIC3, RIC4, etc), this project will examine 1) whether the stromal and cytosolic ATP, NADPH, and NADH/NAD+ ratio oscillate during oscillatory pollen tube growth; 2) whether the matrix pH of mitochondria oscillates during oscillatory pollen tube growth; 3) whether plastid and mitochondria movement in the pollen tube are dependent on myosins, and if so, which myosins are responsible; and 4) whether oscillations in stromal and cytosolic ATP, NADPH, and NADH/NAD+ ratio, and oscillations in mitochondrial matrix pH, if any, are dependent on the actomyosin system or the ROP1/RIC3/RIC4 system at the tip. Our goal is to examine the association between bioenergetics and pollen tube growth oscillation. 我們是首個把能夠實時監測ATP濃度, NADPH濃度 及NADH/NAD+比例的三個螢光蛋白傳感器,引入植物細胞的研究組。這新技術令我們能夠觀察到同一棵植物不同細胞及其不同細胞器內 ATP濃度, NADPH濃度及NADH/NAD+比例的實時變化，這比以往所有需要先提取ATP, NADPH,NADH,NAD+再量度的方法都優勝，因為這些方法需要先將植物磨碎撮取,因此不能夠分辨出各細胞或 細胞器內的ATP濃度, NADPH濃度 或NADH/NAD+比例, 而且不能觀察到活生生植物體內它們的實時變化。 花粉管生長是植物生長最快的過程,需要使用大量能量。 前人曾經利用NADPH 和NADH 能夠在340mm激光的刺激下發出熒光的特性 , 觀察到在百合花粉生長時它們的總含量會隨著花粉管生長而有上下震盪的現象。但是,究竟是 NADPH,是NADH,還是兩者皆有振盪卻不清楚。 此外,這些震盪在哪一個細胞器發生也是不清楚。 在這項目我們會引入我們嶄新的三個螢光蛋白傳感器到植物花粉 ,去實時監測ATP濃度, NADPH濃度 及NADH/NAD+比例在花粉管生長過程中的實時變化。我們亦會藉此觀察質體及線粒體在花粉管生長的移動。 使用不同的突變體及抑制劑,我們會研究: 1. ATP濃度, NADPH濃度 及NADH/NAD+比例會否隨著花粉管生長而上下 震盪。 2. 線粒體的 pH會否隨著花粉管生長而上下震盪。 3. 質體及線粒體在花粉管生長的移動是否基於肌球蛋白。 4. ATP濃度, NADPH濃度 及NADH/NAD+比例在花粉管生長過程中上下震盪是否基於肌球蛋白或ROP1/RIC3/RIC4糸統。 我們的目標是探討花粉管振動生長中的能量轉換機制。

17102722.value: 利用高级成像技术探究糖萼中的脂蛋白脂肪酶在富含甘油三酯脂蛋白加工中的作用

17102722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17102722.value: Most lipids are transported in the form of particles, called lipoproteins, in the blood. These lipoprotein particles can be processed on the luminal side of blood vessels and supply fat nutrients for tissues and cells. This process is a topic of high significance. It provides fuel to vital organs, like the heart and muscle, to maintain normal health. When these lipoprotein particles are not efficiently processed and transported across the blood vessels, it could lead to high plasma triglyceride levels, which are a major risk factor for cardiovascular diseases, and cardiovascular diseases take an estimated 17.9 million lives each year. In the past few years, we have developed innovative approaches to study the processing of lipoprotein particles. These approaches have been extremely useful and enabled us to define key mechanisms on lipoprotein processing in the settings of normal human health and diseases. But important questions remain unanswered. For example, no one fully understands the transport of one of the key proteins, lipoprotein lipase (LPL)that is responsible to process lipoprotein particlesinteracts with lipoprotein particles for processing. Also, no one knows the mechanism of the defective processing of lipoprotein particles in untreated and uncontrolled diabetes, which is the most common cause of new onset chylomicronaemia. Our preliminary data, using recently developed bioreagents in combination with advanced imaging, have shown that some of the LPL that is transported into capillaries by its transporter (GPIHBP1), and a substantial fraction of the LPL detaches from its transporter and enters a layer of membrane-bound matrixes on the luminal side of blood vessels. For years, we assumed the LPL and GPIHBP1 interact with lipoprotein particles in a complex form, but now we suspect that this pool of LPL that detached from GPIHBP1 plays a significant role in lipoprotein processing. In this proposed project, we plan examine the role of the pool of LPL that is detached from GPIHBP1 in lipoprotein processing and investigate its function in the setting of both health and diabetes conditions. Expected outcomes of this project will be the improvement of our understandings of the fundamental mechanisms of the physiology of lipoprotein processing, and it will also provide new and sorely needed insights to the pathophysiology of chylomicronaemia in the setting of diabetes. The improved understandings of lipoprotein processing in health and diseases could have a great potential to develop downstream applications on the diagnosis and management of chylomicronaemia and diabetes. 大多數脂質在血液中以被稱為脂蛋白的顆粒形式運輸。這些脂蛋白顆粒可以在血管腔側加工，並為組織和細胞提供脂類營養。這個過程對於維持健康十分重要，因其為心臟和肌肉等重要器官提供燃料。如果這些脂蛋白顆粒在血管中沒有得到有效處理和運輸，將會導致血漿甘油三酯水準升高，此為心血管疾病的主要危險因素，並因此每年奪去約 1790 萬人的生命。 在過去的幾年裡，我們開發了創新的方法來研究脂蛋白顆粒的加工。這些方法十分優越，使我們能夠明確健康和疾病環境中脂蛋白加工的關鍵機制，但仍有重要問題亟待解決。例如，與脂蛋白顆粒互作並處理脂蛋白顆粒的關鍵分子脂蛋白脂肪酶 (LPL) 的運輸途徑仍然未知。又例如，未經治療及控制的糖尿病存在脂蛋白顆粒加工缺陷的機制未明，此為新發乳糜微粒血症的最常見誘因。 我們使用新近研發的生物製劑結合高級成像技術得到的初步資料表明，一些 LPL 通過其轉運蛋白 (GPIHBP1) 轉運到毛細血管中，而且相當一部分 LPL 與其轉運蛋白分離並進入血管腔側的一層膜結合基質中。多年來，我們一直認為 LPL 和 GPIHBP1 以複合體形式與脂蛋白顆粒互作，但現在我們推測從 GPIHBP1 分離的 LPL 在脂蛋白加工中起重要作用。在本研究中，我們計畫探究與 GPIHBP1 分離的 LPL 在脂蛋白加工中的作用，並研究其在健康和糖尿病情況下的功能。預期該課題的成果將提高我們對脂蛋白加工基本生理學機制的理解，並將為糖尿病情況下產生乳糜微粒的病理生理學機制提供新思路。更重要的是，提高對健康和疾病中脂蛋白加工的理解，將賦能針對乳糜微粒血症以及糖尿病的診斷和治療的應用開發。

17103122.value: 后新冠疫情时代新型抗流感病毒药物玛巴洛沙韦对香港和美国未来流感疫情的影响

17103122.label: Project Objectives
17103122.value: To develop a compartmental model of influenza transmission to capture the epidemic dynamics (e.g., attack rate, deaths, health burden) of future influenza outbreaks in the post-COVID-19 era. To develop a within-host model of influenza virus load dynamics to estimate the antiviral efficacy of baloxavir or other antivirals (e.g., oseltamivir) that impacts the duration of infectiousness. To develop a hierarchical model including both within-host and compartmental models, with the infection force varying with viral replication dynamics on baloxavir treatment. We expect this model can help to estimate the epidemiological impact (e.g., averted deaths, economic benefit) of baloxavir treatment on influenza outbreaks.

17103122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103122.value: 季节性流感的再次流行会对社会构成重大威胁。 虽然自 2020 年以来香港的流感发病率一直较低，但是美国在 2020 年秋季的流感报告病例数显著增加。由于在非药物干预措施期间人群总体的易感性增加，流感在后 COVID-19 时代随时都可能大规模爆发 。 抗病毒药物治疗可以防止流感的传播，并降低相应的发病率和死亡率。 尽管疫苗接种仍然是预防流感的主要方法，抗病毒药物已经被广泛用于治疗流感患者，减轻患者症状，并且缩短感染期。但是耐药流感病毒的已经出现（例如抗奥司他韦的病毒），因此开发新型抗病毒药物至关重要。 最近，一种新型抗流感病毒药（玛巴洛沙韦）获得批准，用于治疗流感患者。 玛巴洛沙韦对流感患者的广泛治疗，可以降低人群的患病率，减轻流感疫情的传播风险。 我们会通过传染病机制模型描述这种全国不同年龄组间的流感传播现象，估计未来流感季节在不同传播情景下的流感流行程度和社会经济负担。 我们将估计在香港和全球其他国家（如美国）中大规模使用玛巴洛沙韦治疗对人群流感发病率的影响。 该研究的具体研究问题包括： 1) 未来流感爆发的流行动态（例如，发病率、死亡人数、健康负担等）； 2) 与其他抗病毒药物（例如奥司他韦）相比，玛巴洛沙韦在减轻流感流行方面的优势（例如，避免死亡、经济效益等）。 我们将提出一个用于研究流感病毒传播动力学的分析框架，提供流行病学防疫建议和和预测模型，为后新冠时代流感爆发提供指导。

17103122.label: Realisation of objectives
17103122.value: The realisation of the objectives are follows: (1) Within-host model of influenza replication dynamics We applied a published model that incorporates both the immune response and the inhibitory effects of antiviral therapy on the virus. The model includes the variables U, F, Z, and V, representing the number of uninfected target cells, the number of infected target cells, the magnitude of the immune response (i.e., antibody levels), and the amount of free virus (measured in TCID50/ml), respectively. Using published estimates of initial values ​​for F and U, we fitted the model to clinical trial data to estimate all model parameters. (2) Mapping viral load to infectiousness To evaluate the impact of antiviral therapy on the transmission dynamics of influenza, we modeled the relationship between the viral load and infectiousness of an individual. Prior studies had explored three types of viral load-infectiousness coupling function: logarithmic, sigmoid, and linear, we assumed that infectiousness is logarithmically related to viral load. (3) Between-host model: Impact of baloxavir or oseltamivir treatment on the transmission dynamics of influenza outbreaks We analyzed both an hieratical model that links the between-host transmission to within-host viral dynamics. Our stochastic individual-based model tracked the progression of cases through the following states: susceptible (S), infected (I), symptomatic (A), pre-symptomatic state (P), symptomatic (Y), treated (T), hospitalized (H), and recovered (R). We assumed that is the product of a population-wide scaling factor matched to the targeted reproduction number and individual's viral load at time. Once an individual is infected, we use the within-host model to explicitly track their changing viral load. They are randomly selected for treatment according to the specified case treatment rate. (4) Estimating epidemiological quantities from simulation data To obtain the R0 of a single simulation, we calculated the average number of secondary cases produced by 100 individuals infected at first. For each scenario, we computed the mean and 95% confidence interval for R0 over 100 stochastic simulations. To estimate the epidemiological benefits of various interventions, we conducted pairwise experiments in which we repeatedly run baseline and treatment simulations in tandem, assuming a total population of 100. For each pair, we recorded the difference in total incidence between the baseline and treatment simulations. The stochasticity in our simulations would erase differences of the projected public health burden of hospitalizations and deaths between different transmission scenarios. We thus estimated the number of hospitalizations and deaths directly using the total incidence directly in each simulation. (5) Estimating the net monetary benefit We evaluated each antiviral strategy by comparing its simulated outcomes to a baseline (placebo) scenario. The health benefit was measured in Years of Life Lost (YLL) averted, calculated by multiplying the reduction in age-specific deaths by the average remaining life expectancy for each age group. The incremental monetary cost for each strategy was determined by summing the extra cost of additional antiviral treatments and the cost savings from reduced hospitalizations. The willingness to pay per YLL averted is the maximum price a society is willing to pay to prevent the loss of one year of life. For a given willingness to pay for a YLL averted, we calculated the net monetary benefit (NMB) of a strategy. We identified threshold antiviral prices above which the baseline strategy is expected to outperform the antiviral treatment strategies for over 50 of 100 stochastic simulations. The objectives of the project were fully achieved. The research was an analytic national-scale framework for studying viral transmission dynamics and provided epidemiological insights and predictive models that can inform healthcare preparedness and preventative care in ensuing influenza outbreaks in the post-COVID-19 era. The tools developed as part of this research have been applied to real-world datasets, yielding significant new insights that have been published in top peer-reviewed journals. The project has therefore realized its objectives to a high degree and laid the groundwork for future progress in prevention of major infectious diseases. (6) Individual-based network The influenza infection dynamic model assumes that the virus spreads through a fixed contact network consisting of 10,000 individuals. We assume that our model represents the household structure, contact patterns, and influenza transmission dynamics of a typical community, and directly scale our results from the 10,000 individuals in the model to the population size of the target country/region. We construct synthetic networks of individuals, who have contacts in households, workplaces, schools and others, that satisfy statistical properties (such as the age distribution, household size, etc.) in countries/regions, informed by country-level census and survey data for a given country/region.

17103122.label: Major findings and research outcome
17103122.value: Compared to the treatment with placebo, the Baloxavir treatment would avert more infections and achieve higher NMB benefits over scenarios, decreasing with reproduction numbers and increasing with treatment rates. For example of 20% treatment rate, in the United States, under a low transmission scenario (Re=1.2), the treatment of Baloxavir is expected to avert 7.33 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 2.96, 11.74) million cases, corresponding to a NMB benefit of 5.93 (95% CI:-0.92, 12.77) billion USD. In contrast, Oseltamivir is expected to avert 5.73 (95% CI:1.94, 9.52) million cases and gain 6.66 (95% CI:0.63, 12.69) billion USD. If the price of Baloxavir can be half, the NMB benefit could be 7.12 (95% CI:-8.55, 22.78) billion USD. Under a high transmission scenario (Re=2.0), this Baloxavir treatment would be expected to avert 3.21 (95% CI:-0.94, 7.35) million cases and gain a NMB benefit of 0.11 (95% CI:-15.86, 16.09) billion USD. Oseltamivir would reduce 2.36 (95% CI:-1.71, 6.42) million cases and gain 2.84 (95% CI:-12.67, 18.35) billion USD. If the price of Baloxavir can be half, the NMB benefit could be 6.66 (95% CI:0.63, 12.69) billion USD. For example in Hong Kong, 20% treatment rate under a low transmission scenario (Re=1.2), the treatment of Baloxavir is expected to avert 1.44 (95% CI: 0.49, 2.38) million cases, corresponding to a NMB benefit of 0.21 (95% CI:-0.53, 0.94) billion USD. In contrast, Oseltamivir is expected to avert 1.05 (95% CI:0.22, 1.88) million cases and gain 0.47 (95% CI:-0.21, 1.15) billion USD. If the price of Baloxavir can be half, the NMB benefit could be 0.47 (95% CI:-0.21, 1.15) billion USD. The Baloxavir treatment has the largest mean NMB gained in most countries in the disease transmission scenario with effective reproduction numbers of 1.2 and the treatment rate of 20% . The US would receive the largest NMB, which has the highest daily cost of hospitalization. We give a threshold price of Baloxavir or Oseltamivir above which the baseline strategy of placebo treatments is expected to be more cost-effective than the treatment strategies for over 50 of 100 stochastic simulations. In the study areas, we found that expanded treatment of Baloxavir (Oseltamivir) is more cost-effective than the baseline scenario if the price per test is less than $52 ($40) across all transmission rates.

17103122.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17103122.value: The potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action were following: First, incorporating variability in viral kinetics and treatment efficacy across age and risk groups should improve intervention assessments and resource prioritization, though it won't qualitatively change these findings. Second, modeling antiviral-resistant virus evolution and spread could alter the population benefits of increased treatment. The CDC assessed influenza susceptibility to Oseltamivir and Baloxavir in 2019, finding little reduced susceptibility; however, Baloxavir-resistant viruses accounted for 23% of Baloxavir-treated children14 and 9.7% of treated adults before COVID-19. These resistant viruses could spread influenza. Future developments will refine our model. Baloxavir-Oseltamivir combination therapy may minimize Baloxavir resistance while maintaining herd impact. No new safety signals emerged. The proposed course of action is to continue evaluating combination therapy and monitoring resistant virus emergence to optimize treatment strategies and resource allocation while minimizing unintended consequences.

17103122.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17103122.value: In layman's terms, this research project aims to develop new antiviral drug mathematical models to better understand and predict future influenza outbreaks. The emergence of drug-resistant influenza strains poses a major threat, so new antiviral drugs with novel mechanisms of action are urgently needed. Recently, a new antiviral drug called baloxavir that targets a subunit of the influenza virus polymerase enzyme was approved for treating influenza A and B viruses, including pandemic strains and those resistant to existing drugs. Widespread use of baloxavir and other antiviral drugs could indirectly reduce influenza cases in the population, helping mitigate future influenza epidemics. Mathematical models that incorporate details about how the virus spreads between different age, risk, and vaccination groups can provide insights into how antiviral strategies might impact influenza transmission. By analyzing clinical trial data on the time intervals between infection, symptom onset, treatment, and recovery, these models could estimate how much baloxavir and other drugs might reduce health burdens from influenza in future seasons under different transmission scenarios. In summary, this research developed a framework for studying how influenza spreads nationally and provided epidemiological insights to guide preparedness and prevention efforts against future influenza outbreaks, especially in the post-COVID-19 era.

17103322.value: Prof Leung, Wing Hang Prof Tsia, Kevin Kin Man Prof Wong, Siu Lun Alan

17103322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103322.value: More than 500,000 people die from blood cancers annually, either because the patients are not physically fit for cancer treatment, or the cancers do not respond to chemotherapy or radiation therapy. Recently T cells that are genetically engineered to express an artificial receptor for B-cell antigens have emerged as a potent therapy for B-lineage leukemia, lymphoma and myeloma, including patients who are not fit for intensive treatment such as stem cell transplantation. Similar successes, however, are not observed for T-lineage malignancies, primarily because of the lack of tumor-associated antigens that are only expressed on malignant cells but not on normal T cells. Therefore, the T cells with artificial receptors against T-cell antigens could attack not only the malignant T cells, but also self and normal T cells, resulting in profound T-cytopenia and substantial risk of life-threatening infections. Another barrier is production failure, long manufacturing time and high cost if the receptor-modified therapeutic T cells are generated using the patient’s own T cells. In this project, we will develop a new artificial receptor that generates an inhibitory signal to the T cells when normal T-cell antigens are encountered, thus avoiding self-killing or killing of normal T cells. We will also produce healthy donor T cells that lack histocompatibility-antigens to eliminate the need for donor-recipient matching for off-the-shelf administration, thereby eliminating the limitations of patient-derived T cells as mentioned. If successful, the application of our approach may not only be useful for T-lineage malignancies, but also many other types of cancers. 每年有超過50萬人死於血癌，要麼是因為患者身體不適合癌症治療，要麼是癌症對化療或放療沒有反應。最近，經過基因工程設計以表達B細胞抗原的人工受體的T細胞已成為B系白血病，淋巴瘤和骨髓瘤的有效治療方法，包括不適合幹細胞移植等強化治療的患者。然而，在T譜系惡性腫瘤中未觀察到類似的成功，主要是因為缺乏僅在惡性細胞上表達而在正常T細胞上表達的腫瘤相關抗原。因此，具有針對T細胞抗原的人工受體的T細胞不僅可以攻擊惡性T細胞，還可以攻擊自身和正常的T細胞，從而導致嚴重的T細胞減少和危及生命的感染的巨大風險。 另一個障礙是生產失敗，製造時間長和成本高，如果受體修飾的治療性T細胞是使用患者自己的T細胞產生的。 在這個專案中，我們將開發一種新的人工受體，當遇到正常的T細胞抗原時，它會向T細胞產生抑制信號，從而避免自殺或殺死正常的T細胞。 我們還將產生缺乏組織相容性抗原的健康供體T細胞，以消除對現成給葯的供體 - 受體匹配的需求 ，從而消除 上述患者來源T細胞的局限性。 如果成功，我們的方法的應用可能不僅對T譜惡性腫瘤有用，而且對許多其他類型的癌症也有用。

17103422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17103422.value: 使用非維生素 K 口服抗凝藥和華法林對患有心房顫動及二尖瓣狹窄華人的有效性和安全性: 真實世界數據研究

17103422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103422.value: Patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and underlying mitral stenosis (MS) are at as much as 17-fold risk of stroke compared to those without. Despite the decline of MS in developed countries, it remains prevalent in Asia especially in developing countries. Long-term anticoagulation is essential in these patients for stroke prevention and reduction of mortality. Currently, warfarin is the only oral anticoagulant (OAC) indicated for the management of AF with moderate-severe MS. However, poor INR control remains a challenge which contributes to adverse events or suboptimal effectiveness. Our previous work found 68% of patients on warfarin have a time-in-therapeutic-range (TTR) of less than 60%. Use of warfarin also requires frequent blood monitoring and has various food-drug and drug-drug interactions. In contrast, non-vitamin-K oral anticoagulants (NOACs) have consistently demonstrated superior safety and comparable efficacy over warfarin, and is currently the standard of care for stroke prevention in patients with non-valvular AF. However, evidence on their use in patients with underlying MS is limited since landmark RCTs comparing NOACs and warfarin excluded those with moderate-severe MS or mechanical heart valves. Important knowledge gaps remain regarding the use of warfarin or NOACs in patients with AF-MS. Despite “off-label” use of NOACs in these patients, whether NOACs are a safe and effective alternative to warfarin in AF-MS patients is currently unknown. Data from observational study can generate real-world evidence to shed light on this clinical question, providing early indicators to support and complement findings of future RCTs. Meanwhile in warfarin users, although previous studies suggest that lower INR target may be more appropriate in Chinese patients with AF, the optimal intensity of anticoagulation with warfarin (INR target) is not well established for AF-MS. Real-world data is essential to guide warfarin dosing to minimize both risks of stroke and bleeding. Hence, we propose a population-based cohort study to compare the safety and effectiveness of NOACs versus warfarin in patients with AF-MS, and determine how intensity and control of anticoagulation is associated with clinical outcomes among warfarin users. Using electronic medical records from Hong Kong and replication of the study using data from Taiwan, our study will provide evidence to guide the use of OACs in patients with AF-MS, and further our understanding of the implications of its use especially in Chinese patients. This study will have considerable community impact to optimise drug use, and provide guidance to reduce healthcare utilisation and medical costs associated with stroke prevention in AF-MS.

17103522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103522.value: DNA双链断裂信号（DSB）的快速传导是有效的DNA修复和维持基因稳定的关键。扰乱DSB反应回路的基因突变会损害基因组稳定性，这与包括癌症和发育缺陷在内的一系列人类疾病有关。 作为哺乳动物DNA损伤应答(DDR)网络工作的一部分，近期，我们致力于研究核肌动蛋白动力学在DSB反应中的作用，并发现了肌动蛋白调控蛋白Spir1是DSB的早期应答者。我们发现，Spir1会在激光微照射诱导的DNA损伤区域积累，据推断，Spir1可能是通过其FYVE结构域与磷酸肌苷（PIPs）相互作用从而靶向受损的染色质。与此同时，考虑到PIPs可能通过修饰DSB微环境来驱动DDRs，我们利用激光微照射，发现磷脂酰肌醇4,5二磷酸（PIP2）同样会在照射区域积累，说明PIP2可能在DNA双链断裂的染色质上有比较早期的作用。 为了系统地分析PIP2如何作为DSB侧翼染色质上的信号中间体，我们将通过体外和体内实验研究Spir1 FYVE与PIP2的相互作用，首先确定Spir1 FYVE如何靶向受损染色质。同时，我们会探究核内PIP2的代谢，以及PIP2如何参与DSB信号转导和DNA修复过程。此外，我们将分析PIP2的相互作用组以确定新的DSB响应因子，并系统地研究PIP2代谢如何通过对基因组稳定性和细胞免疫的影响来产生基因毒性应激。 因此，鉴于PIP2s在肌动蛋白动力学中的作用，我们认为PIP2可能是早期DSB反应的基础，也是维持基因组完整的重要第二信使。故我们提出的项目将会揭示核内PIP2如何介导DSB反应，以及PIP2代谢途径的遗传干扰如何导致基因组不稳定和肿瘤发生，具有重要的意义和研究价值。

17103922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17103922.value: Serotonin targeting drugs are the first-line treatment for anxiety and affective disorders. One of the hallmarks of anxiety disorders is the abnormal acquisition or extinction of fear memory. Despite clinical and preclinical data implicating the involvement of the serotonergic system in fear-related disorders, the precise circuits in the serotonergic system and their role in fear learning and extinction remain elusive. A recent study showed that optogenetic stimulation of the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) efferent to the dorsal raphe nucleus (DRN) resulted in reversible effects on inducing an active behavioural state in the forced swim test, suggesting a role in motivation and despair behaviour. Systematic anatomical and functional mapping studies also indicate long-range direct prefrontal inputs to serotonergic neurons in the DRN. It is found that the direct inputs from mPFC located primarily in layer (L) 5 of the prelimbic cortex (PL) and infralimbic cortex (IL). Nevertheless, the neural correlates and the role of the mPFC-DRN circuitry controlling serotonergic neurons in fear conditioning and extinction are still unclear. In view of the important roles of the PL and IL in fear expression and fear extinction, we hypothesise that L5 pyramidal neurons in the PL and IL directly modulate the activity of serotonergic neurons in the DRN and provide feedback to the mPFC to regulate serotonergic modulation of fear acquisition and extinction behaviour. To test this hypothesis, we will use serotonin transporter (SERT)-Cre mice to decipher the role of the serotonergic modulation of mPFC-DRN circuitry in three specific aims. 1) We will use in vivo two-photon microscopy to examine the structural plasticity of dendritic spines of L5 pyramidal neurons that project to the DRN and the serotonergic axonal boutons from the DRN to mPFC in fear conditioning and extinction. 2) We will use photometry to examine the calcium activity (using genetically encoded fluorescent calcium sensor GCaMP6) and extracellular level of serotonin (using newly developed serotonin sensor GRAB 5-HT) to evaluate the functional plasticity and interaction between the mPFC and the DRN in awake behaving mice. 3) We will use optogenetics to manipulate the mPFC-DNR circuitry to further reveal its role in fear conditioning and extinction. In summary, this study will reveal the fundamental role of serotonergic modulation of the mPFC in fear conditioning and extinction. The findings will reveal how serotonin modulates fear-related neural networks, which will help in the development of novel serotonin-based therapeutics for affective and anxiety disorders. 選擇性血清素（5-HT） 再攝取抑製劑是焦慮症和情感障礙的一線治療藥物。 儘管臨床和臨床前數據表明血清素涉及恐懼和焦慮相關的疾病，但血清素在內側前額葉皮層 (medial prefrontal cortex, PFC) 至背側縫核 (dorsal raphe nucleus, DRN) 神經迴路在恐懼條件反射和恐懼消退中的作用仍不清楚。 鑑於前邊緣皮層 (prelimbic cortex: PL) 和下邊緣皮層 (infralimbic cortex, IL) 在恐懼表達和恐懼消退中的重要作用，我們假設 PL 和 IL 中的 Layer (L) 5 錐體神經元直接調節 DRN 血清素神經元的活動，並向 mPFC 提供反饋以調節恐懼條件反射和恐懼消退行為。 為了驗證這一假設，我們將使用血清素轉運蛋白 (SERT)-Cre 小鼠來破譯 mPFC-DRN 迴路的血清素調節在以下三個目標中的作用 。 1)我們將使用體內雙光子顯微鏡檢查L5錐體神經元和血清素神經元在恐懼條件反射和恐懼 消退中突觸的結構可塑性。 2)我們將使用光度法 (photometry)檢查老鼠鈣活性(使用基因編碼的熒光鈣傳感器: GCaMP6)和血清素的外水平( 使用新開發的血清素傳感器:GRAB5-HT) ，以評估 mPFC 和 DRN 的相互作用。3)我們將使用光遺傳學來操縱 mPFC-DNR 迴路，以進一步揭示其在恐懼條件反射和恐懼消退中的作用。 這項研究將揭示 mPFC 的血清素調節在恐懼條件反射和恐懼消退中的基本作用。 這些發現將揭示血清素如何調節與恐懼相關的神經網絡，將有助於開發新的基於血清素的情感和焦慮症療法。

17104922.label: Project Objectives
17104922.value: Summary of Objectives: Based on our preliminary data (see “Research context” section), we hypothesized that psqL is an amyloid-based substrate of “transcriptional memory”. To investigate the hypothesis that amyloids serve as a substrate to store cellular memory in development, we aim to characterize, functionally and structurally, monomeric and aggregated psqL directly isolated from developing embryos through two specific objectives. The first objective i) investigates how to isolate different conformational states of psqL (i.e., monomers and aggregates) from developing embryos, ii) characterize their biophysical properties, and iii) determine their capacity to interact with physiological partners. In the second objective, a high-resolution structural analysis will be used to elucidate structural features of monomeric psqL as well as to calculate the structure of the biologically relevant, aggregated psqL isolated from developing embryos. Objective 1. Isolation and characterization of monomeric and aggregated psqL from developing embryos Objective 1.1. Isolate monomeric and aggregated psqL from developing embryos. Isolating aggregated psqL from its native environment is key for several reasons. For instance, it has been shown that many polypeptides can fold in vitro into an alternative conformation that allows for self-assembly into amyloids (Dobson, 2003), irrespectively if the amyloid state is achieved under physiological conditions. Besides, we have recently reported that the cellular context may influence decisively on the functional amyloid structure, suggesting that in vitro assembled entities may not be physiologically meaningful. Indeed, we found that the structure of CPEB/Orb2 amyloid filaments assembled in vitro differ from those extracted from the Drosophila brain (Hervas et al., 2020). Due to these structural differences, the in vitro-assembled CPEB/Orb2 amyloid is non-biochemically active as it lacks the ability to recruit a key physiological partner needed to perform its function (Hervas et al., 2020). Consequently, to understand functional amyloids it is important to isolate the full-length protein from the biologically relevant tissue and assess whether it retains the physiological features. Hence, to get insight into the relationship of psqL assembly and its biochemical function, we aim to isolate and characterize the monomeric and aggregated psqL from developing embryos to avoid the mentioned pitfalls of overexpressing recombinant psqL under heterologous conditions. Objective 1.2. Determine the biophysical properties of monomeric and aggregated psqL isolated from developing embryos. Prion-like proteins can assume distinct conformational states (Jakobson and Jarosz, 2018). PsqL forms two physical entities in the developing embryo: a monomer and an amyloid-like aggregate, which assembles after nuclear division and disassembles once cell division occurs (see "Research context" section). We aim to use biophysical methods to get insight into the nature of the different psqL physical states. Objective 1.3. Determine the capability of monomeric and aggregated psqL isolated from developing embryos to interact with physiological partners. Psq recruits Pc-G complexes to specific DNA sequences (PREs) to exert their repressive function (Müller and Kassis, 2006; Schuettengruber et al., 2017). To achieve this function, psq interacts with different physiological partners, i.e., Pc, a subunit of the Pc-G complexes, and the (GA)n motif in PREs (Huang et al., 2002). We aim to employ an immobilized template assay and a chromatographic approach to test the consequences of PsqL prion-like aggregation in DNA- and Pc-binding capabilities, respectively. Objective 2. Structure determination of monomeric and aggregated psqL. Whether amyloids serve as a substrate to store cellular memory in development is unknown. To gain mechanistic insight, we aim to perform a high-resolution structural analysis of monomeric psqL and aggregated psqL through two specific objectives: Objective 2.1. Characterization of the conformational ensemble and dynamics of monomeric psqL in solution by NMR spectroscopy Objective 2.2. Calculate the 3D atomic structure of psqL aggregates isolated from developing embryos by cryo-EM

17104922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17104922.value: Prion-like proteins can assume distinct stable conformations, at least one of which is an aggregated, self-perpetuating state. Traditionally associated with disease, prion-like assemblies also orchestrate a range of physiological processes in space and time, from bacteria to mammals, in response to intracellular and extracellular stimuli. Recent computational studies suggest that prion-like proteins are widespread in higher eukaryotic proteomes. However, the functional relevance, if any, of the prion-like features remains unknown in most of the cases. To provide experimental insight into this, we performed a small-scale systematic screen of the whole proteome of Drosophila melanogaster that led us to the identification of a discrete number of likely functional prion-like proteins involved in diverse biological contexts. Among the candidates, Pipsqueak (psq) is a transcription regulator known for determining cell fate during Drosophila embryonic development. To this end, psq recruits polycomb group (Pc-G) repressor complexes to specific DNA elements, known as polycomb response elements (PREs), to assist them to exert their repressive function on diverse developmental genes. We found that the longest psq isoform (psqL), which is required during early embryonic development, adopts two conformational states in vivo: a monomeric state (nonprion) and a higher-order protein assembly with self-perpetuating features (prion). The aggregated state of psqL, which shows features that resemble an amyloid, assembles following nuclear division in the early developing embryo and disassembles as cell division ensues. Based on these observations, we hypothesize that psqL conversion from monomer to a self-perpetuating amyloid state in developing embryos perpetuates the repressive state of Pc-G loci targets in an epigenetic manner. In the current proposal, the bona fide amyloid nature of endogenous, dynamic psqL assemblies, as well as the physiological relevance of psqL prion-like aggregation will be explored through i) the isolation of the monomeric and aggregated states of psqL from early developing embryos to determine their biophysical and biochemical properties (objective 1), and ii) the use of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and single-particle electron-cryo microscopy (cryo-EM) to characterize the structural features of the monomeric and aggregated psqL, respectively (objective 2). Determining the structure of native, dynamic psqL assemblies will increase our understating into the functional consequences of amyloid assembly in vivo, and into how animals modulate amyloid assembly and disassembly to achieve a spatiotemporal control in their activity. In addition, determining the structural distinctions between beneficial and disease-related amyloids will increase our understanding into why amyloids are frequently connected with human diseases. 阮病毒樣蛋白被視為有著顯著穩定的構象，其中至少有一種是聚集的，自我維持的狀態。傳統上類澱粉蛋白被認為與疾病相關，但同時它也協調了一系列空間與時間上的生理學過程，從細菌到哺乳類動物，響應胞內和 胞外刺激。 最近的計算生物學研究提示我們阮病毒樣蛋白廣泛存在於高等真核生物蛋白質組中。然而，這些阮病毒樣蛋白的功能相關特徵（如果存在）在大部分例子中都依舊不為所知。為了提供對此的實驗見解，我們對黑腹果蠅的全基因組進行了小規模的系統性篩查，結果識別到了不連續的幾個可能的功能性阮病毒樣蛋白，它們參與到了多樣的生物學系統中。在上述識別到的阮病毒樣蛋白中，Pipsqueak(psq)是一種轉錄調節因子，已知在果蠅的胚胎發育中決定細胞命運。總體來說，psq招募多梳組（Pc-G)抑制子複合體至特定的DNA元件，即多梳響應元件（PREs），從而協助它們對多種發育基因發揮抑制功能。 我們發現長psq異構體(psqL)，在早期胚胎發育中所需，在體內形成兩種構象；單體狀態（非阮蛋白樣）和高度有序的蛋白質組裝，具有自我維持特點的特點（阮蛋白樣）。聚集狀態的psqL具有點粉樣蛋白的代表性特徵，在早期胚胎發育時，psqL緊接著核分裂之時組裝，在隨之而來的細胞質分裂時解聚。基於這個觀察結果，我們假設在發育胚胎中，psqL從單體至自我維持的類澱粉蛋白的狀態轉換是一種固定Pc-G基因座抑制狀態的表觀遺傳學方式。 在這份計畫書中，真實的天然內源型類澱粉蛋白，動態psqL組裝，以及psqL阮病毒樣蛋白聚集的生理相關性質將會通過以下方式來探索：i）從早期胚胎中分離單體和聚集狀態psqL以確定它們的生物物理學和生物化學性質（任務1），和ii）採用核磁共振（NMR）方法和單顆粒冷凍電子顯微鏡法（cryo-EM）來確定單體和聚集psqL的對應結構特徵（任務2）。 確認天然、動態的psqL組裝結構將會增加我們的理解：對於體內類澱粉蛋白組裝功能的結論；對於動物如何通過對類澱粉蛋白的組裝和解聚進行調控，以達到在時間和空間上控制生命活動。除此之外，確定有益和致病類澱粉蛋白結構的區別有助於增強我們對為什麼類澱粉蛋白於人類疾病總是相關聯的理解。

17105322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17105322.value: 細胞外囊泡（EVs）是一類高度異質性的膜囊泡，幾乎所有類型的細胞都能分泌EVs。EVs作為細胞間彼此相互溝通的橋樑，能夠參加細胞間的信號傳導與表型改變。有研究表明EVs參與腫瘤的發生和轉移，在腫瘤微環境中起重要調節作用。 EVs 成功進入細胞是EVs對受體細胞產生作用的先決條件。因此，探究EVs如何被細胞攝取至關重要。已有研究證實，在不同細胞中，多種內吞途徑介導了EVs的攝取機制。然而，肝癌細胞攝取EVs的機制尚不明確。我們前期研究結果表明，與正常肝細胞和非轉移性肝癌細胞相比，轉移性肝癌細胞攝取70 kDa的TMR-dextran（大胞飲標記物）以及PKH67標記EVs的能力更高。這一研究結果促使我們探究轉移性肝癌細胞對EVs 的快速攝取是否由增強的大胞飲途徑介導。EIPA作為大胞飲途徑的抑制劑，能抑制TMR-dextran和PKH67標記的EVs的攝取，並且抑制了EVs的促肝癌細胞的增殖、遷移和成瘤性。EIPA是鈉-氫交換子（NHE）的抑制劑，作用於溶質載體家族9（SLC9）。因此，我們推測SLC9成員參與了轉移性肝癌細胞的大胞飲。在SLC9所有家族成員中，SLC9A7的表達水準與細胞的EVs攝取能力密切相關。SLC9A7是一種細胞器的鈉-氫交換子，定位於參與囊泡轉運的反式高爾基體。與對照組相比，敲除SLC9A7的細胞的胞內pH值下降，細胞對EVs的攝取能力、生長能力和遷移能力均降低。此外，臨床數據分析顯示，SLC9A7在人肝癌組織中表達上調，其高表達與預後不良有關。因此，我們假設SLC9A7升高導致肝癌細胞的大胞飲作用增強，使EVs的攝取增強，進一步促進了EVs誘導的肝癌細胞的發生和轉移。 本研究旨在探究：1）SLC9A7在EVs誘導的肝癌細胞的發生與轉移中的作用；2）SLC9A7對細胞內pH值的調控作用；3）SLC9A7在人肝癌發生發展中的臨床意義。本研究首次為肝癌細胞攝取EVs的途徑提供新的證據，並闡明了阻斷EVs攝取對治療轉移性肝細胞癌的潛在臨床意義。
