17105422.value: 工程化組織的預血管化和血管成熟程度與移植物和宿主的血管吻合和功能性血管的建立密切相關。在這種情況下，為了最大程度地提高工程化組織的再生能力，明確預血管網的成熟過程中調控的主要信號機制尤為重要。我們之前的研究證實EphrinB2/EphB4信號通路參與了DPSCs穩定新生血管的調控。當ECs與DPSCs直接共培養時，DPSCs的周細胞標誌物的表達水平隨著TGF-β1的分泌增加而增強。我們進一步發現，TGF-β1的處理可以促使DPSCs向周細胞表型轉變，從而促進血管穩定性，Ang1/Tie2信號可能在這一過程中參與調控。然而，EphrinB2/EphB4信號是否參與調節TGF-β/Smad對DPSC向周細胞表型分化的作用，以及Ang-1/Tie2信號對血管成熟的作用，目前尚不明確。本研究通過分子生物學手段，抑制或過表達Ephrinb2/EphB4信號通路，探究EphrinB2/EphB4對TGF-β/Smad信號調節Ang-1/Tie2的作用。並通過體內研究，組織形態學、免疫組織化學的方法來評估血管直徑、密度、壁細胞的覆蓋率以及血管通透性。揭示EphrinB2/EphB4、TGF-β/Smad和Ang-1/Tie2信號通路與DPSCs介導的血管成熟過程的關係。這一研究可能為牙本質/牙髓再生提供有效途徑。

17106322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17106322.value: RNA剪接因子對微管穩定性，神經突生長，以及突觸囊泡運輸的調控作用

17106322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106322.value: 此項研究致力於了解mRNA選擇性剪接在神經元發育過程中的功能，並研究進化上保守的剪接因子Muscleblind在軸突生長，樹突形成，以及突觸囊泡轉運中的功能。本項目利用遺傳學，基因組學，以及細胞生物學手段研究秀麗線蟲中Muscleblind基因，MBL-1，對三種不同神經元發育的調控作用。通過全基因組分析和正向遺傳篩選，我們會鑒定MBL-1下游靶向基因，並在單細胞水平發現影響神經元發育的關鍵選擇性剪接基因。同時，此項研究會發掘受到選擇性剪接調控的微管結合蛋白，並建立選擇性剪接和微管穩定性之間的連結。 此前的研究發現Muscleblind家族的mRNA剪接調控因子控制很多組織的發育和功能，包括心肌組織，骨骼肌組織，血細胞，眼睛，脂肪組織，和神經系統。Muscleblind的缺失會導致萎縮性肌強直症。雖然Muscleblind在肌肉發育中的功能研究較多，其在神經元發育中的功能並不十分清楚。此外，mRNA選擇性剪接在神經元形態和功能的建成中的作用也並不清楚。 此項目利用秀麗線蟲的神經元來研究Muscleblind的功能，填補上述知識空缺。首先，我們會鑒定mbl-1（-）缺失突變體的表型，包括對觸覺感受神經元TRN的軸突生長，痛覺感受神經元PVD的樹突發育，以及運動神經元DA9的突觸囊泡運輸的影響。我們也會分析mbl-1缺失對微管動態穩定性的影響。其次，我們會利用三種方法搜尋MBL-1的下游調控基因，包括利用RNA-seq鑒定出在mbl-1（-）缺失突變體中受影響的外顯子連結，利用CLIP-seq分析出MBL-1蛋白結合的RNA序列，以及利用正向遺傳篩選找出mbl-1（-）的抑制突變體。在確定MBL-1下游基因之後，我們會以抑制或者過表達某個mRNA异构体的方式，測試這些基因的選擇性剪接對神經元發育的影響。再次，我們會研究MBL-1對下游基因的剪接的調控機制。我們會鑒定出MBL-1識別的調控序列，並研究MBL-1和這些調控序列的結合如何影響這些基因的剪接。總之，此項目會對Muscleblind在神經元發育過程中的調控機制進行深入研究，並幫助理解萎縮性肌強直症中的神經學症狀的分子基礎。

17106622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17106622.value: 解析體細胞至神經幹細胞和多能幹細胞的重編程路線以實現專一性細胞命運轉換

17106622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106622.value: We can now program the identity of cells in the laboratory via the overexpression of defined combinations of transcription factors. Cells reprogrammed in a dish allow studying human diseases and evaluating the effect of drugs. Studies on neurodegenerative diseases can benefit from three cell types produced by reprogramming technologies: (i) induced pluripotent cells (iPSC); (ii) directly transdifferentiated post-mitotic neurons (iN) and (iii) directly transdifferentiated induced neural stem cells (iNSC). The widespread use of iNSCs was hitherto not possible for the absence of efficient and reproducible methods as well as uncertainties about the routes towards iNSCs. Our laboratory has developed a new technology to efficiently reprogram embryonic, adult and aged cells towards iNSCs with the help of an engineered and enhanced SOX17 factor (eSOX17) alongside KLF4 and c-MYC. Conceptually, iNSCs are superior to cells derived from iPSCs for three reasons. First, they lack the oncogenic features associated with iPSCs. Second, they speed up the generation of specific cell models for neurodegenerative diseases. Third, they might bypass the rejuvenation accompanying iPSC reprogramming. iPSC and their derivatives resemble neonatal cells that fail to represent age-associated phenotypes. Post-mitotic iNs solve some of these problems. However, as they can no longer divide they cannot be produced at scale severely limiting their use. Here we propose to perform a dense analysis of the roadmap from skin cells towards iNSCs using single-cell gene expression profiling. We derived cells from genetically modified mice that express fluorescent markers allowing the simultaneous detection of neural and pluripotent stem cells. Reprogramming will be performed through the overexpression of eSOX17/KLF4/c-MYC in a chemically defined medium supporting pluripotent or neural stem cells, respectively. We found that both iNSCs and iPSCs are generated with high efficiency and cell lineage trajectories appear to split at an early time point. However, it remains unclear whether cells traverse through an intermediate pluripotent state before becoming iNSCs and rejuvenate akin to iPSCs. Our dense analysis by single-cell RNA sequencing will help to infer the cellular dynamics, identify regulatory bottlenecks, reveal hitherto unknown cell populations and identify genes that safeguard the transitions. The pharmacological and genetic manipulation of genes unique to the transition towards iNSC will help to bypass a pluripotent intermediate and might lead to iNSCs that avoid rejuvenation. Translating an efficient method to generate iNSCs without iPSC intermediate from human patients will lead to more authentic and safer cell models for neurodegenerative diseases. 目前，通過過表達特定的轉錄因子組合可以在實驗室中對細胞身份進行編程。體外細胞重編程技術可用於研究人類疾病和評估藥效。對於神經退行性疾病的研究可以受益於細胞重編程技術產生的三種細胞類型：(1) 誘導多能幹細胞(induced pluripotent stem cells, iPSC)；(2) 直接轉分化獲得的分裂期后誘導神經元(induced post-mitotic neurons, iN)；(3) 直接轉分化獲得的誘導神經幹細胞(induced neural stem cells, iNSC)。目前，iNSCs的廣泛應用受限於缺乏高效且可重複的誘導方法以及其誘導路徑的不確定性。近年來，本實驗室已開發出一項新技術，通過利用工程改造后的增強型SOX17因子(eSOX17)、KLF4和c-MYC能夠有效地將胚胎、成人和老年細胞重編程為iNSCs。從概念上來看，iNSCs在三個方面優於從iPSCs衍生的細胞。首先，iNSCs不具備和iPSCs相關的致癌特徵。其次，iNSCs加快了特定神經退行性疾病細胞模型的生成。再次，iNSCs可能會繞過伴隨iPSCs重編程的年輕化過程，該過程會使得iPSCs及其衍生細胞類似於新生兒細胞，從而不能表現出與衰老相關的表型。分裂期后的iNs可以解決其中一些問題。然而，iNs不能再分裂增殖，進而無法規模化生產，這極大地限制了其應用。在此，我們提出使用單細胞基因表達譜對從皮膚細胞到iNSCs的重編程路線進行密集分析。我們從攜帶螢光標記基因的轉基因小鼠製備體細胞，這些標記基因可用於同時檢測神經幹細胞和多能幹細胞。通過過表達eSOX17、KLF4和c-MYC，並在分別支持多能幹細胞或神經幹細胞的特定化學成分細胞培養基中進行細胞重編程，我們發現iNSCs和iPSCs都可被高效率誘導產生，並且在重編程早期就表現出不同的細胞譜系軌跡。然而，尚不清楚細胞在轉變為iNSCs之前是否會經歷多能中間態和類似於iPSCs的年輕化過程。因此，通過單細胞RNA測序進行的密集分析將有助於推斷細胞動力學、識別調控瓶頸、揭示迄今為止未知的細胞群，以及鑒定保障細胞命運轉換的基因。而且之後對可特異性介導iNSCs生成的基因進行的藥理和基因操控將有助於繞過多能中間態，並可能使iNSCs避免經歷年輕化。應用一種高效的不經過多能中間態的方法來產生人類患者的iNSCs，將有助於我們建立更真實可靠和更安全的神經退行性疾病細胞模型。

17106722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17106722.value: 了解人類骨髓如何產生中樞神經系統和周圍神經系統神經膠質細胞

17106722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17106722.value: Prof Chan, Ying Shing Prof Cheung, Martin Chi Hang

17106722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17106722.value: Human bone marrow is a rich reservoir from which stem cells may be harvested and harnessed for cell-based regenerative therapies. A subpopulation of human bone marrow stromal cells (hBMSCs) are proposed to arise from the neural crest, from which we were able to generate neurospheres and subsequently functional Schwann cells. Using these same neurospheres, we have recently been able to generate oligodendrocyte precursors. It remains unknown how both types of glia, with differing embryonic origins, could be brought about from a common progenitor source. Here, we propose to characterize human bone marrow-derived progenitors with single cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) to analyse both cellular identity as well as differentiation trajectories towards consolidating our hypothesis that in vitro culture conditions allow for a single neural crest-like progenitor source to give rise to both peripheral as well as central glia. Characterisation will be validated by qPCR and immunocytochemistry. Thereafter, we will demonstrate reprograming of bone marrow neural crest progenitors in culture via the provision of neural tube morphogens to generate ventralised neural progenitors followed by oligodendrocyte precursors. As a proof-of-principle, we will transplant ventralised cells into i) the dysmyelinated shiverer mouse and ii) thoracic cord contusion model to demonstrate engraftment and improved neurological recovery. The prerequisite for genetic manipulate to generate iPSCs as a progenitor source for cell therapy has hindered their translation to the bedside. A unique advantage of our approach is the potential to generate both CNS as well as PNS glia safely and efficiently by culture conditions alone. Derived glia may be transplanted autologously into patients suffering from traumatic and demyelinating diseases. 人骨髓含有可培養用於再生療法的干細胞。少數骨髓基質細胞被認為是從神經嵴產生的，並且能夠產生神經元和雪旺氏細胞。我們最近能夠使用人骨髓基質細胞來產生少突膠質細胞。目前尚不清楚這兩種具有不同胚胎起源的神經膠質細胞如何可以從單一的祖源中產生。 我們將使用單細胞核糖核酸測序表徵人類骨髓來源的神經膠質細胞，以了解細胞特性和起源。我們相信體外培養條件重編程神經嵴祖細胞轉化為中央神經膠質前體。我們將提供神經管形態發生素以加速神經嵴祖細胞的培養重編程對中樞神經系統祖。作為原理證明，我們將重編程的細胞移植到脫髓鞘的脊髓中。 來自 iPSC 的神經膠質細胞需要基因操作，這是臨床應用的障礙。我們的培養平台是安全的，因為避免了基因操作。通過這種方式，我們能夠產生用於臨床移植的自體人類神經膠質細胞。

17107322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17107322.value: 在心臟神經嵴細胞介導的瓣膜形成中的Vinculin-Yap1-TGFβ信號傳導

17107322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17107322.value: Prof Hui, Chi-Chung Dr Kim, Kyoung-Han

17107322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17107322.value: 先天性心臟瓣膜缺損常與神經嵴病相關，可能危及生命，但其潛在的病理機制仍不清楚。我們最近從三名患有腸神經系統 (ENS) 和心臟發育缺陷的患者身上發現了一種新的功能喪失突變 (M209L)，影響一種粘著斑 (FA) 銜接蛋白 Vinculin (VCL)。隨後使用患者特異性誘導多能幹細胞 (iPSC) 進行的功能分析，VCL 中的 M209L 取代會中斷 FA 組裝，導致 iPSC 衍生的神經嵴細胞 (NCC) 的遷移延遲和神經元/平滑肌譜系分化缺陷。 VCL 突變的校正挽救了 FA 表型並恢復了 NCC 功能。同樣地，NCC 特異性敲除小鼠突變體 (Vcl cKO) 表現出 ENS 和心臟缺陷，很好地概括了神經嵴病的複雜臨床狀況。在心臟中，NCC 中 Vcl 的缺失導緻小鼠心臟流出道分隔缺損和半月瓣增生。高分辨率轉錄組和免疫組織化學分析進一步表明，TGF-β 和 Yap1 信號通路不僅在心臟 NCC (CNCC) 中被破壞，而且在心內膜墊中的非 CNCC 衍生瓣膜間質細胞 (VIC) 中也被破壞，導致不能激活 VIC和隨後的心肌化中，並引致突變體中的半月瓣增生和瓣膜重塑缺陷。這些結果引伸出一個有趣的可能性，即 Vcl/Yap1/TGF-β 信號傳導是在瓣膜形成過程中介導瓣膜中兩個祖細胞群（CNCC 和內皮衍生的 VIC）之間的串擾的主要信號通路。因此，我們假設 CNCCs 中減弱的 Vcl/Yap1/TGF-β 信號傳導中斷了 CNCC 和內皮衍生的 VICs 之間的相互作用，導致瓣膜畸形。在這個項目中，我們將從三個方向檢驗這一假設：(1) 使用 Vcl cKO 小鼠模型描述TGF-β 信號的分泌是怎樣影響CNCC 及指導瓣膜發育； （2）破譯Vcl cKO突變引起的體粘著斑和粘附連接的解體是如何干擾瓣膜形成的分子機制； (3) 定義指導瓣膜重塑的關鍵調節機制和細胞外基質成分。總之，我們的研究將提供有關瓣膜發生和相關疾病的分子機制的重要見解，長期目標是確定新的治療靶點。

17107822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17107822.value: 磷酸化Sox9 調控糖酵解活性在神經痛中分子機製的研究

17107822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17107822.value: 神經性疼痛 (NP) 是由於神經系統的損傷或疾病而引發的疾病，導致全球約有7-10%的人患病。迄今為止，對於NP 的治療方法 不能阻止疼痛的復發，而且有不良的副作用，這就突出了對新的治療方法的需求。許多研究表明，一方面，細胞內的代謝重編程控製著星形膠質細胞的生物學活動和功能，有助於調控神經系統疾病的發病機製。目前基於藥物或能量的zhi治療方法可以靶向星形膠質細胞的異常代謝活動，這在很大程度上改善了對NP的治療。另一方面，在脊髓背角內，被重新激活的星形膠質細胞產生和積累大量有損傷性的代謝產物，這也是促進NP發生發展的關鍵機製之一。然而，據此而產生的靶向治療策略卻很少，因為對於NP發展基礎的代謝改變的特征和分子調控機製仍不清楚。因此，解決上述這些問題將有助於揭示 NP 的復雜病理生理學，並提供替代治療策略來改善當前的治療方法。 利用RNA測序技術和代謝組學，我們發現在星形膠質細胞中增強的糖酵解途徑與神經損傷 (SNI) 後被誘發的星形膠質細胞的反應性和疼痛反應有高度的相關性。而抑製糖酵解可以有效減弱機械性異常疼痛。在探索控製糖酵解代謝過程的上遊調節者時，我們發現Sox9是星形膠質細胞生成的關鍵轉錄因子，並在代謝重編程中起著關鍵作用。SNI可以促進Sox9蛋白的磷酸化，這與星形膠質細胞中糖酵解的強度和NP的發展呈正相關。並且功能喪失和獲得的研究表明，磷酸化的Sox9(p-Sox9)是糖酵解基因的上調和疼痛反應的增加所必需的。值得註意的是，在對p-Sox9 進行基因編輯後，兩個糖酵解基因 HK2 和 LDHA表現出最顯著的表達水平變化。最重要的是，我們預測了Sox9（和p-Sox9）蛋白在HK2 和 LDHA 基因啟動子區域可能與其結合的基序，並得到了驗證，這表明Sox9作為轉錄因子可以直接對HK2 和 LDHA基因進行轉錄調控。基於以上實驗結果，我們假設 p-Sox9 促進糖酵解基因 HK2 或/和 LDHA 的轉錄激活，從而提高星形膠質細胞內的糖酵解強度，而細胞內異常改變的代謝狀態促進有害的反應性星形膠質細胞增生。這可能也與其他神經膠質/神經元疼痛信號的激活有關，有助於 NP 的病理性發展。在這個研究項目中，我們有以下幾個目標：1.探索增強的糖酵解在NP 中發揮的病理作用；2.確定p-Sox9在 NP 發病機製中的作用；3.研究p-Sox9 介導的糖酵解活性在疼痛發病機製中的分子機製。因此，我們提出的研究將揭示轉錄因子的翻譯後修飾如何促進疼痛發病機製中的代謝轉變的新機製，為開發基於能量/代謝的疼痛治療方法奠定理論基礎。

17108122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17108122.value: CREB-H, a crucial transcription factor highly expressed in liver and small intestine, is critically involved in transactivation of lipid metabolism genes. CREB-H is induced transcriptionally by fasting and has been implicated in triglyceride clearance. Hypertriglyceridemia observed in patients carrying CREB-H mutations and in CREB-H-KO mice indicates the importance of CREB-H in lipid homeostasis. CGREF1 is a secretory protein with unclear function. Studies have suggested CGREF1 as a growth suppressor and AP-1 inhibitor. However, CGREF1 has not been implicated in lipid metabolism and metabolic disorders. Particularly, it is not known to be a target of CREB-H in the regulation of lipid homeostasis. Our preliminary work identified CGREF1 as a novel CREB-H target by global gene expression profiling of mouse liver as well as RT-qPCR and Western blot analysis of cultured cells. Endogenous CGREF1 expression in mice was highly induced by fasting in which CREB-H is crucially required. Furthermore, being a secretory protein, CGREF1 levels in both mouse liver and serum were strongly induced by high-fat diet; while liver, small intestine and adipose tissue were found to be the major target of circulatory CGREF1. More noticeably, CGREF1-KO mice exhibited reduced body weight and fat mass as well as resistance to diet-induced obesity and hepatic steatosis. These findings are suggestive of the hormonal function of CGREF1 that impacts lipid metabolism. Altogether, our pilot study shows that CGREF1 is a novel CREB-H-induced hepatokine implicated in lipid homeostasis. In this proposal, we will fully characterize CGREF1 functions and shed light on its biological significance in lipid homeostasis. First, we will document CGREF1 expression specificity and dynamics under different nutritional conditions. We will perform extensive metabolic phenotype characterization of CGREF1-KO and CGREF1-overexpressing animals. Essential metabolic parameters including body weight, body composition, energy consumption, serum lipid profile and tissue histology will be examined in detail. Second, functional and mechanistic analysis of CGREF1-mediated lipid homeostasis will be performed. Cellular receptor or functional partners for CGREF1 will be identified by proximity-dependent labelling approach. Impact of CGREF1 on both hepatic and extrahepatic (particularly small intestine and adipose tissues) lipid metabolic functions will be explored. Finally, the therapeutic potential of anti-CGREF1 neutralizing antibody for hepatic steatosis will be tested. This proposal will shed light on the biological significance of a novel hepatokine CGREF1 in lipid homeostasis. The new knowledge gained will instruct future development of therapeutics for various metabolic diseases such as non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and dyslipidemias. CREB-H是在肝臟和小腸中高度表達的關鍵轉錄因子，與脂質代謝基因的反式激活密切相關。 CREB-H轉錄可被禁食誘導，它亦被認為在甘油三酯清除功能上起關鍵作用。在攜帶CREB-H突變基因的患者和CREB-H基因剔除小鼠中觀察到的高甘油三酯血症表明CREB-H在脂質穩態中的重要性。 CGREF1是功能不明確的分泌蛋白。過往研究曾提出CGREF1為生長抑製劑和AP-1抑製劑。然而，CGREF1在脂質代謝和代謝紊亂中的作用則未見報道。CGREF1作為CREB-H在調節脂質穩態中的靶基因的發現尤其新穎。 我們初步通過小鼠肝臟的全基因组表達譜以及培養細胞的RT-qPCR和蛋白質印跡分析等確定CGREF1為新的CREB-H靶基因。禁食高度誘導了小鼠中的內源性CGREF1表達，其中CREB-H是至關重要的。此外，作為一種分泌蛋白，高脂飲食強烈誘導小鼠肝臟和血清中的CGREF1水平。而肝臟、小腸和脂肪組織被發現是循環CGREF1的主要靶點。更值得注意的是，CGREF1基因剔除小鼠表現出體重和脂肪量減少以及對飲食誘導的肥胖和肝脂肪變性的抵抗力。這些發現暗示了CGREF1在影響脂質代謝中的激素功能。總而言之，我們的初步研究表明，CGREF1是新的CREB-H誘導的肝臟因子，與脂質穩態有關。在本研究中，我們將全面描述CGREF1的功能，並闡明其在脂質穩態中的生物學意義。 首先，我們將記錄不同營養條件下的CGREF1表達特異性和動態。我們將對CGREF1基因剔除和CGREF1過表達動物進行廣泛的代謝表型表徵。基本代謝參數，包括體重、身體成分、能量消耗、血清脂質譜和組織學等，將作詳細檢查分析。其次，我們將進行CGREF1介導的脂質穩態的功能和機制分析。CGREF1的細胞受體或功能夥伴將通過鄰近依賴性標記方法進行識別。我們亦將探討CGREF1對肝臟和肝外（特別是小腸和脂肪組織）脂質代謝功能的影響。最後，我們將測試CGREF1中和抗體對肝脂肪變性的治療潛力。 本研究將闡明新型肝臟因子CGREF1在脂質穩態中的生物學意義。獲得的新知識將指導各種代謝疾病（如非酒精性脂肪肝和血脂異常）的治療方法的未來發展。

17108222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17108222.value: C5aR 介導的自噬和線粒體自噬在糖尿病腎病中的作用及機制研究

17108222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17108222.value: 糖尿病腎病（DKD）是糖尿病的嚴重並發症，也是導致慢性腎病的重要原因之一。目前常用的治療方法是對血糖和血壓進行控制，以及對RAS系統和SGLT2進行適度抑制。但是效果往往不理想，僅能適度的減少蛋白尿水平，並不能排除向終末期腎髒病進展的風險。線粒體功能障礙與DKD的發病機制密切相關。線粒體穩態受損會導致ATP生成減少和細胞功能的改變，從而導致腎臟細胞凋亡，纖維化，並最終進展為終末期腎髒病。由於腎臟是一個高能需高代謝器官，其中近端腎小管細胞是體內線粒體密度最高的細胞之一，並且嚴重依賴脂肪的代謝作為其能量來源，因此線粒體穩態對於維持其正常的生理功能至關重要。 補體系統是人體對抗病原體和其他內源性危險信號的先天免疫的一個組成部分。補體C5a是通過與補體C5aR結合發揮作用。我們課題組最近發現了在DKD期間補體C5a對調節細胞代謝途徑的新作用。我們觀察到C5a減少了近端腎小管細胞線粒體ATP的合成和DNA的拷貝數，並進而降低了糖化蛋白誘導的線粒體活性氧（ROS）產生。此外，對C5a進行抑制可以減少糖尿病小鼠的腎臟纖維化情況，同時可以調節糖尿病小鼠腎臟的脂質代謝，這充分錶明了C5aR介導的線粒體功能障礙的關鍵作用。 由於線粒體是脂肪代謝的主要部位。對此，我們假設C5a/C5aR激活可能會誘導線粒體損傷，因此會損害脂肪酸氧化並導致DKD。我們將1）在2個動物模型中研究C5a/C5aR 在線粒體功能障礙中的作用，即（i）db/db 小鼠和（ii）全身 C5aR 敲除的高脂飲食/鏈脲佐菌素（STZ）誘導的DKD小鼠，2）並進而通過在高糖環境下使用培養的腎小管上皮細胞闡明C5aR介導的Akt/mTOR/自噬的重要機制，研究C5a/C5aR信號介導線粒體功能障礙的機制，以及3）在1種新型的小管特異性C5aR敲除小鼠中證明腎小管C5aR激活對DKD造成的腎小管線粒體功能障礙的重要作用。鑑於DKD期間C5aR 激活和線粒體功能障礙發生在腎臟損傷早期，並遠遠先於腎功能的喪失，保持線粒體穩態可能是預防DKD進展的潛在治療靶點。因此，我們的研究結果將揭示補體介導的腎小管代謝調節的新機制，並為追求阻斷腎小管C5a/Ca5R軸，改善DKD進展提供堅實而確切的科學依據。

17108322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17108322.value: 在香港特別行政區通過自然擴散和人為引入的入侵鳥類的遺傳結果

17108322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17108322.value: Biological invasions, defined as human-mediated introductions (HMIs) or natural range-expanding colonisations (RECs), are common. The former constitutes a major threat to biodiversity, ecosystem integrity, agriculture, fisheries and public health. Therefore, understanding what organismal features allow invasive species to become established in new ranges is of interest for applied biology, but also provide important insights into our understanding of how species adapt and thrive in novel environments. The fact that HMIs are typically characterized by severe population size bottlenecks expected to cause loss of genetic diversity and thereby also reduced adaptability and population viability comes across as a paradox given the frequent success and ubiquity of HMIs. While there are examples of invasions where the loss of genetic diversity actually benefitted the invasions, there are also many examples where invasive populations have not experienced a marked loss of genetic diversity. One possible explanation for this is that multiple divergent source populations, and therefore genetic admixture, underline many successful introductions. However, most genetic studies of introduced populations are single species case-studies making generalisations on the genetic underpinnings of successful invasions difficult. Here, the aim is to tap into a rather unique set of “natural experiments” provided by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR), namely to study the genetic underpinnings of several successful HMIs and RECs by forest-dwelling passerine birds between 1936 and 2001. The aims are to establish: (1) whether HMIs are more often characterised by increased genetic diversity (due to admixture between multiple introductory sources) than by loss of genetic diversity (due to population size bottlenecks and inbreeding), (2) whether the demographic and genetic footprints of HMIs and RECs are similar or distinct, (3) whether the load of deleterious mutations in species originating from HMIs is lower than those originating from RECs and (4) whether species life history traits are important determinants of genetic diversity in either or both types of invasions. Furthermore, given that first sightings and timings of population expansions for the study species in HKSAR are known, the project can “ground truth” the historical dynamics of invasions as reflected in the dynamics of effective population size estimates over time as gleaned from genomic data. The results of this comparative genomic study of HMIs and RECs should be of general interest from both fundamental and applied scientific points of view, carrying the potential to also raise public awareness about invasive alien species and how they can become established. 常見的生物入侵有兩種途徑：人為引入 (縮寫為HMIs)和自然擴散 (縮寫為RECs)。生物入侵對生物多樣性、生態系統的完整性、農業、漁業和公共衛生可能構成重大威脅。因此，瞭解入侵物種如何在新的地域建立繁殖種群的機理一直以來都是應用生物學感興趣的研究課題，這也為我們認知物種如何適應新的環境並成功繁衍提供重要見解。實際上，人為引入外來物種常被誤認為會帶來嚴重的種群規模瓶頸，導致遺傳多樣性喪失，從而降低物種的適應力和種群生存力，但這與人為引入外來物種的成功性和普遍性的事實相悖。雖然有一些入侵的案例顯示遺傳多樣性的喪失實際上使入侵物種受益，但也有許多案例顯示入侵物種沒有經歷遺傳多樣性的顯著喪失。對此，一種可能解釋是，入侵種群由多個不同的源種群組成，遺傳混合反而增加了物種入侵成功的概率。然而，大部分入侵物種的遺傳學研究僅限於單個物種的案例研究，難以概括成功入侵的遺傳學基礎。本研究將以香港特別行政區提供的一組從1936年至2001年具有連續跟蹤記錄數據的多個森林雀形目鳥類物種為天然實驗對象，深入探索包括人為引入和自然擴散這兩種途徑成功入侵的物種的遺傳學基礎。具體而言，本研究的目的是明確：(1)人為引入的入侵物種是否常以遺傳多樣性的增加（源於多個源種群的混合）而不是喪失（遭遇種群瓶頸和近親繁殖）為主要特徵; (2)人為引入和自然擴散這兩種途徑的入侵物種的種群動態和遺傳學特徵是相似還是不同; (3) 人為引入的入侵物種中有害突變的遺傳負荷是否低於自然擴散的入侵物種; (4) 無論是人為引入還是自然擴散，物種生活史特徵是否是遺傳多樣性水平的重要決定因素。此外，基於研究對象在香港特別行政區的首次目擊時間和種群擴張時間是已知的，該項目還可以驗證入侵事件的歷史動態，如從基因組數據中估算有效種群數量隨時間推移的動態變化。無論是從基礎科學還是應用科學的角度來看，這項基於人為引入和自然擴散兩種途徑的入侵物種種群基因組比較研究都有其存在的意義，可以引起廣泛的興趣和提高公眾對外來入侵物種如何建立本地種群的認知。

17109022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17109022.value: 腫瘤相關巨噬細胞的單細胞分子圖譜研究

17109022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17109022.value: Prof Huang, Yuanhua Prof Liu, Pengtao Dr Ma, Stephanie Kwai Yee Prof Wong, Carmen Chak Lui

17109022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17109022.value: 免疫抑製性腫瘤微環境一直是癌癥免疫治療的一大的障礙 。其中腫瘤相關巨噬細胞（TAM）是免疫抑製的主要原因。 我們建立了一個強大的幹細胞培養系統以探索巨噬細胞的發育、發展以及腫瘤相關巨噬細胞為何形成免疫抑製。探索在腫瘤微環境中的腫瘤相關巨噬細胞單分子細胞圖譜變化將有利於回答這個問題。 我們建立了一個高度協作的研究團隊，該項目成員將專註於研究腫瘤相關巨噬細胞的分子圖譜。我們將使用新的分子條形碼追蹤技術用於跟蹤腫瘤相關巨噬細胞在腫瘤微環境的單細胞水平圖譜變化。我們將采用腫瘤相關巨噬細胞的受體-配體圖譜和轉錄組相關因子分析作為有效的技術手段，並將研究成果作為腫瘤相關巨噬細胞對腫瘤細胞殺傷力下降的有效治療靶標。我們期望隨著這個3年期限項目的進行將會對靶向於腫瘤相關巨噬細胞的受體-配體和轉錄組相關因子治療靶標的開發，腫瘤疫苗的開發（包括mRNA疫苗-對腫瘤免疫治療有積極作用的新型技術）都有著極其積極的作用。

17109422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17109422.value: FADS1介導的脂質代謝重編程在肝移植後脂肪肝移植物損傷和肝癌復發中的作用

17109422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17109422.value: 肝移植（LT）是肝細胞癌（HCC）患者最有效的治療方法之一。然而，供肝供體短缺和肝移植後 HCC 復發是對肝癌肝移植患者生存的巨大挑戰。為解決移植物短缺問題，利用脂肪肝移植物可有效擴大供體庫。然而，脂肪肝移植物更容易發生肝缺血再灌注損傷，這個過程在肝移植過程中是不可避免的。急性期脂肪肝移植物損傷可能會增加腫瘤復發的風險。因此，全面了解移植後脂肪肝移植物損傷和HCC復發的潛在機制可以最大限度地提高擴大供體庫的臨床應用的有益效果。 20多年來，我們一直致力於研究肝移植損傷和肝移植後HCC復發的機制。我們首先報導了移植物損傷誘導炎症級聯反應，在動物模型中促進腫瘤轉移和侵襲。最近，我們報導脂肪肝移植物損傷是臨床隊列中移植物長期存活的獨立危險因素。此外，我們還報導了 5'-AMP 活化蛋白激酶 (AMPK)-PGC1-α 軸通過調節線粒體穩態在脂肪肝移植物損傷中起關鍵作用，並伴隨著包括脂肪酸氧化 (FAO) 、脂質從頭合成和亞油酸（LA）代謝等的脂質代謝途徑的改變，表明脂質代謝重編程與脂肪性移植損傷有關。重要的是，我們的預實驗結果初步表明，脂肪酸去飽和酶 1 (FADS1) 是一種參與 LA 代謝的必需限速酶，在脂肪肝移植物和 HCC 腫瘤組織中顯著上調。肝腫瘤中 FADS1 過表達與 CD8+ T 細胞浸潤呈負相關，並且是HCC 患者的不良總生存期和疾病特異性生存的獨立預測因子。 基於這些發現，我們假設參與脂質代謝重編程的 FADS1 過表達可能會加速脂肪肝移植物的炎症，進而重塑肝臟免疫微環境，誘導 CD8+ T 細胞功能障礙，最終促進肝移植後 HCC 的複發。在目前的提議中，我們的目標是（1）研究 FADS1 表達在脂肪移植損傷和肝移植 後 HCC 復發中的臨床相關性； (2) 利用體內外模型研究FADS1在在脂肪變進展和HCC復發中的生物學和代謝功能，並探討局部免疫微環境改變的機制； (3) 在我們的臨床前模型中評估下調 FADS1 在脂肪移植損傷、HCC 進展和復發中的治療潛力。我們對 FADS1 在脂肪肝移植物損傷和 HCC 復發中的研究可能為將來供體庫擴展以及脂肪肝移植損傷的預防和 HCC 復發的治療奠定臨床轉化的基礎。

17110122.value: 用鈉-葡萄糖協同轉運蛋白 2 抑製劑治療代謝綜合症：一項隨機對照試驗

17110122.label: Project Objectives
17110122.value: To investigate the effect of a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor in people with the metabolic syndrome in a placebo-controlled randomised controlled trial. To prove the hypothesis that the sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor will improve the metabolic syndrome, in terms of reduction in abdominal obesity, blood pressure, blood glucose, blood triglyceride and increase in HDL. To measure four adipokines, namely, adiponectin, fibroblast growth factor 21, adipocyte fatty acid-binding protein, and lipocalin-2 as biochemical evidence of an improvement in the metabolic milieu. To report the results of this randomised controlled trial in publications and in scientific meetings. This evidence can provide the rationale for a pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial to allow the regulatory approval of this new indication.

17110122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17110122.value: The metabolic syndrome occurs in overweight or obese people who also have abnormal lipids, blood pressure and blood glucose. It precedes the development of diabetes and cardiovascular complications. Currently, there are no drugs licensed for the treatment of the metabolic syndrome. Empagliflozin is a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2) inhibitor, originally developed for diabetes but has since been proven to be beneficial in patients with heart and kidney failure. By increasing glucose excretion in the urine, it reduces body weight, body fat and blood pressure. We therefore hypothesise that it may be the ideal drug to reverse the metabolic syndrome. Search of clinical trials registries shows that there are no industry-sponsored trials targeting patients with the metabolic syndrome. We propose to conduct a randomised controlled trial to study the effects of empagliflozin on 160 people with the metabolic syndrome, who will be randomised to receive either empagliflozin or placebo. The primary hypothesis is that empagliflozin will reduce the metabolic syndrome risk score, while secondary outcome measures include circulating levels of adipokines (adiponectin, fibroblast growth factor 21, adipocyte fatty acid-binding protein and lipocalin-2), body weight, waist circumference, blood pressure, glucose and lipids. This drug has already been approved for use in diabetes and cardiovascular risk prevention. Our study, if positive, would provide evidence for its use in the metabolic syndrome and the treatment for this syndrome for the first time. 代謝綜合症發生在超重或肥胖的人身上，他們也有異常血脂，血壓和血糖。它早於糖尿病和心血管併發症的發展。目前，沒有藥物被許可用於治療代謝綜合征。恩格列凈是一種鈉葡萄糖協同轉運蛋白-2抑製劑（SGLT2）抑製劑，最初是為糖尿病開發的，但後來被證明是對心臟和腎衰竭患者有益。通過增加葡萄糖排泄尿液，它減低了體重，身體脂肪和血壓。因此，我們假設它可能是逆轉代謝綜合症的理想藥物。臨床試驗搜索登記處顯示，沒有行業贊助的試驗針對代謝綜合症患者。我們建議進行一項隨機對照試驗，以研究恩格列凈對160名代謝綜合症患者的影響，這些人將隨機接受恩格列凈或安慰劑治療。主要假設是恩格列凈將降低代謝綜合症風險評分，而次要結局措施包括脂因數（脂聯素，成纖維細胞生長因數21、脂肪細胞脂肪酸結合蛋白與脂質紅素-2）的循環水平、體重、腰圍周長，血壓，葡萄糖和脂質。該藥物已被批准用於糖尿病和心血管風險預防。我們的研究，如果是肯定的，將首次為它在代謝綜合症中的應用和治療提供證據。

17110422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17110422.value: 新型鈣鍶矽酸鹽水泥用於牙本質-牙髓複合物再生

17110422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17110422.value: Dr Abdalla, Mohamed Dr Neelakantan, Prasanna

17110422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17110422.value: 新型鈣鍶矽酸鹽水泥用於牙本質-牙髓複合物再生 當牙髓在外傷後受到感染或發炎時，就會發生牙髓病。根管治療是牙髓病的首選治療方法。然而根管治療技術要求高，價格昂貴，給患者帶來不適和負擔。最近牙髓治療，已從傳統的根管治療轉至微創活髓治療，保留牙髓活力和再生健康。 三氧化二礦物聚集體，已廣泛應用於微創活髓治療。但長凝固時間，較差的處理特性和高成本，限制了其臨床應用。鍶天然存於骨骼和牙齒中。由於電荷和離子半徑和鈣相似，已被加入生物材料以增強骨骼。鍶通過激活成骨細胞和減少破骨細胞吸收，促進骨形成，減少骨折。鍶和矽擁有對骨組織重塑的協同作用。因此矽酸鈣骨水泥加入鍶，能刺激人類間充質幹細胞的成骨分化。 我們最近開發了一種新型鈣鍶矽酸鹽水泥，使用鍶和矽酸鈣的協同效益，增強磷灰石形成，縮短凝固時間，希望能替代三氧化二礦物聚集體。應用微創活髓治療，促進牙髓幹細胞牙源性分化，令牙本質-牙髓再生。這為期 24 個月研究目的是通過一系列體外研究，檢查和比較鈣鍶矽酸鹽水泥和三氧化二礦物聚集體牙源性和免疫調節的潛力評估。 然後進行動物體內研究檢查鈣鍶矽酸鹽的組織炎症反應和牙髓-牙本質鈣化程度。這項研究主要結果，將提供鈣鍶矽酸鹽水泥的牙源性和免疫調節作用的新見解。成功的牙本質-牙髓再生，將徹底改變根管治療 。患病牙齒能恢復健康狀態，為牙髓治療提供了新的解決疾病方案。

17110722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17110722.value: 驗證改善患有非酒精性脂肪肝病成年人士肝臟脂肪之最佳運動頻率: 一項比較性隨機對照試驗

17110722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17110722.value: Dr Chan, Derwin King-Chung Dr Fong, Daniel Yee-Tak Dr Keating, Shelley Dr Lee, Chi Ho Paul Prof Seto, Wai Kay Walter Prof Wong, Stephen Heung-sang

17110722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17110722.value: 肥胖和非酒精性脂肪肝病患病率日益上升，已經構成一項公共衛生危機。非酒精性脂肪肝病確實已成為最常見的慢性肝病。儘管體育鍛煉在非酒精性脂肪肝病的管理中至關重要，但目前尚無詳細的運動處方指南。世界衛生組織建議每週進行 至少150 分鐘的中等強度身體活動或 75 分鐘的劇烈強度身體活動或兩者的等效組合，以保持健康，但對累積推薦量的運動頻率沒有限制。雖然我們的初步數據表明，低頻率運動（例如每週一次）可以有效減少肥胖成人的身體和肝臟脂肪，但治療非酒精性脂肪肝病的最佳運動頻率仍不清楚。探究該頻率具有實際意義，因為非酒精性脂肪肝病患者可以選擇更長的鍛煉時間，同時每週減少鍛鍊天數以達到類似的治療效果，從而為他們提供將鍛鍊計劃適應忙碌的現代生活方式的靈活性。本研究旨在比較不同運動頻率（每週一次與每週三次）在減少肥胖非酒精性脂肪肝病成人肝臟脂肪方面的效果。我們將採用前測後測設計的三臂隨機對照試驗。患有非酒精性脂肪肝病的肥胖成年人將被隨機分配到每週一次或每週三次的運動組或常規護理對照組。每個運動組將接受為期4個月的每週一次或每週三次的快走運動干預，而常規護理組將接受一般健康教育作為註意力控制。根據世界衛生組織的體育活動建議，每週一次組的每節步行時間為 75 分鐘，每週三次組為 25 分鐘。兩組每週的運動量及卡路里消耗一致。各項指標測量，包括肝臟脂肪、內臟和身體脂肪、人體測量、干預依從性、心理測量、健康相關的生活質量、藥物使用、不良事件、習慣性身體活動和飲食，將由不知道組別分配的評估員檢查在基線、4 個月（干預後）和 10 個月（6 個月隨訪）時進行。數據將通過廣義估計方程和線性對比進行分析。此擬議的研究將提供不同運動頻率的比較益處的證據，並在隨訪期內評估每種運動頻率的有效性、安全性、依從性和可持續性。研究結果將告知醫護人員減少肝臟脂肪的最佳運動頻率，並完善非酒精性脂肪肝病患者的運動指南。

17110922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17110922.value: Small-molecule methyltransferase (MT) enzymes utilize S-adenosyl methionine (SAM) as cofactor to methylate small-molecule substrate. With the advance of protein design and engineering, MT promises as a routine green biocatalyst for applications from late-stage functionalization of bioactive molecules to complex chemical synthesis by design at practical cost. While the prevailing research theme around the diversification of MT cofactor and substrate, we aim ahead to study the SAM-mediated positive cooperativity of MT, a phenomenon describing SAM binding enhances MT affinity towards substrate. Briefly, our preliminary studies have utilized a comparative model to investigate the positive cooperativity from biochemical, bioinformatic and biophysical perspectives. The strategic comparative model consists of phylogenetically related SOMT2, COMT, and SOMT1. Through biochemical characterization, we have observed positive cooperativity and cooperativity switch in SOMT2, in contrast to COMT and SOMT1. Multiple sequence alignment of the three OMTs further deduce mutations that are possibly associated with positive cooperativity. Lastly, structural insight of SOMT2 complex at atomic resolution (1.7 Å) hints a novel SAM binding conformation that can exert positive cooperativity and deduces SAM-interacting residues. Collectively, the results grant a holistic foundation to devise an efficient and in-depth study of SAM-mediated positive cooperativity. In this proposed study, we aim to (i) decipher the fundamental basis of SAM-mediated positive cooperativity; (ii) provide a structural basis of SAM-mediated positive cooperativity and cooperativity switch; and (iii) implicate our findings by generating a layout for implementation in the protein design and engineering of MT. Our study outcome will timely synergize with current efforts on MT to create competent MT biocatalysts with freedom to create complex chemicals by design. It will feed into the demand of drug design and chemical biology industries and thrive along the rapid expansion of click chemistry, bioorthogonal chemistry and PROTAC technology. N/A

17111222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17111222.value: γδT細胞在乾燥綜合徵發病中的作用：功能特徵和治療意義

17111222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17111222.value: 作為常見的自身免疫病之一，原發性乾燥綜合徵 (SS) 的主要特徵是唾液腺和淚腺組織浸潤而導致的口乾和眼乾。很多SS 病人表現出系統性器官損傷和較高的惡性病變風險，生活品質嚴重下降。由於對 SS 發病機制的瞭解有限，SS 患者缺乏有效的治療方法，臨床診斷平均延遲 4 年。因此，迫切需要對SS患者的早期診斷和治療進行進一步的研究。本研究旨在探討 SS 發病機制中的免疫失調，並探索治療 SS 的新策略。 γδT細胞是表達γδTCR但不表達傳統αβTCR的T細胞亞群，是在粘膜免疫中發揮先天免疫功能的重要參與者。最近的研究表明，γδT 細胞參與了自身免疫性疾病的發展。儘管包括 CD4 和 CD8 T 細胞在內的適應性 T 細胞亞群在 SS 發病中發揮重要作用，但在很大程度上仍不清楚 γδT 細胞如何參與 SS 的發展。在我們的初步研究中，我們觀察到 γδT17 細胞在SS病人中顯著增加，且與疾病嚴重程度呈正相關。此外，我們在 SS 患者和實驗性 SS (ESS) 小鼠的外周血和唾液腺中檢測到細胞毒性 γδT 細胞。在 ESS 小鼠中，通過逆唾液插管注射清除唾液腺中 γδT 細胞可顯著改善疾病進展，而過繼轉移活化的 γδT 細胞會加重唾液腺病理損傷。在體外培養實驗中，我們發現 IL-15 和 IL-18 都促進了 γδT 細胞的活化和增殖。這些發現為我們研究 γδT 細胞在 SS 發病中的作用提供了重要的依據和基礎。 在本課題中，我們將研究 ESS 小鼠和 SS 患者中各種 γδT 細胞亞群的功能特徵。此外，我們將研究 γδT 細胞功能調控的細胞和分子機制，並進一步研究靶向 γδT 細胞在 ESS 和人源化 SS 小鼠中的治療效果。預期的研究結果將確定 γδT 細胞在 SS 發病機制中的新作用，有助於開發治療 SS這一具有高度社會相關性的慢性自身免疫性疾病的新策略。

17111322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17111322.value: 近紅外光響應型氫化二氧化鈦納米結構塗層實現快速細菌感染治療及通過免疫調控促進植入體表面與骨融合

17111322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17111322.value: Prof Liu, Xuanyong Dr Qiu, Jiajun Dr Zhu, Yizhou

17111322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17111322.value: 鈦（Titanium, Ti）及其合金是目前應用最廣泛的骨科植入材料，常被用於骨折的手術治療。然而，因植入體引起的細菌感染及植入體-骨介面融合不理想等術後併發症也會發生，最終導致手術失敗。到目前為止，研究人員開發了多種具有抗菌功能的植入體表面塗層來處理細菌感染問題，如抗生素塗層、抗菌劑（例如銀離子，銅離子等）塗層等。可惜這些物質在降解時候，因生物相容性緣故，會直接影響手術治療效果。此外，同時能夠滿足抗菌和促進骨整合能力的塗層絕無僅有。因此，本研究團隊提出開發一種安全且能同時消滅細菌感染和促進植入體-骨整合的多功能表面塗層。我們在前期工作中發現，特別設計的蜂窩狀二氧化鈦（TiO2）納米結構可以通過調控巨噬細胞極化來促進成骨細胞的分化。潛在機制在於TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構，能有效激活RhoA-ROCK信號通路，並參與調控巨噬細胞以及間充質幹細胞的轉化行為。在本研究中，我們將進一步改性TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構，使其同時具有顯著的抗菌能力。 活性氧物質（Reactive oxygen species, ROS）能有效氧化細菌內部的大分子，從而引起細菌凋亡，被認為是最有效的抗菌劑之一。事實上，TiO2在紫外光照射下可以產生ROS。然而，紫外線在人體組織中的穿透能力較低，限制了其在骨科植入體中的應用。近期的研究表明，氫化處理可以將TiO2的吸收波長由紫外波段擴展至近紅外光波段（波長λ = 700 nm - 1100 nm）。因此，在本研究中，我們擬對TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構進行氫等離子處理（處理後的TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構被命名為H-TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構），從而使H-TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構在近紅外光刺激下能產生大量ROS並產生溫和的低溫環境。基於這些原理，使蜂窩狀TiO2納米結構能提高植入體-骨融合能力，同時具有原位殺菌的效能。在前期研究中，與未經過氫等離子處理的TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構相比，H-TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構產生的ROS量是前者的30倍。因此本項目定下以下的研究目標：（1）在鈦表面構建H-TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構，並對其理化性質進行系統性表徵及研究，包括表面形貌、化學成分、光催化性能以及光熱性能；（2）通過體外實驗系統性評估H-TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構的抗菌性能、細胞毒性以及其骨免疫調控作用；（3）研究H-TiO2蜂窩狀納米結構在動物體內模型中抗菌性能，如消除植入物表面的生物膜的能力，相關炎症反應，以及對植入體-骨整合的促進作用等。在項目完成後，這種先進的多功能植入體表面塗層可以有效對抗細菌感染並刺激植入物周邊的骨再生，從而為病人提高手術治療效果。

17111922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17111922.value: About 15-30% of patients with schizophrenia do not respond to standard antipsychotic treatment and are considered as treatment resistant schizophrenia (TRS). Clozapine is the only antipsychotic medication that has shown to be effective in TRS patients, significantly superior to the other antipsychotic medications. Clozapine has also been shown to be effective in reducing suicidality in patients with schizophrenia. On the other hand, patients with schizophrenia have an average life expectancy 20 years shorter than the general population and one of the key attributing factors is elevated rates of chronic physical conditions such as cardiometabolic disease. Among all the atypical antipsychotics, clozapine has been associated with the highest risk for developing metabolic complications. Therefore, it is crucial to have a comprehensive understanding of the long-term impact of clozapine use on mortality, comorbidity and hospitalization to better inform the benefit-risk of clozapine use. With the comprehensive clinical information recorded by the Clinical Data Analysis and Reporting System (CDARS) maintained by the Hospital Authority of Hong Kong, which is responsible for over 80% of psychiatric in Hong Kong, we propose to explore the long-term impact of clozapine use on mortality, hospitalization and comorbidity in patients with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders. Patients who first initiation of clozapine with the diagnosis of schizophrenia-spectrum disorders between year 2003 to 2012 will be identified as the clozapine group (ClozG). Patients with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders who were dispensed with any antipsychotic medications other than clozapine during year 2003 to 2012 and has never been exposed to clozapine before 2012 are considered as the non-clozapine group (nClozG). Base on the pilot study, the estimated number of ClozG patients is 2700 and that of the nClozG patients is 41276. The mortality information between year 2003 till 2022, information of hospitalization and comorbidities during the whole treatment period of ClozG and nClozG will be obtained from the CDARS. Age, gender, age of first diagnosis of schizophrenia-spectrum disorders and duration of illness will be used as covariates in all statistical analysis. Multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression analysis with propensity score weighing will be employed to compare mortality between ClozG and nClozG. Regression analysis will be used for exploring the hospitalization and comorbidities. Adapted Charlson comorbidity index will be used to explore the effect of prior comorbidity on the outcomes of clozapine use. 17112422.label: Project Objectives
17112422.value: Brief Introduction: m6A has essential functions in mouse embryo development and in ESC identity maintenance and differentiation. We have established EPSCs of multiple mammalian species (mouse, human, pig, bovine and unpublished species). EPSCs of all the species share similar molecular features and have developmental potential to all embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages. Our preliminary results studying human EPSCs (hEPSCs) demonstrate that depletion of m6A RNA methylation by knocking out the writer gene METTL3 promotes trophoblast lineage but blocks embryonic cell lineage development. We propose to use hEPSCs as an in vitro system to dissect m6A in cell fate determination and cell lineage segregation in human cell lineage development, and to explore the cellular and molecular mechanisms with the following Objectives: Objective 1. Genetic and functional study of m6A RNA methylation using EPSCs as a cellular model Besides METTL3, we will genetically manipulate genes in the m6A RNA methylation pathway. Specifically, we will use inducible knockout and overexpression to mutate another writer complex component METTL14 and reader YTHDC1 as well as erasers FTO and ALKBH5 in hEPSCs. The inducible system is helpful as some mutations such as YTHDC1 KO likely causes cell lethality in hEPSCs. The mutant EPSCs (single and double knockout etc.) will be functionally interrogated in in vitro differentiation assays such as trophoblast stem cell (TSC) development, embryoid body (EB) formation and specific cell lineage development of the three somatic germ layers. We will also examine the mutant cells in teratoma formation assay and in blastoid generation. The normal and mutant hEPSCs and their differentiated cells will be subjected to single cell genomics study as in Objective 2. Objective 2. Using single-cell genomics to study the m6A RNA modification in cell fate determination in human EPSCs differentiation We will use scRNAseq and scATACseq to delineate the cell fate determination and cell lineage segregation of embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages from the normal and mutant hEPSCs, and to identify molecular determinants of cell fate determination. Our scRNAseq dissection of normal hEPSCs’ differentiation towards trophoblast lineages under TSC medium has delineated two development trajectories from hEPSCs: TSCs and amniotic epithelial (AME). AME cells develop from the human epiblast of day 9 days embryo. AME cells are important in early development as they are required for mesoderm development. The efficient generation of AME cells together with TSCs under TSC induction condition provide a unique opportunity to investigate cell lineage segregation from hEPSCs and the role of m6A RNA modification. Specifically, we will collect cells at several time points in hEPSC differentiation, and elucidate at what time point and with what molecular events that TSCs and AME are specified and generated. scATACseq may enable detection of chromatin changes relevant to cell fate determination even before transcription. Besides genetic approaches to perturb m6A, we will use the recently published METTL3 specific inhibitor to treat hEPSCs and interrogate their differentiation. We will aim to discover how m6A alteration affects the cell types and molecular events in hEPSC differentiation. Besides TSCs and AME, we will use the single cell genomics platform to study normal and mutant hEPSCs toward embryonic cell lineages including hematopoietic cells. Objective 3. Dissecting the epigenomic mechanisms underlying m6A RNA modification regulating cell fate determination We will use several genomics platforms to investigate m6A modification and other epigenomics profiles in normal and mutant hEPSCs and during their differentiation to embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages, and to interrogate the molecular events at chromatin levels. These genomics studies will include m6A MeRIP-seq, ChIP-seq of METTL3, YTHDC1, GATA2 and H3K9me3, ATAC-seq, Ribo-seq, whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (WGBS) and Nanopore sequencing. These comprehensive genetic, functional and genomics investigations will help gain fundamental knowledge about m6A in human stem cell identity and maintenance, cell fate determination, segregation of embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages, and facilitate developing efficient approaches to generate functional cells from hEPSCs for basic and translational researches.

17112422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17112422.value: N6-methyladenosine(m6A) is the most prevalent internal mRNA modification in mammals. m6A has crucial and multifaceted roles in mediating gene regulation in numerous physiological and pathophysiological processes. METTL3/METTL14 is the predominant m6A methyltransferase on mRNA, whereas m6A is removed by Fto and Alkbh5-demethylases. Knocking out METTL3 in the mouse causes early embryonic lethality. METTL3 is expressed in both mouse and human ESCs. Knocking out METTL3 enhances pluripotency in ESCs and disrupts stem cell differentiation to all embryonic cell lineages. Trophoblasts in the placenta have essential functions and are derived from the trophectoderm in the preimplantation embryos. But neither mouse ESCs or the commonly used human ESCs(primed) can generate bona-fide trophoblasts, making it impossible to study METTL3 and m6A RNA methylation in development of embryonic vs. extraembryonic cell lineages. We have established expanded potential stem cells(EPSCs) from early implantation embryos of multiple mammalian species. EPSCs possess unique molecular features, can generate all cell types of both embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages. Importantly, trophoblast stem cell(TSC) lines can be directly derived from hEPSCs, which can subsequently produce bona-fidesubtypes of trophoblasts such as syncytio-trophoblasts(STBs) and extra-villous trophoblasts(EVTs). Human EPSCs thus provide an in-vitro system to investigate METTL3 and m6A RNA methylation cell fate determination and lineage segregation in human cell development. Knocking out METTL3 gene in human EPSCs causes substantial depletion of m6A, consisting with METTL3's role of being a catalytically active methyltransferase. Similar to METTL3 KO in mouse and human ESCs, loss of METTL3 in human EPSCs leads to severe defects in generation of embryonic cell lineages such as hematopoietic cells. Remarkably, METTL3 KO hEPSCs have a substantially increased potential to generate trophoblasts. Therefore, METTL3 and m6A RNA play a critical role in the cell fate determination between embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages. We propose to use genetic, functional, and single-cell genomics approaches to investigate METTL3 and m6A RNA methylation in human EPSCs. Specifically, single-cell RNA-seq and single-cell ATAC-seq will be used to delineate the cell types generated and elucidate the molecular events at early hEPSC differentiation, and identify cell fate determinants. Other epigenomics platforms(MeRIP-seq, ChIP-seq, Nanopore) will be used to interrogate molecular events. These comprehensive genetic, functional, and genomics investigations will help gain fundamental knowledge about m6A in human stem cell identity and maintenance, cell fate determination, segregation of embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages, and facilitate developing efficient approaches to generate functional cells from hEPSCs for basic and translational research. N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）是哺乳動物體內最普遍的mRNA甲基化修飾，在許多生理和病理過程中具有基因調控、決定細胞命運等多種作用。 METTL3和METTL14是兩類主要的m6A甲基轉移酶，而FTO和ALKBH5則作為去甲基化酶發揮作用。 在小鼠中敲除METTL3基因會導致早期胚胎致死。 METTL3在小鼠和人類胚胎幹細胞（ESC）中均有表達，敲除METTL3可增強ESC的多能性並 削弱ESC向胚內三胚層細胞譜系分化的潛能，但METTL3在胚外滋養層細胞譜系發育過程中的功能作用尚未見報導。 哺乳動物胎盤中滋養層細胞來源於著床前胚胎的滋養外胚層，具有重要生物學功能。 由於多數小鼠ESC和人類ESC（激發態）難以產生真正的滋養層細胞，因此難以用來研究胚胎 特別是胚外細胞譜系發育過程中RNA m6A甲基化的功能。 我們實驗室已經從多種哺乳動物的早期植入胚胎中建立了擴展多潛能性幹細胞 （EPSC）。 這些EPSC具有獨特的分子特徵，可以產生胚內和胚外細胞譜系的所有細胞類型。 重要的是，我們通過人EPSC建立的人滋養層幹細胞 （hTSC） 與來源於人體胎盤組織的TSC分子特徵極為接近，並可以分化成與人體組織細胞形態和功能相似的合體滋養層細胞 （STB） 和絨毛外滋養層細胞 （EVT）。 因此，我們建立的人EPSC提供了一個理想的體外幹細胞模型，可以用來研究METTL3 等 RNAm6A甲基化相關基因在人胚胎幹細胞的細胞命運決定和譜系分離中的作用。 我們的前期數據表明，敲除人EPSC中的METTL3基因會導致RNA m6A甲基化水平顯著降低，這與METTL3作為m6A甲基轉移酶的功能有關。 與小鼠和人類ESC中的METTL3功能類似， EPSC中METTL3的缺失將 導致胚胎細胞譜系（如造血細胞）的嚴重缺陷。 值得注意的是，METTL3敲除的EPSC具有顯著增加的生成胚外滋養層細胞譜系的潛力。 因此，METTL3和RNA m6A在胚內和胚外細胞譜系之間的細胞命運決定中可能起到關鍵作用。 本專案中，我們擬結合遺傳學手段、功能性分析和單細胞基因組學等方法，研究人EPSC中METTL3 和RNA m6A 甲基化的功能; 通過單細胞RNA測序和單細胞ATAC測序等方法描繪所生成細胞的譜系特徵，闡明早期 EPSC分化的分子事件，並深入分析細胞命運決定因素; 最後結合其他表觀基因組學技術如MeRIP-seq、ChIP-seq、 納米孔測序等系列方法探索上述譜系分化的分子機制。 本項目通過系列研究和綜合分析將不僅有助於獲得m6A在人類極早期幹細胞身份維持、細胞命運確定 、胚內和胚外細胞譜系分離等多方面的基礎理論知識，而且將促進開發從人EPSC衍生出功能性細胞更有效的方法，為胚胎 幹細胞的轉化研究和應用提供堅實的理論基礎和技術策略。

17112422.label: Realisation of objectives
17112422.value: We have completed all the proposed research Objectives and several major scientific findings have been published or to be published. Details are in 6.1 Objective 1. Genetic and functional study of m6A RNA methylation using EPSCs as a cellular model. Since complete knockout of METTL3 gene in human EPSCs and trophoblast stem cells (hTSCs) caused cell lethality, we used a METTL3 inducible knockout (iKO) system to genetically manipulate the gene expression, which enable genetic dissection of the genes involved in m6A RNA modification in a temporal manner. These EPSCs maintain normal pluripotency examined molecularly and functionally in vitro and in vivo assays. We find that loss of METTL3 causes significant upregulation of pluripotency factors including naïve pluripotency genes and failure to exit pluripotency, thus impairing stem cell differentiation towards both embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages such as trophoblast and AME lineages. Objective 2. Using single-cell genomics to study the m6A RNA modification in cell fate determination in human EPSCs differentiation Using the inducible METTL3 KO human EPSCs, We have performed scRNAseq and scATACseq and delineated the cell fate determination and cell lineage segregation of embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages from the normal and mutant hEPSCs. We have discovered that reduced m6A RNA modifications have cause major epigenetic changes in EPSCs, resulting in activation of naïve genes and defective stem cell differentiation, including extraembryonic cell lineages TSCs and AME. These phenotypes are reproducib;e using a METTL3 inhibitor. Objective 3. Dissecting the epigenomic mechanisms underlying m6A RNA modification regulating cell fate determination We have performed various epigenomic analyses and discovered that reduced m6A RNA modification directly affects transposable element and epigenetic modifier expression. Consequently, naïve gene expression is abnormal in EPSCs which leads to differentiation defects. Moreover, reduced m6A RNA modification causes severe defects in human trophoblast stem cells, leading to loss of stemness and to cellular senescence, which is implicated in preeclampsia. Two papers have been published in 2025 directly from this funding. Here are the details: 1. Nucleic Acids Res . 2025 Apr 22;53(8):gkaf349. doi: 10.1093/nar/gkaf349 Abstract N 6-methyladenosine (m6A) is the most prevalent messenger RNA modification with diverse regulatory roles in mammalian cells. While its functions are well-documented in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), its role in human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) remains to be fully explored. METTL3 is the main enzyme responsible for m6A deposition. Here, using a METTL3 inducible knockout (iKO) system, we uncovered that, unlike in mESCs, METTL3 was indispensable for hPSC maintenance. Importantly, loss of METTL3 caused significant upregulation of pluripotency factors including naïve pluripotency genes and failure to exit pluripotency, thus impairing stem cell differentiation towards both embryonic and extraembryonic cell lineages. Mechanistically, METTL3 iKO in hPSCs promoted expression and enhancer activities of two primate-specific transposable elements (TEs), SVA_D and HERVK/LTR5_Hs. At SVA_D elements, loss of METTL3 leads to reduced H3K9me3 deposition. On the other hand, the activation of LTR5_Hs in the METTL3 iKO cells is accompanied by increased chromatin accessibility and binding pluripotency factors. The activated SVA_D and LTR5_Hs elements can act as enhancers and promote nearby naïve gene expression by directly interacting with their promoters. Together these findings reveal that METTL3-dependent m6A RNA methylation plays critical roles in suppressing TE expression and in regulating the human pluripotency network. 2. https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-67484-z METTL3 safeguards cell identity and epigenome of human trophoblast stem cells Abstract N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is the most prevalent RNA modification and plays diverse roles in mammalian cells. However, its significance in human trophoblast lineage commitment and placenta development remains poorly understood. Here we show that METTL3, the primary enzyme responsible for m6A depositions, specifically marks cytotrophoblasts in human placenta, and exhibits defective expression in cytotrophoblasts from preeclampsia patients. Through in-depth in vitro investigation, we identify critical roles of METTL3 in generating human trophoblast stem cells (hTSCs) from human expanded potential stem cells, and in maintaining hTSCs’ self-renewal and identity. In hTSCs, METTL3 loss induces pro-inflammatory responses and promotes premature senescence, leading to preeclampsia-associated transcriptomic signature. Mechanistically, METTL3-dependent m6A methylation directly regulates histone modifiers such as EP300 and EZH2 to maintain epigenetic homeostasis, as well as various transcription factors, including JUND. Targeted inhibition of EP300 in hTSCs successfully ameliorate preeclampsia signature caused by METTL3 deficiency. These findings reveal METTL3-dependent m6A methylation as a critical regulator of human trophoblast development and its potential involvement in pregnancy-related diseases.

17112422.label: Major findings and research outcome
17112422.value: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is the most prevalent RNA modification and plays diverse roles in mammalian cells. However, its significance in human stem cell maintenance, stem cell differentiation and lineage commitment remains poorly understood. This grant aims to investigate its roles in human pluripotent stem cells and other types of stem cells. Major discoveries have been made using fundings from this grant. First, we have published two scientific papers. A. Nucleic Acids Res . 2025 Apr 22;53(8):gkaf349. doi: 10.1093/nar/gkaf349. B. Nat Commun. 2025 Dec 16. doi: 10.1038/s41467-025-67484-z. Second, we are preparing the third manuscript about m6A RNA modification in maintaining genome integrity in stem cells and in vivo development, in collaboration with clinical collaborators. Besides METTL3 and METTL14, we have knockout out several other genes in the m6A RNA modification system and are characterizing the cellular and molecular phenotypes.

17112422.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17112422.value: Following the discovery of m6A RNA modification in human stem cells and trophoblasts, we are studying the system in other types of biological process including their roles in producing hematopoietic cells and immune cells from human pluripotent stem cells and in human cellular aging. These results lay the foundation for future research projects.

17112422.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17112422.value: m6A is a small chemical change that happens to a type of RNA in our cells called messenger RNA. This change can affect how long the RNA lasts and how well it helps make proteins, which are important for how our bodies work. We studied this in human stem cells, which are special cells that can grow into many different types of cells in the body. We found that m6A plays a big role in helping these stem cells develop into other cells, like blood cells or cells in the placenta. If there’s too much or too little m6A, the cells might not develop properly. Understanding more about m6A can help scientists learn how the body works and why some diseases happen, which might one day lead to new treatments.

17112622.value: 青年肥胖是引致冠狀動脈疾病(CAD)及二型糖尿病(T2D)的重要因素。由於亞洲人群正面對由全球化引致的青年肥胖上升趨勢，以及亞洲人群較其他人群更容易患上糖尿病，青年肥胖相關研究與亞洲人群特別相關。雖然青年肥胖與這些疾病的關係是已知道的，相關機制還是不清楚。著重深層表型研究，如蛋白質分析，雖較為合適拆解相關機制（因蛋白質作為機制因素），但相關研究較少，並可能因為其觀察性研究的特質而出現偏差。另外，大部份研究集中於歐洲人群，因此不能確定相關結果能否應用於亞洲人群。 由於蛋白質作為機制因素，了解青年肥胖的蛋白質訊息將有助我們明白青年肥胖怎樣通過影響蛋白質水平引致CAD及T2D。我們的初期研究結果顯示感知較大身型的人與某些蛋白質訊息相關（P值<0.003, 20種蛋白質）。但我們不知道這些結果能否應用於青年亞洲人群。我們這個研究項目利用前瞻性出生隊列的樣本作出蛋白質分析。我們將利用基因數據以避免觀察性研究中因混淆因子所造成的偏差。我們只會選擇由初期研究結果中所指出的頭20種蛋白質集中分析，以減少假陽性的可能性。 主要目的：通過中國人出生隊列基因型召回研究分析青年肥胖與蛋白質的關係，如coiled-coil domain-containing 80及thiosulfate sulfurtransferase。這些蛋白質有可能是青年肥胖影響疾病的機制因素 參加者：九七的兒女出生隊列中的250人（16-18歲） 暴露因素：基因所推測的青年體重指數 主要結果：初期孟德爾隨機化研究結果顯示與青年肥胖相關的20種蛋白質 （如coiled-coil domain-containing 80及thiosulfate sulfurtransferase） 結果預測及重要性：基因所推測的青年體重指數越高的人會有特定的蛋白質訊息，如較高的coiled-coil domain-containing 80及較低的thiosulfate sulfurtransferase。這些結果將有助我們了解蛋白質在中國人群中青年肥胖與CAD及T2D的作用，並能提供更多重要的初步研究結果以支持更大的研究基金申請。研究結果將有助我們找出具潛力的干預對象以減低青年肥胖對成人疾病的影響。

17112622.label: Realisation of objectives
17112622.value: We have successfully assessed the association of childhood body mass index (BMI) with the identified protein signatures using a recall by genotype design in the “Children of 1997” birth cohort [1], where 1) we conducted a genome wide association analysis of childhood BMI in the birth cohort to derive a polygenic risk score (PRS) so as to select those in the extremes of the score for proteomic assay; and 2) we sent the samples in the PRS extremes to conduct proteomic analyses; and 3) compared the proteomic signals between the two PRS groups. Please see below for more details. Firstly, we selected birth cohort participants (n = 3,279) [2] who have BMI measurements at either time points (9-9.9 years old and 10-10.9 years old) and genetic information. If the participants have two BMI measurements, we extracted the BMI which is closer to 10 years old, otherwise we used the only available BMI. We conducted a genome-wide association analysis using childhood BMI z-score at age 10 as phenotype. We selected single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) which were bi-allelic, had minor allele frequency (MAF) > 0.1%, and P value < 5e-6. These variants were clumped using East Asian panel to remove variants in linkage disequilibrium (LD r2< 0.001). After these procedures, we identified 12 SNPs independently associated with childhood BMI. Based on these 12 SNPs, we calculated unweighted PRS for the participants (n =3,279) identified the two groups with the highest and lowest PRS (n = 125 in each group) for plasma proteomic analyses using samples collected at the Biobank follow up of the birth cohort (mean age: 17.6). In total, 7,596 proteins were measured using the SomaLogic SomaScan assay v4 (SOMAscan, SomaLogic, Boulder, Colorado, USA; https://somalogic.com/), amongst which 6,392 (84%) were human proteins. We verified that there were no significant differences of demographic factors between the two PRS groups and hence it was not susceptible to residual confounding, as expected based on the recall by genotype design. We then employed univariable linear regression to assess differences in 6,392 proteins between the highest and lowest PRS groups for childhood BMI, using false discovery rate (q value < 0.05) to correct for multiple comparison. We did not adjust for other covariables given there were no differences between the two PRS groups and genetics are unlikely confounded. Based on this study, we compared the proteomic signatures between those at the lowest and highest PRS group, where we found PRS groups were associated with 19 proteomic signals after FDR correction (See 6.1 for details) although the originally proposed signals (e.g. coiled-coil domain-containing 80 and thiosulfate sulfurtransferase) were not identified. References 1. Formalising recall by genotype as an efficient approach to detailed phenotyping and causal inference. Nat Commun. 2018;9(1):711. 2. Schooling CM, Hui LL, Ho LM, Lam TH, Leung GM. Cohort profile: 'children of 1997': a Hong Kong Chinese birth cohort. Int J Epidemiol. 2012;41(3):611-20. 3. Luo S, Lam HS, Chan YH, Tang CSM, He B, Kwok MK, et al. Assessing the safety of lipid-modifying medications among Chinese adolescents: a drug-target Mendelian randomization study. BMC Med. 2023;21(1):410.

17112622.label: Major findings and research outcome
17112622.value: Based on the recall by genotype design in the “Children of 1997” birth cohort, we found that body mass index (BMI) polygenic risk score (PRS) groups were associated with 19 proteomic signals after false discovery rate correction. When compared with the lowest PRS group (i.e. lower body mass index), 14 proteins were lower in the highest PRS group, including Hyaluronan and proteoglycan link protein 1, Osteomodulin, Collagen alpha-1(IX) chain (two types: CO9A1 and COAA1), Collagen alpha-2(XI) chain, fibromodulin, Matrilin-3, Ankyrin repeat and SOCS box protein 9, Leucine-rich repeat-containing protein 15, Neuroplastin, Collagen Type III, Collagen alpha-1(I) chain, Seizure 6-like protein and Aggrecan core protein. On the contrary, 5 proteins were higher in the highest PRS group, including Cystatin-like 1, Tissue-type plasminogen activator, WNT1-inducible-signaling pathway protein 2, RU2A, and CPZIP. The corresponding study was presented as an oral presentation at an international conference in Finland (5th Paula Rantakallio Symposium) related to birth cohort studies (Part C, Section 9 Item 1). Inspired by the recall by genotype design, this also led to an extension of the study to use a formal 2 step Mendelian randomization design to explore the proteomic mechanisms linking childhood adiposity and type 2 diabetes (Part C, Section 8 Item 2), where we are revising the manuscript based on the comments from co-authors, including overseas institutions (Part C, Section 11 Item 1). Please see Section 6.2 for more details. Lastly, we also contributed to an editorial on a paper using this similar approach via 2 step Mendelian randomization to exploring proteomic signatures linking body mass index and COVID-19 risk (Part C, Section 8 Item 1).

17112622.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17112622.value: During the conduct of this study, there are large scale Europeans genome wide association studies of proteins being published although there are issues with data storage given the size of the associated datasets. After identifying additional funding for storage servers, we have now included assessment of childhood body mass index (BMI) with proteomic signatures using summary statistics from these genome wide associations studies, where we extended the overall design by including the assessment of how these proteomic signatures may mediate the association of childhood BMI using a 2 step Mendelian randomization study, where the most likely signal was Soluble intercellular adhesion molecule-1 (sICAM-1), which was elevated with increasing childhood BMI based on the current analyses. Given these associations were derived from Europeans, we compared the findings with the signals in the recall by genotype design although the signals appeared distinct between Europeans and East Asians, highlighting the need of studies in different populations to elucidate ethnic specific proteomic signals arising from childhood obesity. This will shed light in identifying potential targets of interventions suitable for different populations to mitigate the harms resulting from childhood obesity pandemic.

17112622.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17112622.value: Exploring mechanistic factors, such as protein markers, associated with childhood obesity can help identify intervention targets to mitigate the adverse effect of childhood obesity in adulthood diseases. Taking advantage of high throughput proteomic assays which enable the measurement of thousands of proteomic markers (n=6,392 human proteins) using small samples, we explored the proteomic signatures related to childhood obesity in a population based Chinese birth cohort study. To reduce the level of bias, we used genetics where we sampled the participants based on extremes of polygenic risk score (PRS) of childhood body mass index (BMI) instead of measured childhood BMI (n=250). Using regression analyses, we found 19 proteomic signals related to participants with high PRS of childhood BMI after correction for false discovery rate. This study highlights the epidemiologic value of well characterized birth cohort studies to study the etiology of diseases. Coupled with rapidly developing omics technologies, our study provides contextually relevant evidence related to protein perturbation related to childhood obesity. Additional studies will be needed to elucidate how these proteins link with childhood obesity related adulthood diseases, such as coronary artery disease and type 2 diabetes, and hence informs targets of interventions.

17112822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17112822.value: 先兆子癇 (PE) 是一種常見的妊娠疾病，影響2%-5%的妊娠，是導致產前死亡率和發病率的主要原因。 PE 還與胎兒生長受限的高發生率以及短期和長期孕產婦和圍產期並發症有關，因此是醫療保健系統的重大負擔。 PE的病因與滋養層分化和功能缺陷有關，導致胎盤發育異常、胎盤灌注不足和母胎交換缺陷。 目前，沒有可靠的方法來預測或治療 PE。 調節人類滋養層分化的分子機制知之甚少。 腎上腺髓質素 (ADM) 是妊娠早期胎盤中表達最多的肽激素。 儘管來自動物模型的數據支持滋養層 ADM 在胎盤發育中的作用，但其在人類妊娠中的作用尚不清楚。 我們之前發表的論文已經證明 ADM 與人類滋養細胞結合併上調它們的運動性/侵襲性。 我們近期的數據進一步表明 ADM 參與調節滋養層分化。我們發現（1）ADM 受體拮抗劑在體外抑制滋養層分化;（2）與正常妊娠對照相比，PE 患者的胎盤 ADM 表達降低;（3）在懷孕老鼠身上抑制胎盤ADM 能誘導PE 樣表型和胎盤發育缺陷。 我們假設滋養層 ADM 通過調節滋養層分化來調節人類胎盤發育， ADM 的下調會導致先兆子癇。 該假設將通過利用體外和體內幹細胞、類器官和納米技術研究 ADM 在滋養層分化中的作用和機制，並將這些發現與臨床 PE 的發生相關聯來驗證。 最後，我們將研究基於胎盤特異性納米顆粒的 ADM 操作在治療 PE 中的用途。 該項目的結果將證明有缺陷的滋養細胞 ADM 表達是導致PE 的原因。 具體來說，該缺陷會影響滋養細胞的分化和活動，從而破壞正常的胎盤發育。 臨床上，這項研究的結果將表明 ADM 和/或其受體水平在 PE 早期預測中的可能用途。 他們還將告知 ADM 的胎盤靶向遞送是否可以在臨床上用作治療 PE 的方法。

17113022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17113022.value: 急性術後痛是一個重大的臨床問題，如若控制不佳可能會對患者的預後情況產生負面影響。不同的飲食結構會影響疼痛的嚴重程度。其中，間歇性禁食 (IF) 是一種以徹底禁食和自由飲食來回切換為特徵的飲食模式。熱痛和內臟痛的動物模型已表明這種飲食模式可以減輕疼痛反應和神經性炎症。另一方面，高脂飲食 (HFD) 則被證明會加劇動物疼痛模型中的疼痛反應。絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N (SerpinA3N) 是一種顆粒酶B (GzmB) 抑制劑，而顆粒酶B是一種在自然殺傷細胞 (NK cells) 中表達且可刺激細胞因子釋放的蛋白酶。絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N已被證實具有抗炎和鎮痛效果，且亦發現間歇性禁食能夠增加小鼠腦組織中的絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N的表達。因此，間歇性禁食或許可以通過調節絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N的相關信號通路來減輕疼痛。為了研究急性術後痛，我們在小鼠後爪作一縱形切口再造後爪切口痛 (HPI) 模型。切口痛的小鼠出現持續一周左右的疼痛加劇反應。我們分別給這些小鼠飼喂高脂飲食或進行間歇性禁食。我們現有的初期結果表明，間歇性禁食在術後第4天顯著降低了小鼠的後爪切口痛（雙溫度偏好測試）反應，並使得絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N的表達增加。另外，我們還發現高脂飲食加劇了後爪切口痛小鼠的機械異常性疼痛和熱痛覺過敏。在此課題中，我們計畫研究間歇性禁食和高脂飲食對後爪切口痛模型的影響，並將研究這些飲食模式對絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N及其相關疼痛信號通路的作用。在這項研究中，間歇性禁食和高脂飲食將用來飼喂後爪切口痛組和假手術組的小鼠。疼痛行為學實驗和生化分析將用以研究絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N的表達及共定位情況。此外，評估絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N在有/無間歇性禁食或高脂飲食干預下的後爪切口痛模型中的作用將通過下調（直接使用基因敲除小鼠或體內敲低）和上調（體內過表達）SerpinA3N基因來實現。不同劑量的重組絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N將注射進後爪切口痛的小鼠體內並測試其疼痛反應，這是用以探究不同水平的抑制劑功效。我們還將研究間斷性禁食和高脂飲食對免疫反應的影響。流式細胞分析 (FACS) 將用以研究負責絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N發揮功效的免疫細胞的主群和亞群。在課題的最後部分，我們將探究絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N是否通過作用於顆粒酶B從而調節後爪切口痛模型的疼痛反應，並將探索絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N的其它下游因子。同時，RNA測序將用以尋找差異基因表達 (DEG) 和信號通路網路；基因本體 (GO) 富集分析和京都基因和基因組百科全書 (KEGG) 通路分析會用以確定不同差異表達基因之間的相互作用。我們還將在絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N存在的情形下，通過外源注射過表達顆粒酶B以研究升高的顆粒酶B是否可以抵消絲氨酸蛋白酶抑制劑A3N產生的鎮痛作用。我們的課題可能會為臨床上管理急性術後痛提供轉化依據，而這些所研究的因子也可能會成為疼痛管理的潛在靶點。

17113522.value: 慢性阻塞性肺病影響患者的生活質素。協作式自我管理介入，能有效改善健康相關的態度和行為。我們根據患者的需求，展開了智能手機自我管理的先導計劃 (3S-C)，以改善患者生活質素。研究結果顯示良好的可接受性。 3S-C 旨在改善慢性阻塞性肺病患者的生活質素（主要結果）、自我管理的積極性和自我效能、對疾病的接受程度、對藥物和治療方案的依從性、吸入技術、身體活動、飲食習慣、睡眠質素、運動能力和主觀幸福感，並且減低吸煙、呼吸困難、病情惡化、焦慮和抑鬱症狀，及醫療資源的使用。 3S-C 以社會認知理論元素為基礎提升自我效能，以接受為本的策略提升心理靈活性，以簡短勵志性訪談處理行為改變的不確定性。我們使用階梯支援模式，配合手機社交媒體（WhatsApp/WeChat），提供整體、多元、結構化、個人化資訊和心理支援，並提供以聊天短訊輔導，增強自我管理的認知和行動。 3S-C計劃包括︰A 部分，兩次個人勵志訪談； B 部分，分兩個階段發出以理論和主題為主的 WhatsApp/WeChat 即時信息，以及提供電話健康輔導，次數按時遞減； C 部分，持續個人化的聊天短訊輔導、電話支援和熱線服務； D部分，建立目標設定和自我管理的電子平台；以及 E 部分，患者相互支持的小組聚會。兩個組別都會得到相同的安排和聯繫時間。 這項隨機對照研究，將招募至少 180 名慢性阻塞性肺病患者。患者將被隨機分配到 3S-C 組，或一般衛生訊息組（對照組）。我們會以第4和第12 個月的結果及過程評估，透過主觀及客觀的測試數據，檢視3S-C 的果效。我們將會評估介入的可接受性和可信度、對護理的滿意度、醫療資源使用和成本效用，探討3S-C對生活質素的影響、可能機制和相關結果，以及自我管理的促進因素和障礙。 3S-C 是一項主動性、以患者為中心和互動性的計劃，旨在提高自我管理和健康行為的自我效能，並可能是最簡單、最低成本和以理論為基礎的計劃，去改善慢性阻塞性肺病患者的生活質素和相關結果。從結果和過程評估，以及機制、醫療資源使用和成本效用分析，將為臨床實踐增加新的知識，並為以手機作自我管理介入的研究，建立簡單的行為改變模式。

17113622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17113622.value: 物種的遷徙：通過珊瑚的生理順應(acclimation)和適應(adaptation)能力來預測未來的珊瑚栖息地

17113622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17113622.value: Scleractinian corals form the foundation of the most productive and biodiverse ecosystems in the world, providing ecological goods and services globally. While coral mortality events are increasing in frequency and severity near the equator, poleward range expansions have been reported for many species suggesting that the capacity for some corals to persist in future climate change scenarios may not be exclusively related to their ability to tolerate ever-increasing summer temperatures in the tropics. Instead, predicting where and how corals may shift their ranges as sea temperatures continue to rise can allow for the integration of climate refugia into conservation and management plans. Further study of the physiological and genetic traits of subtropical corals relative to their tropical counterparts may be the key to promoting species persistence at higher latitudes. Our previous work on Hong Kong corals provides some of the first insight into species-specific physiological trade-offs necessary to function under colder annual regimes with larger seasonal shifts. Yet these data are limited to a single locale and fall short of representing the full capacity of coral physiology that can define the relative vulnerabilities of coral species to anthropogenic climate change. Here we seek funding to investigate variation in corals’ capacity to adjust their thermal physiology across broad latitudinal ranges in the Asia-Pacific. These data will be incorporated into mechanistic models of species distributions to predict the potential range of corals under various climate scenarios. Lastly, we will use population genetics to look for underlying structure in genetic diversity as a proxy for understanding the role of acclimation and adaptation in thermal physiology. Adaptive management plans will be most successful where they incorporate the physiological potential for coral range expansion under future climate scenarios and preserve the genetic diversity (adaptive capacity) of corals across latitudes with a focus on genotypes specifically linked to success in subtropical environments. 石珊瑚(Scleractinian coral)構築了世界上其中一個生物多樣性最高和最多產的生態系統。這個生態系統為全球提供了多種重要的生態產品和服務。當近赤道地區錄得越來越頻密和嚴重的珊瑚死亡事件時，學界也記錄到很多不同珊瑚物種開始了向兩極方向進行擴張。這種擴張意味著要應對未來持續全球暖化的威脅，珊瑚不僅僅依賴於提升對熱帶越來越高的夏季溫度的耐受能力。相應地，預測珊瑚在不斷上升的海洋溫度下如何進行極向擴張和擴張的目的地可以協助我們將氣候避難所整合到保育和管理計劃中。進一步研究珊瑚在熱帶和亞熱帶的生理和基因特性差異可能是促進珊瑚在高緯度持續存在的關鍵。生長在溫度更低和年度溫度變化更大地區的珊瑚必要地作出一些生理上的權衡，我們在此前對香港珊瑚的研究中對特定物種的生理權衡提出了初步見解。然而，我們獲取的數據僅來自於一個地區，這些數據不能全面地代表珊瑚的生理特性。而珊瑚的整體生理特性卻決定著在人爲氣候變化大環境下珊瑚的相對脆弱性。有見及此，我們希望尋求資金來研究不同珊瑚在不同維度的亞太地區内如何進行熱生理學調節。我們希望將實驗得到的數據整合到現有的物種分佈模型中，并通過模型來預測在不同氣候場景下未來珊瑚的潛在分佈。最後，我們希望通過群體遺傳學(population genetics) 在豐富的基因多樣性中找到最基本的基因結構，並以此為基礎去瞭解順應(acclimation)和適應(adaptation)能力在熱生理學範疇内起到的作用。在進行適應性管理計劃時，如果我們可以做好以下兩點，那麽計劃將會更容易獲得成功：第一，將珊瑚在未來不同氣候場景下的極向擴張生理潛力考慮到計劃内；第二，做好保育跨緯度的珊瑚基因多樣性，尤其是側重保育成功在亞熱帶生長的基因型。

17114722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17114722.value: 用於計算機輔助頭頸部重建手術的人工智能顱面骨 CT 分割算法的系統驗證

17114722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17114722.value: Prof Komura, Taku Dr Yang, Weifa

17114722.label: Project Objectives
17114722.value: Objective 1: To validate the AI-enabled skull CT segmentation with dry human skulls anatomical ground truth. Rationale: • CT segmentation is the cornerstone of computer-assisted surgery. However, there is no ground truth knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled CT segmentation. Its comparison with the routine clinical method of global thresholding is also unknown. • Establishing geometric ground truth is not straightforward. Anthropomorphic phantoms do not reflect individuality, and their validity for CT imaging is questionable due to artifacts. Cadavers are excellent for geometric measurement and CT imaging, but expensive, labor-intensive, and ethically sensitive. The clinical database is technically sound but impossible for comprehensive geometric measurement. Therefore, dry human skulls serve as the most applicable anatomical ground truth for CT imaging and AI-enabled segmentation. • Segmentation metrics are useful for comparing different segmentation strategies, but are not straightforward for clinical evaluation. A comprehensive validation should include metrics of clinically intuitive geometric deviations. Key issues: • Dry human skulls will serve as anatomical ground truth, which will be measured by 3D coordinate measuring and 3D scanning to retrieve geometric ground truth information. • AI-enabled segmentation will be compared with the routine clinical segmentation and the ground truth manual segmentation. • A comprehensive evaluation will be conducted for time spent, operator satisfaction, bone quality, geometric deviations, and segmentation metrics. Anticipated outcomes: • AI-enabled skull CT segmentation is efficient, operator-friendly, and accurate, as confirmed by dry human skulls anatomical ground truth. Objective 2: To validate the AI-enabled skull CT segmentation with a surgical database of computer-assisted head and neck reconstruction. Rationale: • AI research is accelerating rapidly in healthcare, but its successful deployment in surgical practice is scarce. The clinical applicability of AI-enabled skull CT segmentation should be validated in a surgical database of real clinical scenarios, laying the foundation for its clinical application. • Intensity inhomogeneity of skull CT, induced by the complex anatomy, technical artifacts, bone deformities, etc., restricts the performance of routine clinical segmentations. Therefore, the excellent role of AI-enabled skull CT segmentation should be examined with real surgical cases of varying degrees of deformities and artifacts. Key issues: • A surgical database has been developed containing CT datasets of real patients undergoing computer-assisted head and neck reconstruction by PI, which will validate the clinical applicability of AI-enabled segmentation. • A robust validation strategy will be established to enable direct comparisons of AI-enabled segmentation with the routine clinical method of global thresholding and the ground truth manual segmentation. • Performance metrics reflecting real clinical applicability and being intuitive to clinicians, besides segmentation metrics, will be used for the comprehensive validation of AI-enabled segmentation. Anticipated outcomes: • AI-enabled skull CT segmentation is efficient, operator-friendly, and accurate, as confirmed by a surgical database of computer-assisted head and neck reconstruction. Objective 3: To verify the impact of the AI-enabled skull CT segmentation on the performance of computer-assisted head and neck reconstruction. Rationale: • An accurate, robust, and efficient algorithm of CT segmentation is warranted for the excellent performance of head and neck reconstruction, especially with the high precision demand of patient-specific surgical plates (PSSPs). Before the large-scale clinical application, it is imperative to verify the impact of AI-enabled segmentation on the performance of computer-assisted head and neck reconstruction. Key issues: • In each surgical case, the virtual plan of bone resection and skull reconstruction will be kept the same for different segmentation strategies. 3D-reconstructed skulls of varied sizes and qualities produced by different segmentation strategies can affect the 3D designing of PSSPs and surgical guides. The performance of PSSPs and surgical guides will be examined in a model surgery platform. • A model surgery platform using 3D-printed patient-specific skull models can serve as a viable preclinical platform without ethical concerns. The model surgery platform has been established in our center. • The performance of surgery will be evaluated in multiple dimensions intraoperatively and postoperatively. The fitness of guides and PSSPs will be examined. Surgical outcomes will be characterized comprehensively. • Postoperative 3D scanning can digitize surgical outcomes for comparison, which has been confirmed as the most viable option to prevent the interference of CT artifacts and segmentation errors. Anticipated outcomes: • AI-enabled skull CT segmentation contributes to accurate computer-assisted head and neck reconstruction.

17114722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17114722.value: 摘要 背景： 計算機輔助手術 (CAS) 的創新不斷推動著頭頸部重建領域的發展。這些創新一方面帶動了手術對精確度和穩健性的更高需求，另一方面也推動了為虛擬手術開發更智能工作流程的需求。作為虛擬手術的重要基石，使用不同策略的 CT 分割算法可以生成不同大小和質量的虛擬頭骨，從而影響 CAS 的性能。主流的 CT 分割算法，包括手動或基於形狀和閾值的半手動分割，在準確性、質量和效率方面存在固有缺陷。因此，鑑於人工智能 (AI) 的新興發展，預計支持AI的算法將徹底改變顱面骨 CT 分割領域，具有巨大的臨床轉化潛力。 關鍵問題和知識差距： Mimics 自動算法 CMF CT是通過利用人工智能算法，組合閾值分割、機器學習、深度學習、形狀分割等算法開發而成。我們在 Oral Oncology 2021 上發表的研究，使用了三個案例進行初步探索，發現CMF CT非常適合顱面骨 CT的 分割。但是，這種基於 AI 的分割算法，其基準真相（ground-truth）信息和臨床適用性一無所知，其對 CAS效果的影響也是未知的。因此，在大規模臨床應用之前，需要對AI 顱面骨 CT 分割算法進行系統驗證。 目標： (1) 使用人類頭骨標本作為解剖基準真相，驗證AI 顱面骨 CT 分割算法的準確性； (2) 使用計算機輔助頭頸部重建手術臨床數據庫，驗證AI 顱面骨 CT 分割算法的臨床適用性； (3) 使用計算機輔助頭頸部重建手術臨床數據庫和模型手術平台，驗證AI 顱面骨 CT 分割算法對計算機輔助頭頸部重建性能的影響。 研究計劃： 將AI 顱面骨 CT 分割算法與常規臨床分割和手動分割進行比較。人類頭骨標本將作為解剖基準真相，並通過 3D 坐標測量和 3D 掃描進行數字化。手術臨床數據庫將用於驗證AI分割的臨床適用性。顱面骨CT 分割對手術性能的影響將通過模型手術平台進行檢查。本研究將進行全面的驗證，評估CT分割花費的時間、操作員滿意度、分割結果、幾何偏差和手術結果。 預期結果和意義： AI 顱面骨 CT 分割具有高效、操作友好、準確、臨床適用等特點，有助於進一步提升計算機輔助頭頸部重建的精確度和穩健性。本研究將建立一個全面的驗證策略，其性能指標可以真實反映臨床適用性，並具有對臨床醫生的直觀性，這將為AI支持CAS的大規模臨床研究鋪平道路。

17115122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17115122.value: 雖然食管腺癌 (EAC) 的一個主要病因是胃酸反流，但食管鱗狀細胞癌 (ESCC，食管鱗癌) 的病因更為複雜。世界上食管鱗癌發病率特別高的地區集中在從伊朗和阿富汗沿絲綢之路延伸到中國的“中亞食管癌帶”，其中研究最多的地方是太行山脈的河南、河北和山西三省交界地區，這裡是全球食管鱗癌發病率最高的地區，每10萬人每年發生超過100個病例。針對傳統風險因素（醃製蔬菜和亞硝胺、發霉食物裏的黴菌毒素、燙熱飲食、維生素和礦物質缺乏）的多年研究和乾預並未發現流行地區的食管鱗癌發病率顯著降低，這表明可能存在一些未得到控制的未知風險因素，因此需要新的病因學假設。三個綫索指向小麥殼來源的二氧化硅碎片這一危險因素：1）在太行山地區的居民和當地雞只的食管鱗癌高流行率之間存在相似性；2)太行山地區早期病例對照研究披露的小麥消費與食管鱗癌風險升高之間的關聯；3）乾旱氣候與食管鱗癌流行的地理相關性。乾旱脅迫可能會增加二氧化硅作為植硅體在小麥中的沉積，特別是在小麥毛狀體（表皮細胞的毛髮狀產物）中。富含二氧化硅的小麥毛狀體在小麥脫粒過程中從小麥苞片表面脫落，由於其密度高於小麥殼而避開了風選過程，從而混于小麥中，並在製粉步驟中這些粉塵會進入麵粉，當食團通過食道生理狹窄點時二氧化硅碎片會滯留食道組織中，最終通過慢性炎症促進癌變。本項目的研究目標是： 1) 在一項基於醫院的病例對照研究中，檢查食管鱗癌病例是否比創傷性死亡對照組具有更高的小麥殼來源的二氧化硅碎片的歷史暴露量。 2)檢查食管鱗癌流行地區的創傷性死亡對照是否比非流行地區的創傷性死亡對照具有更高的小麥殼來源的二氧化硅碎片的歷史暴露量。 3) 檢驗和比較病例組、流行區對照和非流行區對照組的食道組織以及實驗室重建小麥粉中二氧化硅碎片的大小和形狀是否不同。研究設計為一項基於醫院的病例對照研究：病例為食管鱗癌患者，對照組為無食管鱗癌的外傷死亡病例。將在多項邏輯回歸模型中報告“流行區病例與對照”、“非流行區病例與對照”的多組優勢比，以估計小麥殼衍生二氧化硅碎片與食管鱗癌 風險的關聯。這些優勢比估計值的對比可以幫助區分由於個人生活方式因素和更大規模的地理因素導致的環境暴露梯度。將探討吸煙、飲酒和其他關鍵變量的潛在混淆和修飾作用。本研究關於非營養性飲食因素在食道癌發展中的潛在作用的研究結果將大大提高我們對世界環境因素相關癌症的理解和預防。

17115322.value: 基于基因挖掘和合成生物学策略联用导向发现核糖体抗菌肽

17115322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17115322.value: Natural products, as one of the most prolific sources of biologically active compounds, have been exploited by pharmaceutical industries for the development of modern antibiotic lead compounds. However, despite the compelling demand for new drugs to tackle rising drug resistance, the progress in discovering bioactive natural products has dramatically declined. The inevitable antibiotics resistance, together with the lack of new effective antibiotics, highlights the urgent need for new drugs that can kill antibiotic-resistant pathogens. Ribosomally synthesized and posttranslationally modified peptides (RiPPs) represent a promising yet largely underexploited “dark matter” for antibiotics discovery. More than 40 classes of RiPPs having been disclosed so far and novel families are being constantly revealed. Notable examples include rSAM –modified peptides with conformationally constrained macrocyclic moiety cross-linked by rSAM catalyzed C-C, C-S, or C-O bonds, which endows them with unique physical and physiological properties. Containing conformationally constrained macrocyclic structures, rSAM-modified RiPPs exhibit diverse structures with antibiotic potential, representing a promising area of antibiotics discovery. Here, we propose to develop a genome mining strategy to discover biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) that encode RiPPs, and then apply synthetic biology strategies to convert the targeted BGCs to antibiotic lead compounds. The proposed study has three main aims. 1) To develop a training set-independent genome mining approach to investigate RiPP BGCs systematically. The proposed method can prioritize BGCs of new antibiotics with chemical novelty and antibiotic potential in a high-throughput manner. 2) To mine the continuously increasing large-scale genomic data to discover antibiotic RiPPs for killing antibiotic-resistant superbugs, including, but not limited to, rSAM-modified RiPPs. 3) To apply synthetic biology strategies (e.g., in vivo assay of enzymes and heterologous expression of BGCs) to convert the genetic potential of RiPP BGCs into antibiotic lead compounds. Collectively, by applying this combinational approach to the bacterial sequenced genome (161,954), we aim to exploit the untapped biosynthetic potential of RiPPs for the discovery of new antibiotics to address the global threat of multidrug-resistant superbugs. This project will use a comprehensive mining approach to instantiate the use of RiPPs as a potential source of new antibiotics. Besides discovering peptide antibiotics with therapeutic potential, the proposed outcomes may also expedite the elucidation of peptide antibiotics' resistance risk and mode of action. 天然產物一直以來都是藥物先導化合物的重要來源。 抗生素耐藥性問題日趨嚴峻，而新抗生素開發卻大幅下降，嚴重威脅人類的健康。 應對嚴峻的抗生素耐葯問題，亟需開發新型抗生素的。 核糖體肽——核糖體合成和翻譯後修飾肽，是一種具有巨大應用潛力卻未經開發的“暗物質”。 到目前為止，已報導的核糖體肽達40多個家族，但仍有新家族不斷地被發現，例如，經S-腺苷甲硫氨酸自由基酶 修飾的核糖體肽（rSAM-modified RiPPs）。 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸自由基酶（radical S-adenosylmethionine， rSAM）是一類存在於多種核糖體肽家族的后修飾酶，能夠催化C-C、 C-S或C-O鍵交聯產生大環結構，從而賦予核糖體肽獨特的化學結構和生理特性。 本課題將開發新的基因組挖掘策略，高效靶向發現編碼核糖體肽的生物合成基因簇，並結合合成生物學策略 獲得目標基因簇編碼的核糖體肽; 從而獲得具有良好生物活性的抗生素先導化合物。 此研究主要有三個目標。 1）開發一種新基因組挖掘方法對核糖體肽進行系統地研究，該方法可以高通量地對編碼結構新穎、生物活性顯著的核糖體肽的生物合成基因簇進行系統分析和挖掘。 2）系統分析和挖掘微生物基因組大數據，以期獲得抑制多重耐藥性超級細菌的核糖體肽，包括但不限於rSAM修飾的RiPPs。 3）結合合成生物學策略（如體內酶學分析和BGCs的異源表達）將編碼核糖體肽的生物合成基因簇成功轉化為抗生素先導化合物。 通過基因挖掘和合成生物學策略聯用，對161，954個微生物基因組進行系統分析並挖掘其核糖體肽的 生物合成潛力，開發新型抗菌肽及研究其作用機理， 為解決抗生素耐藥性危機提供物質與理論基礎。

17115422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17115422.value: 傳達 2 型糖尿病的遺傳風險和可穿戴技術對超重或肥胖東亞個體的客觀測量行為結果的綜合影響。

17115422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17115422.value: Prof Au Yeung, Shiu Lun Ryan Dr Chan, King Chung Derwin Dr Chung, Hon-Yin Brian Dr Godino, Job Dr Multhaup, Michael
rows: Prof Au Yeung, Shiu Lun Ryan

17115422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17115422.value: 背景：鼓勵過重或肥胖人士維持健康的生活方式以預防 2 型糖尿病 (T2D) 具有挑戰性。運用遺傳風險溝通以及結合可穿戴設備的功能和行為改變理論，去激發持續的生活改變。 目的：提議的干預措施有兩個目標：確定 1) 傳達 2 型糖尿病 (T2D) 的遺傳風險的效果，以及 2) 利用可穿戴設備的步數目標和提示功能， 傳達T2D 遺傳風險，以及客觀測量過重或肥胖東亞人其中度至劇烈運動 (MVPA) 的效果。 方法：將總共355名40-60歲的過重或肥胖東亞後裔隨機分為三組之一：1個對照組和2個干預組。所有參與者都會收到一份健康生活的電子傳單，並使用 Fitbit 追踪器作為客觀活動監測設備。兩個干預組都將獲得 T2D 遺傳風險評估，但其中一個將額外使用兩個基於理論的可穿戴功能（例如，步數目標設置和提示）；步數目標將設置比基線平均步數高 10%，Fitbit 設備將在 Fitbit 屏幕上顯示提醒（例如，“還剩 150 步”），如果每小時未累積至少 250 步，Fitbit 設備則會震動。收集的血液樣本將用於估計 T2D 遺傳風險以及分析心臟代謝風險標誌物。 T2D 的遺傳風險將使用既定的估計程序根據 113 個 SNP（與東亞人的 T2D 相關）進行估計。還將在基線、干預後立即、干預後 12 個月和 6 個月隨訪時進行測量和問卷調查，收集自我報告的身體活動、飲食、吸煙和心理質素等信息。主要結果是客觀測量的 MVPA。將執行線性混合效應模型以分別檢查時間和組效應以及它們的相互作用項，然後通過包括遺傳風險水平在內的效應修飾符進行事後分析。 結論.通過為個性化遺傳風險信息和新興可穿戴技術的結合使用提供新的見解，研究結果將為行為改變預防 T2D 提供新的見解。

17116022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17116022.value: 鳳凰肽耦合垂體內IGF-I/-II信息對魚類垂體催乳素的自調節作用

17116022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17116022.value: 鳳凰肽 (PNX) 是一種由生物信息學首次鑑定並被證實是適配孤兒受體GPR173的多肽，也是一種新發現的下丘腦-垂體軸調控子。迄今為止，鳳凰肽的溶解結構及其與GPR173結合的分子相互作用是完全未知的，其於垂體中參與催乳素 (PRL) 調節亦未有被報導。在我們之前對草魚垂體細胞的研究中，PRL處理可以增加PRL轉錄本和PRL細胞含量，然而PRL免疫中和卻可誘導相反反應，這意味著局部釋放的PRL可以刺激草魚垂體PRL的合成。通過RNA-Seq檢測，PRL在草魚垂體細胞中可上調鳳凰肽、胰島素樣生長因子-I (IGF-I) 和胰島素樣生長因子-II (IGF-II) 的基因表達，表明鳳凰肽與IGF-I/-II是PRL於垂體內的調控目標。以草魚垂體細胞檢測PNX在PRL自調節中的作用, 我們的初步研究發現: (i) 鳳凰肽和GPR173的轉錄本和蛋白都在草魚垂体催乳素细胞中有所表達，(ii) 鳳凰肽處理可以提高PRL轉錄本水平、PRL分泌和PRL細胞含量，同時鳳凰肽免疫中和則可誘導相反效果，這些反應都是由cAMP/PKA和PLC/ IP3/Ca2+通路介導的，(iii) IGF-I/-II爲主胰島素為輔, 經MAPK與PI3K/Akt信號通路,可上調的鳳凰肽轉錄本，並且 (iv) PRL處理可增加IGF-I/-II, 鳳凰肽和PRL轉錄本的表達，而PRL免疫中和卻可抵消這些反應，同時PRL誘導的IGF-I/-II表達是由JAK2/ STATs通路介導的。我們的研究結果顯示草魚垂體中的PRL自調節可能具有自分泌/旁分泌成分，其中鳳凰肽更可能與垂體PRL誘導的IGF信號耦合。為了驗證我們的假設並填補我們研究中的空白，我們提議：(i) 建立草魚鳳凰肽的NMR 溶解結構，其將用於與草魚GPR173進行分子結合對接計算，(ii) 闡明 GPR173於鳳凰肽誘導PRL基因表達和蛋白產生/分泌的功能作用及其耦合受體信號傳導的分子機制，(iii) 揭示IGF-I/-II誘導鳳凰肽基因表達/蛋白產生的受體特異性（IGF-I /胰島素受體）與其中信號傳導的機制，以及（iv) 證實鳳凰肽和IGF-I/-II參與PRL自調節，並澂清PRL誘導鳳凰肽和IGF-I/-II表達的通路信號轉導。我們的研究將提供有關鳳凰肽與GPR173結合在分子結構上的新信息，並揭示於魚類垂體中PRL自分泌/旁分泌調節還未有被發現報導的新機理。

17116622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17116622.value: 探究I型干擾素誘導的脂質過氧化在CD8+ T細胞耗竭及腫瘤免疫治療耐受中的作用

17116622.label: Project Objectives
17116622.value: Investigate how chronic IFN-Is signaling triggers LPO in Tex cells Delineate how IFN-Is-induced LPO contributes to T cell exhaustion Evaluate the clinical significance of IFN-Is-LPO-Tex axis in immune checkpoint blockade therapy in HCC
rows: Investigate how chronic IFN-Is signaling triggers LPO in Tex cells
Delineate how IFN-Is-induced LPO contributes to T cell exhaustion
Evaluate the clinical significance of IFN-Is-LPO-Tex axis in immune checkpoint blockade therapy in HCC

17116622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17116622.value: 慢性炎症微環境中持久的抗原刺激會導致CD8+ T細胞出現耗竭，進而促進腫瘤免疫逃逸，囙此，靶向耗竭性T細胞以逆轉其功能的免疫檢查點阻斷（immune checkpoint blockade，ICB）治療在多種腫瘤的臨床治療上顯示出良好療效。 然而，現時的治療策略只能部分逆轉耗竭性T細胞的功能且僅有少數患者受益。 所以，深入理解腫瘤微環境（tumor microenvironment，TME）中的因數如何調控T細胞耗竭具有十分重要的臨床意義。 越來越多的證據表明异常的代謝狀態與T細胞功能异常呈顯著正相關，但觸發細胞出現代謝异常的原因及其分子基礎仍然未知。 囙此，闡明TME中慢性炎症訊號誘發异常的CD8+ T細胞代謝從而促使其走向耗竭的詳細分子機制是我們研究的總體目標。 我們首先將目光聚焦於在香港廣泛流行的腫瘤——肝細胞癌上。 通過深入挖掘肝細胞癌患者的單細胞轉錄組數據，我們發現，相比於腫瘤組織中具有正常殺傷功能的效應性CD8+ T細胞，耗竭性T細胞的I型干擾素（type I interferons，IFN-Is）刺激基因明顯上調。 緊接著，我們使用一種原發性肝細胞癌小鼠作為疾病模型以證實IFN-Is與T細胞耗竭性分化間的因果關係。 實驗結果顯示，腫瘤組織中因IFN-Is受體被特异性敲除而缺乏IFN-Is訊號刺激的CD8+ T細胞更不容易出現耗竭且能更好地抑制腫瘤生長。 同時，我們利用體外的耗竭性T細胞分化模型在人原代CD8+ T細胞上進一步驗證出IFN-Is能够對慢性抗原刺激下的CD8+ T細胞進行代謝重程式設計，誘導其發生有害的脂質過氧化（lipid peroxidation，LPO），進而促進其向終末耗竭性T細胞分化。 總的來說，我們的前期數據提出了一個在TME中高度富集的炎症因數IFN-Is通過調節代謝重編程繼而促進CD8+ T細胞耗竭的新假設。 該過程的分子機制是：IFN-Is通過引發細胞脂質代謝紊亂和過度的氧化應激，導致LPO，從而促進T細胞耗竭以降低ICB治療的療效。 在本研究方案中，我們將進一步揭示IFN-Is誘導LPO以加速CD8+ T細胞耗竭的詳細分子機制。 並且，我們還將在接受ICB治療的肝細胞癌患者中評估IFN-Is-LPO通路在臨床上的應用價值。 我們的研究將會發現針對慢性炎症的靶向CD8+ T細胞耗竭過程的全新檢查點，為開發新的免疫治療生物標誌物和藥物靶點奠定新的科學基礎。

17116822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17116822.value: 一項利用免疫檢查點抑製劑和放射栓塞治療於先前未經治療的轉移性肝細胞癌的 II 期研究

17116822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
