17116822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17116822.value: 肝細胞癌是香港第五大最常見的癌症，也是全球最常見的癌症之一。儘管由於靶向治療和免疫檢查點抑製劑的出現，轉移性肝細胞癌的總體生存率在過去十年中顯著提高，但由於無法治癒的性質，其長期生存率仍然很差。對於這些診斷時患有轉移性肝細胞癌的患者，仍然存在對更持久和有效治療的緊迫和未滿足的需求。 最近，不斷發展的證據表明，免疫檢查點抑製劑與放射治療配合良好，可產生協同抗腫瘤作用。現在，聯合免疫檢查點抑製劑與放射治療用於肝細胞癌進行了全面和廣泛的測試。至少在臨床前模型中假設和證明，放射栓塞可以增強免疫細胞的抗原呈遞能力，從而導致它們的激活和對腫瘤細胞的免疫監視，這最終將改善對腫瘤細胞的殺傷力。此外，越來越多的證據表明，有或沒有免疫檢查點抑製劑配合放射治療（體外或體內）可以產生甚至增強遠隔效應，其中遠離放射區域的腫瘤也顯示出顯著的縮小。引發遠隔效應的潛在機制包括腫瘤基質內骨髓細胞增加的抗原呈遞，從而導致增強的腫瘤細胞殺傷力。以前的病例報告表明，單獨的放射治療可以在小鼠和人體模型中引起遠隔效應。然而，仍然缺乏強有力和具體的證據證明免疫檢查點抑製劑和放射栓塞或外部放射治療在肝細胞中的遠隔效應。 我們正在提議一項關於使用免疫檢查點抑製劑和放射栓塞作為先前未治療的轉移性肝細胞癌的一線治療的第二期單臂研究。我們將於此研究進行一項關於使用放射栓塞後 Y90 正電子電腦掃瞄 (PET-CT) 圖像評估的 Y90 吸收劑量與使用商業劑量學導航軟件的三維 SPECT-CT 圖像和腫瘤客觀反應之間相關性的附帶研究，以確定是否存在預測腫瘤反應的劑量學參數。我們提出的研究可能會改善這些患者的腫瘤反應和可能的存活率，並為腫瘤對免疫檢查點抑製劑和放射栓塞反應的劑量學預測因素提供重要的見解。

17116922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17116922.value: 主動脈瓣膜狹窄（AS）是最為常見的瓣膜性心臟病，影響高達4%的全球人口。AS初期並不會引起症狀，但是隨著瓣葉逐漸受損，症狀便會開始浮現，導致不良預後。目前，主動脈瓣膜置換手術（AVR）為唯一有效的治療方式，可延長患者生存時間並改善生活品質。然而，當前未有任何藥物能夠防止左心室重構，延遲症狀發作或改善無症狀病人的長期預後。 AS的自然病程涉及兩個主要過程：（1）慢性炎症和（2）心肌重塑。AS患者具有較高的瓣膜或全身的炎症水平，導致主動脈瓣逐漸纖維化和鈣化。過往研究的確反映AS的程度及併發症與C 反應蛋白及促炎脫輔成基脂蛋白等炎症標誌物的水平相關。隨著瓣膜逐漸狹窄，心臟的負荷逐漸加重，引致左心室肥厚和纖維化，終而導致左心室擴大及功能障礙。至今，無症狀AS的炎症特徵及其與心肌結構改變的關係仍然未知。因此，在當前研究的第一階段，我們將描述無症狀AS患者的生物標記特徵，並分析其與心肌結構改變、纖維化和收縮的關聯。 鑑於當前AS缺乏藥物治療的問題，我們於第二階段旨在通過進行安慰劑對照隨機試驗評估鈉-葡萄糖協同轉運蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制劑的效用。SGLT2 抑製劑原為一種抗糖尿病藥物，但因其多樣性效應現已成為治療心衰患者的有效藥物。在心力衰竭動物模型中，SGLT2 抑製劑通過減少炎症和心肌纖維化展現其心臟保護作用。最近的臨床試驗亦表明SGLT2 抑製劑 empagliflozin 可提高心衰患者的生存率並降低心血管事件的風險。迄今為止，暫未有隨機研究評估 empagliflozin 是否能夠降低無症狀 AS 患者左心室肥厚、纖維化及功能障礙的風險。本研究推測empagliflozin 能通過其逆重構和抗炎作用減緩無症狀 AS 患者左室的不良重構，從而延遲患者對AVR的需要。

17117122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17117122.value: Homologous to other sarbecoviruses harbored in the bat species, SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 viruses are unique in their ability of crossing species barrier to infect and transmit among humans. While SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 both use the human angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 receptor for cell entry, these two viruses exhibit different replication kinetics at upper and lower respiratory tissues that leads to dissimilar clinical presentations. SARS-CoV patients are invariably symptomatic and mainly exhibit lower respiratory clinical signs, with peak viral load detected on day 10 post-symptom onset. On the other hand, COVID-19 patients exhibit a wide spectrum of clinical outcomes and manifest both upper and lower respiratory symptoms, with peak viral loads detected at the time of symptom onset. As a result, the use of public health interventions including case identification and isolation effectively averted the SARS-CoV pandemic in 2003, but the similar control measures were unable to stop the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. The distinct replication kinetics of SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 suggest that there are differential host responses driving viral pathogenesis and onward transmission potential. We hypothesize that SARS-CoV-2 may induce a stronger antiviral activity than SARS-CoV in airway epithelial cells to facilitate the rapid viral replication kinetics. Here, we aim to identify common and differential host responses elicited after SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 infection in human airway epithelial cells using single cell RNA sequencing. To further examine if differentially induced host responses in infected airway epithelial cells may further impact the subsequent paracrine response to immune cells recruited to the site of inflammation, host response will be analyzed in K18-hACE2 transgenic mice and Syrian hamsters that support efficient replication of both SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 viruses. Identifying common and differential host responses elicited by these two pandemic viruses will provide insights on viral pathogenesis mechanisms and will help us to assess the risk of other genetically homologous sarbecoviruses harboured in bat species. Specific effector pathways can be targeted for the development of immunomodulatory treatment. 與蝙蝠物種中攜帶的其他 sarbecovirus 同源，SARS-CoV 和 SARS-CoV-2 病毒具有獨特的能力跨越物種屏障以感染人類並且在人類之間傳播。雖然 SARS-CoV 和 SARS-CoV-2 都使用人類 ACE2 為受體以進入細胞，但這兩種病毒在上呼吸道和下呼吸道組織中表現出不同的複制動力學，從而導致不同的臨床表現。 SARS-CoV 患者主要表現出下呼吸道臨床症狀，並且在症狀出現後第 10 天檢測到病毒載量峰值。另一方面，COVID-19 患者的臨床表現範圍廣泛，表現出上呼吸道和下呼吸道症狀，並且在感染早期檢測到峰值病毒載量。因此，使用包括病例識別和隔離在內的公共衛生干預措施有效地避免了 2003 年的 SARS-CoV 大流行，然而類似的控制措施無法阻止COVID-19 大流行。 SARS-CoV 和 SARS-CoV-2 的不同複製動力學表明在病毒感染後可能引致不同的宿主反應，影響病毒發病機制和傳播的潛力。我們假設 SARS-CoV-2 可能在呼吸道上皮細胞中誘導比 SARS-CoV 更強的抗病毒活性，因此促進病毒的快速復制動力學。本研究的目標是使用單細胞 RNA 測序比較人類呼吸道上皮細胞中 SARS-CoV 和 SARS-CoV-2 感染後引起的共同和差異性宿主反應。為了進一步檢查受感染的呼吸道上皮細胞中差異誘導的宿主反應是否會進一步影響被激活的免疫細胞，本研究將分析K18-hACE2 轉基因小鼠和敘利亞倉鼠SARS-CoV 和 SARS-CoV-2 病毒感染後的宿主反應。了解這兩種病毒感染後引起的共同和差異性宿主反應將幫助我們評估蝙蝠物種中其他遺傳同源的 sarbecovirus 的大流行風險，並可以針對特定的宿主反應進行免疫調節治療的開發。

17117122.label: Realisation of objectives
17117122.value: Objective 1. To identify common and differential host responses in human bronchial epithelial and pneumocytes after infection with SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 Replication kinetics. Normal human bronchial epithelial cells (NHBE) (100,000 cells/ well) were differentiated into air-liquid interface and were infected with SARS-CoV (strain: HK39849) or prototype SARS-CoV-2 (strain: hCoV-19/Hong Kong/VM0001061/ 2020) at MOI of 0.5. N gene copies and infectious virus titer were determined from the apical side of the transwell and from cell lysates at 2h, 6h, 48h and 72h post-infection. SARS-CoV-2 showed more robust viral replication than SARS-CoV, with higher infectious viral titers detected at 48h and 72h. Host responses. Total RNA were extracted from NHBE cells using Trizol at 2h, 6h, 48h and 72h post-infection. Libraries were prepared using KAPA mRNA HyperPrep Kit and were sequenced on Novaseq 6000. The reads were mapped to the human genome assembly (GRCh38), with 33,673 genes mapped to 60,725 annotated genes. SARS-CoV-2 induced more robust host responses at 48h and 72h post-infection than SARS-CoV, with 4,065 and 2,184 DEGs (defined as |log2 Fold-change (FC)| > 1.5, false discovery rate (FDR) < 0.05) compared to mock-infected cells, respectively. SARS-CoV-2 also activated more genes related to innate immune responses (GO: 0002218), with specific pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) including TLR2, TLR3, RIG-I, MDA5, LGP2, CLEC7A, NOD1, NOD2, AIM2, IFI16, and ZBP1expressed to significantly higher levels than SARS-CoV infected cells at both 48h and 72h post-infection. SARS-CoV-2 induced higher IFN-beta than SARS-CoV at 48h and 72h. Overall achievement of the objective. This objective has been fully achieved. Objective 2. To compare replication kinetics, tropism, and host responses of SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 in K18-hACE2 transgenic mice. Replication kinetics. Female K18-hACE2 mice at 6-10 weeks old were intra-nasally inoculated with 1,000 PFU of SARS-CoV, prototype SARS-CoV-2, or mock-inoculated with PBS. Mouse lungs (left lobe) were collected on 1, 2, 5 days post-inoculation (dpi) to determine viral loads. Peak viral titers were detected at 5 dpi, with SARS-CoV-2 replicated to higher titers than SARS-CoV, although the differences were not statistically significant (2-way ANOVA). Host responses. Total RNA was extracted from the right inferior lobe of mice at 1, 2, 5 dpi for RNAseq.The reads were mapped to the mouse genome assembly (GRCm38), with a total of 31,749 genes mapped to the 48,526 annotated genes. Compared to mock-inoculated mice, SARS-CoV-2 induced 4,984 DEGs while SARS-CoV induced 969 DEGs. Majority of the DEGs were detected on 5 dpi of SARS-CoV-2 inoculated mice. SARS-CoV-2 significantly induced higher expression of specific PRRs than SARS-CoV on 2 dpi in the lungs of K18-hACE2 mice, including TLR7, RIG-I, MDA5, LGP2, IFI204, IFI205, and ZBP1. Overall achievement of the objective. This objective has been fully achieved. Objective 3. To compare replication kinetics, tropism, and host responses of SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 in Syrian hamsters. Transmissibility and replication kinetics. Male Syrian hamsters at 6-8 weeks old were intra-nasally inoculated with 100,000 TCID50 of SARS-CoV, prototype SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV-2 Omicron BA.1 (strain: hCoV-19/Hong Kong/VM21044713_HKUVOC0195P3/2021), or mock-inoculated with PBS. Viral loads were determined from nasal turbinates and left lung lobe at 1, 2, 5 dpi. In nasal turbinates, SARS-CoV-2 replicated more efficiently than SARS-CoV on 1 dpi, but both reached comparable titers on 2 and 5 dpi; Omicron BA.1 replicated to significantly lower titers than SARS-CoV or SARS-CoV-2 on 1 dpi. In the lungs, SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 replicated to comparable titers, while BA.1 showed inferior replication. SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 showed comparable airborne transmissibility to all naive hamsters while BA.1 showed limited transmission to 1 out of 3 naive hamsters. Host responses. Total RNA was extracted from the nasal turbinates or right cranial lobes at 1, 2, 5 dpi for RNAseq. The reads were mapped to the Syrian hamster genome assembly (BCM_Maur_2.0), with 27,804 genes and 25,764 genes mapped to the 36,157 annotated genes in nasal turbinates and lungs, respectively. In the nasal turbinates, SARS-CoV-2 induced more robust host response than SARS-CoV or BA.1, with 9,197, 7,865, and 2,718 DEGs detected when compared to mock, respectively. In particular, SARS-CoV-2 significantly induced higher expression of specific PRRs than SARS-CoV on 1 dpi in the nasal turbinates including TLR1, TLR2, TLR3, TLR4, TLR6, TLR7, TLR8, RIG-I, MDA5, LGP2, CLEC7a, CLEC4e, CLEC4n, NOD1, NOD2, NLRP3, NLRP6, NLRC4, AIM2 and ZBP1. In the lungs, SARS-CoV-2 consistently induced more robust host response than SARS-CoV or BA.1, with 7,831, 5,523, and 1,188 DEGs detected when compared to mock, respectively. Despite of comparable viral load, SARS-CoV-2 induced earlier response than SARS-CoV at 1 dpi, including genes related to innate immune response. SARS-CoV-2 significantly induced higher expression of specific PRRs than SARS-CoV on 1 dpi in the lungs, including TLR2, TLR6, TLR7, RIG-I, MDA5, LGP2, CLEC7a, CLEC4e, NOD2, NLRP3, NLRC4, and ZBP1. Collectively, the results showed that SARS-CoV-2 induced earlier and more robust host responses than SARS-CoV in both upper and lower respiratory tract. Innate sensors, including TLR2, TLR6, TLR7, RIG-I, MDA5, LGP2, CLEC7a, CLEC4e, NOD2, NLRP3, NLRC4, and ZBP1 were consistently expressed at significantly higher levels in SARS-CoV-2 than in SARS-CoV inoculated hamsters on 1 dpi, which warrants further in vitro and in vivo validation. Overall achievement of the objective. This objective has been fully achieved.

17117122.label: Major findings and research outcome
17117122.value: We compared replication kinetics and host response induced in human normal bronchial epithelial cells (NHBE), mouse lungs, and Syrian hamster nasal and lung tissues after SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 infection. SARS-CoV-2 replicated more efficiently than SARS-CoV in NHBE and mouse lungs and induced more robust host antiviral responses, including significantly upregulated specific pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) associated with interferon induction. SARS-CoV-2 and SARS-CoV replicated to more comparable titers in Syrian hamsters and both viruses showed comparable airborne transmission potential to naïve hamsters. Despite of comparable replication in Syrian hamsters, SARS-CoV-2 induced earlier and more robust antiviral host response than SARS-CoV in the nasal turbinates and in the lungs. In particular, SARS-CoV-2 significantly induced higher expression of specific PRRs than SARS-CoV on 1 dpi in both nasal turbinates and the lungs, including TLR2, TLR6, TLR7, RIG-I, MDA5, LGP2, CLEC7a, CLEC4e, NOD2, NLRP3, NLRC4, and ZBP1. We identified shared innate sensors that may facilitate an earlier induction of type I interferon antiviral responses after SARS-CoV-2 infection than SARS-CoV in different hosts. Our results also suggest that specific viral protein encoded by SARS-CoV may have facilitated evasion of innate sensing than SARS-CoV-2. Elucidating these virus-specific immune evasion mechanisms may uncover novel therapeutic targets to promote early antiviral immunity and restrict viral replication. Draft manuscript has been written and will be submitted for peer review.

17117122.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17117122.value: In this study, we have identified common innate sensors that may facilitate an earlier induction of type I interferon antiviral responses after SARS-CoV-2 infection than SARS-CoV in different hosts. With in vitro and in vivo validation of the effect of these innate sensors, targets for host response modulators may be identified. Our results also suggest that specific viral protein encoded by SARS-CoV may have facilitated evasion of innate sensing than SARS-CoV-2. Elucidating these virus-specific immune evasion mechanisms may uncover novel therapeutic targets to promote early antiviral immunity and restrict viral replication.

17117122.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17117122.value: Genetically related SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 exhibited distinct replication dynamics in the respiratory tissues that leads to different clinical presentations and onward transmission potential in humans. We compared replication kinetics and host response induced in human normal bronchial epithelial cells, mouse lungs, and Syrian hamster nasal and lung tissues after SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 infection. SARS-CoV-2 replicated more efficiently than SARS-CoV in NHBE and mouse lungs, induced more robust host antiviral response, and upregulated specific pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) associated with interferon induction. SARS-CoV-2 and SARS-CoV replicated to more comparable titers in Syrian hamsters with comparable airborne transmission potential to naïve hamsters. Regardless, SARS-CoV-2 induced earlier and more robust antiviral host response than SARS-CoV. In particular, SARS-CoV-2 significantly induced higher expression of PRRs than SARS-CoV on 1 dpi in both nasal turbinates and the lungs. Our findings identify shared innate sensors that enable faster type I interferon responses to SARS-CoV-2. Conversely, certain SARS-CoV-encoded proteins appear to more effectively evade early innate detection than their SARS-CoV-2 counterparts. Elucidating these virus-specific immune evasion mechanisms may uncover novel therapeutic targets to promote early antiviral immunity and restrict viral replication.

17117922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17117922.value: Climate change is driving a global redistribution of biodiversity that will have major consequences for humanity and the environment. However, the detection and attribution of climate-driven species redistribution is relatively poorly developed in subtropical and tropical ecosystems. In Hong Kong, recent arrivals of new butterfly species (at least 38 recorded since 2000), many with largely tropical distributions, has led to speculation that tropicalization as a consequence of climate change may be occurring to the ecological community. Alternative explanations are possible in that significant land cover changes, mainly increases in urbanization and forest succession, have also taken place in recent years. Finally, changing host plant distributions and usage are also potential pathways that have facilitated distribution shifts. This study will investigate possible climatic, habitat, and host plant mechanisms that have enabled the establishment of butterflies in Hong Kong. We will employ species distribution models and lab-based techniques to quantify thermal tolerance and preference of both pre-2000 and post-2000 butterflies, to determine the extent that increases in climatic suitability may have led to butterfly persistence. We will also use remote sensing (both LiDAR and Landsat) to look at changes in forest cover and urbanization extent over recent decades. Using these high-resolution spatial datasets, we’ll quantify associations between newly established butterfly species and habitat quality (both forest and urban habitats) to assess the validity of habitat change as a driver of species redistribution. We’ll also run similar models and spatial analyses of host plant species associated with post-2000 butterflies. Exotic host plant species associated with urban environments may also play a key role in the establishment of some newly established butterflies. We will test larval preference through implementation of dual-choice trials (of exotic and native host plants) to see whether post-2000 species use exotic species more readily than pre-2000 species. By holistically testing hypotheses of species redistribution associated with a rapidly changing butterfly community, this research will serve as a means of understanding how climate change (in concert with other environmental changes) is impacting biodiversity in the diverse subtropics and tropics. The results will have direct management implications for Hong Kong’s insect biodiversity and will inform regional and global efforts aiming to conserve tropical biodiversity under global change. 氣候變化可以改變全球物種分布，為人類和環境帶來重大影響。然而，在熱帶和亞熱帶地區，生態系統內的物種分布轉變未有足夠紀錄，也未能有效歸因於氣候變化。香港近年有很多新蝴蝶物種紀錄 (自2000年起有38種)，當中很多主要分布於熱帶地區。關於箇中的原因，其中一個推測是氣候變化令香港的生態群落變得更為熱帶。但近年大規模的土地利用改變，包括城市化發展和森林演替進程，也可能導致蝴蝶群落轉變。再者，寄主植物的分布和蝴蝶對寄主物的使用也可能是影響蝴蝶分布轉變的因素。 這項研究將從氣候變化、生境改變，和寄主植物幾個方向，探討香港近年蝴蝶群落轉變的原因。我們會使用物種分布電腦模型，和溫度耐受性和溫度偏好實驗，研究香港日漸改變的氣候有否令環境更適合熱帶物種生活，從而導致2000年前後顯著的蝴蝶群落轉變。我們也會以高解像度的遙測數據 (例如光學雷達和 Landsat陸地衛星圖像)，比較數十年來城市和森林覆蓋率的變化，了解新近到達的蝴蝶物種與城市和樹林生境質素的關係，繼而探討生境改變引致蝴蝶分布轉變的可能性。我們亦會透過電腦模型和空間分析，探視新紀錄蝴蝶物種的寄主植物分布；並會進行蝴蝶幼蟲食性偏好實驗，提供原生和外來植物供幼蟲選擇，測試2000年後才出現的蝴蝶物種幼蟲會否更易接受外來食草，以了解市區栽種的外來寄主植物有否有助蝴蝶紮根於此。通過全面探討各項可能影響蝴蝶物種分布的因素，這項研究將有助我們認識氣候變化和其他環境轉變如何衝擊熱帶和亞熱帶地區的多樣生態，並提供數據支持地區和全球的研究及保育行動，為保育熱帶生物多樣性帶來直接保育效益。

17118322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17118322.value: Ovarian cancer is one of the commonest gynaecological cancers. Despite the best treatment available, the prognosis is poor. Immunotherapy with programmed cell death 1 (PD-1) or PD-ligand 1 immune checkpoint blockade (ICBs) has been very promising in the treatment of many cancers, including some gynaecological cancers such as endometrial or cervical cancers, the benefit in ovarian cancer is surprisingly low. The highly immunosuppressive microenvironment in ovarian cancer, consisting of inhibitory ligands, suppressive mediators, and cell subsets, leads to CD8+ T cell dysfunction and exhaustion, and contributes to the limited efficacy of immunotherapeutic approaches. Our recent study revealed pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 1 impairs CD8+ T cell function. Chemokines affect T cell infiltration into tumours and impact on patient survival. CXCL10 is a chemokine mainly secreted by monocytes and fibroblasts. A recent study using single-cell sequencing showed that CXCL10 expressed in cancer cells was involved in ICBs therapy. This prompted us to investigate the function and regulatory mechanisms of CXCL10 derived from ovarian cancer on CD8+ T cell antitumor immunity. Our pilot data found that CXCL10 and its receptor CXCR3 had a strong positive correlation with exhausted T cell signature genes in patients with most solid cancers including ovarian cancer, but not in normal ovarian tissues. By multiplex immunohistochemistry, we further demonstrated that CXCL10 expression on tumor cells positively correlated with PD-1(an exhaustion marker)hiCD8+ T cells in ovarian clinical samples. Importantly, we found that CD8+ T cell exhaustion was induced by CXCL10 activation by CRISPRa from ovarian cancer cells, probably through CXCR3-JAK-STAT signaling, whereas inhibition by CRISPRi restored CD8+ T cell function. We hypothesize that CXCL10 derived from ovarian cancer contributes to CD8+ T cell antitumor immunity by regulating CD8+ T cell exhaustion. Targeting CXCL10 may help to overcome the low response rate to current immunotherapy strategies in ovarian cancer. We propose (1) in vitro and in vivo investigations of how tumor-derived CXCL10 leads to T cells exhaustion; (2) to clarify which signaling pathways mediate such effects; and (3) to explore the role of CXCL10 on the response to ICBs in ovarian cancer mouse model. Our results will advance our understanding of the low response rate of immunotherapy in ovarian cancer and explore the potential mechanism underlying the induction of CD8+ T cell exhaustion in the tumor microenvironment. We will also examine the possibility of cancer immunotherapy based on tumor-derived CXCL10 blockade either alone or combined with ICB in ovarian cancer. 卵巢癌是最常見的婦科癌症之一。 由於發病隱匿且缺乏有效的治療手段，病人預後很差。 程序性細胞死亡受體1 （PD-1） 或 PD-1配體（PD-L1）免疫檢查點阻斷 （ICBs） 的免疫療法在治療包括子宮內膜癌及宮頸癌在內的多種癌症方面具有廣闊的應用前景，但對卵巢癌治療收效甚微。 新近研究表明，卵巢癌中的免疫抑制細胞，抑制性細胞因數和配體等組成的高免疫抑制腫瘤微環境，導致 CD8+ T 細胞功能障礙（dysfunction）和耗竭（exhaustion ），使得免疫治療方法的療效有限。 我們最近的研究發現卵巢癌中丙酮酸脫氫酶激酶 （PDK1）的上調損害CD8+ T細胞功能。 有研究表明趨化因數（chemokines）可影響 T 細胞在腫瘤中的浸潤進而影響患者的生存。 CXCL10是一種主要由單核細胞和成纖維細胞分泌的趨化因數。 最近研究報導，通過單細胞測序發現在腫瘤細胞中表達的 CXCL10 與ICBs治療的反應率密切相關。 因此，本研究中，我們深入探討了卵巢癌來源的CXCL10對CD8+ T細胞抗腫瘤免疫功能的影響和相關的分子調控機制。 前期數據發現，在包括卵巢癌在內的大多數實體瘤中，CXCL10 及其受體 CXCR3的高表達與T 細胞耗竭基因集的表達呈正相關，但在正常卵巢組織中無顯著相關性。 通過多重免疫組織化學技術（mIHC），我們進一步在卵巢癌臨床樣本中證明了腫瘤細胞中 CXCL10 的表達與PD-1高表達的CD8+ T 細胞浸潤呈正相關。 重要的是，我們通過CRISPRa 啟動系統上調卵巢癌細胞中CXCL10的表達，發現CXCL10通過 CXCR3-JAK-STAT 信號軸誘導 CD8+ T 細胞耗竭; 相反地，利用CRISPRi 抑制系統下調卵巢癌細胞CXCL10的表達恢復了CD8+ T細胞的抗腫瘤免疫應答 。 基於這些發現，我們假設卵巢癌細胞來源的 CXCL10 參與了 CD8+ T細胞耗竭所致的抗腫瘤功能障礙。 靶向CXCL10有助於提升目前卵巢癌免疫治療策略的反應率。 我們的目標是（1） 在體外和體內實驗中研究卵巢癌細胞來源的 CXCL10 與T 細胞衰竭的關係; （2） 闡明CXCL10介導CD8+ T細胞耗竭的相關分子通路和機制; （3）探討在小鼠原位卵巢癌模型中CXCL10的表達對ICBs應答的影響 。 我們的研究結果不僅增強我們從腫瘤微環境角度對卵巢癌免疫治療低反應率的理解，而且為後續開發基於CXCL10 的全新靶向免疫聯合治療策略開發提供前期實驗基礎和科學依據。

17118322.label: Realisation of objectives
17118322.value: Objective 1: 1.1 Assessment of CXCL10 expression in cancer cells and correlation with T cell exhaustion signatures in clinical samples (please refer to the attached manuscript’s Fig. 1 and Supp Fig. 1). 1.1.1. To investigate the association between CXCL10 and CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion, we first analyzed datasets from TCGA and GTEx. Tumor tissues exhibited higher CXCL10 expression compared to normal tissues in ovarian cancer. Bulk RNA-seq further revealed strong positive correlations between CXCL10/CXCR3 expressions and established T-cell exhaustion signature genes. This correlation was absent in normal ovarian tissues, highlighting the tumor-specific role of CXCL10/CXCR3 signaling in promoting CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion. 1.1.2. We further analyzed scRNA-seq data from ovarian cancer patients and found that tumor cell expression of CXCL10 strongly correlated with elevated expressions of exhaustion-related genes in tumor infiltrating CD8⁺ T cells, suggesting an important role of CXCL10 in T-cell exhaustion within ovarian tumors. 1.1.3. mIHC on ovarian cancer tissue arrays confirmed these findings at the protein level. We found both elevated mean CXCL10 expression and a higher percentage of CXCL10-positive cells in tumor samples, when compared to adjacent normal tissues. Importantly, elevated CXCL10 expression was spatially associated with CD8⁺ T cells expressing exhaustion markers PD-1 and LAG3, concurrently with reduced levels of the progenitor marker TCF-1, indicating a shift towards terminal exhaustion phenotypes. Together, these results established an association between elevated tumor derived CXCL10 expression and CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion in ovarian cancer. 1.2. In vitro studies-exploring the role of tumor-derived CXCL10 on CD8+ T cell exhaustion (Fig. 2 and Supp Fig. 2). 1.2.1. To clarify whether CXCL10 directly induced exhaustion or altered intrinsic tumor properties, we generated CXCL10 knockout ovarian cancer cell lines using CRISPR-Cas9. CXCL10 deletion did not alter tumor cell proliferation, colony formation, migration or invasion capacity in vitro, nor did it influence tumor growth in NOD SCID immunodeficient mice. These results further supported that CXCL10 did not affect tumor cell-intrinsic growth or progression. 1.2.2. Next, we examined the direct immunosuppressive effects of tumor derived CXCL10 on CD8⁺ T cells, using an in vitro exhausted development assay. Activated CD8⁺ T cells cultured in tumor-conditioned medium (TCM) with induced CXCL10 exhibited elevated expression of exhaustion markers PD-1, LAG3, TIGIT, and TIM3. Functional assays confirmed that these cells displayed an impaired ability to co-produce effector cytokines IFN-γ and TNF-α. These results supported that tumor-secreted CXCL10 directly induced terminal exhaustion in CD8⁺ T cells. 1.3 In vivo study (Fig. 3 and Supp Fig. 3). 1.3.1. To determine the functional impact of CXCL10 mediated CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion on tumor progression in vivo, we first utilized the subcutaneous B16F10-OVA melanoma model treated with anti-CXCL10 antibody, FTY720 (to inhibit lymphocyte trafficking), or combination therapy. Anti-CXCL10 treatment significantly suppressed tumor growth, when compared to controls or FTY720 alone, with the greatest tumor control achieved using combination treatment. Using adoptive transfer of antigen-specific CD45.1 OT-I CD8⁺ T cells showed similar effects. 1.3.2. To further verify the contributions of tumor-derived CXCL10 in CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion, we orthotopically injected ovarian cancer ID8 CXCL10-WT or CXCL10-KO cells into C57BL/6J mice. Genetic deletion of CXCL10 exhibited significantly reduced tumor growth and enhanced CD8⁺ T cell activation, when compared to CXCL10-WT tumors. Objective 2: 2.1. Verify CXCL10 role in CD8 T cell exhaustion is via CXCR3 receptor (Fig. 2I-J). We isolated CD8⁺ T cells from wild-type and CXCR3 knockout mice and exposed them to CXCL10-rich TCM. Flow cytometry analysis confirmed the absence of CXCR3 expression in cells from knockout mice. Notably, CXCR3-deficient CD8⁺ T cells exhibited reduced expression of the inhibitory receptor PD-1 and elevated production of effector cytokines IFN-γ and TNF-α compared to wild-type cells, indicating attenuated exhaustion in response to CXCL10 exposure. 2.2. Explore the signaling pathways by which CXCL10 mediated T cell exhaustion (Fig. 4). We first developed an orthotopic ovarian cancer mouse model by inoculating ID8 Cxcl10-WT and Cxcl10-KO cells into the ovary bursa. RNA-Seq analysis revealed a significant decrease in dual-specificity phosphatase 10 (Dusp10) in the Cxcl10-KO group compared to Cxcl10-WT. To further elucidate the mechanism underlying these effects, we performed single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) of tumor-infiltrating CD45⁺ immune cells and CD45⁻ cells isolated from orthotopic ovarian cancer mouse models established with ID8-Trp53⁻/⁻ CXCL10-WT and CXCL10-KO tumor cells. CXCL10 deletion markedly reduced the terminally exhausted CD8⁺ T cell subset, characterized by lower expression of exhaustion markers (Pdcd1, Havcr2, Lag3, Tigit, Tox), and significantly enriched progenitor-like, activated CD8⁺ T cells expressing Tcf7, Ifng, and Tnfa. Pathway enrichment analyses of CD45⁻ tumor cells revealed upregulation of the interferon gamma response in CXCL10-KO tumors, indicative of enhanced anti-tumor signaling. In CD8⁺ T cells from CXCL10-KO models, we observed metabolic reprogramming toward improved oxidative phosphorylation, alongside reduced IL-2-STAT5 signaling, suggesting enhanced metabolic fitness that underpins restored effector function. Objective 3: 3.1. Establish orthotopic ovarian cancer with ID8-CXCL10ko and ID8-wildtype ovarian cancer cell line in C57BL/6J mouse models (Fig. 3). We established clinically relevant orthotopic ovarian cancer model. Mice bearing ID8 CXCL10-KO tumors displayed significantly suppressed primary tumor growth, reduced metastatic dissemination to the omentum and intestine, diminished ascites formation, improved in the survival of mice, and fewer exhausted CD8⁺ T cells, when compared to CXCL10-WT tumors. These results demonstrated that CXCL10 derived from tumor cells critically promoted CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion and tumor progression, indicating CXCL10 as a promising therapeutic target to restore anti-tumor immunity. 3.2. Combination of anti-CXCL10 antibody and anti-PD-1 therapy (Fig. 5) Finally, we evaluated therapeutic synergy between CXCL10 blockade and anti-PD-1 therapy using an orthotopic metastatic peritoneal implantation model. Combined anti-PD-1 and anti-CXCL10 treatment profoundly reduced tumor burden and inhibited metastatic dissemination to key ovarian cancer metastatic sites, including the omentum and intestine, reduced ascites formation, highlighting effective control of advanced metastatic disease. These findings demonstrated that dual blockade of CXCL10 and PD-1 synergistically enhanced anti-tumor immunity, leading to superior control of metastatic ovarian cancer and improved therapeutic outcomes.

17118322.label: Major findings and research outcome
17118322.value: Major findings included: 1. Tumor-derived CXCL10 induced terminal exhaustion of CD8⁺ T cells in ovarian cancer, correlating strongly with an immunosuppressive microenvironment. Analysis of TCGA and single-cell RNA-seq data showed high tumor CXCL10 levels linked to T cell exhaustion. mIHC revealed CXCL10-rich areas contained CD8⁺ T cells expressing exhaustion markers with lower progenitor marker. 2. Blocking CXCL10 reduced CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion, restored effector function, and significantly suppressed ovarian tumor growth and metastasis. In vitro studies demonstrated that tumor-secreted CXCL10 induced CD8⁺ T cell exhaustion by increasing inhibitory receptors, TOX expression, and reducing TCF-1, impairing cytokine production. Deleting CXCL10 reversed these exhaustion features. In vivo models demonstrated that deletion of CXCL10 reduced tumor growth, metastasis, ascites, and improved survival of mice, which depended on restored CD8⁺ T cell function, with decreased exhaustion markers and improved cytokine production. 3. CXCL10 knockout reshaped intratumoral immune profiles, enhancing metabolic fitness and functionality of CD8⁺ T cells within ovarian tumors. Single cell transcriptomics revealed extensive remodeling of the intratumoral immune landscape upon CXCL10 deletion, characterized by reduced exhausted CD8⁺ T cells and enhanced effector T cells expressing elevated IFN-γ and TNF-α. 4. Targeted CXCL10 blockade synergistically enhanced anti-PD-1 therapy, providing a promising strategy to overcome immunotherapy resistance in ovarian cancer. We showed that CXCL10 blockade combined with anti-PD-1 therapy synergistically controlled tumors and reduced metastasis in ovarian cancer models. All these findings suggested that targeting the CXCL10 axis sensitized resistant tumors to checkpoint inhibitors by rescuing terminally exhausted T cells. Research outcome: 1. This work was presented as a poster presentation in the AACR Annual Meeting 2023 at Orlando, FL in 2023. Dr Long Runying has received 2023 AACR SCHOLAR-IN-TRAINING AWARD. 2. This work was also presented as an Elevator Pitch of E-Poster in the Hong Kong International Oncology Conference (HKIOF) 2025. 3. A manuscript based on the present findings titled ‘Targeting CXCL10 Reverses CD8+ T Cell Exhaustion to Enhance Anti-PD-1 Therapy in Ovarian Cancer” is attached with this report, which will be submitted to Cancer Research in the coming month. 4. A PhD student, Dr. Long Runying, has completed her training and graduated with an "excellent (top 10%)" thesis. She also received the Dissertation Year Fellowship.

17118322.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17118322.value: 1. While our study highlighted the immunosuppressive role of tumor-derived CXCL10, it is important to acknowledge the potential contributions from other cellular sources, including stromal cells and myeloid populations, such as tumor-associated macrophages. Future studies should delineate the relative contributions of these cell types. Additionally, longitudinal studies are necessary to map dynamic transitions from progenitor to terminal exhaustion states, particularly during immunotherapeutic interventions. 2. Validation of these findings using patient-derived CD8⁺ T cells are necessary to confirm translational relevance and provide possible clinical applications. Stratification of patients based on CXCL10 expression or TCF-1⁺ CD8⁺ T cell abundance could potentially predict responsiveness to CXCL10-targeted therapies or immune checkpoint inhibitors. 3. Moreover, our single-cell data also suggested that CXCL10 modulated the T cell metabolic state, which is a promising area for deeper mechanistic and therapeutic investigations.

17118322.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17118322.value: This research focuses on understanding why some ovarian cancers do not respond well to immunotherapy, a treatment that helps the immune system fight cancer. We found that a molecule called CXCL10 plays a key role in making immune cells, specifically CD8+ T cells, become exhausted and less effective at attacking tumors. When these T cells are exhausted, they can’t produce the signals needed to destroy cancer cells, which allows the tumor to grow and spread. The study showed that high levels of CXCL10 in the tumor environment cause T cells to become tired and less capable of fighting the cancer. Importantly, by blocking CXCL10, T cell function in mice with ovarian cancer was restored. Combining this with existing immunotherapy drugs improved the ability to control tumors. These findings suggest that targeting CXCL10 could make immunotherapy more effective in ovarian cancer patients, especially those resistant to current treatments. Overall, this research offers a promising new approach to overcome immune resistance, potentially leading to better outcomes for women battling this challenging disease.

17118522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17118522.value: Hypertension is a common cardiovascular disease which is associated with endothelial dysfunction. It promotes the occurrence of thrombosis and vascular inflammation, and hence the development of more severe clinical conditions of atherosclerosis. In the COVID-19 era, hypertension also appears to be a risk factor for increased severity and mortality rate of the coronavirus infection, the initiating event of which involves binding of the coronavirus with angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) isoform 2. During hypertension, angiotensin II signaling is activated; this in turn stimulates the production of ouabain. Ouabain is also a cardiac glycoside with sodium/potassium-ATPase (Na/K-ATPase)-inhibiting activity. A previous study demonstrates that endogenous ouabain is responsible for the upregulation in the heart and brain of angiotensin type 1 receptor and ACE following myocardial infarction. In our preliminary studies in isolated rat aortae, ouabain inhibited endothelium-dependent relaxation to arachidonic acid, which is a major vasoactive mediator in the angiotensin II signaling; however, when the major endothelium-derived vasodilator signals, nitric oxide and endothelium-dependent hyperpolarization, are inhibited it enhanced arachidonic acid-induced relaxations. These findings suggest that ouabain interferes with angiotensin signaling at multiple sites, and its influence is different under different conditions. The present proposal aims to identify the impact of cardiac glycosides, focusing on ouabain, on the vascular actions of angiotensin II under conditions without and with risk factors for cardiovascular complications, namely hypertension and hyperlipidemia [induced, respectively, in rats by long-term inhibition of nitric oxide synthase and in mice with apolipoprotein E-deficiency fed high fat diet]. The effects of ouabain on angiotensin signaling will be assessed in conduit and resistance arteries with reference to changes in vascular tone, inflammatory responses and vascular remodeling [by measuring isometric tension, levels of vasoactive/inflammatory mediators and fibrotic markers, and mRNA/protein levels and activities of the enzymes involved in angiotensin and arachidonic acid signaling pathways]. The effects of exogenous ouabain will be compared with those of endogenous ouabain [induced by long-term treatment with angiotensin II and confirmed by measuring the plasma level of ouabain]. In order to determine the mechanisms, the effects of ouabain will be examined in cultured human aortic endothelial and smooth muscle cells, without and with the knockdown of selective signaling molecules including Na/K-ATPase. The findings of the present proposal will provide additional information on the benefit and risk of the clinical use of cardiac glycosides (digoxin), and determine the potentials of ouabain as a biomarker to predict increased risk/severity of cardiovascular diseases. 高血壓是一種常見的心血管疾病，與內皮功能障礙密切相關。它促使血栓形成和血管炎症，從而導致更嚴重的動脈粥樣硬化。它同時也可能是增加感染新冠狀病毒後肺炎的嚴重程度和死亡率的危險因素。冠狀病毒感染涉及冠狀病毒與血管緊張素轉換酶 (ACE) 亞型2 的結合。在高血壓下，血管緊張素 II 信號被激活， 從而刺激了哇巴因的生產。哇巴因是一種強心苷，具有抑制鈉/鉀-ATP 酶 (Na/K-ATPase) 活性的特性。有研究發現，由心肌梗塞引致的內源性哇巴因，上調了心臟和大腦中血管緊張素 1 型受體和 ACE 的表達。我們在大鼠主動脈中的初步研究中發現，哇巴因抑制了花生四烯酸誘導的內皮依賴性舒張。花生四烯酸是血管緊張素 II 信號傳導中的其中一個主要血管活性介質。 然而，在主要的內皮源性血管擴張信號 - 即一氧化氮和內皮依賴性超極化 - 受到抑制的情況下，哇巴因反而增強花生四烯酸誘導的血管舒張作用。這些結果表明哇巴因可從多個方向干擾血管緊張素信號傳導，且其影響在不同情況下有所不同。本提案旨在確定哇巴因作為強心苷之一對血管緊張素 II血管作用的影響，並探討其影響在沒有和有心血管併發症危險因素 - 即高血壓和高脂血症 - 下有否不同。在高血壓大鼠 [通過長期抑制一氧化氮合酶建立] 和高脂血症小鼠 [通過給予高脂肪食物餵養載脂蛋白E基因敲除小鼠建立] 導管和阻力動脈檢測哇巴因對血管緊張素誘導的血管張力變化、炎症反應和血管重塑的影響 [通過測量等長張力、血管活性/炎症介質和纖維化標誌物的水平，以及血管緊張素和花生四烯酸信號通路酶的mRNA/蛋白質水平和活性] ，分別與在正常大鼠和小鼠組相比，從而評估哇巴因對血管緊張素信號傳導在不同情況下的影響。這些外源性哇巴因的影響將與內源性哇巴因的作用相比 [通過長期給予血管緊張素 II刺激內源性哇巴因的產生，並測量哇巴因的血漿水平確認] 。通過檢查哇巴因在選擇性敲除某些信號分子 - 包括 Na/K-ATPase - 的人主動脈內皮細胞和平滑肌細胞中的作用，與在正常細胞相比，從而揭示哇巴因的作用機制。本提案的研究結果將提供更多有關強心苷臨床使用（地高辛）的益處和風險，並判斷哇巴因作為預測心血管疾病風險/嚴重程度的生物標誌潛在的可能性。

17118822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17118822.value: 關於適應度有力的定義: 於極端環境中抑制新陳代謝是物競天擇的目標嗎？

17118822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17118822.value: 大規模死亡事件（Mass mortality events; MMEs）是對生物多樣性的一個主要威脅。這些事件代表著快速的人口災難，可以在全球範圍內重塑生命的生態和進化動態。MMEs可以作為發生極端環境事件時（Extreme environmental events; EEEs）如風暴、洪水、乾旱、熱浪的直接後果，它們的協同作用會產生深刻而持久的生態進化影響。EEEs和MMEs之間的相互作用可以改變自然選擇的強度和方向，促使種群迅速減少，喪失表型和遺傳的多樣性，局部滅絕，以及群落結構和功能的變化。 最終，MMEs和EEEs的綜合影響可以破壞基本的生態系統服務，並產生重大的生態和社會經濟影響。這一點在全世界的沿海生態系統中都有明確的記錄，在過去的幾十年中，MMEs和EEEs在頻率和程度上都呈現出積極的趨勢。這些動態變化是否影響著沿海海洋物種的當代進化？ 在這個項目中，我們用熱帶岩岸和潮間帶物種作為研究系統來解答這個基本問題。岩岸是地球上最極端的、壓力最大的、溫度變化最大的生境之一。生活在這些棲息地的物種被預測為對MMEs特別敏感，因為日益增加EEEs（如熱浪）的發生頻率和嚴重程度，可以把它們推到其熱極限之外。然而，一些潮間帶物種已經進化出一種基本的生理適應性，使它們能夠通過進入低代謝狀態來承受持續的熱應力、乾燥和缺氧（低潮條件）。這種生理適應可能會幫助潮間帶生物減輕環境影響的負面影響。由於代謝抑制的能力在自然種群中顯示出高度的個體間變異，我們假設這種變異在EEEs期間支撐著生存（適應度）的差異，因此這種生理特徵將成為物競天擇的目標。 在這個項目中，我們整合了進化和生態生理學的方法來。(i) 解開確定性季節性和隨機性EEEs對熱帶潮間帶外生動物中與溫度有關的MMEs的角色及影響（目標1）；(ii) 評估棲息地和/或特定性別特徵對代謝抑制的變化以及與其他性狀的表型共變（潛在制約因素）有多大影響（目標2）。(iii) 確定EEEs和MMEs作為物競天擇的媒介對熱帶潮間帶外生動物的表型可塑性和代謝抑制能力變化的影響（目標3）。研究結果將對極端環境中生命的微觀進化動態以及對MMEs和EEEs的反應形成新的認識。

17119022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17119022.value: 人源複製起始位點DNA打開的機制研究

17119022.label: Project Objectives
17119022.value: Unravel the molecular mechanism of the initial DNA melting by hMCM-DH prior to helicase activation How hMCM-DH melts one base-pair of DNA bound in its central DNA binding channel is yet to be fully understood. In the hMCM-DH structure, two pairs of zinc finger (ZF) motifs from Mcm5 and Mcm2 make contacts with the melted bases and the sugar-phosphate backbone of the nucleotides around the melting point. In addition, three layers of internal hairpin loops from each hexamer also grip DNA tightly. In this study, we will determine the detailed roles of these structural elements in regulating the coordinated movement of MCM rings to untwist duplex DNA for the initial melting. To understand the nature of DNA elements selected by hMCM-DH for initial melting, we will also extract the melted DNA fragments (~55 bp) bound by hMCM-DH for deep sequencing to map the DH binding sites and initial DNA melting points across human genome at single nucleotide resolution. Examine the effect of the initial DNA melting by hMCM-DH on subsequent origin firing We believe that the initial melting of DNA by hMCM-DH, prior to helicase activation, paves the way for further melting of origin DNA and subsequent strand separation at a later stage during origin firing. In this objective, we will characterize a collection of mutants that could abolish or compromise the ability of hMCM-DH in initial DNA melting to understand its influence on CMG assembly, origin firing, and replication fork establishment.

17119022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17119022.value: Eukaryotic DNA replication is initiated from multiple sites, termed replication origins, distributed along each chromosome. Each initiation event is strictly regulated to ensure a faithful genome duplication. Mis-regulation of this process can cause dire consequences, such as genome instability, a hallmark of cancer. This process can be divided into two discrete stages: helicase assembly and helicase activation. In G1 phase of the cell cycle, the origin recognition complex with the help of Cdc6 and Cdt1 assembles two Mcm2-7 complexes into a head-to-head double hexamer (DH) onto origin DNA. Upon S phase entry, the MCM-DH is converted into two active Cdc45-Mcm2-7-GINS (CMG) helicases as the catalytic cores of the bidirectional replisomes. During this process, the MCM-DH melts origin DNA to initiate strand separation, and CMG helicase is remodeled to encircle their respective leading strand DNA while excluding the lagging strand from the MCM ring. As a result, the two CMG helicases translocate along their respective leading strand in a 3’-5’ direction for DNA unwinding. However, little is known about the detailed mechanism of DNA melting by MCM-DH at a molecular level. To better understand the regulation of replication initiation, we previously determined a 3.8-Å structure of endogenous MCM-DH isolated from yeast using cryo electron microscopy (cryo-EM) in 2015. This structure provided crucial insights for a potential role of the DH in facilitating DNA melting. Recently, we also purified chromatin-bound MCM-DH from cultured human cells and determined its structure at 3.2 Å. Although the overall architectures of the DHs from yeast and human are similar, their DNA binding properties are drastically different. In sharp contrast to its yeast counterpart showing low DNA binding affinity, human MCM-DH (hMCM-DH) binds to origin DNA stably using its constrained central channel. Most conspicuously, one base-pair of the bound DNA is melted at the hexamer interface prior to helicase activation. This unusual feature suggests that the inactive hMCM-DH has initiated DNA melting which will resume upon activation for strand separation. Based on this exciting finding, in this project, we will explore in depth the detailed mechanism of the initial DNA melting by the hMCM-DH and its impact on origin firing. The outcomes of this research are expected to provide detailed mechanistic insights into the regulation of replication initiation in mammalian cells. The knowledge obtained will generate a sound structural framework for anti-cancer drug development using Mcm2-7 as targets. 真核生物DNA複製開始於染色體上多個複製起始位點，每一個複製起始的過程都受到嚴格的控制。此過程調控的紊亂，會導致嚴重的後果，從而影響基因組的穩定性，甚至引發癌症。複製起始的過程可分為兩步：複製解旋酶的組裝和激活。在細胞週期的G1期，複製起始複合物聯同Cdc6和Cdt1一同招募兩個Mcm2-7到複製起始位點形成MCM雙六聚體（DH）。在進入S期的時候，MCM-DH被激活，形成兩個有活性的CMG解旋酶，打開DNA雙螺旋，進行解鏈。然後，DNA解鏈的具體分子機制目前還不清楚。 為了更好認識複製起始調控，我們之前在2015年解析了酵母細胞MCM-DH複合物3.8埃的冷凍電鏡結構。該結構對於理解DNA雙鏈的解旋機制提供寶貴的理論基礎。最近我們純化並解析了人源MCM-DH的3.2埃的結構。儘管人源和酵母DH的整體結構比較類似，它們結合DNA的能力卻非常不同。人源MCM-DH能夠非常緊密結合複製原點DNA，並且在六聚體結合部位局部打開DNA雙鏈。在本項目中，我們會深入研究人源MCM-DH打開DNA的機制，以及其在於複製起始過程所發揮的作用。

17119122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17119122.value: 通過調控表觀遺傳建立抗病毒狀態以控制新發病毒的機制研究

17119122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17119122.value: Dr Chan, Jasper Fuk Woo Prof Yuen, Kwok Yung

17119122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17119122.value: 目前針對寨卡病毒及新冠病毒等新興病毒的治療方案的有效性有限，说明业界内需要继续探索可以對抗這些新興病毒的有效策略。表觀遺傳調控是指通過染色質重塑（包括 DNA 甲基化、組蛋白修飾和染色質環化）來操縱基因表達模式。這些染色質修飾物由酶和非編碼 RNA 等染色質修飾劑介導。近年來，已發現表觀遺傳調節在先天免疫反應中發揮關鍵調節作用。特別的是，前期研究已證明消除抑制性組蛋白修飾是誘導抗病毒反應和促炎基因所必需的。在本提案的準備階段，我們使用表觀遺傳 siRNA 庫對寨卡病毒複製進行了敲低篩選，該siRNA庫針對 835 個編碼組蛋白和 DNA 修飾因子，包括甲基轉移酶、乙酰轉移酶、激酶、脫乙酰酶，以及与染色質重塑和組蛋白泛素化有关的因子。我們的 siRNA 篩選发现了一些候選者可以在上調 I 型抗病毒干擾素反應的同時限制寨卡病毒複製。在接下来的小分子抑製劑實驗中，我们发现 RING1 及其相關複合物多梳抑制複合物 1 (PRC1) 在寨卡病毒複製中承担重要作用。在隨後的研究中，我們進一步證明了 RING1 和 PRC1 抑制同樣限制了腸道病毒 (EV-71) 和冠狀病毒 (SARS-CoV-2、SARS-CoV-1、MERS-CoV) 的複制，突出了以抑制RING1/PRC1作為對抗新興病毒感染的可行性。在目前的提案中，我們目標進一步研究 RING1/PRC1 抑制病毒複製的機制，並深入研究以抑制 RING1/PRC1作為一種抗病毒感染的新策略。總體而言，我們的研究將揭示表觀遺傳調控和病毒感染的相互作用，为我们目前的抗病毒策略提供新的目標。

17119322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17119322.value: ADAR1 介導的 GLI1 RNA 編輯通過增加癌細胞幹性來驅動肝細​​胞癌發生

17119322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17119322.value: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the most common and most difficult to cure malignancies in the world. Identifying new effective therapeutic targets is of great significance for the management of HCC. Increasing evidences have demonstrated that cancer stem cells (CSCs) play a critical role in the initiation and progression of cancers. Therefore, targeting and eliminating CSCs is a key step in cancer treatment. In our preliminary work, an in vitro hepatocyte differentiation model was characterized to identify genes responsible to the regulation of CSCs in HCC. ADAR1 is one of the genes expressed in high-level in early liver developing stages. Clinical sample analysis found that ADAR1 is frequently overexpressed in HCCs compared to their adjacent non-tumor tissues. ADAR1 is the major enzyme to catalyze the RNA editing of adenosine to inosine (A-to-G), which may lead to a coding amino acid change and subsequently alter the function of the protein. To identify candidate ADAR1-mediating edited genes involved in stemness regulation in HCC, RNA-seq analysis was performed in 2 ADAR1-overexpressing and 2 ADAR1-silencing cell lines. Seventy-seven edited genes were detected including GLI1, a central effector of Hedgehog (Hh) signaling that implicated in cancer stemness regulation. A-to-G editing at nt2101 of GLI1 transcript causes arginine (R) to glycine (G) substitution at the residue 701 (R701G). It resulted in a cytoplasmic-to-nuclear translocation and enhanced the stability of GLI1 protein. Importantly, editing of GLI1 portended a poor prognosis in patients. In addition, bioinformatic analysis revealed that mitophagy, a cellular process influences stemness, was prominently enriched in higher ADAR1-expressed HCC tumors. Functional studies demonstrated the impacts of such editing on HCC development and mitophagy-associated stemness maintenance. To further delineate the mechanism and regulatory roles of GLI1 editing, I plan to address following 3 questions in this proposal: 1) to investigate the effects of edited GLI1 on the regulation of HCC cancer stem cells; 2) to decipher the molecular mechanism of edited GLI1 subcellular localization and stability; 3) to study whether the effect of edited GLI1 on cancer stemness occurs in a mitophagy-dependent manner. I believe the discovery in this study will greatly facilitate our understanding the role of RNA editing in orchestrating cancer stem cell biology, which may find new approaches for CSC-targeted therapy in HCC. 肝細胞癌（HCC）是世界上最常見和最難治愈的惡性腫瘤之一,尋找新的有效治療靶點對HCC的診治具有重要意義。越來越多的證據表明，腫瘤幹細胞 (CSC)在癌癥的發生和發展中發揮著關鍵作用，因此，靶向清除CSCs是癌癥治療的關鍵步驟。在我們的初步工作中，我們對體外肝細胞分化模型進行了研究，以尋找鑒定負責調節HCC中CSC的相關基因。ADAR1是肝臟發育早期高水平表達的基因之一，臨床樣本分析發現，與鄰近的非腫瘤組織相比，ADAR1在HCC中經常過表達。ADAR1是催化腺苷RNA編輯為肌苷 (A-to-G)的主要酶，這可能導致編碼氨基酸發生變化並隨後改變蛋白質的功能。為了鑒定參與HCC幹性調節的候選ADAR1介導的編輯基因，我們對2個ADAR1過表達和2個ADAR1沈默細胞系中進行了RNA測序分析，共檢測到77個編輯基因，包括GLI1，它是Hedgehog (Hh)信號傳導的中心效應子，與癌癥幹性調節有關。GLI1轉錄本的2101核苷酸的A變G的編輯導致701 (R701G) 處的精氨酸(R)被甘氨酸(G)替換，導致GLI1蛋白從細胞質易位到細胞核，並增強了GLI1蛋白的穩定性。重要的是，GLI1的編輯預示著患者預後不良。此外，生物信息學分析表明，線粒體自噬是一種影響幹性的細胞過程。我們發現線粒體自噬在ADAR1表達較高的HCC腫瘤中顯著增加。功能研究證明了這種編輯對HCC的發展和線粒體自噬相關幹性維持的影響。為了進一步描述GLI1編輯的機製和監管作用，我計劃在本提案中解決以下3個問題：1）研究編輯的GLI1對HCC癌癥幹細胞調控的影響；2）破譯編輯的GLI1亞細胞定位和穩定性的分子機製；3）研究編輯的GLI1對癌癥幹性的影響是否以線粒體自噬依賴性方式發生。我相信這項研究的發現將極大地促進我們理解RNA編輯在協調癌癥幹細胞生物學中的作用，這可能會為HCC的CSC靶向治療找到新的方法。

17119422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17119422.value: 在基於問題的混合式學習(bPBL)中培養協作性知識建構：一項混合方法研究

17119422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17119422.value: Dr Bridges, Susan Dr Chen, Weichao Dr Ganotice, Jr., Fraide A. Dr Lin, Chin-Hsi Dr Tipoe, George Lim Dr Zheng, Binbin

17119422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17119422.value: Medical-school curricula have shifted towards competency-based medical education (CBME) to better prepare future physicians to meet the needs of healthcare in the 21st century. Within CBME, problem-based learning (PBL) has been widely adopted to develop students’ clinical reasoning, problem-solving, teamwork, and self-directed learning, all of which are important lifelong-learning skills for medical students and future doctors. On the other hand, the COVID-19 pandemic has catalysed the transition of teaching and learning from in-person to online settings, reshaping the educational landscape. Scholars expect that during the post-pandemic era, blended learning will be widely adopted as a means of embracing the values of traditional face-to-face teaching while taking advantage of the affordances of digital technologies. This study thus proposes a blended problem-based learning (bPBL) model, in which PBL tutorials will still be delivered face-to-face, with the support of learning technologies including video triggers in face-to-face classrooms, a concept-mapping tool used in self-directed learning phases, and learning analytics to better capture student learning activity and provide multifaceted assessment. The effectiveness of bPBL will be examined in three ways. First, students’ collaborative knowledge construction will be explored using discourse analysis, based on analysis of conversational data from PBL tutorials and student-created concept maps, and comparison of such data across PBL and bPBL settings. Second, tutors’ facilitating strategies will be analysed using multimodal discourse analysis, and compared across those settings; and third, mixed-methods social network analysis will be used to longitudinally depict the social dynamics and roles played students and tutors, and how these differ between PBL and bPBL. The association between students’ network centrality and their students’ learning performance will also be explored. This study is expected to have important implications for theory, practice, and faculty development. By examining PBL using innovative methodologies including discourse analysis, social network analysis, concept-mapping analysis, and learning analytics, this study should help us to more clearly and accurately understand the “black box” of PBL learning processes, and whether the bPBL curriculum and assessment model would an improvement upon it when it comes to supporting medical students’ knowledge, skills, and competence development. Moreover, the results of this study can inform the design of PBL professional development programmes, in terms of the specific facilitating strategies they should provide during each stage of a PBL curriculum, whether the PBL tutors are advanced or novice ones. 醫學院的課程已經轉向以勝任能力為導向的醫學教育（CBME），以更好地培養未來的醫生從而滿足21世紀的醫療保健需求。在CBME中，基於問題式學習（PBL）已被廣泛採用，以培養學生的臨床推理能力、解決問題的能力、團隊合作能力和自主學習能力，這些都是對於醫學生和未來醫生重要的終身學習技能。另一方面，COVID-19的大流行催化了教學和學習從面對面到在線環境的轉變，重塑了教育格局。作為一種同時接納傳統面對面教學的價值和利用數字技術的優勢的手段，學者們期望混合式學習將在後疫情時代被廣泛採用， 基於以上背景，本研究提出了一個基於問題的混合式學習（bPBL）模式，其中PBL輔導仍將面對面地進行，在學習技術的支持下，包括面對面教室中的視頻引導，在自我導向學習階段使用的概念圖工具，以及學習分析數據以更好地捕捉學生的學習活動並提供多方位的評估。bPBL的有效性將從三個方面來考察。首先，根據PBL教程中的對話數據和學生創建的概念圖的分析，以及在PBL和bPBL環境中這些數據的比較，學生的協作性知識構建將通過話語分析被探索。第二，導師的促進策略將被進行多模態話語分析，並在這些環境中進行比較；第三，混合方法的社會網絡分析會被用來縱向描述學生和導師的社會動態和角色，以及這些在PBL和bPBL之間的差異。學生人際關係網絡的中心性與他們學習表現之間的聯繫也會被探討。 這項研究預計將對理論、實踐和教職員發展產生重要影響。通過在研究PBL的過程中使用一些革新的方法包括話語分析、社會網絡分析、概念圖分析和學習數據分析，本研究應有助於我們更清楚和準確地了解PBL學習過程的 "黑盒子"，以及bPBL課程和評估模式在支持醫學生的知識、技能和能力發展方面是否會有改進。此外，本研究的結果可以為PBL專業發展項目的設計提供參考，即在PBL課程的每個階段應該提供的具體促進策略，以及判斷PBL導師是處於進階水平或是新手水平。

17120022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17120022.value: 骨髓脂肪細胞通過調節骨髓造血以調控寒冷誘導的白色脂肪米色化中的2型免疫反應

17120022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17120022.value: Bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which accounts for ~10% of fat mass in healthy adults, is one of the most abundant cell population within the bone marrow (15-70%). Recently, emerging evidences suggest that BMAT is a critical player in maintaining bone marrow microenvironment through the paracrine, autocrine and endocrine actions of secreted adipokines on other cell populations within the bone marrow, such as hematopoietic stem cells. BMAT is developmentally and functionally distinct from the classical white, brown and beige adipose tissues. The amount of BMAT changes under different nutritional, physiological and environmental conditions. Changes of BMAT are often associated with bone loss and other metabolic disorders. However, due to the lack of BMAT-specific depletion or enrichment animal model, the particular role of BMAT on systemic metabolism still needs further investigation. Type 2 immune response is indispensable in regulating beiging of subcutaneous white adipose tissue (sWAT). Cold-induced infiltration of immune cells (especially for macrophages and eosinophils) into sWAT has been asserted by several studies, whereas the driving force of the generation and migration of these immune cells is yet to be elucidated. Our preliminary findings indicate that prolonged cold exposure could lead to loss of BMAT. In parallel, we also observed that cold challenge induced bone marrow-derived macrophage and eosinophil infiltration into sWAT, driven by increased hematopoiesis in the bone marrow and enhanced immune cell egression from bone marrow to the bloodstream. Given that there is an inverse correlation between BMAT and hematopoiesis, our findings collectively suggest that cold-induced loss of BMAT is likely to be the primary cause of type 2 immune response during beiging of sWAT. To test this hypothesis, we further established two new mouse models with specific loss or increase of BMAT but intact peripheral adipose tissues. We will take advantage of these two unique models to validate the causal effect between alterations of BMAT and type 2 immunity in sWAT. We will also try to identify the secretory factors predominantly released from BMAT that have the regulatory effects on hematopoiesis in the bone marrow. These findings will provide novel insights into the role of BMAT in the “remote control” of cold-induced type 2 immune response and beiging of sWAT through modulating hematopoiesis. 骨髓脂肪組織佔健康成人脂肪量的約10%，是骨髓內最豐富的細胞群之一 (15-70%)。最近的研究表明，骨髓脂肪組織是通過分泌的脂肪因子作用于骨髓內其他細胞群（如造血幹細胞）以維持骨髓微環境穩態。骨髓脂肪組織在發育和功能上與經典的白色、棕色和米色脂肪組織不同。骨髓脂肪組織的量在不同的營養、生理和環境條件下發生變化，這種變化會導致骨質流失及代謝紊亂。然而，由於缺乏骨髓脂肪組織特異性缺失或增多的動物模型，其在全身代謝中的特殊作用仍有待進一步研究。 2型免疫反應對於調節皮下白色脂肪組織米色化是必不可少的。現有的研究表明，冷暴露會誘導免疫細胞（特別是巨噬細胞和嗜酸性粒細胞）浸潤到皮下白色脂肪組織中，而這些免疫細胞產生和遷移的驅動力尚未明確。我們的初步研究結果表明，長時間的寒冷暴露會導致骨髓脂肪的減少。同時，我們還觀察到冷暴露會誘導骨髓來源的巨噬細胞和嗜酸性粒細胞浸潤到皮下白色脂肪，這是由骨髓中造血功能的增加和免疫細胞從骨髓到血液的遷移所驅動的。鑑於骨髓脂肪組織與造血功能之間存在負相關的關係，結合我們的初步研究結果，我們認爲寒冷誘導的骨髓脂肪減少很可能是誘發白色脂肪米色化過程中出现的2型免疫反應的主要原因。為了驗證這一假説，我們建立了兩種全新的小鼠模型，它們具有骨髓脂肪組織特異性缺失或增加的特點，但其外周脂肪組織均不受影響。我們將利用這兩個獨特的動物模型來驗證骨髓脂肪組織的改變和皮下白色脂肪中2型免疫反應之間的因果關係。我們亦將嘗試鑒定出由骨髓脂肪組織釋放的、對骨髓造血具有調節作用的分泌因子。這些研究將為骨髓脂肪對造血功能、寒冷誘導的2型免疫反應以及白色脂肪米色化的調控提供新的見解。

17120122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17120122.value: 認知障礙症患者的多重共病類別分析：一個多國隊列研究

17120122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17120122.value: Dr Chan, Wai Chi Prof Knapp, Martin Dr Lau , Wallis Cheuk Yin Dr Luo, Hao Prof Song, Xin Yuan Dr Vetrano , Davide Liborio Prof Wong, Gloria Prof Wong, Ian Chi Kei

17120122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17120122.value: It is the norm rather than the exception that people living with dementia also live with other diseases. Having other conditions may accelerate functional decline in dementia, while dementia may delay the diagnosis and challenge the management of other conditions. Understanding how other diseases co-occur (‘multimorbidity’, concurrence of two or more diseases) in a person with dementia is important as it can inform a tailored approach to care as recommended by clinical guidelines. Multimorbidity is highly heterogeneous, and it has been recently conceptualised as unique clusters of non-random and heterogenic clinical phenotypes. In the general populations, such clusters showed a differential impact on several health outcomes, suggesting their potential value in identifying subgroups susceptible to secondary and tertiary preventive actions. However, little is known about how conditions are clustered in people with dementia and to what extent multimorbidity clusters identified in one population can be generalised to other populations. Recent developments in electronic health records have provided a tool to answer these questions. By using a common protocol to standardize data, findings from representative samples of different characteristics can be combined/compared. In this study, we will use multiple sources of electronic medical records of people with and without dementia to (1) describe the distribution of multimorbidity; (2) identify replicable and population-specific multimorbidity clusters; (3) explore correlates of clusters; and (4) examine death and health care utilisation associated with clusters. People aged 65 years or older that are newly diagnosed with dementia between 2007 and 2019 will be identified from the Hong Kong Clinical Data Analysis and Reporting System (CDARS), the UK Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD), and the Swedish National Study on Aging and Care in Kungsholmen (SNAC-K). We will create a control cohort by selecting a group of people without dementia with key characteristics matched. We will combine data-driven/bottom-up (latent class analysis) and theory-driven/top-down (multidisciplinary expert input) methods to identify clusters. This study will contribute to advancing knowledge and practice of dementia in several ways. Multimorbidity clusters, their correlates and outcomes that are replicable across populations may suggest underlying common biological or healthcare processes. Those specific to a population may shed light on areas of unknown and generate new hypotheses for future trials. Both may contribute to advancing personalized intervention or even preventive strategies. The protocol used may also contribute to multimorbidity research in general, allowing better use of routinely captured service data to produce real-world evidence that informs clinical practice. 認知障礙症患者通常患有共病症。共病症可能加速與認知障礙症相關的功能衰退。同時，認知障礙症的存在也可能延誤其它疾病的診斷並對共病症的臨床管理造成挑戰。因此，了解認知障礙症患者的多病共存（“多重共病”是指同時患有兩種或以上的疾病）類別十分重要，因為這可能為臨床指南所倡導的個性化護理方案設計提供證據。 多重共病具有多種類別。它近年來被概念化為具有非隨機性且異質性臨床表型的疾病群組。以往的研究顯示，不同的多重共病類別在一般人群中會對健康結局產生不同的影響，這表明了解多重共病的類別及其特徵對識別可受益於二級和三級預防措施的病患具有潛在價值。然而，我們目前對多種疾病在認知障礙症患者中如何聚集，且識別出的多重共病類別在其他人群的推廣性知之甚少。 電子健康記錄的最新發展為回答這些問題提供了工具。將通用的數據分析方案應用於標準化的電子健康數據，我們可以結合比較來自不同特徵樣本的研究結果以獲得具有推廣性的證據。在這項研究中，我們將使用來自三個地區的電子醫療記錄（包括來自認知障礙症患者和非認知障礙症患者的記錄）：（1）描述多重共病的分佈情況； (2) 識別多重共病的具體類別（包括普試於一般人群的類別和僅適用於特定人群的類別）；（3）探索具體多重共病類別的相關因素；並且（4）查考與多重共病類別相關的死亡和醫療資源使用情況。我們將分別從香港臨床數據分析和報告系統 (CDARS)、英國 Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) 和瑞典Swedish National Study on Aging and Care in Kungsholmen（SNAC-K）數據庫中提取2007 至 2019 年間被首次診斷為認知障礙症的65歲或以上患者，並匹配出一組無認知障礙症且關鍵特徵相匹配的患者作為對照。我們將結合數據導向/自下而上（通過潛在類別分析）和理論驅動/自上而下（通過多學科專家參與）的方法來識別多重共病類別。 這項研究將為提高認知障礙症的理論和臨床實踐做出貢獻。識別具有推廣性的多重共病類別、它們的相關因素以及臨床結局，可以為共存疾病潛在共享的生物過程及醫療保健流程提供參考。識別僅適用於特定人群的多重共病類別可能會揭示未知領域並為未來的臨床試驗產生新的假設。兩者都可能有助於設計個性化的臨床干預甚至預防策略。本研究對未來基於真實世界數據指導臨床實踐的研究具有借鑒意義。

17120522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17120522.value: N6-甲基腺苷去修飾酶Fto在機械力微環境中調節炎性牙周組織轉歸的作用及機制研究

17120522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17120522.value: Prof Jin, Lijian Prof Matsuo, Koichi

17120522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17120522.value: 背景 巨噬細胞的極化和炎症狀態在牙齒支持組織的牙周破壞中起著關鍵作用，研究發現極化狀態異常會導致牙齒移位和創傷性咬合，最終導致牙齒脫落。輔助矯齒治療對於改善口腔和牙周健康至關重要。然而，不適當的機械力負荷可能會加劇未解決的牙周炎症。相反，健康的牙周組織的機械微環境中相對穩定，機械力的作用不會惡化牙周組織。因此，將牙周組織的炎症狀態調節到健康狀態對於確保牙周炎患者進行安全有效的矯齒治療至關重要。 關鍵問題和假設 巨噬細胞以兩種關鍵的極化狀態存在，M1 和 M2。它們在牙周炎組織中的浸潤以M1型極化為主。該極化改變會導致相鄰骨的惡化，而相對來說後者在已恢復的健康牙周組織中普遍存在。值得注意的是，細胞因子信號 1 (Socs1) 是 M1/M2 轉換的 m6A 依賴性中樞基因，其活性取決於 m6A 甲基化水平，研究發現Socs1 的高 m6A 甲基化導致炎症抑制。我們的初步研究表明，脂肪和肥胖相關蛋白 (Fto)，一種 m6A 去修飾酶，是Socs1 m6A甲基化這一過程中的關鍵“開關”。打開 Fto 會增加促炎反應，而關閉此開關會抑制炎症。此外，我們發現抑制導致 Socs1 m6A 甲基化增加的 Fto 表達逆轉了在協同炎症和機械負荷下看到的增加的 M1/M2 巨噬細胞比率，導致更多數量的 M2 巨噬細胞。因此，我們假設抑制 Fto 可能通過調節 Socs1 m6A 甲基化來驅動 M1 向 M2 轉變，從而促進機械負荷下的炎症恢復和骨重塑。 目標和研究計劃 該項目旨在 i) 研究炎症和/或機械負荷條件下的巨噬細胞極化表型、Fto 表達和 Socs1 m6A 甲基化水平； ii) 評估 Fto 的“開關”功能及其在 M1/M2 轉換過程中對 Socs1 m6A 甲基化的調節，以及 iii) 確定條件性敲除 Fto 對動物模型中炎症和骨重塑恢復的影響牙周炎與機械力牙齒移動有關。 意義 本研究m6A去修飾酶Fto在牙周組織恢復中的作用及其調節Socs1 m6A甲基化的機制。這項研究可能為開發新的治療策略提供機會，同時為牙周炎患者提供安全有效的矯齒治療方案提供研究基礎。

17120622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17120622.value: 精神分裂症患者的情緒動機分離現象對臨床及功能結果的影響：兩項縱向研究

17120622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17120622.value: Prof Chan, Raymond Chor-kiu Prof Chang, Wing Chung Prof Chen, Eric Yu Hai Prof SHAM, Pak-Chung

17120622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17120622.value: Anhedonia and avolition are core negative symptoms of schizophrenia. Recent theories and empirical evidence suggest that schizophrenia patients demonstrate defective translation of emotional salience into motivated behaviour. This ‘emotion-behaviour decoupling’ operates together with other mechanisms, such as impaired cost-benefit computation and reinforcement learning, to generate negative symptoms. Emotion-behaviour decoupling has been found in patients with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and genetic and behavioural high-risk populations. Although emotion-behaviour decoupling offers a promising theoretical framework to understand negative symptoms, previous research did not investigate its relationship with functional outcomes, nor employ ‘state-of-the-art’ negative symptom scales, and were cross-sectional in design. Moreover, how emotion-behaviour decoupling manifests in different schizophrenia subtypes remains unclear. To address the knowledge gap, we investigate the influence of emotion-behaviour decoupling on negative psychopathology and functional outcomes, using longitudinal design and refined symptom and functional assessments. We examine whether baseline emotion-behaviour decoupling can discriminate schizophrenia patients with different clinical and functional outcomes. In the big-data research era which emphasizes scientific replicability, we utilise two independent longitudinal cohorts. In Study 1, we follow-up 150 schizophrenia patients who had already completed a behavioural paradigm measuring emotion-behaviour decoupling in 2010-2015 (baseline), and administer the Clinical Assessment Interview for Negative Symptoms (CAINS), multimodal (comprising clinician-rated, self-report, and performance-based) functional measures, and the same behavioral paradigm at endpoint. In Study 2, we newly recruit 50 schizophrenia patients with prominent negative symptoms (PNS), 50 schizophrenia patients without PNS and 50 controls for a one-year follow-up. The same behavioural paradigm, the CAINS, and multimodal functional measures will be administered at baseline and after one year. Two-stage clustering analyses will be applied. The differences in the end-point CAINS factor scores and social functioning as revealed by multimodal measures between different clusters of schizophrenia patients with varied (baseline) emotion-behaviour decoupling will be compared using ANOVAs and ANCOVAs. The longitudinal changes in emotion-behaviour decoupling will be examined using repeated measure ANOVAs. The difference between PNS and non-PNS schizophrenia patients in emotion-behaviour decoupling, the CAINS and social functioning will be examined using repeated measure ANOVAs. Study 1 and Study 2 findings will unveil the long-term (6-11 years’) and short-term (1-year) effects of emotion-behaviour decoupling on clinical and functional outcomes in schizophrenia patients respectively. Our two studies allow replication of scientific findings, and thus improve validity of psychiatric research. Together, our findings advance the theoretical understandings of negative symptoms as emotion-behaviour decoupling, and extend it to social functioning for possible intervention developments. 情感缺乏與動機缺乏是精神分裂症的主要陰性病徵。理論與過往研究均指出，精神分裂症患者較難將情感引發的動力轉化為行為。這種情況可稱為情緒動機分離。情緒動機分離的現象，結合其他缺損，例如減弱了的利害計算，強化學習等等，都是陰性病徵的成因。過往研究證明，情緒動機分離現象，在精神分裂症患者，雙相情緒病患者，及思覺失調高風險群組中均會出現。儘管情緒動機分離有助闡明陰性病徵的心理機制，過往研究均有幾項局限。首先，過往研究並未釐清情緒動機分離與功能結果的關係。另外，很少研究使用第二代陰性病徵量表。其三，過往情緒動機分離之研究皆為橫向設計。最後，不同類型的精神分裂症患者，是否展現出不同程度的情緒動機分離，尚未清楚。有見及此，本研究旨在探討情緒動機分離對陰性病徵及功能結果的影響。相較過往研究，本研究採用新穎方法去評估陰性病徵及功能結果，並採用縱向設計。在大數據時代，科研着重可重複性。本研究以兩個獨立的縱向樣本為基礎。研究一的對像是曾在過往被招募參與研究的150名精神分裂症患者。我們以2010至2015年收集的情緒動機分離數據為起點作追縱，評估被試在6至11年後的情緒動機分離現象，陰性病徵程度及功能結果。功能結果以多角度方式收集，包括了臨床判斷，自我報告及表現指標。研究二將會招募50名帶有高度陰性症狀的精神分裂症患者， 50名帶有輕度陰性症狀的患者，及50名健康對照者，以作一年追縱。在這項研究的起點與終點，我們均採用相同的範式去評估被試的情緒動機分離現象，並採用第二代陰性病徵量表，和多角度的功能評估。我們會比較不同程度的情緒動機分離現象的精神分裂症患者，探討不同群組在陰性病徵程度及功能結果的分別。我們亦會比較高度與低度陰性病徵患者，在情緒動機分離現象及功能結果的分別。此外，我們會分析精神分裂症患者之情緒動機分離現象的短期及長期變化。本研究涵括兩個獨立樣本，加強結果的可信性。本研究能闡明陰性病徵的心理機制，並將理論層面推進至社交功能研究的前沿範圍，為設計未來的治療手段作出貢獻。

17121022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17121022.value: PI(3,4,5)P3介導的Cdc42調控巨噬細胞偽足小體形成的機制研究

17121022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17121022.value: Immune cells are active and faithful defenders in the human body. Macrophage is a subtype of immune cell and is constantly hunting for foreign pathogens in the tissue. In order to migrate quickly and effectively, macrophage cells have developed a unique type of dynamic adhesion structure called podosome. A macrophage cell can form numerus podosomes concurrently on the cell membrane. Individual podosome, however, lasts for 3 to 5 minutes, disassembles, and then repeatedly reappears again. The formation of podosome enables the macrophage to remove matrix confinement and to migrate through different layers of tissues. On the other hand, the fast turnover of podosome is believed to allow the macrophage to quickly adjust the migration path and to adapt the changes caused by foreign matters. Nevertheless, how the macrophage organizes the rapid turnover and cyclic recurrence of podosome remains largely unknown. In this proposal, we aim to decipher the molecular mechanism that spatiotemporally modulates the rapid turnover and cyclic recurrence of macrophage podosome. Our pilot studies have shown the important role of Rho GTPase Cdc42 in promoting WASP-mediated F-actin polymerization and podosome formation. We hypothesize that PI(3,4,5)P3-dependent guanine nucleotide exchange factors (GEFs) act as a positive regulator to elevate the Cdc42-GTP level and activate the effector WASP. We will use complementary approaches of molecular biology, proteomics, and fluorescence microscopy to identify the key GEF/GAP and develop new tools to control the feedback loop of Cdc42 activation in macrophage podosome. Most importantly, we will examine the functional impact of Cdc42 regulation in macrophage chemotaxis, the key process of pathogen detection. Macrophage-based immunotherapy has recently received significant attentions in the antitumor treatment. Our findings will enrich the current understanding in the GTPase signaling and cytoskeletal regulation of macrophage. Pharmaceutical and biotech industries will potentially be interested in applying our findings to improve the efficacy of immunotherapy and beyond. 免疫細胞是免疫系統中關鍵的角色，而巨噬細胞是其重要亞型之一，能夠在組織中持續不斷的尋找並消滅病原體。 為了能夠實現在生物組織中的快速遷移，巨噬細胞發展出了一種獨特的動態粘附結構，稱為偽足小體（Podosome）。 在本研究中，我們旨在探討調控巨噬細胞偽足小體的分子機制。 我們的初步研究顯示GTP酶Cdc42在促進WASP介導的肌動蛋白聚合和偽足小體形成中起重要作用。 我們將利用分子生物學、蛋白質組學和螢光顯微鏡的互補方法來闡明調控Cdc42的關鍵因子，並開發新的工具來控制偽足小體中Cdc42的啟動及反饋信號。我們的發現將提供對巨噬細胞GTP酶信號傳導和細胞骨架調節的深度理解，還可以應用到製藥和生物技術行業，提高免疫治療的可行性。

17121422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17121422.value: 以手機應用程式評估首發性思覺失調患者陰性症狀及日常功能的半年追蹤研究

17121422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17121422.value: Dr Chan, Kit Wa Prof Chen, Eric Yu Hai Dr Hui, Christy Lai Ming Dr Lui, Sai Yu Simon Dr Strauss, Gregory P.

17121422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17121422.value: Psychotic disorders are severe mental disorders associated with marked functional disability and incur substantial socioeconomic cost. Although early intervention is effective in outcome improvement, a significant proportion of patients experience persistent functional impairment after clinical remission from first-episode psychosis (FEP). Negative symptoms, which are a core feature of illness and prevalent in FEP, strongly predict functional outcome and constitute a key therapeutic target in early illness stage. Conventional clinical-rating instruments are integral to psychiatric research but is constrained by low temporal resolution, limited ecological validity and recall bias, hindering in-depth symptom evaluation, with resultant limited progress in developing targeted treatment for negative symptoms and functional impairment. Digital-phenotyping, which comprises real-time momentary active and continuous, unobtrusive passive data collection via mobile devices in everyday life, represents a promising approach for scalable high-resolution symptom evaluation in mental disorders. A growing body of research has applied digital-phenotyping in psychotic disorders, with preliminary findings supporting its feasibility and tolerability for more refined symptom assessment. Nonetheless, previous studies are hampered by several important limitations. First, the vast majority of prior studies examined chronically-ill patients. There is a paucity of research in early psychosis in this respect. Second, most studies had small sample size, compromising representativeness and statistical power to detect subtle between-group differences. Third, although digital-phenotyping incorporating active and passive data is a powerful approach for symptom characterization, many studies assessed data derived from a single digital modality. Fourth, longitudinal research clarifying the role of digital-phenotyping in functional outcome prediction is scarce. Fifth, few studies evaluated validity of digitally-derived measures for negative symptoms in psychotic disorders, and none in FEP. We will conduct a prospective 6-month follow-up study in FEP patients examining active and passive digital-phenotyping measures including ecological-momentary-assessment surveys, vocal-recording features, geolocation and accelerometry-assessed physical activity. Digital-phenotyping (six consecutive days) and cognitive evaluation are performed at baseline, while clinical/functional assessments are conducted at baseline and 6 months. We aim to investigate digital-phenotyping profiles of patients relative to healthy controls, validity of digitally-derived measures as objective biobehavioral indices for negative symptoms and psychosocial functioning, and predictive capacity of digitally-derived measures on symptom and functional outcomes at follow-up. This study approach will enhance precision of symptom measurement, facilitate developing targeted treatments for negative symptoms, and translation of digital-phenotyping into clinical practice. Complementing and integrating digital-phenotyping with clinically-rated measures will further improve outcome prediction, facilitate personalized medicine in early psychosis intervention, and hence promote early functional recovery. 思覺失調是一種嚴重的精神疾病。患者不但會出現明顯的日常功能倒退，更需要承受相當的經濟、社會代價。雖然早期介入治療能改善患者的癒後效果，但仍有一批患者會一直呈現某種程度的功能障礙。陰性症狀在首發性患者中是十分普遍的，它亦是思覺失調其中一個主要症狀。研究發現陰性症狀和患者的日常功能恢復息息相關，因此改善陰性症狀是早期介入治療的一個重要目標。儘管臨床量表在現今的精神病學研究中是不可或缺的，這類量表評估還是有它的限制。量表評估主要依賴患者的記憶。若患者出現記憶偏差，這不僅減弱量表評估的效果，也讓深入瞭解患者的症狀變得困難，因而限制了改善陰性症狀及自身日常功能治療的發展。 數碼健康評估是一種通過手機應用程式收集數據的研究方法，為提高臨床評估的有效度提供了一個新的機會。近年有不少思覺失調研究採用這方法，並發現它是可行、能被患者容易接受的一種更仔細評估症狀的方式。現有文獻卻有幾個重要的侷限：（1）研究對象大多為長期思覺失調患者，只有少數研究將首發性思覺失調患者作爲研究對象；（2）參加者人數不多，大大減弱研究的代表性以及數據分析力；（3）收集的數據類別較爲單一，涵蓋範圍不足；（4）很少縱貫性研究以數碼評估的方法去釐清甚麼因素能預測思覺失調患者日常功能的恢復結果；（5）只有少數研究檢驗了以一些手機數據去評估陰性症狀的有效性，但皆沒有在首發性思覺失調患者中進行過。 有見及此，我們將透過手機應用程式收集一些數據去評估首發性思覺失調患者的陰性症狀和日常功能。收集的數據分別有實時的問卷答覆、按指示錄音以分析思覺失調患者的語調及記錄手機自動收集的數據，如以定位和加速計的數據為準去量度身體活動程度。這些數據都能有助增加大家對思覺失調患者在日常生活中所呈現的陰性症狀的瞭解。本研究為追蹤研究，參加者需進行兩次評估。第一次評估包括臨床評估、認知功能評估和為期六天的數碼評估。跟進評估則在六個月後進行。研究目標為（1）比較首發性思覺失調患者和健康人士的數據；（2）檢視手機數據作為陰性症狀和社會功能的一個客觀評估的有效性；（3）手機數據在患者臨床上和功能上康復的預測能力。這樣的方法不但可以讓症狀評估變得更精準，也有助於發展較有針對性的陰性症狀介入治療，令數碼評估融入到臨床實踐上。若將量表評估和數碼評估倆者融洽，不但可改善思覺失調患者的康復預測結果，還能讓早期介入治療變得更個人化，提高患者早日恢復日常功能的機會。

17121622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17121622.value: 來自包括腦神經退化疾病研究實驗室 (Laboratory of Neurodegenerative Diseases) 在內的各個實驗室越來越多的證據表明，全身炎症能迅速引發神經炎症。實驗室的團隊採用了不同的實驗模型（包括皮下活菌注射、通過手術引起身體損傷、牙周炎）證明只要出現全身炎症，神經炎症就會被激活。然而，全身免疫網絡如何激活神經免疫反應目前很大程度上尚不明確。幾種假設已被提出。例如，目前已證明細胞因子通過刺激腦內皮細胞從而進一步激活大腦中的小膠質細胞。一些巨噬細胞粘附在腦膜中的血管或淋巴管上。我們和一些實驗室發現活化的單核細胞/巨噬細胞可以滲入大腦以進一步刺激常駐小膠質細胞。我們將我們的研究進一步拓展到了斑馬魚模型，從而更好地觀察單核細胞/巨噬細胞的遷移模式。我們也通過在尾部創造傷口建立了截肢模型，此模型與通過手術引起身體損傷的小鼠模型類似。我們的研究結果表明截肢誘導單核細胞/巨噬細胞浸入大腦。因為IL-1的敲除或突變會抑制單核細胞/巨噬細胞浸入大腦，單核細胞/巨噬細胞的浸潤受到IL-1的高度調節。 根據我們的初步結果，我們假設IL-1是調節身體創傷（截肢）後單核細胞/巨噬細胞浸入大腦的關鍵細胞因子。在這份擬議研究中，我們旨在研究IL-1在全身炎症和神經炎症中如何調節單核細胞/巨噬細胞和小膠質細胞。由於我們的初步研究結果表明單核細胞/巨噬細胞的遷移不是來自於血液循環，我們首先會調查單核細胞/巨噬細胞所在的位置（第一部分）。我們已經建立了kdrl:egfp x mpeg1:mCherry的Casper斑馬魚品系，以便我們更好地觀察幼蟲和成年斑馬魚腦膜中、淋巴管中和大腦中的單核細胞/巨噬細胞。我們將進一步敲除IL-1，從而檢查免疫細胞的位置是否發生變化。接下來，我們會使用表達il1b:egfp的斑馬魚來研究截肢後IL-1的產生位置（第二部分）。我們也會調查截肢後IL-1在截斷tau的斑馬魚品系中的產生位置。第三，我們將會檢測在單核細胞/巨噬細胞中條件性敲除IL-1對它們在大腦中遷移的影響（第三部分）。我們的研究將加深我們對IL-1如何調節單核細胞/巨噬細胞的浸潤，以及IL-1對全身性免疫和神經免疫反應影響的理解。這將為神經退化性疾病患者神經炎症的預防和干預鋪平道路。

17121922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17121922.value: 基於階段和性狀的方法理解全球螞蟻入侵模式及機制

17121922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17121922.value: Prof Economo, Evan Mr Wong, Mark

17121922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17121922.value: 生物入侵是生物多樣性、人類社會和經濟面臨的最主要威脅之一，其造成了沉重且廣泛的代價。瞭解入侵的全球模式及入侵成功者的關鍵特徵是制定高效且具有針對性的生物安全管理措施和計畫的一個主要目標。通過無意引入途徑入侵的物種對特定的檢測及根治方法構成了威脅，在該背景下，這些目標顯得尤為重要。 在此，我們將為最成功的入侵類群之一，螞蟻，建立全球數據庫，從運輸、引入、定殖到其最終的傳播，具體瞭解其入侵路徑的空間和生態成分。基於螞蟻的特殊屬性及已有知識，其代表了在全球尺度上理解入侵模式及機制問題的一個理想模型。因此，我們將在全球螞蟻生物多樣性資訊學項目中擴充現有的資訊，為目前已編制的141,000條引入螞蟻的記錄提供其入侵所處的階段狀態，並將進行與新記錄添加關聯的數據管理程式以提供最準確和最新的資訊。 其次，利用螞蟻的生物地理資訊及新開發的生態、形態和生理生態性狀資料庫，並結合新的野外資料，本研究將更新近520種外來螞蟻的全球狀況、生態特徵及傳播情況。這些數據集將被用來測試入侵物種是否屬於具有特定地理來源、並且具有使其沿入侵路徑達到最終入侵狀態的關鍵性狀物種的非隨機子集。由於特定的性狀可能在入侵途徑中起著截然不同的作用，因此需要一種基於入侵階段的方法用來瞭解外來物種最終的入侵如何成功或失敗，以及如何識別生物安全措施的漏洞。 總的來說，該項目的結果將有助於確定全球螞蟻入侵的主要來源及接收地區。其允許計算一種新的入侵指數以考慮與特定物種有關的風險、潛在的入侵來源和接收區域的適宜性。該指數將直接用於獲取600餘個地區的入侵風險資訊，並根據其貿易來源提出相應的生物安全應對措施

17122022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17122022.value: 开发用于治疗早发性脊柱侧弯的基于镍钛形状记忆合金的脊柱生长棒系统

17122022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17122022.value: Early-onset scoliosis (EOS) is a coronal deformity of the spine before the age of 10. If left untreated, severe thoracic deformities can affect lung growth leading to pulmonary insufficiency and early death. Growing rods are commonly used to treat EOS. Traditional growing rods require the child to undergo repeated surgeries under general anaesthesia to lengthen it, therefore paralleling growth of the spine. It results in significant surgical and psychological trauma to the child and his/her family. Magnetically controlled growing rods (MCGRs) has revolutionized the EOS treatment by offering an out-patient lengthening option, and over the past 10 years has become the treatment of choice for many surgeons and patients, as the numbers of surgeries needed for the growing child is significantly reduced. We performed the first human clinical trial for MCGR in 2009, and have the longest experience of its use in the world. Complications specific to this system has been identified including metallosis from implant wear and issues related to failure of the system to distract. Over the past 12 years, our research group has been developing a novel implant utilizing the superelastic properties of nickel-titanium shape memory alloy (NTSMA). We clinically tested it on adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) patients. We demonstrated the NTSMA spinal rod retains the qualities of strength, fatigue, and wear of current spinal implants, and prevents permanent deformations on the rod and localized stress concentrations that are known to be causing failures in traditional spinal rods. The aim of the present study is to extend the application of NTSMA technology from AIS to the EOS patients, by designing a novel remotely controlled NTSMA linear actuator for the growing orthosis system that allows gradual out-patient lengthening. Employment of NTSMA to design a linear actuator system that merely relies on shape memory effects for the lengthening would address the major complications of MCGRs such as rod stalling, wear, and biocompatibility. Every year, approximately 32000 EOS cases are reported in China, and 800 cases in Hong Kong. Scoliosis has been reported to be the third leading cause of death in children and adolescent after obesity and myopia. Thus, there is great demand for better treatments with improved effectiveness and age-specific applications. This new, remotely controlled NTSMA linear actuator technology would allow these patients to be free from the inconvenience of having unplanned re-operations needed in the current growing rod technology, thus improving their quality of life and outcome. 早发性脊柱侧弯（Early-onset scoliosis，EOS）是指10岁前发生的脊柱冠状面畸形。许多原因都会导致EOS，包括婴幼儿和青少年特发性脊柱侧弯，神经肌肉失调等。通常，胸椎和腰椎的生长会在5岁达到峰值，并在9岁前完成三分之二的生长发育。 生长峰值时发生的胸椎畸形对肺成熟的影响可能会一直持续到8岁，并阻碍其发育。若不加以治疗，这些畸形会快速进展，给患儿的健康带来巨大的风险，甚至可能导致死亡。据报道，脊柱侧弯已成为儿童和青少年第三大疾病，仅次于肥胖和近视，这说明脊柱侧弯治疗是十分重要的，尤其对于儿童来说。 植入生长棒能在避免脊柱曲度恶化的同时，保留脊柱的生长能力，因而成为目前手术治疗EOS的主要方法之一。传统的生长棒植入手术已成为临床治疗的金标准。尽管如此，接受该手术的患者，每6个月需要在全身麻醉条件下手术延长生长棒。因此患儿从6岁到10岁估计需要接受8次延长手术。这不仅会带来并发症风险，也会给给患儿及其家庭带来心理和生理上的巨大压力。磁控生长棒（Magnetically controlled growing rods，MCGRs）的出现给EOS的治疗带来了巨大的变革。因为患儿不再需要全麻下手术延长生长棒，而只需在门诊接受延长操作治疗。在过去的10年中，许多医生和患者都选择了该项手术，从而极大降低了延长手术的数量（图1）。该技术利用外部磁场的作用力，实现植入的生长棒的延长，从而不需要手术延长，也避免了对患者进行全身麻醉。项目申请人于2009年开展了首例MGCR临床试验，并在该术式的积累了全球最长的临床经验。 然而，我们通过大量的MCGR临床实践，发现了一系列相关的并发症。我们通过2年的随访发现，46.7% 的患者需要接收非计划再手术，其中最常见的原因是 生长棒延长失效和近端固定失效。不仅如此，我们还发现患者出现了金属粉末沉积症，而其影响仍有待观察。由于以上问题，美国食品和药品监督管理局（Food and Drug Administration of US，FDA）近期发布了一份关于MCGRs生物相容性的提醒。由此可见，MCGRs术式仍有很大的改进空间，需要更多的研究。 在过去的12年中，本团队已开发了一种用于脊柱侧弯矫形的新型镍钛形状记忆合金棒（Nickel titanium shape memory alloy ，NiTiSMA）。该合金棒具有超弹性，可以持续提供矫形力，降低其在骨上锚定点脱落的风险，因此更适合脊柱侧弯矫形。而NiTiSMA的形状记忆功能可以使其缓慢恢复到预设的性转，实现持续的、温和的、安全的矫形[13]。该理念的可行性和安全性已在前期的研究中加以证实（香港创新科技基金, 新型骨科金属材料的优化和商业化)。团队还开展了临床试验，利用NiTiSMA脊柱生长棒治疗青少年特发性脊柱侧弯患者。结果显示，NiTiSMA脊柱生长棒既保留了传统脊柱植入器械的强度，抗疲劳，持久的特性，又避免了传统生长棒因永久性形变及局部应力集中导致的失效。我们开展了一项随机对照临床研究，并进行了长达5年的随访，证明了该器械的安全性和等效性。在香港创新科技基金(GHP/019/05)的资助下，我们对NiTiSMA 脊柱生长棒开展了大量的生物学和力学测试。迄今为止，NiTiSMA超弹性脊柱生长棒通过了所有脊柱植入器械的规定测试。 本项目拟基于NiTiSMA形状记忆合金，通过设计一种新型的遥控线性驱动器，实现能在门诊通过遥控调节延长脊柱生长棒，以将其应用领域从特发性脊柱侧弯患者推广到早发性脊柱侧弯患者。该设计将在允许医生根据患儿的生长情况，使用主动驱动系统调节生长棒的长度，这对年幼的患者来说是十分重要的。
