17122222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17122222.value: Cellular metabolism especially glucose metabolism plays a critical role in controlling the proliferation, differentiation and function of immune cells and consequently in shaping the immune response. Dysregulated glucose metabolism can influence innate and adaptive immunity, including the immune responses mediated by CD4 and CD8 T cells, NK cells and macrophages which in turn participate in the pathogenesis of metabolic diseases, such as diabetes, the most common chronic metabolic disease characterized by elevated levels of blood glucose. Indeed, high risk of tumor development and progression in the patients with diabetes is associated with dysfunctional immunity caused by dysregulated glucose metabolism. Human Vγ9Vδ2-T cells, as the innate-like T cells, can mediate MHC-unrestricted cytotoxic activities against a broad panel of tumors. Our previous studies have demonstrated that human Vγ9Vδ2-T cells have potent antitumor activity against EBV-associated tumors through perforin/granzyme, Fas/FasL and TRAIL/DR5 pathways. However, little is known about the effect of glucose metabolism on function of human Vγ9Vδ2-T cells, and the role of Vγ9Vδ2-T cells in the tumor immunosurveillance in diabetes also remains unknown. Our preliminary study in vitro and in the patients with type-2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) indicated that high glucose may decrease the antitumor activity of Vγ9Vδ2-T cells by inhibiting IFN-γ secretion and preventing the release of cytolytic granules through induction of granules depolarization. Here, we will test our hypothesis that dysregulated glucose metabolism can impair the antitumor activity of Vγ9Vδ2-T cells by inhibiting IFN-γ secretion and preventing the release of cytolytic granules through distinct pathways to induce granules depolarization in vitro and in T2DM patients. This study may provide novel therapeutic targets for enhancing the antitumor immunity of Vγ9Vδ2-T cells and further reducing the risk of tumor development and progression in the patients with T2DM. 細胞代謝尤其是葡萄糖代謝在控制免疫細胞的增殖、分化和功能方面起著關鍵作用，從而影響免疫反應。葡萄糖代謝失調可以影響先天和適應性免疫，包括由CD4和CD8 T細胞、NK細胞和巨噬細胞介導的免疫反應，而這些免疫反應又參與了代謝性疾病的發病機制，如糖尿病。事實上，糖尿病患者發生和發展腫瘤的高風險與葡萄糖代謝紊亂引起的免疫功能失調有關。作為類固有性T細胞，Vγ9Vδ2-T細胞對各類型腫瘤的殺傷活性不受主要組織相容性複合體（MHC）的限制。我們課題組之前的研究發現人源化Vγ9Vδ2-T細胞可以通過介導穿孔素（perforin）/顆粒酶（granzyme）、Fas/Fas配體（FasL）以及TRAIL/DR5通路對EBV病毒相關的淋巴瘤具有潛在的抗腫瘤活性。然而，糖代謝在人Vγ9Vδ2-T細胞中的作用以及Vγ9Vδ2-T細胞在糖尿病的免疫性病理發展機制中的作用卻知之甚少。我們前期的體外實驗以及對二型糖尿病病人的研究發現高糖可能通過抑制干擾素γ（IFN-γ）的分泌以及誘導顆粒酶的去極化來阻止殺傷性顆粒酶的釋放，進而降低Vγ9Vδ2-T細胞的抗腫瘤活性。此研究中，我們將要驗證以上假說即高糖會通過抑制干擾素γ（IFN-γ）的分泌，並從不同的途徑誘導顆粒酶的去極化來阻止殺傷性顆粒酶的釋放，進而導致體外實驗以及糖尿病病人中Vγ9Vδ2-T細胞抗腫瘤活性的降低。這項研究可能為提高Vγ9Vδ2-T細胞的抗腫瘤免疫活性和進一步降低二型糖尿病患者的腫瘤發生和發展的風險提供新的治療目標。

17122322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17122322.value: 背景：嚴重急性呼吸系統綜合症冠狀病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 是一種新型冠狀病毒，於 2019 年 12 月在武漢首次發現，並迅速在全球傳播。截至 2021 年 10 月 26 日，SARS-CoV-2 已造成超過2.43 億例 2019 冠狀病毒病 (COVID-19) 病例，近 500 萬人死亡。COVID-19 的症狀範圍從無症狀到致命疾病，並具有多種的肺部和肺外症狀臨床表現。這種大流行性疾病的發病機制和最佳治療策略仍然不清楚。脂質在病毒複製週期的多個階段發揮重要作用。我們和其他研究團隊此前報告了脂質擾動在SARS-CoV-2和其他冠狀病毒感染中的重要性。在我們對本提案的準備工作中，我們在 SARS-CoV-2 和其他人類致病性冠狀病毒的刺突蛋白中發現了一個保守的膽固醇共識基序 (CCM)，該基序具有生物學相關性並可能是一個藥物靶點。 假設：膽固醇共識基序在SARS-CoV-2感染的發病機制中起著重要作用，並且是潛在的 “泛冠狀病毒”抗病毒治療靶點。 初步發現：電腦分析識別了一個在SARS-CoV-2和其他人類致病冠狀病毒的刺突蛋白上保守的膽固醇共識基序。體外試驗證實膽固醇共識基序影響 SARS-CoV-2進入細胞和與細胞融合。藥物化合物庫篩選確定了一些膽固醇共識基序拮抗劑。最有效的一種，Cpd8，抑制膽固醇-刺突結合和病毒進入細胞，從而抑制病毒複製。重要的是，用Cpd8治療的SARS-CoV-2感染倉鼠的肺病毒載量和組織病理學變化顯著降低。 研究計劃：基於這些令人興奮的發現，我們現在提議全面研究膽固醇共識基序如何調節 SARS-CoV-2 複製的機制，並在其他生理相關模型中評估膽固醇共識基序拮抗劑和膽固醇-刺突蛋白結合調節劑的治療效果。目標 1 著重於了解膽固醇共識基序在冠狀病毒感染中的作用。首先，我們將研究膽固醇共識基序於SARS-CoV-2感染不同細胞類型和培養條件下的生物學。接下來，我們將剖析膽固醇共識基序在 SARS-CoV-2 進入細胞過程中的作用。然後，我們將研究膽固醇共識基序在其他人類致病性冠狀病毒感染中的概括性。目標2旨在徹底研究膽固醇共識基序拮抗劑和膽固醇-刺突蛋白結合調節劑的抗冠狀病毒作用。我們將評估藥物化合物對 SARS-CoV-2 和其他人類致病性冠狀病毒的體外抗病毒作用，然後全面評估它們在離體人肺器官組織和腸道類器官培養中的抗冠狀病毒作用。最後，我們將在已建立的敘利亞倉鼠（SARS-CoV-2）、K18-hACE2轉基因小鼠（SARS-CoV-2和SARS-CoV-1）和hDPP4基因敲入小鼠（MERS-CoV）模型中評估治療效果。

17122622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17122622.value: The respiratory tract forms an essential mucosal barrier and is vulnerable to damages caused by COVID-19, asthma, cystic fibrosis, and chronic suppurative respiratory diseases. The conducting airway comprises predominantly motile ciliated cells and secretory cells. Mucociliary clearance, the combined actions of beating cilia and mucus to remove pathogens and particulates from the mucosal barrier, represents the primary and foremost host defense mechanism. Many inherited and acquired respiratory conditions, including coronavirus disease, can disrupt cilia motility and mucociliary clearance. Transcriptomic analyses for mouse and human airways in physiological and disease states have uncovered novel cell types and cellular heterogeneity and plasticity at unprecedented resolution. Human genetics on motile ciliopathies, a spectrum of hereditary disorders affecting motile cilia, have led to the identification of gene modules important for cilia motility. In spite of the breadth of knowledge, it remains unclear how mucociliary clearance can scale from individual cilia to clinical phenotypes. Motile cilia are evolutionarily conserved microtubule-based organelles. They are templated from the basal body, a barrel-shaped macrostructure required for the nucleation of ciliary axoneme and anchoring of motile cilia to the apical microtubule lattice. The alignment of basal bodies and the directionality of cilia beating depend on planar cell polarity (PCP), a mechanism that drives coordinated polarization across an epithelial sheet. A structural module, which connects basal bodies to the PCP machinery through the apical microtubule lattice, has emerged as a crucial link to promote directional and collective beating. We have recently identified that genetic inactivation of KIF27, a microtubule-destabilizing kinesin and divergent component for the Hedgehog pathway, can lead to mucus obstruction in the mouse airway. KIF27 localizes the base of cilia and is dispensable for the assembly and beating of individual cilia. Tissue-scale mucus flow, however, is severely disrupted in the absence of KIF27. The unique phenotypes in Kif27-/- animals present a remarkable opportunity to investigate the molecular mechanisms that couple cilia motility to mucociliary clearance. By leveraging the power of mouse models, state-of-the-art imaging platforms, and human airway organoids, we will test the hypothesis that KIF27 plays a critical and conserved role in driving the alignment of motile cilia by linking basal bodies to the apical microtubule lattice, thus enabling directional cilia beating and mucus flow. The data will significantly advance our understanding of motile cilia biology using reproducible and experimentally tractable systems, and define new pathways for mucociliary clearance that can be translated to therapies. 呼吸道是人體重要的黏膜屏障之一，容易受到新型冠狀病毒肺炎（COVID-19）、哮喘、囊性纖維化和慢性化膿性呼吸道疾病等多種疾病的侵害。呼吸道主要覆蓋有活動纖毛細胞和分泌細胞。黏液纖毛清除機制，即通過纖毛的定向擺動和分泌細胞分泌的黏液的聯合作用清除黏膜屏障上的病原體和其他顆粒物，是人體第一道，也是最重要的宿主防禦機制。許多遺傳性或獲得性的呼吸系統疾病，包括新型冠狀病毒肺炎，都能破壞纖毛運動和黏液纖毛清除機制。在以往的研究中，通過對小鼠和人類呼吸道處於生理和病理狀態下的標本進行單細胞轉錄組分析，研究人員以前所未有的分辨率研究了呼吸道上皮細胞的異質性和可塑性，並且發現了新的細胞類型。同時，對活動纖毛疾病的人類遺傳學研究，尤其是對影響活動纖毛的一系列遺傳性疾病的研究，促成了一系列對纖毛運動重要的基因的鑑定。儘管在過往研究中取得了許多成果，但是我們仍然不清楚這些關於黏液纖毛清除機制的知識應當如何從對單個纖毛的研究擴展到臨床表型。活動纖毛是進化上保守的基於微管的細胞器。纖毛的微管組織中心是基體，一種桶狀的複合結構。基體是纖毛軸絲成核和活動纖毛固定在頂端微管晶格上所必要的結構。基體的排列和纖毛擺動的方向取決於平面細胞極性（PCP），一種驅動上皮片內細胞協同極化的機制。因此，應當存在一種結構通過頂端微管晶格將基體和平面細胞極性機制聯繫起來，促進纖毛協同地定向擺動。KIF27是一種會破壞微管穩定性的驅動蛋白，處於Hedgehog信號通路的一個趨異演化的分支。近期我們發現遺傳失活KIF27可以誘發小鼠氣道粘液栓塞。KIF27定位在纖毛的基部，不過並不是單個纖毛的組裝和擺動所必要的組分。但是，在沒有KIF27的情況下，呼吸道內整體的粘液流動會被嚴重破壞。KIF27突變體的這一獨特表型為研究單個纖毛運動與整體黏液纖毛清除機制之間耦合的分子機制提供了難得的機會。通過利用小鼠疾病模型、先進的成像平台和人類呼吸道類器官模型，我們將研究KIF27在驅動活動纖毛的排列方面起的關鍵而保守的功能。我們假設它可以將基體與頂端的微管晶格連接起來，從而使纖毛可以定向擺動以驅動黏液流動。使用易於操作和復現的實驗體系，我們的研究數據將極大地促進我們對活動纖毛生物學的理解，並將發現能進行臨床轉化的黏液纖毛清除機制的新信號通路。

17122822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17122822.value: 解析與觸覺感受相關之微管蛋白同種型對微管力學性質的影響

17122822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17122822.value: The mechanosensory neurons employ microtubules as part of the force-transduction machinery to trigger the opening of mechanoreceptors and generate neuronal signals. In particular, the channel-microtubule interactions that sense the force-induced deformation of the filaments can activate the membrane-bound mechanoreceptors. Mutations in genes encoding specific tubulin families (i.e., isotypes) and tubulin acetyltransferases have been associated with the lack of touch sensation in mice and C. elegans, suggesting that the composition of tubulin subunits is critical for microtubules to convey the force activating the mechanotransduction channels. However, the molecular mechanism by which tubulin isotypes and acetylation function as the intrinsic factors that regulate the response of microtubules to the exerted forces remains unclear. C. elegans has been a powerful model organism for dissecting the molecular basis of mechanosensation. In particular, the sensation of gentle body touch of C. elegans depends on the six touch receptor neurons (TRNs) that have processes filled with bundled microtubules functioning as the force-transmitting organelle. The sensory function of TRNs depends on the genes encoding one α- and one β-tubulin isotypes (mec-12 and mec-7, respectively) as well as α-tubulin acetyltransferases (mec-17 and atat-2). In C. elegans animals harboring touch insensitive alleles of these genes, TRNs have fragmented microtubules that appear unable to respond to the applied forces jointly. However, due to the decades-long challenge of generating isotypically pure recombinant tubulin, how MEC-12/MEC-7 and acetylated α-tubulin confer critical microtubule properties for maintaining the integrity of the force-sensing microtubule architectures remains a fundamental question. This question becomes more intriguing as MEC-12 is the only C. elegans α-tubulin with the lysine 40 that MEC-17 and ATAT-2 can acetylate. To overcome this challenge, we have developed a state-of-the-art strategy for generating a good quantity of recombinant tubulin to reconstitute microtubules with a defined composition of tubulin isotypes. With preliminary data indicating that tubulin isotypes can modulate the axial microtubule rigidity, we are well-positioned to start dissecting the unique roles of MEC-12 and MEC-7 on the mechanical properties of microtubules and reveal the factors that confer the effective force-transmitting on the microtubule-based organelles. We will generate recombinant wild-type and mutant MEC-12/MEC-7, followed by using single-molecule force microscopy (e.g., optical tweezers and atomic force microscopy) to examine the effects of MEC-12/MEC-7 and α-tubulin acetylation on microtubule mechanical properties. Our study will open a new avenue toward revealing the mechanotransduction roles of unique microtubule organizations in higher eukaryotes, such as pillar cells of the mammalian cochlea. 機械感覺神經元利用微管作為力傳導機制的一部分來觸發機械感受器的打開並產生神經元信號。特別是，感知力誘導的細絲變形的通道-微管相互作用可以激活膜結合的機械感受器。編碼特定微管蛋白家族（即同種型）和微管蛋白乙酰轉移酶的基因突變與小鼠和秀麗隱桿線蟲缺乏觸覺有關，這表明​​微管蛋白亞基的組成對於微管傳遞激活機械轉導通道的力至關重要.然而，微管蛋白同種型和乙酰化作為調節微管對施加力反應的內在因素的分子機制仍不清楚。 C. elegans 一直是剖析機械感覺的分子基礎的強大模型生物。特別是，秀麗隱桿線蟲的輕柔身體觸摸感覺取決於六個觸摸感受器神經元 (TRN)，這些神經元具有充滿成束微管的過程，作為力傳遞細胞器。 TRN 的感覺功能取決於編碼一種 α-和一種 β-微管蛋白同種型（分別為 mec-12 和 mec-7）以及 α-微管蛋白乙酰轉移酶（mec-17 和 atat-2）的基因。在具有這些基因的觸摸不敏感等位基因的秀麗隱桿線蟲動物中，TRN 具有似乎無法對共同施加的力作出反應的支離破碎的微管。然而，由於產生同型純重組微管蛋白的數十年挑戰，MEC-12/MEC-7 和乙酰化 α-微管蛋白如何賦予維持力傳感微管結構完整性的關鍵微管特性仍然是一個基本問題。這個問題變得更加有趣，因為 MEC-12 是唯一具有 MEC-17 和 ATAT-2 可以乙酰化的賴氨酸 40 的秀麗隱桿線蟲 α-微管蛋白。 為了克服這一挑戰，我們開發了一種最先進的策略，用於生成大量重組微管蛋白，以重構具有確定的微管蛋白同種型組成的微管。初步數據表明微管蛋白同種型可以調節軸向微管剛度，我們有能力開始剖析 MEC-12 和 MEC-7 對微管機械性能的獨特作用，並揭示賦予有效力傳遞的因素在基於微管的細胞器上。我們將生成重組野生型和突變型 MEC-12/MEC-7，然後使用單分子力顯微鏡（例如，光鑷和原子力顯微鏡）來檢查 MEC-12/MEC-7 和 α-微管蛋白乙酰化對微管力學性能的影響。我們的研究將為揭示高等真核生物（例如哺乳動物耳蝸的柱狀細胞）中獨特微管組織的機械傳導作用開闢一條新途徑。

17123122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17123122.value: 肌營養不良症患者源性誘導多能幹細胞疾病模型，用於新的錶觀遺傳機制評估和推進小分子療法發展。

17123122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17123122.value: Prof Cheung, Hiu Tung Tom Prof Cheung, Yiu-fai Prof Tse, Hung Fat

17123122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17123122.value: Dystrophinopathy is a fatal disease caused by DMD gene mutations that include patients with the commonest muscular dystrophy or having minimal to no skeletal muscle weakness. Yet, the related cardiomyopathies are always severe and manifest early in life, causing significant heart failure leading to premature death. Currently, there is no cure. To date, four FDA-approved exon skipping therapies aiming to alleviate skeletal muscle pathology are approved only for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) – patients with severe muscular dystrophy. These drugs benefit less than half of DMD patients having specific mutations and unknown long-term benefits in treating cardiomyopathies. Conversely, no approved treatments are available for patients with cardiomyopathy having mild skeletal muscle weakness and diagnosed with Becker muscular dystrophy (BMD), or those with no muscle weakness having X-linked dilated cardiomyopathy (XLDCM). Heart transplantation is the only rescuable intervention. DMD mutations affect the related downstream pathways leading to dystrophic heart and muscle disease. Ongoing research unraveling the interdependent epigenetic pathways in modulating the development and differentiation of skeletal muscle cells creates new therapeutic opportunities. The pre-clinical DMD animal model studies have also provided compelling evidence that epigenetic regulators can restore the regenerative ability of dystrophic skeletal muscles. Our previous work focusing on the selective heart disease caused by DMD mutations also confirmed that histone deacetylase inhibitors rescued the calcium handling function of cardiomyocytes (CMs) derived from patient-induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) through the upregulation of a calcium handling gene. We hypothesize that epigenetic regulation plays an instrumental role in cardiac pathology and possesses rescue potential in dystrophin-deficient cardiomyopathy. We will utilize the patient-derived iPSC-CM disease model which provides a valuable unlimited source of patient-derived cardiomyocytes to carry out this study. Firstly, we will establish the human iPSC-CM disease model from patients with cardiomyopathy having minimal or no skeletal muscle weakness. Epigenetic drug screening using this platform will help identify potential therapeutic agents. Furthermore, detailed transcriptome and chromatin immunoprecipitation experiments with high throughput sequencing (ChIP-seq) will be performed to decipher the alterations in the binding sites of the DNA-binding proteins (including transcription factors, epigenetic and chromatin modifiers) on genome-wide levels, allowing us to decode the gene regulatory networks. This study will further our understanding of the epigenetic pathophysiology and insights into developing potential novel epigenetic targets to improve the therapeutic efficacy and survival of patients with dystrophin-deficient heart disease. 肌營養不良蛋白缺乏肌營養不良症(Dystrophinopathy) 是一種由 DMD 基因突變引起的致命疾病，其中包括患者有最嚴重的肌營養不良症,亦有患者只有輕度骨骼肌無力甚至沒有影響。然而，相關的心肌病是最嚴重，並且在早期就會發病，引致嚴重的心臟衰竭導致早逝。至目前為止，並沒有治癒方法。 迄今，FDA 批准的四種外顯子跳躍療法以緩解骨骼肌病變只被批准用於杜興氏肌營養不良症 (Duchenne muscular dystrophy/ DMD)—有嚴重骨骼肌無力的患者。這些藥物只對少於一半有的 DMD 患者(有特定基因突變) 有幫助，對治療心肌病的長期效益亦未知。相反，對於患有輕度骨骼肌無力並被診斷為 Becker 肌營養不良症 (Becker muscular dystrophy /BMD) 的心肌病患者，或患有 X 連鎖擴張型心肌病 (X-linked dilated cardiomyopathy) 而沒有骨骼肌肉無力的患者，並沒有任何批准的治療藥物。心臟移植是唯一可拯救生命的手術治療。 DMD基因突變是透過影響相關生物化學過程導致心臟和肌肉營養不良疾病。正在進行的研究發現相互依賴的錶觀遺傳途徑(epigenetic pathways)以調節骨骼肌細胞的發育和分化，創造岀新的治療機會。臨床前 DMD 動物模型研究也提供了有力的證據, 證明錶觀遺傳調節劑(epigenetic regulators)可以恢復營養不良骨骼肌的再生能力。我們的前期研究亦發現由 DMD 突變引起的選擇性心肌病接受了組蛋白去乙酰化酶抑製劑 (histone deacetylase inhibitors) 可挽救源自患者誘導多能幹細胞(iPSC)分化的心肌細胞 (Cardiomyocytes) 的鈣離子處理和功能。 我們假設錶觀遺傳調控(epigenetic regulation)在心肌病理學中有重要角色，並且在肌營養不良蛋白缺乏心肌病 (dystrophin-deficient cardiomyopathy) 中具有拯救潛力。我們將利用這疾病模型為患者提供無限而寶貴的誘導多能幹細胞分化的心肌細胞 (IPSC-CM) 開展這項研究。首先，我們為有輕微或沒有肌無力的心肌病患者建立 iPSC-CM 疾病模型。使用這模型進行錶觀遺傳藥物篩選 (epigenetic drug screening) 將有助於識別潛在的治療藥物。此外，亦會進行轉錄組分析 (transcriptome analysis) 和染色質免疫沉澱 (chromatin immunoprecipitation) 實驗，並作染色質免疫沉澱後高通量測序 (ChIP-seq), 在全基因組水平上破譯 DNA的 結合蛋白，包括轉錄因子(transcription factors)、錶觀遺傳和染色質修飾劑 (epigenetic and chromatin modifiers) 的結合點變化，從而使我們能為基因調控網絡解碼。 這項研究將進一步加深我們對錶觀遺傳病理生理學的理解，並深入開發潜在的新錶觀遺傳靶點，以提高肌營養不良蛋白缺乏型心肌病患者的治療效果和生存率。

17123422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17123422.value: 慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染期間 HBsAg 特異性 B 細胞反應恢復的新機制

17123422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17123422.value: 實現永久性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 功能性治愈（HBV DNA 和 HBsAg 的血清學陰性）以允許安全終止抗病毒治療對於當前和未來的抗 HBV 策略至關重要。慢性 HBV (CHB) 感染顯著抑制了普遍的以及HBV 特異性的體液免疫反應。然而，HBsAg 特異性 B 細胞的功能可以通過阻斷 B 細胞免疫檢查點 PD1 來部分恢復。這些發現開闢了新的治療可能性，並呼籲設計新的藥物來增強 HBsAg 特異性抗體反應以達到 HBV 功能性治癒。我們最近發現針對 Δ42PD1 的單克隆抗體 mAb (CH34) 可部分恢復 HBsAg 特異性 B 細胞功能，並顯著促進其分化成熟為抗體分泌細胞 (ASC)。 Δ42PD1是人類PD1的一種天然異構體，是我們課題組發現的一種新型B細胞免疫檢查點。與 PD1 參與 PDL1/L2 募集抑制近端 BCR 信號分子（Syk 和 Igβ）並降低 PLCγ2 和 ERK 活性的 SHP2 不同，Δ42PD1 不與 PD1L1/2 結合，但募集抑制遠端信號 Akt1-FoxO1 和細胞分裂的 SHP1。在 CHB 患者中，Δ42PD1+ 記憶 B 細胞 (MBC) 的頻率顯著增加。 HbsAg 特異性 MBCs 在 Δ42PD1+ B 細胞群中高度富集，並且可以通過 CH34 處理而在功能上有所恢復，導致活化、增殖和 ASCs 成熟顯著增加。值得注意的是，在 CHB 患者中也發現了 PD1+ MBC，但很少觀察到 PD1+Δ42PD1+ B 細胞，這表明 Δ42PD1 和 PD1 不僅針對不同的細胞內信號傳導，而且針對不同的細胞群或分化階段。這些發現使 Δ42PD1 成為 HBV 功能性治癒的有吸引力的治療靶點。然而，CHB 感染中 HBsAg 特異性 B 細胞耗竭和 Δ42PD1 阻斷後功能恢復的信號通路尚不清楚。此外，尚不清楚在 CHB 感染期間如何調節 Δ42PD1 表達。在這項擬議的研究中，我們旨在確定新的信號通路、代謝活性和導致 HBsAg 特異性 B 細胞耗竭、Δ42PD1 表達和在 CHB 感染期間通過 Δ42PD1 阻斷恢復 B 細胞功能的因素。我們將重點關注 Δ42PD1 及其主要靶標 AKT-FoxO1 信號，也將同時測試近端和遠端 BCR 信號通路和 PD1 阻斷，以比較和確定雙重阻斷對 B 細胞功能拯救的機制差異和協同作用。從這項研究中獲得的知識將為 B 細胞衰竭的病因提供重要信息，並為開發 HBV 功能性治愈和其他慢性感染的療法提供基礎。

17124422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17124422.value: 極度瀕危的黃胸鹀(Emberiza aureola)和其他同域的鹀(Emberiza spp.)的比較種群基因組學

17124422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17124422.value: 地球正在經歷由人類引起的第六次大滅絕，人為威脅已導致大量物種走向滅亡，這不僅見於分佈受限的稀有物種，也見於常見和廣泛分佈的物種。旅鴿是一個標誌性的例子，說明人類如何在短時間內使一個種群龐大的物種滅絕。如今，過度捕獵正在使另一種曾經擁有龐大種群的物種—黃胸鹀 (Emberiza aureola) 走向滅亡。該物種是北古北地區數量最多的鳥類，牠的種群規模在 20 世紀 80 年代曾經達到數億隻，但僅在 30 年間就減少了約 90%。鑑於這一物種的緊急情況，E. aureola 的保育狀態從 2000 年的「無危物種」升級為 2017 年的「極度瀕危」，使得研究其種群以了解其滅絕風險並製定適當的保育策略有迫切的需要。 在這個提議的項目，我們將使用比較種群基因組學的方法來研究極度瀕危的 E. aureola 及其密切相關的物種，亦即田鵐E. rustica 和小鵐E. pusilla。這些鹀在牠們的繁殖分佈範圍內都是同域的，牠們均通過東亞飛行路線進行遷徙。小鵐是北古北地區數量最多的鳥類之一，種群數量穩定，而田鵐的種群數量卻正在下降，這些同域物種為研究影響其種群特徵的因素提供了一個理想的系統。我們將結合基因組數據和生態位模型的分析，這些都是有力工具，能夠闡明與過去種群變化相關的模式和過程。在這項研究中將獲得的知識，例如種群結構、種群歷史、遺傳多樣性和繁殖範圍變化，都對我們了解 E. aureola 的滅絕風險和進化潛力、以及設計保育計劃來拯救這個瀕臨滅種的瀕危物種至關重要。此外，由於目前缺乏對北古北區候鳥種群的基因組學研究，這項研究將提供該地區鳥類物種擴散模式及機制的重要知識。

17124922.label: Project Title(Chinese)

17125022.value: Stanniocalcin-2調控胰島β細胞分泌胰島素的作用與機制研究

17125022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17125022.value: Pancreatic islets contain several types of endocrine cells (such as α, β and δ cells) that play major roles in controlling glucose homeostasis by secreting multiple peptide hormones. Whilst α cells-secreted glucagon elevates blood glucose levels, insulin secreted from β cells is the principal hormone for lowering blood glucose through its endocrine actions on liver, skeletal muscle and adipose tissues. The β cell loss, dysfunction and impaired insulin secretion are hallmarks for type-2 diabetes, a common chronic disease affecting more than 400 million people globally. Hormones that preserve β cell function and insulin secretion (such as incretions) have been successfully developed as effective drugs for treatment of type-2 diabetes. Stanniocalcins, which are glycosylated peptide hormones originally discovered in body fish, have two mammalian paralogs, namely stanniocalcin-1 (STC1) and Stanniocalcin-2 (STC2). STC1 and STC2 shares 34% sequence identity, and are implicated in diverse biological processes including calcium/phosphate regulation, cell proliferation and apoptosis, inflammation and metabolism. We found that plasma level of STC2, but not STC1, is decreased in patients with type-2 diabetes, and low plasma STC2 level is closely associated with poor glycemic control after oral glucose challenge. Furthermore, our ex vivo and mouse studies showed that treatment of recombinant STC2, but not STC1 potently and acutely, enhances glucose-stimulated insulin secretion and decreases hyperglycemia in obese and diabetic mice. As STC2 is highly expressed in pancreatic α cells, we propose that STC2 is a novel insulinotropic hormone regulating glucose homeostasis. Pancreatic α cells-secreted STC2 may act in a paracrine or autocrine manner to modulate islet architecture, endocrine cell composition, β cell mass, growth and insulin/glucagon secretion. Decreased STC2 may contribute to β cell dysfunction and type-2 diabetes. To test this hypothesis, this project aims to explore the pathophysiological role of STC2 in regulating insulin secretion and glucose homeostasis using both inducible and α-cells-selective STC2 knockout mice, and to evaluate the therapeutic potential of STC2 for treatment of diabetes in both human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs)-derived β cells and diabetic mice with “humanized β cells”. Furthermore, we will comprehensively investigate the structural basis, metabolic pathways and intracellular signal transduction cascades underlying the stimulatory effects of STC2 on insulin secretion. The findings from this study are expected to shed new light on hormonal regulation of metabolic homeostasis and islet biology, and to provide scientific basis for development of novel antidiabetic drugs targeting STC2-induced insulin secretion. 胰腺α和β細胞通過分泌多種激素維持機體血糖穩態。α細胞分泌的Stanniocalcin-2 （STC2）調控β細胞分泌胰島素的作用及機制尚無報導。我們前期研究發現，糖尿病人血清STC2蛋白含量明顯降低，且與血糖水準呈顯著負相關；重組STC2蛋白及AAV介導的STC2過表達均可通過促進胰島素分泌降低小鼠血糖。 由此推測，STC2蛋白由α細胞產生後以旁分泌方式作用於β細胞，通過調控GSIS、cAMP/PKA及IP3/DAG相關通路促進胰島素分泌。為驗證此假說，本課題擬1）利用全身及α細胞特異性敲除STC2基因小鼠探索STC2調控胰島素分泌的生理功能；2）明確STC2促進胰島素分泌的結構基礎和信號轉導途徑；3）體內外評估STC2對多能幹細胞誘導分化的人源β細胞分泌胰島素的影響。本研究預期揭示STC2促進胰島素分泌的機制及構效關係，為豐富激素調控胰島素分泌理論體系、開發靶向STC2新型藥物提供科學依據。

17126122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17126122.value: 多光子微細加工和微圖案化 (MMM) 細胞微環境工程技術 - 表型維持和調節肥大軟骨細胞

17126122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17126122.value: 天然組織中的細胞存在於由相鄰細胞、生長因子、細胞外基質、拓撲特徵和機械信號組成的專門的局部生態位或微環境中。這個微環境維持細胞的長期表型維護並決定它們的命運。適當的細胞微環境對於維持細胞表型和命運至關重要。 軟骨細胞表現出表型可塑性，這意味著當生態位發生變化時，它們的表型會發生變化。存在細胞微環境紊亂後表型轉變的證據，例如單層培養和骨關節炎中的去分化現象。更有趣的是，其他人和我們的合作者小組最近的報告表明，肥大的軟骨細胞可以直接轉分化成成熟的成骨細胞，這強烈暗示了利用這些細胞進行骨組織工程的潛力。 然而，在體外培養軟骨細胞和肥大軟骨細胞而不去分化是一個挑戰。因此，重要的是定義和重建可以維持軟骨形成和肥大表型的細胞微環境。現有的遺傳模型難以定義用於表型維持的多重局部細胞微環境，更不用說將多個因素解耦以研究它們的個體貢獻。因此，高通量細胞微環境工程技術是必要的。 基於多光子的微細加工技術具有設計多重細胞微環境的潛力。我們的團隊開發了多光子微加工和微圖案（MMM）技術，可以自由“打印”用戶定義的 3D 複雜蛋白質微結構和微圖案。我們在製造拓撲、機械、細胞外基質和可溶性細胞生態位因子方面建立了精確、定量和空間控制。 MMM 技術的獨特之處在於它能夠獨立控制單個細胞微環境因子的製造，並通過以數量和空間可控的方式整合多個微環境因子來製造組合細胞微環境。 在這裡，我們假設存在一個最佳地維持體外肥大軟骨細胞表型的組合細胞微環境，並且可以通過 MMM 技術以高通量方式定義和製造。具體來說，我們的目標是（1）進一步擴大細胞生態因子庫（拓撲、機械、基質和可溶性）； (2) 篩選導致肥大表型維持的單個細胞微環境因子； (3) 確定在體外最佳維持肥大軟骨細胞表型的最佳組合細胞微環境。 成功開發基於 MMM 的細胞微環境工程平台和確定維持軟骨形成和肥大表型的最佳組合細胞微環境將有助於合理化 3D 培養基質和骨軟骨組織工程支架的設計。

17126222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17126222.value: 基底外側杏仁核中的分泌神經元是整合社會信號的中心樞紐

17126222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17126222.value: 當我們把我們的小狗帶到公園時，我們經常發現它們四處嗅聞，主要是為了收集氣味和視覺信息， 這些訊息將幫助決定它們的社會地位。這種與生俱來的社會歸屬感和社會等級結構對於動物的生存至關重要。這個過程由涉及多種神經遞質和神經內分泌因子在各種神經迴路的聯合作用控制。我們對這些神經基質如何調節先天的社會行為的理解還遠未完成。我們的實驗室在過去 10 年中提供了有關經典胃腸肽分泌素 (SCT) 在大腦中的功能的全面信息。為了更好地理解它的功能，我們製造了一個 SCT-Cre 鼠標線，使我們能夠使用最新的策略來研究 SCT 的新作用。通過這種轉基因小鼠，我們意外地發現大腦中最高水平的 SCT+ 細胞位於以調節社會行為的基底外側杏仁核 (BLA)。在 BLA 中敲除 SCT 後，我們發現小鼠與同性雄性幼鼠的社交互動顯著減少。我們繼續直接測量與分級社會線索相關的 BLA 中 SCTergic 神經元 (BLASCT+) 的體內神經活動。結論是，活的幼鼠引起了最強的反應，支持 BLASCT+ 細胞對社會線索和隸屬關係的重要性。帶有尿液的假老鼠，但不是單獨的假老鼠，也導致反應顯著升高，這表明通過嗅覺輸入的同種尿液氣味很重要。關於所涉及的神經迴路，我們發現 BLASCT+ 神經元最主要的輸入和輸出分別是梨狀皮層 (Pir) 和內側額葉皮層 (mPFC)。早期研究表明，Pir 接收來自嗅球的直接輸入，因此可以編碼不同的氣味信息，而 mPFC 參與決策。輸入和輸出區域都與之前的報告一致，因此我們的數據表明 BLASCT+ 神經元是這些區域的重要環節。基於這些，我們假設 BLA 中的 SCTergic 神經元作為中心樞紐，用於將 Pir 的氣味等社會信號整合到 mPFC 中導致運動輸出的決策。這個研究提出的目標是鞏固和證實我們的假設。該項目對於為理解BLA中SCTergic神經元的社會行為調節提供科學依據具有明顯的重要性。

To investigate the antibiotic susceptibility profile of identified pathogens from the selected infections and characterize the patterns of antibiotic use in inpatients with the predefined bacterial infections.

To determine the disease burden attributable to antimicrobial resistant bacteria measured by excess hospital stay, risk of ICU admission and mortality in hospitalized patients with the predefined infections.

17126322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17126322.value: Background: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is one of the major public threats to global health. Drug-resistant bacteria have been increasingly detected in patients with infections particularly hospital-acquired infections and are often associated with worse health outcomes in the patients. There hasn't been a well-characterized analytical framework to provide informative estimates of AMR-associated disease burden which can be directly translated into policies and strategies to control AMR although attempts were made to quantify the AMR-associated health impact at the individual or population level. Methods: Inpatient data to be acquired from all public hospitals in Hong Kong will be used to investigate the incidence of major bacterial infections and the temporal trend in the population. Clinical microbiological data will be extracted for the target infections to examine the resistance profile of the identified bacterial pathogens from the patients. A survival analysis will be conducted with the characterized patient cohorts, i.e., patients infected with resistant/multi-drug resistant bacteria, patients infected with drug-susceptible bacteria and those hospitalized without infections, to estimate the AMR-associated disease burden as excess hospital stay, admission to intensive-care-unit and mortality. Expected findings: We intend to demonstrate the feasibility of using patient data routinely recorded in hospital to assess the AMR-associated disease burden for specific groups of patients and for the population. Well-characterized disease burden attributable to AMR can inform clinical practice in local hospitals and provide scientific evidence for policy making to identify potentially effective measures to mitigate the health impact associated with AMR.

17126322.label: Realisation of objectives
17126322.value: With multiple rounds of discussion with the Hospital Authority, we obtained territory‑wide electronic medical records for all inpatients discharged from Hong Kong public hospitals between 2012 and 2021, performed extensive data-quality checks and linked multiple datasets using anonymous pseudo‑keys, enabling assignment of pathogens, antibiotics and resistance profiles to each admission and assessment of outcomes especially in terms of mortality. All three study objectives were fully achieved, as summarised below. Objective 1. Achievements: Using recorded discharge diagnosis codes, antibiotic prescription records and microbiological test results, we were able to define urinary tract infection (UTI), respiratory tract infection (RTI), bloodstream infection (BSI), and skin and soft‑tissue infection (SSTI). We examined age-specific infection‑related hospitalisation rates and derived the annual age‑standardized rate for the study period, including both overall and for laboratory‑confirmed infections, stratified by infection onset and site. Annually one in every 100 persons was admitted with one of the target infection syndromes in Hong Kong during 2012-2021, with overall 20% confirmed by microbiological tests. Less than 10% of the clinically defined bloodstream infection (BSI) had a laboratory confirmation of the causative bacterial pathogen. The incidence of community-onset (CO) infections was largely higher than hospital-onset (HO) infections except for RTIs. The annual incidence of UTI, BSI, and SSTI was increasing over time before the COVID-19 pandemic while the incidence of RTI was relatively stable. In 2020-21, the annual hospitalisation rates of the target infections declined particularly RTIs due to reduced activities of respiratory pathogens while the incidence of SSTIs increased substantially especially in 2021. The highest hospitalisation rates were estimated primarily in older adults (65+ and 45-64 years) and young children (0-4 years) for these target infections. Challenges and solution: The key challenge in achieving Objective 1 was developing the definitions of the target bacterial infections with limited data extracted from routine medical records, including the lack of explicit syndromic indicators, lack of microbiological testing for some patients, and incomplete diagnostic and procedure codes, etc. We therefore developed an analytic framework to systematically examine and define the target infections by first constructing code‑based definitions for UTI, RTI, BSI and SSTI following international references and local clinical input. We then focused on subsequent pathogen‑specific analyses on laboratory‑confirmed infections where organisms and antibiotic susceptibility data were available. We also carefully defined the possible causative pathogen within each admission by jointly examining diagnosis codes, the timing and type of microbiological tests, and the initiation and duration of antibiotic treatment. This ensured that recorded culture results reflected active bacterial infection requiring clinical attention, rather than colonisation, and improved the robustness and clinical interpretability of our estimates. Objective 2. Achievement: For Objective 2, we aimed to describe susceptibility profiles of bacterial pathogens and antibiotic use patterns for the target bacterial infections. By linking microbiology records of individual patients with admission episodes and antibiotic prescribing data, common bacterial pathogens identified from the infectious syndromes were described by infection site and infection origin. E. coli was the leading pathogen detected for UTI and BSI, P. aeruginosa for RTI, and S. aureus for RTI and SSTI. We observed clear differences in pathogen distributions between CO and HO episodes. We summarized AST results particularly for bug-drug combinations, such as extended‑spectrum cephalosporin-resistant (ESCR) E. coli, Klebsiella spp. and Acinetobacter spp., methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) and ampicillin-resistant Haemophilus spp. Empirical antibiotics prescribed for patients with the target infections indicated that amoxicillin-clavulanate was the most frequently prescribed antibiotics across all the target infection groups while piperacillin-tazobactam, meropenem and levofloxacin commonly used for RTI, BSI and Gram‑negative infections. To capture the full course of treatment, we also examined overall antibiotic use, which showed that broad‑spectrum agents such as piperacillin and meropenem were relatively more prominent in overall use than in empirical use, highlighting considerable variations in empirical and definitive antibiotics prescribed for patients with the target infections over the admission. Challenges and solution: In analysis on antibiotic susceptibility of identified bacterial pathogen, we encountered challenges of incomplete AST panels and variable testing practices in clinical settings and over time, which could bias resistance estimates. We addressed this by restricting primary analyses to commonly tested antibiotics, applying clear inclusion criteria for AST results, and focusing on key pathogens and antibiotics that are of clinical significance, informed by consultations with experts and by local and international treatment guidelines and literature. It was a complex practice in linking data of prescriptions, microbiology and diagnoses. We overcame the challenge by developing rule‑based algorithms to align bacterial cultures and antibiotic prescriptions to index infection episodes (e.g. culture dates relative to admission and first relevant antibiotic), and by validating these rules in consultation with clinicians. Despite these limitations, we achieved a coherent and clinically interpretable description of susceptibility patterns and antibiotic use. Objective 3. Achievement: For Objective 3, we aimed to quantify the mortality burden associated with AMR infections. We constructed time‑to‑event models to estimate mortality hazard ratios for patients infected with laboratory‑confirmed pathogens non-susceptible to specific antibiotics, compared with the following counterfactuals, i.e., patients infected with the same type of pathogen whereas susceptible to the antibiotics (attributable risk) and with uninfected patients or patients with negative culture and without antibiotic treatment (for associated risk). The analyses were stratified by infection origin (CO vs HO), infection site and selected pathogen-drug combinations. For CO infections, the target non-susceptible pathogens conferred modestly higher hazards than susceptible infections, whereas considerably higher hazards than the estimates for the counterfactuals with uninfected and untreated patients, indicating the potential impact from non-susceptible bacteria on mortality of patients with CO infections. For HO infections, non-susceptible pathogens to selected antibiotics were associated with clearly elevated hazards compared to either susceptible or uninfected groups, particularly in the analysis for RTI and BSI. Using the estimated hazard ratios and the prevalence of resistance in each stratum, we measured the AMR-associated health impact over 2012 to 2021 based on the derived population‑attributable fraction. On average, substantial mortality and morbidity were attributed to clinically important bug-drug combinations in Hong Kong over the 10 years of the study period, mainly from HO infections. Choosing different counterfactuals might lead to varied estimates of AMR-associated disease burden. Challenges and solution: We faced the following challenges in modeling the AMR-associated disease burden: (i) time‑dependent bias in HO infections, where the risk of HO infection in admitted patients varied over time during admission; (ii) complex, time‑varying AST data, with heterogeneous panels and missing or discordant results; and (iii) the need to define and operationalise AMR‑attributable and AMR‑associated mortality in a way that was both epidemiologically coherent and estimable from routine data. We addressed these by implementing dynamic exposure definitions and matching, addressing missing AST results by developing microbiology‑based stepwise decision rules for imputation, and fitting matched survival models to reduce confounding. Substantial effort was made in testing alternative definitions and specifications and in systematically checking the plausibility of resulting estimates, ensuring that the final framework is robust and suitable for publication.

17126322.label: Major findings and research outcome
17126322.value: In this study, we were able to characterise the morbidity and mortality associated with common bacterial infections, in particular the disease burden potentially attributable to AMR, using territory‑wide hospitalisation data from individual patients. It demonstrated the feasibility of providing a more accurate estimation of the AMR disease burden attributable to selected bug-drug combinations, instead of deriving an estimate solely relying on a multiplicative approach with the population-based information on AMR prevalence and the risk ratio estimated from patients groups with counterfactuals often not clearly defined. More importantly, the developed analytic methods were mechanistically plausible and clinically relevant, with flexibility to adjust catering the local need for public health policy and clinical practices. Our analyses indicated that the majority of the estimated AMR-associated disease burden estimated in HO infections while CO infections contributed a much higher hospitalization burden than HO infections overall. Relatively higher hospitalisation burden was identified in patients with UTIs and RTIs, and in older adults and younger children, based on characterised laboratory-confirmed infections. E. coli (particularly in UTI and BSI), Pseudomonas aeruginosa (RTI) and S. aureus (RTI and SSTI) were the main pathogens identified clinically. Empirical treatment was broadly similar across sites, with amoxicillin-clavulanate most frequently prescribed, followed by piperacillin-tazobactam, meropenem and levofloxacin. Among all bug-drug combinations detected in AST, extended‑spectrum cephalosporin-resistant (ESCR) E. coli accounted for the largest number of resistant infections especially in UTIs and BSIs, whereas ESCR Acinetobacter spp. and fluoquinolone-resistant Salmonella spp. showed the highest and temporally increasing detection proportions in UTIs and BSIs, respectively. Comparing mortality risk in patients with AST‑confirmed resistant infections with susceptible infections (attributable risk) and uninfected patients (associated risk) to estimate the population mortality burden of AMR over 2012-2021. Across the most commonly detected pathogen-drug combinations, HO infections accounted for the largest share of AMR deaths, with the mean attributable deaths up to 11,086 over 10 years from 2012 to 2021 and associated mortality up to 15,168 deaths (approximately 14.8 and 20.0 excess deaths per 100,000 person-years, respectively) overall for all infection sites studied. A smaller but non‑negligible burden was related to CO infections, with up to a total of 775 attributable and 6,937 associated deaths (≈1.0 and 9.3 excess deaths per 100,000 person-years) during the study period. The burden was particularly pronounced for RTIs and BSIs with an onset in hospital.

17126322.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17126322.value: Several important research directions for future studies can be identified based on the findings from this project. First, linking patient‑level antibiotic prescriptions more explicitly with the antibiogram of identified bacterial pathogens would allow assessment of the impact of AMR against antibiotics that were actually prescribed for patients. Our current analyses estimated the excess mortality risk for target infections related to non-susceptibility of selected bacterial pathogens. Extending this to specific treatment regimens would clarify how much of the burden is driven by possibly mismatched or delayed effective treatment, and support modelling of avoidable deaths and excess bed‑days under alternative prescribing strategies. Second, our results suggested changes in infection incidence and AMR burden during the COVID‑19 period, with reduced hospitalisations for several syndromes but persistent or shifting resistance patterns. Carefully evaluating the impact of COVID‑19, especially by separating effects of altered healthcare use, infection‑prevention measures, diagnostics and prescribing, would help determine whether the pandemic has led to sustained reductions, redistribution or new concentrations of AMR risk. Finally, extending the framework to quantify excess length of stay, ICU use and readmissions, and attaching unit costs, would allow estimation of the territory‑wide economic burden of AMR.

17126322.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17126322.value: Using territory‑wide hospital records, the project aimed to answer how much health impact was from the common bacterial infections, which bacterial pathogens accounted for the majority of the disease burden, how frequently bacteria insensitive to clinically important antibiotics were identified in common infections, and how much the mortality impact was associated with clinically important bacterial pathogens resistant to specific antibiotics. We were able to provides the first comprehensive, local picture of the real‑world impact of AMR in Hong Kong, using systematically developed methods. The findings of this study helped identify clinically important bacterial pathogens, antibiotics, infection types and patient groups bearing the highest disease burden. It may inform resource allocation for infection prevention and treatment, and control of AMR. The methodological framework developed in this project can be adapted and applied in other places, supporting monitor of progress against local and international AMR control targets and guiding antibiotic stewardship and policy decisions.

17126722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17126722.value: 背景： 重度抑鬱症是一種普遍且易復發的疾病，往往對患者造成巨大的負擔，甚至導致自殺等嚴重後果。大多數臨床治療指引建議患者持續至少六個月使用抗抑鬱藥物, 以改善抑鬱症狀及預防復發。然而, 停用抗抑鬱藥物在臨床上很常見。很多患者在沒有計劃下便停用抗抑鬱藥物。突然暫停使用抗抑鬱藥物可導致嚴重不良後果，包括出現焦慮症狀，甚至令抑鬱復發。目前利用真實世界數據來研究停用抗抑鬱藥物的證據有限。此外，人們越來越關注停止服用抗抑鬱藥物與自殺風險的關係。儘管有研究已經探索了相關的問題，但由於研究方法的異質性，樣本量少和亞組分析不足等，研究結果並不一致。 目的：本次研究的目的為調查停用抗抑鬱藥物的盛行率以及其與自殺之間的關係。 研究方法：本研究將採用多個地區和國家（包括香港，台灣，英國和韓國）的電子病歷 （EHR）來進行研究。我們通過EHR可獲取患者相關的處方藥物、藥房配藥記錄和診斷的資料及實驗室化驗結果。這些數據都是現有研究所沒有的。這項研究將利用描述性研究方法來調查停用抗抑鬱藥物的發生情況，停止使用的時間、模式（例如，是否突然停藥，逐步停藥還是換藥）和抗抑鬱藥物停藥後又重新服用的情況。本研究採用自身對照的病例系列研究設計來比較抗抑鬱藥物治療前，治療中和停藥期間的自殺風險。此外，我們還會採用隊列研究設計來評估抗抑鬱藥物治療時長，停藥時間長短和不同停藥模式對自殺風險的影響。 研究團隊：我們的研究團隊由來自香港，台灣，英國和韓國的流行病學、統計學、精神科和藥物學的專家組成。所有團隊成員均曾與項目主要負責人合作，並且成功完成了之前的項目。 影響：我們的研究結果將有助於醫療保健的專業人士以及抗抑鬱藥物使用者基於證據而採取最佳的抗抑鬱藥物治療方案，並降低易感人群（包括年輕人和老年人）的自殺風險。同時，醫療衛生政策制定者可以瞭解抗抑鬱藥物應用的情況，以便管理和使用醫療衛生資源。我們的結果亦可為本地和國際的治療指南提供參考，以改善抗抑鬱藥物的在全球的使用情況。

17126722.label: Realisation of objectives
17126722.value: This project successfully established multinational collaborations and harmonised population-based datasets from the UK, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea. Using standardised study protocols, we derived consistent measures of antidepressant treatment discontinuation, and self-harm outcomes across sites. Objectives 1 and 2: To describe the patterns and retention of initial antidepressant treatment and the prevalence, duration, and procedure of antidepressant discontinuation (100% achieved) Since we start this project, 15 additional collaborators from 14 countries voluntarily contributed data on these Objectives to develop an international study. These additional data were provided to our project without funding from the RGC. The additional collaborators are from Oceania (Australia and New Zealand), North America (Canada and two data sources in the US; a privately insured sample - MarketScan, and Medicaid), Northern Europe (Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden), Western Europe (France, Germany and the Netherlands), and Southern Europe (Italy and Spain). The full results are in manuscript 1. Regarding the RGC-funded part, we examined temporal trends in antidepressant prevalence and incidence across the UK, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea. All four countries demonstrated increasing prevalence over time, though the magnitude varied substantially. The UK showed the highest rate of increase (0.342 per 1,000 population per year, 95% CI 0.297-0.387), followed by South Korea (0.194 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.185-0.204), Taiwan (0.158 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.117-0.198), and Hong Kong (0.109 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.103-0.115). Prescribing patterns differed notably across countries. In the UK, SSRIs dominated and drove the prevalence increase (0.347 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.303-0.392). In contrast, South Korea's increase was predominantly driven by non-SSRI antidepressants (0.170 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.161-0.180) rather than SSRIs (0.042 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.040-0.045), reflecting different prescribing preferences. Hong Kong and Taiwan showed more balanced increases between SSRIs and non-SSRIs. Incidence trends, reflecting new treatment initiations, showed more varied patterns across countries and drug classes. The UK demonstrated modest but statistically significant increases in overall incidence (0.023 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.008-0.039), with similar increases for both SSRIs and non-SSRIs. South Korea showed the most substantial incidence increase (0.175 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.117-0.233), again driven primarily by non-SSRI antidepressants. Hong Kong showed minimal change in overall incidence (0.009 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI 0.001-0.017). Taiwan showed a non-significant increase in overall incidence (0.045 per 1,000 per year, 95% CI -0.019 to 0.109). We examined treatment retention and discontinuation patterns using the UK CPRD database, analysing treatment duration before discontinuation and discontinuation prevalence at multiple time points. Among 259,602 patients initiating antidepressant treatment, the median time to discontinuation was 87 days (IQR: 28-310 days). Treatment discontinuation was highest in the early phase, with 51.1% of patients discontinuing within the first 3 months. An additional 14.4% discontinued between 3-6 months and 12.1% between 6-12 months. Overall, 22.4% of patients (58,175) remained on treatment for at least 12 months, representing the stable treatment population examined in Objective 2. Among those continuing beyond 12 months, 24,210 (9.3%) discontinued between 12-24 months, whilst 33,965 (13.1%) remained on treatment for 24 months or longer, demonstrating substantial long-term treatment persistence. The objective has been successfully achieved with complete characterisation of antidepressant utilisation trends across all four countries, with treatment retention and discontinuation pattern analyses. Objective 3: To estimate the association between antidepressant discontinuation and the risk of suicide (100% achieved) This objective has been fully achieved. We successfully harmonised administrative healthcare databases from the UK, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea, standardising definitions for antidepressant treatment episodes, discontinuation, and self-harm outcomes across sites. Following application of eligibility criteria, the final analytic sample comprised 1,267 matched pairs in the UK, 1,598 in Hong Kong, and 1,549 in Taiwan (total 4,414 matched pairs). The South Korean database yielded only 21 matched pairs, insufficient for reliable analysis, and was therefore excluded from main analyses. Using a case-case-time-control design, we found that antidepressant discontinuation was consistently associated with increased self-harm risk across all three countries. In case-crossover analyses adjusted for time-varying concomitant medications, discontinuation was associated with substantially elevated odds: UK adjusted OR 4.36 (95% CI 2.89-6.57), Hong Kong 2.98 (1.70-5.22), and Taiwan 8.82 (5.47-14.21). After further adjustment for temporal exposure trends, associations remained elevated with point estimates ranging from 2.63 to 3.64. Subgroup analyses revealed particularly strong associations amongst patients receiving antidepressant monotherapy (UK: OR 7.07, Hong Kong: 6.46, Taiwan: 10.10), suggesting discontinuation risk is not confined to those with severe illness. Sensitivity analyses using alternative study definitions generally supported the robustness of findings in the UK and Taiwan, whilst Hong Kong results showed more variation. The objective has been successfully achieved, providing robust evidence that antidepressant discontinuation is associated with increased self-harm risk in patients with prolonged stable treatment.

17126722.label: Major findings and research outcome
17126722.value: This study successfully addressed both objectives by examining antidepressant utilisation patterns and the association between discontinuation and self-harm risk in patients with prolonged stable treatment. We characterised antidepressant utilisation trends across the UK, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea. All four countries demonstrated increasing prevalence, with the UK showing the highest rate (0.342 per 1,000 per year), followed by South Korea (0.194), Taiwan (0.158), and Hong Kong (0.109). Prescribing patterns differed notably: the UK increase was driven by SSRIs, whilst South Korea's was predominantly non-SSRI antidepressants. Analysis of 259,602 UK patients revealed that treatment discontinuation was highest early, with 51.1% discontinuing within 3 months. Overall, 22.4% remained on treatment for at least 12 months, representing the population examined in Objective 2. Using a multinational case-case-time-control design across UK, Hong Kong, and Taiwan databases, we analysed 4,414 matched pairs of patients who had completed at least one year of continuous antidepressant treatment. The key finding was a consistent association between antidepressant discontinuation and increased self-harm risk across all three healthcare systems. In case-crossover analyses adjusted for time-varying concomitant medications, discontinuation was associated with substantially elevated odds: UK adjusted OR 4.36 (95% CI 2.89-6.57), Hong Kong 2.98 (1.70-5.22), and Taiwan 8.82 (5.47-14.21). After further adjustment for temporal exposure trends using the case-case-time-control approach, associations remained elevated with point estimates ranging from 2.63 to 3.64 across the three countries, though confidence intervals were wide. The consistency of findings across three diverse healthcare systems with markedly different population characteristics strengthens confidence in this association. Despite substantial heterogeneity in outcome incidence (ranging from 0.42% in Taiwan to 17.4% in Hong Kong amongst patients with ≥1 year treatment) and baseline characteristics (prior self-harm history: 94.5% UK vs 1.9% Taiwan), the self-controlled design inherently minimised confounding by baseline risk factors, and the direction of association remained consistent. These findings address an important evidence gap by specifically examining patients with established stable therapy, the population for whom discontinuation decisions are most clinically relevant. Previous research has yielded inconsistent findings and often examined heterogeneous populations combining early and long-term discontinuers. Our focus on patients with ≥1 year continuous treatment provides clearer evidence to guide clinical decision-making. Two manuscripts reporting these findings are currently in preparation for submission to high-impact psychiatric journals.

17126722.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17126722.value: Several important research directions emerge from these findings. First, future studies should examine optimal tapering strategies by comparing different discontinuation approaches (abrupt vs gradual, varying tapering durations) to identify methods that minimise self-harm risk whilst facilitating successful treatment cessation. Second, research should identify which patients can safely stop antidepressants with lower risk. Examining factors such as treatment duration, previous depressive episodes, and history of self-harm would enable development of personalised risk assessment tools to guide clinical decisions. Third, future analyses will explore whether discontinuation risks differ by antidepressant class (SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics) and specific medications. Some antidepressants may be safer to discontinue than others, which would inform treatment selection for patients likely to need eventual discontinuation. Fourth, further analysis will explore the time course of risk following discontinuation, specifically, when risk peaks and how long elevated risk persists. This would inform the optimal duration and intensity of monitoring after treatment cessation. Finally, examining healthcare utilisation patterns before and after discontinuation, including GP visits and emergency department attendance would enable identifying early warning signs that could trigger intervention before self-harm occurs.

17126722.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17126722.value: Depression affects millions of people worldwide, and antidepressants are commonly prescribed to help manage symptoms. Doctors usually recommend that patients continue taking antidepressants for at least 6-12 months after feeling better. However, many patients eventually want to stop their medication, and we don't know enough about the safety of stopping, particularly regarding suicide risk. We studied over 8,000 patients in the UK, Hong Kong, and Taiwan who had been taking antidepressants continuously for at least one year. We compared each person's medication use in the months just before a self-harm incident with their use several months earlier. We found that stopping antidepressants was consistently linked to increased risk of self-harm across all three countries. The risk was 3 to 9 times higher after discontinuation. These findings highlight the importance of careful planning when stopping antidepressants. Patients and doctors should work together to reduce doses gradually, monitor for warning signs, and maintain regular contact during and after the discontinuation process. This research provides important evidence to help keep patients safe when making decisions about their mental health treatment.

17200222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17200222.value: 用於多層次防偽的可控結晶度二肽的3D打印

17200222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17200222.value: Dr Kim, Jitae Prof SHUM, Anderson Ho-Cheung

17200222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17200222.value: 作為工業4.0的基本要素之一，3D打印正在穩步推進。其全球市場前景廣闊，到2026年，潛在增長將達到350億美元。3D打印技術的長期願景是成為一個超越原型生產並可用於直接生產的真正製造平臺。實現這一目標的第一步是實現功能性材料的高質量可打印性，但這仍然是一個長期的挑戰。在此，我們提出研究開發一種高精度的3D打印方法，不僅能夠自由對有機材料塑形，還能對其晶體進行調控。 肽是氨基酸的短鏈。由於其獨特的、可編程的電學、光學和分子識別特性，以及生物相容性，肽正在成為下一代納米生物器件的一種有前途的基礎材料。此外，肽在弱非共價相互作用驅動下的自組裝性質使其能夠自發地形成各種微觀和納米結構，從球狀、棒狀到管狀，並在分子水平上具有卓越的結晶性能。然而，由此產生的微組裝體存在位置和晶體取向不可控的問題，限制了它們在集成芯片上的實際應用。 在該項研究中，我們計劃開發一種按需製造的方法，用於製造具有可編程形狀和可控結晶度的自由形態二肽微結構。其關鍵是將再沉澱的自組裝方法引入3D打印中。所提出的3D打印方法利用微噴嘴上形成的飛升墨水彎月面在溶劑蒸發的過程中全方位引導二肽自組裝，從而實現3D結晶微結構的製造。另外，在3D打印過程中，按需控制3D晶體微結構是通過蒸發驅動的溶劑工程實現的。如附件所示，我們的初步結果清楚地證明了3D打印可控結晶度二肽的可行性。 該項目旨在（1）瞭解飛升墨水彎月面中二肽自組裝的動力學；（2）建立結晶度可控的3D打印方法；以及（3）基於自組裝二肽的各向異性折射率或手性，打印光學各向異性編碼的防偽標簽，證明其實用性。我們期望這個項目的成果為自由3D打印與分子自組裝的結合提供工程基礎，以便在多尺度上製造具有自由度更高的電路設計的功能器件。

17200422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17200422.value: 量化研究建成环境及城市交通对人行道悬浮颗粒的影响机制

17200422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17200422.value: 随着全球城市化及工业化的不断发展，城市空气污染已经成为当今世界的一个重要环境问题。由于靠近交通且缺乏物理阻隔，街边区域（特别是人行道区域）被认为是城市空气污染暴露风险最高的地方。因此，研究城市人行道区域的空污分布及影响机制是相关学者及城市管理者的重要任务。现有相关研究往往通过局部数据及少量样本来分析推断，而且对交通及建成环境的考量较为单一或粗略。为此，本项目以PM2.5及PM10为例，旨在构建一套从数据收集到量化建模分析人行道空气质量的方法框架。该框架将利用整合了多类传感器的检测背包来移动采集城市街边人行道空气质量数据。项目的一个重要创新点在于采集背包融合了全景相机及激光雷达。利用先进的机器视觉及点云分析技术，所采数据可有效提供例如车辆类别、植被结构等一些列更为详尽的交通及城市环境数据。在整合天气及城市结构数据后，所构建的高维影响因素集可通过可解释深度学习技术来非线性量化分析各自对人行道空气质量的影响机制。项目的预期成果不仅能为学术同仁们带来一个行之有效的方法框架，也能为研究地区的政策制定及空污管理建言献策。
