17200622.value: 香港是世界上人口最稠密的城市之一，每平方公里有 27,000 人，每公里道路有 350 輛汽車。它的密度在全球名列前茅，分別是歐洲和美國的 200 倍和 1000 倍。自動駕駛技術的發展有望提高道路通行量和安全性。然而，目前的技術僅適用於高速公路等封閉道路，但不適用於開放道路，在開放道路上存在許多易受傷害的道路使用者（例如行人和騎自行車的人）的複雜人體運動。現有項目中的這種限制促使我們開發更強大的方法。 Vision Transformer是最近在計算機視覺中提出的一種新型深度神經網絡（DNN）。在許多具有挑戰性的計算機視覺任務（例如 ImageNet 視覺識別挑戰賽和 MS-COCO）中，它的性能優於其他深度網絡架構，例如流行的捲積神經網絡 (CNN)。然而，當前的 Transformer 通常比 CNN 更需要數據，限制了它們在頻繁變化的測試環境中的使用。例如，在美國訓練了一個 Transformer 來預測自動駕駛汽車的人體運動以避免碰撞後，這個訓練有素的模型應該能夠在其他城市和國家使用，因為人們可能會開車或開車去不同的地方.但是，不同的地方可能有不同的道路佈局、場景和交通規則。事實上，將訓練有素的 Transformer 應用到其它地方會顯著降低其準確性。人們經常需要標記來自不同城市的大量訓練數據，以微調模型以最適合這個新領域。但是收集和標記城市中的視頻等數據通常需要大量資源。在全球每個城市重複這樣做的成本很高。作為一種蠻力解決方案，人們同時使用來自多個城市的數據訓練單個 DNN。然而，通過這樣做，學習到的表示只是所有城市的平均表示，但在單個城市中是次優的，因為 DNN 的所有參數都是跨域共享的，並且不能同時最好地適應不同的域。這帶來了一個開放的研究問題，值得更深入的研究。 我們通過一個具有前瞻性的項目解決了這個問題：以無監督的方式在訓練不同領域有效地切換 Transformer 的學習表示，而無需通過標記來自這些領域的數據來對其進行微調。例如，我們的項目可以提供一種最佳方式，通過使用未標記數據在不同域之間切換其學習表示，將美國的訓練模型部署到歐盟和香港的不同地方。該項目需要解決三個關鍵挑戰：(1) 開發多域 Transformer，(2) 設計無監督測試時間訓練算法，以及 (3) 設計算法以有效地跨域切換錶示。

17200722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17200722.value: 用於高強導電水凝膠和器件的框架輔助組裝導電聚合物納米結構

17200722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17200722.value: Hydrogels show great promise for the construction of advanced soft electronics and biomedical devices due to their mechanical flexibility, biocompatibility, and structural permeability. Although most traditional hydrogels are electronically insulating, recent research has begun to explore conductive hydrogels, creating new possibilities for implantable bioelectrodes, soft robots, multifunctional tissue engineering platforms, solar-powered water treatment, and other emerging applications. However, their limited mechanical robustness and processability are fundamental bottlenecks for developing hydrogel-based device technologies. Current methods for improving hydrogel mechanics may compromise their water content, functionality, or means for patterning and integration with other device components. Thus, there are unmet needs for new hydrogel materials that can offer a combination of mechanical strength, electronic functionality, and processing flexibility for device fabrication. We recently developed a class of biomimetic composites from self-assembled aramid nanofibers (ANFs). The 3D interconnected ANFs emulate collagen fibrils in load-bearing biological tissues, providing an adaptive and mechanically strong framework for composite hydrogels. Our preliminary research shows that conducting polymers, such as polypyrrole, can infiltrate into the ANF network, leading to composite hydrogels with unusually high electrical and mechanical properties. Our exciting preliminary findings will require us to develop a better understanding of the mechanisms and means to control the assembly of such conductive nanocomposites for practical applications. In this proposed research, we aim to study the framework-assisted assembly of strong and electronically conductive hydrogels and explore their technological applications. We will investigate the materials interactions between conducting polymers, nanofibers, and other components for the assembly of hybrid percolating structures. Theoretical modelling will be combined with electrical and microstructural characterisation to reveal the spatial configuration of the nanomaterials and its relation to the observed macroscopic electrical behaviour. Based on an understanding of the assembly of the materials, we will engineer nanocomposite hydrogels with robust mechanical and electrical performance. Furthermore, we will develop fabrication techniques that allow patterning of these nanocomposite hydrogels into functional devices. Their potential applications in flexible mechanical sensors and solar evaporation techniques will be explored, which will add to their known utility in bioelectronic interfaces. This comprehensive research will generate critical knowledge for the development of conductive nanocomposites and a range of soft functional systems. 水凝膠由於其良好的機械靈活性、生物相容性和結構滲透性，在構建先進的柔性電子和生物醫學器件方面具有很好的前景。大多數傳統的水凝膠是電子絕緣的，然而最近的研究已經開始探索導電水凝膠，爲植入式生物電極、軟機器人、多功能組織工程平臺、太陽能水處理和其他新興應用創造了新的可能性。然而，它們有限的機械魯棒性和可加工性能是發展水凝膠器件技術的根本瓶頸。目前改進水凝膠力學性能的方法可能會導致其含水量與功能性的下降，或影響其圖案化以及與其他器件集成。因此，對於開發可以提供可觀的機械強度、電子功能性和高加工靈活性的新型水凝膠材料的需求尚未得到滿足。 我們最近開發了一系列的自組裝芳綸納米纖維(ANFs)仿生複合材料。三維相互連接的ANFs用於模擬承重生物組織中的膠原原纖維，爲複合水凝膠提供了具備良好適應性和機械強度的框架。我們的初步研究表明，導電聚合物，如聚吡咯，可以滲透到ANF網絡中，使複合水凝膠具有異常高的電學和力學性能。基於這些驚喜的初步發現，我們將致力於更深入地理解與控制這種導電納米複合材料組裝的機制和方法，以便實現實際應用。 本研究旨在研究高強度導電水凝膠的框架輔助組裝，並探索其技術應用。我們將研究導電聚合物、納米纖維和其他組份之間的相互作用，以組裝雜化滲透結構。我們將利用理論建模與電學以及微觀結構特徵相結合，揭示納米材料的空間構型以及其與觀察到的宏觀電學行爲之間的關係。基於對材料組裝的深入理解，我們將設計出具有出色機械性能和電學性能的納米複合水凝膠。此外，我們將開發製造技術，將這些納米複合水凝膠製備成功能器件。同時也會探索這些複合水凝膠在柔性機械傳感器和太陽蒸發技術方面的潛在應用，以增加水凝膠在生物電子界面的已知效用。這項全面研究將促進導電納米複合材料的開發和一系列柔性功能系統的發展。

17201022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17201022.value: 以鋼結構組裝合成建築法減少香港住宅建築全生命周期隱含碳排放研究

17201022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17201022.value: Buildings contribute significant carbon emissions over their lifecycle. Climate change makes it increasingly urgent to adopt innovative technologies to reduce the lifecycle carbon of buildings. Hong Kong (HK) is a typical city with a high population density and high-rise residential blocks as the norm. Most buildings in HK have been constructed using the cast-in-situ concrete (CISC) method, although modular integrated construction (MiC) has recently been promoted to enhance productivity and competitiveness. In theory, MiC should reduce a building’s lifecycle carbon. However, we lack systematic understanding of the embodied carbon in steel modular buildings and the influencing parameters and variables. Most lifecycle assessment theories consider only single theoretical dimensions, thereby failing to address the complexities of lifecycle embodied carbon. The dynamics of the embodied carbon of buildings in response to various uncertainties have seldom been examined. This project will address a fundamental research question: Can steel MiC help to reduce the lifecycle embodied carbon emissions of residential buildings in HK, and if so, how? This project aims to better understand the embodied carbon emissions of residential buildings adopting steel MiC compared with conventional construction, and develop and validate solutions and recommendations for effectively reducing the lifecycle embodied carbon of steel MiC residential buildings in HK. The project will be carried out over 36 months in four interrelated stages. The first stage will establish embodied carbon estimation models for steel MiC buildings, with a focus on medium- to high-rise residential buildings typical of high-density cities. The building types will include public housing, student hostels, and staff quarters, which constitute important residential sectors. The second stage will compare steel MiC with traditional cases to identify critical parameters and variables. The third stage will investigate the complexities and dynamics in quantifying embodied carbon using sensitivity analyses and fuzzy Monte Carlo simulation. Lastly, the fourth stage will develop solutions and recommendations for the effective reduction of lifecycle carbon of MiC buildings. The project outcomes will include the (1) establishment of new multi-level lifecycle embodied carbon estimation models for steel MiC residential buildings in HK, and a theoretical framework for systematic comparisons with traditional cases; (2) development and validation of low-embodied carbon steel MiC solutions for residential buildings in HK; (3) development and validation of recommendations for achieving effective embodied carbon reductions, while considering the impact of lifecycle costs and project delivery times; and (4) advancements in the knowledge and practice of low-embodied carbon steel MiC buildings. 建築在全生命週期中的碳排放顯著。氣候變化使得采用創新技術來減少建築生命周期碳排放變得越來越緊迫。香港擁有最密集的人口，高層住宅建築成為常態。盡管最近香港開始推廣三維（3D）組裝合成建築法（MiC），以提高生產力和競爭力，大多數建築仍舊采用传统的現澆混凝土(CISC)方法建造。理論上，使用MiC可以減少建築物生命週期碳排放。但是，目前對於鋼結構模塊化建築的隱含碳排放及其影響參數和變量缺乏系統性理解。大多數全生命周期評估理論只考慮單一的理論維度，未能考慮全生命周期隱含碳的復雜性。而對建築隱含碳測算過程存在的不確定也少有研究。 此項目將解決一個基本的研究問題：鋼結構組裝合成建築法是否有助於減少香港住宅建築的全生命周期隱含碳，如果是，如何減少。此項目旨在研究與傳統的二維系統相比，鋼結構模塊化建築的隱含碳排放表現，開發並驗證能夠有效降低香港鋼結構住宅建築的全生命周期隱含碳排放的解決方案和建議。該項目將分四個階段進行，為期36個月。第一階段是建立三維鋼結構模塊化建築的排放估算模型，重點是高密度城市典型的中高層住宅建築。建築類型將包括構成重要住宅部分的公共住房、學生宿舍和員工宿舍。第二階段將鋼結構模塊化建築與傳統案例進行比較，以確定關鍵參數和變量。第三階段將利用敏感性分析和模糊蒙特卡羅模擬來定量研究隱含碳排放的復雜性和動力學。最終，製定能有效降低香港鋼結構模块化住宅建築的全生命周期隱含碳排放的解決方案和建議。 該項目的成果將包括（1）針對採用鋼結構三維組裝合成建築法的香港高層住宅建築的多層次隱含碳排放估算模型，以及與傳統案例進行系統比較的理論框架,（2）針對採用鋼結構三維組裝合成建築法的香港高層住宅建築低碳方案的開發和驗證,（3）考慮全生命周期成本和項目交付時間的低碳方案的開發和驗證, 以及（4）針對香港低碳鋼結構模塊化高層住宅建築的理論和實踐的提升。

17201622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17201622.value: 四維打印於子宮組織工程中的應用

17201622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17201622.value: Uterus is an important organ in women and giving birth to healthy babies is essential for our society. Infertility owing to damage to uterine tissue and surgical removal of uterus to treat womb’s medical conditions including cancer deprive women in reproductive age of the rights of having their own biological children. Around the world, among the 14% of couples in reproductive age who have infertility problem, 0.2% of women suffer from absolute uterine factor infertility due to uterus dysfunction. Also, 12-15% of female cancer patients are diagnosed with gynecologic cancers and 8% of these are endometrial and occur in child-bearing age. Solutions must be developed to repair damaged uterine tissue and moreover, regenerate the uterus. Tissue engineering has made significant advances in regenerating skin, bone, cartilage, etc. Although progress in uterine tissue engineering lags behind, researchers have been investigating cell-, biomolecule-, or scaffold-based strategies for uterine tissue regeneration. Scaffolds play vital roles for cells and in new tissue formation. Growth factor (GF)-encapsulated scaffolds can greatly enhance tissue regeneration. 4D printing, as a powerful manufacturing platform, can produce complex scaffolds with shape-morphing ability for regenerating complex body tissues. However, its application in uterine tissue engineering has been rare. This project will investigate 4D printing of new multilayered scaffolds for uterine tissue regeneration. It will develop a highly elastic and shape-memory biomaterial and use it for 4D printing of shape-morphing, mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)- and biomolecule-encapsulated multilayered scaffolds modeled on uterine tissue structure. Different scaffold layers in multilayered scaffolds will have the architectures to fulfil their functions. An MSC-containing bioink will be formulated for printing MSC-encapsulated struts in scaffold layers. Different inks containing different biomolecules (including GFs) will be used to print biomolecule-incorporated struts in a scaffold layer and for biomolecules’ dual delivery, to be electrospun into another fibrous scaffold layer. Controlled in vitro or in vivo GF release will induce MSCs in scaffolds to differentiate into target cells and promote cell proliferation. At body temperature, the shape-morphing scaffold layer will cause self-rolling of planar multilayered scaffolds to form curved scaffolds suitable for uteri. This project will systematically study the formation (via 4D printing and electrospinning), structures and properties (including biological performance) of various scaffolds that will be made during new scaffold development, with MSC- and biomolecule-encapsulated and multilayered scaffolds being the ultimate structure to achieve. The studies will address a multitude of issues in biomaterials development, biomanufacturing, science and medicine. 子宮是女性的一個重要器官，而且生育健康的嬰兒對於社會的發展至關重要。子宮組織的損傷和因以治療包括癌症在內的疾病而切除子宮所導致的不孕症剝奪了育齡婦女生育孩子的權利。全球範圍內，大約有14%的育齡夫婦患有不孕症，其中0.2%的女性因子宮功能障礙而患有絕對子宮因素不孕症。此外，12-15%的女性癌症患者被診斷患有婦科癌症，其中8%的女性在育齡期被診斷為子宮內膜癌。因此，必須探索新的治療方法來修復受損了的子宮組織或創造性地進行子宮再生。組織工程已經在皮膚、骨、軟骨等的人體組織再生方面取得了重大進展。儘管子宮組織工程領域的進展有所滯后，但科研人員一直進行基於細胞、生長因子或組織工程支架的組織工程策略的子宮組織再生的研究。組織工程支架對細胞和新組織的生成起着至關重要的作用。載有生長因子的組織工程支架可以極大地促進人體組織的再生。作為一個強大的製造平台，四維打印可以製備具有變形能力的、複雜的組織工程支架用以再生複雜的人體組織。然而，它在子宮組織工程中的應用卻非常少見。 該項目將研究應用四維打印技術製備新型多層結構的組織工程支架用於子宮組織的再生。它將開發一種具有高彈性和形狀記憶的生物材料，並且以子宮組織結構為模版，將其用於四維打印來製備具有形變能力、載有間充質幹細胞和活性生物分子的、多層結構的組織工程支架。在該多層支架中，不同的支架層具有不同的結構從而實現它們的各自功能。將研製一種含有間充質幹細胞的生物墨水用來打印載有間充質幹細胞的支架層。將用含有不同活性生物分子（包括生長因子）的不同墨水打印包裹生物分子的支架層，並用靜電紡絲技術製備纖維狀支架層，從而實現活性生物分子的雙重控釋。體外或者體內生長因子的可控釋放將誘導支架中的間充質幹細胞分化為特定細胞並促進細胞增殖。在體溫環境中，具有形變能力的支架層將導致平面的、多層結構的整個組織工程支架自動捲曲從而形成適合子宮形狀的彎曲支架。該項目將系統性地研究在新支架開發過程中各種支架的製備（通過四維打印和靜電紡絲而製成的）、結構和性能（包括生物性能），最終創建具有形變能力、載有間充質幹細胞和活性生物分子的、多層結構的組織工程支架。該項目的研究將解決生物材料開發、生物製造、科學和醫學方面的眾多問題。

17201822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17201822.value: 通過計算光學成像實現無透鏡低光成像

17201822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17201822.value: The notion that taking images requires lenses -- and the quality of the lenses being the major factor contributing to the resulting image quality -- is deeply ingrained in the mindset of most people. While this may still hold true, it is not necessarily a practical guideline for many imaging applications, due to the cost and bulkiness of such optical systems. The paradigm of computational optical imaging enables the alternative of replacing the lenses altogether with simple optical elements such as masks, shifting the burden to computational algorithms in reconstructing the images. Such lensless imaging has promises for a variety of uses, from internet-of-things and wearables to biomedical microscopy and endoscopy. While the quality of lensless imaging has seen consistent improvement over the past few years, most designs either assume active illumination or sufficient ambient lighting. In this proposal, our aim is to push the capability of lensless imaging to a low light environment. In addition to exploring and at the same time expanding the limit of lensless imaging, this can also enable its further use in surveillance, automatic navigation, and mobile imaging under more demanding situations. The major challenge is the significant reduction of photons captured by the detector, and therefore we need to maximize their utilization as otherwise even less reliable information would be available for the subsequent computation. Our starting point is a preliminary work that explicitly incorporates model mismatch in the computational reconstruction, which is a hybrid network combining physics-based optimization and a data-driven compensation branch, resulting in better performance compared to existing reconstruction methods. We will build upon this in three ways: concerning the algorithms, we will re-design the compensation branch and incorporate effects of low light imaging in the image modeling. Concerning the masks, we will investigate various options and design methodologies, from handcrafted phase masks obtained from phase retrieval with a target point-spread function to a learned co-design of the mask pattern and reconstruction algorithm. Concerning the detector and the entire system, we will investigate low-light detector and various mask placement and capture strategies, from snapshot to harnessing diversity through multiple images. Together we aim to push the lensless imaging capabilities not only in delivering photorealistic reconstruction but also in obtaining depth information and object identification. This will be demonstrated through both a lab-based system and a mobile lensless imaging prototype with on-board camera and computation. 在大多數人的觀念中，拍攝圖像需要鏡頭的概念根深蒂固，而鏡頭的質量是影響最終圖像質量的主要因素。這本身有其道理，但由於此類光學系統的成本和體積往往龐大，它不一定適用於所有成像應用。計算光學成像的範式使得可以用簡單的光學元件（例如掩模）完全替換透鏡，從而將重建圖像的重責轉移到計算算法上。這種無鏡頭成像有望用於各種用途，包括物聯網、可穿戴設備、和生物醫學顯微鏡及內窺鏡檢查。 雖然無透鏡成像的技術在過去幾年中不斷提高，但大多數設計要求採用主動照明，或是要有足夠的環境照明。在這個研究計劃，我們的目標是將無鏡頭成像的能力推向低光環境。除了探索並同時推進無鏡頭成像的極限，也可以使其在更嚴苛的情況下進一步應用於監測、自動導航和移動成像。我們面對的主要挑戰是探測器捕獲的光子顯著減少，因此我們需要最大程度地善用它們，否則用於後續計算只有更少可靠的信息。我們的出發點建基在計算重建中明確包含模型失配的初步工作，這是一個結合了基於物理的優化和數據驅動的補償分支的混合網絡，與現有的重建方法相比具有更好的性能。我們將以三種方式以此為基礎：關於算法，我們將重新設計補償分支並將低光成像的效果納入圖像建模中。關於掩模，我們將研究各種選項和設計方法，從通過具有目標點擴展函數的相位檢索獲得的手工相位掩模到掩模圖案和重建算法的學習協同設計。關於探測器和整個系統，我們將研究低光探測器和各種掩模放置和捕獲策略，包括快照和利用多幅圖像的多樣性。我們的目標是共同推動無鏡頭成像功能，不僅在提供逼真的重建方面，亦在獲得景深和物體識別方面。這將通過基於實驗室的系統和移動無鏡頭成像原型進行演示。

17202422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17202422.value: 面向深度視覺理解的組合式神經網絡數據生成器

17202422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17202422.value: 視覺場景理解是計算機視覺領域中的一項長期挑戰，其目的是讓機器像人類一樣感知視覺世界。它涵蓋了許多基本任務，包括對象檢測、語義解析、視覺關係分析和幾何估計等。在過去十年中，在大規模標註數據集的支持下，深度學習已成為該領域的主導方法，並在許多任務上取得了顯著進展。相對於當前大量為各種視覺任務來設計深度學習模型的研究工作，另一個關鍵問題，即如何有效和自動地構建大規模數據集，在很大程度上沒有受到研究的關注。目前，數據獲取、標註和質量控制大多是靠手動完成的，這種方式費力、耗時、昂貴、容易受到註釋偏差的影響，並且無法涵蓋所有現實世界的變化，例如長尾場景。因此，訓練數據已成為限制深度視覺模型在現實世界中表現的主要瓶頸之一。該項目的目的是開發一個基於學習的數據集模擬器，該模擬器可以生成和擴充帶有標籤（例如語義實例掩碼）的新訓練樣本（例如圖像），這些生成的數據可以用於訓練視覺場景理解模型。這是一項具有挑戰性的任務，因為它需要模擬器對場景背後的各種潛在因素進行聯合建模，例如對象和背景的語義關係、不同的對象形狀和外觀、傳感器視點以及環境的照明條件。我們觀察到，場景是三維空間中若干獨立對象和背景的結構化組合，並且受諸如照明條件等其他環境因素影響。這個項目將基於這個簡單的事實，通過分解、生成和組合這些潛在因素來生成帶註釋的場景。為了讓我們的模型以這種組合方式生成一個新的標註場景，我們將首先開發一個基於神經網絡的場景分解模塊，它可以將給定的場景分解為獨立的元素，包括單個對象、背景、它們的關係和相機模型。接下來，我們將設計一個組合生成式模型來預測新的解耦因子並將以上各獨立元素組合起來以創建一個新的帶有標註的場景。此外，基於創建的新場景，我們將設計一個基於神經網絡的數據集渲染模型，該模型可以模擬傳感器效果（例如相機視點）和照明條件，以模擬各種不同的數據採集環境並生成帶有標註的訓練樣本。最後，我們將設計一個質量評估模塊以排除生成的低質量數據的干擾。該框架將在包括語義解析、實例分割和對象檢測在內的基本場景理解任務上進行評估，且所有源代碼都將在 GitHub 上公開。該成果將推進深度生成模型和神經渲染研究的發展，在捕獲和註釋數據集方面為研究人員提供新的思路，並提高深度場景理解模型在真實世界中的表現。

17202522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17202522.value: 解析城市污水系統中質粒介導的抗菌素耐藥基因傳播

17202522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17202522.value: Antibiotic resistance has been one of the greatest challenges facing humanity today. Numerous cases of antibiotic resistance have rendered treatment failure, posing a great threat to human health. Besides clinical setting, the environment has been recognized as an important reservoir of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs). As the interaction interface between bacteria originating from the human gut and the environment, the urban wastewater system (UWS) has particularly been suggested as a pathway for ARG dissemination. Indeed, the UWS borne antibiotic resistance has been largely attributed to plasmid-mediated ARG transmission. Plasmids — extrachromosomal replicons, can efficiently shuttle ARGs across diverse taxa — a process known as horizontal gene transfer. It is therefore essential to evaluate to what extent and in which way the plasmid behaviour in UWS contribute to ARG transmission in the environment. Coupling cutting-edge sequencing technologies and experimental tools, we here propose the integrated research project to decipher plasmid-mediated ARG transmission in UWSs and explore novel control strategies. We will carry out five tasks to address relevant key research questions, in which Task-1 will investigate correlation between plasmids, ARGs and microbial communities through UWS compartments; Task-2 will reconstruct in situ plasmid-host associations in wastewater microbial communities; Task-3 will decipher transfer potential of intracellular and extracellular plasmids in wastewater environment; Task-4 will further examine the mechanism of cellular response and gene expression regulating plasmid transfer under environmental stresses; the final effort of Task-5 will explore novel control strategy of plasmid-dependent phage therapy to curb plasmid transmission in wastewater environment. The efforts of all the five tasks in the project will identify options of science and technique which should be prioritized to tackle the plasmid-mediated ARG transmission in UWSs. The project will have significant impacts, both short-term and long-term, on multiple aspects of scientific research, technology development and public health. The knowledge generated in this project will fill several research gaps in environmental dimension of antibiotic resistance. We believe the project will facilitate setting up an integrated ‘One Health’ framework by providing comprehensive knowledge of the environmental dimension of plasmid-mediated ARG transmission. 抗菌素耐藥性是現今人類面對的巨大挑戰。由於抗菌素耐藥性導致的治療失敗不計其數，對人類健康造成了巨大威脅。環境已被公認為是繼醫療系統之後，抗菌素耐藥性基因的一個重要儲庫。其中，城市污水系統作為人類腸道菌和環境來源菌的相互作用界面，已被認為是抗菌素耐藥性基因傳播的重要途徑。而污水中抗菌素耐藥性基因的富集極大程度歸因於質粒介導的抗菌素耐藥性基因傳播。質粒作為染色體外的獨立複製子，可通過水平基因轉移方式在不同菌種之間高效傳播耐藥性基因。因此，評估污水中質粒的傳播潛力和途徑，及其對環境中抗菌素耐藥性基因擴散的貢獻，具有重要意義。本項目通過結合先進的測序和實驗技術，將全面解析城市污水系統中質粒介導的抗菌素耐藥性基因的傳播，同時探索可能的控制策略。在該項目中，我們將開展五項研究任務，致力於解決相關關鍵科學問題。其中，任務一將研究城市污水系統中質粒、耐藥性基因和微生物群落的相關性；任務二將重建污水菌群中原位質粒和宿主關聯性；任務三將解析胞內和胞外質粒在污水環境中的傳播潛力；任務四將進一步研究環境壓力下，調控質粒轉移的細胞應急和基因表達機制；任務五將探索通過噬菌體控制污水中質粒傳播的方法。該項目的五個任務將共同致力於尋找在科學和技術層面，控制質粒介導抗菌素耐藥性基因傳播的可能途徑。該項目在科學研究，技術開發和公共健康方面，兼具短期和長遠重要意義。項目所產生的成果將彌補環境抗菌素耐藥性基因研究領域的重要空白。我們相信該項目通過全面認識環境中耐藥性基因的傳播將有助於建立“一體化健康”的公共衛生管理框架。

17203022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17203022.value: 基於表達能力更優的線性規劃解決概率模型下的在線匹配問題

17203022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17203022.value: 現實場景中的優化問題往往需要處理信息的不確定性。比如在年利潤數達百億的在線廣告問題中，廣告平台在收到一個用戶查詢請求時需要馬上決定給用戶顯示哪些廣告，這時對於將來還會有哪些用戶查詢無法準確預測。解決這類問題的一個主要工具是利用線性規劃以刻畫要解決的優化問題，並基於線性規劃的結構做出在線決策。直觀而言，通過引入更多的變量和限制條件我們可以得到更具表達能力的線性規劃，從而更好地引導算法作出在線決策。雖然類似的方法在離線優化問題中得到了廣泛的應用，但是對於在線優化問題目相關的方法前還沒有系統的理論研究。本項目將以項目負責人所熟悉的在線匹配問題為切入點，探索線性規劃表達能力與在線算法設計與分析之間的關係。

17203122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17203122.value: 拜占庭網絡中自我驅動節點之間的去中心化、私有、高通訊效率的集成聯邦學習

17203122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17203122.value: This project will investigate clustered federated learning (FL) among self-motivated nodes whose datasets may be sampled from different distributions. FL is introduced for the setting when the empirical data is partitioned among many nodes that participate in a distributed protocol to generate a common model vector, which would hopefully provide good prediction or classification accuracy on another dataset resembling the combined distribution over all nodes. Because of data privacy or communication cost, typically each node keeps its empirical dataset to itself, on which local computation is performed to produce model parameters that are communicated between the nodes. Since the nodes may sample their datasets from very different distributions, a common model vector may not necessarily be suitable for an individual node. In this project, we consider the scenario in which each node is a self-motivated agent, whose goal is to learn a model vector that is suitable for itself. A 2021 work by Donahue and Kleinberg applied the concept of hedonic game to FL and studied how nodes are motivated to form clusters (aka coalitions) such that information is only exchanged between nodes within a cluster. One limitation of their approach is that the decisions on forming coalitions are based only on whether the reduced variance due to more sampled data from different nodes can offset the increased variance due to difference in data distributions. On the contrary, we will also consider stability notions of coalition structures that depend on information derived from the nodes’ empirical datasets, because intuitively nodes with datasets drawn from similar distributions would benefit one another by performing FL together. Because our protocols will achieve privacy and communication efficiency, the model parameters exchanged between nodes will inherently contain random noise. In addition to investigating how these random noises influence the convergence of model vectors in the clusters, we will also consider how this will affect the stability of the resulting coalition structures. Furthermore, to apply the protocols in practical settings, we will develop reward mechanisms to incentivize nodes to cooperate. We will also employ security techniques to defend against Byzantine nodes that might attempt to disrupt the protocols. This project will contribute theoretically to the game and model convergence analysis of clustered FL and impact the practical design of secure, private and efficient FL protocols. 本課題將會研究自我驅動的節點之間的集成聯邦學習，當中這些節點的數據集可能自不同的分佈中採樣。當一個分布式協議中的經驗性數據被劃分存入協議中不同節點以生成一個公共模型向量時，引入聯邦學習將有助於爲另一個在所有節點的聯合分佈上與其相似的數據集提供一個良好的預測或良好的分類準度。出於數據隱私或通訊成本考量，通常每個節點會自我保留其經驗性數據集，在本地對其執行運算後，生成用於與其他節點進行通訊的相關模型參數。 由於不同的節點可能自非常不同的分佈中採樣，一個公共模型向量未必適用於單個節點。在本課題中，我們將會考慮這樣一個情景：每個節點都是一個自我驅動的代理人，而其目標是通過學習得到一個適用於自身的模型向量。Donahue 與 Kleinberg 於 2021 年的一項工作將享樂博弈的概念應用於聯邦學習，並研究不同節點是如何被驅動形成集羣（亦稱聯盟），從而使得信息只會在同一個集羣的節點之間進行交換。該研究的一個局限在於，其關乎是否形成聯盟的決定僅基於一個因素：自不同節點中採樣更多數據，從而導致的方差減少是否能夠抵消數據分佈差異導致的方差增加。與之相反，直觀上看，對保有採樣自相似分佈數據集的節點，讓它們共同執行聯邦學習將可使其互相受益，爲此，我們還將考慮聯盟結構的穩定性概念，而該結構依賴從節點的經驗性數據集中得到的信息。 由於我們的協議會實現隱私和高通訊效率，節點之間交換的模型參數將會固有地帶有隨機噪聲。除了探究這些隨機噪聲會如何影響集羣模型向量的收斂性外，我們亦會考慮其將如何影響得到的聯盟結構的穩定性。此外，爲了能夠在實際環境中應用該協議，我們將研發獎勵機制，以激勵節點之間進行合作。我們亦會應用不同的安全技術，以抵御可能會嘗試破壞協議的拜占庭節點。本課題將爲集成聯邦學習的博弈和模型收斂分析提供理論貢獻，並影響安全、私有和高效的聯邦學習協議的實際設計。

17203522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17203522.value: 大規模動態圖上的高效分佈式 GNN 學習

17203522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17203522.value: 本項目研究在大型動態圖上實現圖神經網絡 (GNN) 高效分佈式訓練的算法和策略。我們研究包括在線圖劃分、特徵量化和流水線處理調度在內的關鍵問題，這些問題將解決分佈式 GNN 在動態圖上學習的主要性能瓶頸。我們的目標是在不斷演化的圖數據上實現高訓練效率和高模型準確性。 動態、隨時間變化的圖在現實生活的各個領域都很常見，包括社交應用程序中的社交網絡、電子商務系統中的用戶產品圖和生物學中的分子交互網絡。 GNN 已成為強大的圖分析模型，越來越多地用於捕獲更複雜的特徵以進行交互分析、推薦/廣告和蛋白質推理等。然而，目前的研究主要進行靜態圖上的GNN 學習，而忽略了許多現實世界圖的動態特性。現實生活中的圖隨著時間的推移而演變，包括新節點/邊的添加，現有節點/邊的刪除，以及節點/邊的特徵變化。分佈式 GNN 訓練的主要瓶頸在於跨圖存儲和訓練器（又名工作人員）的大型圖數據傳輸，這是模型學習過程中最耗時的部分。在大型、隨時間變化的圖上學習 GNN 模型面對新的挑戰：新的和歷史的圖數據均需要不斷被獲取以進行訓練；高效的流量縮減和數據預處理/訓練並行化是減少訓練時間和保證模型性能的關鍵。 首先，隨著時間的推移，新添加和變更的圖數據需很好的存儲到分佈式圖存儲中，以使持續模型學習期間跨機器數據傳輸最小化。 其次，動態圖數據的預處理（對新數據和歷史數據進行採樣和批處理）和 GNN 訓練應該最優的並行化，以實現快速模型收斂和對演化圖的有效持續學習。 此外，量化已被證明可有效加速深度神經網絡訓練。如何在新的和歷史的圖數據上設計特徵量化方案值得探索，以在分佈式 GNN 學習期間有效地減少機器間流量。 在本項目中，我們將研究有效的在線圖劃分算法和特徵量化策略，以最大限度地減少演化圖分佈式 GNN 訓練中的機器間數據傳輸。我們還將設計優化的執行和傳輸計劃，以並行化動態圖預處理和 GNN 訓練。我們追求能夠證明最優性或有理論基礎的算法和策略。我們還將進一步創新地實現用於動態圖學習的分佈式 GNN 訓練系統，並在現實世界 AI 雲中用有代表性的動態圖和 GNN 工作負載進行算法和系統評估。

17203922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17203922.value: 網絡化系統分佈式估計與控制的事件觸發綜合

17203922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17203922.value: Networks facilitate the distributed deployment of the components of a control system, which have reshaped the conventional centralised control system and given birth to distributed networked systems. In the past decades, two types of distributed networked systems, namely, sensor networks--- a system with components/sensors distributedly deployed and multi-agent systems--- a system with subsystems that are distributedly connected-- have been widely applied in industrial control, critical infrastructures, and service systems. Despite the superiority of networked systems, such as high system flexibility, low maintenance costs, and increased scalability, the network-induced constraints that may severely degrade the system performance bring challenges to the system synthesis. In particular, limited communication bandwidth and energy resources should be seriously considered. This project will study the estimation of sensor networks and coordination of multi-agent systems under event-triggered mechanisms. Novel event-triggered mechanisms will be proposed to appropriately address some critical and complex communication limitations in networked systems. First, the security and privacy of networked sensing under communication constraints will be studied. Attack-triggered conditions that may lead to the switching of the communication topology structure will be established. State estimation schemes to achieve information fusion will be derived, and the estimator’s performance will be analysed. As another security issue, to prevent sensitive information from being compromised during fusion, entropy characterising the randomness of a quantity will evaluate the information-sharing level. An event-triggered mechanism will be established to protect data and alleviate communication burdens. Second, as the energy/power of agents is often limited, an event-triggered condition will be developed based on agents’ energy/power level. Under this framework, different communication patterns will be scheduled so that the prescribed performance of the networks can be optimised using barrier functions. Third, a practical issue is that agents’ communication resources may be limited to a different extent when agents are confined within other regions. Thus region-based triggering mechanisms will be investigated to address this problem. Distributed protocols will be designed with state-dependent communication topologies to tackle region-based constraints. The results developed in this project will deliver event-triggered networked control schemes with efficient communication protocols that meet resource conservation demand while achieving good performance in complex environments. Moreover, the insights gained will provide new perspectives and tools for addressing the critical problems encountered in networked communication applications. 網絡化促進了控制系統各組成部分的分佈式部署，改變了傳統的集中控制系統，催生了分佈式網絡系統。在過去的幾十年中，兩種分佈式網絡系統，即傳感器網絡----一種具有分佈式部署的組件/傳感器系統，和多智能體系統----一種包含多個分佈式子系統的系統，已廣泛應用於工業控制、關鍵基礎設施、和服務系統中。儘管網絡化系統具有高靈活性、較低的維護成本和較高的可擴展性等的優勢，但是網絡化誘發的限制可能嚴重降低系統性能，從而對系統綜合問題帶來挑戰。特別是有限的通信帶寬和能源資源應該被認真考慮。本項目將研究事件觸發機制下傳感器網絡的估計和多智能體系統的協調。一些新的事件觸發機制將被提出，來恰當地解決網絡化系統中一些關鍵和複雜的通信限制。首先，本項目將研究通信限制下網絡化感知的安全性和隱私性問題。建立可能導致通信拓撲結構切換的基於攻擊的觸發條件。推導可以實現信息融合的狀態估計方案，並且會對估計器的性能進行分析。另一個安全問題是如何防止敏感信息在融合過程中被泄露，由於熵可以衡量一個量的隨機性，它將被用來評估信息共享的水平。基於此建立事件觸發機制來保護數據和減輕通信負擔。其次，由於智能體的能量/功率往往是有限的，該項目將根據智能體的能量/功率水平來建立事件觸發條件。在這個架構下，不同的通訊模式將會被安排，以便利用屏障函數來優化網絡的預設性能。其三，一個實際問題是，當智能體被限定在不同區域時，其通信資源可能會受到不同程度的限制。因此，將研究基於區域的觸發機制來解決這一問題。將設計具有狀態依賴型的通信拓撲的分佈式協議來解決基於區域的約束。該項目開發的結果將提供具有高效通信協議的事件觸髮網絡控制方案，滿足資源節約需求，同時在複雜環境中實現良好的性能。此外，所獲得的見解將為解決網絡通信應用中遇到的關鍵問題提供新的視角和工具。

17204122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17204122.value: 新型多阶段机器学习框架在基于多数据源驱动的智能风电场偏航控制的应用

17204122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17204122.value: Dr Ti, Zilong Prof YANG, Hong-xing

17204122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17204122.value: 目前，大型风电场在世界范围内进入建造黄金期，其中最大的海上风电场沃尔尼风电场占地145平方公里，总共配备87台8MW风机。通常风机在风电场内排列较为紧密，因此上游风机的尾流效应将造成下游风机来流风速的亏损以及湍流度的增加，从而进一步造成风电场总功率的严重损失。 传统的贪婪控制忽略尾流干涉仅最大化每台风机的自身功率，将导致风电场总功率的严重亏损。协同功率控制通过发展一定的协同偏航策略来动态调整上游风机的尾流轨迹使其偏离下游风机，从而有效克服上述贪婪控制的缺陷。这种方式通过牺牲单个风机的功率来实现风电场整体风能利用率的大幅度提升。然后，就目前发展现状而言，协同尾流偏航控制策略的应用仍然面临诸多技术层面上的挑战，主要包括：（1）标准的解析尾流模型虽然高效，但不能准备刻画风电场偏航尾流的高湍流特性；（2）高保真的CFD分析能够显著提高尾流预测精度，但模拟大型风电场尾流将带来昂贵的计算成本，更不适用实时偏航控制；（3）需要合理的融合多源数据来尽可能减少基于单一模拟的功率预测误差的不确定性；（4）一个复杂风电场的实时尾流偏航控制包含大量的设计参数优化，如每台风机的偏航角，目前缺少成熟的算法仅依靠有限的实测数据来实现上述多参数优化。 本课题的主要目标是建立起一套具有创新性的多阶段机器学习框架应用于大型风电场的实时协同功率控制。该框架主要包括四部分：基于模拟的ANN（人工神经网络）功率模型，贝叶斯优化系统，强化学习功率修正体系和尾流偏航ANN模型，并通过如下三阶段来加以实现。在基于模拟的协同偏航控制初期，基于模拟的ANN功率模型驱动贝叶斯优化系统来确定协同偏航控制策略，同时利用上述偏航策略下实时反馈的功率实测数据，通过强化学习网络训练出一个新的实测率定的ANN模型来对基于模拟的功率预测结果进行修正；在此基础上，在多源数据驱动的协同偏航控制的修正阶段，实测率定的功率修正模型将与基于模拟的功率预测模型一起驱动贝叶斯优化系统以获得更加精确的最优偏航角组合；最后在实时协同偏航控制的技术成熟阶段，利用修正阶段获取的大量来流条件以及对应最优偏航策略的数据组合训练出一个高效的尾流偏航ANN模型，直接建立起来流与最优偏航组合的一一对应关系。带有实测数据修正的基于模拟的ANN功率模型以及协同功率控制策略将会在风洞试验中得到进一步验证。总而言之，多源数据驱动的新型多阶段机器学习框架不仅可以应用于风电场的尾流控制，在其他复杂的物理系统中也具有较大的发展潜力，并且该课题通过提高风能效率也能进一步推动碳中和目标的实现。

17204222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17204222.value: 一種用於動態和高精度操作的靈巧空中連續型機械臂

17204222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17204222.value: 由於其敏捷性、機動性和適應性，無人機已經被用於很多應用，包括但不限於空中攝影、精準農業、空中檢測和緊急投遞。盡管有這些成功的應用，無人機也面臨著巨大的挑戰。其中之一便是與環境的有限物理交互。這極大的限制了無人機在一些需要操作或跟環境進行交互的任務中的使用。 空中機械臂，通過結合無人機的移動性和機械臂的操作能力，能夠增強與環境的物理交互。然而，空中機械臂也面臨著諸多挑戰。第一個挑戰是無人機的有限負載能力與機械臂靈活性的沖突。小型無人機不能夠承載多自由度的大型機械臂，從而極大的限制了機械臂的靈活性。另一個重大挑戰在於無人機和機械臂的動力學耦合。機械臂的運動會影響無人機的運動，反之亦然。這使得空中機械臂很難去執行動態的或高精度的空中操作任務，例如抓取一個移動的物體或空中繪畫。 在本項目中，我們考慮一種新的結合了四旋翼無人機的機動性和連續型機械臂的操作性的空中機械臂。初步研究成果顯示，與傳統的空中機械臂相比，我們提出的連續型機械臂可以在不損失承載能力的情況下提供更多的靈活性。由於其具有彎曲、伸展和扭轉等彈性運動，多自由度的連續型機械臂極其靈活、靈巧。然而，連續型機械臂的動力學與傳統的機械臂完全不同。因此，本項目將對連續型機械臂的動態可行性軌跡生成和跟蹤進行系統性的研究，以使其進行靈活和高精度的空中操作。具體來說，我們將會研究在有負載情況下的精確的端到端的建模、微分平坦性、動態可行性軌跡生成以及防脫線的高精度跟蹤。我們將進行廣泛的實際實驗去驗證我們提出系統的有效性。該項目的順利完成將會為靈巧空中操作帶來新的視角，促進空中機械臂在理論和實踐中的發展。最終，它將增強空中機械臂的物理交互能力，因此將促進智慧城市的發展。

17204322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17204322.value: 增強擠出式3D打印超高性能應變硬化水泥基複合材料（UHP-SHCC）的流變和硬化性能

17204322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17204322.value: Prof Leung, Christopher K Y Prof Qian, Ye

17204322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17204322.value: Since the invention of modern Portland cement and reinforced concrete structures more than 150 years ago, the construction method has hardly changed. It consists of two main steps: i) setting up the formwork, and ii) casting the concrete and vibrating it to fill the formwork. The development of self-consolidating concrete (SCC) over the past thirty years eliminates the vibration process. Further on, extrusion-based 3D printing uses gantry or robotic arms to build up structures layer by layer, thus eliminating both vibration and the use of formwork. It will greatly advance the automation of concrete construction for free design, and will also decrease material waste, labor costs, and human error. The conventional extrusion-based 3D printing faces the challenges of adding traditional reinforcement bars. Strain Hardening Cementitious Composites (SHCC), or Engineered Cementitious Composites (ECC), exhibit tensile strain-hardening and multiple cracking behaviors under tension. With the ability to sustain significant tensile stress up to high strain levels, SHCC potentially offer a solution to enhance the robustness of 3D-printed concrete members and overcome the incompatibility with conventional reinforcements. However, the smooth and continuous printing of SHCC is still a challenge. Meanwhile, the need for high-performance concrete, including high-strength and high-modulus concrete, is also critical. For example, Ultra-High Performance Concrete (UHPC) with dense microstructures and hence high resistance to water/chemical penetration could significantly enhance the durability of the civil infrastructures. However, it also faces the challenges in mixing and placement due to the high viscosity and stickiness. Instead of placing/casting the entire structure, 3D printing technology offers a promising solution in which permanent formworks can be built up layer by layer. Therefore, as a fundamental study, the proposed project will aim to enhance various properties of Ultra-High Performance Strain Hardening Cementitious Composites (UHP-SHCC) with both high performance and high ductility for 3D concrete printing. The key to the success is to mix, pump and extrude the cement matrix with fibers efficiently. The PI has 3D printed SHCC and studied its rheological properties. The proposed study intends to address more of the challenges in incorporating hybrid fibers in UHP-SHCC and to accommodate the requirement for 3D concrete printing by quantitatively characterizing the fundamental rheological and bonding mechanisms between cementitious matrix and fibers, which are governing factors for the performance of printed members. 擠出成型的混凝土3D打印技術面臨著如何添加鋼筋的挑戰。應變硬化水泥基複合材料(SHCC/ECC)在拉伸下表現出應變硬化和多裂縫開裂行為，使得SHCC具有高延展性，從而為克服3D打印與傳統加筋方式不兼容的問題提供一種可能的解決方案。然而，如何實現SHCC的連續流暢打印仍然是一個挑戰。 同時，業界對高強度高模量的高性能混凝土也有很大需求。例如，超高性能混凝土(UHPC)具有緻密的微觀結構，因此具有高抗水/抗化學滲透性，可以顯著提高民用基礎設施的耐久性。然而，它在攪拌和澆築過程中也面臨挑戰。 作為一項基礎研究，該項目旨在提升超高性能應變硬化水泥基複合材料(UHP-SHCC)的流變性能，使其同時具有高強度和高延展性，並用於3D打印。成功的關鍵在於有效地混合、泵送和擠出含有纖維的水泥基材料。

17204622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17204622.value: Dr Gaitan-Espitia, Juan Diego Prof Gu, Ji-Dong

17204722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17204722.value: 嘗試理解費米重複現象的一個觀點：脈動模式、流氓波和級聯機制

17204722.label: Project Objectives
17204722.value: Overview: To understand one particular aspect of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou recurrence (FPUT) through the formation and properties of periodic patterns of breathers for members of the nonlinear Schrödinger family of evolution equations - These analytical models provide elegant formulation for the first occurrence of breathers, spacing between the individual peaks, as well as the periods for subsequent occurrence of pulsating modes. Such features are lacking or simply not feasible in many other applications of FPUT. Theory1: To investigate phase sensitive systems - Four-wave interactions for a special class of materials will lead to evolution systems where the phase of the participating fields becomes a crucial factor in the dynamics. This differs from many conventional descriptions for waves in fluids and optics, where only the intensity or square of the amplitude of the envelope enters the picture. Theoretically, the Darboux transformation is used to derive the breather explicitly for negative coherent coupling. Parallel studies for positive or generalized couplings will be valuable. Application1: Optical fiber with weak birefringence - Coherently coupled Schrödinger equations arise for imperfectly fabricated optical fibers in the weak birefringence limit. Analytical results here can predict the first occurrence of breathers in terms of propagation distance. Physically, coupled waveguides serve as an instructive example in symmetry breaking. If the initial perturbations in the two waveguides are identical, the system degenerates to two identical one-mode operations. If the initial perturbations are different (quadrature perturbations), 'eye-shaped' and 'four-petal' rogue / breather modes will appear in the two waveguides. Interpretation and correspondence with the physical properties of the optical fibers in terms of the 'supermode' of the system will give a more penetrating understanding. Theory2: To study wave packets with 'steepening effects' - Many papers on FPUT for these nonlinear dynamical systems focus on the cubic Schrödinger equation. Other members of this family of equations also permit theoretical advances. We shall choose the derivative Schrödinger equation with a steepening term as instructive example. Darboux transformation is employed to derive the breather, and a cascading mechanism is demonstrated explicitly. Theoretically, it will be illuminating to extend this consideration to other novel nonlinearities, e.g. quintic (fifth order) types. The preliminary results are already encouraging, as the breathers are now moving and not at rest. Experimentally, 'drifting' breathers are detected in wave channels and it will be useful to compare theoretical predictions with laboratory data. Application2: Finite amplitude rogue waves - One of the few scientifically documented rogue waves is the Draupner Wave, measured at an offshore oil platform in the North Sea in Europe on 1995/01/01. The maximum amplitude of 25 meters in a local water depth of 70 meters is consistent with a Peregrine rogue wave of the Schrödinger equation, three times an assumed background carrier wave amplitude of say 8 meters. This wave has been reproduced in the laboratory under carefully controlled conditions (2019). It will be valuable for the offshore engineering community to establish more precise predictor for rogue wave height under finite wave amplitude condition. We shall employ a full fourth order Schrödinger equation including further water wave physics in addition to steepening effects. Preliminary modulation instability calculations have been given in the literature. We plan to produce full numerical simulations to look at the onset of rogue waves and possible recurrence scenarios. Theory3: To utilize doubly periodic wave patterns to describe recurrence phenomenon - While analytical formulations of breathers are intellectually pleasing, they cannot explain FPUT as such breathers are usually localized either in space or time, and cannot accomplish the doubly periodic nature of breather recurrence of FPUT. One special class of doubly periodic solutions expressed via Jacobi elliptic functions studied in the 1980s to 2000s will prove useful. We plan to construct these doubly periodic solutions for further members of the Schrödinger hierarchy of evolution equations. Preliminary numerical simulations show that these wave patterns are robust to random noise perturbations. Application3: Planar flows with vorticity - For two-dimensional (2D, or planar) flows, the vorticity can be expressed as a smooth (but otherwise arbitrary) function of the stream function. Previous computations in the literature confirm the robustness of this feature through simulations with random noise as starting point. The flow field will 'relax' to a pattern with the prescribed relation between stream function and vorticity. Doubly periodic solutions for the case of a 'hyperbolic sine' relation exist. There are previous theoretical and computational works in the literature, but we plan to re-consider these issues in light of FPUT, with new perspectives on topics like first occurrence of breather and cascading mechanism. Extension to asymmetric exponential functions (the Tzitzeica equation) will be useful, not only in fluid mechanics, but also for the ionic properties of asymmetric electrolyte in electrochemistry.

17204722.label: Realisation of objectives
17204722.value: IMPORTANT Note: Professor K. W. Chow has reached retirement age. According to regulations of the University of Hong Kong, he cannot serve as the Principal Investigator. The project is thus transferred to Professor C. H. Liu, but Professor Chow still continues the research work as an 'Honorary Professor' at the University. (1) Nonlinear Dynamics - Triad resonances or three-wave interactions are investigated as examples of significant interactions and energy exchange among modes. Propagating modes had been studied since the 1980s. Analytical expressions for rogue waves or transient states have been derived in the past ten years. However, physical properties and generation mechanisms are still not fully understood. We attempt to understand the formation of rogue waves and breathers through a cascading mechanism. We first start with modulation instability, the amplification mechanism arising from the interplay of nonlinear and dispersive effects. Higher order modes are exponentially smaller than the fundamental mode initially, but they grow at a higher rate. Eventually all modes attain roughly the same magnitude at one instant in time or one spatial location. A breather is formed. The breather decays subsequently. Modulation instability will commence again at sufficiently small amplitude. The cycle is repeated, and is taken as a manifestation of the Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou recurrence. We demonstrate this recurrence explicitly for the triad resonance equation (Physical Review E 2023, Paper 5, Section C). (2) and (3) Optics - A good example of phase sensitive problem is a system of coherently coupled, nonlinear Schrodinger equations. Physically, this scenario will arise for optical fibers with weak birefringence. Here the progress is slower than our expectations, as we face difficulties in finding the exact solutions of coherently coupled systems with transient time dependence. Instead we tackle the recurrence phenomena for a simpler situation, namely, a two-core fiber system. Mathematically, the model is a system of linearly coupled Schrodinger equations. We analyze the recurrence phenomena for various power ratios in the two cores (Physica D 2022, Paper 2, Section C). Furthermore, in another paper, we include the effects of coupling coefficient dispersion. Mathematically, there are additional terms involving the derivatives of the wave envelopes (Chaos 2024, Paper 9, Section C). (4) Analytically, 'self-steepening' nonlinearity usually refers to a term proportional to the product of the intensity of wave envelope and a derivative of the envelope function itself. Physically, this arises for short pulses in optical waveguides. Here the complex modified Korteweg-de Vries equation is taken as an illuminating example, with self-steepening nonlinearity and third order dispersion (Chaos 2024, Paper 10, Section C). (5, 6) Modulation instability has been studied extensively in the literature. There are two common drawbacks. Firstly, only linear disturbances are considered. Secondly, usually the instability is restricted to a specific range of disturbance wave numbers. In practice, doubly periodic patterns and even rogue waves are often observed for wave numbers beyond these ranges. Exact solutions for evolution equations in terms of elliptic functions are taken as starting point. Such finite amplitude doubly periodic motion is taken as an example of growth and decay, with wave numbers outside of the conventional modulation instability ranges (Physics Letters A 2023, Paper 6, Section C). (7) Inviscid two dimensional fluid flows have a special analytical formulation. The vorticity is just an arbitrary function of the stream function. If this function is taken as a trigonometric sine, the governing form is then a 'sine Gordon' equation for the stream function. We derive a special solution for such sine Gordon equation for the hyperbolic case. The hyperbolic case is also applicable to curvature in geometry and dislocations in material science. We study the recurrence phenomena of such sine Gordon equations (Physics Letters A 2025, Paper 15, Section C).

17204722.label: Major findings and research outcome
17204722.value: We have made contributions in theoretical aspects of nonlinear dynamics, as well as applications to fluid mechanics and optics. We have published 16 papers from mid-2022 to mid-2025: (A) Nonlinear Dynamics The existence of long wavelength (or low frequency) modulation instability has been shown to be equivalent to the onset of rogue wave modes for many classical evolution systems. This 'baseband instability' is again demonstrated to be critical for the case of coupled, complex modified Korteweg-de Vries equations, with third order dispersion and 'self-steepening' nonlinearity (Chaos 2024, Paper 10, Section C). (B) Fluid Mechanics (i) Free surface waves with two or more spectral peaks propagating at an oblique angle to each other are commonly termed “crossing sea states”. These crossing patterns have been suggested as possible causes for rogue waves for surface modes of a homogeneous fluid. We extend the consideration to a layered fluid (using the resonance of long waves and short waves) and a stratified fluid (of constant buoyancy frequency). The Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou recurrence is demonstrated explicitly (Physical Review Fluids 2023, Paper 3). (ii) Triad resonance occurs when the sums of frequencies and wave numbers of two waves are equal to those of the third one. Significant interactions can occur. 'Degenerate' resonance arises when two group velocities of the three components are equal. The dynamics of breathers (pulsating modes) are studied from the perspective of recurrence and cascading mechanisms (Physical Review E 2024, Paper 14). (C) Engineering Applications The occurrence of of unexpectedly large, transient oceanic waves is obviously an important issue for coastal and marine engineering. We apply the knowledge and insight gained to two practical situations: (i) The location of breaking and possible damage from overtopping waves are studied for various sloping seafloor configurations. Convex, concave and straight-line seafloors are constructed computationally and wave evolution are investigated in a numerical wave tank. The geometric shape of the seafloors will have a profound influence on the location of breaking waves and thus will be a highly relevant factor in coastal defense (Journal of Marine Science and Engineering 2024, Paper 11). (ii) Severe typhoons will pose immense danger to Hong Kong and the South East Asian coastline every summer. As a temporary and affordable protection, Government Departments have employed floating breakwaters. We have conducted computational and experimental modeling studies to assist this important enterprise for the society (Physics of Fluids 2023, Paper 8)

17204722.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17204722.value: Research efforts in nonlinear dynamics, fluid mechanics and optics will be continued, e.g., (i) While the theoretical formulation of long wave - short wave resonance with multiple short waves has been studied extensively in the literature, the prevailing assumption is to take the dispersion in the two waveguides as identical. In realistic fluid configuration, this feature will NOT hold. Special simplified analytic solutions will be sought and numerical codes for arbitrary initial conditions are being designed. (ii) While the analytical difficulties with finding rogue wave solutions for coherently coupled Schrodinger equations persist, we shall study the issue of robustness through linear and spectral instabilities.

17204722.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17204722.value: Rogue waves are unexpectedly large, transient displacements from an otherwise tranquil background. Besides the oceanic wave context, they have also been studied in physical fields like optics and plasma. Theoretically, rogue waves and their generalizations, breathers (pulsating modes), may exhibit growth and decay cycles. Such cycles constitute a manifestation of the classical Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou recurrence, where a nonlinear system displays a tendency to return to its initial states after complex stages of evolution. Several nonlinear evolution systems are studied here, where analytical solutions and numerical simulations provide explanations for such recurrence. For oceanic waves, 'crossing sea states', pairs of obliquely propagating modes, are examined as causes for extreme events for layered and stratified fluids. For optics, a two-core fiber is modeled by a pair of coupled Schrodinger equations. Repeated power transfers between the cores are demonstrated numerically as a recurrence phenomenon. Triad resonances or three-wave interactions are examined through stratified fluids of constant buoyancy frequency. Our works are recognized through invitation to be Guest Editor of a Special Issue in the journal 'Chaos'. For applications, Government Departments have invited us to serve on Advisory Panel, and to join in coastal engineering projects involving floating breakwater and renewable energy.

17205222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17205222.value: 顆粒流在複雜地形基底阻力的多尺度研究

17205222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17205222.value: Mr Ho, Kenneth Kin Sang Prof LEUNG, Yat Fai

17205222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17205222.value: Geophysical granular flows are massive volumes of granular earth materials flowing down natural slopes. Under increasing extreme weather conditions, geophysical granular flows remain the most destructive geohazards in Hong Kong, causing casualties and economic loss due to their proximity to urban development and dense population areas. A major goal of geohazard assessment is to predict the flow velocity and runout distance via numerical modelling, and basal resistance plays a crucial role in governing the energy dissipation in natural topographic settings. However, the fundamental characteristics of flow-bed interaction for granular flows over complex basal features (topography) remain largely unclear, leading to poorly constrained models and frequent underestimation of mobility and runout distance. The proposed research will adopt advanced experimental and numerical techniques to gain a deeper understanding of the interaction between geophysical granular flows and complex topography at the grain level, and therefrom develop a physics-based basal resistance model for large-scale continuum modelling. A multiscale theoretical framework will be established which is applicable to various types of natural terrain landslides involving rapidly flowing granular materials, such as rock avalanches and debris flows. Current landslide mobility modelling relies on phenomenological and macroscopic basal resistance models but lacks detailed characterization of how flowing granular materials interact with the base. At the particle scale, grain-bed interactions involve a rich variety of mechanisms (e.g., sliding, collisions, and spatial rearrangement), whereas at the flow scale, basal resistance depends highly on the basal features (e.g., geometric roughness) and is controlled by velocity and stress fluctuations in the basal shear layer. A constitutive description of such complicated processes therefore requires physics-based descriptions of the microscopic topographic features and the basal resistance for granular flows. To address this multiscale challenge, an integrated experimental, numerical, and theoretical approach with four interconnected parts is proposed: (i) laboratory flume tests using systematically controlled micro topography (base roughness) generated by 3D printing technique with detailed flow characterization via particle imaging velocimetry; (ii) micromechanical analysis of granular flow-roughness interactions in a physically relevant elementary setup using high-performance particle dynamics simulations; (iii) theoretical modelling of basal resistance for granular flows over complex micro topography; and (iv) implementation of the proposed basal resistance model in continuum theories for large-scale case studies. The outcomes are expected to improve the estimation of runout and velocity of landslide-related geohazards and translate them into enhanced guidelines for hazard zonation and barrier design. 地球物理顆粒流（或簡稱顆粒流）指大量的顆粒狀地球物質沿著自然邊坡流動。由於極端天氣增多，顆粒流（滑坡、泥石流等）仍然是香港最具破壞性的地質災害之一。由於災害鄰近城市基礎設施和人口密集區，可造成嚴重的人員傷亡和經濟損失。顆粒流滑坡災害風險評估主要包括通過數值模擬來預測顆粒流的流速和滑動距離。而在顆粒流中，天然地形環境中基底阻力對底部能量耗散和動力參數等方面起著至關重要的作用。然而，在複雜的自然地形基底上，顆粒流與基底之間相互作用的基本特徵仍缺乏普適的理論描述，數值模擬中顆粒流的邊界行為並不能準確反應其基底的邊界效應，導致預測結果往往低估其超強流動性和較遠滑動距離。本項目旨在結合現有的先進實驗和數值模擬方法，揭示顆粒流與自然地形基底之間在顆粒級微觀尺寸上的互相作用機理，進而基於動力學原理建立具普適性的基底阻力模型，進一步將邊界模型應用於大尺度的連續體模擬。通過建立跨尺度（微觀-宏觀）的顆粒流邊界理論框架，本項目的研究成果可適用於涉及自然邊坡上高速顆粒流的滑坡地質災害，如碎屑流和泥石流。 現階段的滑坡流動性模擬主要採用唯象論的宏觀邊界摩擦模型，卻忽略了流動顆粒與基底間的相互作用機理和邊界效應。在微觀尺度中，顆粒-基底的相互作用涉及複雜的顆粒運動（包括滑移、碰撞和摩擦）；而在宏觀尺度中，顆粒流底部的表觀阻力取決於基底特徵（如幾何粗糙度），並且與底部剪切層中的流動速度和溫度（應力波動）密切相關。因此，為建立颗粒流边界的本構模型，亟需研究針對基底的微觀几何粗糙度和顆粒流基礎阻力的普適表徵方法。針對這一跨尺度的研究框架，本項目將結合室內實驗、數值模擬和基礎理論，提出互相關聯的四項主要的研究內容和方法：(i) 利用3D 打印技術生成可控制微觀粗糙度的基底，進行室內顆粒流斜槽測試，並通過顆粒成像測速法觀測具體的流動參數; (ii) 利用顆粒動力學模擬方法，建立與室內實驗對應的數值單元模型，對顆粒流-基底的相互作用進行微觀機理研究； (iii) 建立複雜地形（基底粗糙度）上顆粒流基底阻力的理論模型； (iv) 在大尺度顆粒流災害案例的連續體數值模擬中實現考慮微觀機理的新邊界模型。預計本項目結果將進一步加強對滑坡相關地質災害的滑動距離和流速的估計能力，並將提升災害風險評估的準確性，為滑坡防護系統提供更可靠的設計參數。

17205322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17205322.value: 破譯電養產甲烷菌的細胞膜蛋白在細胞外電子轉移 (EET) 機制中的作用

17205322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17205322.value: Prof Feng, Shien Ping Tony Prof Li, Xiao-yan

17205322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17205322.value: Attaining sustainable development is the grand challenge of this century. Water, energy, and carbon emission are prioritized under the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. Similarly, Hong Kong has aligned her efforts towards these goals. Methanogens, which are microbes capable of methane production, play an important role in anaerobic wastewater treatment and renewable bioenergy production. Recently, some methanogens were found to consume electron directly, in addition to traditional electron carrier substrates (e.g., hydrogen), for CO2 biomethanation, resulting in enhanced anaerobic treatment kinetics and methane yield. This has also created new possibilities for biogas upgrading and energy offset in CO2-emiting industries, further contributing towards sustainability goals. Key to facilitating these applications and goals realization is the comprehensive understanding of methanogen extracellular electron transfer (EET) mechanism. Electrically conductive materials such as, granular activated carbon (GAC), have been widely reported to induce EET in electrotrophic methanogens. These materials conduct electrons, produced by exoelectrogens, to methanogens, increasing electron transfer rate by 10 times when compared to substrate-based diffusion transfer. Our previous microbiome studies have revealed co-occurrences of exoelectrogens and electrotrophic methanogens (e.g., Methanothrix) on GAC, which were absent in non-conductive materials. However, EET mechanism remains ill-defined and is extremely difficult to study for many methanogens due to technical challenges. Since cell envelop is the first point of contact between the methanogen and an incoming electron, this research aims to decipher the role of cell envelop proteins in EET and identify EET protein candidates in electrotrophic methanogens. Methanothrix soehngenii and Methanosarcina mazei are chosen for this study owing to their propensity to dominate in anaerobic EET environments. With this knowledge, we could selectively target putative EET proteins for further in-depth study to delineate the elusive EET mechanism. Our preliminary data showed that known genes involved in EET (Hdr and Fpo complexes) and a putative EET gene (encoding for a multi-heme cytochrome c) were identified and active in a Methanothrix metagenome bin recovered from GAC. Building upon these findings, this project plans to (1) determine the main cell envelop layer(s) for EET, (2) purify cell envelop proteins for proteomics analysis and characterization, and (3) determine the involvement of cell envelop proteins and decipher their roles in EET mechanism. The outcome of this project is expected to yield new possibilities for anaerobic waste treatment and waste CO2 biomethanation, and on the broader level, generate new research directions in microbial EET for various biotechnological applications including biorefinery and bioremediation. 本世紀的重大挑戰是實現可持續發展。在聯合國可持續發展目標中的，水、能源和碳排放是優先事項。同樣地，香港也在努力實現這些目標。產甲烷菌能產生甲烷，它們在厭氧廢水處理及可再生生物能源生產中扮演重要的角色。最新的研究發現，一些產甲烷菌除了使用傳統的電子載物（如氫氣），更能直接消耗電子將二氧化碳甲烷化，提高厭氧處理的動力學和甲烷產量。這也為碳排放行業的沼氣升級和能源抵消創造了新的可能性，進一步促進我們邁向可持續發展。對產甲烷菌細胞膜對外電子轉移 (EET) 機制的全面了解將是應用這項技術的關鍵。 導電材料如粒狀活性炭 (GAC) 已被廣泛報導在電養產甲烷菌中誘導 EET。這些材料將產電菌 （exoelectrogens）所產生的電子傳導到產甲烷菌，而產甲烷菌通過EET的方式直接接納並使用電子。與傳統的電子載體（例如氫氣）的擴散轉移相比，EET能使電子轉移率提高 10 倍。我們之前的微生物基因組群研究指出，GAC 上同時存在產電菌和電營養產甲烷菌（如 Methanothrix），而這些菌群在非導電材料上是不存在的。然而，研究產甲烷菌在技術上是相當困難，而EET的機制而今仍然不明。 由於細胞膜是產甲烷菌和外來電子之間的第一個接觸點，本研究旨在破譯細胞膜蛋白在 EET 中的作用，並推定出哪些蛋白參與了EET。有了這些知識，我們可以選擇性地針對推定的 EET 蛋白進行深入研究，以闡發 EET 機制。由於養產甲烷菌 Methanothrix soehngenii 和 Methanosarcina mazei是厭氧 EET 環境中主要的產甲烷菌，這兩株菌將被選用於本研究。我們對從 GAC 回收的 Methanothrix 宏基因組進行了初步分析，數據顯示已知的EET基因和蛋白（Hdr 和 Fpo 複合物）和推定的 EET 基因（多血紅素細胞色素 [multi-heme cytochrome]）有基因表達。在這些發現的基礎上，此項目計劃 (1) 確定 EET 的主要細胞膜層，(2) 純化細胞膜蛋白以進行蛋白質組學分析和定性，以及 (3) 確定細胞膜蛋白的參與並破譯它們在 EET 機制中的作用。此項目的成果有望為厭氧廢物處理和廢氣二氧化碳甲烷化帶來新的可能性。在更廣泛的層面上，此項目也會為生物精煉和生物修復的各種生物技術應用提供新的微生物 EET 研究方向。

17205822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17205822.value: 基於互聯汽車實時滲透率估算的交通燈號調節系統

17205822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17205822.value: Traffic signal control is among the most effective tools for alleviating urban traffic congestion. The rapid development of connected vehicles (CVs) and 5G technology suggests the imminent possibility of real-time information exchange among CVs and infrastructures and thus the development of CV-based adaptive signal controls. Nevertheless, there will be a prolonged transition period before full CV deployment, during which CVs and conventional vehicles will inevitably circulate within the traffic network in a mixed driving environment. In developing these control systems, the major challenge will be to estimate the necessary real-time traffic states as inputs based on partial traffic data retrieved from CVs. In this research project, we will develop a CV-based adaptive signal control system using real-time estimates of CV penetration rates in a connected environment. We will consider links in which data are obtained solely from CVs, and links with both on-road fixed detectors and CV data. First, we will establish methods to estimate long-term average CV penetration rates. The empirical Bayes method will be applied to fuse the historical long-term average and real-time CV data to estimate the real-time CV penetration rate and its variability. The major challenge for links purely with CV data will lie in the limited single-source information. Nevertheless, the reliance on only CV data will greatly expand the applicability of signal control to detector-free networks, constituting a paradigm shift in adaptive traffic signal control. Then, we will develop methods employing real-time CV penetration rate estimates to scale-up total traffic flows, estimate queue lengths, and quantify their uncertainty. They will serve as the initial traffic states for traffic propagation simulation and evaluation. Turning proportions, governing the turning movements of traffic, will be estimated by leveraging entropy maximization under the flow conservation law. Based on these inputs, we will formulate a mathematical program for the robust CV-based adaptive signal control. The optimal signal plan will be minimally sensitive to the uncertainty of the inputs and will thus be expected to perform better in the worst-case scenario. An efficient solution procedure will be derived to solve the formulated program. We will compare the performance of the proposed system with competing methods using a simulation platform modeling a real-world Hong Kong network. Overall, the proposed project will advance the methods for estimating real-time traffic states based on CV data and for developing adaptive signal control systems, even for challenging detector-free scenarios at a range of CV adoption levels. 交通燈號控制是舒緩交通擠塞最有效的措施之一。隨著車聯網及第五代流動通訊網絡系統（5G）技術的高速發展和演進，互聯汽車之間及其與路邊基礎設施之間的實時自動數據傳輸和通訊有望得以實現，從而有助推動根據互聯汽車數據而開發的交通燈號調節系統。然而，從傳統汽車到實現完全由互聯汽車主導的行車環境必定會經歷一段漫長的過渡期。在此期間，互聯汽車將無可避免地與傳統汽車一同在一個混合駕駛模式的交通網絡裏行駛。交通燈號調節系統的成功關鍵在於準確的實時交通狀態資訊，因此，在開發混合駕駛模式下的交通燈號調節系統時，其主挑戰為如何只使用部分互聯汽車的交通數據來準確地感應和估算實時交通狀態。本研究項目將提出一個根據互聯汽車實時滲透率而開發的交通燈號調節系統。兩類不同的路段，即配備交通探測器及無交通探測器的路段，都會被列入研究範圍。首先，我們將提出估算互聯汽車歷史平均滲透率的方法。根據經驗貝氏法，歷史平均滲透率會結合互聯汽車的實時數據，從而估算互聯汽車的實時滲透率及其不確定性。對於無交通探測器的路段而言，其主要挑戰是如何使用有限並單一的互聯汽車數據實時估算其滲透率。由於這方法只依賴單一的互聯汽車數據，相應的交通燈號調節系統也能大大擴展其應用至無交通探測器的交通網絡。其後，根據互聯汽車實時滲透率的估算，我們將進一步提出方法估計總交通流、車輛隊列長度，及其不確定性。其估算將被輸入為交通仿真平台的初始狀態以作進行評估之用。根據交通流守恆定律，我們將採用最大熵原理估算交通流的轉向比例。基於上述交通狀態估算，我們將建構強健最佳化互聯汽車交通燈號調節系統的數學模型。此數學模型能大大減低其最優解受估算不確定性的影響，而最優解也能在最壞情況下保持穩定及良好的表現。同時，我們也將研究並為數學模型提出高效的求解程序。通過對真實香港交通網絡的仿真，我們也會為擬議系統和其他系統進行比較分析。總體而言，即使在不同的互聯汽車滲透率下，擬議系統也能應用於無交通探測器的交通網絡。此項目將能推動實時交通狀態估算方法的進步及交通燈號調節系統的發展。

17205922.label: Project Objectives
17205922.value: (Background) Graph learning is rapidly advancing, bearing a wide spectrum of applications such as drug design, recommender systems, and combinatorial optimization. (Key issues) Graph learning is facing 3 key issues in the era of big data and Internet of Things. First, the frequent and massive data shuttling between physically separated off-chip memory and processing units incurs large time and energy overheads on conventional digital hardware, the so called von Neumann bottleneck. Second, the slowdown of Moore’s law makes transistor scaling increasing cost-ineffective, as the size of transistor is close to its physical limit. Third, training graph neural networks could be expensive due to tedious backpropagation for node and graph embedding. (Solution) A novel hardware-software codesign, random resistor arrays-based echo state graph neural network, will be used to address these 3 issues. This codesign not only boosts energy-area efficiency thanks to in-memory computing, but also simultaneously reduces both the hardware cost and graph learning complexity using random resistive memory-based echo state network. Three research tasks are planned accordingly as following. (Task 1) Develop CMOS-compatible nanoscale random resistor arrays by a simple and low-cost method leveraging the controllable stochasticity in dielectric breakdown. (Task 2) Design the high-speed PCB for the hybrid analog-digital computing system and its driving code, using the random resistor arrays developed in Task 1. (Task 3) Implement echo state graph neural networks on the system developed in Task 2 to address representative graph learning problems such as classification of graphs and nodes. (Outcome) The success of the proposed work will bring a solution for efficient and affordable real-time graph learning, thanks to the novel hardware-software co-design.

17205922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17205922.value: Graph learning has drawn widespread attention in dealing with problems such as prediction of molecular properties for drug design, recommender systems for social networks, and combinatorial optimization for electronic design automation. In the era of big data and Internet of Things, the size of graph-structured data is exploding exponentially. As a result, deep learning with graphs on traditional von Neumann computers leads to frequent and massive data shuttling between physically separated off-chip-memory and processing units, inevitably incurring large time and energy overheads. In addition, as the size of transistor is approaching its physical limit, Moore’s law, which has fueled the past development of CMOS chips for decades, is slowing down, making further performance boost of digital hardware increasingly hard. Moreover, training conventional graph neural networks could be expensive due to tedious error backpropagation for node and graph embedding. The growing challenges in both hardware, i.e. von Neumann bottleneck and transistor scaling, as well as software i.e. tedious training, calls for a brand-new paradigm of graph learning. The emerging resistive in-memory computing may provide a novel solution. It employs arrays of tunable and scalable resistors (resistive switches or memristors) for computations using simple physical laws. As the data are effectively stored and processed in the same resistors, it naturally overcomes the von Neumann bottleneck and achieves better efficiency. However, resistive memory suffers from a variety of issues when their resistance is changed, including large programing energy and duration compared to transistor switching as well as intrinsic stochasticity, which can defeat their advantage and prevent them from being used in graph learning. Here, we propose a novel hardware-software codesign, the echo state graph neural network-based on random resistor arrays, which not only boosts energy-area efficiency thanks to in-memory computing, but also simultaneously reduces hardware cost and learning complexity thanks to the random resistive memory-based echo state network. We will first develop CMOS-compatible nanoscale random resistor arrays leveraging the controllable stochasticity in dielectric breakdown of hafnia. Based on that, we will design a hybrid analog-digital computing system and its driving code. We will then implement echo state graph neural networks on this system to address representative graph and node learning tasks. The success of the proposed work will not only enable efficient and affordable real-time graph learning thanks to the novel hardware-software co-design, but more importantly, it will resolve the programming obstacle of resistive in-memory computing, leading to transformative impacts on the next-generation AI hardware. 圖學習在處理藥物設計的分子特性預測、社交網絡的推薦系統和電子設計自動化的組合優化等問題上引起了廣泛的關注。在大數據和物聯網時代，圖結構數據的規模呈指數級增長。因此，在傳統馮諾依曼計算機上使用圖數據進行深度學習，會導致物理分離的片外內存和處理單元之間頻繁的海量數據穿梭，不可避免地會產生大量的時間和能量消耗。 此外，隨著晶體管的尺寸接近物理極限，過去數十年推動CMOS芯片發展的摩爾定律正在放緩，進一步提升數字硬件的性能變得越來越困難。 另一方面，由於節點和圖嵌入需要繁瑣的誤差反向傳播，傳統圖神經網絡訓練代價較大。 硬件方面日益增長的挑戰，即馮諾依曼瓶頸和晶體管節點瓶頸，以及軟件方面繁瑣的訓練，都需要一種全新的圖學習範式。新興的電阻式存内計算可以提供一種新穎的解決方案。它採用可調諧和可擴展的電阻器（電阻開關或憶阻器）陣列，使用簡單的物理定律進行計算。由於數據在同一個電阻中被存儲和處理，自然克服了馮諾依曼瓶頸，實現了更好的效率。然而，阻變存儲器在其電阻發生變化時會遇到各種問題，包括與晶體管開關相比較大的編程能量和編程時間，以及固有的隨機性，會破壞它們的在圖學習上的優勢。在此，我們提出了一種新穎的硬軟件協同設計，即基於隨機電阻陣列的回波狀態圖神經網絡，它不僅通過內存計算提高了能量/面積效率，而且同時降低了硬件成本和學習複雜度。基於隨機電阻記憶的迴聲狀態網絡。我們將首先利用氧化鉿電介質擊穿的可控隨機性開發CMOS兼容 的納米級隨機電阻陣列。在此基礎上，我們將設計一個模數混合計算系統及其驅動代碼。最後，我們將在該系統上實現迴聲狀態圖神經網絡，以解決代表性圖和節點學習任務。由於新穎的硬軟件協同設計，所提出的工作不僅將實現高效且經濟的實時圖學習，更重要的是，它將解決電阻式內存計算的編程障礙，從而為下一代人工智能硬件帶來變革性影響。

17206122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17206122.value: 納濾 (NF) 具有相對較低的能耗和理想的溶質-溶質選擇性，使其成為許多應用的理想分離工藝。然而，納濾膜面臨的滲透選擇性制約極大的限制了其分離效率。受啟發於全芳族聚酰胺反滲透膜中的納米發泡機制，本項目設想在半芳族聚酰胺納濾膜中高效的製備納米空穴，以克服其滲透選擇性制約。將利用界面聚合反應過程中CO2的自發脫氣和揮發性有機溶劑的蒸發來創建具有皺縮表面形態的含納米空穴的聚酰胺截留層。為克服在納濾膜中納米發泡的固有困難，將開發增強納米發泡的新策略，例如添加界面脫氣的前體和改善氣體的保留。本項目的總體目標是開發具有增強分離性能的新型納米發泡納濾膜。主要假說包括（1）皺縮的聚酰胺截留層中包含的納米空穴可以通過重新引導水傳輸路徑來有效降低其整體傳輸阻力並增加其水滲透性；（2） 納米發泡膜中更均勻分佈的局部水通量可提高其防污性能。初步分析模型支持這些假說，並揭示了水滲透性提高一個數量級的潛力。此外，初步實驗結果證實了同時極大提高透水性、防污性能和膜選擇性的可行性。本項目將通過三個明確的工作包執行：（1）制定納米發泡納濾膜的傳輸行為和結構-分離性能關係的理論框架；（2）發展強化的納米發泡方法和建立納米發泡“相圖”；（3）研究納米發泡納濾膜的污染行為和防污染機制。解決這些關鍵的研究問題將有利於高性能納濾膜合成的突破，為新型納米發泡膜的水/溶質傳輸和污染行為提供新的理論框架，以及對其形成機制提供新的見解。預計為納濾水回用節省能源>50%。本團隊在納米發泡方面的前期積累和開創性工作將確保該項目的完成。

17206222.value: 面向能源互聯網的新型無線電動汽車能源網絡的開發

17206222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17206222.value: Dr Lee, Christopher Ho-tin Prof Liu, Wei

17206222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17206222.value: Energy internet has been identified to be the future power grid, which should effectively harness energy resources and flexibly control energy flows with the help of information and communication technology. The routing of energy flows in the energy internet is performed through an energy router – alike an information router for data routing. However, the existing power grid for the energy internet suffers from the problems of insecure and inflexible. As the largest source of greenhouse gas emissions is from burning fossil fuels for electricity and transportation, many countries have been actively developing renewable energy and electric vehicles (EVs). Apart from serving as green transportation, EVs can make use of their inherent energy storage to regulate the power grid by trading energy and power with the grid, so-called the vehicle-to-grid operation. Nevertheless, this vehicle-to-grid operation has not utilized the nature of mobility of EVs. Since EVs are inherently a mobile energy carrier, they can make use of their energy storage to transfer power from one location to another location wherever these locations are road accessible. By incorporating wireless power transfer technology, a wireless EV energy network (WEVEN) can virtually establish an independent power grid for the energy internet. Although this WEVEN inevitably suffers from additional investment costs and power losses, after taking account of higher energy security and better energy utilization, the establishment of WEVEN is justifiable. The key challenge is how to devise the WEVEN infrastructure in such a way that the energy storage capacities of EVs and wireless energy routers (WERs) as well as their necessary numbers can be minimized. Meanwhile, the power transfer efficiency should be optimized. Another key challenge is how to design and control the WER so that it can efficiently and effectively exchange energy between the WER and EVs within the allowable exchange time. One more challenge is how to quantify the merits of this WEVEN. The purpose of this proposal is to develop a novel WEVEN for energy internet. The corresponding objectives are: (1) develop a novel infrastructure of the WEVEN; (2) develop a novel configuration and control strategy of the WER for the proposed WEVEN; (3) perform analytical modeling and electromagnetic analysis of the proposed WER; (4) perform optimal energy routing of the proposed WEVEN; (5) design and construct a prototype of the whole WEVEN for experimentation; (6) identify potential applications of the proposed WEVEN, and assess their practicability and commercial values. 能源互聯網已被確定為未來的電網，應藉助信息通信技術有效利用能源資源，靈活控制能量流動。能源互聯網中能量流動是通過能源路由器執行的——類似用於數據流動的信息路由器。然而，現有用於能源互聯網的電網存在不安全、不靈活等問題。 由於溫室氣體排放的最大來源是用於電力和交通運輸的燃燒化石燃料，許多國家一直在積極開發可再生能源和電動汽車。電動汽車除了作為綠色交通工具外，還可以利用其固有的儲能，通過與電網進行能源和電力交易來調節電網，即所謂的車對網運行。然而，這種車輛對電網的運行並沒有利用電動汽車的移動性。 由於電動汽車本質上是一種移動能源載體，因此它們可以利用其儲能將電力從一個位置傳輸到另一個位置，只要這些位置可以通過道路到達。通過結合無線電力傳輸技術，無線電動汽車能源網絡（WEVEN）可以虛擬地為能源互聯網建立一個獨立的電網。雖然這個 WEVEN 不可避免地要承受額外的投資成本和電力損失，但在考慮到更高的能源安全和更好的能源利用之後，WEVEN 的成立是有道理的。 關鍵的挑戰是如何設計 WEVEN 基礎設施，使電動汽車的能量存儲容量和無線能量路由器所需數量最小化。同時，應優化其功率傳輸效率。另一個關鍵挑戰是如何設計和控制無線能量路由器，使其能夠在允許的交換時間內高效地在無線能量路由器和電動汽車之間交換能量。另一個挑戰是如何量化這個 WEVEN 的優點。 這個項目的目的是為能源互聯網開發一種新穎的 WEVEN。相應的目標是： (1) 開發 WEVEN 的新型基礎設施； (2) 為擬議的 WEVEN 開發一種新穎的無線能量路由器配置和控制策略； (3) 對擬議的無線能量路由器進行分析建模和電磁分析； (4) 對提出的 WEVEN 執行最優能量路由； (5) 設計並搭建整個 WEVEN 的原型進行實驗； (6) 確定擬議 WEVEN 的潛在應用，並評估其實用性和商業價值。

17206322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17206322.value: 競爭條件下含有普通單車和電動單車的共享單車系統的戰略規劃和管理

17206322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17206322.value: Bike-sharing systems are now popular worldwide. Despite the benefits of such systems, several crucial issues must be addressed. First, competition between private bike-sharing operators leads to an oversupply of bikes and bike stations, which causes a waste of resources. Second, the introduction of electric bikes (e-bikes) into conventional bike-sharing systems can cover a wider class of users, but complicates the planning and management of the resultant mixed-fleet systems due to additional considerations: battery charging/replacement for low-charge e-bikes, the user choice of bike type, the tradeoff between various cost types (e.g., charging station setup cost vs. bike and battery repositioning cost), and charging e-bike users the same rental fare as regular bike users at stations with insufficient regular bikes to maintain the level of service. Third, when no booking service is provided, users must physically search for stations with bikes when they wish to rent a bike and for stations with empty docks to return the bikes. This affects the demand level estimation at each station. No bicycle service planning studies have simultaneously tackled all of these crucial issues affecting large, competitive mixed-fleet bike-sharing systems. For the operators to determine their optimal strategies and for the government to regulate the systems, a new methodology must be proposed. The main objective of this project will be to develop a unified trilevel optimization model and an efficient solution method to determine the strategic planning decisions of multiple operators competing in a large mixed-fleet bike-sharing system, considering the users’ searching behavior and choice of bike type and the induced planning decisions due to the introduction of e-bikes into conventional systems. The methodology will further consider the interrelationship between bike repositioning, the design of station location and capacity, pricing and reward, and bike and vehicle acquisition under competition to determine the optimal strategies of the operators. A case study of Hong Kong Island will be conducted to investigate the effects of various regulation policies on system performance, thereby providing managerial insights to the government and planning insights to the operators. The case study will also aim to identify critical factors that affect the user choice of regular bikes and e-bikes offered by various operators and their profitability. 共享單車系統已在全世界範圍內普及。儘管共享單車系統具有諸多益處，其仍有數個關鍵問題亟待解決。首先，私有共享單車運營商之間的競爭導致了共享單車以及單車站供給過剩的情況，造成了資源浪費。其次，在傳統共享單車系統中引入電動單車可以覆蓋更多類別的用戶，但引入電動單車後的混合共享單車系統的規劃和管理也相應變得更為複雜，需要額外考慮的問題包括：電池更換或低電量電動單車替換，用戶對於單車種類的選擇，不同類型成本之間的權衡（例如可充電站點的設置成本與電動單車或電池調配成本之間的權衡），是否為維持服務水平而在普通單車不足的站點對電動單車用戶收取普通單車的租賃費用。其次，在不提供預訂服務的情況下，用戶只得親身尋找可租賃或可歸還單車的車站，這會影響每個車站的估計需求水平。尚未有單車服務規劃的研究能夠對上述影響在競爭條件下大型混合共享單車系統的所有關鍵問題同時進行處理。為使運營商能夠確定其最優策略並使政府能夠對混合共享單車系統進行監管，新方法的推出勢在必行。 本項目的主要目標是開發一個整合式的三層優化模型和一個高效的求解方法來確定多個運營商在競爭下的大型混合共享單車系統的戰略規劃決策，其中考慮到的方面包括用戶的搜索行為，用戶對於單車種類的選擇和傳統共享單車系統引入電動單車後所引發的規劃決策。這一新方法將進一步考慮以下幾個方面的相互關聯來確定存在競爭的情況下運營商的最優策略：單車調配、站點位置及容量設計、定價和回贈、單車和運送單車的貨車的購置。本研究將進行一項對香港島的案例研究來調查不同監管政策對系統表現的影響，從而為政府和運營商提供管理上和規劃上的見解。此項案例研究還將致力於識別影響用戶對於不同運營商提供的普通單車和電動單車的選擇以及運營商盈利能力的關鍵因素。

17206522.value: 為什麼超級傳播者大多只導致一次新冠爆發: 一個綜合病毒和傳播動力學研究

17206522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17206522.value: Among the thousands of COVID-19 outbreaks, including nearly 400 that we have studied, the index case has rarely been involved in another outbreak. This single-outbreak phenomenon has not been studied. Understanding the mechanisms of this phenomenon will help determine the optimal control strategies for super-spreading events (SSEs), which predominate the pandemic. The transmission of respiratory viruses has been studied in at least two disciplines, i.e. viral kinetics and environmental transmission kinetics. Each discipline alone cannot fully explain the single-outbreak phenomenon. We hypothesise that an SSE occurs when there is a super-spreader whose virus shedding is likely to be at its peak and who happens to be in an indoor space that contains a sufficient number of susceptible individuals, has a suitable environment for virus survival, and is environmentally adequate for sufficient virus exposure to cause infection. The low probability of these events co-occurring may explain the single-outbreak phenomenon. We will investigate the single-outbreak phenomenon and identify the bottleneck in the chain of transmission events by integrating viral and transmission kinetics theories. This will be achieved by considering the entire transmission route from the release of the virus from the cells of the index case to the attachment of the virus to the cells of susceptible individuals. Using this approach, the predicted viral load profile will be integrated with the expired droplet volume to provide an expired viral source strength. The expired airflows will be modelled using the expired jet and puff models, and/or will be predicted using computational fluid dynamics. The short- and long-range inhalation infection risks will be estimated using the recently developed continuum model and computational fluid dynamics, taking into account the infectious aerosol removal mechanisms of ventilation, filtration, and virus deactivation in the environment, and virus deposition in the nasal cavity. This model will be further integrated with a connected-indoor network to predict the risk of infection in a large urban city, with a given distribution of ventilation rates and human contact behaviour in each category of buildings and human activity. Our new approach will allow the prediction of viral load directly from viral kinetics, based on the viral load profiles of thousands of patients. Our proposed integrated approach will also offer a new method for evaluating different preventive interventions, such as ventilation, filtration, face-masking, and social distancing. Our study will facilitate the exploration of effective targeted interventions to minimise COVID-19 and influenza SSEs in high-risk settings. 在數千次分析過的COVID-19 爆發中，包括我們研究的近 400 次，指示病例很少涉及另一次爆發。這種單一爆發的現像還沒有被研究過。了解這種現象的機制將有助於確定在大流行中占主導地位的超級傳播事件 (SSE) 的最佳控制策略。呼吸道病毒的傳播至少在兩個學科中進行了研究，即病毒動力學和環境傳播動力學。單靠各個學科並不能完全解釋單一爆發現象。我們假設 SSE 發生在有一個超級傳播者，其病毒脫落可能達到峰值，並且恰好位於包含足夠數量易感個體的室內空間，具有適合病毒生存的環境，並且在環境上足以使病毒暴露於引起感染。這些低概率事件的同時發生似乎可以解釋單一爆發現象。我們將通過結合病毒和傳播動力學理論來研究單一爆發現象並確定傳播事件鏈中的瓶頸因素。這將通過考慮從指示病例細胞釋放病毒，病毒附著，到易感個體細胞的整個傳播途徑來實現。使用這種方法，我們可以結合預測的病毒載量曲線和呼出的液滴體積，以提供呼出的病毒源強度。呼出氣流將使用呼出射流和呼出雲霧模型進行建模，和/或將使用計算流體動力學進行預測。短期和長期吸入感染風險將使用最近開發的連續暴漏模型和計算流體動力學進行估計，同時考慮到環境中通風、過濾和病毒滅活的傳染性氣溶膠去除機制，以及病毒在鼻腔中的沉積。該模型將進一步與連接的室內網絡集成，以預測大城市的感染風險，並在每個類別的建築物和人類活動中具有給定的通風率和人類接觸行為分佈。我們的新方法將允許根據數千名患者的病毒載量曲線直接從病毒動力學預測病毒載量。我們提出的綜合方法還將提供一種新方法來評估不同的預防性干預措施，例如通風、過濾、面罩和社交距離。我們的研究將有助於探索有效的有針對性的干預措施，以最大限度地減少高風險環境中的 COVID-19 和流感 超級傳播事件。
