17312922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17312922.value: Communication security is crucial in many aspects of modern society, such as personal privacy protection, banking, or even national defence. A large part of this security relies on modern public-key cryptographic schemes, such as the widely used RSA protocol. However, with the famous Shor’s algorithm, quantum computers hold the potential to completely break classical cryptographic schemes including RSA. Quantum computing has seen much development in recent years, such as a demonstration of “quantum supremacy” by Google, making quantum computing an increasingly tangible threat to classical cryptography. To protect us against such a looming threat, the Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) protocol enables information-theoretically secure communications between two parties, immune to even attacks from quantum computers. Since its proposal, QKD has generated much interest from the community and has seen many experimental demonstrations over fiber and free space, even from satellite to ground. However, while theoretically secure, practical components in QKD systems might introduce additional side-channels that open up the system to attacks. Among the components of a QKD system, the detectors are particularly susceptible to hacking attacks. Measurement-device-independent (MDI) protocols are proposed to eliminate side-channels in detectors. Twin-field (TF) QKD, a new protocol proposed in 2018 that has attracted huge attention in the QKD community, is a type of MDI protocol that also provides significantly better secure key rate over long distances compared to prior art protocols, making it a very promising candidate for the next generation of practical QKD systems and even QKD networks. However, while TF-QKD might be immune to hacking on detectors, side-channels can still exist in the source modulators controlling the encoding and intensity settings of the signals. For instance, an eavesdropper can infuse an external signal as a “trojan horse” and steal the encoding information from the modulator. To protect the source from such attacks, passive encoding and passive decoy-state (intensity setting) schemes, which use no modulation devices, have been proposed in previous works. However, so far there has not been a fully passive scheme for any QKD protocol, including TF-QKD, that combines passive encoding and decoy-state. In this project, we propose to design a fully passive TF-QKD scheme, where both encoding and decoy states are implemented without modulation devices. This makes the protocol free from side-channels in both the source modulators and the measurement devices, while resulting in both high implementation security and exceptional secure key rate over long distances - a “best of both worlds”. 通信安全在现代社会的许多方面都扮演着重要的角色，例如个人隐私保护、金融交易，乃至国家安全。现今系统的通信安全性有很大程度依赖于现代公钥加密体系，例如被广泛使用的RSA协议。不过，随着著名的秀尔算法被提出，量子计算机被认为具有潜力完全地破解包括RSA在内的传统加密体系。近年来，量子计算得到了长足的发展，例如谷歌展示了“量子霸权”。这使得量子计算日益成为对传统加密体系的切实的威胁。 为了保护我们不受量子计算的威胁，量子密钥分配（QKD）协议应运而生。它能够允许两个用户之间进行具有信息论安全性的加密通信，而这种通信甚至能够免疫量子计算机的攻击。QKD自被提出以来便在世界范围受到了广泛的关注，并且由各国研究者们实现了大量的实验验证，包括通过光纤信道、通过自由空间，甚至从卫星向地面的通信。然而，尽管QKD具有理论安全性，真实的QKD系统中有可能因为不完美的器件被引入额外的侧信道，并导致系统中存在可以被攻击的漏洞。 在一个QKD系统中，探测器是尤其容易受到攻击的器件。因此，研究者们提出了测量设备无关（MDI）QKD协议以消除探测器中的侧信道。2018年，一个被称为双场（TF）QKD的新型协议被提出，并受到了大量关注。它同样是一种测量设备无关的协议，并且能够提供远高于此前协议的密钥率和最远通信距离。因此，双场QKD协议被认为是一种可以用于下一代实用QKD系统、乃至QKD网络的强力候选协议。 然而，虽然TF-QKD能够免疫对探测器的攻击，在协议的光源端控制编码和光强的调制器中依然可能存在着侧信道。例如，一名窃听者有可能从外部输入一些“木马”信号并从调制器中窃取编码信息。为了保护光源不受攻击，前人工作中提出了被动编码和被动诱导态（光强调制）的协议。此类协议不含有任何调制器。然而，迄今为止，还没有一个能够同时实现被动编码和被动诱导态的“全被动QKD协议”（包括TF-QKD协议）被实现。 在该项目中，我们计划设计一个全被动的TF-QKD协议。在该协议中，编码和诱导态的产生全部都不需使用调制器。这将使得该协议成为既不会含有任何光源调制器的侧信道、也不会含有任何探测器的侧信道的“两全其美”的协议，并令其具有坚固的实际安全性和长距离通信下的优秀密钥率。

17313122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17313122.value: 一維單分量費米子的物理性質：三題相互作用以及體黏滯係數

17313122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17313122.value: Recent experiments have renewed interest in the physics of a single component Fermi gas (Li-6 or K-40) confined in a one-dimensional (1D) optical trap. By using the confinement induced resonance, it is possible to explore the stability and spectroscopic properties of the system close to a scattering resonance around which a significant role is played by the three-body physics. It is known that such a one-dimensional system also obeys a set of universal relations that are analogous to their three-dimensional counterpart, however, the role of three-body interactions could be more pronounced in 1D. Therefore, we shall carry out a systematic investigation on the role of three-body interactions especially how they affect the momentum distribution as well as the radio-frequency response of the system; both of which are now under active experimental investigations. On the other hand, one-dimensional quantum gases also offer an opportunity to explore in considerable detail about its dynamical properties due to the existence of a plethora of analytic and numerical techniques. In this particular case, due to the absence of superfluid state at any finite temperature and the absence of internal degrees of freedom, it is possible to study the bulk viscosity in the normal state down to the lowest temperature where the system is presumably described by the Luttinger liquid paradigm. However, apart from the weak coupling limit, it is not yet known what are the appropriate Luttinger parameters close to resonance and how the non-linear terms beyond Luttinger model affect the bulk viscosity. As a result, we shall use a combination of numerical and analytic methods to calculate these crucial parameters and investigate the behaviour of bulk viscosity in the resonant limit, especially for the case when a large one-dimensional p-wave effective range is present as is the case in actual experiments. 最近幾年來，一維單分量費米子的實驗進展取得了諸多進展。利用光晶格，實驗上可以研究其在共振附近的穩定性和譜學性質，這些性質在很大程度上可能依賴於體系的三體關聯，並且也會影響到其普適性質。在這個項目中，我們希望系統研究三體相互作用對於動量分佈以及光譜的影響。另一方面，由於很多解析和數值方法的存在，我們可以深入研究一維體系的動力學性質。由於一維體系大部分遵從Luttinger液體的描述，我們可以研究起在共振處的性質，並計算其超出Luttinger線性理論範圍的相互作用以及其對體黏滯係數的影響。我們希望利用一些解析和數值工具來研究以上問題並與實驗相對照。

17313222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17313222.value: 由索烴配位的銅催化劑於烯烴的氮丙啶化反應中的應用

17313222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17313222.value: In this proposal, mechanical interlocking will be explored as a novel strategy of exploiting ligand kinetic effect in the design of new transition metal catalysts. In particular, catenanes that contain nitrogens as coordination donors for copper will be developed as a new class of mechanically interlocked ligands (MILs) for catalytic olefin aziridination reactions. Catenanes are a representative class of mechanically interlocked molecules comprise of interlocked macrocycles. Due to the physical entanglement between the interlocked rings, the nitrogen donors in the MILs are strongly bonded together and a kinetically stable, coordinatively saturated copper centre is maintained at the resting state to render a long catalyst lifetime. At the same time, as the interlocked rings are able to undergo large-amplitude movement within the context of the mechanical interlocking, such co-conformational change of the MILs will create an open coordination site at the copper only when reacting with the substrate in the active state. Thus dual robustness and dynamics is characteristic to catenanes and thus incorporating mechanical bond in ligand design is a promising strategy in developing new transitional metal catalysts of better stability, higher turnover and new reactivity. In this proposal, copper catalysts featuring a new series of catenane-based MILs for olefin aziridination will be developed. In addition to the dual robustness and dynamic nature of the MILs, mechanical confinement by the interlocked ligands could also lead to reduced ligand conformations, specific substrate orientations and stabilisation of reactive species which would lead to enhanced catalyst activity, product selectivity and new catalytic mechanism. These kinetic effects from the catenane ligands will be studied in this proposal in the context of copper-catalysed aziridination as an efficient C-N bond generation strategy, which is implicated in the synthesis of many commodity chemicals, natural products and bioactive compounds. More generally, results from this proposal will set the foundation for harnessing the attractive and unique features of mechanical interlocking as a novel strategy in capturing ligand kinetic characteristics for tuning metal reactivity in the broad area of transition metal chemistry and catalysis. 在本研究計劃中，我們將通過機械互鎖的方式作為探究配體的動力學效應的策略，並以此為基礎設計新型的過渡金屬催化劑。索烴是一類由互鎖的大環所組成，具代表性的機械互鎖分子。由於互鎖的大環之間的物理糾纏，索烴配體上的氮原子可以與亞銅離子結合成一個動力學上穩定、配位飽和的靜止態催化劑。與此同時，個別的大環亦能通過共構象變化進行大振幅的運動，使其能夠開啟亞銅離子上的一個新配位點並與底物反應，形成具活性的中間體。這種雙重的穩定性和動力學特徵是僅索烴具備的特點，因此在配體設計中引入機械鍵對於開發更穩定、更高轉化率和新反應性的新型過渡金屬催化劑是一個很有前景的策略。 我們在本計劃中將開發一系列全新的索烴配體，並以其與亞銅離子的配合物用於催化烯烴的氮丙啶化反應。在本研究計劃中，我們將以銅催化的烯烴氮丙啶化反應為基礎來研究上述索烴的動力學效應。烯烴的氮丙啶化反應是一類高效的碳-氮鍵形成策略，被用於許多工業品、天然產物和生物活性化合物的合成。總的來說，使用機械互鎖可以調控配體的動力學特徵從而進一步調整金屬反應性，在過渡金屬化學和催化合成的廣泛領域中有著重要應用，而本研究計劃的成果將為該類全新的機械互鎖配體設計策略奠定基礎。

17313722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17313722.value: 用於高維時間序列模型的計算上可擴展的自回歸移動平均模型

17313722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17313722.value: The advent of big data era has spurred a rapid growth of interest in high-dimensional time series modeling in recent years. Examples can be found in numerous areas including energy forecasting, genomics, neuroscience, economics and finance. Arguably, as the most widely used multivariate time series model, the vector autoregressive (VAR) model has been a primary workhorse for high-dimensional tasks. Together with these successes, it has also been shown by more and more empirical evidences to lack of forecasting power for many empirical examples. This is mainly due to the fact that the autocorrelation structures depicted by VAR models are not flexible enough. The VARMA model is the most important compliment of VAR models, and it can provide better prediction accuracy with interpretability. However, when applying to the high-dimensional data, it may encounter two challenging problems. First, the VARMA model is well known to lack of identification, i.e. two groups of coefficient matrices may result in the same data generating process. Moreover, it is usually difficult to directly fit a VARMA model to the data since the corresponding optimization will involve a very high order polynomial. This project provides a different angle to look VARMA models by treating them as parametric AR(infty) models, and this gives us a chance to investigate the roles of these MA coefficient matrices. Specifically, only these eigenvalues will induce the exponential decay of the VAR coefficient matrices, while many other parameters actually play a role similar to AR coefficients. Based on this finding, this project first proposes a new type of VARMA model, which is defined via the AR(infty) model. Hence the identification problem can be readily solved by adding a simple inequality. Secondly these exponential decay patterns appear in an additive form, and then the corresponding estimating procedure will be scalable with respect to the rank of MA coefficient matrices. In order to accommodate high-dimensional time series, this project proposes a reduced rank method, which can limit the parameter space from two directions, and an alternating least squares algorithm is suggested to search for the estimators. A sparsity-inducing regularization method is also considered. Both the statistical and convergence guarantees will be established in the project. 大数据时代的到来激发了对高维时间序列建模兴趣的快速增长。在许多领域都可以找到相关的例子，比如说包括能源预测、基因组学、神经科学、经济学和金融学。作为最被广泛应用的多元时间序列模型，向量自回归模型一直起到了最主要的作用。然而伴随着这些成功的同时，越来越多的证据表明向量自回归模型缺乏足够的预测能力。这主要是因为这个模型不足以能够描述灵活的自相关结构。 与此同时，作为向量自回归模型的一个重要补充，向量自回归移動平均模型可以提供更好的预测准确性以及可解释性。但是当被应用于高维数据时，这个模型可能会遇到两个具有挑战性的困难。第一个就是众所周知的可识别性问题，也就是说两组不同的参数可能会对应于同一个数据生成过程。此外，相应的模型估计会涉及很高阶多项式，从而难于获得对应的估计值。 该项目通过将向量自回归移動平均模型看做为一个无穷阶的向量自回归模型，从而让我们有机会重新审视这些MA 系数矩阵的作用。具体来说，只有它们的特征值会导致AR系数矩阵的指数衰减，而许多其他参数实际上发挥了类似于 AR 系数的作用。基于这一发现，本项目首先提出了一种全新的向量自回归移動平均模型。它是通过无穷阶的向量自回归模型来定义的，因此识别性问题可以通过添加一个简单的不等式来解决。其次，这些指数衰减模式是以加性的形式出现的，因此其相应的估计是可扩展的。 为了把模型应用到高维时间序列，本项目提出了一个降维方法，它可以从两个方向同时限制参数的空间。本项目还提出了一个交替最小二乘算法来搜索估计量，同时还提出了一个sparsity-induced正则化方法。本项目还就会仔细研究有关的统计性和收敛性。

17313922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17313922.value: Copper catalysts, which readily undergo single electron transfer processes, are capable of activating a variety of electrophiles upon light irradiation and promoting a number of radical coupling reactions with different types of carbon, nitrogen, and other heteroatom nucleophiles. However, high loadings and low recyclability of the copper catalysts prone to deactivation and decomposition, render these copper-catalyzed homogeneous reactions difficult to scale up. Thus, it is scientifically crucial and valuable to prepare stable, recyclable, and highly reactive heterogeneous copper photocatalysts and develop corresponding catalytic organic transformations with high efficiency and high selectivity. On account of their regular and controllable porous structures and high flexibility to modify the functionalities on the organic linkers and metal clusters, metal–organic frameworks are excellent solid matrices for supporting transition-metal catalysts. In this program, we aim to graft the well-designed ligands onto the framework supports via direct synthesis or post-synthetic modification and prepare the heterogeneous catalysts possessing photoactive copper photosensitizers and chiral Lewis acids. Ligands on the copper center could be readily tuned to facilitate the activation of olefins via energy transfer. We will then apply these novel catalysts to the development of the visible-light-driven crossed intermolecular cycloaddition reactions which have not yet been reported in heterogeneous catalytic systems, including [2 + 2] cycloaddition of styrenes with acrylates. Photoinduced asymmetric [3 + 2] cycloaddition of cyclopropyl ketones with alkenes could also be significantly promoted via more effective electron transfer between copper photoactive centers and chiral Lewis acid catalytic centers located in close proximity on the MOF matrices. The realization of various [2 + 2] and [3 + 2] cycloaddition reactions with highly effective and recyclable heterogeneous copper photocatalysts will pave the way for the large-scale chemical production in an environmentally benign manner. 銅催化的自由基偶聯反應因其催化劑廉價易得、反應條件溫和、底物官能團兼容性廣等諸多優點，近年來已成為有機催化領域的研究熱點和前沿，在光催化領域有著越來越廣泛的應用。然而，在均相催化體系中，銅絡合物的穩定性較低，光照下易發生聚合失活。因此銅在大多數光激發的自由基反應中催化效率較低，極大地提高了大規模生產中的催化劑成本，且易造成環境汙染。本項目擬從非均相催化體系入手，將光活性銅物種以前修飾或者後金屬化的方式固載於金屬有機框架中，以此方法使催化中心彼此分離而避免其在反應過程中相互作用而發生聚合，從而製備出高穩定性的非均相銅催化劑。再則，將手性路易斯酸通過共價鍵連接的方式引入到框架骨架上，可以顯著提高手性催化劑的回收利用率並極大簡化其與產物的分離過程。我們將通過配體和框架的調控來實現催化中心與烯烴底物之間有效的能量或者電子轉移，從而催化2+2和3+2環加成反應的進行並獲得高附加值的四元環和五元環化合物。以獨特的非均相催化體系實現這些高效、經濟且環境友好的異相銅催化反應過程在有機合成化學中具有十分重要的科學意義和應用價值。

17314222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17314222.value: Precisely arranging matter (atoms, molecules, and particles) into desired structures has been a central challenge in materials science. Self-assembly is a powerful approach towards this goal, whereby building blocks carrying commands of interactions spontaneously organise into well-defined architectures. For atoms and molecule, rich assembly information can be encoded through molecular synthesis and engineering for diverse structures. However, for colloidal particles, with simple isotropic potentials, only a limited kinds of assemblies have been obtained. Recently, the introduction of patchy particles—particles with delicately designed surface patterns—represents a significant breakthrough that tackles this problem. Through patch design, directional interactions are enabled allowing the assembly of low-coordinated and open structures, which are desirable for applications in photonics, sensing, filtration, etc. Despite the rapid progress in this direction, two pressing challenges need to be urgently addressed. First, the interactions between patchy particles are still far from precise, unable to compete with those in atoms and molecules. Current particles derives primarily from polymer latex, and therefore their patches adopt a high-symmetry dome shape with a curved surface. Their bonding cannot lock the exact positions of the relevant particles and has no restriction over the particle’s orientation. This prevents the assembly of well-defined superstructures by design. Second, patchy particles suffer from a limited material scope (again they are synthesized mainly from polymer latex) and the inability to tune functionality/properties. In this project, we propose the synthesis and assembly of a distinct class of patchy particles, in this case, patchy MOF particles, by exploiting the morphological and chemical information of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). On the one hand, patchy MOF particles are microcrystals carrying additional bonding information by having a polyhedral matrix, low-symmetry hexagonal patches, and anisotropic surfaces. By introducing attractive interaction between the patches such as liquid bridging, depletion force, or DNA hybridization, patchy particles are expected to assemble with unprecedented precision, where the bonding symmetry and particle orientation can be controlled. On the other hand, MOFs are highly functional and addressable materials with micropores and channels; assembling them into colloidal superstructures can realize hierarchical structures with tunable physical properties. Finally, depends on the assembly scheme and MOF used, external stimuli can be utilized for controlling the assemblies leading to responsive assemblies. Because of the flexibility in choosing MOFs, the proposed project shall give access to a much expanded scope of materials. 將物質（原子、分子和粒子）精確排列成所需結構一直是材料科學的核心挑戰。自組裝是實現這一目標的有力方法。對於原子和分子，豐富的組裝信息可以通過分子合成和不同結構的工程進行編碼。然而，對於具有簡單各向同性勢能的膠體粒子，只能得到有限種類的組裝體。最近，补丁粒子（即具有表面圖案的粒子）的引入代表了解決這一問題的重大突破。通過补丁設計，粒子可以實現定向相互作用，允許組裝低配位和開放結構，可用於光子學、傳感、過濾等應用。人们儘管在這個方向上取得了快速進展，但仍需要迫切解決兩個挑戰。首先，补丁粒子之間的相互作用還遠不精確，無法與原子和分子中的相互作用相媲美。目前的顆粒主要來源於聚合物膠乳，因此它們的补丁具有曲面的高對稱圓頂形狀。它們的結合不能鎖定相關粒子的確切位置，並且對粒子的方向沒有限制。其次，补丁顆粒的材料範圍有限（同樣它們主要由聚合物膠乳合成）並且無法調整功能/性能。 在這個項目中，我們通過利用金屬有機框架 (MOF) 的形態和化學信息，提出合成和組裝一類獨特的基于MOF的补丁顆粒。一方面，MOF 补丁顆粒是通過具有多面體基體、低對稱的六邊形补丁和各向異性表面而攜帶附加鍵合信息。通過在补丁之間引入有吸引力的相互作用，例如液體橋接、耗盡力或 DNA 雜交，預計补丁顆粒將以前所未有的精度組裝，使得鍵合對稱性和顆粒方向得到控制。另一方面，MOFs 是具有微孔和微通道的功能材料。將它們組裝成膠體超結構可以實現具有可調物理特性的分級結構。最後，取決於所使用的裝配方案和 MOF，外部刺激可用於控制組裝。

17314322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17314322.value: 利用氡刻畫海灘含水層中的大腸桿菌發生、運輸和排放機制

17314322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17314322.value: Prof Gu , Ji-Dong Dr Luo, Xin

17314322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17314322.value: 糞便污染會在休閒海灘造成各種環境和健康問題。在有糞便污染的海灘水域游泳，可能有很高的患胃腸道疾病、皮膚和眼睛感染等風險。出於監管、監測目的，許多政府機構使用大腸桿菌作為糞便監測的細菌指標。以往對海灘大腸桿菌的研究主要集中在大腸桿菌在衝浪區的行為和預測，很少研究大腸桿菌在海灘地下的行為，主要是由於難以表徵地下環境中的大腸桿菌的反應性輸運機制。我們的初步研究表明，222Rn 是一種惰性氣體核素，其產生和衰減常數與大腸桿菌相似。我們假設 222Rn 可以在海灘含水層和衝浪帶中示踪大腸桿菌的發生、運輸和排放。為了驗證這一假設，我們將首先推導多孔介質中一維 222Rn 和大腸桿菌反應傳輸的解析解，並對傳輸過程進行參數化，然後通過一維沙柱實驗驗證解析解。然後，我們將建立 222Rn 和大腸桿菌反應遷移的二維數值模型，並通過二維沙箱實驗描述它們可能相似的發生和遷移機制。之後，我們將選擇兩個具有代表性的海灘，一個是天然海灘，一個是受人為影響的休閒海灘，進行詳細的實地考察。將在海灘建立多層採樣和監測系統，沿垂直於海岸線的斷面進行定期高分辨率採樣和測量。 大量的現場數據將用於確定調節海灘中大腸桿菌和 222Rn 發生和運輸的關鍵過程。將構建基於海灘含水層水文地質環境的大腸桿菌和 222Rn 反應輸運模型，並通過大腸桿菌和 222Rn 的定期測量進行校準。將探索222Rn和大腸桿菌的發生和遷移的機制，並根據一年的現場監測數據檢查它們之間的統計關係。海灘含水層中的大腸桿菌和 222Rn 將通過海底地下水排放 (SGD) 輸送到海灘衝浪區，由於地下水和海水兩者之間的溫差，可以通過 222Rn 分佈和無人機 (UAV) 獲得的熱圖像研究地下水分布。我們將探索開發一個預測模型，以根據 SGD 和地下水攜帶的 222Rn 的無人機熱圖像來有效地繪製和預測衝浪區的大腸桿菌濃度。

17314422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17314422.value: 西澳大利亞全新世相對海平面的演變

17314422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17314422.value: Sea-level rise will be a large, long-lived consequence of human-driven climate change, the impacts of which will be spatially-variable across Earth’s coastlines due to a variety of human and natural mechanisms. The projection of future sea-level rise relies on accurate knowledge of the mechanisms driving its complex evolution, which must be founded on knowledge of its history. Direct observations of ice sheet and sea-level changes over the satellite era are too short (decades) to improve our understanding of natural changes on the timescales needed for future projections (multi-decades to millennia). Geological sea-level proxies preserved in coastal sediments, geomorphic features, and fossil coral reefs overcome this temporal limitation and can provide records of sea-level change over hundreds to thousands of years. Western Australia provides an excellent natural laboratory for studying past sea levels. Its coastline spans 20 degrees of latitude and captures a range of coastal environments, tidal ranges, climatic zones, neotectonic regimes, and metocean conditions. Furthermore, given its far-field location distal to former polar ice sheets, records of Holocene (the last 11.7 ka) relative sea-level change from Western Australia offer important constraints on ice melt contributions to global mean sea-level change. Despite this, recent efforts to reconstruct relative sea level have been limited, and the nature of Holocene relative sea-level evolution in Western Australia remains debated in part due to biased comparisons of data. In this proposed work, we will review, re-evaluate, and aggregate relative sea-level data from Western Australia following international standard protocol and explore the potential of sedimentary archives from estuarine marshes and beach ridge systems of southwestern Australia to produce accurate, high-resolution records of relative sea-level change. 17314822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17314822.value: 通過潮汐力瓦解恆星事件來探測中等質量黑洞

17314822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17314822.value: The study of intermediate-mass black holes (IMBHs) is very important for understanding the formation and growth of massive black holes. IMBHs should have formed at some cosmic time predicted by theories of massive black hole formation. However, it has been challenging to observe them either dynamically or via their accretion power. Tidal disruption events (TDEs) offer great chances for probing IMBHs via electromagnetic signals. As a star is disrupted by an IMBH, part of the stellar debris materials will orbit around the black hole and eventually accrete, which produces unique observational signatures such as the rapid rise of the flare and a decay pattern roughly following t^(-5/3). So far the study of tidal disruption events has mostly focused on supermassive black holes. Here we propose to conduct a comprehensive theoretical study of IMBHs disrupting main-sequence stars. One key component of this study is to simulate the black hole accretion and emission in IMBH-TDEs, where the Eddington ratio is highly super-Eddington. Another key component is to calculate the rates of IMBH-TDEs using the loss cone dynamics by considering realistic stellar density profiles observed in dwarf galaxies and other stellar systems which can host IMBHs. Combining these two components, we can start to probe the IMBH occupation fraction and demographics via IMBH-TDEs. 研究中等質量黑洞對我們了解大質量黑洞的形成和演化是至關重要的。根據黑洞演化理論，在宇宙某些階段應有很多中等質量的黑洞存在。然而，這些黑洞並不容易通過動力學方法或者吸積過程而被探測到。 潮汐力瓦解恆星事件中發出的輻射可以讓我們探測到中等質量黑洞。 當一個恆星被黑洞的潮汐引力撕裂後，部分的恆星碎片繞行黑洞並最後吸積到黑洞上，從而形成一個明亮的暫變光源，其光度迅速增強然後以t^(-5/3)的模式減弱。到目前為止，對于此類天體現象的研究都集中於大質量黑洞上。在此我們建議進行一個全面的對于中等質量黑洞潮汐力瓦解恆星的研究。 此研究的一個重要部分是研究中等質量黑洞潮汐力瓦解恆星事件中高度超越超愛丁頓情況下的吸積及輻射物理。另一個重要部分是通過恆星動力學以及矮星系中心的恆星密度來精確計算此類現象的頻率。這兩個部分的結合可以讓我們探測到中等質量黑洞的參數分佈以及它們在星系中心的佔據比例。

17315122.label: Project Objectives
17315122.value: Enantioselective intramolecular (and intermolecular) nitrene C–H insertion reactions catalyzed by chiral Fe porphyrins: We aim to capitalize on the use of newly modified chiral porphyrins for Fe-catalyzed asymmetric acyl-, alkyl-, aryl- and sulfonylnitrene C–H insertion reactions using the corresponding azides as nitrene source. Major foci will be given to the development of new chiral ligands that affect stereoselectivity and reactivity of the resultant Fe complexes due to synergistic non-covalent interactions between peripheral substituents of the chelating chiral ligand and incoming substrate. An example is the use of hydrogen-bonding secondary interactions to facilitate carbene and nitrene transfer and insertion reactions. Our preliminary studies showed that under visible light irradiation, chiral Fe porphyrins are competent for decomposing aryl azides and catalyzing intramolecular arylnitrene C–H insertion reaction at temperature down to -10 oC. The mild reaction condition is undoubtedly a prerequisite to induce high stereoselectivity and enantioselectivity. Other than expanding substrate scope and exploring functional group tolerance, we will apply this protocol to achieve late-stage functionalization of complex organic molecules and natural products as well as to scrutinize the possibility in scaling up the reactions. Besides, we will attempt to characterize the formal Fe(V)-imido porphyrin species by spectroscopic means (e.g. EPR) and conduct computational calculations to decipher its electronic structure and reaction profile energetics. Asymmetric cis-dihydroxylation of alkenes catalyzed by chiral Fe N4-tetradentate complexes: Biocompatible Fe complexes capable of dihydroxylating alkenes are appealing substitute for the toxic Sharpless OsO4 catalysts. Though methodologies in the dihydroxylation of mono-, trans-di- and tri-substituted alkenes have been reported in our previous works, dihydroxylations of aryl-, electron-deficient, cis-di-substituted and tetra-substituted alkenes with high product yields and enantioselectivity remain undeveloped. We plan to develop a series of new Fe catalysts supported by chiral and unsymmetrical N4-tetradentate ligands to improve chemo- and stereoselectivities. Stereoselective alkylcarbene C–H insertion reactions: We will endeavor to develop Fe-catalyzed intramolecular alkylcarbene C–H insertion reaction. Alkyldiazo compound is known to be unstable, therefore, we leverage on the use of 1,3,4-oxadiazoline as a diazo precursor, which could eventually generate carbene upon photolysis. This obviates the need of heating N-tosylhydrazone in the presence of metal catalyst, enhancing the efficiency in chirality induction. Apart from ligand design, the oxidation state of Fe and auxiliary ligand (e.g. Cl, N-heterocyclic carbene and 2-adamantylidene) will also be regulated to achieve high product yield and good stereoselectivity. On the other hand, alkyldiazo compound stabilized with α-CF3 is a bench-stable carbene source. Our exemplary findings demonstrated that a chiral dirhodium complex is competent for undergoing intramolecular trifluoromethyl alkylcarbene C–H insertion with good yields and enantioselectivity. With these findings, we conceive and showed in a preliminary study that Fe(Pc) and Fe(Por) complexes could also catalyze such reaction. Cation-template metal phthalocyanine (Pc) for stereoselective carbene C–H and C=C functionalization reactions: Owing to the dearth of chiral Pc ligands, we plan to prepare various new Pc ligands through guest-host interactions between crown ether and chiral template. This significantly increases the flexibility of chiral induction as various chiral templates can be used to suit the substrate. As a result, different chiral metal Pc complexes (e.g. Fe and Rh) can be synthesized and used for asymmetric carbene and nitrene transfer reactions. Our initial attempts showed that excellent diastereoselective ratio can be obtained using such Fe catalysts. We plan to isolate and/or characterize Fe-carbene and -nitrene complexes supported by Pc ligands. Synthesis, characterization and reactivity studies of high-valent Fe-imido species: Uncovering the bonding, electronic structure and reactivities of Fe-imido species is highly important to break the bottleneck of biomimetic Fe-catalyzed oxidation reactions. Such intermediates are often transient and hardly detectable. We plan to stabilize the high-valent Fe-imido using robust and/or bulky macrocyclic ligands (e.g. corrole, porphyrin and/or Pc), so as to examine structure-reactivity relationship. In particular, we will conduct a series of spectroscopies (e.g. UV-vis, EPR and XPS) to disclose their electronic structure. Moreover, we will endeavor to study the relative reactivity of their redox-related species (probably via one-electron oxidation) towards the saturated and/or unsaturated hydrocarbons, that would provide useful information to the future design of Fe-based nitrene transfer catalyst. The analogous Fe(V)-oxo corrole will also be examined, so as to compare the effect of oxo versus imido.

17315122.value: 高效廉价地合成生物活性分子和药物分子是现代合成化学中长期探求的难题。对来源广泛的烷烃进行直接官能化是解决这个难题的极具吸引力的方案，然而由于烷烃底物的惰性（碳氢键解离能约90-105千卡每摩尔），常需要先进行预卤化等反应以引入其它官能团。自然界中细胞色素P450（CYP450）则可以在温和的条件下实现碳氢键的羟基化反应。 在过去的几十年中，化学家们进行了许多模拟CYP450催化研究。例如，将各种合成子（卡宾、氮宾和氧烯）和不同的金属（如铁、锰、铜）及配体进行组合目前是提升催化效率的常用策略。由于使用未经合理修饰的简单卟啉配体进行碳氢键官能化反应时反应效果很难提升，因此系统地研究改变和调整金属氧化态、配体上取代基和位阻、辅助配体是实现金属催化的“原子经济性”碳氢键官能化反应的必要手段。这里所说的“原子经济性”指的是利用金属催化的卡宾、氮宾和氧烯转移（碳，氮和氧原子转移）反应，反应中一般只有小分子（氮气）作为副产物释放出来。此外，研究中还将着重通过捕捉活性反应中间体（如铁卡宾，铁氧及铁氮宾）并结合计算化学研究它们的成键模式、电子结构及反应性并以此揭示其反应机制。 在我们近期钌卟啉催化烷基卡宾、芳基和酰基氮宾碳氢键插入研究的基础之上，我们认为与钌同为第8族的金属铁所形成的络合物可以同样进行该类型的催化，但其中一个关键问题在于铁催化反应的转换数较低。为此我们将使用专门设计的高活性卟啉，酞菁，咔咯等多种N4四配位进行研究。此外我们还将研究手性铁络合物催化的不对称碳氢键插入反应，值得注意的是，由于铁络合物的催化活性高于钌络合物而使得反应的立体选择性控制难度提高，因此这方面的研究将会是反应中的难点。我们的前期实验结果表明，通过合理地设计配体可有效地解决这一难题。

17315222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17315222.value: Prof Delamere, Peter Dr Yao, Zhonghua

17315222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17315222.value: Jupiter has the most energetic and powerful auroral emissions in the solar system and exhibits complex morphologies that are distinct from the terrestrial aurora. The dynamic and unique features of the Jovian aurora are of particular interest, but their source and generation mechanisms are largely unknown. Combined with global-scale simulations of the Jovian magnetosphere, auroral imaging is an effective tool for remote sensing distant Jovian magnetospheric activities. In this project, we propose to investigate the physical connection between magnetotail activities and the observed dynamic Jovian aurora signatures using global magnetosphere simulations, focusing on the magnetospheric origin of both dawn storms and polar emissions. The upward Field-aligned currents (FAC) and Alfvénic Poynting flux (S||) will be explored as proxies for monoenergetic and broadband precipitation, respectively. The morphologies of aurorae, FAC, and S|| are key constraints for understanding the driving mechanisms of the observed auroral events. Preliminary simulation results have shown that FAC and S|| exhibits signatures that resemble UV auroral images of dawn storms and polar emissions, suggesting that global simulations are promising in investigating Jovian auroral activities under various upstream conditions. Synoptic diagnostics will be developed to analyze the physical connections between auroral power and magnetospheric activities. The simulation results will also be validated by auroral observations from both Juno and the Hubble Space Telescope and is potentially a significant contribution to the understanding of satellite measurements related to magnetospheric activities. The model results can also be used in future mission design especially on the focus of science goals. In light of past terrestrial successes on how the observed distribution of low-altitude S|| is generated, and what it can tell us about magnetopause activities, we propose to: 1. Design numerical experiments of high-resolution global simulations to understand the physical processes of S|| generation and propagation in the Jovian magnetosphere; 2. Investigate the upstream and internal control of S|| flowing to low altitudes poleward of the main emissions; 3. Develop synoptic diagnostics that can provide key points of comparison with observations, including analysis based on select events reported in the literature to validate evolution of simulated S|| during a Jovian dawn storm; 4. Provide new knowledge of the relationship between dynamic Jovian magnetotail processes and their signatures at low altitudes for use as a future remote sensing tool. 木星擁有太陽系中最強的高能極光輻射。與地球的極光相比，木星具有非常複雜的結構。由於空間探測項目的進行，木星的極光研究受到了廣泛的關注，但是其產生的物理機理目前尚不清楚。通過使用木星太陽風-磁層的全球數值模擬，可以對木星極光的物理原理進行研究。本課題將聚焦木星極光中的晨暴現象，探究其磁層驅動的物理原理。我們將使用場向電流和阿尔芬能流作為木星極光的近似。初步模擬結果顯示，場向電流和阿尔芬能流都可以重現木星極光晨暴的極紫外觀測。通過進一步的數據分析，發現木星極光晨暴由木星磁尾的爆發性過程產生，同時由於木星的旋轉，能量逐漸從夜側疏運到日側，產生極光結構的旋轉。這一過程與哈勃太空望遠鏡和朱諾號衛星的觀測結果一致。本課題開發的木星磁層全球模擬程序，可以用來支持未來的深空探測計劃，尤其是科學問題的提出和探討。

17315522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17315522.value: Generation of hot electrons is an intrinsic process for plasmonic nanostructures under optical illumination. Upon plasmon excitation, the oscillation of free electrons quickly dephases and leads to the generation of energetic hot electrons on a time scale ranging from 1 to 100 fs. It has been proposed that hot-electrons can be directly transferred from plasmonic structures to a neighbouring semiconductor (such as TiO2) or to a photocatalyst. This could assist in augmenting the photoconversion processes, potentially leading to an entire new paradigm in harvesting photons for practical applications. Thus, incorporating plasmonic metal nanoparticles into photocatalytic systems holds great promise for dramatically improving the efficiency of sunlight absorption and solar energy conversion. The strong dependence of the wavelength at which the local surface plasmon can be excited on the nanostructure makes it possible, in principle, to design plasmonic devices that can harvest photons over the entire solar spectrum. So far, however, most such systems show rather low hot-electron generation rate and small photocatalytic activity in the visible as compared with the ultraviolet. In this project, based on our recent achievements on plasmonic metamaterials design, we propose to leverage the curvature of the optical space to engineer electromagnetic hotspots that can substantially enhance both the effective volume and the magnitude of the field, hence improving the plasmonic hot-electron generation rate in an ultra-broad spectrum. This will significantly improve the photocatalytic efficiency. The proposed metamaterial is mainly composed of three components: (1) warped optical space induced by curved surface topography, (2) disordered plasmonic nanocluster network, and (3) a semiconductor layer acting as an electron filter. We will first employ transformation optics to design nanostructures with warped optical space for ultra-broadband light absorption and local field enhancement. We will then design and introduce disordered plasmonic networks, which in conjunction with warped optical space, constitute the hierarchical metamaterials. Finally, we will systematically investigate the photocatalytic hydrogen evolution/water splitting properties of the designed metamaterials. Moreover, by combining theoretical and experimental methods, we will study the temporal evolution of hot electrons in the designed metamaterials, and try to understand the hot-electron dynamics in metal-semiconductor heterostructures and offer additional strategies for manipulating the dynamics of hot carriers in ultrafast timescales. This project will provide a new gateway towards enhancement of the efficiency of photocatalysis. 熱電子的產生是任何等離子體納米結構在光照下的固有特性。最近，有研究認為熱電子從等離子體結構直接轉移到相鄰的半導體（如 TiO2）或光催化劑，可以增強光轉換過程，从而導致收集實際使用的光子的全新範例。因此，將等離激元金屬納米粒子加入光催化系統中對於顯著提高陽光吸收和太陽能轉換的效率是该领域极具前景的方案。在 等離激元激發時，自由電子的振盪迅速停止並導致其在 1 到 100 fs 的時間範圍內產生高能熱電子。局部表面等離激元激發波長對納米結構的強烈依賴性使得原則上可以設計出可以在整個太陽光譜及更遠範圍內收集光子的等離子體裝置。然而，到目前為止，與紫外線相比，大多數此類系統在可見光中表現出相當低的熱電子產生率和較小的光催化活性。 在该項目中，受到我們最近在等離子體超材料設計方面取得成果的啟發，我們提出利用空間的曲率來設計電磁熱點，從而大大增加其有效體積和場的大小，從而改善等離激元熱電子超廣譜的產生率，進一步顯著提高光催化效率。這裡提出的超材料主要由三個部分組成：（1）扭曲的光學空間结构，（2）無序的等離子體納米糰簇網絡，以及（3）半導體層充當電子過濾层。為了實現這些，我們將首先基於變換光學設計具有扭曲光學空間的納米結構，用於超寬帶光吸收和局部場增強。然後，我們將設計並將無序等離子體網絡引入具有扭曲光學空間的納米結構中，以形成分層超材料。最後，我們將系統地研究設計的超材料的光催化析氫/水分解特性。此外，結合理論和實驗方法，我們還將研究設計的超材料中熱電子的時間演化，並嘗試了解金屬-半導體異質結構中的熱電子動力學，並為操縱熱載流子的動力學提供額外的策略在超快的時間尺度上。該項目超越了傳統的等離子體增強光催化概念，將為光催化材料的發現和實現做出具體貢獻。

17315722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17315722.value: 利用高次谐波光谱学探测摩尔二维材料中的动态布洛赫震荡

17315722.label: Project Objectives
17315722.value: In addition to electrical measurement, optical measurement and extraction of physical properties of 2D materials would be of great interest. High-order harmonics spectroscopy has been a great tool to study in situ the electronic dynamics and properties of gases. In this project, we would like to bring attosecond technologies that have been well developed to the condensed phase, more specifically the 2D Moire superlattice. We will probe the dynamical Bloch oscillations in Moire superlattice using high-harmonic spectroscopy. We will first construct the experimental apparatus to record high-order harmonic spectra from interaction of Moire superlattice with ultrashort, strong laser pulses. We will then use the recorded information to reconstruct the dynamical Bloch oscillations. We will investigate the possibility of using the dynamical Bloch oscillations to extract electronic properties of Moire superlattice. Our work will enable a platform to study 2D Moire superlattices and their rich physics using optical technique.

17315722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17315722.value: High-order harmonic generation (HHG), the emission of very high photon energies being multiples of incident photon energy upon interaction of a strong laser pulse with a material, has laid the foundation for the study of electronic dynamics in their native time scale. Traditionally, HHG and its spectroscopy (HHS) have been well studied in the gas phase. In the last decade, research of HHG and HHS has been extended to include condensed matter, opening an avenue for research of ultrafast dynamics and properties of condensed matter at the ultimate time scale. Two-dimensional (2D) materials, on the other hand, have been extensively investigated especially over the last two decades. There have been studies of HHG in 2D materials, however, they are mostly theoretical works serving as prediction and only few experimental works. The dynamical Bloch oscillations have not been investigated in detail in 2D materials. In this project, we would like to combine the concept of reduced Brillouin zone due to superlattice and strong-field driven electronic dynamics in Moire superlattice on 2D materials. This elegant idea will allow us to drive the electronic wavepacket well to the edge of the Brillouin zone without imposing very strong electric field which might easily damage the sample in investigation. By recording the HHG spectra from the associated ultrafast electronic currents and employing semiclassical theory, we would be able to reconstruct the dynamical Bloch oscillations traversing the whole Brillouin zone. The extraction of the electronic properties of the Moire superlattice will be carried out. In addition, the polarization-resolved HHG spectra might allow us to study Berry curvature and Berry phase effects in Moire superlattice. Our work holds strong promise for not only a powerful source of HHG from 2D materials without invoking strong field but also a platform for all-optical-enabled studies of Moire superlattices including strongly correlated physics. 当强激光脉冲与材料相遇，二者之间的相互作用会生成数倍于入射光子能量的极高光子能量辐射，谓之高次谐波产生（HHG）。得益于超短强激光脉冲的引入，高次谐波产生为在电子运动的原生时间尺度内研究电子动力学奠定了基础。在研究初时，对高次谐波产生及其光谱学（HHS）的研究主要集中于气相介质。随着研究的逐渐深入，在过去的十年间，人们开始把目光放在以固相介质为代表的凝聚态体系上。与气相介质一样具备超短时间尺度的特性，凝聚态体系中高次谐波产生及其光谱学的研究为超快动力学和凝聚态体系性质的研究开辟了新的途径。在凝聚态体系的相关研究里，关于二维材料的研究发展势头猛劲，近几年来也被逐渐引入高次谐波产生及其光谱学的研究中。然而，这些研究大多是从理论模拟的角度对二维材料中高次谐波的产生进行探讨，实验方向的研究寥寥，并且在固相介质中的动态布洛赫震荡，在二维材料领域还鲜有人研究。在此项目中，我们将把目光聚焦于一种重要的二维材料：摩尔超晶格，结合简约布里渊区的概念，研究强激光场激发的电子动力学。这个提案的巧妙之处在于，不需要施加极强的足以破坏材料本身结构的电场，我们就可以将电子波包激发到布里渊区的边界。在半经典理论中，对于摩尔超晶格这一类体系，人们认为高次谐波的产生主要是源于激光场诱导的超快电子运动产生的电流变化。通过测量高次谐波光谱，我们将能实现重构横贯整个布里渊区的动态布洛赫震荡，基于此，我们也将实现从高次谐波光谱中提取摩尔超晶格的电子性质这一重要目标。另外，在此研究基础之上，我们也可以实现对极化依赖的高次谐波光谱的测量，这将为我们研究此体系中贝利曲率和贝利相位的影响助力。综上，我们的工作有着十分可期的前景。一方面，我们的工作无需引入极强的电场，即可获得从二维材料产生的高次谐波光源；另一方面，作为一套全光学角度的实验研究方法，这也将为摩尔超晶格中包含强关联效应的电子结构研究提供强有力的支持。

17316022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17316022.value: 该项目将调查被称为“无聊的十亿”的地球历史的神秘时期。这段时间跨度从古元古代晚期到新元古代早期（大约 1.8 到 8 亿年前），包含了一个长期的明显碳循环稳定性，没有“冰屋”气候的证据。无聊的十亿也与超大陆努纳（哥伦比亚）合并后的全球整体构造静止期和长期深海缺氧相吻合。虽然在此期间进化速率可能被认为是静态的，但已经观察到多个主要的生物学进展。值得注意的是，这个区间包括在古元古代晚期和中元古代早期地层中出现了复杂的装饰单细胞真核生物和宏观碳质压缩化石，以及在 1 Ga 左右发生的主要真核生物进化枝的分歧，例如红藻和绿藻。在真核生物进化新奇的发展和停滞的“无聊”环境条件之间，需要对整个地球系统进行了解。因此，本项目旨在通过对华北克拉通厚、保存完好的晚古元古代至新元古代早期沉积层序进行详细的岩石、生物、化学和年代地层研究，扩大我们对 Boring Billion 的记录。 因此，我们将整合新的火成岩和碎屑锆石 U-Pb 和页岩 Re-Os 地质年代，为这些序列建立良好约束的年代地层框架。将对富含有机物的页岩和燧石进行取样以获取微化石，以扩大真核生物多样化的增长记录。我们将从保存完好的石灰岩中生成新的高分辨率 δ13Ccarb、δ13Corg 和 δ18O 化学地层记录以及 87Sr/86Sr，以进一步探索这段时间的环境表面动力学。最后，耦合碎屑锆石 U-Pb 和 Lu-Hf 同位素和微量元素数据将用于评估区域构造的性质，并通过沉积物物源分析检验印度和华北共同位于努纳超大陆内的假设。

17316122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17316122.value: 通過頂夸克衰變尋找新物理

17316122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17316122.value: The Standard Model (SM) is the most successful theory in particle physics, which describes fundamental particles and electromagnetic, weak, and strong interactions among them. In the SM of particle physics, massive fundamental particles obtain masses through their interactions with the Higgs field during Electroweak Symmetry Breaking (EWSB). The EWSB is one of the least understood phenomena of the SM. The discovery of the Higgs boson is a big success of the SM, and a milestone to understand EWSB. However, the mechanism of the EWSB is still not fully understood. In the SM, the Higgs boson mass is not stable due to the quadratically divergent corrections at quantum level. To solve this so-called hierarchy problem, physics beyond the SM is required. Two main groups of models were proposed in past decades. The first one is the Composite Higgs models, which stabilizes the Higgs mass by introducing a cutoff set by new strong dynamics. The second is the Supersymmetry (SUSY), which cancels the quadratically divergent corrections to the squared Higgs mass by introducing contributions from super partners of the SM particles. These models usually predict extended Higgs sectors which contain both neutral and charged Higgs bosons. Searching for undiscovered beyond SM Higgs bosons is a primary goal of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) after the SM Higgs discovery. Top quark is the heaviest SM particle, which mass is close to the EW scale. In the SM, top quarks dominantly decay into a b quark and a W boson. Those new physics models predict non-SM top decay. For example, top quarks decay into a charged Higgs plus a b quark. Top quark may also decay into a SM Higgs plus a quark with different flavor via Flavor Changing Neutral Current (FCNC). The PI's major research interests are exploring and understanding the mechanism of the EWSB. This proposal requests a funding to support the PI's research program as part of the ATLAS experiment. The proposed three-year research will focus on searching for new physics via top quark decays (i.e. light charge Higgs from top quark decays, and FCNC top quark decay.) with Run III data from the ATLAS experiment. After an upgrade, the Run III of the LHC will start in 2022. The LHC will reach a collision energy of 14 TeV and collect about 300 fb^-1 data. With such collision data the experiments will look for new physics with an increased discovery potential. 標準模型是粒子物理最成功的理論模型，它描述了基本粒子，電磁以及強弱相互作用。 在標準模型中，基本粒子通過和希格斯粒子相互作用在電弱對稱性破缺時獲得質量。而電弱對稱性破缺現象是標准模型中還未被完全理解的部分。希格斯粒子的發現是標準模型的很大成功，也是通往了解電弱對稱性破缺之路的里程碑。儘管如此，我們仍未根本了解引起電弱對稱性破缺的機制。 在標準模型中，希格斯粒子的質量由於量子發散修正而不穩定，為了解決這個等級問題，我們需要尋找超越標準模型的新物理。近年來，主要有兩類模型被建議。第一類是複合希格斯模型，希格斯粒子的質量穩定性源於強動力截斷。 第二類是超對稱模型，對希格斯粒子質量的量子修正發散被超對稱粒子的貢獻抵銷。 這兩類模型通常預言了多個電中性和帶電希格斯粒子，因此尋找超越標準模型預言的希格斯粒子是大型強子對撞機的重要目標。 頂夸克是標準模型中最重的粒子，它的質量接近電弱對稱性破缺的能級。在標準模型中，頂夸克主要衰變到一個底夸克和W玻色子。而在新物理中，頂夸克可以衰變到一個帶電希格斯粒子和一個底夸克，頂夸克還可以通過FCNC衰變到不同味的夸克和一個標準模型希格斯粒子。PI的主要研究興趣是電弱對稱性破缺。此研究計劃的經費將用於支持PI在ATLAS實驗的三年研究，主要內容是利用ATLAS Run III數據通過頂夸克衰變尋找新物理，包括頂夸克衰變到輕質量帶電希格斯粒子， 和頂夸克的FCNC衰變。 大型強子對撞機升級後Run III 將於2022年開始運行，預計會採集300 fb^-1 14 TeV的數據，將增加成功發現新物理機會。

17316322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17316322.value: The health of Asian summer monsoon is critical to billions of people in the region relying on monsoonal rainfall for living, yet our ability to project future monsoon behavior in an anthropogenic era is still limited. Studies of past monsoonal changes would gain insights into Asian summer monsoon dynamics and thus improve our projection ability. There exists a general notion that Asian summer monsoon displays a long-term weakening trend over the Holocene, the last ~10,000 years, based on numerous studies. However, its temporal variability and possible spatial patterns remain poorly defined, despite being extensively studied. For instance, it has been suggested recently that during part of the Bronze Age (4000-2200 years ago), exceptional warmth took place in Northwest China, but majority of the monsoonal records do not suggest particularly enhanced summer monsoon. Further, very limited monsoonal records from Southeast China have been reported, which largely hampers the assembly of spatial patterns of Holocene Asian summer monsoon variability. Here we propose to reconstruct Holocene Asian summer monsoon variability from upwelling regions in the northern coast of the South China Sea, a part of the Asian monsoon system and monsoonal wind strength in particular. Resulting from previous RGC-funded projects, we have found that both sea surface temperature (SST), indicated by the alkenone unsaturation index (UK’37), and glycerol dialkyl glycerol tetraethers (GDGT)-based source indicators, from upwelling regions could reflect summer monsoon-induced wind intensity, which cools surface water and enhances coastal mixing with enhanced summer monsoon. We will employ the two organic tools to investigate 4 sediment cores collected at the northern coast impacted by the summer monsoon. Key scientific issues we wish to address include: Could Holocene summer monsoon be reconstructed using the two organic tools? Would the records from 4 localities display a coherent picture of summer monsoon variability? Did the evolution of Holocene East Asian summer monsoon in this region differ from that of Indian summer monsoon? Were hydrological associations with temperature indeed opposite between Southern and Central East Asia? Was summer monsoon substantially enhanced during the Bronze Age? Our previous and preliminary results suggest that these major scientific issues can be addressed in this proposed study. 亞洲夏季風帶來的季風降雨對生活在此區域的上十億人口很為重要，但是我們預測在人類活動影響下的將來夏季風的變化的能力還是有限。研究過去的季風變化可以幫助理解亞洲夏季風動力學以及提高對將來的預測能力。一般認爲過去一萬年以來的全新世亞洲夏季風呈現逐漸減弱的趨勢，然而儘管已有很多研究，可能的時空變化模式還不是特別清楚。例如，最近有研究認爲在青銅器早中時期中國西北地區出現異常溫暖，但多數季風記錄并沒有顯示相應的特別增强的夏季風。另外，中國華南地區的季風記錄較少，這很大程度上影響了評估全新世亞洲夏季風變化的空間特徵。 這裏我們提出從南海北岸的上升流區域重建全新世亞洲夏季風變化。此區域屬於是整個亞洲夏季風系統的一部分，並敏感地響應季風强度。基於以前資助項目的研究結果，我們發現在上升流區域生物標志物長鏈烯酮所指示的海表溫度和古菌所指示的來源指標都可以反應夏季風的風場强度，其可以增强沿岸水體的混合及導致表層水體降溫。我們將對南海北岸上升流區域的4個沉積柱運用長鏈烯酮和古菌指標。主要科學問題包括：1. 此兩生物標志物能否用來重建全新世夏季風變化? 2. 四個沉積柱的記錄能否揭示一致的全新世夏季風變化？3. 此區域的夏季風變化趨勢是否和印度南亞季風的變化一致？4. 東亞南部的水文變化是否是和中部（長江流域）相反？5. 青銅器時期夏季風是否顯著增强？我們的初步結果認爲這些科學問題都可以在這個項目中涉及。

17316622.value: 熱帶森林因其巨大的光合作用能力極大地影響著大尺度的生物地球化學循環，並在調節區域氣候方面發揮著重要作用。因此，準確理解熱帶森林在未來氣候變化下的命運長期以來一直是全球變化生態學的研究焦點。換言之，如果未來氣候變化會引起熱帶森林物種成份的顯著變化，將不僅會影響熱帶森林在碳水生物地球化學循環過程的調節能力，而且也會對大尺度的氣候系統產生影響，甚至還會大大地改變這些森林所提供的關鍵生態系統服務功能（如森林生產力、淡水供給和生物多樣性維護等），從而對生活在這一地區的數十億人口的生活質量產生巨大影響。 水量平衡關係（水量共給和需求之間的平衡）是多年來最常被用來解釋和模擬熱帶地區不同森林類型地理格局的最要理論依據。然而，當前的理論尚未完善，且面臨如下兩個問題：1）傳統的做法將熱帶森林簡單粗暴地劃分為常綠林和落葉林既不能準確地代表熱帶地區真實的森林成份，也不利於用來準確量化氣候變化對森林成份的影響，因為這種影響往往是緩慢且漸進式的發生；2）除了水量平衡關係外，水文氣候的其他方面（如降雨的分佈和大小）以及其他的環境特性（如氣候、土壤和地形）也可能對準確理解帶熱帶地區不同森林類型地理格局背後的機制起作用，然而相關的研究和定量評估還極其匱乏。 本項目旨在解決上述兩個問題（觀測和機理）。首先，我們提議使用"群落落葉度"這一概念來更準確地描述熱帶森林的組成。群落落葉度是一個具有多維意義的生物物理參數。它不僅可以用來刻畫季節尺度內植被落葉與非落葉物候狀態的比例，也可以用來表示落葉木本植物在整個生態群落中的佔比，因此可以作為刻畫熱帶森林物候和物種功能群相對豐度的重要指標，也是衡量熱帶森林生態系統對全球變化敏感度的重要參數。基於這個概念，為了解決觀測方面的問題，我們提出了一種基於多尺度遙感的方法，包含兩個步驟： (1) 在站點尺度，集成前沿3米高空間分辨率PlanetScope衛星遙感與近地面物候相機觀測網絡，開發和評估一種新型的遙感方法，用於更好地刻畫熱帶森林的落葉度特徵； (2) 在區域尺度，利用全球覆蓋的PlanetScope或Landsat衛星數據，探索並確定切實可行的尺度升級方案，實現對大尺度熱帶地區群落落葉度的準確刻畫。為了解決機理上的問題，我們將利用上述遙感所獲得的群落落葉度信息，結合氣候、土壤和地形等環境數據，探討不同維度的環境變量是如何單獨或共同地調控熱帶森林相對物種組成成份的大地理格局。通過這個項目，我們希望不僅能夠在熱帶地區不同森林類型地理格局的監測方法和機理解析方面均取得進展，而且也希望相關的結果能夠對預測氣候變化如何影響熱帶森林生態系統結構、組成和功能這一更大的科學問題提供重要的數據集和機理過程支持。

17316922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17316922.value: 單線態裂分 (SF) 因其在克服 Shockley-Queisser 極限和提高光伏電池效率方面的巨大潛力而備受關注。在本項目書中，我們的目標是設計一些新型的含並五苯/並雜苯側鏈聚合物，並試圖弄清楚聚合物主鏈的長度和側鏈的電子構型將如何影響聚合物的 SF 效率。我們將利用飛秒瞬態吸收光譜（fs-TA）、飛秒時間分辨熒光光譜（fs-TRF）、納秒瞬態吸收光譜（ns-TA）和納秒時間分辨熒光光譜（ns-EM）提供直接的分子中間體的光譜信息以及激發態動力學過程，並實現對SF機制的更深入和更詳細的研究。根據初步的實驗結果，側鏈由並五苯基團官能化的聚（3-己基噻吩）顯示出了 SF 特性，這表明該提案中提到的新設計的聚合物體係可能是研究光誘導 SF 過程的模型體系。本項目將根據新型表徵方式更好地理解主鍊和側連的髮色團如何影響1（三重態三重態）1(T1T1) 的分離、三重態三重態湮滅、三重態衰變過程和其他光物理失活衰變途徑，並試圖解析SF複雜的工作機制。

17317022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17317022.value: 多尺度模型降阶法对含有高雷诺数和不确定性的纳维-斯托克斯方程的应用

17317022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17317022.value: 具有高度异质随机系数的物理过程在许多应用中很常见，例如，地下水模拟、断裂力学、光子晶体和锂离子电池建模。这些系数通常在多个（可能是连续的）尺度之间变化和取独立值。龙卷风模拟包括许多宏观特征和数百万的微观特征。尽管提取这些宏观特征是大多数数值算法的主要目标，但是我们必须推导或模拟微尺度特征的影响。由于传统的数值方法只关注一个尺度，这些应用使它们不具有实用性。 设计许多实际应用的数值求解器要复杂得多，这是由于以随机系数形式存在的高维度问题。 比如，数据集或数学建模中的参数可能是非常高维的，这可能是因为建模误差（例如，测量的不准确性和采样不完整性）和数学物理现象的建模（例如，随机建模和随机同质化）。目前多尺度模型降阶法的应用基本上仅限于低维问题，这极大地阻碍了多尺度模型降阶法应用于许多有趣的工程问题，例如，材料建模、锂离子电池建模、实时多相流仿真和人工智能。 该研究计划的基本目标是开发和分析有效的多尺度模型降阶法对具有高雷诺数，不确定性和长时间的纳维-斯托克斯方程的应用。主要研究工具有逼近论、偏微分方程、多尺度分析、数值分析和数值算法、高维逼近和泛函分析。

17317122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17317122.value: Lasserre松弛法可精确求解的多项式优化问题的近似与分析

17317122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17317122.value: A broad class of problems from combinatorics, geometry and optimization can be formulated by polynomial optimization. The search of global optimal solution is in general a challenging task as many NP-hard combinatorial problems can be cast into this framework. In 2001, Lasserre proposed a hierarchy of relaxation for globally solving polynomial optimization problems using semidefinite programming (SDP). This ground-breaking combination of algebraic tools, analytic tools and modern algorithmic advance has opened up new ways and laid foundations for global solution of hard problems. Since more than 20 years, Lasserre’s hierarchy has inspired enormous intriguing and challenging questions in complexity analysis, algorithm design etc, and continues to be a fascinating research topic today. In this project, we investigate Lasserre’s hierarchy for polynomial optimization from different aspects. We study the SDP exactness problem, i.e., the characterization of class of problems that can be solved exactly by Lasserre’s relaxation of certain order. The novelty in our approach is the connection of the exact region with amoeba, which is a geometric object with striking combinatoric information. This discovery allows us to gain deeper understanding on the geometry of the exact region and in turn, construct tight and computationally tractable approximation of the exact region. As a result, this project will also bring contribution to the ultimate challenge of making Lasserre’s relaxation applicable to large scale problems. 多项式优化涵盖了组合、几何和优化中很多核心问题。因为许多 NP-hard 组合问题都可以放入这个框架中，寻找多项式优化问题的全局最优解通常是一项具有挑战性的任务。 2001 年，Lasserre 提出了一种松弛层次结构，可以通过半正定规划 (SDP) 来全局求解多项式优化问题。Lasserre的工作将代数工具、分析工具和现代算法突破性地组合在一起，为多项式优化解决难题开辟了新途径。 20 多年来，Lasserre 的松弛层次结构在复杂性分析、算法设计等方面激发了许多有趣和具有挑战性的问题，并且在今天仍然是一个引人入胜的研究课题。在这个项目中，我们将从不同方面研究 Lasserre 的多项式优化松弛层次，探索对于固定层次的Lasserre 松弛法能够精确解决的问题类别。我们方法的新颖之处在于将精确区域与热带几何理论中的变形体联系起来，变形体是具有惊人组合信息的几何对象。这一发现使我们能够更深入地了解精确区域的几何形状，进而构建精确区域的紧密且计算上易于处理的近似值。因此，该项目也将为使 Lasserre 松弛适用于大规模问题的终极挑战做出贡献。

17317222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17317222.value: 和积扩张和超强逼近猜想

17317222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17317222.value: 扩展图是一类具有强连通性的稀疏图。该类图在数论、群论、几何，应用数学等不同学科有着深远的应用。人们已知可以用代数群的一些有限生成离散子群的同余商的凯莱图来构造扩展图。而该领域的一个中心猜想，即超强近似猜想则精确地描述哪些离散子群具有这个性质。虽然该猜想的一些特殊情况已经得到证实，但最一般的情形还未得到完全证明，并且一些未解决的情形（例如两个特殊线性群的直积）可能在数论以及动力系统中有应用。本项目的主要目标是开发一些工具来证明超强近似猜想。最关键的一步是严格证明代数整数环的和积扩张现象。和积扩张是用来定量描述在一给定环中，加法结构和乘法结构一般不会在环中共存。该项研究所得的成果还可能用来推导一些悉数多项式指数和的非平凡上界。

17317322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17317322.value: 雙水相液-液相分離與液-固相分離調控生物分子凝聚體與網路結構的組裝與協同作用

17317322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17317322.value: Within living cells, hierarchical subcellular structures synergically regulate essential cellular activities through dynamic assembly, dissociation, and reorganization. Despite extensive efforts, scientists and engineers have yet to reproduce similar dynamics. To understand the dynamic structures and interactions, synthetic model systems have been constructed. Aqueous two-phase systems (ATPSs) have emerged as a promising in-vitro model owing to their all-water and biocompatible environment and the spatial distribution of biomolecules. Although ATPSs have been extensively used to mimic the structures and functions of living cells, previous studies have focused primarily on mimicking liquid-like organelles. Other subcellular structures and functions, such as viscoelastic networks, remain unexplored. The proposed project is motivated by three observations: 1) thermally reversible segregative-to-associative phase transition; 2) network generation via liquid-to-solid transition; and 3) melting of the phase-separated biological condensates by the resultant networks. With the incorporation of polymers with tunable molecular interactions, ATPSs are expected to undergo liquid-to-solid phase separation, resulting in the formation of networks using aqueous droplets as templates. When the composition is above the binodal curve, phase-separated droplets form in the continuous phase. In response to external stimuli, the configurations of the component in the continuous phase change from hydrophilic coils to hydrophobic globules, which should then aggregate to minimize their contact with the surrounding aqueous phase, resulting in a network around the phase-separated droplets. However, this process has never been realized owing to previously reported ATPSs’ inability to undergo hydrophilic-to-hydrophobic transitions. Here, we propose to adopt a stimuli-responsive polymer capable of such reversible transitions as one component of ATPSs. By regulating the concentrations of the two components and the ambient temperature, different biomimetic subcellular structures, including phase-separated droplets and viscoelastic networks, will be generated through aqueous liquid-liquid phase separation and liquid-solid phase separation (AqLL-LS PS2). The aims of the proposed project are to (1) elucidate the mechanism of organelle-inspired droplets; (2) To design an approach to generate dynamic networks in ATPSs; and (3) To demonstrate the control of organelle-mimicking structures by manipulating the interactions between biomolecular condensates and the dynamic networks. In the short term, the project will provide a fundamental understanding of the mechanisms of AqLL-LS PS2 for the spatial regulation of hierarchical assemblies and, accordingly, suggest an effective strategy for precisely controlling the pathologically relevant biomolecular condensates formed by hydrophobic interactions. Hence, our system may inspire an approach to treating neurodegenerative diseases induced by the irreversible aggregation of protein condensates containing intrinsically disordered regions. 在活細胞內，多層級亞細胞結構通過動態組裝、解離、重構來協同調控重要的胞內活動。儘管科學家和工程師們做出了大量努力，仍未能複現類似的動態過程。為了理解動態結構及其相互作用，多種合成模型系統應運而生。雙水相系統因其全水和生物相容的環境以及生物分子在其中的空間分佈使其成為一種非常有潛力的體外模型。儘管雙水相系統已被廣泛用於類比活細胞的結構和功能，但前期的研究主要集中在模擬液態的細胞器。其他亞細胞結構和功能，如粘彈性網路，仍未探索。本項目是受以下三個現象啟發：1）熱可逆分離-締合相變；2）液-固相變形成網路；3）形成的網路誘導相分離生物分子凝聚體的解體。 通過引入具有可調分子相互作用的聚合物，雙水相系統有望以水相液滴為模板經液-固相分離形成網路。當組分位於雙節曲線 (binodal curve) 之上時，液滴從連續相中相分離而出。受外界刺激，連續相組分的構象從親水線團轉變為疏水球形。隨後，為了減小與周圍水分子的接觸面積，輸水球形分子鏈段聚集，沿著相分離的液滴形成網路。然而，已報導的雙水相系統因其組分不具備親疏水轉變的特性故未能實現這一過程。 在本項目中，我們提出採用一種具有上述親疏水轉變特性的刺激回應聚合物作為雙水相系統的組分之一。通過調節雙水相系統組分的濃度和環境溫度，不同的仿生亞細胞結構，如：相分離液滴和粘彈性網路，將通過水相液-液相分離和液-固相分離而形成。 本項目的目標如下：1）闡述類細胞器液滴的形成機制；2）設計一種在雙水相系統中形成動態網路的方法；3）通過操控生物分子凝析體與動態網路之間的相互作用來演示類比對類細胞器結構的控制。在短期內，該項目將會對水相液-液相分離和液-固相分離對多層級組裝體空間調控的機理有一個初步瞭解。在此基礎上，我們將提出一種精確控制由疏水相互作用所形成的病理相關生物分子凝聚體的有效策略。因此，我們的雙水相系統有望啟發一種治療由內在非結構蛋白不可逆組裝所誘導的神經性退行性疾病的治療方案。

17317722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17317722.value: 氣候變化驅動下青藏高原混交林樹木生長異質性

17317722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17317722.value: Warming climate and frequent drought extremes have caused widespread forests mortality, which may shift forests from carbon sinks to carbon sources and further accelerate global climate change. However, dendroecological research in East Asia, especially Tibetan Plateau, has been heavily emphasized on gymnosperms (conifers) despite that about 95% plant species are angiosperms (broadleaf flowering plants). Such a biased sampling strategy impedes comprehensive assessment of forests resistance and resilience to changing climate, and cannot provide practical implications on forest management and ecosystem sustainability. The Tibetan Plateau has experienced rapid warming and more heat-induced droughts. The co-existing angiosperms and gymnosperms on the Tibetan Plateau may have different responses to the changing climate because they adopt different growth strategies. However, previous studies have not explored this topic. This study will systematically investigate 1) climate-growth relationship of co-existing angiosperms and gymnosperms on the eastern Tibetan Plateau, 2) differential sensitivity to climate extremes between angiosperms and gymnosperms with ecophysiological attributions, and 3) elevation-dependent pattern of intrinsic water use efficiency for both angiosperms and gymnosperms. We will leverage previous sampling efforts of gymnosperms and revisit 15-20 sites to sample co-existing angiosperms along elevational gradient, so that we can study and compare their climate-growth relationship. We will employ three metrics (resistance, resilience, and recovery) to quantify how angiosperms and gymnosperms endure and recover from climate extremes where we expect gymnosperms are more sensitive (less resistant) to climate extremes than co-existing angiosperms due to their ecophysiological differences. By using carbon isotope ratio (δ13C) derived from tree-ring samples, we will infer and compare intrinsic water use efficiency of angiosperms and gymnosperms along elevation. Because warming temperature increases drought stress and limits gas exchange along elevation for both angiosperms and gymnosperms, the study of intrinsic water use efficiency will inform their carbon assimilation ability along elevation and the ecophysiology that leads to their differences. Our project will holistically test the hypotheses about the differential growth responses between major tree taxonomic groups on the eastern Tibetan Plateau, which will improve our understanding of the impacts of climate change on the mixed forests with rich biodiversity and ecosystem functions. Our results will guide conservation and management priority to protect the most vulnerable tree species and taxa, and open up future opportunities for examining angiosperms in other parts of East Asia where forests play a crucial role in global carbon sequestration and climate change mitigation. 氣候變暖和頻繁的極端乾旱正導致森林大面積死亡，這可能使森林從碳匯轉向碳源，進一步加劇全球氣候變化。然而，東亞地區，尤其是青藏高原，樹木生態學研究一直高度重視裸子植物（針葉樹），儘管大約 95% 的植物物種是被子植物（闊葉開花植物）。這種有偏差的採樣策略阻礙了全面評估森林對氣候變化的抵抗力和韌性，也未能對森林管理和生態系統可持續發展提供切合實際的指導意義。 青藏高原正經歷著快速變暖和更多高溫引起的干旱。青藏高原上共存的被子植物和裸子植物由於採取不同的生長策略，對氣候變化的響應可能不同。然而，以前的研究並沒有探討這一問題。本研究將系統地調查 1) 青藏高原東部共存的被子植物和裸子植物的氣候-生長關係，2) 被子植物和裸子植物對極端氣候的敏感性差異及其相關生態生理學屬性，以及 3) 被子植物和裸子植物內在水分利用效率隨海拔的變化模式。我們將利用之前對裸子植物的採樣工作，重新訪問 15-20 個樣點，沿海拔梯度對共存的被子植物進行採樣，以便研究比較它們的氣候-生長關係。我們將採用三個指標（抵抗力、韌性和恢復力）來量化被子植物和裸子植物如何承受並從極端氣候事件影響中恢復，並預計由於生態生理差異裸子植物比共存的被子植物對極端氣候更敏感（抵抗力更弱）。利用樹木年輪樣品碳同位素比（δ13C），我們將推斷並比較被子植物和裸子植物內在水分利用效率隨海拔的變化。由於溫度升高會導致乾旱脅迫，被子植物和裸子植物氣體交換限制會隨著海拔變化，因此對內在水分利用效率的研究將揭示兩類植物碳同化能力隨海拔的變化，以及導致它們差異的生態生理學原因。 我們的項目將全面檢驗有關青藏高原東部主要樹木分類組別之間生長響應差異的各種假說，相關結果將有助於我們更好地理解氣候變化對具有豐富生物多樣性和生態系統功能的混交林的影響。我們的研究結果將有助於引導森林保護和管理優先事項，以便保護最脆弱的樹木種類和組別，並為將來研究東亞其他地區的被子植物創造機會，以便這些地區的森林在全球碳封存和減緩氣候變化中發揮至關重要的作用。

17317822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17317822.value: Rankin-Cohen 括號生成函數和調和 Maass 形式與模形式的 Rankin-Cohen 括號的全純投影

17317822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17317822.value: The derivative of a holomorphic modular form is holomorphic but no longer a modular form. In 1956, R.A. Rankin developed successfully a description for a combination of the derivatives of modular forms that remains a modular form. In 1975, H. Cohen considered an interesting particular combination, known as Rankin-Cohen (RC) bracket today, which defines a bilinear form on the graded ring of modular forms. There are vast subsequent developments and applications on RC brackets. An example is the contemporary researches on mock modular forms and Hurwitz's class numbers, in which a particular formal power series plays an important role. A key lies in the realization of the formal power series as a certain generating function of RC brackets. The RC bracket of a harmonic Maass form and a modular form is not necessarily holomorphic. To its end a holomorphic projection is invoked as a remedy. The holomorphic projection of the RC brackets of a harmonic Maass form and a modular form is another key. When one of the two forms is a theta function, there are known results due to Cohen and Mertens respectively. The RC brackets carries interpretation in different contexts such as automorphic pseudodifferential operators by P. B. Cohen, Y. Manin & D. Zagier, composition formula in symbolic calculus of operators by A. Unterberger & J. Unterberger, symmetry breaking operators by T. Kobayashi & M. Pevzner, deformation quantization by M. Pevzner. The result of Pevzner provides a generating function for RC brackets with a closed formula, which is however slightly heavy. This project is devoted to explore RC brackets, and our plan covers assembling a family of RC brackets into a generating function for modular forms, and understanding the holomorphic projection of RC brackets for a harmonic Maass form and a modular form. We hope to derive results which may shed lights on the investigation of RC brackets in various disciplines, and understand more connections underlying them. 全純模形式的導數是全純但不再是模形式。 1956 年，R.A. Rankin 成功地開發了一種以組合模形式導數衍生模形式的方法。 於 1975 年，H. Cohen 考慮當中一個有趣的特殊組合，它在模形式漸變環上定義了一個雙線性形式，今天我們稱它為 Rankin-Cohen (RC) 括號。及後，RC 括號有廣大的後續開發和應用。 一個運用 RC 括號的例子是某些特殊形式冪級數對當今研究 mock 模形式和 Hurwitz 類數中的作用，當中關鍵在於該形式冪級數可表示為 RC 括號的生成函數。調和 Maass 形式和模形式的 RC 括號不一定是全純的。於此，我們能以全純投影補救，調和 Maass 形式和模形式的 RC 括號的全純投影將會是另一個關鍵。當這兩種形式之一是 theta 函數時，Cohen 和 Mertens已取得相關結果。 RC 括號在不同領域中都有演繹，例如 P. B. Cohen, Y. Manin & D. Zagier 的自守擬微分算子， 算子符號演算的 A. Unterberger & J. Unterberger 合成公式，T. Kobayashi & M. Pevzner 的突破對稱性算子，M. Pevzner 的變形量化。事實上，Pevzner 提供了一個略為複雜的 RC 括號生成函數閉公式結果。 這個項目致力於探索 RC 括號，我們計劃為模形式生成函數組合一族 RC 括號，及研究調和 Maass 形式和模形式的 RC 括號的全純投影。我們期待項目結果對 RC 括號于各科的研究有啟發作用，並了解更多它們背後的聯繫。

17318122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17318122.value: ZrBeSi-型津特耳化合物中的聲子與擴散子輸運：空位有序度與高階晶格非簡諧性的影響

17318122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17318122.value: This project aims to (1) develop a new theoretical framework for accurate description of high-order anharmonic lattice dynamics and (2) reveal the mechanisms of dual phonon and diffuson transport in ZrBeSi-type Zintl compounds. The thermal transport properties of conventional crystalline solids can be reliably described using Peierls’ phonon gas model. However, recent studies of materials with ultralow lattice thermal conductivity revealed that this model breaks down when a significant portion of phonons have mean free paths shorter than the atomic spacing. Different phenomenological models have been proposed to describe the thermal transport behavior of such materials, although a more rigorous understanding of the strong phonon interaction and mechanisms of microscopic transport remains elusive. This project will address these knowledge gaps in a combined experimental and theoretical study based on the Green-Kubo theory of linear response, machine learning interatomic potentials, inelastic neutron scattering experiments, and laser flash measurement of thermal diffusivity. ZrBeSi-type Zintl compounds are promising materials for thermoelectric energy conversion applications. The intrinsically strong lattice anharmonicity and high vacancy concentration strongly suppress lattice thermal transport, enhancing the energy conversion efficiency. High-order phonon interactions beyond the three-phonon processes usually have a negligible contribution to thermal transport. Surprisingly, the Principal Investigator (PI)’s preliminary study indicated that four-phonon interactions originating from quartic anharmonicity play a significant role in Eu2ZnSb2, a Zintl compound. The strong lattice anharmonicity and vacancy ordering in ZrBeSi-type Zintl compounds suggest the possibility of novel phonon transport mechanisms. In the proposed project, we will verify this hypothesis by developing a new theoretical framework based on quantum mechanical calculations and by carrying out experiments in large-scale neutron facilities. The proposed research builds upon the PI’s recent studies and is highly feasible. For Zintl compounds, such as Eu2ZnSb2 and Sr2ZnSb2, which contain 50% vacancies in the Zn sublattice sites, we will carry out a nonperturbative study based on machine learning interatomic potentials. Different vacancy orderings and their effects on phonon scattering and thermal transport properties will be considered. The results obtained from different levels of theory will be compared with the experimental measurements. Successful implementation of this project will provide a more complete understanding of the complex thermal transport properties of ZrBeSi-type Zintl compounds, which will be of technological importance for energy conversion applications. 本項目旨在（1）發展可以精確描述高階非簡諧晶格動力學的理論模型，（2）深入理解ZrBeSi-型津特耳化合物中的聲子與擴散子雙輸運機理。傳統晶體材料的熱輸運行為一般可以通過皮爾斯聲子氣體模型描述。然而近期對具有超低熱導率材料的研究表明當相當一部分聲子的平均自由程小於原子間距時，該聲子氣體模型將失效。雖然有不同的唯象模型被提出用以描述該類材料的熱輸運，但是對聲子的強相互作用與微觀熱輸運機理仍需進行更嚴謹的研究。本項目將基於格林-久保線性響應理論、機器學習勢函數、非彈中子散射與熱擴散係數的激光閃光實驗研究上述課題。 ZrBeSi-型津特耳化合物有望在熱電能量轉換領域實現應用。該類材料由於具有本征強晶格非簡諧性與高空位濃度，所以具有低熱導率與高熱電能量轉換效率。三階以上的聲子相互作用對熱導率的貢獻一般可以忽略不計。然而項目申請人前期研究表明四階聲子相互作用對津特耳化合物Eu2ZnSb2具有重要影響。ZrBeSi-型津特耳化合物的強晶格非簡諧性與空位有序度可以導致新穎的聲子輸運機理。在本項目中，我們將基於量子計算理論框架與大尺度中子實驗對該課題進行深入探討。研究內容與申請人的專長匹配，可行度較高。 對與在Zn亞晶格含有50%空位的津特耳化合物Eu2ZnSb2和Sr2ZnSb2，我們將考慮不同空位排布對聲子散射與熱輸運性能的影響，基於機器學習勢函數進行跨越微擾理論範疇的研究。使用不同理論框架所得到的結果將與實驗進行對比。該項目將為ZrBeSi-型津特耳化合物中複雜的熱輸運行為提供更深入的認識，並為其在能量轉換領域的應用奠定基礎。

17318322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17318322.value: 目前，臨床上有多種金屬類藥物用於疾病的診斷和治療。最近，金屬配合物也被認為是對抗抗菌素耐藥性的新型抗生素的有希望的來源。相比之下，很少探索抗病毒金屬化合物。鑑於現有的大型化合物庫，迫切需要探索金屬化合物作為抗病毒劑的可能性。 嚴重急性呼吸綜合徵冠狀病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 是 2019 年冠狀病毒病 (COVID-19) 大流行的病原體，已在全球範圍內造成巨大的生命損失。 SARS-CoV-2 變體的出現與增強的傳播性和對疫苗誘導的保護的敏感性降低有關，因此需要開發抗新冠療法。與其他病毒類似，SARS-CoV-2 合成一系列病毒酶/蛋白質，包括用於病毒進入、複製和發病機制的結構蛋白和非結構蛋白 (nsp)。這些酶可以作為治療藥物開發的有希望的靶點。 鉍(Bi3+))類藥物包括膠體次檸檬酸鉍（CBS）和雷尼替丁檸檬酸鉍（RBC）是臨床上用於治療幽門螺桿菌感染的藥物。我們已經證明，臨床使用的抗潰瘍藥物和其他鉍化合物在感染細胞和倉鼠感染模型中均表現出對 SARS-CoV 和 SARS-CoV-2 的有效抗病毒活性。機理研究表明，鉍通過從 nsp13 的金屬結合結構域置換鋅離子來抑制解旋酶 (nsp13) ATP 酶和雙鏈解旋活性。考慮到 nsp10 和 nsp14 也是含鋅指的酶，我們認為它們可能作為鉍化合物的潛在靶標。由於 nsp14 是一種雙功能酶，具有 N 端 3’ 至 5’ 外切核糖核酸酶 (ExoN) 結構域C 端 S-腺苷甲硫氨酸 (SAM) 依賴性 N7-甲基轉移酶 (MTase) 結構域，nsp10 作為 nsp14 的輔因子執行其 EXoN 活動。鑑於 nsp14 在復制期間的校對以及病毒基因組複製以及完整性和增殖方面發揮重要作用，因此它可能成為開髮用於治療 COVID-19 疾病的抗病毒藥物的有吸引力的靶標。 我們已初步表達並純化了兩種病毒蛋白 nsp10 和 nsp14。在這個項目中，我們旨在進一步了解鉍化合物對 SARS-CoV-2 的作用機制，並發現更有效的抗病毒藥物。我們將檢查鉍以 apo 和 Zn2+ 結合形式與 nsp10 和 nsp14 的結合動力學和熱力學，並且還將監測 Bi3+ 結合誘導的 Zn2+ 可能釋放。我們將使用基於熒光的生物測定以及潛在的抑制機制研究鉍化合物是否抑制 nsp14 酶活性。我們還將探索其他金屬化合物和來自計算機篩選的小分子是否抑制 nsp10/nsp14 活性，將選擇那些表現出與 RBC 相當或更好的活性來進一步評估它們在受感染哺乳動物中的抗 SARS-CoV-2 活性細胞或動物模型。同時，還將了解這些化合物在哺乳動物細胞中的潛在毒性。 通過這個項目，我們對鉍化合物抗SARS-COV-2活性的認識將大大增強。重要的是，nsp10/nsp14 可以作為發現更有效的抗病毒療法的重要靶標。

17318422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17318422.value: 越来越多的证据表明，RNA 在精确位置和指定时间的存在对细胞存活和发育至关重要。能够确定哪些 RNA 参与某些生物事件是阐明潜在分子机制的关键。此外，能够在天然条件下准确捕获这些 RNA 将提供更多生物学相关信息。目前研究 RNA 定位的方法主要限于模拟细胞系，其中一项开创性工作扩展到脑切片样本。我们将此限制归因于缺乏用长波长光激活的 RNA 邻近标记方法（动物模型中的深度穿透）。应激颗粒是RNA 和蛋白质在响应外界刺激的时候形成的复杂且动态的无膜细胞器。它们的形成和分解与疾病的发生和发展密切相关。由于需要预先知道的 RNA 序列以及细胞固定和透化，荧光共聚焦显微镜尚未应用于活细胞以发现新的 RNA。分组分分离所辅助 的RNA 测序往往会丢失外周瞬态和动态应力颗粒成分。尚无其他有效方法来识别应激颗粒中涉及的 RNA，更不用说在活体动物中表征该系统，这极大地阻碍了潜在疗法的发展。在这里，我们建议开发新的工具，在活细胞中用近红外光照射在应力颗粒形成和分解的不同阶段标记 RNA。我们的目标是通过三个步骤来实现这一目标：首先，我们将进行方法开发以实现：a) 具有不同单线态氧生成潜力的不同孔雀石绿衍生物，以及 b) 通过近红外光激活在体外量化单线态氧生成。接下来，我们将通过近红外光照射验证活细胞转录组水平的标记方法。最后，我们的目标是应用该系统研究与应激颗粒相关的RNA，并通过不同光照射的双重RNA定位研究进一步阐明应激颗粒对基因表达的生物学影响。该提案的成功执行将为该领域提供非常需要的用于 RNA 邻近标记的近红外光诱导工具箱、与应力颗粒形成和拆卸相关的 RNA 的全面图片以及我们未来如何调节这些过程的路线图.这里开发的技术将为研究具有高空间和时间分辨率的活体动物的 RNA 定位铺平道路。

17500122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17500122.value: 线下购物中的去偏推荐

17500122.label: Project Objectives
17500122.value: To identify and operationalize factors that characterize customer-space interactions: Given the mall layout and patronage sequence, we aim to operationalize factors that suggest the likelihood of observing a target entity as well as assessing its relevance, in a physical space. With good interpretability, this stage of the proposed study focuses on: (i) how to operationalize exposure factors given pedestrian’s current location, moving status, and visual scope; and (ii) how to extract relevance factors as a tradeoff between the benefits of preference matches and the costs of physical movement efforts. To propose an unbiased learning problem and model a learning objective accordingly: Existing learning objectives commonly adopt data likelihood. Due to possible exposure bias, we shall quantify the extent of data bias at individual level and investigate ways in which training instances can be effectively debiased. Considering a data generation process in an offline space, the proposed learning objective is reweighted to account for the impact of exposure bias. We target proposing and properly incorporating a new debiasing weight that is personalized and based on spatial interactions, the parameters of which should be learned from data. To effectively address the proposed learning problem with a novel method: Once the parametric learning objective has been modeled, we aim to propose an effective learning method that uncovers the optimal model configurations using data. The offline data generation process primarily involves two subprocesses: entity observation and relevance assessment. While the former is a pointwise term, the latter one can be captured as a pairwise comparison. We therefore aim to develop a novel learning method as well as the algorithm that updates between pointwise and pairwise learning steps within the framework of stochastic gradient ascent. 17500122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17500122.value: In response to competition from their online counterparts, offline shopping places are aiming to enhance the personalized shopping experience of pedestrian customers by making relevant recommendations. Given implicit feedback (e.g., store patronage behaviors), a crucial but under-investigated issue is how to handle exposure bias for effective recommendations. Exposure bias arises when customers are only exposed to a subset of stores. Consequently, unvisited stores do not necessarily represent negative preferences. In offline settings, store exposure (i.e., the way in which stores are presented to customers) is driven by pedestrian customers’ active exploration processes in the shopping space, rather than the algorithmic designs used by online platforms. To address the issues this incurs, I intend to propose a recommendation method using an unbiased ranking approach, which accounts for customers’ dynamic movement in the shopping space to debias the data learning and recommendation inference. Specifically, the focal study has formulated an unbiased learning problem, planned to propose a movement-aware embedding model, and planned to devise a deep learning method that optimizes for the best model configurations. Using an offline shopping dataset, preliminary test results show outperformance of the pilot method compared to prevailing recommendation methods. In addition to benchmarking, we have shown that each proposed component brings a theoretical advantage and planned to evaluate their added value in recommendation performance of the proposed method. 为应对在线购物的竞争，线下实体购物场所（如，购物中心和百货商店等）试图通过相关推荐来增强徒步消费者的个性化购物体验。尽管有大量研究开展于在线推荐领域，线下推荐的工作较为稀少，部分原因在于线下零售场景下难以取得用于推荐的直接反馈信息。例如，获取大量消费者问卷和用户评分的成本对于零售业者来说均难以承受。近年来随着人工智能技术的发展，如视频标签技术，消费者购物轨迹的准确获取逐渐成为了可能。徒步消费者在物理空间中的购物轨迹类似于虚拟空间内的点击流数据，它们均归类为隐式反馈信息。给定隐式反馈信息（如，访店行为），要做出有效个性化推荐的一个关键且研究不足的问题在于如何处理曝光偏差。曝光偏差的情况出现于当所有商店的某子集暴露于消费者，而未暴露的集合包含负相关与未观察的店铺实体的混合；其中，未观察实体一旦被消费者观察到就有一定可能是相关的实体。因此，如果说已访问店铺均为相关实例的话，未访问的店铺并不一定代表它们是负相关实例。与在线环境不同，店铺线下曝光受徒步消费者在购物空间中主动探索的驱动，而并非依赖算法所组织的在线店铺平台的结构。为解决这一新问题，作者首创了一个推荐方法，名为基于运动轨迹的无偏成对排序（UMPR）。该方法考虑了消费者在购物空间中的动态移动以达到无偏训练的目的，有利于做出有效的个性化推荐。具体来说，该研究针对线下推荐场景定义了一个无偏学习问题，提出了一个基于运动的推荐模型，并且为获取最佳模型参数开发了一个交替学习算法。本项研究采纳真实线下购物数据集，对比了众多常见的推荐方法。除推荐效果比较之外，评估测试中我们还计划逐项展示各模型组件以及本推荐方法所实现的各变量因子在最终推荐效果中的贡献。本项研究将解析并证明该方法对于个性化推荐文献的创新之处，设计有效的参数学习算法，并实验分析各设计单元的有效性。

17500122.label: Major findings and research outcome
17500122.value: This project investigates personalized recommendation systems in physical environments characterized by pedestrian movement and spatial constraints. It introduces a generalized problem setting—Point-of-interest recommendations in Physical spaces with Pedestrian Movement (P3M)—and identifies exposure bias induced by pedestrian movement as a critical yet underexplored barrier to effective recommendation learning. Unlike digital platforms where exposure is largely algorithm-driven, exposure in physical spaces is dynamically shaped by customers’ movement paths, directions, and visual scopes interacting with spatial layouts. The project demonstrates that failing to account for this mechanism leads to systematic misidentification of negative feedback, biased learning, and suboptimal recommendations. To address this challenge, the project develops a novel recommendation approach, Unbiased Movement-aware Pairwise Ranking (UMPR). UMPR integrates agent-based pedestrian movement modeling with an unbiased pairwise learning framework that incorporates a learnable debiasing component. This design allows the model to dynamically estimate both exposure likelihood and relevance during a customer’s movement process, thereby distinguishing between truly negative preferences and merely unexposed points of interest. Methodologically, the project advances the recommendation literature by proposing one of the first model-based debiasing frameworks for pairwise learning, supported by a new alternating learning algorithm based on stochastic gradient ascent. Theoretical analysis establishes effectiveness guarantees, showing that the debiasing framework reduces training errors under mild assumptions. Empirically, the project validates UMPR using large-scale real-world shopping mall data. The results consistently demonstrate superior recommendation accuracy compared to classic and state-of-the-art benchmarks, as well as the incremental contribution of each design component. Beyond predictive performance, the project evaluates economic and fairness outcomes. The findings show that UMPR substantially increases commercial value—estimated at an additional USD 103 million in annual revenue in the studied mall—while mitigating the “Matthew effect” by improving exposure and recommendation opportunities for less-visited stores. Movement factor analyses further reveal that moving direction and visual scope play more dominant roles than mere spatial position in shaping exposure and relevance. Overall, the project delivers a coherent set of design knowledge, algorithms, and empirical evidence that advance AI-enabled recommendations in physical spaces. It contributes to information systems and AI design science by expanding the scope of recommendation research beyond digital platforms and by offering a principled solution to exposure bias rooted in real-world human movement.

17500122.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17500122.value: The project opens multiple promising avenues for further development. First, future work can relax the assumption that all observed visits represent positive preferences by incorporating richer behavioral signals, such as dwell time or in-store engagement, to probabilistically infer preference strength. Second, while the current study adopts a shortest-path assumption for modeling pedestrian movement, integrating complete real-world movement trajectories would allow for more nuanced modeling of heterogeneous navigation behaviors and further improve exposure estimation accuracy. Third, extending the movement model to three-dimensional physical spaces would enable applications in environments such as hypermarkets and warehouses, where vertical layout and shelf height affect visibility and exposure. Fourth, bridging the model with the shopping mode literature could help capture how exploratory, goal-directed, or routine behaviors alter exposure dynamics and recommendation effectiveness. Fifth, adapting UMPR to other contexts—such as pedestrian streets, museums, and immersive virtual environments like the metaverse—offers substantial opportunities to generalize the framework. As a proposed course of action, subsequent research should prioritize field experiments and pilot deployments to validate behavioral responses, commercial impact, and fairness outcomes in live settings. Parallel efforts should focus on system integration and privacy-preserving deployment practices to facilitate real-world adoption.

17500122.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17500122.value: Many people are familiar with online recommendations, such as suggested products on shopping websites; but offering similar personalized guidance in physical places like shopping malls is much harder. In real-world spaces, what people see and consider depends heavily on where they walk, what direction they face, and which stores fall within their line of sight. As a result, some shops get far more attention simply because of their location, not because customers actually prefer them. This creates an invisible bias that can lead recommendation systems to make unfair or ineffective suggestions. This research studied how people move through physical spaces and how that movement affects what they are exposed to. It developed a new AI-based recommendation method that learns not only what customers like, but also which stores they actually had a chance to notice. By accounting for movement paths and visibility, the system avoids unfairly penalizing stores that were never seen and improves recommendation quality. Tests using real shopping mall data show that this approach can increase sales, help customers discover new stores, and create fairer opportunities for smaller or less-visible retailers. Overall, the project demonstrates how smarter, movement-aware AI can make physical shopping environments more efficient, balanced, and enjoyable for both customers and businesses.
