17503722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503722.value: The effects of carbon emission on the future of mankind have been a global topic of geopolitical importance. Hong Kong government and financial regulators also show increasing attention to this matter that is related to environmental social governance (ESG). The increasing awareness of environmental protection and concerns over global warming have shaped even the political discussions in many countries. Moreover, academia has seen an increasing interest in understanding how carbon emission and its related regulation have affected asset prices and firm behaviors in recent studies. The difficulty of understanding the effects of carbon emission, as well as the emission of other greenhouse gas, on corporate behaviors is that the emission, investment, cash management and other corporate decisions are highly endogenous. It is so far difficult to find a purely exogenous and clean shock of carbon regulation in a major economy that covers the largest corporations in the world. In most countries, the cap-and-trade is voluntary rather than mandatory; in some areas, the carbon emission regulation is mandatory, but it only takes place in a small region or just has started recently. Therefore, in this project we attempt to build a new model and introduce endogenous carbon emission decision into the classical corporate finance models, and try to understand how the environment decision and traditional corporate decisions intertwine, and how potential government policies can affect these decisions. We will link this carbon-investment model with real data by using an advanced estimation methodology called the simulated method of moments (SMM). This estimation methodology has been applied in a series of recent studies about financial policy. It will allow us to obtain a more accurate estimation of our model parameters so that we can use the model to represent the carbon-investment relationship in the reality. Moreover, we can use different countries’ firm financial and carbon emission data to estimate the investor environmental awareness in different countries, and make comparison. Furthermore, we can use the model to conduct counterfactual analysis – that is, we assume that some factor such as a government policy changes; through re-estimation of the model, we can obtain the possible outcome to firm investment and carbon emission in the hypothetical scenario. 碳排放对人类未来的影响一直是具有地缘政治意义的全球性话题。香港政府和金融监管机构也越来越关注与环境社会治理（ESG）相关的问题。越来越多的环保意识和对全球变暖的担忧甚至影响了许多国家的政治讨论。此外，在最近的研究中，学术界对了解碳排放及其相关法规如何影响资产价格和公司行为的兴趣日益浓厚。 理解碳排放以及其他温室气体排放对企业行为的影响的难点在于排放、投资、现金管理和其他企业决策具有高度内生性。迄今为止，在一个涵盖世界上最大公司的主要经济体中，很难找到纯粹的外生和干净的碳监管冲击。在大多数国家，限额与交易是自愿而非强制性的；在一些地区，碳排放监管是强制性的，但只是在小范围内实施或刚刚开始实施。因此，在本项目中，我们试图建立一个新的模型，将内生碳排放决策引入经典的公司财务模型中，并试图了解环境决策和传统公司决策是如何相互交织的，以及潜在的政府政策如何影响这些决策。 我们将通过使用称为模拟矩量法 (SMM) 的高级估计方法将此碳投资模型与实际数据联系起来。这种估计方法已被应用于最近关于金融政策的一系列研究中。这将使我们能够更准确地估计我们的模型参数，以便我们可以使用模型来表示现实中的碳投资关系。此外，我们可以利用不同国家的企业财务和碳排放数据来估计不同国家投资者的环保意识，并进行比较。此外，我们可以使用该模型进行反事实分析——即我们假设某些因素，如政府政策发生变化；通过对模型的重新估计，我们可以得到假设情景下企业投资和碳排放的可能结果。

17503822.label: Realisation of objectives
17503822.value: 1. To examine the long-run impacts of a meritocratic education system on accumulation of human capital, social capital and persistence of local elites This project has fully achieved its objective of examining the long-term effects of a meritocratic education system on the accumulation of human and social capital, as well as the persistence of local elites. By constructing a comprehensive dataset covering four centuries of the Joseon dynasty (1392–1910), the study provides a comprehensive multigenerational perspective on intergenerational mobility. The dataset integrates diverse historical records, including exam rosters, official appointment records, family genealogies, population censuses, and data on private Confucian academies, enabling a detailed evaluation of how meritocratic institutions shaped social mobility. The analysis employs a rigorous methodological framework, including the application of Bayes' theorem to calculate the probability of exam success based on family background, allowing direct measurement of elite persistence. Furthermore, a difference-in-differences approach is used to assess the impact of economic development—specifically, the opening of trading posts with Qing China around 1650—on social mobility, while complementary analyses explore mechanisms such as demographic changes, educational investments, and corruption. The findings reveal striking patterns of elite persistence. Individuals from elite families, defined as those with at least one exam passer in the previous three generations, consistently enjoyed a significant advantage: they were 950 to 2,200 times more likely to pass the lower-level and humanities exams and 5,600 times more likely to attain high-ranking government positions compared to non-elite candidates. Although the degree of persistence declined slightly over time, elite dominance remained a defining feature of the system throughout the four centuries studied. The opening of trading posts facilitated localized economic development, leading to increased exam passers in nearby regions; however, the benefits were disproportionately captured by elites. While non-elite candidates experienced a modest increase in lower-level exam success, their chances of upward mobility to high-ranking positions remained severely limited. Mechanisms such as the rise in private Confucian academies following trading post openings appear to have amplified existing disparities, as elites had better access to these institutions. Additionally, evidence of corruption in commercially developed regions further constrained the system’s meritocratic potential. These findings challenge the assumption that meritocratic institutions inherently promote social mobility. Instead, they demonstrate that without mechanisms to address underlying inequalities, such systems can entrench social hierarchies over time. The research highlights how structural barriers, such as unequal access to education and the influence of familial networks, allowed elites to dominate higher-level positions despite formal equality of opportunity. The study’s broader implications extend to contemporary debates on education and inequality, emphasizing that economic growth or institutional development alone may not disrupt entrenched hierarchies without redistributive policies. By quantifying these dynamics across four centuries, this research contributes to our understanding of how meritocratic systems operate within broader socioeconomic contexts and provides historical insights into the persistent challenges of achieving substantive social mobility. 2. To study the persistent effects of historical institutions and cultural values on major determinants of economic development This project has successfully explored how historical institutions and cultural values exert persistent effects on major determinants of economic development, using the Joseon dynasty’s civil examination system as a case study. The research demonstrates that meritocratic institutions, despite their egalitarian design, can reinforce social hierarchies, thereby shaping development trajectories over the long term. Elite families consistently maintained their dominance in the examination system, with a 950 to 2,200 times higher probability of exam success compared to non-elites. This persistence underscores the enduring influence of institutional frameworks that reward intergenerational advantages, even when formal barriers to entry are minimal. The study also highlights the role of Confucian cultural values in shaping patterns of human capital formation, as elites leveraged their resources to invest in education, thereby monopolizing opportunities tied to the examination system. The research provides compelling evidence of how historical institutions mediate the relationship between economic opportunities and development outcomes. For instance, the opening of trading posts with Qing China around 1650 increased commercial activity, but the benefits were largely captured by elites rather than disrupting existing hierarchies. This is evident in the rise of private educational institutions, which disproportionately benefited elite families, and in the prevalence of corruption, which further limited upward mobility for non-elites. The innovative methodological framework, which combines multigenerational data with difference-in-differences analysis, enables a robust investigation of how historical shocks—such as economic development—interact with deeply entrenched social structures. By documenting these dynamics, the project addresses a critical gap in the literature on institutional persistence, showing how historical factors create path dependencies that influence economic development across centuries. 3. To explore the connection between historical elites and contemporary Chaebols in South Korea Progress on this objective is ongoing through a complementary project that aims to investigate the linkages between historical elites and the founders of South Korea’s modern business conglomerates (Chaebols). This research involves digitizing data on Korean entrepreneurs during the post-independence period (1945–1982) and integrating it with data on elites from the late Joseon dynasty and the colonial period. By creating a unique dataset spanning multiple historical periods, the project seeks to examine how elite families that excelled within the traditional civil examination system may have translated their social capital into economic power during South Korea’s rapid industrialization. This work builds directly on the findings of the current project, which established the extraordinary persistence of elite advantage in Joseon Korea. The ongoing research aims to explore whether these historical elite families leveraged their networks, resources, and cultural capital to maintain their dominance across vastly different institutional contexts, including the Japanese colonial period and South Korea’s shift to a capitalist economy. By tracing the evolution of elite networks across institutional transitions, the study provides valuable insights into the historical foundations of economic development in East Asia and the role of elite persistence in shaping contemporary business structures. Once completed, this research will contribute significantly to understanding the long-term interplay between historical institutions, social mobility, and modern economic development. This objective has not yet been completed due to two primary reasons. First, the scope and workload of the first two objectives were substantial, as they involved constructing an extensive historical dataset and conducting rigorous analyses to address complex questions about intergenerational mobility and institutional persistence. Given the significant time and effort required to achieve these objectives, it was necessary to prioritize and proceed in stages to ensure the quality and depth of the research. Second, while the third objective is conceptually related to the first two, it explores a distinct yet complementary question about the transformation of elite networks across historical periods and their potential connection to South Korea’s modern economic structures. To maintain project coherency and provide a more focused analysis, I decided to address this objective in a separate, dedicated paper. This approach allows for a more comprehensive exploration of the third objective, building on the findings of the current research while ensuring that it receives the time and attention required for meaningful insights.

17503822.label: Major findings and research outcome
17503822.value: I have produced one paper titled “Examining the Exams: Intergenerational Mobility in Joseon Korea,” which we have revised and resubmitted to the Journal of Economic History. The draft version is attached in Part C. I am currently waiting for the second round review report. The main finding of this paper is that the meritocratic civil examination system of Joseon Korea (1392–1910) reinforced social stratification, with elite families enjoying overwhelming advantages in exam success and high-ranking government positions. Elite candidates were up to 2,200 times more likely to pass exams and 5,600 times more likely to secure top roles than non-elites. Economic development, such as the opening of trading posts in 1650, further benefited elites through better access to education and entrenched networks, while corruption limited upward mobility. The study highlights how meritocratic systems can perpetuate inequality without addressing underlying disparities.

17503822.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17503822.value: A potential avenue for further development of this research lies in extending the analysis to explore how historical elite networks influenced modern socioeconomic structures, particularly in shaping contemporary inequality in South Korea. Future research could investigate the connection between elite families of the Joseon dynasty and the founders of modern Chaebols, analyzing how historical social capital and institutional privileges transitioned across periods of colonization, industrialization, and modernization. This direction is already being actively pursued in my complementary project, as outlined in Part B. 5.3.

17503822.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17503822.value: This research explores how social mobility worked in Joseon Korea (1392–1910), a society where success in civil service exams determined who could reach the top levels of government and gain elite status. While these exams were designed to be meritocratic, meaning anyone could succeed based on talent and effort, the study reveals that family background played a huge role in determining success. People from elite families were up to 2,200 times more likely to pass the exams and 5,600 times more likely to secure high-ranking government positions than those from non-elite families. The research also shows that even when economic opportunities expanded—such as when new trading posts with China opened in 1650—these benefits mainly went to elites, further entrenching inequality. The study uses detailed historical data and modern statistical methods to uncover how education, family networks, and even corruption helped elites maintain their privilege over four centuries. This work contributes to our understanding of how systems meant to promote fairness can reinforce inequality without addressing deeper disparities. It provides historical insights into the challenges of achieving true social mobility, offering lessons for modern societies struggling with similar issues of education, inequality, and opportunity.

17503922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503922.value: There are about 8,000 mutual funds to choose from in the USA. This makes it difficult for investors to efficiently screen funds and optimally allocate their wealth across funds. In addition, many retail investors have limited time and financial expertise. It is not surprising that investors base their investment decisions on simple metrics of the past fund performance, ratings, broker recommendations, or analyst forecasts. We focus on the ratings produced by Morningstar. Morningstar’s five-star rating system is transparent, easy to understand, and popular with investors. The academic literature shows that Morningstar ratings have a significant and causal impact on fund flows beyond other metrics of historical fund performance. Funds that receive a high (low) rating, experience a significant fund net inflow (outflow). As the compensation of fund managers depends on assets under management, managers are keen to maximize fund net inflows. Accordingly, managers have incentives to tailor their asset allocation in order to increase the Morningstar rating, even if this asset allocation is not necessarily in the best interest of investors. Our first goal is to quantify unintended, causal effects of Morningstar ratings on mutual fund managers’ asset allocation decisions. We use the 2002 rating methodology change as an exogenous event. We argue that there is a crucial difference in incentives of growth versus value fund managers to take risk in an attempt to increase the Morningstar rating prior to the 2002 rating methodology change. However, this difference in incentives vanishes after the change. Thus, we estimate the differential changes in risk taking across growth and value funds around the 2002 rating methodology change. We already have preliminary results consistent with our hypothesis that growth funds take more risk than value funds before 2002, and this difference disappears thereafter. Our analysis is fundamentally different from the extent literature which focuses on fund flows while keeping the asset allocation of fund managers constant. Our second goal is to quantify the effects of rating induced asset allocations of fund managers on (equilibrium) asset prices. We intend to show that the security market line (SML) is flatter for growth stocks compared to value stocks before 2002, and this difference vanishes after the 2002 rating methodology change. The reason is that growth funds have stronger incentives to invest in high beta growth stocks prior to 2002, which flattens the SML, and these incentives are gone after the methodology change. 在美国, 大约有8,000 种共同基金供投资者选择。这使得投资者难以有效地筛选基金并在各基金之间优化分配他们的财富。此外，许多散户投资者的时间和金融专业知识有限。因此，投资者的投资决策往往基于评价基金过往业绩的简单指标，比如评级、经纪人推荐或分析师预测。 在本文中，我们专注于讨论晨星公司的共同基金评级（以下简称晨星评级）。晨星的五星级评级体系透明、通俗易懂，深受投资者欢迎。已有的学术文献表明，晨星评级对基金资金流的影响显著且其中的因果关系超过基金过往业绩的其他指标。获得高（低）评级的基金会出现显著的资金净流入（流出）。 由于基金经理的薪酬取决于所管理的资产规模，所以他们热衷于最大化基金的资金净流入。因此，基金经理有动力调整其资产配置以提高晨星评级，即使这种资产配置不一定符合投资者的最大利益。 首先，我们量化晨星评级对共同基金经理资产配置决策的意外因果影响。我们将 2002 年评级方法的变更作为外生事件。我们认为，在 2002 年评级方法改变之前，成长型基金经理与价值型基金经理冒险尝试提高晨星评级的诱因存在重大差异。然而，这种差异在评级方法变更后消失了。因此，我们估计了成长型基金和价值型基金在 2002 年评级方法变更前后的风险承担差异。我们已经有了初步结果，这与我们的假设相一致，即 2002 年之前成长型基金比价值型基金承担更多风险，而这种差异在此后消失了。我们的分析与那些关注基金资金流量同时保持基金经理的资产配置不变的文献有本质的差别。 其次, 我们量化由晨星评级所引起的基金经理资产配置对（均衡）资产价格的影响。我们计划阐明，在 2002 年之前，与价值股相比，成长股的证券市场线 (SML) 更平坦，而这种差异在 2002 年评级方法变更后消失了。原因是成长型基金在 2002 年之前有更强的诱因投资于高贝塔成长型股票，这使得 SML 趋于平缓，而这种诱因在方法论改变后就不存在了。

17503922.label: Major findings and research outcome
17503922.value: I have written a paper "Tilting at Windmills: Biased Benchmarks and the Risk-Taking Response of Mutual Funds" with Richard Evans and Hugh Kim. The paper has been presented at several top conferences including the 2026 American Finance Association and is currently under review at the Review of Financial Studies. The paper studies how third party changes to mutual fund peer benchmarking (Morningstar’s 2002 shift from one U.S. equity peer group to nine size–style categories and its 2016 launch of ESG Globe ratings) altered managers’ incentives, risk taking, flows, and portfolio tilts. Value/growth (pre 2002): Under a single equity peer group, growth funds were disadvantaged with average star ratings 0.20 lower than value funds, and the gap moved with the performance of the value factor (HML). Disadvantaged growth funds raised risk: beta by about 0.3 and volatility by about 7% versus value funds. When the expected value premium (value spread) was larger, growth funds took even more risk. Style drift outside growth mandates was higher pre 2002 and fell by about 4.5% after the methodology change. Post 2002, the star rating gap and differences in risk taking effectively disappear. Incentive heterogeneity: Risk shifting was strongest (i) when funds were near Morningstar rating cutoffs (triple interaction +0.017 in beta; +0.51% in volatility) and (ii) among funds with explicit value/growth mandates (+0.09 in beta; +2.25% in volatility). Effectiveness: Extra risk taking partially closed rating gaps. Absent such risk taking, growth funds’ counterfactual disadvantage is about 1.2-1.4 stars. ESG (pre 2016): With only star ratings salient, high ESG funds took more risk (per +1 Std in ESG score: beta +0.016, volatility +0.265%) and held lower ESG stocks. Investor flows were highly star sensitive. ESG (post 2016 globes): Globe ratings reduced star-flow sensitivity for high ESG funds by about 30% of the baseline, dampened their risk taking, and led to higher portfolio ESG scores. High ESG funds’ risk taking is counter cyclical to expected ESG factor returns, with a stronger relation before the globes. Placebo tests show no pre/post change for already ESG labeled funds, consistent with a salience mechanism. Summary: Biased third party peer benchmarks can induce systematic, incentive driven risk taking and mandate drift. Making benchmarks more representative helps to remove these distortions and realigns portfolios with mandates and investor preferences.

17503922.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17503922.value: Building on evidence that biased third‑party peer benchmarks spur risk‑taking and mandate drift (and that Morningstar’s 2002 style‑box and 2016 ESG “globes” mitigated these distortions) future work and practice can move in tandem. Research extensions: (1) Quantify investor‑welfare effects, i.e., tail risk, style mismatch, and long‑run alphas, via a structural model of manager incentives. (2) Build “fairness audits” that track correlations between ratings and relevant factor returns before and after methodology shocks. (3) Use micro‑flows to measure how salience shifts (stars versus globes) transmit to behavior. Knowledge exchange: Inform and work with rating agencies: Recommendation to publish peer‑group construction, release historical percentile ranks and thresholds, and maintain a live fairness dashboard. When a non‑risk dimension matters (e.g., sustainability), issue a parallel rating to keep objectives distinct. Inform and work with asset managers: hard‑code mandate‑consistent risk budgets and style‑drift guardrails; report them alongside stars and globes; monitor distance‑to‑cutoffs to deter gaming. Inform and work with policymakers: require standardized disclosure of RPE design and periodic third‑party fairness reviews.

17503922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17503922.value: Ratings matter. This study shows that when a popular mutual fund rating system compared apples to oranges, some managers reacted by taking extra risks to look better. Before 2002, Morningstar ranked almost all U.S. stock funds together. Funds that focused on “growth” stocks (fast growing companies) tended to look worse than “value” funds (cheaper, slower growing companies). In turn, many growth managers bought riskier stocks and drifted from their stated style. After 2002, Morningstar rated funds controlling for investment styles. The simple change removed the disadvantage and the extra risk taking dissipated. A similar pattern appeared around ESG investing. When only star ratings were prominent ESG funds often took on more risk and even held lower ESG stocks to compete on returns. After Morningstar added easy to recognize “globe” ratings for ESG in 2016, investors could judge funds on both performance and sustainability. Risk taking dropped and portfolios tilted more clearly toward higher ESG companies. These findings are important as the way third party benchmarks are built can unintentionally incentivize managers toward behavior that differs from investors’ expectations. Better designed, more representative ratings align incentives and help investors get the desired fund style.

17504422.label: Project Objectives
17504422.value: The overall objective of this project is to estimate whether and to what extent experts with no venture capital (VC) credentials can help public innovation subsidy programs to play the role of VC in promoting the growth of high-technology ventures. We undertake this study as policy makers face the following dilemma in innovation funding programs: On the one hand, the evaluation of early-stage, hi-tech ventures require knowledge and expertise that are usually associated with professional venture capitalists; on the other hand, professional VC investors are under-supplied and thus these programs heavily rely on non-VC experts to evaluate and select firms to fund. We will develop a theoretical framework based on domain familiarity and professional risk orientation to predict how experts of VC and non-VC backgrounds differ from each other in new venture evaluation with regard to judgement leniency, fallibility, and informativeness. We will particularly investigate whether non-VC experts, although individually error-prone and less informed, can be as informative in evaluation and funding decisions at the group level as their VC peers. We will develop a dataset based on the administrative data of a flagship state innovation subsidy program in Beijing that include detailed information on grant-seeking firms as well as experts recruited by the program to evaluate these ventures. We will further enrich this dataset with firm performance information in survival, growth, patenting and receipt of VC investments using proprietary datasets and public records. We will document the amount of judgement errors each expert commits in grant evaluation (over a set of venture merits that can be objectively assessed). We will distinguish false negatives from false positives to examine whether these two types of error take place under different mechanisms. We will further identify individual experts that are associated with a high level of judgement errors and estimate to what extent the funding program’s evaluation reliability can be improved if these error-prone experts were removed. We will investigate empirically the extent to which VC and non-VC experts differ from each other in evaluation across the dimensions of leniency, judgement errors, and informativeness. We will test whether the evaluation scores from both VC and non-VC experts are highly associated with firms’ historical performance but only scores from VC experts are highly associated with firms’ future, post-grant performance. Leverage the availability of firm-level evaluation scores to identify the cutoff point for grant allocation and to estimate the extent to which firms’ position above/below the cut-off point is impacted by experts’ judgement errors. We will further adopt a regression discontinuity (RD) design to causally estimate the impact of the focal funding program on firm performance in the post-grant period. Work with the focal funding program to redesign the evaluation process so as to reduce experts’ judgement errors (without expanding the hard-to-recruit VC expert pool) and/or improve the informativeness of expert evaluations at the group level even if individual expert’s evaluation is unreliable and prone to errors.

17504622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504622.value: 賣空者經常發佈他們的研究報告，以增加他們的市場影響力。他們有動機以消極的方式構建報告，這種做法可能與（錯誤）信息的市場操縱接壤。擬議的專案旨在更好地瞭解賣空者影響報告的均衡決定，以及改變涉嫌市場操縱的法律處罰的後果。賣空者決定是否發佈報告，如果是，則決定向報告添加多少負面偏見。這兩個決定是不對稱的，因為第一個決策是公開可觀察的，而第二個則不是。因此，賣空者可以承諾不發佈報告，但不能承諾在發佈時不影響報告。因此，對錯誤資訊的更高法律處罰會產生兩個相反的後果。一方面，它阻止了證據較弱的賣空者發佈她的報告，但當她發佈報告時，它減少了負面偏見。兩者都增加了報告對均衡市場的影響。另一方面，市場對報告的強烈反應加劇了賣空者在發佈報告時偏向報告的動機，但對她最初發佈較弱報告的動機的影響更為溫和。因此，對錯誤資訊的更高法律處罰可能導致已發佈報告中出現更多偏見，並減少賣空者提供的整體資訊。

17600522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17600522.value: 利用經顱直流電刺激(tDCS)提升老年孤獨人群的社交快感和參與水平

17600522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17600522.value: Abstract Loneliness, defined as the distressing feeling resulted from unsatisfied social relationship, is a prevalent condition experienced chronically by 40% of older adults. Due to various factors related to aging, the older population is particularly vulnerable to experiencing loneliness, the level of which has further escalated since the onset of COVID-19 pandemic and social distancing measures. Chronic stress has been consistently linked with deterioration in physical and mental health, and is a major risk factor for high morbidity and mortality, Alzheimer’s disease and late-life depression in the elderly. Thus, it is vitally important to discover effective methods to reduce loneliness levels in older individuals. While existing psychosocial interventions have only achieved limited success in reducing loneliness, the transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) appears a promising novel neuromodulation method in boosting social interactions and adaptive psychosocial functioning, via modulating relevant neural processes. Existing studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of tDCS on the right ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (rVLPFC) in reducing negative social emotional processing among young individuals. Also, among both healthy and clinical samples, tDCS on the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (lDLPFC) facilitated non-social reward sensitivity, learning and instrumental motivation. However, it is still unclear whether tDCS could enhance positive social processing, whether any tDCS effect on social processing would translate to increase in social motivation, real-life social activity and reduced loneliness, whether the tDCS effect could be observed in older individuals, and whether the positive tDCS social effects are long-lasting. To address these gaps, we propose a randomized control trial (RCT) including 249 high-loneliness older individuals (>60 years old), who will be randomly allocated to a tDCS rVLPFC group, a tDCS lDLPFC group, and a sham control group. Participants’ emotional processing of social and non-social word stimuli will be examined at baseline, immediately after 10-session tDCS intervention (or sham stimulation), and at two follow-up timepoints (1- and 3-month). We will further examine whether any tDCS-related changes in emotional processing are associated with changes in key psychosocial variables including social motivation, real-life social activity, and loneliness levels. Using linear-mixed models, we will test the hypothesized effects of rVLPFC and lDLPFC tDCS on negative and positive social emotional processing respectively, as well as the tDCS effects on the key psychosocial variables, immediately post-intervention and at follow-up timepoints. The hypothesized association between tDCS-related changes in emotional processing and changes in key psychosocial variables will be tested using correlation and mediation analyses. 孤獨源於社交關係缺乏導致的負面情緒。高達百分之四十的老年人會有孤獨的體驗。由於各種衰老相關的因素，老年人特別容易有孤獨情緒。況且，在新冠疫情下，社交隔離措施進一步導致了孤獨率的升高。以往大量研究證實慢性孤獨和身心健康的惡化有關，並且是高患病率和死亡率、阿茲海默症及晚年抑鬱症的主要風險因子。因此，尋求有效方法降低老年人的孤獨水平尤為重要。 現有的社會心理療法對降低孤獨水平效果並不明顯。另一方面，經顱直流電刺激（tDCS）是一種有前途的新型神經調節方法，可通過調節相關的神經機制來促進社交互動和適應性社會心理功能。現有研究表明作用於右側腹外側前額葉皮層(rVLPFC) 的tDCS可有效減少年輕人的負面社會情緒處理。此外，在健康和臨床樣本中，作用於左側背外側前額葉皮層 (lDLPFC) 的 tDCS 促進了非社會獎勵敏感性、學習和工具性動機。然而，目前尚不清楚 1）tDCS 是否可以增強積極的社會信息處理， 2）tDCS 對社會信息處理的影響是否會轉化為增加社會動機、現實生活中的社會活動參與和減少孤獨感，3）是否可以在老年人中觀察到 tDCS 效應，以及4）tDCS 對社交的正面效應是否持久。 為了解決這些研究問題，我們提出了一項隨機對照試驗 (RCT)，其中包括 249 名高度孤獨的老年人（>60 歲），他們將被隨機分配到 tDCS rVLPFC 組、tDCS lDLPFC 組和假對照組。我們會在基線、10 次 tDCS 干預（或假刺激）之後以及兩個後續時間點（1 個月和 3 個月）探索參與者對社交和非社交詞刺激的情緒處理。我們還將進一步研究情緒處理中任何與 tDCS 相關的變化是否與關鍵社會心理指標的變化有關，包括社會動機、現實生活中的社會活動參與和孤獨程度。我們將運用線性混合模型分別測試 rVLPFC 和 lDLPFC tDCS 對消極和積極社會情緒處理的影響，以及 tDCS 在干預後和後續時間點對關鍵社會心理變量的影響。我們還將運用相關性和中介分析來測試與 tDCS 相關的情緒處理變化和關鍵社會心理變量變化之間的假設關聯。

17600822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17600822.value: 審訊不公？檢視法庭處理以誤譯為由提出之上訴，兼論其耳語傳譯模式

17600822.label: Project Objectives
17600822.value: Identify and document Hong Kong appeal cases advanced on the ground of a misinterpretation or inadequacy in interpretation. Discover how the appellate courts dealt with interpretation problems raised as grounds for appeal, including their views on the notion of the “right to a fair trial”, the reasons for their rulings and the judicial precedents followed in each case. Identify the interpretation problems in dispute in each appeal case, the mode of interpretation used and the practices of the court in facilitating the interpreting process. Highlight and raise awareness of the complexities, challenges and limitations of chuchotage (simultaneous interpretation provided in a whisper) and propose ways to improve the transparency and quality of court interpretation to better safeguard defendants’ right to a fair trial. Protect interpreters from being scapegoated and minimise the chances of defective interpretation being used as a ground for appeal in future.

17600822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17600822.value: 刑事訴訟中，被告獲公平審訊，屬國際公認之基本人權，當中包括為不諳審訊語言者提供免費傳譯服務。如法庭未能提供所需傳譯服務，或傳譯質素欠佳，即等同剝奪或侵害被告獲公平審訊之權利，足以構成上訴理據。以未能提供傳譯服務作為上訴理據，相對簡單直接，惟以傳譯質素欠佳為由則舉證不易。尤其當法庭採用同聲耳語傳譯，則缺乏法庭記錄，無法稽核傳譯質素，以判斷上訴理據是否成立，令上訴法院之裁決缺乏舉證基礎，有欠穩妥之嫌。 審閱相關上訴判決書，發現法院處理方式並不一致：部分要求上訴人證明自身權益如何因誤譯而受到損害，部分則認爲實質或潛在損害不應列作相關考慮因素。根據遵循先例原則，法院處理類似案件時，應遵循相關案例之判決。若上訴法院裁決不一致，兼且意見分歧，則有違該項原則。 本研究主要分析自1946年以來，以傳譯質素欠佳為由，提出上訴之線上判決書，以及判決書引用之其他普通法司法管轄區相關裁決，藉以探討上訴法院如何處理此類上訴及其所遵循之案例。本研究亦會探討法庭採用之傳譯模式，配合傳譯工作之安排，最終如何影響上訴法院之裁決。針對具體之上訴理據，及上訴法院之裁決，本研究將一併檢視現行法庭之傳譯服務，尋求提升傳譯過程透明度及服務質素之方法，冀能同時保障被告人及傳譯員之權益。

17601122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17601122.value: 森林療愈：關於香港自然療法的感官民族誌研究

17601122.label: Project Objectives
17601122.value: To document the range of forest therapy organisations and patient populations in Hong Kong. Considering the varied services and patient demographics, I will develop valuable cartographic perspectives on the different types of patient groups, guides, and therapeutic activities. To investigate the experience of what it means to undergo healing with forest therapy from the perspectives of the different local population groups. Examining patient illness and healing narratives, I will develop insights into the varied relevance and meaning of natural environments and urban contexts to different local demographics, including age, linguistic background, gender, and patient populations. To critically examine the universalised evidence of forest therapy’s therapeutic benefit by focusing sharply on the context of Hong Kong and illustrating the complex qualitative dimensions by which the healing modality is shaped to the particularities of place, cultural context, and history. I will examine how forest therapy mediates tensions, anxieties, and hopes related specifically to urban life in Hong Kong. To illuminate how forest therapy’s emphasis on environmental settings and sensory experience are part of patient processes of place-making, identity, and belonging. This includes considering the varied local and cosmopolitan socialites and exploring how the therapy contributes to varied perceptions of what is meaningful, important, and good. To deepen the local understanding and networks of nature therapy by directly sharing the research insights and activities with student populations at Hong Kong University. I will help build bridges across the disciplines of medical science, social science, and the humanities by undertaking workshops on nature therapy with MBBS medical students and the broader community of students of HKU.

17601122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17601122.value: 香港，一個人口密度和人均收入都是全球最高之一的城市，亦以高強度的工作環境、繁忙的城市空間以及擁擠的居住環境聞名世界。這些因素對香港的公共衛生帶來挑戰，並且與一系列的常見精神健康問題有連繫。近年坊間出現了一批「森林療癒師」，他們對應著環境和社會的需要，在城市外的大自然環境下提供價格合理的健康服務。近年國際研究發現森林治療（forest therapy）和更廣泛的大自然治療（nature therapy）帶來的健康功效，可是這些研究所得的只是全稱的結論，並沒有考慮到當地背景的重要性。現時未有嚴謹的研究探討風行全球的大自然治療如何因應地方需要、社會背景、環境型態，歷史因素和文化信念而成形。在醫療人類學裡，全人健康需考慮到社會和文化背景，因此這個研究缺口相當重要。透過有關香港森林療法小組和活動的民族誌研究（ethnographic research），這個項目將會提供一個首創的界別介入治療以至一個可能符合成本效益的公共健康措施，並探索在香港接受大自然療法的病人如何培育地方感，歸屬感以及對於自然和城市環境的道德覺知。 培養五官感受是森林治療的活動重心。嚮導以自然環境為治療空間，教導病人不同針對感覺，察覺和沉浸於大自然的技巧。森林治療的理念把跟大自然相反的城市五官感受定義為壓力、不安以及症病的源頭。這個項目會檢視在香港提供森林治療的組織和小組，以探索治療師和病人分別如何體驗，定義及理解城市及自然環境。通過感官民族誌方法配合半結構訪問以及線上問卷多重檢核，以質性及量性角度探討感官療癒手法，當地對於城市與自然環境的看法和病患及療癒敘事。這個項目會探討全球性的療癒模式如何被當地的不同因素影響，包括地方營造（place-making）、社交生活，歷史偶然性（historical contingencies）和道德感官覺知。除了產生具影響力的研究，這個項目亦會於香港大學的醫學及人文學的課程引入有關自然治療的工作坊，作為跨學科橋樑，為本地以至全球帶來不少益處。

17601822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17601822.value: 以多元交織性角度分析香港隱蔽人口使用毒品和污名化的情況

17601822.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17601822.value: Prof Kong, Travis Shiu-ki Dr Lowe, Katie

17601822.label: Project Objectives
17601822.value: To understand the relationship between drug use patterns, risk practices and intersectional identities (gender, sexuality, ethnicity/race) among hard-to-reach persons who use drugs (PWUD). To examine the experiences of intersectional stigma among PWUD through integrating the use of multiple qualitative methodologies (e.g., traditional and innovative) as a means to address inclusiveness in studying hard-to-reach populations. To analyse how intersectional stigma among PWUD influences their health, care and social support, so as to bridge drugs, stigmatised populations and intersectionality studies. To identify access points for health, care and social support for PWUD who experience intersectional stigma and structural inequalities. To inform policymakers and social service providers on reaching out and providing inclusive services to hard-to-reach PWUD.

17601822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17601822.value: Official statistics indicate a steady decline in the number of reported drug users in Hong Kong, but frontline workers and researchers have indicated their concerns over the increasingly hidden nature of use due to shifts in settings and context of drug use. These shifts are connected to enforcement efforts, the decline of the dance drug leisure scene, and COVID-19 restrictions. The government has identified three groups of users particularly difficult to access and engage and will be the focus this study: females, ethnic minorities, and men having sex with men. We have limited understanding of these groups drug use and associated risks, given the private nature of their drug use. These populations pose challenges for accessing and involving in research with traditional methodologies. Intersectionality and stigma have been two theoretical concepts that are increasingly observed in drug research on hard-to-reach populations. Intersectionality analyses the relationship between power and social difference, where persons who use drugs (PWUD)’s drug related stigma often overlaps with other stigmas, such as race, gender and sexuality. Such intersectional stigma leads to discrimination and results in discontinuing or resistance to treatment. With the lack of understanding and an inclusive service framework for hard-to-reach PWUD in Hong Kong, this research aims to develop a theoretical and methodological approach to better access and understand how and why some PWUD’s use is hidden, whether and how stigma may impact their use and risks practices, and their ability to seek services. Guided by theoretical concepts of intersectionality and stigma, this research aims to illuminate these hard-to-reach populations through integrating traditional and innovative methods. In-depth interviews will be conducted with 90 PWUD from the hard-to-reach populations, who will be recruited through snowball and web-based sampling. 30 respondents will then be invited to take part in participant photography over a period of three months and participate in photo elicitation interviews. The research will have a direct impact on PWUD with the innovative method of participant photography in the research process, future evaluation and development of such strategy as a form of empowerment. Research data will enable NGOs, policymakers and law enforcement authorities to access and engage these groups of PWUD and address the access gaps of existing services. Within academia, the research will provide new sources of theoretically informed analysis about these marginalized populations in Hong Kong and a point of cultural comparison of similar populations in other countries. 官方統計數據顯示，香港被呈報的毒品使用人數穩步下降，但前線工作人員和研究人員對因環境變化而導致更隱蔽的藥物使用情況表示擔憂。這些轉變與執法力度、娛樂跳舞場所的衰落以及 2019新型冠状病毒相關限制有關。政府已識別出三組難以接觸和建立關係的香港藥物使用者群組，這三個群組將成為本研究的重點：女性、小數族裔和男男性接觸者。基於這些群組用藥的私人性，令社會對他們的用藥情況和相關風險的理解有限。以上，為以傳統方法接觸和研究這些群體帶來了挑戰。 引用多元交織性及污名化理論概念在有關難以接觸的群體之毒品研究越來越普遍。多元交織性分析了權力和社會差異之間的關係，藥物使用者的毒品相關污名通常與種族、性別和性取向等其他污名重疊。這種多元交織性污名會導致歧視並引致中斷或抗拒治療。 由於香港缺乏對難以接觸的藥物使用者的認知和具包容性的服務框架，本研究旨在制定一種結合理論和方法論的模式，從而有效地接觸和了解某些藥物使用者如何及為何隱藏他們的使用情況，污名有否及如何影響他們的藥物使用和具風險的習慣，和他們尋求服務的能力。本研究以多元交織性及污名化為研究框架，旨在通過整合傳統和創新的方法來揭視j這些難以接觸的群體。以滾雪球和網絡抽樣的招募方法，研究團隊會與九十名難以接觸的藥物使用者進行深入訪談。並從中邀請三十名受訪者參加為期三個月的參與式攝影和片引談方式的訪問。 透過研究過程中使用參與式攝影這種創新方法、評估和制定以此方法策略作為一種充權形式，本研究將會對藥物使用者產生直接影響。本研究數據能讓非政府組織、政策制定者和執法當局跟這些藥物使用者群體接觸和建立關係，並回應現有的服務空隙。就學術界而言，這研究會就香港邊緣人口提供新的理論指導分析，並作為對其他國家類此群體的文化比較點。

17602122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17602122.value: 工程學科研究:教師的共通能力评估素养

17602122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17602122.value: Dr Ghannam, Rami Dr Griffiths, Jennifer Dr Timoney, Joseph Dr Zhao, Maggie Yue

17602122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17602122.value: 共通能力 指是 “通用于各种学习场景” 且能够 “帮助学生掌握知识、构建知识、应用所学知识的基本技能、能力及特质”(EMB, 2014)。 2018年的热门视频Did You Know? Shift Happens 《你知道吗？这些变化正在发生》里有一句话可以精准概括共通能力的重要性： “我们正在培养学生从事尚未存在的工作和技术……以应对尚未可知的问题。” 由此可见，教育不仅要关注学科知识的传授，更应关注共通能力的形成。共通能力可以迁移到各种场景并帮助我们应对未知。传统的科学、技术、工程和数学 (简称STEM) 课程主要以学科知识为中心。现实中STEM专业的毕业生却需要和各方人群打交道。这就意味着他们要培养更多元的能力，比如批判性思维、领导力以及团队合作能力。在课程设计中，尤其是评价设计阶段，这些能力往往会被遗漏、忽视。评价可以驱动学习，特别是在以考试为导向的学习文化中，教学通常围绕考试内容展开。因此，如果教师和学生将通用能力和学科知识置于同等位置，那么他们必须首先得学会如何评价通用能力。 本文不在于主张区分学科知识和共通能力，而在于强调教师应该了解共通能力、了解如何创造性地运用各种方法评价共通能力。教师要认识到为什么学生的共通能力需要被评价。同时，教师也要关注到由于和学生存在社会情绪背景上的差异，学生可能会对共通能力的重要性产生质疑。他们可能会认为对共通能力的评价是出于官僚主义而非真正有益于这些能力的增长。 针对工程学科的共通能力，提出教师评价素养框架以及评价量表。我们开创性地聚焦工程类学科所需的四种具体的能力 — 人际交往能力、批判性思维、职业责任感以及创造力。因为，这四种能力被全球范围内的众多工程认证机构及高校所认可。 本研究采用混合研究法，研究范围跨香港、英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰四个地区。可靠的共通能力评价体系可以为学生、教师、雇主以及政策制定者提供直观的参考。帮助他们了解学生的共通能力表现、就业能力和成为全面发展的全球公民的能力。

17602222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17602222.value: 中額文學與女性主義想像: 1930-1960年代韓國小說的新系譜

17602222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17602222.value: 此計畫以「中額文學」定位現代韓國小說，藉以重審現代韓國小說系譜。韓國「中額文學」這一新理論框架提供了鏈接現有殖民地韓國與後殖民時期韓國這人為二分的跨戰爭視角。藉由原被應用於英美文學研究中的「中額」這一有力的類型，此研究重新檢視在經典化且受尊崇的嚴肅文學，及未被經典化且被低估的通俗文學之間的交錯地帶。除了提出一個關於現代韓國文學的新系譜以挑戰雅俗文學的分野，也將側重現代韓國小說中的性別、青年文化、中產階級與女性主義想像。 本研究也將探索所謂「跨戰爭」或（二十）「世紀中」這一框架在韓國文化史的書寫上能具有的啟發性潛能。研究聚焦1930到1960年代，兼及受尊敬的作者與受歡迎的小說家所出版的通俗文學。藉由強調這時期的中額小說中得以獲得社會地位與呈現女性主義議題的主題，本研究指出通俗文學如何因此成為生活在帝國及冷戰資本主義下的中產階級、受過教育的女學生們、現代化的年輕主婦們性別表現的提點指南。同時，研究分析也將證明中額文學抗拒了老一輩，在年輕一代中開創了嶄新的青年文化。 這一計畫將說明在殖民地晚期和後殖民韓國的跨戰爭（二戰和冷戰）過渡期中，於韓國逐漸發展的印刷資本主義，如何推進了中額小說的興起，鼓勵受尊敬的小說家涉足受歡迎的中額主題。此外，本研究將展現仍有待釐清的經典化作者仍未經典化的通俗小說創作的出版、傳播、接受史，也將挖掘包含女性作者的「被遺忘」的小說家。預期研究成果將是一本（緒論和結論除外）由六個章節組成的學術專著，及兩篇頂級期刊論文，而探討的小說家將包括殖民地時期的李光洙、廉想涉、李泰俊、朴啓周，以及跨越1945的創作者如：金末鳳、崔貞熙、張德祚、鄭飛石、金來成。

17602322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17602322.value: 學童聲線治療研究計劃: 網上遙距模式與實體面授模式的成效比較

17602322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17602322.value: Dr Lo, Jacky F.-W. Dr Siu, Alice K.-Y.

17602322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17602322.value: Voice problems are common in children, with the majority of voice problems are associated with benign vocal fold lesions. The impacts of voice problems on the child are significant and should not be under-estimated. Encouraging evidence on the efficacy of behavioral voice therapy for children are available in the literature. Traditionally, voice therapy is delivered in-person in clinic. The clinician conducts voice therapy with children face-to-face in the session. Despite the encouraging evidence of voice therapy in alleviating voice problems in children, there are challenges and barriers that hinder cost-effective voice therapy implementation with children. The percentage of children seeking for voice therapy remains low and the drop-out rate is high. The recent COVID-19 pandemic outbreak poses further challenges to delivering voice therapy in clinic. Face-to-face consultation is not preferred due to social distancing requirements and the risk of disease spreading. Some parents have no alternative options but to postpone voice treatment for their children, which is not preferred. The long-existing barriers and the current (and possibly future) pandemic urge for alternative model of voice therapy delivery for children. One solution to solve the above-mentioned challenges is to deliver voice therapy online (or, telepractice). Use of telepractice in delivering therapy for individuals with communication disorders has gained popularity over the decade. This delivery mode has the benefits that it provides greater flexibility for both the clinician and the clients. It has become one of the delivery options for individuals who cannot attend clinics regularly due to geographical, personal and logistic constrains. This present proposal builds on our completed GRF-funded project on voice therapy with school-age children. This study aims to explore whether voice therapy delivered to children with benign vocal fold lesions via telepractice mode will bring comparable outcomes as the conventional face-to-face mode. A total of 46 children with benign vocal fold lesions will be recruited. They will be randomly allocated to receive voice therapy (vocal hygiene education with resonant voice training) via telepractice mode or face-to-face mode. It is expected that children receiving voice therapy via telepractice mode will demonstrate improvements in voice quality and voice-related quality of life, comparable to those receiving in-person voice therapy. This project addresses the need for additional research into the effectiveness of telepractice as the voice therapy delivery mode for children with benign vocal fold lesions. It provides much-needed empirical data for implementing telepractice for voice therapy with children. 兒童聲線問題非常普遍，大部分的聲線問題跟良性聲帶病變有關。改善兒童聲線問題以聲線（非手術）治療為主，透過遊戲和發聲練習改善聲線。傳統的聲線治療，言語治療師在診所內以實體面授模式與兒童進行聲線訓練。可是，儘管聲線治療已被証明能有效改善兒童的聲線問題，尋求聲線治療的兒童仍然不多。近年的COVID-19 大流行對在診所提供以實體面授模式的聲線治療帶來挑戰，包括社交距離的限制和疾病傳播的風險，一些家長只好選擇推遲他們的孩子接受聲線治療，但這樣會延遲孩子改善聲線的良機，不是理想的情況。這些誘因激起了發展其他模式以提供兒童聲線治療的需求。當中以網上治療模式常見，網上治療模式早於十多年前已開始用於為患有溝通障礙的人提供言語治療。這種治療模式的好處是言語治療師和病人不會因地理因素或其他個人、環境因素而無法定期就診，提供更大的靈活性。 本硏究建基於硏究團隊早前完成的另一個GRF 資助的聲線治療項目的研究結果，旨在探討網上聲線治療是否適用於患有良性聲帶病變的兒童及探討其成效。46 名患有良性聲帶病變的兒童將被隨機分配到其中一組：第一組會接受為期六個星期的聲線治療計劃，以網上形式進行；另一組會接受同樣的聲線治療計劃，以實體面授形式進行。兩組兒童將會就聲線質素和聲線相關生活質素作比較。這項硏究能為網上遙距模式提供的聲線治療效提供有用的數據。

17602622.label: Project Objectives

To defend a view about what a satisfactory answer to this question would involve, and to prepare research journal articles presenting the findings. To develop an argument that contemporary epistemologist’s rejection of epistemic instrumentalism depends on a misleading way of characterizing the aims and scope of first-order epistemic theorizing, and to prepare a research journal article presenting this argument. To explore the range of possible answers to the question of how to explain epistemic authority in terms of their adequacy on two fronts: how well they capture the potential psychological impact of epistemic requirements, and how well they capture the extension of epistemic requirements, and to prepare research journal articles presenting these findings. To explore the psychological and philosophical concepts of agential well-being and the epistemic concepts of truth, evidence, and knowledge, and to examine the probabilistic and psychological connections between these different concepts, and to prepare journal articles presenting the findings. To explore methodological and substantive connections between approaches to philosophical ethics and epistemology, and to prepare a journal article presenting the findings.

17602622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17602622.value: Epistemology is the area of philosophy concerned with questions about what we should believe. But: Why does it really matter what, epistemically speaking, we should believe? It can be tempting to reply: because that is what it would be epistemically right to believe! This reply will not do. The question concerns the authority, or legitimacy of epistemic standards. Compare: Etiquettologists tell us what we should etiquettically do. But: Why does it really matter that, etiquettically speaking, I should not cut in line at the store? It certainly doesn’t help to reply: because cutting in line is not polite! It also does not serve as a reply to point out that, for the most part, we can’t help but believe in the way epistemologists say we should believe. For example, most epistemologists agree that we should believe in accord with our evidence: if our evidence supports believing P, we should believe that P. And it is certainly very difficult (perhaps impossible) to deliberately believe contrary to what one takes one’s evidence to support. If I think my evidence entails that P, I’m (probably) going to believe that P. And importantly, that’s true whether or not there’s a story available about the legitimacy of epistemic standards that say that I should believe that P. But the fact that I’m almost certainly going to do something doesn’t explain why the demand that I do it is legitimate. Compare: I’m almost certainly not going to cut in line at the store. This doesn’t explain why a demand that I don’t cut in line has any kind of legitimate authority over me. My ambition in this project is to tackle this question concerning the explanation of epistemic authority. I think there’s a natural, straightforward answer to the question of why we should believe in the way it’s epistemically right to believe: we should do so because doing so makes us better off. This is the view I call epistemic instrumentalism. Epistemic instrumentalism is unpopular among contemporary epistemologists. But to date there’s been no systematic presentation of the view; so, its unpopularity is, I think, largely due to its being misunderstood. Among other things, I aim to present a new, systematic version of the view in its best light. I also aim to show how we can put that view to work for us in solving other longstanding problems in epistemology. 認識論是哲學領域，關注我們應該相信什麼的相關問題。但從認識論的角度來看，為什麼我們應該相信什麼是個重要的問題？ 有些人會回答：因為根據認識論這些都是我們應該接受的信念。不過，這不是一個好的答案。這個答案涉及知識標準的權威性或合法性。我們可以比較以下例子：禮儀學家告訴我們應該做什麼合乎禮儀的東西。但是：從禮儀上講，為什麼這真的很重要？為什麼我不應該在店裡插隊？如果有人回答：因為插隊是不禮貌的，這也肯定不是一個好的答案。 還有一個答案也不妥當：在大多數情況下，我們事實上相信的東西無可避免地正是認識論者說我們應該相信的東西。例如，大多數認識論者都同意我們的信念應該合符我們的證據：如果我們的證據支持 P，我們應該相信 P。事實上，我們很難（也許不可能）故意相信與證據相反的東西。如果我認為我的證據蘊含 P，我便（有可能）相信 P。更重要的是，無論認知標準合法性的真相如何，我都會這樣做。只是，我幾乎肯定會做一件事，並不能解釋為什麼我這樣做是正確的。比較：我幾乎肯定不會在商店插隊。這並不能解釋為何不插隊這個要求有什麼合理的權威性。 我在這個研究項目中的目標是解決關於解釋認知權威的問題。我認為有一個自然、直接的答案：我們應該這樣做，因為這樣做會讓我們過得更好。這個觀點我稱為「認識工具主義」。認知工具主義在當代認識論學者中不太受歡迎。但迄今為止，還沒有人嘗試有系統地分析這一個觀點。所以，我認為它不受歡迎的原因是很大程度上它被誤解了。我希望有系統地展示一個新而且是最好的認知工具主義版本，以及解釋如何運用這個理論來解決認識論中的一些由來已久的的問題。

17603022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17603022.value: Educational and psychological measurement is among the most important contributions of cognitive and behavioral sciences to modern society. In educational and psychological research, there are two typical measurement approaches: the exploratory approach, which is data-driven with little to no substantive knowledge, and the confirmatory approach, which is theory-driven that requires substantial a priori knowledge. In general, however, owing to the different amounts of substantive input that are available, the two approaches represent two extremes of the confirmatory-exploratory continuum. One traditional practice to relax the limitation is to apply post hoc model modification as a patchwork, which is suboptimal and problematic. Recent developments in statistical learning afford researchers greater flexibility in incorporating different amounts of available knowledge. More recently, the partially confirmatory factor analysis (PCFA) based on Bayesian learning methods has successfully conquered simultaneously two significant psychometric challenges for continuous data, namely, the regularization of loading structure and accommodation of local dependence. As a result, a much wider range of the substantive continuum can be covered, rendering traditional confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) a special case where no learning is involved. Building on the PCFA and item response theory (IRT) model, a partially confirmatory item response model (PCIRM) with similar Bayesian learning methods and functionality has been developed for dichotomous data. In combination, the PCFA and PCIRM have laid a strong foundation for a partially confirmatory approach to educational and psychological measurement that is sufficiently scalable to accommodate various psychometric frameworks such as factor analysis (FA) models, IRT models, and cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs). Although the partially confirmatory approach is promising, a number of important issues remain to be addressed for the framework to be versatile and comprehensive. In this project, three important extensions to the approach with different Bayesian learning methods are considered: 1) a partially confirmatory latent variable model (PCLVM) with both structural and measurement components which can model causal inference with latent variables and different levels of regularization; 2) partially confirmatory CDMs for diagnostic assessments; and 3) fully and partially exploratory FA for an unknown number of factors. Combined, they offer a comprehensive measurement framework that spans the confirmatory-exploratory continuum. Both simulation and real-data studies will be conducted to evaluate the robustness, accuracy, and practical usefulness of the proposed models across different scenarios. Computer programs that can implement the model procedures will also be developed and made available free-of-charge to researchers and practitioners. 教育和心理測量是認知和行為科學對現代社會最重要的貢獻之一。 在教育和心理學研究中，有兩種典型的測量方法：數據驅動的探索性方法不需要或幾乎不需要實質性知識；理論驅動的驗證性方法則需要大量的先驗知識。 然而，實際可用的知識可多可少，使得這兩種方法成为了驗證-探索連續维度上的兩個極端。 传统的补救措施是事後对模型进行补丁式的修改，但這是次優且有問題的。 統計學習的最新發展為研究人員整合不同數量的可用知識提供了更大的靈活性。最近，基於貝葉斯學習方法的部分驗證性因子分析（PCFA）成功地同時克服了针对連續數據的兩大測量学挑戰，即对载荷結構的正則化和容纳局部依賴性。该模型可以在驗證-探索連續维度上覆盖更廣泛的范围，并使得傳統的驗證性因子分析 (CFA) 成為不涉及統計學習的特例。基於 PCFA 和項目反應理論 (IRT) 模型，我们針對二元數據開發了具有類似貝葉斯學習方法和功能的部分驗證性項目反應模型 (PCIRM)。PCFA 和 PCIRM 結合起來能為教育和心理測量的部分驗證性方法奠定堅實的基礎，該方法具有足夠的可擴展性以適應各種測量框架，包括因子分析 (FA) 模型、IRT 模型和認知診斷模型 (CDM)等。 儘管部分驗證性方法很有发展前景，但做为测量框架仍未足够通用和全面，仍有許多重要問題需要解決。本項目基于不同的貝葉斯學習方法进行三個重要擴展：1）同时包含結構和測量組件的部分驗證性潛變量模型（PCLVM），可以基于潛變量和不同水平的正則化为因果推断建模； 2) 用於診斷評估的部分驗證性 CDM； 3) 允许未知數量因子的完全和部分探索性因子分析。这些方法結合起來提供了一個全面的測量框架，足以覆盖整个驗證-探索連續维度。本項目將進行模擬仿真和真實數據研究，以評估所提出模型在不同場景中的穩健性、準確性和實用性。我们還將開發可以實現模型的計算機程序，並免費提供給研究人員和從業人員。

17604022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17604022.value: 古代英國法典之語言與寫作風格

17604022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17604022.value: This project reassesses aspects of the origins and early development of English written law. It investigates the legal vocabulary of early English law codes, and evaluates the growth of English legislative style. These analyses are expected to reveal the significant interaction and mutual influence of legal and non-legal genres, and will establish a new paradigm for understanding how legislative language functioned within English legal culture in its formative centuries. Around seventy secular law codes survive from England’s pre-Conquest period (c.600-1066). These codes were produced by kings and officials across the period; among them are some of the earliest texts written in Old English. The corpus offers evidence of the early growth of legislative prose style and the use of legal language, as well as the development of English legal thought in its foundational centuries. In recent decades, commentators have brought a range of theoretical perspectives to the language and style of legislation, and have demonstrated their significant impact on public interactions with the law. At the same time, reassessments of early English legal culture have increasingly revealed its sophistication and diversity – while also demonstrating that scholarship on early legal text remains limited by reliance on outdated assumptions. No comprehensive examination of Old English legislative language has been undertaken since the early twentieth century, and studies of legislative style are few and limited in scope. In contrast to the illuminating critical approaches applied to literary narrative and poetry, analyses of law codes have rarely sought to develop broader arguments about their language, prose development, and impact on early English law and literature. To address these gaps in knowledge, I ask what the language of the law codes and the development of legislative style reveal about the beginnings of English law and written culture. Applying the perspectives of the law and literature discipline to these texts will challenge accepted narratives about their role, and generate a more sophisticated understanding of how legal concepts travel through (and are transformed by) non-legal textual genres. Dissemination via an online legal dictionary will establish and make widely accessible new knowledge about early legal language. Producing the first book-length study of legislative language and style in the law and literature discipline will shape larger ongoing debates about the function of legal language in Old English and the place of legislative style in early medieval English written culture. 該研究項目透過考察古代英國法典內的詞彙及分析其寫作風格的發展，重新檢視英國成文法律的起源及早期發展。項目不僅展示法律文體與非法律文學體裁的相互影響，並且探討法律語言在英國法律歷史及文化上發揮着甚麼作用。 現時大約有七十份古代英國（約600-1066年）的通俗法典倖存下來。這些法典是由當時的君王及官員所著，而當中包含了最早期的書面古英語。它們見證了不同類型的法律語言運用及寫作風格，同時亦提供有關早期英國法學思想演變的線索。 近年，古英語學者提出了不少關於法律語言及寫作風格之新觀點，並且展示出這些語言特色如何影響當時公眾對法律的參與。同時，學者亦相繼提出古代英國法律文化的複雜性和多樣化，並指出對此範疇的早期研究深受過時的思維所限。自二十世紀開始，學術界並沒有對古英語法律語言進行全面分析，而有關法典寫作風格的研究亦寥寥可數。相比起一般文學研究，法典研究項目鮮有探討語言及寫作特色等領域，亦甚少檢視法典對文學的深遠影響。 為了填補這些研究空白，本項目將集中探討古代英國法典的語言及寫作風格能揭示出甚麼英國法律及書寫文化的資訊。透過融合法學與文學角度作為分析基礎，本項目將重新審視法律與文學在文化歷史上扮演着什麼角色，以及深入了解法律概念如何融入非法律文學體裁（並在此等文體蛻變）。 本項目的研究成果將會透過網上法學字典發佈，以闡釋古英語法律語言的性質。此外，本項目亦會將研究結集成書，藉着對法典語言和寫作風格的分析，在法學與文學領域上作出貢獻：此書籍將討論古英語法律語言與法律寫作風格在古英國書寫文法上發揮着甚麼影響。

17604122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17604122.value: 重用老建築成當代藝術空間：遺產保護+文化孵育能匹配嗎？香港上海與新加坡的空間案例

17604122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17604122.value: Reusing Old Buildings for Contemporary Art: Heritage + Culture or Mismatch? Cases from Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Singapore proposes to critically examine, through eight spatial cases, the until-now little-questioned convergence of heritage and culture in the three regionally-competing East Asian cities. Constructions of cultural infrastructures, from concert halls to museum buildings, have been visible in Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Singapore in the past decades. Theorists dub such projects ‘cultural-led urban developments,’ positing them as part of the regional urban competition to attract capital and talent. The rise of cultural spaces has, since the mid-2000s, coincided with a turn amongst Global East urban authorities towards conserving old buildings, which demolition-redevelopment modernization has rapidly depleted. The National Gallery Singapore, Power Station of Art and Rockbund Museum, Shanghai, and Tai Kwun Contemporary, Hong Kong are prominent examples of these ‘adaptive reuse’ of historic architecture for contemporary art. The Cattle Depot in Hong Kong, M50 and West Bund in Shanghai, and the Gillman Barracks in Singapore also reuse old buildings for visual art functions. Proponents tout these projects as satisfying both culture-led development and heritage conservation. Yet, their physical and institutional compatibilities of culture and heritage remains unevaluated. Studies of the reuse of old buildings for new cultural functions in Asian cities have, to date, been largely textual, and if visual, photographic. The proposed study, in the form of a manual, uses measured drawings at the urban to architectural scales to document and analyze how historic structures of different origins and uses are repurposed for contemporary art. Bringing together form and function--the form being buildings, and the function being contemporary art—the drawings reveal how art practices interact and intersect with the buildings within which they have been placed, and the accommodations and frictions that arise from these pairings. Constructing genealogies of each case will unpack the historical as well as contemporary processes and drivers for the reuses. The dual mode of analysis will show the compatibilities and dissonances that these contemporary pairings of ‘heritage’ and ‘culture’ generate. This project builds on existing discourses in urban studies, architecture, and visual art. It will contribute specificity to the existing discourse on culture-led urban development, as well as to the nascent study of contemporary visual arts developments in the Global East. 摘要 “重用老建築成當代藝術空間：遺產保護+文化孵育能匹配嗎？香港上海與新加坡的空間案例”本課題通過在東亞地區這三座頗有競爭性的城市裡的八個空間案例，考察研究了一個至今還沒有被質疑過的關於遺產保護和文化產業發展是否能合拍的問題。 近十幾年來，在香港、上海和新加坡，文化設施的開發建造，從音樂廳到博物館大樓，都是有目共睹的。城市理論家把這些現象稱之為‘文化導向型的都市發展’，也是都市競爭策略中吸引人才和資金的重要部分。從2000年代中期開始，文化空間的上升恰巧發生在正好與一些東亞城市當局對老建築保護加強關注的同一個時間點上。之前，大尺度拆遷主導的城市開發曾導致了大批老舊房子快速的消失。新加坡國家美術館，上海當代藝術博物館和上海的外灘美術館，和香港的大館都是歷史建築重新利用與藝術空間的傑出案例。香港的牛棚藝術村，上海的M50和西岸，以及新加坡的基爾曼軍營藝術區也同樣把視覺藝術功能加註到老建築裡。支持者們將這些項目說成為滿足了以文化為主導的發展和遺產保護這兩個方面。然而，從文化和遺產的實體和制度上的兼容性問題仍未得到評估。 雖然有越來越多的空間案例，可是對老建築裡注入新的文化功能的研究在亞洲城市大多以文本分析為主，即便有視覺化方式的分析，也大多僅插置一些照片而已。此研究課題將以手冊的形式，採用建築與城市尺度的測繪圖為主要工具，來紀錄並分析這些有歷史性的但來源於不同時代、不同功能、不同結構的建築，怎麼被重新修繕並得以被作為當代藝術服務的空間。把建築空間的形式和當代藝術的功能放在一起，這些測繪圖可以更清楚的顯示出當代藝術創作展覽等實踐是怎麼在這些建築空間裡策劃安排置放的，也能體現出空間和藝術功能的互相容納和可能的衝突。每個案例的演變歷程也會進一步地剖析這些重新利用的動機，開發的過程和與歷史來源的關係。這兩種方式的分析可以呈現出當下把遺產保護和文化孵育放在一起所產生的兼容性和不協調性。 本項目建立在已有的關於城市建築和視覺藝術方面的學術論述上,也必將會對‘文化導向型的都市發展’的現有研究框架以及東亞當代藝術發展的最新探索作出更確切具有地域性的貢獻。 Abstract "Reusing Old Buildings for Contemporary Art: Heritage + Culture or Mismatch? 17604322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17604322.value: 心理學視角下的美學理想主義：近代日本文學形成中的種族、性別和美

17604522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17604522.value: 荀子的後設倫理學和後設倫理學中的構建主義

17604522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17604522.value: This project aims to investigate Xunzi’s metaethics along the line of metaethical constructivism. Metaethical constructivism is primarily concerned with the foundational issues of ethics such as the objectivity and sources of normativity of ethical values. Unlike moral skepticism, metaethical constructivism tends to affirm the objectivity and normativity of ethical values. Unlike moral realism, metaethical constructivism justifies ethical values not on an order of facts independent of human beings, but on human activities, in particular our practical reasoning. As such metaethical constructivism promises to explain and justify the objectivity and normativity of ethical values without recourse to controversial metaphysical claims. Among the pre-Qin Confucian masters, Xunzi provides the most detailed accounts of Heaven, human nature and the origin of rituals. The texts of Xunzi thus contain some of the most valuable resources for understanding and resolving foundational issues of Confucian ethics, such as the ultimate sources of Confucian values and whether such values are objective, truth-apt, and universally valid. Xunzi himself explicitly suggests that ethical norms are something created and constructed by the sages, and he frequently employs analogies of artificial creation to explain the origin of ethical norms. Xunzi also suggests that Confucian ethics embodies the human way rather than the Heavenly way and insists that Confucian ethics is based not on properties of Heaven that are independent of and prior to human beings, but rather on reactions of human beings to the world. As such Xunzi’s metaethics bears a close affinity with metaethical constructivism. Through an interpretation and reconstruction of Xunzi’s metaethics, not only can we gain a better understanding of the foundation of Confucian ethics, but also that we can possibly offer an alternative understanding of metaethical constructivism. 本計劃將從後設倫理學的構建主義此一進路來考察荀子的後設倫理學。後設倫理學的構建主義關懷的是倫理學中的基礎問題，如倫理價值的客觀性及其規範性來源等。不同於道德懷疑論者，後設倫理學的構建主義認為倫理價值有規範性和客觀性。不同於道德實在論者，構建主義認為倫理價值的依據並不在於獨立於人類的事實，而是和人類活動，特別是實踐理性息息相關。基於此，構建主義希望在排除可疑的形上學立場的懂況下，為倫理價值的客觀性和規範性提供解釋和證立。 在先秦儒學之中，荀子對於天、人性和禮之根源等問題提供了最詳細的解釋。荀子文本因此提供了豐富的資源，以供我們瞭解和解決儒家倫理學的基礎問題，譬如儒學價值的終極基礎，這些價值是否客觀，是否普遍適用，其相關命題是否有真假可言等。荀子指出倫理規範是聖人所創設和構建，並且他經常以工藝製造來類比價值規範的設立。荀子亦認為儒家倫理體現的是人道而非天道，他並且強調儒家倫理所依據的並非獨立和先在於人類的天之特質，而是依於人類對於其所處世界的回應。以此看來，荀子的後設倫理學和後設倫理學的構建主義有許多相通之處。通過對荀子後設倫理學的詮釋和重構，我們不但能對儒家倫理學的基礎有更深瞭解，亦可能對後設倫理學的構建主義提出另一種理解。

17605122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17605122.value: 部分睡眠剝奪對消極情緒飲食影響的實驗研究

17605122.label: Project Objectives
17605122.value: Primary Objective: To examine the effects of three nights of five-hour experimentally induced partial sleep deprivation (PSD) compared to three nights of normal sleep condition (NSC) on negative emotional eating (NEE) in the laboratory setting and in naturalistic environments. Hypothesis 1A: Participants will engage in increased NEE measured in an ad-libitum food consumption task in the laboratory following PSD compared to NSC. Hypothesis 1B: Participants will engage in increased NEE in naturalistic environments measured using ecological momentary assessments following PSD compared to NSC. Secondary Aim: To examine the effects of three nights of five-hour PSD compared to three nights of NSC on hunger-driven homeostatic eating, pleasure-driven hedonic eating, and cue-elicited habitual eating, assessed by the Pavlovian-instrumental transfer paradigm, in people with pre-existing tendencies to NEE. Hypothesis 2: Sleep will moderate the interactions between hedonic, homeostatic, and habitual eating such that individuals would engage in greater hedonic and habitual eating compared to homeostatic eating following PSD compared to NSC.
rows: Primary Objective: To examine the effects of three nights of five-hour experimentally induced partial sleep deprivation (PSD) compared to three nights of normal sleep condition (NSC) on negative emotional eating (NEE) in the laboratory setting and in naturalistic environments. Hypothesis 1A: Participants will engage in increased NEE measured in an ad-libitum food consumption task in the laboratory following PSD compared to NSC. Hypothesis 1B: Participants will engage in increased NEE in naturalistic environments measured using ecological momentary assessments following PSD compared to NSC.

Secondary Aim: To examine the effects of three nights of five-hour PSD compared to three nights of NSC on hunger-driven homeostatic eating, pleasure-driven hedonic eating, and cue-elicited habitual eating, assessed by the Pavlovian-instrumental transfer paradigm, in people with pre-existing tendencies to NEE. Hypothesis 2: Sleep will moderate the interactions between hedonic, homeostatic, and habitual eating such that individuals would engage in greater hedonic and habitual eating compared to homeostatic eating following PSD compared to NSC.

17605122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17605122.value: Insufficient sleep is a risk factor of obesity, but the underlying causal mechanisms between sleep and obesity are not fully understood. Preliminary evidence suggests that negative emotional eating (NEE) might mediate the influence of sleep deprivation on the risk of obesity. NEE, defined as compulsive eating behavior in reaction to negative arousal states including negative mood states and stress, is a predictor of future obesity. To evaluate if NEE is a mediating mechanism, we must first establish that sleep deprivation causes increased NEE. However, to date, experimental studies on the effects of sleep deprivation on NEE are non-existent. Previous studies conducted by the PI have shown that experimentally-induced sleep deprivation could moderate the interplay between homeostatic eating (eating for hunger), hedonic eating (eating for pleasure), and habitual eating (cue-elicited eating), measured using the adapted Pavlovian-instrumental transfer (PIT) paradigm. As expected, sleep deprivation was found to elevate hedonic eating over homeostatic eating. However, contrary to expectations, habitual eating diminished following sleep deprivation. Nonetheless, these pioneering studies have been conducted only in healthy individuals without any disordered eating behavior. The effects of sleep deprivation on habitual eating might be elevated only in people who have pre-existing tendencies to overeat in response to negative arousal states, i.e., those with tendencies to NEE. These individuals are especially at-risk for obesity and constitute a significant proportion of community-dwelling adults. Hence, a randomized crossover study is proposed to examine the effects of experimentally-induced sleep deprivation on NEE and the interaction between homeostatic, hedonic, and habitual eating in adults with pre-existing tendencies to NEE. Participants will undergo three nights of partial sleep deprivation (PSD) and three nights of normal sleep condition (NSC), sequenced in a randomized order with a three-day washout period in between. It is hypothesized that participants will exhibit a greater degree of NEE in both laboratory and naturalistic settings following PSD than NSC, and that sleep will alter the interaction between homeostatic, hedonic, and habitual eating such that PSD, compared to NSC, would elevate both habitual and hedonic eating over homeostatic eating. We expect that the findings will provide novel insight into the causal effects of sleep deprivation on NEE and shed light on the understanding of the mechanisms by which insufficient sleep can lead to an increased risk of obesity. If sleep deprivation elevates NEE, NEE could be an intervention target in the prevention and management of obesity among people who are sleep deprived. 睡眠不足是肥胖的一個危險因素，但睡眠與肥胖之間的潛在因果機制尚不完全清楚。初步證據顯示，負面情緒化飲食（NEE）可能在睡眠不足與肥胖風險的關係中有中介作用。 NEE，定義為回應負面情緒狀態和壓力等喚醒狀態而作出的強迫性飲食行為，是增加肥胖風險的因素。為了評估 NEE 是否在睡眠不足與肥胖風險的關係中有中介作用，我們必須首先確定睡眠剝奪會增加NEE 。然而，迄今為止，還沒相關實驗研究。 本研究主理人之前進行的研究顯示，實驗引起的睡眠剝奪可以影響穩態飲食（為飢餓而吃的機制）、享樂飲食（為快樂而吃的機制）和習慣性飲食（由提示引發的飲食）之間的相互作用。然而，與預期相反，睡眠剝奪後習慣性飲食減少。儘管如此，這些開創性研究僅在沒有任何飲食行為紊亂的健康成年人中進行。睡眠剝奪對習慣性飲食的影響可能僅在那些有 NEE 傾向的人才會起作用。 因此，本計劃會針對研究在具有 NEE 傾向的成年人中，睡眠剝奪對 NEE的影響、及睡眠剝奪如何改變穩態、享樂和習慣性飲食之間的相互關係。參與者將經曆三個晚上的部分睡眠剝奪（PSD）和三個晚上的正常睡眠條件（NSC），以隨機順序排序，中間有三天的清除期。我們假設參與者在 PSD 後在實驗室和自然環境中都表現出比 NSC 更高程度的 NEE，並且 PSD 會改變穩態、享樂和習慣性飲食之間的相互作用--與 NSC 相比，PSD 會提高習慣性飲食和享樂飲食多於穩態飲食。 我們希望研究結果將為睡眠剝奪對 NEE 的因果影響提供新的見解，並加深睡眠不足導致肥胖風險增加的機制的理解。這些知識可以用來改善預防及治療肥胖。

17605222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17605222.value: 中國反腐的政治邏輯：多重目標間的競爭、衝突與妥協

17605222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17605222.value: 本研究旨在探究中國反腐敗的潛在政治邏輯。關於中國反腐往往縈繞了許多問題，例如，背後的真正動機，為什麼某些行為、官員或部門在不同時期成為目標。這些問題很多在本質上是由反腐敗的波動而引發的。中國反腐敗的波動至少表現在三個方面：1）在中國共產黨政權的不同時期腐敗概念的內涵存在模糊性，並且充滿變動； 2）反腐倡廉的力度在不同時期強弱波動； 3)反腐的注意力會跨政策領域轉移。我們該如何解釋中國反腐的這種波動性呢？ 目前關於腐敗的文獻沒有對這個問題提供一個完整的解釋。本研究提出在目標多重性的前提下來研究這一問題。核心理論如是：政府經常將多個政治和政策目標加載到其反腐敗努力中，這使得反腐不再是簡單打擊腐敗而是載有多種目的。當目標相互競爭和衝突時，政府會根據其他政治和政策目標的重要性來決定打擊腐敗在政策議程中的優先級，並確定打擊腐敗的內容、時間和方式以及打擊對象。有三組政治和政策目標長期以來尤為影響中國腐敗概念的變換、反腐敗強度的變動，和反腐敗注意力的分配，它們是a) 中國共產黨鞏固政權合法性的宏偉政治目標，b) 經濟改革的指導性政策目標，以及 c) 政治精英的個人目標。 本研究的數據涵蓋從中國共產黨成立初期到當前中國的漫長時間，研究將採用定性與定量混合方法。定性部分將評估大量政府文件、領導人講話和論文、老幹部回憶錄以及對學者和知情人的採訪，以確定複雜歷史背景下的因果關係。在定量方面，將使用帶有結構主題建模的機器學習來挖掘文檔以進行客觀解釋，並進行統計分析以進行嚴格的假設檢驗。 本研究建基於項目主理人長期的研究積累。它將通過系統地解開中國的反腐敗邏輯提供一個理論框架來推進學術研究。本研究也將成為少有的能夠將中國共產黨不同時代的反腐工作聯繫在一個統一框架下的研究。它還會將目前的學術關注引向之前缺乏研究卻又深刻影響政府治理質量的反腐敗政治這個研究議題上。 研究成果將是一本書和兩篇高質量的期刊文章。研究成果還將為中國、香港和其他國家的政策制定、商業和教育部門提供信息。

17606122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17606122.value: 緬甸衝突期間人口精神健康的演變和決定因素：由2021 年至 2025 年的全國縱向研究

17606122.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17606122.value: Dr Aung, Yadanar Prof Chang, Wing Chung Miss Ma, Sze Wai Tiffany Dr Thin Zaw, Phyu Phyu Prof Tun, Hein Min

17606122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606122.value: The mental health consequences of mass conflicts or epidemics have each been of great concern. For the first time in a century, conflict settings are concurrently confronted by a pandemic at the scale of COVID-19. Yet the mental health of populations subjected to conflict, a pandemic and other population shocks are largely unassessed. The United Nations has highlighted the ‘triple crises’ of conflict, uncontrolled COVID-19 epidemic, and economic collapse in Myanmar since the military takeover in February 2021. We established a nationwide random sample in Myanmar during the early stages of the conflict to assess the immediate mental health impact. This showed that one in three adults in Myanmar had a probable mental disorder, exceeding levels observed in conflict settings worldwide. With the state of emergency extended to at least 2023, updated assessments of population mental health in Myanmar are critical. Our proposed study will leverage our nationwide random sample in Myanmar to conduct a total of five survey waves throughout the conflict from 2021 to 2025 and achieve the following objectives:- 1. To assess the evolution of population mental health in Myanmar during the syndemic of mass conflict, COVID-19, economic crisis, and health system collapse. 2. To assess the health care needs and barriers in Myanmar during the conflict. 3. To identify the risk and mitigating factors in a conflict-setting using the diathesis-stress model and to estimate the population attributable fraction for common mental disorders attributable to key modifiable factors during the Myanmar conflict. The mental health burden in Myanmar and conflict-induced humanitarian crises is likely substantial yet often overlooked even when the majority of individuals in low-to-middle-income countries state that mental health is more important than physical health for an individual’s wellbeing. The proposed study is uniquely positioned to draw attention to the intermediate and long-term mental health burden of the conflict. If stakeholders would recognise the profound impact on population health, this may potentially help accelerate the peace process in Myanmar. During the conflict, our study could help health providers and NGOs to address unmet health needs by identifying the barriers to health care access. Population attributable fractions will also be used to estimate the potential reductions of common mental health disorders in Myanmar if prevailing population determinants were addressed. This could carry important implications for priority setting and programme planning by humanitarian organisations and service providers in Myanmar as well as conflict settings elsewhere. 大規模的衝突或是流行病對精神健康的影響一直非常重大並且令人極為關切。受衝突影響的地方百年來首次同時面臨像新冠肺炎這種規模的大流行疫情。然而，同時經歷衝突、大流行疫情及其他重大人口事件的人群的精神健康在很大程度上尚未得到評估。 聯合國強調緬甸自 2021 年 2 月的軍事接管以來，一直面對著衝突、不加控制的新冠肺炎疫情以及瀕臨經濟崩潰的「三重危機」。我們於衝突的初期在緬甸建立了一個全國性的隨機樣本，以評估對國民精神健康的即時影響。調查結果顯示緬甸三分之一的成人疑似患有精神疾病，遠超全球衝突環境中觀察到的精神健康水平。由於緬甸現時的緊急狀態將會至少延長至 2023 年，有關緬甸人口精神健康的最新評估至關重要。我們提議的研究將利用我們在緬甸的全國性隨機樣本，於 2021 年至 2025 年的衝突期間進行共五輪調查，從而達致以下目的： 1. 評估在大規模衝突、新冠肺炎疫情、經濟危機和醫療系統崩潰期間，緬甸人口精神健康的演變。 2. 評估緬甸國民在衝突期間對醫療服務的需求和獲取醫療服務的障礙。 3. 基於素質—壓力模型(diathesis-stress model) 找出衝突環境中有關精神疾病的風險及保護因素，並計算於緬甸衝突期間可歸因於這些可改變因素的常見精神疾病的比例。 在緬甸及衝突引發的人道主義危機當中的人群的精神健康負擔可能很大但往往被忽視，即使中低收入國家的大多數人表示精神健康比身體健康對個人健康更重要。我們提議的研究的獨特之處在於可以引起人們對衝突可造成的中期及長期精神健康負擔的關注。如利益相關者能夠了解到衝突對人口健康的深遠影響，這項研究可能有助加速緬甸邁向和平的進程。在衝突期間，透過找出獲取醫療服務的障礙，我們的研究將有助醫療服務提供者和非政府組織解決未獲滿足的醫療需求。我們亦會使用人群歸因分數（population attributable fraction）去計算在現時盛行的可改變因素被干預之後，緬甸的常見精神疾病可減少的比例。這可能對緬甸和其他衝突環境的人道主義組織和服務提供者在確定優先次序及方案規劃方面帶來重要影響。

17606222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17606222.value: 天空小說：香港五六十年代流行文化新類型的廣播劇研究

17606222.label: Project Objectives
17606222.value: Delineate the trans-regional production and distribution of radio-drama in the postwar Hong Kong. This includes the popularization of single-person narration radio drama in Guangzhou in the 1940s, how this was brought to postwar Hong Kong and Macau, and the rise of dramatized fiction in Hong Kong since the mid-1950s. Summarize, categorize and analyze the content of radio drama. Titles and different genres of radio drama will be listed from sources such as Rediffusion magazines, pulp fiction and Cantonese films. Popular plays will then be identified and the reasons for their popularity will be outlined. The differences between single-person narration and dramatized fiction will be compared. Scripts by female writers will also be examined for their gender and sociological perspectives. Use available online radio plays to illustrate how they were broadcast. Explore the issue of transmedia production by comparing the same radio plays in the formats of novel and film. The narrator’s voice in films will be compared with that used in radio broadcasting. Broaden our understanding of the soundscape in Hong Kong during the 1950s and 1960s. This includes examining the connection between the radio medium and the everyday life of the audience, the kind of cultural identity the medium established and how it was affected by Cold War politics and cultural policies.
