17606222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17606222.value: Before TV rose to popularity in the 1970s, radio served as the mainstream public entertainment medium. It built the collective memory and helped to shape the cultural identity of Hong Kong society during the 1950s and 1960s. Radio study is essential to our understanding of the popular culture of postwar Hong Kong. The ephemeral quality of sound means, however, that it has been a rarely addressed field of study. This project focuses on the radio drama of Hong Kong during the 1950s and 1960s. Referred to as Sky Fiction (Tiankong xiaoshuo), it takes two forms. The form of single-person narration was brought to Hong Kong by popular announcers, such as Lei Ngor, from Guangzhou in the 1940s. Since the mid-1950s, another form of dramatized fiction (Xijuhua xiaoshuo) rose to popularity and attracted a bigger audience with its well-structured plots, vivid dialogues, diversified characters, and concrete sociological references. Innovative female announcers and scriptwriters, such as Ngai Mun, contributed to this new narrative genre. The technological advancement of the transistor radio also led to the individualized programs. Radio drama was one of the main sources of film adaptation, and sky fiction film (Tiankong xiaoshuo pian) existed as a unique phenomenon in the history of Cantonese cinema. Radio drama thus provides a useful interdisciplinary perspective to reflect on critical theoretical issues including sound culture, narrative forms and modern media, female writing, transmedia adaptations, as well as the trans-regional production and distribution of popular culture in the Greater Bay Area and Southeast Asia. I am assured by my preliminary survey that there is rich material to explore in this field; this includes oral histories, online audio files of original radio dramas, radio magazines, novel adaptations, and film adaptations. As a technologized cultural product, can radio drama be considered as a new narrative genre? How can it be distinguished from traditional storytelling and print narratives? How were trans-regional elements included in both the story content and distribution of radio drama in 1950s and 1960s Hong Kong? How did women scriptwriters contribute to this genre and finally, how did its narrative form influence Cantonese film during the transmedia adaptation process? These are some of the crucial questions that this project aims to address. Articulated through radio waves, the acoustic dramas of “Sky Fiction”, in historical retrospect, are cultural refractions of the emerging urban modernity of Hong Kong in the 1950’s and 1960’s.

17607022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17607022.value: 探索古代近東地勢：亞美尼亞的人類居所模式和預計的土地與資源應用

17607022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17607022.value: Prof Cobb, Elvan Dr Kaplan, Jed Oliver

17607022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607022.value: This project examines how humans have interacted with and transformed their local environment and how that environment has reciprocally influenced life in the Vedi river valley of Armenia. This research maps and analyzes settlement spatial patterns, land use, and resource exploitation in the valley across multiple periods of human occupation. By connecting the fertile Ararat plain to the west with the resource rich Gegham mountains to the east, this valley hosts both transregional mobility and diverse local lived experiences. This project applies a landscape archaeological approach and interdisciplinary methods to address three research topics. First, preserved evidence for recent preindustrial land use supports modeling human-landscape relationships and adaptation in the more distant past. Second, the extended chronology of human occupation enables an investigation of how changing political regimes, both local and remote, variably influenced the location and layout of settlements and the related use of surrounding land. Finally, a detailed examination of the spatially defined utilization of resources within and around select settlements demonstrates how humans interacted with their proximate landscape differently through variations in elevation, climate, and natural resources that traverse the valley. This project builds on prior archaeological fieldwork that began in 2019 as the Ararat Plain Southeast Archaeological Project (APSAP), a collaboration between the University of Hong Kong and the Armenian Institute for Archaeology and Ethnography. As the first major archaeological project in the Vedi river valley, and as one of the first large-scale ancient Near Eastern (ANE) field projects led from east Asia, APSAP is filling in a gap in knowledge about this part of the ANE to shed light on how people lived in the landscape of the Vedi river valley in the past. The fieldwork has mapped many new sites across the valley, both premodern and villages abandoned during the 20th century CE, thus highlighting the potential for this new research direction. APSAP’s excavation at the valley’s main site indicates intensive local human activity through multiple periods stretching back at least 5000 years, thus providing a stratigraphic sequence for characterizing sites across the ca1000km2 survey area. This new project combines a historical survey of the abandoned villages with remote sensing, surface survey, and geophysics of premodern sites and the scientific analyses of plants and soils in order to trace past local land use. The multidisciplinary team will thus contribute detailed information about the South Caucasus to scholarly debates about global human-environment interactions through time. 此項目正研究人類如何與當地環境互相影響和改變，分析亞美尼亞Vedi河谷（Vedi river valley）的周遭環境如何影響在地生命。這份研究地圖分析了不同人類時期河谷內的居所地域分布、土地用途和資源開發程度。由肥沃的阿拉臘平原（Ararat plain）的西面至資源豐富的Gegham山脈（Gegham mountains）的東面，這範圍內的河谷擁有跨區流動性和多樣的生活經驗。從景觀考古學和跨學科研究中可發展岀三個考察主題。第一，保存近代工業化前的土地可支持建構更遠古時人類與地貌的關係和互相適應的過程。其次，更久遠的人類生活年表有助研究當，不論是當地或周邊的，政治局勢改變時，會從何方面影響居所的地點與分布和周邊的土地應用。第三，仔細分析居所處和附近以地區性劃分的資源使用率，可得出人類在不同的海拔、氣侯和天然資源的情況下如何與橫跨河谷位置的地形互動。 這項目為2019年開始的亞拉臘平原東南考古項目（Ararat Plain Southeast Archaeological Project (APSAP)）實地考察的延伸，由香港大學與亞美尼亞考古學與民族誌研究所（Armenian Institute for Archaeology and Ethnography）合作。作為第一個東亞主導的大型古代近東考古實地考察項目，亞拉臘平原東南考古項目擴展了對古代近東的了解，窺探古代居住在Vedi河谷地形內的人的生活型態。通過實地考察，更多Vedi河谷範圍內未被挖掘的遺址被定位岀來，遺址包括現代化前和20世紀時被荒廢的村落。這些遺址的發現強調了這新研究方向的潛力。亞拉臘平原東南考古項目位於Vedi河谷的主挖掘地點發現了大量本地人類活動的證據，分別來自不同時期，最遠可追溯到5000年前。由此可提供層序地層去辨認分布在約1000平方公里已勘探區域內的遺址。這新項目結合了遙測、地表探勘、地球物理探勘的方法，對現代化前已被廢棄的村落進行歷史調查；並對植物和泥土進行科學分析，以追溯古時的土地用途。這隊由多學科組成的小組將對於不同時期全球人類與環境的相互影響方面，補充有關南高加索人的詳盡資料。

17607522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17607522.value: 健聽人士學習香港手語的二語習得學習偏向

17607522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17607522.value: Prof Emmorey, Karen Mr Getzie, Gabriel Dr Sehyr, Zed Sevcikova

17607522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607522.value: 健聽人士學習第二語言時會依賴第一語言的語音、詞彙、文法等等的內隱知識。然而，如果不能應用這些知識呢？健聽人士學習手語作為第二語言時，正是面對這一種情況。主要語言經驗是口語的人，究竟是如何習得只有手語、沒有口語的第二語言呢？學界對此問題目前仍然沒有共識。我們研究專題的主要目的是瞭解健聽人士如何習得香港手語（HKSL）作為第二語言。具體而言，我們集中研究學習偏向（learning bias）對學習香港手語的影響。學習偏向的一例是結構偏誤（structural bias）：學習者往往偏向特徵簡單的音韻結構，而非特徵複雜的結構。雖然學習偏向對口語習得影響的研究甚為廣泛，但對手語習得的影響則仍然未有探討。 我們就此建議一項縱向研究，解答學習偏向如何影響香港手語的二語習得的問題。簡單而言，此縱向研究使用多角度錄影，拍攝耳聾手語導師在沉浸式課程中，「一對一」教授母語為廣東話的健聽人士的教學過程。導師會在十二個星期的時間內每週會見學生兩次，按照香港手語專業培訓中心（Professional Sign Language Training Centre）訂立的課程，向其教授手語。是次研究將密切地記錄從未接觸過手語的健聽人士。這一種縱向研究是前所未有的。我們會在取得的錄影中，按照音韻對比、手形複雜性、學生的手語語誤等等的因素進行標籤。由此產生的數據庫可以應用於詳盡的語誤分析，從而評估學習偏向如何影響香港手語的二語習得。而且，數據庫將以開放取用方式發佈，讓有興趣的研究人員探討手語的實時及/或縱向教育法。 我們的研究專題有兩個影響途徑：為研發香港手語的自動翻譯器作出貢獻；及為健聽人士的手語教學法作出研究貢獻。就前者而言，我們研究中將會使用機械學習的方式來偵測及分析手語語誤，並將所得數據用以訓練手語翻譯模型。就後者而言，我們專注探討常見的語誤，利用圖表勾畫語誤隨着時間的演變，並就此提出修正建議，讓導師加以應用，及令手語學生更深入認識常犯的語誤。

17608422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608422.value: 當政見分歧變成道德差異：利用線上下數據研究政見和道德差異對家庭的影響

17608422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17608422.value: Dr Chan, Christian Shaunlyn Mr Lam, Calvin Ka Yu Miss Yu, Branda Yee Man

17608422.label: Project Objectives
17608422.value: Examine the influence of political and moral incongruity, and their interaction, on familial conflicts and relational outcomes among young adults and their parents. Corroborate and integrate evidence from big data, self-report questionnaire data, and in-depth qualitative data to understand the dynamic relationship between political, moral incongruity, and family conflicts and relational outcomes among young adults and their parents.
rows: Examine the influence of political and moral incongruity, and their interaction, on familial conflicts and relational outcomes among young adults and their parents.

Corroborate and integrate evidence from big data, self-report questionnaire data, and in-depth qualitative data to understand the dynamic relationship between political, moral incongruity, and family conflicts and relational outcomes among young adults and their parents.

17608422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608422.value: Political incongruity brought great social chasm and mass clashes during the 2019 Anti-Extradition Bill Movement in Hong Kong and its aftermath. Such chasm is also apparent among family members, especially between younger and older generations, leading to familial conflicts and, in turn, mental health problems. Some families have fared better than others. What are the factors that contributed to and exacerbated seemingly irreconcilable conflict? We propose that moral foundations theory may help to explain why some families can withstand political differences and some do not. This mixed-method study aims to determine the impact of political and moral incongruence on family conflicts during and three to five years after the Anti- Extradition Bill Movement from both the youth and parents’ perspectives. The proposed study consists of three studies: Study 1 is a text mining study of popular online forums for content that reveals users' time-dependent reactions regarding the dynamics between political incongruity-related family conflicts. Study 2 is a two-wave prospective questionnaire augmented with a month-long experience sampling study targeting young adults and their parents from families with political incongruence for examining the antecedents and consequences of political and moral incongruence. Study 3 is a qualitative study with young adults and their parents to explore how different moral values might act as vulnerability and protective factors of family conflicts associated with political incongruence and coping strategies. Current findings will provide insight into the dynamics among political views, moral foundations, and familial conflicts, in the context of social unrest and generational differences. By doing so, the study will contribute to a better understanding of family vulnerability and resilience in response to political differences. 2019 年香港反送中運動以來，政見差異帶來了巨大的社會矛盾和衝突。家庭中年輕與老一代之間的鴻溝特別顯著，導致家庭衝突，甚至心理健康問題。有些家庭的情況比其他家庭好。是什麼因素促成和加劇了分歧？"道德基礎理論"可能有助於解釋為什麼有些家庭可以承受政治分歧而有些家庭則不能。 此項混合研究旨在從青年和父母的角度理解政治和道德觀差異對反送中運動期間和之後三到五年為家庭帶來的影響。此項目包括三方面的研究： 研究 1 透過挖掘網上論壇內容，揭示網友對政見分歧引生的家庭衝突的意見和反應。研究 2 是一項問卷以及為期一個月的經驗抽樣研究，針對來自政見不一的家庭的年輕人及其父母，以審視政見和道德分歧的前因後果。研究 3 是一項針對年輕人及其父母的質性研究，旨在探索不同的道德價值觀如何帶來政治分歧和影響家庭衝突。 此研究結果將有助深入了解社會動盪和世代差異下的政見、道德分歧如何加劇家人之間的衝突。通過此研究，我們能更有效協助家庭應對不和，改善關係。

17608522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608522.value: 年輕網絡游戲玩家的網絡游戲剖面的轉變以及與尋求幫助和自殺風險的關聯:混合研究

17608522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608522.value: Internet gaming has become a prevalent lifestyle with increased gaming usage reported among young people in the modern digital era. Excessive gaming behaviors could lead to gaming addiction defined as Internet gaming disorder (IGD) in the DSM-5. There are prominent concerns about gaming addiction in Asian countries such as China and South Korea. There exist discrepancies in the cutoff point among current studies that bias the prevalence and understanding of IGD. Empirical studies are needed to advance our knowledge of this phenomenon and distinguish among the normal, problematic, and pathological gamers. Suicide rates among the young are persistently on the rise despite clinical & policy efforts. Though internet gaming could be a potential factor in the development of suicidal behaviors, their temporal relationships have yet to be examined in a longitudinal study. The long-term effects of internet gaming habits on their suicidal trajectory have yet to be understood. The potential benefit has yet to be explored. Internet gaming have multiple facets such as gaming motivation, gaming genres, gaming time, and social outcomes. These aspects could play a moderating role in the etiology of gaming addiction and its implications on suicidality from suicidal ideation to suicide planning and suicide attempt. Yet, no existing studies have taken into account the potential effects of these multiple facets of internet gaming through a holistic investigation. Help-seeking behaviors could be potential protective factors against escalating ideation and subsequent actions. It would be of clinical interest to find out in what conditions individuals with gaming addiction would seek for help and to have a better understanding of the rationale among the internet gamers who were not able or willing to seek help. The proposed research comprises a longitudinal, 4-wave study that tracks the trajectories in gaming profiles and suicidal risks of young internet gamers in Hong Kong over 1.5 year. The aims of this study are to examine the latent classes and transition of gaming and social withdrawal behaviors and their associated psychosocial factors; investigate the longitudinal associations between internet gaming and suicidality and build prediction models on suicidality via nomogram risk assessments using gaming characteristics; and evaluate the associated factors of help-seeking behaviors among distressed individuals and the potential roles of perceived usefulness and perceived barriers to seek help. Besides, we conduct a qualitative study to identify the best practices for using Internet games as a platform for developing suicide prevention efforts to young people. 隨著年輕人遊戲使用量的增加，網絡遊戲已成為一種流行的生活方式。過度的遊戲行為可能導致遊戲成癮，即 DSM-5 中定義之網絡遊戲障礙 (Internet Gaming Disorder, IGD)。遊戲成癮成為許多亞洲國家，例如中國、韓國等國家的憂慮。現時有關網絡遊戲障礙的研究偏向關注遊戲成癮之盛行及認識，但對於其定義仍存有分歧。因此，需要實證研究加深我們對於該現象的理解，以區別正常、有問題、病態的遊戲玩家。儘管有預防自殺相關之臨床介入及政策推動，自殺率仍然持續上升。 網絡遊戲有可能是自殺行為的成因， 但兩者之間的時間關係尚未於縱向研究中被驗證。網絡遊戲習慣對於自殺行為的發展之長期影響尚未被理解， 而且其潛在的好處亦有待探索。 網絡遊戲有多個面向，例如遊戲動機、遊戲類型、遊戲時間和社交結果。這些面向可能在遊戲成癮之成因具有中介作用，以及對於從自殺意念發展至自殺計劃及嘗試有一定影響。然而，現有的研究沒有考慮到通過整體調查從多層面驗證網絡遊戲對於自殺行為之潛在影響。求助行為可能是防止意念升級和後續行動發展的潛在保護因素。尋找到遊戲成癮者求助的條件具有臨床價值，使我們對於不願或不能求助的網絡遊戲玩家有更深的了解。 擬議的研究為一項為期1.5 年的四波縱向研究，以追踪香港年輕網絡遊戲玩家的遊戲行為及自殺風險的發展。目的旨在檢示遊戲行為和社會退縮行為的潛在剖面及轉換及其相關的社會心理因素；調查網絡遊戲與自殺之間的縱向關聯並透過遊戲特徵以列線圖風險評估方式建立預測模型；以及評估受困擾的網絡遊戲玩家的求助行為相關因素及求助的預期效用和阻礙之潛在影響。隨此之外， 我們會以質性研究方式，識別透過網絡遊戲去發展預防青少年自殺之最佳做法。

17608622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608622.value: 女性與建築論述：女性對中國及亞洲現代建築研究所作出的貢獻

17608622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608622.value: Women and Architectural Discourses: A history of women's contribution to the study of modern architecture in China and Asia is the first critical study of writing on modern architecture and urbanism by Chinese women in the twentieth century. By studying the writings of women architects and authors and situating them in the historical contexts in which they were written, the project aims to understand how their experiences in the built environments that they traverse and dwell contribute to the production of architectural discourses and in turn, to the broader history and theory of architecture and urbanism. Until this moment, there is not yet a history of architecture that embraces women and race as the twin-category of analysis. Conventions of architectural history privilege projective designs and visual imagery, culminating in the architects' monograph of works. Until the 1990s, historical research of modern architecture did not include women's work or scholarship. When women wrote about architecture, they were understood at best as "experts" in the domestic or the interior. When they wrote collaboratively, they were typically credited as second co-authors or served as editors and copyeditors for books and journals. In contrast to these approaches, my project's focus on texts by Chinese women whose cosmopolitan mobility generated debates on heritage, regionalism, habitation, public space, and everyday life will illuminate the historical relationship between women experiencing development and dislocation and architectural labor. This project is a historiographical recuperation of a crucial feminist end, beginning with the construction of an archive of texts and images that situates women’s thought and work within the discourses of post-war architecture and urban development. An examination of Chinese women's writing on architecture offers valuable insights into how they played diverse roles in transnational migration streams in disseminating, consolidating, and producing architectural ideas. Both "tied" and "lead" migrants, the women were educated elites who negotiated gendered identities and participated in the modernization processes of the cities in which they relocated. The project will rely on a range of previously unexamined and under-examined primary and secondary texts, including textbooks, journal and magazine essays and editorials, novels, newspaper serials, autobiographies, letters, transcripts, personal letters, and notes. Focusing on women whose writings on the modern built environment constitute intellectual and physical labor that has been overlooked, it argues for a conception of architecture that acknowledges women’s writing as a form of critical spatial practice.

17608722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608722.value: 結合虛擬實境與腦神經回饋訓練於專注力不足/過度活躍症的兒童之成效研究

17608722.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17608722.value: Prof Chang, Hue Fung Dorita Dr Li, Johnson Dr Wong, Wai Ho Savio

17608722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608722.value: In Hong Kong, children with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) account for 20% and 26%, respectively, of all primary and secondary school students with special educational needs. Students with ADHD often have difficulties maintaining focus in class and meeting academic and social goals. A recent development in attention training pertains to the use of neurophysiological information as biofeedback to help individuals self-regulate their attention. Near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) is a non-invasive neuroimaging technique that monitors changes in the blood oxy-hemoglobin (oxy-Hb) level in brain tissue to record neural activation. In neurofeedback training (NFT), the blood oxy-Hb level measured by NIRS is translated into visual and/or auditory signals that are fed back to participants, who are required to alter the signals via self-regulation. Only a very few studies have thus far provided evidence on the effectiveness of NIRS-based prefrontal cortex NFT in reducing ADHD symptoms. Moreover, questions remain about whether self-regulatory abilities acquired during NFT can be transferred to real life. We hypothesize that conducting NFT in a virtual reality (VR) environment will enhance both the acquisition of self-regulation skills in the laboratory and their transfer to everyday situations. We propose to conduct two randomized controlled trials (RCTs). The first RCT will explore the effects of NIRS-based prefrontal cortex NFT coupled with VR (NFT-VR) on attentional control in children with ADHD. The second RCT will examine how the mechanism of neurofeedback and VR contribute independently to the effects of NFT-VR. In each RCT, over 130 children (aged 7–12) with ADHD will receive 16 sessions of NFT over 8 weeks. Participants will be assessed at baseline, immediately post-intervention, and at a 2-month follow-up in the laboratory and in a naturalistic setting. Cybersickness and children’s enjoyment of the training will be measured to evaluate the viability of NFT-VR as an intervention tool for children. We will also assess the ecological validity of NFT by examining whether the training benefits, if any, can be transferred to real classroom learning. The proposed study will bridge major gaps in research knowledge on the effectiveness and feasibility of NIRS-based NFT for children with ADHD. It will also provide the first evidence on the ecological validity of such intervention approaches beyond the laboratory. If integrating VR with NIRS-based NFT is proved to be a promising and effective treatment for children with attention problems, the findings will have important implications for educational practice and early intervention in children with ADHD. 在香港的小學和中學有特殊學習需要的學童當中，患有專注力不足/過度活躍症 (ADHD) 的兒童大概分別佔20%（小學）和26%（中學）。有ADHD的學生往往較難於課堂上集中，亦會在學業和社交上遇到困難。近年發展的近红外光譜腦神經回饋訓練運用非入侵性的神經影像技術來監測腦部皮層帶氧血红蛋白的濃度，以反映腦神經的活動，並把此數據化為圖像/語音信息回饋參與訓練者，以助其自行調節腦神經活動。過去很少研究曾經探討近红外光譜腦神經回饋訓練對ADHD兒童的治療成效及對日常生活帶來的幫助。 我們計劃結合虛擬實境與腦神經回饋訓練，以提升患有ADHD兒童的專注力。我們預計在腦神經回饋訓練中加入虛擬實境科技的元素，能令ADHD兒童有親歷其境的感受，有助他們把學到的技巧應用於真實的課堂上，從而提升訓練效能。我們計劃進行兩項隨機對照試驗，來研究結合虛擬實境的腦神經回饋訓練能否提升ADHD兒童的專注力，以及當中涉及的機制。在每項隨機對照試驗中，我們會為大概130位兒童提供為期8星期的訓練。參加者會在訓練前、後，和訓練後兩個月接受評估，以查考訓練的成效及其在日常生活上的影響。 此研究能就腦神經回饋訓練對於ADHD兒童是否有效及其可行性帶來新的知識。與此同時，此研究也會為這類型的訓練之生態效度提供實證。研究結果將會為早期ADHD訓練帶來重要的影響。

17608922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17608922.value: 左額中回在中文閱讀加工的作用

17608922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17608922.value: 在研究閱讀發展的領域裡，不少學者認為閱讀能力普遍受到語言能力的制約。這個理論，稱為「文字系統普遍性機制」，假設所有文字系統均主要為記錄口語而非意思。 一些科學家更認為，由於不同的文字系統有着共同的視覺特徵（如線條和線條連接），而所有的語言均有着相似的腦神經機制，因此，處理不同的文字系統都應該激活相似的腦神經網絡。 這一閱讀普遍性機制的觀點得到了一些認知研究的支持，例如，對語音的靈敏度，亦稱為「語音意識」，與閱讀各種文字系統的能力都有着正相關，對閱讀字母文字系統尤為重要。 神經影像學研究亦一直表明，閱讀字母文字系統時，處理語言訊息的腦神經網絡會被激活，包括布羅卡區（或左下額葉區）和韋尼克區（或左顳頂葉區），而顳頂葉區的缺陷則會導致閱讀障礙。這些都顯示出語言與文字訊息的加工是共用着同一腦神經機制。 然而，近二十年的研究結果表明，閱讀和閱讀障礙的認知與神經機制可能受着文化的影響，當中以中文漢字和西方字母文字系統的差異較為顯著，兩者無論在字形結構或表音方式都有着顯著的不同。 中文乃一種表意或語素文字系統（亦稱為意音文字系統），字形呈方塊，由筆劃組成。大部份漢字均表記語素及有一個讀音，但讀音和字形並沒有直接關係，必須通過背誦將形和音連繫起來。字母文字系統以表音為主，字詞由字母拼成，呈線形，字母表記音素。通過拼合字母及運用字母轉換音素的機制（亦稱為拼讀法）可獲取字詞的讀音，故掌握拼讀法至為重要。神經影像學研究顯示，中文為母語者在閱讀漢字時，無論是在處理字形、字音或字義的訊息時，他們的左顳頂區並不會被激活，但左半球的一個前腦區域，稱為左額中回（LMFG），則有相對強的活動。此外，LMFG的功能和結構缺陷可能導致中文讀閱讀障礙，而一些中文閱讀困難者同時在LMFG和左側頂葉有着缺陷，導致語音和視覺領域雙重的問題。 此外，中文閱讀困難者不一定有着語音意識的缺陷，這一點和西方的發現有所不同。綜上所述，這些研究表明，中文漢字和西方字母文字系統的閱讀和閱讀障礙的行為認知與腦神經基制均有所不同，而LMFG在漢語閱讀中起著非常重要的作用。 LMFG是一個包含多個具有不同細胞結構的大腦區域，每個區域可能具有不同的功能。 事實上，LMFG在工作記憶和執行控制等高階認知功能以及語義、音節處理和視覺空間分析等語言相關功能發揮著重要的作用。 這個大腦區域可能在漢語閱讀過程中被啟動，用以分析漢字特有的複雜視覺空間資訊，或協調形、音、義訊息的處理。 本項目的主要目標是探討LMFG在處理中文閱讀時所提供的功能，並嘗試勾劃出閱讀的三個基本組成部分（字形、字音和字義）的腦神經網絡。 本項目的另一個目標是比較中英文讀者的大腦結構和閱讀的腦神經網絡。 研究發現將揭示LMFG在閱讀加工中的作用，並闡明語言學習經驗會否及如何影響大腦結構和功能。

17609422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609422.value: 太極和有氧運動對晚期肺癌患者情緒症狀群集的影響之混合干預研究和中介分析

17609422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609422.value: Dr Chau, Patsy Pui-Hing Dr Cheung, Denise Shuk Ting Dr HO, James Chung Man Prof Miaskowski, Christine Prof Siu, Parco Ming-Fai Dr Yuen, Kwok Keung

17609422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609422.value: Lung cancer is the most common cancer and leading cause of cancer deaths in Hong Kong. The majority of cases are diagnosed at a late stage. An emotional symptom cluster comprising sleep disturbance, depression, anxiety, and fatigue is prevalent in late-stage lung cancer patients, negatively affecting their quality of life. Yet no effective treatment is available for this symptom cluster, and the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Based on the literature, we propose that emotion regulation is an underlying mechanism of the emotional symptom cluster and that cluster can be improved by exercise through emotion regulation. Aerobic exercise can improve such regulation through improvements in cardiorespiratory fitness, whereas Tai-Chi can improve it through enhanced mindfulness. Both Tai-Chi and aerobic exercise have well-documented evidence in relieving individual cancer-related symptoms. However, evidence is lacking on their ability to relieve symptom clusters. The aim of the proposed study is to investigate the effects of Tai-Chi and aerobic exercise on the emotional symptom cluster, and the underlying mechanism of that cluster, in late-stage lung cancer patients in a robust mixed-methods three-arm randomized controlled trial. Late-stage lung cancer patients (n = 318) meeting the inclusion criteria will be recruited and randomized into one of three groups: 1) Tai-Chi group, 2) aerobic exercise group, or 3) self-management control group. Both the Tai-Chi and aerobic exercise groups will attend twice-weekly group classes for 16 weeks (32 total contact hours). The self-management control group will receive written information regarding the recommended level of physical activity. To evaluate the effectiveness of Tai-Chi and aerobic exercise in alleviating the emotional symptom cluster (primary outcome) and individual symptoms (sleep disturbance, anxiety, depression, fatigue), outcome measures will be conducted at baseline, 8 weeks (mid-point assessment), 16 weeks (post-intervention), and 28 weeks (12-weeks post-intervention). A linear mixed-effects model will be used to study the between-group differences in outcomes. In addition, emotion regulation, mindfulness, and cardiorespiratory fitness will be evaluated at each data collection point, and structural equation modeling will be used for subsequent mediation analysis to determine their mediating role in outcome changes. Qualitative interviews will be conducted to understand patients’ experience and evaluation of the interventions. If proven effective, Tai-Chi and/or aerobic exercise can be important strategies in managing the emotional symptom cluster and improving quality of life in late-stage lung cancer patients. Better understanding of the underlying mechanism will help researchers to develop targeted interventions to treat symptom clusters in the future. 肺癌是香港最常見的癌症和癌症死亡的主要原因，而大多數病例在晚期才被診斷出來。情緒症狀群集包括睡眠障礙、抑鬱、焦慮和疲勞在晚期肺癌患者中普遍存在，對他們的生活品質產生負面影響。然而，對於這症狀群集尚無有效的治療方法，而其潛在機轉仍不清楚。 基於文獻，我們提出情緒調節是情緒症狀群集的潛在機轉，其中運動可以影響情緒調節進而改善情緒症狀群集。有氧運動和太極可以改善情緒調節，分別透過改善心肺功能、以及加強正念來達成。有氧運動和太極皆有實證減輕癌症相關個別症狀，然而，在減輕癌症症狀群集方面的證據較為缺乏。本研究目的為透過三組混合干預隨機對照試驗之研究設計來調查太極和有氧運動對晚期肺癌患者情緒症狀群集的功效，以及其潛在機轉。 我們將邀請符合選樣標準之晚期肺癌患者(n = 318)加入本研究，參加者將隨機分配至下列三組其中之一：1) 太極組、2) 有氧運動組、或3) 自我管理組對照組。太極和有氧運動組將參加一星期兩次為期16週的團體課程 (共32小時)。自我管理組對照組將會收到紙本資訊有關身體活動運動量之建議。成效將在基線(介入前)、第8週(介入期間)、第16週(介入後)、和第28週(介入後12週)測量來分析太極和有氧運對對於情緒症狀群集 (主要成效) 和個別症狀 (睡眠障礙、抑鬱、焦慮和疲勞) 的功效。我們將以混合線性模型來檢視組間差異及其成效，此外，情緒調節、正念和心肺功能會在每個測量點一併檢測。結構方程模式將會用於測試其在改變成效的中介調節效果。另外，我們將進行質性訪談來了解病人的經驗和評估介入措施的成效。 如果證實有效，太極或有氧運動可以成為改善晚期肺癌患者情緒症狀群集和生活品質的重要策略。深入了解其潛在機轉可以幫助研究者在未來發展針對改善症狀群集的介入措施。

17610022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610022.value: 平衡雙眼的不平衡：連續性西塔叢集刺激與知覺訓練

17610022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17610022.value: Prof Cheong, Ming Yan Allen Dr Thompson, Benjamin

17610022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610022.value: Sensory eye dominance, whereby the two eyes’ inputs are weighted unequally by the visual system, is a prominent characteristic of certain clinical groups (e.g., in individuals with strabismic or anisometropic amblyopia) and is thought to underlie broader deficits in binocular function. Binocular imbalance is not a solely clinical phenomenon however, with 87% of the normal population reported to have varying extents of sensory eye dominance. In recent years, separate lines of work have indicated that eye balance can be improved with perceptual training and brain stimulation (TMS targeted at primary visual cortex), although the neuromechanistic manner in which the two approaches lead to these improvements is unclear. Combining neuroimaging (fMRI), brain stimulation (cTBS), and behavioural paradigms, the proposed project aims to reveal the neuroplastic underpinnings of each of cTBS and perceptual learning-driven changes in sensory eye balance, while probing the value of a combinatory (cTBS + learning) approach to bring about even larger re-balancing and functional (binocular) improvements. The eventual goal of this work is to provide a platform upon which methods can be translated towards ameliorating binocular function in clinical settings. 知覺性優勢眼是指兩隻眼睛的輸入在視覺系統中的比重不同。它是一些臨床組別的顯著特征（如：斜視、屈光參差），亦被認為是一系列雙目功能缺陷的原因。雙目不平衡不僅是一種臨床現象，研究顯示，87%的正常人也有不同程度的知覺性優勢眼。近年來，不同的研究工作已經表明可以通過知覺訓練和腦刺激（針對初級視覺皮層進行經顱磁刺激）來改善雙眼平衡。然而，我們對這兩種方法如何改善雙眼平衡背後的神經機制還不清楚。結合神經影像（fMRI）、腦刺激（cTBS）和行為範式，本項目旨在揭示由cTBS和知覺訓練所誘發的知覺性眼平衡變化的潛在神經可塑性機制，同時探索以組合的方式（cTBS+知覺學習）來達到更大的平衡和雙目功能的提升。這項工作的最終目標是提供一個平台來將各種方法轉化到臨床中使用，以改善雙眼視覺受損患者的雙目功能。

17610422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610422.value: 透過即時通訊軟件為中風患者的家庭照顧者提供失眠認知行為治療：混合方法研究

17610422.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17610422.value: Dr Chau, Patsy Pui-Hing Prof Cuijpers, Pim Prof Lau, Esther Yuet-ying Prof Lau, Gary Kui Kai Prof Yu, Doris Sau Fung

17610422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610422.value: Up to 95% of family caregivers had clinically significant insomnia symptoms including reduced total sleep duration, prolonged sleep onset latency, frequent night awakenings, and poor sleep efficiency and quality. Insomnia have severe psycho-physiological effects on caregivers, including depression, anxiety, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and all-cause mortality. While caregivers’ sleep disturbances, particularly insomnia, are well-documented in the literature, the provision of intervention to caregivers has largely been overlooked in Hong Kong (HK) and elsewhere. In our pilot survey, stroke caregivers had the worst sleep quality and depressive symptoms(45.4% and 58.0% respectively), compared to other caregivers in HK. Internet-delivered cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia(iCBT-I) has shown a large effect in reducing insomnia in a meta-analysis(d=0.86), while showing high intervention adherence rate(78%). Ecological momentary intervention(EMI) is an innovative and cost-effective intervention ‘framework’ that utilises mobile messages including instant messages to deliver personalised psychological interventions, showing a medium effect(g=0.57). The proposed study aims to 1) evaluate the effectiveness of brief iCBT-I delivered using instant messaging applications such as WhatsApp and WeChat (i.e., EMI framework) in stroke family caregivers to provide personalised and synchronous insomnia support and 2) understand the experience of and compliance with the intervention. No similar study has been found in PubMed, Cochrane Library or Clinicaltrials.gov. Screened 138 stroke caregivers with Sleep Condition Indicator(SCI) scores 20 or less, indicating clinically significant insomnia, will be recruited from local community centres and neurology clinics. They will then be individually randomised into Intervention or Control group(n=69 each). Intervention group will receive 1) instant message-delivered brief iCBT-I and stroke care education messages for 3 months at participants’ chosen times and frequencies, and 2) nurse-led text or voice message-based insomnia and psychological supports(chat-type) to enhance the effects of iCBT through real-time counselling and practical advice. Control group will receive messages on stroke education with reminders for follow-up surveys, and chat-based psychological support. Post-treatment assessments at the end of intervention(3-month) and at 6 months follow-up include: Primary outcomes of SCI and Insomnia Severity Index(ISI) scores measuring insomnia risk and severity; and secondary outcomes of sleep quality(PSQI), depression(PHQ-9), anxiety(GAD-7), caregiver burden(ZBI-4), quality of life(EQ-5D-5L), and sleep patterns. Intention-to-treat, post-trial qualitative(exploring participants’ compliance with the intervention; n=20), and cost-effectiveness analyses will be conducted. We will strictly follow the CONSORT-EHEALTH checklist. This trial will provide the first empirical evidence on the effectiveness of instant message-delivered brief iCBT-I for relieving insomnia in stroke family caregivers in HK and beyond. 高達95%的家庭照顧者出現臨床失眠症狀，包括：總睡眠時間縮短、入睡潛伏期延長、頻繁夜醒、睡眠效率及質素差。失眠對照顧者有嚴重心理-生理影響，包括抑鬱、焦慮、心血管疾病，糖尿病及全因死亡率。雖然文獻中已詳盡記載照顧者面對的睡眠困擾，香港及各地仍缺乏對照顧者的失眠支援。在香港，與其他參與我們先導問卷的照顧者相比，中風患者的家庭照顧者有最差的睡眠質素及抑鬱症狀(分別為45.4%及58.0%)。薈萃分析顯示線上失眠認知行為治療能有效改善失眠狀況(d=0.86)的同時有高依從率。生態瞬間介入(EMI)是一個創新及具成本效益的介入「框架」，其內容為透過手提電話訊息傳遞個人化的心理治療。此類心理介入有中度效果(g=0.57)。此擬議研究旨在1)評估透過即時通訊軟件如：WhatsApp 及微信(生態瞬間介入框架)為中風患者的家庭照顧者提供個人化及同步的失眠支援的成效及2)了解參加者的介入體驗及其依從性。PubMed, Cochrane Library 及 Clinicaltrials.gov 均沒有類似研究。我們將在社區中心及神經內科門診招募138位在睡眠狀況指標中得分20或以下(即有臨床顯著失眠)的中風患者的家庭照顧者。他們會被隨機分配到試驗組或對照組(每組各69位參加者)。試驗組的參加者會接收到1) 為期3個月透過即時訊息傳遞的簡短網絡失眠認知行為治療及中風護理教育，其傳遞的時間及頻率將由參加者選擇及2)由護士提供以文字或語音形式提供的失眠及心理支援，以及實用建議，以提升網絡認知行為治療的效果。對照組會接收到中風教育，提醒參與後續問卷調查的訊息及聊天心理支援。介入後三個月及六個月的評估的主要指標為睡眠狀況指標、失眠嚴重指標(ISI)，次要指標為睡眠質素(PSQI)、抑鬱(PHQ-9)、焦慮(GAD-7)、照顧者負擔(ZBI-4)，生活質素(EQ-5D-5L)及睡眠模式。我們會在試驗完成後進行意向分析、質性研究(以了解參加者的介入依從性，n=20)及成本效益分析。我們會嚴格跟從CONSORT-EHEALTH指引。此項研究將會為香港及其他地區提供透過即時通訊軟件傳遞的簡短網絡失眠認知行為治療以緩解中風患者的家庭照顧者的失眠狀況有效性的首個證據。

17610622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610622.value: 以後設認知和支持性表達的方法管理對癌症惡化的恐懼：隨機臨床對照實驗

17610622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17610622.value: Dr Chan , Kar Loen, Karen Dr Chan , Wendy Wing Lok Dr Foo, Chi Chung Prof Kwong, Ava Prof Lam, David Chi Leung Dr Lee, Ho Fun Victor Dr Liao, Qiuyan Prof Yuen, Jacqueline Kwan Yuk

17610622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610622.value: Psychological well-being is inevitably challenged in individuals with metastatic cancer because of the profound and diverse stresses and burdens associated with it. While the primary task at the end of life may be to face death with comfort, dignity and a sense of meaning, those with advanced disease earlier in the illness trajectory and/or with a longer expected survival, face the simultaneous challenges of engaging in life while facing the imminence of death. Sustaining such “double awareness” is challenging and the inability to do so may lead to high fear of cancer progression. There is an increasing attention drawn to study fear of cancer progression. Yet, little is known about how to effectively manage fear of cancer progression. There is a brief, individual, manualized psychotherapeutic intervention, namely Managing Cancer And Living Meaningfully (CALM), was designed to alleviate psychological distress in patients with advanced or metastatic cancer. CALM shares features with manualized supportive-expressive, cognitive-existential, and meaning-centered group psychotherapies applied to patients with advanced and terminal disease. Research has shown that CALM is an effective therapy for reducing depression among patients with advanced or metastatic cancer. On the other hand, there is suggestion that metacognitive beliefs about negative thinking play an essential role to the development and maintenance of emotional disorders as these metacognitive beliefs promote intrusive thinking. Our recent work also showed maladaptive metacognition was associated with high fear of cancer recurrence. A theoretically based, manualized intervention, namely ConquerFear, was recently developed and showed its effectiveness in reducing fear of cancer recurrence. Interventions such as CALM and ConquerFear may benefit these patients in managing fear of cancer progression. This is yet to be tested. The present study aims to conduct a randomized controlled trial to assess the effect of CALM intervention and ConquerFear intervention on fear of cancer progression among Chinese patients diagnosed with advanced cancer. Eligible patients are Cantonese- or Mandarin-speaking Chinese patients diagnosed with advanced or metastatic cancer, aged 18 years or above. A total of 261 patients with advanced cancer will be identified through the screening of outpatient clinic lists provided by the trial sites and eligible patients will be approached at the outpatient clinic while awaiting to see the specialists. Primary outcome is change in fear of cancer progression and secondary outcome is change in depression and death anxiety. All measures will be completed at baseline (T0), 3-month post-intervention (T1) and 6-month post-intervention. 晚期或轉移性的癌症患者是有一定的壓力，其心理健康必然會受到影響。雖然帶著舒適、尊嚴和意義感面對死亡可能是在生命末期的主要任務，但是，那些早期的晚期患者和/或其預期生存期較長的患者卻要在面臨死亡迫近時，同時應對日常生活的挑戰。維持這種「雙重意識」具有挑戰性，如果無法做到這一點，可能會導致高度的癌症惡化恐懼。越来越多的研究開始了解癌症惡化的恐懼。然而，關於如何有效管理此恐懼卻知之甚少。有一個簡短的、個人化、人工的心理治療干預，即管理癌症和有意義地生活（CALM），旨在減輕晚期或轉移性癌症患者的心理困擾。CALM 與應用於晚期和未期疾病患者的支持性表達、認知存在和以意義為中心的團體心理治療具有相同的特徵。研究發現，CALM有效地減輕晚期或轉移性癌症患者的抑鬱症狀。另一方面，研究指出，消極思維的後設認知信念會促進侵入性思維，在情緒障礙的發展和維持扮演著十分重要角色。根據我們最近的研究亦發現，消極思維的後設認知與對癌症復發的高度恐懼關息息相關。研究結果初步証實近期創立、以理論為基礎的人工干預，即 ConquerFear，明顯有效地緩解對癌症復發過多的擔憂。 CALM 和 ConquerFear 等干預措施能否為晚期或轉移性的癌症患者帶來同樣的效益，減低他們對癌症惡化的恐懼，仍有待測試。本研究旨在透過一項隨機臨床對照實驗，評估 CALM 干預和 ConquerFear 干預對華裔晚期或轉移性癌症患者的癌症惡化恐懼的影響。符合條件的患者包括年齡在 18 歲或以上、會說粵語或普通話的華裔晚期或轉移性癌症患者。我們將通過對由參與診所所提供的門診名單進行篩選，並在他們等待看專科醫生的同時，招聘總共 261 名符合條件的患者。主要結果是對癌症惡化的恐懼的變化，次要結果是抑鬱和死亡焦慮的變化。所有問卷評估將在基線 (T0)、干預後 3 個月 (T1) 和干預後 6 個月完成。

17611322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611322.value: 這個研究關於1920年至1997年香港婦女期刊文學的歷史。無論是研究女性雜誌的現代中國歷史學家，還是研究女性的香港歷史學家，都沒有研究過這個話題。本專案是首次對香港婦女報刊進行系統研究。將把香港的歷史寫進現代中國的歷史，並將女性期刊文學作為香港女性歷史的主題。 在香港回歸中國前夕，香港是充滿活力和全球女性雜誌出版業的所在地，包括 香港的《姐妹》、法國的《Elle》、日本的《Nonno》和美國的《Cosmo》。但是香港的婦女期刊有一個很長的歷史。香港在二戰前出版了一些女性期刊，特別是那些與學校和婦女組織有關的期刊，但隨著二戰期間和1949年後上海的移民，這種類型有所擴大。上海風格的雜誌在1950年代的香港興起，但在1960年代之後沒有繼續下去，當時新一代冷戰時期的香港女性雜誌開始流行，並被當地女性和散居海外的中國女性閱讀。

17611422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17611422.value: 己所不欲、 勿施于人： 大国民众对自己政府干预他国选举的态度

17611422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611422.value: When, if ever, do publics of major world powers support their government carrying out attempts to influence the outcome of other countries’ elections? Since the Second World War, major world powers have routinely undertaken partisan electoral interventions. These interventions can have various major effects on the targeted country, from successfully accomplishing their goals to catalyzing blowback in the target. It seems likely that the public of the intervening country may have, as in other foreign policy activities, significant effects regarding whether and when such interference is conducted by its own government by influencing officials’ perceptions of the costs and benefits of such operations. Despite the substantive importance of these interventions and the public’s potential influence, however, little research exists about how publics of major world powers perceive such meddling in societies other than the United States, which is likely an unusual case. This lacuna leaves a great deficiency in our understanding of both the general theory of electoral interventions and particular, and substantively important, dynamics in particular powers. We propose to study this question by conducting identical survey experiments in four different major powers (Western and non-Western, rising and incumbent) with a record of such meddling: the UK, Germany, India and Russia. We expect western publics to weigh idealistic concerns more heavily than the national interest in evaluating potential meddling and non-western publics to weigh the national interest more heavily than idealistic ones. We expect both western and non-western publics to prefer overt electoral interventions over covert ones. We plan to publish the results of this research as three separate scholarly papers at high impact venues and assure wider impact of the results through presentations and publications of summary results in various mass media organs. 何時開始世界主導國家的民眾會支持本國政府試圖干預他國的選舉結果？自第二次世界大戰始，世界主導國家常對他國政黨選舉作出干預，這些干預政策，或成功、或帶來反效果，能夠對他國政治帶來重大影響。這正如一般外交政策活動一樣，主動干預國的民眾對政府有重大影響，民眾能影響當權者對干預成本及效益的看法，從而影響政府何時及是否干預選舉的決定。即使這些干預政策及民眾確實存在不菲的影響，但極不尋常的是極少有研究關於世界主導國家的公眾如何看待美國社會以外的干預政策。這空缺讓我們難以對選舉干預的理論和權力關係進行討論及認識。 為了填補這空白，我們提議在四個歷史上有干涉選舉經驗的大國（西方、非西方、 崛起、現任），即：英國、德國、印度、俄羅斯作切入點，去進行相同實驗調查來研究這個學題。 在四個國家：英國、德國、印度、俄羅斯。在評估潛在選舉干預，我們預料西方公眾重視價值理念多於國家利益，反之非西方公眾置國家利益高於價值理念，而西方及非西方公眾均會支持公開多於暗中選舉干預。我們打算發表兩篇獨立學術論文。

17611922.value: 使用結合氣功八段錦與自我穴位按摩以改善癌症患者因化療引起的周圍神經病變: 隨機對照試驗

17611922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611922.value: Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) occurs in more than half of patients receiving neurotoxic chemotherapy. It usually manifests as sensory and motor deficits and persists long into survivorship, leading to a higher fall risk and compromised quality of life. Current medications often lack efficacy in treating CIPN and/or have significant side effects. Acupressure is a non-invasive variant of acupuncture based on Chinese medicine in which patients stimulate acupoints by applying pressure using their hands or suitable devices. Qigong is a mind-body exercise, also based on Chinese medicine, that emphasizes a combination of movement, breath control, and meditation. According to meridian theory, qigong and acupressure stimulate the flow of qi and blood to restore health. From the Western medicine perspective, qigong and acupressure may independently improve CIPN through similar and distinct mechanisms at the central and peripheral nervous system levels. While studies suggest the improvement induced by a single modality to be modest, a combination approach is likely to work in synergy to stimulate the flow of qi and induce supra-additive effects on CIPN. A rigorously designed randomized control trial (RCT) examining the effect of combined qigong and self-administered acupressure on CIPN is warranted. The basis of the combination approach is supported with evidence and novel. The primary aim of the proposed RCT is to test the effects of a combined qigong and self-administered acupressure intervention on self-reported CIPN severity (primary outcome) relative to wait-list control at the 16-week and 28-week follow-up. A total of 104 cancer patients who have completed neurotoxic chemotherapy and are experiencing CIPN will be randomized equally into a combined qigong and self-administered acupressure group and a wait-list control group. Participants in the intervention group will receive a 16-week combined qigong and self-administered acupressure intervention comprising of 1.5-hour group training twice a week for 8 weeks, then 1-hour reinforcement group practice for 8 weeks and self-practice. The control group will be offered the intervention after the study ends. The primary outcome will be self-reported CIPN severity, as measured by the FACT/GOG neurotoxicity subscale. Secondary outcomes include objective measures of CIPN severity, lower-extremity functioning, handgrip strength, fall incidence, and HRQoL. Rates of recruitment, retention, and adherence will be documented. Participants’ acceptability of the intervention will be evaluated using an investigator-designed questionnaire and qualitative interviews. The findings will influence clinical practice in providing a practical non-pharmacological approach for treating CIPN, which is a highly pharmacoresistant condition. 化療引起的周圍神經病變出現在超過一半正接受具神經毒性化療的癌症患者身上，通常表現為感覺神經和運動神經的缺損，並持續一段長時間至康復後，引致較高的跌倒風險和降低生活質素。現有藥物對治療化療引起的周圍神經病變功效不大，亦會有值得注意的副作用。穴位按摩是根據中醫理論中針灸的一種非入侵性方法，患者用手或適當的工具按壓便能刺激到穴位。同樣地，氣功八段錦亦是一種根據中醫理論的身心運動，著重動作、控制呼吸和冥想的結合。 根據經絡學說，氣功八段錦和穴位按摩能刺激氣血運行，從而讓人恢復健康。從西醫的角度來看，氣功八段錦和穴位按摩也許都能分別以相似而又各有不同的機制，在中央和周圍神經系統層面上改善化療引起的周圍神經病變。研究指出單一做氣功八段錦或穴位按摩所帶來的改善不大，然而結合氣功八段錦和穴位按摩的形式，很可能可以在刺激氣的運行方面達到相輔相成的效果，並在治療化療引起的周圍神經病變上產生累加效果。 為了研究結合氣功八段錦與自我穴位按摩的創新治療方案對化療引起的周圍神經病變的效果，一個設計嚴謹的隨機對照試驗是有需要的。這試驗的主要目的是測試結合氣功八段錦和自我穴位按摩的方案，相對於等待對照，在16和28週跟進中，化療引起的周圍神經病變的自我報告嚴重程度（主要結果）上的影響。 我們將招募合共104位已完成具神經毒性的化療，並有化療引起的周圍神經病變的癌症患者，以電腦隨機 (1:1) 分配到兩組，一組是結合氣功八段錦與自我穴位按摩的實驗組，另一組是等待對照組。實驗組會參加為期16個星期的結合氣功八段錦與自我穴位按摩課程。參加者將每週進行兩次 90分鐘的小組訓練，為期 8 週，並在餘下的 8 週內每週兩次進行 60分鐘的強化小組練習。對照組在整個研究結束後，將可參與同樣的課程。測試點將設於研究開始前、16週和28週，主要結果是化療引起的周圍神經病變的自我報告嚴重程度(根據FACT/GOG周圍神經病變量表)，次要結果則包括周圍神經病變的客觀嚴重程度、下肢功能、手握力、跌倒的次數，和健康相關的生活品質。此外，我們將紀錄有關參加者的招募、保留和對計劃的遵從程度等數據，參加者亦會完成由我們設計的問卷和訪談，以評估參加者對課程的接受程度。藥物在治療化療引起的周圍神經病變上效果有限，這次研究的結果將會為這個病變的臨床非藥物干預治療帶來新的機遇。

17612022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17612022.value: Alcohol use is harmful to adolescents’ physical and psychological health. Exposure to alcohol marketing and receptivity to alcohol commercial contents are attributable to the underage alcohol use. Yet, the mechanisms of how exposure to alcohol marketing lead to drinking behaviors remains unclear. Brand capital of alcoholic beverages portrayed in alcohol marketing potentially influence the drinking attitude and drinking culture in adolescents, but these areas have not been explored with rigorous methodology. To test our hypothesis, we propose to use the Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) and a longitudinal survey to document adolescents’ real time exposure to alcohol marketing, receptivity and alcohol use behaviors. The three main research questions of this study include: 1) Is exposure to alcohol marketing associated with drinking attitude, including perceived popularity, perceived social approval, positive expectancy, marketing receptivity, and brand recognition? 2) What are the contents of alcohol marketing that establish the brand capital of alcohol beverages in Hong Kong? 3) Does the brand capital of alcohol beverages mediate the relationship between (a) exposure to alcohol marketing and drinking attitudes? (b) exposure to alcohol marketing and alcohol consumption? To answer these three questions, this observational study will recruit 661 secondary school students via online and offline recruitment to document alcohol drinking and exposure to alcohol marketing via EMA. An EMA app will be developed for data collection. This app will prompt three times a day for 21 days to collect adolescents’ frequency of alcohol marketing exposure and drinking behavior. One-month follow-up will be conducted to assess students’ attitude of alcohol drinking. We will use ordinal logistic regression t to assess the association between frequency of exposure to alcohol marketing and drinking attitude. Descriptive statistics about the alcohol marketing contents will be computed to address the second research question. Structural equation modeling will be conducted to address the third research question. The result of our proposed study shall be used to advocate future alcohol marketing control policies, especially in restriction of alcohol control, that can substantially reduce the marketing impact of alcohol promotions towards youth and youth alcohol consumption. 飲酒對青少年的身體和心理健康都是有危害的。 未成年人飲酒可歸因於他們曾接觸酒類推廣和對酒類推廣的接受程度。 然而，酒類推廣引起飲酒行為的機制仍不清楚。在酒類推廣中描述的品牌資訊如何影響青少年飲酒的態度和文化，尚未透過嚴謹的 方法學進行探索。 為了驗證我們的假設，我們將使用生態瞬間評估（EMA）和縱向調查來記錄青少年實時接觸酒類市場推廣、對這推廣的 接受程度和飲酒行為。 本研究有三個主要的研究問題： 1） 接觸酒類市場推廣是否與飲酒的態度有關，包括受歡迎的程度、社會對飲酒的認可度、 對飲酒的正面預期、酒類飲品的市場行銷接受程度和品牌資產？ 2） 在香港，建立酒精飲料品牌資產的酒精推廣有哪些內容？ 3） 酒精飲料的品牌資產是否對以下的關聯起到媒介的作用？ a. 酒精市場推廣的接觸度和關於飲酒的態度之間的關聯？ b. 酒精市場推廣的接觸度和飲酒量之間的關聯？ 為了回答這三個問題，這項觀察性研究將通過線上和線下的方式招募661名中學生，通過EMA記錄他們的飲酒量和酒精市場推廣的 接觸程度。我們會開發EMA的手機應用程式用於數據的收集。這個手機應用程式會收集青少年在酒類市場推廣的接觸程度和他們的飲酒量，每日三次連續21日。一個月之後，我們將會進行隨訪，評估學生關於的飲酒態度。 序數邏輯回歸將用作評估酒精市場推廣的接觸頻率與飲酒態度之間的關聯。酒精市場的推廣內容將會用描述性統計的方式進行分析，用以解決第2個研究問題。結構方程模型將被用來解決第3個研究問題。我們的研究結果將會用作提倡控制酒類市場推廣的政策，以減少酒類市場對青少年的推廣和降低青少年 的飲酒行為。

17612222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17612222.value: 從無序中創造有序：統計學習和閲讀中規則及半規則輸入加工的神經性適應與誤差消減（NAME）雙重腦機制研究

17612222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17612222.value: The most convincing demonstration of learning is our brain’s involuntary extraction of statistical regularities from various forms of environmental input. This ability, called statistical learning, influences the reading development of children, especially those with dyslexia (Arciuli, 2018). However, conclusions regarding impaired or intact statistical learning in dyslexia remain mixed, due in part to a lack of (1) understanding of the mechanisms underlying statistical learning and reading and (2) a precise quantification of different kinds of statistical regularities, namely, regular and quasi-regular inputs. Our previous studies on dyslexia reveal that learning of regular and quasi-regular inputs involves different mechanisms (Tong et al., 2020b), an assumption further verified by our recent study on statistical learning in skilled adult readers (Zhang et al., submitted) that suggests two related but distinct mechanisms, i.e., neural adaptation and minimizing errors (NAME), are responsible for processing regular and quasi-regular inputs, respectively. Neural adaptation manifests as a reduced neural response (e.g., N1 amplitude) to repeated, highly regular stimuli, while minimizing errors is a process of coping with uncertainty of quasi-regular stimuli (e.g., P3 component). The present study expands our previous work by employing the high temporal sensitivity of event-related potentials (ERPs) with behavioural assessment to directly investigate whether (1) statistical learning of regular and quasi-regular inputs relies on NAME, (2) developmental change occurs in NAME during statistical learning, and (3) NAME underpins the connection between statistical learning and word reading in children with and without dyslexia from grades 1-2 to grades 3-4. In each of three consecutive years, 100 children with dyslexia and 100 age-matched controls from grade 2, and 100 reading-level matched controls from grade 1 will complete an ERP experiment on statistical learning of orthography-phonology mappings and a Chinese pseudocharacter reading test. The regular and quasi-regular inputs will be quantified by the Shannon entropy value, which measures the degree of uncertainty (Shannon, 1948). The performance and the age-related change of neural adaptation (i.e., N1) and minimizing errors (i.e., P3) will be analysed using Bayesian approach of multivariate analysis of variance, while prediction of NAME to pseudocharacter reading will be evaluated using latent-growth modelling. The results of this study will not only identify NAME as the dual-mechanism underlying statistical learning, but help clarify conflicting evidence on the role of statistical learning in reading development. Our findings will inspire a novel intervention direction for creating high-quality inputs that can improve possible NAME weaknesses in children with dyslexia. 人腦會無意識及自發地從環境輸入中獲得統計信息並整合到記憶中相關刺激的表徵，這種隱性學習稱為統計學習，它是人類語言習得和高级心理機能形成的重要基礎。目前，基於拼音文字和象形文字的閱讀發展研究顯示，統計學習影響兒童閱讀能力發展，主要證據之一是大多數讀寫障礙兒童在統計學習上表現欠佳（Arciuli, 2018）。然而，有關研究也發現有些讀寫障礙兒童在統計學習上並不存在困難。這種爭議的主要原因在於先前研究缺乏對統計學習中半規則性（quasi-regularity）輸入刺激材料的精確量化，從而導致無法全面理解統計學習和閲讀能力發展認知神經機制。 基於我們團隊最新的認知行為實驗研究發現，香港中文讀寫障礙兒童對統計學習中規則和半規則刺激材料輸入採用不同的加工機制（Tong et al., 2020b）。而且，我們一項基於成人的研究揭示，統計學習可能是由兩種相關但功能不同的神經機制控制，即神經性適應（neural adaptation）和誤差消減（minimizing error）（即NAME）。 神經性適應（以N1波幅為例）表現在由重複的規則性輸入所引發的神經活動衰減，而誤差消減（以P3波幅為例）則是在應對半規則（quasi-regular）輸入中模糊不確定性所產生的認知加工過程。基於我們前期行為研究的基礎上，研究通過使用具有高時間分辨率的事件相關電位技術，結合統計學習的範式，系統地探討關於統計學習與讀寫障礙關係的三個尚未解決的研究問題：（1）規則和半規則刺激材料輸入的統計學習是否依賴於NAME機制；（2）統計學習的NAME機制如何隨兒童閱讀能力發展而變化；（3）統計學習的NAME機制與閱讀發展的關係。 具體而言，本研究採用縱向追踪研究設計，將系統評估和檢測三組兒童，即100名小學二年級讀寫障礙兒童和100名同齡的小學二年級一般發展兒童，以及100名閲讀能力匹配的小學一年級一般發展兒童，在中文部件聲旁規律學習的腦電實驗和假字命名實驗任務上的表現。我們將運用信息熵量化規則輸入和半規則輸入的不確定性水平（Shannon, 1948）。我們將採用多變量方差分析來考查神經性適應（即N1）和誤差消減（即P3）的表現以及其隨年齡的變化。同時，潛變量增長模型將用於檢測NAME對中文假字命名表現的預測效果。 我們預期本研究結果不僅將揭示神經性適應與誤差消減（NAME）是否支持統計學習的雙重神經加工機制，同時也有助於解釋統計學習與閲讀發展關係的爭論。此外，本研究結果亦將初步證明是否可通過高質量的文字統計輸入來改善和減輕讀寫障礙兒童的困難，從而為開發全新的閱讀障礙治療方案提供科學證據。

17612422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17612422.value: 社區轉變在中國粵港澳大灣區之佈局和演變：廣州、深圳和香港的土地用途及面貌

17612422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17612422.value: 有鑑於過去半個世紀的城市化和城市土地受到壓力，很多中國城市裏接近城市中央的現有社區正經歷巨大的變化。雖然這些都是社區層面的變化，但這些重建 – 大致廣泛被歸納為城市轉變 – 產生了大量人口、社會、建築及政治經濟的變化。這些變化亦深深影響了國際金融、城市政策、商業利益和當地社區的未來。雖然國際上對社區轉變在投資、管治和社會凝聚力等較大事項的影響已有共識，可是中國的都市很少被相關文獻所提及或研究。另外，越來越多有關的研究因為研究方法受到歷代在國際環境（尤其是說英語的北大西洋地區）下發展的士紳化和社區轉變的學術研究的負面影響而受到批評。現時，城市地區（如中國的大灣區）中急速且重要的社區轉變過程未被完全了解，使一個可以有力及全面地考量地區特色和能為國際辯論在這重要的研究或政策發展領域作出貢獻的理論還未可以面世。 這項研究將探討中國大灣區三個主要城市的社區轉變，以解決目前兩大研究主線尚未探討的領域：在全球角度和比較層面下理解的士紳化和社區變化 ，以及中國城市的重建和社區轉變。 本研究之目的是找出中國大灣區現代城市社區轉變的特徵；觀察整個地區以全面了解這現象的模式和過程；及評估社區轉變對中國城市和全球城市在理論、經驗研究和政策方面所帶來的社會、政治經濟及理論性含意。 本研究將以首席研究員過往和正在進行的研究（包括最近在香港進行的一項試點研究）為基礎，採用專門為全面研究社區轉變而設計的四部分方法（面貌調查）作為研究方法。 除了解決現時學術研究中的關鍵知識鴻溝外，本研究的見解和結果將為城市政策的制定和評估帶來益處及正面影響，並有助於更全面地了解中國城市裏的現代生活。

17612722.value: 背景：與男性相比，女性職業道路上通常更非線性。在不同的人生階段中，女性可能會應對其他發展任務，例如組織家庭及照顧。有證據顯示，相隔一段時間再重返工作崗位的女性都面臨著額外的重大障礙。然而，很少人關注有意義的工作理論如何有助於增強香港重返工作崗位的女性的凝聚力和心理健康。此外，較少研究鑑別包容性創業如何促進有意義的工作並促進女性重返勞動力市場的凝聚力。 目標：這項擬議的研究 (1) 考察了有意義的工作對重返勞動力市場的女性心理健康的影響；(2) 檢驗生命凝聚感如何影響重返職場的女性有意義工作和心理健康的關係；(3) 鑑別促進包容性創業的因素，這些因素有利於女性重返工作崗位的有意義的工作和生命凝聚感。 方法：本研究採用順序混合方法研究。研究的第一階段進行一項橫斷面研究，包括對 18 歲或以上，相隔一段時間再重返香港職場且現時參與創業活動的女性進行標準化測量(n=227)。四階段結構方程模型將用於測試所提出的概念模型。而該研究的第二階段包括通過設計思維工作坊進行參與式行動研究，共 30 名參與者。設計思維工作坊產生的數據亦將使用主題分析進行分析。 含義：研究結果將有助於理解重返職場之女性有意義的工作、生命凝聚感和心理健康之間的理論聯繫。這項研究亦將提供有關包容性創業如何增強女性有意義工作的見解。這項研究亦將為公共政策，非營利計劃提供有關戰略和措施的信息，旨在於工作環境中賦予婦女權力同時使她們能夠履行其他生活中的角色。

17613022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613022.value: 利用高分辨率遙感影像準確估算密集高層建築城市地區的不透水表面

17613022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613022.value: Prof Gamba, Paolo Ettore Prof Li, Jonathan Prof Liu, Xiaoping

17613022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613022.value: Intensive anthropogenic activities and rapid urbanization processes have imposed significant impacts on the Earth’s surface, one straightforward change of which is the transformation of different land cover types into urban impervious surfaces (UIS). UIS are related to artificial materials that rainwater cannot penetrate, including buildings, transportation systems and grounds. Timely and accurate measurement of UIS is vital to socioeconomic and environmental monitoring, as well as smart city management. As a highly developed policy and economic body, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) has witnessed rapid urbanization in recent decades. Building and road network construction, as well as reclamation, have changed the area within months or years. The infrastructure monitoring and environmental assessment require accurate UIS estimation at high resolution. Accurate UIS estimation in urban areas of the GBA, with dense and high-rise buildings, involves great challenges due to its complex climate condition and urban morphology. The rainy and cloudy subtropical climate of the GBA introduces obstacles to optical remote sensing observations. The shadow and layover phenomenon in the well-developed urban center, high-rise buildings and skyscrapers complicate the UIS estimation using high-resolution observations. Hence, multisource techniques, including optical, synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and light detection and ranging (LiDAR) data, are needed to overcome the shadow and layover effects. The ultimate objectives of this research are 1) to investigate the mechanism and spatial distribution of the building shadows and layovers that impact an accurate UIS estimation, and 2) to propose a novel, high-resolution multisource deep learning fusion network for UIS estimation in high-rise compact urban areas. The outcomes of this research include 1) a detailed understanding of various types of building shadow and layover impacts on the UIS estimation in high-rise compact urban areas, and 2) a methodological framework to improve the UIS estimation at high resolution using multiple sources of remote sensing data. Intensive anthropogenic activities and rapid urbanization processes have had significant impacts on the Earth’s surface, one straightforward change of which is the transformation of different land cover types into urban impervious surfaces (UIS). UIS are related to artificial materials that rainwater cannot penetrate, including buildings, transportation systems and grounds. Timely and accurate measurement of UIS are of vital importance to social-economic and environmental monitoring as well as smart city management. As a highly developed policy and economic body, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) has witnessed fast urbanization in recent decades, and the urbanization rates of Hong Kong and Shenzhen are nearly 100%. Building and road network construction as well as reclamation have changed the area within months or years. As in the case of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao bridge construction, infrastructure monitoring and environmental assessment requires accurate UIS estimation at high resolution. The ultimate objectives of this research are 1) to improve the accuracy of UIS estimation in the highly urbanized GBA by reducing building shadow effects, and 2) to estimate and validate the distribution and extension of UIS at high resolution via the synergistic use of optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) with advanced deep learning methods.

17614222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614222.value: 光影中的STEM：媒體如何呈現科技工程領域的女性形象

17614222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614222.value: As STEM expertise becomes more urgent with a global rise in infectious diseases, claims about diversity and inclusion within STEM workplaces increasing problem-solving capability (Hong and Page, 2004) echo around the world. Studies suggest that fiction narratives with STEM-related storylines can serve as recruitment tools by increasing interest and visualizing role models in actual STEM training and occupations (Kitzinger et al 2008, 10; Steinke 2017). However, STEM professionals on screen are typically depicted as men more than women (Chimba and Kitzinger 2010). Even in “Draw-a-Scientist” tests among adolescents, scientists are more often portrayed as men (Sainz et al 2016). In studies of gender equity in science in Hong Kong, the U.K., and the U.S., recommendations to address the problem of girls and women “leaking out” of the STEM pipeline includes increasing and improving representations of women in STEM in film and TV (Chan and Cheung 2018; Haran et al 2008; Ryan and Steinke 2010; Steinke 2017). Yet, there is little research that elicits in-depth feedback of women working in STEM about the quality, not just quantity, of representations of women in STEM on screen, and how those representations helped shape their pursuit of STEM. There is a similar dearth for women undergraduates and their relationship to STEM media representations. Finally, Anglo-American qualitative scholarship of media representations of women in STEM needs diversifying; this study will broaden what are mostly Anglo-American studies and amplify predominantly East Asian voices in a site where they are the majority ethnic population, not "model minorities" (Kitzinger et al 2008). Hong Kong is also an optimal site as its local and regional television fare and streaming platforms with international content provide fresh referents. Through mixed methods (semi-structured individual interviews; focus groups interviews; questionnaire; media analysis), this study will investigate how women in Hong Kong perceive fictional film/TV representations of women in STEM. By adapting the methods of Kitzinger et al 2008, who employed a small, qualitative approach to elicit nuanced narratives about media representations of women in STEM, I will collect reflections from a range of women working in and studying STEM about the various ways in which they experience and interact with STEM-themed media representations. I will also conduct media analysis of TVB medical dramas and mainland films (e.g. Wolf Warrior II). Together, these reflections, disseminated publicly online and via public screenings, will reveal insights into relationships between gender and STEM futures in East Asia. 隨著傳染病在全球肆虐，具有科學、技術、工程和數學（STEM）知識的人才顯得炙手可熱，而世界各地都不約而同的認爲，在STEM的工作場域裏，多元性與包容性可以提升解決問題的能力（Hong and Page, 2004）。有研究指出，含有STEM相關情節的虛構敘事，對招募STEM人才有幫助，因爲那些故事能提高大衆對STEM的興趣，又可以使在STEM的真實研習和工作情景中出現的角色楷模形象化（Kitzinger et al 2008, 10; Steinke 2017）。不過，在影視屏幕上出現的STEM專業人員，通常男性比女性多（Chimba and Kitzinger 2010）；甚至給青少年做的「畫個科學家」（Draw-a-Scientist）測驗，其結果也顯示出青少年傾向把科學家描繪成男性（Sainz et al 2016）。在香港、英國及美國等地有關科學領域性別平等的多個研究，對如何處理女性在STEM的教育和職業規劃中被忽略的問題，都提出了建議：就是在與STEM有關的影視作品裏，增加STEM女性的角色並改善她們的形象（Chan and Cheung 2018; Haran et al 2008; Ryan and Steinke 2010; Steinke 2017）。 然而，在深入探討STEM的專業女性的各種考察中，甚少是關於影視作品中STEM女性形象的定性研究（而不僅是定量研究），也沒有多少是關於那些形象塑造如何影響女性對STEM的追求。至於影視媒體中的STEM與女性大學生之間的關係，也是乏人問津。最後一點，就是在英美學術界中，關於影視作品中STEM女性形象的定性研究需要多樣化。本研究項目將致力擴濶這個目前仍以英美研究為主導的局面：在英美研究中，東亞族裔往往被視爲「模範少數」（Kitzinger et al 2008）；而本研究項目則嘗試設身處地，站在東亞考察東亞，並擴大東亞人的聲音。香港正是這個研究的適合地點，因爲這裏本地的和地區性的電視節目，以及含有外國節目内容的串流平台，都為研究提供了新鮮的參考對象。 本項目會透過混合方法（半結構式個人訪談、焦點小組訪談、問卷調查、媒體分析），去研究香港的女性如何看待虛構的影視作品中的STEM女性形象。Kitzinger et al 2008的研究使用了小規模的定性途徑來獲取人們對影視媒體中STEM女性形象的細膩論述。我會採用同樣的方法，透過一組在STEM領域中學習和工作的女性，考察她們與STEM作主題的影視作品的體驗和互動，並收集她們對此的意見。我也會對香港無綫電視的醫護主題劇集以及中國大陸電影（例如《戰狼II》）作媒體分析。所有這些關於網上公開流傳和戲院公映的影視作品的意見和評論，將為我們揭示出在東亞範圍内，性別與STEM的關係和發展趨勢。

17614322.label: Project Title(Chinese)

17614322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614322.value: Parenting styles have been found to exert important influence on students’ learning and achievement, but what is less known is how different cultural values impact student achievement through affecting parenting styles. In recent decades, Chinese students’ outstanding mathematics performance has attracted the attention of many researchers. However, previous studies mainly focused on the Chinese Han group. Less attention has been paid on the mathematics learning of minority students and the cross-ethnic differences within China. Ethnic values and traditions may affect students’ learning process via family and parents. To better understand the potential cross-ethnic differences in mathematics learning within China, it is necessary to pay attention to parenting styles in diverse Chinese families. Previous studies have found that ethnic traditions can shape parenting styles and further affect students’ learning outcomes. However, these studies were mainly conducted in Western contexts. Cross-ethnic studies in China are insufficient. The present study will examine the potential cross-ethnic similarities and differences in parenting styles and their influence on students’ mathematics learning in China. The majority group (Han) and one ethnic minority group (Miao) will be selected. Traditional agricultural production and the mountain environment historically might cause Miao people to adhere more strongly to some traditional values (e.g., parent authority and family hierarchy) than Han people, which may lead to different parenting styles. To better understand parenting styles and their relationship with students’ mathematics motivation and performance in the Miao and Han groups, mixed research methods will be used. In the quantitative phase, a questionnaire survey will be conducted to compare parenting styles and mathematics learning between the Miao and Han groups and further examine the relationship between parenting styles and students’ mathematics learning in the two groups. In the qualitative phase, a series of interviews with students and parents will be conducted to elucidate and supplement the quantitative results. This project will provide information on how parenting styles affect students’ mathematics learning in Miao and Han and reveal possible cross-ethnic differences. On theoretical contribution, this study has the potentials to reveal the mechanism of the influence of ethnic traditions and values on parenting styles and students’ mathematics learning processes. For practical contribution, findings of the study could also help parents and teachers of whatever cultural traditions, including parents and teachers in Hong Kong, to understand how parenting styles may affect children’s mathematics learning, and thus guide them to optimize parenting styles to effectively support students’ learning. 很多人都知道教養方式對學生的學習和成就產生重要影響，但鮮為人知的是不同文化價值觀如何透過對教養方式的影響進而影響學生的成就。近幾十年來，華人學生出色的數學表現，引起了許多學者的關注。然而，以往的研究主要集中探究中國的漢族群體，較少關注少數民族學生的數學學習和中國國內的跨民族差異。 學生的學習過程在一定程度上難免受到家庭和父母的民族價值觀和傳統影響。為了深入了解在中國數學學習中潛在的跨民族差異，必須研究內地不同家庭的教養方式。之前有研究發現，民族傳統可以塑造教養方式並進而影響學生的學習成果。然而，這些研究主要是在西方背景下進行，中國內地的跨民族研究則不足。 本研究將探討教養方式的潛在跨民族異同及其對中國內地學生學習數學的影響。研究對象為多數族群（漢族）和一個少數民族（苗族）。傳統的農業生產和高山環境可能使苗族比漢族更固守某些傳統價值觀（例如父權和論資排輩），因此可能產生不同的教養方式。 為了更深入了解教養方式及其與苗族和漢族學生的數學學習動機和表現的關係，本研究將採用混合研究方法。在定量階段，將進行問卷調查，比較苗族和漢族的教養方式和數學學習，進一步探究兩個不同民族組別教養方式與子女數學學習的關係。在定性階段，將對學生和家長進行一系列訪談，以闡明和補充定量結果。 本研究將提供有關教養方式如何影響苗族和漢族學生數學學習的資料，並揭示潛在的跨民族差異。在理論貢獻上，本研究有可能揭示民族傳統和價值觀如何影響教養方式和學生數學學習過程的規律。就實際貢獻而言，研究結果亦可以幫助不同文化傳統的家長和教師，包括香港的家長和教師，了解教養方式如何影響兒童學習數學，從而引導他們優化教養方式，有效地幫助學生學習。

17614922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17614922.value: 情緒調控對記憶控制的促進研究

17614922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17614922.value: Prof Gross, James Mr Zhang, Jinxiao

17614922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17614922.value: 面對瘟疫和社會動盪等前所未有的挑戰，世界各地的人們罹患焦慮、抑鬱等精神疾病的風險與日俱增。精神健康問題不可避免地給個人和社會帶來巨大的負擔和損失。心理健康的維持需要人們對不良情緒（例如恐懼和悲傷）和不想要的記憶（例如創傷經歷）進行有效調節。具體而言，情緒調節研究通常關注於幫助個體改善情緒體驗的有效策略（例如分心和認知重評等策略）。記憶控制研究則通常關注於幫助個體減少不愉快記憶侵入的有效策略（例如提取抑制）。 迄今為止，關於這兩個主題的理論模型和實證研究在很大程度上是並行發展的。而二者之間的關係和相互作用卻鮮少被關注。尤其是關於情緒調節對記憶控制的影響，目前尚缺乏實證探索。 在本項目中，我們擬開展三項實驗研究來考察情緒調節和記憶控制是如何相互作用的。我們重點關注的情緒調節策略包括認知重評和分心，重點關注的記憶控制策略為提取抑制。其中實驗1將研究情緒調節和記憶控製過程在神經動力學上的異同。實驗2將考察情緒調節是否有助於隨後的記憶控制。實驗3將考察情緒調節訓練是否能夠幫助人們更好地應對消極生活事件帶來的不良記憶和情緒，從而擴展研究的生態有效性。 本項目具有較高的理論和臨床轉化意義。從理論上講，我們首次將情緒調節與記憶控制研究相結合，進行系統的實驗論證。這一探索將加深我們對自我調節背後核心神經認知過程的理解。在臨床轉化意義上，情緒調節和記憶控制能力的缺陷是多種精神疾病的跨診斷風險因素，包括抑鬱症（無法控制的反芻性思維和消極的自我評價），焦慮症（過度擔心和負性情緒偏向），創傷後應激障礙綜合徵（創傷經歷的不自主閃回和過度覺醒）等。因此，本項目的研究結果將有助於新型情緒認知干預措施的開發，並為不同精神疾病的預防和大眾心理健康的保護提供新思路。

17615422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615422.value: The proposed study Bilingual Reading 2023 (BR2023) is the sixth in a series examining trends in children’s Chinese and English reading attainment, habits and attitudes, and evaluating literacy-relate policies and practices in Hong Kong. The BR study adopts the International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement’s (IEA’s) Progress in International Reading Literacy Study (PIRLS), which provides comparative data on reading attainment of grade four children worldwide comparison. While PIRLS assessments in Hong Kong have been conducted in Chinese, the BR studies innovatively administers both Chinese and English reading tests. Approximately 40 school principals, 80 Chinese and English language teachers, 2,400 parents and 2,400 Primary 4 students will be involved in BR2023. Baseline data about students’ reading attainment, demographic background, home support, school policies, curricula and classroom practices will be assembled into a background data bank. With the assistance of surveys and research reference groups, the data will be analyzed to evaluate the influences of educational policies and practices such as reading instructional approaches on students’ reading performance. BR2023, in combination with BR2004, BR2007, BR2010, BR2013 and BR2016, addresses the prevailing lack of large-scale trend studies on bilingual reading literacy by meticulously tracking, describing and examining changes in bilingual literacies in Hong Kong across two decades. BR2023 has three objectives. Firstly, by adding novel subscales of motivation, it will examine the relationships between reading attainment, engagement and motivation, with the aim of interpreting the phenomenon of high score low motivation found in Hong Kong students’ reading. Second, it will also test the hypothesized association between Chinese and English in terms of the impact of strategy use on reading performance, and potentially inform enhancements in second language acquisition. Finally, it will also scrutinize the impact of medium of instruction (MOI) across the curriculum and in Chinese language classrooms on bilingual reading performance, providing empirical evidence for evaluation of MOI effectiveness and policy decisions on the controversial topic of whether to use a more globally-used language or students’ mother tongue in the education system. In short, the findings of BR2023 will provide a platform for reflecting on practice and making decisions about how to enhance bilingual reading literacies. Thus, it will be of interest to policy makers, curriculum planners, reading material and assessment designers teachers, parents, and most importantly, and beneficial to students. 雙語閱讀2023（BR2023）為研究兒童中英文閱讀能力、習慣和態度的趨勢，以及評估香港與讀寫能力有關的政策和實踐的系列中的第六次研究。 BR研究系列採用了國際教育成就評估協會（IEA）的國際閱讀素養進展研究（PIRLS），該研究提供了全球四年級兒童閱讀能力的比較數據。香港的PIRLS評估進行的是對中文的研究，BR研究進而測試中文和英文的閱讀能力。將有約40名校長、80名中文和英文教師、2400名家長和2400名小四學生參與BR2023研究。有關學生的閱讀成績、人口背景、家庭支持、學校政策、課程和課堂實踐的基線數據將被匯集到背景數據庫中；再輔以資料收集與研究參考小組，進行數據的整合與分析，從而得出教育政策和實踐（如閱讀教學方法）對學生閱讀成績影響的評估。 為了解香港雙語讀寫能力在二十年間的變化，BR2023研究將結合之前的BR2004、BR2007、BR2010、BR2013和BR2016研究進行大規模的追踪、歷時描述與比較。BR2023有三個目標。首先，通過添加新的動機量表，本研究將檢測閱讀成績、參與度和動機之間的關係，以探究香港學生一直以來在閱讀中出現的高分低動機現象。其次，本研究還將檢驗中文和英語在策略運用對閱讀表現的影響，從而探究可能提升二語習得的方法。最後，本研究還將探討小學課程和中文課堂中的教學媒介語如何影響雙語閱讀表現，為將來制定關於教學媒介語的政策與決策提供實證依據。 總而言之，BR2023就提升雙語閱讀素養的議題提供反思決策的研究成果；對於政策制定者、課程規劃者、閱讀教材和評估設計者、家長，乃至學生，都將受益。

17623422.value: 透過家長的數字應用對話提升幼童的數字學習能力

17623422.label: Co - Investigator(s)

17623422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17623422.value: Research in the field of math learning has demonstrated that young children’s number skills are a unique predictor of their future math achievement and adulthood career success, and that parents’ number talk is one of the most proximal ecological factors that stimulate children’s early number learning. Less research attention has been paid to which types of number talk are more effective than others in promoting children’s number learning. Emerging evidence shows that parents’ math input encouraging children’s application of math knowledge in everyday life facilitates children’s math learning. Accordingly, parents’ number application talk, defined as parents’ number talk that encourages children to apply number knowledge in real-life settings, may be a promising means of promoting children’s number learning outcomes. Based on two intervention studies of parents with preschool-aged children, the proposed project aims to examine the causal role of parents’ number application talk in enhancing children’s number skills and number interest in two real-life contexts. Both studies adopt a randomized controlled experimental design that involves three groups of parent-child dyads: a group receiving a number application talk intervention, another group receiving a number non-application talk intervention, and still another group serving as a placebo control. Whereas Study 1 consists of brief interventions implemented with 159 parent-child dyads, Study 2 comprises intensified interventions implemented with 180 parent-child dyads. The findings are expected to help identify ways to promote young children’s early math learning, and to support an emphasis in future parent education programs on incorporating math learning within meaningful parent–child interactions in informal settings. 數學學習領域的研究發現，幼童的數字能力往往關係到他們以後的數學成績及職業成功，而家長跟幼童的數字對話則能促進幼童的數學學習。究竟哪些類型的數字對話在促進幼童數學學習方面的效果更好，目前少有研究關注。最近有證據顯示，如果家長能夠鼓勵幼童運用數學知識解決日常生活中的問題，幼童的數學成績就會提升。在本研究計畫中，我們把家長在日常生活中鼓勵幼童運用數字知識的談話定義為“家長的數字應用對話”，我們推測，這種對話可能有助於幼童的數字學習。為了驗證這種推測，我們計畫對幼稚園兒童及家長實施兩項介入研究。兩項研究中都包含三個親子組合：數字應用對話組、非應用數字對話組和安慰劑控制組。研究一是一項包括159個親子組合的簡短介入實驗，研究二則是一項包括180個親子組合的長期介入實驗。我們期待這兩項實驗的研究發現可以幫我們找到促進幼童數學學習的方法，以及如何在親職教育中透過親子互動幫助幼童學習數學的有效途徑。

17623622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17623622.value: 抱有疑虑的旁观者和卡里斯马扩张

17623622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17623622.value: 在青年教师计划基金予以支持的基础上，本项目将进一步完善并推进本人现有的以卡里斯马权威为主题的一系列发表成果（Joosse 2006; 2012a; 2014; 2017a; 2018a; 2018b; 2019; Joosse & Wiley 2020）。本项目将会组织180个访谈（在试验阶段已经完成29个访谈），12周的参与式观察，并充分结合在之前研究中获得的数据资料，来探索一个适时的且未曾被彻底探讨过的课题：制度精英对于社会中卡里斯马权力扩张的重要性。本项目将勾勒出唐纳德·特朗普政治生涯中的卡里斯马要素，并以此为基础，发表本人第一本书的手稿。 卡里斯马经常被偏狭地理论化为，一种闭锁于宗教中的，领袖和其追随者之间的“纽带”。然而，纵观世界历史，卡里斯马的重要性并不源于这种内向化的亲近关系，而是在于其侵略性的外在姿态，这种姿态偶尔会通过传统型社会秩序和/或法理型社会秩序向外辐射，动摇甚至颠覆已有的社会秩序。不同于卡里斯马文献中,专注于领袖和其追随者的研究趋势，本书将跳出现有的框架，通过区分和描述抱有疑虑的旁观者—一种处于卡里斯马社群和外在社会之间，没有信仰的制度精英—来聚焦于卡里斯马的核心前沿。 虽然抱有疑虑的旁观者们意欲阻止卡里斯马运动，但是他们的干预反而事与愿违地增长了卡里斯马的潜能，使其影响力四处蔓延。这种结果通过两种方式产生。首先，他们表达的诸如震惊，恼怒，和义愤填膺的情感，给初期领导者的早期成功—即使这种成功最初是相对微小的—增添了一种愉快的惊奇感（甚至是“奇迹”）。其次，作为组织结构的喉舌，这些抱有疑虑的旁观者，在他们所代表的制度范围内，为异于寻常的表达扩大了开口，使他们全部的作为中间人的能力，能够被卡里斯马型领袖使用。这些因素结合在一起，有助于解释卡里斯马的扩张性和革命性潜能—这是社会学奠基人马克斯·韦伯在最初描述卡里斯马时提出的至关重要的特征。 我在社会学顶级期刊上曾发表过备受赞誉的研究，所以我相信这本书，暂定名为《抱有疑虑的旁观者和卡里斯马革命》，是能够获得认可的，因为他对于卡里斯马研究，对于“特朗普现象”的理解，对于韦伯，对于整个社会学都能做出里程碑式的贡献。

17624022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17624022.value: 在深刻的分歧中走向基於美德的寬恕理論

17624022.label: Project Objectives
17624022.value: Distinguish between forgiveness as a practice and a virtue, then redefine the virtue of forgiveness, making an important contribution to the literature on the moral psychology of forgiveness. Considered as a virtue, forgiveness is not modular but involves the cooperation of several virtues, including cognitive empathy, intellectual humility, and respect for the intrinsic worth of persons. As such, it is an emergent virtue. It is primarily cognitive in nature and does not, strictly speaking, require the cooperation of emotion. It is also best understood as grounded in a broadly Kantian conception of moral worth. Bring this account of forgiveness into conversation with the growing field of the epistemology of disagreement by examining how the above account of forgiveness works in cases of deep disagreement and moral complexity. Related questions explored here will be: which negative emotions does forgiveness require one to relinquish toward the offender (anger and resentment in particular) and their beliefs, should forgiveness be unconditional, how to forgive in the absence of apology or with a close-minded offender, how far does forgiveness require one to let go of one’s own point of view, and how does one maintain moral integrity while forgiving in cases where one’s moral framework is put into question (if forgiveness is possible here)?

17624022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17624022.value: We live in an increasingly polarized world where communities, families, and friendships often fracture along ideological lines. Wounds and hostility stemming from ideological differences are an everyday reality for many. Forgiveness is necessary to heal these wounds and restore broken relationships. But how does one forgive when deep disagreement persists? So far, this question remains untreated in the philosophical literature on forgiveness. This project answers this question with a virtue-based account of forgiveness. If forgiveness requires one to change one’s feelings or point of view toward a matter of deep personal concern (a well-founded moral or political opinion, for example), it seems out of reach in these cases. Common emotion-based and punishment-forbearance accounts which hold this to be necessary therefore falter in cases of deep disagreement. The virtue-based account developed here addresses this challenge, arguing that forgiveness is an emergent virtue grounded in the deeper virtues of cognitive empathy, intellectual humility, and respect for persons. According to the broadly Kantian account of virtue assumed here, these virtues are predominantly cognitive in nature. This allows that some forms of morally appropriate anger or resentment may persist and may even be morally required, provided they are guided by these virtues toward the appropriate objects. An agent equipped with these virtues demonstrates how forgiveness may be achieved when deep disagreement with an offender persists. Such an agent also demonstrates how to forgive without losing personal integrity. Such an agent is able to forgive while remaining steadfast, showing what it is like to live virtuously, maintaining wholeness personally and in one’s relationships, in a world that increasingly tends toward division. This project consists of two research papers that will prepare the groundwork for a larger project on forgiveness to be undertaken upon completion of this project. The first paper focuses on the moral psychology, providing an account of the virtue of forgiveness as distinguished from the practice of forgiveness. The second paper brings this virtue into engagement with the literature on disagreement in social epistemology, arguing that forgiveness is possible (and desirable) in cases of deep disagreement. A virtuous agent can forgive others with whom they deeply disagree, even when their own worldview, integrity, and identity are held in question. 我們生活在一個日益兩極分化的世界中，社區、家庭和友誼經常沿著意識形態路線破裂。意識形態差異造成的傷害和敵意是許多人的日常現實。寬恕對於治愈這些傷口和恢復破裂的關係是必要的。但是當深刻的分歧持續存在時，一個人如何寬恕呢？到目前為止，關於寬恕的哲學文獻中仍未處理這個問題。這個項目用基於美德的寬恕解釋來回答這個問題。如果寬恕需要一個人改變自己的感受或觀點，以解決個人深切關注的問題（例如，有充分根據的道德或政治觀點），那麼在這些情況下似乎遙不可及。因此，在嚴重分歧的情況下，認為這是必要的基於情感和懲罰-寬容的常見解釋會動搖。這裡開發的基於美德的解釋解決了這一挑戰，認為寬恕是一種新興的美德，其基礎是認知同理心、智力謙遜和尊重他人等更深層次的美德。根據這裡假設的寬泛的康德式美德說明，這些美德本質上主要是認知的。這允許某些形式的道德上適當的憤怒或怨恨可能持續存在，甚至可能在道德上是必需的，只要它們被這些美德引導到適當的對象。具備這些美德的代理人展示了當與罪犯的深刻分歧持續存在時，如何獲得寬恕。這樣的代理人還展示瞭如何在不失去個人誠信的情況下寬恕。這樣的代理人能夠在堅定不移的同時寬恕，展示道德生活的感覺，在一個越來越傾向於分裂的世界中保持個人和人際關係的完整性。 該項目由兩篇研究論文組成，這些論文將為完成該項目後開展的更大的寬恕項目奠定基礎。第一篇論文側重於道德心理學，提供了寬恕與寬恕實踐的區別的描述。第二篇論文將這種美德與關於社會認識論分歧的文獻結合起來，認為在嚴重分歧的情況下寬恕是可能的（並且是可取的）。一個有德行的代理人可以原諒與他們有深刻分歧的人，即使他們自己的世界觀、正直和身份受到質疑。
