17624622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17624622.value: The main aim of the proposed study is to examine how a participatory and collaborative approach to the regulatory governance of medical devices based on artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning (ML) should be developed and implemented in Hong Kong SAR, as part of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area (GBA). In this connection, it also seeks to explicate what it means to be “participatory” and “collaborative”; these being regulatory principles that have been put forward by the International Medical Device Regulators Forum (IMDRF), and implicit in the “Guangdong-Hong Kong- Macau Greater Bay Area Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Regulatory Innovation and Development Work Plan” (GBA Medical Device Work Plan). AI/ML-based medical devices are increasingly being incorporated into medical workflows and clinical care pathways. Expected benefits include earlier and more cost-effective interventions, greater diagnostic and prognostic accuracy, better access to care, and more effective cost control. However, ethical and legal challenges that need to be addressed include means to ensure the safety and effectiveness of these devices, improper data appropriation and use, decisional opacity, bias and liability. The three constituent jurisdictions in the GBA currently have different regulatory approaches to govern medical devices, and there is no specific ethical or regulatory guidance on AI/ML-based medical devises. Findings in this study are expected to: (1) Identify obstacles to the uptake of AI/ML-based medical devices in the GBA from the perspectives of the healthcare institutions, healthcare providers and device developers/manufacturers (“key stakeholders”); (2) Indicate the extent that these obstacles are attributable to different ethical, professional, institutional and/or regulatory differences; and (3) Set out possible solutions or responses to these obstacles that are proposed by the key stakeholders. In collaboration with the Hong Kong Academy of Medicine, this study will contribute directly to the development of new ethical and professional guidelines and new training programmes for healthcare institutions in Hong Kong, Macau and the University of Hong Kong – Shenzhen Hospital (this being the first designated medical institution under the GBA Medical Device Work Plan). To support regulatory alignment and/or convergence within the GBA, findings on regulatory obstacles and possible solutions will be shared with the Hong Kong Department of Health (and the Medical Device Control Office), Macau Health Bureau, Guangdong Health Commission and the National Medical Products Administration. Additionally, the research team will work with healthcare institutions to develop a system to track the uptake of AI/ML-based medical devices. 對於基於人工智能 (AI) 或機器學習 (ML) 的醫療設備，本研究項目的主要目的是製定一種參與性和協作性的監管治理，以在香港和大灣區 (GBA) 實施。在這方面，該項目還試圖解釋“參與”和“協作”的含義； 這些是“國際醫療器械監管機構論壇”（IMDRF）推薦的監管原則。 這些原則也隱含在《粵港澳大灣區藥品醫療器械監管創新發展工作方案》中 (醫療器械工作計劃)。 越來越多基於 AI/ML 的醫療設備被納入醫療工作流程和臨床護理路徑。預期的好處包括更早和更具成本效益的醫療護理、更高的診斷和預後準確性、更好的醫療服務以及更有效的成本控制。然而，道德和法律挑戰包括缺乏明確的法規來確保這些設備的安全性和有效性、不當的數據挪用和使用、決策不透明、偏見和不明確的法律責任。大灣區的三個組成轄區目前對醫療器械有不同的監管方法。 基於 AI/ML 的醫療設備也沒有具體的倫理或監管指導。本研究的結果預計將： (1) 從醫療機構、醫療保健提供者和設備開發商/製造商（“關鍵利益相關者”）的角度，識別大灣區採用基於人工智能/機器學習的醫療設備的障礙； (2) 指出這些障礙可歸因於不同的道德、專業、制度和/或 監管差異； 和 (3) 列出關鍵利益相關者針對這些障礙提出的可能解決方案或應對措施。 與香港醫學專科學院合作，這項研究將直接有助於為香港、澳門和香港大學深圳醫院的醫療機構制定新的倫理和專業指南以及新的培訓計劃。 港大-深圳醫院是大灣區醫療器械工作計劃下的首家定點醫療機構。有關監管障礙和可能解決方案的調查結果將與香港衛生署（和醫療器械司）、澳門衛生局、廣東省衛生委員會和國家藥品監督管理局分享。 目標是支持大灣區內的監管協調和/或融合。此外，研究團隊將與醫療機構合作開發一個系統，用於跟踪基於 AI/ML 的醫療設備的使用情況。

17624922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17624922.value: 在位优势还是在位困境？竞争优势的动态变化

17624922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17624922.value: Prof Dessein, Wouter Prof Sun, Chang

17624922.label: Project Objectives
17624922.value: Understand the incumbent advantage Understand the incumbent dilemma Understand how the barrier to entry affects firm and industry dynamics

17624922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17624922.value: We propose a single theory of two central ideas in the strategy literature: Incumbency Advantage and the Incumbent Dilemma. We show how, in the presence of both scale economies and customer captivity, market share becomes a state variable that provides a dynamic advantage to incumbent firms. Firms that have a larger market share today make larger investments in product quality, resulting in an even larger market share tomorrow. But incumbents may also face a `dilemma' between serving existing customers and acquiring new ones. In some instances, economies of scope give incumbents larger incentives to acquire new customers than new entrants, extending their advantage from one market to the next (`world dominance'). Scale economies in serving existing customers, however, also create an opportunity cost to such investments, allowing new entrants to dominate new markets (`disruption') in other instances. Agency problems may exacerbate this incumbent dilemma; organization design may mitigate it 在这个项目中，我们提出了战略文献中两个中心思想的单一理论： 在位优势和在位困境。我们展示了如何在两者都存在的情况下 规模经济和客户占有率，市场份额成为一个状态变量，提供 现有企业的动态优势。今天拥有更大市场份额的公司 对产品质量进行更大的投资，从而在明天获得更大的市场份额。 但老牌企业也可能面临服务现有客户和收购的“两难” 新的。在某些情况下，范围经济会给予现有企业更大的收购动机 新客户多于新进入者，将他们的优势从一个市场扩展到下一个市场 （世界主导地位”）。然而，服务现有客户的规模经济也创造了 此类投资的机会成本，允许新进入者主导新市场.在其他情况下。代理问题可能会加剧当前的困境； 组织设计可能会减轻它。

17624922.label: Realisation of objectives
17624922.value: We have completed the objectives and finished a draft of the paper. We have presented the paper widely, including in places like Columbia, Duke, Harvard, Wisconsin, among others. The paper is currently under review at the American Economic Review.

17624922.label: Major findings and research outcome
17624922.value: Many industries are dominated by large and very profitable firms. We develop a theory of firm dynamics, where competing firms operate a fixed-cost technology but due to customer inertia can only slowly build up a customer base. We show how the interaction between scale economies and customer inertia creates dynamic entry barriers and persistent performance differences. Our model also resolves the ‘paradox of entry barriers’: markets with higher fixed operating costs have higher long-run profits, but are unambiguously less attractive to enter, except when firms can also invest in product quality. In the latter case, early entrants can create persistent performance differences through upgrading and may want to enter high-cost markets. We have submitted the paper to the American Economic Review.

17624922.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17624922.value: We will write follow-up papers on this.

17624922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17624922.value: This research explains why massive, profitable companies dominate certain industries for so long. It boils down to a combination of high daily operating costs and "customer inertia", the tendency for people to stick with brands they know rather than switching to new ones. The study solves a business puzzle: markets that are expensive to run actually generate higher profits eventually, yet they are too risky for most new companies to enter. It shows that "early bird" companies that invest in quality products can overcome these high costs, lock in a loyal customer base, and build a wall that keeps competitors out permanently.

17625122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17625122.value: 實現健康老齡化是老年人的重要目標，也是世界衛生組織在2015到2030年老齡化工作的重點。世界衛生組織將健康老齡化定義為發展和維持使老年人保持健康的身体功能，使他們能夠成為並參與他們所重視的事情。在健康老齡化框架上，身体功能取决于一个人的内在能力（即人的所有身体和心理能力的组合）、他或她所生活的环境（基于最广泛意义上的理解，包括实体、社会和政策环境）及其相互之间的互动。然而，迄今為止關於健康老齡化的研究一直使用靜態研究方法，未能突出個體與環境交互的動態過程，也未能揭示個體與環境互動如何影響老年人身体功能。 為了克服這些挑戰，我們建議應用人與環境契合理論來更好地理解老年人功能能力的交互途徑。該理論使用個人與環境之間的兩個相互作用過程來解釋健康老齡化：作為代理的過程和發展歸屬感的過程。代理過程側重於老年人的功能行為及其與環境特徵的相互作用。歸屬過程強調情感體驗和發展對地方的依戀的過程。我們還建議使用 GPS、活動跟踪器和生態瞬時評估的最新實時數據收集方法來測試個體與環境交互的動態性質。以前沒有研究試圖結合這三種方法來研究健康衰老的動態過程。 擬議的研究旨在：1) 根據世卫组织框架開發新的實時指標來描述健康老齡化；2) 通過將動態評估和經驗抽樣方法與傳統的靜態活動測量方法進行比較來驗證它們的使用； 3) 通過應用人與環境契合理論提出的代理和歸屬模型的見解，促進對世卫组织健康老齡化框架的理論理解，以更好地理解内在能力，生活的环境，和身体功在世卫组织健康老齡化模型中的動態性質。將招募三百名老年人參加面對面訪談以完成問卷調查，然後使用全球定位系統、活動跟踪器和生態瞬時評估進行七天的數據收集。可交付成果是一套新的動態健康老齡化阻斷劑，供世界衛生組織及其成員國監測其在健康老齡化十年（目標#1）邁向健康老齡化方面的進展，以及基於動態評估和經驗抽樣方法的新研究方法（目標 #2)，以及對界衛生組織健康老齡化模型的潛在互動途徑的新理論理解（目標 #3）。

18300622.value: 具有偶數或奇數本構關係的無粘性活動標量方程的適定性和奇異點形成

18300622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18300622.value: 無粘性活動標量方程屬於一種特殊類型的輸運方程，其中的標量函數可以通過一些本構定律與速度場建立數學關係。這種微分方程來自眾多的物理模型，例如 納維爾-斯托克斯方程、歐拉方程或磁流體動力學方程，它們在從流體力學到大氣科學、海洋學和地球物理學的實際應用中都具有重要意義。在這個研究項目中，PI 提議研究對一般類無粘性活動標量方程的適定性和有限時間的奇異點形成相關的不同數學問題，這些問題出現在各種物理模型中，包括表面準地轉方程、不可壓縮多孔介質方程和非粘性磁地轉方程。該項目的主要目標是研究在各種參數狀態下的一類一般無粘性活動標量方程以及將標量函數與速度場相關的一些特定本構定律實現一些基本結果。這樣的問題之所以困難主要是因為本構定律在不同的參數範圍內表現得截然不同，並且這個問題的成功將影響基礎物理科學，其方式是通過建立適定性和發現這些數學模型可能存在的奇點，它可以幫助我們在更深層次上解釋和認識相應的物理現象。該項目的第二個目標是將一般類別的無粘性活動標量方程的結果應用於一些著名的物理模型。這樣的問題是至關重要但具有挑戰性的，因為我們尚未完全理解流體力學或物理科學中的一些系統，這個問題的成功將為我們研究這些物理現象帶來一些全新的途徑。短期而言，該項目可帶動香港學者與其他國際專家的合作，有利於加強未來學術界與各方持份者的合作。此外，該項目可以為本科生和研究生提供學習應用分析各個理論領域的機會，幫助他們為以後的研究做好準備。從長遠來看，這個項目最終將給我們的社會帶來良好的影響，因為它豐富了我們對不同物理科學分支的理解，有助於改善我們的生活環境和質素。

18300922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18300922.value: 利用射電觀測探測暗物質訊號

18300922.label: Project Objectives
18300922.value: Observing radio signals of dark-matter-rich galaxy clusters. Constraining dark matter properties by the observed radio data. Detecting and identifying possible signals of dark matter annihilation. Facilitating collaboration between local theoretical and observational astrophysicists in Hong Kong.
rows: Observing radio signals of dark-matter-rich galaxy clusters.
Constraining dark matter properties by the observed radio data.
Detecting and identifying possible signals of dark matter annihilation.
Facilitating collaboration between local theoretical and observational astrophysicists in Hong Kong.

18300922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18300922.value: Dark matter is the most intriguing scientific mystery that continues to captivate the attention of the wider world, as well as engaging the analytical minds devoted to studying astrophysics and particle physics. Abundant observational data suggest that this unknown matter exists in our universe and that none of the existing particles we know of have the unique properties of dark matter. Various candidates of particles have been proposed over several decades to explain the composition of dark matter. Specifically, one class of candidates called weakly interactive massive particles (WIMPs) has been the most popular as a possible candidate in hypotheses on the subject of dark matter in recent years, though some experiments appear to have achieved only null signal so far. We know that dark matter particles do not interact with ordinary matter, which makes its detection extremely difficult. However, if dark matter particles were able to self-annihilate as predicted by theoretical models, large amounts of high-energy particles would be produced. Thus, many researchers are now aiming to observe signals of gamma rays or positrons originating from dark matter annihilation. So far, there has been no confirmation of dark matter signals. Indeed, some signals that were previously thought to be from dark matter annihilation were later found to be highly degenerate due to the presence of pulsar emissions in our galaxy. However, high-energy electrons and positrons that originate from dark matter annihilation can emit synchrotron radiation in radio bands when there is a strong magnetic field. Such signals of dark matter annihilation may well be detectable by radio observations because so many galaxies and galaxy clusters have strong magnetic fields. In this project, we propose to analyze the radio continuum spectral data of galaxy clusters previously observed to search for signals from dark matter annihilation. New radio data of several galaxy clusters will also be observed with a wide range of frequencies using the Nanshan Radio Telescope. We have developed an effective method to differentiate between cosmic ray emissions and emissions of high-energy electron-positron pairs originated from dark matter annihilation using the radio continuum spectral data of galaxy clusters. It is possible for us to detect signals of dark matter annihilation using our developed theoretical framework. If any dark matter signals can be identified, we will be able to significantly further our understanding of the nature of dark matter, and facilitate the discovery of new particles in future collider experiments. 在天文物理和粒子物理的研究領域中，暗物質是其中一個最受關注的謎團之一。大量的觀測數據指出一種未知的暗物質存在於宇宙中，而且該物質的特性並不符合我們現時標準粒子模型中任何一種粒子。過去數十年間曾有不少理論粒子被提出嘗試解釋暗物質的組成，當中有一類型稱為「弱交互作用重粒子」的粒子，雖然該種粒子還未被正式發現，但它是現時其中一種暗物質的熱門選擇。我們知道暗物質粒子與正常物質幾乎沒有交互作用，這令探測暗物質粒子的難度極高。然而，不少理論模型指出暗物質粒子會互相碰撞並產生湮滅作用，這現象可以產生大量的高能粒子。故此，不少研究暗物質的學者都在嘗試探測這些由暗物質湮滅作用所產生的高能粒子，包括伽瑪射線、反電子等的訊號。到現時為止，我們並未正式發現到任何有關暗物質的訊號，早期一些疑似暗物質訊號的發現都可能只是來自脈衝星的訊號而已。然而，由暗物質湮滅作用所產生的高能粒子，能夠在強磁場下產生同步輻射。由於普遍星系與星系團都有強大的磁場，當中產生出來的同步輻射能夠被射電望遠鏡觀測得到。在這研究項目中，我們將透過分析由星系團發出的射電連續光譜，嘗試尋找暗物質的湮滅作用訊號。我們會利用南山射電望遠鏡以多個頻率觀測一些星系團的射電連續光譜訊號，並透過由我們創立的分析方法將宇宙射線訊號與暗物質訊號分別出來，這有可能讓我們探測到暗物質的真正潛在訊號，從而增加我們對暗物質的認識和促使大型粒子對撞機實驗可以找到新粒子。

18300922.label: Major findings and research outcome
18300922.value: Apart from observing new radio data for analysis, we have analysed archival data to constrain dark matter. The data of several targets have been analysed, including M33 galaxy, G2 cloud and RXJ1720 galaxy cluster. Besides, we have also investigated the possible radio absorption effect of dark matter in our atmosphere, the data of the alleged planet nine, the 21-cm radio cosmological data, and the data of two black hole binary systems. These analyses have helped constrain the properties of dark matter in various ways. Altogether we have published seven high-impact journal papers based on this project. We have constrained some possible ranges of dark matter mass (~ 30-200 GeV) and annihilation channels. We have also discovered some evidence supporting the existence of dark matter density spikes in black hole binary systems. Also, in the M33 analysis, we have first combined the multi-frequency analysis with the radio profile analysis to come up with better constraints of dark matter. It can initiate more new radio analyses following this approach. Furthermore, through this project, we have established a very close connection with the Xinjiang Astronomical Observatory and we have initiated some new research collaboration. We have involved in the upcoming new Qitai Radio Telescope, which will be the largest steering radio telescope in the world. We will have more opportunities to engage in the state-of-the-art radio astronomical research.

18300922.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
18300922.value: Through this project, we have initiated some new research direction, including the combination of multi-frequency analysis with the radio profile analysis and the studies of dark matter density spikes. The new approach and the results of the dark matter density spike studies can be used to investigate the radio signature of the supermassive black hole in our Galactic Center (Sgr A*). We will propose new research study by using these results in the future. Besides, this project has faciliated the collaboration between Xinjiang Astronomical Observatory and our research group. The upcoming Qitai Radio Telescope is under construction and it can be used in 2028. We will propose new research studies using the new Qitai Radio Telescope and continue to collaborate with Xinjiang Astronomical Observatory. Because of this project, the science goals of the Qitai Radio Telescope have included the study of dark matter. Therefore, our research group will be involved in the dark matter study using the new telescope.

18300922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
18300922.value: Observational data indicate that dark matter exists in our universe. However, the properties of dark matter are still poorly understood. In this project, we have used radio data to identify if there is any possible signal of dark matter and constrain dark matter properties. Using the data of M33 galaxy, G2 cloud and RXJ1720 galaxy cluster, we have obtained some possible ranges of dark matter mass and identified some slightly positive signals of dark matter. We have also developed new techniques to combine the multi-frequency method and radio profile method to analyse radio data of a galaxy. This initiates a new pathway to search for dark matter signals in future. Further follow-up investigations and analyses will be continued to solve the long lasting problem of dark matter.

18612922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18612922.value: 比較香港與中華臺北中學領袖對公民學習影響的研究

18612922.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18612922.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof Kennedy, Kerry Prof Lee, John Chi Kin Dr Liou, Show-Mann

18612922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18612922.value: School principals struggle to meet their responsibility as civic leaders by preparing their students via citizenship education to navigate polarized, pluralistic societies, such as Hong Kong and Chinese Taipei. Despite Hong Kong and Chinese Taipei 's similar cultural heritages, their regimes have produced differences in: (a) school leadership and policy in civic education; (b) teaching civics; and (c) student attitudes—all of which can affect civic learning (*Kennedy et al., 2016). Although past studies have demonstrated the effects of one or more of these mechanisms (*Kennedy et al., 2016), no published study has integrated them into a comprehensive three-level model (principal, teacher, student) and demonstrated how they account for civic learning. Building on past studies of school leadership and students’ civic learning, we propose and test a three-level theoretical model of civic learning. The model will take into account principals’ civic accountability and trust (Szeto, 2020) which enables teacher autonomy, self-efficacy and trust (*Wong et al., 2020), which in turn increase students’ autonomy, self-efficacy and civic learning outcomes (Knowles & McCafferty-Wright, 2015). This study investigates how school leaders can provide suitable policy and support to enhance civic teaching and learning. A mixed method approach, utilizing surveys and interviews with principals, teachers and students will provide the data to test our three-level civic learning model. Our study will use a sequential explanatory design to collect and analyze data in Hong Kong and Chinese Taipei. We will analyze surveys (validated by *Wong et al., 2021) from 80 principals, 320 teachers and 1200 students from 40 secondary schools in Hong Kong and Chinese Taipei (half in each). A multilevel structural equation model will test the relationships among principal leadership, teachers’ teaching and students' civic learning. We will also interview 10 principals, 20 teachers and 25 students at 10 schools and examine their leadership, teaching and learning processes via recursive, inductive and thematic analysis. Our analyses will yield three-level findings that inform a comprehensive theory of civic learning and identify principal and teacher practices that contribute to school leadership and citizenship/civic education. The results of this study will provide pedagogical and practical knowledge for informing professional development training for: (a) principals to enhance their leadership of civic education; and (b) teachers to enhance their civics teaching. We will disseminate our findings via journal articles and policy briefs to extend this line of research, inform policy makers, and stimulate a discussion among the general public. 學校校長們通過公民教育努力履行他們作為公民領袖的責任以便使學生們更好的適應兩極分化和多元化的社會（如香港和臺北）。儘管香港和臺北有相似的文化傳統，他們的管理制度卻不同，因而在以下方面產生了差異：（a）學校在公民教育方面的領導以及公民教育政策；（b） 公民教育方法；（c）學生態度。這些差異都會影響學生公民意識的學習（*Kennedy等人，2016）。儘管之前的研究已經分別證明了以上因素對學生公民意識的影響（*Kennedy等人，2016年），目前還沒有任何研究將以上因素整合為一個綜合的三階模型（校長、教師、學生）以研究這三種因素對學生公民意識學習的綜合影響。基於以往對學校領導和學生公民學習的研究，我們提出並將測試一個公民學習理論的三階模型。該模型將研究校長的公民責任感和信念，以及它們在激勵教師自主性，提升教師自我效能感以及信念感中發揮的作用（*Wong等人，2020）。更優化的校長領導力和教師教學能夠進一步提升學生的自主性，自我效能感以及公民意識學習成果（Knowles和McCafferty-Wright，2015）。 本研究將探討學校領導如何提供適當的政策和支持以加強公民教學。本研究採用質性和量化相結合的混合研究方法，通過對校長、教師和學生問卷調查和訪談的形式來測試我們提出的三階公民學習模型。我們的研究將使用解釋性時序設計來收集和分析來自香港和臺北的40所中學的80名校長、320名教師和1200名學生（各占一半）的數據（問卷經Wong等人於2021年驗證）。我們將使用多層結構方程模型來測試校長領導力、教師教學和學生公民學習之間的關係。此外，我們還將採訪10所學校的10名校長、20名教師和25名學生以便更深刻的了解他們的領導、教學和學習過程。我們將使用遞迴、歸納和主題分析的方法分析訪談數據。 我們的研究將產生三個層面的結果並構建一個有關學生公民學習的綜合理論框架。此外，我們的研究將發現並歸納總結校長及教師針對公民教育的有效教育實踐。我們的研究成果能夠為以下人士針對公民教育提供理論和實踐指導：（a）校長們可以參考我們的研究加強對公民教育的指導；（b）教師可以參考我們的研究提升公民教育技巧。我們也會將我們的研究成果發佈在期刊雜誌以及政策簡報上，以進一步擴大本研究的影響力，啟發政策決策者以及激勵公眾討論。

18613922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18613922.value: 超過130年的記憶研究表明，比起在短時間內硬記大量知識，有規律地隔開（分散）學習時間會有更好的學習和記憶效果（Cepeda et al., 2006）。此外，有幾個變量會影響這些間隔效果，包括（a）學習次數、（b）學習間隔的長度（Intersession Interval，以下簡稱為ISI），（c）相同或逐漸延長的學習間隔，以及（d）練習及學後測驗之間的時間長度（Retention Interval以下簡稱為 RI）。然而，我們並未深入了解這些變量如何互動，影響分散學習時間的效果，對其在學習第二語言（L2）方面的作用更是知之甚少（*Rogers, 2017, 2020）。此外，現存間隔研究的生態效度未能令人信服，限制了研究結果對真實L2學習環境的普遍性。 為了填補這些研究缺口，我們建議在網上進行大規模研究（n ≥ 1080），透過3個 ISI（3、9或21天）及6個RI（1 至192天），有系統地考查相同或逐漸延長的學習間隔對L2詞彙學習的影響。然後，使用高級統計分析方法分析這些數據，以查明間隔與學習成果之間的關係，並建立模型。 我們的研究結果將（a）有助我們理解學習機制，認識相同或逐漸延長的學習間隔有何相對優勢，並（b）為課程規劃及教學實踐提供資訊，例如如何安排時間，分配課程內容，以達致最佳學習效果。這項研究將會處理以往文獻未有提及，關於學習間隔對長期記憶保留L2詞彙的影響。對教授及學習第二語言習範疇，如應用語言學/第二語言習得，以及範圍更大的教育科學領域感興趣的研究人員而言，本研究十分值得關注。 在實踐層面，本項目將幫助教師、課程設計者及政策制定者了解應如何間隔學習，以達致最佳的記憶保留效果。對於政策制定者而言，研究結果可用於討論應讓學生在正規教育中隔多久學習一次外語，以及每次學習多久。研究數據將有助課程設計者編排現有的課程內容，以達致學習成果，並促進長期學習。本項目將為教師、學生及家長提供指引，協助其在課堂及家中作學習規劃，以加強學習及記憶效果。

18614922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18614922.value: 漢化辛約翰：辛約翰劇本在大中華地區的翻譯與接受

18614922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18614922.value: 辛約翰(1871-1909)在二十世紀愛爾蘭文學備受推崇，特別是其戲劇創作，例如《西部痞子英雄》和《騎馬下海人》，尤為後人所稱頌。今年是辛約翰一百五十週年紀念，其作品經常展示鄉野、抵抗、想像的重要性，同時卻也因其另類書寫國家與女性而遭人詬病。辛約翰雖然在歐美文壇頗有名氣，但相較於葉慈等塞爾特文藝復興作家，其劇作在大中華地區較少人聽聞。然而，自1920年代以來，辛約翰戲劇在中國及台灣已有九位譯者，其重要性可見一斑。這些譯本雖質量可觀，卻少見相關研究。本計劃將詳細討論辛約翰戲劇的中文譯本，內容包九位譯者：郭沫若、徐序瑄、田漢、彭鏡禧、馬清照、陳戈、蔡進松、張崇旂、謝志賢。為能進一步瞭解辛約翰的中文譯本，本研究亦討論《西部痞子英雄》的兩個劇場表演，第一場於2006年在北京演出，而第二場則在2016年於台北登場。本計劃擬依照譯本出版的時間順序，研究辛約翰戲劇在大中華地區的譯本與舞台演出，期能處理不同年代譯本的重要議題：跨文化翻譯的本質與類型、中西方文化的交互影響、早期文化藝術的歸化與異化、可譯性的語言學問題等等。除了上述譯本與舞台演出以外，為能全盤了解辛約翰作品於華文地區的接收與理解，本計劃也將檢視其他研究資料，例如期刊論文、博碩士論文、以及報章雜誌文章等等。橫向來看，本研究將有助深入瞭解辛約翰戲劇在大中華地區的翻譯、接受、以及影響。縱向而言，本計劃將有助於闡明辛約翰劇本中譯作為現代中國與西方文化交流一環的意涵。

18615522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18615522.value: 校長的工作本質是複雜多變並具有挑戰性的，這種情形在新冠病毒大流行後更加明顯。這一現象不可避免的會影響校長的個人福祉和學校效能。校長職業韌性也相應的成為具有時代效應的一個研究領域以便更好的支持校長處理職業挑戰和不確定性的未來。香港校長的情形相對而言更加需要職業韌性來迎接社會，政治等各方面的挑戰。 本研究項目旨在調查校長職業韌性及其職業相關的影響因素。此專案的第一個目的是開發並檢驗校長職業韌性問卷效能。第二個目的是調查校長職業韌性的現狀。第三個目的是確定影響校長職業韌性的工作資源和工作要求等因素以及這些影響因素之間的協同效應。第四個目的是確定這些因素是怎樣影響校長職業韌性的。 本研究項目將運用包括質化和量化混合研究方法。質化研究方法包括24名校長的訪談和3名專家訪談。量化研究方法包括兩個問卷調查，分別包括50-100 和300-350名校長。 本研究專案將有助於完善校長職業韌性這一研究領域。此研究項目的成果將幫助校長和研究者設計關於校長職業韌性的干預專案，提高校長職業韌性以便更好地處理職業挑戰和迎接不確定的未來。本研究專案的成果也將給政府決策者提供改變現有相關政策和制定新的相關政策的建議。

18615622.label: Project Objectives
18615622.value: The first objective of this project is to test whether Contrast or Induction is more effective in enhancing children’s awareness of the function of components in signifying meaning in characters. The second objective is to determine the delayed learning effects of children in their awareness of the function of components three weeks after receiving Contrast and Induction. The third objective is to find out to what extent the learning effects of children from Contrast and Induction can be transferred to their awareness of the function of some other components not mentioned during the instruction. The fourth objective is to uncover whether the children indeed make significant improvement in immediate and delayed testing of their awareness of the function of components after receiving Induction, which is apparently counter to the conjecture of variation theory, as compared to random pairings of characters.

18615622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18615622.value: Learning Chinese characters is immensely hard (Moser, 1991). Existing research on teaching characters are however mostly based on anecdotal evidence (Lam, 2011). More rigorous interventional studies that examine the taken-for-granted practice of teachers are lacking. This project is about how learning can be enhanced in the context of teaching characters. The specific purpose of the project is to ascertain more effective way to foster children’s awareness of the function of components in characters, which is to become aware of the functions components of characters can play in signifying the meanings of the characters. For example, a three-dot component (meaning ‘water’) on the left-hand side of the character 浪 ‘wave’ signifies the relation of its meaning to ‘water’. Plenty of evidence from psychological studies indicates that children’s awareness of such functions of components is of crucial importance to their future learning of other novel characters (Chan & Nunes, 1998; Ho, Ng, & Ng, 2003; Shu & Anderson, 1997). In practice, from my experience, almost all teachers teach the function of a three-dot component by giving several examples of characters having this component and related meanings; for example, 浪 ‘wave’ and 湯 ‘soup’ (In this project, this common, but unexamined, practice is called Induction condition). However, this is contradictory to the conjecture of variation theory, which is one of the contemporary theories of learning currently gaining wide popularity in educational research. Variation theory posits that, ‘We cannot discern quality X without simultaneously experiencing a mutually exclusive quality ~X (Marton & Pang, 2006, p. 199).’ Applying this argues that in order for children to discern the function of the three-dot component, they must experience variations in characters with and without a three-dot component and being related and unrelated to ‘water’; for example, 浪 ‘wave’ and 狼 ‘wolf’ (called Contrast condition). This project puts the above conjecture of variation theory to the test. Experimental design is adopted with about 150 (K3) children, recruited from three mainstream kindergartens, randomly assigned to three instructional conditions: Induction, Contrast, and Control. In classrooms, the same set of 16 characters are taught in different order in the three conditions. Pre-, immediate post-, and delayed post-tests are administered before, right after, and also three weeks following the teaching. The expected benefit of this interventional study is its intended contribution to the theoretical development of variation theory. Moreover, the results also inform the everyday practice of teaching in schools. 學習漢字並不容易（Moser, 1991）。現存漢字教學的研究，一般依據軼事資料提出議論（Lam, 2011）。嚴謹的干預研究，以驗證教師視為理所當然的教學實踐，並不常見。 本計劃探究如何提升學習的成效，以漢字學習作為例子。計劃的具體目的，是確定有效提升幼兒對漢字部件功能覺識的方法，即幼兒能認出部件能標示字義的功能。譬如說，有「三點水」部件的字（例如：「浪」），可能與「水」的意思有關。 心理學研究顯示，幼兒覺識這部件功能，對他們將來學習其他漢字十分重要。（Chan & Nunes, 1998; Ho, Ng, & Ng, 2003; Shu & Anderson, 1997）。 依據筆者的觀察，教師在學校的實踐是，當要教「三點水」部件功能時，會採用有該部件、並且字義相關的字來舉例說明，例如：「浪」與「湯」。這常見、但未曾驗證過的教學方法，本研究稱為「歸納」方法。 然而，這教學方法，與學習理論中變易理論的推測，存有矛盾。變易理論指出：我們如果未曾經驗過屬性 ~X，就無法辨識屬性X（Marton & Pang, 2006）。把這理論應用到「三點水」部件功能的教學，則得出教師應使用字例「浪」與「狼」（稱為「對比」方法）。 本研究旨在驗證這變易理論的推測。研究採取實驗設計，從三所主流幼稚園中，邀請約一百五十位高班幼兒參與。研究把幼兒隨機分成三組，稱為「歸納」、「對比」、「控制」組。教師在三組中，分別使用不同方法，教幼兒相同的十六字。研究會在教學前、後、約三星期後，為幼兒進行前測、後測、延宕測。 本研究的結果，盼能促進變易理論本身的發展，以及改善學校的日常教學實踐。

18616522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18616522.value: 為甚麼學習騎自行車可以改善自閉症兒童的執行功能？

18616522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18616522.value: Prof Anderson, David. I Prof Chan, Ka Shing Kevin Dr Cheng, James Wesley Ching-Hei Ms Ho, Amy Wing Yin Dr Lai, Wing Him Elvis Dr Lee, Paul Hong Ms Liu, Hok Ling Venus Dr Szechy, Kathryn A Dr Tse, Choi Yeung Andy

18616522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18616522.value: 執行功能 (EF) 是一組高級認知功能，使我們能夠計劃、記著指令、控制注意力和靈活思考。最新研究顯示，自閉症譜系障礙 (ASD) 不僅會影響患者的社交互動、溝通技巧、情緒和行為調節，還會影響在兒童時期的執行功能等認知功能。儘管臨床醫生和研究人員不認為執行功能障礙是 ASD 的主要特徵，但他們很清楚普遍 ASD 會有這種認知功能障礙。研究顯示，ASD在兒童時期對執行功能障礙的負面影響可能很嚴重，因為它可能會損害集中和聚焦注意力的能力，亦影響他們組織、計劃、開始和完成任務以及將轉移注意力的能力。因此制定一套有效針對ASD的執行功能障礙的干預策略非常重要，其中一種受到越來越多關注的干預策略是體育鍛煉。最近，我們開始一項 RCT 研究，通過比較兩種踏自行車的干預計劃（學習自行車組與固定自行車組）對 ASD 兒童的認知影響，了解體育鍛煉如何影響認知功能。結果顯示，只有學習自行車組的EF有所改善，而固定自行車組或對照組則沒有。這一發現很有趣，因為它代表學習技能的過程才是體育鍛煉對ASD人士認知功能有改善的原因，而不是運動本身引起的生理變化。在這項擬議的研究中，我們打算對運動干預的組成部分進行更深入的研究，嘗試了解哪一組成部分對於改善ASD 兒童的 EF 至關重要。例如，(A) 身體在平移過程中對空間的適應 (B) 學習踏自行車過程中相關的動態平衡需求對改善EF的幫助。在這項研究中，我們將對 100 名患有 ASD 的兒童參與者進行隨機對照試驗，比較 1）學習自行車組（招募機制 A 和 B），2）學習在滾輪自行車機上踏自行車（招募機制 B），踏有輔助輪的自行車（招募機制 A）和固定自行車組（不屬於任何招募機制）的EF。三個因變量將在進行干預計劃之前 (T1)、中期 (T2) 和10 周之後 (T3) 進行評估。因變量包括：1）執行功能，由四個組成部分（計劃、靈活性、工作記憶和抑制能力），2）身體活動水平和 3）尿液 BDNF 水平。這項擬議研究的結果可以為對體育鍛煉如何改善 ASD 兒童的認知功能提供重要的見解，從而幫助設計更有效的干預計劃，以改善 ASD 兒童的認知、運動表現、健康和功能獨立性。

18619322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18619322.value: 從卓越到影響：香港和英國研究評審的比較研究

18619322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18619322.value: Dr Lee, Jack T. Prof Macfarlane, Bruce

18619322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18619322.value: Impact beyond academia has become an essential component of research assessment in HK. Although there is an abundance of literature in the field of higher education studies that exemplifies how the impact agenda has changed the UK’s higher education system – on which HK is traditionally modelled – little is known about the implications of this evolution of research assessment in the local context. A key theme that emerges in the UK literature is criticism that the impact agenda has undermined the freedom and autonomy of academics, causing an erosion of integrity and authenticity in academia. This theme essentially corresponds to the public/private dualism emphasised in Anglo-American societies. This dualism however is less relevant to Chinese culture, which tends instead to stress an overlap between public and private. This research will take this overlap as a counter to the public/private dualism to construct a theoretical framework for comparing how the impact agenda is received in HK and the UK. This research will consist of two qualitative inquiries designed to explore the significance of the cultural approaches to the public/private distinction in understanding the reception of the impact agenda in the two different contexts, supplemented with a documentary analysis that offers a thorough review of policy transfer in research assessment between HK and the UK. The first qualitative inquiry will investigate perceptions of the impact agenda among 96 academics from eight case universities in the two jurisdictions. In the second qualitative inquiry, participants from key research funding bodies and research users recruited via the case universities will be interviewed about their expectations for academic research in the two systems; this inquiry will continue until it reaches data saturation. This comparative research will provide a thorough understanding of the evolution of the impact agenda in HK and the UK. By comparing academics’ perceptions with funders’ and research users’ expectations, the research will offer a deeper understanding of how the impact imperative of academic research is received by key stakeholders in the sector, thereby enriching empirical knowledge of the manifestation of public accountability in the two higher education systems. By incorporating the cultural elements, the research will establish an innovative theoretical approach to the examination of the prevalent impact agenda in higher education. 對學術界以外的影響力已成為香港研究評審的重要組成部分。儘管在高等教育研究領域已有大量文獻分析了影響力議程如何改變英國的高等教育制度，而香港傳統上亦以英國制度為楷模，但我們仍對此研究評審的演變對香港高等教育的影響知之甚少。 有關英國的文獻主要批評影響力議程削弱了學術界的自由和自主，並導致學術界的誠信和真誠到侵蝕。此評論本質上對應了英美社會所強調的公私二元論。然而，這種二元論與中國文化並不契合。中國文化傾向於強調公私之間的重疊。本研究以此強調公私重疊的理念對應公私二元論，從而構建一理論框架以比較香港和英國如何接受影響力議程。 本研究將包括兩項定性調查，旨於探討對公私區隔的不同文化態度如何影響港英兩地人們對影響力議程的接受程度，並透過文獻綜述以了解港英兩地研究評審的政策轉移。第一項定性調查將著眼來自港英兩地的八所大學的 96 名學者對影響力議程的看法。第二項定性調查則以兩地的研究資助機構和研究用戶為訪談對象，以了解他們對學術研究的期望。此調查將持續至獲得足夠數據為止。 這項比較研究將對香港和英國影響力議程的演變作深入剖析。通過比較學者的看法與資助者和研究用戶的期望，本研究讓我們更深入地了解兩地高等教育主要持份者如何理解學術研究的影響力，從而對兩地如何演繹公共問責性有更豐富的實證知識。通過結合文化元素，本研究將建立一種嶄新的理論方法，用以了解高等教育中日趨重要的影響力議程。

18620022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18620022.value: 家長過份使用手機與孩子的內顯和外顯問題：邁向一個統整的模型

18620022.label: Project Objectives
18620022.value: To examine the longitudinal association of parents’ use of smartphones with their children’s internalizing symptoms and externalizing behaviors. To examine different family processes as mediators of such associations.
rows: To examine the longitudinal association of parents’ use of smartphones with their children’s internalizing symptoms and externalizing behaviors.
To examine different family processes as mediators of such associations.

18620022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18620022.value: More and more people use their smartphones nonstop, finding it hard to refrain from using their mobile devices even in the middle of tasks or in the presence of others. Research has been testing how such problematic use of smartphones may affect individual adjustment, but little work has been conducted on how parents’ problematic use of smartphones may affect the adjustment of their children. In the early years, two broadband indices that underlie child adjustment are internalizing symptoms (e.g., depression, anxiety, psychosomatic complaints) and externalizing behaviors (e.g., inattention, aggression, conduct problems). Therefore, we proposed to use a 3-wave panel design to examine whether fathers’ and mothers’ problematic use of smartphones are longitudinally associated with their children’s internalizing symptoms and externalizing behaviors in early childhood, and whether such associations are mediated by four different family processes. Integrating an under-involvement hypothesis, a distraction hypothesis, a distress and hostility hypothesis, and an active learning hypothesis, we will examine whether parental problematic use of smartphones may increase child internalizing symptoms and externalizing behaviors by reducing parent-child interactions in general, distracting parents while interacting with their children, increasing parents’ anger and hostility toward their children, and increasing children’s own use of smartphones. On three occasions over 2 years, fathers and mothers will independently fill in questionnaires and daily diaries on their smartphone use and parenting practices. Children will be individually interviewed, completing tasks that reveal their internalizing symptoms and externalizing behaviors. Class teachers will also fill in questionnaires on the internalizing symptoms and externalizing of children. Multilevel cross-lagged models will be used to examine whether increases in fathers’ and mothers’ problematic use of smartphones uniquely predict increases in internalizing symptoms and externalizing behaviors of their children, and test decreases in parent-child involvement, increases in parents’ distraction during parent-child interactions, increases in parents’ anger and hostility, and increases in parents’ use of smartphones to calm their children as mediators. The proposed study is important at both theoretical and practical levels. Theoretically, it will move the field forward by developing a comprehensive framework that illustrates how parents’ mobile technology use may affect their family relationships and the adjustment of their children. Practically, it will address whether parents should regulate their use of smartphones in the absence and presence of their children, and whether children’s own use of smartphones at times of distress does more harm than good to them in the early years. 越來越多人感到難以放下自己的智能手機：就算是在工作過程當中或在與別人面對面溝通時，很多人都覺得要時刻「機不離手」。學者發現，過份使用手機對個人發展有負面影響，但很少學者研究家長過份使用手機對孩子發展的影響。在幼兒時期，孩子的兩大發展指標包括內顯問題﹙如：抑鬱、焦慮和身心不適﹚和外顯問題﹙如：難以專注、身體暴力和行為問題﹚。所以，我們會收集數據三次，了解父親和母親過份使用手機如何影響孩子的內顯和外顯問題。我們更會測試不同的家庭因素，看看它們可否解釋家長使用手機與孩子發展結果的關係。綜合四個不同的理論，包括「減少照顧理論」、「分心理論」、「不安與暴躁理論」和「孩子過份使用手機理論」，我們會測試過份使用手機的家長會否減少與孩子互動的時間、與孩子互動時顯得心不在焉、與孩子互動時顯得易怒和沒有耐性或經常讓孩子用手機，進而增加孩子的內顯和外顯問題。在兩年內的三個時間點，父親與母親將會用問卷和日記方式記錄他們使用手機的習慣和教養孩子的方法。孩子則會接受訪問，完成可以顯示他們的發展結果的小任務。老師則會填寫問卷，評價孩子的內顯和外顯問題。我們將會運用「交叉滯後面板模型」去測試父親和母親過份使用手機和孩子結果的關係，亦會測試種種家庭因素為中介因素。這項研究在理論和實踐層面都有重要貢獻。在理論層面，我們將會融合四個不同的理論，推出一個統整的模型，了解家長使用手機的習慣如何影響家庭互動和幼兒發展。在實踐層面，我們將會幫助大眾理解家長在孩子面前是否真的需要節約使用手機，將會幫助大眾理解幼兒過早使用手機究竟是好是壞。

18621522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18621522.value: 中國大陸的技術官僚與中層政策企業家：解釋社會福利領域的地方政策創新

18621522.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18621522.value: Dr Liu, Xiaoting Prof Mintrom, Michael Dr Tang, Na

18621522.label: Project Objectives
18621522.value: To illuminate the entrepreneurial role played by mid-level technocrats in China’s social welfare innovations at the local level To examine the motivations, strategies, processes, and outcomes of mid-level policy entrepreneurship in selected cases To explain—through comparative case studies—the interaction between institutional structure and individual agency in the process of mid-level policy entrepreneurship in authoritarian China To enrich scholarly understanding of policy innovations in the social welfare arena as well as bureaucratic behaviors in contemporary China To experiment with a compound comparative case research design on subnational policy process in a large country
rows: To illuminate the entrepreneurial role played by mid-level technocrats in China’s social welfare innovations at the local level
To examine the motivations, strategies, processes, and outcomes of mid-level policy entrepreneurship in selected cases
To explain—through comparative case studies—the interaction between institutional structure and individual agency in the process of mid-level policy entrepreneurship in authoritarian China
To enrich scholarly understanding of policy innovations in the social welfare arena as well as bureaucratic behaviors in contemporary China
To experiment with a compound comparative case research design on subnational policy process in a large country

18621522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18621522.value: What explains policy innovations in authoritarian states in which political centralization and rigid personnel control are thought to stifle innovation? China’s experience of ‘crossing the river by feeling for the stones’ in the past four decades has defied the conventional wisdom drawn from state failures in the Soviet Union and former Eastern European Bloc. While some theoretical explanations suggest that China’s long tradition of policy experimentation establishes a cognitive and institutional framework conducive to bottom-up innovations, others posit that the promotion tournament amongst communist cadres powerfully incentivizes them to initiate policy innovations for the purpose of career advancement. The proliferation of studies in this decade has greatly enriched scholarly understanding of policy innovations in authoritarian China. However, a major gap remains in that most previous studies either analyze macro-level institutional or fiscal arrangements, or focus on political decisions made by senior local leaders such as party secretaries, mayors, and other administrative executives. We know very little about the middle- and lower echelon of the huge bureaucratic machinery that plays a crucial role in policy innovations. In many policy domains—health care, public housing, long-term care financing, and the like—policy reforms are associated with a great deal of technical sophistication and fiscal complexities, where technocrats extensively participate in policy formulation, implementation, and even agenda setting. Against the theoretical backdrop described above, this project seeks to investigate how middle-level technocrats in Chinese local governments maneuver within the bureaucracy and promote policy innovations in the social welfare realm. We extensively engage with the prominent literature on policy entrepreneurship, especially the emerging studies on middle- and low-level policy entrepreneurship. This project intends to elucidate the unique role played by mid-level technocrats in social welfare innovations in China, their motivations, entrepreneurial strategies, processes, and outcomes. Qualitative in nature, this project adopts an innovative compound comparative research design to fill the research gaps stated above. Multiple cases from Zhejiang Province and Hubei Province are selected for investigation in a rigorous comparative fashion. The highly experienced international team comprises senior and mid-career scholars outstanding for their academic background, track record, and local connections. Upon completion, this project is expected to advance scholarly knowledge of the dynamics of social welfare innovations in an authoritarian system, and achieve a renewed understanding of bureaucratic behaviors in contemporary China. 過往很多觀點認為，在強政府體制下，政治集權與嚴密的人事控制會阻礙政策創新，然而事實上有時並非如此。中國大陸過去四十年『摸著石頭過河』的漸進改革已經對上述基於前蘇聯和東歐『國家失敗』的研究結論提出挑戰。有些研究指出，中國大陸長期的政策試點傳統形成了一種有利於自下而上政策創新的框架；也有不少學者認為，中國地方官員的『晉升錦標賽』起到了推動政策創新的積極作用。儘管已有研究對於中國大陸的政策創新做出了很好的理論解釋，但亦有明顯不足。它們要么透過宏觀層面的制度與財政安排來解釋政策創新的動因，要么聚焦於地方政治精英的個人因素。在中國大陸龐大的官僚體制中大量的中低層官僚除了一般性的政策執行，還扮演何種角色，學者知之甚少。在醫療衛生、公共房屋、長期護理等政策領域，改革往往具有高度的技術複雜性，需要大量專業知識，這讓各級技術官僚可以更深入地參與到政策規劃、執行、乃至議程設定中。 因此，本研究旨在聚集中國大陸社會福利領域中的各種政策創新，並分析中層技術官僚在其中扮演的角色。研究團隊將與政策企業家的重要理論深度對話，試圖闡明地方層面社會政策創新中中層官僚所扮演的改革推動者的關鍵角色，他們的行為動機、策略、改革過程，以及創新結果。 本研究立足於質性傳統，採用了新穎的複合型比較個案分析設計。研究團隊從浙江省和湖北省選取多個匹配案例，進行深度比較分析。研究團隊由中國大陸、香港和澳洲的四位學者組成，他們均在本領域有相當學術造詣，並在兩個省份具有一定的研究支持網絡。本研究結束後，勢將深化對社會福利領域政策創新研究的理論認知，並幫助學者更好理解當代中國基層官員的行為邏輯。

18621622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18621622.value: 探索青少年在社交媒體中的數碼公民身份: 形成與轉化, 數碼素養和影響因素

18621622.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18621622.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof Jiang, Lianjiang George Dr Phyak, Prem Prof Yu, Lu

18621622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18621622.value: 互聯網的匿名性和無限制的訪問既容易引發黑客入侵、網絡攻擊和網絡霸凌，也為學生提供了學習、社交和相互接納的機會。引導學生參與網絡社區和社會（即數碼公民[Digital Citizenship]教育）可以幫助他們保護自己免受有害行為的影響；並且，最大限度地發揮其積極作用。為了提供這樣的教育，我們必須了解甚麽是具有倫理和社會文化意義的數碼行爲並且支持正面的數碼公民塑造。過往的研究主要考察了成年人（而非青少年）對於數碼公民身份的觀點，但沒有探索他們如何通過社交媒體和/或社交網絡背景下的數碼素養實踐來實現數碼公民，也沒有系統研究影響數碼公民塑造的因素。 本研究採用混合研究法，將考察青少年（從中學四至六年級）在社交媒體和/或社交網絡中不斷發展的數碼公民身份和數碼素養實踐，並探索其影響因素。我們將招募810名不同背景的青少年（跨年級[4，5，6]和文化[本地華人和少數民族]的分層樣本）來完成問卷調查；其中，36人將參與定性階段的研究。對問卷調查結果進行多層次的結構方程建模，以確定影響數碼公民身份的個人、家庭和人際關係等因素。定性研究部分將採用多種方法，包括半結構化訪談、學生數碼活動視頻、焦點小組訪談和文獻分析。第一個半結構性訪談將調查每個學生對於數碼公民身份的觀點和相關數碼行爲。然後，學生將視頻記錄他們四個月的相關數碼行爲，與我們分享他們有代表性的數碼活動，並在第二次和第三次訪談中討論。我們隨後將與由三至四名參與者組成的焦點小組進行訪談，探索相似性和差異。最後，我們會分析政策、課程、教學材料如何影響參與者的數碼公民觀點和實踐。 我們將通過了解青少年在網絡空間和物理空間中數碼公民身份的形成，以及它們的前因後果，重新對數碼公民進行概念化。充分理解學生、教師、教師教育者、課程開發者和政策制定者的需求，將為製定改革、支持和/或教育干預提供信息，以促進學生的數碼公民身份發展，這將有助於：(1) 引導學生以合法和負責任的方式參與數碼實踐或活動；(2) 發展學生的數碼素養，引導學生有效利用數碼技術來實現和促進社會發展。

18622022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18622022.value: 以不同語言學習概念：認知和情感機制

18622022.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18622022.value: Dr Cohn, Neil Prof Holcomb, Phillip Dr Liu, Duo Dr Midgley, Katherine Dr Wang, Jie

18622022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18622022.value: Understanding complex concepts is necessary for gaining knowledge in academic fields and for making informed decisions, e.g., getting vaccinated or taking out a mortgage. Recent news about misinformation on diverse and high-stakes topics has underscored the importance of studying factors influencing concept formation. Much of concept learning occurs in classrooms in a second language (L2) for the world’s bilingual population, so the challenge in understanding new concepts is compounded by the language barrier in L2 reading comprehension. Although language is a dominant interface for accessing and storing concepts, pictorial and structural representations of knowledge moderate successful concept learning. Previous research using people’s first language (L1) has shown that knowledge presented with images result in better comprehension, while concept maps make knowledge structure more explicit and promote learning retention. The results are mixed in whether and how multimodal presentations support concept learning in non-native learners, perhaps because processing of L2 multimodal materials are susceptible to cross-cultural differences and affective variables. The proposed study will address these issues by comprehensively examining how concept learning is influenced by language proficiency and multimodal processing, and potentially mediated by affective factors. Experiment 1 will be an online study involving three sites (n = 200 each at Hong Kong, the Netherlands, and the US). Adult participants who are first-year university students will learn new concepts in English from a series of sentence definitions (Vasopressin is a hormone that alters kidney function.). Effects of language groups and multimodal presentations on concept learning will be compared while taking into account the corresponding changes in learning interest and perceived ease. The learning outcomes will be two levels of conceptual knowledge, i.e., meaning recognition and generation, immediately after learning and at one week delay. The international comparisons across native English speakers and L2 English participants with different L1 backgrounds will allow us to systematically compare language and cultural distances. In Experiment 2, we will recruit Chinese-English participants in Hong Kong (n = 60) to examine event-related potentials (ERP) responses to L2 multimodal concept learning. By comparing the neural changes within learners, the ERP data can extend behavioral findings to pinpoint the mechanisms of concept learning under different multimodal and language conditions. The results from this study will inform theories of bilingual word learning and guide practical instructional design in concept learning and knowledge dissemination. The study will have important implications for pedagogical development across educational sectors. 了解複雜的概念對於獲得學術知識和做出合理的決定（例如接種疫苗或辦理抵押貸款）是必要的。最近關於各種高風險誤導性信息的新聞強調了瞭解概念形成的影響因素的重要性。對於世界上的雙語人群，大部分概念學習發生在第二語言 (L2) 的課堂上，因此第二語言閱讀理解中的語言上屏障加劇了理解新概念的挑戰。儘管語言是接觸和存儲概念的主要界面，但知識的圖像和結構亦會影響概念的成功學習。先前使用第一語言 (L1) 的研究表明，用圖像呈現的知識可以更容易地被理解，而概念圖使知識結構更加明確並促進學習的保留。多模態演示是否以及如何支持非母語學習者的概念學習的結果好壞參半，這可能是因為二語多模態材料的處理容易受到跨文化差異和情感變量的影響。是次研究將通過全面檢查概念學習如何受到語言能力和多模式處理的影響以及潛在的情感因素介導來解決這些問題。實驗 1 將是一項涉及三個地點的在線研究（香港、荷蘭和美國各 200 人）。大學一年級的參與者將從一系列句子定義中學習新的英語概念（加壓素是一種改變腎功能的激素。）。我們將比較語言組和多模式演示對概念學習的影響，同時考慮學習興趣和難易度的相應變化。學習成果將是兩個層次的概念知識，即意義識別和生成，在學習後立即和延遲一周測量。以英語為母語的人和具有不同 L1 背景的 L2 英語參與者之間的國際比較將使我們能夠系統地比較語言和文化距離。在實驗 2 中，我們將在香港招募中英文參與者 (n = 60)，以檢查L2 多模態概念學習對事件相關電位 (ERP)的反應。通過比較學習者的神經變化，ERP 數據可以擴展行為發現，以查明不同多模態和語言條件下的概念學習機制。這項研究的結果將為雙語單詞學習的理論提供信息，並指導概念學習和知識傳播中的實際教學設計。該研究將對不同教育階段的教學發展產生重要影響。

18622222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18622222.value: 通過語音訓練提高中英文雙語閱讀能力的發展：行為干預和認知神經科學研究

18622222.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18622222.value: Prof Cheung, Him Prof McBride, Catherine

18622222.label: Project Objectives
18622222.value: To examine whether Pinyin-to-Chinese training program, designed to teach children Pinyin knowledge, improves phonological skills and word reading in L1 Chinese at the behavioural level in Hong Kong children; To investigate whether Phoneme-to-English training program, designed to teach children English phonemic knowledge, enhances Hong Kong children’s L2 English phonological skills and word reading; To evaluate whether there is any transfer of Pinyin-to-Chinese training to English phonological awareness and word reading; To determine whether improvements at the behavioural level lead to systematic long-term changes at the neural level and, if so, how improvements at the behavioural level correlate with neural changes.
rows: To examine whether Pinyin-to-Chinese training program, designed to teach children Pinyin knowledge, improves phonological skills and word reading in L1 Chinese at the behavioural level in Hong Kong children;
To investigate whether Phoneme-to-English training program, designed to teach children English phonemic knowledge, enhances Hong Kong children’s L2 English phonological skills and word reading;

To determine whether improvements at the behavioural level lead to systematic long-term changes at the neural level and, if so, how improvements at the behavioural level correlate with neural changes.

18622222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18622222.value: Considerable theoretical and empirical research suggests that phonological awareness (i.e., the ability to identify and manipulate basic units of sounds (i.e., phonemes)), plays a fundamental role in reading development across languages. However, increasing evidence shows that Hong Kong children exhibit difficulties in learning basic phonological skills in Chinese and demonstrate limited phonological awareness in English compared to Taiwanese and Mainland Chinese children. It is well known that Taiwanese and Mainland Chinese children use Zhu-Yin-Fu-Hao and Pinyin, respectively, as aids to learn their L1 Chinese, and derive assistance from English phonics to learn their L2. It remains unclear, however, whether Pinyin and English phonemic training effectively facilitate the acquisition of phonological awareness and, if they do, whether L1 and L2 reading skills will improve. This study will combine behavioural training and a neurophysiological approach (i.e., event-related potentials (ERPs)) to investigate three key questions: 1) Does Pinyin-to-Chinese training program (i.e., designed to teach children Pinyin knowledge) enhance Hong Kong trilingual children’s phonological awareness in L1 Chinese and word reading? 2) Does Phoneme-to- English phonemic training program (i.e., designed to teach children’s English phonemic knowledge) facilitate L2 English phonological awareness and word reading?3) Is there any possible transfer effect of Pinyin training on children’s English phonological skills and word reading?4) Are there any changes at the neural level after receiving Pinyin and English phonemic training and, if so, how do the behavioural training effects correlate with brain activities? Employing a randomized controlled trial design, we will randomly assign ninety 5- to 6-year-old typically developing kindergarteners into Pinyin-to-Chinese and Phoneme-to-English training and control groups (N = 30 for each group). Children in the Pinyin-to-Chinese and Phoneme-to-English training groups will receive 8 weeks of explicit instruction on Pinyin and English phonemic knowledge. Tasks of nonverbal IQ, phonological awareness, and word reading in Chinese and English, as well as brain activities of speech perception in both L1 Chinese and L2 English, will be administered before and after the training. Findings of this study will provide key behavioural and neural evidence on the effectiveness of Pinyin and English phonemic training to facilitate Hong Kong children’s phonological skills and word reading in both L1 and L2, which, in turn, can inform educational policy and guide Chinese and English curriculum design. Findings of this study will also shed light on the neural plasticity of learning related to intervention, which suggests the need to accelerate phonological learning and reading acquisition. 大量的理論研究和實證研究指出語音意識（即辨認與運用聲音基本單位即音素的能力）在各語言的閱讀發展中起著重要的作用。然而，有越來越多的證據發現， 對比與台灣和大陸兒童，香港兒童在中文語音基礎知識學習上表現出一定的困難和較弱的英文語音意識。眾所周知，台灣和中國大陸的兒童分別使用注音符號和拼音來輔助學習他們的第一語言中文，並且從英文語音拼讀法中得到學習第二語言英文的輔助。但目前仍未確定拼音和英文音素訓練能否有效地促進語音意識的學習及語音訓練是否能夠提高第一語言與第二語言的閱讀能力的發展。本研究將結合行為訓練和認知神經生物學的方法（即事件相關電位，ERPs）探討以下三個主要研究問題：１）「由拼音至中文」訓練計劃（即旨在訓練拼音知識）能否加強香港三語兒童的中文語音意識和閱讀能力？２）「由音素至英文」訓練計劃（即旨在訓練英文音素知識）能否加強他們第二語言英文的語音意識和閱讀能力？３）中文拼音訓練在兒童的英文語音技能和閱讀能力上有否存在遷移？４）接受完中文和英文的語音訓練計劃後，在腦部神經層面上有否出現改變？如有，該行為訓練的效果與腦部活動有怎樣的關聯？ 運用隨機對照試驗，九十名５至６歲發展正常的幼稚園兒童將會隨機被編入「由拼音至中文」組別、「由音素至英文」組別和對照組（每組n = 30人）。被編入「由拼音至中文」和「由音素至英文」組別的兒童將會接受維期8星期的拼音或英文語音拼讀法的外顯教學。於訓練之前和之後，兒童將會接受非文字智力測驗、中英文語音意識測試和中英文閱讀測試，他們處理語言知覺時的腦部活動亦會被收集。 本研究之結果將為由中文拼音與英文音素訓練在香港兒童第一和第二語言的語音技能和閱讀能力之效用提供行為上以及腦部神經上的證據。由此，為教育政策和中、英文課程設計提出參考。是次研究的結果亦可以解釋與介入訓練相關的學習神經可塑性，間接表明加快培養語音和閱讀能力的必要性。

18622322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18622322.value: 網上「尋找得著」介入：以認知障礙家庭照顧者為對象的隨機對照試驗

18622322.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18622322.value: Dr Lai, Frank Ho-yin Dr Ng, Hiu Fung Peter

18622322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18622322.value: In view of the need to serve more caregivers as we confront an aging population with support network vulnerable to major disruption by events such as the pandemic, we propose to turn an evidence-based benefit-finding therapeutic (BFT) intervention into an online version and test it in a participant-blind randomized controlled trial with a waitlist control. Besides evaluating its impact on caregiver depressive symptoms (primary outcome) and anxiety, burden and positive gains (secondary outcomes), the study will examine whether the intervention effects are mediated by hypothesized therapeutic mechanisms, namely, self-efficacy in controlling upsetting thoughts and habitual use of cognitive reappraisal. Measures will be taken at baseline (T1), 2 months (postintervention or T2), 3 months (T3) and 5 months (T4). After T3, the waitlist control will receive the intervention. To strengthen external validity and to eliminate assesssor bias, following determination of study eligibility, data will be obtained through computer-administered questionnaires only (to mimic actual usage when the intervention is launched for public consumption). 160 primary caregivers of relatives with dementia will be recruited via NGOs, corporates, other community organizations, and promotional materials on social media. The inclusion criteria are: (a) a primary caregiver aged 18+; (b) having been a caregiver for ≥3 months; (c) providing ≥14 care hours weekly; (d) not having participated in any dementia- or caregiving-related intervention in the past year; (e) computer literacy; and (f) scores ≥5 on a 10-item version of the Center for Epidemiologic Studies-Depression Scale. Exclusion criteria are presence of other neurological or psychiatric condition in the CR and presence of cognitive impairment in the caregiver. Intent-to-treat analyses will be performed using mixed-effects regression to examine whether the outcome trajectories over time differ between conditions (i.e., treatment x time and treatment x time2 interactions). Path models with 5,000 bootstrapped samples will be used to examine longitudinal mediation of BFT effects via the hypothesized mediators. All estimations will be made using full-information maximum-likelihood to handle missing data in the longitudinal dataset. We expect BFT participants to report lower depressive symptoms, anxiety and burden, as well as more positive gains, compared with waitlist control, up to T3. We also expect such decreases to be maintained to T4 while control will benefit from exposure to BFT, resulting in the two groups being indistinguishable at T4 (as further support of BFT’s efficacy). We also expect the treatment effects on T2 mediators to mediate the treatment effects on T3 outcomes. 現今社會存在人口老齡化的問題，故支援服務的需求日益增加。但在疫情之下，支援服務及護理者均受到影響，有見及此，我們建議將已有實証的尋找得着治療改於網上進行，並以隨機盲選方式選擇參與者進行測試，同時採用候補名單作為對照組。此研究除了評估該治療法對護理者抑鬱症狀（主要結果）、焦慮程度、負擔和積極收益（次要結果）的影響外，並研究背後的介體（即治療機制），也就是控制消極思想的自我效能及改變思維的習慣。 此研究將在基線（T1），兩個月（介入完成後或T2），三個月（T3）和五個月（T4）時作出評估。在T3之後，候補名單將接受尋找得着治療。為了加強有效性和消除評核人員可能出現的偏見，在確定研究資格後，數據將僅通過電子問卷獲得（以模仿研究項目供公眾使用時的實際使用情況）。 我們將通過非政府組織，公司，其他團體機構和社交媒體上的宣傳素材，招募160名認知障礙親屬的主要照顧者。納入標準是：(1)18歲以上的主要照顧者；(2)擔任照顧者≥3個月；(3)每週提供≥14個小時的照顧時長；(4)過去一年沒有參加過任何與認知障礙或照顧有關的課程；(5)電腦素養；和(6)流行病學研究中心抑鬱量表10題版本的得分≥5。排除標準是被照顧者存在其他神經或精神狀況以及照顧者本身存在認知障礙。 治療意向分析法將使用混合效應回歸來審查兩個組別會否隨著時間出現差異（即治療x時間和治療x時間2次方的相互作用）。同時，具有5,000個自動重複抽樣的通徑模型，將用於檢查背後的介體。我們將採用完全信息最大概似法來處理縱向數據集會出現的缺失數據。 與候補名單對照相比，我們預計尋找得着治療的參與者會在T3或之前出現較少的抑鬱症狀，焦慮和負擔，以及更多正面的收益。我們還預計抑鬱症狀下降的趨勢將保持到T4，而對照組將受益於尋找得着治療，導致兩組在T4時無法區分（作為尋找得着治療效果的進一步支持)。我們還期望對T2介體的作用可以解釋T3的治療效果。

18622622.label: Project Objectives
18622622.value: Literary critics generally agree that Wenyi Xinchao magazine played a crucial role in the development of early Hong Kong modernism. However, relatively little research has been conducted on the major features of modernism found in the magazine with reference to numerous issues raised in the recent development of Western modernist discourse. This study seeks to make a scholarly contribution toward filling this gap. To conceptualize the major characteristics of early Hong Kong modernism by examining Wenyi Xinchao systematically. To study Wenyi Xinchao by concentrating on its relationship with Hong Kong modernism from the two perspectives of politics and tradition. This study will not only serve as a reference point for future studies on Hong Kong modernism but also enrich the study of modernism as a whole.

However, relatively little research has been conducted on the major features of modernism found in the magazine with reference to numerous issues raised in the recent development of Western modernist discourse. This study seeks to make a scholarly contribution toward filling this gap.

This study will not only serve as a reference point for future studies on Hong Kong modernism but also enrich the study of modernism as a whole.

18622622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18622622.value: No consensus has been achieved on when literary modernism began in Hong Kong. Some critics trace the beginning of Hong Kong modernism to the 1950s, while others argue that its roots lie further back. While it is difficult to determine beginning of Hong Kong modernism with precision, it is an indisputable fact that the publication of Wenyi Xinchao [Literary New Wave] in the 1950s by Ma Lang (a.k.a. Ma Boliang), who served as a poet-cum-editor of the magazine, was crucial for the later development of Hong Kong modernism. The relationship between the magazine and modernism has been the focal point for much discussion since then. However, to what extent did the magazine devote to promoting modernism is controversial. For example, while Ma Lang claimed that the magazine was meant to advocate modernism in Hong Kong in the 1950s, a major and regular contributor to the magazine, Lee Wai-Ling, thought otherwise. In the seventh issue of the magazine, Lee remarks that whether the much-used term “modernism” should be considered a catch-all term is still a question that has yet to be answered. Despite the fact that no consensus has been reached about the relationship between the magazine and modernism, it is a common belief that the magazine has had a potent influence on the later development of Hong Kong modernism. Therefore, rather than following along with the current discussion, this proposed project will focus on the following question: What are the elements of modernism to be found in the magazine? Among previous studies it should be noted that only a few have actually investigated the characteristics of modernism. In addition, the recent development of Western modernist discourse has not been taken into account. This project aims to bridge this research gap by examining all fifteen issues of the magazine. Two distinctive features of Hong Kong modernism observed in the magazine will be discussed in detail. This study argues that the transformative political stance of the magazine, from nationalism to localism over the years, and its localized Chinese lyrical tradition are in fact a progressive and future-oriented force in the development of Hong Kong modernism. Upon reconsidering the characteristics of modernism found in the magazine, this project will help conceptualize the distinctive features of early Hong Kong modernism. 香港現代主義究竟始於何時到目前為止還沒有定論。例如，有部分學者認為香港現代主義的起點是五十年代，但亦有研究認為應該追溯至更早的時間。雖然要為香港現代主義的起點定一個準確的年份並不容易，但一般認同《文藝新潮》在這個文學思潮中扮演十分重要的角色。《文藝新潮》於1950年代由馬朗（馬博良）出版，他本身是詩人但同時亦是這本文學雜誌的編輯。由於《文藝新潮》對香港現代主義發展影響深遠，所以兩者的關係一直是研究及討論的焦點。然而，到底《文藝新潮》多大程度上倡導現代主義仍然需要進一步討論。事實上，雖然馬朗指出《文藝新潮》是旨在推動現代主義的發展，但雜誌的主要撰稿人之一李維陵卻持不同想法。李維陵在雜誌的第七期中指出，「現代主義」這個概念能否涵蓋現代生活的種種問題是值得反思，及有待研究。 正如上述提到儘管香港現代主義的起點還沒有定論，但較能肯定的是《文藝新潮》對香港現代主義日後的發展有重要的影響，因此是項研究將集中在以下的議題上：《文藝新潮》包含了哪些現代主義的特徵？事實上，在現有的研究中只有極少數對現代主義的特質進行探討。同樣地，現有的分析亦很少參考最新的西方現代主義論述。這項研究希望透過分析雜誌全部內容（共十五期），嘗試補充這些方面的研究，其中焦點會放在以下兩種重要的特色。這個研究計劃提出並且說明這本雜誌政治取向的轉變（由民族主義改變為本土主義），以及把中國抒情傳統本地化這兩種特徵，為日後香港現代主義的發展奠定了基礎。 是項研究計畫相信通過把《文藝新潮》中主要的現代主義特色勾劃出來，會有助理解早期香港現代主義的特徵。

18622822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18622822.value: Occupational well-being (OWB) among early childhood educations (ECEs) plays an important role in ECEs’ job performance, children’s development, and the operation of early childhood education sectors. Recently, ECEs’ OWB has become an increasing concern both globally and locally, as the job characteristics of early childhood education involve enormous challenges threatening a positive well-being experience at work. This concern is particularly salient for beginning ECEs, because they not only bear as many responsibilities as veteran teachers do but also need to navigate many adaptive changes during the transition from training to teaching. Moreover, beginning teachers' OWB upon employment sets the tone for subsequent well-being and chronic poor OWB leads to a cascade of inefficacy and attrition within the first few years of teaching. Thus, enhancing and sustaining Hong Kong beginning ECEs’ OWB is paramount, but what factors, and how these factors, influence beginning ECEs’ OWB is rarely known. The job demands-resources (JD-R) model recently proposes a dynamic, yet comprehensively examined, model that delineates how employees’ OWB develops at work in relation to job demands, job resources, and self-control. Taking the JD-R model as an overarching framework while also considering other relevant accounts, this project aims to advance the understanding of Hong Kong beginning ECEs’ OWB by examining four questions: (1) What are the transitional associations between self-control during pre-service period and the initial levels of OWB? (2) What are the bidirectional associations between job demands, job resources, self-control, and OWB over time? (3) Does self-control mediate the said bidirectional links? and (4) How do beginning ECEs narrate their OWB in relation to job demands, job resources, and self-control? We plan to conduct a mixed-method study to examine these questions. Firstly, we will implement a four-wave longitudinal research to collect quantitative data in 618 ECEs across the transition from pre-service (i.e., last semester of the training program) to in-service (i.e., up to 14th month since the beginning of the first teaching semester) periods. Secondly, we will select 15 eligible participants for a qualitative research where they share their experiences of OWB. Structure equation modeling and thematic analysis will be used to respectively analyze the quantitative and qualitative data. Theoretically, the findings will advance our understanding of the interplay between organizational and personal factors in shaping beginning ECEs’ OWB. Practically, the findings will inform prevention and intervention strategies that foster and sustain Hong Kong beginning ECEs’ OWB. 幼兒教師的職業幸福感對幼兒教師的工作表現、兒童的發展以及幼兒教育行業的運作起到重要作用。基於幼兒教育工作的特殊性，幼兒教師在工作中的積極體驗正面臨著巨大的挑戰，因此幼兒教師的幸福感問題日益受到全球和本地研究的關注。這一問題對於新手幼兒教師來說尤為突出，因為他們不僅需要承擔和教學經驗豐富的教師一樣多的責任，而且還需要適應從學生過渡到教師期間的許多變化。此外，新手教師的職業幸福感為之後的幸福感定下基調，長期匱乏職業幸福感會引發一連串的問題，包括低工作效率和高流失率。因此，提升和維持香港新手幼兒教師的職業幸福感十分重要。然而，究竟是什麼因素，以及這些因素如何影響新手幼兒教師的幸福感仍然知之甚少。工作需求-資源（JD-R）模型從動態的視角勾畫了員工的職業幸福感如何結合工作需求、工作資源以及自我控制而發展，然而目前還鮮有研究對該模型進行綜合驗證。本研究以JD-R模型為理論框架，同時考慮其他相關的理論，旨在透過探討以下四個問題來加深對香港新手幼兒教師職業幸福感的理解：(1) 幼兒教師職前培訓時的自我控制水準與入職後的職業幸福感之間有什麼聯繫？(2) 工作需求、工作資源、自我控制和職業幸福感這四個變量之間隨時間變化的雙向關係是怎樣的？(3) 自我控制感在上述雙向關係中是否起到中介作用？(4)新手幼兒教師是如何評價他們的職業幸福感與工作需求、工作資源以及自我控制之間的關係？我們計畫採用混合設計方法來探討上述問題。首先，我們將實施一項四個時間點的縱向研究，對618名幼兒教師從入職前（即就讀課程項目的最後一個學期）到在職（即從任教的第一個學期開始到第14個月）期間收集定量數據。其次，我們將挑選15名符合條件的參與者進行定性研究，邀請他們分享自己對職業幸福感的體驗。我們將採用結構方程模型來分析定量數據以及採用主題分析法來分析定性數據。從理論層面上來說，本次研究結果將促進我們理解組織因素以及個人因素如何共同塑造新手幼兒教師的職業幸福感。從實踐層面上來說，本次研究結果將為如何提升和維持香港新手幼兒教師職業幸福感的預防和干預策略提供實證參考。

18624022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18624022.value: 元認知，被定義為個人對於認知過程的了解以及這些知識在控制認知過程中的應用。元認知在學生學習和學術成就中起著至關重要的作用。元認知不是學生天生就有的，教師在培養學生的元認知從而去優化教學效果方面發揮著重要作用。因此，教師必須具備豐富的元認知知識以及紮實的元認知教學策略。然而，文獻指出，掌握豐富元認知知識或具有能夠培養學生元認知能力的教師很稀缺，特別是在第二語言寫作環境中，大量的第二語言寫作教師仍然將寫作教學看作是分配寫作主題和提供反饋，他們會花費過多的時間來回應學生寫作中的錯誤。 探索如何培養第二語言初級寫作教師元認知教學能力是至關重要的。越來越多的文獻表明，元認知思維在兒童早期成長中得到顯著發展，元認知教學可以為元認知思維奠定堅實的基礎，兒童可以在學校教育的不同階段建立起這種思維基礎。此外，寫作是一項對認知要求很高的任務，尤其是對初級第二語言寫作者而言，因此教授以及學習元認知在提高學生的寫作能力方面具有巨大潛力。在這樣的背景下，該研究項目將考察教師將元認知教學融入寫作課堂的情況；教師如何以及在多大程度上發展他們在元認知寫作的教學能力；以及影響教師元認知寫作教學能力發展的因素。 該項研究採用個案研究的方法，涉及全港兩所小學所有五年級的英語教師。該研究將收集多種數據來源，包括對校長、英語系主任以及教師的個人訪談、閱讀教師的學習日誌、觀察教師會議以及進行課堂觀察、閱讀學生寫作以及有關元認知的教學文件（例如學校的寫作教學政策和指導方針、教學材料、會議記錄）。 通過加深我們對教師在制度和社會文化因素介導下元認知教學能力發展過程的理解，這項研究將會為文獻做出貢獻，並且將闡明如何縮小理論與實踐之間的差距，並為教師教育計劃提供有關信息，說明如何更好地為教師在元認知教學方面的專業發展做好準備。

18624222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18624222.value: 許多面對讀寫困難的學童都因為讀寫能力不足而令其學業成績未如理想，在將來就業時亦可能需要克服種種挑戰，以致錯失人生的不同機會。更甚的是，香港的中、英文雙語教學環境使他們在學業上的負擔更為沉重。過往的研究發現，對以中文作為母語的學童而言，他們的中文閱讀能力能夠預測其英文閱讀能力。因此，在教導患有讀寫障礙的華語學生不同的閱讀技巧時，這些閱讀策略皆以中文為主。然而，中文為意音並重的語素文字，以漢字為基礎，英文則為表音文字，以拉丁字母為基礎。兩者的書寫系統不同，所要求的認知技巧亦有顯著的差異。故此，理論上，提升中文閱讀能力的策略應難以直接應用於改善英文閲讀能力上。過往絕少有針對患有讀寫障礙的華語學生發展英文讀寫能力的研究，所以本計劃將啟動兩項研究以驗證上述推論，並為患有讀寫障礙的華語學生在培養英文讀寫能力的過程中，訂立合適的支援及輔助建議。研究一將以初小學生作為研究對象，探究語音技巧如何預測患有讀寫障礙的華語學生的英文閱讀表現。研究二將嘗試兩種有關語音技巧的閱讀策略，並找出它們對改善不同組別患有讀寫障礙的學生中文水平的成效。參與研究一的學童將會接受語音意識或語音技巧的訓練。在訓練結束後，研究團隊會評核他們的英文讀寫能力及相關的閱讀技巧，以檢視訓練成效。由於診斷讀寫障礙只需考慮第一語言的能力，本研究將讓我們深入了解患有讀寫障礙的華語學童在學習英文上的情況。了解這個關連後，便能夠按他們的語音意識水平而訂立有效的英文學習介入方案。

18624322.label: Project Title(Chinese)

18624322.label: Project Objectives
18624322.value: To protect community-dwelling older adults from loneliness, we will develop and evaluate psycho-social intervention, especially during time like COVID-19 or other novel infectious disease pandemics in the future. To meet the huge demand for such intervention during future pandemic, we plan to recruit and train retirees to implement those interventions. Consequently, the overall objective of this proposed study is to develop and evaluate three psycho-social interventions in reducing loneliness among Hong Kong older adults in a 3-arm randomized controlled (RCT). The specific objectives are as follows: 1. To evaluate the effect of 4-week layperson-delivered, empathy-focused program of telephone calls and telephone-delivered wisdom enhancing interventions on the primary (loneliness, social network size, social support) and secondary outcomes (perceived stress, sleep quality, post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety, and depressive symptoms) to be collected at baseline, 4-week, 3-month and 6-month follow-up assessments relative to 4-week telephone-delivered befriending group using a 3-arm randomized controlled trial of a large representative sample of community-dwelling older adults who feel lonely. To examine whether the effect of loneliness intervention (i.e. layperson-delivered, empathy-focused program of telephone calls, telephone-delivered wisdom enhancing interventions and telephone-delivered befriending interventions) is mediated by changing in wisdom and received empathy using a 3-arm randomized controlled trial. To examine how responses to different interventions (i.e. layperson-delivered, empathy-focused program of telephone calls, telephone-delivered wisdom enhancing interventions and telephone-delivered befriending interventions) in loneliness intervention depends on the baseline scores of wisdom and received empathy using a 3-arm randomized controlled trial.

18624322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18624322.value: Older adults are not only at a significantly greater risk of mortality and a more difficult recovery following infection with COVID-19, but they also face additional vulnerabilities, such as social isolation because of a range of non-pharmaceutical public health social distancing measures. Social isolation is likely to lead to loneliness and our study has shown that approximately 45% of Hong Kong Chinese older adults sometimes or always felt lonely. It is well-established that loneliness is associated with numerous detrimental consequences on psychological, physical, and cognitive health. Against this backdrop, it is of the utmost importance to develop an effective intervention to reduce loneliness among Hong Kong’s older adults, especially during times like the COVID-19 pandemic. Accordingly, we will examine the effectiveness of two different psychosocial interventions (i.e. a layperson-delivered, empathy-focused program of telephone calls and wisdom-enhancing narrative-therapy intervention) by comparing them with a telephone-delivered befriending intervention in a three-arm randomized controlled trial (RCT) of a random sample of 282 community-dwelling older adults who feel lonely. To meet the huge demand for such interventions during possible future pandemics – or this ongoing one – we plan to recruit and train retirees as volunteers to implement the promising interventions. The primary outcomes including loneliness and the secondary outcomes are sleep quality, depressive symptoms, cognitive functioning, social network and social support. We will also examine the potential mediators (wisdom and empathy received) underlying the effect of the intervention, and investigate whether the proposed tailoring factors (gender, age, poor financial situation, self-rated health, baseline assessment of wisdom and empathy received) moderate their impact of the intervention on loneliness. Data collection will be done at baseline, four weeks, six months and 12 months after the beginning of the intervention. Our selection of interventions and secondary outcomes are based on the Biopsychosocial (BPS)-Pathways model of loneliness and the findings will provide evidences to understand and refine the model. 長者於感染2019冠狀病毒病 (COVID-19) 後，不但要面臨更高的死亡風險，亦較難復原，同時他們亦面對額外的隱憂，如因一系列的非藥物公共衛生社交距離措施而導致的社交隔離。社交隔離很有可能會導致長者產生孤獨感，從我們的研究所得，約 45% 的香港華人長者有時或經常感到孤獨。眾所周知，孤獨感對心理、身體和認知健康有著很多不利的影響。制定有效的介入措施，以減少香港長者的孤獨感，在2019冠狀病毒病的疫情期間尤其重要。於是，我們將研究兩項不同的社會心理介入措施（即非專業人士透過電話以同理心為中心的介入和增強智慧的敘事治療介入），並與參與電話「友同行」(Befriending) 介入等共282 名有孤獨感的長者進行三臂隨機對照試驗 (RCT)比較。為了應付新一波疫情（或現處於的疫情狀況）對此類介入措施的龐大需求，我們計劃招募和培訓退休人士作為義工以實踐各項的介入措施。研究的主要結果為長者的孤獨感，其次結果是他們的睡眠質量、抑鬱症狀、認知功能、社交網絡和社會支援。我們亦將會研究潛在的中介變數（包括智慧和同理心）的介入影響，並調查所建議的有關因素（性別、年齡、較差的財務狀況、自評健康狀況、基線評估的智慧和同理心）如何調節有關介入對長者孤獨感的影響。數據收集將在基線，及於完成介入後的四星期、六個月及十二個月進行。我們基於孤獨感之生物心理社會途徑模型，選擇介入措施及次要結果，而研究結果將提供證據以理解並完善整個模型。

21103522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21103522.value: One of the grand scientific challenges of our time is to mechanistically understand how our brain accomplishes incredibly sophisticated functions to allow every individual to have unique thoughts, perceptions, memories, and actions. This is a daunting task that requires a comprehensive understanding of a brain at every level of complexity, from molecules to neurons, the circuits to behavior, and the underlying computations. To reach this ultimate goal, we must first be able to understand and simulate simpler brains like the nervous system of the nematode worm Caenorhabditis elegans. With only 302 neurons and invariant connectivity, scientists have been able to map the physical wiring of its entire nervous system – the connectome – in the attempt to reconstruct the worm brain. However, without knowing the biophysical properties of the diverse neuron types and the activity pattern they produce, scientists have not been able to generate a unifying model that explains how the simple worm brain works. This project aims to address this problem by comprehensively characterizing the biophysical properties of every C. elegans neuron type and constructing accurate mathematical models to simulate their dynamics. Our goal is to reproduce neural activity dynamics at both the cellular and circuit levels, and eventually simulate how the worm brain generates simple behaviors. To accomplish this goal, we will take a systematic approach of recording from all 106 somatic neuron types in C. elegans using electrophysiology. Detailed electrophysiological parameters and recordings of neural dynamics will be obtained from experiments for each neuron type and deposited into a database. Our preliminary recordings have yielded a first-pass electrophysiological map covering ~25% of all neuron types and revealed a rich unforeseen biophysical diversity among different neuron types with distinct computational functions, demonstrating the feasibility of an “electrophysiome” of the entire nervous system and the positive impact it would produce to the field of whole-brain modeling. As the next step toward attainment of our goal, we will formulate conductance-based single neuron models which will subsequently be integrated into a connectome-based circuit-level framework to develop anatomically and biophysically correct neural system models. This proposal is a proof-of-principle study to evaluate the impact of biophysically accurate single-neuron models on full-scale electrophysiome simulation and provide insights into the level of abstraction possible for systemic modeling of a complete nervous system. Ultimately, the knowledge gained from this project is expected to act as steppingstone for understanding and modeling more complex nervous systems.

21104822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21104822.value: 研究阿尔茨海默病中转座子激活的功能作用

21104822.label: Project Objectives
21104822.value: The general goal of this project is to investigate the functional impacts from the activation of transposable element (TE) in Alzheimer’s disease (AD). TEs are generally suppressed with DNA methylation and in heterochromatins, but recent studies indicated that their inhibitory factors are impaired in the etiology of AD, likely induced by the accumulation of phosphorylated Tau proteins. The TE activation can lead to genomic insertion mutations and promote genotoxicity such as DNA damages or genome instability, or double stranded RNAs that can trigger inflammatory responses. Thus, it is highly plausible that the TE activation plays a critical role in the AD pathogenesis. In this project, we will investigate three possible mechanisms with which the TE activation can contribute to the AD etiology, including (1) TE mediated double stranded RNAs that activate the inflammatory responses, (2) genomic insertions of active TEs and genome instability, and (3) expansion of genomic cDNAs that lead to overexpression of AD-related genes such as amyloid precursor protein (APP). We will use a induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-organoid system to model the AD progression. We will study three AD patients and three age/gender/ethnicity matched controls, whose iPSCs are established at the Coriell Institute. Previous studies demonstrated significant Tau protein accumulation in the brain organoids derived from two of the selected AD iPSCs, and we expect the third iPSC to show similar AD hallmarks in the organoid too. We will differentiate the iPSCs into brain organoids following an established protocol, and will assess the transcriptome and somatic mutations at three developmental stages: 20 days, 110 days and 220 days. To test the hypothesis that TE-mediated double stranded RNAs (dsRNAs) are enriched in AD and associated with inflammation, we will measure the whole transcriptome with long-read RNAseq, and the double stranded RNAs with a targeted approach, dsRNA-seq. We will also measure the Tau protein accumulation and the level of cytokines at the chosen stages. If TE-induced dsRNAs play a functional role, we expect the TE classes with higher expression also produce more dsRNAs, and this trend will correlate with the Tau protein accumulation, transcriptional activation of genes in inflammation-associated pathways, and the change of proinflammatory cytokines. To test the hypothesis that somatic retrotransposition is activated in AD, we will isolate single cells and carry out whole genome sequencing for 15 cells in each organoid. We pioneered in a set of computational and experimental tools that utilize next generation sequencing (NGS) to identify somatic MEIs, and will further improve these methods to quantitate the somatic MEIs from L1, Alu and SVA elements. Based on the MEI junction sequences, we can evaluate whether the MEIs are driven by DNA damages and assess their likely functional disruptions to nearby genes. To test the hypothesis that somatic genomic cDNAs (gencDNAs) are widespread in AD, we will characterize the number of gencDNAs in our single-cell sequencing data by evaluating APP and all other AD-related genes. We will also assess whether the gencDNAs were driven by the L1-encoded proteins, by studying the gencDNA junction sequences for L1 retrotransposition hallmarks. The brain organoids will be maintained for 220 days, during which we plan to design a new computational pipeline for the detection of somatic MEIs, based on the method that we had previously published. We will retrain the machine learning model by adding more training datasets of diverse genetic backgrounds, including the Illumina Polaris dataset (N=59), and the recently sequenced trios in the 1000 genome projects (N=602). We will also test other training features (e.g., replication timing), and different models including ensemble learning or deep learning. Finally, we will add detection methods for SVA elements and gencDNAs. Proving the role of TE activation in AD with specific molecular mechanisms will open new possible therapeutic interventions through alleviating the TE-related stress, such as anti-inflammatory molecules or inhibitors for the L1-encoded endonuclease or reverse transcriptase. The brain organoid system we established can also serve as a solid platform for the initial drug screening. Finally, our study will also generate novel insights into the potential pathological effects of somatic retrotransposition, which has been discovered in many other disorders but the functions are generally under-explored.
