21104822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21104822.value: There are an increasing number of data suggesting a large scale of transcriptional activation of transposable elements (TE) in the progression of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), likely followed by changes in the epigenetic landscape induced by the accumulation of the pathogenic Tau proteins. The TE activation can lead to genomic insertion mutations and promote genotoxicity such as DNA damages or genome instability, or double stranded RNAs that can trigger inflammatory responses. It is therefore highly plausible that the TE activation plays a critical role in the AD pathogenesis. Here we plan to investigate the cellular perturbations and the molecular mechanisms followed by the TE activation. Specifically, we will test three hypotheses, including (1) the transcription of TE generates double-stranded RNAs (dsRNAs), alerts the antiviral surveillance machinery and triggers inflammatory responses, (2) the transcription of active retrotransposons leads to genomic mobile element insertions (MEIs), precipitates DNA rearrangement and promotes further genotoxicity, and (3) TE-encoded proteins induces the genomic insertion of messenger RNAs, and leads to the overexpression and mutations of genes such as the amyloid precursor protein (APP). My lab will exploit a brain organoid model, where induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived neural stem cells divide, differentiate and mature in a 3-D environment, generating Tau pathology that is highly relevant to the TE activation. We will study three different developmental stages (day 20, day 110 and day 220) of three pairs of AD and control organoids, by measuring (1) transcriptome changes of TE subfamilies and the inflammatory pathways via long-read RNAseq, (2) TE-induced dsRNAs via a targeted approach, dsRNA-seq, and (3) the somatic mutations via single-cell whole genome sequencing. Notably, TE sequences are highly repetitive and whole genome amplification can create false positive insertions, and therefore we expect the detection of somatic MEIs to have a low signal-to-noise ratio. We have previously established a computational pipeline that can correct these technical artifacts, and plan to further improve the machine learning method, by adding 60 times more training data and new machine learning models. With the new computational and experimental investigations, our work will provide direct answers to the mechanisms and functional consequences of the TE activation in AD, which can open new possible therapeutic interventions through alleviating the TE-related stress, and shed light to the general pathological impacts of transposons in human diseases. 这项研究将分析在阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer’sdisease）中由转座子(transposable elements)激活所导致的的细胞扰动和分子机制. 在近期阿尔茨海默病的研究中,有越来越多的数据发现有大规模的转座子转录激活，体现为表达量显著增加, 这可能是由Tau蛋白的积累诱发的表观遗传变化所导致。转座子的激活可以产生新的基因组插入突变,并影响基因组整体的稳定性，它也可能生成双链RNA而激发炎症反应。因此，在阿尔茨海默病的发病机制中转座子的激活可能起到关键作用。具体来讲, 我们将测试三个假说，包括（1）转座子的转录产生双链RNA（dsRNA），激活人体抗病毒机制并触发炎症反应，（2）活性逆转录转座子(retrotransposon)的转录会导致基因组内的插入突变（Mobile element insertion），可能引发DNA的缺失或重排，以及（3）转座子合成的蛋白可能诱导其它信使RNA的基因组插入， 并导致淀粉样蛋白前体蛋白（APP）等基因的过量表达和突变。我的实验室将利用类脑器官模型，诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）衍生为神经干细胞, 在3D环境中分裂，分化和成熟，并产生与转座子活性高度相关的Tau蛋白积累。我们将研究三对阿尔茨海默病和正常对照组, 并分析三个不同的发育阶段（第20天，第110天和第220天），包括（1）通过长序列RNA测序研究不同转座子TE亚家族及炎症信号通路的转录组变化,（2）通过靶向测序捕捉双链RNA，研究转座子是否产生大量双链RNA, 以及（3）通过单细胞全基因组测序研究体细胞突变, 如转座子或者其它信使RNA的插入。值得注意的是，转座子的序列具有高重复性，在研究单细胞中常用的全基因组扩增会产生大量假阳性信号，因此检测转座子通常具有较低的信噪比。为了解决这一问题, 我将使用我近期建立的一个新的机器学习算法(RetroSom)，它已被证明可以有效的纠正这些技术问题，在这项研究中, 我也计划通过添加60倍以上的训练数据和新的机器学习模型来进一步改进算法的准确度。通过新的实验研究和算法改进，这项工作将会明确阐述在阿尔茨海默病中转座子激活的机制和功能后果，其结果可以用作开发基于抑制转座子活性的治疗和干预措施，并进一步阐明转座子在一般人类疾病中病理影响。

21200522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21200522.value: 面向AI相機圖像篡改的基於AI技術的解決方案

21200522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21200522.value: The era of artificial intelligence (AI) has witnessed increasing volumes of high-quality image content through smart photography and popular image applications. However, the advance of AI also makes high-quality image manipulation (i.e., image splicing, inpainting, copy-move) much easier, which threatens image integrity and can lead to serious security and ethical issues. Harmful consequences include public disinformation and damaged personal reputation from pornographic images created through face-swapping technologies. Therefore, there is an increasing need for image manipulation detection tools to counter such threats. Previous research on forensics and image manipulation detection has mainly focused on how conventional digital cameras introduce intrinsic image regularities when their image signal processor (ISP) processes photographs. Image manipulation affects those regularities and thus leaves digital traces. However, the advent of new-generation AI cameras (e.g., smartphones’ built-in cameras using AI technologies) poses a major challenge because they use a smart ISP based on deep neural networks. Owing to the non-linear structure of deep neural networks, image regularities introduced by AI cameras can be much more complex than those introduced by conventional cameras, rendering existing image manipulation detection techniques ineffective. Furthermore, an adversary can launch an anti-forensics attack by using an AI camera to recapture a manipulated image in high quality to hide manipulation traces. Hence, it is urgent to develop advanced techniques to detect manipulated AI-camera-captured images, and to prevent and respond to anti-forensic attacks. In this proposal, we aim to create a generalized and robust system to detect manipulation of AI-camera-captured images. Importantly, our system will be powered by AI and based on promising results from our preliminary experimental study. Our research tasks for the system design are as follows: (1) to design a framework for digital fingerprint extraction that accounts for key neural network features of smart ISPs in AI cameras; (2) to design an algorithm to detect manipulation of AI-camera-captured images that is generalizable to various AI camera models for real-world application; and (3) to design an algorithm to counter anti-forensics attacks and further improve the robustness of our image manipulation detection system. By harnessing novel AI-enabled solutions, our proposal aims to fight the threat to image integrity caused by AI cameras in the new generation of smart photography. We expect to advance the research area of digital image forensics, while also benefiting society in many areas including security, law, journalism, social media, business, and research integrity. 人工智能 (AI) 時代見證了越來越多的通過智能攝影以及圖像應用程序生成的高質量圖像內容。然而，人工智能的進步也使得高質量的圖像篡改（即圖像拼接、修復、複製移動）變得更加容易，這會威脅到圖像的完整性，並可能導致嚴重的安全和道德問題。有害後果包括公開虛假信息以及通過換臉技術生成的色情圖片損害個人聲譽。因此，提出有效的圖像篡改檢測工具來應對此類威脅顯得越來越重要。先前關於取證和圖像篡改檢測的研究主要集中於傳統數碼相機的圖像信號處理器(ISP)在處理照片過程中所引入的固有圖像範式。而圖像篡改過程會打破這些固有範式，從而留下篡改痕跡。然而，新一代AI相機（如使用AI圖像處理技術的智能手機的內置攝像頭）使用基於深度神經網絡的智能ISP對圖像進行處理，因此給圖像篡改檢測任務帶來了巨大挑戰。由於深度神經網絡的非線性結構，人工智能相機引入的圖像範式比傳統相機引入的圖像範式複雜得多，從而可能導致現有的圖像篡改檢測技術失效。更有甚者，攻擊者可以通過使用AI攝像頭重新拍攝高質量的被篡改的圖像來隱藏其篡改痕跡，從而發起反取證攻擊。因此，迫切需要開發先進的新技術來檢測被篡改的AI相機捕獲的圖像，並預防和應對反取證攻擊。在本提案中，我們致力於創建一個通用且強大的檢測系統，對AI相機捕獲的圖像的後續篡改操作進行檢測。此外，根據我們令人滿意的初步實驗結果，我們的檢測系統將由人工智能提供支持。我們的系統設計研究任務如下：(1) 設計一個數字指紋提取框架，該框架考慮了人工智能相機中智能ISP的關鍵神經網絡特徵；(2) 設計一種算法針對 AI相機捕獲的圖像的篡改進行檢測，該算法可泛化到各種 AI 相機模型以供實際應用；(3) 設計一算法來對抗反取證攻擊，並進一步提高我們的圖像篡改檢測系統的魯棒性。通過利用新的人工智能解決方案，我們的提案旨在對抗新一代智能攝影中人工智能相機對圖像完整性造成的威脅。我們希望推進數字圖像取證的研究領域，同時在安全、法律、新聞、社交媒體、商業和研究誠信等許多領域造福社會。

21200622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21200622.value: 新型納米晶磁材料雙向無線電動汽車充電系統

21200622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21200622.value: The decarbonization of road transport through the use of ultralow emission electric vehicles (EVs) is critical for mitigating climate change and improving air quality. However, state-of-the-art batteries for EVs exhibit considerably lower energy density than fossil fuels (265 Wh/kg for Li-ion battery, only 2.2% of 12200 Wh/kg for gasoline), which significantly compromises the EV driving range. Without foreseeable breakthroughs in battery technology, frequent and convenient battery charging is the only way to enable EVs as the dominant means of green decarbonized transportation. Most current fast EV chargers require drivers to connect a tethered electrical outlet to the vehicle, which leaves drivers prone to hazards. By contrast, wireless power transfer (WPT), the most popular of which is known as inductive power transfer (IPT), eliminates the need for physical contact and enables unobtrusive and hassle-free charging. Since EVs can serve as mobile power plants to support and stabilize the power grid or household power with renewables, the development of vehicle-to-grid (V2G) or to-home (V2H) technology is promising. Therefore, bidirectional wireless EV charging/discharging can be seamlessly integrated into the IPT and can eliminate plug-in forgetfulness in our daily life. Although considerable advances in bidirectional IPT have been achieved in the last ten years, some bottleneck issues, such as low saturation of ferrite core and the parallel SiC MOSFET topology, are still awaiting enhanced solutions. This project aims to develop a novel WPT4 22 kW Nanocrystalline IPT system for a bidirectional wireless EV charging system with high energy efficiency and power density. The new laminated Nanocrystalline ribbons with less than 18 µm thickness are optimally designed as the magnetic core, which would reduce core loss by 14.8%, compact size by 20%, and improve saturation to 1.2 T. In addition, the quadrilateral current mode (QCM) switching scheme is proposed for the parallel connected SiC MOSFETs by artfully utilizing the LCC compensation network as the distributed commutation inductors to achieve zero-voltage switching for all MOSFETs. Furthermore, a dual-active topology that incorporates the QCM scheme and triple-phase shift control is proposed to attain comprehensive controllability, low switching loss, and superior thermal balance. The successful completion of this project will further enhance system performance and lead the bidirectional IPT system to a new height. Beyond the scientific contribution across the globe, the cutting-edge technologies developed in this project will have a crucial real-world application in reducing energy consumption and improving the user convenience of wireless EV chargers. 使用具有超低碳排放的電動汽車 (EV) 對於道路交通節能減排，減緩氣候變化和改善空氣品質至關重要。然而，目前電動汽車電池的能量密度遠低於化石燃料（鋰離子電池為265 Wh/kg，僅為汽油12200 Wh/kg的2.2%），從而影響了電動汽車的續航里程。在電池技術沒有可預見的重大突破的情況下，頻繁、便捷的電池充電方式是使能電動汽車成為綠色脫碳交通的主導手段的唯一途徑。 大多數當前的快速 EV 充電器要求用戶手動將充電線連接到車輛，這將致用戶處於易發生觸電危險之中。相比之下，當前流行的無線電能傳輸(WPT)，它無需物理接觸，可實現便捷且輕鬆的充電。同時，由於電動汽車可以作為移動能量存放裝置，可配合新能源發電穩定電網或提供日常家庭用電，從而使得車到電網 (V2G) 或到戶 (V2H) 技術的發展前景廣闊。因此，雙向EV無線充電/放電技術可以融合到WPT系統，可實現便捷化智慧化電能管理利用。儘管在過去十年中雙向 WPT 取得了很大的進步，但一些瓶頸問題，例如鐵氧體磁芯的低飽和度和多並聯碳化矽功率器件拓撲控制問題，仍然有待進一步優化。 本項目旨在開發一種新型 WPT4 22 kW納米晶無線充電技術，用於具有高能效和功率密度的雙向無線電動汽車充電系統。將厚度小於18 µm 的新型疊層納米晶帶優化設計為磁芯，可使磁芯損耗降低14.8%，體積縮小20%，飽和度提高到1.2 T。此外，四象限電流工作模式（QCM ）將巧妙地利用LCC補償網路作為分散式換流電感，為並聯的碳化矽功率器件提出了新的開關優化方案，以實現接近所有功率器件的零電壓開關。此外，本專案將提出了一種結合 QCM 方案和相移控制技術的雙有源拓撲，以實現系統全面可控、低開關損耗和出色的熱管理。

21202822.label: Project Objectives
21202822.value: To develop a permanent magnet system (PMS)-based computer-aided teleoperation system that offers users with an intuitive "direct linkage" between user inputs and a millimetre-scale magnetic soft capsule robot in minimally invasive gastroscopy and colonoscopy. To prototype the system based on (i) a systematic (instead of previously heuristic) investigation of shape-morphing behaviours of the capsule robot in magnetic field, (ii) a theoretical and computational characterization of the robotic manipulator - permanent magnet system - soft robot tandem, and (iii) a real-time optimization strategy. To test and iterate the system with the capsule robot working inside medical phantoms for targeted delivery and liquid biopsy associated with minimally invasive healthcare.

21202822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21202822.value: Millimetre-scale shape-morphing robots promises to bring transformative improvement to the existing healthcare paradigm. They access hard-to-reach regions buried deep inside human body to perform minimally invasive diagnosis and therapy. Particularly in the peri- and post-pandemic eras, these untethered and wirelessly controlled robots offer unique benefits for infection control. First, they need minimal or even no cut of human body to prevent cross-infection and contamination between the in vivo and ex vivo environments. Second, they are remotely controlled by external signals such as magnetic field and allow for teleoperation with a safe distance between patients and doctors. However, the prohibitive upfront learning curve for untrained users to use these robots with existing setup discourages healthcare professionals and hinders the adoption of these novel robotic systems in real-world clinical scenarios. This research proposes to develop an intuitive computer-aided teleoperation system for a millimetre-scale soft capsule robot. A standalone system with both hardware and software is developed. It builds a direct and intuitive linkage between user inputs and robot actions, with assistant subroutines for enhanced accuracy and repeatability in teleoperation. Users need not worry about how the robot works, as all calculation, optimization, and implementation are carried out in real-time behind the scene. Instead, users concentrate on completing biomedical tasks using the robot as an enabling tool. A permanent magnet system is mounted at the tip of a multiple degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator. Compared with electromagnetic coil systems, this system offers the benefits of open workspace, high field strength, and low heat generation. Similar previous efforts have been made with rigid or tethered robots. But they lack the compatibility with versatile shape-morphing robots which have a wider catalogue of functionalities. This research fills this vacancy with a system that takes full advantages of the unique shape-morphing behaviours of soft untethered robots for biomedical applications. The developed teleoperation system reduces the barrier for untrained users to interact with miniature shape-morphing robots and deploy them in real-world applications. In particular, it encourages healthcare professionals to adopt these novel robotic systems into their workflow, by taking on much working load that was previously borne by users. The successful completion of this project facilitates the transition of small-scale robotics from laboratory toys towards genuine real-world applications to make far-reaching societal and economic impacts. The developed system is tested in gastroscopy and colonoscopy. It can be extended to work for other minimally invasive healthcare procedures with various miniature shape-morphing robots. 毫米級可形變機器人有望給現有的醫療範式帶來改革與提升。 此類機器人可進入深埋於人體深處的區域並執行微創診斷與治療。 尤其在當下疫情以及未來的後疫情時代，這些無線遙控的機器人在抑制傳染病傳播方面有著其獨特的優勢。 首先，它們只需要很小甚至不需要人體上的切口，預防了體內、外環境間的交叉感染和互相污染。 其次，它們被外部信號（如磁場）無線遙控操作，允許醫生在治療時與病人保有安全的距離。 然而對於未受過訓練的醫療從業人員來說，利用當下已有的系統來使用這些機器人有著極高的學習成本，阻礙了這些新型機器人系統在現實醫療場景中的推廣和使用。 本項目旨在研發一個直觀的計算機輔助遙控操作系統來使用毫米級軟體膠囊機器人。 本系統將研發硬體與軟體兩部分，在使用者的輸入信號與機器人的響應之間建立一個直接且直觀的連結，並輔以計算機子程式來提升操作的準確性和可重複性。 系統運行時所有的計算、優化和執行都由計算機即時、自動完成，而使用者則不需要分心去考慮機器人的工作原理。 一個永磁體將被安置於一個多自由度機械臂末端。 與電磁繞圈系統相比，本系統擁有開放的工作區間、高磁場強度和低熱量產生等優勢。 已有的研究只針對非軟體或非無線遙控機器人，因而無法適用於可形變多功能性機器人。 本項目所研發的系統將填補此處空白，充分將無線軟體機器人所獨特的形變特性應用在生物醫學之中。 本項目所研究的遙控操作系統將降低未受訓使用者操作微型可形變機器人用於現實應用的門檻要求。 該系統將承擔大部分原本需由使用者承擔的工作負荷，進而鼓勵醫療專業者在他們的工作流程中引入這些新型機器人系統。 本項目的成功完成將促進微型機器人由實驗室向著真正的現實世界應用進化，從而產生深遠且廣泛的社會、經濟影響。 所研究的系統將在胃、腸鏡場景中進行測試研究。 它也可以利用多種微型可形變機器人來將自己拓展至其他微創醫療手術。

21206222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21206222.value: 眾籌的策略性信息披露和建議

21206222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21206222.value: Crowdfunding is a novel fundraising model that enables creators to raise funds from a crowd of contributors through online platforms (e.g., Kickstarter and Indiegogo). In return, the creators will use the funding to develop their innovative projects (e.g., digital arts, smartwatches, and board games), put them into production, and usually reward the contributors with the products. As crowdfunding usually involves the fundraising of innovative projects that have not existed in the market yet, there is a high degree of information asymmetry between creators and contributors. The online platforms alleviate it by releasing pledging status on its webpage and facilitating creators’ communication with contributors through product updates. Because such information plays an important role in shaping contributors’ perception towards the project success likelihood, it gives rise to an active research area of strategic information disclosure [1]. In this line of research, an honest yet strategic platform, which releases truthful information at the optimized timing for revenue maximization, is considered. So far, most of these studies are limited to empirical research, which lacks the theoretical foundation for the rigorous algorithm design. Thus, in Task 1, we aim to theoretically understand the impact of the information disclosed to the contributors’ pledging behavior, and develop a practical pricing and information disclosure algorithm. In addition, the online platforms create value for the creators and contributors by reducing their matching costs. Due to a large number of projects and contributors in a stochastic setting, the optimal matching problem aiming to maximize the project success ratio in the platform is a daunting task. Thanks to the recent advancement in artificial intelligence (AI), it is possible to improve the matching efficiency through a recommendation system. Unfortunately, the existing solutions are usually based on poorly motivated heuristics [2] that can lead to overfunding problems [3], while the academic research on crowdfunding matching services is limited and impractical. Thus, in Task 2, we aim to fill in this research gap on crowdfunding recommendation by first establishing the theoretical foundation on the allocation of advertisement space to projects. For practical implementations, we plan to design a real-time recommendation system based on individual contributors’ preferences by using the contextual multi-armed bandit framework. In summary, with our preliminary results [4, 5, 6], the proposed research is highly feasible. These research efforts will establish the theoretical understanding of strategic information disclosure and recommendation and lead to the design of practical algorithms in crowdfunding. 眾籌是一種新穎的籌款模式，使創作者能夠通過在線平台（例如 Kickstarter 和 Indiegogo），從大量的貢獻者手上籌集資金，開發他們的創新項目（例如數字藝術、智能手錶和棋盤遊戲），將它們投入生產，並將產品回饋貢獻者。 由於眾籌通常涉及尚未完成的創新項目的籌款，所以創作者和貢獻者在市場上存在著高度的信息不對稱性。為了緩解這個問題，在線平台可以在其網頁上發放認購狀態 ，並通過提供產品的最新資訊促進創作者與貢獻者的交流 。由於這些信息在塑造貢獻者對項目成功率的看法起著重要的作用 ，所以它引發出一個有關「策略性信息披露」的研究領域[1]。在這研究領域中，我們考慮一個誠實但有策略性的平台。這平台為了達到收入最大化，它會優化發布真實信息的時間。迄今為止，這些研究大多限於實證研究，並且缺乏嚴謹演算法的理論基礎。因此，在任務 1 中，我們旨在從理論上理解披露信息對出資人認購行為的影響，並制定切實可行的定價和信息披露算法。 此外，在線平台通過降低創作者和貢獻者之間的匹配成本來為他們創造價值 。由於這涉及大量的項目和貢獻者的隨機設置，所以考慮項目成功率最大化的最優匹配問題是一項艱鉅的任務。可幸的是通過應用人工智能（AI），我們可以提高推薦系​​統的匹配效率 。不過，因為現有的解決方案通常基於動機不足的啟發式演算法 [2]，所以可能會導致資金過剩的問題 [3]。同時， 眾籌匹配服務的學術研究有限且不切實際。因此， 在任務 2 中，我們的目標是首先建立廣告空間配置的理論基礎，從而填補眾籌推薦的研究缺口。對於實際應用，我們計劃通過使用「情境式多臂賭博機」的框架，設計出一個基於個人貢獻者偏好的實時推薦系統，。 總括而言，根據我們的初步研究結果 [4, 5, 6]，我們所提出的研究是高度可行的。這些研究工作將建立對策略性信息披露和推薦的理論基礎，從而設計出實用的演算法應用在眾籌當中。

21216822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21216822.value: 基於跨層設計的抗干擾低功耗廣域網

21216822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21216822.value: Complementary to existing wireless protocols (e.g., 5G, WiFi, and Bluetooth), the recently introduced low-power wide-area networks (LPWANs) offer wireless connections with a long communication range and low energy consumption. These unique benefits empower LPWAN's rapid deployment in critical Internet of Things (IoT) applications, such as smart city, precision agriculture, and environment monitoring. Despite the demonstrated success, LPWAN in the unlicensed spectrum inevitably suffers from homogeneous interference due to LPWAN transmissions and heterogeneous interference caused by communication in other protocols. The wireless interference corrupts LPWAN's signal, leading to packet losses, increased energy consumption, and prolonged delay. These issues severely affect IoT application performance and are expected to aggravate given the explosive IoT growth. We note that there exist many interference mitigation techniques for radios with shorter ranges or higher transmission rates. However, these solutions are not applicable for LPWAN, whose unique signal characteristics and inherent natures, e.g., extremely low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), require dedicated mitigation solutions. Recently, researchers have started to recognize the importance of interference resilience for LPWAN, but they commonly focus on designs at either the Physical layer or the Link layer, still lacking a holistic framework for synergic reliability. Different from existing research, this proposal aims at a cross-layer framework for achieving synergic interference resilience. Our plan consists of Physical-layer signal analysis and Link-layer optimization. More importantly, we will integrate them together to boost the interference resilience beyond individual operations. We will begin with our Physical-layer techniques that propose to analyze the received signal while adapting to LPWAN's inherent challenges, such as low SNR and low power, for resilience improvement. Specifically, we will recover corrupted LPWAN symbols with low cost and high reliability under heterogeneous interference. To deal with homogeneous interference, our concurrent communication will examine unique signal features across different LPWAN devices. In the second part, we plan to identify the critical Physical-layer information and exploit it through Link-layer optimization to boost interference resilience. Our forward error correction will consider LPWAN's symbol reliability, estimated by our Physical layer, in the coding and decoding procedures for enhancing interference protection capability. In addition, we will elaborately schedule LPWAN transmissions to create collisions solvable by our Physical layer for improving communication reliability. By enabling interference-resilient LPWAN, this proposal is expected to offer reliable IoT application performance and prolong low-power devices' lifetime, further benefiting emerging IoT services and fostering Hong Kong's transformation into a smart city. 作為對現有各類無線協議的補充，最近推出的低功耗廣域網（LPWAN）能夠提供長距離和低能耗的無線連接。這些獨特的優勢促使LPWAN能夠在智能城市、精準農業和環境監控等關鍵物聯網（IoT）應用中實現廣泛部署。但由於LPWAN工作在非認證頻譜中，其不可避免地受到來自LPWAN的同構干擾和來自其他協議的異構干擾。無線干擾破壞了LPWAN的信號，導致數據包丟失、能耗提升與延遲升高等一系列問題。這些問題嚴重影響物聯網應用的性能，並且會隨著物聯網設備的激增而進一步加劇。我們注意到目前已有許多針對較短通信距離或較高傳輸速率的無線電技術的干擾緩解方案。然而，現有方案並不適用於具有獨特信號特性（如極低的信噪比）的LPWAN。最近，研究人員開始認識到LPWAN抗干擾技術研究的重要性，但一般專注於物理層或鏈路層的獨立設計，直至現在仍然缺乏一個跨層協同框架來進一步提高LPWAN通信可靠性。 與現有研究不同，本提案旨在建立一個協同抗干擾的跨層框架。我們的計劃包括物理層信號分析和鏈路層優化。更為重要的是我們將兩者整合以達到比單個設計更高的抗干擾能力。在本提案的第一部分，我們將分析物理層接收的信號並解決LPWAN固有的挑戰（如低信噪比和低功率等）以提升LPWAN通信的抗干擾能力。針對異構干擾，我們將研發低成本和高可靠性的LPWAN符號恢復技術。針對同構干擾，我們將利用不同LPWAN設備特有的信號特徵實現併發通信。在本提案的第二部分，我們計劃識別關鍵的物理層信息並通過鏈路層優化加以利用，以提高LPWAN的可靠性。我們的前向糾錯技術將在編解碼的過程中考慮物理層LPWAN符號的可靠性，從而提高抗干擾能力。此外，我們將協調多LPWAN設備間的傳輸以提升網絡的吞吐量。 本提案的抗干擾LPWAN技術將提供可靠的物聯網應用性能並延長低功耗設備的壽命，進一步惠及新興物聯網服務並幫助香港成為世界級的智慧城市。

21309222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21309222.value: 球面與其最大函數的Nikodym集合

21309222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21309222.value: This proposal is concerned with geometric properties of sets associated with spheres and related maximal functions. A sphere is a fundamental geometric object, which is the boundary of a ball. While a sphere in the 3-dimensional Euclidean space has a positive 2-dimensional area, its 3-dimensional volume is 0. The same holds for any finite (or a "countable”) union of spheres. On the other hand, consider a collection of spheres which contains a sphere centered at every point of the 3-dimensional space. Is it possible that spheres in the collection can be packed into a set of 0 volume? It turns out that the answer is no, that is, any set containing such a collection of spheres must have a positive volume. This result is due to Stein, which follows from his seminal work on the spherical maximal function. Is it possible to extend the result to more general collections of spheres with a greater flexibility in selecting spheres? What happens if spheres are replaced by other geometric objects, in particular, lower dimensional ones? This proposal aims to address problems related to these questions by using techniques from harmonic analysis and geometric measure theory. To this end, the PI proposes to study a new class of maximal functions associated with spheres. The first project is concerned with measure theoretic properties of sets containing a circle centered at every point in the 3-dimensional space and Lebesgue space mapping properties of related maximal functions. The second project deals with maximal functions related to Nikodym sets for circles discovered by Chang and Csörnyei. Their Lebesgue space mapping properties have been partly addressed in a joint work of the PI and his collaborators. The PI, with his collaborators, will strengthen and extend results obtained in the joint work in several directions. The projects will involve training of postgraduate students. 該研究提案涉及球面與其最大函數的Nikodym集合的幾何特性。球面是基本的幾何對象，是球體的邊界。雖然3維歐幾里得空間中的球面具有正的2維面積，但它的3維體積為0。這同樣適用於任何有限 球面的並集。另一方面，考慮一個球面的集合，使得對於3維空間每一個點，這個集合都包含以這個點為中心的球面。是否可以將該集合中的球面包裝成一個體積為0的集合？答案是否定的，即任何這樣的集合必須有正的體積。這個結果歸功於Stein對於球面最大函數的開創性工作。是否可以將該結果擴展到更一般的球面集合？如果球面被低維幾何對象取代會發生什麼？該提案旨在通過使用調和析和幾何測度論的技術來解決些問題。 為此，項目負責人建議研究一類新的與球面相關的最大函數。第一個項目涉及包含以3維空間中的每個點為中心的球面的集合的測度性質和相關最大函數的Lebesgue空間映射性質。第二個項目研究與Chang和Csörnyei發現的圓的Nikodym集相關的最大函數。它們的Lebesgue空間映射特性在項目負責人和他的合作者的聯合工作中得到了部分解決。項目負責人與他的合作者將在多個方向上加強和擴展在聯合工作中取得的成果。這些項目將涉及研究生培訓。

21309322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21309322.value: 非常規相銅基Janus納米結構的可控合成及其串聯電催化二氧化碳還原应用

21309322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21309322.value: 在過去的四十年裡，全球大氣中的二氧化碳（CO2）濃度從 340 ppm 急劇上升到 415 ppm，導致了許多嚴重的環境問題，包括全球變暖、冰川融化和海平面上升。因此，如何實現碳中和已成為全世界，尤其是香港這樣的沿海地區的一項重要/緊迫的任務。最近，電催化 CO2 還原反應 (CO2RR) 可以通過間歇性可再生電力將 CO2 轉化為有用的化學品/燃料，已成為解決上述環境問題的新策略。特別是，將 CO2 電催化還原為多碳產物（例如乙醇和乙烯）極具吸引力，因為它們具有高能量密度和高經濟價值。迄今為止，銅基材料對多碳產品表現出最有希望的 CO2RR 性能。然而，由於反應中間體之間的線性比例關係、碳-碳耦合的較大能壘以及催化劑的固有活性有限，目前銅基材料上將CO2電催化還原為多碳產物仍然存在選擇性差、低電流密度和大的過電位等問題。 該項目旨在開發高性能非常規相銅基金屬串聯催化劑，該催化劑能夠有效、選擇性地將二氧化碳轉化為高價值的多碳產品。我們將通過控制銅在不同非常規相金屬納米結構的特定區域的生長來合成各種非常規相（例如，4H、4H/fcc 和 fcc-2H-fcc）銅基 Janus 納米結構。然後將系統地測量和優化新型 Janus 納米結構的 CO2RR 性能。之後，將通過非原位/原位實驗研究和理論計算相結合，揭示Janus納米結構上電催化CO2RR的機理。將確定影響 CO2RR 性能的關鍵因素，同時建立結構和性能之間的一般關係。為了展示連續產生特定多碳產品的潛力，將使用最佳非常規相銅基催化劑構建 CO2RR 的流動池原型。我們的初步結果揭示了非常規相銅納米晶體和銀/銅 Janus 納米結構的優越 CO2RR 性能，表明該項目具有很高的可行性。 課題負責人在金屬納米材料晶相控制、非常規相雙/多金屬異質納米結構的模板合成、電催化CO2RR等方面積累了豐富的經驗。課題負責人實驗室的材料合成和電催化測量設施將使該項目的成功交付成為可能。該項目的成功實施，將啟發下一代 CO2RR 催化劑的設計，推動 CO2RR 的實際應用，進而有利於香港和世界實現碳中和。

21309522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21309522.value: 流固耦合问题的非拟合数值方法及应用

21309522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21309522.value: 流固耦合 (FSI) 的数学建模在工程和生物工程中具有广泛的实际应用。基于此，大量的工作致力于设计和分析有效的求解FSI的数值方法。由于两个域之间的刚性耦合，为 FSI 设计准确有效的数值方法具有极大挑战性。数值方法还受到稳定性或准确性的限制，这些问题需要严格的时间步长限制，或者当流体和固体具有相似的密度时，系统中的附加质量会加重这些问题的负担。在解决多域设置中的问题时，不拟合方法具有突出优势，因为它可以减轻由复杂几何形状和弯曲界面的存在引起的繁琐网格划分过程。其中尤为重要的是未拟合方法的背景网格独立于区域的几何形状，但是如何修正离散方法使其能够处理切割元素是一大挑战。 在这个项目中，我们将设计和分析非拟合网格上的 FSI 问题的前沿数值方案。关于空间离散化，该项目侧重于多边形网格上的新颖不连续 Galerkin 方法。这些方法结合了稳健性和效率，在模拟 FSI 问题方面具有创新性。伴随切割元素的一个问题是在存在小切割的情况下有限元离散化的病态。为了克服这个问题，将开发一种新方法来确保该方案对于小切口的稳健性。另外，将开发没有附加质量效应的整体方案和松散耦合方案，这将为在未拟合网格上设计松散耦合方案提供新的视角。此外，将提出和分析高阶精确时间步长方案，旨在以适度的计算成本提高解的时间精度。然后，我们将扩展所提出的方案以解决涉及移动域和/或界面的非线性 FSI。该方案的准确性和性能将通过严格的数学分析和针对基准问题的广泛数值模拟来验证。 该项目处于数值分析和计算科学的前沿，涉及与实际应用的接口。此外，未拟合方法的主题在国际上非常活跃，并涉及许多实际应用。因此，所开发的方法和数学工具将有可能产生相当大的影响。

21310722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21310722.value: 硅和鍺π鍵分子的單分子電子輸運研究

21310722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21310722.value: Silicon and germanium are ubiquitously used as key semiconductor materials in fabricating solid-state devices, and continue to be explored for creating qubits and qubit interactions in use for quantum computing. In parallel, efforts have been made in the design, synthesis, characterization, and implementation of silane and germane molecules for fabricating single molecule devices. In particular, single molecule switches and insulators have been created by use of molecules that contain silicon and germanium σ bonds, such as permethyloligosilanes, siloxanes and a bicyclo[2.2.2]octasilane moiety. Despite this progress, there remain significant gaps in such theoretical and experimental demonstrations for the π-conjugated silicon and germanium double bonds. Silicon and germanium π-conjugation, carrying delocalized charges, can provide strong electronic coupling thus opening the door to applications as tunable platforms for electrochemistry, mechanochemistry, and nanoelectronics. In addition, incorporating π-conjugated silicon and germanium wires with other σ- and π-conjugated components can achieve versatile functions and novel transport behaviors such as the ones dictated by the quantum interference effects. We therefore propose herein to study the formation, structure, electronic and thermoelectric properties of π-conjugated silicon and germanium molecules attached to metallic electrodes through an interdisciplinary approach that combines organic chemistry, physics, and engineering. Specifically, this research project focuses on rationally designing π-conjugated silenes and germenes, developing protocols for forming metal-molecule-metal junctions inside solutions under room temperature and ambient conditions, and characterizing the charge transport and thermoelectric properties of such single molecule junctions. Towards these goals, we will develop and apply custom-designed scanning tunneling microscope break junction technique, which allows us to fabricate single molecule circuit efficiently and reproducibly. The motivations for pursuing studies of π-conjugated silenes and germenes are their scientific importance and technological implications; the fundamental role that chemistry is expected to play in determining their molecular electronic properties; and the paucity of such experimental studies. By applying single molecule approaches onto silenes and germenes, we aim to uncover the structure-function relationships and ultimately design and create novel functionalities that harness molecular properties. An understanding of the smallest building blocks in nature - molecules, as well as their dynamic processes, holds promise in addressing issues that are critical in nanotechnology, electronics, energy and human health. 硅和鍺是製造固體器件最爲廣泛使用的核心半導體材料，並且被用來製成比特和量子位交互作用而用於量子計算。與此同時，硅烷分子和鍺烷分子的設計、合成、表徵和在單分子器件中的應用也取得長足的進步。其中，包含硅和鍺的σ鍵的分子，例如鏈狀硅烷、硅氧烷和双环[2.2.2]辛硅烷衍生物，被成功製成了單分子開關和絕緣體。 在推進這些進步的基礎上，我們在理論和實驗上對包含硅和鍺的π鍵的分子的認知仍有欠缺。硅和鍺的π鍵帶有離域的電子，可以提供較強的電子耦合，從而有巨大潛力應用在電化學、機械化學和納米電子學中。除此之外，硅和鍺的π鍵與其他σ鍵和π鍵結構的結合能夠實現多面的功能和新穎的電子輸運行為，例如量子干涉效應。 本項目計劃利用包含有機化學、物理和工程的跨學科的手段，研究連接在金屬電極中含有硅和鍺的π鍵的單分子結的形成、結構和電學性質。其中，我們會設計硅和鍺π鍵為骨架的分子，探索出在室溫和常压下連結金屬-分子-金屬的實驗條件，並對這些單分子結進行表徵。為此，我們會搭建一台能夠高效並可重複地構建單分子電路的掃描隧道顯微鏡斷裂結。 本項目對π鍵連接的硅和鍺的分子的研究動機源自於它們科學上的重要性和技術中的延伸性；化學在決定分子電學性質中起到的根本作用；以及這些研究的稀缺性。通過運用單分子的方法研究以π鍵連接的硅和鍺為骨架的分子，我們預計闡釋分子結構和功能的關係並最終設計和開發出利用分子特性的新的電子學功能。

21310922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21310922.value: 二取代有機硼正離子、硼自由基以及硼陰離子化合物的合成、結構以及反應研究

21310922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21310922.value: 本課題的研究目標是合成新型的二取代有機硼化合物並且研究其反應性。 有機硼正離子，有機硼自由基以及有機硼陰離子化合物是具有活潑化學反應性的有機硼化合物。最近的研究進展表明，有機硼正離子化合物以及硼自由基化合物可作為催化劑、重要的反應中間體以及反應試劑應用於有機合成。不僅如此，有機硼自由基化合物還可發展為化學分子探針、聚合反應的引髮劑以及新穎的有機發光材料。對於大多數的有機硼化合物，其反應性通常表現為親電性，而有機硼陰離子化合物由於其獨特的親核反應性引發關注。文獻中已報導的這些有機硼化合物，主要是由路易鹼配體穩定的三取代、四取代有機硼化合物。不可否認，路易斯鹼配體的引入的確能起到了穩定活潑硼中心的作用，但同時與路易斯鹼的作用及位阻的關係，硼化合物的反應活性亦受到了一定限制。在這份研究計劃書中，我們計劃通過引入大位阻的芳香取代基來合成一系列新型的二取代有機硼化合物並系統研究它們的反應活性。我們希望可以將這些二取代有機硼化合物應用於小分子活化、構築新的硼-元素鍵中，從而進一步發掘它們在有機合成中的應用。

21313922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21313922.value: 關於高維高階時空數據的聚類統計方法

21313922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21313922.value: This project concerns the problem of clustering high-dimension high-order spatio-temporal data. This project is motivated by analyzing brain imaging, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), functional MRI(fMRI), electroencephalography (EEG), etc. Brain imaging data has played an increasingly important role in analyzing the mechanisms of many mental issues, including intellectual disabilities, cognitive disorders, etc. However, unlike many diseases that are easy to be diagnosed, labeling a potential patient whether s/he has a certain mental disability is extremely difficult. It would be desired to understand and interpret the brain imaging data without the help of labels. To achieve this goal, a key step is to identify the spatial regions or temporal periods that are truly informative and able to differentiate the subgroups of subjects. Identifying the informative regions would not only help data interpretation, but also greatly benefit clustering. In this project, we aim to provide a general framework to address the spatial-temporal clustering problem. This framework would simultaneously divide spatial-temporal data into clusters and detect spatial regions/temporal periods that are informative for clustering. The proposed approach would be formulated into a problem of recovering sparse tensors with CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) low-rank structure. Algorithm and theory for estimating CP low-rank tensors will be developed. 本項目研究高維高階時空數據的聚類問題。此問題基於研究腦成像數據，例如核磁共振 成像（MRI），功能核磁共振成像（fMRI），腦電圖（EEG）等。腦成像數據在分析精神疾病（如智力障礙，認知障礙等）的機制方面發揮著越來越重要的作用。然而，與許多易於診斷的疫病不同，精神疾病的診斷是極其困難的。因此能夠在沒有標籤幫助的情況下理解腦成像數據是非常必要的。為實現這一目標，其關鍵步驟在於識別導致某類精神疾病的大腦區域。這不僅有助於解釋腦成像數據，更有助於提升聚類準確性。此項目旨在提供一類解決時空聚類問題的通用框架。此框架在聚類的同時能夠識別重要的空間區域（或時間週期）。上述方法可被轉化為一個用CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) 低秩結構恢復稀疏張量的統計問題。因此，本項目也將對CP低秩張量的恢復進行算法和理論研究。

21500122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21500122.value: 技術相關無形資產公允價值估計的外部性：來自企業合併的證據

21500122.label: Project Objectives
21500122.value: Reasons for undertaking the project- Debate on Accounting for Tech-Intangibles • Technology-related intangible assets (tech-intangibles) are the primary driver of firm value in the modern knowledge economy. • Yet, the lack of balance sheet recognition of internally generated tech-intangibles (IGTI) reduces the value relevance of accounting information and leaves the onus of gauging the value of IGTI on financial statement users. • However, due to the lack of certainty of payoffs of IGTI, their recognition on the balance sheet at a cost basis is challenging. • Furthermore, given the lack of readily available market-based estimates of the value of IGTI, their recognition or even disclosure on fair value basis is questionable, given substantial managerial discretion in such estimates. Demand for more Research on Accounting for Tech-Intangibles • Under the cloud of the above conflicting viewpoints, Standard setters are facing increasing demand from investors to provide more information about the value of tech-intangibles, especially that of IGTI, through recognition or disclosure given their importance in the knowledge economy. • In response, both FASB and IASB have initiated projects on how to improve the information environment for intangibles. • Yet, due to the lack of availability of data on tech-intangible values, rather limited research has directly examined the decision usefulness of recognition (and/or disclosure) of IGTI. • Standard setters have called for academic research to provide direct evidence of whether and how the information on the value of (tech-)intangibles is used by users of financial statements. Key issues addressed- • In this study, I answer the call of standard setters and academics to shed more light on the decision usefulness of recognition (or disclosure) of the value of IGTI. • Specifically, since the value of IGTIs is not observable under the current accounting system unless a firm is acquired in a Business Combination transaction, I use the disclosed fair value of the tech-intangibles of the target firm after the acquisition, as a proxy for the estimated fair value of its pre-acquisition IGTI. • While prior research primarily focuses on the decision usefulness of accounting information to a firm’s own investors and managers, I take a different approach and investigate whether this information is useful for investors and managers of peer firms. • First, I study if investors of technologically similar peer firms of the target find the fair value of the target’s tech-intangibles incrementally informative after controlling for other pre-existing accounting and non-accounting signals of the value of the tech-intangibles. I do so by investigating the stock market reaction around the disclosure of the fair value of the tech-intangibles. • Second, I investigate if the managers of the technologically similar peers of the target use the fair value estimate of the tech-intangibles in strategic decision-making about the orientation of their technology portfolio. • I propose to use a new setting not explored in prior research—the mandatory proforma disclosure under Article 11 of Reg SX—, which is a timelier source of information about the fair value of acquired intangibles in business combinations than the final purchase price allocation disclosure commonly used in prior research. Practical outcomes- • By investigating whether the investors of the peer firms find the fair value estimates of IGTI informative and whether managers of these peer firms use this information in their strategic decision making concerning their investments in tech-intangibles, this project seeks to provide direct evidence of decision usefulness of fair value estimates of IGTI. • This directly responds to the call of standard setters (in ongoing projects related to improving the information environment of intangibles) for academia to provide direct evidence of decision usefulness of accounting value estimates of intangibles and “how the information is used by users”. • The decision usefulness of information on values of IGTI for peer managers and investors also speaks to two other projects (PPA disclosure and Proforma disclosure) under consideration at FASB and SEC, where they are evaluating whether the separate recognition and disclosure of the fair value of identifiable intangibles separate from goodwill is informative for investors. Possible new knowledge creation- • Academics have long been divided over recognition and (or) disclosure of the value of IGTI. Another heavily debated interrelated accounting issue is about the reliability of fair value estimates of non-financial assets, for which a readily available market quoted price is not available. This project can contribute to the above two inter-related debates in accounting research by providing direct evidence of the decision usefulness of fair value estimates of IGTI from the perspective of investors and managers of the peer firms. • By studying the implications of fair value estimates of IGTI on peer firm managers and investors, this study extends the scope of the literature on accounting information transfer, which has traditionally focused on earnings announcements. • This study extends the scope of literature on the real effects of accounting information, which has primarily focused on investments in general but not on tech-specific policies.

21500122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21500122.value: Intangibles such as patents, know-how, trade secrets, developed and in-process technology (collectively tech-intangibles henceforth), generated from research and development efforts, are a primary driver of firm value in the modern knowledge economy. Yet, the current accounting system does not recognize their value (when internally generated) unless acquired through a mergers and acquisition (M&A) transaction. Hence, investors and analysts have argued that the current standards do not provide enough information about the value of tech-intangibles, making it difficult to value technology-intensive firms. However, given the lack of reliable fair value information, recognition of such items is challenging. Facing increasing information demand from investors about tech-intangibles, standard setters have called for more academic research to show direct evidence that recognizing (or disclosing) the value of tech-intangibles, would be useful for investors’ decision-making. However, due to limited data availability, rather limited research has directly examined this issue. To fill this void, this study aims to shed more light on the decision usefulness of the fair value of tech-intangibles. Specifically, I exploit a mandatory disclosure post M&A, wherein the acquirer discloses the post-deal recognition of the fair value of the target’s tech-intangibles. While prior research primarily focuses on the decision usefulness of accounting information to a firm’s own investors and managers, I take a different approach and investigate this issue from the perspective of the investors and managers of peer firms. First, I study if investors of peers technologically similar to the target find the fair value of the target’s tech-intangibles incrementally informative beyond other accounting and non-accounting signals of the value of these items. Second, I investigate if the managers of the peer firms use the fair value of the tech-intangibles in their investment decisions regarding which area(s) of technology to invest in. This study responds to the call of standard setters for more academic research to provide direct evidence of whether and how information about the value of tech-intangibles is used by financial statement users. Furthermore, this study speaks to two interrelated important debates in accounting literature, (i) recognition (or disclosure) of intangibles (ii) usefulness of fair value accounting by examining the decision usefulness of fair value estimates of tech-intangibles. Lastly, this study extends the literature on accounting information transfer, which has traditionally focused on earnings announcements, and the literature on the real effects of accounting information, which has primarily focused on investments in general but not on tech-specific policies. 研發工作產生的無形資產，如專利、專有技術、商業秘密、已開發和在製技術（以下統稱為技術無形資產），是現代知識經濟中企業價值的主要驅動力。然而，當前的會計系統只承认通過併購 (嘛) 交易獲得的無形資產，不承認內部產生的無形資產的價值。因此，投資者和分析師認為，目前的准则沒有提供足夠的關於技術無形資產價值的信息，因此很難對技術密集型公司進行估值。然而，由於缺乏可靠的公允價值信息，此類资产項目的確認具有挑戰性。面對投資者對技術無形資產日益增長的信息需求，准则制定者呼籲進行更多的學術研究，以提供直接證據，證明識別（或披露）技術無形資產的價值將有助於投資者的決策。然而，由於數據限制，只有有限的研究直接研究了這個問題。 為了填補這一空白，本研究旨在進一步闡明技術無形資產公允價值的決策有用性。具體來說，我计划利用併購後对收購方強制披露目標公司技術無形資產公允價值的要求来研究这一问题。之前的研究主要關注會計信息對公司自身投資者和經理的決策有用性，我计划採取不同的方法，從同行公司的投資者和經理的角度來研究這個問題。首先，我计划研究與目標公司技術相似的同行公司的投資者是否發現目標公司技術無形資產的公允價值对這些項目的估值提供了有用的增量信息。其次，我会調查同行公司的經理是否在投資決策中使用技術無形資產的公允價值來影响他们投資哪些技術領域的决定。 這項研究響應了准则制定者的呼籲，進行更多的學術研究，以提供直接證據證明財務報表用戶是否以及如何使用有關技術無形資產價值的信息。此外，本研究还涉及到了會計文獻中兩個相互關聯的重要辯論，（i）無形資產的承認（或披露）（ii）公允價值會計的有用性。最後，本研究擴展了有關會計信息傳遞的文獻（大多数文献側重於收益公告）和有關會計信息實際决策影響的文獻，後者的文献主要側重於一般投資，而不是特定技術的投资。

21500422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21500422.value: 通過收益可預測性了解大宗商品市場

21500422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21500422.value: Commodity futures markets allow commodity producers and consumers to engage in hedging; one market participant may unload her unwanted price risk to someone who is more suitable to bear that risk. Hedging helps the economy function by allowing producers and consumers to conduct their businesses with greater certainty. Because commodities are central to manufacturing and industrial processes, their prices are also intimately related to the macroeconomy. Given the importance of commodities, researchers have long sought to understand these markets. Multiple theoretical explanations have been proposed to capture the behavior of commodity futures returns, but there is limited agreement on which theory provides the best description of the real world. Researchers also cannot agree on which variables best capture expected return variation in commodity futures, a central question in understanding the behavior of these markets. In this proposal, we take a step towards resolving the above issues. We seek to evaluate competing theories and characterize expected return variation in commodity markets through return predictability tests. We set out to address three research questions. Our first question seeks to distinguish among different theoretical explanations of commodity returns. Existing papers tend to test the predictions of a single theory, which makes it difficult to assess the relative merit of competing theories. We contribute to the literature by proposing a testing framework that allows us to jointly examine multiple competing theories, and we apply this framework to test four theories of commodity returns. Our second question relates to the measurement of commodity expected returns, calculated as the predictable component of future realized returns. Extant work typically uses a small number of predictors, which potentially leads to limited characterization of expected returns. Our tests are based on a large and diverse set of variables, and our work helps to resolve the problem of measuring commodity expected returns. Our final research question aims to uncover the drivers of average return differences across commodities. Our approach differs from current research in that we start from a large set of candidate variables, and we use a data-drive method to reduce the dimensionality and build an asset pricing model. The variables that explain the cross section of commodity returns can reveal the most important risks in commodity markets, paving the way for improved theoretical explanations. 商品期貨市場允許商品生產者和消費者進行套期保值；一位市場參與者可以將她不想要的價格風險轉嫁給更適合承擔該風險的人。通過風險對沖，生產者和消費者可以更確定地開展業務。由於大宗商品是製造業和工業過程的核心，它們的價格也與宏觀經濟密切相關。 鑑於商品的重要性，學者們長期以來一直試圖了解這些市場。學術文獻裡提出了多種理論解釋來捕捉商品期貨收益的行為，也有至多的爭議性哪一種解釋提供了對現實世界的最佳描述。學者們也無法達成一致哪些變量最能反映商品期貨的預期收益變化。在本提案中，我們試圖解決上述問題。我們試圖通過回報可預測性測試來評估不同的理論並描述商品市場的預期回報變化。 我們試圖解決三個研究問題。第一個問題試圖區分商品收益的不同理論解釋。現有論文傾向於測試單個理論，這使我們很難評估並比較不同的理論。我們提出一個可以同時檢驗多個相互競爭的理論的測試框架，並且我們應用這個框架來測試四種商品收益理論。第二個問題與商品預期收益的衡量有關。現存的工作通常使用少量的預測變量，這可能導致對預期收益的錯誤估計。我們的測試基於大量多樣的變量，我們的工作有助於解決衡量商品預期收益的問題。最後一個研究問題旨在揭示大宗商品平均回報差異的驅動因素。我們的方法與當前研究的不同之處在於，我們從大量候選變量開始，我們使用數據驅動的方法來降低維度並建立資產定價模型。解釋商品收益橫截面的變量可以揭示商品市場中最重要的風險。

21503922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21503922.value: 使用手机时更极端：智能手机的使用导致极端的意见表达

21503922.label: Project Objectives
21503922.value: There is a growing concern that the world is getting more and more polarized. Recently, Gallup (Jones, 2020) reported that the political polarization between Republicans and Democrats is the largest in the 74-year history of the poll and Pew Research Center (Dimock, & Wike, 2020) also found similar results in various matters including the economy, racial justice, climate change, law enforcement, and international engagement. Interestingly, the pandemic has revealed how pervasive the divide is. In 2020, while 76% of Republicans felt the U.S. had done a good job dealing with the coronavirus outbreak while just 29% of Democratic felt that way. Also, people indeed perceive this partisanship in that 77% of Americans said the country was now more polarized than before the Covid-19 outbreak. This is shown in the digital world, where people can freely share their opinions in various forms – from a star rating to a tweet. Smartphones have become one of the most prevalent digital devices that consumers use to share their opinions. Recent data suggests that over 80% of tweets are from mobile devices (Google, 2017) and 67% of smartphone owners use their devices to share content online (Smith, 2015). More and more consumers are now using their phones, rather than PCs, to rate the restaurant they recently visited at TripAdvior.com mobile app and to tweet their feelings toward recent Covid-19 related regulations. Along with this “mobile shift” trend in consumer opinion expression, recent work has investigated whether smartphone use, as compared with PC use, can fundamentally change how and what consumers express and share. This research aims to understand the effects of smartphone use on opinion expression, in particular, in their degree of extremity. I propose that smartphone use, as compared with PC use, leads people to express more extreme and polarized opinions. I further theorize that this occurs because smartphone use increases users’ focus on their private self. There are three main goals that this research aims to achieve. First, this project aims to establish the causal relationship between smartphone use and opinion extremity. For this purpose, in a series of experiments, I plan to manipulate the device use and then examine its impacts on the degree of extremity in opinion expression. Second, I plan to examine the underlying mechanisms for why smartphone use increases the extremity in opinion expression. Building on the prior findings that smartphone use shifts users’ focus toward their private self, I propose that this psychological process can explain why smartphone use leads to extreme opinion expression. Third, I plan to examine important downstream consequences of extreme opinion expression from the self and observer’s perspective. For the self, after expressing extreme opinions, people are more likely to behave consistently with their expressed attitudes and opinions. I plan to demonstrate that whether using a smartphone to rate their experiences can lead people to make the same choice again in the long term and to advocate their earlier choice when encountering negative information about it. For others, as more extreme opinions have stronger influences on others to form an impression and to make a choice, I will examine whether the reviews written on smartphones can have that impact. This project has several important theoretical and practical implications. This project contributes to the budding literature on smartphone use and consumer behavior by extending the extent of the understanding of the causal effect of smartphone use on consumer opinion expression. Also, this research has implications for the literature studying opinion polarization and attitude extremity by showing an important contextual factor, the medium of opinion expression, matters. More importantly, this research can help marketers and policymakers effectively employ different strategies to “nudge” people to use different smartphones. For the positive events, encouraging people to use smartphones might lead to extremely positive ratings, responses, and reactions, however, for the negative events, it may backfire.

21503922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21503922.value: 智能手机已成为消费者用来分享自己意见的最流行的数字设备之一。消费者可以使用他们的手机，而不是个人电脑，来对他们最近在 TripAdvior.com移动应用程序上访问过的餐厅进行评分，并在推特上发表他们对最近 Covid-19 相关法规的感受。公司和政策制定者可以通过使用二维码或移动应用程序，鼓励消费者使用手机进行意见表达，如满意度调查、客户服务聊天和民意调查。随着消费者意见表达的这种“移动转变”趋势，公司和政策制定者面临的一个关键问题是，智能手机是否仅仅是一个新的平台，或者它们可能会改变消费者表达和分享的方式和内容。 本研究旨在了解智能手机使用对意见表达的影响，特别是在极端程度方面。我认为，与个人电脑的使用相比，智能手机的使用会导致人们表达更加极端和两极分化的意见。我进一步推测，发生这种情况是因为智能手机的使用增加了用户对私人自我的关注。 本研究旨在实现三个主要目标。首先，该项目旨在建立智能手机使用与意见极端性之间的因果关系。其次，我计划研究为什么智能手机的使用会增加意见表达的极端性的潜在机制。我认为这种心理过程可以解释为什么智能手机的使用会导致极端的意见表达。第三，我计划从自我和观察者的角度研究极端意见表达的重要后果。对于自己来说，在表达了极端意见后，人们更容易表现出与自己所表达的态度和意见相一致的行为；对于他人来说，更极端的意见对他人形成印象和做出选择的影响力更强。我计划研究智能手机使用对极端意见表达的影响是否会显示出这样的后续后果结果。 该项目具有若干理论和实践意义。该项目扩展了人们对智能手机使用对消费者意见表达的因果影响的理解程度，并对研究意见极化和态度极端化的文献产生了影响，因为它显示了一个重要的背景因素，即意见表达的媒介，是很重要的。更重要的是，这项研究可以帮助营销人员和政策制定者有效地采用不同的策略来“推动”人们使用不同的智能手机。对于积极的事件，鼓励人们使用智能手机可能会带来非常积极的评价、回应和反应，但对于消极的事件，它可能会适得其反。

21503922.label: Realisation of objectives
21503922.value: The project set out to determine whether, why, and with what consequences smartphone use (versus PC use) affects the extremity and polarization of opinion expression, and to translate these insights into theoretical advances and practical guidance. Overall, the core aims were achieved, with remaining gaps concentrated in the identification of mechanisms and the validation of downstream consequences. Objective 1 was to demonstrate social impact and relevance. I achieved this, especially by conducting a study that focused on political opinion expression across devices—smartphones versus PCs—where public discourse is increasingly taking place. By experimentally testing how device context shapes the polarization of expressed political views, I identified a modifiable, real-world lever: smartphone use amplifies polarization relative to PC use. This provides actionable evidence for platforms, policymakers, and educators to implement mobile-specific interventions (e.g., calibrated frictions, balanced prompts, readability cues) that can mitigate partisan amplification and support healthier civic discourse. Accordingly, Objective 1 is fully achieved. Objective 2 was to determine whether smartphone use, relative to PC use, makes consumer opinion expression more aligned with individuals’ inner selves. I operationalized the core effect—smartphones yielding more extreme and polarized expressions—through the lens of correspondence between dispositional differences (e.g., stable traits, attitudes, identities) and expressed opinions. The rationale is twofold. First, extremity and polarization are person-centered: they emerge when individuals translate strong, identity-consistent attitudes into outward expression. If smartphones intensify this tendency, then dispositional predictors should account for more variance in what people say or rate on smartphones than on PCs. Second, stronger disposition–expression linkage is a process-tracing test of inner-directed expression: when the device nudges users toward private-self focus and affective certainty, their stable preferences and identities exert greater influence on the expressed outcome, yielding more extreme ratings or statements. In a series of studies, using various individual traits, attitudes, and identities, I demonstrated that smartphones increase the correspondence between dispositional differences and expressed opinions. Consumers using smartphones showed stronger alignment between their dispositional profiles and what they said or rated, compared to those using PCs. Following the mid-term report, additional adequately powered replications confirmed this effect and refined its magnitude. These results demonstrate that mobile contexts make consumer expression more self-consistent, with implications for consumption choices, reviews, and word-of-mouth. Accordingly, Objective 2 is fully achieved. Objective 3 set out to (a) establish the core effect that smartphone use, compared to PC use, leads people to express more extreme and polarized opinions, and (b) identify the underlying mechanism, theorized as increased private-self focus under smartphone use. I have confirmed the core effect across a series of studies: smartphones reliably produce more extreme and polarized expressions. Evidence for the mechanism is promising but not yet definitive; preliminary patterns are consistent with heightened private-self focus, but causal identification remains incomplete. Accordingly, Objective 3 is 70% achieved. Objective 4 set out to establish the core causal effect of device context on opinion extremity, to identify the mechanism driving this effect, and to assess downstream consequences for the self and observers. I have established the causal effect through device-manipulation experiments demonstrating that smartphone use, relative to PC use, increases extremity and polarization in expressed opinions. Evidence for the proposed mechanism—heightened private-self focus under smartphone use—is promising but remains preliminary; current findings are consistent with the account, yet definitive causal identification is not yet established. More work is needed to strengthen process evidence via validated self-focus measures, experimental manipulations orthogonal to the device, temporally separated mediation, and adjudication against alternative mechanisms such as attentional load, screen size, input modality, and mobility context. Evidence for downstream consequences is currently limited. Taken together, Objective 4 is partially achieved (50%): causality is confirmed, the mechanism is under active investigation with preliminary support, and downstream consequence testing is underway but not yet conclusive. Objective 5 was to deliver the theoretical and practical implications of the device effect on opinion expression. Theoretically, the project advances literature on smartphone use, self-expression, and attitude extremity by establishing the medium of expression as a consequential contextual factor with a causal influence on extremity and polarization. This reframes device context from a methodological nuisance to a core determinant of expressed attitudes, clarifies boundary conditions for theories of self-focused processing, and motivates mechanism-focused models of private-self activation. Practically, the findings offer actionable guidance for platforms, marketers, and policymakers. Mobile-specific interventions—such as calibrated frictions for impulsive posting, balanced prompts that surface countervailing information, readability and deliberation cues, or device-origin signaling—can mitigate partisan amplification and reduce backfire in negative contexts while harnessing smartphones to amplify positive experiences when appropriate. These implications are robustly supported by the core causal effect established across studies; additional confirmation of the mechanism and downstream consequences will further refine and target these interventions. Accordingly, Objective 5 is 70% achieved. In summary, the project fully achieved Objectives 1 and 2 by demonstrating socially consequential device effects in political opinion expression and by showing that smartphones heighten correspondence between dispositions and expressed opinions in consumer contexts. Objective 3 reached 70% completion by confirming the core effect of smartphone-induced extremity while leaving the mechanism—hypothesized as private-self focus—partially identified. Objective 4 reached 50% completion by establishing causality but producing only preliminary evidence on the mechanism and limited evidence on downstream consequences for self and observers. Objective 5 reached 70% completion by articulating theoretically grounded and practically actionable implications based on the established core effect. The under-achievements primarily reflect two challenges. First, definitive mechanism identification is inherently demanding: despite attempts using validated self-focus measures, experimental manipulations independent of device, and temporally separated mediation designs, results to date have been suggestive but not conclusive, and tests adjudicating alternative explanations (e.g., attentional load, screen size, input modality, mobility context) did not yield consistent mediation. Second, downstream consequence testing requires longitudinal and multi-party designs; I implemented platform-mimicking paradigms, expanded samples, extended follow-up windows, and added observer-evaluation protocols, but these efforts have so far produced limited or mixed effects, likely due to timeframe constraints and effect-size attenuation in more ecologically valid settings. These past attempts clarify where the bottlenecks lie and inform the next wave of studies to resolve mechanism and consequence validation.

21503922.label: Major findings and research outcome
21503922.value: This project establishes that the device people use causally shapes the extremity and polarization of their expressed opinions: smartphones reliably amplify polarized and extreme expressions relative to PCs. I demonstrate this in politically consequential settings by showing greater polarization when opinions are expressed on smartphones, thereby identifying a modifiable, real-world lever that can inform interventions to mitigate partisan amplification in a mobile-first public sphere. In consumer contexts, I show that smartphone use makes expression more inner-directed and self-consistent. I operationalize this by testing whether dispositional differences—stable traits, attitudes, and identities—more strongly predict what people say or rate when they use smartphones rather than PCs. Across studies, dispositions accounted for more variance in smartphone users’ ratings and statements, and adequately powered replications confirmed the robustness and magnitude of this effect. This process-tracing operationalization aligns with the core effect: when smartphones increase private, affect-laden self-focus, people translate their inner orientations more directly into outward expression, producing more extreme evaluations. Causality is established through a series of device-manipulation experiments, which consistently show that the smartphone condition yields more extreme statements across topics and samples. Evidence on the underlying mechanism is suggestive but not yet definitive. Measures and manipulations of private-self focus generally move in the theorized direction, but mediation tests and adjudication against alternative accounts—such as attentional load, screen size, input modality, and mobility context—produce mixed results. Thus, the core effect is robust, while the precise process requires further delineation. Initial tests of downstream consequences, using ecologically oriented paradigms, indicate that smartphone-authored expressions may increase attitude-consistent behavior over time and influence observer impressions and choices. However, these effects are attenuated and imprecisely estimated, reflecting the need for larger samples and longer follow-ups. Collectively, the findings advance theory by elevating device context from a methodological backdrop to a causal determinant of expressed attitudes and by sharpening boundary conditions for models of self-focused processing and polarization. They also yield practical guidance: mobile-specific interventions—such as calibrated frictions for impulsive posting, balanced prompts surfacing countervailing information, readability and deliberation cues, and device-origin signaling—can help temper extreme expression where harmful, while strategically harnessing amplification where beneficial. The core causal effect is established; the mechanism and downstream impacts are partially evidenced and remain priorities for continued investigation.

21503922.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21503922.value: In order to test and underlying mechanism, future research can employ high-powered studies combining validated private-self focus measures, orthogonal self-focus manipulations (independent of device), and temporally separated mediation to isolate necessary and sufficient pathways, while adjudicating alternatives (e.g., attentional load, screen size, input modality, mobility). To establish downstream consequences, future research can run longitudinal and multi-party designs that track attitude-consistent behaviors (choice persistence, sharing, donation) and observer responses to smartphone- versus PC-authored content, using platform-mimicking interfaces to boost ecological validity. To refine practical impact, future research can evaluate mobile-specific interventions—calibrated frictions, balanced prompts, readability/deliberation cues, and device-origin signaling—in randomized field or lab-in-the-field experiments, benchmarking benefits against potential costs (engagement, satisfaction). New research directions may include boundary conditions and heterogeneity (e.g., issue valence, identity centrality, cultural context, age), the role of AI-assisted composition on mobile devices, cross-device spillovers in multichannel journeys, and situational moderators such as mobility, multitasking, or privacy. Additionally, future research can investigate how smartphones, compared to other personal devices, influence various aspects of consumer behavior and psychology, such as language use, attention, and imagery, which may depend on smartphone-related factors.

21503922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21503922.value: This research poses a simple yet profound question: Does the device you use—your smartphone or computer—alter how strongly you express your opinions? We find that it does. People tend to share more extreme and polarized views when using smartphones compared to PCs. This matters because a significant portion of public conversation now occurs on phones. This research tested this in both political and everyday consumer settings. On phones, what people say lines up more closely with their personal traits and identities, which can make their opinions sound stronger. A series of experiments shows the device itself plays a causal role. These findings help explain why online debates can heat up so quickly on mobile. They also point to practical steps: platforms and policymakers could design phone-specific features—like gentle prompts to pause, balanced information nudges, or clearer cues that encourage reflection—to support healthier discussions. In short, understanding the “phone effect” can help create better, fairer conversations online and in daily life.

21504222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21504222.value: 強制披露對私營企業交易量的影響：來自美國銀行們的證據

21504222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21504222.value: 先前的實證研究表明，上市公司的強制性財務披露會增加其股票的交易量。然而，據我們所知，沒有关于財務披露要求對私營公司交易量影響的經驗證據，這很可能是由於缺乏私營公司的數據引起的。從理論上講，強制性財務披露對私營公司和上市公司的影響可能不同（Barth、Clinch 和 Shibano，1999 年），因為它們的披露環境不同。在我們的研究中，我們計劃研究針對私營公司的財務披露要求對其股票交易量的影響。本文中的交易量是指改變所有權結構的交易淨數量。 一方面，強制性財務披露可能會減少私人公司的交易量，因為強制性披露會暴露公司的機密信息，降低內部人員的信息優勢，降低他們交易的利潤空間，從而可能降低內部人員的交易意願。另一方面，強制性財務披露可能會增加私營公司的交易量，因為強制性披露會增加私營公司的透明度，因此可能會吸引更多潛在的外部投資者。 我們將以銀行業為背景，調查針對美國私人銀行的財務披露要求對該銀行股票交易量的影響。具體來說，我們將分析一個全新的關於美國私人銀行股東所有權的數據集，並使用雙重差分的研究設計來檢驗準外生的2006 年放鬆管制的影響，這次的放鬆管制要求合併資產總額低於 5 億美元的銀行提交不太詳細和不太頻繁的財務監管報告。我們預測，與擁有 5 億美元或更多資產的私人銀行相比，合併總資產少於 5 億美元的私人銀行在放鬆管制後交易量相對增加。此外，我們預測交易量的增加主要是由內部人員購買更多股票推動的。 我們的研究將具有多重貢獻。首先，據我們所知，這項研究將提供第一個實證證據，表明針對私營公司的強制披露如何影響其股票交易量。先前的研究只關注強制披露對上市公司的影響。其次，據我們所知，本研究將為投資者如何選擇私人公司進行投資提供第一個經驗證據。

21504722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21504722.value: 审计报告质量与信任度的关系：审计合伙人继承性文化的重要性

21504722.label: Project Objectives
21504722.value: To determine whether audit partners’ inherited culture (specifically, tendency to trust) affects audit quality. Assuming that audit partners’ inherited culture affects audit quality, determine what factors amplify and dampen this relation.
rows: To determine whether audit partners’ inherited culture (specifically, tendency to trust) affects audit quality.
Assuming that audit partners’ inherited culture affects audit quality, determine what factors amplify and dampen this relation.

21504722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21504722.value: Research in economics suggests that individual judgment and decision making depends not only on formal institutions (e.g., rules, laws, constitutions), but also on informal institutions (e.g., norms, conventions, rituals) (North 1994; Williamson 2000). The latter is often referred to as (inherited) culture and proxied using race/ethnicity (Guiso, Sapienza and Zingales 2015). Inherited culture has been shown to affect a number of decisions including work and fertility choices (Fernandez and Fogli 2009) and tendency to trust (Guiso, Sapienza, and Zingales 2009). However, the effects of inherited culture on auditing have remained unexplored due to data availability. Until recently, the identity of audit partners was disclosed in only a few countries such as Belgium, China, and Sweden. The challenge with studying the effects of inherited culture in these settings is that these countries have limited variation in cultural backgrounds. For example, most of the audit partners in China share the same cultural background. The PCAOB and the SEC have adopted rules requiring that U.S. audit firms disclose the names of engagement partners for audit reports issued on or after January 31, 2017. This disclosure mandate provides a unique opportunity to test the effects of inherited culture on audit quality due to the multi-cultural nature of the U.S. economy. Using this newly available data, I test the following hypotheses. Audit partners from more trusting countries (“trusting audit partners”) are more likely to make aggressive auditing errors (e.g., issuing a clean audit report when a modified audit report is warranted). On the other hand, audit partners from less trusting countries (“non-trusting audit partners”) are more likely to make conservative auditing errors (e.g., issuing a modified audit report when a clean audit report is warranted). This study responds to calls for research on the role of individual auditors in the audit process. DeFond and Zhang (2014, p. 304) note that “the individual auditor’s competencies are also likely to play a role in providing high quality” and they “encourage future research to consider additional individual auditor characteristics.” Hanlon, Yeung, and Zuo (2021) echo this call in a recent review of the behavioral economics literature in accounting. 在经济学中，有研究证明，个人的判断以及决策不仅仅受制于制度层面（如条例、法律、宪法等），也同样会依赖更为非正式的规则（如行为习惯、惯例、习俗等）。(North 1994; Williamson 2000) 后者通常被称之为继承性文化，其来源通常由自身的种族或民族文化角度出发。这种继承性文化被证实会对许多决策产生影响，包括工作和生育上的选择 (Fernandez and Fogli 2009)，以及对他人的信任程度 (Guiso, Sapienza, and Zingales 2009)。令人感兴趣的是，由于数据的取得较为困难，“继承性文化对审计中决策的影响”并没有能够被深入研究。一直以来，只有少数几个国家，如比利时、中国和瑞典，会公开审计合伙人的身份。要从这些国家入手研究“继承性文化对审计决策的影响”有一个明显的缺陷，即这些国家金融从业人员缺乏文化多样性。例如，中国的审计合伙人大多来源于汉文化。自2017年1月31日起，PCAOB和SEC要求美国所有审计单位公开新发布的审计报告中相关合伙人的名字。美国作为一个典型的多民族文化国家，这道新颁布的制度为研究“继承性文化对审计决策的影响”提供了一个独特的金融环境样本。通过最新的数据资料，我测试了以下假说：从高信任度国家来的审计合伙人，我们称之为“更轻信的审计合伙人”，更容易出具过于宽松的审计报告，如，当财务报表出现失实陈述时，出具“无保留意见”；从另一方面来说，从低信任度国家来的审计合伙人，我们称之为“更疑心的审计合伙人”，更容易出具过于严苛的审计报告，如，夸大财务报表中失实陈述的影响。这个研究对“呼吁研究审计个体差异对审计过程的影响”作出了回应。DeFond and Zhang (2014, p.304) 提出“审计人员的个人能力也很可能对报告品质有重要影响”，并且“鼓励未来的研究能够将更多审计人员的个人特质囊括其中”。Hanlon, Yeung, and Zuo (2021) 也在其最近的行为经济学文献综述（侧重会计学）中对此做出了回应。

21504722.label: Major findings and research outcome
21504722.value: Main Findings: Building on economic theories of cultural transmission, which emphasize the role of culture in shaping individual beliefs and preferences, we examine how audit partners’ cultural attitudes toward trust influence audit outcomes. Based on the “presumptive doubt” perspective of professional skepticism, we propose that audit partners from trusting cultures are more likely to rely on management’s assertions, while still exercising a high degree of caution and not naively trusting management. Consistent with our prediction, we find that audit partners from trusting cultures commit fewer Type I errors when issuing going concern opinions, without significantly increasing Type II errors. The reduction in Type I errors is primarily found in settings where audit partners normally tend to be more conservative, and it is attenuated when management is less trustworthy. At the same time, audit partners from trusting cultures are also associated with more within-GAAP earnings management, suggesting that increased trust entails a cost. Collectively, our findings offer new insights into how cultural trust affects the assurance of accounting information. Research Outcome: The paper is conditionally accepted at the Journal of Accoutning and Economics, a top-tier journal in accounting.

21504722.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21504722.value: The grant has led to a number of follow-on projects. For example, "Trust and SEC Investigations" with Francois Brochet (BU) and Meiling Zhao (CUHK) is currently being revised for 2nd round submission to The Accoutning Review.

21504722.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21504722.value: By documenting the nuanced effects of audit partners’ cultural trust, we contribute to an emerging literature on culture in accounting and finance (e.g., Zingales 2015), and we add to a growing body of research attempting to understand the forces that lead to inter-partner variation in audit outcomes (e.g., Lennox and Wu 2018). In doing so, our findings can help auditors become more aware of potential biases in their decision making—a critical step toward enhancing the quality of complex audit judgments (Griffith, Kadous, and Young 2021). Further, by integrating cultural perspectives into the study of audit quality, our study opens the door to future research on how such factors interact with institutional and regulatory environments.
