21506022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21506022.value: 挖掘底层供应商：来自冲突矿产披露的证据

21506022.label: Project Objectives
21506022.value: I will seek to produce causal evidence on the real effects of supply chain transparency. I will examine the effect of conflict mineral rules on the investment efficiency of the firm. I will examine how supply chain transparency, especially transparency towards low-tier suppliers can help firms weather through supply chain shocks in the era of globalization.
rows: I will seek to produce causal evidence on the real effects of supply chain transparency.
I will examine the effect of conflict mineral rules on the investment efficiency of the firm.
I will examine how supply chain transparency, especially transparency towards low-tier suppliers can help firms weather through supply chain shocks in the era of globalization.

21506022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21506022.value: A growing trend in global sourcing has created a complex network of supply chains. As a result, firms need to efficiently manage their relationships with as well as acquire information about not only their direct suppliers, but also low-tier, indirect suppliers (i.e., the suppliers of their suppliers). Although anecdotal and academic evidence suggest that indirect suppliers may significantly influence the focal buying firm (Choi & Linton, 2011; Rowley, 1997), few firms collect or provide information about their low-tier suppliers. In this proposed study, I focus on disclosure mandates that require firms to disclose information about their low-tier suppliers and examine the economic consequences of such disclosure. Specifically, I examine whether and how conflict minerals disclosure – an exogenous shock to firm’s supply chain disclosure – affects firm’s supply chain performance. Conflict minerals, the natural resources that are traded to finance armed conflicts, feed a range of global supply chains. Therefore, governments have discussed the mineral resources’ contribution to funding the conflict and the need to sever the link. To that end, the U.S. Congress enacted “conflict minerals provision” to require companies to trace the source of conflict minerals used along its supply chain and publicly disclose the suppliers at all tiers that provide conflict minerals. I argue that the conflict minerals disclosure induces managers to collect more information about the firm’s supply chain, especially about the low-tier suppliers. Such deeper level of understanding can help managers better understand potential supply risks and supply chain investments opportunities that managers would not discover otherwise. Therefore, I examine whether conflict mineral disclosure, by improving multi-tier supply chain visibility, can induce supply chain to be more resilient to supply chain disruptions. Specifically, I examine whether there is less decrease in shipment volume around supply chain disruption for firms that identified low-tier suppliers in conflict minerals report. This study has several contributions. While the existing literature on supply chain disclosure tend to focus on direct suppliers, I examine the impact of supply chain disclosure regarding lower tier suppliers, which are particularly relevant in light of the increasingly complex supply chain. This study also contributes to the literature on the real effects of mandatory CSR disclosure. Finally, my study should be of interest to regulators as it adds to the growing evidence of the benefits of CSR disclosure.

21506022.label: Realisation of objectives
21506022.value: The original research project aimed to examine the real effects of supply chain transparency regulation, with a focus on the U.S. Conflict Minerals Disclosure (CMD) rule introduced under Dodd-Frank Section 1502. The three stated objectives were: (1) to produce causal evidence on the real effects of supply chain transparency, (2) to examine the effect of CMD on firms’ investment efficiency, and (3) to assess how transparency—particularly with respect to lower-tier suppliers—can help firms manage supply chain shocks. Substantial progress was made in achieving these objectives, though the second objective was refined during the research process, as outlined below. Objective 1: Causal Evidence on the Real Effects of Supply Chain Transparency This objective has been largely achieved. Using a difference-in-differences framework centered on CMD implementation, we provide empirical evidence that mandatory supply chain disclosure significantly improves firms’ supply chain risk management. We hypothesized that the due diligence process required under CMD—particularly its emphasis on tracing upstream suppliers—would enhance firms’ ability to identify and mitigate supply chain vulnerabilities. To test this, we use a supply chain risk (SCRisk) measure using textual analysis of quarterly earnings call transcripts, following established approaches in the literature. We find that firms subject to CMD experience a statistically and economically significant reduction in SCRisk following the rule’s adoption, relative to control firms. We further distinguish between firms that file only the basic Form SD and those that also submit a more detailed Conflict Minerals Report (CMR). Firms submitting a CMR exhibit greater reductions in SCRisk, consistent with the idea that deeper engagement with CMD enhances firms’ visibility and control over supply chain risks. Objective 2: From Investment Efficiency to Operational Mechanisms Although the original proposal included an investigation of investment efficiency, we refined this objective to focus more directly on the mechanisms through which CMD improves supply chain resilience. Specifically, we examine how CMD affects supplier base diversification—a key operational strategy for mitigating risk. We find that CMD firms diversify their supplier base more extensively, both in terms of number and geographic dispersion, following implementation. Moreover, we show that CMD’s impact on SCRisk is stronger for firms with greater flexibility to diversify—such as those with international operations or more substitutable inputs. These results offer novel insight into how firms operationalize the supply chain transparency mandated by CMD. Objective 3: The Role of Transparency Toward Lower-Tier Suppliers This objective is addressed through a series of empirical tests linking natural disasters to supply chain disruptions across tiered supplier relationships. Using FactSet supply chain data and the SHELDUS database of U.S. disasters, we track firm exposure to shocks originating from tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers. We find that disruptions at tier-2 suppliers lead to significant declines in firm sales growth. However, this effect is significantly attenuated for firms subject to CMD, suggesting that enhanced visibility into lower-tier suppliers enables more effective monitoring and risk mitigation. We also analyze firms’ operational responses—specifically inventory adjustments—to these shocks. Consistent with prior studies, firms generally increase inventory (particularly raw materials and intermediate goods) in response to upstream disruptions. However, CMD firms exhibit a smaller increase in inventory following tier-2 shocks, indicating less reliance on reactive buffering and stronger upstream planning capabilities. Together, these findings underscore the critical role of multi-tier supply chain transparency in enhancing firms’ resilience to disruption and improving overall risk management practices.

21506022.label: Major findings and research outcome
21506022.value: This study investigates how mandatory supply chain disclosure—specifically the U.S. Conflict Minerals Disclosure (CMD) rule under Section 1502 of the Dodd-Frank Act—affects firms’ ability to manage supply chain risk. The central hypothesis is that requiring firms to trace and report the use of conflict minerals enhances visibility into lower-tier suppliers, thereby improving risk identification and mitigation. We document several key findings. First, using a difference-in-differences design, we find that CMD leads to a statistically and economically significant reduction in firms’ supply chain risk exposure. This reduction is more pronounced for firms that file a Conflict Minerals Report (CMR), which involves more extensive supply chain due diligence than the basic CMD filing. Second, we explore the mechanisms underlying this effect by analyzing changes in firms’ supplier base. We find that CMD firms tend to diversify their suppliers—both in terms of the number of suppliers and their geographic spread—following the rule’s adoption. Furthermore, the decline in supply chain risk is more pronounced among firms that are better positioned to diversify, such as those with international segments or more substitutable inputs. These results suggest that firms leverage enhanced supply chain visibility to proactively manage their exposure. Third, we examine how CMD influences firms’ responses to exogenous supply chain shocks. Linking firm outcomes to natural disasters affecting tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers, we find that CMD firms are less negatively affected by disruptions at tier-2 suppliers. Specifically, CMD firms experience smaller declines in sales growth and exhibit less reliance on inventory stockpiling. This implies that greater visibility into upstream suppliers enables more informed and measured operational responses. Overall, the project offers causal evidence that mandatory supply chain transparency improves firms’ resilience to disruption by enhancing upstream visibility, enabling supplier diversification, and promoting more efficient operational planning.

21506022.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
21506022.value: As there are relatively few empirical studies examining multi-tier supply chain visibility, the CMD setting offers a valuable framework for exploring a broader set of questions related to supply chain transparency and corporate behavior. Our findings suggest that firms respond meaningfully to regulatory disclosure requirements, not only by complying, but also by learning and adapting their operational practices. This opens up avenues for future research on how disclosure-based regulation shapes firms’ information environments and internal decision-making processes. Building on this project, we plan to further explore the intersection between supply chain management and accounting—an emerging and inherently interdisciplinary research area. Topics such as supplier dependency, ESG risks in supply networks, and internal control design in globally dispersed operations are all promising directions for future work. For the current project, we aim to submit the draft to major academic conferences this summer to receive early feedback. Based on this feedback, we will refine the analysis and prepare the manuscript for submission to a top-tier peer-reviewed journal in accounting

21506022.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
21506022.value: This study examines whether mandatory supply chain disclosure can help firms manage supply chain risk by improving their understanding of their supply networks. Specifically, we analyze the U.S. Conflict Minerals Disclosure (CMD) rule, which requires firms to trace and report the origins of certain raw materials—often reaching down to lower-tier suppliers. This extensive due diligence process enhances firms’ visibility into their broader supply chain and helps identify potential vulnerabilities. We find that firms subject to CMD experience a significant reduction in supply chain risk. This improvement appears to come from firms taking proactive steps after learning more about their supply chain vulnerabilities. For example, CMD firms tend to diversify their supplier base, spreading sourcing across more countries and vendors. These firms also react differently when supply chain disruptions occur: when a natural disaster hits one of their lower-tier suppliers, CMD firms see smaller drops in sales and make fewer reactive increases to inventory. Overall, our results show that mandatory supply chain disclosure not only promotes transparency and accountability but also helps firms prepare for and respond to disruptions—making their operations more resilient in an increasingly complex global economy.

21602822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21602822.value: “推測性聽覺虛擬環境”：評估與拓展追蹤雙耳回放的藝術可能性

21602822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21602822.value: Binaural techniques reproduce sound as heard in one’s two ears and are intended for headphone playback, giving listeners a sense of being present at the recording location. This immersive effect originally developed in 1881 for telephone transmissions of opera (Paul 2009) is created through mimicking the acoustic effects of the human head and ears. Artists have created binaural recordings since 1978 (Reed 1978, Cardiff 1991). Since 1988, virtual environments have used binaural rendering with head-orientation tracking, causing corresponding rotations of soundfields as typical in the real world (Wenzel et al 1988). Since 2016, binaural rendering with tracking has become more affordable for creatives through its adoption into Virtual Reality formats. Despite this increase in accessibility, there are few artistic works specifically for binaural playback with tracking, and even fewer where the primary objective is not merely to locate users in visual virtual environments. The proposed research expands the use of binaural sound in VR beyond imitating real-world soundfields, developing the artistic potential of “creational” Auditory Virtual Environments (Novo 2005; Rumori and Marentakis 2017), or what we propose as “speculative” AVEs. We use the term “speculative” from design to mean imagining possible futures (Dunne and Raby 2013). Semi-structured interviews with eight artists based in Hong Kong and abroad and an online survey with 20 international participants will be conducted to determine the strategies used to create their existing works with binaural techniques and their intended effect. These two primary data sources will be coded and analysed to develop the first typology of binaural audio in art, of interest to musicology and sonic art scholars. The typology will be used by the PI to produce eight artistic works, each exemplifying a “signature”strategy of each interviewee and developed towards speculative AVEs for audience evaluation through focus groups. This systematic practice-based research uses an “iterative cyclic web of practice-led research and research-led practice” (Smith and Dean 2009) to extend the PI’s previous data sonification and visualisation work within immersive audiovisual environments (Ikeshiro 2012) to create speculative soundfields that would be impossible to experience in the real world, requiring a recalibration of headphone listening practice. Concurrently, we will contextualise the practice-based research through scholarly papers and develop an online best practice guide for artists and curators for designing and presenting binaural works. We will present the research and artistic outputs in an exhibition and a public showcase aimed at a general audience. 雙耳技術再現了人類雙耳所聽到的聲音，並用雙耳式耳機回放，給聽眾一種在錄音現場的感受。這種身臨其境的效果最初是在1881年為歌劇的電話傳輸而開發的（保羅2009），是通過模仿人的頭部和雙耳的聲學效果而產生的。自1978年以來，藝術家們已經創造了雙耳錄音。（雷德 1978, 加迪夫 1991）自從1988年以來，虛擬環境使用雙耳渲染與頭部方向跟蹤，導致聲場響應的旋轉，成為了現實世界中的典型。（溫澤爾等 1988）自從2016年以來，通過虛擬現實格式，帶有追蹤功能的雙耳渲染被創意人員越來越多地採用。 儘管這種可及性增加了，但是卻很少有藝術作品專門針對與雙耳的追蹤與回放，而目標不僅僅集中在視覺虛擬環境中定位用戶的作品就更少了。這項研究計劃擴大了雙耳聲音在VR（Virtual Reality, 虛擬現實）中的使用，超越了模仿現實世界的聲場，開發了“創造性”聽覺虛擬環境的藝術潛力（諾沃 2005; 魯莫爾和莫倫塔基斯 2017），就是我們計劃提出的“推測性AVEs“（Auditory Virtual Environments，虛擬聽覺環境）。我們選擇使用設計概念中的“推測”一詞，意味著想像可能的未來 （鄧恩和雷比 2013）。我們將對8位在香港與國外的藝術家展開半結構式訪談，並且對20位國際參與者展開在線調查，以確定他們用雙耳技術創造現有作品的策略以及預期的效果。这两个主要的数据源将会被编码和分析，以發展音樂學與聲音藝術學者們感興趣的第一個雙耳音頻藝術類型學。該類型學將被首席研究員用來製作8個藝術作品，每件作品都體現了一位受訪者的“標誌性”策略，並且通過焦點小組的方式拓展觀眾對於“推測性AVEs”的評估。這項基於實踐的系統性研究使用了一種以“實踐主導研究與研究主導實踐的迭代循環網絡” （史密斯和迪恩 2009），來擴展之前首席研究員在沈浸式視聽環境中的聲波數據與可視化工作（池城 2012），創造在現實世界中不太可能經歷的推測性聲場，這需要重新校準耳機的聆聽實踐。同時，我們將把這項基於實踐的研究置與學術論文的語境中，並為藝術家與策展人發展出一個最佳在線實踐指南，以設計和展示雙耳作品。我們將在展覽中展示我們的研究與藝術成果，並面向普通觀眾進行公開展示。

21604522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21604522.value: 母親和外籍家庭傭工的語言程度和語言輸入在幼兒雙語發展中的作用

21604522.label: Project Objectives
21604522.value: Caretaker proficiency in English: To recruit 50 families with healthy first-born toddlers (aged 2;6), who hear English mainly from their mothers and/or Filipino domestic helpers in Hong Kong; to collect their demographic and sociolinguistic background information and place them into 2 groups depending on the child’s main source(s) of English input (namely, input from both Cantonese-L1 mother and Tagalog-L1 helper, input from Cantonese-L1 mother only); to assess and compare the English proficiency of the Canotnese-L1 mothers and Tagalog-L1 helpers in these families through standardized assessment tools focusing on vocabulary and verb morphology. Caretaker input in English: To document and compare the quality of English input provided by the mothers and the helpers through recording of caretaker-child interaction at child age 2;6. Child developmental outcomes in English: To assess and compare the English proficiency of the Cantonese-English bilingual children through standardized assessment tools of vocabulary and verb morphology, as well as caretaker reports at 3;0. Caretaker proficiency-caretaker input-child outcomes associations: To examine correlations between fine-grained measures among the three components (caretaker proficiency, caretaker input and child developmental outcomes in English) documented above; to identify key features of language input provided by the Cantonese/Tagalog-L1 caretakers; to discuss to what extent these features are predicted by caretaker proficiency measured at 2;6 and will predict child developmental outcomes at age 3.

21604522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21604522.value: The quality of language input has a massive impact on the child’s language development. In Hong Kong, many young children develop knowledge in English through daily interaction with their caretakers such as mothers and Filipino domestic helpers, who speak Cantonese or Tagalog as their first language (L1) and vary in their proficiency in English, their second language (L2). Existing research shows that caretakers with ‘good’ proficiency in the L2 can provide high-quality language input for young children in that language. However, the evidence has mainly come from Spanish immigrant families in the US, using composite and indirect proficiency measures. Little do we know about the input provided by caretakers whose L1s are typologically and culturally distant from English or those in multilingual contexts like Hong Kong. To fill these gaps, this study builds on the PI’s existing projects and investigates two sources of English input directed to Cantonese-English bilingual toddlers in Hong Kong: Cantonese-L1 mothers and Tagalog-L1 helpers, with English-L1 mothers as controls. In addition to general input measures such as lexical diversity and grammatical complexity, we will closely examine the verb lexicon and tense/agreement morphology in the caretakers and the children. Research has shown that verb morphology causes persistent difficulty for both adult and child Chinese-L1 learners of L2 English. With Cantonese instantiating little inflectional morphology and Tagalog rich and complex verb morphology, it is likely that these L1 characteristics will be carried over to child-directed speech and impact on the child’s development in English differently. Adopting a Time 1/Time 2 design, this study will measure caretakers’ proficiency and input quality directly and accurately through standardized tools and caretaker-child interaction tasks at child age 2.5 years (Time 1), and assess child developmental outcomes in English and Cantonese through a battery of language and cognitive tests at age 3 (Time 2). This study will advance the frontiers of bilingual acquisition research by identifying fine-grained qualitative features of language input provided by L2 caretakers with different L1s and evaluating to what extent these features are predicted by the caretakers’ proficiency and will predict the children’s developmental outcomes at age 3 with unprecedented accuracy and precision. The findings will enable parents to reach scientifically informed decisions on whether, who and how to talk to their children in a non-native language, and have important policy implications on home-based input planning and intervention in Hong Kong, mainland China and beyond. 語言輸入的質量對孩子的語言發展有巨大的影響。在香港，很多幼兒透過與母親和外籍家庭傭工（外傭）等照顧者的日常互動來學習英語。這些照顧者的母語多爲粵語或他加祿語，而英語則是她們的第二語言，熟練程度因人而異。現有研究顯示，照顧者若具有「良好」的英語能力，則可以為幼兒提供高質量的英語輸入。但是現有的證據主要來自身處美國的西班牙移民家庭，透過綜合和間接的方式來測量這些以西班牙語為母語的母親的英文程度。而且香港作爲一個多語言環境，照顧者的母語（粵語、他加祿語）在語言類型和文化上與英語相距甚遠，關於這種照顧者的語言輸入的研究則鮮有聞之。 為了填補這個研究空白，本研究建基於主要研究者以往的研究項目，考察香港粵英雙語幼兒獲得英語輸入的兩個主要的來源：以粵語為母語的母親和以他加祿語為母語的菲律賓外傭，並與英語為母語的母親對照。除了詞彙多樣性和語法複雜性等一般輸入指標外，我們還會仔細觀察照顧者和孩子的動詞詞彙以及時態和形態一致性方面的特徵。 研究顯示，中文為母語的人士學習英文時，不論成人或兒童，英語的動詞形態都會帶來特別的困難。粵語少有屈折形態，他加祿語的動詞形態則豐富而複雜，這些特徵很可能會被帶到照顧者的英語輸入中，並以不同的方式影響兒童的英語發展。 本研究將進行兩次語言數據採集 ，首先在幼兒兩歲半時透過標準化的測量工具與對話錄影，直接及準確地量度照顧者與兒童互動時的語言熟練程度和輸入質量（第一次採集），然後在兒童三歲時透過一系列語言和認知測試來評估兒童的雙語發展（第二次採集）。本研究將首次精準地識別不同母語的照顧者所提供的英語輸入中細微的特徵，評估照顧者的語言水平在多大程度上能夠預測這些特徵以及兒童三歲時的英語發展，從而大力推進雙語學習研究的前沿。研究結果將能夠讓父母在決定是否和孩子講英文及由誰和孩子講英文時作出科學明智的決定，並對香港、中國內地及世界各地的家庭語言輸入規劃和決策產生重要意義。

21604722.label: Project Objectives
21604722.value: The incumbent disappearance of small island States and the retreat of coastlines urges us to understand the legal underpinnings of sea-level rise and its implications on the established law of the sea. This project’s main objective is to further that understanding. This objective can be subdivided into the aims listed below. Advance our theoretical understanding of the law of the sea: although the modern law of the sea has been mostly codified by UNCLOS, sea-level rise urges re-assessing certain of its fundamental notions. UNCLOS’ architecture of maritime zones depends on the notion of “baseline”, because from baselines States measure the breadth of territorial seas, Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZs) and continental shelves. Under Article 121 UNCLOS, maritime zones also appertain to islands. Therefore, the notion of “island” is another premise on which UNCLOS’ maritime zones depend. Both notions are customary, binding even non-parties to UNCLOS. Sea-level rise will result both in the complete or partial submersion of island features, and in changes in the shape of coastlines and, thus, relevant baselines. UNCLOS negotiators did not appreciate the changes likely resulting from climate-change-driven sea-level rise, as they had limited understanding of such issues. Tension exists between UNCLOS’ notions of “baseline” and “islands” and the reality of rising sea levels. This project will explore re-thinking these notions owing to sea-level rise, advancing our understanding of basic concepts of law of the sea through a doctrinal lens. Baselines: baselines are the foundation of allocating maritime space under UNCLOS. According to scholars and the International Law Association’s Committee on Baselines, baselines are ambulatory. As the “baseline” is considered an established concept of international law, scholars have shown little interest in it since UNCLOS’ adoption. Sea-level rise requires re-considering this view. Because of sea-level rise, States have begun openly to contradict the understanding of baselines as ambulatory, by declaring them to be permanent. This project aims to re-visit the notion of “baseline” based on the State practice, meaning how States conduct themselves internationally, stemming from sea-level rise. The project will ascertain if the notion of “baseline” under UNCLOS has given way to a new, customary notion of “baseline”, which also requires considering whether later customary rules can override UNCLOS treaty rules. Islands: the legal definition of “islands” has been most contentious since UNCLOS’ adoption. This level of contention originates from the recognition, under Article 121 UNCLOS, that “islands” have not only a 12-nautical-mile territorial sea, but also a 200-nautical-mile EEZ. Disputes have arisen where States have claimed that maritime features were “islands” while others doubted that they met the criteria of Article 121: (i) naturally-formed, (ii) above water at high tide, (iii) capable of sustaining human habitation or an economic life of their own. Sea-level rise impacts all three criteria. Due to sea-level rise, States have conducted engineering works to fortify islands and prevent their disappearance. Unsurprisingly, States support such works as lawful in international law, which scholars have not criticised. However, the use of artificial ways to prevent island submersion seems inconsistent with UNCLOS’ requirement that islands are formed naturally. This project will analyse this question, improving our understanding of a fundamental concept of the law of the sea. Advance our understanding of the South China Sea dispute: among the most contentious issues relating to the South China Sea, one finds the practice of several States to undertake land reclamation works around small maritime features to claim their status as islands. Potential changes in the definition of “island” under international law resulting from the State’s practice to fortify existing islands may have implications for maritime features in the South China Sea. This project will explore these implications, to assess the legal foundation of existing maritime claims in the South China Sea and the impact of sea-level rise on those claims and on the arbitral award in the Philippines v. China case. This project will use other examples of coastal management as a comparison, such as fortifications by the Netherlands and other States to prevent loss of territory to the sea. Advance our understanding of Asia-Pacific State practice: beyond the South China Sea dispute, sea-level rise will impact several other States, especially archipelagic and island States, throughout the Asia-Pacific region. The focus of this project on State practice concerning coastal management will foster a deeper understanding of the legal position of interested States in the region. Although sea-level rise is a global issue, localised approaches to countering it are legally possible. These approaches could include the development of local customary rules of international law and regional co-operation. Understanding these approaches can have practical benefits. For example, it could be useful in on-going or prospective litigation (domestic and international) on sea-level rise. Understanding the practice of other States may also be useful for a State to develop its approach to negotiating common solutions to sea-level rise.

21604722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21604722.value: Rising sea levels threaten both the physical existence of several small island States and the legal existence of the fishery zones upon which they depend. Rising sea levels also threaten to erode the coastlines of continental States, thus determining the retreat of the maritime zones where those States harvested fish and extracted hydrocarbon resources. The 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) divides the sea into zones under national jurisdiction (e.g., territorial sea and Exclusive Economic Zone). These zones are measured from the baseline, which is the limit of a State’s sovereignty over land on which the extent of maritime jurisdiction depends. Normally, the baseline runs along the coast of mainland territory and islands (Article 5 UNCLOS). If the coast is deeply indented, baselines can be straight lines connecting fixed points on the coast (Article 7 UNCLOS). By changing the shape of coastlines, sea-level rise complicates the UNCLOS legal framework. UNCLOS seems to foresee this eventuality by providing for ambulatory baselines that change as the coastline changes. Yet, States have been reluctant to accept that, owing to sea-level rise, they may lose sovereign rights in maritime areas under their jurisdiction. Certain States have passed legislation to make their baselines permanent. This sea-level-rise-driven practice, which is mostly undocumented, urges us to re-think UNCLOS’ notion of “baseline”. Moreover, certain States have been fortifying existing maritime features to prevent their disappearance. The question is whether fortifications are compatible with the notion of “island” under Article 121 UNCLOS as a “naturally formed area of land”. Because of their foundational character in the law of the sea, re-thinking these notions will be a theoretical paradigm shift for the field. In practice, this project will impact the South China Sea dispute, as the maritime claims of the relevant States, including China, rest on the character of fortified maritime features as “islands”. The PI’s collaborator will be Dr. Nilüfer Oral, Co-chair of the International Law Commission’s Study Group on Sea-level Rise. The project will result in at least two journal articles and be disseminated to its intended audience in three ways: (i) a conference in Hong Kong and intended for East Asian scholars and policymakers; (ii) a workshop in Geneva during the 2025 session of the International Law Commission, intended for members of the Commission; (iii) a publicly-accessible online database on State practice (i.e., manifestation of State conduct) on sea-level rise.

21605022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21605022.value: 激勵反壟斷私人訴訟以促進寬待申請：實驗證據

21605022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21605022.value: In the field of antitrust, there are different kinds of anti-competitive behaviors. Among all these behaviors, the most severe ones are hardcore cartels (also known as cartels). Cartels are conducted secretly and hard to detect. Societies rely on two essential procedural devices to detect and combat cartels - private enforcement and leniency programs. On the one hand, private enforcement involves the victims of competition law violations bringing lawsuits against cartels. On the other hand, leniency programs provide leniency, such as full immunity or reduction of fines, to the cartel members who are the first ones to blow the whistle on their cartel to antitrust authorities. Many jurisdictions around the world are promoting private antitrust enforcement. However, currently, the dominant view is that private actions discourage leniency applications, an important source for antitrust authorities to detect and combat cartels. Such a view hinders the development of private enforcement. In a separate theoretical work, based on a game theory model created by Professor Joseph E. Harrington, I revealed that private enforcement does not always negatively impact leniency application. Further, I argued that, instead, private enforcement, when used “properly,” could serve as a tool to promote leniency application. The current project aims to offer empirical evidence to support this theoretical study. To this end, I propose a randomized control experiment on 336 eligible students. These student participants will be randomly assigned to five treatment groups and two control groups to test five hypotheses: (1) incentivizing follow-on actions resulting from leniency applications discourages leniency applications, (2) incentivizing follow-on actions that do NOT result from leniency applications promotes leniency applications, (3) incentivizing standalone actions encourages leniency applications, (4) incentivizing all victims to sue proportionally discourages leniency applications if victims do NOT always bring follow-on actions that result from leniency applications and (5) incentivizing all victims to sue proportionally promotes leniency applications if victims always bring follow-on actions that result from leniency applications. Such empirical evidence could be used to persuade lawmakers and antitrust authorities to adopt my proposal and use private antitrust enforcement as a tool to promote leniency applications. As such, societies could capture the benefits of having more private actions and leniency applications at the same time. 世界各地許多的司法管轄區都在促進反壟斷私人執法。然而，目前的主流觀點是，私人訴訟減少寬待處理的申請。但寬待申請是反壟斷執法機關發現和打擊卡特爾的重要來源。所以，上述的主流觀點防礙了私人執法的發展。在本人另一篇基於 Joseph E. Harrington 教授創建的博弈論模型的理論著作中，我揭示了私人執法並不總是會對寬待申請產生負面影響。相反，我認為如果私人執法被運用 “得宜” ，可以作為促進寬待申請的工具。而是次研究旨在提供實驗證據來支持本人先前的理論假設。為此，我建議對 336 名符合條件的學生進行隨機對照實驗。這些學生參與者將被隨機分配到五個實驗組和兩個對照組，以檢驗五個假設：(1) 激勵因寬待申請而採取的後續私人訴訟會阻礙寬待申請，(2) 激勵並非因寬待申請而導致的後續私人訴訟促進寬待申請，(3) 鼓勵獨立的私人訴訟鼓勵寬待申請，(4) 如果受害者並不總是採取寬待申請導致的後續私人訴訟，按比例激勵所有受害者起訴減少寬待申請，以及 (5) 如果受害者總是採取因寬待申請而導致的後續私人訴訟， 按比例激勵所有受害者則會促進寬待申請。這些實驗證據可以用來說服立法者和反壟斷執法機關採納本人的建議，並使用反壟斷私人執法作為促進寬待申請的工具。那樣，社會便可以同時獲得更多私人訴訟和更多寬待申請所帶來的好處。

21609122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21609122.value: 特定學科學生寫作中的語法複雜度：寫作發展、寫作質量、及語法功能描述

21609122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21609122.value: The aim of this project is to help university students improve their discipline-specific English writing in Hong Kong (HK). English is used as a medium for academic and professional communication in specialized areas in HK, for example, business, science, and education. To enhance students’ communication in these areas, HK universities often provide mandatory discipline-specific English courses for first-year undergraduate students. One major course objective is to help students build appropriate grammatical structures for effective communication with intended audiences in disciplinary communities. However, students are now linguistically more diverse than they used to be: Both local and international students have different English-learning backgrounds prior to coming to the university. Thus, it is a challenge for instructors to effectively address the learning needs of such a diverse group. This challenge has not been comprehensively tackled, although it can affect students’ academic success in specific disciplines and their professional careers in the future. To address this challenge, this project will analyze grammatical structures in a corpus of student writing to provide recommendations for effective communication in disciplinary written contexts. The student writing will be collected from four discipline-specific courses: English for Science, English for Engineering, English for Business, and English for Humanities and Social Sciences at a HK university. The four courses are designed for major disciplines, and the student writing from these courses represent important genres that students need to master for effective communication in the disciplines. For each discipline-specific context, three important aspects of English learning will be emphasized: a) Student writers: Analyzing stages of writing development for students with diverse English-learning backgrounds based on selected grammatical measures; b) Writing assessment: Exploring the relationship between grammatical measures and teachers’ judgements of writing quality; c) Writing instruction: Providing a functional description of co-occurring grammatical features and their communicative functions in good-quality student writing. Few studies have focused on how grammatical structures are related to writing development, writing quality, and functional description in discipline-specific student writing. Bridging this gap will not only contribute to existing knowledge on second language writing but will also have important impacts on discipline-specific English education in HK universities. Benefits include providing targeted instruction for students at different stages of writing development, offering teacher training for assessing writing assignments, and providing evidence-based guidelines for the development of instructional materials. The beneficiaries are stakeholders related to discipline-specific English education, including students, teachers, and program coordinators in HK universities and beyond. 本研究項目旨在幫助香港高校學生提高特定學科的英文寫作能力。英文是香港學術和專業領域中溝通的重要媒介，例如商務、科技、及教育。為提高學生在特定領域中的寫作溝通能力，香港高校通常為學生提供以學科為導向的必修英文課程。該類課程中，重要的教學目標之一是提高學生寫作中的語法使用，從而使其滿足與該學科相關的話語共同體的要求與期待。目前，香港高校的學生擁有十分多元的語言背景：無論是本地學生還是國際學生都有著不同的語言學習經歷。因此，對授課老師來講，在課堂中同時滿足多元學生群體的語言學習需求並非易事。即使該問題對學生學業和未來就業有著一定程度的影響，此問題並未被全面且有效地解決。為此，本研究項目從語法複雜度的角度出發，使用語料庫領域的研究方法來分析學生在特定學科寫作中的語法結構。本項目的語料庫基於香港某高校的四門必修英文課程，即理學英文、工程英文、商務英文、及人文社科英文。本語料庫包含該課程中的主要作業（單人完成），從而代表四類特定學科中的重要寫作文體。在本項目中，以下三方面將被著重研究。第一，基於語法測量指標，探究學生語法使用的多樣性，從而對其寫作能力的發展展開探討；第二，探索語法測量指標和寫作質量的關係，其中寫作質量量化為教師的評分；第三，在學生寫作文本中分析語法現象和解讀相關的語法功能。目前，特定學科的英文寫作分析在語法複雜度的研究中還未受到廣泛關注。因此，本課題有助於拓展該領域的實證研究並且為特定學科英文寫作提供教學建議。具體研究帶來的意義包含但不僅限於：在語法使用上為學生提供針對性的幫助；為對於特定學科寫作質量的評估提供指導建議；根據本項目中提出的相關模型進行教學材料的改進。該項目受益人包括特定學科中英文教學的利益相關者，例如學生、教師、教育項目負責人等。受益面主要以香港高校為主，並有機會拓展到其他教學環境。

21609922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21609922.value: 繪製奢侈品行業的可持續性：環境、社會和公司治理多模態話語的社會符號學分析

21609922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21609922.value: For decades, institutions, businesses, and individuals have engaged in discourse regarding their commitment to building a better world. In 2021, however, we are still a long way from achieving sustainable development. While institutions have struggled to agree on common standards and regulations, businesses have shifted their corporate discourse to focus on environmental, social, and governance themes (ESG), which reflect their efforts to preserve the planet (E), generate positive societal impact (S), and operate in compliance with economic policies (G). This shift has resulted from corporate peer pressure, increased activism and consumer engagement on social media, and growing risks for reputational damage and financial impacts on corporations. Among business sectors, the luxury sector, which has historically been associated with qualities that do not naturally align with sustainability such as overconsumption and social stratification, has worked to integrate ESG factors into corporate discourse. Although law and business scholars have pioneered studies on ESG, impact investments, and consumer sentiment towards sustainability, such research fails to satisfactorily engage with sustainability discourse. Moreover, while applied linguists account for discourse, their studies have failed to account for the shift from corporate social responsibility to ESG and have tended to focus only on the linguistic aspects of communication. However, due to advances in digital media and the increasing usage of social media, other modes of communication (such as images) have become more prominent. Therefore, a ‘multimodal’ analysis of the ways in which corporate ESG discourse is constructed is needed to properly understand the evolution of this space. Drawing upon the PI’s previous research and relevant industry experience, this proposed project investigates the corporate discourse of the world’s two largest multi-category luxury conglomerates, Kering and LVMH. The project adopts a social semiotic approach to conduct a corpus-assisted multimodal discourse analysis of multiple forms of communication: 200 webpages, 400 press releases, 20 videos, 60 reports, and 1,600 Instagram posts. The goals of the proposed project are to determine the following: how Kering and LVMH have integrated sustainability and ESG factors in both discursive and practical terms over time; what the integration of sustainability and ESG discourse entails for the luxury sector and how this discourse has transformed the concept of both luxury and sustainability in this context; how discourse about ESG issues is interdiscursively distributed across different forms of communication; and how meaning in this context is created through the co-deployment of different semiotic resources across forms of communication.

22200722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22200722.value: 基于对话推理的弱监督证据检测方法用于可解释的虚假新闻发现

22200722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22200722.value: Fake news or misinformation circulated on media outlets could seriously hurt user experience and hinder the healthy development of Internet economy. Recent years witness the explosion of fake news, which has grew to be a daunting issue in human community. Automatic fake news detection and related research have attracted increasing attention from various disciplines. However, most fake news detection methods learn latent feature representations based on neural networks, which makes them black boxes to classify a piece of news without giving any justification. This project aims to explore a principled and intelligent way for explainable fake news detection. Although interpreting machine learning models have been extensively studied, explainable fake news detection only recently received attention. Existing studies suffer from two drawbacks: (i) some systems naively select keywords or sentences as evidences to determine the veracity of news. But such evidences are not understandable for users with limited domain expertise; and (ii) the evidences for explaining fake news detection are generated via supervised learning and requires sizeable semantically annotation data, which is a daunting task especially for trending news. To tackle these fundamental challenges, in this project, we propose to develop a new explainable fake news detection framework that can effectively digest massive web data, mine the dependencies among them and automatically detect evidences for news veracity reasoning and interpretation. To handle the paucity of understandable explanations, the problem will be approached from two perspectives: (i) we enhance news storyline representation with conversation structures by mining both shallow and hidden dependencies among relevant contexts, which embed valuable signals about credibility and evidence. And (ii) text summarization techniques will be extended to detect evidences from the heterogeneous conversation utilizing graph transformer algorithm. To solve the model training issue, we will design a weak supervised learning framework capable of detect evidences from massive web data with minimal annotations, the basic idea of which is to employ the accessible coarse label (e.g., news uncertainty) to infer the evidentiality for each piece of corresponding storyline. Finally, on top of the detected evidences, we propose a new approach for reasoning news veracity and providing human-understandable explanations via sentence ordering and coherence modeling. With our rich research experience, beside the theoretical and mathematical analysis, we plan to conduct interdisciplinary research and implement the framework on some realistic applications. We will collaborate with our industrial partners such as Master Concept Limited to provide quality news dissemination. 虚假新闻或不实信息经媒体的扩散会严重损害用户体验，阻碍互联网经济的健康发展。近年来，虚假新闻的爆炸式增长已经成为人类社会的一个令人生畏的问题。虚假新闻的自动检测及其相关研究越来越受到不同学科的关注。然而，大多数虚假新闻检测方法都是利用神经网络来学习潜在特征表示，这使得它们成为了一个黑盒系统，即在不给出任何解释的情况下对新闻进行分类。 本项目旨在探索一种智能的可解释的虚假新闻发现方法。虽然可解释机器学习模型已经得到了广泛的研究，但可解释的虚假新闻发现只是最近才受到关注。现有的研究存在两个不足:(1)一部分模型简单地选择关键词或句子作为证据来判断新闻的真实性。但这些证据对于专业知识有限的用户来说是无法理解的;(2)用来解释虚假新闻的证据是通过监督学习产生的，需要大量的语义注释数据，尤其对于突发新闻来说是一个艰巨的任务。为了解决这些根本性的挑战，在本项目中，我们提出了一种新的可解释的虚假新闻检测框架，可以有效地理解海量网络数据，挖掘数据之间的潜在依赖关系，并自动检测新闻的真实性并提供解释文本。为了解决可解释数据的缺乏问题，我们将从两个角度来解决:(i)我们通过挖掘新闻的上下文信息之间的表层和潜在的依赖关系来增强新闻故事线的对话结构，这些依赖关系包含可信度和证据等有价值的信息；(ii)将文本摘要技术扩展到利用图算法从异构的对话中检测证据的方法。为了解决模型训练的问题，我们将设计一个弱监督学习框架，能够从大量的网络数据中利用最少的标注数据来挖掘证据文本，其核心思想是使用现有的粗粒度标签(如新闻不确定性)来推断新闻故事线中的每条信息是否包含关键证据。最后，基于所检测到的证据，我们提出了一种新的对新闻准确性进行推理的方法，通过对句子进行排序并结合一致性模型来获取普通用户可以理解的解释文本。 基于我们以往的相关研究经验，除了理论和数学分析，我们也计划进行跨学科研究，并在一些实际应用中验证所提出的框架。我们希望能够与业界伙伴合作并从未提供优质的新闻传播服务。

22201322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22201322.value: 基于大规模音频数据表征分析的表现性及可控性人工智能音乐创作

22201322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22201322.value: Music represents human creativity and is an essential carrier of culture. Using artificial intelligence (AI) to create music, namely, AI music creation (AMC), has become a popular and important topic because of its significant value on scientific research and society. Specifically, this topic directly addresses the problem of artificial creativity and has great potential for culture protection, media, entertainment, and the metaverse. AMC is conventionally tackled by splitting the process into composition, performance control, and audio synthesizing stages. Although many progresses have been achieved, the current methods still have limited capability to produce music works with expressive and emotive feelings, achieve harmonic organization considering timbres and sound effects in multiple tracks, and allow for flexible control of the output. This is mainly due to the fact that early stages including composition and performance control mainly work on symbolic music, which is inadequate to model complex effects such as emotion, sound effects, and timbres; Moreover, different stages are separately studied and optimized, which prevents early stages considering the overall performance to be perceived by a human. It is known that humans appreciate music in audio form. Human composers use the perception system to interactively evaluate the generated pieces in terms of expressiveness and multi-track harmony. Therefore, actually, all information is gathered during each stage of music creation. In other words, the perception ability helps the creation process. A similar framework is needed for the machines to achieve pleasant AMC. Since all factors including expressiveness, emotion, harmony, and timbre are compacted in the audio, the audio domain provides a suitable platform to perform both perception and creation. This project aims to develop a new audio-oriented framework for AMC, which can perform end-to-end joint optimization on all different factors of music. We take representation analysis as the core of the project, which indicates external characteristics of music, enables joint optimization, flexible control and recreation. Moreover, as most open-source music is in audio form, the audio-oriented AMC will benefit from large-scale learning. The research objectives of the project are: 1) collecting and releasing large-scale audio-oriented music database for AMC; 2) conducting large-scale disentangled representation learning to find out how to represent and analyse the complex external characteristics of music; 3) performing expressive and controllable multi-track AMC based on joint optimization of the representations; 4) enabling recreation on existing audio music by representation transformation, such that the music can be precisely edited. 音樂代表著人類的創造力，是文化的重要載體。利用人工智能（AI）創作音樂，即AI音樂創作，因其對科學研究和社會的重要價值而成爲熱門且重要的研究方向。具體而言，該課題旨在探究創造性人工智能的科學問題，幷在文化保護、傳媒、娛樂和元宇宙等場景具有巨大的應用潜力。 傳統上，AI音樂創作分爲作曲、表演控制和音頻合成三大階段。儘管相關研究已經取得了諸多進展，但現有方法在生成具有表現力和情感的音樂作品、多軌音色和音效聯合建模、高可控生成等方面仍有較多不足。其主要原因在于作曲和演奏控制等階段主要對符號性音樂建模，而難以表徵情感、音效和音色等複雜特性。此外，AI音樂創作的三大階段通常被獨立優化，使得作曲和表演控制難以感知到音樂的整體聲學效果。 衆所周知，人類通過聽覺系統欣賞音頻形式的音樂。在創作過程中，人類也不斷使用其聲學感知交互式評估其創作的作品在旋律、表現力、聲學等方面的特點，因而在音樂創作的所有階段，人類均可感知音樂的所有信息。人類感知的能力極大促進了音樂創作，如何實現類似的AI音樂創作框架以融合聲學感知特性，成爲一個重要研究課題。 音樂表現力、情感、和聲和音色等諸多特性均可通過音頻表達，因此，音頻有望提供AI音樂感知和創作的統一信息處理及交互模態。本項目旨在研究面向音頻的AI音樂創作框架，以對音樂生成的諸多特性進行端到端的聯合優化。本課題提出以表徵分析爲核心，研究隱空間表徵和音樂的外部特徵的關聯關係，以實現音樂生成的多特性聯合優化及靈活控制，幷可對現有音頻智能感知及編輯。由于絕大多數綫上開源音樂均爲音頻形式，本研究將使得基于大規模學習的AI音樂創作成爲可能。本項目的研究目標包括：1）收集幷發布面向大規模AI音樂創作的音頻數據庫； 2）通過大規模解耦表徵學習，探究隱空間表徵和音樂複雜外部特徵的關聯關係； 3）研究基于表徵分析的富有表現力和可控多軌AI音樂創作框架； 4)研究表徵變換方法，以通過對現有音樂音頻進行感知及再創作。

22300222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22300222.value: 銥配合物氧化水和氨氣的機理研究

22300522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22300522.value: 3D打印立體光刻的相場建模、校準和實驗設計

22300522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22300522.value: Industry 4.0 is a concept that attempts to revolutionize the way we manufacture products in factories. Through recent progresses in Internet-of-Things, cloud computing and artificial intelligence, companies can now capitalize on real-time visibility of the status and progress occurring in production, and have begun gradually transitioning towards a new manufacturing format with minimal human input and increased automation. At the centre of this paradigm shift, 3D printing technologies are expected to play a significant role. Stereolithography, as one of the earliest 3D printing technologies, builds objects in a layer-by-layer fashion by using an ultraviolet laser to solidify liquid polymer resin. Its main application lies in crafting high resolution 3D models of anatomical regions for medical training and surgery planning. However, objects created from the same design can exhibit undesirable variations in mechanical properties due to small differences in the printing environment. These variations can be minimized by combining data collection with well-placed sensors and numerical prediction of mechanical properties from calibrated mathematical models, which then guide the appropriate adjustment of the construction apparatus. We plan to provide a mathematical framework of the above strategy for stereolithography. The main goals of this proposal are to develop and calibrate some novel mathematical models, and explore sensor configurations minimizing uncertainty in the collected data to facilitate model calibration. The key ingredient for the modeling is the phase field approach that produces mathematical descriptions amenable to further theoretical and numerical analysis. Then, we tackle the problems of calibration and sensor placement with the framework of optimal experimental design. The proposed modeling and accompanying investigations can also be applied to other 3D printing technologies, and thus we envision the ideas developed here can contribute towards resolving other challenges encountered in the advent of Industry 4.0. 工業 4.0 是一個試圖徹底改變我們在工廠製造產品的方式的概念。通過物聯網、雲計算和人工智能的最新進展，工廠現在可以利用生產中出現的狀態和進展，並開始逐漸向一種最少人工投入，更高自動化的製造形式過渡。在這種範式轉變的中心，3D 打印技術有望發揮重要作用。 立體光刻作為最早的 3D 打印技術之一，通過使用紫外激光固化液態聚合物樹脂逐層構建物體。它的主要應用在於為醫療培訓和手術計劃製作解剖區域的高分辨率 3D 模型。但是，由於打印環境的微小差異，由相同設計創建的模型可能會在機械性能方面表現出不同的變化。通過將數據收集與放置良好的傳感器和來自校準的數學模型的機械性能的數值預測相結合來可以將這些變化最小化，然後指導施工設備的適當調整。 我們計劃為上述立體光刻策略提供一個數學框架。該提案的主要目標是開發和校準一些新穎的數學模型，並探索傳感器配置，以最大限度地減少收集數據中的不確定性，以促進模型校準。建模的關鍵要素是產生數學描述的相場方法可以進行進一步的理論和數值分析。然後，我們在優化實驗設計的框架下解決校準和傳感器放置問題。提議的建模和相關調查也可以應用於其他 3D 打印技術，因此我們這裡開發的想法可以有助於解決工業 4.0 到來時遇到的其他挑戰。

22614922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22614922.value: 走向反種族主義自然：亞裔澳大利亞環境文學與藝術

22614922.label: Project Objectives
22614922.value: To illustrate the relationships between land, identity, and nation, by exploring Asian Australian narratives that write against dominant myths of national landscapes and associated discourse of racial exclusion. I will pay attention to how Asian Australian storytelling puts iconic landscapes in the Australian national imaginary, including bush, land, and ocean, under a historical lens to unpack how these landscapes are racially constructed to privilege white conquest. To provide the first transnational study of Asian Australian place-making that reflects how national spaces and racial minorities are mutually transformative. I will examine the ways in which migrant labour, cultural memory, and environmental skills contribute to making culturally hybrid places that recast the land as a fluid concept. To critically challenge, and suggest a refreshing approach to, Asian Australian studies, by considering the political significance of nonhuman and multispecies imaginations. 22614922.value: 疫情演變下全球提高了對白人至上與結構不平等機制的認識，及其如何造成生態危機和種族主義。種族生態批評是批判性種族研究和環境人文學科的交匯，重在研究種族和自然兩個概念如何緊密交織，主張將自然的意義從白人的專屬擴展出來，探討自然領域如何被用來種族排斥。在這一發展中，亞裔澳大利亞生態想像尚未成為學術分析的重點。土地和地方的故事是澳大利亞表達歸屬感的有力方式，而亞洲移民和難民作為該國的局外人一直受到邊界和領土的空間政治監管，這些因素解釋了此學術研究的必要。本項目將寫出關於澳大利亞亞裔生態批評的研究專著彌補該學術空缺，為理解在國家、跨國和氣候變化背景下有關種族和地方的文化政治提供原創性見解。 土地如何塑造亞裔澳大利亞人的歸屬感，而移民故事又如何重塑土地？亞裔澳大利亞的文化表現形式中有哪些跨種族、跨文化和跨物種的倫理？非人類如何改變亞裔澳大利亞的身份政治？亞裔澳大利亞關於氣候變化和人類世的故事中出現了哪些文學和思想實驗以及另類未來？該項目將結合文本分析、視覺藝術分析和採訪的方法：1）研究亞裔澳大利亞有關“地方”的故事所營造的國家與跨國敘事，探討其對移民勞工、流散記憶、種族主義和跨種族交際的描寫；2) 發展多物種探究模式， 分析種族主義和物種歧視之間的關係； 3) 理論化亞裔澳大利關於氣候變化和另類未來的科幻文學形式； 4) 在文學研究和創意藝術之間開展創新的生態對話； 5) 撰寫兩篇研究文章，一部學術專著，一篇大眾文章，以及一個採訪研討會系列，旨在推動與大眾就人文藝術在氣候變化和促進社會包容等話題上的對話。該項目有望就亞洲和澳大利亞長期的跨國交流歷史中產生的移民物質與生態批評提供原創知識，並對亞裔澳大利亞文學藝術中紮根的反種族主義環境想像提供第一個系統研究。

22621522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22621522.value: This project stages a jointly arranged performance to premiere in Hong Kong (HK) to reframe the subjectivities of black, “non-black,” and queer contemporary anglophone South African women playwrights. It studies how those subjectivities contest geographical and cultural boundaries and intersect with HK theatrical spaces. When apartheid ended in 1994, South Africa (SA) no longer had a black-versus-white dichotomy; but to this day SA theatre remains an important form for self-representation and empowerment of women. However, despite its multiracial and ethnic contexts, SA theatrical spaces are unusefully compartmentalised into realms of black, “non-black,” and queer. The current approach is no longer effective in today’s SA: where racial, ethnic, and cultural tensions remain unstable (e.g. the social unrest in SA in 2021). Yet few have examined how these distinct realms of analysis may be mutually determining. This dynamic, which converges and diverges within female consciousness in postcolonial SA theatre, is what this project is interested in. It seeks to rebut the current framework and unfolds: (i) How female consciousnesses (black, non-black, and queer) are juxtaposed in the postcolonial theatrical space of South Africa? (ii) How do they contest with each other via new forms of performance? (iii) How does theatre contribute to forming a constituency of pluralised and contested female identities among playwrights, actresses, and audiences? The project also examines how these female subjectivities are translated into the theatrical space of Hong Kong with practice-as-research methods. Both SA and HK were released from colonial sovereignty and its legacy in the 1990s. The two places also witnessed the empowering of women through theatre in the 1970s and 1980s. By holding a pilot “South African Theatre Festival,” the project invites playwrights from SA to collaborate with local directors in HK and brings HK audiences to the forefront of synthesising postcolonial female subjectivities. In the process, the project probes the interactions among SA playwrights, HK theatrical practitioners, and audiences to excavate: (iv) What women’s subjectivities are being adapted and why? (v) What is the impact of inviting both SA and HK practitioners to perform before a local audience on reshaping their understanding of postcolonial female identities? This project is ground-breaking in staging a collaborative theatrical performance to premiere in Hong Kong in nuancing the intersectional framework of postcolonial female consciousness in SA and HK. It is a timely project that pluralises literature and the theatre and retheorises the intersections of postcolonial women’s subjectivities. It is a timely project that pluralises literature and the theatre and retheorises the intersections of postcolonial women’s subjectivities. 本項目將在香港安排一場的聯合演出，以重新構建以英語寫作的當代南非裔女性劇作家的主體性，他們當中有黑人、“非黑人”和酷兒女性。通過此項目，我們研究這些主體性如何挑戰地理和文化的界限，以及與香港舞台空間的相交。 在1994 年種族隔離結束時，黑白膚色之間的對立在南非已經不存在；但直至今天，南非的劇院仍然是當地女性自我表現和賦權的重要形式。雖然處於多種族、多民種族的大背景，南非的劇院仍然常被沒意義地劃分為黑人、“非黑人”和酷兒。當前的南非面對種族、民族和文化的緊張局勢仍然不穩定（例如 2021 年南非的社會動盪），因此現行的研究方法在今天已經不再有效。只有少數學者嘗試在這些不同領域的分析找出共通點。本項目著重研究在後殖民南非劇院中展現的女性意識的統一及分化之間的變化，試圖打破當前的框架並就以下幾個方面展開具體探究。第一、女性意識（黑人、非黑人和酷兒）如何在南非的後殖民戲劇空間存在。 第二、 他們如何通過新的表演形式相互交叉。第三、 就在劇作家、女演員和觀眾中形成的多元化和有爭議的女性身份群體上，戲劇起到什麼作用。此項目還研究這些女性主體如何以「實踐即研究」（practice-as-research）的方法轉化為香港的戲劇空間。 南非和香港都在 1990 年代擺脫了殖民主權。兩地還見證了 1970 年代和 1980 年代通過戲劇賦予婦女權力。項目開展期間，將舉辦“南非戲劇節”的試點活動，邀請南非劇作家與香港本土戲劇工作者合作，把香港觀眾帶到綜合後殖民女性主體的前沿。在此過程中，本項目會探討南非劇作家、香港戲劇從業者和觀眾之間的互動，以此挖掘女性的哪些主體性正在被改編，為什麼會被改變。就邀請南非和香港從業者在當地觀眾面前表演，對重塑他們對後殖民女性身份的理解有何影響？本項目在香港首映的合作戲劇表演方面具有開創性，旨在細化南非和香港後殖民女性意識的交叉框架。本項目的及時性還體現在其將文學和戲劇多元化，並為後殖民女性主體性的交叉點的研究提供新的理論框架。

22625322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22625322.value: 探索當代中國漢藏佛教界中的漢人僧尼的信仰

22625322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22625322.value: The past three decades have seen Han Chinese involvement in Tibetan Buddhism increase dramatically across greater China, including on the Chinese mainland. Now more accessible than ever before, the Tibetan Buddhist world – and its charismatic teachers, institutions, and teachings – have attracted ethnic Chinese audiences in the millions. The present study begins from the observation that while scholarly research on Tibetan Buddhism’s spread among the Han Chinese is steadily growing, a focus on lay religiosity has predominated to date. There have been few efforts to understand, much less ethnographically investigate, the experience of monastic practitioners who comprise a dynamic minority cohort within Tibetan Buddhism’s broader Han Chinese constituency. In tackling this important but under-researched topic, the present study zeroes in on mainland China, where prominent communities of Han Chinese monks and nuns have existed at leading Tibetan Buddhist monastic institutions from the 1990s to recent times. Owing, in large part, to these Tibetan Buddhist institutional contexts that have pedagogically accommodated Sinophone Buddhists in their midst, the extent of contemporary Han Chinese monastic participation in Tibetan Buddhism in mainland China has been significantly higher than in other global contexts where Tibetan Buddhism has taken root among non-Tibetan audiences. In view of the prominence of Han Chinese monks and nuns in the Sinophone Tibetan Buddhist landscape and the active role they have played in mediating Tibetan Buddhism for their co-ethnic lay counterparts, an investigation of Han Chinese monastic practitioners must be recognised as crucial for achieving a fuller understanding of Tibetan Buddhism’s contemporary transmission in Han Chinese society. This project will undertake an in-depth ethnographic study, supplemented by textual research, of Han Chinese monastics in the contemporary Tibetan Buddhist world inside the PRC. Not only will it survey the institutional landscape of Han Chinese monastic involvement in Tibetan Buddhism, with a focus on the key centres of Larung Gar and Yachen Gar, it will explore the role of Han Chinese monastic practitioners in the spread of Tibetan Buddhism through their teaching and institution-building activities. The mobility of Han Chinese monastic practitioners in the Sino-Tibetan Buddhist landscape will also be analysed, as will the ways in which they negotiate their religious identities and pursue different goals, ideals and agendas through their involvement in Tibetan Buddhism. The present study expects to significantly enrich understandings of the assimilation of Tibetan Buddhism in contemporary Han China and the importance of Han Chinese monastic practitioners in this process. 過去三十年裡，包括中國大陸在內的大中華地區華人對藏傳佛教的參與度急劇增加。現今，憑藉著比以往任何時候都便利的交流渠道，藏傳佛教的世界以及它具有超凡魅力的師父，寺院及教義都吸引了數百萬的華裔信眾。 目前，關於藏傳佛教在華人社會傳播的學術研究在穩步增多，但是這些研究仍然以關注居士群體為主。迄今為止，幾乎沒有針對（藏傳佛教中）漢人僧尼進行的研究，而這些僧尼在藏傳佛教廣泛的漢人信眾中是一個充滿活力的少數群體。為了探索這個重要但研究不足的領域，本研究將關注重點放在自1990年到至今的中國大陸。在此期間，一些著名的藏傳佛教寺院裡出現了比較大的漢人僧尼群體。 在很大程度上由於這些藏傳佛教寺院/學院在教學上榮納了華語佛教徒，大陸的漢族僧尼對藏傳佛教的參與程度明顯高於世界範圍內的其他地區。鑑於漢族僧尼在華語藏傳佛教界中的突出地位，以及他們在為同族同胞講解藏傳佛教方面發揮的積極作用，我們必須承認，一項針對漢族僧尼的調查研究對全面了解藏傳佛教在當代華人社會的傳播是至關重要的。 本研究將對當代藏傳佛教世界中的漢族僧尼進行深入的民族志研究，並以文本研究為輔。本研究不僅會對漢族僧尼參與藏傳佛教寺院/學院的整體情況進行調研，還將探討漢族僧尼通過他們的教學活動以及機構建設等行動在傳播藏傳佛教中的作用。本研究還將分析漢族僧尼在漢藏佛教生態中的流動性，以及他們如何通過修習藏傳佛教定義自己的宗教身份並追求不同的目標和理想。本研究有望加強對藏傳佛教在當代漢人社會的適應過程以及漢族僧尼對此過程的重要性的了解。

23500522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23500522.value: 克制在嫉妒的眼前: 他人嫉妒對放縱性消費的影響

23500522.label: Project Objectives
23500522.value: This study aims to examine the effects of being envied on indulgent consumption. Previous research on the consequences of being envied is scant (for exceptions, see Mosquera et al., 2010; Romani et al., 2016), and thus, the underlying implications of being envied on consumption decisions remain largely unknown. Hence, we aim to uncover the effects of being envied due to high versus low deservingness perceptions on individuals’ indulgent consumption decisions. Previous research on envy has highlighted different subtypes of envy— benign envy and malicious envy—corresponding to high and low levels of deservingness appraisals, respectively (Van de Ven et al., 2012). Following this distinction, we will further investigate the effects of being maliciously envied on interpersonal concerns and indulgent consumption. We particularly focus on its impact on indulgent consumption behaviors (e.g., eating indulgent chocolate cake) since such decisions for indulgent consumption are prevalent and consequential to long-term interests and well-being (e.g., health) of consumers. This research aims to investigate the underlying mechanism of how being envied affects indulgent consumption in social contexts due to the impression management motive. Specifically, we will examine how being envied with the undeserved perception damages one’s moral reputation, and resultingly, reduces indulgent consumption of an envied consumer. Prior literature has shown that the morality dimension is more important in forming a global evaluation of a person than other personality dimensions such as competence (Goodwin et al., 2014; Pagliaro et al., 2016), and consequently, people are strongly concerned about protecting their moral reputation (Engelmann et al., 2013; Pagliaro et al., 2016; Vonasch et al., 2017). Thus, we propose that, when envied individuals expect undeserving perception, those who are envied will be apprehensive about their moral reputation damage and will try to amend it. We identify that the indulgent consumption context affords an opportunity to signal one’s morality due to the conventional belief that consumption restraint means morality. Hence, envied individuals will try to recover their moral reputation by strategically displaying their restraint in the presence of envious others. By documenting the role of moral reputation in the effect of being envied, the proposed research will clearly provide the underlying mechanism of how being envied can reduce indulgent consumption. The proposed research aims to identify the boundary conditions for the effects of being envied. Particularly, the proposed research will uncover conditions under which the effects of being envied with the undeserving perception will be weakened on either (1) moral reputation concerns or (2) indulgent consumption decisions. First, if being envied with the undeserving perception no longer derogates one’s moral reputation (e.g., moral reputation safeguarded by one’s prior virtuous deed), it will not lead to a moral reputation damage, and thus, will not affect restraint of indulgent consumption. Second, only when the indulgent consumption context provides an opportunity to recover one’s morality, the proposed effects of being envied on restraint are expected. To test this, the social nature of indulgent consumption context will be tested (e.g., whether envious others are present or absent in the consumption context; or whether envious others are in-group or out-group). Additionally, for envied individuals to utilize indulgent consumption to signal their moral reputation, it is necessary for them to believe the relationship between restraining behavior and the innate morality of a person. Testing these boundary conditions will help us clearly show how being envied influences indulgent consumption decisions according to our theory based on moral reputation.
rows: This study aims to examine the effects of being envied on indulgent consumption. Previous research on the consequences of being envied is scant (for exceptions, see Mosquera et al., 2010; Romani et al., 2016), and thus, the underlying implications of being envied on consumption decisions remain largely unknown. Hence, we aim to uncover the effects of being envied due to high versus low deservingness perceptions on individuals’ indulgent consumption decisions. Previous research on envy has highlighted different subtypes of envy— benign envy and malicious envy—corresponding to high and low levels of deservingness appraisals, respectively (Van de Ven et al., 2012). Following this distinction, we will further investigate the effects of being maliciously envied on interpersonal concerns and indulgent consumption. We particularly focus on its impact on indulgent consumption behaviors (e.g., eating indulgent chocolate cake) since such decisions for indulgent consumption are prevalent and consequential to long-term interests and well-being (e.g., health) of consumers.

This research aims to investigate the underlying mechanism of how being envied affects indulgent consumption in social contexts due to the impression management motive. Specifically, we will examine how being envied with the undeserved perception damages one’s moral reputation, and resultingly, reduces indulgent consumption of an envied consumer. Prior literature has shown that the morality dimension is more important in forming a global evaluation of a person than other personality dimensions such as competence (Goodwin et al., 2014; Pagliaro et al., 2016), and consequently, people are strongly concerned about protecting their moral reputation (Engelmann et al., 2013; Pagliaro et al., 2016; Vonasch et al., 2017). Thus, we propose that, when envied individuals expect undeserving perception, those who are envied will be apprehensive about their moral reputation damage and will try to amend it. We identify that the indulgent consumption context affords an opportunity to signal one’s morality due to the conventional belief that consumption restraint means morality. Hence, envied individuals will try to recover their moral reputation by strategically displaying their restraint in the presence of envious others. By documenting the role of moral reputation in the effect of being envied, the proposed research will clearly provide the underlying mechanism of how being envied can reduce indulgent consumption.

The proposed research aims to identify the boundary conditions for the effects of being envied. Particularly, the proposed research will uncover conditions under which the effects of being envied with the undeserving perception will be weakened on either (1) moral reputation concerns or (2) indulgent consumption decisions. First, if being envied with the undeserving perception no longer derogates one’s moral reputation (e.g., moral reputation safeguarded by one’s prior virtuous deed), it will not lead to a moral reputation damage, and thus, will not affect restraint of indulgent consumption. Second, only when the indulgent consumption context provides an opportunity to recover one’s morality, the proposed effects of being envied on restraint are expected. To test this, the social nature of indulgent consumption context will be tested (e.g., whether envious others are present or absent in the consumption context; or whether envious others are in-group or out-group). Additionally, for envied individuals to utilize indulgent consumption to signal their moral reputation, it is necessary for them to believe the relationship between restraining behavior and the innate morality of a person. Testing these boundary conditions will help us clearly show how being envied influences indulgent consumption decisions according to our theory based on moral reputation.

23600722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23600722.value: 亞洲都市化中崛起的教育都市：亞洲的大學與都市之間的新關係

23600722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23600722.value: Aim: This proposed research investigates the emerging university–urban relationships in Asian cities through recent cross-border branch campus (CBC) development projects by drawing attention to the political and economic processes that drive these developments. To do so, this project aims to find out the following: 1) how and why a university is driven to open a CBC and how it chooses its CBC location; 2) how a partnership between a CBC and other stakeholders is formed to promote a speculative urban development project; and 3) how the CBCs intersect with the broader social, economic and political interests and institutions that are involved in new CBC development projects within specific urban contexts. Background: Since the 1990s, CBCs have increased rapidly. Currently, there are more than 300 international branch campuses, and most of them are concentrated in Asia. Although this notable trend has led to extensive research in the field of higher education, there have been fewer attempts in other disciplines, including urban studies, even though CBCs are often considered as transnational urban actors and mobilised for a speculative urban development project. In this regard, significant research gaps have been identified in terms of understanding the emerging university–urban nexus in Asian cities. Research tasks: This project synthesises insights drawn from the latest debates from the following three research areas: contemporary university–urban relationships, comparative urbanism and Asian urbanism. Moreover, it draws on qualitative comparative case studies of new CBCs in developing cities in Asia to achieve the project aims. Iskandar Malaysia and Guangdong in China (the Greater Bay Area) have been selected as the two case regions. This project first conceptualises how universities in developing cities have developed as multi-scalar urban actors. Then, a comparative analysis of recent CBC-led urban development projects in the two case cities will be conducted. The investigation of the two regions in different contexts is designed to maximise the impact of this project by contributing to the three research areas that are mentioned above. Significance: Synthesising the research outcomes will present the university–urban nexus as a heterogeneous process based on a particular historical and geographical context. Additionally, it will offer a more heterogeneous understanding of Asian urbanism through a more plural and situated aspect of the urbanisation process by investigating cross-border branch campuses as the emerging urban actors. It will add significant non-Western cases to the critical urban scholarship on university–urban relationships, whose works have concentrated on Western contexts. 目的： 本研究項目通過分析推動近年大學跨境分校發展計劃的政治和經濟過程，以探討在亞洲都市冒起的大學–都市關係。為此，本研究旨在回應下列問題：（1）一所大學如何及為何會開設跨境分校，以及它怎樣為跨境分校選址？（2）跨境分校和其他持分者的合作關係是怎樣建立來推動這樣的投機都市發展項目？以及，（3）跨境分校如何與更廣泛的社會、經濟和政治利益，以及在特定都市條件下牽涉在新跨境分校項目的機構交織在一起。 背景： 自九十年代以來，跨境分校快速增加。目前有逾三百所國際跨境分校，其中大部分都座落在亞洲。雖然這顯著趨勢吸引了高等教育研究的大量關注，但包括都市研究在內的其他學科領域甚少關注這現象，即使跨境分校常被視作跨國都市行動者並參與在投機都市發展項目。有見及此，對於亞洲都市的大學–都市關係的理解有重大的研究缺口。 研究任務： 本研究綜合以下三個研究領域的新近辯論的見解：當代大學–都市關係、比較都市研究、亞洲都市研究。此外，為實現研究目的，本項目利用在亞洲發展中都市的新跨境分校來進行質性比較式案例研究。馬來西亞依斯干達和中國廣東（大灣區）是兩個案例研究區域。首先，對於大學在發展中都市的跨尺度都市行動者角色，本研究將之概念化。然後，本研究對兩個案例都市裏面，由跨境分校帶動的都市發展項目進行比較研究。對這兩個不同背景的區域的調查，是為了貢獻前述的三個研究領域，並最大化本研究的影響力。 重要性： 綜合分析本研究的成果，能將大學–都市關係呈現成在特定歷史和地理背景中的異質過程。此外，通過研究跨境分校作為都市行動者的新興角色，本研究展現都市化過程的一個較為多元和在地的面向，提供關於亞洲都市化的更異質性理解。目前關於大學–都市關係的批判都市研究集中在西方實證經驗，而本項目將對此研究領域貢獻非西方的重要案例。

23601522.label: Project Objectives
23601522.value: This project has four major intellectual goals. First, it seeks to make a major contribution to the study of twentieth-century Chinese economic history and thought by recovering ‘scientific’ management as a major discursive through-line. This lacuna in the current scholarship is glaring. Despite sustained attention to individual firms’ management practices, there are no English-language monographs on the subject and just two flawed volumes in Chinese. By re-examining this history from the introduction of Taylorism through the launch of MBA programs in the 1990s, this project will forge entirely new ground in these fields. Second, this project seeks to interrogate the evolving ‘scientific’ aspirations of Chinese management in order to reframe broader historiographical debates over terms such as “socialism” and “capitalism” in modern Chinese history. Although management’s subfields often use quantitative methods, the discipline is not a natural science—as is often claimed. Instead, this project approaches the evolving discourse of ‘scientific’ management in China as a deeply historically embedded aspiration for management to become objective and empirical so as to accelerate China’s national development in “correct” and “apolitical” ways. This semi-utopian aspiration held remarkable staying power across China’s upheavals and provides a previously overlooked thread of continuity that spans these different political-economic periods. "Managing Modern China" will analyze how diverse industrialists, economists, mathematicians, engineers, educationalists, and officials first embraced this ‘science’ in the early Republican era, re-tailored this knowledge-making under the Nationalist and Mao regimes, and used “management science” in the Reform era to help reconcile capitalist labor practices with socialist ideology. In so doing, "Managing Modern China" seeks to offer an alternative narrative of China’s journey to ‘wealth and power’ focused on overlooked non-state actors. My initial research has shown that Chinese advocates of ‘scientific’ management routinely promoted these methods of maximizing control and efficiency across not only industry and education, but also diverse other areas ranging from animal husbandry to family planning. By examining these individuals and their wide-ranging activities, "Managing Modern China" will expand the boundaries of traditional business and economic history with a more human narrative of ‘scientific’ management’s impact across society. The final monograph will thus deliver a highly readable narrative of China’s modernization focused on understudied economic and intellectual leaders, not senior officials. Finally, this project also seeks to make a major contribution to the study of Chinese foreign relations—and Sino–US relations in particular—by adopting a global framing that interweaves overseas educational migrations, international management thought, and both Hong Kong and Taiwan. Japanese, German, and Soviet management models all exerted significant influence at different times and places, but American management models were the single most consistent source of influence for Chinese management over the twentieth century, only briefly supplanted by Soviet models during the First Five-Year Plan (1953-1957). Yet, rather than a narrative of great power rivalry or American contributions to China’s development, "Managing Modern China" will offer an interwoven transpacific history of Sino–US intellectual exchange and collaboration. This project’s concrete objectives include two peer-reviewed articles published in top (3* or 4*) international journals and the final book manuscript. To produce these three outputs, I will focus on 1) securing a book contract this fall with Columbia University Press, which published my first book and has now sent my proposal and sample chapter out for peer review; 2) revising and submitting in spring 2022 a piece of initial research as a first journal article; 3) continually conducting research through digital and published sources; 4) completing the necessary archival research over summers 2022, 2023, and 2024 in mainland China, Taiwan, and the United States; 5) refining and disseminating new chapter drafts through conference presentations and one additional journal article submitted in spring 2024; and 6) submitting a full manuscript draft to Columbia University Press by June 2025.

23601522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23601522.value: 該項目探討20 世紀中國“科學管理”的歷史。它從經濟史、思想史、和跨國史的不同角度，追溯“科學”管理貫穿當今中國社會的複雜歷史過程。該項目問：“科學管理”這種話語起源於哪裡，它是如何在動蕩的二十世紀中國演變和經得起考驗？ 初步研究勾勒出此項目將在未來三年發表兩篇文章和第一本現代中國管理史的英文專著，暫定名為 “Managing Modern China: A Global History”。自 1912 年清朝滅亡，外國對中國低效率、非理性和混亂的描述在中國精英中留下慘痛的烙印。在這危機和歐美科學廣泛應用下，1910 年代回流美國的學生引入“科學”管理為提升效率、紀律和秩序的方法。這種外來的評論雖然激起了一些有組織的勞工抵制，但卻廣泛影響共和時代的實業家、教育家和官員，部分原因是因為日本接受了這些想法。1949 年後，蘇聯模式已在中國聲稱於1950年代末重新發明“管理科學”和文革中追求“管理民主化”之前迅速佔據主導地位。這些變化讓 1978 年後的改革者，例如朱鎔基，更決心將“科學”管理融入到國家計劃和管理教育中，為 1990 年代中國第一個 MBA 課程奠定了基礎。 透過運用批判性和定性的歷史方法追溯從晚清到改革時期的這段歷史，此項目將把“科學”管理重新定義為中國走向“富強” 和中美關係歷史的重要時刻。在這過程，此項目將對二十世紀中國經濟史、經濟思想和對外關係的研究作出精闢的貢獻。雖然以前的學者反複關注個別公司的管理實踐，但只有少數人有更廣泛的敘述。管理現代中國將以任何語言提供最完整的分析，並進行兩項關鍵干預：強調這“科學”知識在不斷變化的政治體制中的可塑性，以及在全球框架中重新定位這段歷史。

23602622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23602622.value: 輕鐵沿線「餘」你共享：探索以社區為本廚餘管理的多重路徑

23602622.label: Project Objectives
23602622.value: To examine whether and how food waste becomes a significant contributor to Hong Kong’s longstanding waste management crisis by mapping out its diverse material flows. To investigate the diverse waste management methods that have been implemented and refined by local communities in Hong Kong’s Big Northwest. To develop an integrated framework for sustainable waste management that harnesses social mobilisation in the form of a community economy for food waste, so as to develop a more sustainable relationship between humans and waste in a rural-urban nexus of Hong Kong.
