24108522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24108522.value: 異聚乙酰輔酶A羧化酶的結構表徵

24108522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24108522.value: 乙酰輔酶A羧化酶 (ACCase) 催化脂肪酸從頭合成的第一步，這是自然界中最基本的生化途徑之一。在細菌和植物中，多亞基異聚體形式的 ACCase (htACCase) 是膜生物發生和生物體生存所必需的。細菌 htACCase 的本質及其與人類對應物的結構差異使其成為抗生素發現的絕佳選擇目標，而植物 htACCase 代表了作物分子育種以實現可持續植物油生產的主要目標。 HtACCase 屬於生物素依賴性羧化酶超家族。儘管已經對該家族的成員進行了廣泛的研究，但我們對其結構 - 功能關係的了解仍然不完整，因為它們具有極其多樣化的結構和構象變異性，儘管整體序列保守性很強。自從五十多年前在大腸桿菌中首次發現以來，由於復合物固有的不穩定性，尚未確定完整 htACCase 的結構。我們目前對 htACCase 的結構知識完全基於亞配合物的晶體結構，無法提供有關 htACCase 組裝及其詳細反應機制的信息。在這裡，我們建議通過冷凍電鏡解決這一臨床和工業上重要的蛋白質靶標，該技術非常適合高度複雜和異質樣品的結構研究。我們開發了獨特的純化和優化方案，能夠對穩定、完整的 htACCase 進行冷凍電鏡成像。該提案旨在繼續我們在高分辨率下研究 htACCase 結構並闡明其獨特的作用和調節模式。我們還將探索基於結構的策略，以潛在地針對細菌和植物 htACCase 進行抗生素發現和農業生物技術。我們的研究不僅會提供第一個結構快照，還會提供這種重要酶的複雜催化機制。該結果將對一般生物學、醫學和農業的研究產生深遠的影響。

24109922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24109922.value: 兒童魚類過敏的口服免疫療法：隨機對照臨床試驗

24109922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24109922.value: 背景：魚類過敏多在幼年出現，其中十分之一的過敏兒童會出現嚴重的過敏反應。避免致敏原和在過敏反應的情況下為緊急治療做好準備仍然是目前的護理標準。由於魚類過敏往往會持續終生，而意外攝入魚類是很常見的情況，因此魚類過敏患者和家人的生活質量會受到負面的影響。這項擬議的研究旨在通過在魚類過敏兒童的飲食中引入漸進份量的魚類致敏原，為魚類過敏患者開發一種新的治療選擇，並調查這種治療方法是否安全，可以提高他們的反應閾值並加速他們的魚過敏恢復. 目的：確定與安慰劑相比，在飲食中引入漸進份量的魚類致敏原是否能夠達到更高的魚過敏耐受度。 設計和方法：這將是一項雙臂、平行設計、雙盲、隨機對照試驗。年齡在 3-10 歲的雙盲安慰劑對照食物激發測試確認的鱈魚過敏兒童將被隨機分配到活性組或安慰劑組。兩組的參與者將定期食用鱈魚或者安慰劑，為期 52 週，之後將安排進行食物激發測試以評估他們對鱈魚的耐受水平。 預期結果：我們的發現將為魚類過敏兒童提供一種簡單、安全且廉價的治療選擇。口服免疫療法, 與標準的避免措施相反，是一種能夠將患者從魚類過敏轉向魚類耐受的免疫療法，並改變世界治療食物過敏的方向。

24110822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24110822.value: 線粒體形態、線粒體自噬和細胞骨架重塑的組合調節增強對缺血再灌注損傷的心臟保護作用

24110822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24110822.value: 背景：心血管疾病仍然是全球發病和死亡的主要原因。而在心血管疾病患者中，心肌梗塞為主要的死亡原因。儘管及時再灌注對於挽救心肌有一定的效果，但再灌注過程本身亦在稱為“缺血再灌注損傷”（IRI）的現像中導致心臟損傷和死亡。再灌注時開始後，活性氧（ROS）的升高以及心臟細胞中超載的鈣，會導致線粒體通透性過渡孔（mPTP）的開放和線粒體功能障礙，最終引起心臟細胞死亡。心臟線粒體形態、線粒體自噬和細胞骨架重塑的變化在調節 IRI 中具有相互交織的作用，但單一過程的調節尚未成功轉化為臨床預防 IRI 的靶點。這可能是由於線粒體途徑多層面特徵以及 IRI 本身的多因素性質。 假設：相對於靶向單一途徑，心臟線粒體形態學、線粒體自噬和細胞骨架重塑(MMCR) 的組合性調製可能具有更有效的防止 IRI功能。 目標/目標： (i) 闡明 MMCR 在 IR 不同階段的變化， (ii) 確認靶向介導 MMCR變化的關鍵蛋白的非編碼 RNA (ncRNA) 以作為生物標誌物 (iii) 探討在IR不同階段的MMCR組合調製中的心臟保護功效。 方法：本項研究將利用 (i) 共焦顯微鏡和電子顯微鏡以探討在 IR不同階段MMCR的變化，再以超分辨率顯微鏡，例如具有四通道多光譜的結構照明顯微鏡 (SIM) 熒光成像作為驗證，（ii）將 MMCR 的變化與循環中的生物標誌物，例如，靶向 MMCR 關鍵介質的 ncRNA 加以連貫和 (iii) 組合性調製 MMCR 以防止 IRI。 預期結果：研究結果將使我們更深入地了解 IR 過程中 MMCR 的變化，再將 MMCR 的變化與循環中的生物標誌物加以連貫以提高診斷價值，並以MMCR的組合調製構成為新型靶向 IRI 的治療方法。

24114922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24114922.value: 開發用於治療 Epstein-Barr 病毒 (EBV) 相關鼻咽癌的適體-藥物偶聯物 (ApDCs)

24114922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24114922.value: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) is an Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-associated cancer prevalent in Southeast Asia and Southern China. Our recent genomic sequencing revealed few druggable oncogenic mutations in this cancer, suggesting personalized and targeted therapies cannot be generally applicable to most NPC patients. Systemic chemotherapy remains as the major treatment modality in the management of primary, recurrent and metastatic NPC. Therefore, improvement in selective drug delivery is imperative for enhancing efficacy and lowering toxicity. Aptamers are single-stranded oligonucleotides with 3D folding and can bind to specific targets. They can serve similar role as drug-targeting antibodies by directing toxic cargoes against cell-surface proteins on tumor cells. We have exploited the unique presence of EBV infection in NPC and Cell based Systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment (Cell-SELEX) to enrich aptamers targeting to EBV-associated NPC cells. Our preliminary data shows the success in discovering Apt-2019 and Apt-1194 as NPC-targeting aptamers and they could preferentially accumulate in LMP1/EBV+ve tumors in mice models. Notably, both aptamers are readily internalized after binding to target cells. They are also G-quadraplex structures which give high serum stability. CCHC-Type Zinc Finger Nucleic Acid Binding Protein (CNBP) and metadherin (MDTH) have been identified to be the binding partners of Apt-2019 and Apt-1194 respectively. CNBP and MDTH were shown to be overexpressed in NPC cell lines, xenografts and primary NPC tissues. In this project, the internalization route of both aptamers and the oncogenic roles of CNBP and MDTH as well as their modulation by EBV infection will be elucidated. Another goal of this project is to apply the newly discovered aptamers as drug-delivery vehicles by loading them with toxic nucleotide analogues. Fluorouracil (5FU) and gemcitabine, which are the commonly used chemodrugs in NPC treatment, have been intrinsically exchanged with T or C nucleotides in our aptamers. The drug-loaded aptamers could potently suppress the viability of NPC cells. Remarkably, the effective dose of 5FU in suppressing the in vivo tumor growth in mice could be 11.5 folds less when loaded in Apt-2019 compared to free 5FU treatment. We also aim to develop another effective therapeutic strategy by conjugating aptamers with dendrimer nanoparticles. Dendrimers are cationic polymers which can complex with anti-tumor siRNAs as nanomedicine. In this study, the aptamer-directed delivery of chemodrugs and nanomedicine to NPC models will be preclinically assessed. The co-opting of therapeutics with aptamers will provide promising and invaluable treatment options with dually enhanced selectivity and toxicity to NPC. 鼻咽癌（NPC）是一種與愛潑斯坦-巴爾病毒（EBV）相關的癌症，在東南亞和中國南部流行。我們最近的基因組測序揭示了這種癌症中很少有可藥用的致癌突變，這表明個性化和靶向治療不能普遍適用於大多數 NPC 患者。全身化療仍然是治療原發性、復發性和轉移性鼻咽癌的主要治療方式。因此，改善選擇性藥物遞送對於提高療效和降低毒性至關重要。適體是具有 3D 折疊的單鏈寡核苷酸，可以與特定靶標結合。它們可以通過將有毒貨物引導至腫瘤細胞上的細胞表面蛋白來發揮與藥物靶向抗體類似的作用。我們利用 EBV 感染在 NPC 中的獨特存在和基於細胞的配體通過指數富集 (Cell-SELEX) 的系統進化來豐富靶向 EBV 相關 NPC 細胞的適體。我們的初步數據顯示成功發現 Apt-2019 和 Apt-1194 作為 NPC 靶向適體，它們可以優先積聚在小鼠模型的 LMP1/EBV+ve 腫瘤中。值得注意的是，兩種適體在與靶細胞結合後很容易內化。它們也是 G-quadraplex 結構，可提供高血清穩定性。 CCHC 型鋅指核酸結合蛋白 (CNBP) 和間黏著蛋白 (MDTH) 已被確定分別是 Apt-2019 和 Apt-1194 的結合夥伴。 CNBP 和 MDTH 在 NPC 細胞系、異種移植瘤和原代 NPC 組織中過表達。在這個項目中，將闡明兩種適體的內化途徑和 CNBP 和 MDTH 的致癌作用以及它們對 EBV 感染的調節。該項目的另一個目標是通過裝載有毒核苷酸類似物，將新發現的適體用作藥物遞送載體。氟尿嘧啶 (5FU) 和吉西他濱 (gemcitabine)是 NPC 治療中常用的化學藥物，已在我們的適體中與 T 或 C 核苷酸進行了內在交換。載藥適體可以有效抑制NPC細胞的活力。值得注意的是，與free-5FU 治療相比，在 Apt-2019 中加載 5FU 在抑制小鼠體內腫瘤生長方面的有效劑量可以少 11.5 倍。我們還旨在通過將適體與樹枝狀大分子 (dendrimer) 納米粒子結合來開發另一種有效的治療策略。樹枝狀大分子是陽離子聚合物，可以與抗腫瘤 siRNA 複合作為納米藥物。在這項研究中，將在臨床前評估適體定向遞送化學藥物和納米藥物到 NPC 模型。治療劑與適配體聯合使用將對治療 NPC 具有雙重增強的選擇性和毒性。

24121522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24121522.value: 一項雙盲隨機對照實驗 - 以預防性鉗夾減低新式口服抗凝血藥使用者於進行大腸鏡瘜肉切除術後的出血風險

24121522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24121522.value: Colorectal cancer is the commonest but preventable cancer in Hong Kong. The current territory-wide colorectal cancer screening programme excludes high-risk patients, especially antithrombotic users due to high bleeding risk after colonoscopy and polyp resection. With increasing prevalence of cardiovascular conditions, the associated higher colorectal cancer risk and the rapidly rising prescription of direct oral anticoagulants in our aging population, there is an urgent unmet need to develop a novel strategy to improve the screening uptake rate. Evidence is lacking to support the use of prophylactic clipping and therapeutic drug level monitoring in patients on direct oral anticoagulants. Our observational study showed a significant risk reduction of bleeding after clip application. A prospective randomized trial is warranted to further investigate the clinical efficacy of this practice in the high-risk patient population. Also, the role of drug level monitoring in the peri-procedural period should be explored. The proposed project consists of two parallel parts including a clinical trial and a laboratory-based analysis. The first part (clinical trial) is a parallel group, double blinded randomized controlled trial to investigate the effect of prophylactic clip application after colonoscopy and polyp resection, to reduce the post-procedural bleeding in subjects using direct oral anticoagulants. Eligible subjects will receive usual preparation before procedure and standardized method for polyp resection. They will be randomized to receive either prophylactic clipping or none for each resection site. Treatment arm allocation will be blinded to non-endoscopist doctors and data analysts. Subjects will be closely followed up to 30 days after procedure for any significant bleeding as the primary endpoint. Urgent interventions will be offered in case of significant bleeding. The second part (laboratory-based analysis) is a prospective observational study in parallel with the clinical trial. It involves the analysis of the subjects’ drug levels of direct oral anticoagulants, to correlate with the risk of bleeding complications. Drug level measurements will be performed at different time points (baseline, the day before procedure, same day of procedure). The serial drug levels will be correlated to any intra-procedural or post-procedural bleeding complications. This industry-independent randomized trial, regardless of the outcome, will be the first of its kind to address a major unmet clinical need in a high-risk population who are being deprived of the opportunity to screen for this preventable cancer. This important clinical question is unlikely to be a priority of pharmaceutical or endoscopic device companies. We aim to provide a definitive solution by the proposed project. 隨著香港人口老化，新式口服抗凝血藥的使用者正在增加，其相關的大腸瘜肉和腫瘤的風險也大大增加。服用抗凝血藥的病人，於進行大腸鏡瘜肉切除術後，有較高風險出現出血的情況。我們有著迫切的需要去研發一種新的策略，以改善大腸鏡篩查計劃。我們認為有必要進行一項前瞻性研究，以驗証於進行大腸鏡瘜肉切除術後，有關預防性鉗夾和藥物水平監測以減低出血風險的效果。 該研究項目是由兩個部分組成，包括臨床實驗和實驗室分析。第一部分（臨床實驗）是一項平行、雙盲、隨機對照實驗，旨在研究於進行大腸鏡瘜肉切除術後預防性鉗夾的效果，以減少新式口服抗凝血藥的使用者的術後出血。第二部分（實驗室分析）是與第一部分同步進行。我們會抽血檢查受試者的抗凝血藥物水平，並分析它與出血併發症的風險關聯。 我們希望透過這項研究，尤其針對服用口服抗凝血藥的高危群組，以完善本地及國際的大腸癌篩查計劃。

24121622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24121622.value: 長鏈非編碼RNA H19在骨關節炎中調節軟骨下骨重塑以及骨細胞機械反應的研究

24121622.label: Project Objectives
24121622.value: Reasons for undertaking the project: Osteoarthritis is a prevalent aging-related disease and the leading cause of disability [1]. Over 50% of the population over 55 years old had osteoarthritis [2], and with an increasing life expectancy in the world a greater number of people will be affected by this musculoskeletal problem [3]. Despite its high prevalence, however, little is known about the pathogenesis of OA and this is no available cure for OA. Cartilage degeneration and subchondral bone changes are established hallmark of OA, but the causal mechanisms driving the initial structural and composition changes in these two tissues remains controversy [4]. Subchondral bone changes in OA occur in distinct patterns and its dynamic remodeling is largely dependent on the stage of disease, an increase in the thickness, volume and stiffness in the subchondral bone can impact the stress distribution at the overlying articular cartilage that adversely affected chondrocyte function and contributed to cartilage matrix loss [5]. Hence, a better understanding of the pathological processes of aberrant subchondral bone remodeling can provide a rationale framework for developing novel therapeutic interventions that have the potential to modify the natural history of OA. The key issues and/or problems being addressed: The alterations in the architecture and properties of the bone are mediated by bone cells through active cellular processes of modeling and remodeling [6]. According to the Wolff’s hypothesis, the cell-mediated process will adapt the bone to local mechanical influences, and increased in bone mass reflect a relative increase in the local loading history of OA. Osteocytes, descendent of osteoblasts that exist in bone tissue and surrounded by bone matrix secreted by themselves, are critical mechanosensing cells and orchestrate bone resorption and formation [7]. If the mechanical points at which osteocytes respond to cartilage degradation can be identified, these cells may emerge as a potential target of new therapies to prevent or treat OA. Two recent studies demonstrated abnormal osteocytes activity in OA subchondral bone changes which might be novel therapeutic option for OA. However, how do osteocytes contribute to abnormal subchondral bone changes and eventually cartilage degradation is largely unknown. LncRNA is a type of non-coding RNA with a length of more than 200 nucleotides without protein coding function [8]. LncRNA is increasingly acknowledged to be involved in the regulation of the physiologic and pathologic processes of OA joints, such as articular cartilage [9-11], synovium [12, 13]. Among, lncRNA H19 has been suggested to regulate multiple differentiation processes of the musculoskeletal system [14]. Emerging evidence has shown that lncRNA H19 is also closely related to the development and progression of OA (Refer to Research Context below). Despite there are attempts to dissect the molecular function of H19 on chondrogenic differentiation at cellular level, several key research questions regarding the role of H19 in OA from clinical perspective remain unexplored. What is the association between H19 level and OA clinical symptoms such as cartilage degradation, subchondral bone alteration and mechanical alignment? What is the spatial and temporal expression pattern of H19 during OA progression? What is the role of H19 in abnormal subchondral bone changes in OA? Could treatment targeting H19 or its downstream genes/proteins ameliorate subchondral bone changes and OA severity? Hypothesis and objectives: In this proposal, with supported by our preliminary data, we hypothesize that the elevated H19 expression in OA osteocytes is associated with osteocytes dysfunction and aggravate abnormal subchondral bone remodeling upon mechanical stimulation. The planned investigations in this proposal are: (i) Investigate the expression pattern of H19 in human surgical OA tissue samples and surgically-induced OA mouse samples, and determine its association with OA and osteocytes related functional parameters. (ii) Investigate the role of H19 in OA progression and subchondral bone changes using osteocyte-specific H19 knockout mice. (iii) Identify H19-mediated differentially expressed genes in osteocytes and conduct a proof-of-concept animal study to explore if knocking down H19 in osteocytes could ameliorate subchondral bone changes and even cartilage degradation. Possible outcomes of the research project: This proposed study will fill current knowledge gap in the OA research field. It will address a fundamental biological question whether upregulated H19 expression in OA subchondral bone osteocytes is associated with OA progression. Furthermore, the findings will provide insight on how mechanical loading affects H19 and its downstream genes expression in osteocytes. Targeting H19 in osteocytes may become a new therapeutic option to treat OA.

24121622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24121622.value: 骨關節炎（OA）是一種關節退行性疾病，其特徵是軟骨損傷和軟骨下骨重塑。時至今日，OA的發病機制仍存在爭議。因為缺少對OA的有效治療手段，許多OA患者只能在疾病的終末期接受全關節置換術。因此，臨床工作中迫切需要一種新的、有效的治療手段來預防 OA 進展。 OA進展過程中軟骨下骨的變化是否先於軟骨退化一直存有爭議。大量的研究證據表明關節機械力學異常會導致軟骨下骨重塑，並在OA發病早期起到重要作用。因此，靶向干擾軟骨下骨重塑，進而改善關節軟骨上不均勻的應力分佈，可以作為一項針對OA的治療策略。然而，骨細胞作為骨組織中主要的機械感應細胞，其在OA進展中的作用是依舊未知。據既往研究報導，長鏈非編碼 RNA (lncRNA) H19與 OA 進展密切相關，並可參與細胞機械力學信號轉導。 我們前期的研究表明，在接受膝關節置換術OA患者的關節軟骨下骨組織中lncRNA H19的表達水平增高。同時，在小鼠 OA 模型中也進一步證實了此結果。因此，我們假設 OA軟骨下骨中骨細胞H19表達升高會導致骨細胞機械反應異常，進而促進重軟骨下骨的異常重塑。 本項目的計劃研究方案：(i) 研究lncRNA H19在OA患者以及OA小鼠軟骨下骨中表達分佈，進而確定其表達水平與組織中骨細胞相關功能的相關性。(ii)使用骨細胞H19特敲小鼠，研究H19在OA 進展和軟骨下骨重塑中的作用。(iii) 鑒定骨細胞中 H19調節差異基因表達，並且概念驗證在OA動物模型中敲除骨細胞中H19的表達是否可以改善軟骨下骨重塑以及關節軟骨退變。 本研究將闡明在OA進展過程中，骨細胞中的lncRNA H19是否是維持軟骨下骨重塑和軟骨退變的重要調節因子。而此研究結果將豐富我們對OA病理發展的理解。並且進一步提出骨細胞結構和功能的異常可以作為OA治療的新靶點。

24121922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24121922.value: 組蛋白低乙醯化介導的CD9表達抑制及其調控兒童急性髓系白血病細胞分化阻滯和免疫逃逸的全新機制研究

24121922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24121922.value: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a genetically heterogeneous hematologic malignancy characterized by uncontrolled proliferation of progenitor cells accompanied by impaired differentiation. Despite intensive treatment, the clinical outcomes remain poor, underscoring the need to decipher the underlying pathology and implement therapeutic interventions. Emerging evidence suggest AML could evolve machineries to evade immunotherapies. Here, we present a new and unique mechanism intertwining differentiation arrest and immune escape in the context of pediatric AML. We found that CD9 was absent in two-thirds of patients where low expression correlated with a dismal survival. At the CD9 locus, we observed low occupancies by acetylated histones, thereby suppressing its transcription but reversible by the HDAC inhibitor panobinostat. Overexpression of CD9 not only inhibited myeloblast proliferation, but also blocked their dissemination in NOD/SCID mice. Mechanistically, transcriptome profiling of pediatric AML samples revealed decreased stemness and increased monocyte gene signatures in CD9+ cases. Concordantly, we detected a profound upregulation of CD9 in monocyte/macrophage-like AML differentiation cultures. Further, single-cell RNA-seq revealed a significant enrichment of genes functioning in the antigen presentation pathway. In connection, the gain of CD9 promoted basal and cytokine-induced MHC expression potentially through the JAK/STAT axis. Inter-patient comparisons also revealed a higher MHC expression in CD9+ AML. Interestingly, CD9 physically bound to MHC and formed an immune complex. In humanized NSG mice, co-transplantation of allogeneic PBMCs mounted an effective immunity against CD9+ but not CD9- AML, concomitant with a robust infiltration of cytotoxic T cells. These encouraging findings lead us to propose the present study aiming to deconvolute the functional, mechanistic and therapeutic relevance of CD9 in pediatric AML. The specific aims are: (1) to consolidate the its tumor suppressive function by performing loss-of-function experiments in AML cell lines and samples, and provide definitive evidence linking CD9 to maturation of leukemic blasts; (2) to identify the immune-related mechanisms underlying CD9-mediated suppression of AML by analyzing the impact of JAK-STAT axis on MHC regulation, activation/inhibition status of T cells in patient specimens, followed by functional experiments of T cell co-cultures and evaluation in immunocompetent and immune-reconstituted animal models; and (3) to determine the therapeutic potential of CD9 derepression by assessing a combinatorial therapy comprising panobinostat priming and T cell infusion in patient-derived xenografts of refractory AML. By completing this study, we will be able to identify epigenetic silencing of CD9 as a novel pathogenic mechanism driving leukemia progression, and offer new approaches to combat high-risk pediatric AML. 急性髓系白血病（AML） 是一組具有高度遺傳異質性的血液系統惡性腫瘤，其特徵是髓系祖細胞克隆性惡性增殖以及終末分化阻滯。雖然目前針對AML患者採取了強化治療方案，但是臨床預後仍然不甚理想。因此，更加深入地探究AML的潛在發病機理並基於此研發新的治療方案迫在眉睫。大量研究發現AML腫瘤細胞可以進化出針對T細胞免疫監控的逃逸機制，從而影響免疫療法的臨床效果。基於此，我們探索並揭示了一種能夠調控兒童AML分化阻滯和免疫逃逸的全新機制。 我們發現在三分之二的AML樣本中CD9低表達，同時CD9的低表達與臨床的預後不良密切相關。進一步研究發現，組蛋白在CD9基因各區域呈現低乙醯化水平，進而抑制CD9的轉錄活性。此外，組蛋白去乙醯基轉移酶(HDAC)抑制劑Panobinostat可以逆轉該現象，有效增強CD9的轉錄及表達。此外，我們發現過表達CD9能夠抑制AML細胞體外增殖能力和在NOD/SCID小鼠體內的腫瘤發展。兒童AML樣本的全轉錄組測序結果顯示CD9陽性的樣本呈現更多單核細胞相關基因的富集以及幹細胞相關基因的匱乏。同時，我們在AML單核-巨噬細胞發育分化過程中檢測到CD9的表達得到顯著上調。此外，小鼠骨髓細胞的單細胞轉錄組測序結果顯示CD9陽性的細胞中抗原提呈通路相關基因表達顯著增強。進一步研究發現，CD9能夠通過JAK-STAT通路增強MHC的基礎表達以及細胞因子刺激下的誘導性表達。AML樣本蛋白表達分析也證實了CD9陽性病人呈現更高的MHC表達水準。更有趣的是，我們發現CD9蛋白能夠結合MHC並形成免疫複合物。在人源化的NSG小鼠中，同種異體移植PBMC能夠有效遏制CD9陽性的AML發展，而對CD9陰性的AML療效不佳。同時，植入CD9陽性AML的小鼠也呈現更強的細胞毒性T細胞的組織浸潤能力。 基於上述重大發現，我們將進一步開展研究，旨在探索CD9在兒童AML中的功能作用、機制研究以及潛在治療價值。具體的目標有：（1）通過在AML細胞系和臨床樣本中開展功能缺失實驗，進一步證實CD9的抑癌功能，並提供CD9調控細胞分化的決定性證據；（2）通過分析JAK-STAT通路對MHC表達的調控作用、探究病人樣本中T細胞的活化或抑制狀態、開展體外T細胞與癌細胞共培養實驗和建立免疫健全或免疫重建等多種小鼠模型，進而探究CD9介導的抑癌功能的免疫相關作用機制；（3）通過構建復發性AML的人源腫瘤異種模型，評估聯合應用小分子抑制劑Panobinostat上調CD9表達的表觀遺傳療法結合T細胞移植的免疫療法的臨床可能性。通過本研究，我們將揭示CD9表觀沉默在白血病發生發展進程中的關鍵作用，並為高危兒童AML的治療提供新策略和新希望。

24213522.value: 三維高解像度頸部脊髓擴散張量影像技術的開發

24213522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24213522.value: 在過去的二十年，快速磁力共振成像技術的持續技發展推動了擴散張量影像的應用，開啟了以非侵入方式來探測大腦白質的潛在資訊。擴散張量影像的成功也同時引起了探索大腦以外的應用其可能性，一些初步的研究給予了在頸部脊髓擴散張量影像應用的鼓勵性結果，例如比傳統磁力共振影像可更好地評估脊髓病的嚴重程度和預後。這都是擴散張量影像其應用的合理推廣，因為脊髓的結構在解剖學和組織學上和大腦白質很相似，以及它也是透過密集排列的纖維來傳達重要的神經功能。 然而，頸部脊髓擴散張量影像在技術上是頗具挑戰性的，因為頸部脊髓是很細小和延長的白質纖維束，成像需要足夠的影像解像度和高效率的切面覆蓋方式。常規的擴散張量影像僅使用二維單次激發面迴波成像技術，它只能提供有限的影像解像度和幾何準確度，因此並不是達到頸部脊髓擴散張量影像的理想技術。雖然有些高階二維擴散張量影像技術已經在臨床磁力共振儀器上商品化，但每項技術只能夠解決頸部脊髓擴散張量影像的某部分困難，而且只有少數的技術是為了頸部脊髓擴散張量影像而定制的。 因此，本研究計劃的目標是開發一個高階高解像度的頸部脊髓擴散張量影像技術來克服在常規檢查下所面對的挑戰。首先，我們將會整合縮小視野技術和先前已開發的 3D-MUSER 擴散張量影像技術，並加上自我參考的假影修正法，來開發一個三維頸部脊髓擴散張量影像技術能同時改善解像度、幾何準確度和掃描覆蓋。然後，我們將會針對提出的三維頸部脊髓擴散張量影像技術，開發對應的資料重建方法，包括採用幾個不同的高階相位修正方法以及心臟門控再排列方法來有效地減少假影，以達到同時減少由於心跳脈動、硬體缺陷和資料不一致所造成的假影。最後，我們將計估利用新開發的三維頸部脊髓擴散張量影像技術所得到的各種擴散張量影像的量化生物標記，並優化掃描參數和使用深度學習方法來進一步改善掃描效率。成功完成本研究計劃將會開啟一個高解像度和高品質的頸部脊髓擴散張量影像技術，可改善頸部脊髓擴散張量影像在常規放射學檢查的採用。此外，初步的評估實驗也將會提供寶貴的資訊，能作為頸部脊髓擴散張量影像標準化的參考依據和幫助擴大其納入臨床評估的可能性。

24220422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24220422.value: 金屬3D列印監控系統研發

24220422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24220422.value: 此項目旨在對金屬3D列印監控進行系統研發。 質量對任何工業部件來說都是重中之重。 對3D列印這一製造工藝來說, 最理想的質量監控方法是在列印過程當中，透過對每層打印面的檢測去完成 – 當發現列印參數有偏離，即時改錯修正; 發現部件出現缺陷， 即時彌補修復。 如今工業以及學術界所採用的3D列印監控技術仍有大量進步空間。 即使最前沿的3D列印設備， 也只是使用工業相機或光電二極管作為傳感器，對打印面和溶池進行監測。將現有傳感器並湊到設備裏去， 效果往往不盡人意。因為儘管傳感器本身功能強大， 但若果與設備整合不到位，也是事倍功半。我們研究組認為，當下監控技術其中最大樽頸位之一就是不能實現即時放大/ 縮小成像視野。質量監控包涵了監測與管控兩個層面。而兩者關係為先監測，後管控 – 只有測到好的數據，才能做出好的分析。 所以， 若果監測技術不到位，遑論管控，遑論改錯修復。 我們打算開展對傳感器製造的研究，通過實現即時放大/ 縮小成像視野， 去推進3D列印質量監控技術。有別於一般相機的成像技巧， 我們會利用激光自混合干涉這一物理現象去開發一款新穎的、專為3D列印設備而打造的傳感器原型。 此項目旨在透過改革監控技術從而推進3D列印工藝發展。有效的監控能確保列印質量。質量高，次品少，列印成本自然下降。這發展將有助醫療和航空航天等消費以及工業部件的批量生產。

24302422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24302422.value: 基於統計視角的判別性特徵識別

24302422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24302422.value: 深度學習模型在實際應用中的成功對許多工程和科學領域產生了深遠的影響。然而，深度學習的日益突出也凸顯了其黑盒性質的可解釋性問題。這個擬議的研究項目將開發一個靈活的數據自適應判別特徵定位框架，以幫助解釋輸入特徵和預測結果之間的決策。 在此基礎上，我們將引入定位算子作為數據自適應特徵篩選，以調整特徵的重要性權重。或者，它傾向於增強具有大權重的判別特徵，並通過分配小權重或零權重來消除冗餘或噪聲特徵。然後，將對細化的特徵進行下游學習算子，以評估預測性能的潛在改進。此外，圖像分割可以以半監督的方式參與所提出的框架。具體來說，基於像素級標記數據的分割算子通過所提出的框架得到增強，該框架利用從僅具有圖像級標籤的弱監督或無監督數據中提取的信息。該框架將進一步擴展到其他數據結構，以實現更實質性的醫療應用，包括基於 ECG 序列數據和新型序列到序列神經網絡的心房顫動診斷。為此，將研究所提出框架的理論預測和選擇一致性，以及其擴展在半監督圖像分割中的理論優勢。此外，我們還將新框架與現有最先進的深度學習模型相結合，開發 R 和 Python 軟件，並使用最新的基準圖像數據集對其進行評估。 總而言之，擬議的研究將提供一個靈活的框架來定位判別特徵，這使人類視覺直覺能夠提高黑盒模型預測的信任度、透明度和置信度。

24302822.value: 檢驗拓撲超導體中自旋三重態配對的對稱性

24302822.label: Project Objectives
24302822.value: Preparing high-quality thin film specimens of likely topological superconductors. We will synthesize thin film samples of materials of interest to provide the raw materials for the study. As many of the materials have hitherto only been studied in form of bulk crystals, our effort exploring thin film growth methods expands the knowledge of material synthesis and opens up new possibilities for the scientific community. Fabricating nanodevices from the thin film materials. Rings and SQUID devices with critical dimensions of 10 - 100 nm shall be made for studying the flux quantization. Conducting phase-sensitive experiments in superconducting ring devices. We shall identify half-quantum flux from the Little-Parks experiment. The presence of half-integer or integer quantization identifies the triplet and singlet pairing state respectively. Conducting the singlet-triplet SQUID experiment for identifying the odd-parity symmetry of the triplet pairing state. Such a SQUID device comprises of a triplet-pairing topological superconductor with opposing crystalline facets connected by a singlet-pairing conventional superconductor. Half-quantum flux observed in the SQUID device will be a smoking-gun evidence for odd-parity symmetry of spin-triplet pairing states.

24302822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24302822.value: As the classical computers reaching their physical limits in terms of the miniature circuit dimensions, topological quantum computing emerges as a promising technology of the future. The foundation of this roadmap is a novel class of materials known as topological superconductors, where the interplay between superconductivity and topology gives rise to Majorana fermions with non-abelian statistics, critical for realizing fault-tolerant quantum computing. The topological superconductors are found to be intimately connected with spin-triplet pairing, i.e., two electrons forming a Cooper pair with spin 1. Triplet pairing states are very rare in superconductivity, very much sought after, but challenging to identify. Some superconductors have been proposed to be topological and await unequivocal identification of their pairing symmetry. Our earlier experiment shows that the magnetic flux quantization, one of the defining characteristics of a superconductor, can serve as a decisive phase-sensitive method to distinguish triplet-pairing superconductors from the most common spin-singlet superconductors. A superconducting ring with triplet pairing demonstrates half-integer flux quantization, i.e., half flux quanta with fractional quantum numbers of 1/2, 3/2, 5/2, etc. instead of integer numbers of 0, 1, 2, etc. We propose experimental studies to systematically investigate promising candidate materials of topological superconductors. We will fabricate thin film materials and pattern nanoring devices for the phase-sensitive experiment to determine the superconducting pairing symmetry. We shall measure the flux quantization via the Little-Parks experiment and identify half-quantum flux as the signature for spin-triplet pairing. We propose also to conduct phase-sensitive experiment employing superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) comprising of singlet and triplet superconductors to provide direct evidences for the odd-parity symmetry of triplet pairing. The expected outcome of the proposed study includes the following: 1. a thin film material synthesizing platform for topological superconductors; 2. a portfolio of materials with topological superconductivity; 3. a phase-sensitive method as a paradigm for identifying the pairing symmetry. The proposed research is in the realm of fundamental studies of condensed matter physics. The materials explored in this study may become basic building blocks for future quantum computers.

24304222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24304222.value: 非緊流形上的里奇流存在性問題及其應用

24304222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24304222.value: 在這個項目中，PI計畫研究非緊完備流形上曲率無界時的里奇流存在性及應用。 這個項目主要包括兩大主題。第一目標是研究在Perelman能量及數里曲率接近非負時的里奇流存在問題。Perelman能量是一種幾何量，主要以log-Sobolev不等式來量度與歐幾里得空間的分別。這個項目的目標是透過里奇流優化，量化與歐幾里得空間的幾何距離。 項目的另一主題是利用里奇流研究 Yau 的猜想: 完備非緊 Kahler 有正雙全純曲率的 Kahler 流形是全純等價歐氏空間。PI會繼續研究Kahler里奇流在正曲率空間下的長/短時間存在性及利用它研究 Yau 的猜想。

24304722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24304722.value: 拓撲物態中缺陷之理論

24304722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24304722.value: Topological phases of quantum matter are new quantum materials with great potential in the fast developing quantum technology nowadays. In topological quantum matter, there are defects of various dimensions: point defect (0 dimensional), line defect (1 dimensional), membrane defect (2 dimensional) and so on. Most properties of topological quantum matter can be understood in terms of these defects. In this project, the general theory of defects will be studied. A higher dimensional defect can bear lower dimensional defects on it. We will exploit and develop the higher categorical language, which naturally describe such behaviour. In particular, we will study the topological quantum matter in three spatial dimensions and their boundary theory. The possible experimental identifications and practical applications will also be explored. 拓撲量子物態是一類新型量子材料，在現今快速發展的量子技術中有巨大的潛力。在拓撲量子物質中，存在着不同維數的缺陷：點狀缺陷（0維），綫狀缺陷（1維），面狀缺陷（2維），等等。拓撲量子物質的絶大多數性質可以藉由研究這些缺陷得到理解。本項目將研究關於這些缺陷的一般理論。一個高維數的缺陷可以在其上攜帶更低維數的缺陷。這種結構自然地由高階範疇論刻畫。我們將利用和發展這套高階範疇論的數學語言。我們會重點研究三維空間中的拓撲量子物質及其邊界理論。我們還會探索可能的實驗驗證和實際應用。

24501222.value: 過度自信的編程：演算法，感知客觀性和過度精確

24501222.label: Project Objectives
24501222.value: Test the main effect if algorithms render people to become more overprecise, a prevalent type of cognitive bias. Develop a mediation model of algorithms, perceived objectivity, and overprecision to understand the mechanism why people become more overprecise when exposed to information generated by algorithms. Resolve the mixed picture whether people trust (i.e., algorithm appreciation) or distrust (i.e., algorithm aversion) information generated from algorithms. This includes not only testing the main effect of algorithm on overprecision, but also examining different dependent variables including accuracy or/and the level of trust in algorithm.

24501222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24501222.value: 演算法在現今的機構和社會中很普遍。雖然在大眾媒體上有很多圍繞著演算法能否或是否將會取代人類管理者的討論，但現實情況是演算法將在管理者的決策中共存並支持管理者。以機械學習和人工智能為基礎的演算法有可能顯著提高管理決策的準確性和質素，但演算法中所嵌入的偏見引起公眾的擔憂及其廣泛採用的懷疑。我們亦能從演算法對人類決策的影響找到第二個重要的偏見來源：當機構不願意讓演算法擁有「最終決定權」，人類最終將負責以客觀和公正的方式整合演算法的信息，然而固有文獻並未就演算法對人類決策的潛在負面影響有充分研究。 整個研究提案將專注研究具有演算法信息的人為什麼無法做出正確決策的機制。過度精確（Overprecision）是一種常見的認知偏差形式，會導致人們在估計價值時過度自信。我將於此研究通過計算過度精確度來檢驗演算法對人們決策質素的影響，以及研究演算法導致人們做出過度精確決策的機制。人估算自己比他人客觀的過度自信（Overconfidence），即所謂的客觀性錯覺（illusion of objectivity），是演算法導致過度精確的其中一個原因。人們在從演算法中接收到信息後，會自以為自己客觀。此「虛假光環（false halo）」會令人的感知客觀性不恰當地高，從而驅使他們在決策中變得過於精確（即有偏見）。 在一系列的實驗室實驗和實地數據收集中（目前正與各間香港國際酒店的人力資源總監進行溝通，包括凱悅酒店、萬豪酒店和其他香港國際酒店，進行數據收集的討論會議，並獲取過去的績效數據）。我將會調查（一）演算法是否會導致人們過度精確化； （二）演算法引起的過度精確化是否受決策者的感知客觀性所影響。透過研究演算法對人類的偏見及其決策質量的影響，將會更深入了解人工智能和其他技術提升對機構和社會造成的影響。

24501222.label: Realisation of objectives
24501222.value: [Introduction] The project objectives were to (a) test the main effect if algorithms render people to become more overprecise, (b) develop a mediation model of algorithms, perceived objectivity, and overprecision to understand the mechanism why people become overprecise when exposed to algorithm-generated information, and (c) resolve the mixed picture whether trust or distrust in algorithm-generated information. I successfully developed a theoretical model and found results in an experimental setting and shared these results by making presentations at international conferences (e.g., presentation at the Academy of Management Annual Meeting, appearance in the proceedings of the conference, etc.). Thus, the project objectives have been successfully achieved. However, despite multiple field data collection attempts (e.g., hotel customers), I note that I was unable to find robust results. Therefore, the findings should be interpreted with caution when considering practical applications. One possible explanation of the inconsistency between experimental results and field experiment results is that field settings introduce uncontrolled variables that dilute the effect of algorithm exposure. For instance, customer decisions in hospitality environments may be influenced by prior experiences, social norms, or marketing cues that could potentially compete with algorithmic recommendations. In addition, trust in algorithms (e.g., source credibility) might be domain-specific, meaning that effects observed in experiments might not translate to service-related decisions. Ultimately, these findings underscore the importance of contextual factors in shaping the psychological impact of algorithms. Despite these limitations, the project contributes valuable insights into the psychological mechanisms underlying overprecision and algorithmic influence. [Objective 1: Testing the Main Effect Between Algorithm-Generated Information and Overprecision] Throughout multiple studies, I recruited about 3,000 participants. Participants were randomly assigned to one of the two conditions: (a) algorithm condition where participants received algorithm advice; and (b) human expert condition where participants received advice from a human expert to complete the task. Main Effect (Overprecision). Participants in the algorithm condition provided an average peak confidence of 44.19%, but this peak confidence corresponded to the actual result 12.75% of the time, resulting in an overprecision of 31.44%. Participants in the human-input condition provided an average peak confidence of 38.45%, but this peak confidence corresponded to the actual result of 15.19%, for an overprecision level of 23.19%. I predicted that participants in the algorithm condition will exhibit a higher overprecision level. The results of post hoc Tukey analyses indicate that the difference between algorithm condition and human-input condition was significant (Mean Difference=8.25, SE=2.16, p=.02). Therefore, the first objective was achieved in this experimental setting. [Objective 2 Develop a Mediation Model of Algorithms, Perceived Objectivity, and Overprecision] Perceived Objectivity. I used Armor (1998)’s 12-item perceived objectivity scale to measure participants’ perception of their own objectivity level. On a 7-point scale from 1 (not at all) to 7 (extremely), participants answered items such as, “Have a realistic view of your skills and abilities” and “Be even-handed when evaluating your personal qualities.” These items were averaged to make a composite scale (α=.85). Mediation (Perceived Objectivity). I found a significant indirect effect of algorithm advice on overprecision (SPIES), via perceived objectivity (b=1.43, SE=0.56, CI: [.45, 2.23]). The direct effect of algorithm on overprecision became nonsignificant (b=3.35, SE=1.97, t=1.70, p=.09, CI: [-.54, 7.24]), after accounting for perceived objectivity. Thus, perceived objectivity fully mediated the relationship between algorithm and overprecision. Therefore, the second objective was achieved in this experimental setting. [Objective 3 Resolve a Mixed Puzzle Between Trust and Distrust in Algorithm-Generated Information] Source Credibility. On a 7-point Likert scale, participants answered the credibility items adapted from Smith, De Houwer, & Nosek (2013), examining the extent to which the source was “trustworthy,” and “informative” (α=.89). Participants in the algorithm condition (M=5.31, SD=1.12) rated algorithms to be systematically less credible than those in the human expert condition (M=5.77, SD=.85; t=-3.26, d=-.46, p=.001, CI: [-.74, -.18]). Thus, it is confirmed from this experimental data that participants placed greater source credibility on human experts. However, 5.31 is still a high score where participants in the algorithm condition perceived the source to be moderately credible. In a separate follow-up study, I compared people’s perception of algorithm’s source credibility with their perception on humans (non-experts). I found that participants in the algorithms condition (M=5.37, SD=1.14) rated algorithms to be systematically more credible than those in the human condition (M=5.10, SD=1.07; t=-2.21, d=-.25, p=.028, CI: [-.52, -.03]). Thus, people perceived algorithm as a highly credible source but not equivalently high as human experts. This suggests that while algorithms are gaining credibility, their acceptance still lags behind human experts, even as technological progress narrows the gap. Literatures on algorithm aversion or defensiveness indicates that trust in algorithmic outputs is not yet unconditional, reflecting a psychological barrier rather than a purely technical one. Thus, this is an ongoing debate whether people trust or distrust algorithm-generated information. Therefore, the third objective was partially achieved. [Conclusion] This project advances our understanding of how algorithmic advice influences human judgment, particularly by increasing overprecision through perceived objectivity. While experimental findings strongly support the proposed mediation model, the lack of consistent results in field settings underscores the complexity of applying these insights in real-world contexts. Despite these limitations, the research offers meaningful theoretical contributions to decision-making, advice-taking, and human–algorithm interaction literature. Future research should focus on refining experimental designs to better simulate real-world decision environments and explore interventions that reduce overconfidence when interacting with algorithms. Ultimately, this work provides a foundation for designing algorithmic systems that mitigate unintended psychological biases while enhancing decision quality.

24501222.label: Major findings and research outcome
24501222.value: Throughout this project, I focused on investigating the mechanism on why people with algorithmic information ironically become incapable of making sound decisions. Specifically, I examined the impact of algorithms on people’s decision quality by measuring overprecision, a common form of cognitive bias that leads people to be overconfident when estimating a value, and the mechanism by which algorithms lead people to make overprecise decisions. One reason for algorithm-induced overprecision is people’s self-confidence in estimating themselves to be more objective than others, the so-called illusion of objectivity (Armor, 1998). I tested and found that people possess a “false halo” of objectivity after they receive information from algorithms, and their inappropriately high level of perceived objectivity drives them to become overly precise (i.e., biased) in their decision-making. I investigated whether (a) algorithms do indeed lead people to be overprecise and (b) whether algorithm-induced overprecision is mediated by decision-makers’ perceived objectivity level. Examining the effects of algorithms on people’s biases and their decision quality deepened understanding of the impact of artificial intelligence and other technological advances on organizations and society. Despite the success in finding the results in an experimental setting, the findings were not clearly detected in field data (e.g., hotel customers). Thus, the version accepted to conference presentations and appearance in proceedings only included experimental results. Since I could not find robust results from the field data collection, I am currently thinking boundary conditions to explain this inconsistency. In addition, archival data is also considered as an alternative route. I have measured overprecision using strike zones (5 seasons) and published it in one of the top tier journal. From these attempts, I wish to figure out whether the discrepancy between experimental and field results stems from contextual factors, measurement limitations, or theoretical gaps. Ultimately, my goal is to develop a more comprehensive framework that explains when and why overprecision emerges across different environments.

24501222.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
24501222.value: I proposed and shown in experimental studies that algorithmic advice exacerbates overconfidence bias in decision-making contexts. Importantly, my argument implies that the effect should extend beyond the specific decision in which algorithmic advice is provided, altering behavior in subsequent judgment tasks. Beyond simply receiving algorithm advice, I posit in this proposal that rejecting algorithm advice leads individuals to greater biasedness in one’s decision. In this project, I focus on how rejecting the objective and rational algorithm advice shape an individual’s overconfidence, the “inflated sense of confidence in the accuracy of one’s knowledge and/or cognitive estimates” (Fast et al., 2012: 250), thus affect decision quality. Overconfidence is one the most significant and robust (DeBondt & Thaler, 1995) cognitive biases in decision-making, responsible for a wide range of failures at the personal (e.g., excessive stock trading) and system (e.g., financial crisis) levels (Moore & Healy, 2008).

24501222.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
24501222.value: Algorithms are everywhere today, helping businesses and society make decisions. People often wonder if algorithms will replace human managers, but in reality, they are more likely to work alongside humans. Algorithms powered by AI can improve decision-making, but they also raise concerns about bias. Bias can come from the algorithms themselves or from how humans use them. Since humans usually have the final say, it’s important to understand how algorithms affect human judgment. My research examines why people sometimes make worse decisions after using algorithmic advice. I studied a bias called “overprecision,” a type of overconfidence where people feel overly confident about their estimates. I found that when people use algorithms, they often believe they are more objective than others—a false objectivity halo. This illusion makes them too confident and overly-precise, which limits people from making sound decisions. I tested whether algorithms cause this bias and whether it happens because people think they are more objective. Understanding these effects helps us see how AI changes human decision-making and what organizations should watch out for.

24501922.label: Project Objectives
24501922.value: First, this project will theoretically examine and empirically test whether going public decreases employee satisfaction. Second, this project will elucidate the reasons for a decline in employee satisfaction following an IPO. Third, this project will provide specific recommendations for how soon-to-be and newly public companies can maintain and enhance employee satisfaction post IPO. Fourth, this project will compare the impact of IPOs on employee satisfaction between firms in the U.S. and Hong Kong, which will have managerial implications for Hong Kong companies.

24501922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24501922.value: For most companies, going public is a key milestone of success. However, the effects of public shareholders on organizational management have not been fully explored. Recent work in stakeholder theory has called for research to consider the complexity of multiple stakeholder relationships. My proposed research will answer this call by investigating how the addition of transactional stakeholders (i.e., public shareholders) influences relational stakeholders (i.e., employees) in the context of companies’ initial public offerings (IPOs). I hypothesize that employee satisfaction decreases post IPO because employees perceive lower levels of organizational justice—including distributive justice, procedural justice, and interactional justice—during this period. Using natural language processing methods and sentiment analyses of data from Glassdoor.com and Glassdoor.com.hk, the proposed project will develop a unique method for assessing employee perception of organizational justice. In a preliminary study, I analyzed a sample of U.S. companies and found that an IPO is associated with a decrease in employee satisfaction. I also found evidence suggesting that this decrease is mediated by reductions in employees’ perceived procedural and interactional justice. The proposed project will contribute to stakeholder theory by taking a first step toward understanding the complexity of managing multiple stakeholder relationships. It will advance research methodology by providing a unique technique for analyzing data on employee reviews using natural language processing models. It will provide practical managerial suggestions for better understanding and improving employee satisfaction in companies that have recently gone public. More broadly, the proposed project will also compare how the impact of IPOs on employees may differ between firms in the U.S. and Hong Kong. Overall, the proposed project will make unique and significant contributions to stakeholder theory, content analysis methods, and the business practice of organizational management. 對於大多數公司而言，首次公開募股是標誌著成功的重要里程碑。然而，大眾股東的加入對公司管理帶來的影響卻並未得到充分研究。基於利益相關者理論 (stakeholder theory) 的近期研究提出，多個利益相關者之間的複雜關係是一個值得探討的問題。以此為出發點，本研究將探究交易型利益相關者的加入如何影響關係型利益相關者。亦即，在首次公開募股後，大眾股東的加入將對公司員工產生怎樣的影響。本研究假設員工滿意度在其公司首次公開募股之後將會降低，因為大眾股東的加入使得員工感知到的組織公平性降低，具體體現在分配公平、程序公平、互動公平三個維度。為驗證上述假設，本研究採用自然語言處理和情感分析方法對Glassdoor網站數據進行分析，從而評估員工對組織公平性的感知。研究者初步分析了美國公司的樣本，發現首次公開募股和員工滿意度降低存在相關性。初步證據還表明，員工感知的程序公平和互動公平對員工滿意度降低起到了調節作用。本研究對利益相關者理論的貢獻在於探討了多個利益相關者之間的影響作用。本研究對實證方法的貢獻在於使用自然語言處理模型對員工評價文本進行分析。本研究對管理實踐的指導意義在於為公司上市初期如何提高員工滿意度提供了參考。進一步地，本研究還將探討上述結論對於美國公司和香港公司的適用性。綜上所述，本研究將在利益相關者理論、文本分析研究方法、組織管理商業實踐三個方面作出重要貢獻。

24501922.label: Realisation of objectives
24501922.value: We have realised all four objectives in our proposal. First, we find that employee satisfaction declines post initial public offerings (IPOs). Specifically, we develop a unified stakeholder-theoretic account that reconciles normative and instrumental predictions by distinguishing relational from transactional evaluations among employees, and we empirically test whether going public decreases employee satisfaction. Using matched difference-in-differences designs on Glassdoor reviews, we find that overall employee evaluations significantly decline post-IPO. In the most conservative estimation, overall ratings drop by 0.08 points (p < 0.01), which is 2.09% of the mean and 5.63% of the standard deviation. Ordered logit models, alternative fixed-effects structures, tighter month windows, and complementary textual sentiment analyses (VADER and CoreNLP) corroborate the post-IPO decline in overall sentiment. Second, we elucidate why employee satisfaction declines following an IPO by unpacking mechanism-consistent patterns. Relational evaluations (culture and values) decrease markedly post-IPO (e.g., −0.14, p < 0.001 in the most conservative estimation), consistent with a shift toward more transactional management, reduced transparency, and tighter internal information control after the introduction of public shareholders and formal boards. Semi-structured interviews echo these dynamics: employees report exclusion from decision-making and weakened trust, while managers and investors describe increased market pressure. Although financial evaluations rise on average, justice-related sentiment declines after IPOs and partially mediates the effect on overall evaluations, suggesting that shifting reference points and perceived inequities can offset financial gains. Third, we provide recommendations for soon-to-be and newly public companies to maintain and enhance employee satisfaction post-IPO, focusing on the relational mechanisms that deteriorate. Our framework allows managers to tailor governance strategies based on stakeholders’ positions on the transactional-to-relational continuum. For example, relational stakeholders, such as long-tenured employees, benefit from strategies emphasizing trust-building, reciprocity, and alignment with long-term goals. In contrast, transactional stakeholders, such as short-term contractors, may respond more effectively to performance metrics and financial incentives. By assessing stakeholder-firm relationships and adapting practices accordingly, managers can navigate dual financial and relational pressures, particularly during organizational transformation events like IPOs. Fourth, through qualitative interviews, we compare the impact of IPOs on employee satisfaction between firms in the United States and Hong Kong. Specifically, we have conducted interviews with employees and managers in newly public companies in both U.S. and Hong Kong. Also, we have conducted quantitative analyses using region fixed effects, as well as separately for each region. Both qualitative and quantitative evidence show that the mechanism likely generalises to both settings. In summary, we theorize and show that IPOs are followed by a statistically and practically meaningful decline in employee evaluations, driven primarily by deteriorating relational perceptions despite modest financial improvements. The effect is stronger for longer-horizon, relationally oriented employees and weaker for financially motivated employees. We also offer actionable and generalisable practices to maintain and enhance employee satisfaction in newly public firms.

24501922.label: Major findings and research outcome
24501922.value: Initial public offerings (IPOs) are strategic inflection points that restructure stakeholder governance, yet their effects on internal stakeholders remain underexplored. This project has examined how and why employee evaluations of firms change post-IPO. While IPOs bring in financial capital that can benefit employees, they also introduce public shareholders whose short-term financial priorities may conflict with employees’ interests. Using matched difference-in-differences analyses of 98,652 Glassdoor reviews and text analysis, this project found that employee evaluations declined post-IPO. This decline was particularly pronounced among employees with longer-term time horizons but attenuated among those with stronger financial motivations. By developing a stakeholder transactionalism framework and testing boundary conditions, this project reconciled competing predictions in stakeholder theory and highlighted the unintended internal consequences of IPOs for employee–firm relationships. My research outcomes are as follows. First, I presented the paper at the Academy of Management Conference, and the paper was included in the Academy of Management Proceedings in July 2023. Second, I submitted the paper to the Academy of Management Journal (UTD-24) in December 2023 and completed two rounds of revise-and-resubmit before it was ultimately rejected in January 2025. Third, I revised the paper and delivered another presentation at the Special Symposium of the Academy of International Business on Sustainability in May 2025. Fourth, I submitted the revised paper to the Strategic Management Journal (UTD-24) in July 2025 and received a first-round revision decision in September 2025. I am currently working on this revision.

24501922.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
24501922.value: This research can be further developed in both theorisation and empirical analyses. Theoretically, this research adopted a traditional “hub-and-spoke” model of stakeholder–firm relationships, where stakeholders interact primarily with the firm rather than with each other. While appropriate for the context—where public shareholders and employees rarely interact directly—this model overlooks the more complex, networked stakeholder dynamics relevant in collective action contexts. Future research could explore multilateral stakeholder interactions to advance governance theory. Empirically, while our large-scale review data provide rich insights, the anonymity of the data prevents us from tracking individual employees over time. To address this limitation, this research focused on employees who joined pre-IPO; however, survey-based designs could better capture within-person changes. Second, although the matched difference-in-differences (DiD) design and fixed effects account for many identification concerns, unobserved confounders may still exist. Experimental approaches could further strengthen causal inferences.

24501922.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
24501922.value: Going public is a hallmark of firm success—but for many employees, it leads to a decline in their perceptions of the company. Our analysis of employee reviews before and after IPOs reveals that evaluations become more negative, particularly among full-time and longer-tenured employees. Financially motivated employees, however, are more resilient to this shift. These findings suggest that IPOs are not just financial events but governance transformations that change how firms prioritize stakeholder needs. Managers navigating this transition must tailor employee engagement strategies to the transactional profiles of different employee groups.

24502422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24502422.value: 公共財政與地方污染排放：來自信用評級標準調整的實證分析

24502422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24502422.value: Local governments exert a direct and major influence on local environmental protection. Not only are they delegated to enforce federal environmental laws, they also endeavour to develop and implement local environmental policies. It is the local governments that polluting firms are faced with and have to deal with during their daily operation. While prior literature documents various determinants of corporate pollution emission decision majorly from the side of the firm, the evidence on the impact of local governments is limited. This project investigates the role of local governments by examining the effect of their access to bond financing on local firm pollution emission. The direction of the effect is not straightforward ex ante. On one hand, expanded debt capacity may enable local governments to better implement environmental regulation and thus curtail pollution emission. On the other hand, local governments are likely to prioritize spending that spurs local economic growth, which in turn leads to higher pollution. The study exploits the exogenous upgrade of U.S. municipal bond ratings resulting from Moody's rating scale recalibration in 2010 to identify local governments’ better access to municipal bond financing. Using establishment-level pollution data, I compare the change in toxic release by plants in localities receiving bond rating upgrades, with that by plants in localities without rating upgrades. I further explore whether the effect is more pronounced for localities with higher local environmental demands and for localities with stronger bond financing incentives. I also explore whether and how local government access to bond financing affects their environmental expenditure and enforcement. 地方政府對地方環境保護具有直接而重大的影響。他們不僅被授權執行聯邦環境法，還致力於製定和實施當地的環境政策。污染企業在日常運營中面臨的以及不得不應對的正是地方政府。雖然先前的文獻主要從企業方面探究了企業污染排放的各種決定因素，但對地方政府如何影響企業排污，所知甚少。本項目通過考察地方政府債券融資來探究地方政府對地方企業污染排放的影響。具體影響的方向並不清晰。一方面，擴大融資能力可以使地方政府更好地實施環境監管，從而減少污染排放。另一方面，地方政府可能會優先考慮刺激地方經濟，反過來又會導致更高的污染。本研究利用 2010 年穆迪評級準則重新調整導致的美國市政債券評級上調，來衡量地方政府更高的債券融資能力。本研究將利用工廠的污染數據來比較評級上調地區工廠和評級未上調地區工廠之間有毒物質排放情況。本研究進一步探究這種影響是否對於民眾環境要求較高的以及地方政府有較強融資需求的地方更明顯。此外，本研究也將探究地方政府獲得債券融資是否以及如何影響其在環境保護方面的財政支出和執法力度。

24503522.value: 企業社會責任(CSR/ESG)的研究涵蓋了環境(E)，社會(S)，和公司治理(G)的方面。與傳統公司理論下所倡導的企業以利潤或者股東最大化為目標所不同，最近幾年無論是投資者，相關交易機構或者政府都越來越重視和強調企業的對整個社會的責任及貢獻。與此對應的，相關利益群體對於企業社會責任的信息披露的需求也越來越多。企業社會責任的信息披露對於研究者和監管者而言都是重要的課題，這是因為企業社會責任報告不僅給企業經營和交易相關的群體包括內部員工，外部投資者，供應鏈夥伴以及監管者提供實質性信息，而且也會對企業資源配置有重要影響。後者主要通過減少信息摩擦和通過監督和同行壓力規範企業管理者的行為 （Jensen and Meckling, 1976; Myers, 1977; Myers and Majluf, 1984; Jensen, 1986)。有關企業社會責任信息披露對企業經濟行為的實質影響的研究很大程度上還是一塊空白。 目前有兩塊有潛力的研究缺口等待被填補。第一個研究缺口是目前關於企業社會責任報告的研究主要聚焦於企業的自願性信息披露。自願性信息披露研究的一個嚴重短板是樣本自選擇問題(selection issue)。這是由於那些自願披露社會責任的企業和其他選擇不披露的企業基本面有很大不同。如此，便很難將企業經濟行為的變化歸功於自願性社會責任披露。一個處理樣本自選擇問題的方法是研究強制性社會責任信息披露。第二個研究缺口是目前很多的企業社會責任研究聚焦於對環境（E）維度的研究，而對社會（S）維度的經濟後果研究相對較少。 本研究項目旨在通過深究中國與2016年開始的關於強制一部分上市公司披露企業精準扶貧的政策填補如上兩個研究缺口，並同時研究此政策對企業行為以及行為外部性的實質影響。具體而言，本研究項目試圖回答一下問題: (1) 該強制企業披露精準扶貧的政策是否會鼓勵更多企業參與扶貧行動？值得註意的是，該政策僅僅對信息披露有強制要求，而非強制企業進行扶貧行為。(2) 對於那些參與扶貧行動的企業，該行為是否對扶貧對應的貧困地區的經濟有影響？(3) 考慮到企業的能夠用於社會責任相關投資的總的資源是有一定限度的，該政策是否會導致企業減少對社會責任其他維度的投入，比如工作環境安全以及環境保護等？到2013年為止，盡管中國政府在扶貧方面做出了受到聯合國認可的成就，中國尚未完全實現超貧困地區的脫貧。習近平主席於2013年首次提出精準扶貧的概念，旨在精準定位貧困地區並實施相應措施(Liu, Guo and Zhou, 2018)。中國兩大交易所，上海證券交易所和深圳證券交易所相應政策號召並於2016年退出企業精準扶貧公告, 強製要求部分交易所上市公司在年報或者企業社會責任報告裏披露扶貧情況, 並規定了相應的報告模板。該政策的一個重要以及有意義的特征是它僅對一部分上市公司適用。這樣我們就可以通過本項目研究的結果進行因果推斷。需要指出的是，中國是第一個也是唯一一個鼓勵號召企業參與貧困地區扶貧的國家。考慮到貧窮這個話題在世界範圍內特別是發展中國家仍舊是一個挑戰，本項目的研究成果將對其他國家和的確如何通過激勵企業參與精準扶貧從而減少貧困有一定的政策指導意義。另一方面，本項目通過對發展經濟學以及企業社會責任進行交叉研究，對這兩方面經濟研究有一定理論貢獻。

24503822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24503822.value: 在線社交線索和消費者行為

24503822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24503822.value: With the explosive growth of the Internet, consumers are using online platforms more often. In a survey conducted by KPMG in 2020, 75% of Hong Kongers use online channels more often than before. While it has become easier to purchase products and services online, consumers also face the issue that there is too simply too much information provided to them when making the decisions. Platforms often display the information about prior users' actions, such as sales and viewership, and the opinion from previous consumers, such as online ratings the number of Likes. The different types of information are referred to as social cues in this project. To better assist consumers in their decision journeys, it is important to examine social cues and the underlying mechanisms. In this project, we aim to understand how and why social cues influence consumers differently. More specifically, we try to answer: 1) For different products, how do different types of social cues influence consumers’ online behavior? 2) For the same type of products, how do different display formats of social cues change consumers’ online behavior? 3) What are the underlying mechanisms that lead to the observed differences? The project will be conducted in three phases. In Phase I, we will use lab experiments to understand how consumers utilize social cues in their decision-making and whether there exists a difference across different products. In Phase II, we conduct more experiments to explore the presentation formats of social cues. By altering the formats, we can tease out the effect resulting from displays or product type and understand the pure influence of social cues. As lab experiments may pose potential concerns about the external validity of our findings, we will conduct field experiments in Phase III. We randomly assign participants to our control and experiment groups and observe whether the new design is effective. Additional empirical analysis and matching techniques will be applied to control for heterogeneity and establish causality. This paper will make several contributions. Theoretically, we contribute to the literature on social cues by providing a more holistic understanding of how and why various social cues influence consumers’ decision-making. We also provide empirical evidence to show the effectiveness of different display formats. Practically, we provide a pathway for practitioners on how to design their platforms. As Hong Kong is becoming more engaged in e-commerce, our findings will benefit platform designers and policymakers. 隨著互聯網的爆炸式增長，消費者使用在線平台的頻率越來越高。畢馬威在 2020 年進行的一項調查顯示，75% 的香港人比以往更頻繁地使用在線渠道。雖然在線購買產品和服務變得更加容易，但消費者也面臨著在做出決定時提供給他們的信息太多的問題。平台通常會顯示有關先前用戶行為的信息，例如銷量和收視率，以及來自先前消費者的意見，例如在線評分和點贊數。在這個項目中，不同類型的信息被稱為社會線索。為了更好地幫助消費者進行決策，檢查社會線索和潛在機制非常重要。 在這個項目中，我們旨在了解社交線索如何以及為什麼會以不同方式影響消費者。更具體地說，我們試圖回答：1）對於不同的產品，不同類型的社交線索如何影響消費者的在線行為？ 2）對於同一種產品，不同的社交線索展示形式如何改變消費者的上網行為？ 3）導致觀察到差異的潛在機制是什麼？該項目將分三個階段進行。在第一階段，我們將使用實驗室實驗來了解消費者如何在決策中利用社交線索，以及不同產品之間是否存在差異。在第二階段，我們進行了更多的實驗來探索社交線索的呈現形式。通過改變格式，我們可以梳理出展示或產品類型所產生的效果，並了解社交線索的純粹影響。由於實驗室實驗可能會對我們研究結果的外部有效性產生潛在的擔憂，我們將在第三階段進行現場實驗。我們將參與者隨機分配到我們的控制組和實驗組，並觀察新設計是否有效。將應用額外的經驗分析和匹配技術來控制異質性並建立因果關係。 本文將做出若干貢獻。從理論上講，我們通過提供對各種社會線索如何以及為何影響消費者決策的更全面的理解，為關於社會線索的文獻做出了貢獻。我們還提供經驗證據來證明不同顯示格式的有效性。實際上，我們為從業者提供瞭如何設計平台的途徑。隨著香港越來越多地參與電子商務，我們的研究結果將使平台設計者和政策制定者受益。

24505122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24505122.value: 關於家庭動機的經濟性-象征性雙重意義模型

24505122.label: Project Objectives
24505122.value: Current research has largely focused on the financial/economic meaning of family motivation, but overlooked other ways in which family motivation can be experienced by employees. This economic-centered view on family motivation essentially equates family motivation with employees’ family financial considerations. However, we believe this narrow perspective has masked a much richer story that could have been told about what it means to be motivated by family. People experience family motivation not only as a desire to financially benefit their families. They may also be motivated to serve as a good role model for their family members, show their children the importance of work, and make their parents and spouse proud, through their work (Menges et al., 2017; Zhang et al., 2020). Yet, the latter meaning of family motivation, as well as its implications for employee work behaviors and outcomes, is largely dismissed in the current literature. Therefore, the first objective of this research is to move beyond this traditional economic perspective, and systematically examine how family motivation is experienced by employees and how it shapes employees’ perceptions of the meanings of family motivation. While it is relatively well-established that family motivation has a positive influence on work behaviors and performance that are certainly tied to employees’ economic outcomes and thus their family’s financial well-being (e.g., diligence; persistence, and productivity), it is unclear whether family motivation can likewise drive employee behaviors and performance that may not bring certain and immediate financial rewards to employees. For example, compared with in-role task performance, organizational citizenship behaviors (OCBs) and creative endeavors are often not financially rewarded by organizations (Bolino, Klotz, Turnley, & Harvey, 2013). They may even adversely impact employees’ in-role task performance and concomitant economic rewards, or lead to job loss (Dewett, 2007; Madjar, Greenberg, & Chen, 2011). Therefore, when employees with strong family motivation fail to see how their engagement in OCBs/creative processes can produce economic rewards to support their family, will they expand (or alternatively, constrain) their efforts on such activities? Extant research offers limited insights on this question. Therefore, our second objective is to examine the relationship between family motivation and OCB and creativity

24505122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24505122.value: While it is widely recognized that the desire to support one’s family is a fundamental force driving many people to work diligently for more than two-thirds of their waking life, how this family motivation affects employees’ work behaviors and work outcomes is surprisingly less understood. Many researchers suggested that if employees are motivated by a desire to benefit their family, they tend to work harder in their jobs to get greater financial rewards, but they also tend to engage less in favorable behaviors which may not necessarily yield financial rewards for employees, such as creative endeavors and organizational citizenship behaviors. However, this narrow, economic-centered perspective has masked a much richer story that could have been told about what it means to be motivated by those we love the most—our family. People experience family motivation not only as a desire to financially benefit their families. They may also be motivated to serve as a good role model for their family members, show their children the importance of being responsible, and make their parents and spouse proud, through their work. Yet, the latter meaning of family motivation, as well as its implications for employee work behaviors and outcomes, is largely dismissed in the current literature. Therefore, we intend to fill this gap by systematically understanding the meanings of family motivation: how is family motivation experienced and what does it mean to be motivated at work by ones’ family? Based on insights from past research and our initial results, we propose that family motivation can have two sets of meanings for employees: a financial/economic meaning and a symbolic meaning. The former refers to employees’ desire to financially benefit their families through their work, whereas the latter refers to employees’ desire to serve as a good role model for their family members and inspire their family members through their work. It is the purpose of the this project to empirically validate this economic-symbolic dual-meaning framework through a more thorough qualitative study. Moreover, we will conduct a quantitative study, a field experiment specifically, to test whether these two meanings of family motivation will have differential impacts on employees’ work behaviors and performance that may not necessarily yield financial rewards for employees (OCB and creativity, specifically). 雖然人們普遍認為，養家糊口的願望是推動許多人勤奮工作的基本動力，但令人驚訝的是，這種家庭動機如何影響員工的工作行為和工作成果卻鮮為人知。許多研究人員認為，如果員工的工作動機僅僅是為了家庭，他們往往會在工作中更加努力地工作以獲得更大的經濟回報，但他們也傾向於較少參與不一定會給員工帶來經濟回報的行為，例如高創造性但高風險的工作以及組織公民行為。 然而，這種以經濟效益為中心的觀點是狹隘的。家庭動機不僅意味著人民希望在經濟上使他們的家庭受益。他們也可能被這種動機激勵著為家庭成員樹立良好的榜樣，通過工作向孩子展示責任心的重要性，並讓父母和配偶感到自豪。然而，家庭動機的後一種含義，以及它對員工工作行為和結果的影響，在當前的文獻中很大程度上被忽視了。因此，我打算通過系統地理解家庭動機的含義來填補這一空白：即家庭動機如何如何激勵員工？基於過去研究的見解和我們的一些初步結果，我們提出家庭動機對員工可以具有兩種含義：財務/經濟性含義和象徵性含義。前者是指員工希望通過工作為家庭帶來經濟利益，而後者是指員工希望為家人做好榜樣，通過工作激勵家人。本項目的目的是通過更系統的定性研究來實證驗證這一經濟性-象征性雙重含義框架。此外，我們將進行定量研究，通過實地實驗來測試家庭動機的這兩種不同含義是否會對員工的工作行為和績效產生不同的影響。

24505122.label: Major findings and research outcome
24505122.value: I found that family may affect employees' perception of work in two different ways. First, it will motivate them to view work as a way to earn financial support for family (financial meaning of work). Second, family motivates people to view work as a way to show their family members the importance of being diligent, responsible, and hardworking (symbolic meaning of work). We found that symbolic meaning of work will lead employees to conduct more OCB and put more efforts into work. This is especially true for female employees who have kids. The research findings have been presented in two conferences: Academy of Management Annual Meeting, and Association of International Business Annual Meeting. Moreover, with the help of this grant, my research team published a paper at the Journal of Applied Psychology, which is a top tier journal in Management and Organizational Behavior.

24505122.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
24505122.value: I will further explore the cultural differences of symbolic meaning of work. I have some preliminary evidence that different cultures will have different levels of symbolic-economic meaning, and I hope to systematically investigate such cultural differences. Propose of action: I will collect data from diverse cultures, as well as using cross-cultural archival data to investigate whether there is systematic differences in symbolic-economic meaning of work, and if so, what cultural factors are at play.

24505122.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
24505122.value: This research will help better understand how family could have positive influence on one's work. In the past, people assume that involvement in family will have negative effects on one's work, that family is a source of distraction for work. However, our findings suggest that family could inspire employees to view work differently, which can actually contribute to work. Therefore, this finding may help employers better understand the value of hiring employees with strong family motivation.

24505822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24505822.value: 在公允披露制度下的債務合同選擇性披露

24505822.label: Project Objectives
24505822.value: This project is motivated by the limited insights in the input and progress information of contract negotiations and renegotiations between borrowers and (potential) lenders. The input and progress information is incrementally informative of borrowers' creditworthiness, relative to the output information such as initial and amended loan contracts and waivers granted. Moreover, such information could reveal the nature of the private information obtained by lenders from borrowers and enrich our understanding on lenders' informational advantages. Therefore, this proposal collects a novel sample of the input and progress information from the Reg FD Disclosure section of 8-Ks. I have read 200 out of 6,543 files of 8-Ks that contain loan contract-related information in this section. Reading all of the 6,543 files could provide comprehensive understanding on the nature of the input and progress information and form a unique dataset. The information disclosed in the Reg FD Disclosure section is borrowers' selective disclosure, and publicly disclosing material non-public information is costly to borrowers, jointly leading to the question why borrowers provide such selective disclosure. I will explore the underlying incentives, which could shed new insights into the effect of loan contracts on borrowers' voluntary disclosure. Such disclosure could reduce the private information known to only lenders and borrowers, and therefore mitigates the information asymmetry within lenders and between lenders and shareholders. I plan to examine the consequences of such disclosure in loan markets proxied by loan spreads and in stock markets proxied by the speed of stock price discovery. This examination could show a new channel through which the information flows from loan markets to stock markets. This is new because existing studies (e.g., Bushman et al., 2010; Ivashina and Sun 2011) focus on the information flow via lenders’ trading on borrowers’ private information, but my potential results could demonstrate the information flow via borrowers' selective disclosure triggered by loan contracts. My novel data reveals that borrowers selectively disclose information relating to their loan contracts under the Regulation FD Disclosure, an unexplored benefit associated with this regulation. Prior studies such as Li, Saunders, and Shao (2015) find an increase in the information asymmetry in the debt markets subsequent to the adoption of this regulation. By showing the reduced information asymmetry caused by this regulation in loan markets, this project could contribute to the literature on the effect of the Reg FD Disclosure on loan markets. Only 6,543 out of 281,177 8-K files selectively contain the input and progress data relating to loan contracts, indicating that borrowers have concerns on the costs of such disclosure. The main cost is losing competitive advantages when the information is proprietary. I, therefore, test borrowers’ and their peers’ stock market reactions to the selective disclosure, and expect significantly negative borrowers’ reactions and significantly positive peers’ reactions. The input and progress data could help explore how to determine loan contract terms especially financial covenants. Gu and Zhu (2021) provide a sample of 37 loan contracts explicitly mentioning the use of management forecasts to determine covenant thresholds. However, how to set the thresholds based on the forecasts, i.e., the existence and the size of cushion, is also worthwhile to explore.

Only 6,543 out of 281,177 8-K files selectively contain the input and progress data relating to loan contracts, indicating that borrowers have concerns on the costs of such disclosure. The main cost is losing competitive advantages when the information is proprietary. I, therefore, test borrowers’ and their peers’ stock market reactions to the selective disclosure, and expect significantly negative borrowers’ reactions and significantly positive peers’ reactions.

The input and progress data could help explore how to determine loan contract terms especially financial covenants. Gu and Zhu (2021) provide a sample of 37 loan contracts explicitly mentioning the use of management forecasts to determine covenant thresholds. However, how to set the thresholds based on the forecasts, i.e., the existence and the size of cushion, is also worthwhile to explore.

24505822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24505822.value: Existing studies focus on the output of loan contract negotiations, such as initial and amended loan contracts and waivers. However, relative to the output, the input and progress of negotiations could be incrementally informative of borrowers’ credit quality for three reasons. The input and progress data allows investors to make independent assessment and inference on loan contract terms; contains information that does not directly relate to contract terms but reveals borrowers’ operating, financing, and investment plans; and exists even when borrowers and lenders fail to produce an output of negotiations. I collect 6,543 files of 8-Ks containing the Regulation FD Disclosure Section where the information is elected by borrowers to furnish and relates to loan contracts. To identify the nature of the information, I randomly read 200 files and classify the information into (1) the interactions between borrowers and lenders and (2) the material non-public corporate information released in the progress of negotiations. The two types of information reduce the information asymmetry between existing lenders and potential lenders in a timely manner, mitigating information risk. I, therefore, expect lower loan spreads of new borrowings for borrowers with such selective disclosure relative to borrowers without. Such disclosure could also address the information asymmetry between lenders and shareholders, and I hypothesize that the price discovery in stock markets is faster for borrowers with such disclosure than for borrowers without. To mitigate the self-selection issue in examining the effect of such disclosure on loan spreads, I employ Heckman (1979)’s selection model. In the determinant model, I construct proxies for borrowers’ incentives to facilitate financing, to enhance the credibility of their forecasts, to fulfill their disclosure obligations specified in confidentiality agreements or under the Reg FD Disclosure, or to mitigate litigation risk. I also employ a Propensity Score Matching to construct a control group based on this determinant model, and compare the intra-period stock price discovery, a proxy for the speed of price discovery, between borrowers with and without such disclosure. This proposal strengthens our understanding of the private information accessible to lenders, sheds new insights into the effect of loan contracts on borrowers’ voluntary disclosure, demonstrates a new channel via which information flows from loan markets to stock markets, and adds new evidence on the effect of Reg FD Disclosure on loan markets. 現有文獻探究債務合同談判的結果，比如新合同，修改合同，或獲得債務違約豁免。然而相較於談判的結果，談判的準備工作和進程會提供更多關於借款人信用質量的信息。準備工作和進程的數據便於投資者獨立評價債務合同條款內容，包含與合同條款不直接相關但能體現借款人經營，融資，和投資計劃等相關內容，並且該數據即使談判失敗也會存在。本文搜集了6,543個8-K文檔。這些文檔披露借款人在公允披露制度下的關於債務合同的選擇性披露。為識別這些披露的信息性質，我隨機閱讀200個文檔，並將信息歸類為借款人和債權人的交流與談判過程中的重要非公開信息。這兩類信息有利於緩解現有與潛在的債權人之間的信息不對稱，進而降低信息風險。鑒於此，我預測相較於沒有選擇性披露債務合同的借款人，披露該信息的借款人更有可能在新合同中獲得更低的利率。這兩類信息也有助於解決債權人與借款人股東之間的信息不對稱，因此我預測此披露可以加速股權市場的價值發現。本文擬用Heckman (1979)模型檢測以上假設。本文潛在的發現有助於我們更好地了解債權人從借款人處獲取的非公開信息以及債務合同對借款人信息披露的影響。
