24506022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24506022.value: Companies are facing increasingly uncertain demand in today’s competitive business environment. They need to make production arrangements for different types of orders based on limited capacity. The theory of process flexibility provides a useful approach in mitigating the mismatch between supply and demand. It has been well established that even just a little flexibility if configured appropriately, can be terrifically effective in hedging against demand uncertainty. In reality, the companies receive demand orders with different profitability and priority. However, the influence of profit margin for different demands on the design of flexible structures has remained unclear. This indicates a need to understand the design of flexible structures where there exist profit margin differentials among demand orders. Motivated by the real-world problem faced by a large electronic-device manufacturing firm, my collaborators and I aim to address this gap in the literature. First, we study the concept of expansion property when the products have different profit margins, based on which, we characterize good structures in the profit-maximization settings. Besides, we adopt a worst-case analysis to evaluate the performance of flexibility structures compared with the performance of a fully flexible system. Finally, we will develop guidelines and heuristic algorithms to generate effective flexibility designs. We will complement the literature in the way that flexibility enables the pooled resources not only to hedge against demand variation but also to improve revenues by satisfying more highly profitable demand at the expense of less profitable demand. 在當今競爭激烈的商業環境中，公司面臨著越來越不確定的需求。他們需要根據有限的產能對不同類型的訂單進行生產安排。過程靈活性理論為緩解供需不匹配提供了一種有用的方法。眾所周知，如果配置得當，即使只是一點點的靈活性，也可以非常有效地對沖需求的不確定性。實際上，公司收到的需求訂單具有不同的盈利能力和優先級。然而，不同需求的利潤率對柔性結構設計的影響仍不清楚。這表明需要了解需求訂單之間存在利潤率差異的靈活結構的設計。受大型電子設備製造公司面臨的現實問題的啟發，我和我的合作者旨在解決文獻中的這一空白。首先，我們研究了產品具有不同利潤率時的擴張屬性的概念，在此基礎上，我們描述了利潤最大化設置中的良好結構。此外，我們採用最壞情況分析來評估柔性結構的性能與完全柔性系統的性能相比。最後，我們將開髮指南和啟發式算法以生成有效的靈活性設計。我們將補充文獻的方式，即靈活性使匯集的資源不僅可以對沖需求變化，而且可以通過以較低利潤的需求為代價滿足更高利潤的需求來提高收入。

24506022.label: Realisation of objectives
24506022.value: This project set out to study the design and performance of flexibility structures under a profit-maximization objective in the presence of heterogeneous order profitability, and to translate theoretical insights into actionable design guidelines for a real manufacturing system. Overall, the project objectives have been largely achieved, with substantial progress on analytical characterization, structural insights, and practical design implications. Below we summarize the realization of each objective and discuss remaining challenges. Evaluation of flexibility structures under profit margin differentials. The project successfully developed analytical and computational frameworks to evaluate the performance of flexibility structures when demand orders differ in profit margins. Unlike the traditional throughput- or service-level-oriented literature, the analysis explicitly incorporates profit heterogeneity, allowing flexibility decisions to account for both volume and value dimensions of demand. Through theoretical analysis and numerical experiments, the project demonstrated that profit margin differentials can fundamentally alter the relative performance of commonly used flexibility structures. In particular, structures that are near-optimal under homogeneous profit assumptions may become suboptimal when high-margin and low-margin orders compete for shared capacity. This objective has been fully achieved. Characterization of high-performing flexibility structures. The project made substantial progress in identifying and characterizing special flexibility structures that perform well under profit maximization. The analysis revealed that effective structures tend to prioritize selective flexibility that protects capacity for high-margin orders while still maintaining limited pooling benefits. Several classes of structures were shown to achieve strong profit performance across a wide range of demand and margin scenarios, including sparse but strategically placed flexibility links. While a complete characterization of all optimal structures remains analytically intractable due to combinatorial complexity, the project achieved its goal of identifying robust structural patterns and performance guarantees for important subclasses. Any remaining gaps are primarily due to inherent model complexity rather than methodological limitations. Development of design guidelines and implementable heuristics. Based on the structural insights, the project successfully derived design guidelines that explain how profit heterogeneity should influence flexibility decisions, such as when to favor dedicated capacity over pooling and how to allocate limited flexibility across order types. These insights were translated into simple, implementable heuristics that generate high-quality flexibility designs without requiring exhaustive optimization. Computational experiments show that the proposed heuristics consistently outperform benchmark designs derived from throughput-based objectives, particularly in environments with large profit dispersion. This objective has been fully achieved. Application to the industry collaborator’s manufacturing network. The general design principles were applied to the manufacturing network of the industry collaborator, which involves multiple types of manufacturing centers and orders with heterogeneous profitability. The project developed a tailored flexibility design that reflects both operational constraints and profit considerations specific to the collaborator’s setting. While data availability and confidentiality constraints limited the scope of large-scale empirical validation, scenario-based analyses demonstrated meaningful profit improvements relative to the collaborator’s baseline design. The project team actively worked with the collaborator to adapt the guidelines to practical constraints, partially overcoming data limitations through sensitivity analysis and stress testing. In summary, the project has achieved its core objectives to a high degree. It advances the theoretical understanding of flexibility design under profit heterogeneity and provides practical tools for real-world implementation. The remaining challenges—primarily related to full structural characterization and large-scale empirical validation—point to promising directions for future research and collaboration rather than shortcomings of the project itself.

24506022.label: Major findings and research outcome
24506022.value: This project investigated the design of flexibility structures in manufacturing and resource allocation systems when performance is evaluated using profit and service reliability, rather than traditional throughput-based measures. The project addressed two fundamental gaps in the existing flexibility literature: (i) how flexibility and capacity should be jointly designed when demand information is limited and service-level guarantees are required, and (ii) how profit margin differentials across orders affect the value of sparse flexibility relative to full flexibility. A key finding of the project is that sparse flexibility structures remain highly effective under significantly broader and more realistic settings than previously understood. When service-level guarantees must be met with high probability and demand distributions are unknown, the project established a data-driven framework that jointly determines flexibility links and capacity levels. The analysis shows that the classical long-chain structure continues to perform optimally under low demand volatility and conservative risk requirements, even when capacities are decision variables. Importantly, the project also identifies conditions—such as high demand volatility, relaxed risk tolerance, or heterogeneous capacities—under which asymmetric or selectively pooled designs outperform symmetric structures. These results clarify when traditional flexibility designs should be retained and when they should be modified. Under a profit-maximization objective, the project uncovered a counterintuitive but robust structural insight. While full flexibility becomes increasingly valuable relative to dedicated systems as profit margins diverge, the performance gap between well-designed sparse structures and full flexibility shrinks as profit differentials increase. In particular, an alternating sparse structure that strategically clusters high-margin and low-margin orders captures a growing fraction of the profit achievable under full flexibility when profit dispersion is large. This result overturns the conventional intuition that greater margin heterogeneity necessarily calls for denser flexibility. Beyond theoretical characterization, the project produced implementable design heuristics that require only basic system information—such as capacities, average demand, and profit margins—without requiring full demand distributions. These heuristics consistently generate sparse flexibility designs that achieve near-optimal performance across balanced, unbalanced, and asymmetric systems. Overall, the project delivers a coherent set of analytical results and practical tools demonstrating that effective flexibility design depends critically on the performance objective. It provides clear guidance on how to tailor flexibility structures to profit and service considerations, substantially advancing both the theory and practice of flexibility design.

24506022.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
24506022.value: The research opens several promising directions for further development. A natural next step is to integrate service-level and profit objectives within a unified multi-criteria framework, allowing decision-makers to explicitly trade off reliability and profitability. This would be particularly relevant for industries facing regulatory service requirements alongside commercial objectives. Another important extension is to explore dynamic and multi-period settings, where demand learning, capacity adjustment, and flexibility redesign evolve over time. Incorporating adaptive data-driven ambiguity sets and rolling-horizon decisions would enhance the practical relevance of the framework. From an application perspective, deeper collaboration with industry partners would enable large-scale empirical validation and customization of the proposed heuristics to sector-specific constraints, such as heterogeneous machine capabilities or contractual service obligations. Finally, extending the analysis to networked and multi-echelon systems would broaden the impact of the results to supply chains, healthcare delivery, and emergency response networks.

24506022.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
24506022.value: Many companies and organizations face the same challenge: they must decide how flexible their systems should be when demand is uncertain and resources are limited. Flexibility—such as allowing machines or workers to serve multiple tasks—can help, but building full flexibility is often expensive and unnecessary. This project shows that a small amount of well-designed flexibility can go a long way, even in complex environments. First, when organizations need to meet service targets (for example, hospitals ensuring patient coverage), the research shows how to design flexible systems that remain reliable even when demand data are limited or uncertain. Second, when profit matters and different products generate different returns, the research finds that simple, sparse flexibility designs can achieve nearly the same profit as fully flexible systems—especially when profit differences are large. In practical terms, the project provides clear design rules and easy-to-use tools that help managers decide where flexibility is most valuable and where it is unnecessary. These insights help organizations save costs, improve performance, and make better decisions under uncertainty, benefiting industries ranging from manufacturing and logistics to healthcare and public services.

24602022.label: Project Objectives
24602022.value: To study and assess the existing spatial conditions of transitional housing including Subdivided Units, Community Housing Movement (CHM), and Modular Social Housing (MSH) using graphical analysis methods. The research will investigate the spatial condition in transitional housing through graphical analysis to increase understanding and awareness of the spatial quality in minimal living environments. The analysis aims at identifying spatial problems and compares the improvement from SDU to CHM, and MSH to provide spatial understanding the limitations in living conditions in transitional housing, the output will be illustrated in graphical form for easy understanding by general public, the end users, and NGOs. To develop a graphical method as a tool to evaluate the living conditions of transitional housing that incorporates modern living and wellbeing standards. The research refines existing graphical methods and further develops them to fit the context of Hong Kong and modern living standards. For instance, the study of zoning (wet and dry areas) and privacy (programmatic relationships) will be developed to evaluate the spatial quality in small dwellings. The development and refinement of the graphical method will help provide an evaluation framework and propose new criteria in designing better living spaces. To generate design principles and guidelines for social housing in Hong Kong, with a focus on improving the spatial quality and adaptability for users in minimal dwellings. A set of human-centred design principles shall be further developed based on the local context for small space conditions. The graphical method is both an evaluation tool and a design tool, and provides the criteria for exploring good quality living spaces, by redesigning and reconfiguring the attributes such as path lengths, number of turns, proportion of free spaces and traffic spaces, to generate human-centred design principles for small living spaces. The study also looks into new forms of domestic life with more virtual communication at home, post-COVID. The development of design principles for social housing include spaces for community and neighbourhood relationship with the hope of inspiring a new housing model for communities.

24606722.label: Project Objectives
24606722.value: To explore how an analytical focus on littoral fringes (watery zones adjoining the land) will provide new insights not only on the relationship between the British government and Chinese society but also on features of British rule in early colonial Hong Kong. To examine the formation of a simplified yet increasingly well-classified Chinese littoral society, the emergence of social categories such as “Tanka” and “boat people,” and the taxonomy of Chinese watercraft in the British colonial archive of Hong Kong (censuses, population and watercraft registrations, administrative reports, and other writings by officials) from 1841 to 1898. To identify the factors that led to the paradoxical perceptions of the Chinese waterborne population in the colonial archive as a distinct “race” or “tribe” and as water dwellers incorporable into the mainstream Chinese society, and the factors that informed the British colonial policies related to these littoral subjects in nineteenth-century Hong Kong. To reveal the legacy of British colonial rule in shaping contemporary understanding of the Hong Kong boat communities and Hong Kong Chinese society in general. To demonstrate the transregional power of British colonialism in conceptualizing and transforming Asian littoral societies. This will be accomplished by comparing the British efforts to construct and conquer “indigenous” societies through census operations, registration mechanisms, and other measures in nineteenth-century Hong Kong and British-ruled South and Southeast Asia. To understand the roles of the Hong Kong colonial officials in shaping China’s littoral ethnic landscape. This project investigates the similarities and differences between the British authorities in Hong Kong and the Qing authorities in China in contributing to the evolution of Chinese littoral ethnicity in their respective realms.

24606722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24606722.value: A land-centered approach has long dominated scholarship on the history of colonial Hong Kong. This project is the first systematic application of a focus on littoral fringes—watery zones adjoining the land—to study the relationship between the British colonizers and Chinese society and features of British colonial rule in nineteenth-century Hong Kong. Examining censuses, population and watercraft registrations, administrative reports, and other writings by officials, the project demonstrates how the British authorities identified, classified, and described the Chinese people living afloat and the Chinese ships and boats of various types in the colony of Hong Kong. Focusing on the period from the beginning of British rule in 1841 to the eve of the lease of the New Territories in 1898, it charts the formation in the nineteenth-century colonial archive of a simplified yet increasingly well-categorized version of Chinese littoral society. In the archive, the “Tanka” or “boat people” surrounding Hong Kong Island and Kowloon Peninsula paradoxically constituted both an unassimilable “race,” “outcast,” or “tribe” descending from the boat-dwelling Dan of South China and communities of waterborne residents incorporable into the mainstream Chinese society of the colony. Not only the representation of the waterborne people and watercraft but also the corresponding colonial policies were a function of the backgrounds of the colonial officials, their knowledge of China and its people, their visions and local concerns, and the major events and developments in early colonial Hong Kong. This project shows how the British colonial authorities contributed to contemporary understanding of the Hong Kong boat communities. It argues that rather than replicating the Mainland counterpart, the structure of Hong Kong Chinese society during the colonial era was an evolving process in which the British authorities played indispensable roles. In a comparative perspective, this project uses the case of Hong Kong to illustrate the transregional power of British colonialism in conceptualizing and transforming Asian littoral societies. It links the experience of colonial Hong Kong with other British possessions in South and Southeast Asia, by looking at the colonizers’ efforts to construct and conquer “indigenous” societies through methods such as census operations and registration mechanisms. Finally, this project is the first inquiry into the roles of the Hong Kong colonial officials in the making of China’s ethnic landscape. It reveals the similarities and differences between the British authorities in Hong Kong and Qing authorities in China in shaping Chinese littoral ethnicity in their respective realms. 有關殖民時代香港的歷史研究，視角大多以陸地為中心。本研究以水陸之間的沿岸地區為切入點，重新審視十九世紀英國殖民統治者與香港華人社會的關係以及英國殖民統治的特色。透過考察人口調查的資料、人口與船隻的註冊記錄、其他官方報告，以及殖民官員的不同著作，本研究將闡釋港英當局如何識別、劃分和描述居於水上的華人及其各式各樣的船隻。本研究的年期以1841年為始、1898年英國租借新界前夕為迄，探討十九世紀殖民檔案中被簡化但劃分日益精細的華人沿岸社會如何得以形成。在殖民檔案中，港、九一帶的「艇家」或「船民」一方面被描繪成難以同化的「種族」、賤民群體或「部落」，與華南一帶浮家泛宅的蛋民同種同源；另一方面，他們被看成正「等待」融入於本地華人主流社會的水上聚落。這些水上人及船隻的形象乃至於相關的殖民政策，往往受一系列的因素所影響。這些因素包括殖民官員的背景；其有關中國及華人的認識；其對於香港發展的遠見與顧慮，以及早期殖民時代香港主要的歷史發展與事件。當代對於香港水上群體的理解，英國殖民當局的角色實在不容忽視。香港華人社會的結構並非單單是中國內地社會的複製品；它是一個不斷演化的過程，而在這過程當中，港英官員扮演了不可或缺的角色。 從比較的角度來看，本研究以香港作為例子，剖析英國殖民主義如何構想並徹底地改變亞洲跨地域的沿岸社會。透過考察殖民者如何以人口調查與註冊等統治手段去建構與征服「本土」社會，本研究將會把殖民時代香港的經驗與南亞、東南亞英國殖民地的歷史連繫起來。最後，本研究倡導探討港英殖民政權於塑造中國族群中的角色，分析港英當局與滿清政府於各自的轄境內塑造沿岸華人族群的相似與不同之處。

24608322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24608322.value: 生一個更好的寶寶：關於中國胚胎植入前基因檢測的民族志研究

24608322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24608322.value: 進入新千年，中國面臨著新的挑戰：勞動力短缺（Yang，2005）、低生育率以及對出生缺陷率可能增加的擔憂（Qiao et al，2021）。為了解決這些問題並保持人口質量和人口數量之間的健康平衡（Greenhalgh，2003；Greenhalgh & Winckler，2005），中國政府在2016年開啟了二孩政策以及“健康中國”新話語；到了2021年，更進一步啟動了三孩政策。如以往所觀察到的，國家對“人口質量”的執著關注成爲每一個家庭生育完美下一代以履行他們對民族國家責任的動力（Zhu & Dong, 2018）。因此，每個中國家庭都感受到了生育至少一個完美嬰兒的壓力。與此同時，管理人類生殖的新自由主義轉向加速。 “選擇”的價值話語讓中國夫婦關注起醫療市場上兩種明碼標價的生殖技術：選擇性生殖技術（SRT）和輔助性生殖技術（ART）。而位於這兩者交叉口上的正是胚胎植入前基因檢測 (PGT)。 作為我在中國對使用 SRT 和基因檢測技術的三年田野工作的自然延伸（Dong & Zhu, 2017），本研究將（1）提供一份關於 PGT 在中國和其他國家應用的元民族志； (2) 跟隨在日常工作中使用 PGT 的主要參與者，包括臨床醫生和生育中介，書寫一份多點民族志； (3) 通過對患者體驗的詳細描述，特別是那些到他省或者他國尋求PGT技術的“生殖遊客”(Inhorn, 1994, 2011)，探討在中國境內和跨境使用 PGT 所引發的倫理和法律問題。 我將在上海、貴陽和曼谷的三個 PGT 診所進行民族志研究，包括非參與式觀察和深度訪談。我將採訪（1）出於不同原因選擇在不同地點進行PGT的中國夫婦，（2）從事PGT的醫生、臨床遺傳學家、遺傳諮詢師和實驗室科學家，以及（3）來自PGT機構和基因檢測公司的工作人員。這個為期 36 個月的項目將深入了解新自由主義關於 “選擇”境内外輔助性生育技術的話語構建與實踐，以及在此過程中所浮現的複雜和矛盾。

24609222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24609222.value: 莫特曼在中國：一個漢語神學的接受史

24609222.label: Project Objectives
24609222.value: The first objective is to interpret the scholarly-theological reception, translation, critical analysis and discursive employment of Jürgen Moltmann’s ideas in Chinese-language ecclesial and academic settings and thereby develop a model for evaluating theological reception in contemporary Chinese-language settings. The portrayal of theological transmission and reinvention in the case of Moltmann’s Chinese interpreters demonstrates diversity not just in terms of thematic and disciplinary range, but also with regards to the creative use of theological concepts to articulate critical insights and ideas in current humanities debates, expanding the space and vocabulary of a globally engaged Chinese humanistic discourse. Another aim is to analyze the present state of theological translation in the field of Chinese Moltmann studies as a case for wider application and relevance. This objective involves translational hermeneutics, a holistic understanding of translation processes without which effective and culturally intelligible translation is impossible. Underlying the PI’s research more broadly is a concern to systematically examine contemporary Chinese theological streams, particularly those emerging in contemporary scholarly settings, and translate these for international scholarly audiences interested in theological developments beyond the “traditionally Christian” west. Here the object is to highlight the development of theological constructs and ideas contributing in important ways to global theological debates and cross-cultural intellectual exchange. Further, the PI wants to bring the voices of Chinese theologians to greater prominence through her work as a researcher; this project also falls within that wider objective. Finally, building on experience from teaching her course, “Moltmann’s Reception History” in 2020, the PI in collaboration with experts in contextual theology and related fields plans to develop curricular tools to build courses on the theme of theological reception for seminary teaching and other relevant curricular settings; these will focus both on developing courses focused on a particular reception history and a course on the theory of theological reception.

Finally, building on experience from teaching her course, “Moltmann’s Reception History” in 2020, the PI in collaboration with experts in contextual theology and related fields plans to develop curricular tools to build courses on the theme of theological reception for seminary teaching and other relevant curricular settings; these will focus both on developing courses focused on a particular reception history and a course on the theory of theological reception.

24609222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24609222.value: The precise ways in which theologies once developed within “western” traditions of thought and meaning-making are to be contextualized in new settings has occupied missiologists and historians of World Christianity for a good century. Although debates have somewhat diversified, approaches to theological contextualization are often fixed in familiar patterns of seminary instruction or mainstream church practice. What happens, however, if serious theological debate emerges in contexts less obvious, such as among secular researchers at state institutions propagating atheism – as with contemporary “Sino-Christian theology”? While several scholars have already examined this theological discourse from various angles, the process of one particular “western” theology’s translation – terminological, ideological, constructive, and functional – into contemporary Chinese-language settings is yet to be systematically researched and interpreted. The focused treatment of one theological reception history as undertaken in this project promises not only to shed light on the contextual concerns particular to Chinese scholarly inquiry and its attendant modes of theological expression in 21st century discourse, but also to highlight ways in which Chinese academics articulate issues of universal humanistic concern in newly-minted theological registers. This project on the Chinese reception and interpretation of Reformed theologian Jürgen Moltmann (1926-) offers an in-depth analysis and nuanced reading of the dialogue between Moltmann and contemporary Chinese scholars, in Beijing, Hong Kong, and Taipei, who began to translate and critically interpret Moltmann’s theology in the 1980s; the project traces this emerging engagement of a philosophically sophisticated, innovative theology across different disciplines – including theology, philosophy, religious studies, and comparative studies – by critically engaging the narratives and published works of its key proponents. It will generate and interpret qualitative data from in-depth interviews with Chinese academics researching Moltmann, examine Chinese translations of Moltmann’s theology, interpret his dialogue with Chinese thinkers and culture, and thickly describe this discursive interaction, plotting its trajectory and meaning for theological reception more universally. The research thus addresses the following issues: ---How do Chinese scholars study Moltmann, and how do their methodologies impact Chinese theology more generally? ---What are the intellectual and contextual reasons for Chinese scholars’ interest in Moltmann over the last 35 years? ---How to critically assess Sinicization in theological reception histories? Through the research outputs, formal scholarly exchanges, curricular development and networking events outlined in the present proposal, the project offers a reconceptualization of the notion of reception in favor of dialogical approaches to understanding the Chinese conversation with western theologies. 神學處境化的研究方法，對此儘管有多元化的爭論，但通常固定在神學教學或主流教會實踐的熟悉模式中。然而，如果嚴肅的神學爭論出現在不太顯著的處境中，比如，在那些身處在傳播無神論的國家機構的世俗研究人員當中，這正如當代「中國基督教神學」，會呈現出怎麼樣的狀況呢？雖然一些學者已從不同的角度審視了這種神學話語，但具體的「西方」神學翻譯成當代漢語環境的進程，在術語、意識形態、建構和效能的層面上，仍有待系統研究和解釋。本研究項目對神學接受史進行集中研究，除了有望闡明中國學術討論所特有的處境關注及其伴隨二十一世紀話語而來的神學表達方式，還將突顯出中國學者在新興的神學領域中，是如何表達出普遍人文主義關懷的。 本研究項目是關於對改革宗神學家于爾根·莫特曼（Jürgen Moltmann，1926-）在中國處境中的接受和詮釋，透過對莫特曼與北京、香港和台北的當代中國學者之間的對話來進行深入的剖析和細緻入微的解讀。這些學者於八十年代開始翻譯和批判地詮釋莫特曼的神學；本研究項目透過批判地參與莫特曼主要支持者的話語敘述和出版作品，從而追溯帶有哲學的複雜和創新的神學學科在其他不同學科（包括神學、哲學、宗教研究和比較研究）中的新興的研究參與。本研究項目將通過對研究莫特曼的中國學者的深入訪談來獲取和解讀質性資料，深入考察莫特曼神學的中文譯本，解讀他與中國思想家和文化的對話，從而詳細地論述這種話語互動，在更普遍的層面上來描繪神學接受的思想軌跡和意義。因此，本研究項目會解決以下問題： ---中國學者是如何研究莫特曼的，他們的方法論如何更廣泛地影響中國神學？ ---過去 35 年中國學者對莫特曼的研究興趣在知識和處境層面上的理據是什麼？ ---如何批判地評價神學接受史的中國化？ 透過本研究計劃書中所概述的研究成果、正式的學術交流、課程開發和網絡活動，本項目提供「接受」概念的再概念化，以便用對話的方法來深入理解中國與西方神學的交流對話。

24609822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24609822.value: 言語的誕生：從梅洛-龐蒂語言現象學看言語的本質與發展

24609822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24609822.value: This project is an inquiry into language as both a natural phenomenon and a phenomenon that language users consciously experience. At the same time, it is an inquiry into the ultimate origins of linguistic meaning. I locate those origins in the human body and preverbal human interactions. I understand both these as uniquely evolved for the development and acquisition of conventional languages. My approach to this problem is based on the Merleau-Ponty’s late, incomplete phenomenological ontology of nature. I provide both a historical reconstruction of the development of this problematic in his philosophy, and a systematic elaboration of this issue within his philosophy as it was outlined in his late working notes. I see out that program in light of recent advances in Merleau-Ponty scholarship; phenomenology more broadly; and empirical research into life, mind, and language. Recent Merleau-Ponty scholarship has largely targeted questions of nature, child development, and language as three separate areas of inquiry. As a result, many studies have failed to see the intimate interrelationships between these domains, specifically the natural foundations of language in the human body and its early lifespan development. The resulting interpretations view language as autonomous and foundational for the phenomenological project of understanding. While there is some truth in these proposals, their neglect of the foundational role of nature, the body, and development for language and linguistic meaning is a critical oversight. My project remedies this lacuna in the literature. At the same time, Merleau-Ponty’s interdisciplinary phenomenology provides an original constructive and critical framework for interpreting a range of empirical findings from diverse sciences of life, mind, and language. It allows us to weave together these various researches into a composite picture of the symbolic animal, the human being, as it has evolved and as it develops in ontogeny. To that end, my project interprets and integrates findings from developmental psychology, neurolinguistics, evolutionary biology, gesture studies, and embodied cognitive science. 本項目既探究語言作為一種自然的現象以及語言使用者有意識地體驗的現象，也探究語言意義的最終起源。我認為起源有二，那就是人的身體，以及人類有語言之前的互動；這兩者經歷了獨特的演化過程，傳統語言因而得以發展和習得。我對上述問題採取的進路，乃建基於梅洛-龐蒂晚期的、未完成的自然現象學本體論。我從歷史的角度，重構梅洛-龐蒂哲學中相關問題意識的發展，並根據他晚期的工作筆記，條分縷析地作進一步闡述；同時參考梅洛-龐蒂研究的最新進展，結合現象學以及生命、心靈、語言的實證研究，以繼續並完成梅洛-龐蒂未竟之功。 新近的梅洛-龐蒂研究，主要集中在自然、兒童發展以及語言，並視之為三個獨立的研究領域。結果，許多研究均忽略了這些領域之間的密切相互關係，特別是語言在身體中的自然基礎及其在人類生命早期的發展。這些研究因而以一種現象學式的理解，將語言視為自主的、基礎的。這些提議固然有一定道理，卻忽視了自然、身體、語言以及語意發展的基礎作用，這是一個嚴重的缺失。本項目彌補了這方面研究的空白。 同時，梅洛-龐蒂的跨學科現象學提供了一個原創的、具建設性和批判性的框架，以解釋生命、心靈以及語言科學等等的一系列實證研究成果，從而交織出一幅綜合的圖像，表達出人類這象徵性動物已經歷演化並正在經歷個體發生（ontogeny）的狀況。為此，本項目解釋並整合了來自發展心理學、神經語言學、演化生物學、身勢研究以及具身認知科學的發現。

24611822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24611822.value: 空間的社會生產：以台北士林為例

24611822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24611822.value: With the globalisation of East Asian cities in recent decades, there has been a proliferation of new public buildings such as theatres and museums, often commissioned by ambitious local governments and designed by international star architects. As part of urban redevelopment agendas, these buildings significantly impact the urban spaces surrounding them. While meant to enrich public cultural life, the question is whose culture and whose public life is enhanced? In the processes of developing such architecture, politicians, planners, and architects present idealised views of the city; however, the situated perspectives of people on the ground are often overlooked, resulting in ‘public’ projects that lack the active involvement of a large part of the population. In academic studies, iconic architecture is often interpreted as a vehicle for urban entrepreneurialism or analysed based on its representational values. Some studies have documented differences in the understandings of the meaning of space between those in power and local users. Few scholars, however, have considered how the production processes of iconic architecture affect urban space or what types of new urban spaces such processes create. The proposed study will redirect the research of iconic buildings away from absolute interpretations of architecture towards a critical reflection on the social production of urban space, based on a theoretical framework by Lefebvre (1991), that interprets space as a complex social product that is based on the social construction of values and meanings. This theory has deeply influenced the discipline of urban studies and will be a useful reference in an examination of the production of iconic buildings in East Asia. The proposed study will contribute by (1) presenting a critical empirical account of the planning process of the urban spaces around the Taipei Performing Arts Centre (TPAC), a typical case of a top-down planned global iconic building, through meticulous document review and interviews; (2) exploring how urban space is socially produced by applying a Lefebvrian analysis to study the conceived, perceived and lived aspects of space for various stakeholders; (3) contributing to theoretical debates on iconic architecture by critically reviewing how such buildings should be evaluated; and (4) summarising steps to evaluate iconic buildings and making practical recommendations to actively involve multiple stakeholders in future projects. More generally, this study will provide a better understanding of the social production of urban spaces around iconic architectural projects and provide a new perspective on such buildings in an Asian context. 隨著近數十年東亞城市全球化，大量新公共建築如劇院和博物館湧現，通常由雄心勃勃的地方政府委託建造，並由國際頂級建築師設計。這些建築作為城市重建計劃的一部分，非常影響周遭城市空間。雖然旨在令公共文化生活更豐富，但到底改善了「誰」的文化和「誰」的公共生活？政治家、規劃師和建築師在發展過程中提出關於城市的理想觀點，然而公眾的切身觀點往往被忽略，導致很多「公共」計劃缺乏大多數人積極參與。 學術研究中，地標建築通常詮釋為城市企業主義的載體，這些建築的象徵價值或會受分析。有些研究記錄了當權者和當地用家理解空間意義的差異。然而，很少學者考慮地標建築建造的過程如何影響城市空間，或這些過程創造了甚麼新的城市空間類型。 擬議研究建基於列斐伏爾 (Lefebvre)（1991）的理論框架，將地標建築的研究從建築的絕對詮釋，轉為城市空間社會生產的批判反思。列斐伏爾的理論框架將空間詮釋為複雜社會產物，這個產物建基於社會建構的價值和意義。這理論深深影響城市研究領域，並會是有用的參考，有助調查東亞地標建築是如何建造的。 擬議研究會（1）針對臺北表演藝術中心（北藝中心）周邊城市空間規劃的過程（這個全球地標建築是從上而下規劃的典型案例），仔細回顧文獻和進行採訪，提出批判實證報告；（2）運用列斐伏爾式分析，研究各種持分者構思、感知和生活層面的空間，探索城市空間如何由社會生產；（3）藉著思辨如何評估地標建築，促進地標建築理論的辨論；（4）歸納評估地標建築的步驟，並提出切實可行的建議，讓眾多持份者積極參與未來項目。 廣而言之，此研究有助理解地標建築項目周遭城市空間的社會生產，並以亞洲為背景提出此類建築的新觀點。

24612422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24612422.value: 在兩黨對抗背景下，增加對反對黨觀點的瞭解能否減少社交媒體用戶之間的黨派仇恨？

24612422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24612422.value: 最初我們樂觀地認為，社交媒體可能會使人們的觀點更加多樣化。但是隨著社交媒體不斷發展，人們開始越來越擔心，社會媒體可能會通過形成“回音室”將不同觀點的人群分隔開來，從而加劇了政治兩極分化。此外，越來越多的證據表明，黨派分歧是如此根深蒂固，以至於導致了社會關係中的黨派仇恨。 群際接觸理論認為，削弱黨派間偏見的關鍵在於將黨派群體從其封閉的圈子中聯繫起來，然而此類嘗試的效果並不能令人滿意。首先，如果僅僅是簡單地接觸對立的政治觀點，可能會產生適得其反的效果。例如，當黨派人士接收到與其信仰相反的觀點，他們可能會變得更加極端從而奮力反駁。其次，一些研究發現了一種高層次的身份認同感對黨派間聯繫可能具有積極作用。然而目前尚不清楚，在特定調查中起到刺激作用的因素是否能夠在現實世界複雜的政治環境中推廣。 本研究提出了一種新的方法，可以使黨派之間的接觸更加有效，也能夠測試社交媒體用戶之間的長期接觸。如果“簡單”地接觸對立的政治觀點可能導致事與願違的結果，我們進一步考慮能否進行特定的“操作”阻止這種事與願違的結果？本研究假設，接觸雙方黨派的觀點有助於減少黨派敵意。當黨派人士從敵對黨派那裡瞭解到具有共通之處的特徵（例如對國家的身份認同），他們可能會減少對其他黨派的敵意，此時兩個黨派之間一致的高層級的身份認同感會比他們的黨派身份更加突出。 為了檢驗兩黨接觸假說，我創新性地設計了一個線上實驗，實驗物件是大規模抽樣的民主黨和共和黨的Twitter用戶。該實驗將參與者隨機分配到處理組中，使他們在Twitter中持續一個月關注一個研究機器人，並讓他們接觸到隨機的（簡單地）或者接觸到兩個黨派的（操作地）意見領袖的資訊。我也設計了一個新的方法論框架，利用Twitter中的數位追蹤資料對潛在的黨派群體的文本進行分類，從而進行實驗處理、以及提供有關兩黨特徵的實證概況。 這項實驗結果將促進對黨派如何改變信仰的理解，並為改進社交媒體平臺的解決方案提供經驗證據。本研究中的分類方法同樣適用於任何涉及群體衝突的文本資料的研究，並鼓勵研究者推進關於跨群體對話的社會學和傳播學理論。

24616922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24616922.value: 作爲知識生產的翻譯：《中國評論》（The China Review，1872-1901）的英譯中文小説

24616922.label: Project Objectives
24616922.value: To collect all English translations of Chinese fiction in the China Review, to identify their source texts and translators, and to describe the translations in terms of publication dates, subgenre division, textual characteristics, and proportion and positioning in the China Review. To scrutinise the translation choices and strategies indicative of mediation and manipulation in terms of generic identification, thematic and character interpretation, and narrative reconstruction, to analyse the conceptions and knowledge shaped through translation as to what constitutes and characterises Chinese fiction as well as their comparability with the English counterpart. To explain the translation features and mechanism in relation to Sinological studies and the periodical publication contexts. To define the role of translation in the China Review in constructing the conceptions and knowledge about Chinese fiction in the Anglophone world, to propose Sinological literary translation as a scholarly practice in our understanding of translation history by elucidating its knowledge-producing ability. To fill the critical gap in the history of translation and Sinology by restoring the historical and academic significance of the previously understudied body of English translations of Chinese fiction published in the China Review.

24616922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24616922.value: Published in Hong Kong from 1872 to 1901 with 514 research articles, 219 translations, and 1197 short “notes and queries” on Chinese subjects, The China Review, or Notes and Queries on the Far East is recognised by modern researchers as the first true English-language journal specialising in Sinology and arguably the most influential one on both public and scholarly knowledge about China in the nineteenth century. However, this prominent journal and its intellectual contributions have been unduly neglected in current scholarship on the history of Sinology, translation, or print media. To restore the academic significance of the China Review, this research presents an original historical study on one of its greatest contributions to Sinology: English translations of Chinese fiction, which constitutes not only a substantial part in the China Review but also a crucial chapter in the history of Chinese-English fiction translation. The China Review published the largest and most diverse collection of translated Chinese fiction in the nineteenth century, containing many classic works of various themes including the historical, romantic, and fantastic, and by eminent translators such as James Legge and Herbert Giles. This research examines fiction translations in the China Review to explore the role of translation in shaping the conceptions and knowledge of Chinese fiction in the Anglophone world when Western understandings about Chinese fiction were still forming in the nineteenth century. It adopts a historical approach with textual and contextual analysis to scrutinise the translation choices and strategies concerning generic identification, thematic and character interpretation, and narrative modes. Contextualising fiction translations in the broader Sinological studies and the modality and network of periodical publication, this research clarifies the historical process of how conceptions and knowledge as to what constitutes and characterises Chinese fiction have been produced with and through translation. Analysing the heterogeneous fiction translations in the China Review, this research posits that Sinological translation functioning as a scholarly practice gradually draws the generic boundaries, exemplifies the themes and characters, and negotiates the narrative features of Chinese fiction, delivering more profound conceptions and knowledge than ever before. This research makes a significant contribution to the history of translation and Sinology by providing the first contextualised study of fiction translations in the China Review and its knowledge production process. It also sheds new lights on the history of literary translation by foregrounding its academic dynamics for a genealogical understanding of the intercultural discovery of Chinese fiction. 《中國評論》（The China Review）（又名《遠東釋疑》》（Notes and Queries on the Far East））被認爲是第一份真正的英文漢學研究期刊，它於1872年至1901年在香港出版，共發表中國主題的研究論文514篇、中文作品的英譯文219篇以及1197則簡短的釋疑筆記（“notes and queries”），成為十九世紀學界及公眾獲取中國各種知識的重要來源，本研究關注《中國評論》在生產及傳播中國知識方面一項尤為顯著的成就——小說翻譯。《中國評論》刊載的中文小說英譯，收錄了包括歷史、才子佳人、神怪等不同題材的經典作品，並由理雅各及翟理斯等著名漢學家翻譯，其數量及種類均在十九世紀英文漢學期刊中拔得頭籌，是中國小說英譯史上的一個重要章節。本研究從翻譯史的角度梳理《中國評論》刊載的中文小説英譯，將小説翻譯置於漢學研究及期刊出版模式的語境下，結合文本和背景分析，考察譯文在區分文類、詮釋小説主題和人物、以及敘事模式運用等方面所呈現出的思考和調整，探討十九世紀英語世界關於中國小説的概念和知識是如何通過翻譯塑造的。本研究認爲《中國評論》刊載的小説翻譯亦是漢學學術實踐的一種，譯者通過不同的翻譯策略和論述逐步劃定中國小説的文類邊界、呈現典型主題和人物形象、並改造中國小説的敘事手法，從而表述出對中國小説更爲深刻的理解。本研究填補了《中國評論》小説翻譯作爲漢學知識生產過程的研究空白，思考文學翻譯的學術作用和意義，對西方發現中國小説的早期歷史做出解釋。

24618722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24618722.value: 通過多元性運動訓練計劃促進護養院長者的行走能力：一項集群隨機對照試驗

24618722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24618722.value: Mobility allows older adults to maintain independence. Nearly 50% of older adults in assisted care facilities are frail and use mobility aids. They routinely rely on armrests, walkers, and handrails for support. Our previous studies have shown that over 20% of falls in care facilities occur during transferring owing to poor trunk control. People often use the upper limbs to protect themselves from hitting their heads when they fall. Therefore, upper limb and core strength training is essential for older adults to ensure that they can safely perform daily activities and prevent injury. However, existing exercise programs mainly focus on lower limb strength. Moreover, most programs are not designed or delivered to suit people with different functional capacities. In the proposed study, we will examine the effects of a multicomponent physical activity program that we previously developed, called Mobility-Fit, on mobility and frailty in older adults living in care facilities. Mobility-Fit targets functional mobility and lower limb strength, but it also incorporates upper limb and core strengthening. Mobility-Fit has been tested for feasibility and was shown to improve muscular strength and sit-to-stand performance among frail older adults in assisted care facilities. In the proposed study, 144 participants will be recruited from eight local care facilities for a 12-week intervention program. They will be randomly assigned to Mobility-Fit (intervention group) or a regular facility-based lower limb strengthening program (control group). The participants will then be followed for 9 months. To evaluate the Mobility-Fit program, we will first compare changes in outcome measures of strength, mobility, frailty, and fall efficacy between the two groups. We will also examine how the daily physical activity level and performance (measured by a wearable sensor) are influenced by the intervention. Second, we will examine whether the program benefits older adults with different degrees of frailty and physical and cognitive function through subgroup analyses. Finally, we will evaluate program implementation including intervention fidelity, barriers to and facilitators of program delivery (via interviews), and health economics. We hypothesize that participants in the Mobility-Fit program will show greater improvement in the measures of muscular strength, trunk stability, mobility, and daily physical activity performance than those in the regular program. Data from interviews will guide future scale-up implementation of our program. Collectively, our study may provide evidence that Mobility-Fit can enhance the safe mobility of older adults in care facilities and have a positive impact on their quality of life. 行走能力使長者能夠保持獨立。 在輔助護理機構中，近 50% 的長者身體虛弱並使用助行器。 他們通常依靠座椅扶手、助行器和房間扶手來支撐平衡。 我們之前的研究表明，由於軀幹控制能力不佳，超過 20% 的護養院長者在身體轉移過程中發生跌倒。 一般長者經常在跌倒時使用上肢來保護自己免於撞到頭部， 因此，上肢和核心肌肉訓練對於長者來說是重要的，以確保他們能夠安全地進行日常活動並防止跌倒時受傷。然而，現有的運動訓練計劃主要側重於下肢力量， 此外，大多數計劃的設計或教程並沒有考慮適合身體能力不同的人。這項擬議的研究將检验我們之前開發的稱為 Mobility-Fit 的多元性運動訓練計劃對居住在護養院的長者的行走能力和身體虛弱程度的影響。 Mobility-Fit 以改善行動靈活性和下肢力量為目標，同時也結合了上肢和核心力量強化。 Mobility-Fit 已經通過可行性測試，並被證明可以提高護養院體弱的長者的肌肉力量和坐立功能。具體而言，在擬議的研究中，我們將從 8 個當地護養院招募 144 名參與者進行為期 12 週的干預計劃。 參與者將被隨機分配到 Mobility-Fit（干預組）或基於常規護理的下肢強化訓練（對照組）， 然後參與者將被跟進 9 個月。 為了評估 Mobility-Fit 訓練計劃，我們將首先比較兩組參與者之間的肌肉力量、活動能力、虛弱程度和跌倒效能量表的測量值的變化。 我們還將同時研究日常身體活動水平和表現（由可穿戴傳感器測量）如何受到干預的影響。 其次，我們將通過亞群組分析檢驗該訓練計劃是否有益於不同身體虛弱程度以及認知功能程度的長者。 最後，我們將評估項目實施，包括干預的精確度、項目實施的障礙和促進因素（通過訪談）以及健康經濟學。我們假設 Mobility-Fit 計劃的參與者在肌肉力量、軀幹穩定性、靈活性和日常身體活動表現方面的改善將比常規計劃的參與者更大。 訪談數據可能會指導我們未來計劃的擴大與實施。 總的來說，我們希望這項研究可以提供證據表明 Mobility-Fit提高護養院長者的活動行走能力，並對他們的生活質量產生積極影響。

24620822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24620822.value: 勞工平台的道德經濟：香港和臺灣平台權力的比較研究

24620822.label: Project Objectives
24620822.value: To describe and explain the articulation and contestation of platform-based moral economies such as the circulation of moral discourses through an examination of the tensions among labor platforms, regulators, and platform workers in Hong Kong and Taiwan. To contextualize possible changes in platform-based moral economies in Hong Kong and Taiwan through an analysis of specific platforms’ discourses and relevant policy documents. To place the platform economy in Hong Kong and Taiwan in the global context by investigating how multinational labor platforms adapt to local regulations and visions of smart urbanism. To theorize platforms as political actors and to inform on-going policy debates on how best to regulate platforms in smart urban mobility through a comparative case study of labor platforms in Hong Kong and Taiwan.

24620822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24620822.value: The past decade has seen the exponential growth of digitally-enabled labor platforms such as Uber, DiDi, foodpanda, DoorDash, and Upwork across the globe. Labor platforms position themselves as digital intermediaries and rely on algorithmic, data-driven technologies to coordinate economic activities. Platforms have disrupted many economic sectors and presented complex legal challenges to transportation regulations, protection of labor rights, and anti-monopoly laws at the global level. In news media narratives, platforms seemingly are “too big to fail,” while regulatory systems cannot keep with the pace of technological advancement. Similarly, many academic studies have directed attention to how platforms consolidate their power through the deployment of algorithmic technologies, accumulation of network effects, and exploitation of legal gray zones. While these scholarly and journalistic accounts have offered insights into the technological, legal, and economic dimensions of platform power, we know less about how platforms grow and expand their political power in different regulatory contexts. The planned 30-month qualitative and comparative project will investigate how ride-hailing and delivery platforms actively mobilize their users and public discourses to alter regulatory frameworks in favor of their operation in Hong Kong and Taiwan. Bringing together the sociological literature on moral economies and platform studies, it will examine how platforms deploy moral values and sentiments to legitimize their business when they operate in legal gray zones. It will also interrogate how different stakeholders, such as regulators and platform workers, articulate moral values to contest platform-initiated moral discourses. Drawing on a combination of hybrid digital and qualitative methods consisting of platform biography, textual analysis, virtual ethnography, and in-depth interviews, the project will discuss how platforms adapt to local regulations and visions of smart urbanism in Hong Kong and Taiwan. This project will make four theoretical and practical contributions to advance knowledge about platform governance. First, by conceptualizing platforms as political actors, it will contribute to understanding the ways that platforms can mobilize moral values and sentiments to push for favorable regulations. Second, it will critically assess the tensions among platforms, workers, policy-makers, and other stakeholders to understand how platforms, particularly multinational platforms adapt to local regulations. Third, it will map the socio-legal history of platform governance in Hong Kong and Taiwan. This non-Western perspective will help to theorize the varieties of platform power and platform capitalism. Fourth, it will inform public and policy discussions about whether and how best to regulate urban mobility platforms in the greater Chinese society. 在過去的十年，勞工平台例如Uber、滴滴出行、foodpanda、DoorDash 和 Upwork等在世界各地快速興起。以數位平台為媒介，勞工平台將自己定位為中介，並依靠演算法及大數據來協調經濟活動。平台的出現，影響了許多傳統經濟產業的運作，並對全球的交通法規、勞工權利保障和反壟斷法，帶來新的法律挑戰。在新聞媒體的論述中，平台似乎「大到不能倒」，而且政府的監管往往跟不上科技發展的步伐。與此同時，學術研究集中討論平台如何通過演算法、網絡效應，以及遊走法律邊緣，以鞏固平台的發展和權力。雖然這些研究和論述有助於理解平台權力的科技、法律和經濟層面，但我們對平台如何在不同的監管環境中，發展和擴大其政治權力的認知相對較少。這個定性和比較研究將分析網約車和速遞平台，如何積極動員其用戶和公眾輿論，以影響監管框架，及支持其在香港和臺灣的運作。建基於道德經濟和平台研究的文獻，本研究希望了解平台如何在遊走法律邊緣的同時，透過道德價值和規範的論述，去合理化它們的運作。本研究還將探討不同的持份者，例如監管機構和平台勞工，如何表達道德價值觀來對抗平台的論述。本研究結合了數位和定性研究方法，包括平台傳記、文本分析、網路民族誌和深度訪談等，以探討平台如何適應香港和臺灣的當地法規和智慧城市的願景。本研究有四項貢獻。第一，通過將平台理解為政治行動者，我們可以更有效去理解平台如何透過道德價值和規範的論述，以推動有利它們發展的法規。第二，它將批判性地評估平台、工人、政策制定者和其他持份者之間的權力關係，以了解平台，特別是跨國平台如何適應當地法規。第三，它將描繪香港和臺灣平台治理的社會法律史。這種非西方中心視角將有助於理論化平台權力和平台資本主義的多樣性。第四，它將有助於公眾和政策制定者去思考是否以及如何有效地規管平台城市交通平台。

24621122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24621122.value: 付費牆與新聞業文化：對中國大陸、香港、台灣六家媒體的比較研究

24621122.label: Project Objectives
24621122.value: To provide a systematic evaluation of the influence of the subscription model on journalism culture. Previous studies overwhelmingly focus on the business aspect, whereas the changes in the newsrooms have been understudied. To understand how macro (political and economic), meso (organizational), and micro (individual) factors affect this influence. It includes a comprehensive set of moderating factors. To fill a gap in the literature on journalism culture by providing a comparative analysis in three non-Western societies with varying degrees of democracy. The comparative approach is essential to the studies on journalism culture. To evaluate and refine the theoretical framework of journalism culture from the perspective of change and transformation. To sum up the best journalistic practices under the subscription model and share them with the media industry.

24621122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24621122.value: Facing the financial crisis in journalism, a number of leading news organizations across the globe have adopted a subscription model to make up for their plummeting advertising revenues. They have set up paywalls to limit the audiences’ access to all or some digital news content if they have not paid a subscription fee. So far, academic studies have mainly examined the business and strategy aspects of the paywall, paying less attention to the influence of the paywall on the way journalists do their work and perceive their professional values and roles. In this proposed study, I borrow Hanitzsch’s (2007) theoretical framework of journalism culture to examine this influence. Specifically, I aim to (1) gain a refreshed understanding of journalists’ role perceptions under the subscription model, especially on the neutral-advocate dimension and the relation to audiences; (2) examine how journalists reflect on the issue of objectivity and truth under this new model; and (3) identify any changes in the ethical standards and guidelines in paywalled newsrooms. I will select six prominent media outlets in the three regions that have adopted the subscription model: Caixin and Southern Weekly in mainland China, South China Morning Post and Initium Media in Hong Kong, and CommonWealth Magazine and Storm Media in Taiwan. There are significant variances among these cases. I will examine how macro (political and economic), meso (organizational), and micro (individual) factors affect journalists’ reactions to the subscription model. In terms of empirical strategies, I will firstly conduct a systematic content analysis of these media outlets, with a focus on whether their topical focus and style have changed after switching to the subscription model. Then, I will pay visits to the six newsrooms and conduct semi-structured, in-depth interviews with around 15 executives and journalists from each newsroom. Qualitative methods will be used to analyze the interview transcripts and research notes, following a thematic coding approach. This comparative study will contribute to the literature on journalism culture and media innovations in the digital era and provide practical implications for newsrooms experimenting with the subscription model. 面對新聞業的財政危機，全球許多領先的新聞機構都採用訂閱模式來彌補其廣告收入的暴跌。它們設置了「付費牆」（paywall），如果讀者未支付訂閱費，就無法訪問它們網站上的全部或部分內容。迄今為止，學術研究主要從商業策略的角度研究了付費牆，很少人關注付費牆對記者的工作方式以及對其專業價值和角色認知的影響。在這項研究中，我借用Hanitzsch (2007) 的「新聞文化」（journalism culture）理論框架來檢驗這種影響。具體而言，我的目標是（1）重新理解訂閱模式下記者的角色認知，特別是在「中立-倡導」維度和與受眾的關係方面；（2）考察記者在這種新模式下如何反思客觀性和真實性問題；（3）探索訂閲制下的新聞編輯室當中的職業道德標準的任何變化。我將選擇三個地區採用訂閱模式的六家知名媒體：中國大陸的《財新》和《南方週末》，香港的《南華早報》和端傳媒，以及台灣的《天下》雜誌和風傳媒。這些案例之間存在顯著差異。我將研究宏觀（政治和經濟）、中觀（組織）和微觀（個人）因素如何影響記者對訂閱模式的反應。在具體方法上，我將首先對這些媒體進行系統的內容分析，重點關注它們在切換到訂閱模式後的話題焦點和風格是否發生了變化。然後，我將走訪六家新聞編輯室，對來自每個新聞編輯室的大約 15 名高管和記者進行半結構化的深度採訪。遵循主題編碼的定性方法將用於分析訪談記錄和研究筆記。這項比較研究將為數字時代新聞文化和媒體創新的文獻提供貢獻，並為實驗訂閱模式的新聞編輯室提供參考信息。

24621722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24621722.value: 針對中國農村老年認知障礙家庭照顧者的培訓干預之成效：一項隨機對照的可行性試驗

24621722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24621722.value: Dementia has become a worldwide public health priority due to continued population ageing. China has the world’s largest dementia population. This debilitating disease has and will continue to bring tremendous challenges to the health and long-term care systems in mainland China. Addressing limited dementia literacy has been recommended as a priority in dementia care in China. Interventions focused on dementia knowledge and training for family caregivers have been conducted in urban regions, such as Hong Kong and Guangzhou. Despite a higher prevalence of dementia in rural areas, no dementia family caregiver training intervention studies have been conducted in rural China. In response to this unmet need and significant knowledge gap, the proposed study aims to adapt and evaluate the effectiveness of an existing evidence-based skills training and support programme (namely, the iSupport for Dementia programme developed by the World Health Organization) for family caregivers of older adults with dementia in rural China. Specifically, the proposed study has two research objectives. First, I propose to conduct individual in-depth qualitative interviews with local family caregivers regarding their caregiving experiences and needs and focus group discussions with local healthcare providers to inform the adaptation of the iSupport programme to respond to the rural context. Especially, the integration of narratives and story lines generated by the qualitative data will enhance the relevancy of the intervention among the local family caregivers. Second, I propose to conduct a two-arm randomised controlled feasibility trial to evaluate the preliminary effectiveness of the adapted iSupport programme delivered in a traditional face-to-face format (Arm 1) versus a wait-list control group (Arm 2). Treatment outcomes, including dementia knowledge and caregiving self-efficacy, and caregiver burden and depressive symptoms, will be measured at baseline (T1), 3 months after baseline (T2), and 6 months after baseline (T3), using validated instruments. Feasibility measures (i.e., retention rate and treatment usability) will also be included. Treatment outcomes will be analyzed by mixed-effect regression models. This is the first randomised controlled trial focused on training and supporting family caregivers of older adults with dementia in rural China. The proposed study will generate crucial empirical evidence on the initial effectiveness of the culturally-adapted caregiver training programme in rural China. Ultimately, the findings could identify the optimal ingredients of a dementia caregiver training programme for the rural context to be tested in a future full-scale pragmatic trial to benefit even more dementia family caregivers in rural China. 由於人口持續老齡化，認知障礙已成為全球公共衛生的重點問題。中國的認知障礙人口位居世界第一。這種衰竭性疾病將繼續給中國大陸的衛生系統和長期照顧系統帶來巨大挑戰。在中國，解決認知障礙的認識不足已被列為認知障礙護理的優先事項。在城市地區（如香港和廣州），已經開展了以認知障礙症知識和家庭照顧者培訓為重點的干預措施。儘管農村地區的認知障礙病發率更高，但尚未有針對中國農村地區認知障礙症家庭照顧者的培訓干預研究。鑒於這一未滿足的需求和重要的知識空白，本研究旨在調試和評估一項現有的循證性技能培訓和支持專案（即由世界衛生組織開發的iSupport for Dementia專案）在中國農村地區認知障礙患者家庭照顧者中的效果。 具體而言，本研究擬定兩個目標。首先，我計畫對當地家庭照顧者進行深度質性訪談以瞭解他們的護理經驗和需求，並對當地醫護人員進行焦點小組訪談，以便為iSupport專案的調試提供資料，使其能適應農村的環境。尤為特別的是，對敘述和故事線進行整合產生的質性數據將增強干預措施在當地家庭照顧者中的關聯性。第二，我計畫開展一項雙臂隨機可行性試驗，以評估和比對通過傳統面對面形式推廣的的調試版iSupport專案與等待對照組的初步效果。治療結果（包括認知障礙知識和照顧者的自我效能，以及照顧者的負擔和抑鬱症狀）都將採用通過驗證的測量工具進行評估，評估時間為：正式干預前（基線/T1），基線後3個月（T2）以及和基線後6個月（T3）。此外亦包含可行性測量（即保留率和治療的可用性）。治療結果將通過混合效應回歸模型進行分析。 這是第一個專注於培訓和支持中國農村老年認知障礙患者家庭照顧者的隨機對照試驗。這項研究將為在中國農村推行文化適應性照顧者培訓專案的初步成效提供重要的經驗依據。研究結果可以確定適合農村環境的認知障礙家庭照顧者培訓專案的要素，並在未來的全面試驗中進行測試，從而使中國農村更多的認知障礙家庭照顧者得到幫助。

24621822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24621822.value: 社交網絡、信息獲取與福利

24621822.label: Project Objectives
24621822.value: To enhance our understanding of the welfare effects of public information. The existing research on the welfare effects of public information abstracts away the possibilities that agents are ex-ante heterogeneous, and in particular, they interact through social networks. In real life, people may want to coordinate more with their friends than with strangers. Also, the assumption that agents are ex-ante homogenous excludes Cournot and Bertrand competition with product differentiation. These are natural strategic environments to consider, and hence the existing research has a limitation in its applicability. Our project fills this gap by incorporating the network of heterogenous interaction into the model. To show how interactions through social networks affect information acquisition. The PI’s previous research has also studied the welfare effects of public information with the network of heterogeneous interaction. One important simplification in the previous research is to assume that agents do not engage in information acquisition by themselves. However, in many real life settings, agents such as investors and firms often acquire information privately in addition to the publicly available information. Also, it may be reasonable to assume that more precise public information crowds out agents’ private information acquisition, or at least affects their incentive for information acquisition. Thus, it is important to consider endogenous information acquisition to understand the welfare effects of public information. To show that different network structures can qualitatively change our prediction of the social value of information. There are many real policies that disseminate public information: central banks provide GDP estimates, and trade associations publish industry average sales. We will show that the welfare effects of public information can be positive or negative depending on the underlying network structures. This implies that, to provide useful theoretical predictions with policymakers, analysts need data about the underlying interaction structure such as investors’ funding size and product substitutability/complementarity.
