24621822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24621822.value: 許多社會經濟互動在網絡中發生。例如，當同一技術被親密的朋友或同事採用時，用戶從這項技術中獲得的效用可能比被無關的用戶採用時要高。同樣，一個零售商可能更容易受到附近零售商降價的影響，而不是遠距離零售商。 這些類型的網絡交互大多數發生在不確定的情况下，人們往往通過自己的努力獲取信息以降低他們的不確定性。一個新技術的潛在用戶可能不知道其質量，因此可能會收集有關其使用的信息。一個零售商可能不了解他們的產品需求，因此可能會進行市場調查。 在這些環境中，由於獲取信息的成本很高，在均衡狀態時獲取信息的準確性取決於決策者或統計局提供的公共信息的質量。此外，由於私人信息對公眾的相對價值取決於代理人想與其他代理人的保持一致行為的意願，社會互動的網絡結構也會影響信息獲取的均衡。 這篇論文旨在描述異質交互網絡如何影響私人信息獲取的均衡和更精確的公共信息帶來的福利效應。著眼於 Morris 和 Shins（2002）選美比賽模型的網絡擴展，我們的初步分析表明，稱為 Katz-Bonacich 中心性的網絡中心性概念可用於表徵信息獲取的均衡，並發現更多的中心代理獲取的私人信息更少。公共信息的社會價值也被表示為代理人的 Katz-Bonacich 中心性的簡單二次函數。 相對於現有的關於信息社會價值的論文，我們的模型的新穎之處在於通過社交網絡進行的異質交互。通過採用一般的二次收益類，我們的應用將不僅包括選美的網絡模型，還包括具有產品差異化的古諾和柏氏競爭。

25100122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25100122.value: 通過加速度測量日常生活步態質量以預測跌倒：一項前瞻性研究

25100122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25100122.value: 約三分之一，在社區居住長者每年至少跌倒一次。據估計，2002年香港與跌倒有關的額外醫療服務費用超過5.52億港元。鑒於老年人口自那時以來已經翻倍，並且到2050年將再次翻倍，與跌倒有關的額外醫療服務費用已大幅增加，並將不斷增長。跌倒預防措施可以減少高達 50%的跌倒風險。許多國際指南亦建議對有跌倒風險的老年人提供針對性的治療。 長久以來，平衡與步行穩定性一直被認為是最重要而且可被調控的跌倒風險因素之一。可是，現時的評估方案對跌倒的預測存在不足。現時針對跌倒風險的臨床評估一般會通過測量完成某些 任務所需的時間 或 臨床判斷，間接或主觀地評估平衡力和跌倒風險。這些評估也僅能捕捉到被測試者在實驗室中短時間內的表現。而實驗室中的表現亦已被證實與日常生活中的表現有所不同。因此，在現實生活中對步態質量進行客觀和長時間的測量有可能大大改善預測跌倒的準確度，但這一直難以實踐。 得益於近年基於加速度測量來評估步態的研究發展，讓評估日常生活步態質量變得可行。通過在腰部佩戴一個加速度計，便可持續地監測日常活動中的步行穩定性。我們的團隊已經證明，基於加速度計測量所得的日常生活步態質量綜合指數能夠預測老年人的跌倒（AUC = 0.66-0.72）。通過評估跌倒風險的額外維度，日常生活步態質量具備良好的潛力來提升對高跌倒風險者的識別能力。然而，要証明日常生活步態質量在臨床跌倒風險評估中的實用性，我們需要驗證在現存的跌倒風險評估框架上，測量日常生活步態質量能否進一步改進對老年人跌倒的預測。因此，此研究旨在探討（1）在調整現存跌倒風險評估中測量的相關因數後，日常生活步態質量綜合評分是否仍是跌倒的獨立預測因數，如果是，（2）組合模型在跌倒預測方面是否比任何單獨的評估具有更高的準確度。 此研究將闡明基於加速度評估的日常生活步態質量在預測跌倒的臨床實用性。瞭解基於加速度測量所評估的步態與其他體格檢查的獨立跌倒預測能力，將可優化識別高跌倒風險長者的臨床篩檢方案，以便為他們提供進一步的跌倒預防措施。我們假設，將這兩種評估方法結合起來可以顯著提高跌倒預測能力。

25206422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25206422.value: 风险感知的机器学习系统及其在安全与质量关键系统中的应用

25206422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25206422.value: The past few years have witnessed the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) in solving long-standing problems. AI/ML has played an indispensable role in profoundly transforming business, transportation, and finance. However, the adoption of AI/ML in risk-sensitive areas is still in its infancy because AI/ML systems exhibit fundamental limits and practical shortcomings: the field of AI/ML lacks a rigorous framework for reasoning about risk, uncertainty, and their potentially catastrophic outcomes, while safety and quality implications are top priorities in practice across a broad array of high-stakes applications that range from medical diagnosis to aerospace systems. Since the consequences of AI/ML system failures in life and safety-critical applications can be disastrous, it is becoming abundantly clear that, reasoning about uncertainty and risk will become a cornerstone when adopting AI/ML systems in large-scale risk-sensitive applications. As ML systems face varied risks arising from the input data (e.g., data bias, dataset shift etc.) as well as the ML model (e.g., model bias, model misspecification, etc.), the goal of this project is to develop a systematic risk-aware ML framework that consists of a series of control checkpoints to safeguard ML systems against potential risks to increase the credibility of adopting ML system in critical applications. Towards this goal, this project consists of three coherent tasks: (1) develop an integrated approach for data quality monitoring by combining feature-based anomaly detection technique with outcome-based uncertainty measure. The developed integrated approach will produce a composite probabilistic risk indicator to reveal input data quality; (2) develop a two-stage ML-based framework to estimate model reliability for individual prediction (MRIP). MRIP characterizes the probability of the observed difference between model prediction and actual value being within a tiny interval while model input varies within a small prescribed range, and it provides an individualized estimation on model prediction reliability for each input x. (3) develop a ML model to learn system-level risk. A ML model will be developed to map data-level and model-level risk indicators derived in the first two tasks to a risk measure at the system level. The proposed effort has profound practical implications, the risk-aware framework will act as an effective safety barrier in preventing ML models from making over-confident predictions on cases that are either too noisy, anomalous, outside the domain of the trained model, or with low model prediction reliability, thus facilitating safe and reliable adoption of ML systems in critical applications. 过去几年，我们见证了人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）在解决一些长期存在的问题方面发挥的巨大作用。目前，AI/ML在改变商业、交通和金融等方面发挥了不可或缺的作用。然而，AI/ML在风险敏感领域的应用仍处于起步阶段，因为AI/ML系统表现出基本的局限性和应用缺陷：AI/ML领域缺乏一个严格的框架来推理风险、不确定性及其潜在的灾难性后果，而安全和质量保障是很多高风险领域（比如医疗诊断，航空航天系统）的首要需求。由于AI /ML系统在生命和安全关键应用中的失效可能导致灾难性的后果，因此，在大规模风险敏感应用中采用AI/ML系统时，对不确定性和风险的推理将成为一个至关重要的任务。 由于ML系统面临着来自输入数据（如数据偏差、数据漂移等）和ML模型（如模型偏差、模型错误指定等）的各种风险，本项目的目标是开发一个带有风险意识ML框架，该框架由一系列控制检查点组成从而保障ML系统免受潜在风险的影响，进而提高其在关键领域中应用的可信度。为了实现这一目标，本项目包括三个连贯的任务：（1）通过结合基于特征的异常检测技术和基于结果的不确定性测量方法，开发出一种数据质量监测的综合方法。这一综合方法将产生一个复合的概率性的风险指标，从而揭示输入数据的质量；（2）开发一个基于ML的两阶段框架来估计模型对于个体预测的可靠性（MRIP）。MRIP描述了当模型输入在一个小的规定范围内变化时，所观察到的模型预测值和实际值之间的差异在一个微小的区间内的概率，它对每个输入x的模型预测提供了一个个性化的可靠性估计；（3）开发一个ML模型来学习系统层面的风险。我们将开发一个ML模型，将前两个任务中得出的数据层面和模型层面的风险指标进行映射，从而建立系统层面的风险度量。 我们拟开展的工作具有深远的实际意义，这一风险意识框架将作为一个有效的安全屏障防止ML模型对噪音过大、异常数据、超出训练模型领域或模型预测可靠性低的情况做出过于自信的预测，从而促进ML系统在关键应用中安全可靠的采用。

25206822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25206822.value: 高效的太陽能計劃設計和住宅能源選擇：用代理人基模型（ABM）來最大限度地增加家庭參與度

25206822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25206822.value: Buildings are major contributors to energy and environmental problems, as responsible for the largest share of global energy consumption. This concern has led to a new energy paradigm shift from centralized generation to distributed generation (DG) with renewable energy. Thanks to abundant sunlight and rooftop/wall spaces in cities, installing residential solar photovoltaic (PV) systems is recognized to be an accessible and promising form of DG in the urban environment. Despite its significance, understanding the dynamics of residential solar PV diffusion is extremely challenging because it involves individual-level decisions and behaviours. While conventional diffusion models often fail to explain the influence of individual behaviour on overall diffusion, the advent of agent-based modelling (ABM) has enabled many researchers to explicitly capture individual heterogeneity and dynamic interactions between households in understanding and modelling residential solar PV adoption behaviour. More importantly, existing literature on residential solar PV adoption is limited to explaining solar PV installation of homeowners with individually-owned rooftops, thereby largely neglecting other types of households. In other words, previous studies lack theoretical discussion on the mechanism behind solar PV adoption of individuals who are unable to install solar panels on their rooftops, such as flatowners and tenants. Although innovative solar programmes have emerged for these types of households, residential solar PV adoption behaviour that considers alternative solar programme options and their impact on overall diffusion have been unexplored. To address this gap in the literature, this research project aims to develop a comprehensive and novel ABM approach for residential energy choices, more specifically, residential solar PV adoption decision, given alternative options in vertical cities. The proposed ABM framework consists of the following three hierarchical procedures: (1) PART 1: Identifying the determinants of residential solar PV adoption in vertical cities; (2) PART 2: Modelling residential solar PV adoption behaviour given alternative solar programme options using the ABM approach; and (3) PART 3: Evaluating alternative solar programme design scenarios through policy testing. The proposed ABM approach will be calibrated and validated in the Hong Kong context, which yet remains unexplored by any other researcher. With its high urban density, Hong Kong is one of the most intensive energy-consuming cities in the world where buildings account for 90% of total electricity consumption. This research project is expected to have a far-reaching impact on residential electricity customers at the individual level, stakeholders at the community level, and the general public at the societal level. 建築被視為能源與環境問題的主要來源，因為建築能源佔全球能源消耗的最大份額。此憂慮引發了集中式發電轉向運用新能源來分布式發電（DG）的新模式。由於城市中充足的陽光以及屋頂和牆壁的空間，安裝住宅式太陽能光伏（PV）系統被認為是在城市中發展DG的一種可行且有前景的模式。 儘管意義重大，但了解住宅式PV系統擴散發展的動態機理極具挑戰性，因為它涉及到個人層面的決策和行為。雖然傳統的擴散模型通常無法解釋個體行為對整體擴散的影響，但代理人基模型（ABM）的出現使許多學者能夠明確捕捉個體異質性和家庭之間的動態相互作用，以理解並建立住宅式PV系統採用行為的模型。更重要的是，現有關於住宅式PV系統採用的文獻僅限於解釋擁有私人屋頂的屋主的行為，因而很大程度上忽略了其他類型的家庭。換言之，以往的研究缺乏對無法在屋頂安裝PV系統的個人的背後機制及理論的討論，如公寓主人和租戶。儘管針對這些家庭類型已經出現了創新型太陽能計劃，但對於考慮了這些創新型太陽能計劃選項的住宅式PV系統的採用行為及其對整體擴散發展的影響尚未得到探索。 為了填補文獻中的這一空白，本研究項目旨在為住宅能源選擇開發一種全面而新穎的 ABM 決策方法，更具體地說，是在垂直城市中提供給住戶多種選擇的住宅式PV採用決策。擬議的 ABM 框架由以下三個層次程序組成： (1) 第 1 部分：確定垂直城市採用住宅式PV的決定因素； (2) 第 2 部分：使用 ABM 方法對在多種太陽能計劃選擇下的住宅式PV採用行為進行建模； (3) 第 3 部分：通過政策測試評估多種太陽能項目設計方案。擬議的 ABM 方法將在香港的大環境中進行校準和驗證，此方法尚未被任何其他學者探索研究。香港的城市密度高，建築物耗電佔總耗電量的 90%，是世界上能源消耗最密集的城市之一。總的來說，該研究項目將對個人層面的住宅用電用戶、社區層面的各利益相關者和社會層面的公眾產生深遠的影響。

25207822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25207822.value: 不依賴人工標註的大規模三維點雲語義幾何學習

25207822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25207822.value: 精確理解大規模三維點雲的語義信息對機器理解周圍環境至關重要。現有基於深度學習的方法，依賴於大量人工標註的數據用於訓練神經網絡。雖然這些方法取得了不錯的效果，但人工標註成本極高，而且訓練完成的神經網絡模型不能泛化到全新場景。本項目旨在擺脫對人工標註的依賴，通過無監督學習方法理解三維場景。具體地，本項目將設計無監督方法自主學習三維語義以及物體實例信息，並且通過多幀點雲學習恢復連續三維空間表面結構。本項目將直接促進大規模點雲的無監督理解，並節省大量人工標註成本，在諸多場景具有潛在應用價值。

25208322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25208322.value: 可感知錯誤的知識圖譜對比學習

25208322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25208322.value: A knowledge graph (KG) consists of numerous triples, in which each triple, i.e., (head entity, relation, tail entity), denotes an assertion. By embedding KGs into low-dimensional representations, we could integrate them into deep learning models to perform various tasks, such as search and recommendation. However, real-world KGs often contain many false assertions, e.g., (Bill_Gates, CEO, Microsoft). These errors are significantly affecting KG downstream applications. They were inevitably injected during the construction of KGs, in which heuristic algorithms were employed to extract knowledge from unstructured sources with noise. We propose to investigate error-aware KG learning to eliminate the impact of errors on KG-based systems. This is a challenging task since entities and triples have semantic meanings. Erroneous triples have diverse patterns, while labels are not available. A traditional solution is to construct logical rules to verify triples, but it is not generalizable. Recent studies focus on designing tailored classifiers or ranking triples based on KG embedding loss. However, they all rely on synthetic false triples to perform training. Given a positive triple, they replace its head or tail entity with a random entity. This is inconsistent with the fact that, in a real-world erroneous triple, e.g., (Bruce_Lee, Birthplace, Chinatown), the three elements are often relevant, although mismatched. Additionally, given the error detection results, e.g., scores indicating triple trustworthiness, it remains nontrivial to enable error-aware KG learning. Intuitive solutions may even degrade the performance. To this end, in this project, we will explore leveraging contrastive multi-view learning to advance KG error detection, and develop a widely applicable framework that could integrate off-the-shelf KG embedding models and make them error-aware. The learned error-aware latent representations could be directly used to perform downstream tasks. Our core idea is to consider triples as nodes and construct multiple triple graphs as different views. Triples could be evaluated according to the consistency in multiple views. Such triple-level contrastive evaluation could complement the detection based on synthetic false triples. Meanwhile, we would employ the learned trustworthiness to adaptively update the weighted aggregation in contrastive learning and margin loss in KG embedding. Then, potential errors would contribute little to KG learning. We will validate our error-aware framework on three applications, i.e., relation prediction, question answering over KGs, and KG-enhanced recommendations. Our outcomes will benefit various KG-based systems, including search engines, recommender systems, and conversational agents, by enabling error-aware learning and enhancing their prediction performance, e.g., presenting more accurate results to the public. 知識圖譜由海量的三元組構成。每個三元組包含頭實體、關繫、和尾實體，代表了一個論斷。通過被映射到低維向量表示，知識圖譜可被整合到深度學習模型中，以執行蒐索、推薦等各種任務。然而，現實中的知識圖譜經常包含許多錯誤的三元組，例如(比爾蓋茨，首席執行官，微軟)。這嚴重影響了知識圖譜的應用。知識圖譜多是從非結構化的文本中提取出來的，在這個構建過程中，錯誤被不可避免地引入了。 本項目研究可感知錯誤的知識圖譜學習，以消除錯誤三元組對下遊應用的影響。這是一項極具挑戰的任務，因爲實體和三元組具有豐富的語義。導緻三元組錯誤的原因有很多，但是被標注的錯誤三元組卻很難獲得。傳統的解決方案是構建邏輯規則來驗証三元組，但這並不具備普遍性。最近的研究集中在設計定製的分類器或根據知識圖譜表示學習中的損失對三元組進行排名。然而，這些解決方案都依賴於人工合成的三元組來進行訓練。將一個正確的三元組的頭實體或尾實體替換成任意其他的實體，即可獲得合成的錯誤三元組。但這與事實不符。現實中的錯誤三元組往往包含相關聯的實體和關繫，例如(李小龍，出生地，中國城)。此外，即使給定檢測結果，如所有三元組的可信度，要實現可感知錯誤的知識圖譜學習仍是具有挑戰的。 爲此，本項目開創性地將對比學習應用於知識圖譜錯誤檢測任務，並將開髮一個廣泛適用的框架，可以整合現有的知識圖譜表示學習模型並使其具有錯誤感知能力。學習到的消除了錯誤的向量表徵可直接用於下遊應用。我們的核心思想是將三元組視爲節點，並構建多個以三元組爲點的圖作爲不同的視圖。三元組在多個視圖中的一緻性可用於評估其可信性。這種以三元組爲點的對比學習可以與傳統的錯誤檢測相結合。同時，學到的三元組可信度可用來適應性地更新對比學習中的加權聚合和知識圖譜表示學習中的邊際損失，以減少錯誤對知識圖譜學習的影響。本項目將在三個應用上驗証所提出的框架，包括關繫預測，基於知識圖譜的問答，以及基於知識圖譜的推薦。 項目成果將有利於各種基於知識圖譜的繫統，包括蒐索引擎、推薦繫統和對話代理。通過實現可感知錯誤的學習，這些繫統的預測性能將得到提高，並向公衆展示更準確的蒐索結果或回答。

25211722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25211722.value: 本地預製工廠部署的最佳補貼計劃：最大化本地預製產品使用和最小化運輸排放

25211722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25211722.value: Prefabrication is a sustainable construction method, which is increasingly adopted worldwide to improve productivity and reduce environmental footprint. Many governments have begun to offer subsidies to manufacturers for establishing local prefabrication factories (LPFs) and coordinating their holistic deployment, to increase the uptake of prefabrication and ease the restrictions on transporting prefabricated components (PCs). However, the lack of sufficient LPFs is acknowledged to be the main obstacle hindering the wider adoption of prefabrication. The establishment of a network of LPFs requires various barriers to be overcome, such as the expensive investment in a prefabrication factory (PF), the limited subsidies, and the establishment of effective government–manufacturer–contractor relationship. The PC price in a newly established LPF is mainly determined by the LPF investment from the manufacturer and the subsidy from the government, and influences a contractor’s decision on how many PCs to purchase from the newly established LPF and existing PFs. Contractor procurement decisions in turn affect the government’s objectives on the establishments of LPFs (i.e., the use of local PCs and the carbon emitted by their transportation from PFs to sites). Thus, an effective subsidy plan must carefully consider the interacting effects of government, manufacturers, and contractors. However, current subsidy programs focus on a manufacturer’s investment, which only involve the government–manufacturer relationship but overlook the fundamentally important manufacturer–contractor relationship. The study will fill the gap by developing a bi-level model that assesses the real-life competitive interactions between manufacturers and contractors, and ultimately developing a tri-level model of a governmental subsidy program that can be used as a managerial tool to attract investment in LPFs in a region, thereby enhancing the maturity of local prefabrication market. The proposed models will inform the government on the optimum subsidy policy for a region which maximizes the local economy and the environmental benefits while incentivizing manufacturers because the chosen policy is constrained by the manufacturers’ needs to maximize their profit margins and the decisions made by contractors aimed at minimizing their costs. The Hong Kong government plans to establish LPFs because the quality of non-local PCs is often unsatisfactory. A case study of Hong Kong will be conducted to determine how this can be achieved, and if successful, the proposed models could also be applied to other countries/regions for the formulation of appropriate subsidy measures. This project will greatly contribute to the sustainability of the construction industry and the construction of more high-quality prefabricated buildings. 預製建造法是一種可持續的施工方法，越來越多的國家及地區正採用此方法來提高生產力和減少環境足跡。許多政府已開始向製造商提供補貼，用於在當地建立預製工廠並協調其整體部署，以增加預製件的使用並緩解預製件運輸的限制。然而，缺乏足夠的本地預製工廠被認為是阻礙更廣泛採用預製的主要障礙。 建立一系列本地預製工廠需要克服各種障礙，例如預製工廠的昂貴投資、有限的補貼以及建立有效的政府-製造商-承包商關係。新建本地預製廠的預製件價格主要由製造商本地預製廠投資和政府補貼決定，並影響承包商決定從新建本地預製廠採購多少預製件和現有的預製工廠採購多少預製件。承包商的採購決策反過來會影響政府建立當地預製工廠的目標（即使用當地預製件的量及其從預製工廠到工地的運輸的碳排放）。因此，有效的補貼計劃必須仔細考慮政府、製造商和承包商三者之間的相互作用。然而，目前的補貼計劃側重於製造商的投資，僅涉及政府-製造商關係，而忽略了至關重要的製造商-承包商關係。 該研究將通過建立一個雙層模型來填補這一空白，該模型將評定製造商和承包商之間的現實競爭互動關係，並最終建立一個政府補貼計劃的三層模型，該模型可用作吸引本地預製工廠投資的管理工具，從而提高本地預製市場的成熟度。此研究所建立的三層模型將告知政府最佳補貼政策，該政策可最大限度地提高當地經濟和環境效益，同時最大化製造商的利潤以及最小化承包商購買預製件的成本。香港政府已計劃在本地建立預製件工廠，主要原因是非本地預製件的質量往往不能令人滿意。此研究將以香港為案例來進行建模及計算，並可以應用於其他國家及地區製定適當的補貼措施。該項目將大力促進建築業的可持續發展和建造更多高質量的裝配式建築。

25213022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25213022.value: 高精度小时内倾斜面太阳辐照度预测的新型混合方法

25213022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25213022.value: The accelerated installation of solar power systems especially distributed photovoltaic systems (PV) has imposed severe operational challenges on local and regional power grids due to the intermittent and uncertain nature of ground-level solar irradiance. High-fidelity directional solar irradiance (or plane-of-array POA) forecasts are enabling and cost-effective technologies to mitigate the negative effects on the power grids caused by PV power variability. In recent years, solar irradiance forecasting methodologies for intra-hour, intra-day and day-ahead energy markets have been extensively explored using data-driven, local-sensing, remote-sensing, numerical weather prediction and hybrid methods. However, the accuracy of forecasts has begun to asymptote and improvements have tapered recently due to the insufficiency of relevant and high-resolution data, and simplified prediction of cloud dynamics due to its rapidly evolving characteristics in the complex atmospheric system. Therefore, this project proposes to collect and utilize new data, and develop new model in the aim to improve cloud cover forecasts and intra-hour POA forecasts. The focal objective is to improve the intra-hour POA forecast skill from 20% to 30% and improve ramp forecast accuracy from 50% to 70% during high variability periods. To achieve the objective, cost-effective solar instruments and programing package will be developed to automatically collect high resolution local-sensing data and remote-sensing data, for the purpose of atmosphere and clouds surveying. Secondly, a comprehensive hybrid model with the integration of atmospheric radiative transfer, local-sensing, remote-sensing and deep learning techniques will be developed to forecast cloud cover. The hybrid approach is expected to retrieve detailed cloud motion and optical properties, which will potentially improve the prediction of future cloud field. Thirdly, a full 3D Monte Carlo radiative transfer model will be developed to quantify the effects of finite clouds (with diverse locations, geometries and optically properties) on local POA with varied panel orientations. Then a thorough framework will be developed to forecast POA based on the predicted cloud cover and evaluate the forecasting model. In sum, this project proposes to utilize new data and develop new model to theoretically investigate the radiative interactions within the complex atmospheric system and to advance the research frontier of intra-hour forecasting of directional solar irradiance. 由于地表太阳辐照度的间歇性和不确定性，太阳能发电系统尤其是分布式光伏系统（PV）的迅速发展，为地方和区域电网带来了严峻的运营挑战。高精度倾斜面太阳辐照度（或阵列平面辐照度 POA）预测是能够减轻光伏产能波动对电网负面影响的低成本技术。近年来，适用于小时内、日内和日前能源市场的太阳辐照度预报技术广泛地使用数据驱动、地表观测、卫星遥感、数值天气预报方法和混合方法。然而，由于缺乏高分辨率的有效相关数据，以及对复杂大气系统中云场快速变化特征的简化，目前的辐照度预测精度已经达到瓶颈。 因此，本项目提出收集并利用新的数据以及开发新的模型，旨在提高云场预测的准确度，进而提高小时内 POA 预报的准确度。研究目标是将小时内 POA 预测能力系数从现有的 20% 提高到 30%；并在云场高度变化的时间段，将辐照度上下波动的预测精度从现有的 50% 提高到 70%。 为实现上述研究目标，本项目将：（1）研发高效及低成本的太阳辐照度观测仪器和程序包，以自动采集高分辨率的本地数据和卫星遥感数据，用于大气和云场观测。（2）融合大气辐射传热、地表观测、卫星遥感、深度学习等方法来预测云场。此新型混合方法将探究云的运动和光学特性等物理特征， 可潜在地提高云场的预测精度。（3）研发三维蒙特卡洛太阳能短波辐射传热模型，以量化不同的三维云层（位置、大小形状、光学特性等）对地表不同倾斜表面POA 的影响。（4）开发一个基于云场预测来预测POA并评估其准确性的全面模型架构。总之，本项目提出利用新数据和开发新模型，基于对复杂大气系统内的辐射传热相互作用的理论研究，推进小时内倾斜面太阳辐照度预测的研究前沿。

25215122.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25215122.value: 有卖空约束的投资组合变现问题

25215122.label: Project Objectives
25215122.value: When studying portfolio liquidation problems, it has major practical importance to consider a short-sell constraint, which leads to novel stochastic control problems and games with absorption. However, literature on such topic is very sparse. The goal of this project is to study liquidation problems with absorption. We expect that our project will make great contributions to literature on quantitative finance and stochastic control. The assumption of absorption raises mathematical complexity. This is why literature on this topic is sparse. Thus, the first objective is to develop innovative mathematical tools for the analysis of liquidation problems with absorption. We will solve optimal portfolio liquidation problem for a single player, who will leave the market once her position reaches zero. Our model includes several interesting models as examples, including models with temporary and permanent price impact, stochastic trading target and absolute valued trading cost, respectively. We shall solve portfolio liquidation games with absorption, including mean-field games and finite-player games. In addition to finding Nash equilibrium theoretically, we will further explore how initial distribution and various market parameters influence our Nash equilibrium, and how financial markets benefit from our assumption of absorption.

25228722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25228722.value: 新型可靠表面觸覺技術的建模及心理-物理學評價

25228722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25228722.value: Surface haptics is an emerging branch in human-machine interactions with great potentials, thanks to the already ubiquitous touchscreens in modern life. Effective surface haptics could be used to render virtual features and textures on the touchscreen, which would vastly expand the capabilities and functionalities of current touch surfaces. Current surface haptics devices, particularly electroadhesion based surface haptics devices, however, are suffering from three main issues that imminently threaten their anticipated commercial success: (a) performance inconsistency due to users’ variations like sweating rate and environmental variation such as changes in temperature and relative humidity, (b) contamination accumulation due to finger sweat, sebum, and other contaminants, and (c) concern of surface borne pathogens, especially during the on-going COVID-19 pandemic. Therefore, this project aims to solve these issues by designing a new electroadhesion surface with infused lubricants and nano-textures (ESILNT) that can achieve broadband repellency towards multi-phase foulants including complex liquids and bio-foulant, thereby solving these issues. To achieve the desired performances, new models, along with designing algorithms and validation methodologies will be established. The successful development of ESILNT relies heavily on the understanding of the underlying multi-physics interactions. While there have been separate models explaining the finger friction force by contact mechanics, capillary formation, material property change, lubrication, and van der Waals force, these models cannot comprehensively explain the inconsistency and contamination issues related to the current electroadhesion surface haptics. Furthermore, there are no models readily available to predict how finger and liquid infused surfaces like ESILNT would interact. Therefore, the first task of this project is to develop and experimentally validate a modelling framework that can quantitatively describe the interactions in the ESILNT interface by a combination of analytical and numerical approaches. Parametric study based on this modelling framework will then reveal how surface geometry and material properties of the infusion lubricant and substrate affect the overall performance. Optimization algorithms along with machine learning surrogate models will be further developed to optimize the design of ESILNT prototypes. With the prototypes, psychophysical and physiological evaluations for users' preference and acceptance will be performed. The completion of this project will bring new knowledge to the field of surface haptics and other human-machine interfaces. The comprehensive model of finger friction force on liquid-infused interface, optimization algorithms and machine learning model for ESILNT surface and users’ preference for different infusion lubricant with respect to its physical properties can benefit both academia and industries. 現代生活中，隨處可見的觸摸屏幕為表面觸覺技術的快速發展提供了良好的基礎。表面觸覺技術可以在觸屏上渲染虛擬物品及材質，進而極大地擴展現有觸摸表面的功能。然而現有表面觸覺技術，尤其是基於電粘滯效應的表面觸覺設備，在以下三方面仍存在重大缺陷：（1）由於用戶出汗、環境濕度溫度變化帶來的性能不穩定問題，（2）由手指汗液、油汙導致的表面汙染物累積問題，（3）病原體在表面的累積問題，尤其是在COVID-19疫情持續蔓延的當下。因此，本項目旨在通過設計具有微納米尺度紋理且註入潤滑劑的新型觸摸表面（ESILNT），以實現多種液體汙染物及生物汙垢的自動排斥，進而解決上述問題。為使新型表面觸覺設備獲得理想的表面性能，本項目將建立新的模型、設計算法以及實驗方法。 ESILNT的設計重度依賴於手指接觸界面間的多物理模型。盡管現有模型對手指接觸力學、毛細橋形成、材料物性、潤滑效應及範德華力都有獨立的研究，但這些獨立的模型並不能完善地解釋現有電粘滯觸覺表面性能不穩定及汙染問題。更進一步地，預測手指和註入液體的表面間摩擦力的模型尚不存在。因此，本項目的首個研究目標即為建立一套預測手指與ESILNT表面摩擦行為的理論及數值模型並進行實驗驗證。在此基礎上，本項目將通過參數研究揭示表面幾何、材料參數對表面觸覺效果的綜合影響。最後，本項目將利用優化算法和人工智能替代模型進一步優化ESILNT樣機，並利用樣機開展用戶接受度的心理-物理學分析評價。 本項目可為表面觸覺研究及人機交互界面研究帶來新的知識包括：（1）手指及液體浸潤界面摩擦力模型，（2）ESILNT樣機設計的優化算法及人工智能模型，（3）用戶對不同表面潤滑劑的偏好。

25300022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25300022.value: 探索具有優異性能的化學改性無鉛鐵電體的原子尺度機制

25300022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25300022.value: Ferroelectric ceramics are among the most technologically important functional materials that are utilised in electronic devices (actuators, transducers, and sensors) and a growing number of emerging fields, including renewable energy harvesting, energy storage and micro-electromechanical systems. Globally, the piezoelectric device market where ferroelectric materials are commonly utilised, is expected to grow from USD $28.9 billion in 2020 to $34.7 billion in 2025. The usefulness of ferroelectrics stems from their ability to transform an electrical response to a mechanical one and vice-versa which is a property termed piezoelectricity. Although there are a vast number of ferroelectric systems utilised currently, the materials with the best properties and performance are largely lead-based perovskites. The solid solution PbZrO3-PbTiO3 is the baseline to which lead-free alternatives are compared given its superior piezoelectric coefficients and high Curie temperatures. Comparatively, three of the top lead-free alternatives (BaTiO3-based, (Na,Bi)TiO3-based, and (K,Na)NbO3-based materials) significantly underperform the piezoelectric performance and temperature stability of PbZrO3-PbTiO3. With ever-increasing environmental and human health concerns, however, there are a growing number of regulations being put in place around the world to restrict the use of lead-containing materials. As a result, the development of high-performance lead-free ferroelectrics has been at the forefront of materials research to meet the sustainable society development requirements. Among the lead-free ferroelectric alternatives, the (K,Na)NbO3 solid solution has received considerable attention, given its promising piezoelectric coefficients and temperature stability. Research efforts have been placed on improving performance by introducing local structural heterogeneity through compositional modification to improve piezoelectric performance. These multiphase solid solutions have resulted in significant piezoelectric property improvements. Despite these ongoing efforts, the structural/physical origin of their piezoelectricity remains unclear. While these mechanisms are believed to originate due to several factors, including easier polarisation rotation and the coexistence of hierarchical nanodomains, direct observation of these phenomena will be essential to facilitate comprehensive understanding. This project aims to understand the structural and chemical relationships that govern the properties of chemically modified lead-free ferroelectrics using advanced electron microscopy. This project expects to uncover complex structural relationships at the micro and atomic scales that govern ferroelectric performance through direct observation. Expect outcomes include developing refined electron microscopy techniques that will uncover the complex relationship between local chemistry and structure in these materials. This should give significant benefits, such as providing new insights for the design of high performance environmentally friendly lead-free ferroelectrics for use in electronic devices and energy storage. 鐵電陶瓷材料被廣泛地應用於各種電子設備，其中包括執行器，換能器以及傳感器。最近幾年，鐵電陶瓷材料吸引了諸多新興領域的關注，其中包括可再生能源收集領域，能源存儲領域以及微機電系統領域。在全球範圍內，直到2025年，大量使用鐵電陶瓷材料的壓電器件市場份額預計將從2020年的289億美元增長到347億美元。鐵電體的用途主要源於電響應與機械響應之間的相互轉換，而目前性能最優異的鐵電體主要是含鉛鐵電體。相對應的，無鉛鐵電體，包括BaToO3-基鐵電體，(Na,Bi)TiO3-基鐵電體，以及(K,Na)NbO3-基鐵電體的相應性能卻遠低於含鉛鐵電體。然而，隨著環境保護意識的提高以及對人類健康的關注，世界範圍內對含鉛材料的使用越來越嚴格。因此，發展高性能的無鉛鐵電體成為了鐵電材料研究的新方向。在無鉛鐵電材料中，(K,Na)NbO3由於優異的壓電耦合係數吸引了廣泛的關注。近期，科學家雖然在提高(K,Na)NbO3材料壓電性能方面取得了很大的突破，其中包括化學改性的方式，但是在導致鐵電性能提高的原因方面仍然缺乏了解。這個項目主要是通過使用先進電子顯微學在原子尺度深入研究影響化學改性的無鉛鐵電體性能的機理。通過揭示結構-性能之間的關係，為未來高性能無鉛鐵電材料的設計提供理論與實驗基礎。

25301522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25301522.value: 載流子倍增 (CM) 指一個高能光子產生多個電子-空穴對的過程，已被證明可以在包括太陽能電池、光電探測器、太陽能燃料和光催化在內的多種光捕獲技術中提高光轉換效率。與其他類型的新型光轉換技術（例如，串聯電池或熱載流子電池）相比，挑戰集中在器件設計/製造上，CM 的利用主要受限於開發具有窄带隙、低阈值高效 的CM 材料。傳統半導體中的 CM 效率低，閾值高（≥ 4Eg）。值得注意的是，最近在鹵化物鈣鈦礦中發現了高效的 CM，這推動了 CM 在上述技術中的應用前景。 該項目基於 PI 近年來在鈣鈦礦（包括 纳米晶 和薄膜）中熱載流子動力學和 CM 過程的超快光譜研究方面取得的研究基礎（Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., 60, 10957, 2021 ; Nat. Commun., 9, 4197, 2018; Nat. Commun., 8, 14350, 2017) 和正在進行的關於 CM 對鈣鈦礦器件中光電流量子效率 (QE) 增強的影響的工作。最近，我們首次證明，基於 Sn/Pb 混合鈣鈦礦-NCs 的光電導體（于Nat. Photonics 评审中）中展示了鈣鈦礦作為光電應用中出色的 CM 材料的潛在重要性。下面提出的研究可以將CM的研究和應用推向一個新的水平。 該項目旨在解決幾個重要的未解決問題，這些問題對於使用窄帶隙 Sn/Pb 混合鈣鈦礦（例如低至 ~1.2 eV）作为高效 CM 電池的實際開發至關重要：（1）報告的高效 CM 是否穩健？如何令人信服地評估 Sn/Pb 鈣鈦礦 NC 和體膜中的 CM 性能？為了解決這個問題，光泵浦/太赫茲探测(OPTP) 光譜技術將首次應用於鈣鈦礦，並提供有關 CM 性能的可靠和有見地的信息。 (2) 高效CM的特殊要求是什麼？如何在窄帶隙 Sn/Pb 鈣鈦礦中滿足這一要求？為了闡明這一要求，我們新開發的新型泵浦/推进/太赫茲探测技術將用於清楚地了解如何通過尺寸、Sn/Pb 成分和缺陷密度調整來實現高效 CM。 (3) Sn/Pb 鈣鈦礦薄膜中的 CM 是否以及如何導致 PV 中的光電流 QE 超過 100%？為了驗證和利用器件中的 CM 效應，將對具有 UV 透明電極和不同吸收層厚度的概念驗證 CM 電池中的 EQE 和 IQE 進行詳細研究。所有測量的 QE(λ) 也將與來自太赫茲測量的內部 CM(hv) 進行定量比較，以評估 CM 對光電流 QE 增強的影響的證據。 該項目的成功完成將為材料內部的 CM 機制提供清晰的路线，並為材料和窄帶隙 Sn/Pb 混合鈣鈦礦的工作單元中的 CM 效應提供強有力的評估。這些見解將大大有助於開發受益於 CM 的高效新型光捕獲技術。

25302822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25302822.value: 随机波动方程的保结构算法

25302822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25302822.value: 中文摘要： 本项目聚焦于于随机波动方程的保结构数值方法，这些方法已被广泛用于在许多物理领域模拟波的传播。作为一个无限维随机哈密顿系统，随机波动方程具有两个内在性质：随机辛结构和能量演化定律。在计算上，非常需要开发有效的数值方法，尽可能保留原始系统的固有特性。尽管在利普希茨系数条件下随机波方程已经有了丰富的数值结果，但对于一般随机波动方程，其保结构数值方法仍难以构建。尽管最近这方面的问题引起了越来越多的关注，但还远未得到很好的理解。 在本项目中，我们将构造设计有效的结构保持数值方法，用于随机波动方程的数值模拟。建立基于截断分裂技巧和随机辅助变量方法的一般框架，设计随机波方程的显式辛积分子和保持能量演化律的高效数值方法。保结构性质在数值解的数值稳定性和长期动力学分析中起着关键作用。为了针对具有非全局Lipschitz系数随机波动方程研究所提出算法的收敛性和准确性，我们将研究一些内在的概率统计行为，包括指数可积性，遍历内变测度和概率密度函数。概率统计行为分析将成为研究一般随机波动方程数值方法的基础，丰富数值概率理论。本项目的主要贡献是 • 构建有效的结构保持数值方案， • 对数值解的概率统计行为进行严格分析， • 强误差和弱误差估计，以及不变测度的近似误差和随机波动方程的概率密度函数。

25305222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25305222.value: 二维杂化钙钛矿中铁畴的原子微观形貌研究

25305222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25305222.value: 材料中的铁畴所产生的特性可用于机电传感器、多态存储和低能量自旋电子学器件。二维有机无机杂化钙钛矿是一类新型具有单一或多铁畴特性可通过电场或应力来切换的材料。轻量级的有机链和高机械强度的无机骨架允许高能量/功率输出应变发生在有机无机杂化钙钛矿中。已报道的二维杂化钙钛矿中的压电响应甚至超过传统的氧化物铁电体（锆钛酸铅和钛酸铅）。与此同时，灵活调整杂化钙钛矿有机无机部分，可以对铁质秩序进行前所未有的控制。比如极化轴（自发极化方向）可以通过结构和组分来调控产生面内，面外或多轴偏振，导致工程复杂铁电畴结构，如涡旋状。此外，二维杂化钙钛矿也可以表现出铁弹性质，即畴相变对于压力的响应。虽然已有在化学设计和合成方面的铁电和铁弹钙钛矿工作的报道，但原子尺度下杂化钙钛矿铁电畴和铁弹畴结构以及它们之间相互耦合的工作还鲜有报道。虽然铁电畴和铁弹畴可以很好的共存在传统的无机氧化物钙钛矿，但是否能够共存在杂化二维钙钛矿中还鲜有报道。了解铁畴如何响应应力和电场对于制造机电换能器非常重要；同时对于多电导水平的设计和记录突触权重神经形态计算也是必不可少的。 在这个项目中, PI 提出通过调节有机链和引入卤化物的极性扭曲来合成具有铁电和/或铁弹性的n >=2 杂化钙钛矿。PI 提出使用尖端功能化的扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和原子力显微镜（AFM）来扫描杂化钙钛矿中的铁电和铁弹畴原子结构形貌并且通过施加STM针尖应力来研究这些畴对于电场和应力的响应。拟议的项目将为二维杂化钙钛矿的铁电和铁弹特性提供重要的见解，以及在铁电存储器件和电化学传感器领域铺平道路。

25505322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25505322.value: 随着信息技术的飞速发展，很多公司都拥有包括交易记录和顾客特征信息（例如用户资料、统计信息和历史浏览记录）在内的大量的历史数据。个性化定价，即对同一产品，公司通过利用顾客的特征信息向不同顾客提供不同价格的做法已被许多在线零售商广泛采用，这不仅有助于了解客户需求，也帮助公司增加了利润。个性化定价在现实业务中的应用也引起学术界关于基于特征的利用在线学习进行动态定价问题的研究。然而，现有文献普遍采用的一个关键假设是零售商在开始在线学习之前，没有任何关于消费者需求的先验信息。然而实际情况并非如此，在采用动态定价之前，许多在线零售商已经收集了一些历史销售数据和顾客特征信息。在本项目中，我们提出同时利用在线学习和离线数据来研究基于特征的动态定价问题，并且希望定量刻画出离线数据对在线学习统计复杂度的影响。在我们的初步研究中，我们分析了具有同质价格弹性的基于特征的线性需求模型，利用预先收集的离线数据和线上产生的在线数据，设计出了学习算法。我们通过研究我们算法的残差上界和证明与之匹配的任一算法的残差下界刻画了离线数据对在线学习最优残差的影响。在本项目中，我们将会研究更复杂的具有异质价格弹性的需求模型和更实用的广义线性需求模型，我们将会对这两个模型设计有效的学习算法，进行详细的残差分析和充分的数值实验。如果成功，本项目的产出将会对基于特征的在线学习动态定价这一领域填补重要的研究空白。此外，它还将对工业界的从业者在制定高效、自适应和稳健的个性化动态定价策略的问题中，提供有效的决策支撑和定量见解。

25509722.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25509722.value: 政府采购的绿色驱动力

25509722.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25509722.value: Climate change is by now widely recognized as one of the major threats to the sustainability of the environment, societies and economies globally. Many countries have already realized the urgency to address climate challenges, and has committed to take ambitious carbon reduction actions. For example, the UK became the first major economy to pass a net zero emissions law in 2019, legally requiring the UK to bring all greenhouse gas emissions to net zero by 2050. China also march to net-zero emissions, and pledge to be carbon neutral by 2060. Given these strong national commitments, how to effectively incentivize firms to embrace carbon emission reduction activities becomes a central question for government regulators in achieving a carbon-neutral economy. With government expenditure representing nearly 20% of the GDP worldwide, public procurement constitutes a significant portion of the global economy and can potentially be used by governments as a lever to help transform the economy into a low carbon one. However, empirical evidence on the green power of government purchases is sparse. Recently, the UK has taken the initiative to incorporate suppliers’ net zero commitment and carbon reduction plan into its latest procurement policy note (PPN 06/21), taking effect in September 2021. This policy note requires the mandatory commitment to net zero emissions by 2050 and detailed carbon reduction plans from prospective suppliers bidding for UK government contracts above £5 million per annum. This initiative provides an ideal setting for the exploration of the real effects of government procurement policies on the government-supplier relationship, suppliers’ carbon emission performance, and the policy’s spillover effect on the equity market capital allocation. The findings of this project will shed light on whether and how governments can use their purchasing power to facilitate carbon neutrality. The project is expected to benefit at least four different groups, all of whom should have an interest in knowing whether and how government expenditure can influence companies to transition to a low-carbon economy. The five groups are as follows: (1) government regulators who set policies for companies to promote environmental sustainability; (2) companies who plan on bidding for procurement contracts from governments, especially those located in countries who have committed to a aggressive carbon emission reduction. (3) investors who consider carbon emission as an important investment criterion; (4) organizations that are active in promoting green and sustainable activities, such as environmental activist groups. 如何有效激励企业参与碳减排活动是政府监管机构实现碳中和经济的核心问题。由于政府支出占全球GDP的近20%，公共采购在全球经济中占有重要地位，政府可以将其作为推动经济向低碳转型的杠杆。然而，关于政府采购的绿色力量的实证证据却很少。最近，英国主动将供应商的净零承诺和碳减排计划纳入其最新采购政策文件(PPN 06/21)，将于2021年9月生效。这份政策报告要求投标英国政府每年500万英镑以上合同的潜在供应商承诺在2050年之前实现净零排放并制定详细的碳减排计划。这一举措为探索政府采购政策如何影响政府-供应商关系、供应商碳排放绩效 及股权市场资本配置提供了理想的样本。这项研究的发现将揭示政府是否以及如何利用其购买力来促进碳中和

25510122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25510122.value: The public concern on environmental policies grows partly because of their labor market consequences such as job losses. This growing concern plays a central role in political debates over environmental policies, undermining environmental lawmaking. Nevertheless, the literature has not reached a consensus on the labor market effects of environmental policies. Little is known about the mechanisms through which environmental policies affect labor market outcomes and about the distribution of costs associated with environmental policies in the labor market. This project exploits an exogenous source of variations from a carbon tax policy in the Canadian province of British Columbia (BC) to fill the gap. Combining matching with a difference-in-difference approach, this project examines the causal effect of BC's carbon tax on labor market activities. It investigates the determinants of layoffs. In response to carbon tax, are jobs cut because of the characteristics of employers or employees? For example, inefficient firms may cut jobs because their tight profit margins are taken off by the policy. So, the policy improves the match quality. However, firms with tighter credit may fail to upgrade their abatement technology; consequently, they cut jobs because of the higher cost incurred by the environmental policy. If firms with tighter credit cut jobs, it calls for policies to finance firms to save jobs, providing a rationale for transition finance. This project will answer whether employees are more likely laid off because of observed characteristics such as age, gender, educational level, etc., or because of unobserved elements such as productivity. If workers with a specific demographic characteristic are more likely laid off, social resources can be wisely re-distributed to compensate these workers. In contrast, if firms laid off less-productive workers, an environmental policy indeed helps improve the match quality between firms and workers. This project is interesting for three reasons. First, it addresses the public concern on the labor market responses to environmental policies. Second, it helps economists understand the channels through which environmental policies influence labor market activities. It answers why jobs are cuts and reveals the distribution of costs associated with environmental policies in the labor market. Third, this project helps policymakers formulate appropriate labor market policies along with environmental policies. It guides the design of social benefits to compensate firms and workers who suffer the brunt of the costs created by environmental policies. It provides empirical support for a relatively new debt instrument, known as a transition bond. 公眾對環境政策的關注日趨增加。部分原因來自環境政策對勞動力市場帶來的影響。這種日益增長的擔憂亦見於政治辯論，防礙環境政策的立法。然而，文獻對環境政策於勞動力市場的影響尚未達成共識。人們對其中的機制知之甚少。此項目利用加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省的碳稅政策去了解裁員的決定因素面對新增的碳稅，裁員的主因來自雇主還是僱員的內在因素呢？ 假若，碳稅促使效率低的公司裁員。那麼，該政策或會提高勞動市場整體的質素。然而，緊縮的企業或因信貸問題而無法升級其減排技術。面對成本提高的壓力，他們或會削減工作崗位。此項目將回答員工是否更有可能因為觀察到的因素而被解僱(例如：年齡、性別、教育程度等特徵)還是由於未觀察到的因素(例如：生產力)。如果具有特定特徵的工人更有可能下​​崗，社會資源可以更有效地重新分配資源以補償這些工作人員。相反，如果公司解僱生產力較低的工人，環境政策則有助於提高企業與工人之間的匹配質量。 這個項目的價值有三。首先，它解決了公眾對勞動力市場對環境政策的反應。其次，它有助於經濟學家理解環境政策影響勞動力市場的渠道。其次，它回答了裁員的原因並揭示了環境政策於勞動市場的成本分佈。再者，這項目幫助決策者制定適當的勞動市場政策和環境政策。它引導決策者設計社會福利以補償受影響的企業和工人。

25607322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25607322.value: 為我們的國家減緩氣候變化﹖國家身份認同與社會生態環境對環保行為的聯合影響

25607322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25607322.value: The detrimental impact of climate change is already observable worldwide, including more frequent heatwaves, droughts, hurricanes, rainstorms, and flooding. There is, therefore, a pressing need for researchers to (1) understand why and when people engage in behaviors that can reduce greenhouse gas emissions directly and indirectly through lobbying or supporting policy changes in regulating such emissions and (2) develop effective ways to promote these behaviors (i.e., pro-environmental behaviors) cross-nationally. Against this backdrop, the proposed project will systematically address these two issues by integrating social, cross-cultural, and socio-ecological psychology theories. We propose a socio-ecological × social identity model to investigate how social identification influences pro-environmental behaviors and under what socio-ecological conditions such influences are stronger or weaker. In particular, we aim to test how national identification contributes to mobilizing pro-environmental behaviors, given that nations are often the central frame of reference in climate discourse and mitigation commitment (e.g., the amount of carbon emissions in a country) and that achieving the carbon emission goal requires joint efforts from citizens within each country. We posit that national identification strengthens people’s sense of connection and common fate with their in-group members and thus motivates them to engage in behaviors that promote the group’s wellness (climate change mitigation). Our proposed model integrates psychological (national identification) and contextual factors (national political contexts, culture, and socio-ecological threats) to explain pro-environmental behavior. We further posit that the influence of national identification is modulated by political contexts that favor pro-environmental orientations (national identity content, national pro-environmental goals) as well as cultural (e.g., individualism-collectivism) and socio-ecological (e.g., exposure to natural disasters, economic crises) contexts that favor group adherence over maintaining individual independence. To test these ideas, we propose conducting four studies with mixed methods. Study 1 will test the causal influence of national identification on pro-environmental behaviors by experimentally manipulating the level of national identification and testing the moderation effect of perceived national identity content. Studies 2 and 3 will examine the influence of national identification and the moderation effects of socio-ecological factors with a longitudinal design and a multilevel design, respectively. Study 4 will demonstrate the application of the proposed model in promoting pro-environmental behavior through message framing in the United States and China—countries with distinct socio-ecological contexts. Positive results from this project will advance the social identity approach to pro-environmental behaviors, open new research directions, and offer practical insights into promoting pro-environmental behaviors cross-nationally. 氣候變化帶來的負面影響已經在世界範圍內可見，包括更頻繁的熱浪、乾旱、颶風、暴雨和洪水。因此，我們急需了解(1)為甚麼有些人會參與環保行為 (包括︰直接減少碳排放、遊說或支持實行減排政策)及何時他們會參與這些活動；(2)建立有效的方法在世界各地推廣環保行為。本研究將會通過綜合社會、跨文化和社會生態環境心理學理論來解答這兩個問題。 我們提出一個社會生態環境x 社會身分認同模型來了解社會身分認同如何影響環保行為，以及在甚麼樣的社會生態環境下，其作用會變得更強或更弱。鑑於國家通常是氣候變化討論和減緩目標的焦點(例如︰一個國家所承諾的碳排放量)以及實現碳排放目標需要各國公民的共同努力，我們將會探討國家身分認同如何幫助推廣環保行為。我們提出國家身分認同有助於加強公民之間的連接感和命運共同感，從而激勵他們參與能促進團體福祉的行為(如︰減緩氣候變化)。我們提出的模型綜合了心理(國家身分認同)和環境因素(國家政治環境、文化及社會生態威脅)來了解環保行為。我們進一步提出國家身分認同對環保行為的影響將取決於︰有利於環保的政治環境及促進集體依從性多於個人獨立性的文化與社會生態環境。 我們將會通過四項不同方法的研究來驗證以上的理論。研究一將會通過實驗方式來測試國家身分認同與環保行為的因果關係，及國家身分認同內容的調節作用。研究二將採用追蹤研究來檢驗國家身分認同對環保行為的作用，及社會生態環境的調節作用。研究三將採用跨文化及多層次研究來測驗文化及社會生態環境的調節作用。最後，研究四將會測試如何通過不同信息框架來在中國和美國 — 兩個不同社會生態環境的國家 — 來推廣環保行為。研究結果將有助於推進社會身分認同理論在環保行為上的應用、展開新的研究方向，及為跨國推廣環保行為提供實用的見解。

26200222.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26200222.value: 一種高階高可信度尺度解析跨音速流動氣動預測框架

26200222.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26200222.value: 如今，商用飛行器已成為主要的運輸工具之一。實踐表明，用可靠的方法預測飛行器表面流動對於縮短飛行器的設計周期至關重要。近年來流行的帶壁面模式的大渦模擬方法準確解析了流場中的大尺度結構，並模化亞格子尺度結構。較之基於雷諾平均方程的預測方法，帶壁面模式的大渦模擬方法能夠更準確地捕捉流動的非定常特性，而且與直接數值模擬方法相比，帶壁面模式的大渦模擬方法很大程度上更為高效。現有的帶壁面模式的大渦模擬方法在大渦模擬解析區域使用顯式亞格子模型，同時在近壁區使用平衡近壁模型。然而，它依舊有提升的空間，例如，(1) 對於複雜幾何外形，缺乏同時能魯棒捕獲激波和低耗散解析湍流的一般數值方法；(2) 亞格子模型與數值截斷誤差之間的相互作用是不確定的，這讓不同代碼的計算結果對亞格子模型和數值格式的組合非常敏感；(3) 對於非平衡流動的模擬效果並不理想，因為平衡壁面模型可能難以準確處理強逆壓梯度效應。 最近的初步研究表明，通過與非多項式重構結合在一起，目標本質無振蕩格式優秀的激波捕捉和波解析特性可以極大地提升大渦模擬的計算效果。並且，對於不可壓縮流動，申請人已經開發了基本的非平衡模型。 為了高保真地預測跨音速流動，在本項目中，(1) 通過提出一系列非多項式高階目標本質無振蕩格式並與一種改進的可壓縮壁面模型混合，將開發一種新的帶壁面模式的大渦模擬算法，它可以用來處理複雜幾何外形。 在不犧牲激波捕捉能力的前提下，新目標本質無振蕩格式的譜特性將通過局部反卷積方法進行系統的優化，使其截斷誤差表現為與物理一致的亞格子耗散。從而使得亞格子模型誤差與數值截斷誤差之間的相互作用得到緩解；(2) 改進的可壓縮壁面模型在保持傳統基於微分方程的平衡模型的簡單性的同時，也將考慮壓力梯度和馬赫數的影響；(3) 將開展一系列帶激波和強壓力梯度的物理工程問題的模擬，用以評估新的帶壁面模式的大渦模擬算法，並與已成熟的方法進行綜合對比。 本項目的成果將提升航空工程中的流動預測技術。而且，本項目提出的數值方法可用於求解其他控制著廣泛物理現象的偏微分方程。

26200422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26200422.value: 調用位移轉變函數的彈性變換方法：設計極性 Willis 彈性體實現所需的變形行為

26200422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26200422.value: 一般來講，已知桁架超材料的微觀結構和邊界條件，利用線性彈性理論我們便可以獲得超材料的變形行為。 然而，給定特定載荷下所需的位移或應力場來設計無序並占據任何形狀區域的微結構，這樣的反問題仍未解決。這是由於這種反問題的解非唯一並且需要巨大的參數空間。 除了利用優化或數據驅動的數值方法外，我們也需要尋求一種解析方法，以簡單明瞭的方式告知變形-行為-微觀結構之間的關係並快速設計所需的桁架，從而促進超材料在力學、能源、生物和醫學中的發展。 本項目提出的方法源於坐標變換。這種數學方法可根據同質材料簡單的波傳播路徑求解異質材料的材料參數來實現所需的複雜的波傳播路徑。不同的是，本項目的核心思想是根據簡單的質量彈簧桁架結構的已知位移場求解複雜的質量彈簧桁架結構來實現所需的位移場。我們將利用位移轉變函數建立兩個位移場之間的聯係，彈性變換規則將建立從位移場和坐標的變化到桁架幾何形狀和彈簧系數的變化的關係，從而指導複雜桁架的設計。然而，這樣做會在桁架結構中產生兩種非常規彈性屬性：Willis 耦合和極性（不對稱應力）。目前還沒有已知的設計可以滿足需求。最近，我們開發了離散彈性變換理論。利用這種理論我們設計由任意坐標變換產生的極性彈性體，但位移轉變函數必須是常數。 本項目將開發任意位移轉變函數的廣義離散彈性變換理論，來快速設計可加工的極化 Willis彈性體。此彈性體可占據任何形狀區域，和實現任意所需變形行為。為實現這一目標，我們將 (1) 重新研究廣義連續彈性變換理論，為後續工作奠定理論基礎；(2) 開發廣義離散彈性變換理論，為設計所需的質量-彈簧桁架提供指導；(3) 提出獨特且實用的機構來實現 Willis 耦合和極性，以及設計可製造的超材料結構；(4) 加工極化 Willis 彈性體，並實驗驗證。在基礎研究方面，本項目將為坐標變換方法、彈性理論和機構設計帶來新思路。在實際應用方面，這種新型彈性體具有高精度變形等特點，可被用於（例如）骨科植入物。

26201522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26201522.value: 基於氧化鎂水泥和中空植物纖維開發可固碳的高性能水泥基材料

26201522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26201522.value: Reactive magnesia cement (RMC) is an emerging alternative concrete binder to Portland cement (PC). RMC is potentially more sustainable than PC, because it hardens by hydration in water and getting carbonated by CO2 from ambient air, while PC hardens by hydration only. Theoretically, one tonne CO2 can be sequestrated by approximately one tonne reactive magnesia (MgO); the resultant concrete can achieve mechanical strength comparable to PC-based concrete. However, the application of RMC-based concrete is still limited, especially for large-sized load-bearing structural components. One important reason is that CO2 cannot efficiently penetrate through the dense microstructure of hydrated RMC, which limits the carbonation depth and subsequently induces inadequate CO2 sequestration, strength, and size of the concrete. This study aims to develop a new class of RMC-based composites that will have significantly enhanced CO2 penetration, mechanical properties, and member size. We propose a new approach, i.e., adding hollow natural fibers (HNFs) to enhance the CO2 diffusion in RMC matrix; another advantage of this approach is that the moderate alkalinity of RMC matrix (pH=10.5) can mitigate the degradation of natural fibers, a common problem observed in PC matrix (pH=12.5). While our preliminary study has verified these complementary effects between HNF and RMC, three research objectives/tasks are set to robustly design HNF-RMC composites for the target properties. The first objective is to enhance the CO2 penetration; we will study the effect of strategic coating (reactive silica) to fiber surface, matrix composition, and curing scheme on the drying-induced free radial shrinkage of HNF, to preserve the hollow lumens inside the fiber. The second objective is to predict the carbonation; we will quantify the effect of HNF-related factors (e.g., lumen size, fiber fraction, length, and orientation) on the microstructure (esp. lumen connectivity) and carbonation profile (degree vs. depth) of RMC matrix. The third objective is to develop large-sized CO2-sequstrating strain-hardening cementitious composites (SHCCs) using magnesia cement and natural fibers; we will add the carbonation-induced size-dependency to the classic micromechanics-based SHCC model, and utilize the modified model to design mix proportions of the new composite based on the predicted carbonation. This new HNF-RMC SHCC would significantly increase the CO2 sequestration capacity of structural concrete and promotes the application of eco-friendly natural fibers in construction. As the neighboring Mainland China and Southeast Asia have major resources of magnesia and natural fibers respectively, Hong Kong could especially benefit from its large-scale field application following the success of this project. 氧化鎂水泥是一種有潛質替代硅酸鹽水泥的新型凝膠材料。硅酸鹽水泥通過水化反應硬化，而氧化鎂水泥通過水化-碳化反應硬化，故其更有利於環境保護。理論上，每噸氧化鎂水泥可以吸收約一噸二氧化碳；其混凝土製品的強度可與基於硅酸鹽水泥的混凝土相近。然而，基於氧化鎂水泥的混凝土尚未在實際工程，尤其是足尺的結構構件中得到應用。其主因是二氧化碳不能有效地穿透氧化鎂水化物內部的緻密結構，限制了碳化深度，進而造成混凝土固碳量、強度和尺寸的不足。本項目計劃開發一類碳化更深、強度更高、尺寸更大的氧化鎂水泥基建材。核心方法是通過加入中空的植物纖維，加快加深二氧化碳在氧化鎂水泥基中的擴散；該方法的另一優勢在於，氧化鎂水泥基鹼性較低（pH=10.5），能有效預防在硅酸鹽水泥基（pH=12.5）中常見的植物纖維過快分解。申請人團隊已經初步驗證了植物纖維和氧化鎂水泥的協同作用。為了能夠有效設計優化該類新材料，本項目將針對三個具體目標在三個方面開展研究。第一，為高效改進二氧化碳的擴散，我們將研究纖維表面塗層（活性二氧化硅）、水泥基體成分和養護條件對於植物纖維的脫水-徑向自由收縮的控製作用，進而保護纖維空腔結構的完整性。第二，為準確預測該新材料的碳化，我們將通過實驗量化植物纖維的空腔尺寸、體積摻量、空間分佈等設計參數對微觀結構（尤其是纖維空腔的完整性）和基體碳化過程（即程度-深度關係）的影響。第三，為設計高固碳-大尺寸的高延性氧化鎂基複合材料（SHCC），我們將改進基於微觀力學的經典SHCC模型，以量化碳化深度和材料尺寸的影響，並利用該新模型優化材料的配合比設計。植物纖維-氧化鎂SHCC的使用將有效增大混凝土結構的固碳量，並促進植物纖維這類綠色原材料在建築中的使用。與香港比鄰的中國內地和東南亞地區分別擁有巨大的鎂礦儲量和植物纖維產量。得益於這樣的資源分佈，香港可優先受益於本技術的開發和應用。

26202122.value: 用於下一代無線通信的微波/毫米波微聲諧振器和濾波器技術

26202122.label: Project Objectives
26202122.value: This project focuses on developing new advanced frameworks for miniature microwave/mmWave micro-acoustic resonator and filter technologies that outperform state-of-the-art solutions (surface acoustic wave technique and thin-film bulk acoustic wave technique) to meet the challenges of the global transition to 5G and next-generation wireless communication networks. Micro-acoustic resonators/filters are irreplaceable in wireless communications as they provide access to the crowded frequency spectrum, enhance the signal-to-noise ratio of the transmitter, lower the power consumption for a given communication link, and maximize the frequency spectrum usage efficiency, which cannot be fully delivered by other technologies considering size, integration, and cost. Their significance increases as more frequency bands are licensed. These proposed micro-acoustic resonator/filter technologies would feature high-quality factors, large energy coupling, and an unprecedented wide operating frequency range. Specifically, this project proposes a new framework to support sub-6 GHz 5G new radio with a fractional bandwidth of over 10% and two new frameworks featuring high-quality factors and large energy coupling to support mmWave frequency bands. The proposed frameworks are based on lithium niobate thin films but in different structures, including solidly mounted and multi-morph suspended, for different usage scenarios. The successful demonstration of these frameworks would address the limitations in the state-of-the-art solutions and expand the room for innovative research in other cross-cutting fields. To push the performance frontier, loss mechanisms need to be analyzed. Investigation on materials’ properties is considered as a pathway to higher performance in a bottom-up approach. This project will lay the extensive groundwork in understanding loss mechanisms that currently bottleneck mmWave acoustic resonators/filters. Unlike microwave acoustics, several negligible effects at microwave become more prominent at higher frequencies. These include higher fractional surface roughness, degraded film crystallinities in thinner piezoelectric films, imperfection inherent to different layer transfer techniques, and substrate electromagnetic loss. These limiting factors will be analyzed and associated with device performance in different operating frequencies. A clear understanding of these effects would help us develop the corresponding design philosophies for different structures in different frequency ranges. Additionally, this study would point out the direction on how lithium niobate thin-film technology should develop and promote the applications of lithium niobate thin films in other cross-cutting fields. Based on the proposed frameworks and the investigated effect of thin-film lithium niobate quality, this project develops design philosophies to enhance the quality factor and energy coupling of micro-acoustic devices. In addition to the improvement in material, novel designs and structures are essential to break the confined design space of state-of-the-art solutions and push the performance frontier to the physical limitations of the current era of science and technology. Specifically, this project would outcome the design philosophies for multi-morph structures that use lithium niobate thin film as the piezoelectric driver and one or two compensation layers in the device stack. The core objectives of the design philosophy are to utilize compensation layers to increase the quality factors and maximize energy couplings in the mmWave frequency range. As a result, micro-acoustic resonators/filters can be made with previously inaccessible design latitude. The project also focuses on advanced cost-efficient microfabrication methods. Microfabrication technology is the engine behind RF microsystems. Advances in microfabrication can enable novel structures to break limiting factors of size, cost, system integration, and power consumption in conventional systems, leading to higher performance. The new structures proposed in this project require the corresponding microfabrication processes, including single-crystal lithium niobate layer thinning, deposition of trap-rich layers, bonding of multiple thin films, lithium niobate dry etching, suspension of thin films, and device integration. The development of these microfabrication processes would help us to verify our theories and designs. Moving forward, feasible and cost-efficient microfabrication features would further promote the development and commercialization of the proposed frameworks.

26202122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26202122.value: 該項目旨在開發基於鈮酸鋰薄膜的新型框架，能同時在工作頻率、機電能量耦合和品質因數等方面提高射頻（RF）微聲諧振器/濾波器的性能前沿。微聲諧振器和濾波器已經在無線通信系統中發揮了至關重要的作用，用於訪問擁擠的頻譜，提高發射機的信噪比，降低通信鏈路的功耗，並最大限度地提高頻譜使用效率。隨著更多無線通信頻帶獲得許可，微聲諧振器和濾波器的重要性繼續增加，並且其諸多優點（包括小型化、低損耗和低成本大規模製造）使其在當前（5G）和未來無線通信中處於不可替代的地位。然而，隨著現代通信標準朝著更高頻率和更寬帶寬的方向發展，以滿足更高數據速率的應用，當下最先進的解決方案（即表面聲波和體聲波設備）可能因其物理限制而無法滿足這些嚴格的要求。十多年來，這些挑戰一直困擾著微聲諧振器/濾波器領域。因此，研究人員一直在尋求一種新型的微聲諧振器/濾波器，其能工作於前所未有的寬頻率範圍，並具有更高的轉換效率。 該項目旨在通過先進框架、材料研究、設計理念和微納製造等方面的多項創新來應對上述挑戰。首先，提出了三種新的框架，可在幾百MHz到50 GHz的頻率範圍內工作。為了推動性能前沿，將分析基於材料特性（本項目中的鈮酸鋰薄膜）的損耗機制。研究材料性能和器件性能之間的關係將有助於指明鈮酸鋰薄膜技術應如何發展並促進其在其他交叉領域的應用。此外，本研究將為不同頻率範圍的不同結構開發相應的設計理念，以打破當下先進解決方案的有限設計空間，將性能前沿推向當前科技時代的物理限制。除了在材料方面的革命性進步外，該項目還提出了兩種設計理念，以提高品質因數和機電能量耦合。最後，本項目還研究了先進的低成本微納製造技術，以製造和論證所提出的理論和設計。成功的論證將進一步促進擬議框架的開發和商業化。

26208122.label: Project Objectives
26208122.value: Consider a Bitcoin-like Blockchain with *static* transaction fees. Develop a fixed-parameter tractable algorithm based on graph sparsity parameters that, given a set Σ of transactions as input, finds the optimal block for a miner, i.e. the algorithm should output a block that maximizes the miner's revenue using transactions in Σ. Then, optimize this algorithm's runtime in terms of dependence on both |Σ| and the parameter. Consider a programmable Blockchain such as Ethereum with *dynamic* transaction fees. Develop a fixed-parameter tractable algorithm based on graph sparsity parameters that, given a set Σ of transactions as input, finds the optimal block for a miner, i.e. the algorithm should output a block that maximizes the miner's revenue using transactions in Σ. Then, optimize this algorithm's runtime in terms of dependence on both |Σ| and the parameter. Solve an online (dynamic) variant of Objective 1 in which Σ can change: new transactions can be added, or old transactions can be removed. Find an FPT algorithm that updates the optimal block after each addition/deletion in Σ. Note that each transaction in Σ has a given size and a given static fee. Solve an online (dynamic) variant of Objective 2 in which Σ can change: new transactions can be added, or old transactions can be removed. Find an FPT algorithm that updates the optimal block after each addition/deletion in Σ. Note that each transaction in Σ is a function call to a smart contract and has dynamic fees.

26208122.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26208122.value: -------------------- Synopsis -------------------- We consider a fundamental optimization problem in Blockchains and propose solutions based on parameterized complexity and formal program analysis. Our research is theoretical in nature, but it has direct real-world applications. For example, in our preliminary results, our approach increased Bitcoin miners' reveneus by a whopping 300,000 USD/day. -------------------- Research Abstract -------------------- Following the Bitcoin model, many modern Blockchains reward their miners/validators in two ways: (i) a base reward for each block that is mined, and (ii) the transaction fees of those transactions that are included in the mined block. The base reward is fixed by the protocol and is not under miners' control. Hence, for a miner who wishes to maximize earnings, the fundamental problem is to form a valid block with maximal total transaction fees and then try to add it to the Blockchain. Moreover, in many proof-of-work Blockchains, including Bitcoin itself, the base reward halves at predetermined intervals, hence increasing the importance of maximizing transaction fees and mining an optimal block. The problem of forming an optimal block is further complicated by the fact that transactions can be prerequisites of each other or have conflicts (in case of double-spending). Moreover, in programmable Blockchains, such as Ethereum, each transaction is a function call in a smart contract. Hence, interdependencies between transactions can become arbitrarily complicated, e.g. even the order of transactions in a block would affect the miner's revenue. In this project, we consider the problem of forming an optimal block, i.e. a valid block with maximal total transaction fees. We consider variants of the problem where the transaction fees are static and fixed for each transaction (as in Bitcoin) or dynamic and dependent on the runtime and resource usage (as in Ethereum). We have already shown that both cases are NP-hard and hard-to-approximate within a factor of 7/8+Ɛ unless P=NP. So, it seems the problems are unsolvable. However, we observe that the real-world instances of these problems are sparse, i.e. the transactions have very few dependencies and conflicts. As such, we propose to use graph sparsity parameters such as treewidth and pathwidth to obtain fixed-parameter tractable algorithms that run in polynomial time for the real-world sparse instances. We provide preliminary results, showing that this parameterized approach is applicable to Bitcoin and vastly outperforms the current Bitcoin miners in practice, obtaining a significant per-block average increase of 13.4% in transaction fee revenues. This translates to roughly 5 BTC~= 300,000 USD/day. 本研究针对区块链中的一个基础的优化问题，提出基于参数化复杂度和形式化程序分析的解决方案。本项目属于理论研究范畴，但是有直接的实际应用。例如，本项目的初步成果显示，对比特币矿工收益的提升可以高达每天30万美元。 继比特币模型之后，当前主流的区块链对矿工/验证者的激励机制分为两种：1）基于每个区块的发布给出基础激励，2）基于每个区块包含的所有交易记录对应的交易费给出激励。第一部分基础激励由区块链协议确定，而非由矿工控制。因此，为了最大化收益，矿工需要寻找含有最高交易费记录的合法区块，并且添加到区块链中。此外，在多数基于工作量证明(Proof-of-Work)的区块链（包括比特币）中，基础激励每经过一段指定时间会减半，因此寻找包含最大化交易费的最优区块变得尤为重要。 由于各交易之间可能存在前置依赖要求或者两两冲突（比如双重支付），寻找最优区块是一个复杂问题。而在以太坊之类的可编程区块链中，每个交易是智能合约中的函数调用，因而交易间的依赖关系非常复杂，比如区块中交易的顺序不同可能导致矿工收益不同，使得区块优化问题更加复杂。 本项目着眼于矿工寻找最优区块的问题，即寻找一个含有最高交易费收益的合法区块。具体而言，本项目不仅考虑比特币类型的固定静态交易费设定，也考虑以太坊类型的受运行时状况和资源调度影响的动态交易费设定。本项目已经显示两种设定下的问题都是NP-难问题，且难以达到7/8+ε的近似比，除非P=NP。所以，这个问题看似难以解决。但是，本研究发现实际应用中的实例具有稀疏特征，即交易之间的依赖和冲突是很少见的。鉴于此，我们提出了基于图稀疏参数（比如树分解宽度treewidth、pathwidth）的多项式时间复杂度的确定参数可解算法(FPT)。 本项目的初步结果显示参数化方法可以适用于比特币，其找到的区块显著优于比特币矿工的实际选择，平均每个区块可以提升矿工13.4%的交易费收益，相当于每天约5比特币（约30万美元）。

26208122.label: Major findings and research outcome
26208122.value: All objectives were successfully achieved. Specifically, we obtained the following huge improvements in the income of cryptocurrency miners: - Bitcoin: An improvement of 11.34%, corresponding to more than 10 million dollars per year [Published in the Journal of Combinatorial Optimization, 2025] - Cardano: An improvement of more than 50%, corresponding to almost 500,000 dollars per year [Published in IEEE Blockchain 2024] - Ethereum: An improvement of 73.45% per block, corresponding to roughly 63 million dollars per year [Accepted to appear in ICSE 2026]

26208122.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26208122.value: We have started collaborations with the Cardano Foundation and the Ethereum Foundation. Cardano is the 10th largest cryptocurrency in the world. Ethereum is the 2nd largest cryptocurrency and the largest programmable one. We have already co-authored one paper (IEEE Blockchain 2024) with the Cardano Foundation as part of this project. We have also been awarded an Ethereum Foundation Research Grant to study incentives and benefit maximization for honest miners.

26208122.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26208122.value: This work developed novel algorithms, using advanced techniques from parameterized complexity, to dramatically increase the revenues of cryptocurrency miners, reaching benefits of millions of dollars per year.

26209422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26209422.value: 具有期望值約束的數據驅動多層優化問題

26209422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26209422.value: 近年來，隨機多層優化問題引起了許多科研工作者的關注。 該問題為解決瑪律科夫決策問題，風險管理優化，線上矩陣恢復等問題提供了一個強大的工具。 學術界已經提出了多種演算法來解決隨機多層化問題。 儘管我們已經取得了一些成功，但現存的隨機多層優化演算法都依賴於向約束集上進行投影。 不幸的是，對於很多現實的問題，例如有期望值約束的優化問題，這一假設都無法實現。 如果不知道這些隨機變數的準確分佈，我們就無法向這些期望值約束上進行投影。 現實中的常規方法是把每一個期望值約束轉化成一個懲罰項，然後解決帶懲罰項的優化問題。 然而，此類方法需要很大的計算量去找到合適的懲罰比重。 因此，對於有大量期望值約束的問題，這些演算法的實際應用價值較低。 由於現有的演算法都無法解決這一關鍵的難點，我們需要提出新的方法去解決有期望約束的隨機多層優化問題。 在該科研專案中，我們會提出新的更為高效的演算法去解決具有期望值約束的隨機多層優化問題。 首先，我們將會研究我們演算法在不同步長下的實際表現和實際收斂速度。 接下來，我們會分析演算法的收斂性質，包括絕對收斂性和理論收斂速度。 我們會提出一些加速演算法並研究可以達到的最快收斂速度。 我們將會在現實的金融風險管控問題上測試我們演算法。 我們也會將演算法應用於現實世界中的重要的工業生產和管理問題。 我們認為這個科研專案可以幫助決策者進行更好的決策。

26214522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26214522.value: 結合動力學蒙特卡羅和機器學習對活性自由基聚合製備的功能聚合物進行計算機輔助設計

26214522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26214522.value: Polymers are an important class of materials that are being extensively used in the industry and households. Most commercial polymers are produced through conventional free radical polymerization (FRP), but controlled radical polymerization (CRP) has been revolutionizing the polymer reaction engineering field due to its high level of controllability and versatility. Therefore, it has been exploited in the construction of materials with advanced functions and properties. In order to make the best use of CRP for advanced materials design, computational models need to be developed to predict the structure and properties of the polymers based on a given synthesis reaction recipe. This will provide experimentalists with additional guidance and rationale in making the desired products. The kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) method was favored in simulating polymerization reactions, due to its ability to predict sequence details of polymer and radical chains. However, its practical applicability is largely limited by the low computational efficiency due to the large number of reaction events it needs to simulate. For modeling CRP this issue is further exacerbated because the design space can be much larger compared to FRP because there are more tunable reaction conditions that can have an impact on the product properties. Therefore, in this project I propose to overcome these challenges from two perspectives – improving the algorithm and improving the sampling strategy. First, I will improve the KMC algorithm by developing a method to significantly reduce the number of molecules it needs to simulate. It will be an extension of an existing scaling approach, whose application has been limited to FRP. Second, I will develop an active learning strategy to efficiently select sample points to obtain a good surrogate model for exact KMC simulations. Active learning methods employ certain strategies to iteratively select new sample points to maximize the informational gain, so that a well-performing surrogate model can be built with minimal sample points. Finally, I will use the developed model to perform synthesis recipe design for given property targets. In order for the model to be practically most useful, the optimization model will be solved multiple times to obtain contour lines of reaction conditions that can help achieve the design goal. The surrogate model constructed through active learning will be used for this purpose to ensure that the optimization model can be solved efficiently. Additionally I will develop the capability of online optimization by further including kinetic parameters as additional variables. 聚合物是一類重要的材料，被廣泛應用於工業和日常生活中。大多數商品聚合物是通過自由基聚合（FRP）生產的，活性自由基聚合（CRP）為控制聚合物分子鏈的分佈提供了有效手段。因此，它被用於構建具有先進功能和性能的材料。為了充分利用CRP進行先進材料設計，計算機模擬模型的應用十分重要。這些模型可以基於給定的合成反應配方預測聚合物的結構和性能。這將為實驗提供有效的指導。動力學蒙特卡洛 (KMC) 方法在模擬聚合反應中受到越來越多的應用，因為它可以預測聚合物和自由基鏈的序列細節。但是，它的實用性在很大程度上受到低計算效率的限制，因為大它需要模擬的反應事件的數量。對於 CRP 建模，這個問題更進一步加劇，因為與 FRP 相比，CRP設計空間更大，因為有更多可調節的反應條件。因此，本項目將從兩個角度克服這些挑戰——改進算法和改進採樣策略。首先，本項目將開發顯著減少KMC需要模擬的分子數的方法應用於CRP。它將拓展原來僅限於FRP系統的算法。第二，本項目會運用主動學習（Active Learning）有效選擇樣本點以獲得精確替代模型的策略KMC 模擬。主動學習方法採用某些策略來迭代選擇新的樣本點以最大化信息增益，從而可以用最少的樣本點建立好的代理模型。KMC模型將被用於數據的生成，而主動學習模型將縮短探索整個設計空間需要進行的KMC模擬次數。此外，該模型將被用於模擬聚合反應的在線優化，即應對實驗中可能需要的參數調整。

26300822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26300822.value: 河口海岸帶陸源有機碳的激發效應探究

26300822.label: Project Objectives
26300822.value: Identify whether the priming effect of terrestrial OM is prevalent in the Pearl River estuary and its coastal oceans. Evaluate the contribution of the priming effect to the rapid degradation of terrestrial OM. Determine the microbial communities that play key roles in the rapid degradation of terrestrial OM.
rows: Identify whether the priming effect of terrestrial OM is prevalent in the Pearl River estuary and its coastal oceans.
Evaluate the contribution of the priming effect to the rapid degradation of terrestrial OM.
Determine the microbial communities that play key roles in the rapid degradation of terrestrial OM.

26300822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26300822.value: As the most active zone of land-ocean interaction, estuaries and coastal seas, despite representing only 7% of the global ocean surface area, contribute about 80% of organic carbon (OC) burial, and thus play a key role in the global carbon cycle. Each year, global rivers transport an enormous amount of OC from terrestrial environments to the oceans. But this OC, known to be relatively refractory, is missing: only a very small fraction of this OC in seawater and marine sediments is found to be of a terrestrial origin. Determining the underlying biogeochemical processes and mechanisms that lead to “the missing terrestrial OC in the ocean” has remained as a key challenge for marine organic geochemists for decades. One possible mechanism is the “priming effect”: the occurrence of labile substrates stimulate the microbial degradation of refractory OC components. This is likely to occur during the mixing of terrestrial and marine materials at the land-ocean interface such as estuaries and coastal oceans, leading to the rapid degradation of terrestrial organic matter (OM) in marine ecosystems. However, our present knowledge about the priming effect is mainly restricted to soil science and freshwater environments, which are significantly different from coastal environments, and surprisingly, to date few studies have investigated OC priming in estuarine zones and coastal oceans. In this project, we will address this knowledge gap using the subtropical Pearl River (China) fluvial system, a large world river, and its adjacent seas as our study area. We will combine analyses of samples from field investigations and laboratory incubation experiments to assess the contribution of the priming effect to terrestrial OC degradation as well as its mechanism, by applying a series of state-of-the-art complementary OM characterization methodologies, including stable carbon isotope analyses, optical spectroscopy, molecular biomarkers, ultra-high-resolution mass spectrometry, and microbial molecular ecology tools. Our major objectives are to 1) identify whether the priming effect of terrigenous OM is prevalent in estuaries and coastal areas, 2) estimate the contribution of the priming effect to the rapid degradation of terrigenous OM in the ocean, and 3) evaluate the microbial communities which play key roles in the rapid degradation of terrigenous OM. Collectively, this project will not only shed light on “the fate of terrestrial OC in the ocean” and improve our understanding of the marine carbon cycle but also support teaching and interdisciplinary research in marine science. 河口海岸帶作為海陸相互作用最活躍的區域，雖只佔全球海洋表面積的7%，卻貢獻了其約80%的有機碳埋藏，因而在全球碳循環中發揮關鍵作用。全球河流每年將大量的有機碳從陸地輸送到海洋，然而海洋（海水和沈積物）有機碳中卻只有極小的一部分來源於陸地，儘管傳統研究認為河流搬運的陸源有機碳相對難降解。幾十年來，探究導致“海洋中陸源有機碳缺失”的生物地球化學過程和機制一直是海洋有機地球化學家面臨的關鍵挑戰。一種可能的機制是“激發效應”：活潑底物的添加激發微生物降解難降解的有機碳組分。其可能發生在陸海界面物質混合的過程中，進而導致海洋生態系統中陸源有機碳的快速降解。然而，目前對有機碳激發效應的認識主要局限於土壤和淡水環境，這與河口海岸帶環境有顯著差異。令人驚訝的是，迄今為止也很少有研究針對河口海岸帶陸源有機碳激發效應進行探究。 由此，我們將以中國亞熱帶珠江河流及其鄰近海域為研究區域，來嘗試探究這一科學問題。我們將結合實地調查和實驗室培養實驗，通過應用一系列先進的針對有機碳的表徵方法，包括穩定碳同位素、光譜、分子生物標誌物、超高分辨率質譜和微生物分子生態學手段，評估激發效應對陸源有機碳降解的貢獻及其機制。我們的主要目標是1)確定陸源有機碳的激發效應是否在河口海岸帶地區存在，2)估計激發效應對陸源有機質快速降解的貢獻。總而言之，該項目不僅將揭示”海洋中陸源有機碳的命運“，增進我們對海洋碳循環的理解，還有效支持海洋科學的教學和跨學科研究。

26304822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26304822.value: 研發用於癌症傳感和人工金屬酶的酶原活化機制

26304822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26304822.value: Over the past decade, researchers have shown that the chemoselective reactivity of abiotic transition metals (i.e. palladium, ruthenium, gold, etc) hold a lot of promise for developing various bioapplications. However, because these metals are so easily quenched and intrinsically toxic, concentrations used to remain under toxic thresholds are generally not enough to ensure prolonged periods of catalytic activity. To solve this problem, the overall aim of this project is to devise a system that can protect a metal catalyst before directing its exposure solely to a targeted environment. In this manner, in vivo catalytic activity can be increased while keeping concentrations well below toxic thresholds. To do this, the PI proposes the design of an artificial zymogen (defined as an enzyme precursor that is activated via non-natural mechanisms), which will be based on cysteine proteases (i.e. papain) and their inhibitor proteins (i.e. chagasin). The core hypothesis is that opposing forces applied on the N- and C-terminuses of chagasin should be enough to “pull apart” the protein to create a distorted tertiary structure with significantly lower affinity to cysteine proteases. To elicit these forces, peptide-based targeting sequences (RGD and AP2H) will be separately installed at each terminus. In this manner, an artificial zymogen can be created in which suppressed cysteine protease activity is turned on only in the presence of cancer cells that overexpress both targeted membrane receptors (integrins and LAPTM4B). To add further functionality to this work, papain-based artificial metalloenzymes will be created via conjugating the free sulfhydryl group in the protein active site to a metal catalyst complex. Then, by binding a modified chagasin that acts as a lid, the bound metal should be protected from the surrounding environment. In theory, these metals will only display catalytic activity once the lid is removed in the presence of cancer cells. As a direct outcome of this work, a cancer-responsive artificial metalloenzyme will be developed. Further research into creating prodrug therapies will see these systems not only benefit from the chemoselectivity of transition metals, but its cancer localized activity will allow minimal levels to maintain therapeutic effects. Overall, the hope is that this project will lead to a platform that can allow artificial metalloenzymes to better integrate into the development of future medicinal and biotechnological applications. 在過往的十年中，研究人員展示了利用非生物過渡金屬（如鈀、釕、金等）的化學選擇性反應來開發各類生物應用具有良好的發展前景。然而，由於這些金屬容易失去其活性且本身帶有毒性，在濃度不超過毒性閾值水平的情況下, 非生物過渡金屬的濃度通常不足以確保長時間的催化活性。為了解決這個問題，本項目的總體目標是設計一個可以保護金屬催化劑及只在目標環境下引導金屬催化劑釋放的系統。以這種方式，非生物過渡金屬可以在保持濃度遠低於毒性閾值下增加其活體內催化活性。為此，本項目負責人提議設計一種人工酶原（即為通過非自然機制活化的酶前體），該酶原將基於半胱氨酸蛋白酶（即木瓜蛋白酶）及其抑製劑蛋白（即 chagasin）。其核心假設是當chagasin的氮端和碳端被施加相反力量時應該足以 “拉開” 蛋白質以產生一種對半胱氨酸蛋白酶的親和力顯著降低的扭曲三級結構。為了產生這些力量，基於肽的靶向序列（RGD 和 AP2H）將分別加於兩個末端。以這種方式，將可以產生一種僅在遇到帶有兩種過度表現靶向膜受體（整合素和 LAPTM4B）的癌細胞時才釋放被抑制活性的半胱氨酸蛋白酶的人工酶原。 為使此項目能帶來更多用處, 此項目將通過聯接在蛋白質中活性部位的活性硫基和金屬催化劑複合物以創造出基於木瓜蛋白酶的人工金屬酶。改性chagasin將被作為蓋子和人工金屬酶結合以保護金屬免受周邊環境影響。理論上，只有在癌細胞存在的情況下蓋子才會被移除，而後這些金屬才會顯示出其催化活性。此項目將開發出一種對癌細胞有反應的人造金屬酶作為其直接成果。在前驅藥物治療的進一步研究上, 這些人造金屬酶將同時受益於過渡金屬的化學選擇性和針對癌細胞的局部活性, 從而使需要維持治療效果的劑量維持在最低水平。總體而言，此項目希望能夠帶來一個令人造金屬酶能夠更好地融入醫學和生物技術應用的未來發展的平台。

26305322.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26305322.value: 几何表示论中的无穷范畴方法，以及对扭结不变量范畴化的应用

26305322.label: Project Objectives
26305322.value: Provide a uniform approach to mixed geometry in the spirit of Beilinson, Ginzburg, and Soergel, using novel methods from higher algebra developed by Gaitsgory, Lurie, Rozenblyum, and others. Use the new theory of mixed geometry developed to construct new graded geometric categorifications of finite Hecke algebras. If time permits, affine Hecke algebras will also be considered. Apply the ideas of Ben-Zvi and Nadler to the new graded setting to study categorical traces and Drinfeld centers of finite Hecke categories, relating them to the Hilbert scheme of points on the plane. Apply the abovementioned results to understand annular braid invariants and their relations to the Hilbert scheme of points on the plane.

26305322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26305322.value: A knot (link) is an embedding of a circle (disjoint union of circles) in the three dimensional space $mathbb{R}^3$. Knot theory aims to find powerful but computable knot (link) invariants, i.e., algebraic objects associated with a knot (link), to detect when one object cannot be deformed to the other through an isotopy. HOMFLY-PT homology, one of the most powerful algebraic knot (link) invariants we understand, has many interesting connections with many mathematical fields, including algebraic geometry, representation theory, and physics. The PI aims to study these connections using new tools from higher categorical algebra and the Betti/Geometric Langlands program. In broad strokes, the strategy involves producing new geometric realizations of various versions of Hecke algebras and using them to interpret and study some of the abovementioned interesting connections. 一个扭结（链接）是一个圆（圆的不交并）在三维空间R^3中的嵌入。扭结理论旨在寻找强大但可计算的扭结（链接）不变量，即与扭结（链接）相关的代数对象，以检测何时一个对象不能通过同痕变形到另一个对象。HOMFLY-PT同调是我们所了解的最强大的代数扭结（链接）不变式之一，与许多数学领域有许多有趣的联系，包括代数几何、表示理论和物理学。该研究员旨在利用高等范畴代数和贝蒂/几何朗兰兹纲领的新工具来研究这些联系。大体上，该策略涉及到对各种版本的Hecke代数进行新的几何实现，并利用它们来解释和研究上述的一些有趣的联系。

26500422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26500422.value: Can policies aimed at liberalizing access to finance unintentionally induce risky strategic behavior by technology ventures, leading to inferior innovation performance as they scale up? Conventional wisdom suggests that financial resources are key to a venture’s ability to pursue innovation. On the one hand, the burdens associated with fundraising can dissuade ventures from seeking financing; on the other hand, governments have at their disposal a suite of policies to lift such barriers. In this proposed work, I will develop theory predicting that such liberalization policies have their limits and, under certain boundary conditions, can negatively affect innovation despite increasing resource access. I will examine this in the context of the post-initial-public-offering (IPO) innovation performance of U.S. biotech and IT ventures in the wake of a unique policy change in the last decade. In 2012, the U.S. Congress enacted the Jumpstart Our Business (JOBS) Act, exempting ventures below a certain size from disclosing a host of critical information to the public during an IPO. Notably, it significantly lowered (a) the degree of executive compensation structure and (b) the number of internal control mechanisms that had to be disclosed to the public. While the limited literature on disclosure deregulation has focused on immediate positive consequences (e.g., IPO volumes), I will develop a theoretical framework that helps predict the unintended, negative consequences of this liberalization. First, the lower regulatory burden (cost and complexity) attracts many ventures to go public while still being nascent. Firms in a nascent stage can lack the strategic competence required to manage large-scale R&D and successfully commercialize intellectual property. Second, a critical component of executive compensation – stock options – incentivizes excessive risk-taking because of its asymmetric design. I argue that hiding stock option information amplifies risk-taking away from investor scrutiny. In the long run, inefficient or risky strategies will precipitate inferior inventive performance. Preliminary analyses of U.S. patents, scientific publications, and data from clinical trials support these predictions. The study will contribute to the understanding of the complex ways in which institutions (specifically venture financing-related policy) affect the performance of innovative firms. It would be one of the few in strategy literature to argue that deregulation or liberalization aimed at helping ventures can turn out to be a double-edged sword and harm ventures in the long run. I aim to add to the literature on entrepreneurship, technology management, and IPOs, and generate implications for policymakers and entrepreneurs. 旨在放开融资渠道的政策是否会无意中引发风险战略？技术企业的行为，导致创新绩效低下，因为他们放大？传统观点认为，财务资源是风险投资的关键追求创新的能力。一方面，与筹款相关的负担可以阻止企业寻求融资；另一方面，各国政府在他们制定了一套政策来消除这些障碍。在这项提议的工作中，我将开发理论预测，这种自由化政策有其局限性，并且在某些情况下尽管增加了资源获取，但边界条件可能会对创新产生负面影响。我将在首次公开募股后 (IPO) 创新的背景下对此进行研究美国生物技术和 IT 企业在独特的政策变化之后的表现过去十年。 2012 年，美国国会颁布了 Jumpstart Our Business (JOBS) 法案，豁免 向公众披露大量关键信息的风险低于一定规模 在首次公开募股期间。值得注意的是，它显着降低了 (a) 高管薪酬的程度 结构和 (b) 必须向其披露的内部控制机制的数量 公众。虽然关于信息披露放松管制的有限文献集中在 直接的积极影响（例如，IPO 数量），我将开发一个理论 有助于预测这种意外的负面后果的框架 自由化。 首先，较低的监管负担（成本和复杂性）吸引了许多企业 公开，同时还处于萌芽状态。处于起步阶段的公司可能缺乏战略 管理大规模研发和成功商业化所需的能力 知识产权。其次，高管薪酬的一个重要组成部分——股票 期权——由于其不对称设计，激励过度冒险。我认为 隐藏股票期权信息会放大风险承担，远离投资者的审查。 从长远来看，低效或冒险的策略将导致低劣的发明 表现。对美国专利、科学出版物和数据的初步分析 临床试验支持这些预测。 该研究将有助于理解机构的复杂方式 （特别是风险融资相关政策）影响创新绩效 公司。这将是战略文献中少数认为放松管制或 旨在帮助企业的自由化可能是一把双刃剑 从长远来看会损害企业。我的目标是增加关于创业的文献， 技术管理和首次公开募股，并对政策制定者和 企业家。
