26500822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26500822.value: Businesses are increasingly deploying data-driven systems to make automated intervention decisions. Large-scale examples include targeting online advertisements, targeting retention incentives, and making online recommendations across a wide variety of business domains. In such tasks, data-driven systems can be used to identify individuals for whom a certain intervention will be most effective. Those people can then be subsequently targeted with that specific intervention. The purpose of the proposed project is to improve the decision making supported by such systems. One of the most important challenges when building data-driven systems that can support intervention decisions is acquiring adequate data. On one hand, businesses often acquire massive amounts of data as a matter of course; however, such data can be problematic for inferring cause-and-effect relationships due to confounding. Specifically, if intervened individuals are systematically different from non-intervened individuals, then data-driven systems may attribute a spurious cause-and-effect relationship to the intervention that should be attributed to the systematic difference between the groups. On the other hand, randomized experiments offer an alternative way to deal with confounding, but due to the costs of experimentation, they may result in data sets that are too small to accurately estimate causal effects at the individual level. With this in mind, the proposed project looks to develop and evaluate methods to leverage and combine both types of data in order to make better intervention decisions. The PI will extend his preliminary research in which he and another investigator developed an algorithm to correct for confounding errors in systems that predict cause-and-effect relationships. The focus of this proposed project is to (i) extend the previously developed algorithm to address errors specifically caused by unobserved confounders and correct for such errors in systems that predict optimal interventions, (ii) determine the general conditions under which the proposed algorithm is expected to improve decision making, (iii) showcase the utility of the algorithm in a variety of scenarios, and (iv) develop a software implementation of the proposed algorithm that will be publicly available to practitioners and researchers. The findings of the project will (a) inform future methodological developments for automated decision making, and (b) provide actionable results to practitioners looking to improve the decision-making performance of their data-driven systems. 企业越来越多地部署数据驱动系统来做出自动化干预决策。相关使用案例包括在线广告、客户保留激励以及在各种业务领域进行在线推荐。在此类任务中，数据驱动系统可用于识别针对某项干预最有效的个体。这些个体随后可以成为特定干预的目标。本研究的目的是改进此类系统支持的决策。 在构建可以支持干预决策的数据驱动系统时，最重要的挑战之一是获取足够的数据。一方面，企业经常会理所当然地获取大量数据；但是，由于混杂，此类数据对于推断因果关系可能存在问题。具体来说，如果受干预的个体与未干预的个体存在系统性差异，那么数据驱动的系统可能会将虚假的因果关系归因于干预，而这本应归因于两类个体之间的系统差异。另一方面，随机实验提供了另一种处理混杂的方法，但由于实验的成本，它们可能导致数据集太小而无法准确估计个体层面的因果效应。考虑到这一点，本研究希望开发基于观测数据以及实验数据的方法，以便做出更好的干预决策。 本人将扩展已有的初步研究，即一种算法用来纠正预测因果关系中的混淆错误。本研究的重点是（i）扩展先前开发的算法以解决由未观察到的混杂因素引起的错误，并通过纠正此类错误来预测最佳的干预，（ii）确定该算法可以用于改进决策的一般条件，(iii) 展示算法在各种场景中的实用性，以及 (iv) 开发对从业者和研究人员公开可用的基于该算法的软件。 本研究结果将 (a) 为未来的自动化决策方法的开发提供依据，以及 (b) 为从业者提供可操作的依据用以提高其数据驱动系统的决策表现。

26500822.label: Realisation of objectives
26500822.value: All project objectives were successfully achieved. Below, we describe how each was realized and summarize the key findings and outcomes. 1. Propose a new machine learning algorithm that can leverage both observational and experimental data to improve the intervention decisions made by data-driven systems. We developed a novel machine learning framework that uses limited experimental data to refine the outputs of any predictive scoring model, including those trained purely on observational data. In this framework, observational data are first used to build a predictive model, and experimental data are then employed to post-process its scores so they better align with causal decision making. This two-stage approach enables data-driven systems to integrate both data sources effectively—leveraging the scale of observational data while incorporating the causal validity of experimental data. 2. Benchmark the potential improvement in decision making that the proposed algorithm could achieve in a variety of scenarios. We conducted extensive benchmarking analyses across a range of settings that varied in (a) the amount of experimental data available and (b) the degree of misalignment between observational estimations and causal effects. The results show that our approach performs best in intermediate regimes—where both experimental data and causal misalignment are moderate. When alignment is very high and experimental data are scarce, a purely observational model tends to perform better. Conversely, when alignment is low and experimental data are abundant, relying solely on experimental data is preferable. These findings provide practical guidance on when causal post-processing is most beneficial. 3. Derive a set of theoretically and empirically motivated conditions under which the proposed algorithm could lead to better intervention decisions. We derived and validated several theoretically and empirically motivated conditions describing when our method improves decision making. Empirically, we confirmed that causal post-processing works best in intermediate data regimes. We also analyzed several existing algorithms originally designed for other purposes, showing how they can be repurposed to combine observational and experimental data for intervention decision making. This analysis clarified the complementary regions where these approaches perform best. For instance, some methods for effect calibration can be used effectively when alignment is high but experimental data are limited, while other methods for heterogenous effect estimation can be repurposed to perform well when alignment is low and experimental data are abundant. However, no existing algorithm performs well when both alignment and experimental data availability are low. Theoretically, we characterized: - When observational models can be fully causally aligned. This occurs when a latent variable acts as both a moderator and a confounder, causing the bias in observational estimates to vary systematically with effect size in the same direction. - When predictive (non-causal) models can still recover causal ordering reasonably well. This tends to occur when the proxy model (a) explains substantial variance in effect heterogeneity, (b) produces scores that are monotonically related to causal effects, and (c) estimates the proxy with high precision. These results were reported across three separate papers stemming from this project. 4. Create a software implementation of the proposed algorithm that will be publicly available to practitioners and researchers. We developed and released an open-source software implementation of our algorithm. The implementation is available on GitHub and can be readily applied by practitioners and researchers to improve data-driven intervention decisions: https://github.com/ferlocar/deconfounder/tree/causal-postproc

26500822.label: Major findings and research outcome
26500822.value: This ECS produced three complementary research outcomes that together advance how observational and experimental data can be integrated to improve data-driven intervention decisions. The project also strengthened research capacity: the research assistant originally funded by this grant became my PhD student and is now co-authoring follow-up work. 1) Causal Post-Processing of Predictive Models (under review at Management Science) This paper introduces causal post-processing (CPP)—a new framework that uses limited experimental data to refine the scores of predictive models trained on observational data. CPP combines the scale of observational data with the causal validity of experimental data, with the goal of improving intervention decisions. Theoretical analysis, simulations, and an advertising case study show CPP works best in intermediate regimes—when experimental data and structural alignment are moderate. This paper fulfills all project objectives: algorithm design, benchmarking, derivation of theoretical and empirical conditions, and creation of an open-source implementation. 2) Causal Ordering Without Effect Estimation: A Framework for Using Proxies in Treatment Prioritization (in preparation for submission to Information Systems Research) This theoretical work complements CPP by developing a framework for causal ordering—ranking individuals by treatment effects when effect estimation is unreliable. It identifies when proxy-based models (e.g., baseline-outcome or surrogate-behavior predictors) can recover correct causal orderings. The paper derives conditions—dominant moderation, monotonic relationships, and high signal-to-noise ratio—when combining observational and experimental evidence should succeed. These insights underpin the theoretical conditions described in § 5.3 (Objective 3). 3) Observational vs. Experimental Data When Making Automated Decisions Using Machine Learning (published in INFORMS Journal on Data Science, 2025) This publication extends the project’s theoretical analysis by comparing models trained on confounded-but-large observational data versus smaller unconfounded experimental data. It formalizes the causal bias–variance trade-off and shows that confounding does not always harm—and can even improve—decision quality when it aligns with effect magnitude. The paper also introduces weaker-than-ignorability conditions under which confounding preserves effect rankings, along with heuristic checks and practical tools for practitioners. Overall impact. Together, these outcomes deliver (i) a deployable method (CPP) to combine experimental validity with observational scale; (ii) a theoretical foundation for when proxy models can yield good intervention decisions; and (iii) formal and empirical guidance on when confounding may not hinder causal decision-making—directly achieving the project’s objectives and establishing a foundation for future decision-focused causal ML research.

26500822.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
26500822.value: The results of this project open several promising avenues for future research. First, the causal post-processing (CPP) framework can be extended to multi-action and continuous-treatment settings, enabling richer decision optimization in applications such as pricing, recommendation, and healthcare. Further work will also explore adaptive versions of CPP that can continuously update causal corrections as new experimental data become available. Second, the theoretical framework for causal ordering invites empirical validation across domains where proxy-based decision systems are common. This includes developing practical diagnostics to assess causal alignment when experimental data are scarce and integrating these tools into applied machine-learning pipelines. Third, the findings on the bias–variance trade-off between observational and experimental data motivate a more general theory of causal data value—quantifying when investing in experiments yields meaningful returns for decision quality. In the next stage, we plan to formalize these extensions into a unified decision-focused framework and implement them in open-source software to support both academic research and industry adoption. Collectively, these efforts aim to bridge predictive modeling and causal inference more tightly within real-world decision systems.

26500822.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
26500822.value: Many organizations today use predictive models to decide who should receive an intervention—such as which customers to target with promotions, which patients to treat, or which users to show an ad. However, these models are usually designed to predict what will happen, not what will change because of the intervention. As a result, their recommendations can be ineffective or even counterproductive. This project developed new ways to align decision systems with causal reasoning—that is, better aligned with how interventions actually affect people. The main contribution is a method called causal post-processing, which uses small amounts of experimental data (for example, from an A/B test) to adjust the predictions of existing models, improving decisions without rebuilding the system. The project also advanced the theory behind when combining observational and experimental data works best and when confounding (bias in the data) might not harm decision quality. These insights help organizations understand when to rely on existing data and when running experiments is worth the cost. Overall, the research contributes both new methods and guidance for making data-driven decisions that are more effective, fair, and scientifically sound.

26507422.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26507422.value: 成功学习 vs. 失败学习

26507422.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26507422.value: When we embark on a new problem, decision, or task, we often seek out the experience and advice of others to help guide our own behavior towards successful outcomes. What type of experience do we aim to learn from? And what kind of advice do we elicit? In our research, we hypothesize that people are not agnostic in seeking out any kind of experience or advice, but that people actively solicit information about how others succeeded, far more than other how others failed. More specifically, we predict that people have a stronger desire to learn from the experience of others who have succeeded on a similar problem, compared to the experience of failures. Therefore, we believe that people will be more likely to ask for advice focusing on what to do to achieve successful outcomes, rather than what they shouldn’t do or what to do to avoid failures. In addition to documenting this preference to ask for advice that focuses on successful experiences, our research aims to explore why we have this preference and whether this preference benefits us in terms of our own learning and performance. Do we solicit the most optimal advice or would it be more helpful for us to seek out information on failures, specifically ways in which we can avoid failures? 当我们试图解决问题、做出决策、以及完成任务的时候，我们经常向他人寻求意见，以期以他人的经验来指导我们自己的行为从而获得成功。在这个过程中，我们在寻求什么样的经验？我们通常得到的又是怎样的经验？ 在我们的研究中，我们假设在寻求获得他人经验的时候，人们不是未有预设的，相比于他人失败的经验，人们在更多的主动寻求获得他人成功的经验。具体来说，相比于向拥有失败经验的人学习，人们更倾向于向在处理类似问题有成功经验的人学习。所以我们认为，在寻求意见的时候，人们更有可能会以“我应该做什么以获得成功”为核心来提问，而不是以“我应该做什么以避免失败”来提问。 在研究人们对寻求获得他人成功经验的偏好之外，我们的研究将会探索人们为什么会有这样的偏好，以及对成功经验的偏好是否会对学习有帮助、对绩效有利。那么，寻求了解成功的经验是否是一种最优的策略，寻求了解失败的经验、尤其是了解如何避免失败是否会更有帮助？

26603022.value: 美联储中的“影响者”：个人特征和魅力如何影响联邦公开市场操作委员会的政策决策

26603022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26603022.value: Monetary policy at central banks is usually the result of a deliberation process within a committee of policymakers, which decides on future policy implementation based on majority vote. It has been shown by the literature that the organization, size and other characteristics of these committees affects the way monetary policy consensus is built, which has potentially important implications for the aggregate economy. One of the fundamental challenges in achieving consensus stems from the heterogeneous beliefs and preferences of policymakers. In terms of beliefs, the uncertainty inherent to policy-making in real time might lead committee members to disagree on the fundamental causes of the economic conditions faced by the central bank. In terms of preferences, central banks typically target a dual mandate based on price stability and full employment, but trade-offs between the targets usually exist in the short-run and policymakers exhibit heterogeneous preferences with respect to the importance assigned to each. In this project, I will study how the preferences and persuasion capacity of policymakers affects the beliefs and votes of other members, and how this translates into the consensus policy adopted. To do so, I will employ an exclusive dataset collected by Dordal Carreras et al. (2021) on the FOMC committee at the US Federal Reserve that contains a detailed classification of individual preferences for policy direction, speed of adjustment, perceived policy trade-offs and peer-to-peer interactions and disagreements. Using this data, I will create individual measures of discussion centrality (influence scores) for each member and study how they correlate with the preferences and beliefs that they hold. On a second step, I will merge the previous variables with a dataset on detailed personal and professional characteristics of the FOMC members, and study how those characteristics affect the preferences of each policymaker. Lastly, I will investigate the predictive power of these characteristics in determining the influence score of each member, and ask whether the influence capacity of policy-makers is rooted on their professional experience and policy record, or on the contrary, on idiosyncratic characteristics of the individuals akin to what is commonly referred as a `charming' personality. 中央银行的货币政策通常是由政策制定委员会审议决定，该委员会根据多数票决定未来的政策实施。文献表明，这些委员会的组织、规模和其他特征会影响货币政策共识的达成方式，这对整体经济具有潜在的重要影响。达成共识的基本挑战之一源于决策者的不同理念和偏好。就理念而言，即时决策固有的不确定性可能会导致委员会成员在中央银行面临的经济状况的根本原因上存在分歧。在偏好方面，中央银行通常以价格稳定和充分就业为基础的双重使命作为目标，但目标之间的权衡通常存在于短期内，且政策制定者在分配给每个目标的重要性上显示出不同的偏好。 在这个项目中，我将研究决策者的偏好和说服能力如何影响其他成员的理念和投票，以及这如何转化为所采用的共识政策。为此，我将使用 Dordal Carreras 等人（2021 年）收集的关于美联储的 联邦公开市场操作委员会的独家数据集，其中包含对政策方向、调整速度、政策权衡以及点对点互动和分歧的个人偏好的详细分类。通过这些数据，我将单独衡量每个成员的讨论中心度（影响力得分），并研究它们如何与他们持有的偏好和理念相关联。 第二步，我将把前面的变量与关于联邦公开市场操作委员会成员详细的个人和专业特征的数据集合并，并研究这些特征如何影响每个政策制定者的偏好。最后，我将考察这些特征在确定每个成员的影响力得分方面的预测能力，并探讨决策者的影响力是基于他们的专业经验和政策记录，还是相反，是基于个人的特征，即类似于通常所说的“迷人的”人格。

27105922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27105922.value: Objectives: Dementia is a neurodegenerative disease. Both encephalopathies (presented as seizure, delirium or psychosis) and infections are common in people living with dementia. Some classes of antibiotics are suspected to cause encephalopathies; however, some may reduce cognitive decline, which makes them potential good candidates for antimicrobial treatment among people living with dementia. Nevertheless, complications of infections can also cause encephalopathies. There is an urgent need to detangle the associations between infection, antibiotics and encephalopathies. This study aims to 1) compare the epidemiology of dementia and antibiotic use across Hong Kong, the United Kingdom and New Zealand 2) assess the risk of the encephalopathy-related hospitalization rate among people with dementia during periods of antibiotic exposure compared with periods of non-exposure; and 3) and assess the risk among specific antibiotic drug classes. Hypothesis: Antibiotics may increase cognitive burden. People with dementia are at high risk of adverse outcomes if exposed to these medications due to their lack of cognitive reserve. Design and subjects: Population-based study with self-controlled case series analysis, which is a within-individual comparison study design. People with dementia with both an event of encephalopathy-related hospitalization, and exposure to antibiotics. Study instruments: Population-based data collected from Hong Kong, the United Kingdom and New Zealand. Intervention: The exposure to antibiotics. Main outcome measures: The incidence risk ratio of encephalopathy-related hospitalization during antibiotics exposed periods compared to non-exposed periods. Data analysis and expected results: The rates of encephalopathy-related hospitalization during periods of antibiotic exposure will be compared to non-exposure periods to obtain incidence rate ratios. Conditional Poisson regression will be used. We expect that the risk of encephalopathy-related hospitalization is higher before antibiotic exposure periods when compared with antibiotics exposure and non-exposure periods, possibly due to the condition for which antibiotics were prescribed. Some classes of antibiotics—namely doxycycline and aminoglycosides—may demonstrate a decreased risk during exposure periods when compared with other antibiotic classes. Exposure to different antibiotic drug classes may demonstrate different magnitudes of risk. Results across databases should yield similar findings. 研究目的：認知障礙症是一種神經退行性疾病。腦病（如:癲癇，精神錯亂，精神病） 和細菌感染在認知障礙症群眾中比較常見。有一些抗生素類別發現可以引起腦病， 但是有一些抗生素類別也發現可以減慢認知能力下降的速度，所以它們有潛力可以醫治認知障礙症。但是，細菌感染的併發症亦都可以引起腦病。因此，我們有迫切需要理解細菌感染，抗生素和腦病之間的關係。這項研究的目的是： 1） 比較在香港，英國，紐西蘭三個不同地方認知障礙症和抗生素使用的流行病學 2）評估認知障礙症病患者被處方抗生素期間同沒有抗生素期間相比較的腦病入院風險 3） 比較不同特定抗生素類別的腦病入院風險 。 假設：抗生素有可能增加認知負荷。認知障礙症患者認知存能較低，因此接觸抗生素後出現不良後果的風險較高。 研究設計和對象：採用以人口數據為研究基礎的個案自我對照法，這個設計並沒有一個平行對照組，採用的是自我對照。研究對象是有過腦病入院和有被處方抗生素的認知障礙症病患者。 研究工具：來自香港，英國和紐西蘭的人口數據。 干預： 抗生素。 主要結果測量： 抗生素和沒有抗生素的腦病入院的發生率比值。 數據分析和預期結果： 通過比較有抗生素和沒有抗生素期間的腦病入院發生率計算發生率比值。我們將會應用條件泊松回歸模型計算。我們預期有抗生素之前和期間，與沒有抗生素期間比較的話，腦病入院風險比較高，估計原因是病人被處方抗生素的當時條件。我們預期有些抗生素類別例如四環素和氨基糖苷類同其他類別相比，腦病入院風險有可能比較小。不同的抗生素類別將會引起不同的風險程度。我們亦預期不同的數據庫將會產生相似的研究發現。

27112522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27112522.value: 用於快速開發siRNA藥物的超精確shRNA平台

27112522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27112522.value: 自從第一個RNAi治療藥物Patisiran於2018年獲得FDA批准以來，其他三種RNAi藥物也已獲得批准。預計到2030年，諾華公司的RNAi藥物Inclisiran的市場規模將達到每年40億美元。雖然目前已經確立了RNAi用於肝臟靶向遞送和長期表達的化學修飾，但仍存在瓶頸。新RNAi藥物的快速開發是從疾病相關基因的編碼DNA序列(CDS)和 3' 非轉譯區(3’UTR)內的數百或數千個候選者中選擇合適的siRNA序列。 為了確定有效且安全的小分子干擾核糖核酸(siRNA)序列，RNAi公司通常會合成數百種可能的siRNA，並使用基於微量盤的檢測方法測試其有效性。這種策略的一個嚴重問題是：在進行小鼠實驗之前，他們無法全面測試候選藥物的長期副作用。 另一種小RNA平台利用小髮夾核糖核酸(shRNA)克服上述限制，因為shRNA可以與大規模寡核苷酸合成、高通量FACS篩选和單細胞RNA測序相結合。因此，理論上，我們可以通過在細胞模型中使用shRNA庫來減少siRNA候選藥物的數量，然後只使用化學修飾的siRNA進行體內小鼠實驗。然而，目前可用的shRNA設計無法產生精確的小RNA，從而阻礙了shRNA數據和siRNA數據之間的可互換解釋。 基於我們在小分子干擾核糖核酸 (miRNA) 方面的專業知識(Cell 2016；Molecular Cell 2019；NAR 2020)，我們測試了新的shRNA設計而其中一種設計可以產生超精確的小RNA。在來自shRNA的所有小RNA中，93.1%是用戶定義的。 相反，兩個目前可用的 shRNA 的異質小 RNA 分別只有 47.1±21.8%和 58.7±5.4%的用戶定義的小RNA。 利用這個新的shRNA設計，我們將建立一個全面的可藥用siRNA序列篩選平台，可用於肝病相關的蛋白。為了驗證概念，我們將尋找針對轉甲狀腺素蛋白的高效但脫靶減少的siRNA序列，來治療遺傳性轉甲狀腺素蛋白介導的澱粉樣變性（一種進行性和致命的疾病）（慢病毒shRNA將僅用於siRNA序列篩選步驟。RNA藥物將是化學修飾的siRNA，因為siRNA藥物公司已經建立了化學修飾。）。在學術界，我們的shRNA平台將取代以前不完善的shRNA設計，以 成為每個實驗室的新標準。

27117022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27117022.value: 與腸道菌群相關的抑鬱症及其菌群的可調節性

27117022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27117022.value: 抑鬱症是受生理、心理及社會等多種因素影響的疾病。早前的研究結果發現約68.5%香港大學生患有輕度至重度抑鬱症狀。隨著近年的社會動蕩和冠狀病毒的影響，這種情況甚至將有可能惡化的趨向。腸、腦軸線的雙向交流一直是最近研究的焦點，以破譯腸道菌群在抑鬱症發展中的作用。大多數過去的觀察性研究之中，患者群體的樣本數量有限，這使研究結果容易受到多種因素的影響；例如年齡、飲食、疾病和藥物等。在我們的試點研究中，我們從患有抑鬱症狀學生的糞便中，觀察到菌群多樣性顯著降低，並發現B. thetaiotaomicron 和B. animalis 與大學生抑鬱症狀發展的關聯。因此，我們將會以大學生作為研究對象進行更大規模的前瞻性隊列研究，以進一步證實腸道菌群在抑鬱症狀發展中的因果關係或中介作用。 目前醫學上仍缺少可作生物標誌物的糞便細菌進行簡單而低成本的抑鬱症診斷。為了制定抑鬱症的干預策略，我們將評估腸道菌群誘發的抑鬱症及其菌群可調節性，以及 B. thetaiotaomicron 和 B. animalis 與抑鬱症狀發展的關聯性。我們初步以小鼠作出的實驗顯示，將帶有抑鬱症相關菌群(DM) 的小鼠與含有正常菌群(NM) 的小鼠共同飼養一週，可以改善DM小鼠的抑鬱症行為，這可能是NM小鼠令DM 小鼠的菌群正常化導致的。然而，我們仍然需要探索在共同居住的環境下對無菌 (GF) 小鼠腸道菌群和行為表型的影響，並驗證 B. thetaiotaomicron 和 B. animalis 與抑鬱症狀發展之間的關聯機理。本研究將通過在GF 小鼠中的多組學術研究，有系統地分析菌群組對宿主代謝的調節，探索菌群誘導的抗抑鬱症的發病機制，並進一步通過GF 小鼠的慢性及不可預測輕度壓力模型 (CUMS)對B. thetaiotaomicron 和 B. animalis 的功能進行研究，及評估它們在臨床診斷和治療策略中的適用性。

27118022.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27118022.value: 分子伴侶介導的植物葉綠素代謝熱保護研究

27118022.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27118022.value: Temperature is an essential environmental factor that significantly determines plant development and crop yield. Increased temperature owing to climate changes poses a serious threat to protein homeostasis by causing misfolding and/or denaturation of proteins. To cope with this threat, plants have evolved sophisticated molecular chaperone systems that assist protein folding and prevent thermal-induced aggregation of proteins. However, the molecular function of various chaperones in plants remained to be elucidated. Photosynthesis is vital for most life on the earth as it supplies us with oxygen and food. As the most abundant photosynthetic pigment, chlorophyll is a fundamental element of photosynthesis. Chlorophylls, which are embedded into the various light-harvesting chlorophyll a/b-binding proteins and the core chlorophyll-binding proteins of the photosystem I and photosystem II, allow plants, green algae, and cyanobacteria to absorb solar energy and initiate light reaction of photosynthesis at the thylakoid membrane of chloroplasts. Newly synthesized chlorophyll must be timely incorporated into the chlorophyll-binding proteins, as chlorophyll is essential for correct folding and assembly of the chlorophyll-binding proteins while accumulating free chlorophylls will generate toxic reactive oxygen species upon illumination and further cause irreversible photooxidative damage to living cells. Therefore, various auxiliary factors are required to ensure optimal chlorophyll biosynthesis and to synchronize chlorophyll biosynthesis with the biogenesis of the photosystem-antenna complexes during chloroplast development and stress response. However, little is known about the function of molecular chaperones in the regulation of chlorophyll metabolism under heat stress. It is hypothesized that molecular chaperone-mediated quality control of chloroplast proteins is essential for proper chloroplast development and heat stress tolerance. This project is aimed to address the regulatory function of three chloroplast-localized molecular chaperones, including the chloroplast signal recognition particle 43 and two DnaJ proteins, CHAPERONE-LIKE PROTEIN OF POR1 and ORANGE, in the thermoprotection of the chlorophyll biosynthesis pathway. Employing the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana, methods in genetics, plant physiology, molecular biology, and biochemistry will be applied to systematically investigate three chloroplast chaperones for the posttranslational control of two tightly regulated enzymes of the chlorophyll biosynthesis pathways, including magnesium chelatase and light-operating protochlorophyllide oxidoreductase. The functional divergence and redundancy between three molecular chaperons in the chlorophyll biosynthesis pathway will be demonstrated. Understanding molecular chaperone-mediated protein quality control will help develop the next generations of horticultural and crop plants with optimized heat tolerance capacity. Thus, this fundamental research will lay the basis for the potential agricultural application in the future. 溫度是決定植物的重要環境因素發展和作物產量。全球氣候變化導致氣溫升高，並進一步導致蛋白質的錯誤折疊和變性，嚴重威脅蛋白質的分子功能。為了應對這種威脅，植物進化出了複雜的分子伴侶系統幫助蛋白質折疊，防止蛋白質的錯誤折疊和聚集沉澱。然而，植物中各種分子伴侶的分子功能仍有待研究。光合作用對地球上的大多數生命至關重要，因為它為我們提供氧氣和食物。作為最豐富的光合色素，葉綠素是一種基礎光合作用的元素。葉綠素，嵌入到各種捕光葉綠素 a/b 結合蛋白和光系統的核心葉綠素結合蛋白中，幫助植物、綠藻和藍細菌吸收太陽能並在類囊體膜上啟動光合作用的光反應。新合成的葉綠素必須及時組裝進入葉綠素結合蛋白，因為葉綠素對於蛋白的正確折疊至關重要，游離葉綠素在光照下產生有毒的活性氧並進一步導致不可逆對活細胞的光氧化損傷。因此，光合生物需要各種輔助因子確保最佳的葉綠素生物合成，並使葉綠素生物合成與葉綠體發育過程中光系統-天線複合物的生物發生同步進行。然而，人們對分子伴侶在熱應激下調節葉綠素代謝的功能知之甚少。據推測分子伴侶介導的葉綠體蛋白質量控制對於提高葉綠體發育和節葉綠素代謝熱應激耐受性必不可少。該項目旨在解決三個葉綠體定位的分子伴侶的調節功能，包括葉綠體信號識別粒子 43 和兩個 DnaJ 蛋白，在熱保護葉綠素生物合成途徑的分子功能。本研究採用模式植物擬南芥，將應用遺傳學、植物生理學、分子生物學和生物化學方面的方法系統地研究三種葉綠體伴侶翻譯後水平控制葉綠素生物合成途徑中兩種關鍵酶，包括鎂螯合酶和光光依賴原葉綠素氧化還原酶作用機制，並分析三個分子伴侶之間的功能差異和冗餘。了解分子伴侶介導的蛋白質質量控制將有助於開發下一代具有優化耐熱能力的園藝和農作物。因此，該研究为潛在的農業應用奠定基礎。

27125522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27125522.value: 以光遺傳學解密成年的體型大小

27125522.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27125522.value: 適當的發育需要協調各組織的生長和分化, 而這個過程是由內分泌腺來完成的，它接收整個身體的信息，並通過分泌激素來支配和傳遞有系統的決定。信息通過激活細胞表面的受體傳遞給內分泌腺，而受體又通過Erk等途徑激活下游信號。了解這些信號如何被傳遞和處理以控制生長和通過生物成熟檢查點的進程是一個重要的生物學問題，對開發治療有關生長和分化的疾病至關重要，如糖尿病和被名為RASopathies的發育障礙。這項工作的目的是了解在青春期到成年過渡期間，生物如何整合來自整個身體的信號以設定成年尺寸。我們設計了利用光遺傳學來控制果蠅幼蟲Erk通路的方法，使我們能以果蠅幼蟲作為一個生物模型系統，了解Erk信號如何協調整個生物的成熟和生長。孵化後，幼蟲的尺寸增加了一千倍，隨後生長停止，開始蛻變，並設定成蠅的尺寸。這種轉變的時間是由幾個不同的受體激活下遊的類固醇激素生產控制的，每個受體都傳達著各種有關於生物體的大小、年齡和營養狀況的信息。然而，所有這些受體都是通過Erk途徑來傳遞信息的，Erk途徑對這一過程至關重要。因此，我們試圖了解這些不同的受體是如何通過Erk來傳遞信息，並隨後整合來決定成體的大小。以前的研究已經確定了這個過程的關鍵受體，但沒有確定它們所帶來的下遊信號傳導的動態。此計劃書希望成為第一個使用活細胞生物傳感器來描述幼蟲內分泌腺中的內源性信號，以捕捉其下遊信號的動態。通過在缺乏內源信號下進行光遺傳學控制，我們可以完全控制這些信號，使我們能夠探究下遊基因網絡是如何作出和處理這些大規模的決定。這項工作大大地擴展了我們對內分泌系統如何整合競爭信號的認識，有可能為治療青春期與成人的發育障礙提供新的見解。

27200822.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27200822.value: 新型聚合物和二維過渡金屬硫化物異質結構中的超快電荷動力學

27200822.label: Project Objectives
27200822.value: Develop a series of novel hybrid organic/2D-TMD heterostructures with type-II energy level alignments based on donor polymers with low energetic disorder (including D18 and PM6), and study the underlying charge dynamics using ultrafast optical spectroscopy techniques. 27200822.value: 半導體異質結構上的光致電荷產生是許多光電應用的基礎，包括光電探測器、太陽能和生物傳感。然而，當前光電器件使用的無機晶體材料不適合在柔性和仿生應用中的使用。相比之下，有機聚合物半導體和二維無機過渡金屬硫屬化物（2D-TMDs）由於其柔韌性、化學可調性和生物相容性而成為有前途的新型半導體材料。有機半導體因其強的光吸收和發射而被廣泛認可，但由於其無序的性質而具有較差的電荷傳輸。相反，2D-TMD（如 MoS2 和 WS2）具有出色的面內電荷傳輸和有趣的激子特性，但它們的光吸收較弱且電荷壽命較短。 混合有機/2D-TMD 異質結構提供了一個平台來利用它們的互補優勢。先前的報導表明，光生激子可以在混合界面上進行超快電荷轉移以形成自由載流子，從而在所有光伏技術中獲得最高的單位厚度功率輸出。這突出了它們在超薄和透明太陽能電池或光電探測器方面的潛力。然而，目前的混合系統顯示出相對較低的電荷分離產率（內部量子效率（IQE）<40%），並且仍然缺乏對界面光物理學的全面了解，為進一步研究和優化留下了很大的空間。 在這個項目中，我們的目標是使用超快光譜研究混合有機/2D-TMD 異質結構中的界面電荷動力學，並確定提高其 IQE 的策略。迄今為止開發的最有效的系統是 PTB7/MoS2 (IQE~40%)，其中 PTB7 是一種經過充分研究的給體聚合物，用於有機光伏 (OPV)。 申請人和其他人以前的工作表明，減少有機層中的能量無序對於抑制界面電荷重組至關重要。此外，2D-TMD 層中的表面缺陷可能導致顯著的界面電荷俘獲。 因此，用最先進的低無序供體聚合物（Urbach 能量 <30meV；例如 PM6 和 D18）替換 PTB7 並使用具有低缺陷的高質量 2D-TMD 層是改善混合異質結構中電荷分離的有希望的方法.在我們的初步工作中，我們通過將低無序供體聚合物旋塗到 2D-TMD 單分子層上成功地製造了新型雜化異質結構，顯示出顯著的光致發光猝滅和大大延長的電荷壽命（因此表明雜化界面處的有效電荷分離）。我們與 Lain-Jong Li 教授合作，旨在揭示電荷動力學與界面能量學和缺陷之間的精確關係。我們的結果將為具有高電荷產生 IQE 的混合設備鋪平道路。

27201922.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27201922.value: 健康建築的興起：來自新數據集的經濟評估

27201922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27201922.value: Human beings spend around 90% of their time indoors (Klepeis et al., 2001), but indoor spaces may expose their occupants to health risks, such as infectious diseases and pollutant-related illnesses. In the workplace, inadequate ventilation and poor indoor air quality might increase the incidence of sick leave (Milton, 2000) and mental distress (Wong et al., 2009), while reducing labor productivity (Palacios et al., 2020). The significant health impacts of the built environment have captured the attention of regulators, the public, and investors, who are increasingly demanding more transparency through building certification. The latest COVID-19 crisis further elevates these health-related concerns, as more than 90% of reported infections occur indoors (Bulfone et al., 2021). Even energy-efficient buildings (i.e., “green buildings”) are not exempt from health issues. For instance, an energy-efficient building with poor indoor air circulation may facilitate the spread of airborne viruses, casting doubt on the conventional thinking that only energy savings matter. This project will provide the first-ever academic insights into the economic incentives that affect the supply of healthy spaces in commercial buildings by leveraging a dataset compiled from two global healthy building certification programs operated by Fitwel and WELL. In this study, I will examine whether certified commercial buildings enjoy higher rents and occupancies than comparable non-certified buildings. I will then address whether and how building-level cost–benefit trade-offs translate into outperformance (or underperformance) of owners’ stocks. In other words, do capital market investors respond more (or less) favorably when building owners include healthy buildings in their portfolios? The difference-in-differences research design will help identify the causal link between incentives to building owners to incorporate healthy building technologies and the associated economic consequences. The findings will help answer several important questions. What drives the rise of healthy buildings? What value do investors assign to healthy buildings? How does building health awareness affect real estate performance? All else equal, health risk acts as an additional tax that reduces the building occupants’ labor productivity due to incidents such as sick leave (Anelli and Koenig, 2021). However, if property owners do not reap benefits from investing in healthy buildings due to a lack of building health awareness, the market for such buildings cannot thrive. The findings of this research will help policymakers and investors explore policy measures that reduce information asymmetry, providing prospective investors and tenants with a credible signal regarding the impact of the built environment on health. 人類大約 90% 的時間都在室內度過，建築環境對人的身體健康有重要影響。在2019冠狀病毒病大流行期間，90% 以上的感染發生在室內，這使人們對「節能優先」等傳統觀念產生疑慮。健康風險作為一種附加稅會降低建築使用者的生產效率。本研究首次使用來自 Fitwel 和 WELL 的數據集量化「健康建築」的經濟價值。研究預期，獲得「健康建築」認證的物業比沒有認證的物業回報率更高。本研究項目將「健康建築」認證和房地產企業所持物業進行匹配，然後使用雙重差分模型驗證上述預測。研究成果將有助於回答推動「健康建築」認證興起的因素和投資者對「健康建築」的投資回報預期。雖然健康風險會降低建築的使用效率，但是如果業主和投資者無法從投資「健康建築」中獲益，那麼「健康建築」的市場將無法興起。研究成果還有助於政策制定者和投資者減少信息不對稱，為潛在投資者和租戶提供量化建築環境對人的身體健康影響的方案。

27202322.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27202322.value: Entrepreneurship is a significant contributor to facilitating economic development through creating innovations and boosting employment. Cities are competing with each other to attract entrepreneurs to come and establish new ventures, while knowledge externalities are found to be spatially bounded with heterogeneous effects on urban development (Raspe and van Oort, 2011). Existing studies are limited to analyzing the rise of new ventures without unravelling how access to financial resources, especially venture capital (VC) within a local or regional economy, affects the entrepreneurship-induced growth of a city (i.e. urban entrepreneurship). Filling this knowledge gap can advance our understanding of the interactive mechanism between urban and financial landscapes. The primary question this research seeks to address is ‘What is the relationship between financial capital and urban entrepreneurship?’. To address this question, the proposed research newly combines the Schumpeterian growth model (Audretsch et al., 2006) with network capital discourse (Huggins, 2010) as the theoretical foundation to examine the impact of financial capital on urban entrepreneurship. The Schumpeterian theory underpins entrepreneurship-induced “creative destruction” for sustaining economic growth, while network capital discourse provides a framework to capture the network effects of formal VC-startup relations as “venture network capital”. Following this line of reasoning, this research takes advantage of VC investors’ expertise on evaluating startups’ growth potential as a natural filter for Schumpeter’s “Unternehmergeist” (entrepreneur spirit), and utilizes VC-startup relations as a flow metric to construct business networks in which local startup “buzz” and VC business network “pipelines” are interconnected (Bathelt et al., 2004). VC, as a significant financial source for entrepreneurs, have grown considerably in China over the past two decades, providing enough observations and dynamic changes for this research. Based on the Wind VC database, the spatial-temporal-industrial pattern of VC-backed entrepreneurship in China is elucidated. We then employ a social network analysis (SNA) approach to exploit venture network capital embedded in VC-startup business networks. These network variables are further specified in fixed effect panel regression models to estimate the effect of network capital on startups’ performance. Finally, spatial regression models are used to examine the aggregated impact of VC-backed entrepreneurship on China’s urban economic development. The research complements the conventional Schumpeterian growth model by incorporating network capital conceptual relevance. Practically, the results will help VC investors and startups acknowledge their network positions and target strategic partners efficiently, and assist city governments formulating policies to strengthen urban economic competitiveness. 創業能力通過促進創新和就業成為經濟發展的重要引擎，是城市保持經濟活力和可持續發展的關鍵。因此城市為吸引創業家和創造友好的創業環境展開激烈的競爭。然而，初創企業的外部性被發現局限在特定空間範圍，具有極高的城市異質性 (Raspe and van Oort, 2011)。 目前的研究主要集中在初創企業本身，而忽略了初創企業和金融資本的交互機制，尤其是忽略了本地或區域經濟內的風投資本的重要性。填補此研究缺失能夠幫我們認識金融和城市發展間的交互機制，有助於回答本項目的核心問題‘金融資本和城市創業能力有什麼關係？’。 本項目開創性地將熊彼特經濟增長模型和網絡資本理論結合起來，建立風投網絡資本的理論框架，分析金融資本對於城市創業能力的影響。熊彼特理論強調創業產生的‘破壞力’對產業升級和維持經濟成長的重要作用，而網絡資本理論為捕捉風投資本和初創企業之間的網絡效應提供了分析路徑。在此理論框架下，本項目將利用風投機構在評估初創企業發展潛力上的專業能力作為天然的過濾器，篩選出有發展潛力和經受市場檢驗的初創企業組建跨區域公司網絡（Bathelt et al., 2004）。 風投資本，作為初創企業發展的重要資金來源，在中國大陸已經有近二十年的發展歷程，為本項目提供了豐富的觀察對象和動態變化。基於萬得金融數據庫，本項目首先分析風投資本支持的城市創業能力的空間-時間-產業格局。然後我們應用社會網絡分析方法對風投資本組織形成的初創企業網絡進行分析，量化初創企業在網絡中的表現。這些網絡變量將會被代入固定效應的面板回歸模型中探索網絡資本對於初創企業發展的影響。最後，我們將對初創企業進行地址匹配並採用空間回歸方法檢驗風投資本支持的城市創業能力對於城市經濟發展的整體效用。 本項目將通過結合網絡資本概念來拓展傳統的熊彼特增長模型。在實證方面，研究結果將會幫助風投機構和初創企業更好的認清自身網絡位置和採取相應的發展戰略，同時也會為地方政府提高城市經濟競爭力提供政策建議。

27204522.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27204522.value: 面向深度無線感知的信號處理與深度學習協同設計

27204522.label: Project Objectives
27204522.value: Objective 1 - Learning-Assisted Spectrogram Enhancement: To design a Spectrogram Enhancement Network (SEN) to break down the fundamental limitations of frequency leakage of Fourier transform and generate high-fidelity spectrograms for wireless sensing. Many wireless sensing approaches, either model-based or data-driven, employ Short-Term Fourier Transform (STFT) on a time series of radio data to obtain time-frequency spectrograms of human activities. STFT suffers from errors due to an effect known as leakage, when the block of data is not periodic (the most common case in practice), which results in a smeared spectrum of the original signal and further leads to misleading data representation for learning-based sensing. Classical approaches reduce leakage by windowing, which, however, cannot completely eliminate leakage. In effect, they only change the shape of the leakage, in a slightly different way with a different windowing function. Conversely, utilizing learning-based methods promises to push the boundaries beyond classical limitations and, in turn, provide high-fidelity spectrograms for further learning tasks. This project introduces a spectrogram enhancement network to learn an optimal function to minimize or nearly eliminate the leakage, thereby outputting an unparalleled spectrum with high accuracy. Objective 2 - Polarized Convolutional Network: To design a Polarized Convolutional Network (PCN) that polarizes the spectrograms by specially modulated phase information, preserving the spectrogram’s local features and the global discrimination simultaneously. The Radio Frequency (RF) spectrograms are like images by format, and thus it is straightforward to employ convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to extract underlying features from them, as is commonly done in the literature. Invented mainly for perceptual data, CNNs learn local features irrespective of global locations of objects in an image, allowing images to be shifted. Unfortunately, the locality property makes CNNs inappropriate for RF spectrogram learning, as the global locations represent absolute frequencies, which are correlated with the physical properties of a person’s activities and are not shift-invariant. Instead of inputting the spectrograms directly, we consider a PCN by introducing artificial phases to polarize the spectrograms to be locally unaltered while globally differentiated. Then, we will study complex-valued convolutional operators to extract features from the polarized spectrograms. Compared to CNNs, the PCN will preserve both the local and global features and thus boost the learning performance. Objective 3 - Physical Data Augmentation for Deep Wireless Sensing: To develop techniques for Physical Data Augmentation (PDA) for radio data to boost the training process and reduce the efforts of cumbersome radio data collection and labeling. Data augmentation is a widely used technique in computer vision fields to overcome overfitting when there is not sufficient data for training. These kinds of techniques are particularly useful for deep wireless sensing as it is much more difficult to collect and label large-scale datasets. Common techniques for image data augmentation, such as scaling, cropping, flipping, and translation, however, are not suitable for radio data. No generic framework of data augmentation exists for wireless sensing. This project pursues generic radio data augmentation techniques by exploiting the physical properties of the RF sensing data. Specifically, we plan to leverage frequency diversity to generate multi-subcarrier spectrograms, space diversity to generate multi-antenna spectrograms, and time diversity to generate multi-resolution spectrograms, all together boosting the training dataset, physically and significantly. Objective 4 - Task-Adaptive Network and Case Study: To build a Task-Adaptive Network (TAN) that can be flexibly customized for different sensing tasks and conduct real-world case studies, especially on critical and challenging applications such as fall detection and in-car child presence detection, among others. Specifically, this project aims to design a TAN with the proposed PCN to extract high-level feature maps of the spectrograms and a compression network to reduce feature dimensions. Built upon this, we seek to implement the proposed framework with commodity WiFi chipsets and validate the performance on challenging wireless sensing tasks in real-world settings. We particularly focus on two critical applications of elder fall detection and in-car child presence detection (i.e., detecting unattended children left in a car to avoid heatstroke deaths), both requiring very high accuracy. Targeting at a generic framework, we will also evaluate other applications like gesture recognition, gait recognition, multi-person sleep monitoring, etc. We will also benchmark the system against state-of-the-art networks, such as those for WiFi/FMCW radar/acoustic sensing and the existing complex-valued networks. We expect to open-source the framework as well as the baseline implementations, and further, build and release a large-scale dataset to be available to both the sensing and learning communities. We will also leverage our strong connections with industry to seek real-world adoption of the proposed techniques.

27208022.value: 當前的機器學習模型，尤其是基於深度學習的模型，已經能夠在許多任務上取得突出表現，比如能夠在圖像識別中超越人類水平。然而，這樣的成功依賴於海量人工標註數據。在實際中，人工標註海量數據代價很昂貴。例如，著名的ImageNet數據集包含了來自1000個物體類別的一百多萬張圖像。一方面，標註全世界所類別的物體是不可能的，同時會有新的物體類別產生。另一方面，標註某些特定的數據，比如醫療數據，需要專業知識，這使得海量標註不切實際。許多半監督學習的方法同時利用有標註數據和無標註數據來進行訓練，以減少對海量標註的依賴。然而，這些方法假設標註數據和無標註數據都來自於相同物體類別。在現實生活中，我們通常面對一個開放的世界，我們無法事先知道物體類別，或者沒有任何標註信息。遺憾的是，當前的機器學習方法在開放世界設定下無法取得令人滿意的表現。換句話說，在沒有額外標註的情況下，機器不具備自動組織數據、理解物體概念(如類別)的能力。因此，在這個項目中，我們研究從無標註數據中自動發現和識別新類別的問題。在該問題中，我們假設有來自部分類別的一些圖像有標註，而不是把這個問題當做一個完全無監督的聚類問題。從這部分標註的數據中，我們期望模型能夠學到物體類別組成的屬性知識，進而將這樣的知識遷移到無標註數據上進行新類別發現。在本項目中，我們計劃聚焦於（1）提出能夠有效融合全局結構和局部細節特徵的算法來進行新類別發現；（2）利用物體的視覺屬性和語言模型，提出可解釋的物體概念學習框架進行新類別發現；（3）將類別發現問題擴展到更具挑戰性的開放世界設定，同時在這個新問題設定下提出新的基準方法。關於新物體類別發現的研究還處於起步階段，我們希望本研究的成果能夠揭示如何讓當前的機器學習模型從標註數據中學習視覺概念，並遷移到無標註數據，從而讓機器具備自動處理無標註數據的能力。這將促進現有的機器學習方法在開放世界場景中的應用，例如在自動駕駛中自動發現沒有見過的物體、在衛生保健中發現新疾病/藥物、在自然界中發現新物種等。

27212822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27212822.value: Virtual, augmented, and mixed reality (VR|AR|MR) systems are a next-generation computing platform with extensive applications in entertainment, education, communication, training, medical visualization, automotive assistance, as well as basic vision and bio research. In all these applications, the primary interface between the user and the device is a near-eye or head-up display. High-fidelity displays that offer vivid 3D visual experience have always been demanding, but proven difficult to achieve. Holographic displays are poised to be a transformative technology in this domain, because of their potential to address long-standing challenges of conventional refractive type displays in delivering focus and depth cues, vision correction capabilities, small device form factors, high image resolution, brightness, and dynamic image as well as eye-box steering capabilities. However, the limited space-bandwidth product of individual devices hinders its widespread use. Until recently, computer-generated holography (CGH) has suffered from a fundamental tradeoff between algorithm runtime and achieved image quality. Our recent work on Neural Holography [1] has taken the first step of demonstrating how to overcome this tradeoff using artificial intelligence. Neural Holography has demonstrated unprecedented 2D holographic image and video quality using newly developed camera-in-the-loop calibration and optimization techniques. In addition, real-time framerates using a neural network architecture, dubbed HoloNet, has been achieved. Notably, this existing work is still in its infancy, and we are excited about the prospects for expanding our work to find practical solutions for VR/AR/MR display technologies, as described in this proposal. We are eager to explore the benefits of incorporating advances in optics with advances in machine intelligence to develop intelligent human-centered systems. With this proposed work we aim to solve several remaining important challenges of Neural Holography that currently limit this technology from being a practical VR|AR|MR solution: (i) we will miniaturize our holographic light engine and couple it to a diffractive waveguide to enable the near-eye holographic display AR experience; (ii) we will address image quality concerns created by both coherent and partially coherent light sources in waveguides (i.e., speckle vs. blur) using a partially coherent Neural Holography approach that utilizes LED light sources; (iii) we will extend our holographic light engine and incorporate it into a freeform optical combiner and an optimized Etendue expander to enable the head-up holographic display AR experience; (iv) we will develop real-time 3D neural holography algorithms to enable focus and depth cues with holographic near-eye and head-up displays. 虛擬、增強和混合現實 (VR|AR|MR) 系統是下一代视觉計算平台，可廣泛應用於娛樂、教育、通信、培訓、醫學可視化、汽車輔助以及基礎視覺和生物研究。在這些應用中，用戶和設備之間的主要界面是近眼或平視 (抬头) 顯示器。业界对提供生動三维視覺體驗的高保真顯示器的需求一直很高，但事實證明是非常具有挑战的。全息顯示有望成為該領域的一項變革性技術，因其有巨大潛力以解決傳統折射型顯示器在提供焦點和深度提示、視力矯正能力、小型化設備外形、高圖像分辨率、亮度的動態圖像以及眼框轉向功能。然而，單個設備或器件有限的空間帶寬積阻礙了其廣泛使用。 直到最近，計算機生成全息術 (CGH) 一直在算法運行時間和所實現的圖像質量之間進行基本權衡。课题组成员最近在神經全息術 [Neural Holography] 方面的工作展示了如何使用人工智能克服這種權衡的第一步。通过使用新開發的相機闭環校準和優化技術，神經全息術展示了前所未有的 2D 全息圖像和視頻質量。此外，其亦實現了稱為 HoloNet 的神經網絡架構以达到實時幀速率的全息图生成。值得注意的是，這項研究工作還處於起步階段，课题组很高興看到在本提案的背景下進一步探索其成為 VR/AR/MR 顯示技術的實際解決方案的巨大潜力。该提案研究的核心是探索結合光學和機器智能進步的带来的巨大优势。 通過本项擬議的工作，我們旨在探索解決神經全息術的幾個剩餘重要挑戰，這些挑戰目前限制該技術成為實用的 VR|AR|MR 解決方案，具体而言：(i) 我們將小型化全息光学引擎並將其耦合到折射或衍射波導以實現近眼全息顯示的AR體驗； (ii) 我們將借鉴利用 LED 光源的部分相干神經全息术解決由波導中的相干和部分相干光源（即散斑與模糊）產生的圖像質量問題； (iii) 我們將擴展全息光学引擎的能力並將其整合到基于自由曲面光學組合器和潜在的经过優化的 Etendue 擴展器中，以實現平視（抬头）全息顯示 AR 體驗； (iv) 我們將探究開發實時 3D 神經全息图生成算法，以通過全息近眼和平視顯示器實現焦點和深度提示。

27310822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27310822.value: Quantum metrology provides the foundation for a new generation of ultra-precise sensors, powered by quantum resources such as entanglement and coherence. Quantum metrology features a broad spectrum of applications, ranging from entanglement enhanced interferometry, which has already been applied to gravitational wave detection, to networks of quantum sensors and quantum radar, which may reshape sensor science in the future. Nevertheless, a major limitation exists on the conventional model of quantum metrology: it adopts a Markov assumption that the signal interacts with the sensor in a time-uncorrelated fashion. This limitation hinders the application of quantum metrology in situations where the physical process carrying the signal has intrinsic memory. For example, frequent and brief measurements performed on a two-level system coupled to a heat bath can result in non-Markovian effects beyond the conventional model of quantum metrology. As the first step of addressing this issue, the PI proposed in two recent Physical Review Letters papers a novel approach of quantum metrology that is applicable to non-Markovian processes. It allows for the evaluation of the ultimate accuracy of probing a generic non-Markovian physical process. Nevertheless, the current theory focuses on single-parameter estimation, whereas many practical tasks involve multiple parameters. For instance, to benchmark a quantum computer, it is essential to account for not only single-qubit errors but also the crosstalk between different qubits, whose effect depends on multiple parameters. When the computation lasts for a long time, the effect of the crosstalk will become more prominent, leading to multiple complex and temporally correlated noise patterns. Such situations are likely to appear much more frequently in the near future, as increasing the scale and the depth of quantum circuits has become a major objective of quantum computing. The main target of the proposed project is to develop our approach into a complete framework of non-Markovian quantum metrology, by incorporating the case of multiparameter estimation. We will tackle some critical questions in quantum computing and sensing, such as benchmarking deep quantum circuits. In turn, based on near-term quantum technologies, we will propose and experimentally demonstrate novel intelligent quantum sensors that deal with non-Markovian noises in quantum metrology automatically. This project will explore a new research direction of quantum metrology and tighten the bond between it and quantum computing. It will output a series of efficient criteria for building and testing larger-scale quantum computers and shed light on next-generation quantum sensors with robustness to complex time-correlated noise. 量子精密測量為下一代精密傳感器打下基礎，用糾纏和相干性等量子資源達到更高的傳感精度。量子精密測量有著廣泛的應用前景，包括量子糾纏顯微技術、引力波檢測、量子傳感器網絡、量子雷達等。然而，量子精密測量的傳統理論模型有著一個較大局限，即該模型假設信號與傳感器之間的作用關係符合時間無關的馬爾科夫假設。該局限限制了量子精密測量在被測物理過程擁有內在記憶情境下的應用。例如，頻繁的測量一個與熱源連接的雙能級系統便會導致以上模型失效的非馬爾科夫效應。 為了解決以上問題，項目負責人在近期兩篇發表在《物理通訊快報》上的工作中提出了一個應用於非馬爾科夫過程的量子精密測量理論的新方法。該方法可以計算任意非馬爾科夫精密測量問題的可達到的最大精度。然而，該方法局限於單參數測量問題，而許多實際問題涉及多個參數。例如，為了衡量量子計算機的表現，不僅需要考慮單個量子比特的誤差，亦需要考慮多比特之間的關聯誤差，而該類型誤差通常涉及多個參數。隨著量子計算運行時間增長，多比特關聯誤差的效應會愈發顯著，從而導致複雜且時間上關聯的誤差模式。這些情境將隨著量子計算的發展變得愈發重要。 本項目的主要目標是將負責人前期理論推廣為一套涵蓋多參數量子精密測量理論的完整框架，並用以解決量子計算和傳感中幾個關鍵問題，如長量子線路的基準測試。反過來，基於近期量子技術，我們將設計並通過實驗展示可以自動處理非馬爾科夫噪聲的全新的智能量子傳感器。 本項目將探求量子精密測量的一個全新方向，並加深其與量子計算之間的聯繫。項目擬產出一系列用於製造和測試更大規模量子計算設備的基準條件，並為具備對複雜噪聲魯棒性的下一代量子傳感器的設計帶來新的思路。

27315922.label: Project Objectives
27315922.value: Objective 1: Develop superoxide-specific chemical probes and chemoproteomics platform to monitor superoxide level and to identify proteins associated with superoxide redox biology. Issues and elements of the problem: Currently, we do not have good tools and technology to study superoxide redox biology. Superoxide is found to contribute to serious diseases such as cancer and neurodegenerative disorders, but also is essential to life and can serve as an important signaling molecule when it is produced in a controllable fashion. Its regulations on protein activity is mainly through oxidative modifications which are relatively unstable in biological environment, making the detection of these modifications and identification of proteins involved very difficult by conventional biochemical/biological experiments. As a result, molecular mechanisms on initiation, transduction and regulation of oxidative modifications, as well as how this superoxide biology associates with disease development and progression, remain poorly understood. Our proposed solutions: To better understand superoxide biology, we propose to identify protein targets modified/regulated by superoxide using superoxide-specific probes and chemoproteomics platform. Our superoxide probes, QMP-SO, can react with superoxide to generate quinone methide intermediate, which can further react with nucleophilic amino acids on protein targets of superoxide biology. Therefore, these proteins, instead of modified by superoxide with unstable modifications, will be covalently tagged by QMP-SO in the presence of superoxide. The covalent tag is stable in biological samples, and its alkyne handle allows further functionalization through click chemistry. Thus, the tagged proteins can be identified by our chemoproteomics platform coupled with LC-MS/MS. In addition, cellular superoxide level can also be monitored by installing fluorophore onto tagged proteins through click chemistry and subsequent measurement of fluorescence intensity. Furthermore, in order to unravel the complex superoxide biology in mitochondria which is one of the major sources of endogenous superoxide, we will incorporate mitochondria-targeting group onto QMP-SO, so that the probe can localize specifically in mitochondria and study the key superoxide biology there. Significance: Our novel superoxide-specific chemical probes and chemoproteomics platform should be powerful tools to discover new superoxide biology by monitoring superoxide level in biological samples and identification of new proteins regulated by superoxide. This should enable in-depth study on how superoxide biology is initiated, transduced and regulated. The high specificity of QMP-SO toward superoxide can give us better understandings on different biological roles of superoxide from other ROS. The mitochondria-targeting probe should be valuable for studying complex superoxide biology in mitochondria. All these should shed light on the association of superoxide redox biology with diseases, and identification of proteins which can promote better health and/or be new targets for developing better therapy. In a broader chemical context, the proposed strategy is highly versatile and should initiate the development of similar probes and chemoproteomics platform for studying other ROS biology. Objective 2: Identify superoxide as one of the key regulators of HIF-1α stability and activity. Issues and elements of the problem: In literature, there is equally compelling evidence supporting or disagreeing regulatory roles of superoxide on HIF-1α biology. HIF-1α is an important protein governing cell survival in hypoxic conditions, and shows strong associations with cancers due to the importance of its gene transcripts for cell survival and proliferation, glucose metabolism and angiogenesis. Earlier work suggested that under hypoxia, an increase in mitochondrial superoxide resulted in HIF-1α accumulation and stabilization. Although there seems to be a link established between superoxide and HIF-1α biology, opposite results have also been reported and support ROS-independent regulations of HIF-1α. This discrepancy can be due to different expression levels of superoxide in these reported studies, which are not measured precisely using superoxide-specific probes, resulting in complications in examining effects of superoxide on HIF-1α. Our proposed solutions: We will apply the more advance superoxide probes QMP-SO and the chemoproteomics platform to study roles of superoxide on HIF-1α in normoxic and hypoxic cells respectively. QMP-SO should enable good monitoring of cellular superoxide levels through incorporating fluorophore onto tagged proteins by click chemistry. With this important property to confirm superoxide stimulation/depletion, we will then identify protein targets associated with superoxide biology in the normoxic/hypoxic cells through MS-based chemoproteomics experiments. The protein targets showing close association with HIF-1α biology will be further examined by treating cells with activator/inhibitor of these targets to examine their effects on HIF-1α stability and activity. We anticipate that JNK, p38α MAPK, HIF PHD and FIH can be potential proteins being regulated by superoxide which can modulate HIF-1α biology. Significance: Identifications of new regulatory roles on HIF-1α by superoxide should significantly increase our knowledge on HIF-1α biology as well as cross-talk between superoxide and HIF-1α in cancer development and progression. These superoxide-regulated proteins can also be new druggable targets for cancers with HIF-1α hyperactivity. In addition, the findings in normoxic cells should open up new avenues of studying molecular mechanisms of redox stress on causing cancers, where HIF-1α can be a key pathway.

We anticipate that JNK, p38α MAPK, HIF PHD and FIH can be potential proteins being regulated by superoxide which can modulate HIF-1α biology.

Significance: Identifications of new regulatory roles on HIF-1α by superoxide should significantly increase our knowledge on HIF-1α biology as well as cross-talk between superoxide and HIF-1α in cancer development and progression. These superoxide-regulated proteins can also be new druggable targets for cancers with HIF-1α hyperactivity. In addition, the findings in normoxic cells should open up new avenues of studying molecular mechanisms of redox stress on causing cancers, where HIF-1α can be a key pathway.

27315922.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27315922.value: 超氧化物是生命系統中產生的內源性活性氧 (ROS) 的主要來源之一。它與嚴重疾病的形成和發展，如癌症和神經退化性疾病，有密切的關係。同時，超氧化物也可作為重要的信號分子，以維持生命系統的正常運作，因此了解這種複雜的超氧化物生物學有望找出促進健康的方法和開發更好的療法。不過，現在我們對超氧化物生物學仍沒有充分的理解，其中一個主要原因，是因為它通常涉及可逆修改，如蛋白質氧化，從而改變蛋白質活性和下游信號。這些不穩定的可逆修改，是很難通過常規的生化/生物學實驗來研究，箇中的複雜性可見於超氧化物對缺氧誘導因子-1,α亞基(HIF-1α) 活性的影響。HIF-1α 是一種在缺氧條件下控制細胞存活的重要蛋白質，並與癌症密切相關。儘管有不少研究指出超氧化物可調控HIF-1α的活性，但同時也有不少實驗結果反對這一說法。 為了能更了解超氧化物生物學及其對 HIF-1α 和相關疾病的調控作用，我們擬議開發新的超氧化物探針和化學蛋白質組學平台，以測定超氧化物水平和確認參與超氧化物生物學的蛋白質身份。正如初步結果所支持的，我們的超氧化物探針 QMP-SO 可以與超氧化物反應生成甲基醌中間體，該中間體可以進一步和參與超氧化物生物學的蛋白質上親核氨基酸反應。透過這方法，參與超氧化物生物學的蛋白質會被 QMP-SO 共價標記，在這共價標記上的炔烴手柄可通過點擊化學(click chemistry)進一步功能化，用於成像/化學蛋白質組學實驗，以監測超氧化物水平並識別參與超氧化物生物學的蛋白質。QMP-SO 的初步實驗結果顯示，在甲萘醌培養下的 HepG2細胞，有更高的內源性超氧化物水平和更多的標記於超氧化物相關蛋白上。另外，在被表皮生長因子(EGF) 刺激的細胞中，QMP-SO成功地鑑定SOD1 和 Akt1為參與超氧化物生物學的蛋白質。在缺氧條件下，QMP-SO可以標記到在常氧條件下不被探測到的超氧化物相關蛋白。這些蛋白質可以是調節 HIF-1α 生物學的重要一員，它們的鑑定將有助解答長期存在的超氧化物如何調節 HIF-1α 的問題。 這項擬議項目的完成將為超氧化物生物學的研究建立新的工具和平台，我們的方法也可以廣泛地用於研究其他 ROS 生物學。而當中解答超氧化物對 HIF-1α 的調節作用，更可增加我們對 HIF-1α 生物學的認識，以及超氧化物和 HIF-1α 在癌症成因和進展中的相互作用。

27500622.label: Project Objectives
27500622.value: Construct a unique dataset on the equity division for early-stage technology ventures in China with rich information at the firm, the entrepreneur, and the founding team levels. Develop a theoretical framework to predict and empirically investigate the relative importance of knowledge contribution in comparison to other forms of contribution in equity split decision among entrepreneurial founders of technology ventures. Introduce a dynamic perspective to examine how the initial equity split agreement forged at the start of the company is adjusted over the course of venture development. Validate the underlying mechanism for the changing role of knowledge contribution in equity split by examining the moderating effects of technological uncertainty and cofounders’ prior experience in innovation/venture evaluation. Investigate to what extent professional investors such as venture capital (VC) funds facilitate the equity split adjustment process. Examine to what extent prior relationships among founders affect the equity split adjustment process. Provide strategic implications for entrepreneurs and investors regarding equity division negotiations, founding team dynamics, and funding partnerships and inform entrepreneurship- and innovation-focused policy making through an investigation into the role of state-affiliated VC funds in founder equity adjustment process.

27500622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27500622.value: 股权分配直接影响初创企业创始团队成员的财务回报，进而影响他们的动机、付出的努力以及利益一致性。由于初创企业的发展是由许多事件决定的，创始团队很难在最初的股权分配协议中准确估计每个成员的贡献的未来价值。当创始团队成员的贡献是通过想法、技术和信息等无形知识的方式体现时，这一评估挑战尤其艰巨。无形知识虽然对于价值创造极其重要，但其很难评估，也很容易被盗用。 本课题研究知识贡献在科技初创企业股权分配决策中的影响。我从技术市场的文献和创业行为理论中得到启示，提出以下研究问题：1）在企业发展过程中，知识贡献的（相对）价值如何变化？与其他形式的贡献相比，知识贡献在最初的股权分配协议中是否被 "高估"？随着时间的推移和企业的发展，知识贡献是否会被相对更多地调整？2）股权分配的调整在多大程度上由所涉及知识的性质以及联合创始人先前的创新创业经验所决定？3）专业投资者（如风险投资公司）是否可以促进初创企业建立更加合理的股权分配以及调整机制？是否有风险投资介入的企业，知识贡献在企业发展的早期被“高估”的概率更低，而在未来被“调低”的概率也更低？ 众所周知，研究初创企业股权分配机制的最大的挑战是数据的获取。初创企业一般不愿意分享与股权相关的内部信息。本项目将依托中国的一个著名的创新基金项目构建一个独特的包含公司、创始人和创始团队层面信息的数据库。本数据库独特之处在于收集整理每个联合创始人在获得其初始股权时的贡献的类型。我将利用中国市场监管总局提供的股权分配调整的信息进一步扩充数据库。 本研究将在以下几个方面做出贡献：第一，与研究股权分配和初创企业绩效的已有文献相比，本研究将就联合创始人之间的知识和其他形式的贡献如何影响股权分配决定提出新的见解。第二，本项目还会深入研究股权分配决策的调整以及不同形式的联合创始人的贡献的影响在这一过程如何变化。本研究有助于帮助科技初创企业创始人、专业投资者和政府相关部门做出更明智的股权分配决策和政策制定。

27500822.label: Project Title(Chinese)

27500822.label: Project Objectives
27500822.value: Build a dynamic contract design model in a queueing system, where the agent can frequently adjust his service rate (effort level), and the principal's contract depends on all the past public information. Derive an optimal contract that includes payments, termination rules, and the recommended effort process, and compare it with the first-best policy to develop managerial insights. If the optimal contract is too hard to be derived, we will find the optimal contract in restricted contract spaces (for example, the contracts when the agent always exert effort). Derive an easier-to-implement contract in which the effort process only depends on the length of the queue and evaluate the performance of these types of contracts. Solving a diffusion optimal control problem, which will provide an optimal strategy and translate the control strategy back into a control policy that applies to the original queuing system.

27500822.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27500822.value: Many business environments need long-term contracts to manage incentives over time. For example, a call center must continuously motivate its service agents to work hard to serve the customers. The call center always has an incentive to reduce waiting time. However, the call center does not have full control over the servers, and it needs to use incentive schemes to incentivize them to work. Similarly, reducing waiting time is one of the targets of a hospital. A hospital incentivizes its nurses/doctors to take care of the patients while the patients continuously arrive at the hospital over time. In this project, we will consider a service contracting setting where a principal (firm) hires an agent (server) to provide services to customers. Customers arrive at the system according to a Poisson process at an exogenous rate. The agent can dynamically adjust the service rate, which will incur a flow cost to the agent if the agent chooses a higher service rate. Customers' arrival and departure times are public information, and the service rate is unobservable by the principal. Every customer waiting in the queue incurs a flow holding cost to the principal. The principal designs a dynamic contract that includes a recommended working schedule, payments, and termination rules, which depend on all the past public information, to minimize the sum of payments and holding costs. We will formulate the contract design problem as a stochastic optimal control model and expect to derive the optimal contract. Furthermore, we will propose an easy-to-implement contract and evaluate the performance of this contract. We expect that the framework will help practitioners to examine whether the contracts used in practice (in service and healthcare settings) can direct the agent to work as the principal wanted. Furthermore, the optimal contract structure may be used as a guide to help practitioners design more efficient mechanisms. Finally, we expect that our project will stimulate follow-up research to apply our framework to more general queueing systems. 许多商业环境需要长期合同来管理员工激励。例如，电话服务中心需要不断激励其客服努力为客户服务。电话服务中心总是希望减少等待时间。但是，电话服务中心对客服没有完全的控制权，它需要使用激励方案来激励客服工作。同样地，减少等待时间也是医院的目标之一。医院激励其护士/医生照顾患者，而患者不间断地到达医院。 在这个项目中，我们考虑一个服务合同的环境：委托人（公司）聘请代理人（客服）为客户提供服务。客户根据外生速率的泊松过程到达系统。代理人可以动态调整服务费率，如果代理人选择更高的服务费率，则会给代理人带来成本。客户的到达时间和离开时间是公开信息，而代理人的服务费率是委托人无法观察到的。每个在队列中等待的客户都会给委托人带来等待成本。委托人设计了一份动态合同，其中包括推荐给代理人的服务速率、工资和合同终止规则。这些均取决于所有过去的公共信息，以最大限度地减少工资和等待成本的总和。我们将合同设计问题转化为随机最优控制模型，并计划推导出最优合同。此外，我们将同时提出一个易于实施的合同并评估该合同的绩效。 我们希望我们的框架能够帮助从业者检查在实践中使用的合同（服务和医疗保健行业）是否可以指导代理人按照委托人的意愿工作。 此外，最佳合同结构可以指导从业者设计更有效的机制。 最后，我们希望我们的项目能够激发后续研究，将我们的框架应用于更通用的排队系统。

27500822.label: Realisation of objectives
27500822.value: Our previous objective was to study a dynamic contract design model in a queueing system. However, we find it difficult to derive analytical results for this complex model. Instead, we consider a slightly simpler version: a dynamic contract design model under Poisson uncertainty, where the agent can frequently adjust his effort level, and the principal needs to dynamically schedule the agent to work or be suspended. Under this model, we derive an optimal contract that includes payments, termination rules, and the recommended effort process, and develop managerial insights. Since, in this simpler model, we can derive the optimal contracts, we do not need to solve a diffusion optimal control problem to obtain heuristic policies. As a result, we do not pay too much attention to the fourth objective.

27500822.label: Major findings and research outcome
27500822.value: In completing the first three objectives, we develop a dynamic principal–agent model where the principal can alternate between work and suspension as an incentive instrument. When the agent works and exerts effort, it increases the arrival rate of a Poisson success process that benefits the principal; suspension operates as a punishment by delaying future compensation. The paper characterizes optimal policies for scheduling work vs. suspension and shows how switching costs fundamentally change the use of suspension: rather than frequent short suspensions, the optimal contract tends to feature structured, state-dependent discipline that trades off incentive benefits against costly restarts, delivering actionable guidance on when and how to deploy suspension as a credible dynamic threat. The major findings have published in a paper in Management Science. Ping Cao, Peng Sun, and Feng Tian (2023). Punish Underperformance with Suspension: Optimal Dynamic Contracts in the Presence of Switching Cost. Management Science 70(5):3020-3037. Following the published paper, we further study a dynamic moral-hazard contracting problem in which the agent can walk away to an outside option (e.g., quit, switch employers, or take an alternative project), so the principal must jointly design incentives and retention. The core contribution is to incorporate the outside option into the promised-utility formulation of dynamic contracting, yielding an optimal contract that balances (i) paying enough to keep the agent from leaving, (ii) providing effort incentives over time, and (iii) managing the cost of informational frictions. The analysis highlights how the outside option reshapes the optimal front-loading vs. back-loading of compensation, when termination/renewal is efficient, and how changes in the outside option level or volatility translate into contract tightness and firm value. The working paper is prepared to submit to Operations Research. Zhao, Zhenwen, Feng Tian, Feifan Zhang, Shuaijie Qian. "Dynamic Contract Design under Random Outside Options."

27500822.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
27500822.value: Building on the two papers, the next step is to develop a unified framework for dynamic incentive and retention design in environments where agents have outside options (quit/switch) and the principal can use state-dependent discipline (e.g., suspension/probation) that involves restart/switching frictions. The key research opportunity is to characterize how optimal contracts jointly determine pay paths, continuation values, suspension rules, and separation to balance effort incentives, retention, and operational disruptions. Proposed course of action: (1) integrate outside-option constraints and suspension with switching costs in a continuous-time promised-utility model, deriving clear policy regions (“work/retain,” “suspend,” “separate”); (2) extend to multi-agent/team settings with rotation or replacement to study discipline versus reassignment under frictions; and (3) translate the optimal contract into implementable primitives (base pay + milestone bonus + probation/suspension rule + retention/severance clause).

27500822.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
27500822.value: This project studies a common challenge in managing people over time: how to keep someone motivated to perform when their effort is hard to observe, results arrive unpredictably, and the person can always choose to leave for another opportunity. We develop models that help organizations design better long-term incentive plans, deciding not only how to pay, but also how to respond to underperformance. A key insight is that “suspension” or temporary removal from work, widely used in practice, can be an effective incentive tool, but only if it is scheduled carefully. In many real jobs, bringing someone back after suspension is costly (disruption, retraining, rebuilding trust), so the best policy is not frequent punishment, but a structured, state-dependent approach that balances discipline with operational continuity. The research provides clear guidance on when to reward, when to pause work, and when separation is efficient, and how these choices change when outside job options improve. Overall, the project offers a rigorous foundation for designing more effective and practical performance management systems.

27502622.label: Project Title(Chinese)
27502622.value: 现金流量预测与企业投资-来自一个自然实验的证据

27502622.label: Project Objectives
27502622.value: A fundamentally important question in accounting is how accounting information affects investment. Several prior studies have examined whether accounting information constrains managers’ suboptimal investment behaviors (e.g., Hope and Thomas 2008; Francis and Martin 2010; Bushman, Piotroski, and Smith 2011). In a recent review paper, Roychowdhury, Shroff, and Verdi (2019) conclude that “the literature has provided reasonably consistent evidence of a negative relation between reporting quality and over-investment.” They further suggest that “opportunities exist to distinguish between specific aspects and types of reporting and disclosure choices. For example, are forward-looking versus backward-looking disclosures more relevant for constraining moral hazard?” The primary objective of this research is to contribute to this literature by examining whether corporate investment is affected by cash flow forecasts. We focus on cash flow forecasts because the trend towards using fair values in financial reporting increasingly requires managers to estimate future cash flows.

27502622.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
27502622.value: A fundamentally important question in accounting is how accounting information affects investment. Several prior studies have examined whether accounting information constrains managers’ suboptimal investment behaviors (e.g., Hope and Thomas 2008; Francis and Martin 2010; Bushman, Piotroski, and Smith 2011). In a recent review paper, Roychowdhury, Shroff, and Verdi (2019) conclude that “the literature has provided reasonably consistent evidence of a negative relation between reporting quality and over-investment.” They further suggest that “opportunities exist to distinguish between specific aspects and types of reporting and disclosure choices. For example, are forward-looking versus backward-looking disclosures more relevant for constraining moral hazard?” The primary objective of this research is to contribute to this literature by examining whether corporate investment is affected by cash flow forecasts. We focus on cash flow forecasts because the trend towards using fair values in financial reporting increasingly requires managers to estimate future cash flows. We will exploit a natural experiment of a disclosure regulatory change that offers plausibly exogenous variation in cash flow forecasts. A Canadian security issuer that produces minerals and metals had been required to provide cash flow forecasts in its technical reports as mandated by the National Instrument 43-101 Standards of Disclosure of Mineral Projects. We consider an amendment to this regulation that exempted certain firms from providing these forecasts. This setting is powerful for addressing the research question because it enables us to examine the change in corporate investment between firms that were exempted from the disclosure requirement and those that remained required to provide this disclosure in a difference-in-differences framework. We argue that these cash flow forecasts are useful for monitoring investment because they are timely, relevant for determining project value, and appear to be accurate ex post. If the disclosure exemption leads to worse monitoring, then we would expect exempted firms to engage in more suboptimal investment after the amendment compared with firms that were not exempted. We consider both fixed assets investment and acquisition quality. We will also examine change in long-term performance, a consequence of investment quality. 会计信息如何影响企业投资是一个根本性的问题。以前的研究发现会计信息制约了经理的次优投资行为。Roychowdhury等人（2019）在他们最近的一篇综述文献中总结道先前研究对报告质量和过度投资之间的负相关关系有较为一致的发现。他们进一步提出区分具体种类的报告或披露选择是潜在的研究机会。比如，就信息披露而言，是对未来的展望还是对历史的回顾对于制约道德困境更为相关呢？本研究的主要目标是研究现金流量预测是如何影响企业投资的。我们关注现金流量预测，是由于在财务报告中公允价值的使用越来越多的要求管理层预测未来的现金流量。我们采用一个信息披露法规的变化，该变化可能能提供对于现金流量预测的外生性冲击。加拿大的在矿业行业运营的证券发行方历史上被要求披露技术报告。我们考虑对于该信息披露要求的一个修订，该修正豁免了某些公司的预测。这个设定能有力解答我们的研究问题，因为我们可以在一个双重差分模型的框架中比较被豁免公司和仍披露预测公司之间企业投资的变化差异。我们提出这些现金流量预测有助于监督企业投资，因为它们是及时的，对于决定项目价值是相关的，并且事后来看似乎是准确的。如果豁免披露导致更差的监督，那么我们推测被豁免的公司与未被豁免公司相比在披露规则修订后投资效率会变得相对更低。我们考虑固定资产投资和兼并收购的质量。我们还会检验公司业绩表现的变化。

27502622.label: Realisation of objectives
27502622.value: The project objectives have been substantially achieved. The original application proposed to examine whether corporate investment is affected by cash flow forecasts by exploiting a 2011 amendment to Canada’s National Instrument 43-101, which exempted certain producing issuers from providing forecast disclosures in technical reports. The project has successfully completed data collection, identification design refinement, empirical analysis, and manuscript development, and has produced a completed paper titled “Management Forecasts and Investment Efficiency: Evidence from a Natural Experiment,” which was accepted by Accounting Horizons in November 2025 and released in Early Access in January 2026. In terms of research execution, the project fulfilled the planned data work by hand-collecting forecast-related information from NI 43-101 technical reports and merging these data with archival databases to construct the empirical sample. The completed study uses a sample of 266 firm-year observations from 136 firms around the regulatory thresholds and shows that the amendment reduced the likelihood of providing forecasts. This confirms that the regulatory change generated meaningful variation in disclosure, as required for identifying the research question. The main objective has also been achieved at the empirical level. The completed paper shows that exempting firms from the forecast requirement increased investment-q sensitivity, indicating that the original forecast requirement impaired investment efficiency. This result is statistically significant, economically meaningful, and supported by a range of additional tests. Accordingly, the project provides direct evidence that mandatory management forecasts or forward-looking disclosures can materially affect corporate investment outcomes. The project additionally achieved an important mechanism-related objective that emerged during the course of the research. In the mid-term review, the RGC noted that the project’s underlying logic involved learning from stock prices and suggested that the first step should be to test how the exemption affects price efficiency. In response to this comment and the reviewers’ comments during the R&R process at the Accounting Horizon, the completed paper presents evidence consistent with several channels: enhanced managerial learning from stock prices, reduced short-termism, and lower competitive pressure following disclosure exemption. Specifically, the study finds evidence of more informed trading, stronger effects among firms with greater analyst following, and stronger effects in more competitive product-market environments. These additional analyses helped address the reviewer’s concern and materially strengthened the project. The project did not proceed exactly as originally planned in every respect, but these deviations were necessary and ultimately improved the study. First, after a close examination of the institutional setting, it became clear that the relevant technical reports include multiple forms of forward-looking information rather than cash flow forecasts only. This meant that isolating the effect of cash flow forecasts alone would be difficult and potentially misleading. The study therefore broadened its focus to management forward-looking disclosures, which remains faithful to the spirit of the original objective. Second, the initial plan proposed a difference-in-differences design, but the final study adopts a difference-in-discontinuities design. This change was made because firms do not necessarily file technical reports every year, leaving limited within-firm variation around the amendment year, and because another rule also changes at the same revenue thresholds. The final design better fits the institutional setting and improves identification. As for research outputs, the project has progressed beyond the working-paper stage anticipated in the mid-term report. The paper was first developed as “Real Effects of Mandatory Forward-Looking Disclosures: Evidence from a Natural Experiment,” and the completed paper has since been accepted for publication in Accounting Horizons. This indicates that the project has generated a publishable and externally validated research output directly arising from the grant. The paper also acknowledges RGC support under Project No. 27502622. Overall, the objective may be regarded as fully achieved. The project successfully answers the core question of whether mandated forecast-related disclosures affect corporate investment, though the answer is developed through the more precise lens of investment efficiency rather than through all originally proposed outcome measures such as acquisition quality and long-term accounting performance. This partial reallocation of emphasis reflects the realities of the institutional setting, the need for credible identification, and feedback from the progress review. These challenges were addressed through careful redesign of the empirical strategy, additional mechanism tests, and refinement of the paper’s framing.
